translation_verse: Na Sem ne Yafet faa ntoma de guu wɔn mmatiri so nam nkyirinkyire de kɔkataa wɔn agya adagya so, na wɔdanee wɔn ani kyerɛɛ akyire, na wɔanhunu wɔn agya adagya mu.

english_verse: When Noah sobered up and learned what his youngest son had done,
translation_verse: Na Noa ani so tete firii ne nsaborɔ mu na ɔtee deɛ ne ba kumaa no ayɛ no no,

english_verse: he said, “I now put a curse on Canaan! He will be the lowest slave of his brothers.
translation_verse: ɔkaa sɛ: Wɔadome Kanaan, ɔbɛyɛ nkoa mu akoa ama ne nuanom.

english_verse: I ask the Lord my God to bless Shem and make Canaan his slave.
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa nso sɛ: Nhyira ne Sem Nyankopɔn, AWURADE, na Kanaan nyɛ wɔn akoa.

english_verse: I pray God will give Japheth more and more land and let him take over the territory of Shem. May Canaan be his slave.”
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn mma Yafet ase ntrɛ, na ɔntena Sem ntomadan mu, na Kanaan nyɛ wɔn akoa.

english_verse: and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Noa nna a ɔdiiɛ nyinaa yɛ mfeɛ ahankron aduonum, na ɔwui.

english_verse: After the flood Shem, Ham, and Japheth had many descendants. The Descendants of Japheth
translation_verse: Na yeinom ne Noa mma Sem, Ham ne Yafet awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ. Na nsuyire no akyi, wɔwoo mma.

english_verse: This completes the list of Noah's descendants. After the flood their descendants became nations and spread all over the world.
translation_verse: Yeinom ne Noa mma mmusua, sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ teɛ wɔ wɔn amanaman mu. Na ɛfiri yeinom mu na nsuyire no akyi amanaman petee asase soɔ.

english_verse: but after some of them moved from the east and settled in Babylonia,
translation_verse: Na wɔtuu kwan faa apueeɛ no, wɔhunuu asasetam bi wɔ Sinear asase so, na wɔtenaa hɔ.

english_verse: they said: Let's build a city with a tower that reaches to the sky! We'll use hard bricks and tar instead of stone and mortar. We'll become famous, and we won't be scattered all over the world.
translation_verse: Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: Wiɛ, momma yɛnkyekyere kuro, na yɛnto abantenten a n’atifi bɛduru soro, na yɛmfa nnye din, na yɛanhwete asase nyinaa ani.

english_verse: But when the Lord came down to look at the city and the tower,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE siane bɛhwɛɛ kuro ne abantenten a nnipa mma retoɔ no.

english_verse: he said: These people are working together because they all speak the same language. This is just the beginning. Soon they will be able to do anything they want.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman baako, na wɔn nyinaa ka kasa korɔ; na deɛ wɔafiri aseɛ reyɛ nie; na afei, biribiara rentumi nsi wɔn deɛ wɔsusu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ no biara ho kwan.

english_verse: Let's go down and confuse them! We'll make them speak different languages, and they won't be able to understand each other.
translation_verse: Wiɛ, momma yɛnsiane nkɔ hɔ na yɛnkɔyɛ wɔn kasa basabasa, na wɔn mu biara ante ne yɔnko kasa bio.

english_verse: So the people had to stop building the city, because the Lord confused their language and scattered them all over the earth. That's how the city of Babel got its name. The Descendants of Shem
translation_verse: Enti na wɔfrɛ hɔ Babel, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na AWURADE yɛɛ asase nyinaa kasa basabasa. Ɛfiri hɔ na AWURADE bɔɔ wɔn hwetee asase nyinaa ani. Sem awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ (

translation_verse: Na Sem woo Arfaksad no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanum na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.

translation_verse: Na ɔwoo Sela no akyi no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanan ne mmiɛnsa, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.

english_verse: Shelah had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Sela woo Eber no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanan ne mmiɛnsa na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.

english_verse: Eber had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na ɔwoo Peleg no akyi no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanan aduasa na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.

english_verse: Peleg had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Peleg woo Reu no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanu ne nkron na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.

english_verse: Reu had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Reu woo Serug no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanu ne nson, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.

english_verse: Serug had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Serug woo Nahor no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanu na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.

english_verse: Nahor had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Nahor woo Tera no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ɔha ne dunkron na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.

english_verse: Terah decided to move from Ur to the land of Canaan. He took along Abram and Sarai and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran. But when they came to the city of Haran, they settled there instead.
translation_verse: Na Tera faa ne ba Abram ne ne nana Lot, a ɔyɛ Haran ba, ne n’ase Sarai, ne ba Abram yere, na ɔne wɔn firii Ur a ɛwɔ Kaldea sɛ wɔrekɔ Kanaan asase so. Na wɔduruu Haran no, wɔtenaa hɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram: Leave your country, your family, and your relatives and go to the land that I will show you.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Wo deɛ, firi w’asase so ne w’abusua mu ne w’agya fie kɔ asase a mɛkyerɛ woɔ no so.

english_verse: I will bless you and make your descendants into a great nation. You will become famous and be a blessing to others.
translation_verse: Na mɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛseɛ, na mahyira wo, na mama wo din ayɛ kɛseɛ, na woayɛ nhyira.

english_verse: I will bless those who bless you, but I will put a curse on anyone who puts a curse on you. Everyone on earth will be blessed because of you.
translation_verse: Na mɛhyira wɔn a wɔhyira woɔ, na wɔn a wɔdome woɔ no, mɛdome wɔn; na wo mu na wɔbɛhyira asase so mmusua nyinaa.

english_verse: Abram went as far as the sacred tree of Moreh in a place called Shechem. The Canaanites were still living in the land at that time,
translation_verse: Na Abram twaa mu asase no so kɔduruu baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Sekem wɔ More pɔ no ho. Nso berɛ no mu na Kanaanfoɔ wɔ asase no so.

english_verse: but the Lord appeared to Abram and promised, “I will give this land to your family forever.” Abram then built an altar there for the Lord.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Abram kaa sɛ: W’asefoɔ na mede asase yi bɛma wɔn. Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ maa AWURADE a ɔyii ne ho kyerɛɛ no no.

english_verse: Abram traveled to the hill country east of Bethel and camped between Bethel and Ai, where he built another altar and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔtu firii hɔ kɔɔ Betel apueeɛ bepɔ bi so. Na ɔsii ne ntomadan a Betel da n’atɔeɛ, na Ai da apueeɛ; na ɔsii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ, na ɔsɔree AWURADE.

english_verse: Later, Abram started out toward the Southern Desert. Abram in Egypt
translation_verse: Na Abram dii atutena ara kɔɔ Negeb. Abram kɔ Misraim

english_verse: The crops failed, and there was no food anywhere in Canaan. So Abram and his wife Sarai went to live in Egypt for a while. But just before they got there, Abram said, “Sarai, you are really beautiful!
translation_verse: Na ɔreyɛ aduru Misraim asase soɔ no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne yere Sarai sɛ: Hwɛ, menim sɛ woyɛ ɔbaa a wo ho yɛ fɛ,

english_verse: When the Egyptians see you, they will murder me because I am your husband. But they won't kill you.
translation_verse: na sɛ Misraimfoɔ hu wo a, wɔbɛka sɛ: Ne yere nie, na wɔaku me, na wɔama woatena ase.

english_verse: Please save my life by saying you are my sister.”
translation_verse: Enti ka sɛ, me nua ne wo, na wo nti wɔayɛ me yie, na matena ase.

english_verse: As soon as Abram and Sarai arrived in Egypt, the Egyptians noticed how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: Na Abram duruu Misraim no, Misraimfoɔ hunuu ne yere no sɛ ne ho yɛ fɛ sɛ.

english_verse: The king's officials told him about her, and she was taken to his house.
translation_verse: Na Farao atitire hunuu no, na wɔkɔkamfoo no kyerɛɛ Farao, na wɔbɛfaa ɔbaa no kɔɔ Farao fie.

english_verse: The king was good to Abram because of Sarai, and Abram was given sheep, cattle, donkeys, slaves, and camels.
translation_verse: Na ne nti ɔyɛɛ Abram yie; na ɔnyaa nnwan, anantwie, mfunumu, nkoa, mfenaa, mfunumubereɛ ne yoma.

english_verse: Because of Sarai, the Lord struck the king and everyone in his palace with terrible diseases.
translation_verse: Na Abram yere Sarai ho asɛm no nti AWURADE de ɔhaw akɛseɛ haa Farao ne ne fie.

english_verse: Finally, the king sent for Abram and said to him, “What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me Sarai was your wife?
translation_verse: Na Farao frɛɛ Abram kaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ me yi? Adɛn nti na woanka ankyerɛ me sɛ ɔyɛ wo yerɛ?

english_verse: Why did you make me believe she was your sister? Now I've married her. Take her and go! She's your wife.”
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na wose: Ɔyɛ me nua? Anka meremfa no nware no; na afei, hwɛ wo yere nie, fa no na kɔ wo kwan.

english_verse: So the king told his men to let Abram and Sarai take their possessions and leave.
translation_verse: Na Farao tuu nnipa maa no sɛ wɔnkɔgya no ne ne yere ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa kwan.

english_verse: Abram and Sarai took everything they owned and went to the Southern Desert. Lot went with them.
translation_verse: Na Abram ne ne yere ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, ne Lot nso, firii Misraim baa Negeb.

english_verse: Abram was very rich. He owned many cattle, sheep, and goats, and had a lot of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Na Abram anya ne ho sɛ, mmoa, dwetɛ ne sika mu.

english_verse: Abram moved from place to place in the Southern Desert. And finally, he went north and set up his tents between Bethel and Ai,
translation_verse: Na ɔdii atutena firi Negeb kɔduruu Betel, deɛ akane na ne ntomadan sie no, wɔ Betel ne Ai ntam,

english_verse: where he had earlier camped and built an altar. There he worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: deɛ afɔrebukyia a ɔsii kane no wɔ. Na Abram sɔree AWURADE wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Lot, who was traveling with him, also had sheep, goats, and cattle, as well as his own family and slaves.
translation_verse: Na Lot nso a ɔne Abram nam no wɔ nnwan ne anantwie ne ntomadan.

english_verse: Abram said to Lot, “We are close relatives. We shouldn't argue, and our men shouldn't be fighting one another.
translation_verse: Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Lot sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, mma akasakasa mmma me ne wo ntam, ne me mmoahwɛfoɔ ne wo mmoahwɛfoɔ ntam, na yɛyɛ anuanom.

english_verse: There is plenty of land for you to choose from. Let's separate. If you go north, I'll go south; if you go south, I'll go north.”
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ asase no nyinaa na ɛda w’anim yi? Mesrɛ wo, twe wo ho firi me ho, sɛ wofa benkum a, mɛfa nifa, na sɛ wofa nifa a, mɛfa benkum.

english_verse: This happened before the Lord had destroyed the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. And when Lot looked around, he saw there was plenty of water in the Jordan Valley. All the way to Zoar the valley was as green as the garden of the Lord or the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Na Lot maa n’ani so hwɛɛ Yordan kanko nyinaa de kɔsi Soar hunuu sɛ ne nyinaa so wɔ nsuo te sɛ AWURADE turo no, te sɛ Misraim, ansa na AWURADE resɛe Sodom ne Gomora no.

english_verse: So Lot chose the whole Jordan Valley for himself, and as he started out toward the east, he and Abram separated.
translation_verse: Na Lot yii Yordan kanko no nyinaa, na ɔtu faa apueeɛ fam; na anuanom no dii mpaapaemu.

english_verse: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan. But Lot settled near the cities of the valley and put up his tents not far from Sodom,
translation_verse: Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so, na Lot deɛ, ɔtenaa Yordan kanko no nkuro mu, na ɔtutuu ne ntomadan ara de kɔduruu Sodom.

english_verse: where the people were evil and sinned terribly against the Lord. Abram Moves to Hebron
translation_verse: Nso na Sodomfoɔ yɛ atirimuɔdenfoɔ ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ kɛse, AWURADE anim. Abram kɔtena Hebron

english_verse: After Abram and Lot had gone their separate ways, the Lord said to Abram: Look around to the north, south, east, and west.
translation_verse: Na Lot tee ne ho firii Abram ho no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Ma w’ani so, na firi deɛ wowɔ hɔ hwɛ atifi fam ne anafoɔ fam, apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ.

english_verse: I will give you and your family all the land you can see. It will be theirs forever!
translation_verse: Na asase a wohunu yi nyinaa, wo ne w’asefoɔ na mede bɛma mo daa.

english_verse: I will give you more descendants than there are specks of dust on the earth, and someday it will be easier to count those specks of dust than to count your descendants.
translation_verse: Na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛ asase so mfuturo. Na sɛ obi tumi kan asase so mfuturo a, ɛnneɛ na ɔbɛtumi akan w’asefoɔ nso.

english_verse: Now walk back and forth across the land, because I am going to give it to you.
translation_verse: Sɔre, fa asase no tentene ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ mu, na wo na mede bɛma woɔ.

english_verse: Abram took down his tents and went to live near the sacred trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Abram tutuu ne ntomadan, na ɔbɛtenaa Mamre pɔ a ɛwɔ Hebron no ho, na ɔsii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: About this time, King Amraphel of Babylonia, King Arioch of Ellasar, King Chedorlaomer of Elam, and King Tidal of Goiim
translation_verse: Na Sinear hene Amrafel, Elasar hene Ariok, Elam hene Kedorlaomer ne Goiim hene Tideal berɛ so no,

english_verse: attacked King Bera of Sodom, King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, a city also known as Zoar.
translation_verse: wɔne Sodom hene Bera ne Gomora hene Birsa, Adma hene Sinab ne Seboim hene Semeber ne Bela hene dii ako.

english_verse: A year later King Chedorlaomer and his allies attacked and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, and the Emites in Shaveh-Kiriathaim.
translation_verse: Na afe a ɛtɔ so dunan mu no, Kedorlaomer ne ahemfo a wɔkeka ne ho no bɛkum Refaim wɔ Asterot-karnaim, ne Susifoɔ wɔ Ham, ne Emifoɔ Kiriataim mpaperɛ so,

english_verse: They also defeated the Horites in the hill country of Edom, as far as El-Paran, near the desert.
translation_verse: ne Horifoɔ wɔ wɔn bepɔ Seir so de kɔsii El-paran a ɛwɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no.

english_verse: They went back to the city of Enmishpat, better known as Kadesh. Then they captured all the land that belonged to the Amalekites, and they defeated the Amorites who were living in Hazazon-Tamar.
translation_verse: Na wɔsane baa Enmispat, , na wɔkaa Amalekfoɔ asase nyinaa ne Amorifoɔ nso a wɔte Haseson-tamar no gui.

english_verse: At Siddim Valley, the armies of the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela fought the armies of King Chedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar. The valley
translation_verse: Na wɔne Elam hene Kedorlaomer, Goiim hene Tideal, Sinear hene Amrafel ne Elasar hene Ariok de bɛbɔɔ ani wɔ Sidim bonhwa mu, ahemfo baanan a wɔreko atia baanum.

english_verse: was full of tar pits, and when the troops from Sodom and Gomorrah started running away, some of them fell into the pits. Others escaped to the hill country.
translation_verse: Na Sidim bonhwa mu yɛ ama amena ara nko. Na Sodom ne Gomora ahemfo dwanee. Na ebinom totɔɔ amena no mu, na wɔn a aka no dwane kɔɔ bepɔ so.

english_verse: Their enemies took everything of value from Sodom and Gomorrah, including their food supplies.
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa Sodom ne Gomora nnoɔma ne wɔn nnuane nyinaa de sii mu kɔe.

english_verse: They also captured Abram's nephew Lot, who lived in Sodom. They took him and his possessions and then left.
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa Abram nua ba Lot a ɔte Sodom ne n’ahodeɛ kɔe.

english_verse: At this time Abram the Hebrew was living near the oaks that belonged to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner were Abram's friends. Someone who had escaped from the battle told Abram
translation_verse: Na odwanefoɔ bi bɛka kyerɛɛ Hebrini Abram a ɔte Amorini Mamre, Eskol ne Aner nua no pɔ mu; na wɔne Abram wɔ apam. Abram gye Lot

english_verse: that his nephew Lot had been taken away. Three hundred and eighteen of Abram's servants were fighting men, so he took them and followed the enemy as far north as the city of Dan.
translation_verse: Na Abram tee sɛ wɔafa ne nua ba dommum no, ɔde ne mmarima a wɔawo wɔn wɔ ne fie ahasa ne dunwɔtwe tuu ɔsa tii wɔn kɔduruu Dan.

english_verse: That night, Abram divided up his troops, attacked from all sides, and won a great victory. But some of the enemy escaped to the town of Hobah north of Damascus,
translation_verse: Na ɔne ne nkoa kyɛɛ wɔn ho mu baa wɔn so anadwo, na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn, na wɔtaa wɔn kɔduruu Hoba a ɛda Damasko benkum no.

english_verse: and Abram went after them. He brought back his nephew Lot, together with Lot's possessions and the women and everyone else who had been captured. Abram Is Blessed by Melchizedek
translation_verse: Na ɔde nnoɔma no nyinaa ne ne nua ba Lot ne ne nnoɔma ne mmaa no nso ne nkurɔfoɔ no sane bae. Melkisedek hyira Abram

english_verse: Abram returned after he had defeated King Chedorlaomer and the other kings. Then the king of Sodom went to meet Abram in Shaveh Valley, which is also known as King's Valley.
translation_verse: Na ɔsane firii Kedorlaomer ne ahemfo a ɛkeka ne ho so nkonimdie reba no, Sodom hene firi kɔhyiaa no wɔ Sawe bonhwa mu.

english_verse: King Melchizedek of Salem was a priest of God Most High. He brought out some bread and wine
translation_verse: Na Salem hene Melkisedek de paanoo ne bobesa brɛɛ no; na ɔyɛ ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn sɔfoɔ.

english_verse: and said to Abram: “I bless you in the name of God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Na ɔhyiraa no sɛ: Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔsoro ne asase wura no nhyira nka Abram.

english_verse: All praise belongs to God Most High for helping you defeat your enemies.” Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
translation_verse: Na nhyira ne ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔde w’atamfo ahyɛ wo nsa. Na Abram maa no nnoɔma no nyinaa mu ntotosoɔ du du.

english_verse: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “All I want are my people. You can keep everything else.”
translation_verse: Na Sodom hene ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Fa nnipa no ma me, na fa ahodeɛ no.

english_verse: Abram answered: The Lord God Most High made the heavens and the earth. And I have promised him
translation_verse: Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Sodom hene no sɛ: Mema me nsa so mekyerɛ AWURADE, ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔsoro ne asase wura no,

english_verse: that I won't keep anything of yours, not even a sandal strap or a piece of thread. Then you can never say that you are the one who made me rich.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛfiri asaawa so de kɔsi mpaboa homa soɔ, meremfa biribiara a ɛyɛ wo deɛ, na woanka sɛ: Me na mama Abram anya ne ho;

english_verse: Let my share be the food that my men have eaten. But Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre went with me, so give them their share of what we brought back.
translation_verse: gye deɛ mmeranteɛ no adie no nko, ne mmarima a wɔne me kɔeɛ no, Aner, Eskol ne Mamre nya wɔn kyɛfa.

english_verse: Later the Lord spoke to Abram in a vision, “Abram, don't be afraid! I will protect you and reward you greatly.”
translation_verse: Nsɛm yi akyiri no, AWURADE asɛm baa Abram nkyɛn anisoadehunu mu sɛ: Nsuro, Abram, mene wo kyɛm, na w’akatua bɛdɔɔso pii.

english_verse: But Abram answered, “Lord All-Powerful, you have given me everything I could ask for, except children. And when I die, Eliezer of Damascus will get all I own.
translation_verse: Na Abram bisaa sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, ɛdeɛn na wode bɛma me? Menni ba na menam, na deɛ ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ ne Damaskoni Eliesa anaa?

english_verse: You have not given me any children, and this servant of mine will inherit everything.”
translation_verse: Na Abram kaa sɛ: Ao, me deɛ, woamma me asefoɔ, na hwɛ, me fienipa na ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “No, he won't! You will have a son of your own, and everything you have will be his.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi na ɔbɛdi w’adeɛ, na deɛ ɔbɛfiri wo ara w’asene mu na ɔbɛdi w’adeɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord took Abram outside and said, “Look at the sky and see if you can count the stars. That's how many descendants you will have.”
translation_verse: Na ɔde no firii adi kaa sɛ: Hwɛ ɔsoro ɛ, na kan nsoromma sɛ wobɛtumi akan anaa? Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ w’asefoɔ bɛyɛ ne no.

english_verse: Abram believed the Lord, so the Lord was pleased with him and accepted him. The Lord Makes Another Promise to Abram
translation_verse: Na Abram gyee AWURADE diiɛ, na ɔbuu yei sɛ tenenee maa no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram, “I brought you here from Ur in Chaldea, and I gave you this land.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mene AWURADE a ɔde wo firii Ur a ɛwɔ Kaldea no, sɛ mede asase yi bɛma wo sɛ agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: Abram asked, “Lord God, how can I know the land will be mine?”
translation_verse: Na ɔbisaa sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, ɛdeɛn na mede bɛhunu sɛ mɛnya?

english_verse: Then the Lord told him, “Bring me a three-year-old cow, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a dove, and a young pigeon.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa nantwie ba a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, abirekyie a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, odwennini a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, anyankuku ne aborɔnoma ba brɛ me.

english_verse: Abram obeyed the Lord. Then he cut the animals in half and laid the two halves of each animal opposite each other on the ground. But he did not cut the doves and pigeons in half.
translation_verse: Na ɔde yei nyinaa brɛɛ no, na ɔpaepaee wɔn mu mmienu mmienu, na ɔde afaafa no kyerɛkyerɛɛ anim totoo hɔ; na nnomaa no deɛ, wampaapae wɔn mu.

english_verse: And when birds came down to eat the animals, Abram chased them away.
translation_verse: Na nnomaa a wɔdi nam bɛsisii mmoa afunu no so, na Abram pamm wɔn.

english_verse: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and everything became dark and frightening.
translation_verse: Na owia reyɛ akɔtɔ no, Abram daa nnahɔɔ, na hwɛ, ehu sum kabii duruu no.

english_verse: Four generations later, your descendants will return here and take this land, because only then will the people who live here be so sinful that they deserve to be punished.
translation_verse: Na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nnan mu na wɔbɛsane aba ha, ɛfiri sɛ Amorifoɔ amumuyɛ nnya nnurui.

english_verse: Sometime after sunset, when it was very dark, a smoking cooking pot and a flaming fire passed between the two halves of each animal.
translation_verse: Na owia tɔeɛ na esum kusuu duruiɛ no, hwɛ, biribi a ɛte sɛ gyaframa a ɛrefiri wisie ne tɛnee a ɛredɛre bɛfaa afaafa no ntam.

english_verse: At that time the Lord made an agreement with Abram and told him: I will give your descendants the land east of the Shihor River on the border of Egypt as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Da no ara na AWURADE ne Abram yɛɛ apam sɛ: W’asefoɔ na mede asase yi mama wɔn ɛfiri Misraim asubɔnten ho de kɔsi asubɔnten kɛseɛ, Eufrate asubɔnten ho:

english_verse: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaites,
translation_verse: Hetifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Refaimfoɔ,

english_verse: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Girgasifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ.

english_verse: Abram's wife Sarai had not been able to have any children. But she owned a young Egyptian slave woman named Hagar,
translation_verse: Na Abram yere Sarai nwo mma no. Na ɔwɔ afenaa bi a ɔyɛ Misraimni a ne din de Hagar.

english_verse: and Sarai said to Abram, “The Lord has not given me any children. Sleep with my slave, and if she has a child, it will be mine.” Abram agreed,
translation_verse: Na Sarai ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Hwɛ, AWURADE asi m’awoɔ ho kwan, enti kɔ m’afenaa nkyɛn, ebia mɛnya ne ho mma. Na Abram tiee Sarai.

english_verse: and Sarai gave him Hagar to be his wife. This happened after Abram had lived in the land of Canaan for ten years.
translation_verse: Na Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so mfirinhyia du no, ne yere Sarai faa n’afenaa Hagar a ɔyɛ Misraimni no de no maa ne kunu awareɛ.

english_verse: Later, when Hagar knew she was going to have a baby, she became proud and treated Sarai hatefully.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔɔ Hagar ho, na ɔnyinsɛnee. Na ɔhunuu sɛ wanyinsɛn no, ɔbuu n’awuraa animtia.

english_verse: Then Sarai said to Abram, “It's all your fault! I gave you my slave woman, but she has been hateful to me ever since she found out she was pregnant. You have done me wrong, and you will have to answer to the Lord for this.”
translation_verse: Na Sarai ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Asɛmmɔne a wadi me da wo so. Me na mede m’afenaa mato wo kokom, na ɔhunuu sɛ wanyinsɛn nti, ɔbu me animtia. AWURADE mmu me ne wo ntam atɛn.

english_verse: Abram said, “All right! She's your slave—do whatever you want with her.” Then Sarai began treating Hagar so harshly that she finally ran away.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Abram ka kyerɛɛ Sarai sɛ: Hwɛ, w’afenaa wɔ wo nsam, yɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ w’ani soɔ. Na Sarai tanee n’ani maa no dwane firii ne nkyɛn.

english_verse: Hagar stopped to rest at a spring in the desert on the road to Shur. While she was there, the angel of the Lord came to her
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ hunuu no nsuo aniwa bi ho wɔ ɛserɛ so wɔ Sur kwan so nsuo aniwa no ho.

english_verse: and asked, “Hagar, where have you come from, and where are you going?” She answered, “I'm running away from Sarai, my owner.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Hagar, Sarai afenaa, wofiri he na woreba, na worekɔ he ni? Na ɔse: Mefiri m’awuraa Sarai anim na meredwane.

english_verse: The angel said, “Go back to Sarai and be her slave.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sane kɔ w’awuraa nkyɛn, na kɔbrɛ wo ho ase ma no.

english_verse: I will give you a son, who will be called Ishmael, because I have heard your cry for help. And someday I will give you so many descendants that no one will be able to count them all.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, woanyinsɛn, na wobɛwo ɔba, na wobɛto ne din Ismael, sɛ AWURADE ate w’amanehunu.

english_verse: But your son will live far from his relatives; he will be like a wild donkey, fighting everyone, and everyone fighting him.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbɛyɛ onipa a ɔte sɛ ɛserɛ so afunumu. Ne nsa bɛtia nnipa nyinaa, na nnipa nyinaa nsa atia no, na ɔbɛsɔre atia ne nuanom nyinaa.

english_verse: Hagar thought, “Have I really seen God and lived to tell about it?” So from then on she called him, “The God Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Na ɔfrɛɛ AWURADE a ɔne no kasaeɛ no din sɛ: Wone El-roi, na ɔse: Mahunu deɛ ɔhu me no ampa anaa?

english_verse: That's why people call the well between Kadesh and Bered, “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Enti wɔfrɛ asubura no sɛ: Beer-lahai-roi, na hwɛ, ɛwɔ Kades ne Bared ntam.

english_verse: I will keep my solemn promise to you and give you more descendants than can be counted.”
translation_verse: Na mɛma m’apam ada me ne wo ntam, na mama woadɔ kɛse ara.

english_verse: Abram bowed with his face to the ground, and God said:
translation_verse: Na Abram daa hɔ de n’anim butuu fam; na Onyankopɔn ne no kasaa sɛ:

english_verse: I promise that you will be the father of many nations. So now I'm changing your name from Abram to Abraham.
translation_verse: Na wɔremfrɛ wo din Abram bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Abraham, ɛfiri sɛ mayɛ wo aman pii agya.

english_verse: I will give you a lot of descendants, and they will become great nations. Some of them will even be kings.
translation_verse: Na mɛma woadɔ pii pa ara, na mɛyɛ wo aman, na ahemfo afiri wo mu.

english_verse: I will always keep the promise I have made to you and your descendants, because I am your God and their God.
translation_verse: Na mɛma me ne wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no apam agyina wɔ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu, na ayɛ daa apam, na mayɛ wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I will give you and them the land in which you are now a foreigner. I will give the whole land of Canaan to your family forever, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Na mede asase a woyɛ so hɔhoɔ yi, Kanaan asase nyinaa, bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire, sɛ daa agyapadeɛ, na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Abraham, you and all future members of your family must promise to obey me.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo deɛ, di m’apam so, wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyi wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu.

english_verse: As the sign that you are keeping this promise, you must circumcise every man and boy in your family.
translation_verse: Na montwitwa mo ho twetia, na ayɛ me ne mo ntam apam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ.

english_verse: Any man who isn't circumcised hasn't kept his part of the promise and cannot be one of my people.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima momonoto biara a wɔntwaa no twetia no, saa onipa no wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu, ɛfiri sɛ wato m’apam.

english_verse: Abraham, from now on your wife's name will be Sarah instead of Sarai.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo yere Sarai deɛ, mfrɛ no Sarai bio, na mmom Sara.

english_verse: I will bless her, and you will have a son by her. She will become the mother of nations, and some of her descendants will even be kings.
translation_verse: Na mɛhyira no, na mama wo ne mu ɔba nso, ampa ara, mɛhyira no. Ɔbɛyɛ aman, na aman ahemfo bɛfiri ne mu.

english_verse: Then he asked God, “Why not let Ishmael inherit what you have promised me?”
translation_verse: Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: O, ɛnneɛ anka ma Ismael nya w’anim adom ɛ!

english_verse: But God answered: No! You and Sarah will have a son. His name will be Isaac, and I will make an everlasting promise to him and his descendants.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ: Ampaneampa, wo yere Sara bɛwo ɔba ama wo, na woato ne din Isak. Na mɛma me ne no apam no agyina ayɛ daa apam ama n’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi n’akyire no.

english_verse: However, I have heard what you asked me to do for Ishmael, and so I will also bless him with many descendants. He will be the father of twelve princes, and I will make his family a great nation.
translation_verse: Na Ismael ho deɛ, matie wo. Hwɛ, mɛhyira no, na mama no awo, na wadɔɔso pii pa ara. Atitire dummienu na ɔbɛwoɔ, na mayɛ no ɔman kɛseɛ.

english_verse: But your son Isaac will be born about this time next year, and the promise I am making to you and your family will be for him and his descendants forever.
translation_verse: Na m’apam deɛ, me ne Isak a Sara bɛwo no ama wo afeda sɛsɛɛ no na ɛbɛpam ama no agyina.

english_verse: God finished speaking to Abraham and then left.
translation_verse: Na ɔne no wiee kasa no, Onyankopɔn firii Abraham nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: On that same day Abraham obeyed God by circumcising Ishmael. Abraham was also circumcised, and so were all the other men and boys in his household, including his servants and slaves. He was
translation_verse: Na ne fie mmarima nyinaa, wɔn a wɔwoo wɔn ne fie ne wɔn a wɔde sika totɔɔ wɔn wɔ ahɔhoɔ nkyɛn, wɔtwitwaa wɔn twetia kaa ne ho.

english_verse: One hot summer afternoon while Abraham was sitting by the entrance to his tent near the sacred trees of Mamre, the Lord appeared to him.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Abraham wɔ Mamre pɔ mu, na ɔte ne ntomadan pono ano awia ketee.

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. He quickly ran to meet them, bowed with his face to the ground,
translation_verse: Na ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛe, na hwɛ, mmarima baasa abɛgyina ne ntentensoɔ. Na ɔhunuu wɔn no, ɔfirii ne ntomadan pono ano tuu mmirika kɔhyiaa wɔn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase

english_verse: and said, “Please come to my home where I can serve you.
translation_verse: kaa sɛ: Me wura, sɛ manya w’anim adom a, mesrɛ wo, nsiane w’akoa ho nkɔ.

english_verse: I'll have some water brought, so you can wash your feet, then you can rest under a tree.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnkɔsa nsuo kakraa bi mmra, na monhohoro mo nan ase, na monhome dua yi ase.

english_verse: Let me get you some food to give you strength before you leave. I would be honored to serve you.” “Thank you very much,” they answered. “We accept your offer.”
translation_verse: Moanya abɛfa mo akoa nkyɛn yi, merekɔ makɔfa paanoo kakra maba, na mode adwodwo mo akoma, na ɛno akyiri no moakɔ. Na wɔse: Yɛ sɛdeɛ woaka yi.

english_verse: Abraham went quickly to his tent and said to Sarah, “Hurry! Get a large sack of flour and make some bread.”
translation_verse: Na Abraham yɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ Sara nkyɛn ntomadan mu kaa sɛ: Yɛ ntɛm, fa esiam pa susukoraa mmiɛnsa, fete to taterɛ.

english_verse: After saying this, he rushed off to his herd of cattle and picked out one of the best calves, which his servant quickly prepared.
translation_verse: Na Abraham tuu mmirika kɔɔ anantwie mu kɔkyeree nantwie ba a ɔyɛ na ɔde maa ɔsomfoɔ bi, na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm siesiee no.

english_verse: He then served his guests some yogurt and milk together with the meat. While they were eating, he stood near them under the tree,
translation_verse: Na Abraham faa nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne nufosuo ne nantwie ba nam a ɔsiesiee no no, na ɔde bɛsii wɔn anim; na ɔno deɛ, ɔgyinaa wɔn nkyɛn dua no ase, maa wɔdidii.

english_verse: and they asked, “Where's your wife Sarah?” “She is right there in the tent,” Abraham answered.
translation_verse: Na wɔbisaa Abraham sɛ: Wo yere Sara wɔ he? Na ɔse: Hwɛ, ɔwɔ ntomadan mu.

english_verse: Abraham and Sarah were very old, and Sarah was well past the age for having children.
translation_verse: Na Abraham ne Sara nyinaa anyininyini a wɔadi mfirinhyia pii, na deɛ ɛyɛ mmaa no to atwa wɔ Sara ho.

english_verse: So she laughed and said to herself, “Now that I am worn out and my husband is old, will I really know such happiness?”
translation_verse: Enti Sara seree ne mu kaa sɛ: Sɛ manya awie aberewa bɔ na me wura nso abɔ akɔkoraa yi, na mɛnya anigyeɛ?

english_verse: The Lord asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh? Does she doubt that she can have a child in her old age?
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bisaa Abraham sɛ: Adɛn nti na Sara seree sɛ: Ampaneampa ara manyini yi mɛwo ɔba?

english_verse: I am the Lord! There is nothing too difficult for me. I'll come back next year at the time I promised, and Sarah will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Biribi yɛ AWURADE yɛna anaa? Berɛ a mahyɛ no, mɛsane aba wo nkyɛn afeda sɛsɛɛ no na Sara anya ɔba.

english_verse: Sarah was so frightened that she lied and said, “I didn't laugh.” “Yes, you did!” he answered. Abraham Prays for Sodom
translation_verse: Na Sara sanee sɛ: Menseree, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔsuro. Na ɔse: Dabi, woasere. Abraham di ma Sodomfoɔ

english_verse: When the three men got ready to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked part of the way with them.
translation_verse: Na mmarima no sɔre firii hɔ danee wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Sodom, na Abraham kɔgyaa wɔn kwan.

english_verse: The Lord said to himself, “I should tell Abraham what I am going to do,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Memfa deɛ merebɛyɛ yi mensie Abraham anaa?

english_verse: since his family will become a great and powerful nation that will be a blessing to all the other nations on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ ampa ara Abraham bɛyɛ ɔman a ɛso na wɔwɔ tumi, na ne mu na wɔbɛhyira wiase aman nyinaa.

english_verse: I have chosen him to teach his family to obey me forever and to do what is right and fair. If they do, I will give Abraham many descendants, just as I promised.”
translation_verse: Na mahu no mayi no sɛ ɔnhyɛ ne mma ne ne fiefoɔ a ɛbɛdi n’akyire sɛ wɔnni AWURADE kwan so nyɛ tenenee ne atɛntenenee adeɛ, na AWURADE ama deɛ waka no Abraham ho no aba ne so.

english_verse: ?” “Because of them, I won't destroy the city,” was the Lord's answer.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ Sodom ne Gomora so nteamu so, na wɔn nnebɔne yɛ duru dodo nti,

english_verse: Now I am going down to see for myself if those people really are that bad. If they aren't, I would like to know.”
translation_verse: meresiane makɔhwɛ sɛ wɔayɛ sɛdeɛ nteamu a ɛduru me nkyɛn no teɛ no a; na sɛ ɛnte saa, mahunu.

english_verse: The men turned and started toward Sodom. But the Lord stayed with Abraham.
translation_verse: Na mmarima no danee wɔn ani firii hɔ kɔɔ Sodom; na Abraham deɛ, na ɔda so gyina AWURADE anim ara.

english_verse: And Abraham asked him, “Lord, when you destroy the evil people, are you also going to destroy those who are good?
translation_verse: Na Abraham twe bɛn bisaa sɛ: Wobɛpra ɔteneneeni ne ɔbɔnefoɔ abom agu anaa?

english_verse: You surely wouldn't let them be killed when you destroy the evil ones. You are the judge of all the earth, and you do what is right.”
translation_verse: Yei mpare wo sɛ wobɛdi saa asɛm yi sɛ wobɛkum ɔteneneeni ne ɔdebɔneyɛni afra, na ɔteneneeni ayɛ sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni; yei mpare wo. Deɛ ɔbu asase nyinaa atɛn no remmu atɛntenenee anaa?

english_verse: Abraham answered, “I am nothing more than the dust of the earth. Please forgive me, Lord, for daring to speak to you like this.
translation_verse: Na Abraham buaa sɛ: Hwɛ, meyɛ mfuturo ne nso deɛ, nanso masi me bo sɛ me ne AWURADE bɛkasa:

english_verse: Then Abraham said, “I don't have any right to ask you, Lord, but what would you do if you find only
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, masi me bo sɛ me ne AWURADE bɛkasa. Ebia wɔbɛhunu aduonu wɔ hɔ. Na ɔse: Aduonu no nti merensɛe hɔ.

english_verse: Finally, Abraham said, “Please don't get angry, Lord, if I speak just once more. Suppose you find only
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Mma AWURADE bo mmfu, na menkasa baako pɛ yi: Ebia wɔbɛhunu edu wɔ hɔ. Na ɔse: Edu no nti merensɛe hɔ.

english_verse: After speaking with Abraham, the Lord left, and Abraham went back home.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ne Abraham kasa wieeɛ no, ɔkɔe, na Abraham sane baa ne fie.

english_verse: That evening, while Lot was sitting near the city gate, the two angels arrived in Sodom. When Lot saw them, he got up, bowed down low,
translation_verse: Na abɔfoɔ baanu no duruu Sodom anwummerɛ; na Lot te Sodom kuro pono ano. Na Lot hunuu wɔn no, ɔsɔre kɔhyiaa wɔn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase kaa sɛ:

english_verse: and said, “Gentlemen, I am your servant. Please come to my home. You can wash your feet, spend the night, and be on your way in the morning.” They told him, “No, we'll spend the night in the city square.”
translation_verse: Me wuranom, mesrɛ mo, mommane mmra mo akoa fie mmɛsoɛ anadwo yi, na monhohoro mo nan ase, na anɔpatutu moasɔre akɔ mo kwan. Na wɔse: Dabi, yɛbɛda abɔntene so.

english_verse: But Lot kept insisting, until they finally agreed and went home with him. He quickly baked some bread, cooked a meal, and they ate.
translation_verse: Na ɔsrɛɛ wɔn dendeenden. Na wɔmanee ne nkyɛn baa ne fie, na ɔtoo wɔn pono, na ɔtoo apiti maa wɔdii.

english_verse: Before Lot and his guests could go to bed, every man in Sodom, young and old, came and stood outside his house
translation_verse: Na wɔnnya nkɔdaeɛ no, Sodom kurom hɔfoɔ bɛtwaa ɛdan no ho hyiae, ɛfiri mmɔfra so kɔsi mpanimfoɔ so, ɔman mu no nyinaa.

english_verse: and started shouting, “Where are your visitors? Send them out, so we can have sex with them!”
translation_verse: Na wɔfrɛɛ Lot ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mmarima a wɔbaa wo nkyɛn anadwo yi no wɔ he? Yi wɔn brɛ yɛn, na yɛne wɔn nna.

english_verse: Lot went outside and shut the door behind him.
translation_verse: Na Lot firi kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn ɛpono ano, na ɔtoo ɛpono no mu wɔ n’akyi.

english_verse: Then he said, “Friends, please don't do such a terrible thing!
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Anuanom, mesrɛ mo, monnyɛ bɔne saa!

english_verse: I have two daughters who have never had sex. I'll bring them out, and you can do what you want with them. But don't harm these men. They are guests in my home.”
translation_verse: Hwɛ, mewɔ mmammaa baanu a wɔnhunuu ɔbarima, momma memfa wɔn mfiri mmrɛ mo, na monyɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ mo ani soɔ na mmarima yi nko deɛ, monnyɛ wɔn hwee, na ɛno nti na wɔbaa me suhyɛ aseɛ yi.

english_verse: “Don't get in our way,” the crowd answered. “You're a foreigner. What right do you have to order us around? We'll do worse things to you than we're going to do to them.” The crowd kept arguing with Lot. Finally, they rushed toward the door to break it down.
translation_verse: Na wɔkaa sɛ: Twe wo ho firi hɔ! Na wɔse: Saa onipa yi ba bɛyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, ɛnna afei ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔtemmufoɔ yi! Afei yɛbɛyɛ wo bɔne akyɛne wɔn. Na wɔhyɛɛ ɔbarima Lot so denden twe baa sɛ wɔbɛbubu ɛpono no.

english_verse: But the two angels in the house reached out and pulled Lot safely inside.
translation_verse: Na mmarima no tenee wɔn nsa twee Lot baa wɔn nkyɛn wɔ ɛdan no mu, na wɔtoo ɛpono no mu.

english_verse: Then they struck blind everyone in the crowd, and none of them could even find the door.
translation_verse: Na nnipa a wɔgyina ɛpono ano no deɛ, wɔfirafiraa wɔn ani firi mmɔfra so kɔsi mpanin so, na wɔhwehwɛɛ ɛpono ano kwan brɛe. Lot tu firi Sodom

english_verse: Lot went to the men who were engaged to his daughters and said, “Hurry up and get out of here! The Lord is going to destroy this city.” But they thought he was joking, and they laughed at him.
translation_verse: Na Lot firii adi ne ne nsenom a wɔrebɛware ne mmammaa no kɔkasaa sɛ: Monsɔre mfiri ha, na AWURADE rebɛsɛe kuro yi. Nanso ɔyɛɛ ne nsenom ani so sɛ obi a ɔredi fɛw.

english_verse: Early the next morning the two angels tried to make Lot hurry and leave. They said, “Take your wife and your two daughters and get away from here as fast as you can! If you don't, every one of you will be killed when the Lord destroys the city.”
translation_verse: Na adeɛ reyɛ akye no, abɔfoɔ no piapiaa Lot sɛ: Sɔre, fa wo yere ne wo mmammaa baanu a wɔwɔ ha no kɔ, anyɛ saa a, wɔbɛsɛe wo, ɔman yi asotwe mu.

english_verse: At first, Lot just stood there. But the Lord wanted to save him. So the angels took Lot, his wife, and his two daughters by the hand and led them out of the city.
translation_verse: Na ɔtwentwɛn ne nan ase no, mmarima no sosɔɔ ɔno ne ne yere ne ne mmammaa baanu no nsa, na wɔde no firii adi gyaa no kuro no akyi ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE huu no mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: When they were outside, one of the angels said, “Run for your lives! Don't even look back. And don't stop in the valley. Run to the hills, where you'll be safe.”
translation_verse: Na wɔde wɔn firii adie no, ɔkaa sɛ: Dwane gye wo kra nkwa, nhwɛ w’akyi, nso nnyina kanko yi mu baabiara; bepɔ so na dwane korɔ, anyɛ saa a, wɔbɛsɛe wo.

english_verse: Lot answered, “You have done us a great favor, sir. You have saved our lives, but please don't make us go to the hills. That's too far away. The city will be destroyed before we can get there, and we will be killed when it happens.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, w’akoa anya w’anim adom, na woama w’adɔeɛ a woayɛ me yi aso sɛ woregye me nkwa nanso merentumi nnwane nkɔ mmepɔ no so, na mmusuo no ammɛto me, na manwu.

english_verse: There's a town near here. It's only a small place, but my family and I will be safe, if you let us go there.”
translation_verse: Hwɛ, kuro yi na ɛbɛn sɛ wɔdwane kɔ hɔ, ɛhɔ sua. Ma mennwane nkɔ hɔ ɛ! Ɛnsua anaa? Na me kra anya nkwa.

english_verse: “All right, go there,” he answered. “I won't destroy that town.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, matie wo wɔ saa asɛm yi ho nso, na meremmutu kuro a woaka ho asɛm yi.

english_verse: Hurry! Run! I can't do anything until you are safely there.” The town was later called Zoar because Lot had said it was small. Sodom and Gomorrah Are Destroyed
translation_verse: Yɛ ntɛm dwane kɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ merentumi nyɛ hwee gye sɛ woakɔduru hɔ ansa. Enti na wɔfrɛ kuro no din sɛ: Soar. Sodom ne Gomora sɛeɛ

english_verse: The sun was coming up as Lot reached the town of Zoar,
translation_verse: Na Lot duruu Soar no, na owia apue asase so.

english_verse: and the Lord sent burning sulfur down like rain on Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE tɔɔ sɔfe ne ogya firi ɔsoro guu Sodom ne Gomora so.

english_verse: He destroyed those cities and everyone who lived in them, as well as their land and the trees and grass that grew there.
translation_verse: Na ɔbutuu nkuro no ne kanko no nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔtete nkuro no mu nyinaa ne deɛ afifiri asase no soɔ.

english_verse: On the way, Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a block of salt.
translation_verse: Na Lot yere no deɛ, ɔhwɛɛ n’akyi, na ɔdanee nkyene sie.

english_verse: That same morning Abraham got up and went to the place where he had stood and spoken with the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Abraham tuaa ahema kɔɔ faako a na ɔgyina AWURADE anim hɔ no.

english_verse: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and saw smoke rising from all over the land—it was like a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Na ɔdanee n’ani kyerɛɛ Sodom ne Gomora ne kanko no asase nyinaa, na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, asase no so wisie foroo sɛ fononoo mu wisie.

english_verse: When God destroyed the cities of the valley where Lot lived, he remembered his promise to Abraham and saved Lot from the terrible destruction. Moab and Ammon
translation_verse: Enti berɛ a Onyankopɔn sɛee kanko no nkuro no no, ɔkaee Abraham, na ɔgyee Lot firii butuo a ɔbutuu nkuro a Lot te mu no mu. Moabfoɔ ne Amonfoɔ ahyɛaseɛ

english_verse: Lot was afraid to stay on in Zoar. So he took his two daughters and moved to a cave in the hill country.
translation_verse: Na Lot firii Soar kɔtenaa bepɔ no so, ɔne ne mmammaa baanu no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔsuroo Soar tena, na ɔne wɔn kɔtenaa ɔbodan bi mu.

english_verse: One day his older daughter said to her sister, “Our father is old, and there are no men anywhere for us to marry.
translation_verse: Na abakan no ka kyerɛɛ akumaa no sɛ: Yɛn agya anyini, na ɔbarima biara nni asase yi so a ɔbɛba yɛn ho, sɛdeɛ asase sofoɔ nyinaa amanneɛ teɛ.

english_verse: Let's get our father drunk! Then we can sleep with him and have children.”
translation_verse: Bra, na yɛmma yɛn agya nsa nnom, na yɛne no nkɔda, na yɛanya yɛn agya ho mma.

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and the older daughter got in bed with him, but he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Na wɔmaa wɔn agya nsa nomee anadwo no, na abakan no kɔɔ mu ne n’agya kɔdae; na wanhunu ne nna ne ne sɔreɛ mu.

english_verse: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, “I slept with my father last night. We'll get him drunk again tonight, so you can sleep with him, and we can each have a child.”
translation_verse: Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, abakan no ka kyerɛɛ akumaa no sɛ: Hwɛ, me ne m’agya akɔda anadwo yi, ma yɛmma no nsa nnom nnɛ anadwo yi nso, na kɔ mu, na wo ne no nkɔda, na yɛanya yɛn agya ho mma.

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and this time the younger sister slept with him. But once again he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Na wɔmaa wɔn agya nsa nomee anadwo no nso, na akumaa no sɔre ne no kɔdae; na wanhunu ne nna ne ne sɔreɛ mu.

english_verse: That's how Lot's two daughters had children.
translation_verse: Na Lot mma maa baanu no nyinaa nyinsɛn wɔn agya ho.

english_verse: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.
translation_verse: Na abakan no woo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Moab; ɔne Moabfoɔ agya de bɛsi nnɛ.

english_verse: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Na akumaa no nso woo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Ben-ami; ɔne Amon mma agya de bɛsi nnɛ.

english_verse: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ Abraham kaa ne yere Sara ho sɛ: Ɔyɛ me nuabaa. Na Gerar hene Abimelek soma maa wɔbɛfaa Sara.

english_verse: But God came to Abimelech in a dream and said, “You have taken a married woman into your home, and for this you will die!”
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn baa Abimelek nkyɛn anadwo daeɛ mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔbaa a woakɔfa no no nti, woawu awie, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima bi yere.

english_verse: Abimelech said to the Lord, “Don't kill me! I haven't slept with Sarah. Didn't they say they were brother and sister? I am completely innocent.”
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Me nua ne no? Na ɔbaa no nso kaa sɛ: Me nua ne no. M’akomam kann ne me tirim fitaa na mede meyɛɛ yei.

english_verse: Then God continued: I know you are innocent. That's why I kept you from sleeping with Sarah and doing anything wrong.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no daeɛ mu sɛ: Me nso menim sɛ w’akomam kann na wode yɛɛ yei, na me nso mesɔɔ wo mu, na woanyɛ bɔne, ɛno nti na mamma woamfa wo ho anka no no.

english_verse: Her husband is a prophet. Let her go back to him, and his prayers will save you from death. But if you don't return her, you and all your people will die.
translation_verse: Na afei dane ɔbarima no yere kɔma no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ, na wapa kyɛw ama wo, na woanya nkwa; na sɛ woannane no ankɔma no a, ɛnneɛ, hunu sɛ wuo na wobɛwuo, wo ne deɛ ɛwɔ woɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: Early the next morning Abimelech sent for his officials, and when he told them what had happened, they were frightened.
translation_verse: Na Abimelek sɔree anɔpatutu frɛɛ ne nkoa nyinaa, na ɔkaa nsɛm yi nyinaa guu wɔn aso mu, na nnipa no suroo pii.

english_verse: Abimelech then called in Abraham and said: Look what you've done to us! What have I ever done to you? Why did you make me and my nation guilty of such a terrible sin?
translation_verse: Na Abimelek frɛɛ Abraham ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yɛn yi, na bɔne bɛn na mayɛ woɔ, na wode bɔne kɛseɛ yi aba me ne m’ahennie soɔ? Adeɛ a wɔnyɛ na woayɛ me yi.

english_verse: What were you thinking when you did this?
translation_verse: Na Abimelek ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wohunuiɛ na wodii saa asɛm yi?

english_verse: Abraham answered: I did it because I didn't think any of you respected God, and I was sure that someone would kill me to get my wife.
translation_verse: Na Abraham kaa sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ mesusuu sɛ, ampa Onyankopɔn ho suro nni ha yi, na me yere nti wɔbɛku me.

english_verse: Besides, she is my half sister. We have the same father, but different mothers.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛwom ampa sɛ ɔyɛ me nua; m’agya ba ne no, na ɛnyɛ me na ba a; na wayɛ me yere.

english_verse: When God made us leave my father's home and start wandering, I told her, “If you really love me, then tell everyone that I am your brother.”
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn maa mefirii m’agya fie mebɛkyiniiɛ no, mesee ɔbaa no sɛ: W’adɔeɛ a wobɛyɛ me ne sɛ, baabiara a yɛbɛduro no, ka no me ho sɛ: Ɔyɛ me nua.

english_verse: After Abimelech had given Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves, he sent Sarah back
translation_verse: Ɛnna Abimelek faa nnwan ne anantwie ne nkoa ne mfenaa de maa Abraham, na ɔdanee ne yere Sara maa no.

english_verse: and told Abraham he could settle anywhere in his country.
translation_verse: Na Abimelek kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, m’asase na ɛda w’anim yi, baabiara a ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ no, tena.

english_verse: Meanwhile, God had kept Abimelech's wife and slaves from having children. But Abraham prayed, and God let them start having children again.
translation_verse: Ɛsiane Abraham yere Sara ho asɛm no nti, na AWURADE ato Abimelek fiefoɔ mmaa nyinaa yafunu mu.

english_verse: The Lord was good to Sarah and kept his promise.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɛhwɛɛ Sara sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no, na ɔyɛɛ Sara sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ no bɔ no.

english_verse: Although Abraham was very old, Sarah had a son exactly at the time God had said.
translation_verse: Na Sara nyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima maa Abraham wɔ ne nkɔkoraaberɛ mu, berɛ a Onyankopɔn kaa ne ho asɛm no mu.

english_verse: and when the boy was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, just as God had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Abraham ba Isak dii nnawɔtwe no, ɔtwaa no twetia sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: and Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. And now everyone will laugh with me.
translation_verse: Na Sara kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn ama me sereɛ, obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no bɛsere ama me.

english_verse: Who would have dared to tell Abraham that someday I would have a child? But in his old age, I have given him a son.”
translation_verse: Na ɔse: Hwan na anka ɔbɛka akyerɛ Abraham sɛ Sara bɛma mma nufoɔ? Nanso hwɛ, mawo ba ama no ne nkɔkoraaberɛ mu.

english_verse: The time came when Sarah no longer had to nurse Isaac, and on that day Abraham gave a big feast. Hagar and Ishmael Are Sent Away
translation_verse: Na abɔfra no nyinii, na wɔtwaa no nufoɔ. Na da a wɔtwaa Isak nufoɔ no, Abraham too pono kɛseɛ. Wɔpamo Hagar ne Ismael

english_verse: One day, Sarah noticed Hagar's son Ishmael playing, and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that Egyptian slave woman and her son! I don't want him to inherit anything. It should all go to my son.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Pamo afenaa yi ne ne ba no, na ɛnyɛ afenaa yi ba ne me ba Isak na ɛbɛdi adeɛ.

english_verse: But God said, “Abraham, don't worry about your slave woman and the boy. Just do what Sarah tells you. Isaac will inherit your family name,
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Mma abɔfra no ne w’afenaa asɛm no nnyɛ wo ya, na deɛ Sara ka kyerɛɛ woɔ nyinaa, tie, na Isak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefoɔ.

english_verse: but the son of the slave woman is also your son, and I will make his descendants into a great nation.”
translation_verse: Na afenaa ba no nso, mɛyɛ no ɔman kɛseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ w’aseni.

english_verse: Early the next morning Abraham gave Hagar an animal skin full of water and some bread. Then he put the boy on her shoulder and sent them away. They wandered around in the desert near Beersheba,
translation_verse: Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutu faa aduane ne nsuo kotokuo, na ɔde maa Hagar, ɔde sii ne kɔn ho, na ɔmaa no ne abɔfra no kɔe. Na ɔkɔe kɔkyinkyinii Beer-seba serɛ so.

english_verse: and after they had run out of water, Hagar put her son under a bush.
translation_verse: Na nsuo no saa wɔ kotokuo no mu no, ɔgyaa abɔfra no too dɔtɔ bi ase.

english_verse: Then she sat down a long way off, because she could not bear to watch him die. And she cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔkɔ kɔtenaa akyiri bɛyɛ sɛ deɛ wɔto bɛmma a ɛbɛtɔ, na ɔse: Mma mennhunu abɔfra yi wuo! Na ɔtenaa ne ntentensoɔ, na ɔmaa ne nne so sui.

english_verse: When God heard the boy crying, the angel of God called out to Hagar from heaven and said, “Hagar, why are you worried? Don't be afraid. I have heard your son crying.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn tee abarimaa no nne, na Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ Hagar bisaa no sɛ: Hagar, ɛdeɛn na ɛreyɛ woɔ? Nsuro, na Onyankopɔn ate abarimaa no nne wɔ deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Help him up and hold his hand, because I will make him the father of a great nation.”
translation_verse: Sɔre ma abarimaa no so, na fa wo nsa sɔ ne mu; na mɛyɛ no ɔman kɛseɛ.

english_verse: Then God let her see a well. So she went to the well and filled the skin with water, then gave some to her son.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn buee n’ani, na ɔhunuu subura bi, na ɔkɔ kɔsaa bi hyɛɛ nsuo kotokuo no ma, na ɔde bi maa abarimaa no nomee.

english_verse: God blessed Ishmael, and as the boy grew older, he became an expert at hunting with his bow and arrows. He lived in the Paran Desert, and his mother chose an Egyptian woman for him to marry. A Peace Treaty
translation_verse: Na ɔtenaa Paran serɛ so; na ne na kɔwaree yerɛ firi Misraim asase so brɛɛ no. Abimelek ne Abraham apam

english_verse: About this time Abimelech and his army commander Phicol said to Abraham, “God blesses everything you do!
translation_verse: Na berɛ no mu no, Abimelek ne ne safohene Pikol bɛka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Onyankopɔn di w’akyi wɔ biribiara a woyɛ mu.

english_verse: Now I want you to promise in the name of God that you will always be loyal to me and my descendants, just as I have always been loyal to you in this land where you have lived as a foreigner.”
translation_verse: Enti afei ka Onyankopɔn ntam kyerɛ me sɛ worentwa me ne me mma ne me mmanana nkontompo, na sɛ adɔeɛ a meyɛɛ woɔ no teɛ no, wode bi bɛyɛ me ne m’asase a woabɛyɛ hɔhoɔ wɔ soɔ yi.

english_verse: And so, Abraham promised he would.
translation_verse: Na Abraham kaa sɛ: Mɛka ntam no.

english_verse: One day, Abraham told Abimelech, “Some of your servants have taken over one of my wells.”
translation_verse: Na asubura bi a Abimelek nkoa nam aniɛden so gyeeɛ no nti, Abraham kaa Abimelek anim.

english_verse: “This is the first I've heard about it,” Abimelech replied. “Why haven't you said something before? I don't have any idea who did it.”
translation_verse: Na Abimelek kaa sɛ: Mennim deɛ ɔyɛɛ saa adeɛ yi, na wo nso, woanka ankyerɛ me, nanso mentee da, gye nnɛ.

english_verse: Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle, then the two men made a peace treaty.
translation_verse: Na Abraham de nnwan ne anantwie maa Abimelek, na wɔn baanu pamee.

english_verse: Abraham separated seven female lambs from his flock of sheep,
translation_verse: Na Abraham yii nnwanten mma abereɛ nson gyinaa fa.

english_verse: Abraham replied, “I want you to accept these seven lambs as proof that I dug this well.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Nnwanten mma abereɛ nson yi, gye wɔ me nsam, na ɛnyɛ me adanseɛ sɛ me na metuu abura yi.

english_verse: So they called the place Beersheba, because they made a treaty there.
translation_verse: Enti ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Beer-seba, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na wɔn baanu nyinaa kekaa ntam.

english_verse: When the treaty was completed, Abimelech and his army commander Phicol went back to the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Na wɔpamee wɔ Beer-seba; na Abimelek ne ne safohene Pikol sɔree, na wɔsane kɔɔ Filistifoɔ asase so.

english_verse: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and worshiped the eternal Lord God.
translation_verse: Na Abraham duaa ɛsɛnteɛ dua wɔ Beer-seba, na ɔsɔree AWURADE a ɔyɛ daa Nyankopɔn no wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Then Abraham lived a long time as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Na Abraham yɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ Filistifoɔ asase so nna pii.

english_verse: Some years later God decided to test Abraham, so he spoke to him. Abraham answered, “Here I am, Lord.”
translation_verse: Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, Onyankopɔn sɔɔ Abraham hwɛe, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham! Na ɔse: Menie.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Go get Isaac, your only son, the one you dearly love! Take him to the land of Moriah, and I will show you a mountain where you must sacrifice him to me on the fires of an altar.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Fa wo ba, wo ba korɔ a wodɔ no, Isak, kɔ Moria asase so, na fa no kɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ, wɔ mmepɔ no mu baako a mɛkyerɛ woɔ so.

english_verse: So Abraham got up early the next morning and chopped wood for the fire. He put a saddle on his donkey and set out with Isaac and two servants for the place where God had told him to go.
translation_verse: Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’afunumu, na ɔfaa n’asomfoɔ mu baanu ne ne ba Isak kaa ne ho, na ɔtwaa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina, na ɔsii mu kɔɔ faako a Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no.

english_verse: Three days later Abraham looked off in the distance and saw the place.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu beaeɛ hɔ wɔ akyirikyiri.

english_verse: He told his servants, “Stay here with the donkey, while my son and I go over there to worship. We will come back.”
translation_verse: Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ no sɛ: Mo ne afunumu yi ntena ha; na me ne abarimaa yi bɛkɔ nohoa akɔsɔre, na yɛasane aba mo nkyɛn.

english_verse: Abraham put the wood on Isaac's shoulder, but he carried the hot coals and the knife. As the two of them walked along,
translation_verse: Na Abraham faa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina no de soaa ne ba Isak, na ɔfaa ogya ne sekan kurae, na wɔn baanu kɔe.

english_verse: when they reached the place that God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and placed the wood on it. Next, he tied up his son and put him on the wood.
translation_verse: Na wɔkɔduruu deɛ Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no hɔ, na Abraham sii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔsiesiee nnyina no, na ɔkyekyeree ne ba Isak, na ɔde no too afɔrebukyia no so wɔ nnyina no so.

english_verse: He then took the knife and got ready to kill his son.
translation_verse: Afei Abraham tenee ne nsa faa sekan no sɛ ɔde rebɛkum ne ba no.

english_verse: But the Lord's angel shouted from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am!” he answered.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham, Abraham! Na ɔse: Menie.

english_verse: “Don't hurt the boy or harm him in any way!” the angel said. “Now I know that you truly obey God, because you were willing to offer him your only son.”
translation_verse: Na ɔse: Mfa wo nsa nka abarimaa no, nso nyɛ no hwee. Afei na mahunu sɛ wosuro Onyankopɔn, na woankame me wo ba korɔ no.

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in the bushes. So he took the ram and sacrificed it instead of his son.
translation_verse: Na Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu odwennini a dɔtɔ asɔ ne mmɛn mu wɔ n’akyi. Na Abraham kɔfaa odwennini no de no sii ne ba no ananmu bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Abraham named that place “The Lord Will Provide.” And even now people say, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”
translation_verse: Na Abraham too bea hɔ din sɛ: Yahwe-yir’e. Enti wɔka no nnɛ ara sɛ: AWURADE bepɔ so na wɔbɛhwɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's angel called out from heaven a second time:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ Abraham bio sɛ:

english_verse: You were willing to offer your only son to the Lord, and so he makes you this solemn promise,
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ woayɛ saa asɛm yi, na woankame me wo ba korɔ no nti, maka me ho ntam sɛ:

english_verse: “I will bless you and give you such a large family, that someday your descendants will be more numerous than the stars in the sky or the grains of sand along the seashore. They will defeat their enemies and take over the cities where their enemies live.
translation_verse: Hyira na mɛhyira woɔ, na dɔ na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔre sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma ne mpoano anwea. Na w’asefoɔ bɛfa wɔn atamfoɔ nkuro ano apono adi so.

english_verse: You have obeyed me, and so you and your descendants will be a blessing to all nations on earth.”
translation_verse: Na w’asefoɔ mu na wɔbɛhyira asase so amanaman nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ woatie me nne.

english_verse: Abraham and Isaac went back to the servants who had come with him, and they returned to Abraham's home in Beersheba. The Children of Nahor
translation_verse: Ɛnna Abraham sane baa ne mmeranteɛ no nkyɛn, na wɔsɔre sii mu baa Beer-seba. Na Abraham tenaa Beer-seba. Nahor asefoɔ

english_verse: Nahor also had another wife. Her name was Reumah, and she had four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
translation_verse: Na ne mpena baako bi a wɔfrɛ no Rehuma nso woo Teba, Gaham, Tahas ne Maaka.

english_verse: he went to the Hittites and said,
translation_verse: Na Abraham sɔre firii n’amu no anim, na ɔne Het mma kɔkasaa sɛ:

english_verse: “I live as a foreigner in your land, and I don't own any property where I can bury my wife. Please let me buy a piece of land.”
translation_verse: Meyɛ mo nkyɛn hɔhoɔ ne mamfrani, momma me amusiebea wɔ mo nkyɛn, na mensie m’amu yi ma no mfiri m’ani so.

english_verse: “Sir,” they answered, “you are an important man. Choose the best place to bury your wife. None of us would refuse you a resting place for your dead.”
translation_verse: Owura, tie yɛn! Okunini bi ne wo wɔ yɛn mu. Yɛn ada mu deɛ wopɛ no, sie w’amu no wɔ mu. Yɛn mu biara renkame wo ne da, sɛ nsie w’amu wɔ mu.

english_verse: and replied, “If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Zohar's son Ephron
translation_verse: na ɔne wɔn kasaa sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ mo pɛ sɛ mesie m’amu yi ma no firi m’ani so a, montie me, na monsrɛ Efron, Sohar ba, mma me,

english_verse: to sell me Machpelah Cave at the end of his field. I'll pay what it's worth, and all of you can be witnesses.”
translation_verse: na ɔmfa Makpela bodan a ɛyɛ ne deɛ, na ɛwɔ n’afuo ano no mma me; ɔnnye me n’abotene na ɔmfa mma me, na mennya asieeɛ wɔ mo ha.

english_verse: Ephron was sitting there near the city gate, when Abraham made this request, and he answered,
translation_verse: Na Efron te Het mma no mu. Na Hetini Efron buaa Abraham maa Het mma no tee wɔ wɔn a wɔhyɛne ne kuro pono mu no nyinaa anim sɛ:

english_verse: “Sir, the whole field, including the cave, is yours. With my own people as witnesses, I freely give it to you as a burial place for your dead.”
translation_verse: Dabi, me wura, tie me: Mede afuo no mema wo, na ɔbodan a ɛwɔ mu no nso mede mema wo. Me man mma anim na mede ma woɔ yi, sie w’amu.

english_verse: and said to Ephron, “In front of these witnesses, I offer you the full price, so I can bury my wife. Please accept my offer.”
translation_verse: na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ Efron maa asase no so nkurɔfoɔ no tee sɛ: Sɛ wotie me a, mede afuo no tiri dwetɛ bɛma wo; gye no me nsam, na mensie m’amu wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: “But sir,” the man replied, “the property is worth only
translation_verse: Me wura, tie, nnwetɛbena ahanan asase yɛ deɛn wɔ me ne wo ntam? W’amu ara na sie.

english_verse: So Abraham buried his wife Sarah in Machpelah Cave that was in the field
translation_verse: Na ɛno akyiri no, Abraham siee ne yere Sara wɔ Makpela afuo mu ɔbodan mu, wɔ Mamre ntentensoɔ, a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no.

english_verse: Abraham was now a very old man. The Lord had made him rich, and he was successful in everything he did.
translation_verse: Na Abraham abɔ akɔkoraa, na wadi nna pii, na AWURADE ahyira no ade nyinaa mu.

english_verse: One day, Abraham called in his most trusted servant and said to him, “Solemnly promise me
translation_verse: Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne fie asomfoɔ mu panin a ɔhwɛ deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa soɔ sɛ: Fa wo nsa ka m’asene mu,

english_verse: in the name of the Lord, who rules heaven and earth, that you won't choose a wife for my son Isaac from the people here in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: na mɛma woaka AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn ne asase Nyankopɔn, ntam sɛ worenware Kanaanfoɔ a mete wɔn mu yi mmammaa mu bi mma me ba.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for him from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Na kɔ me kuro ne m’abusua mu kɔware yerɛ ma me ba Isak.

english_verse: But the servant asked, “What if the young woman I choose refuses to leave home and come here with me? Should I send Isaac there to look for a wife?”
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ebia ɔbaa no rempɛ sɛ ɔbɛdi m’akyiri aba asase yi soɔ; ɛnneɛ memfa wo ba no mensane menkɔ asase a wofiri so baeɛ no so anaa?

english_verse: “No!” Abraham answered. “Don't ever do that, no matter what.
translation_verse: Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ yie, na woamfa me ba ansane ankɔ hɔ bio.

english_verse: The Lord who rules heaven brought me here from the land where I was born and promised that he would give this land to my descendants forever. When you go back there, the Lord will send his angel ahead of you to help you find a wife for my son.
translation_verse: AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn a ɔfaa me firii m’agya fie ne asase a wɔwoo me wɔ soɔ no so, na ɔne me kasaeɛ, na ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ me sɛ: W’asefoɔ na mede asase yi bɛma wɔn no, ɔbɛsoma ne bɔfoɔ adi w’anim, na woakɔware yerɛ afiri hɔ abrɛ me ba.

english_verse: If the woman refuses to come along, you don't have to keep this promise. But don't ever take my son back there.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbaa no mpɛ sɛ ɔdi w’akyiri a, ɛnneɛ wo ho afi me ntam yi mu, nanso mfa me ba nsane nkɔ hɔ bio.

english_verse: So the servant gave Abraham his word that he would do everything he had been told to do.
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfoɔ no de ne nsa kaa ne wura Abraham asene mu, na ɔkaa no ntam wɔ asɛm no ho.

english_verse: Soon after that, the servant loaded ten of Abraham's camels with valuable gifts. Then he set out for the city in northern Syria, where Abraham's brother Nahor lived.
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfoɔ no faa ne wura yoma mu du, na ɔkɔe, na ɔkura ne wura nnepa ahodoɔ nyinaa bi. Na ɔsɔre sii mu kɔɔ Mesopotamia, Nahor kuro mu.

english_verse: When he got there, he let the camels rest near the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when the women came out for water.
translation_verse: Na ɔmaa ne yoma no butuu kuro no kurotia wɔ asubura bi ho anwummerɛ a mmaa bɛsa nsuo.

english_verse: The servant prayed: You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships. Please keep your promise to him and let me find a wife for Isaac today.
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo, ma no nsi me yie nnɛ, na yɛ me wura Abraham adɔeɛ.

english_verse: The young women of the city will soon come to this well for water,
translation_verse: Hwɛ, meregyina asubura yi so ha; na kurom hɔfoɔ mmammaa bɛfiri abɛsa nsuo.

english_verse: and I'll ask one of them for a drink. If she gives me a drink and then offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen and that you have kept your promise to my master.
translation_verse: Na ma no mmra sɛ ababaa a mɛse no sɛ: Soɛ w’ahina ma mennom nsuo no bi, na ɔbɛka sɛ: Nom, na mɛma wo yoma no anom bie no, ma ɔno ara nyɛ deɛ woayi no ama w’akoa Isak, na ɛno mu na mɛhunu sɛ woayɛ me wura adɔeɛ.

english_verse: Abraham's servant ran to her and said, “Please let me have a drink of water.”
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfoɔ no tuu mmirika kɔhyiaa no sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma mennom w’ahina yi mu nsuo kakra.

english_verse: “I'll be glad to,” she answered. Then she quickly took the jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.
translation_verse: Na ɔse: Me wura, nom bi! Na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm soɛɛ n’ahina no sii ne nsam maa no nomee.

english_verse: After he had finished, she said, “Now I'll give your camels all the water they want.” She quickly poured out water for them, and she kept going back for more, until his camels had drunk all they wanted.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm kɔhwiee n’ahina mu nsuo no guu anomeeɛ hɔ, na ɔtutuu mmirika kɔɔ abura no mu bio kɔsaa nsuo, na ɔsa maa ne yoma no nyinaa.

english_verse: Abraham's servant did not say a word, but he watched everything Rebekah did, because he wanted to know for certain if this was the woman the Lord had chosen.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima no hwɛɛ no ara, na ɔyɛɛ komm sɛ ɔbɛhunu sɛ AWURADE ama ne kwankorɔ no ayɛ dwoodwoo anaasɛ ɛnte saa.

english_verse: The servant had brought along an expensive gold ring and two large gold bracelets. When Rebekah had finished bringing the water, he gave her the ring for her nose and the bracelets for her arms.
translation_verse: Na yoma no wiee nsuo nom no, ɔbarima no yii sika hwenemkaa a ano si dwetɛbena fa ne nsa so nkapo mmienu a ano si sikabena du de hyɛɛ no.

english_verse: Then he said, “Please tell me who your father is. Does he have room in his house for me and my men to spend the night?”
translation_verse: Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Hwan ba ne wo? Mesrɛ wo, kyerɛ me! Yɛbɛnya daberɛ wɔ w’agya fie anaa?

english_verse: She answered, “My father is Bethuel, the son of Nahor and Milcah.
translation_verse: Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: M’agya ne Betuel a ɔyɛ Nahor ne Milka ba no.

english_verse: We have a place where you and your men can stay, and we also have enough straw and feed for your camels.”
translation_verse: Na ɔtoaa so sɛ: Yɛwɔ ɛserɛ ne mmoa aduane pii ne deɛ mobɛda.

english_verse: Then the servant bowed his head and prayed,
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima no bɔɔ ne mu ase sɔree AWURADE.

english_verse: “I thank you, Lord God of my master Abraham! You have led me to his relatives and kept your promise to him.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Nhyira nka AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn a wamma n’adɔeɛ ne ne nokorɛ ammɔ me wura. Na me nso, AWURADE akyerɛ me me wura nuanom fie kwan.

english_verse: Rebekah ran straight home and told her family everything.
translation_verse: Na ababaa no tuu mmirika kɔkaa saa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ ne na fiefoɔ.

english_verse: Her brother Laban heard her tell what the servant had said, and he saw the ring and the bracelets she was wearing. So Laban ran out to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.
translation_verse: Na ɔhunuu hwenemkaa ne ne nsa so nkapo no, na ɔtee ne nua Rebeka nsɛm no sɛ: Sɛdeɛ ɔbarima no kasa kyerɛɛ me nie no, ɔbaa ɔbarima no nkyɛn. Na hwɛ, na ɔgyina yoma no nkyɛn, asubura no ho.

english_verse: Then Laban said, “The Lord has brought you safely here. Come home with me. There's no need for you to keep on standing outside. I have a room ready for you in our house, and there's also a place for your camels.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Wo a AWURADE ahyira woɔ, bra, adɛn nti na wogyina kurotia? Na masiesie ɛdan mu, ne baabi nso mama yoma no.

english_verse: Abraham's servant went home with Laban, where Laban's servants unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then they brought water into the house, so Abraham's servant and his men could wash their feet.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima no kɔɔ fie, na ɔyii yoma no so nnoɔma maa no ɛserɛ ne aduane, na ɔmaa ɔno ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nsuo sɛ wɔnhohoro wɔn nan ase.

english_verse: After that, they brought in food. But the servant said, “Before I eat, I must tell you why I have come.” “Go ahead and tell us,” Laban answered.
translation_verse: Na wɔde aduane bɛsii n’anim sɛ ɔnni. Nanso ɔkaa sɛ: Merennidi gye sɛ mabɔ m’amanneɛ ansa. Na ɔse: Bɔ na yɛn ntie ɛ!

english_verse: The servant explained: I am Abraham's servant.
translation_verse: Na ɔse: Abraham somfoɔ ne me.

english_verse: The Lord has been good to my master and has made him very rich. He has given him many sheep, goats, cattle, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of silver and gold, and many slaves.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ahyira me wura pii na wayɛ ɔkɛseɛ. Na wama no nnwan ne anantwie, dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ, nkoa ne mfenaa, ne yoma ne mfunumu.

english_verse: Sarah, my master's wife, didn't have any children until she was very old. Then she had a son, and my master has given him everything.
translation_verse: Na me wura yere Sara awo ba wɔ ne mmerewaberɛ mu ama me wura, na ɔde deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa ama no.

english_verse: I solemnly promised my master that I would do what he said. And he told me, “Don't choose a wife for my son from the women in this land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Na me wura ama maka ntam sɛ: Nware Kanaanfoɔ a mete wɔn asase soɔ yi mmammaa mu bi mma me ba.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for my son from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Na mmom kɔ m’agya fie ne m’abusua mu kɔware yerɛ brɛ no.

english_verse: I asked my master, “What if the young woman refuses to come with me?”
translation_verse: Na mebisaa me wura sɛ: Na sɛ ɔbaa no anni m’akyi ɛ?

english_verse: My master answered, “I have always obeyed the Lord, and he will send his angel to help you find my son a wife from among my own relatives.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: AWURADE a menam n’anim no bɛsoma ne bɔfoɔ aka wo ho, na wama wo kwan so ayɛ dwoodwoo, na woakɔware yerɛ wɔ m’abusua mu ne m’agya fie abrɛ me ba;

english_verse: But if they refuse to let her come back with you, then you are freed from your promise.”
translation_verse: Ɛno na sɛ wokɔ m’abusua mu, na wɔamma wo bi a, ɛnneɛ na wo ho afi me ntam no mu.

english_verse: When I came to the well today, I silently prayed, “You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships, so please lead me to a wife for his son
translation_verse: Na mebaa asubura no ho nnɛ kaa sɛ: AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn, sɛ wo ara worema me kwan a meretuo yi ayɛ dwoodwoo a,

english_verse: while I am here at the well. When a young woman comes out to get water, I'll ask her to give me a drink.
translation_verse: hwɛ, megyina asubura yi ho, na ma no mmra sɛ ababaa a ɔbɛfiri abɛsa nsuo no, na mɛse no sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma me w’ahina yi mu nsuo kakra mennom,

english_verse: If she gives me a drink and offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen.”
translation_verse: na ɔbɛka akyerɛ me sɛ: Nom, na menkɔsa bi memmrɛ wo yoma no nso no, ma ɔno ara nyɛ ɔbaa a AWURADE ayi no ama me wura ba.

english_verse: Even before I had finished praying, Rebekah came by with a water jar on her shoulder. When she had filled the jar, I asked her for a drink.
translation_verse: Na mennya menwiee m’akoma mu kasa no, hwɛ, Rebeka firii adi bae a ahina si ne mmatiri soɔ, na ɔkɔɔ abura no mu kɔsaa nsuo. Na mesee no sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma me bi mennom.

english_verse: She quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and said, “Have a drink. Then I'll get water for your camels.” So I drank, and after that she got some water for my camels.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm soɛɛ n’ahina no kaa sɛ: Nom, na mɛma wo yoma no nso bi anom. Na menomee, na ɔmaa yoma no nso bi nomee.

english_verse: I asked her who her father was, and she answered, “My father is Bethuel the son of Nahor and Milcah.” At once I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms.
translation_verse: Na mebisaa no sɛ: Hwan ba ne wo? Na ɔse: M’agya ne Betuel a ɔyɛ Nahor ne Milka ba no. Na mede ɛhwenemkaa no mesɛnee ne hwenem, na mede nkapo no mehyehyɛɛ ne nsa,

english_verse: Then I bowed my head and gave thanks to the God my master Abraham worships. The Lord had led me straight to my master's relatives, and I had found a wife for his son.
translation_verse: na mebɔɔ me mu ase mesɔree AWURADE, na mehyiraa AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn a ɔkyerɛɛ me nokorɛ kwan sɛ menkɔware me wura nua ba memma ne ba no.

english_verse: Now please tell me if you are willing to do the right thing for my master. Will you treat him fairly, or do I have to look for another young woman?
translation_verse: Na afei sɛ mo ara moreyɛ me wura adɔeɛ adi no nokorɛ a, monka nkyerɛ me; na sɛ ɛnte saa a, monka nkyerɛ me, na mennane memfa nifa anaa benkum.

english_verse: Laban and Bethuel answered, “The Lord has done this. We have no choice in the matter.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Laban ne Betuel buaa sɛ: AWURADE na asɛm yi firi no, yɛrentumi nka no papa anaa bɔne nkyerɛ wo.

english_verse: Take Rebekah with you; she can marry your master's son, just as the Lord has said.”
translation_verse: Hwɛ, Rebeka na ɔgyina w’anim yi, fa no kɔ ma no nkɔyɛ wo wura ba yere, sɛdeɛ AWURADE aka no.

english_verse: Abraham's servant bowed down and thanked the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Abraham somfoɔ no tee wɔn nsɛm no, ɔkotoo fam sɔree AWURADE.

english_verse: Then he gave clothing, as well as silver and gold jewelry, to Rebekah. He also gave expensive gifts to her brother and her mother.
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfoɔ no yii dwetɛ nnwinneɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ nnwinneɛ ne ntadeɛ de maa Rebeka; na ɔde nnoɔma a ɛsom boɔ maa ne nuabarima ne ne na.

english_verse: Abraham's servant and the men with him ate and drank, then spent the night there. The next morning they got up, and the servant told Rebekah's mother and brother, “I would like to go back to my master now.”
translation_verse: Na ɔne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no didii na wɔnomeeɛ no, wɔdaa hɔ anadwo no. Na wɔsɔree anɔpa no, ɔkaa sɛ: Monnya me kwan, na menkɔ me wura nkyɛn.

english_verse: “Let Rebekah stay with us for a week or ten days,” they answered. “Then she may go.”
translation_verse: Na ne nua ne ne na kaa sɛ: Ma ababaa no ntena yɛn nkyɛn nna tiaa bi sɛ dadu ansa na woakɔ.

english_verse: But he said, “Don't make me stay any longer. The Lord has already helped me find a wife for my master's son. Now let us return.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monnsi me kwan, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ama m’akwantuo no asi me yie. Monnya me kwan mma menkɔ me wura nkyɛn.

english_verse: They answered, “Let's ask Rebekah what she wants to do.”
translation_verse: Na wɔse: Ma yɛmfrɛ ababaa no mmisa ɔno ara.

english_verse: They called her and asked, “Are you willing to leave with this man at once?” “Yes,” she answered.
