translation_verse: Na Mose firii adi kɔhyiaa n’ase, na ɔkotoo no fee n’ano, na wɔkyeakyeaa wɔn ho wɔn ho, na wɔbaa ntomadan mu.

english_verse: where Moses told him everything the Lord had done to protect Israel against the Egyptians and their king. He also told him how the Lord had helped them in all of their troubles.
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa nnoɔma a Israel nti AWURADE ayɛ Farao ne Misraim nyinaa, ne amaneɛ a ɛtoo wɔn kwan no soɔ nyinaa, ne sɛdeɛ AWURADE yii wɔn no kyerɛɛ n’ase.

english_verse: Now I know that the Lord is the greatest God, because he has rescued Israel from their arrogant enemies.”
translation_verse: Afei na mahunu sɛ AWURADE yɛ kɛseɛ sene anyame nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyii ɔman no firii Misraim nsam, berɛ a wɔredi wɔn so ahantansɛm.

english_verse: Jethro offered sacrifices to God. Then Aaron and Israel's leaders came to eat with Jethro there at the place of worship. Judges Are Appointed (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na Yetro, Mose ase no, de ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne okum afɔdeɛ brɛɛ Onyankopɔn. Na Aaron ne Israel mpanin nyinaa baa sɛ wɔne Mose ase rebɛdidi wɔ Nyankopɔn anim. Wɔyiyi atemmufoɔ (Deuteronomium

english_verse: You and the people who come to you will soon be worn out. The job is too much for one person; you can't do it alone.
translation_verse: Brɛ na wo ne ɔman a wɔka wo ho yi bɛbrɛ, ɛfiri sɛ adwuma yi yɛ den dodo ma wo, na wo nko ara rentumi nyɛ.

english_verse: The next morning Moses sat down at the place where he decided legal cases for the people, and everyone crowded around him until evening.
translation_verse: Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Mose tenaa ase sɛ ɔresiesie ɔmanfoɔ no ntam asɛm; na ɔman no gyinaa Mose ho firi anɔpa kɔsii anwummerɛ.

english_verse: Jethro saw how much Moses had to do for the people, and he asked, “Why are you the only judge? Why do you let these people crowd around you from morning till evening?”
translation_verse: Na Mose ase no hunuu deɛ ɔreyɛ ɔman no nyinaa no, ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne deɛ woreyɛ ɔman no yi? Adɛn nti na wo nko ara wote hɔ, na ɔman no nyinaa gyinagyina wo ho firi anɔpa abɛduru anwummerɛ yi?

english_verse: Moses answered, “Because they come here to find out what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ n’ase sɛ: Ɔman no ba me nkyɛn bɛhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn hɔ akwankyerɛ.

english_verse: They bring their complaints to me, and I make decisions on the basis of God's laws.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔnya asɛm bi a, wɔba me nkyɛn, na mesiesie onipa ne ne yɔnko ntam, na mekyerɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara.

english_verse: Jethro replied: That isn't the best way to do it.
translation_verse: Na Mose ase no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Deɛ woyɛ yi nyɛ.

english_verse: God will help you if you follow my advice. You should be the one to speak to God for the people,
translation_verse: Afei tie me nne, mɛtu wo fo, na Onyankopɔn nni w’akyi: Wo deɛ, gyina Nyankopɔn anim ma ɔman no, na fa nsɛm no brɛ Onyankopɔn,

english_verse: and you should teach them God's laws and show them what they must do to live right.
translation_verse: na kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ahyɛdeɛ ne mmara ahodoɔ no mu, na ma wɔnhunu kwan ko a wɔmfa soɔ ne deɛ wɔnyɛ.

english_verse: You will need to appoint some competent leaders who respect God and are trustworthy and honest. Then put them over groups of
translation_verse: Na wo nso yiyi ɔman no nyinaa mu mmarima a wɔfata, wɔsuro Onyankopɔn, wɔyɛ anokwafoɔ na wɔnyɛ sikanibereɛ, na fa wɔn sisi wɔn so, apem apem so mpanin, ɔha ɔha so mpanin, aduonum aduonum so mpanin ne du du so mpanin.

english_verse: These judges can handle the ordinary cases and bring the more difficult ones to you. Having them to share the load will make your work easier.
translation_verse: Na wɔnsiesie ɔman no mu nsɛm berɛ nyinaa mu; na asɛnkɛseɛ biara deɛ, wɔmfa mmrɛ wo, na nsɛm nketewa nyinaa deɛ, wɔn ara wɔnni, na ama no ayɛ wo so hare, na wɔne wo asɔ mu.

english_verse: This is the way God wants it done. You won't be under nearly as much stress, and everyone else will return home feeling satisfied.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ yei sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn hyɛ wo yi a, ɛno na wobɛtumi agyina, na ɔman yi nyinaa nso bɛkɔ wɔn tenabea dwoodwoo.

english_verse: He chose some competent leaders from every tribe in Israel and put them over groups of
translation_verse: Na Mose yiyii Israel nyinaa mu nnipa a wɔfata, na ɔde wɔn sisii ɔman no so atitire, apem apem so, ɔha ɔha so, aduonum aduonum so, ne du du so mpanin.

english_verse: They served as judges, deciding the easy cases themselves, but bringing the more difficult ones to Moses.
translation_verse: Na wɔsiesie ɔman no mu nsɛm nyinaa, na nsɛm a ɛyɛ den no, wɔde brɛɛ Mose, na nsɛm nketewa deɛ, wɔn ara dii.

english_verse: After Moses and his father-in-law Jethro had said goodbye to each other, Jethro returned home.
translation_verse: Na Mose kɔgyaa n’ase kwan, na ɔkɔɔ ɔno ara n’asase so.

english_verse: Moses went up the mountain to meet with the Lord God, who told him to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na Mose foro kɔɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na AWURADE firi bepɔ no so frɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛdeɛ ka kyerɛ Yakob fie, na ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no nie:

english_verse: You saw what I did in Egypt, and you know how I brought you here to me, just as a mighty eagle carries its young.
translation_verse: Mo ara moahunu deɛ meyɛɛ Misraim no ne sɛdeɛ mesoaa mo akɔdeɛ ntaban soɔ, na mede mo aba me nkyɛn yi.

english_verse: Now if you will faithfully obey me, you will be my very own people. The whole world is mine,
translation_verse: Na afei sɛ mobɛtie me nne na moadi m’apam so a, ɛnneɛ, mobɛyɛ m’agyapadeɛ a ɛsom boɔ afiri aman nyinaa mu, na me na asase nyinaa wɔ me.

english_verse: but you will be my holy nation and serve me as priests. Moses, that is what you must tell the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na mo deɛ, mobɛyɛ me asɔfoɔ ahemman ne ɔman kronkron. Yeinom ne nsɛm a ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no.

english_verse: After Moses went back, he reported to the leaders what the Lord had said,
translation_verse: Na Mose ba bɛfrɛɛ ɔman no mpanimfoɔ, na ɔde nsɛm a AWURADE de hyɛɛ no yi nyinaa too wɔn anim.

english_verse: and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded.” So Moses told the Lord about this.
translation_verse: Na ɔman mu no nyinaa buaa prɛko sɛ: Deɛ AWURADE aka nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ. Na Mose sane kɔkaa ɔman no nsɛm no kyerɛɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I will come to you in a thick cloud and let the people hear me speak to you. Then they will always trust you.” Again Moses reported to the Lord what the people had said.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, me deɛ, mereba wo nkyɛn mununkum tumm mu, na sɛ me ne wo kasa a, ɔman no ate, na wo nso wɔagye wo adi akɔsi daa. Na Mose kaa ɔman no nsɛm no kyerɛɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: Once more the Lord spoke to Moses: Go back and tell the people that today and tomorrow they must get themselves ready to meet me. They must wash their clothes
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kɔ ɔman no nkyɛn na dwira wɔn ho nnɛ ne ɔkyena, na ma wɔnsi wɔn ntadeɛ;

english_verse: and be ready by the day after tomorrow, when I will come down to Mount Sinai, where all of them can see me.
translation_verse: na wɔnsiesie wɔn ho nsie da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no; na saa da no, AWURADE bɛsiane ɔman no nyinaa anim aba bepɔ Sinai so.

english_verse: Warn the people that they are forbidden to touch any part of the mountain. Anyone who does will be put to death,
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔman no ho hyeban, na ka sɛ: Monhwɛ yie na moamforo bepɔ no anaasɛ moanka ne hyeɛ. Obiara a ɔbɛka bepɔ no no, wuo na ɔbɛwuo;

english_verse: either with stones or arrows, and no one must touch the body of the person being put to death in this way. Even an animal that touches this mountain must be put to death. You may go up the mountain only after a signal is given on the trumpet.
translation_verse: nsa biara nnka no, aboɔ na wɔnsi no anaasɛ agyan na wɔntoto no; aboa oo, onipa oo, ɔrennya nkwa: Sɛ wɔhyɛne totorobɛnto no twe mu a, wɔmforo bepɔ no.

english_verse: After Moses went down the mountain, he gave orders for the people to wash their clothes and make themselves acceptable to worship God.
translation_verse: Na Mose siane firii bepɔ no so baa ɔman no nkyɛn, na ɔdwiraa ɔman no ho, na wɔsii wɔn ntadeɛ.

english_verse: He told them to be ready in three days and not to have sex in the meantime. The Lord Comes to Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monsiesie mo ho nsie da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no. Monnkɔ mo yerenom ho.

english_verse: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud covered the mountain, a loud trumpet blast was heard, and everyone in camp trembled with fear.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no anɔpa no, aprannaa ne anyinam ne mununkum duruduro ne totorobɛnto nne a ɛyɛ den yie baa bepɔ no so. Na ɔman a wɔwɔ nsraban no mu nyinaa ho popoe.

english_verse: Moses led them out of the camp to meet God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Na Mose de ɔman no firii adi firii nsraban no mu kɔhyiaa Onyankopɔn, na wɔkɔgyinagyinaa bepɔ no ase.

english_verse: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke because the Lord had come down in a flaming fire. Smoke poured out of the mountain just like a furnace, and the whole mountain shook.
translation_verse: Na wisie kataa Sinai bepɔ no so nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ na AWURADE nam ogya mu asiane aba so, na ne wisie no tu kɔɔ soro sɛ fononoo mu wisie, na bepɔ no nyinaa wosoo biribiri.

english_verse: The trumpet blew louder and louder. Moses spoke, and God answered him with thunder.
translation_verse: Na totorobɛnto no nne kɔɔ so na ano yɛɛ den ara no, Mose kasae, na Onyankopɔn de nne kɛseɛ gyee so.

english_verse: The Lord came down to the top of Mount Sinai and told Moses to meet him there.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE siane baa Sinai bepɔ so wɔ n’atifi; na AWURADE frɛɛ Mose kɔɔ bepɔ no atifi, na Mose foro kɔe.

english_verse: Then he said, “Moses, go and warn the people not to cross the boundary that you set at the foot of the mountain. They must not cross it to come and look at me, because if they do, many of them will die.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Siane kɔbɔ ɔman no kɔkɔ, na wɔantra hyeban no amma AWURADE nkyɛn ammɛhwɛ, na wɔn mu pii antotɔ.

english_verse: Only the priests may come near me, and they must obey strict rules before I let them. If they don't, they will be punished.”
translation_verse: Na asɔfoɔ nso a wɔbɛn AWURADE no nnwira wɔn ho, na AWURADE anto anhyɛ wɔn so.

english_verse: Moses replied, “The people cannot come up the mountain. You warned us to stay away because it is holy.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Ɔman no rentumi mforo mma Sinai bepɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ wo ara woabɔ yɛn kɔkɔ aka sɛ: Bɔ bepɔ no ho hyeban na yɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Then the Lord told Moses, “Go down and bring Aaron back here with you. But the priests and people must not try to push their way through, or I will rush at them like a flood!”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Siane kɔ, na wo ne Aaron mforo mmra; na mma asɔfoɔ no ne ɔman no ntra hyeban no mmforo mmma AWURADE nkyɛn, na wanto anhyɛ wɔn so.

english_verse: After Moses had gone back down, he told the people what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Na Mose siane baa ɔman no nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: God said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn kaa nsɛm yi nyinaa sɛ:

english_verse: But when Moses went near the thick cloud where God was, the people stayed a long way off. Idols and Altars
translation_verse: Afɔremmukyea ho mmara Na ɔman no gyinaa akyirikyiri, na Mose twe pinii esum kabii a Onyankopɔn wɔ mu no.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a meyii wo Misraim asase so nkoafie mu no.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Nnya anyame foforɔ nka me ho.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ohoni biara anaa adeɛ a ɛwɔ wiem wɔ soro anaa deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ wɔ fam anaa deɛ ɛwɔ nsuo mu wɔ asase ase nsɛsoɔ biara mfa; nkoto wɔn, na nsom wɔn.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: na meyɛ mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wɔdi me mmara nsɛm soɔ adɔeɛ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn din kwa, na AWURADE remma deɛ ɔbɔ ne din kwa no mfa ne ho tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Remember that the Sabbath Day belongs to me.
translation_verse: Kae homeda, na yɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Nnansia na yɛ adwuma, na yɛ w’adeɛ nyinaa;

english_verse: but the seventh day of each week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your slaves, your animals, or the foreigners who live in your towns.
translation_verse: na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ homeda ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; nyɛ adwuma biara, wo ne wo babanin ne wo babaa, w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne wo mmoa ne wo hɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo fie apono mu.

english_verse: In six days I made the sky, the earth, the oceans, and everything in them, but on the seventh day I rested. That's why I made the Sabbath a special day that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na nnansia na AWURADE de yɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase, ɛpo ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, na ɔhomee da a ɛtɔ so nson no; enti na AWURADE hyiraa homeda, na ɔyɛɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, and you will live a long time in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Di wo na ne w’agya ni, na wo nna aware asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.

english_verse: Be faithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Nsɛe awadeɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: Mmɔ korɔno.

english_verse: Do not tell lies about others.
translation_verse: Nni wo yɔnko ho adansekurumu.

english_verse: Do not desire to possess anything that belongs to another person—not a house, a wife, a husband, a slave, an ox, a donkey, or anything else. The People Are Afraid (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Mma w’ani mmmere wo yɔnko fie. Mma w’ani mmmere wo yɔnko yere anaa n’akoa anaa n’afenaa anaa ne nantwie anaa n’afunumu anaa biribiara a ɛyɛ wo yɔnko dea. Ɔman no suro (Deuteronomium

english_verse: So you must never make idols of silver or gold to worship in place of me.
translation_verse: Monnyɛ me so dwetɛ anyame anaa sika anyame biara mmfa.

english_verse: The people trembled with fear when they heard the thunder and the trumpet and saw the lightning and the smoke coming from the mountain. They stood a long way off
translation_verse: Na ɔman no nyinaa hunuu aprannaa ne anyinam a ɛpapaeɛ ne totorobɛnto nne ne bepɔ a ɛfiri wisie no. Na ɔman no hunuiɛ no, wɔn ho popoe, na wɔkɔgyinaa akyirikyiri.

english_verse: and said to Moses, “If you speak to us, we will listen. But don't let God speak to us, or we will die!”
translation_verse: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wo na wo ne yɛn nkasa, na yɛbɛtie; na mma Onyankopɔn ne yɛn nnkasa, na yɛanwuwu.

english_verse: “Don't be afraid!” Moses replied. “God has come only to test you, so that by obeying him you won't sin.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monnsuro, na Onyankopɔn rebɛsɔ mo ahwɛ, na ne ho hu atena mo ani so, na moanyɛ bɔne.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people of Israel: With your own eyes you saw me speak to you from heaven.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sɛ ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ nie: Mo ara moahunu sɛ mefiri ɔsoro na me ne mo akasa.

english_verse: Build an altar out of earth, and offer on it your sacrifices of sheep, goats, and cattle. Wherever I choose to be worshiped, I will come down to bless you.
translation_verse: Dɔteɛ afɔrebukyia na yɛ ma me, na ɛso na fa wo nnwan ne w’anantwie bɔ ɔhyeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ. Na baabiara a mɛma wɔakae me din no, mɛba wɔn nkyɛn mabɛhyira wɔn.

english_verse: If you ever build an altar for me out of stones, do not use any tools to chisel the stones, because that would make the altar unfit for use in worship.
translation_verse: Na sɛ worebɛyɛ aboɔ afɔrebukyia ama me a, mfa aboɔ a wɔatwa nsi; na sɛ woma w’adwinneɛ so bɔ so a, woagu ho fi.

english_verse: And don't build an altar that requires steps; you might expose yourself when you climb up.
translation_verse: Na mforo atwedeɛ nkɔ m’afɔrebukyia so, na w’adagya anna adi wɔ so.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for attacking your father or mother.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbɔ n’agya anaa ne na no, kum na wɔnku no.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for murder.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbɔ onipa ma no wuo no, kum na wɔnku no.

english_verse: Suppose two of you are arguing, and you hit the other with either a rock or your fist, without causing a fatal injury. If the victim has to stay in bed,
translation_verse: Sɛ mmarima reko, na obi bɔ ne yɔnko boɔ anaasɛ kuturuku, na wanwu, na ɛka no to mpa so a,

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses the following laws for his people:
translation_verse: Na yeinom ne atemmusɛm a fa to wɔn anim:

english_verse: If you buy a Hebrew slave, he must remain your slave for six years. But in the seventh year you must set him free, without cost to him.
translation_verse: Sɛ wotɔ akoa a ɔyɛ Hebrini a, ɔnsom mfeɛ nsia, na afe a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɔmfa ne ho nkɔdi kwa.

english_verse: If he was single at the time you bought him, he alone must be set free. But if he was married at the time, both he and his wife must be given their freedom.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔno nko na ɔbaeɛ a, ɔno nko na ɔnkorɔ; sɛ ɔyɛ ɔwarefoɔ a, ne yere no ne no nkɔ.

english_verse: If you give him a wife, and they have children, only the man himself must be set free; his wife and children remain the property of his owner.
translation_verse: Sɛ ne wura ama no ɔyerɛ, na wawo mmabanin anaa mma mmaa ama no a, ɔbaa no ne ne mma no nyɛ ne wura dea, na ɔno nko nkɔ.

english_verse: But suppose the slave loves his wife and children and his owner so much that he won't leave them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ akoa no ka sɛ: Medɔ me wura ne me yere ne me mma, mempɛ sɛ mefa me ho mekɔdie a,

english_verse: Then he must stand beside either the door or the doorpost at the place of worship, while his owner punches a small hole through one of his ears with a sharp metal rod. This makes him a slave for life.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ ne wura no mfa no mmra Nyankopɔn anim, na ɔmfa no mmra ɛpono ho anaa aponnwa ho, na ne wura no mfa fitiiɛ mfiti n’aso mu, na ɔnsom no daa.

english_verse: A young woman who was sold by her father doesn't gain her freedom in the same way that a man does.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima bi tɔn ne babaa kɔyɛ afenaa a, ɛnneɛ ɔmmfa ne ho nnkɔdi sɛ nkoa no.

english_verse: If she doesn't please the man who bought her to be his wife, he must let her be bought back. He cannot sell her to foreigners; this would break the contract he made with her.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnsɔ ne wura a ɔtɔɔ no sɛ ɔreware no ani a, ɔmma wɔmmɛgye no, na ɔnni ho kwan sɛ ɔbɛtɔn no ama ɔnanani bi, ɛfiri sɛ wadaadaa no.

english_verse: If he selects her as a wife for his son, he must treat her as his own daughter.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔgye no awareɛ ma ne ba a, ɔnyɛ no sɛ ɔbabaa.

english_verse: If the man later marries another woman, he must continue to provide food and clothing for the one he bought and to treat her as a wife.
translation_verse: Sɛ agya no ware ɔbaa foforɔ ka ne ho a, ɔmmma n’anoduane, ne nkataho ne n’awadeɛ asɛdeɛ so nnhwan.

english_verse: If he fails to do any of these things, she must be given her freedom without paying for it. Murder and Other Violent Crimes The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na sɛ wanyɛ adeɛ mmiɛnsa yi amma no a, ɛnneɛ ɔmfiri nkɔ kwa, sika biara nni mu. Kum a ɛnam nsapare soɔ

english_verse: But if you did not intend to kill someone, and I, the Lord, let it happen anyway, you may run for safety to a place that I have set aside.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wantɛ no na Onyankopɔn na ama ne nsa apa a, ɛnneɛ mɛyi baabi mama wo, na wadwane akɔ hɔ.

english_verse: If you plan in advance to murder someone, there's no escape, not even by holding on to my altar. You will be dragged off and killed.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi hyɛ da kɔtoa ne yɔnko ku no aniteɛ mu a, yi no m’afɔrebukyia ho na ɔnwu.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for kidnapping. If you sell the person you kidnapped, or if you are caught with that person, the penalty is death.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔwia onipa tɔn no anaasɛ wɔhu no ne nsam no, kum na wɔnku no.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for cursing your father or mother.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔdome n’agya anaa ne na no, kum na wɔnku no.

english_verse: and later has to use a stick when walking outside, you must pay for the loss of time and do what you can to help until the injury is completely healed. That's your only responsibility.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔsɔre bio sɔ ne poma mu nante firi adi a, ɛnneɛ deɛ ɔbɔɔ no no mfa ne ho tɔtorɔtɔɔ, ne mmerɛ a wasɛe no nko ho ka na ɔntua, na sa na ɔmma wɔnsa no yadeɛ.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for beating to death any of your slaves.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi bɔ n’akoa anaa n’afenaa abaa na ɔtɔ ne nsa ano a, wɔntɔ no so were.

english_verse: However, if the slave lives a few days after the beating, you are not to be punished. After all, you have already lost the services of that slave who was your property.
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ ɔtena hɔ da koro anaa nnanu a, wɔnntɔ no so were, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ ne sika.

english_verse: Suppose a pregnant woman suffers a miscarriage as the result of an injury caused by someone who is fighting. If she isn't badly hurt, the one who injured her must pay whatever fine her husband demands and the judges approve.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mmarima reko na wɔkɔpem onyinsɛnfoɔ, na ɔba no firi, na bɔne bi amma akyire a, gyeɛ na wɔnnye no deɛ ɔbaa no kunu de bɛto no soɔ no, na ɔmma sɛdeɛ atemmufoɔ no bɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: But if she is seriously injured, the payment will be life for life,
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɔne bi ba akyire a, ɛnneɛ ma ɔkra nsi ɔkra ananmu,

english_verse: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
translation_verse: aniwa nsi aniwa ananmu, ɛse nsi ɛse ananmu, nsa nsi nsa ananmu, ɛnan nsi ɛnan ananmu,

english_verse: burn for burn, cut for cut, and bruise for bruise.
translation_verse: ɔhyeɛ nsi ɔhyeɛ ananmu, apirakuro nsi apirakuro ananmu, ntampeɛ nsi ntampeɛ ananmu.

english_verse: If you hit one of your slaves and cause the loss of an eye, the slave must be set free.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi bɔ n’akoa ani anaa n’afenaa ani na ɛsɛe a, n’ani no nti akoa anaa afena no mfa ne ho nkɔdi.

english_verse: The same law applies if you knock out a slave's tooth—the slave goes free.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔtu n’akoa se anaa n’afenaa se a, ne se no nti ɔmma akoa anaa afena no mfa ne ho nkɔdi. Awuranom asodie

english_verse: A bull that kills someone with its horns must be killed and its meat destroyed, but the owner of the bull isn't responsible for the death.
translation_verse: Sɛ nantwie pem ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa ma no wu a, ɛnneɛ wɔnsi nantwie no aboɔ, na wɔnnni ne nam, na nantwie no wura no mfa ne ho tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you own a bull that has been in the habit of attacking people, but you have refused to keep it fenced in. If that bull kills someone, both you and the bull must be put to death by stoning.
translation_verse: Na sɛ nantwie no yɛ apempem dada, na wɔama ne wura no ate, na wanhwɛ no so, na wakɔkum ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa a, wɔnsi nantwie no aboɔ, na ne wura no nso, wɔnku no.

english_verse: pieces of silver for the loss of the slave, and the bull must be killed by stoning.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔbɛgye no mpata a, ɔmma adeɛ biara a wɔbɛgye no mfa nnye ne kra.

english_verse: This same law applies if the bull gores someone's son or daughter.
translation_verse: Ɔbabanin na ɔpem no oo, ɔbabaa na ɔpem no oo, atɛn yi ara na wɔmfa mmu no.

english_verse: If the bull kills a slave, you must pay the slave owner
translation_verse: Sɛ nantwie no pem akoa anaa afenaa a, ɔmma akoa anaa afena wura dwetɛ, nnwetɛbena aduasa, na wɔnsi nantwie no aboɔ.

english_verse: Suppose someone's ox or donkey is killed by falling into an open pit that you dug or left uncovered on your property.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi kɔbue abura ano anaasɛ obi kɔtu amena na wankata so, na nantwie anaa afunumu kɔhwe mu a,

english_verse: You must pay for the dead animal, and it becomes yours.
translation_verse: amena no wura no nhyɛ ananmu, na ɔmma wɔn wura no sika, na efunu no nyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: If your bull kills someone else's, yours must be sold. Then the money from your bull and the meat from the dead bull must be divided equally between you and the other owner.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi nantwie pem ne yɔnko nantwie na ɔwu a, wɔntɔn nantwie nikanfoɔ no na wɔnkyɛ ne tiriadeɛ no mu, na efunu no nso wɔnkyɛ.

english_verse: If you refuse to fence in a bull that is known to attack others, you must replace any animal it kills, but the dead animal will belong to you.
translation_verse: Anaasɛ, sɛ wɔnim sɛ nantwie no yɛ apempem dada na ne wura no anhwɛ no so a, ɔmfa nantwie nikanfoɔ nsi nantwie no ananmu, na efunu no nyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: If you steal an ox and slaughter or sell it, you must replace it with five oxen; if you steal a sheep and slaughter it or sell it, you must replace it with four sheep.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi kɔwia nantwie anaa odwan kum anaa ɔtɔn no a, ɔmfa anantwie nnum nsi nantwie baako no ananmu, ne nnwan nnan nsi odwan baako no ananmu.

english_verse: If you allow any of your animals to stray from your property and graze in someone else's field or vineyard, you must repay the damage from the best part of your own harvest of grapes and grain.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi ma n’aboa di afuo anaa bobe turo bi mu adeɛ anaa ɔgyaa no ma no kɔdi obi afuo mu adeɛ a, ɔmfa ɔno ara n’afuo mu nnepa ne ne bobe turo mu nnepa bi na ɛnsi ananmu.

english_verse: If you carelessly let a fire spread from your property to someone else's, you must pay the owner for any crops or fields destroyed by the fire.
translation_verse: Sɛ ogya dɛre na ɛkɔsɔ nkasɛɛ mu, na ɛhye ayuo afiafi kuo anaa ayuo a ɛgyina hɔ anaa afuo a, hyɛ na deɛ ɔsɔɔ gya no nhyɛ ananmu.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor asks you to keep some silver or other valuables, and they are stolen from your house. If the thief is caught, the thief must repay double.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi de sika anaa nnoɔma ma ne yɔnko asie na wɔwia wɔ onipa no fie na wɔhunu owifoɔ no a, owifoɔ no mmu mmɔ ho nhyɛ ananmu.

english_verse: But if the thief isn't caught, some judges will decide if you are the guilty one.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔanhunu owifoɔ no a, wɔmfa efiewura no mmra Nyankopɔn anim mmɛhwɛ sɛ ɔmfaa ne nsa nkaa ne yɔnko no adeɛ no anaa.

english_verse: Suppose two people claim to own the same ox or donkey or sheep or piece of clothing. Then the judges must decide the case, and the guilty person will pay the owner double.
translation_verse: Mmarato ho asɛm biara, nantwie deɛ oo, afunumu deɛ oo, odwan deɛ oo, atadeɛ deɛ oo, adeɛ a ayera biara a nnipa baanu bɛpere ho sɛ ɛyɛ wɔn dea no obi bɛka sɛ “ɛne no” deɛ oo, Nyankopɔn anim ara na wɔmfa wɔn baanu asɛm no mmra. Deɛ Onyankopɔn bɛbu no fɔ no, mmɔ ho mmienu nhyɛ ne yɔnko no ananmu.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor who is going to be away asks you to keep a donkey or an ox or a sheep or some other animal, and it dies or gets injured or is stolen while no one is looking.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi de afunumu, sɛ nantwie, sɛ odwan, sɛ aboa bi ma ne yɔnko asie, na aboa no wu anaa ɔpira anaasɛ wɔka no to wiram na obi anhunu a,

english_verse: If you swear with me as your witness that you did not harm the animal, you do not have to replace it. Your word is enough.
translation_verse: AWURADE ntam mmra wɔn baanu ntam, sɛ ɔmfaa ne nsa nkaa ne yɔnko aboa no. Na ɔdenadeɛ no mpene na ɔbaako no nsi no ananmu.

english_verse: But if the animal was stolen while in your care, you must replace it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wia na ɔwiaa no ne nkyɛn a, ɔnsi ɔdenadeɛ no ananmu.

english_verse: If the animal was attacked and killed by a wild animal, and you can show the remains of the dead animal to its owner, you do not have to replace it.
translation_verse: Sɛ teteɛ na aboa bi tetee no a, ɔmfa mmra mmɛdi adanseɛ. Na ɔnnsi deɛ wɔatete no no ananmu.

english_verse: Suppose you borrow an animal from a neighbor, and it gets injured or dies while the neighbor isn't around. Then you must replace it.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi kɔfɛm biribi ne yɔnko nkyɛn na aboa no pira anaasɛ ɔwu, na ɔdenadeɛ no ho nnim ho bi a, ɔnii ko no nhyɛ ananmu.

english_verse: But if something happens to the animal while the owner is present, you do not have to replace it. If you had leased the animal, the money you paid the owner will cover any harm done to it. Laws for Everyday Life The Lord said:
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔdenadeɛ no nim ho bi a, ɔnnsi ananmu; sɛ wɔbɔɔ no paa a, na ne paadie na ɛmaa no baeɛ. Abrabɔ ne nyamesom ho mmara

english_verse: Suppose a young woman has never had sex and isn't engaged. If a man talks her into having sex, he must pay the bride price and marry her.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi kɔdaadaa ababaa a wɔnnyee no awadeɛ ne no da a, ma no mma tiriadeɛ na ɔnware no.

english_verse: But if her father refuses to let her marry the man, the bride price must still be paid.
translation_verse: Sɛ n’agya mpene sɛ ɔde no ma no a, ɔnkari sika mma, sɛdeɛ wɔma mmaa bunu tiriadeɛ no.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for witchcraft.
translation_verse: Mma ɔbaa ntafowayifoɔ nntena ase.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for having sex with an animal.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔne aboa bɛda no, kum na wɔnku saa onipa no.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for offering sacrifices to any god except me.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama onyame biara na ɛnyɛ AWURADE nko no, wɔnseɛ no korakora.

english_verse: Do not mistreat or abuse foreigners who live among you. Remember, you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Na ɔhɔhoɔ deɛ, mmɔ no atirimuɔden, nso nhyɛ no so, ɛfiri sɛ mo nso moakɔyɛ ahɔhoɔ Misraim asase so pɛn.

english_verse: Do not mistreat widows or orphans.
translation_verse: Monnhyɛ ɔbaakunafoɔ anaa awisiaa biara so.

english_verse: If you do, they will beg for my help, and I will come to their rescue.
translation_verse: Sɛ wohyɛ wɔn so, na wɔsu frɛ me pɛ a, tie na mɛtie wɔn sufrɛ no,

english_verse: In fact, I will get so angry that I will kill your men and make widows of their wives and orphans of their children.
translation_verse: na m’abufuo ano ayɛ den, na mede nkrantɛ maku mo, na mo yerenom adanedane akunafoɔ, na mo mma ayeyɛ nwisiaa.

english_verse: Don't charge interest when you lend money to any of my people who are in need.
translation_verse: Sɛ wofɛm me man mu mmɔborɔni bi a ɔne wo wɔ hɔ sika a, ɛnyɛ no sɛ ɔpempensifoɔ; monnnye no nsiho.

english_verse: Before sunset you must return any coat taken as security for a loan,
translation_verse: Sɛ wogye wo yɔnko ntoma awowa a, sane fa ma no ansa na owia akɔtɔ,

english_verse: because that is the only cover the poor have when they sleep at night. I am a merciful God, and when they call out to me, I will come to help them.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ ɛno nko ara ne ne nkataho, ne honam ntoma. Ɛdeɛn na ɔmfa nna? Na sɛ ɔsu frɛ me a, mɛtie, ɛfiri sɛ mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne me.

english_verse: Don't speak evil of me or of the ruler of your people.
translation_verse: Nka abususɛm ntia Onyankopɔn, na wo man mu panin nso, nnome no.

english_verse: Don't fail to give me the offerings of grain and wine that belong to me. Dedicate to me your first-born sons
translation_verse: Wo nnɔbaeɛ ne wo nnuaba mu nsuo a ɛdi kan no, ntwentwɛn sɛ wode bɛma. Wo mmabanin mu mmakan no, fa ma me.

english_verse: and the first-born of your cattle and sheep. Let the animals stay with their mothers for seven days, then on the eighth day give them to me, your God.
translation_verse: Saa ara na yɛ w’anantwie ne wo nnwan; nnanson na ɔne ne na ntena, da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, fa no brɛ me.

english_verse: You are my chosen people, so don't eat the meat of any of your livestock that was killed by a wild animal. Instead, feed the meat to dogs.
translation_verse: Na monyɛ nnipa kronkron mma me, na monnni nam bi a wɔatete mu wɔ wiram; monto ntwene mma akraman.

english_verse: Always tell the truth in court, even if everyone else is dishonest and stands in the way of justice.
translation_verse: Nni nnipa dodoɔ akyi nkɔyɛ bɔne, nanso nkasa asɛm bi mu nkom nkɔdi nnipa dodoɔ akyi nnane asɛm ani.

english_verse: And don't favor the poor, simply because they are poor.
translation_verse: Na mmɔborɔni nso, nhwɛ n’anim wɔ n’asɛm mu.

english_verse: If you find an ox or a donkey that has wandered off, take it back where it belongs, even if the owner is your enemy.
translation_verse: Sɛ wokɔto wo tamfo nantwie anaa n’afunumu sɛ wafom kwan a, fa no sane brɛ no.

english_verse: If a donkey is overloaded and falls down, you must do what you can to help, even if it belongs to someone who doesn't like you.
translation_verse: Sɛ wohunu deɛ ɔkyiri woɔ afunumu sɛ ɔhyɛ n’adesoa ase a, hwɛ yie na woannya no amma no, sane na wo ne no nsane no.

english_verse: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.
translation_verse: Nnane wo mmɔborɔni asɛm ani wɔ atemmuo mu.

english_verse: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.
translation_verse: Twe wo ho firi atorosɛm mu kɔ akyirikyiri. Na nkum deɛ ɔnyɛɛ bɔne biara ne ɔteneneeni, ɛfiri sɛ meremmu ɔbɔnefoɔ bem.

english_verse: Don't accept bribes. Judges are blinded and justice is twisted by bribes.
translation_verse: Nso nnye kɛtɛasehyɛdeɛ, na ɛfira aniwa, na ɛkyea ateneneefoɔ nsɛm.

english_verse: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like. Laws for the Sabbath The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na nhyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ so, na mo ara monim ɔhɔhoɔ kra, ɛfiri sɛ mo nso moayɛ ahɔhoɔ Misraim asase so pɛn. Mfeɛ a ɛtɔ so Nson ne Ɛda a ɛtɔ so Nson no

english_verse: Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
translation_verse: Mfeɛ nsia na dua w’asase so aduane, na boaboa nnɔbaeɛ no ano sie;

english_verse: but let the land rest during the seventh year. The poor are to eat what they want from your fields, vineyards, and olive trees during that year, and when they have all they want from your fields, leave the rest for wild animals.
translation_verse: na deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no so deɛ, ma asase no nhome na ɛnna hɔ kwa, na wo man mu ahiafoɔ nni, na deɛ wɔbɛgya no, wiram mmoadoma mmɛdi. Saa ara na yɛ wo bobe turo ne wo ngodua turo.

english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: Nnansia na fa yɛ w’adwuma, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no, fa home; na wo nantwie ne w’afunumu nhome, na w’afenaa ba ne wo hɔhoɔ nya ahomegyeɛ.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Deɛ maka no nyinaa, monni so. Na anyame foforɔ din nso, mommmɔ, mommma wɔnnte wɔ mo anomu. Afahyɛ akɛseɛ ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa no (Eksodɔs

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: Mfa m’afɔdeɛ mogya mmɔ afɔdeɛ ngu mmɔreka so, na mma adeɛ nnkye m’afahyɛ mu sradeɛ so.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Worenhunu deɛ ɔpɔn anaa obonini wɔ w’asase so; wo nna dodoɔ no mɛma no adu.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Di otwa afahyɛ no, na fa w’adeɛ a woduaa no w’afuo mu no aba a ɛdi kan no brɛ me. Afei nso di anoboaboa afahyɛ no, afe awieeɛ a woaboaboa w’adwumadeɛ ano afiri mfuo mu no.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: Wo mmarima nyinaa mmɛpue AWURADE Nyankopɔn anim mprɛnsa afirinhyia.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: Mprɛnsa na hyɛ fa ma me afirinhyia mu.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: Di apiti nnapa no: Nnanson na di apiti, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ woɔ no, bosome Abib mu berɛ a wɔahyɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno mu na wofirii Misraim baeɛ; nso obiara mmfa nsapan mmmɛpue m’anim.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: W’asase so aba a ɛdi kan no, fa bra AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn fie. Nnoa odwan ba wɔ ne na nufosuo mu. Bɔhyɛ ne Nhyehyɛɛ ahodoɔ

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, meresoma ɔbɔfoɔ adi w’anim akɔhwɛ wo ɛkwan mu, na ɔde wo akɔduru deɛ masiesie hɔ no.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Hwɛ yie wɔ n’anim, na tie ne nne; nnwene ntia no, na ɔremfa mo mmarato nkyɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ me din wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ampa ara wotie ne nne na woyɛ deɛ meka nyinaa a, ɛnneɛ mɛyɛ w’atamfo tamfoɔ na mahiahia w’ahohiahiafoɔ ho.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: Na me bɔfoɔ no bɛdi w’anim de wo akɔduru Amorifoɔ, Hetifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ no mu, na matu wɔn agu.

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: Nsɔre wɔn anyame na nsom wɔn, na nyɛ wɔn nneyɛɛ nso, na butuo na butu wɔn, na bubuo na bubu wɔn adum.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Na monsom AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn na wahyira w’aduane ne wo nsuo so, na mayi yadeɛ afiri wo mu.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: Mɛma me ho hu adi w’anim, na mama aman a wobɛduru wɔn soɔ nyinaa agyigya, na mama w’atamfo nyinaa adane wɔn akyi akyerɛ wo.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Na mɛsoma nkotokurodu adi w’anim na wɔapam Hewifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ ne Hetifoɔ no wɔ w’anim.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Merempamo wɔn w’anim afe koro, na asase no annane amamfo, na wiram mmoadoma ammɛdɔɔso antia wo;

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: nkakrankakra na mɛpamo wɔn w’anim akɔsi sɛ wobɛdɔɔso na woagye asase no.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Na mɛtwa w’ahyeɛ afiri Mmɛwa Po ano akɔsi Filistifoɔ po ano, na afiri ɛserɛ so akɔsi asuo no ano; na mɛyi asase no sofoɔ mahyɛ mo nsa na woapamo wɔn afiri w’anim.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Mma wɔnntena w’asase so, na wɔamma woanyɛ me ho bɔne; na sɛ wosom wɔn anyame a, ampa ɛbɛyɛ wo fidie.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Na Mose deɛ, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Foro bra AWURADE nkyɛn, wo ne Aaron, Nadab ne Abihu ne Israel mpanimfoɔ mu aduɔson, na mommɛsɔre wɔ akyirikyiri.

english_verse: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.”
translation_verse: Na Mose nko ntwe mpini AWURADE, na wɔn deɛ, wɔnntwe mmpini na ɔman no ne no mmforo mmma.

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Na Mose ba bɛkaa AWURADE nsɛm no nyinaa ne atemmusɛm no nyinaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no. Na ɔman mu no nyinaa de nne koro gyee so sɛ: Nsɛm a AWURADE aka nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Mose twerɛɛ AWURADE nsɛm no nyinaa. Na ɔtuaa nhema sii afɔrebukyia bepɔ no ase, ne adum dummienu sɛ Israel mmusuakuo dummienu no ano teɛ.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔsomaa Israelfoɔ no mu mmeranteɛ, na wɔde anantwinini kɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ maa AWURADE.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Na Mose de mogya no fa guguu nyaawa mu, na mogya no fa no nso ɔhwie guu afɔrebukyia no so.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa apam nwoma no, na ɔkenkan guu ɔman no aso mu. Ɛnna wɔse: Deɛ AWURADE aka no nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ na yɛbɛtie.

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Na Mose faa mogya no petee ɔman no so, na ɔse: Hwɛ, apam a AWURADE ne mo apam wɔ nsɛm yi nyinaa soɔ no mogya nie.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Ɛnna Mose ne Aaron, Nadab ne Abihu ne Israel mpanimfoɔ mu aduɔson foro kɔeɛ.

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: Na wɔhunuu Israel Nyankopɔn no; na ne nan ase te sɛ adeɛ a wɔde hoaboɔ a emu teɛ ayɛ, na ne nahanaha te sɛ ɔsoro pa ara.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Na wantene ne nsa anka Israelfoɔ mu atitire no; na wɔhwɛɛ Onyankopɔn, na wɔdidii na wɔnomee.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Foro bra me nkyɛn bepɔ no so bɛtena ha, na mɛma wo aboɔpono ne mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ a matwerɛ, na woakyerɛkyerɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Na Mose sɔree, ɔne n’abɔfra Yosua, na Mose foro kɔɔ Nyankopɔn bepɔ no so.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: Mo deɛ, montena ha ntwɛn yɛn nkɔsi sɛ yɛbɛsane aba mo nkyɛn; na hwɛ, Aaron ne Hur ne mo na ɛwɔ hɔ; sɛ obi wɔ asɛm bi di a, momma no mmra wɔn nkyɛn.

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Na Mose foro kɔɔ bepɔ no so, na mununkum bɛkataa bepɔ no so.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE animuonyam bɛtenaa Sinai bepɔ so, na mununkum no kataa so nnansia, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɔfiri mununkum no mu frɛɛ Mose.

english_verse: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: bibire, asaawa a ɛbere dum, koogyan, asaawa fufuo, mmirekyie nwi,

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no na wɔmmɛma me mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ. Obiara a n’akoma pɛ no nkyɛn na monnye me mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Na yei ne mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ a monnye no wɔn nkyɛn no: Sika, dwetɛ, kɔbere mfrafraeɛ,

english_verse: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: adwennini nwoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ, sukraman nwoma ne okuo nnua;

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: apopobibire aboɔ ne aboɔ a wɔde bɛsisi asɔfotadeɛ no ne adaaboɔ no mu no.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Na ma wɔnyɛ tenabea kronkron mma me na mentena wɔn mu.

english_verse: The lamp on the top and those at the end of each of its six branches must be made so as to shine toward the front of the lampstand.
translation_verse: Na yɛ ɛso nkanea nson, na wɔmfa ne nkanea no nsisi so, na ɛnnɛre wɔ anim nkyerɛ fa hɔ.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Na fa sika amapa dura ho, emu ne ɛho nyinaa na dura, na yɛ sika hankra twa ho hyia.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Na gu sika nkaa nnan, na fa tuatua ne nan nnan no ho; nkaa mmienu nni fa ha, na nkaa mmienu nni fa ha.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Na fa okuo sene mpoma, na fa sika dura ho.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Na fa poma no wurawura nkaa no mu wɔ adaka no nkyɛn mu, na wɔmfa nsoa adaka no.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Mpoma no nwurawura adaka no ho nkaa no mu; wɔnnyiyi mmfiri mu.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Na yɛ kerub baako wɔ etire ha ne kerub baako wɔ etire ha. Mpata adwa no mu na momma kerubim no nyi adie wɔ ne tiri mmienu so soɔ.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Na fa mpata adwa no si adaka no so, na adaka no mu na fa Adanseɛ a mede bɛma woɔ no hyɛ.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Na ɛhɔ na me ne wo bɛhyia, na mafiri mpata adwa no so wɔ kerubim mmienu a wɔwɔ Adanseɛ adaka no soɔ no ntam maka wo nnoɔma a mɛhyɛ wo sɛ fa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa. Ɛpono no ho nhyehyɛɛ (Eksodɔs

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Na yɛ ɛho mfemfamho a ne trɛ te sɛ nsam hyia, na fa sika hankra twa mfemfamho no ho hyia.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Na yɛ sika nkaa nnan, na fa nkaa no sisi ntweaso nnan a ɛwowɔ ne nan ho no so.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Na fa okuo sene mpoma no, na fa sika duradura ho, na wɔde asoa ɛpono no.

english_verse: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold
translation_verse: Na fa sika amapa a waboro yɛ kaneadua; ne nan ne ne dua; ɛho nhwiren nkuramu, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren no mfiri ɛno ara mu.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Ɛho kukuduuduu ne ɛho nsa no mfiri mu ara; ne nyinaa na wɔmfa sika amapa a waboro nyɛ no baako.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Na ɛho daawa ne ɛho nso nkuruwa nyɛ sika amapa.

english_verse: The lampstand and its equipment will require
translation_verse: Sika amapa dwetikɛseɛ baako na wɔmfa nyɛ, ne ɛho nnoɔma yi nyinaa.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Na hwɛ na yɛ no sɛdeɛ ne nsususoɔ a wɔde akyerɛ wo bepɔ no soɔ no teɛ no.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Na fa bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira nwono nkyeremu fa yɛ ntomadan no ano nkataano.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Ntoma no baako tentene nyɛ basafa dunum, na ntoma no baako tɛtrɛtɛ nyɛ basafa mmienu; ntoma dubaako no nsusuiɛ nyɛ baako.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Na tenabea no, yɛ no ntoma du a ɛyɛ asaawa fitaa a wɔafira ne bibire, ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan yɛ ntomanwono mu adwini.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Wɔmfa ntoma no nnum ntoatoa so, baako ntoa baako so; na ntoma nnum nso ntoatoa so, baako ntoa baako so.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Na fa ntoma no mu nnum toatoa so yɛ no baako, na fa nsia nso toatoa so yɛ no baako, na buka ntoma a ɛtɔ so nsia no ma no nkata ntomadan no so wɔ anim.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Na fa adwennini nwoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ yɛ ntomadan no nkatasoɔ, na fa sukraman nwoma yɛ ɛno so nkatasoɔ.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Na fa mpata adwa no si Adanseɛ adaka no so wɔ kronkron mu kronkronbea hɔ.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na fa okuo yɛ tenabea no ntaaboɔ a ɛsisi hɔ.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: ne ne dwetɛ nnyinasoɔ aduanan, ntaaboɔ no mmaako mmaako ase nnyinasoɔ mmienu mmienu.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Na tenabea no akyiri fam a ɛkyerɛ atɔeɛ no, fa ntaaboɔ nsia yɛ hɔ.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Na ɛmpam ho mfiri fam nkɔ, nanso ɛnyɛ mu nkɔduru ne hini so wɔ deɛ kaa a ɛdi kan no tua hɔ. Saa ara na ne mmienu nyinaa nyɛ, na ɛnni ntweaso mmienu no soɔ.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Na ɛnyɛ ntaaboɔ nwɔtwe ne ne dwetɛ nnyinasoɔ dunsia, taaboɔ baako ase nnyinasoɔ mmienu, ne taaboɔ baako no ase nnyinasoɔ mmienu.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Na mfimfini mmeamu a ɛfa ntaaboɔ no mfimfini no ntwam mfiri tire nkɔduru tire.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Na ntaaboɔ no, fa sika duradura ho, na fa sika yɛ ɛho nkaa no ma no nyɛ mmeamu no hyehyɛbea, na fa sika duradura mmeamu no ho nso.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Na si tenabea no sɛdeɛ ne nsususoɔ a wɔayi akyerɛ wo bepɔ no soɔ no teɛ no.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Na fa ɛpono no si ntwamutam no anim, na kaneadua no nni ɛpono no ntentensoɔ wɔ tenabea no nkyɛn mu anafoɔ fam, na fa ɛpono no si nkyɛn mu atifi fam.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Na fa ntwamutam no sɛne nkoamu no ase, na fa Adanseɛ adaka no bɛsi ntwamutam no akyi, na ntwamutam no ntwa kronkronbea ne kronkron mu kronkronbea no mu mma mo.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Na fa okuo adum nnum yɛ nkataano no, na fa sika duradura ho, na ne nkɔtɔkorɔ nyɛ sika, na fa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ nnum gu aseɛ.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa mpoma no nwurawura nkaa no mu, na mpoma no nhyehyɛ afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn nkyɛn, na wɔde asoa.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Na yɛ ɛho nsenawa a wɔde ne nso bɛgu mu ne ne sofi ne ne nkoraa ne ne wɔeɛ ne ne nsramma kukuwa, ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa, kɔbere mfrafraeɛ na fa yɛ.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Fa ntaaboɔ yɛ, na emu nna kwan. Sɛdeɛ wɔakyerɛ wo bepɔ no soɔ no, saa ara na wɔnyɛ no. Tenabea no adihɔ (Eksodɔs

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: Na wo nso, hyɛ Israelfoɔ no na wɔmmrɛ wo ngodua aba a wɔasie anya mu ngo korɔgyenn, na wɔmfa nsɔ kanea no, na nkanea no nsisi so daa.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: ne n’adum aduonu ne ne nnyinasoɔ aduonu a wɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ayɛ; na adum no mprɛngo ne ne mmeamu nyɛ dwetɛ.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Na adihɔ no ano pono no nkataano nyɛ basafa du; wɔmfa bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira a ɛyɛ nkyeremu; na n’adum nnan ne ne nnyinasoɔ nnan.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Tenabea no ho som nyinaa mu adwinneɛ, ne ne mpɛɛwa nyinaa ne adihɔ no ho mpɛɛwa nyinaa nyɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ. Kanea no ngo (Lewitikɔs

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma nhwɛ so, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ntwamutam a ɛkata Adanseɛ no anim no akyi, mfiri anwummerɛ nkɔsi anɔpa, AWURADE anim. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ a Israelfoɔ nni so wɔ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Afei, ma wo nua Aaron ne ne mmabanin mfiri Israelfoɔ mu mmra wo nkyɛn, na wɔnyɛ me asɔfoɔ: Aaron ne ne mma Nadab, Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Na ka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ nyansa akoma a mede nyansa honhom mahyɛ wɔn mu amaama no nyinaa na wɔmpam Aaron ntadeɛ no, na wɔmfa nyɛ no kronkron na ɔnni me sɔfoɔ.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Na ntadeɛ a wɔmpam nie: Adaaboɔ ne asɔfotadeɛ ne batakari ne atadeɛ yuu a wɔanwono no damedame ne abotire ne abɔsoɔ; na wɔmpam kronkronyɛ ntadeɛ mma wo nua Aaron ne ne mmabanin, na wɔnhyɛ nni me sɔfoɔ.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa sika ne bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa nyɛ.

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: ne sika ntweaban mmienu; wɔ no mmɛsa yɛ no sɛ nhoma, na fa ntweaban a wɔawɔ no mmɛsa no hyehyɛ mfefaano no so. Atemmuo Adaaboɔ no (Eksodɔs

english_verse: and engrave on each of them the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Na aboɔ no ano nyɛ sɛ Israel mma no din ano teɛ, dummienu, sɛ wɔn din no teɛ; ɛnyɛ nsɔanodeɛ nkurukyireeɛ, sɛdeɛ din no teɛ mmaako mmaako, sɛ mmusuakuo dummienu no teɛ.

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: Na yɛ atemmuo adaaboɔ, ntomanwono mu anyansadwuma, yɛ no sɛdeɛ asɔfotadeɛ no yɛbea teɛ: Sika, bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira na fa yɛ.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Na fa aboɔ sisi mu, aboɔ kyerɛpɛn nnan. Kyerɛpɛn a ɛdi kan nyɛ bogyanamboɔ, akrateboɔ ne ahahammonoboɔ;

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛtɔ so mmienu no nyɛ nsramaboɔ, hoaboɔ ne bɔwerɛboɔ;

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no nyɛ akutuhonoboɔ, mfrafraeɛboɔ ne beredumboɔ;

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛtɔ so nnan no nyɛ sikabereɛboɔ, apopobibireboɔ ne ahwehwɛboɔ; ne nsisimu no, sika mfefaano ntwa ho nhyia.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Na mmɛsa mmienu no ano mmienu a aka no, fa toatoa mfefaano mmienu no mu, na fa hyehyɛ asɔfotadeɛ no mmatiri mmienu no so anim fam.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa bibire nhoma nkyekyere adaaboɔ no nkaa no nsosɔ asɔfotadeɛ no nkaa no mu, na ɛmfam asɔfotadeɛ no nkyekyeremu no atifi, na adaaboɔ no ansane amfiri asɔfotadeɛ no so.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: Na fa birisi nko ara yɛ asɔfotadeɛ no ase batakari.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Na tokuro nna mfimfini wɔ n’atifi, na wɔmfa ntomaban a wɔanwono mmare tokuro no ano nhyia te sɛ adaaboɔ mu tokuro, na ansuane.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Sika adɔmma ne atoaa aba, ntwa batakari no mmuano ho nhyia.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Na Aaron nhyɛ nsom, na sɛ ɔhyɛne kronkronbea hɔ AWURADE anim na ɔfiri adi a, wɔate ne nnyegyeeɛ, na wanwu.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na boro sika amapa traatraa, na kurukyire so sɛ nsɔanodeɛ nkurukyireeɛ sɛ: Kronkron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Na fa fam bibire homa so, na ntena abotire no so; abotire no anim na ɛmfam.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Na ɛmfam Aaron moma so, na Aaron nsoa mmusuo biara a aba akronkronneɛ a Israelfoɔ yɛ no kronkron, wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ kronkron nyinaa mu no; na ntena ne moma so daa, na AWURADE ani asɔ wɔn.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma no nso, yɛ ntadeɛ ne aboomu ma wɔn, na yɛ abotire bi ma wɔn, na wɔn anim nyɛ nyam na wɔn ho nyɛ fɛ.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Na fa hyehyɛ wo nua Aaron ne ne mma a wɔka ne ho no, na sra wɔn ngo, na hyɛ wɔn asɔfoɔ na dwira wɔn, na wɔnni me sɔfoɔ.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Na yɛ nwera twakoto ma wɔn, na ɛnkata wɔn adagya so mfiri asene nkɔsi nsrɛkyire.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma no, sɛ wɔreba ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu anaasɛ wɔrebɛn afɔrebukyia no abɛsom kronkronbea hɔ a, wɔnhyehyɛ, na wɔammɔ mmusuo na wɔanwu; ɛnyɛ daa atorɔmudeɛ mma no ne n’asefoɔ a wɔbɛdi n’akyire no.

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Na fa nantwinini bɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ daa, na ɛnyɛ mpata. Na sɛ wɔrepata afɔrebukyia no so a, prapra ɛho bɔne, na sra no ngo fa yɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: ne apiti paanoo ne taterɛ a wɔagu mu ngo, ne apiti ɔfam a wɔasra ho ngo; ayuosiam na fa yɛ.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Na fa gu kɛntɛn baako mu, na ɛngu kɛntɛn no mu na fa bra, ɛne nantwinini ne adwennini mmienu no.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Na fa Aaron ne ne mma no bra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na fa nsuo dware wɔn.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Na fa ntadeɛ no hyɛ Aaron, atadeɛ yuu ne asɔfotadeɛ ase batakari ne asɔfotadeɛ ne adaaboɔ no, na fa asɔfotadeɛ no nkyekyeremu no bɔ ne mu,

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: na fa sra ngo hwie gu n’atifi fa sra no.

english_verse: caps, and sashes, then ordain them, because they and their descendants will always be priests.
translation_verse: Na fa aboomu bobɔ Aaron ne ne mma no mu, na bobɔ wɔn abotire; na asɔfodwuma nyɛ wɔn deɛ sɛ daa atorɔmudeɛ. Sɛɛ na hyɛ Aaron ne ne mma asɔfoɔ.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Na ma wɔmfa nantwinini no mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim, na Aaron ne ne mma no mfa wɔn nsa ngu nantwie no atifi.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Na kum nantwie no AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Na fa nantwie no mogya no bi, na fa wo nsateaa bɔ mu sra afɔrebukyia no mmɛn no ho; na hwie mogya no nyinaa gu afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Nantwie no nam ne ne nwoma ne n’agyanan deɛ, fa ogya hye no nsraban no akyi, ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Na fa odwennini baako, na Aaron ne ne mma no mfa wɔn nsa ngu odwennini no atifi.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na kum odwennini no, na fa ne mogya pete afɔrebukyia no ho hyia.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Na twitwa odwennini no asinasini, na hohoro n’ayamdeɛ ne ne nnyawa ho, na fa gu n’asinasini no ne ne tiri so.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na hye odwennini mu no nyinaa afɔrebukyia no so. Ɛyɛ AWURADE hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, adeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam, ɛyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Na fa odwennini baako no, na Aaron ne ne mma mfa wɔn nsa ngu odwennini no atifi.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na kum odwennini no na fa ne mogya no bi, na fa ka Aaron aso nifa ne ne mma no aso nifa ano ne wɔn nsa nifa kokurobetie ano, ne wɔn nan nifa kokurobetie ano, na fa mogya no pete afɔrebukyia no ho hyia.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na fa afɔrebukyia no so mogya no bi ne sra ngo no bi, na fa petepete Aaron ne ne ntadeɛ so, ne ne mma no ne ne mma ntadeɛ nso so, na ɛnnwira no ne ne ntadeɛ ne ne mma ne ne mma ntadeɛ no nso.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: Na afei fa odwennini no sradeɛ ne ne sradeɛ dua no ne sradeɛ a ɛkata n’ayamdeɛ ho ne deɛ ɛsensɛne ne mmerɛboɔ ho ne ne sawa mmienu ne ɛho sradeɛ ne ne srɛ nifa no, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ asɔfohyɛ dwennini,

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: na fa ne nyinaa gu Aaron ne ne mma no nsam him di akɔneaba yɛ AWURADE anim ehim afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na gye wɔn nsam, na ka ano gya afɔrebukyia no so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no so, na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam, AWURADE anim: Ɛyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na fa Aaron asɔfohyɛ dwennini no yan, na him yɛ ehim afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE, na ɛnyɛ wo kyɛfa.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Ne mma mu deɛ ɔbɛsi n’ananmu adi sɔfoɔ no nhyɛ no nnanson ansa na waba ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu abɛsom kronkronbea hɔ.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: Na fa asɔfohyɛ dwennini no, na noa ne nam no beaeɛ a ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma no nni odwennini no nam ne paanoo a ɛwɔ kɛntɛn mu no, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Na wɔnni nnoɔma a wɔde pata maa wɔn de hyɛɛ wɔn asɔfoɔ na wɔde dwiraa wɔn no, nanso asɔfoɔ nko ara na wɔnni bi, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Na sɛ asɔfohyɛ nam no ne paanoo no bi ka ma adeɛ kye so a, ɛnneɛ fa ogya hye deɛ ɛkaeɛ no; wɔnnni, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: Na sei na yɛ Aaron ne ne mma no, sɛdeɛ mahyɛ woɔ yi nyinaa. Nnanson na fa hyɛ wɔn asɔfoɔ.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Nnanson na pata afɔrebukyia no soɔ yɛ no kronkron, na afɔrebukyia no ayɛ akronkronneɛ mu kronkron; obiara a ɔka afɔrebukyia no nyɛ kronkron. Daa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ (Numeri

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Fa odwan ba no baako bɔ afɔdeɛ anɔpa, na fa odwan ba baako no bɔ afɔdeɛ anwummerɛ;

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Na adwammaa baako no, fa no bɔ afɔdeɛ anwummerɛ, na yɛ no sɛ anɔpa aduane afɔdeɛ no ne ɛho ahwiesa no, na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam, ɛyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Na mɛma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ne afɔrebukyia no ayɛ kronkron, na mɛma Aaron ne ne mma ayɛ kronkron, na wɔayɛ me asɔfoɔ.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Na mɛtena Israelfoɔ no mu, na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn,

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: na wɔahunu sɛ mene AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn a meyii wɔn firii Misraim asase soɔ sɛ mɛtena wɔn mu no, mene AWURADE, wɔn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Na aduhwam a worebɛyɛ yi, monnsusu so nnyɛ bi mmfa nyɛ wo kronkron mma AWURADE.

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.
translation_verse: ne ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ne kuduo no ne ne ntaaseɛ no ho;

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: Na yɛ aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia, okuo na fa yɛ.

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.
translation_verse: Na fa sika amapa dura ɛso ne ɛho ne ne mmɛn no ho hyia; na yɛ sika hankra twa ho hyia.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Na yɛ ɛho sika nkaa mmienu wɔ ne hankra no ase, wɔ n’afanu, na wɔmfa mpoma nwurawura mu, na wɔde asoa.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Na fa okuo sene mpoma no, na duradura ho sika.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Na fa si ntwamutam a ɛwɔ Adanseɛ adaka no ho no anim wɔ mpata adwa a ɛsi Adanseɛ no soɔ no anim, deɛ me ne wo bɛhyia hɔ no.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Monnhye so aduhwam foforɔ biara, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa aduane afɔdeɛ; na monnhwie ahwiesa nso nngu so.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Na daa afirinhyia mu prɛko na Aaron mfa bɔne ho mpata afɔdeɛ mogya no bi mpata wɔ ne mmɛn no soɔ; daa afe ɔmpata wɔ so prɛko, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. Ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ma AWURADE. Akra mpata

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: Sɛ wobu Israelfoɔ ano hwehwɛ wɔn dodoɔ a, wɔn kan yi mu no, wɔn nyinaa mfa wɔn kra mpata adeɛ mma AWURADE, na, sɛ wɔkan wɔn a, owuyadeɛ bi amma wɔn mu.

english_verse: , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma mfa nhohoro wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan ho.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Na gyegye mpata sika no Israelfoɔ no nsam, na fa ma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu som no, na ɛnyɛ Israelfoɔ no nkaeɛ, AWURADE anim, na wɔmfa mpata mma mo kra. Kuduo

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛyɛ bie a ɛte sɛ ɛno ahua ahwɛ no, wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu atwene.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: na dwira ho ma no nyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron; obiara a ɔka no nyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: for dedicating the tent and chest,
translation_verse: Na fa sra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne Adanseɛ adaka no,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: ne ɛpono no ne ɛho nnoɔma no nyinaa ne kaneadua no ne ɛho nnoɔma no ne aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia no,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Na sra Aaron ne ne mma no ngo yɛ wɔn kronkron, na wɔnni me asɔfoɔ.

english_verse: and say to the people of Israel: “This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Yei nyɛ sra ngo kronkron mma me, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu;

english_verse: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.
translation_verse: wɔnnhwie nngu onipa honam so; na monnsusu so nnyɛ bi a ɛte sɛ ɛno; ɛyɛ kronkron, enti ɛnyɛ kronkron mma mo.

english_verse: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord's people.” The Sweet-Smelling Incense
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛfra bie a ɛte sɛ ɛno anaasɛ ɔde bi bɛka ɔhɔhoɔ no, wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu atwene. Aduhwam

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: na fa yɛ aduhwam a wɔhyeɛ, adufrafoɔ nyansa so adufra a wɔaposa a ɛyɛ korɔgyenn ne kronkron.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Na si bi fekɔfekɔ, na fa bi si Adanseɛ no anim ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, deɛ me ne wo bɛhyia no: Ɛnyɛ mo akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, mabɔ Hur ba Uri ba Besalel a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu din mafrɛ no,

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Na me ara, hwɛ, mafa Ahisamak ba Oholiab a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu maka ne ho; na nnipa a wɔwɔ nyansa akoma nyinaa, mede nyansa mahyɛ wɔn akoma mu na wɔayɛ deɛ mahyɛ woɔ yi nyinaa;

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: Na wo nso ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Me home da no ara na monnie; na ɛyɛ me ne mo ntam nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu, na moahunu sɛ me AWURADE na meyɛ mo kronkron.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
