translation_verse: Nnansia na wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ ɔhome mu homeda a ɛyɛ kronkron ma AWURADE; obiara a ɔyɛ adwuma homeda no, kum na wɔbɛku no.

english_verse: Every generation of Israelites must respect the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Enti Israelfoɔ no nhwɛ homeda no na wɔnni, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu, sɛ daa apam.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Me ne Israel ntam nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne no de kɔsi daa; na nnansia na AWURADE de yɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no ɔhomee na ɔdwodwoo ne ho.

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Na ɔne Mose wiee kasa Sinai bepɔ soɔ no, ɔmaa no adanseɛ apono mmienu, aboɔpono a wɔde Nyankopɔn nsateaa atwerɛ soɔ.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Mahunu ɔman yi, na hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔn kɔn asene;

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Na wɔtuaa nhema bobɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ; na ɔman no tenaa ase didii nomee, na wɔsɔre goroe.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa sɛ: Moayɛ mo ho kronkron ama AWURADE nnɛ, sɛ obiara bɛsɔre atia ne ba ne ne nua mpo, na mode nhyira aba mo so nnɛ.

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Na ɔman no hunuu sɛ Mose akyɛreɛ na ɔnsiane mfiri bepɔ no so mma no, ɔman no boaa wɔn ano baa Aaron nkyɛn bɛsee no sɛ: Sɔre yɛ anyame ma yɛn, na wɔnni yɛn anim, ɛfiri sɛ Mose yi, ɔbarima a ɔkɔyii yɛn firii Misraim baeɛ no deɛ, yɛnnim deɛ ayɛ no.

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Aaron ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monyiyi sika nkaa a ɛwowɔ mo yerenom ne mo mmabanin ne mo mmammaa aso mu mfa mmrɛ me.

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Na ɔgyee wɔ wɔn nsam, na ɔde pɛeɛ yeyɛe, na ɔyɛɛ no nantwie a wɔaguo; na wɔkaa sɛ: Israel, yeinom ne w’anyame a wɔyii wo firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no.

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na Aaron hunuu sɛ wɔn ani gye ho no, ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ n’anim; na ɔpaee sɛ: Ɔkyena ne AWURADE afahyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Siane kɔ, na wo man a wode wɔn firi Misraim asase so baeɛ no redi asɛmmɔne;

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: wɔamane afiri kwan a mekyerɛɛ wɔn no so ntɛm; wɔayɛ nantwie ba a wɔaguo, na wɔasɔre no abɔ afɔdeɛ ama no aka sɛ: Israel, yeinom ne w’anyame a wɔyii wo firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no.

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: na afei ma me kwan na me bo nhuru ntia wɔn, na memmene wɔn, na memfa wo menyɛ ɔman kɛseɛ.

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Na Mose paa AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn kyɛw sɛ: AWURADE, adɛn nti na wo bo huru tia ɔman a wode ahoɔden kɛseɛ ne nsa a ɛyɛ den kɔyii wɔn Misraim asase so baeɛ no?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na Misraimfoɔ nka sɛ: Adwemmɔne bi nti na ɔbɛyii wɔn kɔeɛ sɛ ɔrekɔkum wɔn mmepɔ soɔ na wapra wɔn afiri asase ani? Sane firi w’abufuhyeɛ no mu, na ma bɔne a worebɛyɛ wo man no nyɛ wo ya.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Kae Abraham, Isak ne Israel, wo nkoa a wokaa wɔn wo ara wo ntam see wɔn sɛ: Mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, na asase a maka ho asɛm yi nyinaa, mede bɛma w’asefoɔ na wɔadi so akɔsi daa no.

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE nuu ne ho wɔ bɔne a ɔkaa sɛ ɔrebɛyɛ ne man no ho.

english_verse: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.
translation_verse: Na apono no yɛ Nyankopɔn adwuma, na atwerɛ no yɛ Nyankopɔn atwerɛ a wɔakurukyire no apono no soɔ.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Na Yosua tee sɛ ɔman no rebɔ ose na wɔreyɛ gyegyeegye no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ɔko gyegyeegye wɔ nsraban no mu.

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Na ɔse: Ɛnyɛ nkonimdie ho sebɔ gyegyeegye na ɛnyɛ nkoguo ho nteamu gyegyeegye, na mmom ɛdwontoɔ gyegyeegye na meteɛ yi.

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Na ɛbaa sɛ Mose bɛn nsraban no na ɔhunuu nantwie ba ne asa no ara pɛ, ne bo fui, na ɔtoo apono a ɛwɔ ne nsam no gui maa no bobɔe wɔ bepɔ no ase.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa nantwie ba a wɔyɛeɛ no de gya hyee, na ɔyam no muhumuhu de petee nsuo ani maa Israelfoɔ no nomee.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Na Mose bisaa Aaron sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ɔman yi yɛɛ woɔ a wode bɔne kɛseɛ aba wɔn soɔ yi?

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Aaron buaa sɛ: Mma me wura bo mmfu, wo ara wonim ɔman yi sɛ bɔne ara na wɔde asi wɔn anim.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yɛ anyame ma yɛn na wɔnni yɛn anim, ɛfiri sɛ Mose yi, ɔbarima a ɔkɔyii yɛn firi Misraim asase so baeɛ no, yɛnnim deɛ ayɛ no.

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Na mesee wɔn sɛ: Wɔn a wɔwɔ sika bie no, wɔnyi. Na wɔde maa me, na meto guu gya mu, na nantwie ba yi firi mu bae.

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: ɔgyinaa nsraban no tia kaa sɛ: Deɛ ɔwɔ AWURADE afa mmra me nkyɛn. Na Lewifoɔ nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ano baa ne nkyɛn.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Momfa mo nkrantɛ mmobɔ mo asene, na montwa nkɔ, na monsane mmra, mfiri nsraban no tia nkɔ tia, na monkunkum mo nuanom ne mo nnamfonom ne mo afipamfoɔ.

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɔ no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no, na ɛda no ɔman no mu nnipa bɛyɛ mpensa totɔe.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Mo deɛ, moayɛ bɔne kɛse, na afei mɛforo makɔ AWURADE nkyɛn, ebia mɛtumi mapata ama mo bɔne no.

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Na Mose sane kɔɔ AWURADE nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: Ao, bɔne kɛseɛ na ɔman yi ayɛ, na wɔayɛ sika anyame afa.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Na afei, sɛ wode wɔn bɔne no bɛkyɛ a! Na sɛ ɛnte saa a, pepa me nso firi wo nwoma a woatwerɛ no mu ɛ!

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Deɛ wayɛ me bɔne no, ɔno na mɛpepa no mafiri me nwoma mu.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Na afei kɔ, na kɔgya ɔman no kɔ deɛ maka makyerɛ woɔ no; hwɛ, me bɔfoɔ bɛdi w’anim; nanso da a mɛba abɛhwɛ wɔn no, mɛtua wɔn wɔn bɔne so ka.

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔayɛ nantwie ba a Aaron yɛeɛ no nti, AWURADE haa ɔman no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sim firi ha kɔ, wo ne ɔman a wokɔyii wɔn firi Misraim baeɛ no, kɔ asase a mekaa ɛho ntam mekyerɛɛ Abraham, Isak ne Yakob sɛ: W’asefoɔ na mede bɛma wɔn no so.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Kɔ asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no so; na me deɛ merenni wo mu nkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ ɔman a wo kɔn asene, na mammene wo ɔkwan no mu.

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kɔka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Moyɛ ɔman a mo kɔn asene; sɛ medi mo mu kakraa bi ne mo kɔ a, anka mɛhye mo. Na afei monyi mo ho ahokekadeɛ, na menhunu deɛ mɛyɛ mo.

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Ɛnna Israelfoɔ no yiyii wɔn ho ahokekadeɛ firi bepɔ Horeb ho hɔ ara. Wɔnsi ntamadan

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Na Mose taa fa ntomadan no de kɔsi nsraban no akyi akyirikyiri, na ɔfrɛɛ no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan. Na obiara a ɔhwehwɛ AWURADE no firi adi kɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no a ɛwɔ nsraban no akyiri no ho.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Mose firi kɔ ntomadan no ho a, ɔman no nyinaa sɔresɔre kɔgyinagyina wɔn ntomadan ano, na wɔde Mose akyiri hwɛ ara kɔsi sɛ ɔhyɛne ntomadan no mu.

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Hwɛ, wo ara na woaka akyerɛ me sɛ: Fa ɔman yi kɔ, nanso womma menhunu deɛ wobɛsoma no na ɔne me akorɔ. Nanso wo ara na woaka sɛ: Mede wo din menim wo, na woanya m’anim animuonyam nso.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Enti mesrɛ wo, sɛ manya w’anim adom a, ma menhunu wo kwan ɛ, na mahu wo, na hunu sɛ nkurɔfoɔ yi yɛ wo man a!

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Me ara ankasa mɛdi wo anim ne wo akɔ, na mama woakɔhome.

translation_verse: Di deɛ mehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so. Hwɛ, meretu Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Hetifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ no afiri w’anim.

translation_verse: Na hyɛ wo nnapɛn fa no, ayuotwa berɛ mu adekan deɛ no, ɛne anoboa afahyɛ no, afeda mu.

translation_verse: Na mɛtu amanaman no afiri w’anim, na matrɛ w’ahyeɛ mu; na woreforo akɔpue AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim afirinhyia mu mprɛnsa no a, obiara ani remmere w’asase.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: Mfa mmɔreka nka w’afɔdeɛ a wobɔ no mogya ho, na mma adeɛ nnkye twam afahyɛ afɔdeɛ no so.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: W’asase so adekan a ɛbɛba kane no fa bra AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn fie. Nnoa odwan ba wɔ ne na nufosuo mu.

translation_verse: Na Mose ne wɔn wiee kasa no, ɔde nkatanimu kataa n’anim.

translation_verse: Na daa sɛ Mose rekɔ AWURADE anim ne no akɔkasa a, ɔyi nkatanimu no de kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛfiri adie; na ɔfiri adi a ɔbɛka deɛ wɔahyɛ no no kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no.

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Israelfoɔ no hunu Mose anim sɛ n’anim wedeɛ no ahyerɛn; na Mose de nkatanimu no sane kata n’anim kɔsi sɛ ɔkɔ mu ne no kɔkasa.

translation_verse: na ɔde adaka no kɔɔ tenabea no mu, na ɔsii ntwamutam no, na ɔde kataa adanseɛ adaka no ano, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Na ɔde ɛpono no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, tenabea no nkyɛn mu a ɛkyerɛ atifi fam wɔ ntwamutam no akyi;

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔde nkanea no sisii so AWURADE anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: Na ɔde sika afɔrebukyia no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ntwamutam no anim;

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: na ɔhyee so aduhwam, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔde nkataano no sɛnee tenabea no ano.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: Na ɔde ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan tenabea no ano, na ɔbɔɔ so ɔhyeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Na ɔde kuduo no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam, na ɔde nsuo guu mu sɛ wɔmfa nhohoro wɔn ho.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron ne ne mma no de hohoroo wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan ho;

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔkɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu anaasɛ wɔrebɛbɛn afɔrebukyia no ho a, wɔhohoroo wɔn ho, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance. The Glory of the Lord
translation_verse: Na ɔsii adihɔ no de twaa tenabea no ne afɔrebukyia no ho hyiae, na ɔde adihɔ no aboboano ntwamutam no sɛnee hɔ. Na Mose wiee adwuma no. Mununkum bɛkata Tenabea no so (Numeri

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛnna mununkum no bɛkataa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no soɔ, na AWURADE animuonyam bɛhyɛɛ tenabea no ma.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ akwantuo no nyinaa mu, sɛ mununkum no ma ne ho so firi tenabea no so a, na wɔkɔ wɔn anim;

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: na sɛ mununkum no amma ne ho so a, ɛnneɛ wɔntu ara kɔsi da a ɛma ne ho soɔ.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn akwantuo no nyinaa mu, na AWURADE mununkum no wɔ tenabea no so awia, na ogya wɔ mu anadwo, Israel fie no nyinaa anim.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no atifi, na ɛnsɔ ani mma no na ɛmpata mma no.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔnkum nantwinini no, AWURADE anim, na Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no, mfa mogya no mmra, na wɔmfa mpete afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no so nhyia.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Na ɔnnwa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no nwoma, na ɔntwitwa no asinasini.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron mma no nsiesie nnyina wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na wɔnsɔ ano.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔnhohoro n’ayamdeɛ ne ne nnyawa ho wɔ nsuo mu; na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye ne nyinaa afɔrebukyia no so, na ɛnyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no firi nnwan mu, nnwanten anaa mmirekyie mu, na ɔde rekɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a, onini a ɔdi mu na ɔmfa mmra.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔnku no afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn mu atifi fam, AWURADE anim, na Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no, mfa ne mogya mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ayamdeɛ ne nnyawa no, ɔmfa nsuo nhohoro ho; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nyinaa mmra mmɛhye no afɔrebukyia no so; ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no firi ntakraboa mu na ɔde rebɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE a, ɔmfa anyankuku anaa mmorɔnoma mma nyɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ mmra.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mmra afɔrebukyia no ho, na ɔnte ne ti na ɔnhye no afɔrebukyia no so, na ɔnkyi ne mogya ngu afɔrebukyia no ho.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔnyi ne mene ase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nto ntwene afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn apueeɛ fam, deɛ nso guo hɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔnsuane no mu, n’atabu so, nanso ɔnnte mu, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so; ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi de aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE a, n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no nyɛ esiam, na ɔngu so ngo, na ɔmfa ohwamfufuo nto so.

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mmrɛ Aaron mma no, asɔfoɔ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa esiam ne ngo no nsa mama, ne ohwamfufuo no nyinaa, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ. Ɛyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Na aduane afɔdeɛ no mu deɛ ɛbɛka no nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea, AWURADE gya mu akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ne no.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wode aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ a wɔato no fononoo mu bi reba a, fa esiam apiti a wɔde ngo afɔre taterɛ ne apiti ɔfam a wɔagu so ngo bra.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Na sɛ w’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔakye no dadeɛ so a, ma no nyɛ esiam apiti a wɔde ngo afɔre;

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: bubu mu asinasini, na hwie ngo gu so, aduane afɔdeɛ ne no.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Na sɛ w’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ kukuo mu aduane afɔdeɛ a, fa esiam ne ngo yɛ.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na fa aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔde nnoɔma yi ayɛ no brɛ AWURADE; na wɔde brɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no a, ɔmfa mmra afɔrebukyia no ho.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nyi ayɛyɛdeɛ no so nkaeɛ adeɛ no, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so; ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE ne no.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Na aduane afɔdeɛ no nkaeɛ nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea; akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron a ɛfiri AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ mu ne no.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Aduane afɔdeɛ a mode bɛbrɛ AWURADE no nyinaa, mommfa mmɔreka nnyɛ; na monnhye mmɔreka biara ne ɛwoɔ biara sɛ ogya afɔdeɛ mmma AWURADE.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Momfa nnoɔma yi mmrɛ AWURADE sɛ aba a ɛdi kan mu afɔrebɔdeɛ, nanso wɔmmfa bi mmma afɔrebukyia no so sɛ ɛmmɛyi hwa hwanhwam.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na w’aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ nyinaa, to mu nkyene, na mma wo Nyankopɔn apam nkyene mmpa w’aduane afɔdeɛ mu; fa nkyene ka w’ayɛyɛdeɛ nyinaa ho.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wode aba a ɛdi kan ayɛyɛdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE a, fa aburoo mmɛtem a wɔato no ogya mu atutu apɔn ho yɛ w’aba a ɛdi kan mu ayɛyɛdeɛ;

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: na fa ngo gu so, na fa ohwamfufuo to so; aduane afɔdeɛ ne no.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye aburoo mfuamfua a wɔapɔn ho no bi ne ngo no bi ne ohwamfufuo no nyinaa sɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ; ɛyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi ayɛyɛdeɛ yɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, na anantwie no bi na ɔde reba a, onini oo, ɔbedeɛ oo, deɛ ɔdi mu na ɔmfa no mmra AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no atifi, na ɔnku no, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na Aaron mma no, asɔfoɔ no, mfa mogya no mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne sawa mmienu no ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no; ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma no nhye no afɔrebukyia no so, mpae ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛgu ogya no so, na ɛnyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɔde rebɛbɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE no yɛ nnwan no bi a, onini oo, ɔbedeɛ oo, deɛ ɔdi mu na ɔmfa mmra.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ yɛ adwammaa na ɔde reba a, ɔmfa mmra AWURADE anim;

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no atifi, na ɔnku no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na Aaron mma no mfa ne mogya mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne sawa mmienu no ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no; ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no afɔrebukyia no so: Ɛyɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ no gya so ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ abirekyie a, ɔmfa mmra AWURADE anim;

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’atifi, na ɔnku no, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na Aaron mma no mfa ne mogya mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne sawa mmienu no, ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no; ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so; ɛyɛ ogya afɔreduane a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam; sradeɛ no nyinaa yɛ AWURADE dea.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu ne mo tenabea nyinaa sɛ: Monnni sradeɛ anaa mogya biara.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa mmɔ mogya no mu, na ɔmpete mogya no bi mprɛnson, AWURADE anim, kronkronbea ntwamutam no anim.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto ɔpapo no atifi, na ɔnku no deɛ wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no wɔ AWURADE anim: Bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne no.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa nka mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie ne mogya nyinaa ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Sɛ obi anhyɛda na ɔyɛ nnoɔma a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu biara,

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: sɛ nso ɔsɔfoɔ a wɔasra no ɔsɔfo panin yɛ bɔne ma ɔman no di so a, ɛnneɛ ne bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ nti ma no mfa nantwie ba onini a ɔdi mu mmrɛ AWURADE mmɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa nantwinini no mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, AWURADE anim, na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’atifi, na ɔnku no, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ a wɔasra no no mfa nantwie no mogya no bi nkɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mogya no bi nkeka aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia a ɛwɔ AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan mu no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie nantwie no mogya nyinaa ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano no ase.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: nantwinini mu no nyinaa, mfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi, deɛ ɛhɔ teɛ, deɛ wɔhwie nso guo, na ɔmfa ogya nhye no nnyina so; deɛ wɔhwie nso guo na wɔnhye no. Ɔman mu no

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Israel asafo nyinaa fom, na asɛm no ahunta ɔman no ani so, na wɔyɛ nnoɔma a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu bi, na wɔdi so,

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: na wɔhunu bɔne a wɔayɛ de afom no a, ɛnneɛ, asafo no mfa nantwie ba onini mmra mmɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na wɔmfa no mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Na asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ mfa wɔn nsa ngu nantwinini no atifi, na wɔnkum nantwie no, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ a wɔasra no no mfa nantwinini no mogya no bi nhyɛne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu;

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsateaa mmɔ mogya no mu mfa mpete mprɛnson, AWURADE anim, ntwamutam no anim,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa mogya no bi nkeka afɔrebukyia a ɛsi AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie mogya no nyinaa ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɛsi ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano no ase.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ, ɔmfa n’ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ ɔpapo a ɔdi mu mmra;

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa mfa bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie ne mogya no ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na ɔnhye ne sradeɛ nyinaa wɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ sradeɛ no; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, ne bɔne no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no. Ɔmanfoɔ no

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ, ne bɔne a wayɛ no nti, ɔmfa n’ayɛyɛdeɛ, abirekyibereɛ a ɔdi mu mmra mmɛma;

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no atifi, na ɔnkum bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no deɛ wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ hɔ.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔnyi ɛho sradeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔyi asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ deɛ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔde adwammaa bɛyɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ ba bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ a, ɔmfa ɔbedeɛ a ɔdi mu mmra.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no atifi, na ɔnku no nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, deɛ wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ hɔ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa nka bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie mogya no nyinaa ngu afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na ɔnyi ne sradeɛ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔyi asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ adwammaa ho sradeɛ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no afɔrebukyia so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE gya afɔrebɔ teɛ no; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, ne bɔne a wayɛ no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
translation_verse: Anaasɛ sɛ obi ka afideɛ biara, sɛ aboa bi a ne ho nteɛ funu, anaa afieboa bi a ne ho nteɛ funu, anaa aboaa bi a ne ho nteɛ funu, na ɔnnim mpo a, ne ho agu fi, na ɔdi so.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Anaasɛ sɛ ɔka onipa ho fi bi, na sɛ afideɛ a ama oniiko ho agu fi no te sɛn ara, na ɔnnim mpo a, sɛ akyire yi ɔhunu a, ɔdi so.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Sɛ asɛnhunu firi onipa anomu anaasɛ ɔka ntam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ bɔne anaa papa bi na ɔnnim mpo a, sɛ akyire n’ani ba ne ho so a, ɔdi adeɛ yi mu biara ho so;

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: na afei sɛ ɔdi adeɛ yi mu biara ho so a, ɔnka deɛ wayɛ mu bɔne no,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: na ne bɔne a wayɛ no nti, ɔmfa n’asodie ho afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, nnwan mu ɔbedeɛ, odwanten anaa abirekyie, na ɛnyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no wɔ ne bɔne no ho.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no, na ɔmfa deɛ ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no kane, na ɔnkyinsa ne ti, ne kɔn so, nanso ɔnnte mfiri so;

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no mogya no bi mpete afɔrebukyia no ho, na mogya no nkaeɛ no ɔmfa ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ase, bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne no.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne nsa anso anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu so a, deɛ ɔmfa nyɛ ne bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ ho ayɛyɛdeɛ ne esiam olonka abupɛn du mu baako, na ɛnyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ; ɔmmfa ngo nngu so, na ɔmmfa ohwamfufuo nnto so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mu nsa ma nyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ, na ɔnhye no afɔrebukyia no so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE gya afɔrebɔ teɛ no: Bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne no.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, ne bɔne a wayɛ nnoɔma yi biara mu no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no; na nkaeɛ no nyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no deɛ, sɛ aduane afɔdeɛ. Asodie ho afɔdeɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi anhyɛ da yɛ bɔne a ɛyɛ kusumdie wɔ AWURADE akronkronneɛ ho a, ɛnneɛ, n’asodie afɔdeɛ a ɔmfa mmrɛ AWURADE ne odwennini a ɔdi mu, sɛdeɛ wobɛbɔ ne boɔ, dwetɛ nnwetɛbena mu, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena teɛ; na ɛnyɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhyɛ ne nwera atadeɛ, na ɔnhyɛ ne nwera twakoto nkata ne ho, na ɔnsesa nso a ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ogya no hye gyaa no afɔrebukyia no soɔ no ngu afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn.

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: Yei ne Aaron ne ne mma ayɛyɛdeɛ a wɔmfa mmrɛ AWURADE, ɛda a wɔsra no ngo no; esiam olonka abupɛn du mu baako nyɛ daa ayɛyɛdeɛ, anɔpa deɛ fa na anwummerɛ deɛ fa.

english_verse: In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong. Daily Sacrifices (Exodus
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no wɔ AWURADE anim, na wɔde adeɛ biara a wayɛ a ɔdi ho so no bɛkyɛ no. Ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ho mmara

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Mmarima a wɔfiri asɔfoɔ abusuakuo mu nyinaa nni bi; ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Na ahina a wɔnoaa no wɔ mu no, wɔmmɔ, na sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ sɛn mu na wɔnoaeɛ a, wɔntwi mu na wɔmfa nsuo nhohoro mu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: Hyɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Yei ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ho mmara: Ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ntena asomurofi, afɔrebukyia no so anadwo mu nyinaa nkɔsi anɔpa, na wɔmma afɔrebukyia no so gya no nnɛre wɔ so.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Na ɔnyi ne ntadeɛ no, na ɔnhyɛ ntadeɛ foforɔ, na ɔmfa nso no mfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi nkɔgu deɛ ɛhɔ teɛ.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Na wɔmma afɔrebukyia so gya no nnɛre, ennnum ara da, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nsɔ nnyina wɔ so daa anɔpa, na ɔnsiesie ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no wɔ so, na ɔnhye so asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ho sradeɛ no.

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Na yei ne aduane afɔdeɛ ho mmara: Aaron mma no mfa mmra AWURADE anim wɔ afɔrebukyia no anim.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa aduane afɔdeɛ no esiam no nsa ma ne ngo no bi ne aduane afɔdeɛ no so hwamfufuo nyinaa, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam nyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ mma AWURADE.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Wɔmmfa mmɔreka mmfra nnto. Wɔn kyɛfa a mede mama wɔn wɔ me gya afɔdeɛ mu ne no; ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron, sɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne asodie ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aaron mma mu mmarima nyinaa nni; ɛnyɛ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ ahodoɔ ho daa ahyɛdeɛ, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. Obiara a ɔka no nyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Wɔmfa ngo nkye no dadeɛ ayowa mu; yɛ no nkyekyeewa bra; yɛ no sɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔatoto abubu mu asinasini bra, na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Yei ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ho mmara: Faako a wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ aboa no, ɛhɔ ara na wɔnkum bɔne ho afɔdeɛ deɛ no, AWURADE anim; akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ne no.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no na ɔnnie; faako a ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron na wɔnni wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no adihɔ.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔka nam no nyɛ kronkron; na deɛ mogya no bi apete n’atadeɛ mu no nsi deɛ ɛpetee mu no wɔ deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Na bɔne ho afɔdeɛ a wɔde ne mogya no bi ba ahyiaeɛ ntomadan mu bɛpata wɔ kronkronbea hɔ no nyinaa, wɔnnni, wɔmfa ogya nhye.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye ne nyinaa afɔrebukyia no so nyɛ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ; asodie ho afɔdeɛ ne no.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa ayɛyɛdeɛ no mu biara baako mmra, na wɔmma so mma AWURADE, ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔde asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ mogya peteeɛ no na ɛnyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Na nam a aka biribi a ɛho nteɛ no, wɔnnni; wɔmfa ogya nhye. Na nam deɛ, obiara a ne ho teɛ nni,

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: Na yei ne asodie ho afɔdeɛ ho mmara; ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Faako a wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ aboa no, ɛhɔ ara na wɔnkum asodie ho afɔdeɛ deɛ no nso; na ɔnhwie ne mogya mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Na ɔnyi ne sradeɛ nyinaa mmra: Ne sradedua, ne sradeɛ a ɛkata ayamdeɛ ho no,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne sawa mmienu ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan, ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi;

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Mmarima a wɔfiri asɔfoɔ abusuakuo nyinaa nni; deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron na wɔnnie; ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ teɛ no, sɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ nso teɛ ne no, mmara korɔ na ɛda ho; ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔde pata no, ɛnyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma obi no, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɔbɔeɛ no nwoma nyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no dea.

english_verse: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.
translation_verse: Na aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔto no fononoo mu nyinaa ne deɛ wɔsiesie no kukuo mu ne ɛkyeɛ dadeɛ soɔ nyinaa, ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔde ba no na ɛnyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔagu so ngo anaa deɛ ɛyɛ wesee nyɛ Aaron mma nyinaa deɛ, obiara nnya sɛdeɛ ne yɔnko nya. Asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Na yei ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ ma AWURADE no ho mmara.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔyɛ no aseda afɔdeɛ de ba a, aseda afɔdeɛ a ɔde ba no nyɛ apiti taterɛ a wɔde ngo afɔre, ne apiti ɔfam a wɔde ngo agu soɔ ne esiam taterɛ a wɔde ngo afɔre akyeɛ.

english_verse: You must also make some bread with yeast.
translation_verse: Mmɔreka paanoo taterɛ na ɔmfa nka n’ayɛyɛdeɛ ne n’asomdwoeɛ aseda afɔdeɛ no ho mmra.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Na n’asomdwoeɛ aseda afɔdeɛ no nam no, wɔnni no da a wɔde baeɛ no ara, wɔnnnya bi nnkɔsi adekyeeɛ.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ bɔhyɛ anaa ayamyi ayɛyɛdeɛ a, wɔnni no da a ɔbɔ n’afɔdeɛ no, na sɛ adeɛ kye bi so a, wɔnni ara;

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi di n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ nam no bi da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no a, ɛrensɔ ani, na wɔremmu mma deɛ ɔde baeɛ no, ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ, na ɔkra a ɔbɛdi bie no bɛsoa ne mmusuo.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Na ɔkra bi a ɔbɛka afideɛ biara, onipa ho afideɛ bi oo, aboa a ne ho nteɛ oo, akyiwadeɛ biara a ɛho nteɛ oo, na ɔbɛdi AWURADE asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ nam no bie no, wɔbɛtwa saa ɔkra no afiri ne man mu atwene. Mogya ne sradeɛ akyiwadeɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Nantwie ne odwanten ne abirekyie sradeɛ biara, monnni.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Na aboa funu sradeɛ ne deɛ wɔatete no sradeɛ, wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma biara, na die na monnnie.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔbɛdi afieboa a wɔde bi bɛbɔ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ sradeɛ no, wɔbɛtwa ɔkra a ɔdie no afiri ne man mu atwene.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Na mogya biara nso, anomaa deɛ oo, atɔteboa deɛ oo, monnni wɔ mo tenabea biara mu.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔkra biara a ɔbɛdi mogya biara no, wɔbɛtwa saa ɔkra no afiri ne man mu atwene. Asɔfoɔ no kyɛfa

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ɔno ara ne nsa na ɔmfa nsɔ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ no mu mmra, sradeɛ ne ɔyan na ɔmfa mmra; ɔyan no, wɔnhim nyɛ ohim afɔdeɛ AWURADE anim.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye sradeɛ no, afɔrebukyia no so, na ɔyan no nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Aaron mma mu deɛ ɔde asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ mogya ne sradeɛ ba no, ɔno na ɔsrɛ nifa no nyɛ ne kyɛfa.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Na ohim yan ne mmasoɔ srɛ no na mafa, Israelfoɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no mu, na mede mama Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ne ne mma sɛ wɔn daa kyɛfa a ɛfiri Israel mma nsam.

english_verse: These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained.
translation_verse: Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne asodie ho afɔdeɛ ne atuhoakyɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: a AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose, Sinai bepɔ soɔ, ɛda a ɔhyɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, Sinai serɛ soɔ no.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Na Mose faa atuhoakyɛ afɔdeɛ dwennini no yan no, na ɔhim yɛɛ ohim afɔdeɛ AWURADE anim; ɛyɛɛ Mose dea, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Fa Aaron ne ne mma ka ne ho, ɛne ntadeɛ no ne sra ngo no, ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwinini no ne adwennini mmienu no ne apiti kɛntɛn no.

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ma asafo no nyinaa mmɔ dwa, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Na Mose yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na ɔmaa asafo no bɔɔ dwa, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ asafo no sɛ: Yei ne adeɛ a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ.

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Na Mose de Aaron ne ne mma no bae, na ɔde nsuo hohoroo wɔn ho;

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: na ɔde atadeɛ yuu no hyɛɛ no, na ɔde aboomu no bɔɔ n’asene, na ɔde batakari no hyɛɛ no, na ɔde asɔfotadeɛ no hyɛɛ no, na ɔde asɔfotadeɛ no nkyekyeremu no bɔɔ no abɔsoɔ;

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: na ɔde adaaboɔ no hyehyɛɛ no, na ɔde Urim ne Tumim no hyɛɛ adaaboɔ no mu;

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔde abotitene no bɔɔ ne ti, na ɔde sikaterɛ no, kronkronyɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ no, fam abotitene no anim sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Na Mose faa sra ngo no de sraa tenabea no ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, na ɔyɛɛ no kronkron;

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: na ɔde bi petee afɔrebukyia no so mprɛnson, na ɔsraa afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ne kuduo no ne ntaaseɛ no ngo de yɛɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔhwiee sra ngo no bi guu Aaron atifi sraa no ngo de yɛɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose de Aaron mma no nso bae, na ɔhyehyɛɛ wɔn ntadeɛ, na ɔde aboomu bobɔ wɔn mu, na ɔde abotire bobɔɔ wɔn, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Na ɔmaa wɔde bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwinini no bae, na Aaron ne ne mma no de wɔn nsa guu bɔne afɔdeɛ nantwinini no atifi.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na Mose kumm no, na ɔde ne nsateaa kaa mogya no bi kekaa afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho hyiae, na ɔyii afɔrebukyia no ho bɔne, na ɔhwiee mogya no petee afɔrebukyia no ase de dwiraa sɛ ɔde repata so.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ayamdeɛ no ho nyinaa ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no ne sawa mmienu no ne ɛho sradeɛ, na Mose hyee no afɔrebukyia no so.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na nantwinini no ara ne ne nwoma ne ne nam ne n’agyanan no, ɔde ogya hyee, nsraban no akyi, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Na ɔde ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ dwennini no bae, na Aaron ne ne mma de wɔn nsa guu odwennini no atifi.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔkum no, na Mose hwiee mogya no petee afɔrebukyia no so hyiae,

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na n’ayamdeɛ ne ne nnyawa no, ɔde nsuo hohoroo ho. Na Mose too odwennini mu no nyinaa mu gya, afɔrebukyia no so; ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ne no, AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ ne no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Na ɔde odwennini a ɔtɔ so mmienu no, atuhoakyɛ afɔdeɛ dwennini no bae, na Aaron ne ne mma no de wɔn nsa guu odwennini no atifi.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Na Mose kumm no, na ɔfaa ne mogya no bi de kaa Aaron aso nifa ano ne ne nsa nifa kokurobetie ne ne nan nifa kokurobetie ano.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔde Aaron mma no bae, na Mose de mogya no bi kekaa wɔn aso nifa ano ne wɔn nsa nifa kokurobetie ne wɔn nan nifa kokurobetie ano; na Mose hwiee mogya no petee afɔrebukyia no so hyiae.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa sradeɛ no ne sradedua no ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ayamdeɛ no ho nyinaa ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no ne sawa mmienu no ne ɛho sradeɛ ne srɛ nifa no,

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔfaa apiti kɛntɛn a ɛsi AWURADE anim no mu apiti taterɛ baako ne ngo paanoo taterɛ baako ne ɔfam baako de guu sradeɛ ne srɛ nifa no so,

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔde ne nyinaa hyɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma no nsa, na ɔhim yɛɛ ohim afɔdeɛ, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Na Mose gyee wɔn nsam, na ɔtoo mu gya wɔ afɔrebukyia no so wɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no so de yɛɛ atuhoakyɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam; Ɛyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mose faa sra ngo no bi ne afɔrebukyia no so mogya no bi de petee Aaron ne ne ntadeɛ ne ne mma ne ne mma ntadeɛ nyinaa so de dwiraa Aaron ne ne ntadeɛ ne ne mma ne ne mma ntadeɛ no.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Monnoa nam no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na monni no hɔ ara, ɛne atuhoakyɛ afɔdeɛ kɛntɛn no mu paanoo no, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ sɛ: Aaron ne ne mma nnie no.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Na mommfiri ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano nnanson nkɔsi da a mo atuhoakyɛ nna no bɛwie duro, ɛfiri sɛ, nnanson na wɔde rehyɛ mo asɔfoɔ.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ wɔreyɛ no nnɛ da yi no, AWURADE na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ mfa mpata mma mo.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Na montena ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano awia ne anadwo nnanson, na monwɛn sɛdeɛ AWURADE ahyɛ no, na moanwuwu, na saa na wɔahyɛ me.

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma no dii nsɛm a AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛeɛ no nyinaa so.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no Mose frɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma no ne Israel mpanimfoɔ,

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: na ɔka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Fa nantwie ba a wode bɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne odwennini a wode bɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, wɔnni mu, na fa bra AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no nso, kasa kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa ɔpapo mmɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne nantwie ba ne odwanten ba a wɔadi afe afe a wɔdi mu mmɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ,

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: ne nantwinini ne odwennini mmɛyɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, na wɔmfa mmɔ afɔdeɛ AWURADE anim ne aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔagu so ngo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnnɛ na AWURADE bɛyi ne ho akyerɛ mo.

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Na wɔde deɛ Mose hyɛeɛ no baa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim, na asafo no nyinaa twe bae bɛgyinaa AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a AWURADE hyɛeɛ no, monyɛ, na AWURADE animuonyam nyi ne ho nkyerɛ mo.

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Twe pini afɔrebukyia no ho, na bɔ wo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne wo bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na pata ma wo ho ne ɔman no; na fa ɔman no ayɛyɛdeɛ bra, na pata ma wɔn, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Na Aaron twe pinii afɔrebukyia no ho, na ɔkum ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwie ba no.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Na ne mma no de mogya no kɔmaa no, na ɔde ne nsateaa bɔɔ mogya no mu de kekaa afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho, na ɔhwiee mogya no petee afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Na bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no mu sradeɛ ne sawa ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no, ɔtoo mu gya, afɔrebukyia no so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Na ɛnam no ne nwoma no deɛ, ɔde ogya hyee no nsraban no akyi.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔkumm ɔhyeɛ aboa afɔdeɛ no nso, na Aaron mma no de mogya no brɛɛ no, na ɔhwie petee afɔrebukyia no so hyiae.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Na wɔde ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no asinasini ne ne tiri no brɛɛ no, na ɔhyee no afɔrebukyia no so.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Na ɔhohoroo ayamdeɛ ne nnyawa no ho, na ɔhyee no ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ afɔrebukyia no soɔ no so.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔde ɔman no afɔdeɛ no baeɛ, na ɔfaa bɔne ho afɔdeɛ papo a ɔyɛ ɔman no deɛ no kumm no de bɔɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ sɛ kane deɛ no.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Na ɔde ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no bae, na ɔbɛyɛɛ no sɛdeɛ ne yɛbea teɛ no.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Na ɔde aduane afɔdeɛ no bae, na ɔfaa emu nsa ma hyee no afɔrebukyia no so kaa anɔpa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔkumm nantwinini ne odwennini a ɛyɛ ɔman no asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no, na Aaron mma no de mogya no brɛɛ no, na ɔhwie petee afɔrebukyia no so hyiae.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Na nantwinini ne odwennini no sradeɛ no, sradedua no ne deɛ ɛkata sawa ho no ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Na ɔyan no ne srɛ nifa no, Aaron him de yɛɛ ohim afɔdeɛ, AWURADE anim, sɛdeɛ Mose hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Aaron maa ne nsa so kyerɛɛ ɔman no, na ɔhyiraa wɔn. Na ɔbɔɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ wieeɛ no, ɔsianee.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron hyɛnee ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu; na wɔfirii adie no, wɔhyiraa ɔman no. Ɛnna AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ogya firii AWURADE anim bɛhyee afɔrebukyia no so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne sradeɛ no. Na ɔman no nyinaa hunui, na wɔde anigyeɛ huroe, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma Nadab ne Abihu fefaa wɔn gyasɔ adeɛ, na wɔde ogya guguu mu, na wɔde aduhwam guguu so, na wɔde ananagya a ɔnhyɛɛ wɔn ho mmara baa AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Na ogya firii AWURADE anim bɛhyee wɔn, na wɔwuwuu AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Ɛno ne deɛ AWURADE kaa sɛ: Wɔn a wɔtwe pini me no mu na mɛyɛ me ho kronkron, na ɔman no nyinaa anim na mɛhyɛ me ho animuonyam.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Na Aaron yɛɛ komm. Ɛnna Mose frɛɛ Aaron n’agya nuabarima Usiel mma Misael ne Elsafan baeɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Montwe mpini, na mommɛsoa mo nuanom no mfiri kronkronbea anim nkɔ nsraban no akyi.

english_verse: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.
translation_verse: Na wɔtwe bae bɛsoaa wɔn, wɔn ntadeɛ mu, de wɔn kɔɔ nsraban no akyi sɛdeɛ Mose kaeɛ no.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma Eleasa ne Itamar sɛ: Mommpɛsɛ mo ti, na monnsunsuane mo ntadeɛ mu, na moanwuwu, na abufuo amma asafo no nyinaa so, nanso mo nuanom, Israel fie nyinaa, nsu wɔn a AWURADE de ogya ahye wɔn yi.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Na mommfiri ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano nso, na moanwuwu, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE sra ngo no wɔ mo so. Na wɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ Mose kaeɛ no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: Wo ne wo mma nyinaa, ansa na mobɛhyɛne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu no, monnnom bobesa anaa nsa biara, na moanwuwu. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Na moahunu ade kronkron ne adeɛ a ɛnyɛ kronkron ne adeɛ a ɛho teɛ ne deɛ ɛho nteɛ ntam nsonsonoeɛ,

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: na moakyerɛkyerɛ Israelfoɔ ahyɛdeɛ a AWURADE nam Mose so ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa.

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma Eleasa ne Itamar a wɔkaeɛ no sɛ: Momfa AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ mu aduane a ɛkaeɛ no, na monni no apiti, afɔrebukyia no ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Monni no deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, na ɛyɛ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ ho kyɛfa ma wo ne wo mma, ɛfiri sɛ saa na wɔahyɛ me.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Mmasoɔ srɛ ne ohim yan no na wɔmfa nka sradeɛ a wɔhyeɛ no ho mmra, na wɔnhim no ohim afɔdeɛ, AWURADE anim, na ɛnyɛ wo deɛ ne wo mma deɛ nyɛ daa kyɛfa, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Na bɔne ho afɔdeɛ papo no, Mose hwehwɛɛ no brɛɛ ara yie, na hwɛ, wɔahye no. Na ne bo fuu Aaron mma Eleasa ne Itamar a wɔkaeɛ no, na ɔkaa sɛ:

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na moanni bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no wɔ kronkronbea hɔ? Ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron, na ɛno na wɔde ama mo, sɛ monsoa asafo no mmusuo no, na mompata mma wɔn, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Hwɛ, wɔamfa ne mogya no amma kronkronbea dan no mu; anka ɛsɛ sɛ modi no kronkronbea hɔ, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ mo no.

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Na Aaron kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ wɔde wɔn bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne wɔn hyeɛ afɔdeɛ aba AWURADE anim, na adeɛ a ɛte seyie abɛto me yi; na sɛ medi bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nnɛ a, ɛbɛsɔ AWURADE ani anaa?

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Na Mose teeɛ no, n’akoma tɔɔ ne yam.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron see wɔn sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: Monkasa nkyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Yeinom ne mmoa a monni wɔ asase so mmoa nyinaa mu:

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: ne hwinamanhwan, ɔmampam, ɔkoterɛ, bɔmɔte ne abosomakoterɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔn ho nte mma mo, mmoa a wɔwea nyinaa mu; sɛ wɔwu a, obiara a ɔka wɔn no, ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: If something made of wood, cloth, or leather touches one of their dead bodies, it must be washed, but it is still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na adeɛ biara a wɔn mu bi awu atɔ soɔ no, ɛho nte: Dua adeɛ biara oo, atadeɛ oo, nwoma oo, awere oo, adeɛ biara a wɔde yɛ adwuma; wɔmfa nhyɛ nsuo mu, na ɛho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ ansa na ɛho ate.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Na kukuo biara a wɔn mu bi bɛhwe mu no, deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa ho nte, na kukuo no nso mommɔ no.
