english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Aduane a wɔdie biara a nsuo no bi bɛgu mu no ho nte, na anonneɛ biara a wɔnom adeɛ biara a ɛte saa mu no ho nte.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na adeɛ biara a wɔn funu ho biribi bɛhwe soɔ, ɛho nte: Fononoo oo, bukyia oo, wɔmmubu: Ɛho nte, na mommu no sɛ ɛho nte.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Nanso nsuo aniwa anaa abura a nsuo wɔ mu deɛ, ɛho te ara; na biribiara a ɛka wɔn funu no, ɛho nte.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔn funu bi hwe kuadeɛ a wɔdua biara so a, kuadeɛ no ho te;

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: na sɛ wɔde nsuo gu kuadeɛ no so na wɔn afunu bi hwe so a, ɛho nte mma mo.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mmoa a modie no bi wu a, deɛ ɔka ne funu no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔdi ne funu no bie no nsi ne ntadeɛ, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; na deɛ ɔsoa ne funu no nsi ne ntadeɛ, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Monnyɛ mo ho akyiwadeɛ wɔ mmoa a wɔwea no biara ho, na monnyɛ mo ho fi a ɛmma mo ho nteɛ wɔ wɔn ho.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn, enti monte mo ho na monyɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ kronkron; enti mommma mo kra ho nnkum, adeɛ biara a ɛwea a ɛtwe ne ho ase no ho.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Na mene AWURADE a meyii mo Misraim asase so sɛ mɛyɛ mo Nyankopɔn no; enti monyɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔmfa mpae adeɛ a ɛho nteɛ ne deɛ ɛho teɛ mu, ne mmoa a wɔdie ne mmoa a wɔnnie mu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ ɔbaa bi nyinsɛn na ɔwo ɔbabanin a, ne ho nte nnanson te sɛ ne nsabuo nna mu a ne ho nteɛ no.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Na da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, wɔntwa abɔfra no twetia.

english_verse: but her loss of blood keeps her from being completely clean for another
translation_verse: Na ɔntena tannan mu adaduasa nnammiɛnsa n’ahodwira mogya mu; ɔnnka ade kronkron biara na ɔmmma kronkronbea hɔ kɔsi sɛ n’ahodwira nna bɛwie duro.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔwo ɔbaa a, ne ho nte nnawɔtwe mmienu sɛ ne nsabuo nna mu, na ɔntena tannan mu adaduosia nnansia n’ahodwira mogya mu.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ahodwira nna no wie du ma ɔbabanin anaa ɔbabaa no a, ɔmfa odwanten ba a wadi afe a wɔde bɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aborɔnoma ba anaa anyankuku a wɔde bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano mmɛma ɔsɔfoɔ no.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mmra AWURADE anim, na ɔmpata mma no, na ne ho nte mfiri ne mogyaguo no mu. Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma ɔbaa a wawo ɔbabarima anaa ɔbabaa no.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne nsa anso odwan ba so a, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmra mmɛma, baako nyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na baako nso nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, na ne ho nte.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: Sɛ biribi ba onipa honam wedeɛ mu, sɛ nsoa oo, ntwintwameeɛ oo, ntampeɛ oo, na ɛdidi ne honam wedeɛ mu yɛ kwata ntotɔeɛ a, wɔmfa no mmrɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron anaa ne mma, asɔfoɔ no mu baako.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ honam wedeɛ mu ntotɔeɛ no, na ntotɔeɛ no so nwi adane fitaa, na ntotɔeɛ no atotɔ mu asene ne honam wedeɛ no a, ɛyɛ kwata ntotɔeɛ; na ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ no a, ɔmmu no deɛ ne ho nteɛ.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛyɛ ne honam wedeɛ mu ntampeɛ fitaa, na sɛ wɔhwɛ na ɛntotɔ mu nsene ne wedeɛ no, na ɛso nwi nnanee fitaa a, ɛnneɛ, ɔsɔfoɔ no nto ɔyarefoɔ no mu nnanson.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɔsɔfoɔ no nhwɛ, na sɛ ɔhunu sɛ ntotɔeɛ no te sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ n’ani so na ɛnyerɛɛ ne wedeɛ mu a, ɔsɔfoɔ no nto no mu nnanson bio.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ no da a ɛtɔ so nson no bio na sɛ ntotɔeɛ no ani adum na ɛntrɛɛ ne wedeɛ mu a, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no sɛ deɛ ne ho teɛ, ɛyɛ ntwintwameeɛ; na ɔnsi n’atadeɛ na ne ho ate.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na hwɛ, ntwintwameeɛ no ayerɛ wedeɛ no mu a, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho nteɛ; ɛyɛ kwata.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Sɛ kwata ntotɔeɛ wɔ onipa bi ho a, wɔmfa no mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na hwɛ, nsoa fitaa bi wɔ wedeɛ no mu a adane nwi no fitaa, na ɛnam mono repu nsoaeɛ no mu a,

english_verse: he will say, “This is leprosy. You are unclean and must stay away from everyone else.”
translation_verse: ɛyɛ kwata dada a ɛwɔ ne honam wedeɛ mu, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no sɛ ne ho nte. Ɔnnto no mu; na ne ho nte.

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na kwata no akata ne honam nyinaa so a, ɔmmu ɔyarefoɔ no sɛ ne ho te; ne ho nyinaa adane fitaa a, ne ho te.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ ɛnam mono no a, ɔmmu no deɛ ne ho nteɛ; ɛnam mono no ho nte, ɛyɛ kwata.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na sɛ ntotɔeɛ no adane fitaa a, ɛnneɛ, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho teɛ; ne ho ate.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: na soa fitaa bi anaa ntampeɛ fitaa a ɛbereɛ ba mpɔmpɔ no ananmu a, wɔmma ɔsɔfoɔ no nhwɛ.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na sɛ ɛhɔ atotɔ mu asene wedeɛ no na emu nwi adane fitaa a, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho nteɛ; ɛyɛ kwata ntotɔeɛ, apue wɔ mpɔmpɔ no mu.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ na sɛ nwi fitaa bi nni mu, na ɛntotɔɔ mu nsenee wedeɛ no na ani dum a, ɔsɔfoɔ no nto no mu nnanson;

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: na sɛ ɛyerɛ wedeɛ no mu a, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho nteɛ: Ɛyɛ ntotɔeɛ.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ntampeɛ no te sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ na ɛnyerɛe a, ɛyɛ mpɔmpɔ no twa, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho teɛ.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Anaasɛ ogya kuro bi ba honam wedeɛ no mu, na ekuro no so bɔn repu yɛ ntampeɛ a ɛhoa fitaa na emu gyegyeɛ anaasɛ ɛhoa fitaa,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na sɛ ntampeɛ no mu nwi adane fitaa na wɔhwɛ a atotɔ mu asene wedeɛ no a, ɛyɛ kwata, na apue ogya kuro no mu, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho nteɛ: Ɛyɛ kwata ntotɔeɛ.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na sɛ enwi fitaa nni ntampeɛ no mu, na ɛntotɔɔ mu nsenee wedeɛ no, na ani dum a, ɔsɔfoɔ no nto no mu nnanson.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɔsɔfoɔ no hunu sɛ ayerɛ wedeɛ no mu a, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho nteɛ: Ɛyɛ kwata ntotɔeɛ.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ntampeɛ no te sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ na ɛnyerɛe wɔ wedeɛ no mu na ani dum a, ɛyɛ soa a ogya kuro no asoa, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho teɛ; na ɛyɛ ogya kuro no bɔn.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa bi, sɛ biribi tɔ n’atifi anaa ne bɔgyesɛ mu,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ ntotɔeɛ no, na sɛ atɔ mu asene wedeɛ no, na enwi kɔkɔɔ nhweanhweaa wɔ mu a, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no sɛdeɛ ne ho nteɛ; ɛyɛ ntutuiɛ, ɛyɛ etire anaa bɔgyesɛ mu kwata.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ ntutuiɛ ntotɔeɛ no, na sɛ ɛhɔ ntɔɔ mu nsenee wedeɛ no, na enwi tuntum nso nni mu a, ɔsɔfoɔ no nto deɛ ntutuiɛ atotɔ no no mu nnanson.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ ɔyarefoɔ no da a ɛtɔ so nson no, na sɛ ntutuiɛ no nyerɛe na enwi kɔkɔɔ mmaa mu, na ntutuiɛ no ntɔɔ mu nsenee wedeɛ no a,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ɔnyi ne ho nwi, na ɔnnyi ntutuiɛ no so, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nto deɛ ntutuiɛ ayɛ no no mu nnanson bio.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ ntutuiɛ no da a ɛtɔ so nson no, na sɛ ntutuiɛ no nyerɛɛ wedeɛ no mu na ɛhɔ ntɔɔ mu nsenee wedeɛ no a, ɛnneɛ, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu no deɛ ne ho teɛ; na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ne ho ate.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ no, na sɛ ntutuiɛ no ayerɛ wedeɛ no mu a, ɔsɔfoɔ no nnhwehwɛ enwi kɔkɔɔ; ne ho nte.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ntampeɛ fitaa ba ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa wedeɛ ani,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na sɛ ntampeɛ a ani dum fitaa wɔ wɔn honam wedeɛ mu a, ɛyɛ ɛyam a ayerɛ wedeɛ mu; ne ho te.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ n’apampam anim fam na apa a, ɔyɛ atipa; ne ho te.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na sɛ ntotɔeɛ fitaa a ɛbereɛ asoa n’atipa no anaa n’apampam paeɛ no mu a ɛte sɛ honam wedeɛ mu kwata a,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: Na ɔkwatani a yadeɛ no wɔ ne ho nsunsuane ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔmpɛsɛ ne ti, na ɔnkata ne soro anofafa, na ɔnteam sɛ: Me ho nte, me ho nte!

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Nna dodoɔ a yadeɛ no wɔ ne ho no, teɛ na ne ho nteɛ; ɔno nko na ɔntena, nsraban no akyi na ɔntena.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ, ɔsɔfoɔ no nhyɛ na wɔnsi adeɛ a ntotɔeɛ no wɔ mu no, na ɔnto mu nnanson bio.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Na ntotɔeɛ no sie akyiri no ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na sɛ ntotɔeɛ no ani nsakyerae na ɛnyerɛe nso a, ɛho nte, wɔmfa ogya nhye; ani akuku oo, akyire akuku oo, ɛyɛ nweweeɛ.

english_verse: But if the spot has faded after being washed, he will tear away the spot.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne sie akyiri no ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ, na sɛ ntotɔeɛ no ani dum a, ɔnte mfiri ntoma no anaa nsa anaa mfa no mu.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔhunu bio wɔ ntoma no mu wɔ nsa anaa mfa anaa nwoma adeɛ biara mu a, ɛyɛ kwata a ɛrepue, wɔmfa ogya nhye deɛ ntotɔeɛ no wɔ mu no.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Na ntoma no, mfa anaa nsa anaa nwoma adeɛ biara a wɔbɛsie na ntotɔeɛ no bɛfiri mu no, wɔnsi bio na ɛho ate.

english_verse: These are the rules for deciding if clothing is clean or unclean after a spot appears on it.
translation_verse: Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma kwata ntotɔeɛ, kuntutam anaa asaawatam anaa nsa anaa mfa anaa nwoma adeɛ biara mu, na wɔde abu no adeɛ a ɛho teɛ anaa adeɛ a ɛho nteɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: ɔsɔfoɔ no nhyɛ mma wɔmfa nnomaa a wɔn ho teɛ mmienu animono ne tweneduro dua ne koogyan ne adwera mma deɛ wɔrebɛte ne ho no mmra.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhyɛ mma wɔnkum nnomaa no mu baako, ayowa bi mu, mmasuo so.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Na anomaa nikanfoɔ no deɛ, ɔmfa no ne tweneduro dua no ne koogyan ne adwera no, na ɔmfa ne nyinaa ne anomaa nikanfoɔ no mmɔ anomaa a wɔaku no mmasuo soɔ no mogya mu,

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa mpete deɛ ɔbɛte ne ho afiri ne kwata ho no so mprɛnson, na ɔnte ne ho, na ɔnnyaa anomaa nikanfoɔ no mma no nkɔ wiram.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Na deɛ wɔate ne ho no nsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔnyi ne nwi nyinaa koraa, na ɔmfa nsuo nnware na ne ho ate; na ɛno akyiri no ɔmmra nsraban no mu, nanso ɔntena ne ntomadan akyi nnanson.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɔnyi ne ho nwi nyinaa, ne tiri ne ne bɔgyesɛ ne n’anintɔnnwi nyinaa na ɔnyie; na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ, na ɔmfa nsuo nnware ne honam, na ne ho ate.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: Na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa nnwanten mma mmienu a wɔdi mu, ne odwammaa bedeɛ baako a wadi afe a ɔdi mu, ne aduane afɔdeɛ esiam efa abupɛn du mu mmiɛnsa a wɔde ngo afɔre, ne ngo toa ma baako mmra.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔte ne ho no mfa ɔbarima a wɔrete ne ho no ne nnoɔma no mmɛgyina AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa nnwanten no mu baako mmra, sɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ ne ngo toa ma no, na ɔnhim no ohim afɔdeɛ, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: na ɔnkum odwanten ba no deɛ wɔkum bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ hɔ, deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ no nso yɛ asɔfoɔ no dea, te sɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa asodie ho afɔdeɛ mogya no bi nkeka deɛ wɔrete ne ho no aso nifa ne ne nsa nifa kokurobetie ne ne nan nifa kokurobetie ano.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ngo toa no mu bi nhwie ngu ɔno ara ne nsa benkum mu;

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa nifa mmɔ ngo a ɛwɔ ne nsa benkum mu no mu, na ɔmfa ne nsateaa nka ngo no bi mpete mprɛnson, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: na ngo a ɛbɛka ne nsam no, ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa bi nkeka deɛ wɔrete ne ho no aso nifa ne ne nsa nifa kokurobetie ne ne nan nifa kokurobetie ano, asodie ho afɔdeɛ mogya no so;

english_verse: If you are poor and cannot afford to offer this much, you may offer a ram as a sacrifice to make things right, together with
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔdi hia na ne nsa anso yeinom so a, ɛnneɛ ɔmfa odwanten ba baako mmɛyɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ nyɛ ohim afɔdeɛ mfa mpata mma no, ne aduane afɔdeɛ esiam olonka abupɛn du mu baako a wɔde ngo afɔre, ne ngo toa ma

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: ne anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu a ne nsa bɛso soɔ; baako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ na baako nyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ;

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: na n’ahodwira da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Na ɔnkum asodie ho afɔdeɛ dwanten ba no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa asodie ho afɔdeɛ mogya no bi nkeka deɛ wɔrete ne ho no aso nifa ne ne nsa nifa kokurobetie ne ne nan nifa kokurobetie ano;

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ngo no ngu ɔno ara ne nsa benkum mu,

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa nifa nka ngo a ɛwɔ ne nsa benkum mu no bi mpete mprɛnson, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ngo a ɛwɔ ne nsam no bi nkeka deɛ wɔrete ne ho no aso nifa ne ne nsa nifa kokurobetie ne ne nan nifa kokurobetie ano, deɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ no mogya no wɔ no;

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: adeɛ a ne nsa bɛso soɔ no mu baako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako nyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mpae aduane afɔdeɛ no so, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma deɛ wɔrete ne ho no, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma deɛ kwata atotɔ no a ne nsa nso n’ahodwira adeɛ soɔ no. Adan a wɔagu ho fi

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: Sɛ moduru Kanaan asase a mede merema mo sɛ monni soɔ no so, na sɛ mede kwata ntotɔeɛ metotɔ mo dibea asase no so fie bi ho a,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ efie no wura no mmra mmɛka nkyerɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no sɛ: Ɛyɛ me sɛ biribi a ɛte sɛ ntotɔeɛ wɔ me fie hɔ.

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no hwɛ ntotɔeɛ no, na sɛ ntotɔeɛ no wɔ efie no fasuo ho, nkekaeɛ apopobibire anaa kɔkɔɔ, na ani atotɔ mu asene ɔfasuo no a,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: ɔsɔfoɔ no mfiri efie no mu mmra ɛpono ano, na ɔnto efie no mu nnanson.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no ɔsɔfoɔ no sane ba, na ɔbɛhwɛ, na sɛ ntotɔeɛ no ayerɛ efie no fasuo ho a,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: na wɔnwewɛre efie no mu nhyia, na wɔmfa dɔteɛ a wɔwewɛreeɛ no nkɔgu kuro no akyi deɛ ɛhɔ nteɛ;

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: na wɔmfa aboɔ foforɔ nhyehyɛ aboɔ no ananmu, na wɔmfa dɔteɛ foforɔ mma efie no ho.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no ba na ɔbɛhwɛ, na sɛ ntotɔeɛ no ayerɛ efie no mu a, ɛyɛ efie no mu kwata a ɛsɛe adeɛ; ɛho nte.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Enti ɔnnwiri efie no ngu fam, n’aboɔ ne ne mpuna ne efie no ho dɔteɛ nyinaa, na ɔnsesa mfiri adi nkɔ kuro no akyi nkɔgu deɛ ɛhɔ nteɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔbɛkɔ efie no mu nna a wɔato mu nyinaa no, ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ,

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: na deɛ ɔda efie hɔ no nsi ne ntadeɛ, na deɛ ɔdidi fie hɔ no nsi ne ntadeɛ.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ efie no ho ma akyi ɔsɔfoɔ no ba bɛhwɛ, na sɛ ntotɔeɛ no nyerɛɛ efie no mu a, ɛnneɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu efie no sɛ ɛho te, ɛfiri sɛ ntotɔeɛ no asa.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Na ɔnkum nnomaa no mu baako ayowa mu, mmasuo so,

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: na ɔnnyaa anomaa animono no kuro no akyi mma no nkɔ wiram, na ɔmpata mma efie no, na ɛho ate.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛnkyerɛkyerɛ berɛ a adeɛ ho nteɛ ne berɛ a ɛho teɛ mu; yei ne kwata ho mmara.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: Monkasa nkyerɛ Israelfoɔ no nse wɔn sɛ: Ɔbarima biara sɛ ne ho sene gu a, n’ahosene no nti ne ho nte.

english_verse: Anything that he rests on or sits on is also unclean,
translation_verse: Mpa biara a deɛ ne ho sene no bɛda so no ho nte, na adeɛ biara a ɔbɛtena soɔ no ho nte.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔka deɛ ne ho sene no honam no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ;

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: na sɛ deɛ ne ho sene no to ntasuo gu deɛ ne ho teɛ so a, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔsoa saa adeɛ no nsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔhosenefoɔ no amfa nsuo anhohoro ne nsa na ɔbɛka no no, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Na kukuo a ɔhosenefoɔ no bɛka no, wɔmmɔ, na dua adeɛ biara deɛ, wɔmfa nsuo nhohoro ho.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔhosenefoɔ no ho te firi n’ahosene no mu a, ɔnkan nnanson ngu n’ahofire so, na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ, na ɔmfa mmasuo nnware ne honam, na ne ho ate.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmra AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na ɔmfa mma ɔsɔfoɔ no.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa baako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako no nso ɔmfa nyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no AWURADE anim mfiri n’ahosene no mu.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima bi ahoba firi ne mu a, ɔmfa nsuo nnware ne honam nyinaa, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na ntoma biara anaa nwoma biara a ahoba bɛgu mu no, wɔmfa nsuo nsi, na ɛho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa da na ahoba gu no a, wɔmfa nsuo nnware na wɔn ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ. Mmaa ahosene fi

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na ɔbaa sɛ ne ho sene na mogya firi ne honam mu gu a, ɔntena ne nsabuo no mu nnanson, na obiara a ɔka no no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: na sɛ biribi wɔ mpa no so anaasɛ adeɛ a watena soɔ no so a, obi ka a, ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima ne no da na ne nsabuo adeɛ no bi ka ne ho a, ne ho nte nnanson, na ne mpa a ɔda soɔ no nyinaa ho nte.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Na ɔbaa sɛ ne ho sene mogya gu nna pii, na ɛnyɛ ne nsabuo berɛ, anaasɛ ne ho sene tra ne nsabuo a, ɛnneɛ n’ahosene a ɛho nteɛ nna no nyinaa ne ho nte te sɛ ne nsabuo nna mu.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Ne mpa a ɔda soɔ biara n’ahosene nna nyinaa mu no nyɛ no sɛ ne nsabuo mpa, na adeɛ biara a ɔtena soɔ no ho nte sɛ ne nsabuo mu deɛ no.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔka nnoɔma yi no ho nte, na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne ho te firi n’ahosene no mu a, ɔnkan nnanson mfa, na ɛno akyiri no ne ho ate.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako no ɔmfa mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, AWURADE anim, mfiri n’ahosene a ɛho nteɛ no mu.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Na momma Israelfoɔ no nyi wɔn ho mfiri wɔn fi mu, na wɔanwuwu wɔn fi mu sɛ wɔrekɔgu me tenabea a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no ho fi.

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ wo nua Aaron sɛ ɔnnhyɛne kronkronbea hɔ nnkɔ ntwamutam no akyi mpata adwa a ɛwɔ adaka no soɔ no anim berɛ nyinaa mu, na wanwu, ɛfiri sɛ mununkum no mu na meyi me ho mekyerɛ, mpata adwa no so.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Na yei ne deɛ Aaron mfa nhyɛne kronkronbea hɔ: Nantwininiburuwa a wɔde bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne odwennini a wɔde bɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: Ɔnhyɛ nwera atadeɛ kronkron no, na nwera twakoto nkata ne ho, na nwera aboomu no mmɔ n’asene, na ɔmmɔ nwera abotitene no, yei ne ntade kronkron no; ɔmfa nsuo nnware ne ho ansa na wahyɛ.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Na ɔnnye Israel asafo no hɔ mpapo mmienu, na wɔmfa mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, ne odwennini baako, na wɔmfa mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mfa bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwinini a ɛyɛ ne deɛ no mmra, na ɔmfa mpata mma ɔno ara ne ho ne ne fie.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mpapo mmienu no mmɛgyina AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ntwe mpapo mmienu no so tonto, AWURADE tonto baako ne Asasel tonto baako.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Na Aaron mfa ɔpapo a AWURADE tonto bɔɔ no no mmra mmɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Na ɔpapo a Asasel tonto bɔɔ no no, ɔmfa no animono nnyina AWURADE anim mfa mpata mma no na wɔnkɔgya no nkɔ serɛ so mma Asasel.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mfa bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwinini a ɛyɛ ne deɛ no mmra mfa mpata mma ɔno ara ne ho ne ne fie, na ɔnkum bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwinini a ɛyɛ ne deɛ no.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa ogyasɔ adeɛ nnyansramma ma mfiri afɔrebukyia no so, AWURADE anim, ne aduhwam a wɔasi no fekɔfekɔ ne nsa mmienu ma, na ɔmfa nkɔ ntwamutam no akyi.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa aduhwam no ngu ogya no so, AWURADE anim, na aduhwam no wisie nkata mpata adwa a ɛwɔ Adanseɛ no soɔ no ho, na wanwu.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa nantwinini no mogya no bi, na ɔmfa ne nsateaa nka mpete mpata adwa no so anim fam, na ɔmfa ne nsateaa nka mogya no bi mpete mpata adwa no anim hɔ mprɛ nson.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Na ɔnkum bɔne ho afɔdeɛ papo a ɔyɛ ɔman no deɛ no, na ɔmfa ne mogya nkɔ ntwamutam no akyi, na ɔmfa mogya no nyɛ sɛdeɛ ɔde nantwinini no mogya no yɛeɛ no, na ɔmfa mpete mpata adwa no so ne mpata adwa no anim,

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: na ɔmpata mma kronkronbea no, Israelfoɔ no afideɛ, ne wɔn mmara a wɔto, wɔn bɔne nyinaa nti; na saa na ɔnyɛ mma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan a ɛsi wɔn mu ɛsiane wɔn afideɛ no nti.

english_verse: Only you are allowed in the sacred tent from the time you enter until the time you come out.
translation_verse: Na onipa biara nntena ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, berɛ a ɔhyɛne hɔ kɔpata kronkronbea no mu, kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛfiri adie a wapata ama ɔno ara ne ne fie ne Israelfoɔ asafo nyinaa.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfiri adi mmra afɔrebukyia a ɛsi AWURADE anim no ho, na ɔmpata mma no, na ɔmfa nantwinini no mogya no bi ne ɔpapo no mogya no bi nkeka afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho nhyia,

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsateaa nka mogya no bi mpete so mprɛ nson, na ɔnte ho nyɛ no kronkron mfiri Israelfoɔ no afideɛ mu.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔpata ma kronkronbea ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ne afɔrebukyia no wie a, ɔmfa ɔpapo animono no mmra.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mfa ne nsa mmienu ngu ɔpapo animono no atifi, na ɔnka Israelfoɔ no mfomsoɔ nyinaa ne wɔn mmarato nyinaa sɛdeɛ wɔn bɔne teɛ no ɔmfa ngu ɔpapo no atifi, na ɔmma ɔbarima bi a ɔwɔ hɔ nkɔgyaa no mma no nkɔ ɛserɛ so,

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: na ɔpapo no nsoa wɔn mfomsoɔ nyinaa mfa nkɔ asase fo so.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa nsuo nnware ne ho deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, na ɔnhyɛ ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfiri adi nkɔbɔ ne hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɔman no hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔmpata mma ɔno ara ne ho ne ɔman no.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔnhye bɔne ho afɔdeɛ sradeɛ no afɔrebukyia no so.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔde ɔpapo no kɔ kɔgyaa no maa Asasel no nsi ne ntadeɛ, na ɔmfa nsuo nnware ne ho, na ɛno akyi ansa na ɔmmra nsraban no mu.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Na bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwinini ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ papo a wɔde wɔn mogya kɔɔ kronkronbea hɔ kɔpataeɛ no, wɔmfa wɔn mfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi, na wɔmfa ogya nhye wɔn nwoma ne wɔn nam ne wɔn agyanan.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔkɔ kɔhyeeɛ no nsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware ne ho, na ɛno akyi ansa na waba nsraban no mu.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Na yei nyɛ mo daa ahyɛdeɛ: Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so du no, mommrɛ mo ho ase, kuromani oo, ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔbɛsoɛ mo mu oo, monnyɛ adwuma biara.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Na da no na wɔpata ma mo de dwira mo, na mo ho ate afiri mo bɔne nyinaa mu, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ mo ɔhome mu homeda na mommrɛ mo ho ase: Ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Na mpata no, ɔsɔfoɔ a wɔasra no ngo a wɔde ahyɛ ne nsa sɛ ɔnni sɔfoɔ nsi n’agya ananmu no na ɔmpata, na ɔnhyɛ nwera ntadeɛ no, ntade kronkron no,

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: na ɔmpata mma kronkronbea kronkron no, na ɔmpata mma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ne afɔrebukyia no, na ɔmpata mma ɔsɔfoɔ no ne ɔman asafo mu no nyinaa.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na yei nyɛ mo daa ahyɛdeɛ na wɔde apata ama Israelfoɔ afiri wɔn bɔne nyinaa mu prɛko daa afirinhyia. Na Mose yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa mma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano mmɛyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ mma AWURADE wɔ tenabea anim no, wɔbɛbu mogya agu ne so, waka mogya agu, na wɔbɛtwa saa onipa no afiri ne man mu atwene,

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: na ama Israelfoɔ de wɔn afɔdeɛ a wɔkum wɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no abrɛ asɔfoɔ no ama wɔde abrɛ AWURADE wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na wɔakum abɔ AWURADE asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mogya no mpete AWURADE afɔrebukyia no so, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na ɔnhye sradeɛ no na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Na wɔnnkum wɔn afɔrebɔdeɛ mmma mpapo abosom a wɔdi wɔn akyiri adwamammɔ soɔ no bio. Na ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mma wɔn, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: na wamfa amma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano ammɛbɔ amma AWURADE no, wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu atwene.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie anaa ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛsoɛ wɔn mu no mu a ɔdi mogya biara no, mɛma m’ani asa saa ɔkra a ɔdi mogya no, na matwa no afiri ne man mu atwene.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ ɔhonam biara nkwa wɔ mogya no mu, na mede ama mo, afɔrebukyia no so sɛ wɔmfa mpata mma mo ho; na mogya na wɔde pata ma ɔkra.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔfiri Israel mma ne ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛsoɛ mo mu no a wɔyɛ ha kum aboa anaa anomaa a wɔdie no, wɔnhwie ne mogya ngu na wɔmfa dɔteɛ nkata so.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Na ɔhonam nyinaa deɛ, ne mogya ne ne nkwa, enti na mese Israelfoɔ sɛ: Monnni nam biara mogya, ɛfiri sɛ honam nyinaa nkwa ne ne mogya; obiara a ɔdie no, wɔbɛtwa no atwene.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔdi deɛ wawuo anaasɛ deɛ wɔatete no, kuromani oo, ɔhɔhoɔ oo, ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ ansa na ne ho ate;

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: na sɛ wansi ne ntadeɛ na wannware ne ho a, ɛnneɛ ɔnsoa ne mmusuo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Misraim asase a motenaa soɔ no so nneyɛɛ deɛ, monnyɛ. Na Kanaan asase a mede mo rekɔ soɔ no so nneyɛɛ nso, monnyɛ, na monnni wɔn ahyɛdeɛ so.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: M’atemmudeɛ na monyɛ, na monkora m’ahyɛdeɛ sɛ mobɛdi soɔ.

english_verse: Obey them and you will live. I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. Na monkora m’ahyɛdeɛ ne m’atemmudeɛ a onipa a ɔyɛ no bɛnya mu nkwa no. Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: Obiara nnkɔ ne bogya biara a ɔyɛ ne honam no ho nnkɔyi n’adagya so. Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: especially your own mother. This would disgrace your father.
translation_verse: Nyi w’agya anaa wo na adagya so; wo na ne no, nyi n’adagya so.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Nyi w’agya yere adagya so; w’agya adagya ne no.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: Wo nuabaa a ɔyɛ w’agya ba anaa wo na ba no, wɔwoo no efie oo, wɔwoo no baabi oo, nyi wɔn adagya so.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: Wo babanin babaa anaa wo babaa babaa, nyi wɔn adagya so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ w’adagya.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Nyi wo na nuabaa adagya so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ wo na honam.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Nyi w’agya nuabarima adagya so nkɔ ne yere ho; wo na kumaa ne no.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your daughter-in-law
translation_verse: Nyi w’ase adagya so; wo babarima yere ne no, nyi n’adagya so.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Nyi ɔbaa bi ne ne ba adagya so; mfa ne babanin babaa anaa ne babaa babaa nyi wɔn adagya so; ne honam ne wɔn; ɛyɛ abusudeɛ.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Na mfa ɔbaa ne ne nua nware sɛ wobɛma wɔatwe kora, sɛ ɔda so te aseɛ no, wobɛyi n’adagya so aka ne ho.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Na nkɔ ɔbaa a ne nsabuo mu ne ho nteeɛ no ho nkɔyi n’adagya so.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Na wo ne wo yɔnko yere nnna, na mfa wo ho nsuo mma no mfa ngu wo ne no ho fi.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Na mfa w’asefoɔ mu bi mmɔ afɔdeɛ mmma Molek, na ngu wo Nyankopɔn din ho fi; mene AWURADE.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Na wo ne ɔbarima nnna ɔbaa nna; ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Mommfa nnoɔma yi biara nngu mo ho fi, ɛfiri sɛ yeinom nyinaa na amanaman a merebɛtu wɔn afiri mo anim yi de agu wɔn ho fi,

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: na asase no so agu fi, enti na meretua ɛso amumuyɛ no so ka, na asase no afe ɛsotefoɔ no agu.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi nyinaa na asase no sofoɔ a wɔdi mo anim no ayɛ, na asase no so agu fi.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Na asase no amfe mo angu sɛ moagu ho fi, sɛdeɛ ɛfee amanaman a wɔdii mo anim no guiɛ no.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Enti monhwɛ m’ahwɛdeɛ, na moanyɛ ahyɛdeɛ a wɔkyire a wɔdii mo anim yɛeɛ no amfa angu mo ho fi: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Monyɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ me, AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn, meyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Monnnane mo ho nnkɔ abosonhuhuo no nkyɛn, na monnyɛ ahoni a wɔaguo te sɛ anyame mmfa: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mobɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE a, mommɔ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma moasɔ ani:

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Da a mokum no ara na wɔnnie, ne n’adekyeeɛ, na deɛ ɛbɛka akɔduru nnansa no, wɔmfa ogya nhye.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔdi no da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no a, ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ, ɛnsɔ ani;

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: na deɛ ɔdie no bɛsoa ne mmusuo, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE akronkronneɛ na wagu ho fi, na wɔbɛtwa saa ɔkra no afiri ne man mu atwene.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Na sɛ motwa mo asase so nnɔbaeɛ a, nwie wo nkwanseɛ deɛ no twa, na nni w’afuomdeɛ no mu mpɛpɛ;

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: na wo bobe turo nso, nni mu mpɛpɛ, na wo turo mu aba a ɛgugu fam no, ntase; gya ma ohiani ne ɔhɔhoɔ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Mommmɔ korɔno, na monnni kusum, na obiara nntwa ne yɔnko nkontompo.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Na monnka me din ho ntam atorɔ mu, na woanhura wo Nyankopɔn din ho: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Nni wo yɔnko amim na ntwa no dwo. Mma wo paani akatua nnka wo nkyɛn mma adeɛ nnkye.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Nnome ɔsotifoɔ na mfa suntidua nto onifirani anim, na suro Onyankopɔn: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: Monntwa atemmuo mu nkontompo. Nhwɛ mmɔborɔni anim, na nyɛ deɛ ɛbɛsɔ otumfoɔ ani; tenenee mu na bu wo yɔnko atɛn.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Nkyini wo nkurɔfoɔ mu nni nsekuro; nsɔre ntia wo yɔnko mogya. Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: Ntane wo nua w’akoma mu; ka na ka wo yɔnko anim, na woansoa ne ho bɔne.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Ntɔ were na nnya wo nkurɔfoɔ mu biara ho menasepɔ, na dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Monni m’ahyɛdeɛ so. Mma w’afieboa nnni afrafra mmforo wɔn ho; w’afuo nso, mfa adeɛ mfrafra nnua mu, na mma ntoma ahodoɔ mmienu nsasaawa nnka wo ho.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbarima bi ne ɔbaa da na ɔde ne ho ka no, na ɔbaa no yɛ afenaa a wɔde no ama obi awareɛ, na gyeɛ na wɔnnya nnyee no anaasɛ wɔnnya mfaa ne ho nkyɛɛ no a, wɔmpeepee mu ntwe wɔn aso, na wɔnnku wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnne ne ho.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa asodie ho afɔdeɛ dwennini no mpata mma no, AWURADE anim, bɔne a wayɛ no nti, na wɔde ne bɔne a wayɛ no akyɛ no.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Na sɛ moduru asase no so na motɛ dua biara a wɔdie a, mommu n’aba no sɛ momonotodeɛ; mfeɛ mmiɛnsa na ɛnyɛ mo momonotodeɛ, wɔnnni;

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: na afe a ɛtɔ so nnan no, ɛso aba nyinaa nyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE ayeyie;

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: na afe a ɛtɔ so nnum no, monni n’aba, na ne nnɔbaeɛ nkɔ so nnɔɔso mma mo: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Mommfa mogya nnka biribi ho nnni. Monnni adebisasɛm na monngoro abayigorɔ.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Mommotabota mo ho mmma awufoɔ, na monnkurukyire mo ho atwerɛ biara: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: Nhura wo babaa ho mma no mmmɔ adwaman, na asase no ammɔ adwaman, na mmusuo anyɛ asase no so ma.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Monni me home nna na monsuro me kronkronbea no: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Monnnane mo ho nnkɔ ɔdebisafoɔ nkyɛn, na monnhwehwɛ adunsinfoɔ akyiri kwan mmfa nngu mo ho fi wɔ wɔn ho: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Fa obuo ma ɔpanin, aane di akɔkoraa ni, na suro wo Nyankopɔn: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ bi bɛsoɛ mo asase so a, monnhyɛ ne so.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛtena mo mu nyɛ mo sɛ mo kuromani bi, na dɔ no sɛ wo ho, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ Misraim asase so ahɔhoɔ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: nsania tee, abrammoɔ tee, efa tee ne susutoa tee na monkura: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a meyii mo firii Misraim asase soɔ no.

english_verse: and I command you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Na monni m’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa ne m’atemmudeɛ nyinaa so nyɛ: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Obiara a ɔfiri Israelfoɔ anaa ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛtena Israel mu no mu a ɔde ne mma mu bi ma Molek no, kum na wɔnku no; asase no sofoɔ nsi no aboɔ.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Na me nso mɛma m’ani asa onipa no, na matwa no afiri ne man mu atwene, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔde ne mma mu bi ama Molek de agu me kronkronbea no ho fi na wahura me din kronkron no ho.

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: me deɛ, mɛma m’ani asa onipa no ne n’abusua, na mɛtwa ɔno ne wɔn a wɔdi n’akyire adwamammɔ kwan soɔ na wɔdi Molek akyire bɔ adwaman no nyinaa afiri wɔn man mu agu.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔdane ne ho kɔ adebisafoɔ anaa adunsinfoɔ nkyɛn kɔdi wɔn akyi adwamammɔ kwan soɔ no, mɛma m’ani asa saa onipa no, na mɛtwa no afiri ne man mu atwene.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Enti monte mo ho na monyɛ kronkron, na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Na monni m’ahyɛdeɛ so na monyɛ: Mene AWURADE a ɔyɛ mo kronkron no.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Sɛ obiara dome n’agya anaa ne na a, kum na wɔnku no; wadome n’agya ne ne na, ne mogya gu n’atifi.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima a ɔfa ɔbarima bi yere na ɔne ne yɔnko yere sɛe awadeɛ no, kum na wɔnkum ɔbarima ne ɔbaa awaresɛefoɔ no.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne n’agya yere da no, wayi n’agya adagya so; kum na wɔnkum wɔn baanu nyinaa; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne n’ase a ɔyɛ ne ba yere da no, kum na wɔnkum wɔn baanu nyinaa; wɔayɛ akyiwadeɛ. Wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbarima bi da ɔbaa nna no, wɔn baanu ayɛ akyiwadeɛ, kum na wɔnku wɔn; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbarima bi fa ɔbaa ne ne na nyinaa a, ɛyɛ abusudeɛ. Wɔmfa ogya nhye ɔno ne wɔn nyinaa, na abusudeɛ antena mo mu.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbaa a ɔkɔ aboa biara ho kɔda hɔ ma no no, kum ɔbaa no ne aboa no; kum na wɔnku wɔn; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔfa ne nuabaa a ɔyɛ n’agya ba anaa ne na ba na ɔhunu n’adagya na ɔbaa no nso hunu n’adagya no, ɛyɛ animguasedeɛ, na wɔntwitwa wɔn ngu, wɔn man mma anim; wayi ne nuabaa adagya so; ɔnsoa ne mmusuo.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbaa a wabu ne nsa da na ɔyi n’adagya soɔ na ɔbue n’abura ano, na ɔno nso yi ne mogya abura soɔ no, wɔntwitwa wɔn baanu nyinaa mfiri wɔn man mu ngu.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Na nyi wo na nuabaa anaa w’agya nuabaa adagya so, ɛfiri sɛ wayi ne bogya adagya so; wɔnsoa wɔn mmusuo.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne n’agya nua yere da, wayi n’agya nua adagya so, wɔnsoa wɔn bɔne, wɔrenwo mma na wɔawu.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Na obi fa ne nua yere ware a, ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛho nteɛ; wayi ne nua adagya so, wɔrennya ɔba.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Enti monni m’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa ne m’atemmudeɛ nyinaa so na monyɛ, na asase a mede mo rekɔ akɔtena soɔ no amfe mo angu.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Na mommfa aman a merebɛtu wɔn mo anim ho ahyɛdeɛ so; na wɔayɛ yeinom nyinaa na wɔn ho ayɛ me nwunu;

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: na mese mo sɛ: Mo na monni wɔn asase soɔ, na mede mema mo sɛ momfa, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ. Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a mayi mo afiri amanaman mu no.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Na monyɛ kronkron mma me, ɛfiri sɛ me AWURADE, meyɛ kronkron. Na mayi mo afiri aman mu sɛ mommɛyɛ me deɛ.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa a adebisa anaa akɔm honhom wɔ ne mu no, kum na wɔnku wɔn; wɔnsi wɔn aboɔ; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo mu biara nngu ne ho fi efunu bi ho ne man mu,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: ne ne nuabaa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu a ɔbɛn no a ɔnnya nnyaa kunu, ɔno ho na ɔmma ne ho nkum.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ mu nipa titire nti, ɔnngu ne ho fi, nanso ɔnnhura ne ho.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Wɔnnyi wɔn mpampam na wɔnnwɛre wɔn bɔgyesɛ ano, na wɔmmmotabota wɔn honam mu.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Wɔnyɛ kronkron mma wɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔnnhura wɔn Nyankopɔn din ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔde AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ, wɔn Nyankopɔn aduane no ba; enti wɔnyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Wɔnnware ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ bi anaa deɛ ne ho ahura, nanso wɔnnware ɔbaa a ne kunu ako no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ kronkron ma ne Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Na bu no kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ wo Nyankopɔn aduane na ɔde ba; ɔnyɛ onipa kronkron mma wo, ɛfiri sɛ kronkron ne me AWURADE a ɔyɛ mo kronkron no.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ babaa firi aseɛ bɔ adwaman a, wahura n’agya ho, wɔmfa ogya nhye no.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: Na ne nuanom mu sɔfo panin a wɔahwie sra ngo agu n’atifi na wɔde ahyɛ ne nsam sɛ ɔnhyɛ ntadeɛ no, ɔmmpɛsɛ ne ti na ɔnnsunsuane ne ntadeɛ mu,

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: na ɔnnkɔ efunu biara ho, n’agya ne ne na ho mpo ɔmmma ne ho nnkum.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmfiri kronkronbea hɔ, na ɔnnhura ne Nyankopɔn kronkronbea ho, ɛfiri sɛ ne Nyankopɔn sra ngo no wɔ n’atifi: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Na ɔno deɛ, ɔbaabunu na ɔnwareɛ;

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: okunafoɔ ne deɛ wɔako no ne deɛ ne ho ahura ne odwamamfoɔ deɛ, ɔnnware yeinom mu biara, na mmom ne man mu baabunu na ɔnwareɛ.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Na ɔnnhura n’asefoɔ ho ne man mu: Na mene AWURADE a meyɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: na obiara a ɔdi dɛm no mmmɛn, onifirani oo, apakye oo, hwento oo, deɛ ne honam biribi boro so oo,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: deɛ ne nan anaa ne nsa abu oo,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: afu oo, epira oo, deɛ ɛtɛ si n’ani soɔ oo, deɛ ɔyare ntwom oo, ogyatɔni oo, deɛ ne hwewa nnwoa abobɔ oo,

english_verse: They may eat the food offerings presented to me,
translation_verse: Ne Nyankopɔn aduane, akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ɛne akronkronneɛ no deɛ, ɔnni bi.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Ntwamutam no ho nko na ɔmmma, na afɔrebukyia no ho na ɔnntwe mmpini, ɛfiri sɛ ɛdɛm wɔ ne ho: Na wanhura m’akronkronneɛ no ho, ɛfiri sɛ mene AWURADE a meyɛ wɔn kronkron.

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma sɛ wɔnte wɔn ho mfiri Israelfoɔ akronkronneɛ ho, na wɔnnhura me din kronkron no ho, adeɛ a wɔyɛ no kronkron ma me no mu: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu barima biara a ɔfiri mo asefoɔ nyinaa mu a ɔba akronkronneɛ a Israelfoɔ ayɛ no kronkron ama AWURADE na ne fi wɔ ne soɔ no, wɔbɛtwa saa ɔkra no afiri m’anim atwene: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Aaron asefoɔ mu barima biara a ɔyɛ ɔkwatani anaa deɛ ne ho sene no nnni akronkronneɛ no bi kɔsi sɛ ne ho bɛteɛ; na deɛ ɔka adeɛ a efunu agu ɛho fi anaa obi a ne ho nsuo afiri ne mu,

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: anaa obi a ɔka adeɛ biara a ɛwea a ɛmma ne ho nteɛ anaa ɔka onipa biara a ne ho wɔ fi no, ho nte;

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Na sɛ owia kɔtɔ a, ne ho te, ɛno akyiri ansa na ɔnni akronkronneɛ no bie, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ n’aduane.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Aboa funu anaa deɛ wɔatete ne mu no, ɔnnni mmfa nngu ne ho fi: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Na wɔnhwɛ m’ahwɛdeɛ na wɔansoa ɛho bɔne, na sɛ wɔhura ho a, wɔanwuwu: Mene AWURADE a meyɛ wɔn kronkron no.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔhoɔ biara nnni akronkronneɛ no bi, na deɛ wabɛtena ɔsɔfoɔ bi nkyɛn anaa ɔpaani nnni akronkronneɛ no bi.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ bi de ne sika tɔ onipa bi a, ɔno deɛ, ɔnni bi, ɛne deɛ wɔwoo no ne fie, wɔn na wɔnni n’aduane no bie.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ babaa bi kɔware ɔhɔhoɔ bi a, ɔnnni akronkronneɛ mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ no bi.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ babaa yi yɛ okunafoɔ anaasɛ wɔako no, na ɔnni ba, na ɔsane ba n’agya fie sɛ ne mmɔfraase a, ɔnni n’agya aduane no bi; na ɔhɔhoɔ biara deɛ, ɔnnni bi.

english_verse: and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi anhyɛda, na ɔdi akronkronneɛ no bi a, ɔmfa n’abupɛn nnum mu baako mpae so, na ɔnnane akronkronneɛ no mma ɔsɔfoɔ no.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: adeɛ biara a ɛdɛm wɔ ne ho no, mommfa mmma, ɛfiri sɛ ɛrensɔ ani mma mo.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na wɔnnhura Israelfoɔ no akronkronneɛ a wɔde bɔ afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE no ho,

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: na wɔmmma wɔnnsoa asodie bɔne bi wɔn akronkronneɛ no die mu, ɛfiri sɛ mene AWURADE a ɔyɛ wɔn kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma ne Israelfoɔ no nyinaa na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Obiara a ɔfiri Israel fie anaa Israel mu ahɔhoɔ mu a ɔde n’ayɛyɛdeɛ bɛba, wɔn bɔhyɛ adeɛ biara anaa wɔn ayamyi adeɛ biara a wɔde brɛ AWURADE abɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ;

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔde asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ bɛbrɛ AWURADE sɛ ɔde rewie n’aboadeɛ ma anaa ayamyi adeɛ a ɛfiri anantwie anaa nnwan mu no, ɔmma no nni mu, na ɛnsɔ ani; ɛnnni dɛm biara.

english_verse: Don't offer an animal that is blind or injured or that has an infection or a skin disease.
translation_verse: Deɛ n’ani afira anaasɛ wabubuo anaasɛ wapira anaasɛ watutu akuro anaasɛ ntwom anaa nsoa agu ne ho no, mommfa yeinom biara mmmrɛ AWURADE, na mommfa wɔn mu biara nnsɔ afɔrebukyia no so gya mmma AWURADE.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Na nantwie anaa odwan a ne ho biribi boro soɔ anaasɛ watɔ ape no, ayamyi afɔdeɛ deɛ, fa no bɔ, na aboadeɛ deɛ, ɛnsɔ ani.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Na deɛ wɔapɛkyɛ, wɔabɔ, wɔatu anaa wɔasa no no, mommfa mmmrɛ AWURADE, na mo asase so nso monnyɛ saa.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Na ɔnanani bi nsam nso monnnye yeinom mu biara mmfa mmmɛyɛ mo Nyankopɔn aduane, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ho aka, ɛdɛm wɔ wɔn ho, ɛrensɔ ani mma mo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: Nantwie, odwanten anaa abirekyie, sɛ wɔwo no a, ɔntena ne na ase nnanson, na ɛfiri da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe de rekorɔ no, wɔde yɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ ma AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ a ɛbɛsɔ ani.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Na monnkum nantwie anaa odwan ne ne ba nyinaa da koro.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mobɔ aseda afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE a, mommɔ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma moasɔ ani;

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: da no ara wɔnni; monnnya mu bi nnkɔsi anɔpa: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na monni me mmara nsɛm so na monyɛ: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: AWURADE afahyɛ ahodoɔ a mompae sɛ ɛnyɛ nhyia kronkron, m’afahyɛ nna no nie.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Nnansia na wɔnyɛ adwuma, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ home mu homeda, wɔnhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwuma biara, ɛyɛ AWURADE homeda mo tenabea nyinaa mu.

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Na ɛda no monnyɛ adwuma biara, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ mpata da a wɔpata ma mo, AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim.
