english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE nnanson; da a ɛtɔ so nson no monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moduru asase a mede merema mo no so na motwa ɛso nnɔbaeɛ a, momfa mo nnɔbaeɛ fi a ɛdi kan no mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ;

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ, esiam abupɛn du mu mmienu a wɔde ngo afɔre, na ɛnyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ne ɛho ahwiesa, bobesa susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Na monnni paanoo anaa ayuo a wɔato anaasɛ wɔasie kɔsi da no ara a mode mo Nyankopɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ reba no. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, mo tenabea nyinaa mu.

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Monnyɛ adwuma biara; ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, mo tenabea nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Na monkan nna mfa mfiri homeda no akyiri da, da a mode ohim fi no ba no ɛnyɛ nnawɔtwe nson pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Momfa ohim paanoo mmienu mfiri mo tenabea mmra; esiam abupɛn du mu mmienu mmɔreka na wɔmfa nto, na ɛnyɛ aduanekan mma AWURADE.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Na momfa nnwanten mma nson a wɔdi mu a wɔadi afe afe ne nantwiburuwa baako ne adwennini mmienu nka paanoo no ho; wɔnyɛ AWURADE ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ ne ahwiesa, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Na momfa ɔpapo baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne nnwanten mma mmienu a wɔadi afe afe mmɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhim wɔn ne aduanekan paanoo no ne nnwanten mma mmienu no na ɛnyɛ AWURADE anim ohim afɔdeɛ: Ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE na wɔmfa mma ɔsɔfoɔ no.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Na monhyia da no ara; ɛnyɛ mo nhyia kronkron, monnyɛ adwuma den biara. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mo tenabea nyinaa mu, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Na sɛ motwa mo asase so nnɔbaeɛ a, nwie w’afuo nkwanseɛ deɛ twa, na nni wo nnɔbaeɛ no mu mpɛpɛ: Gya ma ohiani ne ɔhɔhoɔ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson yi ara da a ɛtɔ so du ne mpata da; monhyia nhyia kronkron, na mommrɛ mo ho ase na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ home mu homeda ma mo, na mommrɛ mo ho ase bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nkron no anwummerɛ; monni mo homeda no mfiri anwummerɛ nkɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Na ɛda a ɛdi kan no, momfa nnua afɛfɛ so adeɛ, ɛberɛ ne nnua kusuu mman ne nsunoa nnua, na mo ani nnye AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim nnanson.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson yi da a ɛtɔ so dunum no yɛ asese afahyɛ nnanson ma AWURADE.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Nnanson na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE; da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no nyɛ mo nhyia kronkron, na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE; ɛyɛ afahyɛ awieeɛ, monnyɛ adwumaden biara.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: Yeinom ne AWURADE afahyɛ ahodoɔ a mompae sɛ wɔnhyia nhyia kronkron no, na wɔmfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne kum afɔdeɛ ne ahwiesa, ebiara wɔ ne da mu.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Ɛsono AWURADE home nna no, na ɛsono mo ayɛyɛdeɛ, na ɛsono mo aboadeɛ nyinaa, na ɛsono mo ayamyi adeɛ nyinaa a mode ma AWURADE no.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Nso bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so dunum a moreboa asase so nnɔbaeɛ ano no, monni AWURADE nnapɔnna nnanson: Da a ɛdi kan no yɛ homeda, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no yɛ homeda.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Na momfa nni nnapɔnna mma AWURADE, nnanson daa afe. Ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ; bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no mu na monni nnapɔnna yi.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Asese mu na montena nnanson, Israel man mma nyinaa ntena asese mu,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: na mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ahunu sɛ meyii Israelfoɔ firii Misraim asase soɔ no, asese mu na memaa wɔtenaeɛ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Na Mose paee AWURADE afahyɛ no kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ.

english_verse: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, or a tooth for a tooth.
translation_verse: Ebuo nsi ebuo ananmu, ani nsi ani ananmu, ɛse nsi ɛse ananmu; sɛdeɛ ɔpiraa onipa no, saa ara na wɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔkum afieboa no, ɔnsi ananmu, na deɛ ɔkum onipa no, wɔnku no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: Hyɛ Israelfoɔ ma wɔmmrɛ wo ngodua aba a wɔasie ngo korɔgyenn na wɔmfa nsɔ kanea no, na kanea no nsi so daa;

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Na fa esiam to taterɛ dummienu; olonka abupɛn du mu mmienu nyɛ taterɛ baako.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Na fa sesɛ so akyerɛpɛn mmienu, nsia nyɛ kyerɛpɛn baako, ɛpono a ɛho teɛ no so, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Na fa ohwamfufuo korɔgyenn toto akyerɛpɛn no so, na ɛnyɛ paanoo no so nkaeɛ adeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a wɔsɔ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Daa homeda na ɔnsiesie wɔ AWURADE anim daa, ɛyɛ Israelfoɔ fam daa apam;

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: na ɛnyɛ Aaron ne ne mma deɛ, na wɔnni wɔ deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron a ɛfiri AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ so ma no, ɛyɛ daa kyɛfa. Mmusuo ho asotwe

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Na Israelni baa no ba no kaa edin no ho abususɛm, na ɔdomee. Na wɔde no brɛɛ Mose. Nso ne na din de Selomit, Dibri ba a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu;

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: na wɔbɔɔ no dua mu sɛ ɛnkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛnya AWURADE anomu asɛm aka akyerɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: Fa deɛ wadome no firi adi kɔ nsraban no akyi, na wɔn a wɔteeɛ no nyinaa mfa wɔn nsa ngu n’atifi, na asafo no nyinaa nsi no aboɔ.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔka AWURADE din ho abususɛm no, kum na wɔnku no: Sie na asafo no nyinaa nsi no aboɔ; ɔhɔhoɔ oo, kuromani oo, sɛ ɔka edin no ho abususɛm a, wɔnku no.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi kum onipa biara a, kum na wɔnku no.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔkum afieboa no, ɔnsi ananmu, ɔkra nsi ɔkra ananmu.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔpira ne yɔnko nipa no, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔnyɛ no saa ara:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Atemmuo koro nna hɔ mma mo, ɔhɔhoɔ nyɛ sɛ okuromani. Na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ, na wɔde deɛ ɔdomeeɛ no firii adi kɔɔ nsraban no akyi kɔsii no aboɔ. Na Israelfoɔ yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no akyiri mfirinhyia ano teɛ na tɔ wo yɔnko nkyɛn adeɛ, sɛdeɛ nnɔbaeɛ mfirinhyia ano teɛ na ɔntɔn mma woɔ.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Sinai bepɔ so sɛ:

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ na saa afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum no nyɛ mma mo: Monnnua adeɛ na monntwa ne ntwakaeɛ a ɛfifiriiɛ, na monntete mo bobe homa a wɔampempane ho no so aba.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moduru asase a mede merema mo no so a, asase no nhome nni home afe mma AWURADE.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: na afe a ɛtɔ so nson no nyɛ ahomegyeɛ home mma asase no, ɛnyɛ home mma AWURADE: Nnua w’afuo mu adeɛ, na mpempane wo bobe turo mu nnua ho.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Wo ntwakaeɛ a ɛfifire no, ntwa, na wo bobehoma a woampempane no so esa esa no, ntete, ɛnyɛ ahomegyeɛ afe mma asase no.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: ne w’afieboa ne mmoa a wɔwɔ w’asase no soɔ, na ɛso nnɔbaeɛ no nyinaa nyɛ wɔn aduane.

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: anaasɛ n’agya nua anaa n’agya nua ba nnye no, anaasɛ n’abusua mu bogya bi nnye no, anaasɛ ne nsam wɔ biribi a, ɔnnye ne ho.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so du no, ma wɔnhyɛne totorobɛnto ntwa mu; mpata da no mu na momma wɔnhyɛne totorobɛnto ntwam mo asase nyinaa soɔ.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Na monyɛ afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum no afe kronkron, na mompae ahofadie, asase no so, mma ɛsotefoɔ nyinaa; ɛnyɛ mo ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ na mo mu biara nsane nkɔ mo agyapadeɛ mu, na obiara nsane nkɔ n’abusua mu.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Na ɛyɛ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma mo. Monni mfuo mu nnɔbaeɛ a ɛba afe no mu no.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: Ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe yi mu no, mo mu biara nsane nkɔ mo agyapadeɛ mu.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Mfeɛ no dɔɔso a, to ne boɔ so, na mfeɛ no sua a, te ne boɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ afe afe nnɔbaeɛ na ɔtɔn ma woɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Na mo mu biara nnni ne yɔnko amim, na suro wo Nyankopɔn: Na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Na asase no bɛba n’aduane na moadi amee, na moatena so dwoodwoo.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Na sɛ moka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛbɛdi afe a ɛtɔ so nson no mu? Hwɛ, yɛnnua na yɛntwa yɛn nnɔbaeɛ a,

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ, mɛhyɛ me nhyira mama mo afe a ɛtɔ so nsia no mu, na aba mfeɛ mmiɛnsa aduane;

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: na modua aduane afe a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no mu a, mobɛdi nnɔbaeɛ dada no akɔsi afe a ɛtɔ so nkron no mu. Mobɛdi aduane dada no akɔsi sɛ ne nnɔbaeɛ bɛba.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Na wɔnntɔn asase no korakora, ɛfiri sɛ asase no yɛ me dea na moyɛ me nkyɛn ahɔhoɔ ne atubrafoɔ.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Na asase a modi soɔ nyinaa, momma asase no gyeɛ ho kwan.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhia wo nua na ɔtɔn n’adeɛ bi a, ɛnneɛ ne gyefoɔ a ɔyɛ obusuani a ɔbɛn no mmra mmɛgye deɛ ne nua tɔneeɛ no.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi nni gyefoɔ na ne nsa aso na wanya deɛ ɛso gyeɛ a,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ, ɔmmu mfeɛ a ɔtɔneeɛ no ano na ɔnhyɛ deɛ ɛboro soɔ no ananmu mma deɛ ɔtɔn maa no no, na ɔnsane mmra n’adeɛ ho.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne nsa anso deɛ ɛso ananmuhyɛ no so a, ɛnneɛ, adeɛ a ɔtɔneeɛ no ntena deɛ ɔtɔeɛ no nsam nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no, na ɛfiri ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu no, ɔnsane mmra n’adeɛ ho.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi tɔn efie a wɔtena mu wɔ kuro a ɔfasuo wɔ ho mu a, wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan nkɔsi sɛ ne tɔn afe no duru soɔ; nna yi na ɔwɔ ne gyeɛ ho kwan.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wannye ma afe mu wie duru a, ɛnneɛ, efie a ɛwɔ kuro a ɔfasuo wɔ ho mu no nyɛ deɛ ɔtɔeɛ no dea korakora, n’awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu; ɔdenadeɛ no ntumi mmɛgye bio ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na adan a ɛwowɔ nkuraa a ɔfasuo nni ho aseɛ no deɛ, wɔmmu nka asase no so mfuo ho: Wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan; na wɔmmɛgye no ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɔ nkuro a ɛyɛ nkuro a wɔdi soɔ no mu afie deɛ, Lewifoɔ wɔ ne gyeɛ ho kwan daa.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Lewifoɔ mu bi annye ne fie a wɔatɔn a ɛwɔ kuro a ɔdi soɔ mu a, ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu no, ɔmfa n’adeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Lewifoɔ nkuro mu afie ne wɔn adeɛ a wɔdi soɔ Israelfoɔ mu.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na wɔn nkuro ho mmoa adidibea nsase deɛ, wɔnntɔn, na ɛyɛ wɔn adeɛ a wɔdi so daa.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛhia wo nua na ɔpa aba a, sɔ ne mu na ɔntena wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ ne otudanfoɔ.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Mfa wo sika mma no nnye ɛho mfɛntomu, na nhuri w’aduane a woma no no:

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a meyii mo firii Misraim asase soɔ sɛ mede Kanaan asase merema mo na mayɛ mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛhia wo nua a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn na wɔtɔn no ma wo a, nni no nya,

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: na mmom ɔntena wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔpaani ne otudanfoɔ; ɔnsom wo nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Ɛno na ɔmfiri wo nkyɛn, ɔno ne ne mma nyinaa, na ɔnsane nkɔ n’abusua mu ne n’agyanom adeɛ a wɔdi soɔ no ho.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛ me nkoa a meyii wɔn firii Misraim asase so. Wɔnntɔn wɔn nkoatɔn.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Mfa nyadie nhyɛ no so, na suro wo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: na moagya wɔn ama mo mma wɔ mo akyi ayɛ wɔn awunnyadeɛ ne adeɛ a wɔdi so daa, na wɔnsom mo nkoasom; na mo nuanom Israelfoɔ deɛ, obiara mmfa nyadie nnhyɛ ne nua so.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Na sɛ wo nkyɛn hɔhoɔ anaa otubrafoɔ bi nsam wɔ biribi, na ɛhia wo nua a ɔne no wɔ hɔ, na wɔtɔn no ma ɔhɔhoɔ a watu abɛtena wo nkyɛn anaa ɔhɔhoɔ no abusua mu nipa bi a,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ, ne tɔn akyiri no, wɔmma ne gyeɛ ho kwan; ne nuanom mu baako nnye no,

english_verse: by paying your owner for the number of years you would still be a slave before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na ɔne deɛ ɔtɔɔ no no mmu nkonta mfiri afe a wɔtɔn no maa no no so nkɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so, na ne tiriadeɛ nyɛ sɛdeɛ mfeɛ no dodoɔ teɛ, ɔne no asetena nyɛ sɛ ɔpaani nna.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Ɔne no asetena nyɛ sɛ ɔpaani deɛ afe afe: Ɔmmfa nyadie nnhyɛ no so wɔ w’anim.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔamfa yeinom so annye no a, ɛnneɛ, ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu, ɔmfa ne ho nkɔdi, ɔno ne ne mma nyinaa.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Na me na Israelfoɔ yɛ me nkoa. Me nkoa a meyii wɔn firii Misraim asase soɔ ne wɔn: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Monni me home nna, na monsuro me kronkronbea: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ mɛma osuo atɔ ama mo ne berɛ mu, na asase no ama ne nnɔbaeɛ, na mfuo mu nnua aso aba;

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Na mɛma ɔmannwoeɛ aba asase no so, na moada na obiara anyi mo hu; na mɛsɛe mmoa bɔne afiri asase no so, na nkrantɛ remfa mo asase so.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Na mobɛka mo atamfoɔ agu, na wɔatotɔ mo anim wɔ nkrantɛ ano;

english_verse: Your barns will overflow with grain each year.
translation_verse: Na mobɛdi akoradeɛ dada a akyɛre, na mobɛyi adada no agu, afoforɔ no nti.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Na mɛdane m’anim mama mo, na mɛma moawo na moadɔ, na mɛma me ne mo apam no agyina.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Na mede me tenabea bɛsi mo mu, na mo ho renyɛ me kra nwunu.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Na mɛnante mo mu, na mayɛ mo Nyankopɔn, na mo nso moayɛ me ɔman:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a meyii mo firii Misraim asase so sɛ monnyɛ nkoa bio, na mebubuu mo kɔnnua na memaa monantee kyirebenn no. Wɔn a wɔnni soɔ no nnue

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: na sɛ mopa m’ahyɛdeɛ, na m’atemmuo yɛ mo kra nwunu, na moanni me mmara nsɛm nyinaa so na mobu m’apam so a,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: me nso deɛ mɛyɛ mo nie: Mɛma akomatudeɛ abɛto mo, nsamanwa ne ɔfoɛ a ɛbɛma mo ani ayɛ siamoo na mo kra atotɔ piti, na mobɛdua mo aduadeɛ kwa, na mo atamfoɔ abɛdi.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Na mɛma m’ani asa mo, na moadi mo atamfoɔ anim nkoguo na wɔn a wɔkyiri mo ahyɛ mo so, na obi mpamo mo po a, moadwane.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Na sɛ yeinom mu moantie me ara a, ɛnneɛ mo bɔne nti mɛtwe mo aso mprɛnson aka ho,

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: na mabubu mo ahoɔden ahokyerɛ no. Na mɛyɛ mo soro sɛ dadeɛ, na mo asase ayɛ sɛ kɔbere,

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: na mo tumi asa kwa, na mo asase remma ne nnɔbaeɛ, na asase no so nnua renso aba.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: Na sɛ mone me di asie ara na mompɛ sɛ motie me a, mɛkɔ so mabɔ mo mprɛnson sɛdeɛ mo bɔne teɛ no.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Na mɛsoma wiram mmoa aba mo mu na wɔagye mo nsam mma, na wɔadi mo afieboa, na wɔama moasua, na mo akwan ayɛ akwan fo.

english_verse: I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ me nso mene mo bɛdi asie, na me nso mo bɔne nti mabɔ mo mprɛnson.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Na mede aweretɔ nkrantɛ a ɛbɛtɔ m’apam no so were bɛba mo so, na moaboaboa mo ano akɔ mo nkuro mu, na mɛma yaredɔm aba mo mu, na wɔde mo ahyɛ ɔtamfoɔ nsa.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Na mɛbubu mo aduane dua, na mmaa du ato mo paanoo fononoo baako mu, na wɔakari mo paanoo ama mo, na mobɛdi na moremmee.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ mede abufuhyeɛ ne mo bɛdi asie, na me nso mo bɔne no nti matwe mo aso mprɛnson.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Na mobɛdi mo mmammarima nam, na mo mmabaa nam nso moadi.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Na mɛsɛe mo sorɔnsorɔmmea, na matwitwa mo aduhwam afɔrebukyia no agu, na matoto mo afunu agu mo abosonhunu afunu no so, na mo ho ayɛ me kra nwunu.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na mɛgu mo nkuro mayɛ no amamfo na masɛe mo kronkronbea, na merennye mo aduhwam no hwa.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Na me ara mɛsɛe asase no ama mo atamfoɔ a wɔbɛtena soɔ no ani so ayɛ wɔn yaa;

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: na mo deɛ, mɛbɔ mo ahwete wiase amanaman mu, na matwe nkrantɛ madi mo akyi, na mo asase bɛda hɔ tuu, na mo nkuro ayɛ akurofo.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Nna a ɛso bɛda hɔ tuu no nyinaa na ɛbɛhome, sɛ nna dodoɔ a anhome, mo home mmerɛ mu, berɛ a na mote soɔ no.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Na mobɛwuwu wɔ wiase amanaman mu, na mo atamfoɔ asase amene mo.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na mo mu wɔn a wɔbɛka no ho bɛhiahia wɔn wɔ wɔn amumuyɛ mu, mo atamfoɔ asase so, na wɔn agyanom amumuyɛ nso nti wɔn ho bɛhiahia wɔn sɛ wɔn agyanom no ara.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: me nso mene wɔn dii asie, na mede wɔn kɔɔ wɔn atamfoɔ asase so; — na sɛ afei wɔn akoma momonoto no bɛbrɛ ase na wɔapene wɔn amumuyɛ ho asotwe no so a,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ mɛkae mene Yakob apam no; ɛne mene Isak apam no nso; na mene Abraham apam no nso mɛkae, na mɛkae asase no.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Nanso yeinom nyinaa akyiri no, sɛ wɔwɔ wɔn atamfoɔ asase so mpo a, merempa wɔn, na wɔn ho renyɛ me nwunu na masɛe wɔn korakora, na mabu me ne wɔn ntam apam no so: Na mene AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Na wɔn nti mɛkae apam a mene wɔn agyanom a meyii wɔn firii Misraim asase so wiase amanaman nyinaa anim pamm sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn no ama wɔn: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yeinom ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ ne mmara a AWURADE de nam Mose so too ɔno ne Israelfoɔ ntam, Sinai bepɔ soɔ no.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ obi hyɛ bɔ titire bi a, nnipa deɛ, wɔnyɛ AWURADE deɛ, sɛdeɛ wobɛbɔ wɔn boɔ.

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Na sɛ wadi mfeɛ aduosia anaasɛ deɛ ɛboro saa na ɔyɛ ɔbarima a, wo boɔ nyɛ nnwetɛbena dunum, na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbaa a, nnwetɛbena du.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Na asase no so aduane ntotosoɔ du du a ɛfiri asase so aduadeɛ ne nnua so aba mu no nyinaa yɛ AWURADE dea; ɛyɛ kronkron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: Wɔnnsakyera, na wɔmmfa papa nnsesa bɔne anaasɛ bɔne nnsesa papa; na sɛ sesa na wɔde aboa sesa aboa a, ɛnneɛ ɛno ne deɛ wɔde sesaeɛ no nyinaa nyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ohia aka no a enti ɔntumi mma wo boɔ a wobɔeɛ no a, wɔmfa no mmɛgyina ɔsɔfoɔ no anim, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mmɔ no boɔ; sɛdeɛ deɛ wahyɛ bɔ no nsa bɛso soɔ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mmɔ no boɔ.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛyɛ afieboa a wɔde bi brɛ AWURADE sɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ no bi a, adeɛ a wɔde bi brɛ AWURADE nyinaa yɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛyɛ aboa biara a ne ho nteɛ a wɔmfa no mmrɛ AWURADE sɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ a, wɔmmfa aboa no mmɛgyina ɔsɔfoɔ anim,

english_verse: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔgyeɛ a, ɛnneɛ ɔmfa wo boɔ no abupɛn nnum mu baako nka ho.

english_verse: If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi yɛ ne fie kronkron sɛ ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE a, sɛ ɛyɛ oo, ɛnyɛ oo, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmɔ ne boɔ; sɛdeɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛbɔ no, saa ara na ɛnnyina.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi yɛ n’asase a ɔdi soɔ kronkron ma AWURADE a, wo boɔ bɔ nyɛ sɛdeɛ n’aduadeɛ teɛ; bɔ atokoɔ a wɔdua homer baako boɔ nnwetɛbena aduonum.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔfiri ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe so yɛ n’asase no kronkron a, ɛnnyina wo boɔ no so;

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: na sɛ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no akyi na ɔyɛ n’asase no kronkron a, ɛnneɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu n’akonta mma no sɛdeɛ mfeɛ a aka na ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe aduro no teɛ no, na wɔnte wo boɔ no so.

english_verse: If you decide to buy back the land, you must pay the price plus an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛ gyeɛ na deɛ ɔyɛɛ asase no kronkron no bɛgyeɛ a, ɔmfa wo boɔ no dwetɛ abupɛn nnum mu baako nto so, na ɛntena ne nsam;

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: na sɛ asase no nni wura ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no mu a, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE, sɛ asase a wɔahyira so de ama; ɛnyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔyɛ asase a ɔtɔeɛ a ɛnyɛ n’asase a ɔdi soɔ bi kronkron ma AWURADE a,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: ɔsɔfoɔ no mmu akonta mma no nkyerɛ no wo boɔ no mu deɛ ɛbɛka akɔsi ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no soɔ, na ɔmma wo boɔ a wobɔeɛ no da no ara; ɛyɛ kronkron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe no so, asase no nsane nkɔyɛ deɛ ɔtɔɔ no ne nkyɛn a ɛyɛ n’asase a ɔdi soɔ no dea.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na wo boɔ a wobɛbɔ nyinaa nyɛ sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ; gera aduonu yɛ dwetɛbena baako.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: Na afieboa mu mmakan a wɔawo ama AWURADE no nko deɛ, obi nnyɛ wɔn kronkron; nantwie oo, odwan oo, ɛyɛ AWURADE dea.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: Nso ahyiradeɛ biara a obi bɛhyira so ama AWURADE, adeɛ a ɔwɔ nyinaa mu no, onipa oo, aboa oo, n’asase a ɔdi so oo, ɛno deɛ wɔnntɔn, na wɔnnnye nso; ahyiradeɛ biara yɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Obiara a wɔabu no kumfɔ no, wɔnnnye; kum na wɔnku no.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔgye ne ntotosoɔ du du no bi a, ɔmfa abupɛn nnum mu baako nto so.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Na anantwie ne nnwan mu ntotosoɔ du du nyinaa, adeɛ a ɛfa odwanhwɛfoɔ poma ase nyinaa mu deɛ ɛtɔ so du du no, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Wɔmmpa papa ne bɔne mu, na wɔnnsesa ebi nso; na sɛ obi bɛsesa ebi a, ɛnneɛ ɛno ne deɛ wɔde resesa no nyinaa nyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE; wɔnnnye.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yeinom ne mmara nsɛm a AWURADE de hyɛɛ Mose, Sinai bepɔ soɔ, maa no de kɔmaa Israel mma no.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ firii Misraimfoɔ asase so akyi afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu, ne bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no da a ɛdi kan no, AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose wɔ Sinai serɛ so wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan mu sɛ:

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: ɛfiri wɔn a wɔadi mfeɛ aduonu so de rekorɔ, Israel mu obiara a ɔbɛtumi akɔ ɔsa; wo ne Aaron nkan wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm teɛ,

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron faa mmarima a wɔabobɔ wɔn din yi,

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: na wɔhyiaa asafo no nyinaa boaa ano, bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no da a ɛdi kan, na wɔkaa wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, wɔn din dodoɔ, ɛfiri wɔn a wɔadi mfirinhyia aduonu so de rekorɔ, mmaako mmaako;

english_verse: just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no, saa na ɔkan wɔn Sinai serɛ soɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɔ no deɛ, wɔmmɔ adanseɛ tenabea no ho nsraban nhyia, na AWURADE abufuo amma Israelfoɔ asafo no so. Na Lewifoɔ no nkura adanseɛ tenabea no so hwɛ mu.

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Na Lewi mma deɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn nananom abusuakuo teɛ no, wɔankan wɔn amfra wɔn. Lewifoɔ no ahyɛdeɛ

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Lewi abusuakuo no nko deɛ, nkan wɔn, nanso mmu wɔn dodoɔ ano mfra Israelfoɔ,

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no mmobɔ nsraban wɔn ara wɔn nsraban mu ne wɔn frankaa ho sɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ mmaako mmaako.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: Israelfoɔ no nkyere nsraban, wɔn mu biara wɔ ɔno ara ne frankaa ho, ɛne wɔn mpanimfie nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ho; ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ntentensoɔ na wɔnkyere nsraban no nhyia.

english_verse: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduonum nnan ne ahanan.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduonum nson ne ahanan.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the south side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduanan nsia ne ahanum.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduonum nkron ne ahasa.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn mpem aduanan nnum ne ahansia aduonum.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: Afei ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne Lewifoɔ nsraban no ntu nni nsraban ahodoɔ no ntam. Sɛdeɛ wɔkyere nsraban no, saa ara na wɔntuo, wɔn nyinaa wɔ wɔn dibea sɛdeɛ wɔn mfrankaa no teɛ.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduasa mmienu ne ahanu.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Yeinom ne Israelfoɔ a wɔkan wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, nsraban ahodoɔ no mu wɔn a wɔkan wɔn nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ, yɛ ɔpeha nsia ne mmiɛnsa ne ahanum aduonum.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduasa nnum ne ahanan.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the north side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduosia mmienu ne ahanson.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ mpem aduanan baako ne ahanum.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, mpem aduonum mmiɛnsa ne ahanan.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɔ no deɛ, wɔankan wɔn amfra Israelfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa. Wɔkyeree nsraban, sɛdeɛ wɔn mfrankaa no teɛ, na saa nso na wɔtuiɛ, wɔn nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no.

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Na yeinom ne Aaron mma din: Nadab a ɔyɛ abakan, Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Na Nadab ne Abihu wuwuu AWURADE anim, sɛ wɔde anana gya bi kɔɔ AWURADE anim Sinai serɛ soɔ no, na wɔannya mma; na Eleasa ne Itamar dii asɔfoɔ wɔn agya Aaron anim.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: They are assigned to help Aaron and his sons,
translation_verse: Na fa Lewifoɔ no ma Aaron ne ne mma no, wɔde wɔn ama no koraa afiri Israelfoɔ mu.

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma no deɛ, yi wɔn si hɔ na wɔnkura wɔn asɔfodie no mu; na ɔhɔhoɔ biara a ɔtwe pini ho no, wɔnku no.

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose, Sinai serɛ so sɛ:

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: Kan Lewi mma no sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie ne wɔn mmusua teɛ, mmarima a wɔadi bosome ne akyire no nyinaa, kan wɔn.

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Na yeinom ne Lewi mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn din teɛ: Gerson, Kohat ne Merari.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Na Kohat mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ, ne: Amram ne Isehar, Hebron ne Usiel.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Na Merari mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ ne: Mahli ne Musi. Yeinom ne Lewi mmusua no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gerson deɛ ne Libni abusua ne Simei abusua; yeinom ne Gersonfoɔ mmusua no.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Na deɛ Gerson mma no nhwɛ wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho ne tenabea no ne ntomadan no, ne nkatasoɔ ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano nkataano no,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: ne adihɔ no ho ntwamutam no ne adihɔ a ɛtwa tenabea no ne afɔrebukyia no ho hyia no ano nkataano ne ne ntampehoma, ntomadan no ho adwuma nyinaa.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Na Kohat deɛ ne Amramfoɔ abusua, Iseharfoɔ abusua, Hebronfoɔ abusua ne Usielfoɔ abusua; yeinom ne Kohatfoɔ mmusua no.

english_verse: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Kohatfoɔ mmusua no agya fie bapɔmma ne Usiel ba Elisafan.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Na deɛ wɔnhwɛ ne adaka no, ɛpono no, kaneadua no, afɔrebukyia no ne kronkronbea hɔ nnoɔma nyinaa a wɔde som no ne ntwamutam no ne ɛho adwuma nyinaa.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Na Lewi mmapɔmma mu panin ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Eleasa, ɔne wɔn a wɔkura kronkronbea mu no so no mu panin.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Merari deɛ ne Mahli abusua ne Musi abusua; yeinom ne Merari mmusua no.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Merari mmusua no agya fie bapɔmma ne Abihail ba Suriel. Tenabea no nkyɛn na wɔnkyere wɔn nsraban atifi fam.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wɔnkyere nsraban, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim, apueeɛ no, ne Mose ne Aaron ne ne mmammarima a wɔkura kronkronbea no ma Israelfoɔ no; na ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔtwe pini no, wɔnku no.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was
translation_verse: Lewifoɔ a wɔkan wɔn a Mose ne Aaron nam AWURADE asɛm so kan wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ no, mmarima a wɔadi bosome ne akyire no nyinaa yɛ mpemaduonu mmienu. Lewifoɔ gye mmakan

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kan Israelfoɔ no mu mmakan mmarima a wɔadi bosome ne akyire nyinaa, na bu wɔn din dodoɔ ano;

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: na fa Lewifoɔ no ma me — mene AWURADE — fa wɔn si Israelfoɔ mu mmakan nyinaa ananmu, ne Lewifoɔ afieboa si Israelfoɔ no afieboa mmakan nyinaa ananmu.

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Na Mose kan Israelfoɔ mu mmakan nyinaa sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: Fa Lewifoɔ si Israelfoɔ mu mmakan nyinaa ananmu ne Lewifoɔ afieboa si wɔn afieboa ananmu, na Lewifoɔ no nyɛ me dea: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ mmakan mu nnipa ahanu aduɔson mmiɛnsa a wɔboro Lewifoɔ soɔ no agyedeɛ deɛ,

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: gye obiara dwetɛbena nnum, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena teɛ na gyeɛ, gera aduonu nyɛ dwetɛbena baako;

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: na fa dwetɛ a ɛyɛ wɔn a wɔboro wɔn soɔ no agyedeɛ no ma Aaron ne ne mma.

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so de wɔn a wɔagye wɔn no tiri dwetɛ no maa Aaron ne ne mma, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Yei ne Kohat mma no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu som adwuma: Akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron no.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Na sɛ nsraban no rebɛtu a, Aaron ne ne mma mmra mmɛyi ntwamutam no, na wɔmfa nkata adanseɛ adaka no ho,

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: na wɔmfa sukraman nwoma akatasoɔ nto so, na wɔmfa bibitoma mu nsɛ so, na wɔmfa ne mpoma no nwurawura mu.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa bibitoma nkata anim pono no so, na wɔmfa nyowa no ne nyowaa ne nkoraa ne nkuruwa a wɔde hwie no nsisi so, na daa paanoo no nsisi so;

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa bibitoma nkata kaneadua no ne ne nkanea ne n’adaawa ne ne nso nkukuwa ne ne ngo ntoa a wɔde som no nyinaa ho.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa ɛno ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa nhyɛ sukraman nwoma nkatasoɔ no mu, na wɔmfa nto pata no so.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa bibitoma nsɛ sika afɔrebukyia no so, na wɔmfa sukraman nwoma nkata ho, na wɔmfa ne mpoma nwurawura mu.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa ɔsom nnoɔma a wɔde som kronkronbea hɔ no nyinaa nhyɛ bibitoma mu, na wɔmfa sukraman nwoma nkatasoɔ nkata ho, na wɔmfa nto pata no so.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Na afɔrebukyia no, wɔnsesa so nso ngu, na wɔmfa ntoma a ɛbere dum nsɛ so,

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: na wɔmfa ɛho nnoɔma a wɔde som so nyinaa, nsramma kukuwa ne adinam ne sofi ne nkoraa no, afɔrebukyia no ho nnoɔma nyinaa, na wɔmfa sukraman nwoma akatasoɔ nsɛ so, na wɔmfa ɛho mpoma no nwurawura mu.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Na nsraban no rebɛtu na Aaron ne ne mma no wie akronkronneɛ no ne kronkronbea nnoɔma no nyinaa ho kata a, ɛno akyi ansa na Kohat mma nhyɛne mu nkɔma soɔ, na wɔanka akronkronneɛ no amma wɔanwuwu. Yei ne Kohat mma no adwuma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Eleasa ahwɛdeɛ ne kanea ngo ne nnuhwam ne daa aduane afɔdeɛ ne sra ngo no, tenabea no nyinaa ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa so hwɛ, kronkronbea hɔ ne ɛho nnoɔma fam.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: Wɔn na wɔnsoa tenabea no ntoma no ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no, ne nkatasoɔ, ne sukraman akatasoɔ a ɛwɔ soɔ no ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano nkataano no,

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: ne adihɔ no ho ntwamutam ne adihɔ a ɛtwa tenabea ne afɔrebukyia no ho hyia no aboboano nkataano no ne ne ntampehoma ne ɛho adwuma ho nnoɔma nyinaa; na wɔnyɛ biribiara a ɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ no wɔ ho.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Yei ne Gersonfoɔ mma mmusua no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu som adwuma, na wɔn adwuma no sohwɛ wɔ Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Itamar nsam.

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Na yei ne nnesoa a wɔnsoa sɛ wɔn ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu adwuma; tenabea no ntaaboɔ ne ne mmeamu ne n’adum ne ne nnyinasoɔ,

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: ne adihɔ a ɛhyia ho no adum ne ne nnyinasoɔ ne ne mpɛɛwa ne ne ntampehoma ne ɛho nnoɔma ne deɛ ɛkeka ho nyinaa; na monkan nnoɔma a wɔnsoa no mmobɔ din mfa nhyɛ wɔn nsa.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Yei ne Merari mma mmusua no adwuma, wɔn ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu adwuma nyinaa, wɔ Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Itamar nsam.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛeɛ no na wɔde wɔn sisii wɔn som adwuma ne asɛdeɛ ne deɛ wɔde hyɛɛ wɔn nsa no soɔ mmaako mmaako; sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa na montu no, nsraban no akyi na montu wɔn nkorɔ, na wɔangu mo nsraban a mete mu wɔ mo mu no ho fi.

english_verse: The Israelites obeyed the Lord's instructions. The Penalty for Committing a Crime (Leviticus
translation_verse: Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ saa, na wɔtuu wɔn kɔɔ nsraban no akyi; sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose no, saa na Israelfoɔ no yɛeɛ. Asodideɛ

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa yɛ bɔne tia onipa bi de fom AWURADE a,

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: ɔmpae mu nka wɔn bɔne a wɔayɛ no, na ɔntua n’asodideɛ no abotene mfa abupɛn nnum mu baako nto so, na ɔmfa mma onipa a wayɛ bɔne atia no no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na sɛ onipa no awu na ɔnni busuani a ɔbɛn no bi ara a wɔde asodideɛ no bɛma no a, wɔmfa asodideɛ a ɛyɛ AWURADE dea no, wɔmfa mma ɔsɔfoɔ no nka mpata dwennini a wɔde rebɛpata ama no no ho.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Na obiara akronkronneɛ yɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no dea; deɛ obiara de ma ɔsɔfoɔ no yɛ ne dea. Ninkuntwe ho asɛm

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: na ninkuntwe honhom ba ɔbarima no so na ɔtwe ne yere no ho ninkunu, na ɔbaa no agu ne ho fi ampa, — anaasɛ ninkuntwe honhom ba ne so na ɔtwe ne yere ho ninkunu na ɔbaa no nguu ne ho fi a,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ ɔbarima no mfa ne yere no mmra ɔsɔfoɔ no anim. Na ɔmfa ɔbaa no ho ayɛyɛdeɛ, atokosiam olonka abupɛn du mu baako mmra: Ɔnngu so ngo nanso ɔnnto so ohwamfufuo, na ɛyɛ ninkunu ho aduane afɔdeɛ, nkaeɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔde kae amumuyɛ.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ɔbaa no mmra mmɛgyina AWURADE anim.

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nsa nsu kronkron ngu kukuo bi mu, na ɔnsa tenabea hɔ fam mfuturo bi, na ɔmfa ngu nsuo no mu;

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no ntwerɛ nnome yi ngu nwoma so, na ɔnhohoro ngu nsu nwononwono no mu,

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: na ɔmma ɔbaa no nnom nsu nwononwono a ɛde nnome ba no, na nsuo a ɛde nnome ba no nkɔ ne mu nkɔyɛ nwononwono.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nnye ɔbaa no nsam ninkuntwe ho aduane afɔdeɛ no, na ɔnhim aduane afɔdeɛ no AWURADE anim, na ɔmfa mpini afɔrebukyia no;

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa aduane afɔdeɛ no nsa ma nyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɛno akyiri no, ɔmma ɔbaa no nnom nsuo no.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔma no nom a, na sɛ, wagu ne ho fi na wayɛ ne kunu bɔne a, ɛnneɛ nsuo a ɛde nnome ba no bɛhyɛne ne mu akɔyɛ no nwono, na ne yafunu ahon na n’asrɛ atotɔ mu, na ɔbaa no adane nnome, ne man mu.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbaa no ho nguu fi na ne ho te a, ɛnneɛ ne ho bɛyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ, na wanya mma.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: anaasɛ ninkuntwe honhom ba ɔbarima bi so na ɔtwe ne yere ho ninkunu a, ɔmfa ɔbaa no mmɛgyina AWURADE anim, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nyɛ no sɛdeɛ mmara yi hyɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima no ho bɛyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ afiri amumuyɛ no ho, na ɔbaa no asoa n’amumuyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa bi de ne ho kɔhyɛ ahotuafoɔ mu hyɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛtua ne ho adeɛ de ne ho ama AWURADE a,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ ɔntua ne ho bobesa ne nsa nyinaa; ɔnnnom bobesa a emu ka ne nsa a emu ka, na adeɛ biara a wɔde bobe aba ayɛ nso, ɔnnnom, na bobe aba mono ne dwane nso, ɔnnni;

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: N’ahotua bɔhyɛ nna nyinaa mu no yiwan biara nnka ne ti; ɔnyɛ kronkron nkɔsi sɛ nna a ɔtuaa ne ho maa AWURADE no bɛwie duro; ɔnsi atimum.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: Nna a watua ne ho adeɛ ama AWURADE no, ɔnnkɔ efunu ho.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi kɔwu mpofirim wɔ ne nkyɛn ma ɔgu n’ahotua tiri ho fi a, ɔnyi ne tiri n’ahodwira da a ɛne da a ɛtɔ so nson no mu.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako nso ɔmfa nyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔmpata mma no sɛ efunu no nti wafom, na ɔnyɛ ne tiri kronkron bio da no ara.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Na ɔntua ne ho adeɛ mma AWURADE n’ahotua nna no, na ɔmfa odwanten ba a wadi afe mmra mmɛbɔ asodie ho afɔdeɛ; na kane nna no ayera, ɛfiri sɛ n’ahotua no ho agu fi.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: Na yei ne ahotuafoɔ ho mmara: Ɛda a n’ahotua nna wie duro no, wɔmfa no mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano,

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa n’ayɛyɛdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE; odwanten ba a wadi afe a ɔdi mu baako mmɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ne odwammereɛ baako a wadi afe a ɔdi mu nso mmɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne odwennini baako a ɔdi mu mmɛbɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ;

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: ne apiti paanoo, esiam taterɛ a wɔde ngo afɔre, ne apiti ɔfam a wɔasra ho ngo kɛntɛn, ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ ne ahwiesa.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mmra AWURADE anim, na ɔmmɔ ne bɔne ne ne hyeɛ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Then he will sacrifice the ram and offer the wine, grain, and bread.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa odwennini no mmɔ AWURADE asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ nka apiti kɛntɛn no ho, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mmɔ n’aduane afɔdeɛ ne n’ahwiesa afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Na ɔhotuafoɔ no nyi n’ahotua ti ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na ɔmfa n’ahotua tirinwi no ngu asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no ase gya mu.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa odwennini no basa a wɔanoa ne kɛntɛn no mu apiti taterɛ baako ne apiti ɔfam baako ngu ɔhotuafoɔ a wanya ayi n’ahotua no nsam;

english_verse: These are the requirements for Nazirites. However, if you can afford to offer more, you must do so. The Blessing for the People
translation_verse: Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma ɔhotuafoɔ a, n’ahotua nti, wahyɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ ho bɔ ama AWURADE, de ka deɛ ne nsa bɛso soɔ ho; sɛ ne bɔ a ɔhyɛeɛ no teɛ no, saa na ɔmfa n’ahotua mmara so nyɛ. Nhyira a wɔmfa nhyira ɔman no

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Sɛdeɛ monhyira Israelfoɔ no nka nkyerɛ wɔn nie:

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: AWURADE nhyira wo, na ɔnhwɛ wo so;

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: AWURADE nte n’anim nkyerɛ wo, na ɔnnom wo;

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: AWURADE mma n’ani so nhwɛ wo, na ɔmma wo asomdwoeɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa me din nto Israelfoɔ so, na me deɛ, mɛhyira wɔn.

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Na Mose wiee tenabea no sie, na ɔsraa ho ngo, na ɔyɛɛ no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ne afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa kronkron, na ɔsraa ho ngo na ɔyɛɛ ho kronkron no,

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Israel mmapɔmma, wɔn mpanimfie so atitire a wɔyɛ mmusuakuo no asafohempanin a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔkan wɔn no soɔ no de ayɛyɛdeɛ bae.

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: Na wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ baa AWURADE anim. Nteaseɛnam a ɛso wɔ nkatasoɔ nsia ne anantwie dummienu; mmapɔmma baanu de nteaseɛnam baako, na obiara de nantwie baako; na wɔde baa tenabea no anim.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: Gye no wɔn nsam, na wɔmfa nyɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho adwuma, na fa ma Lewifoɔ no, obiara sɛdeɛ n’adwuma teɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Na Mose de nteaseɛnam ne anantwie no maa Lewifoɔ no.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: na ɔde nteaseɛnam nnan ne anantwie nwɔtwe maa Merari mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn adwuma teɛ, wɔ Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Itamar nsam;

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: na Kohat mma deɛ, wamma wɔn bi, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn adwuma ne sɛ wɔsoa kronkronbea ho nnoɔma no wɔn mmatiri soɔ.

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Na mmapɔmma no de afɔrebukyia no adwiradeɛ bae, da a wɔsraa no ngo no; na wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ baa afɔrebukyia no anim.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Mmapɔmma no mfa wɔn afɔrebukyia dwira ho ayɛyɛdeɛ mmra mmaako mmaako, obiara ne ne da.

english_verse: And so when the altar was dedicated to the Lord, these twelve leaders brought the following gifts:
translation_verse: na asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ anantwie no nyinaa yɛ anantwinini aduonu nnan, adwennini aduosia, mpapo aduosia, nnwanten mma a wɔadi afe afe aduosia. Yei ne afɔrebukyia no sra akyiri adwiradeɛ.

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: ɔpapo baako a wɔde rekɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ;

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Da a ɛtɔ so nkron no, Benyamin mma bapɔmma Gideoni ba Abidan bae.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Na Mose hyɛnee ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu sɛ ɔne AWURADE rekɔkasa no, ɔtee ɛnne no sɛ ɛrekasa kyerɛ no firi mpata adwa a ɛwɔ adanseɛ adaka no soɔ no so wɔ kerubim mmienu no ntam; na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Aaron sɛ: Wode nkanea no sisi kaneadua so a, nkanea nson no nnɛre wɔ so nkyerɛ anim.

english_verse: Aaron obeyed and placed the lamps as he was told.
translation_verse: Na Aaron yɛɛ saa: Ɔde nkanea no sisii kaneadua no so kyerɛɛ anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Na yei ne kaneadua no yɛbea: Ɛyɛ sika a wɔaborɔ; ɛfiri n’ase kɔsi ne nhwiren soɔ, ɛyɛ sika a wɔaborɔ ara nko; sɛ nhwɛsoɔ a AWURADE maa Mose hwɛeɛ no teɛ no, saa ara na ɔyɛɛ kaneadua no. Dwira a wɔdwira Lewifoɔ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Na sɛdeɛ dwira wɔn nie: Fa bɔneyie nsuo pete wɔn so, na wɔmfa yiwan nyi wɔn ho nyinaa, na wɔnsi wɔn ntadeɛ, na wɔmfa nte wɔn ho.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa nantwinini ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ esiam a wɔde ngo afɔre; na fa nantwinini foforɔ nso a wɔde bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na fa Lewifoɔ no bra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na ma Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa mmɛbɔ dwa;

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: na fa Lewifoɔ no bra AWURADE anim, na Israelfoɔ no mfa wɔn nsa ngu Lewifoɔ no so;

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: na Aaron nhim Lewifoɔ no, AWURADE anim, sɛ ohim afɔdeɛ a ɛfiri Israelfoɔ no nsam, na wɔntena ase nyɛ AWURADE som adwuma.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɔ no mfa wɔn nsa ngu anantwie no atifi, na fa baako bɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na fa baako nso bɔ AWURADE hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na pata ma Lewifoɔ no.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: Na fa Lewifoɔ no gyina Aaron ne ne mma no anim, na him wɔn yɛ ohim afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Na te Lewifoɔ no firi Israelfoɔ mu, na Lewifoɔ no mmɛyɛ me dea.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ɛno akyiri ansa na Lewifoɔ no mmra mmɛsom ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho. Na te wɔn ho, na him wɔn yɛ ohim afɔdeɛ,

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na mayi wɔn afiri Israelfoɔ mu; mede wɔn masi adeɛ a ɛbue yafunu ano nyinaa, Israelfoɔ mu mmakan nyinaa, ananmu mafa.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ mu mmakan nyinaa, nnipa mu oo, afieboa mu oo, wɔyɛ me dea: Da a mebobɔɔ Misraim asase so mmakan nyinaa no na meyɛɛ wɔn kronkron mefaeɛ.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Na mafa Lewifoɔ no asi Israelfoɔ mu mmakan nyinaa ananmu.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Na mede Lewifoɔ no mama Aaron ne ne mma sɛ akyɛdeɛ afiri Israelfoɔ mu sɛ wɔnyɛ Israelfoɔ no adwuma, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu na wɔmpata mma Israelfoɔ no, na Israelfoɔ no rebɛn kronkronbea hɔ a, ɔhaw biara amma wɔn so.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
