translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron ne Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa yɛɛ Lewifoɔ no saa; sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose maa Lewifoɔ ho no, saa na Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɔ no yii wɔn ho bɔne, na wɔsii wɔn ntadeɛ, na Aaron him wɔn sɛ ohim afɔdeɛ, AWURADE anim, na Aaron pata maa wɔn de dwiraa wɔn ho.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ɛno akyiri na Lewifoɔ no ba bɛyɛɛ wɔn som adwuma ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, Aaron ne ne mma no anim; sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose, Lewifoɔ no ho no, saa na wɔyɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Nanso wɔnni mmoa wɔn nuanom no, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, nkura ɛso hwɛ no mu bi, na ɔsom adwuma no na wɔnnnyɛ. Saa na hyehyɛ ma Lewifoɔ no dwumadie ma wɔn.

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Sinai serɛ so, wɔn Misraim asase so fire afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no bosome a ɛdi kan no mu sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Ma Israelfoɔ no nni twam no ne berɛ mu.

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Bosome yi da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ, monni no ne berɛ mu; sɛdeɛ n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’akwan nyinaa so na monnie.

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Na wɔdii twam no bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ, Sinai serɛ so; sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa, saa na Israel mma no yɛeɛ.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Na mmarima bi wɔ hɔ a wɔn ho akum wɔ efunu bi ho, na wɔantumi anni twam no ɛda no; na wɔbaa Mose ne Aaron anim da no ara;

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: na mmarima no see no sɛ: Yɛn deɛ, yɛn ho akum wɔ efunu bi ho; adɛn na wɔbɛkame yɛn sɛ yɛmmfa yɛn ayɛyɛdeɛ mmmrɛ AWURADE ne berɛ mu wɔ Israelfoɔ mu?

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monnyina hɔ na menkɔtie deɛ AWURADE bɛhyɛ ama mo.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ mo anaa mo asefoɔ mu bi ho kum wɔ efunu bi ho anaasɛ ɔwɔ akwantuo mu akyirikyiri a, ɔnni twam mma AWURADE ara.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no da a ɛtɔ so dunan anwummerɛ na wɔnnie; apiti ne ɛfan nwononwono na wɔmfa nnie:

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Wɔnnnya bi nnkɔsi anɔpa na wɔmmmu ne dompe; wɔnni twam no ho ahyɛdeɛ no nyinaa so.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ne ho teɛ na ɔntuu kwan na ɔpo twam no die no, wɔbɛtwa ɔkra no afiri ne man mu atwene, ɛfiri sɛ wamfa AWURADE ayɛyɛdeɛ no amma ne berɛ mu; saa onipa no nsoa ne bɔne.

english_verse: Anyone, including foreigners who live among you, can celebrate Passover, if they follow all the regulations. The Cloud over the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ bi bɛsoɛ mo mu a, ɔnni twam mma AWURADE: Twam ahyɛdeɛ ne ne yɛbea no so na ɔnnie, ɔhɔhoɔ oo, asase no soni oo, ahyɛdeɛ baako na ɛnna hɔ mma mo. Ogya ne mununkum fadum no

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: na sɛ nnanu, sɛ bosome, sɛ nna bebree, na mununkum no di tenabea no so a na ɛsi so ara a, Israelfoɔ no tena nsram na wɔntu; na sɛ ɛma ne ho so a, na wɔtuo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: Yɛ dwetɛ ntotorobɛnto mmienu fa, dwetɛ a wɔaborɔ na fa yɛ, na wɔde afrɛ asafo no aba, na wɔde ama wɔatu nsraban no akɔ.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔhyɛne ne mmienu nyinaa a, asafo no nyinaa ano nhyia wo nkyɛn ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔhyɛne baako a, mmapɔmma a wɔdi Israel apem apem so atitire no mmɛhyia wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔrebɛma asafo no abɔ dwa a, monhyɛne, na nnyɛ osebɔ nnyegyeeɛ.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no na wɔnhyɛne ntotorobɛnto no; na ɛnyɛ mo daa ahyɛdeɛ mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ morekɔ ɔsa mo asase so ne ahohiahiafoɔ a wɔhiahia mo ho akɔko a, ɛnneɛ momfa ntotorobɛnto nhyɛne osebɔ nnyegyeeɛ, na wɔnkae mo, AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim, na wɔnnye mo nkwa mo atamfoɔ no nsam.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Na mo anigyeɛ nna ne mo afa a mohyɛ ne mo bosome foforɔ no mu nso monhyɛne ntotorobɛnto, mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne mo asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no so, na ɛnyɛ nkaeɛ mma mo, mo Nyankopɔn anim: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. Israelfoɔ firi Sinai kɔ Paran

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Na afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu no, mununkum no maa ne ho so firii adanseɛ tenabea no so.

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no tutuu wɔn nsraban sii mu firii Sinai serɛ so, na mununkum no kɔgyinaa Paran serɛ so.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Na yei ne deɛ ɛdi kan a wɔnam AWURADE asɛm a ɛnam Mose soɔ no so tuiɛ.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Na Yuda mma nsraban frankaa no tuu kane, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ teɛ; na ne dɔm no so na Aminadab ba Nahason die;

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: na Isakar mma abusuakuo dɔm no so na Suar ba Natanel die;

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: na Sebulon mma abusuakuo dɔm no so na Helon ba Eliab die.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Ɛnna wɔhwinhwan tenabea no, na Gerson mma ne Merari mma soasoaa tenabea no tui.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Na Ruben mma nsraban frankaa no tuu sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ teɛ; na ne dɔm no so na Sedeur ba Elisur die;

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: na Simeon mma abusuakuo dɔm no so na Surisadai ba Selumiel die;

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: na Gad mma abusuakuo dɔm no so na Deuel ba Eliasaf die.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Kohatfoɔ no soasoaa akronkronneɛ no tuiɛ; na wɔsii tenabea no de kɔsii sɛ wɔbaeɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Na Efraim mma nsraban frankaa no tuu sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ teɛ; na ne dɔm no so na Amihud ba Elisama die;

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: na Manase mma abusuakuo dɔm no so na Pedahsur ba Gamaliel die;

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: na Benyamin mma abusuakuo dɔm no so na Gideoni ba Abidan die.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Ɛnna Dan mma nsraban frankaa no tu bɔɔ nsraban no nyinaa kyidɔm sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ; na ne dɔm no so na Amisadai ba Ahieser die;

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: na Aser mma abusuakuo dɔm no so na Okran ba Pagiel die;

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: na Naftali mma abusuakuo dɔm no so na Enan ba Ahira die.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Yei ne Israelfoɔ tuo a wɔtuu sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ teɛ no.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ n’ase Reuel a ɔyɛ Midianni ba Hobab no sɛ: Yɛretu akɔ deɛ AWURADE kaa ho asɛm sɛ: Ɛha na mede bɛma mo no; bra ma yɛnkɔ, na yɛbɛyɛ wo yie, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE aka Israel ho asɛmpa.

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Merenkɔ, na mmom me ara m’asase so ne m’abusua mu na mɛkorɔ.

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Na ɔse: Yei deɛ, nnya yɛn hɔ, na wo na wonim deɛ yɛbɛkyere nsraban ɛserɛ no soɔ nti, yɛ yɛn aniwa;

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: na sɛ wo ne yɛn nante a, papa ko a AWURADE de bɛyɛ yɛn no, yɛde bi bɛyɛ wo.

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Ɛnna wɔtutu firii AWURADE bepɔ no ho nantee nnansa kwan, na AWURADE apam adaka no tu dii wɔn anim nnansa sɛ ɛrekyerɛ wɔn asoɛeɛ;

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Na sɛ adaka no retu a, Mose ka sɛ: AWURADE, sɔre na w’atamfo mmɔ mpete na wɔn a wɔkyiri woɔ nnwane w’anim.

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛsoɛ a, ɔka sɛ: AWURADE, sane bra Israel mpempem no nkyɛn.

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ wɔrenwiiwii wɔn amaneɛ ho, AWURADE aso mu; na AWURADE teeɛ no, ne bo hurui, na AWURADE gya bɛsɔɔ wɔn mu hyee nsraban no ano ano.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no su frɛɛ Mose, na Mose paa AWURADE kyɛw, na ogya no dumii.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Tabera, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE gya dɛree wɔ wɔn mu.

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Na afrafrafoɔ a wɔwɔ wɔn mu no kɔn dɔɔ adeɛ, na Israelfoɔ no nso sane suu bio sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛma yɛn nam adie?

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Yɛakae nsunam a yɛdii no Misraim kwa ne ɛferɛ, anamuna, fan, gyeene ne aanwo no.

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Afei yɛn kra akusa, na biribiara nni hɔ sɛ mana a ɛtua yɛn aniwa mu yi nko.

english_verse: The manna was like small whitish seeds
translation_verse: Na mana no te sɛ wisa aba, na ɛho te sɛ bedola hyɛ ho.

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo ne w’akoa adi no bɔne, na adɛn nti na mannya w’anim animuonyam sɛ wode ɔman yi nyinaa adesoa ato me soɔ yi?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: Me na menyinsɛnee ɔman yi nyinaa anaasɛ me na mewoo wɔn, na wose me sɛ: Turu wɔn wo koko so, sɛdeɛ ɔbayɛnfoɔ turu n’akɔkoaa, fa kɔ asase a wokaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn nananom no so?

english_verse: They keep whining for meat, but where can I get meat for them?
translation_verse: Ɛhe na mɛnya nam mama ɔman yi nyinaa sɛ wɔsu gu me so sɛ: Ma yɛn nam na yɛnni yi?

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Me nko ara mentumi menkura ɔman yi nyinaa ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ duru ma me.

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Na sɛ saa na wo ne me bɛdi no a, ɛnneɛ sɛ m’anim aba nyam w’anim a, kum mmom na ku me, na manhunu m’amaneɛ no.

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Na mɛsiane na me ne wo abɛkasa, na mede honhom a ɛwɔ wo soɔ no bi magu wɔn so na wɔne wo asɔ ɔman no adesoa no mu, na wo nko woankura.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Na ka kyerɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monyɛ mo ho kronkron nsie ɔkyena, na mobɛdi nam, ɛfiri sɛ moakɔsu agu AWURADE aso mu sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛma yɛn nam adie? Anka na ɛyɛ ma yɛn wɔ Misraim. Enti AWURADE bɛma mo nam adi:

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: na mmom ɛbɛkɔ akɔsi bosome, akɔsi sɛ ɛbɛfifiri mo hwene mu na afono mo, ɛsiane sɛ moapo AWURADE a ɔwɔ mo mu no, na moasu n’anim aka sɛ: Adɛn nti na yɛfirii Misraim baeɛ yi?

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Wɔbɛkunkum nnwan ne anantwie ama wɔn na aso wɔn? Anaasɛ wɔbɛboa ɛpo mu mpataa nyinaa ano ama wɔn na aso wɔn?

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wɔatwa AWURADE nsa so? Afei wobɛhunu sɛ m’asɛm bɛba mu ama wo anaasɛ ɛremma mu.

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Na mmarima baanu kaa nsraban no mu, ɔbaako din de Eldad na ɔbaako no de Medad; na honhom no baa wɔn so, na wɔfra nnipa a wɔtwerɛɛ wɔn din no mu, nanso na wɔmfirii adi nkɔɔ ntomadan no ho; enti wɔkaa adiyisɛm nsraban no mu.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Na aberanteɛ bi tutuu mmirika bɛka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Eldad ne Medad reka adiyisɛm nsraban no mu.

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Na Nun ba Yosua, Mose somfoɔ a ɔyɛ ne mmeranteɛ no mu baako no gyee so sɛ: Me wura Mose, bara wɔn!

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Woretwe me ho ninkunu? Ɛkaa me nko a, anka AWURADE man nyinaa adanedane adiyifoɔ, na AWURADE de ne honhom agu wɔn so.

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: Na mframa firi AWURADE nkyɛn bɔe, na ɛkɔpraa mmoko firi ɛpo no ho bɛguu nsraban no so, ɛbɛyɛ da koro kwan wɔ ɔfa ha ne da koro kwan wɔ ɔfa ha, nsraban no ho, wɔn sorokorɔ ne asase ani bɛyɛ sɛ basafa baako.

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no sɔree da mu no nyinaa ne anadwo no nyinaa ne adekyeeɛ nyinaa, na wɔkɔboaboaa mmoko no ano; deɛ ɔnyaa deɛ ɛsua koraa no mpo boaa homer du ano, na wɔhatahatae ara de twaa nsraban no ho hyia fae.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Na ɛnam no da so wɔ wɔn se mu a wɔnnya nwesaeɛ no, AWURADE bo huru tiaa ɔman no, na AWURADE de ɔhaw kɛseɛ pa ara bobɔɔ ɔman no.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Na wɔfrɛɛ hɔ sɛ: Kibrot-hataawa, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na wɔsiee ɔman a adeɛ yɛɛ wɔn akɔnnɔ no.

english_verse: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no tu firii Kibrot-hataawa kɔɔ Haserot, na wɔtenaa Haserot.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ɛnna AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron ne Miriam mpofirim sɛ: Mo baasa momfiri adi mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho.

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: Na wɔn baasa no firii adi. Na AWURADE sianee mununkum dum mu bɛgyinaa ntomadan no ano, na ɔfrɛɛ Aaron ne Miriam; na wɔn baanu firii adi.

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Montie me nsɛm ɛ. Sɛ AWURADE diyifoɔ bi wɔ mo mu a, adehunu mu na mema no hu me, daeɛ mu na mekasa mekyerɛ no:

english_verse: But my servant Moses is the leader of my people.
translation_verse: Na ɛnte sɛ m’akoa Mose; ɔno na mede me fie nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa.

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: Ano ne ano na me ne no de kasa ehunu mu, na ɛnyɛ mmebuo mu, na ɔhunu AWURADE suban. Na adɛn nti na moansuro sɛ mobɛkasa atia m’akoa Mose?

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bo fuu wɔn, na ɔsii mu kɔe.

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: Na mununkum no firii ntomadan no soɔ, na hwɛ, Miriam ayare kwata sɛ sukyerɛmma. Na Aaron danee ne ho hwɛɛ Miriam no, hwɛ, na wayare kwata.

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wo kyɛw nie, me wura. Mfa bɔne a yɛadi nkwaseasɛm ayɛ yi nto yɛn so.

english_verse: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead!”
translation_verse: Mma no nnyɛ sɛ efunu a ɔfiri ne na yam baeɛ na ne honam fa asɛe dada.

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Na sɛ n’agya hinam n’ani so ntasuo kɛkɛ mpo a, anka n’ani renwu nnanson anaa? Wɔnto no mu nnanson nsraban no akyi, na ɛno akyiri ansa na wɔmfa no mmra mu bio.

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Na wɔtoo Miriam mu nsraban no akyi nnanson. Na ɔman no antu kɔsii sɛ wɔde Miriam baa mu bio.

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Na ɛno akyiri no, ɔman no tu firii Haserot, na wɔkɔkyeree nsraban Paran serɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: na ɛhɔ na yɛhunuu abrane akɛseɛ no, na yɛyɛɛ yɛn ara yɛn ani so sɛ mmɛbɛ, na saa nso na yɛyɛɛ wɔ wɔn ani soɔ.

english_verse: “Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.”
translation_verse: Fa mmarima soma wɔn, na wɔnkɔsra Kanaan asase a mede merema Israelfoɔ no; monsoma ɔbarima baako mfiri wɔn nananom abusuakuo biara mu, na wɔn mu biara nyɛ wɔn mu mmapɔmma no bi.

english_verse: So Moses sent twelve tribal leaders from Israel's camp in the Paran Desert
translation_verse: Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so somaa wɔn firii Paran serɛ so, wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmarima a wɔyɛ Israelfoɔ mu atitire.

english_verse: Before Moses sent them into Canaan, he said: After you go through the Southern Desert of Canaan, continue north into the hill country
translation_verse: Na Mose somaa wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔsra Kanaan asase no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔfa Negeb ha yi na monkɔforo mmepɔ no.

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,
translation_verse: Na monkɔhwɛ asase no sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ ne aman a wɔtete soɔ no, sɛ wɔyɛ den anaasɛ wɔgo, wɔsua anaasɛ wɔdɔɔso,

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: ne sɛdeɛ asase no teɛ, sɛ emu yɛ fɔɔfɔɔ anaa pɛsɛɛ sɛ nnua wɔ so anaasɛ ebi nni so; na momfa akokoɔduro ntete asase no so aba bi mmra. Nso na saa berɛ no yɛ bobe aba a ɛdi kan berɛ.

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Na wɔsii mu kɔ kɔsraa asase no firi Sin serɛ so kɔsii Rehob, deɛ wɔnam kɔ Hamat no.

english_verse: After exploring the land of Canaan for
translation_verse: Na adaduanan duruiɛ no, wɔsane firi asase no so nsra bae.

english_verse: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit
translation_verse: Na wɔbaa Mose ne Aaron ne Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa nkyɛn Paran serɛ so wɔ Kades, na wɔbɔɔ wɔn kaseɛ kyerɛɛ wɔn ne asafo no nyinaa, na wɔde asase no so aba no kyerɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: and said: Look at this fruit! The land we explored is rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Na wɔbɔɔ wɔn amanneɛ kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛakɔ asase a wosomaa yɛn soɔ no so, na ɛsene nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ ampa, na ɛso aba nie.

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.
translation_verse: Nanso aman a wɔtete asase no soɔ no yɛ den, na nkuro no, wɔabɔ ho ban, ɛsoso sɛ, na yɛhunuu Anak mma nso wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Amalek te Negeb asase so, na Hetifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ ne Amorifoɔ tete bepɔ so, na Kanaanfoɔ tete mpoano ne Yordan ho.

english_verse: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, “Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it!”
translation_verse: Na Kaleb dwodwoo ɔman no maa Mose, na ɔkaa sɛ: Momma yɛnkɔ nkɔforo, na yɛnkɔfa asase no. Na tumi deɛ, yɛbɛtumi wɔn.

english_verse: But the other men replied, “Those people are much too strong for us.”
translation_verse: Na mmarima a wɔne no kɔeɛ no kaa sɛ: Yɛrentumi nkɔforo ntia ɔman no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ den sene yɛn.

english_verse: Then they started spreading rumors and saying, “We won't be able to grow anything in that soil. And the people are like giants.
translation_verse: Na wɔmaa asase a wɔkɔsraeɛ no ho atenka bɔne trɛɛ Israelfoɔ no mu sɛ: Asase a yɛfaa mu kɔsraeɛ no yɛ asase a ɛdi ɛsotefoɔ, na nkurɔfoɔ a yɛhunuu wɔn wɔ soɔ no nyinaa yɛ abrane ara nko;

english_verse: and complained to Moses and Aaron, “We wish we had died in Egypt or somewhere out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no nyinaa nwiinwii tiaa Mose ne Aaron, na asafo no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛkaa yɛn nko a, anka yɛwuwui wɔ Misraim asase so, anaa ɛserɛ so ha mpo. Ɛkaa yɛn nko a, anka yɛawuwu.

english_verse: Is the Lord leading us into Canaan, just to have us killed and our women and children captured? We'd be better off in Egypt.”
translation_verse: Na adɛn nti na AWURADE de yɛn reba asase yi so sɛ yɛmmɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano, na wɔmfa yɛn yerenom ne yɛn mma nnommum? Ɛnyɛ yɛ na ɛyɛ ma yɛn sɛ yɛbɛsane akɔ Misraim bio?

english_verse: Then they said to one another, “Let's choose our own leader and go back.”
translation_verse: Na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Momma yɛnsi otitire na yɛnsane nkɔ Misraim.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron bowed down to pray in front of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Mose ne Aaron de wɔn anim butubutuu fam, Israelfoɔ asafo badwa no nyinaa anim.

english_verse: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.
translation_verse: na wɔka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa sɛ: Asase a yɛtwaa mu kɔsraeɛ no yɛ asase pa ara.

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛsɔ AWURADE ani a, ɔde yɛn bɛduru asase no so na ɔde ama yɛn, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ.

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!
translation_verse: AWURADE ani so atua ara nko na monnteɛ, na monnsuro asase no sofoɔ no, na wɔyɛ yɛn aduane; wɔn kataman afiri wɔn so, na yɛn deɛ, AWURADE di yɛn akyi, monnsuro wɔn.

english_verse: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent. Moses Prays for the People
translation_verse: Na asafo no nyinaa kaa sɛ wɔnsi Yosua ne Kaleb aboɔ. Ɛnna AWURADE animuonyam puee ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ɔman yi bɛbu me animtia akɔsi da bɛn? Na ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na wɔrennye me nnie, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a mayɛ no wɔn mu no nyinaa akyi?

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: Mede owuyadeɛ mɛbobɔ wɔn na masɛe wɔn, na mede wo mayɛ ɔman kɛseɛ a ɛyɛ den sene wɔn.

english_verse: Show us your great power, Lord. You promised
translation_verse: Enti, mesrɛ wo, ma AWURADE tumi no nyɛ kɛseɛ, sɛdeɛ wokaa sɛ:

english_verse: that you love to show mercy and kindness. And you said that you are very patient, but that you will punish everyone guilty of doing wrong—not only them but their children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: AWURADE yɛ abufuo mu nyaa na n’adɔeɛ so. Ɔde amumuyɛ ne mmrato kyɛ, na bem na ɔmmu deɛ ɔdi fɔ; na ɔtua nananom amumuyɛ so ka de fa mma so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mmiɛnsa ne nnan so.

english_verse: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Fa ɔman yi amumuyɛ kyɛ wɔn ɛ, sɛdeɛ w’adom kɛseɛ no teɛ ne sɛdeɛ wode akyɛ ɔman yi firi Misraim abɛduru ha yi no.

english_verse: But as surely as I live and my power has no limit,
translation_verse: nanso sɛ mete aseɛ na AWURADE animuonyam bɛhyɛ asase nyinaa ma yi,

english_verse: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.
translation_verse: Na m’akoa Kaleb deɛ, sɛ honhom a ɛso wɔ ne mu na wadi m’akyi awie nti, mede no bɛduru asase a ɔkɔɔ soɔ no so, na n’asefoɔ adi so.

english_verse: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites Are Punished for Complaining
translation_verse: Na Amalekfoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ no te bonhwa no mu, ɔkyena monnane mo ho ntu nkɔ ɛserɛ so, Mmɛwa Po kwan so. Anwiinwiifoɔ no asotwe

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: to give this message to the people of Israel: You sinful people have complained against me too many times! Now I swear by my own life that I will give you exactly what you wanted.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Me ara sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, sɛdeɛ moakasa agu m’aso mu no, saa ara na mɛyɛ mo:

english_verse: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ yi so ara na mo afunu bɛdeda; mo mu nnipa a wɔkan wɔn sɛdeɛ mo nyinaa ano sie firi wɔn a wɔadi mfeɛ aduonu de rekorɔ, mo a monwiinwii tiaa me no,

english_verse: will enter the land that I solemnly promised to give you as your own—only Caleb and Joshua will go in.
translation_verse: morennuru asase a memaa me nsa so mekyerɛɛ sɛ mede mo bɛtena soɔ no so, gye Yefune ba Kaleb ne Nun ba Yosua.

english_verse: You were worried that your own children would be captured. But I, the Lord, will let them enter the land you have rejected.
translation_verse: Na mo mma a moka sɛ wɔbɛfa wɔn nnommum no, wɔn na mede wɔn bɛkɔ soɔ, na wɔahunu asase a moto ho pe no.

english_verse: You will die here in the desert!
translation_verse: Na mo deɛ, mo afunu bɛdeda ɛserɛ yi so,

english_verse: So they got up early the next morning and got ready to head toward the hill country of Canaan. They said, “We were wrong to complain about the Lord. Let's go into the land that he promised us.”
translation_verse: Na wɔtuaa nhema foro kɔɔ bepɔ no atifi kaa sɛ: Yɛn nie, yɛbɛforo akɔ deɛ AWURADE kaeɛ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ yɛayɛ bɔne.

english_verse: Ten of the men sent to explore the land had brought back bad news and had made the people complain against the Lord.
translation_verse: Na mmarima a Mose soma maa wɔkɔsraa asase no a wɔsane baeɛ na wɔmaa asafo no nyinaa nwiinwii tiaa no sɛ wɔmaa asase no ho atenka bɔne tenneeɛ no,

english_verse: So he sent a deadly disease that killed those men,
translation_verse: mmarima a wɔmaa asase no ho atenka bɔne tenneeɛ no wuwuu atɔfoɔ wuo AWURADE anim,

english_verse: but he let Joshua and Caleb live. The Israelites Fail To Enter Canaan (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: gye Nun ba Yosua ne Yefune ba Kaleb a wɔfra mmarima a wɔkɔsraa asase no mu no nko. Wɔn a wɔantie Nyankopɔn asɛm no asotwe

english_verse: But Moses replied, “You're disobeying the Lord! Your plan won't work,
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa sɛ: Adɛn na mofom AWURADE asɛm no ho yi? Yei deɛ, ɛrenyɛ yie.

english_verse: The Amalekites and the Canaanites came down from the hill country, defeated the Israelites, and chased them as far as the town of Hormah.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Amalekfoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte bepɔ no soɔ no siane ba bɛkunkumm wɔn bobɔɔ wɔn pete kɔduruu Horma.

english_verse: The people of Israel were very sad after Moses gave them the Lord's message.
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa nsɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa; na ɔman no dii abooboo pii.

english_verse: so don't even try it. The Lord refuses to help you, because you turned your backs on him. The Amalekites and the Canaanites are your enemies, and they will attack and defeat you.”
translation_verse: na Amalekfoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ wɔ mo anim hɔ, na mobɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano; na ɛnam sɛ moasane afiri AWURADE akyiri nti, AWURADE nso renni mo akyi.

english_verse: But the Israelites ignored Moses and marched toward the hill country, even though the sacred chest and Moses did not go with them.
translation_verse: Na wɔtintim wɔn anim foro kɔɔ bepɔ no atifi; na AWURADE apam adaka no ne Mose anka wɔn ho amfiri nsraban no mu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to give the Israelites the following laws about offering sacrifices:
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ moduru asase a morekɔtena soɔ a me ara mede merema mo no so,

english_verse: Bulls or rams or goats are the animals that you may burn on the altar as sacrifices to please me. You may also offer sacrifices voluntarily or because you made a promise, or because they are part of your regular religious ceremonies. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: na morebɔ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛfiri anantwie anaa nnwan mu ama AWURADE a, sɛ ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa okum afɔdeɛ a mode reyɛ aboadeɛ, anaa ɛyɛ ayamyi afɔdeɛ, anaa mo afahyɛ ase deɛ, sɛ morema no ayi hwa hwanhwam ama AWURADE a,

english_verse: If a bull is offered as a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing,
translation_verse: Na sɛ nantwie ba na wode rebɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa okum afɔdeɛ de ayɛ w’aboadeɛ, anaasɛ wode rebɛbɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE a,

english_verse: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a ɔmfa nka nantwie ba no ho ne esiam abupɛn du mu mmiɛnsa a wɔde ngo susutoa fa afɔre;

english_verse: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: na fa ahwiesa susutoa fa nso bra, na ɛnyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔyɛ ɔman mma nyinaa nyɛ adeɛ yi sei mfa mmɔ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE.

english_verse: This law will never change. I am the Lord, and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Mmara korɔ ne atemmudeɛ korɔ na ɛnna hɔ mma mo ne ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛsoɛ mo mu nyinaa.

english_verse: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.
translation_verse: na ɛba sɛ modi asase no so aduane no bi a, momma mmasoɔ adeɛ so mma AWURADE,

english_verse: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.
translation_verse: momfa mo mmɔre a ɛdi kan bi taterɛ nyɛ mmasoɔ adeɛ; sɛdeɛ moyɛ ayuporebea mmasoɔ adeɛ no, saa ara na momma soɔ;

english_verse: All your descendants must follow this law and offer part of the first batch of bread dough.
translation_verse: momfa mo mmɔrekan no bi mma AWURADE sɛ mmasoɔ adeɛ mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses to tell the people what must be done if they ever disobey his laws:
translation_verse: deɛ AWURADE nam Mose so ahyɛ mo nyinaa, firi da a AWURADE hyɛɛ mmara no de rekɔduru mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so no,

english_verse: If all of you disobey one of my laws without knowing it, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice, a wine offering, and a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: na sɛ wɔfom anifasoɔ mu a ɔman no nnim a, ɛnneɛ asafo no nyinaa mfa nantwinini baako mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE ne n’aduane afɔdeɛ ne n’ahwiesa, sɛdeɛ ne yɛbea teɛ, ne ɔpapo baako, na ɛnyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa, na wɔde bɛkyɛ wɔn; ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ ɛfom; na wɔn deɛ, wɔn fom no nti wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ aba de rebɛbɔ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ ne wɔn bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong without knowing it, you must sacrifice a year-old female goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi anhyɛ da na ɔyɛ bɔne a, ɛnneɛ ɔmfa abirekyibereɛ a wadi afe mmra mmɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ,

english_verse: The priest will then ask me to forgive you, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata, AWURADE anim, mma ɔkra a ɔfom anifasoɔ mu no, sɛ ɔrepata ama no; na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.
translation_verse: Mmara korɔ na ɛnna hɔ mma mo mma deɛ ɔyɛ biribi anifasoɔ mu; deɛ ɔyɛ Israelfoɔ mu kuromani, ne ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛsoɛ wɔn mu.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong on purpose, whether Israelite or foreigner, you have sinned against me by disobeying my laws. You will no longer belong to my people. A Man Put to Death for Gathering Firewood on the Sabbath
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ wabu AWURADE asɛm animtia na wabu ne mmara asɛm so: Twa na wɔbɛtwa saa onipa no atwene, n’amumuyɛ da ne so. Wɔsi homedasɛefoɔ aboɔ

english_verse: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no wɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no, wɔkɔhunuu ɔbarima bi a ɔrepɛ nnyina homeda;

english_verse: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.
translation_verse: na nnipa a wɔhunuu no sɛ ɔrepɛ nnyina no de no brɛɛ Mose ne Aaron ne asafo no nyinaa;

english_verse: But no one knew what to do with him, so he was not allowed to leave.
translation_verse: na wɔbɔɔ no dua mu, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔnnya nkyerɛɛ deɛ wɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death!”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kum na wɔnkum ɔbarima no, asafo no nyinaa nsi no aboɔ wɔ nsraban no akyi.

english_verse: So he was killed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Tassels on the People's Clothes
translation_verse: Ɛnna asafo no nyinaa de no firii adi kɔɔ nsraban no akyi kɔsii no aboɔ maa no wuiɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Ntoma ano nnwo ho mmara

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Wɔnyɛ wɔn ntoma ano nnwo wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu, na wɔmfa bibire homa nsosɔ ntoma ano nnwo no mu;

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na moakae me mmara nsɛm nyinaa ayɛ, na moayɛ kronkron ama mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God who led you out of Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a meyii mo firii Misraim asase soɔ sɛ mɛyɛ mo Nyankopɔn no: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Korah son of Izhar was a Levite from the Kohathite clan. One day he called together Dathan, Abiram, and On from the Reuben tribe, and the four of them decided to rebel against Moses. So they asked
translation_verse: na wɔne Israelfoɔ mu mmarima ahanu aduonum a wɔyɛ asafo no mu mmapɔmma a wɔayi wɔn sɛ abadwafoɔ, nnipa a wɔwɔ din sɔre tiaa Mose;

english_verse: and Aaron and said, “Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge?”
translation_verse: na wɔbɔɔ Mose ne Aaron so dwa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ayɛ yie! Asafo mu yi nyinaa yɛ nnipa kronkron, obiara biara na AWURADE wɔ wɔn mu, na adɛn nti na moma mo ho so AWURADE badwa soɔ?

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Na Mose teeɛ no, ɔde n’anim butuu fam;

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ Kora ne n’asefoɔ no nyinaa sɛ: Anɔpa, AWURADE bɛma wɔahunu deɛ ɔyɛ ne deɛ, ne deɛ ɔyɛ kronkron a ɔbɛma no abɛn no; na deɛ ɔbɛfa no no, ɔno na ɔbɛma no abɛn no.

english_verse: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!
translation_verse: na momfa ogya ngu mu, na momfa aduhwam ngu so, AWURADE anim, ɔkyena. Na ɛbɛba sɛ onipa a AWURADE bɛyi no no, ɔbɛyɛ kronkron. Afei deɛ, ayɛ yie, mo Lewi mma!

english_verse: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ mo ade ketewa sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn no ate mo afiri Israel asafo ho sɛ ɔde mo rebɛn ne ho na moayɛ AWURADE tenabea no ho adwuma, na moagyina asafo no anim asom wɔn?

english_verse: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.
translation_verse: Na wama wo ne wo nuanom Lewi mma a wɔka wo ho nyinaa abɛn no, na morepɛ asɔfodie nso yi?

english_verse: You and your followers have rebelled against the Lord, not against Aaron.
translation_verse: Enti AWURADE na wo ne w’asafo nyinaa ahyia atia no; na Aaron deɛ, hwan ne no na monwiinwii tia no?

english_verse: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: “We won't come!
translation_verse: Na Mose soma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram; na wɔse: Yɛremma!

english_verse: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ adewa sɛ woayi yɛn afiri asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ so rebɛku yɛn ɛserɛ soɔ, na woredi yɛn so abakomasɛm nso yi?

english_verse: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord, “Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Mose bo fuu pii, na ɔka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Nnane w’ani nkyerɛ wɔn aduane afɔdeɛ. Mennyee wɔn nsam afunumu baako mpo, nso menyɛɛ wɔn mu biara bɔne bi.

english_verse: Then he said to Korah, “Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Kora sɛ: Wo ne w’asafo no nyinaa mmra AWURADE anim, wo ne wɔn ne Aaron mmra ɔkyena;

english_verse: Each of you take along your fire pan with incense in it and offer the incense to the Lord.”
translation_verse: na mo mu biara mfa ne kukuwa, na ɔmfa aduhwam ngu mu, na obiara mfa ne kukuwa mmra AWURADE anim, nkukuwa ahanu aduonum; na wo nso, ne Aaron, obiara mfa ne kukuwa mmra.

english_verse: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na wɔn mu obiara faa ne kukuwa, na wɔsosoo gya guguu mu, na wɔde aduhwam guguu so de bɛgyinagyinaa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, wɔne Mose ne Aaron.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory
translation_verse: Na Kora maa asafo mu no nyinaa bɔɔ wɔn so dwa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. Na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ asafo mu no nyinaa.

english_verse: and said to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: “Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once!”
translation_verse: Montwe mo ho mfiri asafo yi mu, na memmene wɔn amonom.

english_verse: But the two men bowed down and prayed, “Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned?”
translation_verse: Na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn a woyɛ honam nyinaa ahonhom Nyankopɔn! Ɔbarima baako bɛyɛ bɔne na wo bo afu asafo mu no nyinaa?

english_verse: “Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translation_verse: Montwe mo ho mfiri Kora, Datan ne Abiram tenabea ho.

english_verse: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.
translation_verse: Na Mose sɔre sii mu kɔɔ Datan ne Abiram nkyɛn; na Israel mpanimfoɔ dii n’akyi kɔe.

english_verse: Then Moses warned the people, “Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ asafo no sɛ: Montwe mo ho mfiri nnipa abɔnefoɔ yi ntomadan ho ɛ, na monnka wɔn biribiara, na wɔampra mo ne wɔn bɔne nyinaa ankɔ.

english_verse: Moses said to the crowd, “The Lord has chosen me and told me to do these things—it wasn't my idea. And here's how you will know:
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa sɛ: Yei na mode bɛhunu sɛ AWURADE na ɔsomaa me sɛ menyɛ nneyɛɛ yi nyinaa, na ɛmfiri me ara:

english_verse: If these men die a natural death, it means the Lord hasn't chosen me.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ nnipa nyinaa wuo na yeinom bɛwuwuo na deɛ ɛto nnipa nyinaa na ɛto wɔn a, ɛnneɛ na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔsomaa me;

english_verse: But suppose the Lord does something that has never been done before. For example, what if a huge crack appears in the ground, and these men and their families fall into it and are buried alive, together with everything they own? Then you will know they have turned their backs on the Lord!”
translation_verse: na sɛ ade foforɔ na AWURADE bɛbɔ na asase bɛbue n’ano amene wɔn ne deɛ ɛwɔ wɔn nyinaa na wɔnam anikan asiane akɔ Asamando a, ɛnneɛ monhunu sɛ mmarima yi abu AWURADE animtia.

english_verse: As soon as Moses said this, the ground under the men opened up
translation_verse: Na ɔwiee nsɛm yi nyinaa ka no, wɔn ase asase paee,

english_verse: and swallowed them alive, together with their families and everything they owned. Then the ground closed back up, and they were gone.
translation_verse: na wɔne deɛ wɔwɔ nyinaa nam anikan siane kɔɔ Asamando, na asase sram wɔn so, na wɔyeraa wɔ ɔman asafo no mu.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites heard their screams, so they ran off, shouting, “We don't want that to happen to us!”
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia no nyinaa dwanee wɔ wɔn gyegyeegye no ano, kaa sɛ: Anyɛ a asase bɛmene yɛn nso!

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent a fire that burned up the
translation_verse: Na ogya firi AWURADE nkyɛn bɛhyee mmarima ahanu aduonum a wɔde aduhwam no baeɛ no.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Tell Aaron's son Eleazar to take the fire pans from the smoldering fire and scatter the coals. The pans are now sacred,
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Eleasa, na ɔntase nkukuwa no mfiri nhyeeɛ no mu, na dwiri ogya no petepete; na ɛyɛ kronkron:

english_verse: because they were used for offering incense to me. Have them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar. Those men died because of their sin, and now their fire pans will become a warning for the rest of the community.”
translation_verse: Nnebɔneyɛfoɔ yi a wɔayɛ wɔn kra ho bɔne nkukuwa no, na mommoro nyɛ abena atɛtrɛtɛ nkata afɔrebukyia no ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde baa AWURADE anim, na ayɛ kronkron, na ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mma Israelfoɔ no.

english_verse: Eleazar collected the pans and had them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar,
translation_verse: Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa faa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nkukuwa a wɔn a wɔahyeɛ no de baeɛ no, na wɔboro de yɛɛ afɔrebukyia no ho nkataho,

english_verse: just as the Lord had told Moses. The pans were a warning to the Israelites that only Aaron's descendants would be allowed to offer incense to the Lord. Anyone else who tried to would be punished like Korah and his followers. The Israelites Rebel and Are Punished
translation_verse: sɛ ɛnyɛ Israelfoɔ nkaeɛ adeɛ, na onipa foforɔ a ɔmfiri Aaron asefoɔ mu no ammɛn ammɛhye aduhwam AWURADE anim, na anyɛ no sɛ Kora ne n’asafo no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so ka kyerɛɛ no no.

english_verse: The next day the people of Israel again complained against Moses and Aaron, “The two of you killed some of the Lord's people!”
translation_verse: Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Israel asafo no nyinaa nwiinwii tiaa Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Mo na moakum AWURADE nkurɔfoɔ.

english_verse: As the people crowded around them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the sacred tent, and the Lord appeared in his glory in the cloud covering the tent.
translation_verse: Na asafo no boaboaa wɔn ano tiaa Mose ne Aaron no, wɔdanedanee wɔn ani kyerɛɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no, na hwɛ, na mununkum no akata so, na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho adi.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron walked to the front of the tent,
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron baa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim.

english_verse: where the Lord said to them,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Stand back! I am going to wipe out these Israelites once and for all.” They immediately bowed down and prayed.
translation_verse: Monsɔre mfiri asafo yi mu na memmene wɔn amonom. Na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron, “Grab your fire pan and fill it with hot coals from the altar. Put incense in it, then quickly take it to where the people are and offer it to the Lord, so they can be forgiven. The Lord is very angry, and people have already started dying!”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Fa kukuwa no, na so afɔrebukyia no so gya gu mu, na yɛ ntɛm fa kɔ asafo no nkyɛn kɔpata ma wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ abufuhyeɛ afiri AWURADE anim afi. Ɔyaredɔm no afiri aseɛ.

english_verse: Aaron walked back and stood with Moses at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔyaredɔm no to twaeɛ no, Aaron sane baa Mose nkyɛn ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Place these sticks in the tent right in front of the sacred chest where I appear to you.
translation_verse: Na gya gu ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, Adanseɛ no anim, deɛ me ne mo hyia hɔ no.

english_verse: I will then choose a man to be my priest, and his stick will sprout. After that happens, I won't have to listen to any more complaints about you.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a mɛyi no no poma bɛfefɛ, na mama me ho anwiinwii a Israelfoɔ nwiinwii tia mo no agyae.

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had commanded, and they gave him the walking sticks from the twelve tribal leaders, including Aaron's from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no; na wɔn mmapɔmma no nyinaa memaa no mpoma mmaako mmaako; mpoma dummienu, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no; na Aaron poma wɔ wɔn mpoma no mu.

english_verse: Moses took them and placed them in the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Mose gyaa mpoma no guu AWURADE anim adanseɛ ntomadan no mu.

english_verse: The next day when Moses went into the tent, flowers and almonds were already growing on Aaron's stick.
translation_verse: Na adeɛ kyeeɛ a Mose kɔɔ adanseɛ ntomadan no mu no, na hwɛ, Aaron poma a ɛyɛ Lewi fie deɛ no afefɛ ayɛ frɔmfrɔm agu nhwiren na aso sorɔno aba abere.

english_verse: Moses brought the twelve sticks out of the tent and showed them to the people. Each of the leaders found his own and took it.
translation_verse: Na Mose tasee mpoma no nyinaa de firii AWURADE anim firii adi brɛɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa, na wɔhwɛe, na wɔn mu biara faa ne poma.

english_verse: But the Lord told Moses, “Put Aaron's stick back! Let it stay near the sacred chest as a warning to anyone who might think of rebelling. If these people don't stop their grumbling about me, I will wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa Aaron poma no sane bra Adanseɛ no anim na wɔmfa nsie, na ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mma asoɔdenfoɔ no, na woatwa wɔn anwiinwii a wɔnwiinwii tia me no so, na wɔanwuwu.

english_verse: The Israelites cried out to Moses, “We're done for
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛrewuwu, yɛresɛe, yɛn nyinaa resɛe!

english_verse: and doomed if we even go near the sacred tent!”
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛn AWURADE tenabea no wu: Yɛn nyinaa nwie sa anaa?

english_verse: You must see that they perform their duties. But if they go near any of the sacred objects or the altar, all of you will die.
translation_verse: na wɔnkura w’adwuma no mu bi na wɔnyɛ ntomadan no ho nnwuma nyinaa; na kronkronbea nnoɔma ne afɔrebukyia no ho nko na wɔmmpini, na wɔne mo nyinaa nso anwuwu.

english_verse: No one else is allowed to take care of the sacred tent or do anything connected with it.
translation_verse: Na wɔnka wo ho, na wɔnkura ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho adwuma no mu, nyɛ ntomadan no ho adwuma nyinaa, na onipa foforɔ biara ammɛn mo.

english_verse: Follow these instructions, so I won't become angry and punish the Israelites ever again.
translation_verse: Na monhwɛ kronkronbea no ho nnwuma no ne afɔrebukyia no ho nnwuma no, na abufuhyeɛ bi amma Israelfoɔ no so bio.

english_verse: I alone chose the Levites from all the other tribes to belong to me, and I have given them to you as your helpers.
translation_verse: Na me deɛ, hwɛ, mafa mo nuanom Lewifoɔ afiri Israelfoɔ no mu ama mo sɛ akyɛdeɛ a wɔde ama AWURADE, sɛ wɔnyɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho som adwuma no.

english_verse: But only you and your sons can serve as priests at the altar and in the most holy place. Your work as priests is a gift from me, and anyone else who tries to do that work must be put to death. The Priests' Share of Offerings Given to the Lord (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na wo ne wo mma a wɔka wo ho no nhwɛ mo asɔfodie no, afɔrebukyia no ho nsɛm nyinaa mu ne ntwamutam no mu deɛ no mu mfa nsom. Mede mo asɔfodie no mama mo sɛ akyɛdeɛ som adwuma; na obi foforɔ biara a ɔpinkyɛ no, wɔnku no.

english_verse: You are allowed to eat the meat of those animals, just as you can eat the choice ribs and the right hind leg of the special sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na wɔn nam nyɛ wo deɛ sɛ ohim yan ne srɛ nifa no yɛ wo deɛ no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron: I have put you in charge of the sacred gifts and sacrifices that the Israelites bring to me. And from now on, you, your sons, and your descendants will receive part of the sacrifices for sin, as well as part of the grain sacrifices, and the sacrifices to make things right. Your share of these sacrifices will be the parts not burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron a ɛfiri ogya no mu a ɛnyɛ wo deɛ nie: Wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ biara a wɔde ba, wɔn aduane afɔdeɛ biara ne wɔn bɔne ho afɔdeɛ biara ne wɔn asodie ho afɔdeɛ biara a wɔde brɛ me nyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron mma wo ne wo mma no.

english_verse: Since these things are sacred, they must be eaten near the sacred tent, but only men are allowed to eat them.
translation_verse: Di no faako a ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron pa ara, mmarima nyinaa nni bi, ɛnyɛ wo ade kronkron.

english_verse: You will also receive part of the special gifts and offerings that the Israelites bring to me. Any member of your family who is clean and acceptable for worship can eat these things.
translation_verse: Na yei nso nyɛ wo deɛ: Wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ mu mmasoɔ adeɛ, Israelfoɔ him afɔdeɛ nyinaa; wɔde ama wo ne wo mmammarima ne wo mmammaa a wɔka wo ho sɛ daa kyɛfa; obiara a ne ho teɛ wo fie mu nni bi.

english_verse: For example, when the Israelites bring me the first batches of oil, wine, and grain, you can have the best parts of those gifts.
translation_verse: Ngo foforɔ mu deɛ ɛyɛ koraa no nyinaa ne nsa foforɔ ne ayuo mu deɛ ɛyɛ koraa no nyinaa, emu adikan a wɔde ma AWURADE no, wo na wɔde ama woɔ.

english_verse: And the first part of the crops from their fields and vineyards also belongs to you. The people will offer this to me, then anyone in your family who is clean may have some of it.
translation_verse: Wɔn asase so ade nyinaa mu adikan a wɔde brɛ AWURADE no, ɛnyɛ wo deɛ; obiara a ne ho teɛ wɔ wo fie nni bi.

english_verse: The first-born son in every Israelite family, as well as the first-born males of their flocks and herds, belong to me. But every first-born son and first-born donkey must be bought back from me.
translation_verse: Adeɛ biara a ɛbue yafunu ano ɔhonam nyinaa mu a wɔde brɛ AWURADE no, onipa oo, afieboa oo, ɛnyɛ wo deɛ; nnipa mmakan ne afieboa a wɔn ho nteɛ mmakan nso, wɔnhyɛ wɔn ananmu.

english_verse: The price for a first-born son who is at least one month old will be five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Na ananmuhyɛdeɛ no deɛ, dwetɛ nnwetɛbena nnum a wobɛhyɛ ama wɔn sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena a ano si gera aduonu no teɛ.

english_verse: However, all first-born cattle, sheep, and goats belong to me and cannot be bought back. Splatter their blood on the altar and send their fat up in smoke, so I can smell it and be pleased.
translation_verse: Na nantwie abakan anaa odwanten abakan anaa abirekyie abakan deɛ, mma wɔnnhyɛ ananmu, na wɔyɛ kronkron; fa wɔn mogya pete afɔrebukyia no so na hye wɔn sradeɛ ma no nyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: From now on, the sacred offerings that the Israelites give to me will belong to you, your sons, and your daughters. This is my promise to you and your descendants, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Akronkronneɛ mu mmasoɔ adeɛ a Israelfoɔ de brɛ AWURADE nyinaa, mede mama wo ne wo mmammarima ne wo mmammaa a wɔka wo ho no sɛ daa kyɛfa; ɛnyɛ AWURADE anim daa nkyene apam mma wo ne w’asefoɔ a wɔka wo ho no.

english_verse: You will not receive any land in Israel as your own. I am the Lord, and I will give you whatever you need. What the Levites Receive The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Wɔn asase no bi na worennie, na worennya kyɛfa biara wɔn mu: Mene wo kyɛfa ne w’agyapadeɛ Israelfoɔ mu.

english_verse: Ten percent of the Israelites' crops and one out of every ten of their newborn animals belong to me. But I am giving all this to the Levites as their pay for the work they do at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɔ no deɛ, wɔn som a wɔsom wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu no nti, hwɛ, mede Israel mu ntotosoɔ du du nyinaa mama wɔn sɛ agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: They are the only ones allowed to work at the tent, and they must not let anyone else come near it. Those who do come near must be put to death, and the Levites will also be punished. This law will never change. Since the Levites won't be given any land in Israel as their own,
translation_verse: na Lewifoɔ no deɛ, wɔn na wɔnyɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho som adwuma, na wɔnsoa ɛho mmusuo: Ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu; Israelfoɔ mu deɛ, wɔrennya agyapadeɛ biara.

english_verse: they will be given the crops and newborn animals that the Israelites offer to me. What the Levites Must Give
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ ntotosoɔ du du a wɔmema so yɛ mmasoɔ adeɛ ma AWURADE no, mede mama Lewifoɔ no sɛ agyapadeɛ, ɛno nti na maka no wɔn ho sɛ: Wɔrennya agyapadeɛ biara Israelfoɔ mu no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the Levites: When you receive from the people of Israel ten percent of their crops and newborn animals, you must offer a tenth of that to me.
translation_verse: Lewifoɔ no deɛ, kasa kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ mogyegye Israelfoɔ hɔ ntotosoɔ du du a mede mama mo firi wɔn nkyɛn sɛ mo agyapadeɛ no a, ɛnneɛ momma emu bi so nyɛ AWURADE mmasoɔ adeɛ, ntotosoɔ du du no mu ntosoɔ du.

english_verse: Just as the Israelites give me part of their grain and wine, you must set aside part of what you receive
translation_verse: Na wɔmmu mo mmasoɔ adeɛ mma mo sɛ ayuporebea ayuo ne nsa-kyi-amena mu adenya.

english_verse: so the best of what you receive will be mine.
translation_verse: Adeɛ a wɔbɛma mo nyinaa mu na momma AWURADE mmasoɔ adeɛ nyinaa, emu deɛ ɛyɛ koraa no nyinaa mu akronkronneɛ.

english_verse: After you have dedicated the best parts to me, you can eat the rest, just as the Israelites eat part of their grain and wine after offering them to me.
translation_verse: Enti ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Morema emu deɛ ɛyɛ koraa no so a, wɔmmu deɛ aka no mma Lewifoɔ sɛ ayuporebea nnɔbaeɛ ne nsa-kyi-amena mu adenya.

english_verse: Your share may be eaten anywhere by anyone in your family, because it is your pay for working at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na monni no baabiara, mo ne mo fiefoɔ, na ɛyɛ mo ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ho som adwuma so akatua.

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron the following law: The people of Israel must bring Moses a reddish-brown cow that has nothing wrong with it and that has never been used for plowing.
translation_verse: Yei ne mmara mu ahyɛdeɛ a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ wɔmfa nantwibereɛ kɔkɔɔ a ɔdi mu a ɔnni dɛm a kɔnnua nkɔɔ ne so pɛn mmrɛ wo;

english_verse: Moses will give it to Eleazar the priest, then it will be led outside the camp and killed while Eleazar watches.
translation_verse: na momfa no mma Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa, na ɔmfa no mfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi, na wɔnku no n’anim.

english_verse: He will dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times in the direction of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa mfa ne nsateaa nka ne mogya no bi, na ɔmpete ne mogya no bi ngu ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim fam mprɛnson.

english_verse: Then the whole cow, including its skin, meat, blood, and insides must be burned.
translation_verse: Na wɔnhye nantwibereɛ no wɔ n’anim, ne nwoma ne ne nam ne ne mogya ne ne sɛbeɛ no.

english_verse: A priest is to throw a stick of cedar wood, a hyssop branch, and a piece of red yarn into the fire.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa tweneduro ne adwera ne kuntu kɔkɔɔ ngu nantwibereɛ a ɔrehyeɛ no so.

english_verse: After the ceremony, the priest is to take a bath and wash his clothes. Only then can he go back into the camp, but he remains unclean and unfit for worship until evening.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nsi ne ntadeɛ na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ɛno akyiri ansa na ɔmmra nsraban no mu; na ɔsɔfoɔ no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: The man who burned the cow must also wash his clothes and take a bath, but he is also unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔhyeeɛ no nsi ne ntadeɛ nsuo mu, na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: A man who isn't unclean must collect the ashes of the burnt cow and store them outside the camp in a clean place. The people of Israel can mix these ashes with the water used in the ceremony to wash away sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima bi a ne ho teɛ nsesa nantwibereɛ no nso no mfa nkɔgu nsraban no akyi baabi a ɛhɔ teɛ, na ɛnyɛ Israelfoɔ asafo no ahodwira nsuo nsie; ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The man who collects the ashes must wash his clothes, but will remain unclean until evening. This law must always be obeyed by the people of Israel and the foreigners living among them. What Must Be Done after Touching a Dead Body The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔsesaa nantwibereɛ no nso no nsi ne ntadeɛ, na ne ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ; na ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mma Israel mma ne ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔsoɛ wɔn mu.

english_verse: If you touch a dead body, you will be unclean for seven days.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔka onipa biara funu no, ne ho nte nnanson;

english_verse: But if you wash with the water mixed with the cow's ashes on the third day and again on the seventh day, you will be clean and acceptable for worship. You must wash yourself on those days; if you don't, you will remain unclean.
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔmfa yei nnwira ne ho mfiri ne bɔne mu da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne da a ɛtɔ so nson no, na ne ho ate; na sɛ wannwira ne ho da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne da a ɛtɔ so nson no a, ne ho rente.

english_verse: Suppose you touch a dead body, but refuse to be made clean by washing with the water mixed with ashes. You will be guilty of making my sacred tent unclean and will no longer belong to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔka owufoɔ, onipa bi a wawuo funu, na wannwira ne ho no agu AWURADE tenabea ho fi, na wɔntwa saa ɔkra no mfiri Israel mu ntwene, ɛfiri sɛ ahodwira nsuo a wɔampete angu ne soɔ nti, ne ho nte, ne ho fi da so wɔ ne ho.

english_verse: If someone dies in a tent while you are there, you will be unclean for seven days. And anyone who later enters the tent will also be unclean.
translation_verse: Yei ne mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ berɛ a obi awu ntomadan mu: Sɛ onipa wu ntomadan mu a, obiara a ɔba ntomadan no mu ne adeɛ biara a ɛwɔ ntomadan no mu no ho nte nnanson;

english_verse: Any open jar in the tent is unclean.
translation_verse: adeɛ biara a ano da hɔ na ɛnni mmuasoɔ ne ɛho homa no, ɛho nte.

english_verse: If you touch the body of someone who died or was killed, or if you touch a human bone or a grave, you will be unclean for seven days.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔka deɛ watɔ nkrantɛ ano anaa efunu bi anaa onipa nnompe anaa ɛda bi wiram no, ne ho nte nnanson.

english_verse: Before you can be made clean, someone who is clean must take some of the ashes from the burnt cow and stir them into a pot of spring water. That same person must dip a hyssop branch in the water and ashes, then sprinkle it on the tent and everything in it, including everyone who was inside. If you have touched a human bone, a grave, or a dead body, you must be sprinkled with that water.
translation_verse: na ɔbarima a ne ho teɛ bi mfa adwera mmɔ nsuo no mu, na ɔmpete ngu ntomadan no ne emu nnoɔma nyinaa ne akra a wɔwɔ hɔ no ne deɛ waka dompe anaa ɔtɔfoɔ anaa efunu anaa ɛda bi no so.

english_verse: If this is done on the third day and on the seventh day, you will be clean. Then after you take a bath and wash your clothes, you can worship that evening.
translation_verse: Na deɛ ne ho teɛ no mpete ngu deɛ ne ho nteɛ no so, da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne da a ɛtɔ so nson no, na ɔnnwira ne ho da a ɛtɔ so nson no, na ɔnsi ne ntadeɛ, na ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na ne ho ate anwummerɛ.

english_verse: If you are unclean and refuse to be made clean by washing with the water mixed with ashes, you will be guilty of making my sacred tent unclean, and you will no longer belong to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na onipa a ne ho nteɛ na wannwira ne ho no, wɔbɛtwa saa ɔkra no afiri ɔman asafo no mu, ɛfiri sɛ wagu AWURADE kronkronbea no ho fi; wɔampete ahodwira nsuo no angu ne so, enti ne ho nte.

english_verse: These laws will never change. The man who sprinkled the water and the ashes on you when you were unclean must also wash his clothes. And whoever touches this water is unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na yei nyɛ wɔn daa ahyɛdeɛ. Na deɛ ɔpetee ahodwira nsuo no nsi ne ntadeɛ; na deɛ ɔka ahodwira nsuo no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ;

english_verse: When you are unclean, everything you touch becomes unclean, and anyone who touches you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: na adeɛ biara a deɛ ne ho nteɛ no ka no ho nte, na obiara a ɔka no no ho nte kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel arrived at the Zin Desert during the first month and set up camp near the town of Kadesh. It was there that Miriam died and was buried.
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa baa Sin serɛ so, bosome a ɛdi kan no mu, na ɔman no tenaa Kades; na Miriam wuu wɔ hɔ, na wɔsiee no hɔ ara.

english_verse: The Israelites had no water, so they went to Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na nsuo nni hɔ mma asafo no, na wɔhyia tiaa Mose ne Aaron.

english_verse: and complained, “Moses, we'd be better off if we had died along with the others in front of the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no ne Mose hamee, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɛkaa yɛn nko a, anka ɛberɛ a yɛn nuanom wuwuu AWURADE anim no yɛwuwuu bi.

english_verse: You brought us into this desert, and now we and our livestock are going to die!
translation_verse: Na adɛn nti na mode AWURADE man aba ɛserɛ yi so sɛ yɛmmɛwuwu wɔ ha, yɛn ne yɛn mmoa?

english_verse: Egypt was better than this horrible place. At least there we had grain and figs and grapevines and pomegranates. But now we don't even have any water.”
translation_verse: Na adɛn nti na moyii yɛn Misraim sɛ mode yɛn reba deɛ ɛnyɛ yi, deɛ wɔntumi nnua hwee a borɔdɔma ne bobe ne atoaa nnie, na nsuo mpo a wɔnom nnie yi?

english_verse: Moses and Aaron went to the entrance to the sacred tent, where they bowed down. The Lord appeared to them in all of his glory
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron firii asafo no anim baa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam; na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: and said, “Moses, get your walking stick. Then you and Aaron call the people together and command that rock to give you water. That's how you will provide water for the people of Israel and their livestock.”
translation_verse: Fa poma no na boa asafo no ano, wo ne wo nua Aaron, na monkasa nkyerɛ ɔbotan no wɔn anim, na ɛmma ne nsuo, na yi ɔbotan no mu nsuo ma wɔn ma asafo no ne wɔn mmoa nnom.

english_verse: Moses obeyed and took his stick from the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Mose faa poma no firii AWURADE anim, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ no no;

english_verse: After he and Aaron had gathered the people around the rock, he said, “Look, you rebellious people, and you will see water flow from this rock!”
translation_verse: na Mose ne Aaron boaboaa ɔman asafo no ano ɔbotan no anim, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Montie ɛ, mo asoɔdenfoɔ, adɛn ɛsɛ sɛ yɛnya nsuo firi ɔbotan yi mu ma mo anaa?

english_verse: He raised his stick in the air and struck the rock two times. At once, water gushed from the rock, and the people and their livestock had water to drink.
translation_verse: Na Mose maa ne nsa so de ne poma no bɔɔ ɔbotan no mprenu, na nsuo pii firi mu bae, na asafo no ne wɔn mmoa nomee.

english_verse: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you refused to believe in my power, these people did not respect me. And so, you will not be the ones to lead them into the land I have promised.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Sɛ moannye me annie na moanyɛ me kronkron Israelfoɔ anim nti, moremfa ɔman asafo yi nnuru asase a mede mama wɔn no so.

english_verse: The Israelites had complained against the Lord, and he had shown them his holy power by giving them water to drink. So they named the place Meribah, which means “Complaining.” Israel Isn't Allowed To Go through Edom
translation_verse: Yei ne Meriba asuo, ɛfiri sɛ Israelfoɔ ne AWURADE hamee na ɔyɛɛ ne ho kronkron wɔn mu. Edomfoɔ si Mose kwan

english_verse: Moses sent messengers from Israel's camp near Kadesh with this message for the king of Edom: We are Israelites, your own relatives, and we're sure you have heard the terrible things that have happened to us.
translation_verse: Na Mose somaa abɔfoɔ firi Kades kɔɔ Edomhene nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛ wo nua Israel seɛ nie: Wo ara wonim ɔhaw a ɛtoo yɛn nyinaa,

english_verse: Our ancestors settled in Egypt and lived there a long time. But later the Egyptians were cruel to us,
translation_verse: sɛ yɛn nananom siane kɔɔ Misraim, na yɛtenaa Misraim nna bebree, na Misraimfoɔ yɛɛ yɛn ne yɛn nananom bɔne;

english_verse: and when we begged our Lord for help, he answered our prayer and brought us out of that land. Now we are camped at the border of your territory, near the town of Kadesh.
translation_verse: na yɛsu frɛɛ AWURADE, na ɔtee yɛn nne, na ɔsomaa ɔbɔfoɔ maa no bɛyii yɛn firii Misraim; na hwɛ, yɛwɔ Kades, kuro a ɛwɔ wo hyeɛ soɔ mu.

english_verse: Please let us go through your country. We won't go near your fields or vineyards, and we won't drink any water from your wells. We will stay on the main road until we leave your territory.
translation_verse: Ma yɛmfa w’asase so; yɛremfa mfuo ne nturo mu, nanso yɛrennom mmura mu nsuo bi; yɛbɛnante ɔhene tempɔn so akɔ, yɛremmane nifa anaa benkum de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ yɛbɛtwam w’asase soɔ.

english_verse: But the king of Edom answered, “No, I won't let you go through our country! And if you try, we will attack you.”
translation_verse: Na Edom ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mmɛfa me mu, na mamfa nkrantɛ mamfiri adi mammɛhyia wo.

english_verse: Moses sent back this message: “We promise to stay on the main road, and if any of us or our livestock drink your water, we will pay for it. We just want to pass through.”
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Tempɔn so na yɛrebɛfa, na sɛ yɛn ne yɛn mmoa nom wo nsuo bi a, yɛbɛtua ka; ɛnyɛ asɛm biara, na yɛn nan nko ara na ma yɛmfa ntwam mu nkɔ

english_verse: But the king insisted, “You can't go through our land!” Then Edom sent out its strongest troops
translation_verse: Na wɔse: Mommɛtwam! Na Edom de dɔm pii ne nsa a emu yɛ den firii adi bɛhyiaa wɔn.

english_verse: to keep Israel from passing through its territory. So the Israelites had to go in another direction. Aaron Dies
translation_verse: Na Edom kamee Israel ɔkwan a wɔde bɛtwam n’asase soɔ. Enti Israel mane firii ne ho.

english_verse: After the Israelites had left Kadesh and had gone as far as Mount Hor
translation_verse: Na Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa tu firii Kades, na wɔbaa Hor bepɔ ho.

english_verse: “Aaron, this is where you will die. You and Moses disobeyed me at Meribah, and so you will not enter the land I promised the Israelites.
translation_verse: Aka kakraa bi na Aaron ati ne mpanimfoɔ wɔ asamando, na ɔrenkɔ asase a mede merema Israelfoɔ no so, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ asoɔden maa m’anomu asɛm Meriba asuo ho.

english_verse: Moses, go with Aaron and his son Eleazar to the top of the mountain.
translation_verse: Fa Aaron ne ne ba Eleasa, na wo ne wɔn mforo Hor bepɔ,

english_verse: Then take Aaron's priestly robe from him and place it on Eleazar. Aaron will die there.”
translation_verse: na yi Aaron ntadeɛ no fa hyɛ ne ba Eleasa, na ɔnwu wɔ hɔ nti ne mpanimfoɔ wɔ asamando.

english_verse: Moses obeyed, and everyone watched as he and Aaron and Eleazar walked to the top of Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Na Mose yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na wɔforoo Hor bepɔ, asafo no nyinaa anim.

english_verse: Moses then took the priestly robe from Aaron and placed it on Eleazar. Aaron died there. When Moses and Eleazar came down,
translation_verse: Na Mose yiyii Aaron ntadeɛ no de hyɛɛ ne ba Eleasa, na Aaron wuu wɔ bepɔ no atifi hɔ. Na Mose ne Eleasa firii bepɔ no so sianee.

english_verse: the people knew that Aaron had died, and they mourned his death for
translation_verse: Na asafo no nyinaa hunuu sɛ Aaron awuo no, Israel fie nyinaa suu no adaduasa.

english_verse: The Israelites had to go around the territory of Edom, so when they left Mount Hor, they headed south toward the Red Sea. But along the way, the people became so impatient
translation_verse: Na wɔtu firii Hor bepɔ ho faa Mmɛwa Po kwan so sɛ wɔretwa Edom asase ho kɔntɔnkrɔn akɔ. Na ɔman no ahome tee wɔn ho pii ɔkwan no so.

english_verse: that they complained against God and said to Moses, “Did you bring us out of Egypt, just to let us die in the desert? There's no water out here, and we can't stand this awful food!”
translation_verse: Na ɔman no kasa tiaa Onyankopɔn ne Mose sɛ: Adɛn nti na moyii yɛn firii Misraim sɛ yɛmmɛwuwu ɛserɛ soɔ? Na aduane biara nni hɔ, na nsuo biara nso nni hɔ, na aduane hunu yi afono yɛn.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent poisonous snakes that bit and killed many of them.
translation_verse: Ɛnna AWURADE somaa awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ borɔ baa ɔman no mu bɛkekaa ɔman no, na Israel mu nnipa pii wuwui.

english_verse: Some of the people went to Moses and admitted, “It was wrong of us to insult you and the Lord. Now please ask him to make these snakes go away.” Moses prayed,
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔman no baa Mose nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Yɛayɛ bɔne sɛ yɛkasa tiaa AWURADE ne woɔ; pa AWURADE kyɛw na ɔmmɛyi awɔ no mfiri yɛn so. Na Mose paa kyɛw maa ɔman no.

english_verse: and the Lord answered, “Make a snake out of bronze and place it on top of a pole. Anyone who gets bitten can look at the snake and be saved from death.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Yɛ ɔwɔ a n’ano wɔ borɔ nsɛsoɔ, na fa no sɛne frankaa dua so; na obiara a ebi aka no no, sɛ ɔhwɛ a, ɔbɛnya nkwa.

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord. And all of those who looked at the bronze snake lived, even though they had been bitten by the poisonous snakes. Israel's Journey to Moab
translation_verse: Na Mose yɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɔwɔ no, na ɔde no sɛnee frankaa dua no so, na sɛ ɔwɔ ka obi na ɔhwɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɔwɔ no a, na wanya nkwa. Israelfoɔ toa wɔn akwantuo no so

english_verse: As the Israelites continued their journey to Canaan, they camped at Oboth,
