english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Mo anafoɔ fam nkyɛn mfiri Sin serɛ so Edom nkyɛn mu. Na mo anafoɔ fam hyeɛ no mfiri Nkyene Po awieeɛ wɔ apueeɛ;

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: na mo hyeɛ no mmra Akrabim aforoeɛ anafoɔ fam, na ɛntwam nkɔ Sin, na ɛmfiri hɔ nkɔ Kades-barnea anafoɔ fam, na ɛmfiri hɔ nkɔ Hasar-adar ntwam nkɔfa Asmon.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Na ɛhyeɛ no nkonton mfiri Asmon nkɔ Misraim subonhwa no mu, na ano nkɔpem po no ano.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Na yei nyɛ mo atifi fam hyeɛ: Momfiri po kɛseɛ no ano mfa mo ani nkari Hor bepɔ,

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: na momfiri Hor bepɔ ho nkari deɛ wɔfa kɔ Hamat, na ɛhyeɛ no ano nkɔpem Sedad.

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: Na ɛhyeɛ no mfiri hɔ nkɔ Sifron, na ano nkɔpem Hasar-enan; yei na ɛnyɛ mo atifi fam hyeɛ.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Na monkari apueeɛ fam hyeɛ mfiri Hasar-enan nkɔ Sefam;

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: na ɛhyeɛ no mfiri Sefam nsiane nkɔ Ribla, Ain apueeɛ, na ɛhyeɛ no nsiane ara nkɔpem Kineret Po no nsunoa, apueeɛ;

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: na ɛhyeɛ no nsiane nkɔduru Yordan, na ano nkɔpem Nkyene Po ano. Yei ne mo asase no, sɛdeɛ ɛho ahyeɛ teɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Na Mose hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Yei ne asase a momfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ mu nni soɔ a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Na Ruben mma abusuakuo, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, ne Gad mma abusuakuo, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, ne Manase abusuakuo fa no anya wɔn kyɛfa.

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: Mmusuakuo mmienu ne fa no anya wɔn kyɛfa Yeriko, Yordan agya, anim fam ne apueeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Mmarima a wɔnkyɛ asase no mu mma mo no din nie: Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne Nun ba Yosua.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Na monyiyi mmusuakuo nyinaa mu mmapɔmma mmaako mmaako, na wɔnkyɛ asase no mu.

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Yeinom ne wɔn a AWURADE hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkyɛ Kanaan asase mma Israelfoɔ no.

english_verse: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Hyɛ Israelfoɔ no na wɔmfa wɔn agyapadeɛ a wɔanya no mu nkuro bi mma Lewifoɔ no na wɔntena mu, na nkuro no ho mmoa adidibea nsase nso momfa mma Lewifoɔ.

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: Na nkuro no nyɛ wɔn tenabea, na ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase no nneda hɔ mma wɔn anantwie ne wɔn nyɛmmoa ne wɔn mmoa nyinaa.

english_verse: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure
translation_verse: Na monsusu kuro no akyi apueeɛ fam basafa apem ne anafoɔ fam basafa apem ne atɔeɛ fam basafa apem ne atifi fam basafa apem, na kuro no nna ntam. Yei ne nkuro no ho mmoa adidibea nsase a ɛnyɛ wɔn dea.

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: Na nkuro a mode ma Lewifoɔ no nyɛ dwanekɔbea nkuro nsia a mode bɛma sɛ nnipakumfoɔ nnwane nkɔ hɔ; na momfa nkuro aduanan mmienu nka ho:

english_verse: Since the towns for the Levites must come from Israel's own tribal lands, the larger tribes will give more towns than the smaller ones. The Safe Towns (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na nkuro a mogye firi Israelfoɔ no agyapadeɛ mu ma Lewifoɔ no, wɔn a wɔn deɛ dɔɔso no, wɔn hɔ na monnye pii, na wɔn a wɔn deɛ sua no, monnye wɔn hɔ kakraa bi. Obiara sɛdeɛ n’agyapadeɛ a wanya no dodoɔ teɛ no na ɔmfa ne nkuro no bi mma Lewifoɔ. Dwanekɔbea nkuro

english_verse: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revengefor his relative's death as soon as he finds you.
translation_verse: Mogya ho weretɔfoɔ na ɔnkum owudini no; ɔto no a, ɔnku no.

english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Na nkuro a mobɛyie no nyɛ mo dwanekɔbea nkuro nsia.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ motwa Yordan kɔ Kanaan asase so a,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: monyiyi nkuro a ɛfata na ɛnyɛ dwanekɔbea nkuro mma mo, na onipakumfoɔ a ne nsa apa obi ho no adwane akɔ hɔ.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Na nkuro no nyɛ dwanekɔbea mma mo mfiri ɔweretɔfoɔ nsam, na onipakumfoɔ no anwu kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛgyina asafo anim na wɔabu no atɛn ansa.

english_verse: three on each side of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Monyi nkuro mmiɛnsa mma Yordan agya, na monyi nkuro mmiɛnsa nso mma Kanaan asase so;

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: ɛnyɛ dwanekɔbea nkuro, na nkuro nsia yi nyɛ dwanekɔbea mma Israelfoɔ ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne ɔmamfrani a ɔte wɔn mu, na obiara a ne nsa apa onipa bi ho no adwane akɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Anaasɛ ɔkura dua a ɛbɛtumi akum onipa de bɔ obi ma no wu a, ɔyɛ owudini; kum na wɔnkum owudini no.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: anaasɛ nitan so na ɔde ne nsa bɔ no ma no wu a, kum na wɔnkum deɛ ɔbɔɔ no no; ɔyɛ owudini: Mogya ho weretɔfoɔ, sɛ ɔto owudini no a, ɔnku no.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ asafo no nnyina saa ahyɛdeɛ yi so mmu onipakumfoɔ no ne mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no ntam atɛn.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Na asafo no nyi onipakumfoɔ no mfiri mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no nsam, na asafo no mfa no nsane nkɔ ne dwanekɔbea kuro a ɔdwane kɔɔ mu no mu, na ɔnkɔtena hɔ nkɔsi sɛ ɔsɔfo panin a wɔasra no sra ngo kronkron no bɛwuo.

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: na mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no kɔto no ne dwanekɔbea kuro no hyeɛ akyi, na mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no kɔkum onipakumfoɔ no a, ɔnni mogya ho fɔ.

english_verse: You must stay inside the town until the high priest dies; only then can you go back home.
translation_verse: Na anka ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtena ne dwanekɔbea kuro no mu kɔsi sɛ ɔsɔfo panin no bɛwuo, na ɔsɔfo panin no wuo akyiri no, onipakumfoɔ no asane aba asase a ɛyɛ n’agyapadeɛ no so bio.

english_verse: The community of Israel must always obey these laws.
translation_verse: Na yei nyɛ atemmuo ahyɛdeɛ mma mo, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu, mo tenabea nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔkum obi no, adansefoɔ anomu asɛm so na wɔmfa nkum onipakumfoɔ no; na ɔdanseni baako nnni adanseɛ nntia ɔkra biara mmma no nnwu.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: Nso monnnye owudini a ɔdi fɔ sɛ wakum onipa bi no hɔ biribiara mmfa nnnye no nkwa; na mmom kum na wɔnku no.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Na monnnye agyedeɛ nso nnsi ne dwanekɔbea kuro mu dwanekorɔ ananmu mmma no nnsane mmmɛtena asase no so kɔsi sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛwuo.

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Na Gilead, Makir ba, Manase ba mma abusuakuo mu mpanimfie so atitire a wɔfiri Yosef mma mmusua mu no ba bɛkasaa Mose ne mmapɔmma no, Israelfoɔ mpanimfie so atitire no, anim,

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: na wɔse: AWURADE ahyɛ me wura sɛ wɔmfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ asase no mu mma Israelfoɔ na wɔnni so, na me wura nyaa AWURADE anomu mmara sɛ wɔmfa yɛn nua Selofehad agyapadeɛ mma ne mmammaa.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔkɔyɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu mma bi yerenom a, ɛnneɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ no bɛfiri yɛn nananom agyapadeɛ mu, na wɔde akɔka abusuakuo ko a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn dea no agyapadeɛ ho, na afiri yɛn ntonto kyɛfa no mu;

english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: na sɛ ɛduru Israelfoɔ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe so a, wɔde wɔn agyapadeɛ no bɛka abusuakuo a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn dea no agyapadeɛ ho, na wɔayi wɔn agyapadeɛ afiri yɛn nananom abusuakuo agyapadeɛ mu.

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Deɛ Yosef mma abusuakuo aka yi tene.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Yei ne deɛ AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ Selofehad mmammaa no ho: Obiara a wɔsusu sɛ ɔyɛ no, wɔnware no; nanso wɔn nananom abusuakuo mu abusua bi mu nko na wɔnwareɛ;

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: na Israelfoɔ agyapadeɛ amfiri abusuakuo bi mu ankɔ abusuakuo foforɔ bi mu, na Israelfoɔ no mfemfam wɔn nananom abusuakuo agyapadeɛ ho.

english_verse: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.
translation_verse: na agyapadeɛ bi amfiri abusuakuo bi mu ankɔ abusuakuo foforɔ mu; na Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo no mfemfam wɔn agyapadeɛ ho.

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: na Mahla, Tirsa ne Hogla ne Milka ne Noa, Selofehad mmammaa no warewaree wɔn agya nuanom mma;

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: na wɔwarewaree wɔn a wɔfiri Yosef ba Manase mma mmusua mu, na wɔn agyapadeɛ no kaa wɔn agya abusuakuo no mu.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Yeinom ne mmara nsɛm ne atemmudeɛ a AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ wɔ Moab mpaperɛ so Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Na mo deɛ, monnane mo ho ntu nkɔ ɛserɛ so, Mmɛwa Po kwan so.

english_verse: People of Israel, when we were in our camp at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God told us: You have stayed here long enough.
translation_verse: AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn kasa kyerɛɛ yɛn wɔ Horeb sɛ: Moatena bepɔ yi ho akyɛre dodo,

english_verse: Leave this place and go into the land that belongs to the Amorites and their neighbors the Canaanites. This land includes the Jordan River valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Southern Desert, the Mediterranean seacoast, the Lebanon Mountains, and all the territory as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: monnane mo ho ntu nkɔ Amorifoɔ bepɔ ne nsase a ɛbemmɛn ho wɔ Araba mpaperɛ no so, bepɔ so ne mpaperɛ so ne Negeb ne mpoano nyinaa, Kanaanfoɔ asase so ne Lebanon so nkɔduru asukɛseɛ, Asubɔntene Eufrate ho.

english_verse: I give you this land, just as I promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Now you must go and take the land. Leaders Were Appointed (Exodus
translation_verse: Hwɛ, mede asase no mato mo anim; monkɔ nkɔfa asase a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo nananom, Abraham, Isak ne Yakob, sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn ne wɔn asefoɔ a wɔdi wɔn akyire no.

english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Na mehyɛɛ mo nnoɔma a monyɛ no nyinaa ho mmara berɛ no mu.

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: na monwiinwii mo ntomadan mu sɛ: Ɔtane so na AWURADE yii yɛn firii Misraim asase soɔ, sɛ ɔde yɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifoɔ nsa na wɔasɛe yɛn.

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: Na meka mekyerɛɛ mo berɛ no mu sɛ: Me nko ara mentumi menkura mo;

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: AWURADE mo nananom Nyankopɔn mfa no sɛdeɛ moteɛ yi mmɔho apem nka mo ho, na ɔnhyira mo sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no.

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na me nko ara mɛtumi masoa mo ne mo aperedie ho adesoa duruduro yi?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Ɛnna mede mo mmusuakuo mu atitire, mmarima anyansafoɔ a wɔdɛnso sisii mo so atitire, apem apem so mpanin ne ɔha ɔha so mpanin ne aduonum aduonum so mpanin ne du du so mpanin ne mo mmusuakuo so ahwɛfoɔ.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Na mehyɛɛ mo atemmufoɔ no mmara berɛ no mu sɛ: Montie mo nuanom ntam nsɛm, na mommu ntɛntenenee onipa ne ne nua ne ne hɔhoɔ ntam.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Monnhwɛ nnipa anim atemmuo mu, montie aketewa sɛ ɔkɛseɛ; monnsuro onipa anim, ɛfiri sɛ atemmuo yɛ Nyankopɔn dea. Na asɛm a ɛyɛ den sene mo na momfa mmrɛ me, na mentie.

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: nanso ɔno na na ɔdi mo anim ɔkwan soɔ sɛ ɔrekɔsra mo nsrabankyerebea ama mo, ogya mu anadwo, sɛ ɔrekyerɛ mo kwan a momfa soɔ, mununkum mu awia.

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: Na yɛtu firii Horeb, na yɛnante faa ɛserɛ kɛseɛ a ɛso yɛ hu a mohunuiɛ nyinaa so, Amorifoɔ bepɔ kwan so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ yɛn no, na yɛduruu Kades-barnea.

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna mo nyinaa motwe pinii me kaa sɛ: Ma yɛnsoma mmarima nni yɛn anim nkɔsra asase no mma yɛn, na wɔmmɛka kwan ko a yɛbɛfa soɔ ne nkuro a yɛbɛduru soɔ no ho asɛm nkyerɛ yɛn.

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Na asɛm no sɔɔ m’ani sɛ, na mefaa mo mu nnipa dummienu, mmusuakuo biara mu nipa baako.

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: Na wɔdanee wɔn ani foroo bepɔ no, na wɔkɔduruu Eskol subonhwa mu, na wɔsraeɛ.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa asase no so aba bi kura de siane brɛɛ yɛn; na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ yɛn bio sɛ: Asase a AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de rema yɛn no yɛ.

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nanso moampɛ sɛ moforɔ, na motee AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anomu asɛm so atua,

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Ɛhe na yɛmfa nkorɔ? Yɛn nuanom atu yɛn akoma sɛ: Nnipa no soso na wɔwoware sene yɛn, nkuro no yɛ akɛseɛ a wɔatoto ho afasuo kɔ soro, na bio nso yɛhunuu Anakfoɔ mma no wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a ɔdi mo anim no, ɔno na ɔbɛko ama mo, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛ maa mo Misraim wɔ mo anim no ara,

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: ne ɛserɛ so a wohunuu sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn kura wo sɛdeɛ onipa kura ne ba, akwan a mofaa soɔ no nyinaa so bɛsii sɛ moduruu ha yi.

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Na yei mu nso, moannye AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anni,

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE tee mo nsɛm no, na ne bo fuiɛ, na ɔkaa ntam sɛ:

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ bɔne yi mu nnipa yi mu biara renhunu asase pa a mekaa ho ntam sɛ mede bɛma mo nananom no!

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: Gye Yefune ba Kaleb, ɔno na ɔbɛhunu, na ɔno na mede asase a ɔtiaa soɔ no bɛma no ne ne mma, ɛfiri sɛ wadi AWURADE akyi.

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Me nso, mo nti AWURADE faa me ho abufuo kaa sɛ: Wo nso, worenkɔ hɔ bi.

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Nun ba Yosua a ɔgyina w’anim no, ɔno na ɔbɛduru hɔ; ɔno na hyɛ no den, na ɔno na ɔbɛkyɛ agyapadeɛ no ama Israel.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Na mo mma nketewa a mose wɔbɛyɛ nnommum ne mo mma a nnɛ wɔnnim papa ne bɔne no, wɔn na wɔbɛduru hɔ, wɔn na mede bɛma wɔn na wɔn na wɔbɛdi soɔ.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Ɛnna mobua see me sɛ: Yɛayɛ AWURADE bɔne, yɛn ara yɛbɛforo akɔko sɛdeɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ yɛn no nyinaa. Na mode mo akodeɛ miamiaeɛ no, ɛyɛɛ mo sɛ bepɔ no forɔ yɛ agorɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mommforo nnkɔko, na menni mo mu, na moankɔtotɔ mo atamfoɔ anim.

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Na mekasa mekyerɛɛ mo, na moantie, na motee AWURADE anomu asɛm atua, na motintim mo anim foroo bepɔ no.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Na Amorifoɔ a wɔte bepɔ no soɔ no firi bɛhyiaa mo na wɔtaa mo sɛdeɛ nwowa yɛ, na wɔkunkum mo Seir kɔduruu Horma.

english_verse: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Ɛnna motenaa Kades dii nna pii, sɛdeɛ nna a mode tenaa hɔ teɛ no.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: Moakyini bepɔ yi ho akyɛre dodo, monnane mo ho nkyerɛ atifi fam;

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: na hyɛ ɔman no sɛ: Morebɛtwam mo nuanom Esau mma a wɔte Seir no hyeɛ so, na wɔsuro mo, monhwɛ mo ho yie,

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: mo ne wɔn nnni aperepereɛ, na meremfa wɔn asase nammɔn baako mpo memma mo, ɛfiri sɛ mede Seir bepɔ mama Esau sɛ n’atenaeɛ.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Momfa sika ntɔ wɔn nkyɛn aduane nni, na nsuo nso momfa sika ntɔ no wɔn nkyɛn nnom;

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Na yɛsianee yɛn nuanom Esau mma a wɔte Seir no ho faa Araba mpaperɛ so kwan so firii Elat ne Esion-geber danee yɛn ho bɛtwaa mu Moab serɛ so kwan so.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nteetee Moab ho, na ɛne wɔn nnni aperepereɛ nnko, na meremma wo wɔn asase no bi nni so, ɛfiri sɛ mede Ar mama Lot mma sɛ wɔnni so.

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: (Emifoɔ na kane no na wɔte soɔ, ɔman a wɔso na wɔdɔɔso na wɔwoware sɛ Anakfoɔ;

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: wɔn nso wɔbu wɔn abrane akɛseɛ sɛ Anakfoɔ; Moabfoɔ na ɛfrɛ wɔn Emifoɔ.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na Seir nso akane no Horifoɔ na na ɛte hɔ, na Esau mma tuu wɔn na wɔsɛee wɔn, wɔn anim, na wɔtenaa wɔn ananmu, sɛdeɛ Israel yɛɛ asase a ɛyɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ a AWURADE de maa wɔn no.)

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Na akofoɔ no nyinaa saeɛ na wɔwuwu firii ɔman no mu no,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: Ɛnnɛ worebɛtwam wɔ Ar, Moab hyeɛ so,

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: na woduru Amon mma hyeɛ so a, nteetee wɔn, anaasɛ ɛne wɔn nnni aperepereɛ, na meremma wo Amon mma asase no bi nni so, ɛfiri sɛ mede mama Lot mma sɛ wɔnni so.

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Wɔbu ɛno nso abrane akɛseɛ asase; abrane akɛseɛ na na ɛte so kane no, na Amonfoɔ frɛ wɔn Samsumim,

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: sɛdeɛ ɔyɛ maa Esau mma a wɔte Seir a ɔsɛee Horifoɔ wɔn anim maa wɔtuu wɔn tenaa wɔn ananmu bɛduruu nnɛ yi no.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Na Awifoɔ nso a wɔtenaa nkuraa nkuraa kɔduruu Gasa no, Kaftorim a wɔfiri Kaftor baeɛ no, wɔbɛsɛee wɔn tenaa wɔn ananmu.) Wɔdi Amorifoɔ hene Sihon so

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Monsɔre ntu nkɔtwa Arnon subonhwa; hwɛ, mede Hesbonhene Sihon a ɔyɛ Amorini no ne n’asase mahyɛ wo nsa, firi aseɛ di so na ɛne no nni aperepereɛ na monko.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Ɛnnɛ da yi na mɛfiri aseɛ mede wo ho suro ne wo ho hu magu soro nyinaa ase aman a wɔbɛte wo nka soɔ, na wɔn ho apopo na wɔn akoma atu w’anim.

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: Ma mentwam w’asase so; ɔkwan so ara na mɛfa, meremmane nifa anaa benkum.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: sɛdeɛ Esau mma a wɔte Seir ne Moabfoɔ a wɔte Ar yɛɛ me no, de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛtwa Yordan makɔ asase a AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de rema yɛn no soɔ.

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, mafiri aseɛ mede Sihon ne n’asase mato w’anim, firi aseɛ fa, na di n’asase so.

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Ɛnna Sihon firi bɛhyiaa yɛn, ɔno ne ne man nyinaa, sɛ ɔne yɛn rebɛko wɔ Yahas.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de no hyɛɛ yɛn nsa, na yɛkunkum no ne ne mma ne ne man nyinaa.

english_verse: Then we captured and destroyed every town in Sihon's kingdom, killing everyone,
translation_verse: Na yɛfaa ne nkuro nyinaa saa berɛ no, na yɛsɛee nkuro no nyinaa pasapasa, mmarima ne mmaa ne mmɔfra, yɛannya wɔn mu fua mpo,

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: gye afieboa nko na yɛfom wɔn faeɛ, ɛne nkuro a yɛfaeɛ no mu asadeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri Aroer a ɛda Arnon subonhwa ano ne kuro a ɛda subonhwa no mu no so de kɔsi Gilead, kuro biara nni hɔ a na ɛyɛ den sene yɛn; AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de ne nyinaa hyɛɛ yɛn nsa.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Gye Amon mma asase no nko ho na woantwe ampini; Yabok subonhwa nkyɛn mu nyinaa ne mmepɔ no so nkuro ne baabiara a AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn amma yɛn ho kwan no.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsuro no, na mede ɔne ne man nyinaa ne n’asase mahyɛ wo nsa, sɛ yɛ no sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔtenaa Hesbon no.

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Na yɛsɛee wɔn pasapasa sɛdeɛ yɛyɛɛ Hesbon hene Sihon no, yɛsɛee nkuro no ne emu mmarima, mmaa ne mmɔfra nyinaa pasapasa.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Na afieboa nyinaa ne nkuro no mu asadeɛ deɛ, yɛfom fae.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Na yɛgyee asase no firii Amorifoɔ ahemfo baanu a wɔwɔ Yordan agya no nsam, saa berɛ no, ɛfiri Arnon subonhwa mu kɔsi Hermon bepɔ ho,

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: asaseta so nkuro nyinaa ne Gilead nyinaa ne Basan nyinaa kɔduru Salka ne Edrei, Basanhene Og ahennie no nkuro.

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: nkɔsi sɛ AWURADE bɛma mo nuanom ahome sɛ mo, na wɔn nso wɔadi asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema wɔn Yordan agya no so, ansa na moasane aba mo agyapadeɛ a mede mama mo no so.

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Na mesrɛɛ AWURADE saa berɛ no sɛ:

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, wo na woafiri aseɛ de wo kɛseyɛ ne wo nsa a ɛyɛ den no akyerɛ w’akoa, na onyame bɛn na ɔwɔ soro anaa asase soɔ a ɔbɛtumi ayɛ wo nnwuma ne wo mmaninneɛ yi bie?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Mesrɛ wo, ma mentwa menkɔhwɛ asase pa a ɛwɔ Yordan agya no, bepɔ fɛfɛ no ne Lebanon.

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Nanso mo nti AWURADE bo fuu me, na wantie me; na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ɛdɔɔso ma wo, nkɔ so ne me nkasa asɛm yi ho bio.

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Foro kɔ Pisga so, na ma w’ani so hwɛ atɔeɛ ne atifi fam ne anafoɔ ne apueeɛ, na fa w’ani hwɛ, na Yordan yi deɛ, worentwa.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Na hyɛ Yosua yie, na hyɛ no den na hyɛ no aboɔduro, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔbɛdi ɔman yi anim akyɛ asase a wobɛhunu no mu ama wɔn.

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Na yɛtenaa bonhwa no mu, Bet-peor ntentensoɔ.

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Na afei, Israel, tie ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a mekyerɛ mo sɛ monyɛ no, na moanya nkwa na moakɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo nananom Nyankopɔn de rema mo no.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Mommfa hwee nnka asɛm a merehyɛ mo yi ho, nanso monnyi mu biribi, na moadi AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo yi so.

english_verse: You saw how he killed everyone who worshiped the god Baal Peor.
translation_verse: Mo ani ahunu deɛ Baal-peor nti AWURADE yɛeɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔdii Baal-peor akyire nyinaa AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn sɛee wɔn firii mo mu;

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: na mo a mobataa AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ho no, mo nyinaa te ase nnɛ.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Monhwɛ mo ho yie, na monhwɛ mo kra nso so yie, na mo werɛ amfiri nsɛm a mo ani ahunu no, na mo nkwa nna nyinaa mu amfiri mo akoma mu, na ma mo mma ne mo asefoɔ nhunu.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Ɛda a na wogyina AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, Horeb soɔ no na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Boaboa ɔman no ano ma me, na memma wɔntie me nsɛm a wɔnsua mfa nsuro me, nna a wɔde te aseɛ, asase soɔ nyinaa, na wɔmfa nkyerɛ wɔn mma:

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Na motwe pini bɛgyinaa bepɔ no ase, berɛ a na ogya redɛre de wisie kumɔnn rekɔ soro tɔnn, bepɔ no so, mununkum ne esum kabii mu.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE firi ogya no mu kasa kyerɛɛ mo; sɛdeɛ nsɛm no teɛ no, mo ara motee, na ne tebea bi na moanhunu anka ɛnne no ho.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa n’apam a ɔhyɛɛ mo sɛ monyɛ no kyerɛɛ mo, mmara nsɛm du no, na ɔtwerɛɛ wɔ aboɔpono mmienu so.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na me nso AWURADE hyɛɛ me berɛ no mu sɛ menkyerɛ mo ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a monyɛ, asase a moretwam akɔfa no so. Abosonsom ho kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Enti monhwɛ mo kra so yie, ɛfiri sɛ moanhunu tebea biara da no a AWURADE firi ogya no mu kasa kyerɛɛ mo Horeb soɔ no.

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: Na moanni asɛmmɔne ankɔyɛ ohoni a wɔasene amfa, adeɛ biara tebea, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa nsɛsoɔ,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Na woamma w’ani so ankyerɛ soro anhwɛ owia ne ɔsrane ne nsoromma, ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, na antwe wo ankɔsɔre wɔn ansom wɔn, nnoɔma a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyekyɛ ama wiase amanaman nyinaa no.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Na mo deɛ, AWURADE na wayi mo afiri dadeɛ fononoo mu, afiri Misraim sɛ mommɛyɛ n’agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ moteɛ nnɛ da yi.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Na mo nti AWURADE nyaa me abufuo, na ɔkaa ntam sɛ merentwa Yordan na merenkɔ asase pa a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di soɔ no so;

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: na me deɛ, merebɛwu asase yi so, merentwa Yordan, na mo na mobɛtwa akɔfa asase pa no.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Monhwɛ mo ho yie na mo werɛ amfiri AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn apam a ɔne mo pameeɛ no, na moanyɛ ohoni a ɛyɛ biribiara a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abara woɔ nsɛsoɔ amfa.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɛpansam mo agu amanaman mu, na ɛbɛka mo mu kakraa bi wɔ wiase aman a AWURADE de mo bɛkɔ hɔ no mu;

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: na ɛhɔ na mobɛsom anyame a ɛyɛ onipa nsa ano adwuma, nnua ne aboɔ a ɛnhunu adeɛ na ɛnte asɛm na ɛnnidie na ɛnhua adeɛ nhwɛ no.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Sɛ mokɔ ahohiahia mu na nnoɔma yi nyinaa to mo nna a ɛdi akyire no mu a, mobɛsane aba AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn abɛtie ne nne;

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn yɛ Onyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunufoɔ, ɔrempa mo na ɔrensɛe mo, na ne werɛ remfiri mo nananom apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn no.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Anaasɛ onyame bi asɔ ahwɛ pɛn sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔyi ɔman bi afiri ɔman bi mu afa wɔ sɔhwɛ ahodoɔ, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne akodie ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a watene ne ahodwirideɛ akɛseɛ mu, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛ maa mo Misraim wɔ mo anim no anaa?

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔfiri soro ma wotee ne nne sɛ ɔretenetene woɔ, na asase so nso wama woahunu ne gya kɛseɛ no, na woate ne nsɛm afiri ogya mu.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɛsiane sɛ ɔdɔ wo nananom nti, wayi wɔn asefoɔ a ɛdi wɔn akyire, na ɔde n’anim ne ne tumi kɛseɛ ayi wo afiri Misraim,

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔrebɛtu aman a wɔso na wɔyɛ den sene woɔ afiri w’anim, sɛ ɔde wo rekɔ hɔ de wɔn asase akɔma wo sɛ awunnyadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛte nnɛ da yi.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Enti hunu nnɛ, na fa sie w’akoma mu, sɛ AWURADE ne Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔsoro ne asase so na obi nni hɔ bio.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Na di n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so, na awie wo ne wo mma a wɔdi w’akyire yie, na woakye wɔ asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so daa nyinaa. Mose yi dwanekɔbea nkuro mmiɛnsa

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: Yordan agya, bonhwa no mu, Bet-peor ntentensoɔ, Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔtenaa Hesbon a Mose ne Israelfoɔ firi Misraim baeɛ no, wɔkum no no asase so.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa n’asase ne Basan hene Og asase, Amorifoɔ ahemfo baanu a wɔtenatenaa Yordan agya, apueeɛ fam no, asase,

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: ɛfiri Areor a ɛda Arnon subonhwa ano kɔsi Sion bepɔ ,

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: ne Araba mpaperɛ a ɛda Yordan agya apueeɛ no nyinaa kɔduru Araba mpaperɛ so ɛpo no ano wɔ Pisga ase.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Na Mose frɛɛ Israel nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Israel, montie ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a mereka magu mo aso mu nnɛ yi, na monsua, na monni so nyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ne yɛn yɛɛ apam Horeb so;

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: ɛnyɛ yɛn nananom na AWURADE ne wɔn pam apam yi, na ɛyɛ yɛn a ɛnnɛ yɛn nyinaa tete aseɛ yi ara.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: AWURADE firi ogya no mu bepɔ no ho ne mo dii nhwɛanim na ɔkasaeɛ.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Me deɛ, na megyina AWURADE ne mo ntam saa berɛ no, sɛ merekyerɛ mo AWURADE asɛm, ɛfiri sɛ mosuroo ogya no anim na moamforo bepɔ no. Na ɔkaa sɛ:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a meyii wo firii Misraim asase soɔ, nkoafie mu no.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Nnya anyame afoforɔ nka me ho.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ohoni, adeɛ a ɛwɔ wiem ɔsoro ne deɛ ɛwɔ asase so ɛfam ne deɛ ɛwɔ nsuo mu asase ase suban mfa; nkoto wɔn na nsom wɔn.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Na me AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn meyɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ a metua nananom amumuyɛ so ka mefa mma soɔ kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mmiɛnsa ne nnan a wɔtane me soɔ,

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: na meyɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wɔdi me mmara nsɛm so adɔeɛ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn din kwa, na AWURADE remma deɛ ɔbɔ ne din kwa ho nyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Show respect for the Sabbath Day—it belongs to me.
translation_verse: Di homeda na hwɛ yɛ no kronkron, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ woɔ no.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Nnansia na yɛ adwuma, na yɛ w’adeɛ nyinaa;

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ homeda ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, nyɛ adwuma biara, wo ne wo babarima ne wo babaa, ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa, ne wo nantwie ne w’afunumu ne wo mmoa nyinaa, ne wo hɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu, na w’akoa ne w’afenaa ahome sɛ wo.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim asase so, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a wɔatene mu yii wo firii hɔ, enti na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛ wo sɛ di homeda no.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Di w’agya ne wo na ni, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ woɔ no, na wo nna aware na asi wo yie, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ korɔno.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: Nsɛm yi na AWURADE firi ogya mununkum ne esum kabii no mu de nne kɛseɛ ka kyerɛɛ mo badwa nyinaa, bepɔ no soɔ, na wamfa bi anka ho; na ɔtwerɛɛ no aboɔpono mmienu so de maa me.

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Na motee ɛnne no firi esum no mu na bepɔ no redɛre no, motwe pinii me nkyɛn, mo mmusuakuo mu atitire nyinaa ne mo mpanimfoɔ

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: bɛkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ama yɛahunu n’animuonyam ne ne kɛseyɛ, na yɛate ne nne afiri ogya no mu, ɛnnɛ da yi na yɛahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn ne onipa kasa nanso ɔnya nkwa.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Na afei, adɛn nti na yɛnwuo? Ɛfiri sɛ ogya kɛseɛ yi rebɛhye yɛn. Sɛ yɛte AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn nne bio a, yɛbɛwuwu.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Na honam nyinaa mu hwan na wate Nyankopɔn teasefoɔ no nne sɛ ɛrekasa firi ogya mu, sɛ yɛn, na wanya nkwa?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Wo na twe pini hɔ na tie deɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛka nyinaa, na bɛka yɛn deɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛka akyerɛ woɔ nyinaa, na yɛbɛtie na yɛayɛ.

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Na morekasa akyerɛ me no, AWURADE tee mo nsɛm no, na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mate ɔman yi nsɛm a wɔaka akyerɛ woɔ no, deɛ wɔaka nyinaa, wɔaka no yie.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: O, sɛ anka wɔbɛnya akoma a ɛte seyie na wɔde asuro me adi me mmara nsɛm so nna nyinaa, na asi wɔn ne wɔn mma yie daa ɛ!

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Kɔ na kɔka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Monsane nkɔ mo ntomadan mu.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Na wo deɛ, gyina me nkyɛn ha, na menka mmara nsɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn no nyinaa menkyerɛ wo na wɔnyɛ wɔ asase a mede merema wɔn sɛ wɔmfa no so.

english_verse: Israel, you must carefully obey the Lord's commands.
translation_verse: Enti monhwɛ na monyɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ mo no; mommmane nifa anaa benkum;

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: ɔkwan a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ mo no nyinaa so na monnanteɛ na moanya nkwa, na asi mo yie, na mo nna aware asase a morekɔnya no so.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: Na yei ne mmara nsɛm, ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ mo na monyɛ asase a moretwam akɔfa no soɔ,

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: na woasuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn adi n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ woɔ yi nyinaa so, wo ne wo ba ne wo ba ba, wo nkwa nna nyinaa, na wo nna aware.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Enti, Israel, tie, na hwɛ yɛ, na asi wo yie, na woadɔɔso pii, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo nananom Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ woɔ no, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no so.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Israel, tie, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ AWURADE koro.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Na fa w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa ne w’ahoɔden nyinaa dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mma yie, na kasa ho, w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nanteɛ mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔreɛ mu;

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: na fa yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ abotire;

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: na twerɛ gu wo fie aponnwa ho ne w’aponkɛseɛ so. Asoɔden ho kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nya de wo duru asase a ɔkaa wo nananom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so, nkuro akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛnyɛ wo na wokyekyereeɛ,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: ne adan a nnepa nyinaa ayɛ no amaama a ɛnyɛ wo na wode hyehyɛɛ mu, ne mmura a wɔatutuo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotutuiɛ, bobe nturo ne ngodua nturo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotetɛeɛ, na sɛ wodidi mee a,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE a ɔyii wo Misraim asase so firii nkoafie mu no:

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, na ɔno na som no, na ne din ho ntam na ka;

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: monnni anyame foforɔ a wɔfiri amanaman a wɔgugu mo ho no anyame no akyi;

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abufuo annɛre antia wo, na wansɛe wo amfiri asase ani.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Monnsɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, sɛdeɛ mosɔɔ no hwɛɛ Masa hɔ no;

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: monni AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm ne n’adansesɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a wahyɛ mo no so pɛpɛɛpɛ;

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔkyena bi, wo ba bisa wo sɛ: Adansesɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ bɛn na AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de hyɛɛ mo yi?

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ wo ba no sɛ: Na anka yɛyɛ Farao nkoa Misraim, na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii yɛn firii Misraim;

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: na AWURADE maa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu baa Misraim, Farao ne ne fie nyinaa so wɔ yɛn anim;

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: na yɛn deɛ, ɔyii yɛn firii hɔ sɛ ɔde yɛn reba de asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ yɛn nananom no abɛma yɛn.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: na sɛ yɛhwɛ di mmara nsɛm yi nyinaa so, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ yɛn no a, ɛbɛyɛ yɛn ateneneefoɔ.

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Enti di mmara nsɛm ne atemmudeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so, na yɛ. Setie mu Nhyira (Deuteronomium

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Na sɛe aman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn bɛma woɔ no nyinaa; mma w’ani nnhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na nsom wɔn anyame, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno bɛyɛ fidie ama wo.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yi wɔn ma wo ma woku wɔn a, ɛnneɛ sɛe wɔn pasapasa; wo ne wɔn mmpam, na nhu wɔn mmɔbɔ;

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛdane wo mma ani afiri m’akyi, na wɔasom anyame foforɔ, na AWURADE bo afu mo, na wasɛe wo ntɛm.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Na mmom sɛ monyɛ wɔn nie: Monnwiridwiri wɔn afɔrebukyia, na mommubu wɔn aboɔ adum, na montwitwa wɔn abosompɔ ngu, na momfa ogya nhye wɔn ahoni.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Na mo yɛ ɔman kronkron ma AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn; mo na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ayi mo sɛ mommɛyɛ ɔman a wafa ayɛ ne dea wɔ aman a ɛwɔ asase so nyinaa mu.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Na ɛsiane sɛ AWURADE dɔ mo na ɔdi ne ntam a ɔkaa mo nananom no soɔ nti na ɔde nsa a ɛyɛ den yii mo, na ɔgyee mo firii nkoafie firii Misraimhene Farao nsam.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Enti hunu sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno ne Onyankopɔn, — Onyankopɔn nokwafoɔ a ɔkora apam ne adɔeɛ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ no na wɔdi ne mmara nsɛm so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ apem soɔ,

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: na ɔtua wɔn a wɔtane no ka wɔ wɔn anim na ɔsɛe wɔn; ɔnyɛ nyaa mma deɛ ɔtane no, ɔbɛtua no ka wɔ n’anim.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛhyira wo asene aman nyinaa; ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa, anaa w’afieboa renyɛ obonini wɔ wo mu.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Na mfa akyiwadeɛ nkɔ wo fie, na woanyɛ abusudeɛ sɛ ɛno; ma no nyɛ wo tane, na kyi, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ abusudeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: na wadɔ wo ahyira wo ama woadɔre, na wahyira wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’aburoo ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ne w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma, asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Na sɛ motie atemmudeɛ yi na modi so yɛ a, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nso bɛdi apam ne adɔeɛ a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no so ama wo,

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɛyi yadeɛ nyinaa afiri wo so, na ɔremfa Misraim yadeɛ bɔne a wonim no biara nto wo so, na ɔde bɛto wɔn a wɔtane woɔ nyinaa so.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wose no w’akoma mu sɛ: Amanaman yi dɔɔso sene me, mɛyɛ dɛn na matumi matu wɔn?

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Nsuro wɔn, na kae deɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Farao ne Misraim nyinaa,

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: sɔhwɛ akɛseɛ a w’ani hunuiɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a watene mu a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de yii woɔ no; saa na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ aman a wosuro wɔn no nyinaa.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Nkotokurodu nso na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsoma ama wɔakɔ wɔn mu akɔsi sɛ wɔn a wɔaka na wɔahunta no bɛsɛe w’anim.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Mma wɔn anim nnyɛ wo hu, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn wɔ wo mu, Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ a ne ho yɛ hu ne no.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Na ɔde wɔn ahemfo bɛhyɛ wo nsa, na woasɛe wɔn din afiri wiase; obiara rentumi nnyina w’anim de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ wobɛsɛe wɔn.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Wɔn anyame ahoni no, momfa ogya nhye; mma w’ani mmmere ɛho dwetɛ ne sika, na mfa bi, na ansum wo fidie, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa monhwɛ nyɛ, na moanya nkwa, na moadɔre, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo nananom no adi so.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Na ɔbrɛɛ wo ase maa ɛkɔm dee wo, na ɔde mana a wonnim na wo nananom nso nnim maa wo diiɛ, na wama woahunu sɛ, ɛnyɛ aduane nko so na onipa nam bɛtena aseɛ, na adeɛ biara a ɛfiri AWURADE anomu so na onipa nam tena aseɛ.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Na hunu no w’akoma mu sɛ, sɛdeɛ onipa tea ne ba no, saa ara na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn tea woɔ.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Enti di AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so, sɛ wobɛnante n’akwan soɔ na woasuro no.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo rekɔ asase pa so, asase a ɛso wɔ nsubɔntene, nsuo aniwa ne atareɛ a ɛfifiri mmonhwa ne mmepɔ mu sene,

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wodidi mee a, hyira AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, asase pa a ɔde ama woɔ no nti.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sɛ worenni ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmudeɛ ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi soɔ;

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: na sɛ wodidi mee na wosisi adan pa tena mu,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: na w’anantwie ne wo nnwan dɔre, na wo dwetɛ ne wo sika dɔɔso ma wo, na adeɛ a wowɔ nyinaa dɔɔso a,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: hwɛ yie na w’akoma amma ne ho so, na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo Misraim asase so firii nkoa fie no;

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔdii w’anim de wo faa ɛserɛ kɛseɛ a awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ borɔ ne anyanyankyerɛ wɔ, ne nkyɛkyerɛ a nsuo nni hɔ so; ɔyii nsuo firii ɔbohemmaa botan mu maa wo;

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: ɔde mana a wo nananom nnim maa wodii wɔ ɛserɛ so, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo aseɛ na wasɔ wo ahwɛ, na awieeɛ no, wayɛ wo yie,

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: na woanka no w’akoma mu sɛ: M’ahoɔden ne me nsa den na ama manya ahonyadeɛ yi,

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: na mmom kae AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔma wo ahoɔden a wode nya wo ho, na wama n’apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no atim sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Sɛ amanaman a AWURADE sɛe wɔn firi mo anim no, saa ara na mobɛsɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nne.

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Israel, tie! Worebɛtwa Yordan nnɛ akɔ akɔtu amanaman a wɔsoso na wɔn ho yɛ den sene woɔ, afa nkuro akɛseɛ a wɔatoto ho afasuo akɔ soro,

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: ɔman kɛseɛ a wɔwowareɛ, Anakfoɔ mma a woni wɔn na woate wɔn ho asɛm sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛgyina Anak mma anim?

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Na hunu nnɛ sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ne deɛ ɔdi w’anim retwa, sɛ ogya a ɛhyeɛ; ɔno na ɔbɛsɛe wɔn, na wabrɛ wɔn ase, w’anim, na watu wɔn asɛe wɔn ntɛm, sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ woɔ no.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Kae na mma wo werɛ mmfi, sɛdeɛ wohyɛɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abufuo ɛserɛ soɔ no; ɛfiri da a wofirii Misraim asase soɔ de bɛsii sɛ mobaa ha yi, mote ne so atua.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Na Horeb nso mohyɛɛ AWURADE abufuo, na ɛmaa ne bo fuu mo sɛ anka ɔbɛsɛe mo;

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre siane firi ha ntɛm, na ɔman a wokɔyii wɔn firii Misraim no adi asɛmmɔne. Wɔadane ntɛm afiri ɔkwan a mehyɛɛ wɔn no so; wɔayɛ ohoni a wɔaguo afa.

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mahunu ɔman yi, na hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔn kɔn asene;

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: gyaa me ma mensɛe wɔn, na mempepa wɔn din mfiri asase so, na mede wo bɛyɛ ɔman a ɛyɛ den na ɛso sene wɔn.

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Ɛnna medanee me ho mefirii bepɔ no so mesianeeɛ, na bepɔ no redɛre ogya, na apam apono mmienu no kurakura me nsam;

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: na mehunui, na hwɛ, na moayɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn bɔne ayɛ nantwie ba a wɔaguo afa: Moamane ntɛm afiri ɔkwan a AWURADE hyɛɛ mo no so.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Ɛnna mefaa apono mmienu no meto firii me nsam guiɛ, na mebobɔɔ no wɔ mo anim.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Na AWURADE faa Aaron ho abufuo kɛse sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe no, na mepaa kyɛw memaa Aaron nso saa berɛ no.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Na mefaa mo bɔne a moyɛeɛ a ɛne nantwie ba no, na mede ogya mehyee, na mesi meyam no muhumuhu kɔsii sɛ ɛfee sɛ mfuturo, na metoo ne mfuturo no guu asuo a ɛfiri bepɔ no so sene no mu.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Na Tabera ne Masa ne Kibrot-hataawa nso mohyɛɛ AWURADE abufuo.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE somaa mo firi Kades-barnea kaa sɛ: Momforo nkɔfa asase a mede mama mo no, motee AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anomu asɛm so atua, na moannye no anni, na moantie ne nne.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: AWURADE anim atuatefoɔ ne mo firi da a mehunuu mo.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Na mehwee ase AWURADE anim adaduanan, awia ne anadwo. Mehwee ase, ɛfiri sɛ na AWURADE aka sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe mo.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti mepaa AWURADE kyɛw sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, nsɛe wo man ne w’agyapadeɛ a wode wo kɛseyɛ agye wɔn na wode nsa a ɛyɛ den ayi wɔn afiri Misraim no.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Kae wo nkoa Abraham, Isak ne Yakob; nnane w’ani nhwɛ ɔman yi asoɔden ne wɔn amumuyɛ ne wɔn bɔne,

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: na asase a woyii yɛn firii soɔ no sofoɔ anka sɛ: AWURADE antumi amfa wɔn ankɔ asase a ɔkaa wɔn ɛho asɛm no so, na tane a ɔtane wɔn nti na ɔde wɔn firi kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔkunkum wɔn ɛserɛ soɔ.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛ wo man ne w’agyapadeɛ a wode wo tumi kɛseɛ ne wo nsa a woatene ayi wɔn.

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: Saa berɛ no na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sene aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no na fa foro bra me nkyɛn bepɔ no so, na yɛ dua adaka;

english_verse: When I had taken the second set of stones up the mountain, I spent
translation_verse: Na me deɛ, megyinaa bepɔ no so sɛ kane no, adaduanan awia ne anadwo, na AWURADE tiee me saa berɛ no nso, na wampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe woɔ.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: na mɛtwerɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ kane apono a wobobɔeɛ no soɔ no mahyɛ apono no so, na fa sie adaka no mu.

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Na meyɛɛ okuo adaka, na mesenee aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no, na meforoo bepɔ no a apono mmienu no kura me nsam.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE twerɛɛ apono no so sɛ kane ntwerɛeɛ no, nsɛm du no a ɔfiri ogya no mu ka kyerɛɛ mo wɔ bepɔ no so dwabɔ da no, na ɔde maa me.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Na medanee me ho siane firii bepɔ no so, mede apono no mebɛsiee adaka a meyɛeɛ no mu, na ɛwɔ hɔ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ me no.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, ɔno na som no, na ne ho na bata, na ne din ho ntam na ka.

english_verse: When your ancestors went to live in Egypt, there were only
translation_verse: Akra aduɔson na wo nananom de siane kɔɔ Misraim, afei AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ wo dodoɔ sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: (Na Israelfoɔ tu firii Beerot-bene-yaakan kɔɔ Mosera. Ɛhɔ na Aaron wuiɛ na wɔsiee no wɔ hɔ, na ne ba Eleasa sii n’ananmu dii sɔfoɔ.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɛfiri hɔ na wɔtu kɔɔ Gudgod, na wɔfirii Gudgod kɔɔ Yotbat, asase a nsutene wɔ soɔ.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Saa berɛ no na AWURADE yii Lewifoɔ abusuakuo sɛ wɔnsoa AWURADE apam adaka no, na wɔnnyina n’anim nsom no, na wɔmfa ne din nhyira, a wɔayɛ de abɛduru nnɛ da yi.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre kɔdi ɔman no anim ma wɔntu nkɔfa asase a mekaa wɔn nananom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no. AWURADE apɛdeɛ

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Na afei, Israel, ɛdeɛn na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn repɛ no wo nkyɛn? Ɛne sɛ wobɛsuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wonante n’akwan nyinaa soɔ, na woadɔ no, na wode w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa asom AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn,

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: na woadi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi soɔ, na asi wo yie.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, ɔsoro ne ɔsoro mu soro yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dea, asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Nanso wo nananom nko na AWURADE bata wɔn ho sɛ ɔbɛdɔ wɔn, na wayi wɔn asefoɔ a wɔdi wɔn akyire a ɛne mo, afiri aman nyinaa mu, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
