translation_verse: Na ɔtwɛn nnansɔn bio, na ɔsomaa aborɔnoma no; na wansan amma ne nkyɛn bio.

english_verse: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was completely dry.
translation_verse: Ɔsram a ɛto so abien no da a ɛto so aduonu ason no na asase so awo koraa.

english_verse: God said to Noah,
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn kasa kyerɛɛ Noa sɛ:

english_verse: “You, your wife, your sons, and your daughters-in-law may now leave the boat.
translation_verse: Fi adaka no mu, wo ne wo yere ne wo mma ne wo mma yerenom a wɔka wo ho;

english_verse: After Noah and his family had left the boat,
translation_verse: Na Noa ne ne mma ne ne yere ne ne mma yerenom fii adi;

english_verse: the living creatures left in groups of their own kind. The Lord's Promise for the Earth
translation_verse: mmoadoma nyinaa, wɔn a wɔwea nyinaa ne nnomaa nyinaa, nea ɛkeka ne ho asase so nyinaa, sɛnea wɔn mmoaban te, fi adaka no mu fii adi.

english_verse: Noah built an altar where he could offer sacrifices to the Lord. Then he offered on the altar one of each kind of animal and bird that could be used for a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Na Noa sii afɔremuka maa AWURADE, na ɔfaa ntɔteboa a wɔn ho tew nyinaa mu bi ne nnomaa a wɔn ho tew nyinaa mu bi de wɔn bobɔɔ ɔhyew afɔre wɔ muka no so. Onyankopɔn bɔhyɛ

english_verse: The smell of the burning offering pleased the Lord, and he said: Never again will I punish the earth for the sinful things its people do. All of them have evil thoughts from the time they are young, but I will never destroy everything that breathes, as I did this time.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE tee afɔre no huam, na ɔkae ne komam sɛ: Onipa nti meremmɔ asase dua bio, efisɛ onipa komam adwene yɛ bɔne fi ne mmofraase, na merensɛe nea ɛte ase nyinaa bio, sɛnea mayɛ yi.

english_verse: As long as the earth remains, there will be planting and harvest, cold and heat; winter and summer, day and night.
translation_verse: Nna nyinaa a asase wɔ hɔ yi, ogu ne otwa, awɔw ne ahohuru, asusow ne ɔpɛ, awia ne anadwo rennyae da.

english_verse: God said to Noah and his sons: I am giving you my blessing. Have a lot of children and grandchildren, so people will live everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn hyiraa Noa ne ne mma, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ Monwo na monnɔɔso, na monhyɛ asase so ma.

english_verse: All animals, birds, reptiles, and fish will be afraid of you. I have placed them under your control,
translation_verse: Na mo ho hu ne mo ho suro mmra asase so mmoadoma nyinaa ne wim nnomaa nyinaa, nea ɛwea fam nyinaa ne ɛpo mu mpataa nyinaa so; mo nsa na wɔde wɔn ahyɛ.

english_verse: and I have given them to you for food. From now on, you may eat them, as well as the green plants that you have always eaten.
translation_verse: Nea ɛkeka ne ho a ɛwɔ nkwa nyinaa, ɛnyɛ mo aduan; mede ne nyinaa mama mo, sɛnea mede nhabanmono memaa mo no.

english_verse: But life is in the blood, and you must not eat any meat that still has blood in it.
translation_verse: Nam a ne mogya wɔ ne mu nko na munnni.

english_verse: I want you and your descendants to have many children, so people will live everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Na mo de, monwo na monnɔ, na monyɛ asase so manyamanya, na monnɔɔso wɔ so.

english_verse: Again, God said to Noah and his sons:
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Noa ne ne mma a wɔka ne ho no sɛ:

english_verse: I am going to make a solemn promise to you and to everyone who will live after you.
translation_verse: Na me nso, hwɛ, merema m'apam atim hɔ ama mo ne mo asefo a ebedi mo akyi,

english_verse: I promise every living creature that the earth and those living on it will never again be destroyed by a flood.
translation_verse: Na mama me ne mo apam yi agyina hɔ, sɛ meremfa nsuyiri mensɛe abɔde nyinaa bio, na nsuyiri remma mmɛsɛe asase bio.

english_verse: The rainbow that I have put in the sky will be my sign to you and to every living creature on earth. It will remind you that I will keep this promise forever.
translation_verse: Me nyankontɔn na mede masi omununkum mu, na ayɛ me ne asase ntam apam no ho sɛnkyerɛnne.

english_verse: When I send clouds over the earth, and a rainbow appears in the sky,
translation_verse: Na sɛ mede omununkum meba asase so a, wobehu nyankontɔn no wɔ omununkum no mu,

english_verse: I will remember my promise to you and to all other living creatures. Never again will I let floodwaters destroy all life.
translation_verse: na makae m'apam a ɛwɔ me ne mo ne abɔde nyinaa mu ateasefo ntam no, na nsu annan nsuyiri ansɛe ɔhonam nyinaa bio.

english_verse: When I see the rainbow in the sky, I will always remember the promise that I have made to every living creature.
translation_verse: Na nyankontɔn no bɛba omununkum mu, na mahwɛ, na mede makae daa apam a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn ne abɔde a ɛwɔ asase so nyinaa ntam no.

english_verse: Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, left the boat. Ham later had a son named Canaan.
translation_verse: Na Noa mma a wofii adaka no mu fii adi no ne Sem ne Ham ne Yafet; na Ham ne Kanaan n'agya.

english_verse: All people on earth are descendants of Noah's three sons.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne Noa mma baasa no. Wɔn mu na nnipa fi petee asase nyinaa so.

english_verse: Noah farmed the land and was the first to plant a vineyard.
translation_verse: Na Noa fii ase yɛɛ kua, na ɔyɛɛ bobeturo.

english_verse: One day he got drunk and was lying naked in his tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔnom nsa no bi, na ɔbowee, na ɔda ne ntamadan mu a ne ho da hɔ.

english_verse: Ham entered the tent and saw him naked, then went back outside and told his brothers.
translation_verse: Na Kanaan n'agya Ham kohuu n'agya adagyaw mu, na ɔkɔka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom baanu no wɔ adiwo.

english_verse: Shem and Japheth put a robe over their shoulders and walked backwards into the tent. Without looking at their father, they placed it over his body.
translation_verse: Na Sem ne Yafet faa ntama, na wɔn baanu de guu wɔn mmati so nam nkyirinkyiri de kɔkataa wɔn agya adagyaw so, na wɔdan wɔn ani kyerɛɛ akyiri, na wɔanhu wɔn agya adagyaw mu.

english_verse: When Noah sobered up and learned what his youngest son had done,
translation_verse: Na Noa ani so tetew fii n'asabow mu na ɔtee nea ne ba kumaa no ayɛ no no,

english_verse: he said, “I now put a curse on Canaan! He will be the lowest slave of his brothers.
translation_verse: ɔkae sɛ: Wɔadome Kanaan, ɔbɛyɛ nkoa mu akoa ama ne nuanom.

english_verse: I ask the Lord my God to bless Shem and make Canaan his slave.
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ Nhyira ne Sem Nyankopɔn, Awurade, na Kanaan nyɛ wɔn akoa.

english_verse: I pray God will give Japheth more and more land and let him take over the territory of Shem. May Canaan be his slave.”
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn mma Yafet ase ntrɛw, na ɔntena Sem ntamadan mu, na Kanaan nyɛ wɔn akoa.

english_verse: and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Noa nna a odii nyinaa si mfe ahankron aduonum, na owui.

english_verse: After the flood Shem, Ham, and Japheth had many descendants. The Descendants of Japheth
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne Noa mma Sem, Ham ne Yafet awo ntoatoaso; na nsuyiri no akyi wɔwoo mma.

english_verse: This completes the list of Noah's descendants. After the flood their descendants became nations and spread all over the world.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne Noa mma mmusua, sɛnea wɔn awo ntoatoaso te wɔ wɔn amanaman mu. Na efi eyinom mu na nsuyiri no akyi amanaman petee asase so.

english_verse: At first everyone spoke the same language,
translation_verse: Na asase nyinaa sofo yɛ anokoro kasa ɔkasa koro.

english_verse: but after some of them moved from the east and settled in Babylonia,
translation_verse: Na ɛbae sɛ wotuu kwan faa apuei no, wohuu asasetaw bi wɔ Sinear asase so, na wɔtenaa hɔ.

english_verse: they said: Let's build a city with a tower that reaches to the sky! We'll use hard bricks and tar instead of stone and mortar. We'll become famous, and we won't be scattered all over the world.
translation_verse: Ɛnna wɔkae sɛ: Wiɛ, momma yɛnkyekye kurow, na yɛnto abantenten a n'atifi bedu soro, na yɛmfa nnye din, na yɛanhwete asase nyinaa ani.

english_verse: But when the Lord came down to look at the city and the tower,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sane bɛhwɛɛ kurow ne abantenten a nnipa mma reto no.

english_verse: he said: These people are working together because they all speak the same language. This is just the beginning. Soon they will be able to do anything they want.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kae sɛ: Hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman biako, na wɔn nyinaa kasa ɔkasa koro na nea wɔafi ase reyɛ ni; na afei, biribiara rentumi nsiw wɔn nea wosusuw sɛ wɔbɛyɛ no biara ho kwan.

english_verse: Let's go down and confuse them! We'll make them speak different languages, and they won't be able to understand each other.
translation_verse: Wiɛ, momma yensian nkɔ hɔ na yɛnkɔyɛ wɔn kasa basabasa, na wɔn mu biara ante ne yɔnko kasa bio.

english_verse: So the people had to stop building the city, because the Lord confused their language and scattered them all over the earth. That's how the city of Babel got its name. The Descendants of Shem
translation_verse: Enti na wɔfrɛ hɔ Babel ase ne: Basabasa, efisɛ ɛhɔ na AWURADE yɛɛ asase nyinaa kasa basabasa, na efi hɔ na AWURADE bɔɔ wɔn hwetee asase nyinaa ani. Sem awo ntoatoaso

english_verse: Two years after the flood, when Shem was
translation_verse: Na Sem woo Arfaksad no akyi no, odii mfe ahannum, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.

english_verse: Arpachshad had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Arfaksad woo Sela no akyi no, odii mfe ahanan ne abiɛsa, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.

english_verse: Shelah had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Sela woo Eber no akyi no, odii mfe ahanan ne abiɛsa, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.

english_verse: Eber had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Eber woo Peleg no akyi no, odii mfe ahanan aduasa, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.

english_verse: Peleg had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Peleg woo Reu no akyi no, odii mfe ahanu ne akron, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.

english_verse: Reu had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Reu woo Serug no akyi no, odii mfe ahanu ne asɔn, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.

english_verse: Serug had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Serug woo Nahor no akyi no, odii mfe ahanu, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.

english_verse: Nahor had more children and died at the age of
translation_verse: Na Nahor woo Tera no akyi no, odii mfe ɔha ne dunkron, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.

english_verse: Terah decided to move from Ur to the land of Canaan. He took along Abram and Sarai and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran. But when they came to the city of Haran, they settled there instead.
translation_verse: Na Tera faa ne ba Abram ne ne nena Lot, Haran ba ne n'ase Sarai, ne ba Abram yere, na ɔne wɔn fii Ur a ɛwɔ Kaldea sɛ wɔrekɔ Kanaan asase so. Na woduu Haran no, wɔtenaa hɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram: Leave your country, your family, and your relatives and go to the land that I will show you.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Wo de, fi w'asase so ne w'abusua mu ne w'agya fi, kɔ asase a mɛkyerɛ wo no so.

english_verse: I will bless you and make your descendants into a great nation. You will become famous and be a blessing to others.
translation_verse: Na mɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛse, na mehyira wo, na mama wo din so, na woayɛ nhyira.

english_verse: I will bless those who bless you, but I will put a curse on anyone who puts a curse on you. Everyone on earth will be blessed because of you.
translation_verse: Na mehyira wɔn a wohyira wo, na wɔn a wɔdome wo no, mɛdome wɔn; na wo mu na wobehyira asase so mmusua nyinaa.

english_verse: Abram went as far as the sacred tree of Moreh in a place called Shechem. The Canaanites were still living in the land at that time,
translation_verse: Na Abram twaam asase no so koduu baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Sikem, toaa so koduu More pɔw ho. Nso bere no mu no, na Kanaanfo wɔ asase no so.

english_verse: but the Lord appeared to Abram and promised, “I will give this land to your family forever.” Abram then built an altar there for the Lord.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Abram kae sɛ: W'asefo na mede asase yi mɛma wɔn. Na osii afɔremuka wɔ hɔ maa AWURADE a oyii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ no no.

english_verse: Abram traveled to the hill country east of Bethel and camped between Bethel and Ai, where he built another altar and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Na otutu fii hɔ kɔɔ Betel apuei bepɔw bi so, na osii ne ntamadan, Betel da atɔe, na Ai da apuei; na osii afɔremuka maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ, na ɔsɔree AWURADE.

english_verse: Later, Abram started out toward the Southern Desert. Abram in Egypt
translation_verse: Na Abram dii atutena ara kɔɔ negeb. Abram kɔ Misraim

english_verse: The crops failed, and there was no food anywhere in Canaan. So Abram and his wife Sarai went to live in Egypt for a while. But just before they got there, Abram said, “Sarai, you are really beautiful!
translation_verse: Na ɔreyɛ adu Misraim asase so no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne yere Sarai sɛ: Hwɛ, minim sɛ woyɛ ɔbea a wo ho yɛ fɛ,

english_verse: When the Egyptians see you, they will murder me because I am your husband. But they won't kill you.
translation_verse: na ɛbɛba sɛ Misraimfo hu wo a, wɔbɛka sɛ ne yere ni, na wɔakum me, na wɔama woatena ase.

english_verse: Please save my life by saying you are my sister.”
translation_verse: Enti ka sɛ, me nua ne wo, na wo nti wɔayɛ me yiye, na matena ase.

english_verse: As soon as Abram and Sarai arrived in Egypt, the Egyptians noticed how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: Na Abram duu Misraim no, Misraimfo huu ne yere no sɛ ne ho yɛ fɛ sɛ.

english_verse: The king's officials told him about her, and she was taken to his house.
translation_verse: Na Farao atitiriw huu no, na wɔkɔkamfoo no kyerɛɛ Farao, na wɔbɛfaa ɔbea no kɔɔ Farao fi.

english_verse: The king was good to Abram because of Sarai, and Abram was given sheep, cattle, donkeys, slaves, and camels.
translation_verse: Na ne nti ɔyɛɛ Abram yiye; na onyaa nguan ne anantwi ne mfurum ne nkoa ne mfanaa ne mfurummere ne yoma.

english_verse: Because of Sarai, the Lord struck the king and everyone in his palace with terrible diseases.
translation_verse: Na Abram yere Sarai ho asɛm no nti AWURADE de ɔhaw akɛse haw Farao ne ne fi.

english_verse: Finally, the king sent for Abram and said to him, “What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me Sarai was your wife?
translation_verse: Na Farao frɛɛ Abram kae sɛ ɛdɛn na woayɛ me yi? Adɛn nti na woanka ankyerɛ me sɛ ɔyɛ wo yere?

english_verse: Why did you make me believe she was your sister? Now I've married her. Take her and go! She's your wife.”
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na wuse: ɔyɛ me nua? Na afei, hwɛ, wo yere ni, fa no na kɔ wo kwan.

english_verse: So the king told his men to let Abram and Sarai take their possessions and leave.
translation_verse: Na Farao tuu nnipa maa no sɛ wonkogya no ne ne yere ne nea ɔwɔ nyinaa kwan.

english_verse: Abram and Sarai took everything they owned and went to the Southern Desert. Lot went with them.
translation_verse: Na Abram fii Misraim, ɔno ne ne yere ne nea ɔwɔ nyinaa, ne Lot nso, baa negeb.

english_verse: Abram was very rich. He owned many cattle, sheep, and goats, and had a lot of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Na Abram anya ne ho sɛ, mmoa ne dwetɛ ne sika mu.

english_verse: Abram moved from place to place in the Southern Desert. And finally, he went north and set up his tents between Bethel and Ai,
translation_verse: Na odii atutena fi negeb koduu Betel, nea kan ne ntamadan si no, wɔ Betel ne Ai ntam,

english_verse: where he had earlier camped and built an altar. There he worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: nea afɔremuka a osii kan no wɔ hɔ. Na Abram sɔree AWURADE wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Lot, who was traveling with him, also had sheep, goats, and cattle, as well as his own family and slaves.
translation_verse: Na Lot nso a ɔne Abram nam no wɔ nguan ne anantwi ne ntamadan.

english_verse: Abram said to Lot, “We are close relatives. We shouldn't argue, and our men shouldn't be fighting one another.
translation_verse: Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Lot sɛ mesrɛ wo, mma akasakasa mmma me ne wo ntam, ne me mmoahwɛfo ne wo mmoahwɛfo ntam, na yɛyɛ anuanom.

english_verse: There is plenty of land for you to choose from. Let's separate. If you go north, I'll go south; if you go south, I'll go north.”
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ asase no nyinaa na ɛda w'anim yi? Mesrɛ wo, twe wo ho fi me ho, sɛ wofa benkum a, mɛfa nifa, na sɛ wofa nifa a, mɛfa benkum.

english_verse: This happened before the Lord had destroyed the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. And when Lot looked around, he saw there was plenty of water in the Jordan Valley. All the way to Zoar the valley was as green as the garden of the Lord or the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Na Lot maa n'ani so hwɛɛ Yordan nyinaa de kosi Soar huu sɛ ne nyinaa so wɔ nsu te sɛ AWURADE turo no te sɛ Misraim, ansa na AWURADE resɛe Sodom ne Gomora no.

english_verse: So Lot chose the whole Jordan Valley for himself, and as he started out toward the east, he and Abram separated.
translation_verse: Na Lot paw Yordan dantaban no nyinaa, na otutu faa apuei fam; na anuanom no dii mpaepaemu.

english_verse: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan. But Lot settled near the cities of the valley and put up his tents not far from Sodom,
translation_verse: Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so, na Lot de, ɔtenaa Yordan dantaban no nkurow mu, na otutuu ne ntamadan ara de koduu Sodom.

english_verse: where the people were evil and sinned terribly against the Lord. Abram Moves to Hebron
translation_verse: Nso Sodomfo yɛ awudifo ne nnebɔneyɛfo akɛse AWURADE anim.

english_verse: After Abram and Lot had gone their separate ways, the Lord said to Abram: Look around to the north, south, east, and west.
translation_verse: Na Lot tew ne ho fii Abram ho no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Ma w'ani so, na fi nea wowɔ hɔ hwɛ atifi fam ne anafo fam ne apuei ne atɔe.

english_verse: I will give you and your family all the land you can see. It will be theirs forever!
translation_verse: Na asase a wuhu yi nyinaa, wo ne w'asefo na mede mɛma mo daa.

english_verse: I will give you more descendants than there are specks of dust on the earth, and someday it will be easier to count those specks of dust than to count your descendants.
translation_verse: Na mɛma w'asefo adɔɔso sɛ asase so mfutuma, na sɛ obi tumi kan asase so mfutuma a, ɛnne na obetumi akan w'asefo nso.

english_verse: Now walk back and forth across the land, because I am going to give it to you.
translation_verse: Sɔre, fa asase no tenten ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ mu, na wo na mede mɛma wo.

english_verse: Abram took down his tents and went to live near the sacred trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Abram tutuu ne ntamadan, na ɔbɛtenaa Mamre pɔw a ɛwɔ Hebron no ho, na osii afɔremuka maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: About this time, King Amraphel of Babylonia, King Arioch of Ellasar, King Chedorlaomer of Elam, and King Tidal of Goiim
translation_verse: Na Sinear hene Amrafel, Elasar hene Ariok, Elam hene Kedorlaomer ne Goiim hene Tideal bere so,

english_verse: attacked King Bera of Sodom, King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, a city also known as Zoar.
translation_verse: wɔne Sodom hene Bera ne Gomora hene Birsa, Adma hene Sinab ne Seboim hene Semeber ne Bela hene dii ako.

english_verse: A year later King Chedorlaomer and his allies attacked and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, and the Emites in Shaveh-Kiriathaim.
translation_verse: Na afe a ɛto so dunan no, Kedorlaomer ne ahene a wɔkeka ne ho no bekum Refaim wɔ Asterot-karnaim, ne Susifo wɔ Ham, ne Emifo wɔ Kiriataim tataw so,

english_verse: They also defeated the Horites in the hill country of Edom, as far as El-Paran, near the desert.
translation_verse: ne Horifo wɔ wɔn bepɔw Seir so de kosii El-paran a ɛwɔ sare so no.

english_verse: They went back to the city of Enmishpat, better known as Kadesh. Then they captured all the land that belonged to the Amalekites, and they defeated the Amorites who were living in Hazazon-Tamar.
translation_verse: Na wɔsan baa En-mispat, na wɔkaa Amalekfo asase nyinaa ne Amorifo nso a wɔte Hasesontamar no gui.

english_verse: At Siddim Valley, the armies of the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela fought the armies of King Chedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar. The valley
translation_verse: Na wɔne Elam hene Kedorlaomer, Goiim hene Tideal, Sinear hene Amrafel ne Elasar hene Ariok de bɛbɔɔ ani wɔ Sidim bon mu, ahene baanan a wɔreko atia baanum.

english_verse: was full of tar pits, and when the troops from Sodom and Gomorrah started running away, some of them fell into the pits. Others escaped to the hill country.
translation_verse: Na Sidim bon mu yɛ ama amoamoa ara nko. Na Sodom ne Gomora ahemfo guanee. Na ebinom totɔɔ amena no mu, na wɔn a aka no guan kɔɔ bepɔw so.

english_verse: Their enemies took everything of value from Sodom and Gomorrah, including their food supplies.
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa Sodom ne Gomora nneɛma nyinaa ne wɔn nnuan nyinaa de siim kɔe.

english_verse: They also captured Abram's nephew Lot, who lived in Sodom. They took him and his possessions and then left.
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa Abram ne nua ba Lot a ɔte Sodom ne n'ahode kɔe.

english_verse: At this time Abram the Hebrew was living near the oaks that belonged to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner were Abram's friends. Someone who had escaped from the battle told Abram
translation_verse: Na oguanfo bi bɛka kyerɛɛ Hebrini Abram a ɔte Amorini Mamre, a ne nuanom ne Eskol ne Aner ne nua, pɔw mu; nso wɔne Abram wɔ apam. Abram gye Lot

english_verse: that his nephew Lot had been taken away. Three hundred and eighteen of Abram's servants were fighting men, so he took them and followed the enemy as far north as the city of Dan.
translation_verse: Na Abram tee sɛ wɔafa ne nua dommum no, ɔde ne mmarima a wɔawo wɔn wɔ ne fi ahasa dunwɔtwe tuu sa tiw wɔn koduu Dan.

english_verse: That night, Abram divided up his troops, attacked from all sides, and won a great victory. But some of the enemy escaped to the town of Hobah north of Damascus,
translation_verse: Na ɔne ne nkoa kyɛɛ wɔn ho mu baa wɔn so anadwo, na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn, na wɔtaa wɔn koduu Hoba a ɛda Damasko benkum so no.

english_verse: and Abram went after them. He brought back his nephew Lot, together with Lot's possessions and the women and everyone else who had been captured. Abram Is Blessed by Melchizedek
translation_verse: Na ɔde nneɛma no nyinaa ne ne nua Lot nso ne ne nneɛma ne mmea no nso ne nkurɔfo no san bae. Melkisedek hyira Abram.

english_verse: Abram returned after he had defeated King Chedorlaomer and the other kings. Then the king of Sodom went to meet Abram in Shaveh Valley, which is also known as King's Valley.
translation_verse: Na ɔsan fii Kedorlaomer ne ahemfo a ɛkeka ne ho no so nkonimdi no reba no, Sodom hene fi kohyiaa no wɔ Sawe bon mu.

english_verse: King Melchizedek of Salem was a priest of God Most High. He brought out some bread and wine
translation_verse: Na Salem hene Melkisedek de abodoo ne bobesa brɛɛ no; na ɔyɛ ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn sɔfo.

english_verse: and said to Abram: “I bless you in the name of God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Na ohyiraa no sɛ ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔsoro ne asase wura no nhyira nka Abram,

english_verse: All praise belongs to God Most High for helping you defeat your enemies.” Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
translation_verse: na nhyira ne ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔde w'atamfo ahyɛ wo nsa. Na Abram maa no nneɛma no nyinaa mu ntotoso du du.

english_verse: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “All I want are my people. You can keep everything else.”
translation_verse: Na Sodom hene ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Fa nnipa no ma me, na fa ahode no.

english_verse: Abram answered: The Lord God Most High made the heavens and the earth. And I have promised him
translation_verse: Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Sodom hene no sɛ: Mema me nsa so mekyerɛ AWURADE, ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔsoro ne asase wura no,

english_verse: that I won't keep anything of yours, not even a sandal strap or a piece of thread. Then you can never say that you are the one who made me rich.
translation_verse: sɛ efi asaawa so de kosi mpaboa hama so, meremfa biribiara a ɛyɛ wo de, na woanka sɛ: Me na mama Abram anya ne ho;

english_verse: Let my share be the food that my men have eaten. But Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre went with me, so give them their share of what we brought back.
translation_verse: gye nea mmerante no adi no nko, ne mmarima a wɔne me kɔe no, Aner, Eskol ne Mamre nya wɔn kyɛfa.

english_verse: Later the Lord spoke to Abram in a vision, “Abram, don't be afraid! I will protect you and reward you greatly.”
translation_verse: Nsɛm yi akyi no, AWURADE asɛm baa Abram nkyɛn anisoadehu mu sɛ: Nsuro, Abram, mene wo kyɛm, na w'akatua bɛdɔɔso pii.

english_verse: But Abram answered, “Lord All-Powerful, you have given me everything I could ask for, except children. And when I die, Eliezer of Damascus will get all I own.
translation_verse: Na Abram se: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, ɛdɛn na wode bɛma me? Minni ba na menam, so nea obedi m'ade ne Damaskoni Eliesa anaa?

english_verse: You have not given me any children, and this servant of mine will inherit everything.”
translation_verse: Na Abram kae se: Ao, me de, woamma me asefo, na hwɛ, me fienipa na obedi m'ade.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “No, he won't! You will have a son of your own, and everything you have will be his.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi na obedi w'ade, na nea obefi wo ankasa asen mu no na obedi w'ade.

english_verse: Then the Lord took Abram outside and said, “Look at the sky and see if you can count the stars. That's how many descendants you will have.”
translation_verse: Na ɔde no fii adi kae sɛ: Hwɛ ɔsoro ɛ, na kan nsoromma sɛ wubetumi akan anaa? Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ w'asefo bɛyɛ nen.

english_verse: Abram believed the Lord, so the Lord was pleased with him and accepted him. The Lord Makes Another Promise to Abram
translation_verse: Na Abram gyee AWURADE dii, na obuu eyi sɛ trenee maa no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram, “I brought you here from Ur in Chaldea, and I gave you this land.”
translation_verse: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Mene AWURADE a ɔde wo fii Ur a ɛwɔ Kaldea sɛ mede asase yi mɛma wo sɛ awunnyade.

english_verse: Abram asked, “Lord God, how can I know the land will be mine?”
translation_verse: Na ose. AWURADE Nyankopɔn, ɛdɛn na mede mehu sɛ menya?

english_verse: Then the Lord told him, “Bring me a three-year-old cow, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a dove, and a young pigeon.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa nantwi ba a wadi mfe abiɛsa ne abirekyi a wadi mfe abiɛsa ne odwennini a wadi mfe abiɛsa ne aturukuku ne aborɔnoma ba brɛ me.

english_verse: Abram obeyed the Lord. Then he cut the animals in half and laid the two halves of each animal opposite each other on the ground. But he did not cut the doves and pigeons in half.
translation_verse: Na ɔde eyi nyinaa brɛɛ no, na ɔpaepaee wɔn mu abien abien, na ɔde afaafa no kyerɛkyerɛɛ anim totoo hɔ; na nnomaa no de, wampaepae wɔn mu.

english_verse: And when birds came down to eat the animals, Abram chased them away.
translation_verse: Na nnomaa a wodi nam besisii mmoa afunu no so, na Abram pam wɔn.

english_verse: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and everything became dark and frightening.
translation_verse: Na owia reyɛ akɔtɔ no, Abram daa nnahɔɔ, na hwɛ, ehu ne esum kabii duruu no so.

english_verse: Four generations later, your descendants will return here and take this land, because only then will the people who live here be so sinful that they deserve to be punished.
translation_verse: Na awo ntoatoaso anan mu na wɔbɛsan aba ha, efisɛ Amorifo amumɔyɛ nnya nnui ɛ.

english_verse: Sometime after sunset, when it was very dark, a smoking cooking pot and a flaming fire passed between the two halves of each animal.
translation_verse: Na owia tɔe na esum kusuu durui no, hwɛ, biribi a ɛte se gyaframa a efi wusiw ne gyatɛn a ɛdɛw bɛfaa afaafa no ntam.

english_verse: At that time the Lord made an agreement with Abram and told him: I will give your descendants the land east of the Shihor River on the border of Egypt as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Da no ara na AWURADE ne Abram pamee sɛ: W'asefo na mede asase yi mama wɔn, efi Misraim asubɔnten ho de kosi asubɔnten kɛse, Eufrate asubɔnten, no so:

english_verse: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaites,
translation_verse: Hetifo, Perisifo, Refaimfo,

english_verse: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Amorifo, Kanaanfo, Girgasifo, ne Yebusifo.

english_verse: Abram's wife Sarai had not been able to have any children. But she owned a young Egyptian slave woman named Hagar,
translation_verse: Na Abram yere Sarai nwo mma no. Na ɔwɔ afanaa bi a ɔyɛ Misraimni a ne din de Hagar.

english_verse: and Sarai said to Abram, “The Lord has not given me any children. Sleep with my slave, and if she has a child, it will be mine.” Abram agreed,
translation_verse: Na Sarai ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Hwɛ, AWURADE asiw m'awo ho kwan, enti kɔ m'afenaa nkyɛn, ebia menya ne ho mma. Na Abram tiee Sarai.

english_verse: and Sarai gave him Hagar to be his wife. This happened after Abram had lived in the land of Canaan for ten years.
translation_verse: Na Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so mfirihyia du no, Abram yere Sarai faa n'afenaa Hagar a ɔyɛ Misraimni no de no maa ne kunu Abram aware.

english_verse: Later, when Hagar knew she was going to have a baby, she became proud and treated Sarai hatefully.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔɔ Hagar ho, na onyinsɛnee. Na ohui sɛ wanyinsɛn no, obuu n'awuraa animtiaa.

english_verse: Then Sarai said to Abram, “It's all your fault! I gave you my slave woman, but she has been hateful to me ever since she found out she was pregnant. You have done me wrong, and you will have to answer to the Lord for this.”
translation_verse: Na Sarai ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Asɛmmɔne a wɔadi me da wo so. Me na mede m'afenaa mato wo kokom, na ohuu sɛ wanyinsɛn nti, obu me animtiaa. AWURADE mmu me ne wo ntam atɛn.

english_verse: Abram said, “All right! She's your slave—do whatever you want with her.” Then Sarai began treating Hagar so harshly that she finally ran away.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Abram ka kyerɛɛ Sarai sɛ: Hwɛ, w'afenaa wɔ wo nsam, yɛ no sɛnea eye w'ani so. Na Sarai tan n'ani na oguan fii ne nkyɛn.

english_verse: Hagar stopped to rest at a spring in the desert on the road to Shur. While she was there, the angel of the Lord came to her
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfo huu no nsu aniwa bi ho wɔ sare so, Sur kwan so nsu aniwa no ho.

english_verse: and asked, “Hagar, where have you come from, and where are you going?” She answered, “I'm running away from Sarai, my owner.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Hagar, Sarai afanaa, wufi he na woreba, na worekɔ he ni? Na ose: Mifi m'awuraa Sarai anim na mereguan.

english_verse: The angel said, “Go back to Sarai and be her slave.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfo no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: San kɔ w'awuraa nkyɛn, na kɔbrɛ wo ho ase hyɛ ne nsa ase.

english_verse: I will give you a son, who will be called Ishmael, because I have heard your cry for help. And someday I will give you so many descendants that no one will be able to count them all.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfo no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, woanyinsɛn, na wobɛwo ba, na wobɛto no din Ismael, ase ne: Onyankopɔn tie, efisɛ AWURADE ate w'amanehunu.

english_verse: But your son will live far from his relatives; he will be like a wild donkey, fighting everyone, and everyone fighting him.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbɛyɛ onipa a ɔte sɛ sare so afurum, ne nsa bɛtia nnipa nyinaa, na ɔbɛsɔre atia ne nuanom nyinaa.

english_verse: Hagar thought, “Have I really seen God and lived to tell about it?” So from then on she called him, “The God Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Na ɔfrɛɛ AWURADE a ɔne no kasae no din sɛ: Wone El-roi, na ose: So mahu nea ohu me no ampa?

english_verse: That's why people call the well between Kadesh and Bered, “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Enti wɔfrɛ asubura no sɛ: Beerlahairoi, ase ne: Ɔteasefo a ohu me no abura, hwɛ, ɛwɔ Kades ne Bared ntam.

english_verse: I will keep my solemn promise to you and give you more descendants than can be counted.”
translation_verse: Na mɛma m'apam ada me ne wo ntam, na mama woadɔ kɛse ara.

english_verse: Abram bowed with his face to the ground, and God said:
translation_verse: Na Abram daa hɔ de n'anim butuw fam; na Onyankopɔn ne no kasae sɛ

english_verse: I promise that you will be the father of many nations. So now I'm changing your name from Abram to Abraham.
translation_verse: Na wɔremfrɛ wo din Abram, a ase ne: Agya a wɔama no so bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Abraham ase ne: Nnipakuw agya, efisɛ mayɛ wo aman pii agya.

english_verse: I will give you a lot of descendants, and they will become great nations. Some of them will even be kings.
translation_verse: Na mɛma woadɔ pii pa, na mɛyɛ wo aman, na ahene afi wo mu.

english_verse: I will always keep the promise I have made to you and your descendants, because I am your God and their God.
translation_verse: Na mɛma me ne wo ne w'asefo a ebedi w'akyi no apam agyina wɔ wɔn awo ntoatoaso mu, na ayɛ daa apam, na mayɛ wo ne w'asefo a ebedi w'akyi no Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I will give you and them the land in which you are now a foreigner. I will give the whole land of Canaan to your family forever, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Na mede asase a woyɛ so hɔho yi, Kanaan asase nyinaa, mɛma wo ne w'asefo a ebedi w'akyi, sɛ daa awunnyade, na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Abraham, you and all future members of your family must promise to obey me.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Wo de, di m'apam so, wo ne w'asefo a ebedi w'akyi awo ntoatoaso mu.

english_verse: As the sign that you are keeping this promise, you must circumcise every man and boy in your family.
translation_verse: Na muntwa mo ho twetia, na ayɛ me ne mo ntam apam no ho sɛnkyerɛnne.

english_verse: Any man who isn't circumcised hasn't kept his part of the promise and cannot be one of my people.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima momonoto biara a wontwaa no twetia no, saa onipa no wobetwa no afi ne man mu, wato m'apam.

english_verse: Abraham, from now on your wife's name will be Sarah instead of Sarai.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo yere Sarai de, mfrɛ no Sarai bio, na mmom Sara, ase ne: Ɔhene babea.

english_verse: I will bless her, and you will have a son by her. She will become the mother of nations, and some of her descendants will even be kings.
translation_verse: Na mehyira no, na mama wo ne mu ba nso. Yiw, mehyira no, na ɔbɛyɛ ɔmankɛse. Aman ahemfo befi ne mu.

english_verse: Then he asked God, “Why not let Ishmael inherit what you have promised me?”
translation_verse: Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: O, enne anka ma Ismael nya w'anim adom ɛ!

english_verse: But God answered: No! You and Sarah will have a son. His name will be Isaac, and I will make an everlasting promise to him and his descendants.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Ampa ne ampa, wo yere Sara bɛwo ba ama wo, na woato ne din Isak ase ne: Ɔserew. Na mɛma me ne no apam agyina ayɛ daa apam ama n'asefo a ebedi n'akyi no.

english_verse: However, I have heard what you asked me to do for Ishmael, and so I will also bless him with many descendants. He will be the father of twelve princes, and I will make his family a great nation.
translation_verse: Na Ismael ho de, matie wo. Hwɛ, mehyira no, na mama wawo, na wadɔɔso pii pa ara. Atitiriw dumien na ɔbɛwo, na mayɛ no ɔman kɛse.

english_verse: But your son Isaac will be born about this time next year, and the promise I am making to you and your family will be for him and his descendants forever.
translation_verse: Na m'apam de, me ne Isak a Sara bɛwo no ama wo afedan sesɛɛ no na ɛbɛpam ama agyina.

english_verse: God finished speaking to Abraham and then left.
translation_verse: Na ɔne no wiee kasa no, Onyankopɔn fii Abraham nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: On that same day Abraham obeyed God by circumcising Ishmael. Abraham was also circumcised, and so were all the other men and boys in his household, including his servants and slaves. He was
translation_verse: Na ne fifo nyinaa, wɔn a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ ne fi ne wɔn a wɔde sika totɔɔ wɔn wɔ ahɔho nkyɛn, wotwitwaa wɔn twetia kaa ne ho.

english_verse: One hot summer afternoon while Abraham was sitting by the entrance to his tent near the sacred trees of Mamre, the Lord appeared to him.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ no wɔ Mamre pɔw mu, na ɔte ne ntamadan pon ano awia ketee.

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. He quickly ran to meet them, bowed with his face to the ground,
translation_verse: Na ɔmaa n'ani so hwɛe, na hwɛ, mmarima baasa abegyina ne ntentenso. Na ohuu wɔn no, ofii ne ntamadan pon ano tuu mmirika kohyiaa wɔn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase,

english_verse: and said, “Please come to my home where I can serve you.
translation_verse: kae sɛ: me wura, sɛ manya w'anim anuonyam a, mesrɛ wo, ntwa w'akoa ho nkɔ.

english_verse: I'll have some water brought, so you can wash your feet, then you can rest under a tree.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnkɔsaw nsu kakra bi mmra ɛ, na monhohoro mo anan ase, na monhome dua yi ase.

english_verse: Let me get you some food to give you strength before you leave. I would be honored to serve you.” “Thank you very much,” they answered. “We accept your offer.”
translation_verse: Na mekɔ makɔfa abodoo kakra maba, na mode adwudwo mo koma, na ɛno akyi no moakɔ, na enti na mobɛfaa mo akoa nkyɛn yi. Na wose: Yɛ sɛnea woaka yi.

english_verse: Abraham went quickly to his tent and said to Sarah, “Hurry! Get a large sack of flour and make some bread.”
translation_verse: Na Abraham yɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ Sara nkyɛn ntamadan mu kae sɛ: Yɛ ntɛm, fa asikresam pa susukora abiɛsa, fɔtɔw to tetare.

english_verse: After saying this, he rushed off to his herd of cattle and picked out one of the best calves, which his servant quickly prepared.
translation_verse: Na Abraham tuu mmirika kɔɔ anantwi mu kɔkyeree nantwi ba a oye, na ne nam bɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɔde maa ne somfo bi, na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm yɛɛ aduan no.

english_verse: He then served his guests some yogurt and milk together with the meat. While they were eating, he stood near them under the tree,
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa nufusu ani srade ne nufusu ne nantwi ba a osiesiee no no, na ɔde besii wɔn anim; na ɔno de, ogyinaa wɔn anim dua no ase, na wodidii.

english_verse: and they asked, “Where's your wife Sarah?” “She is right there in the tent,” Abraham answered.
translation_verse: Na wobisaa no sɛ: Wo yere Sara wɔ he? Na ose: Hwɛ, ɔwɔ ntamadan mu.

english_verse: Abraham and Sarah were very old, and Sarah was well past the age for having children.
translation_verse: Na Abraham ne Sara nyinaa anyin, na wɔadi mfirihyia pii, na nea ɛyɛ mmea no to atwa wɔ Sara ho.

english_verse: So she laughed and said to herself, “Now that I am worn out and my husband is old, will I really know such happiness?”
translation_verse: Enti Sara serewee ne mu kae sɛ: Sɛ manya mawie aberewa bɔ na me wura nso abɔ akwakoraa yi, na menya anigye?

english_verse: The Lord asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh? Does she doubt that she can have a child in her old age?
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bisaa Abraham sɛ: Dɛn nti na Sara serewee sɛ: So ampa ne ampa na manyin yi mɛwo ba?

english_verse: I am the Lord! There is nothing too difficult for me. I'll come back next year at the time I promised, and Sarah will already have a son.”
translation_verse: So biribi yɛ AWURADE yɛna? Bere a mahyɛ no, mɛsan maba wo nkyɛn afedan sesɛɛ, na Sara anya ɔba.

english_verse: Sarah was so frightened that she lied and said, “I didn't laugh.” “Yes, you did!” he answered. Abraham Prays for Sodom
translation_verse: Na Sara sanee sɛ: Menserewee ɛ, efisɛ osuro. Na ose: Daabi, na woaserew. Abraham di ma Sodomfo

english_verse: When the three men got ready to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked part of the way with them.
translation_verse: Na mmarima no sɔre fii hɔ dan wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Sodom, na Abraham ne wɔn kɔe kogyaa wɔn kwan.

english_verse: The Lord said to himself, “I should tell Abraham what I am going to do,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kae sɛ: So memfa nea merebɛyɛ yi minsie Abraham anaa?

english_verse: since his family will become a great and powerful nation that will be a blessing to all the other nations on earth.
translation_verse: Efisɛ ampa ara, Abraham bɛyɛ ɔman a ɛso na ɛwɔ tumi, na ne mu na wobehyira wiase aman nyinaa.

english_verse: I have chosen him to teach his family to obey me forever and to do what is right and fair. If they do, I will give Abraham many descendants, just as I promised.”
translation_verse: Na mahu no mayi no sɛ ɔnhyɛ ne mma ne ne fifo a ebedi n'akyi sɛ wonni AWURADE kwan so nyɛ adetrenee, mmu atɛntrenee, na AWURADE ama nea waka Abraham ho no aba no so.

english_verse: ?” “Because of them, I won't destroy the city,” was the Lord's answer.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kae sɛ: Sodom ne Gomora nteɛm so, na wɔn nnebɔne yɛ duru dodo nti,

english_verse: Now I am going down to see for myself if those people really are that bad. If they aren't, I would like to know.”
translation_verse: meresian makɔhwɛ sɛ wɔayɛ sɛnea nteɛm a edu me nkyɛn no te anaa; na sɛ ɛnte saa a, mahu.

english_verse: The men turned and started toward Sodom. But the Lord stayed with Abraham.
translation_verse: Na mmarima no dan wɔn ani fii hɔ kɔɔ Sodom, na Abraham de, na ɔda so gyina AWURADE anim ara.

english_verse: And Abraham asked him, “Lord, when you destroy the evil people, are you also going to destroy those who are good?
translation_verse: Na Abraham twiw bɛn kae sɛ: So wobɛpra ɔtreneeni ne ɔbɔnefo abom agu anaa?

english_verse: You surely wouldn't let them be killed when you destroy the evil ones. You are the judge of all the earth, and you do what is right.”
translation_verse: Eyi mpare wo sɛ wubedi saa asɛm yi, sɛ wubekum ɔtreneeni ne ɔbɔnefo afra, na ɔtreneeni ayɛ sɛ ɔbɔnefo; eyi mpare wo. Nea obu asase nyinaa atɛn no remmu atɛntrenee anaa?

english_verse: Abraham answered, “I am nothing more than the dust of the earth. Please forgive me, Lord, for daring to speak to you like this.
translation_verse: Na Abraham buae sɛ: Hwɛ, meyɛ mfutuma ne nso de, nanso masi me bo sɛ me ne AWURADE bɛkasa:

english_verse: Then Abraham said, “I don't have any right to ask you, Lord, but what would you do if you find only
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Hwɛ, masi me bo sɛ me ne AWURADE bɛkasa. Ebia wobehu aduonu wɔ hɔ. Na ose: Aduonu no nti merensɛe hɔ.

english_verse: Finally, Abraham said, “Please don't get angry, Lord, if I speak just once more. Suppose you find only
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Mma Awurade bo mmfuw, na menkasa prɛko pɛ yi: Ebia wobehu edu wɔ hɔ. Na ose: Edu no nti merensɛe hɔ.

english_verse: After speaking with Abraham, the Lord left, and Abraham went back home.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ne Abraham wiee ɔkasa no, ɔkɔe, na Abraham san baa ne fi.

english_verse: That evening, while Lot was sitting near the city gate, the two angels arrived in Sodom. When Lot saw them, he got up, bowed down low,
translation_verse: Na abɔfo baanu no duu Sodom anwummere; na Lot te Sodom kurow pon ano. Na Lot huu wɔn no, ɔsɔre kohyiaa wɔn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase kae sɛ:

english_verse: and said, “Gentlemen, I am your servant. Please come to my home. You can wash your feet, spend the night, and be on your way in the morning.” They told him, “No, we'll spend the night in the city square.”
translation_verse: Me wuranom, mesrɛ mo, momman mmra mo akoa fi mmɛsoɛ anadwo yi, na monhohoro mo anan ase, na anɔpatutu moasɔre akɔ mo kwan. Na wose: Dabi, na yɛbɛda abɔnten so.

english_verse: But Lot kept insisting, until they finally agreed and went home with him. He quickly baked some bread, cooked a meal, and they ate.
translation_verse: Na ɔsrɛɛ wɔn dennennen. Na wɔman ne nkyɛn baa ne fi, na ɔtow wɔn pon, na ɔtoo apiti ma wodii.

english_verse: Before Lot and his guests could go to bed, every man in Sodom, young and old, came and stood outside his house
translation_verse: Na wonnya nkɔdae no, kurom hɔfo, Sodomfo, betwaa ɔdan no ho hyiae, efi mmofra so kosi mpanyimfo so, ɔman mu no nyinaa.

english_verse: and started shouting, “Where are your visitors? Send them out, so we can have sex with them!”
translation_verse: Na wɔfrɛɛ Lot ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ; Mmarima a wɔbaa wo nkyɛn anadwo yi no wɔ he? Yi wɔn brɛ yɛn, na yene wɔn nna.

english_verse: Lot went outside and shut the door behind him.
translation_verse: Na Lot fi kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn ɔpon ano, na ɔtoo ɔpon no mu wɔ n'akyi.

english_verse: Then he said, “Friends, please don't do such a terrible thing!
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Anuanom, mesrɛ mo, monnyɛ bɔne sa!

english_verse: I have two daughters who have never had sex. I'll bring them out, and you can do what you want with them. But don't harm these men. They are guests in my home.”
translation_verse: Hwɛ, mewɔ mmabea baanu a wonhuu ɔbarima ɛ, momma memfa wɔn mimfi memmrɛ mo, na monyɛ wɔn sɛnea eye mo ani so, na mmarima yi nko de, monnyɛ wɔn hwee, na ɛno nti na wɔbaa me suhyɛ nwini ase yi.

english_verse: “Don't get in our way,” the crowd answered. “You're a foreigner. What right do you have to order us around? We'll do worse things to you than we're going to do to them.” The crowd kept arguing with Lot. Finally, they rushed toward the door to break it down.
translation_verse: Na wɔkae sɛ: Twe wo ho fi hɔ! Na wose: Saa onipa yi bae bɛyɛɛ ɔhɔho, ɛnna afei ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔtemmufo yi! Afei yɛbɛyɛ wo bɔne akyɛn wɔn. Na wɔhyɛɛ Lot so dennen twiw bae sɛ wobebubu pon no.

english_verse: But the two angels in the house reached out and pulled Lot safely inside.
translation_verse: Na mmarima no teɛɛ wɔn nsa twee Lot baa wɔn nkyɛn wɔ ɔdan no mu, ma wɔtoo pon no mu.

english_verse: Then they struck blind everyone in the crowd, and none of them could even find the door.
translation_verse: Na nnipa a wogyina ɔpon ano no de, wofurafuraa wɔn ani fi nketewa so kosi akɛse so, na wɔhwehwɛɛ ɔpon ano kwan brɛe.

english_verse: Lot went to the men who were engaged to his daughters and said, “Hurry up and get out of here! The Lord is going to destroy this city.” But they thought he was joking, and they laughed at him.
translation_verse: Na Lot fii adi ne ne nsenom a wɔrebɛware ne mmabea no kɔ kasae sɛ: Monsɔre mfi ha, na AWURADE rebɛsɛe kurow yi. Nanso ɔyɛɛ ne nsenom no ani so sɛ obi a ɔredi fɛw.

english_verse: Early the next morning the two angels tried to make Lot hurry and leave. They said, “Take your wife and your two daughters and get away from here as fast as you can! If you don't, every one of you will be killed when the Lord destroys the city.”
translation_verse: Na ade reyɛ akye no, abɔfo no piapiaa Lot sɛ: Sɔre, fa wo yere ne wo mmabea baanu a wɔwɔ ha no kɔ, anyɛ saa a, wɔbɛsɛe wo, ɔman yi amumɔyɛ mu.

english_verse: At first, Lot just stood there. But the Lord wanted to save him. So the angels took Lot, his wife, and his two daughters by the hand and led them out of the city.
translation_verse: Na ɔtwentwɛn ne nan ase no, mmarima no susoo ɔno ne ne yere ne ne mmabea baanu no nsa, na AWURADE huu no mmɔbɔ na wɔde no fii adi gyaw no kurow no akyi.

english_verse: When they were outside, one of the angels said, “Run for your lives! Don't even look back. And don't stop in the valley. Run to the hills, where you'll be safe.”
translation_verse: Na wɔde wɔn fii adi no, ɔkae sɛ: Guan gye wo kra nkwa, nhwɛ w'akyi, nso nnyina dantaban yi mu baabiara; bepɔw so na guan kɔ, anyɛ saa a, wɔbɛsɛe wo.

english_verse: Lot answered, “You have done us a great favor, sir. You have saved our lives, but please don't make us go to the hills. That's too far away. The city will be destroyed before we can get there, and we will be killed when it happens.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, w'akoa anya w'anim dom, na woama w'adɔe a woayɛ me yi aso sɛ woregye me nkwa, nanso merentumi nguan nkɔ bepɔw so, na mmusu no ammɛto me, na manwu.

english_verse: There's a town near here. It's only a small place, but my family and I will be safe, if you let us go there.”
translation_verse: Hwɛ, kurow yi na ɛbɛn sɛ woguan kɔ hɔ, nanso ɛhɔ sua; ma minguan menkɔ hɔ ɛ, so ensua anaa? Na me kra anya nkwa.

english_verse: “All right, go there,” he answered. “I won't destroy that town.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, matie wo wɔ saa asɛm yi ho nso, na meremmutuw kurow a woka ho asɛm yi.

english_verse: Hurry! Run! I can't do anything until you are safely there.” The town was later called Zoar because Lot had said it was small. Sodom and Gomorrah Are Destroyed
translation_verse: Yɛ ntɛm guan kɔ hɔ, efisɛ merentumi menyɛ hwee gye sɛ woakodu hɔ ansa. Enti na wɔfrɛ kurow no din sɛ: Soar, ase ne: Ade ketewaa.

english_verse: The sun was coming up as Lot reached the town of Zoar,
translation_verse: Na Lot duu Soar no, na owia apue asase so.

english_verse: and the Lord sent burning sulfur down like rain on Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE tɔɔ sufre ne gya fi ɔsoro guu Sodom ne Gomora so.

english_verse: He destroyed those cities and everyone who lived in them, as well as their land and the trees and grass that grew there.
translation_verse: Na obutuw nkurow no ne dantaban no nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔtete nkurow no mu nyinaa ne nea afifi asase no so.

english_verse: On the way, Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a block of salt.
translation_verse: Na ne yere no de, ɔhwɛɛ n'akyi, na ɔdan nkyene siw.

english_verse: That same morning Abraham got up and went to the place where he had stood and spoken with the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Abraham tuaa ahema kɔɔ nea ogyinaa AWURADE anim hɔ no.

english_verse: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and saw smoke rising from all over the land—it was like a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Na ɔdan n'ani kyerɛɛ Sodom ne Gomora ne dantaban no asase nyinaa, na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, asase no so wusiw foroe sɛ, fononoo mu wusiw.

english_verse: When God destroyed the cities of the valley where Lot lived, he remembered his promise to Abraham and saved Lot from the terrible destruction. Moab and Ammon
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn sɛee dantaban no nkurow no no, Onyankopɔn kaee Abraham, na ogyee Lot fii butuw a obutuw nkurow a Lot te mu no mu. Moab ne Amonfo mfiase

english_verse: Lot was afraid to stay on in Zoar. So he took his two daughters and moved to a cave in the hill country.
translation_verse: Na Lot fii Soar kɔtenaa bepɔw no so, ɔne ne mmabea baanu no, efisɛ osuroo Soar tena, na ɔne ne mmabea baanu no kɔtenaa ɔbodan bi mu.

english_verse: One day his older daughter said to her sister, “Our father is old, and there are no men anywhere for us to marry.
translation_verse: Na abakan no ka kyerɛɛ akumaa no sɛ: Yɛn agya anyin, na ɔbarima biara nni asase yi so a ɔbɛba yɛn ho, sɛnea asase sofo nyinaa amanne te.

english_verse: Let's get our father drunk! Then we can sleep with him and have children.”
translation_verse: Bra, na yɛmma yɛn agya nsa nnom, na yɛne no nkɔda, na yɛanya yɛn agya ho mma.

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and the older daughter got in bed with him, but he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Na wɔmaa wɔn agya nsa nomee anadwo no, na abakan no kɔɔ mu ne n'agya kɔdae; na wanhu ne nna ne ne sɔre mu.

english_verse: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, “I slept with my father last night. We'll get him drunk again tonight, so you can sleep with him, and we can each have a child.”
translation_verse: Na ade kyee no, abakan no ka kyerɛɛ akumaa no sɛ: Hwɛ, me ne m'agya akɔda anadwo yi, ma yɛmma no nsa nnom nnɛ anadwo yi nso, na kɔ mu, na wo ne no nkɔda, na yɛanya yɛn agya ho mma.

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and this time the younger sister slept with him. But once again he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Na wɔmaa wɔn agya nsa nomee anadwo no nso bio, na akumaa no sɔre ne no kɔdae; na wanhu ne nna ne ne sɔre mu.

english_verse: That's how Lot's two daughters had children.
translation_verse: Na Lot mmabea baanu no nyinsɛn wɔn agya ho.

english_verse: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.
translation_verse: Na abakan no woo babarima, na ɔtoo no din Moab; ɔne Moabfo agya de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Na akumaa no nso woo babarima, na ɔtoo no din Benami; ɔne Amonfo agya de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
translation_verse: Na Abraham kae ne yere Sara ho sɛ ɔyɛ me nuabea. Na Gerar hene Abimelek soma ma wɔbɛfaa Sara.

english_verse: But God came to Abimelech in a dream and said, “You have taken a married woman into your home, and for this you will die!”
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn baa Abimelek nkyɛn anadwo dae mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔbea a woakɔfa no no nti woawu awie, efisɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima bi yere.

english_verse: Abimelech said to the Lord, “Don't kill me! I haven't slept with Sarah. Didn't they say they were brother and sister? I am completely innocent.”
translation_verse: So ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Me nua ne no? Na ɔbea no nso kae sɛ: Me nua ne no. Me komam fann ne me tirim fitaa na mede meyɛɛ eyi.

english_verse: Then God continued: I know you are innocent. That's why I kept you from sleeping with Sarah and doing anything wrong.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no ɔdae mu sɛ: Me nso minim sɛ, wo komam fann na wode yɛɛ eyi, na me nso misoo wo mu, na woanyɛ me bɔne, ɛno nti na mamma woamfa wo ho anka no.

english_verse: Her husband is a prophet. Let her go back to him, and his prayers will save you from death. But if you don't return her, you and all your people will die.
translation_verse: Na afei dan ɔbarima no yere kɔma no, efisɛ ɔyɛ odiyifo, na wapa kyɛw ama wo, na woanya nkwa; na sɛ woannan no ankɔma no a, ɛnne, hu sɛ owu na wubewu, wo ne nea wowɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: Early the next morning Abimelech sent for his officials, and when he told them what had happened, they were frightened.
translation_verse: Na Abimelek sɔree anɔpatutu frɛɛ ne nkoa nyinaa, na ɔkaa nsɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ wɔn, na nnipa no suroe pii.

english_verse: Abimelech then called in Abraham and said: Look what you've done to us! What have I ever done to you? Why did you make me and my nation guilty of such a terrible sin?
translation_verse: Na Abimelek frɛɛ Abraham ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Dɛn na woayɛ yɛn yi, na bɔne bɛn na mayɛ wo, na wode bɔne kɛse yi aba me ne m'ahenni so? Ade a wɔnyɛ na woayɛ me yi.

english_verse: What were you thinking when you did this?
translation_verse: Na Abimelek ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Dɛn na wuhui na wudii saa asɛm yi?

english_verse: Abraham answered: I did it because I didn't think any of you respected God, and I was sure that someone would kill me to get my wife.
translation_verse: Na Abraham kae sɛ: Efisɛ misusuwii sɛ, ampa Onyankopɔn ho suro nni ha yi, na me yere nti wobekum me.

english_verse: Besides, she is my half sister. We have the same father, but different mothers.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛwom ampa sɛ ɔyɛ me nua; m'agya ba ne no, na ɛnyɛ me na ba a; na wayɛ me yere.

english_verse: When God made us leave my father's home and start wandering, I told her, “If you really love me, then tell everyone that I am your brother.”
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ma mifii m'agya fi mibekyinii no, misee no sɛ: W'adɔe a wobɛyɛ me ne sɛ, baabiara a yebedu no, ka me ho sɛ ɔyɛ me nua.

english_verse: After Abimelech had given Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves, he sent Sarah back
translation_verse: Ɛnna Abimelek faa nguan ne anantwi, ne nkoa ne mfenaa de maa Abraham, na ɔdan ne yere Sara maa no.

english_verse: and told Abraham he could settle anywhere in his country.
translation_verse: Na Abimelek kae sɛ: Hwɛ, m'asase na ɛda w'anim yi, baabiara a eye wɔ w'ani so no, tena.

english_verse: Meanwhile, God had kept Abimelech's wife and slaves from having children. But Abraham prayed, and God let them start having children again.
translation_verse: Esiane Abraham yere Sara ho asɛm no nti, na AWURADE ato Abimelek fifo mmea nyinaa yafunu mu.

english_verse: The Lord was good to Sarah and kept his promise.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɛhwɛɛ Sara sɛnea ɔkae no, na Awurade yɛɛ Sara sɛnea ɔhyɛɛ no bɔ no.

english_verse: Although Abraham was very old, Sarah had a son exactly at the time God had said.
translation_verse: Na Sara nyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo babarima maa Abraham ne nkwakorabere mu, bere a Onyankopɔn kaa no ho asɛm no mu.

english_verse: and when the boy was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, just as God had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Abraham ba Isak dii nnawɔtwe no, otwaa no twetia, sɛnea Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: and Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. And now everyone will laugh with me.
translation_verse: Na Sara kae sɛ: Onyankopɔn ama me ɔserew, obiara a ɔbɛte no bɛserew ama me.

english_verse: Who would have dared to tell Abraham that someday I would have a child? But in his old age, I have given him a son.”
translation_verse: Na ose: Hena na anka ɔbɛka akyerɛ Abraham sɛ: Sara bɛma mma nufu? Nanso hwɛ, mawo ba ama no, ne nkwakorabere mu.

english_verse: The time came when Sarah no longer had to nurse Isaac, and on that day Abraham gave a big feast. Hagar and Ishmael Are Sent Away
translation_verse: Na abofra no nyinii, na wotwaa no nufu. Na da a wotwaa Isak nufu no, Abraham tow pon kɛse. Wɔpam Hagar ne Ismael

english_verse: One day, Sarah noticed Hagar's son Ishmael playing, and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that Egyptian slave woman and her son! I don't want him to inherit anything. It should all go to my son.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Pam afenaa yi ne ne ba no, na ɛnyɛ afenaa yi ba ne me ba Isak na ebedi ade.

english_verse: But God said, “Abraham, don't worry about your slave woman and the boy. Just do what Sarah tells you. Isaac will inherit your family name,
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Mma abofra no ne w'afenaa asɛm no nnyɛ wo yaw, na nea Sara ka kyerɛ wo nyinaa, tie, na Isak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w'asefo.

english_verse: but the son of the slave woman is also your son, and I will make his descendants into a great nation.”
translation_verse: Na afenaa ba no nso, mɛyɛ no ɔman kɛse, efisɛ ɔyɛ w'aseni.

english_verse: Early the next morning Abraham gave Hagar an animal skin full of water and some bread. Then he put the boy on her shoulder and sent them away. They wandered around in the desert near Beersheba,
translation_verse: Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutu faa aduan ne nsu kotoku, na ɔde maa Hagar, ɔde sii ne kɔn ho, na ogyaa ɔne abofra no kwan. Na ɔkɔe, kokyinkyinii Beer-seba sare so.

english_verse: and after they had run out of water, Hagar put her son under a bush.
translation_verse: Na nsu no sae wɔ kotoku no mu no, ogyaw abofra no wɔ ɔdɔtɔ bi ase,

english_verse: Then she sat down a long way off, because she could not bear to watch him die. And she cried bitterly.
translation_verse: na ɔkɔ kɔtenaa akyiri bɛyɛ sɛnea wɔtow bɛmma a ɛbɛtɔ, na ose: Mma minnhu abofra yi wu! Na ɔtenaa ne ntentenso, na ɔmaa ne nne so sui.

english_verse: When God heard the boy crying, the angel of God called out to Hagar from heaven and said, “Hagar, why are you worried? Don't be afraid. I have heard your son crying.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn tee abarimaa no nne, na Onyankopɔn bɔfo fi soro frɛɛ Hagar ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hagar, dɛn na ɛyɛ wo? Nsuro, na Onyankopɔn ate abarimaa no nne wɔ nea ɔwɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Help him up and hold his hand, because I will make him the father of a great nation.”
translation_verse: Sɔre, ma abarimaa no so, na fa wo nsa so no mu; na mɛyɛ no ɔman kɛse.

english_verse: Then God let her see a well. So she went to the well and filled the skin with water, then gave some to her son.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn buee n'ani, na ohuu asubura bi, na ɔkɔe kɔsaw bi hyɛɛ nsu kotoku no ma, na ɔde bi maa abarimaa no nomee.

english_verse: God blessed Ishmael, and as the boy grew older, he became an expert at hunting with his bow and arrows. He lived in the Paran Desert, and his mother chose an Egyptian woman for him to marry. A Peace Treaty
translation_verse: Na ɔtenaa Paran sare so; na ne na kɔwaree yere fi Misraim asase so brɛɛ no. Abimelek ne Abraham apam

english_verse: About this time Abimelech and his army commander Phicol said to Abraham, “God blesses everything you do!
translation_verse: Na bere no mu no, Abimelek ne ne safohene: Pikol bɛka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Onyankopɔn di w'akyi wɔ biribiara a woyɛ mu.

english_verse: Now I want you to promise in the name of God that you will always be loyal to me and my descendants, just as I have always been loyal to you in this land where you have lived as a foreigner.”
translation_verse: Enti afei ka Onyankopɔn ntam kyerɛ me sɛ, worentwa me ne me mma ne me mmanana nkontompo, na, sɛ adɔe a meyɛɛ wo no te no, wode bɛyɛ me ne m'asase a woabɛyɛ ɔhɔho wɔ so yi.

english_verse: And so, Abraham promised he would.
translation_verse: Na Abraham kae sɛ: Mɛka ntam no.

english_verse: One day, Abraham told Abimelech, “Some of your servants have taken over one of my wells.”
translation_verse: Na asubura bi a Abimelek nkoa nam anuɔden so gyei no nti Abraham kaa Abimelek anim.

english_verse: “This is the first I've heard about it,” Abimelech replied. “Why haven't you said something before? I don't have any idea who did it.”
translation_verse: Na Abimelek kae sɛ: Minnim nea odii saa asɛm yi, na wo nso, woanka ankyerɛ me, nanso mentee da, sɛ nnɛ.

english_verse: Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle, then the two men made a peace treaty.
translation_verse: Na Abraham de nguan ne anantwi maa Abimelek, na wɔn baanu pamee.

english_verse: Abraham separated seven female lambs from his flock of sheep,
translation_verse: Na Abraham yii nguanten mma abere ason gyinaa ɔfa.

english_verse: Abraham replied, “I want you to accept these seven lambs as proof that I dug this well.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Nguanten mma abere ason yi, gye wɔ me nsa mu, na ɛnyɛ me adanse, sɛ me na mituu abura yi.

english_verse: So they called the place Beersheba, because they made a treaty there.
translation_verse: Enti ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Beer-seba a ase ne: Ntanka abura, efisɛ ɛhɔ na wɔn baanu nyinaa kekaa ntam.

english_verse: When the treaty was completed, Abimelech and his army commander Phicol went back to the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Na wɔpamee wɔ Beer-seba, na Abimelek ne ne safohene titiriw Pikol sɔree, na wɔsan kɔɔ Filistifo asase so.

english_verse: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and worshiped the eternal Lord God.
translation_verse: Na Abraham tɛw asantɛw dua wɔ Beer-seba, na ɔsɔree AWURADE a ɔyɛ daa Nyankopɔn din wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Then Abraham lived a long time as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Na Abraham yɛɛ ɔhɔho Filistifo asase so nna pii.

english_verse: Some years later God decided to test Abraham, so he spoke to him. Abraham answered, “Here I am, Lord.”
translation_verse: Na nsɛm yi akyi no, Onyankopɔn sɔɔ Abraham hwɛe, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham! Na ose: Mini.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Go get Isaac, your only son, the one you dearly love! Take him to the land of Moriah, and I will show you a mountain where you must sacrifice him to me on the fires of an altar.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Fa wo ba, wo ba koro a wodɔ no, Isak, kɔ Moria asase so, na fa no kɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔre wɔ hɔ, wɔ mmepɔw no mu biako a mɛkyerɛ wo so.

english_verse: So Abraham got up early the next morning and chopped wood for the fire. He put a saddle on his donkey and set out with Isaac and two servants for the place where God had told him to go.
translation_verse: Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n'afurum, na ɔfaa ne mmofra mu baanu ne ne ba Isak kaa ne ho, na otwaa ɔhyew afɔre nnyina, na osiim kɔɔ nea Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no.

english_verse: Three days later Abraham looked off in the distance and saw the place.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛto so abiɛsa no, Abraham maa n'ani so, na ohuu beae hɔ wɔ akyirikyiri.

english_verse: He told his servants, “Stay here with the donkey, while my son and I go over there to worship. We will come back.”
translation_verse: Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne mmofra no sɛ: Mo ne afurum yi ntena ha, na me ne abarimaa yi bɛkɔ noho akɔsɔre, na yɛasan aba mo nkyɛn.

english_verse: Abraham put the wood on Isaac's shoulder, but he carried the hot coals and the knife. As the two of them walked along,
translation_verse: Na Abraham faa ɔhyew afɔre nnyina no de soaa ne ba Isak, na ɔfaa ogya ne sekan kurae, na wɔn baanu kɔe.

english_verse: when they reached the place that God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and placed the wood on it. Next, he tied up his son and put him on the wood.
translation_verse: Na wokoduu nea Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no hɔ, na Abraham sii afɔremuka wɔ hɔ, na osiesiee nnyina no, na ɔkyekyeree ne ba Isak, na ɔde no too afɔremuka no so wɔ nnyina no so.

english_verse: He then took the knife and got ready to kill his son.
translation_verse: Na Abraham teɛɛ ne nsa faa ɔsekan no sɛ ɔde rebekum ne ba no.

english_verse: But the Lord's angel shouted from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am!” he answered.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfo fi soro frɛɛ Abraham bio sɛ: Abraham, Abraham! Na ose: Mini.

english_verse: “Don't hurt the boy or harm him in any way!” the angel said. “Now I know that you truly obey God, because you were willing to offer him your only son.”
translation_verse: Na ose: Mfa wo nsa nka abarimaa no, nso nyɛ no hwee, na afei mahu sɛ wusuro Onyankopɔn, na woankame me wo ba koro no.

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in the bushes. So he took the ram and sacrificed it instead of his son.
translation_verse: Na Abraham maa n'ani so, na ohui, na hwɛ, odwennini a ɔdɔtɔ aso ne mmɛn mu wɔ n'akyi; na Abraham kɔfaa odwennini no de no sii ne ba no ananmu bɔɔ ɔhyew afɔre.

english_verse: Abraham named that place “The Lord Will Provide.” And even now people say, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”
translation_verse: Na Abraham too beae hɔ din sɛ Yahwe-Yire. Enti wɔka nnɛ ara sɛ AWURADE bepɔw so na wɔbehwɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's angel called out from heaven a second time:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔfo fi soro frɛɛ: Abraham bio sɛ,

english_verse: You were willing to offer your only son to the Lord, and so he makes you this solemn promise,
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Esiane sɛ woadi saa asɛm yi, na woankame me wo ba koro no nti, maka me ho ntam sɛ:

english_verse: “I will bless you and give you such a large family, that someday your descendants will be more numerous than the stars in the sky or the grains of sand along the seashore. They will defeat their enemies and take over the cities where their enemies live.
translation_verse: Nhyira na mehyira wo, na ɔdɔ na mɛma w'asefo adɔ sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma ne mpoano nwea, na w'asefo bɛfa wɔn atamfo nkurow ano apon adi so;

english_verse: You have obeyed me, and so you and your descendants will be a blessing to all nations on earth.”
translation_verse: na w'asefo mu na wobehyira asase so amanaman nyinaa, efisɛ woatie me nne.

english_verse: Abraham and Isaac went back to the servants who had come with him, and they returned to Abraham's home in Beersheba. The Children of Nahor
translation_verse: Ɛnna Abraham san baa ne mmerante no nkyɛn, na wɔsɔre siim baa Beer-seba. Na Abraham tenaa Beer-seba.

english_verse: Nahor also had another wife. Her name was Reumah, and she had four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
translation_verse: Na ne yere biako bi a wɔfrɛ no Rehuma nso woo Teba ne Gaham ne Tahas ne Maaka.

english_verse: he went to the Hittites and said,
translation_verse: Na Abraham sɔre fii n'amu no anim, na ɔne Het mma kɔkasae sɛ:

english_verse: “I live as a foreigner in your land, and I don't own any property where I can bury my wife. Please let me buy a piece of land.”
translation_verse: Meyɛ mo nkyɛn hɔho ne mamfrani. Momma me amusie wɔ mo nkyɛn ha, na minsie m'amu a ɔda m'anim yi na emfi m'ani so.

english_verse: “Sir,” they answered, “you are an important man. Choose the best place to bury your wife. None of us would refuse you a resting place for your dead.”
translation_verse: Owura, tie yɛn! Woyɛ okunini bi wɔ yɛn mu. Yɛn amusie no mu nea wopɛ biara no, sie w'amu no wɔ hɔ. Yɛn mu biara renkame wo ne da, sɛ nsie w'amu wɔ mu.

english_verse: and replied, “If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Zohar's son Ephron
translation_verse: na ɔne wɔn kasae sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ mo pɛ sɛ misie m'amu yi ma no fi m'ani so a, muntie me, na monsrɛ Sohar ba Efron, mma me,

english_verse: to sell me Machpelah Cave at the end of his field. I'll pay what it's worth, and all of you can be witnesses.”
translation_verse: na ɔmfa Makpela ɔbodan a ɛyɛ ne de, na ɛwɔ n'afuw ano no mma me; na onnye me n'aboten na ɔmfa mma me, na minnya asiei wɔ mo ha.

english_verse: Ephron was sitting there near the city gate, when Abraham made this request, and he answered,
translation_verse: Na Efron te Het mma no mu. Na Hetini Efron buaa Abraham maa Het mma tee wɔ wɔn a wɔhyɛn ne kurow pon mu no nyinaa anim sɛ:

english_verse: “Sir, the whole field, including the cave, is yours. With my own people as witnesses, I freely give it to you as a burial place for your dead.”
translation_verse: Dabi, me wura, tie me: Mede afuw no mema wo, na ɔbodan a ɛwɔ mu no nso mede mema wo. Me man mma anim na mede mema wo yi, sie w'amu.

english_verse: and said to Ephron, “In front of these witnesses, I offer you the full price, so I can bury my wife. Please accept my offer.”
translation_verse: na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ Efron maa asase no so nkurɔfo no tee sɛ: Sɛ wutie me a, mede afuw no ti dwetɛ mɛma wo; gye wɔ me nsam, na minsie m'amu wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: “But sir,” the man replied, “the property is worth only
translation_verse: Me wura, tie, nnwetɛbona ahanan asase yɛ dɛn wɔ me ne wo ntam? W'amu ara na sie.

english_verse: So Abraham buried his wife Sarah in Machpelah Cave that was in the field
translation_verse: Na ɛno akyi no, Abraham siee ne yere Sara wɔ Makpela afuw no mu, wɔ ɔbodan mu, wɔ Mamre ntentenso, ɛne Hebron a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase so.

english_verse: Abraham was now a very old man. The Lord had made him rich, and he was successful in everything he did.
translation_verse: Na Abraham abɔ akwakoraa, na wadi nna pii, na AWURADE ahyira no ade nyinaa mu.

english_verse: One day, Abraham called in his most trusted servant and said to him, “Solemnly promise me
translation_verse: Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne somfo ne fie panyin a ɔhwɛ nea ɔwɔ nyinaa so sɛ: Fa wo nsa ka m'asen mu,

english_verse: in the name of the Lord, who rules heaven and earth, that you won't choose a wife for my son Isaac from the people here in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: na mɛma woaka AWURADE, ɔsoro ne asase Nyankopɔn, ntam sɛ: Worenware Kanaanfo a mete wɔn mu yi mmabea mu bi mma me ba.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for him from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Na kɔ me kurow ne m'abusua mu kɔware yere ma me ba Isak.

english_verse: But the servant asked, “What if the young woman I choose refuses to leave home and come here with me? Should I send Isaac there to look for a wife?”
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfo no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ebia ɔbea no rempɛ sɛ obedi m'akyi aba asase yi so: ɛnne memfa wo ba no mensan menkɔ asase a wufi so bae no so anaa?

english_verse: “No!” Abraham answered. “Don't ever do that, no matter what.
translation_verse: Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ yiye, na woamfa me ba ansan ankɔ hɔ bio.

english_verse: The Lord who rules heaven brought me here from the land where I was born and promised that he would give this land to my descendants forever. When you go back there, the Lord will send his angel ahead of you to help you find a wife for my son.
translation_verse: AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn a ɔfaa me fii m'agya fi ne asase a wɔwoo me wɔ so no so, na ɔne me kasae, na ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ me sɛ: W'asefo na mede asase yi mɛma wɔn no, ɔbɛsoma ne bɔfo adi w'anim, na woakɔware yere afi hɔ abrɛ me ba.

english_verse: If the woman refuses to come along, you don't have to keep this promise. But don't ever take my son back there.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbea no mpɛ sɛ odi w'akyi a, ɛnne wo ho afi me ntam yi mu, nanso mfa me ba nsan nkɔ hɔ bio.

english_verse: So the servant gave Abraham his word that he would do everything he had been told to do.
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfo no de ne nsa kaa ne wura Abraham asen mu, na ɔkaa no ntam wɔ asɛm no ho.

english_verse: Soon after that, the servant loaded ten of Abraham's camels with valuable gifts. Then he set out for the city in northern Syria, where Abraham's brother Nahor lived.
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfo no faa ne wura yoma mu du, na ɔkɔe, na okura ne wura nnepa ahorow nyinaa bi, na ɔsɔre siim kɔɔ Mesopotamia, Nahor kurow mu.

english_verse: When he got there, he let the camels rest near the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when the women came out for water.
translation_verse: Na ɔmaa ne yoma no butuw kurow no kurotia wɔ asubura bi ho anwummere a mmea bɛsaw nsu.

english_verse: The servant prayed: You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships. Please keep your promise to him and let me find a wife for Isaac today.
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔɔ mpae sɛ: AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo, ma ensi me yiye nnɛ, na yɛ me wura Abraham adɔe.

english_verse: The young women of the city will soon come to this well for water,
translation_verse: Hwɛ, migyina asubura yi so ha yi, na kurom hɔfo mmabea rebefi abɛsaw nsu yi,

english_verse: and I'll ask one of them for a drink. If she gives me a drink and then offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen and that you have kept your promise to my master.
translation_verse: ma ɛmmra sɛ ababaa a mese no sɛ: Soɛ wo kuruwa ma mennom nsu no bi, na ɔbɛka sɛ: Nom, na mɛma wo yoma no anom bi no, ma ɔno ara nyɛ nea woayi no ama w'akoa Isak, na ɛno mu na mehu sɛ woayɛ me wura adɔe.

english_verse: Abraham's servant ran to her and said, “Please let me have a drink of water.”
translation_verse: Na ɔsomfo no tuu mmirika kohyiaa no sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma memmɔ wo kuruwa yi mu nsu kakra hwirow.

english_verse: “I'll be glad to,” she answered. Then she quickly took the jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.
translation_verse: Na ose: Me wura, nom bi! Na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm soɛɛ ne kuruwa no sii ne nsam ma ɔnomee.

english_verse: After he had finished, she said, “Now I'll give your camels all the water they want.” She quickly poured out water for them, and she kept going back for more, until his camels had drunk all they wanted.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm kohwiee ne kuruwa mu nsu no guu anomee hɔ, na otutuu mmirika kɔɔ abura no mu bio kɔsaw nsu, na ɔsaw maa ne yoma no nyinaa.

english_verse: Abraham's servant did not say a word, but he watched everything Rebekah did, because he wanted to know for certain if this was the woman the Lord had chosen.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima no hwɛɛ no ara, na ɔyɛɛ komm sɛ obehu sɛ AWURADE ama ne kwankɔ no ayɛ dwoodwoo anaasɛ ɛnte sa.

english_verse: The servant had brought along an expensive gold ring and two large gold bracelets. When Rebekah had finished bringing the water, he gave her the ring for her nose and the bracelets for her arms.
translation_verse: Na yoma no wiee nsu no nom no, ɔbarima no yii sika hwene mu kaa a ano si dwetɛbona fa ne nsa so nkapo abien a ano si sikabona du de hyɛɛ no,

english_verse: Then he said, “Please tell me who your father is. Does he have room in his house for me and my men to spend the night?”
translation_verse: na ɔkae sɛ: Hena ba ne wo? Mesrɛ wo, kyerɛ me! So yebenya dabere wɔ w'agya fi anaa?

english_verse: She answered, “My father is Bethuel, the son of Nahor and Milcah.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Betuel, Milka ba a ɔwoo no maa Nahor no ba ne me.

english_verse: We have a place where you and your men can stay, and we also have enough straw and feed for your camels.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛwɔ sare ne mmoa aduan pii ne nea mobɛda.

english_verse: Then the servant bowed his head and prayed,
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima no bɔɔ ne mu ase sɔree AWURADE,

english_verse: “I thank you, Lord God of my master Abraham! You have led me to his relatives and kept your promise to him.”
translation_verse: na ɔkae sɛ: Nhyira nka AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn a wamma n'adɔe ne ne nokware ammɔ me wura. Na me nso, AWURADE akyerɛ me me wura ne nuanom fi kwan.

english_verse: Rebekah ran straight home and told her family everything.
translation_verse: Na ababaa no tuu mmirika kɔkaa saa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ ne na fifo.

english_verse: Her brother Laban heard her tell what the servant had said, and he saw the ring and the bracelets she was wearing. So Laban ran out to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.
translation_verse: Na ohuu hwene mu kaa ne ne nua nsa so nkapo no, na ɔtee ne nua Rebeka nsɛm no sɛ: Sɛnea ɔbarima no kasa kyerɛɛ me ni, no, ɔbaa ɔbarima no nkyɛn, na hwɛ, ogyina yoma no nkyɛn, asubura no ho.

english_verse: Then Laban said, “The Lord has brought you safely here. Come home with me. There's no need for you to keep on standing outside. I have a room ready for you in our house, and there's also a place for your camels.”
translation_verse: Na ose: Wo a AWURADE ahyira wo, bra, ɛdɛn nti na wugyina kurotia? Na masiesie ɔdan mu ne baabi nso mama yoma no.

english_verse: Abraham's servant went home with Laban, where Laban's servants unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then they brought water into the house, so Abraham's servant and his men could wash their feet.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima no kɔɔ ofie, na oyii yoma no so nneɛma, na ɔmaa yoma no sare ne aduan, na ɔmaa ɔno ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nsu sɛ wɔnhohoro wɔn anan ase.

english_verse: After that, they brought in food. But the servant said, “Before I eat, I must tell you why I have come.” “Go ahead and tell us,” Laban answered.
translation_verse: Na wɔde aduan besii n'anim sɛ onni; na ose: Merennidi gye sɛ mabɔ m'amanneɛ ansa. Na ose: Bɔ na yentie ɛ!

english_verse: The servant explained: I am Abraham's servant.
translation_verse: Na ose: Abraham somfo ne me.

english_verse: The Lord has been good to my master and has made him very rich. He has given him many sheep, goats, cattle, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of silver and gold, and many slaves.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ahyira me wura pii, na wayɛ ɔkɛse, na wama no nguan ne anantwi, ne dwetɛ ne sika, ne nkoa ne mfenaa, ne yoma ne mfurum.

english_verse: Sarah, my master's wife, didn't have any children until she was very old. Then she had a son, and my master has given him everything.
translation_verse: Na me wura yere Sara awo ɔba wɔ ne mmerewabere mu ama me wura, na ɔde nea ɔwɔ nyinaa ama no.
