english_verse: The people started complaining to Moses, “Give us some water!” Moses replied, “Why are you complaining to me and trying to put the Lord to the test?”
translation_verse: Enti ɔman no ne Mose hamee, na wose: Ma yɛn nsu nnom. Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛdɛn nti na mo ne me ham? Ɛdɛn nti na mosɔ AWURADE hwɛ?

english_verse: But the people were thirsty and kept on complaining, “Moses, did you bring us out of Egypt just to let us and our families and our animals die of thirst?”
translation_verse: Nanso osukɔm dee ɔman no wɔ hɔ; na ɔman no nwiinwii hyɛɛ Mose kae sɛ: Ɛdɛn nti na wuyii yɛn fii Misraim sɛ wode osukɔm rebekum yɛn ne yɛn mma ne yɛn mmoa yi?

english_verse: Then Moses prayed to the Lord, “What am I going to do with these people? They are about to stone me to death!”
translation_verse: Na Mose su frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Dɛn na menyɛ memma ɔman yi? Aka kumaa na wɔasiw me abo.

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Take some of the leaders with you and go ahead of the rest of the people. Also take along the walking stick with which you struck the Nile River.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sen di ɔman no anim, na fa Israel mpanyin mu bi ka wo ho, na fa wo poma a wode bɔɔ asu no kura wo nsam kɔ.

english_verse: When you get to the rock at Mount Sinai, I will be there with you. Strike the rock with the stick, and water will pour out for the people to drink.” Moses did this while the leaders watched.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, megyina w'anim wɔ Horeb ɔbotan no so hɔ, na bɔ ɔbotan no, na nsu befi mu aba, na ɔman no anom. Na Mose yɛɛ sa wɔ Israel mpanyin no anim.

english_verse: The people had complained and tested the Lord by asking, “Is the Lord really with us?” So Moses named that place Massah, which means “testing” and Meribah, which means “complaining.” Israel Defeats the Amalekites
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no ham ne ɔsɔ a wɔsɔɔ AWURADE hwɛe sɛ: So AWURADE wɔ yɛn mu anaasɛ onni yɛn mu no nti, ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Masa ne Meriba, ase ne: Sɔhwɛ ne Ɔham. Wodi Amalek so nkonim

english_verse: When the Israelites were at Rephidim, they were attacked by the Amalekites.
translation_verse: Na Amalek bae ne Israel bɛkoe wɔ Refidim.

english_verse: So Moses told Joshua, “Have some men ready to attack the Amalekites tomorrow. I will stand on a hilltop, holding this walking stick that has the power of God.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Yi mmarima ma yɛn, na fi adi kɔ, na wo ne Amalek nkɔko. Ɔkyena me de, megyina koko no atifi, na makura Onyankopɔn poma no wɔ me nsam.

english_verse: Joshua led the attack as Moses had commanded, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur stood on the hilltop.
translation_verse: Na Yosua yɛe sɛnea Mose ka kyerɛɛ no no ne Amalek kɔkoe, na Mose ne Aaron ne Hur foroo koko no kɔɔ atifi.

english_verse: The Israelites out-fought the Amalekites as long as Moses held up his arms, but they started losing whenever he lowered them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Mose ma ne nsa so a, na Israel adi nim, na sɛ ogyaa ne nsam a, na Amalek adi nim.

english_verse: After a while, his arms were so tired that Aaron and Hur got a rock for him to sit on. Then they stood beside him and supported his arms in the same position until sunset.
translation_verse: Na Mose nsa yɛɛ duru, enti wɔfaa ɔbo de too n'ase, na ɔtenaa so, na Aaron ne Hur susoo ne nsa mu, obiako wɔ ha, na obiako nso wɔ ha, na ne nsa no yɛɛ pintinn kosii sɛ owia tɔe.

english_verse: That's how Joshua defeated the Amalekites.
translation_verse: Na Yosua dwɛree Amalek ne ne man nkrante ano.

english_verse: Afterwards, the Lord said to Moses, “Write an account of this victory and read it to Joshua. I want the Amalekites to be forgotten forever.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kyerɛw eyi hyɛ nhoma bi mu fa yɛ nkae, na ka hyɛ Yosua asom sɛ ɔpopa na mɛpopa Amalek nkae mafi soro ase.

english_verse: Moses built an altar and named it “The Lord Gives Me Victory.”
translation_verse: Na Mose sii afɔremuka, na ɔtoo din Yahwe Nisi, ,

english_verse: Then Moses explained, “This is because I depended on the Lord. But in future generations, the Lord will fight the Amalekites again and again.”
translation_verse: na ɔkae sɛ: AWURADE aka ntam, AWURADE ne Amalek bedi ako afi awo ntoatoaso so de akosi awo ntoatoaso so.

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the desert near Mount Sinai, Jethro sent Moses this message: “I am coming to visit you, and I am bringing your wife and two sons.”
translation_verse: Na obi ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, w'ase Yetro, ne wo yere ne ne mma baanu reba wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: When they arrived, Moses went out and bowed down in front of Jethro, then kissed him. After they had greeted each other, they went into the tent,
translation_verse: Na Mose fii adi kohyiaa n'ase, na ɔkotow no few n'ano, na wokyiakyiaa wɔn ho wɔn ho, na wɔbaa ntamadan mu.

english_verse: where Moses told him everything the Lord had done to protect Israel against the Egyptians and their king. He also told him how the Lord had helped them in all of their troubles.
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa nneɛma a Israel nti AWURADE ayɛ Farao ne Misraim nyinaa, ne amane a ɛtoo wɔn ɔkwan no so nyinaa, ne sɛnea AWURADE yii wɔn no kyerɛɛ n'ase.

english_verse: Now I know that the Lord is the greatest God, because he has rescued Israel from their arrogant enemies.”
translation_verse: Afei na mahu sɛ AWURADE yɛ kɛse sen anyame nyinaa, efisɛ oyii ɔman no fii Misraim nsam, bere a wɔredi wɔn so ahantansɛm.

english_verse: Jethro offered sacrifices to God. Then Aaron and Israel's leaders came to eat with Jethro there at the place of worship. Judges Are Appointed (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na Yetro, Mose n'ase, de ɔhyew afɔre ne okum afɔre brɛɛ Onyankopɔn. Na Aaron ne Israel mpanyin nyinaa bae sɛ wɔne Mose n'ase rebedidi wɔ Onyankopɔn anim. Woyiyi atemmufo (Deuteronomium

english_verse: You and the people who come to you will soon be worn out. The job is too much for one person; you can't do it alone.
translation_verse: Ɔbrɛ na wo ne ɔman a wɔka wo ho yi bɛbrɛ, efisɛ ade yi yɛ duru dodo ma wo, na wo nko worentumi nyɛ.

english_verse: The next morning Moses sat down at the place where he decided legal cases for the people, and everyone crowded around him until evening.
translation_verse: Na ade kyee no, Mose tenaa ase sɛ ɔrebu ɔman no atɛn; na ɔman no gyinaa Mose ho fi anɔpa kosii anwummere.

english_verse: Jethro saw how much Moses had to do for the people, and he asked, “Why are you the only judge? Why do you let these people crowd around you from morning till evening?”
translation_verse: Na Mose n'ase no huu nea ɔreyɛ ɔman no nyinaa no, ɔkae sɛ: Dɛn ne nea woreyɛ ɔman no yi? Ɛdɛn nti na wo nko wote hɔ, na ɔman no nyinaa gyinagyina wo ho fi anɔpa abedu anwummere yi?

english_verse: Moses answered, “Because they come here to find out what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ n'ase sɛ: Ɔman no ba me nkyɛn bebisa me hɔ Onyankopɔn ho akwankyerɛ.

english_verse: They bring their complaints to me, and I make decisions on the basis of God's laws.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wonya asɛm bi a, wɔba me nkyɛn, na mibu onipa ne ne yɔnko ntam atɛn, na mekyerɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn ahyɛde ne ne mmara.

english_verse: Jethro replied: That isn't the best way to do it.
translation_verse: Na Mose n'ase no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nea woyɛ yi nye.

english_verse: God will help you if you follow my advice. You should be the one to speak to God for the people,
translation_verse: Afei tie me nne, metu wo fo, na Onyankopɔn nni w'akyi; wo de, gyina Onyankopɔn anim ma ɔman no, na fa nsɛm no brɛ Onyankopɔn,

english_verse: and you should teach them God's laws and show them what they must do to live right.
translation_verse: na kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ahyɛde ne mmara horow no mu, na ma wonhu ɔkwan ko a wɔmfa so ne nea wɔnyɛ.

english_verse: You will need to appoint some competent leaders who respect God and are trustworthy and honest. Then put them over groups of
translation_verse: Na wo nso yiyi ɔman no nyinaa mu mmarima a wɔyɛ den, wosuro Onyankopɔn, wɔyɛ anokwafo na wɔnyɛ sikanibere, na fa wɔn sisi wɔn so, apem apem so mpanyin, ɔha ɔha so mpanyin, aduonum aduonum so mpanyin ne du du so mpanyin.

english_verse: These judges can handle the ordinary cases and bring the more difficult ones to you. Having them to share the load will make your work easier.
translation_verse: Na wonsiesie ɔman no mu nsɛmbere nyinaa mu; na asɛnkɛse biara de, wɔmfa mmrɛ wo, na nsɛm nketewa nyinaa de, wɔn ara wonni na ama ayɛ wo so hare, na wɔne wo aso mu.

english_verse: This is the way God wants it done. You won't be under nearly as much stress, and everyone else will return home feeling satisfied.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ eyi na Onyankopɔn hyɛ wo saa a, ɛno na wubetumi agyina, na ɔman yi nyinaa nso bɛkɔ wɔn tenabea dwoodwoo.

english_verse: He chose some competent leaders from every tribe in Israel and put them over groups of
translation_verse: Na Mose yiyii Israel nyinaa mu nnipa a wɔyɛ den, na ɔde wɔn sisii ɔman no so atitiriw, apem apem so, ɔha ɔha so, aduonum aduonum so ne du du so mpanyin.

english_verse: They served as judges, deciding the easy cases themselves, but bringing the more difficult ones to Moses.
translation_verse: Na wosiesie ɔman no mu nsɛm bere nyinaa mu: nsɛm a ɛyɛ den no, wɔde brɛɛ Mose, na nsɛm nketewa de, wɔn ara dii.

english_verse: After Moses and his father-in-law Jethro had said goodbye to each other, Jethro returned home.
translation_verse: Na Mose kogyaa n'ase kwan, na ɔkɔɔ n'ankasa asase so.

english_verse: The Israelites left Rephidim and arrived at the desert. Then two months after leaving Egypt, they arrived at the desert near Mount Sinai, where they set up camp at the foot of the mountain. This was two months after they had left Egypt.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Refidim no, wɔbaa Sinai sare so bɛbɔɔ nsra sare no so; na Israel bɔɔ nsra bepɔw no anim hɔ.

english_verse: Moses went up the mountain to meet with the Lord God, who told him to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na Mose foro kɔɔ Onyankopɔn nkyɛn, na AWURADE fi bepɔw no so frɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛnea ka kyerɛ Yakob fi, na ka kyerɛ Israelfo no ni:

english_verse: You saw what I did in Egypt, and you know how I brought you here to me, just as a mighty eagle carries its young.
translation_verse: Mo ara moahu nea meyɛɛ Misraim no ne sɛnea mesoaa mo akɔre ntaban so, na mede mo maba me nkyɛn yi.

english_verse: Now if you will faithfully obey me, you will be my very own people. The whole world is mine,
translation_verse: Na afei sɛ mubetie me nne na moadi m'apam so a, ɛnne mobɛyɛ m'agyapade a ɛsom bo aman nyinaa mu, na me na asase nyinaa wɔ me.

english_verse: but you will be my holy nation and serve me as priests. Moses, that is what you must tell the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na mo de, mobɛyɛ me asɔfo ahemman ne ɔman kronkron. Eyinom ne nsɛm a ka kyerɛ Israelfo.

english_verse: After Moses went back, he reported to the leaders what the Lord had said,
translation_verse: Na Mose bae bɛfrɛɛ ɔman no mpanyimfo, na ɔde nsɛm a AWURADE de hyɛɛ no yi nyinaa too wɔn anim.

english_verse: and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded.” So Moses told the Lord about this.
translation_verse: Na ɔman mu no nyinaa buae prɛko sɛ: Nea AWURADE aka nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ. Na Mose san kɔkaa ɔman no nsɛm no kyerɛɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I will come to you in a thick cloud and let the people hear me speak to you. Then they will always trust you.” Again Moses reported to the Lord what the people had said.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, me de, mereba wo nkyɛn omununkum tumm mu, na sɛ me ne wo kasa a, ɔman no ate, na wo nso wɔagye wo adi akosi daa. Na Mose kaa ɔman no nsɛm no kyerɛɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: Once more the Lord spoke to Moses: Go back and tell the people that today and tomorrow they must get themselves ready to meet me. They must wash their clothes
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kɔ ɔman no nkyɛn na dwira wɔn ho nnɛ ne ɔkyena, na ma wɔnhoro wɔn ntade;

english_verse: and be ready by the day after tomorrow, when I will come down to Mount Sinai, where all of them can see me.
translation_verse: na wonsiesie wɔn ho nsie da a ɛto so abiɛsa; na ɛda a ɛto so abiɛsa no, AWURADE besian ɔman no nyinaa anim aba bepɔw Sinai so.

english_verse: Warn the people that they are forbidden to touch any part of the mountain. Anyone who does will be put to death,
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔman no ho hyeban, na ka sɛ: Monhwɛ yiye na moamforo bepɔw no anaasɛ moanka ne hye. Obiara a ɔbɛka bepɔw no, owu na obewu;

english_verse: either with stones or arrows, and no one must touch the body of the person being put to death in this way. Even an animal that touches this mountain must be put to death. You may go up the mountain only after a signal is given on the trumpet.
translation_verse: nsa biara nnka no, abo na wonsiw no anaasɛ mmɛmma na wɔntotow no; sɛ aboa oo, onipa oo, ɔrennya nkwa. Sɛ wɔhyɛn torobɛnto no twe mu a, wɔmforo bepɔw no.

english_verse: After Moses went down the mountain, he gave orders for the people to wash their clothes and make themselves acceptable to worship God.
translation_verse: Na Mose sian fii bepɔw no so baa ɔman no nkyɛn, na odwiraa ɔman no ho, na wɔhoroo wɔn ntade.

english_verse: He told them to be ready in three days and not to have sex in the meantime. The Lord Comes to Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Munsiesie mo ho nsie da a ɛto so abiɛsa no. Monnkɔ mo yerenom ho.

english_verse: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud covered the mountain, a loud trumpet blast was heard, and everyone in camp trembled with fear.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛto so abiɛsa no anɔpa no, aprannaa ne anyinam ne omununkum duruduru ne torobɛnto nne a ɛyɛ den yiye baa bepɔw no so. Na ɔman a wɔwɔ nsra no mu nyinaa ho popoe.

english_verse: Moses led them out of the camp to meet God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Na Mose de ɔman no fii adi fii nsra no mu kohyiaa Onyankopɔn, na wokogyinagyinaa bepɔw no ase.

english_verse: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke because the Lord had come down in a flaming fire. Smoke poured out of the mountain just like a furnace, and the whole mountain shook.
translation_verse: Na wusiw kataa Sinai bepɔw no so nyinaa, efisɛ na AWURADE nam ogya mu asian aba so, na ne wusiw no tu kɔɔ ɔsoro sɛ ɔfononoo mu wusiw, na bepɔw no nyinaa wosowee biribiri.

english_verse: The trumpet blew louder and louder. Moses spoke, and God answered him with thunder.
translation_verse: Na torobɛnto no nne kɔɔ so na ano yɛɛ den ara no, Mose kasae, na Onyankopɔn de nne kɛse gyee so.

english_verse: The Lord came down to the top of Mount Sinai and told Moses to meet him there.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sian baa Sinai bepɔw so wɔ bepɔw no atifi; na AWURADE frɛɛ Mose kɔɔ bepɔw no atifi, na Mose foro kɔe.

english_verse: Then he said, “Moses, go and warn the people not to cross the boundary that you set at the foot of the mountain. They must not cross it to come and look at me, because if they do, many of them will die.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sian kɔbɔ ɔman no kɔkɔ, na wɔanhwirew mu amma AWURADE nkyɛn ammɛhwɛ, na wɔn mu pii antotɔ.

english_verse: Only the priests may come near me, and they must obey strict rules before I let them. If they don't, they will be punished.”
translation_verse: Na asɔfo nso a wɔbɛn AWURADE no nnwira wɔn ho, na AWURADE antow anhyɛ wɔn so.

english_verse: Moses replied, “The people cannot come up the mountain. You warned us to stay away because it is holy.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Ɔman no rentumi mforo mma Sinai bepɔw so, efisɛ wo ara woabɔ yɛn kɔkɔ aka sɛ: Bɔ bepɔw no ho hyeban na yɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Then the Lord told Moses, “Go down and bring Aaron back here with you. But the priests and people must not try to push their way through, or I will rush at them like a flood!”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sian kɔ, na wo ne Aaron mforo mmra; na mma asɔfo no ne ɔman no nnhwirew mu mmforo mmma AWURADE nkyɛn, na wantow anhyɛ wɔn so.

english_verse: After Moses had gone back down, he told the people what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Na Mose sian baa ɔman no nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: God said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn kaa nsɛm yi nyinaa sɛ:

english_verse: But when Moses went near the thick cloud where God was, the people stayed a long way off. Idols and Altars
translation_verse: Na ɔman no gyinaa akyirikyiri, na Mose twiw bɛn sum kabii a Onyankopɔn wɔ mu no.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a miyii wo Misraim asase so nkoafi mu no.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Nnya anyame foforo nka me ho.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ohoni bi anaa ade a ɛwɔ wim wɔ ɔsoro anaa nea ɛwɔ asase so wɔ fam anaa nea ɛwɔ nsu mu wɔ asase ase nsɛso biara mfa; nkotow wɔn, na nsom wɔn.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: na meyɛ mpem a wɔdɔ me na wodi me mmara nsɛm so adɔe.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Mmɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn din kwa, na Awurade remma nea ɔbɔ ne din kwa no ho nyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Remember that the Sabbath Day belongs to me.
translation_verse: Kae homeda, na yɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Nnansia na yɛ adwuma, na yɛ w'ade nyinaa;

english_verse: but the seventh day of each week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your slaves, your animals, or the foreigners who live in your towns.
translation_verse: na ɛda a ɛto so ason no yɛ homeda ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn: nyɛ adwuma biara, wo ne wo babanin ne wo babea, w'akoa ne w'afenaa ne wo mmoa ne wo hɔho a ɔwɔ wo fi apon mu.

english_verse: In six days I made the sky, the earth, the oceans, and everything in them, but on the seventh day I rested. That's why I made the Sabbath a special day that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na nnansia na AWURADE de yɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase, ɛpo ne nea ɛwowɔ mu nyinaa, na ɔhomee da a ɛto so ason no; enti na AWURADE hyiraa homeda, na ɔyɛɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, and you will live a long time in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Di w'agya ne wo na ni, na wo nna aware asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so.

english_verse: Be faithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Nsɛe aware.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: Mmɔ korɔn.

english_verse: Do not tell lies about others.
translation_verse: Nni wo yɔnko ho adansekurum.

english_verse: Do not desire to possess anything that belongs to another person—not a house, a wife, a husband, a slave, an ox, a donkey, or anything else. The People Are Afraid (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Mma w'ani mmmere wo yɔnko fi. Mma w'ani mmmere wo yɔnko yere anaa n'akoa anaa n'afenaa anaa ne nantwi anaa n'afurum anaa biribiara a ɛyɛ wo yɔnko dea. Ɔman no suro (Deuteronomium

english_verse: So you must never make idols of silver or gold to worship in place of me.
translation_verse: Monnyɛ me so dwetɛ anyame ne sika anyame; monnyɛ bi mmfa.

english_verse: The people trembled with fear when they heard the thunder and the trumpet and saw the lightning and the smoke coming from the mountain. They stood a long way off
translation_verse: Na ɔman no nyinaa huu aprannaa ne anyinam a ɛpaepae ne torobɛnto nne ne bepɔw a efi wusiw no. Na ɔman no hui no, wɔn ho popoe, na wokogyinaa akyirikyiri.

english_verse: and said to Moses, “If you speak to us, we will listen. But don't let God speak to us, or we will die!”
translation_verse: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wo na wo ne yɛn nkasa, na yebetie; na mma Onyankopɔn ne yɛn nnkasa, na yɛanwuwu.

english_verse: “Don't be afraid!” Moses replied. “God has come only to test you, so that by obeying him you won't sin.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Munnsuro, na Onyankopɔn rebɛsɔ mo ahwɛ, na ne ho hu atena mo ani so, na moanyɛ bɔne.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people of Israel: With your own eyes you saw me speak to you from heaven.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sɛ ka kyerɛ Israelfo no ni: Mo ara moahu sɛ mifi soro na me ne mo akasa.

english_verse: Build an altar out of earth, and offer on it your sacrifices of sheep, goats, and cattle. Wherever I choose to be worshiped, I will come down to bless you.
translation_verse: Dɔte afɔremuka na yɛ ma me, na wode hyew afɔre ne w'asomdwoe afɔre, wo nguan ne w'anantwi no abɔ so afɔre; baabiara a mɛma wɔakae me din no mɛba wo nkyɛn mabehyira wo.

english_verse: If you ever build an altar for me out of stones, do not use any tools to chisel the stones, because that would make the altar unfit for use in worship.
translation_verse: Na sɛ worebɛyɛ abo afɔremuka ama me a, mfa abo a wɔatwa nsi; na sɛ woma w'adwinnade so bɔ so a, woagu ho fi.

english_verse: And don't build an altar that requires steps; you might expose yourself when you climb up.
translation_verse: Na mforo atrapoe nkɔ m'afɔremuka so, na w'adagyaw anna adi wɔ so.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for attacking your father or mother.
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɔ n'agya anaa ne na no, okum na wonkum no.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for murder.
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɔ onipa ma owu no, okum na wonkum no.

english_verse: Suppose two of you are arguing, and you hit the other with either a rock or your fist, without causing a fatal injury. If the victim has to stay in bed,
translation_verse: Sɛ mmarima reko, na obi bɔ ne yɔnko bo anaa kuturuku, na wanwu, na ɛka no to mpa so a,

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses the following laws for his people:
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne atemmusɛm a fa to wɔn anim:

english_verse: If you buy a Hebrew slave, he must remain your slave for six years. But in the seventh year you must set him free, without cost to him.
translation_verse: Sɛ wotɔ akoa a ɔyɛ Hebrini a, ɔnsom mfe asia, na afe a ɛto so ason no, ɔmfa ne ho nkodi kwa.

english_verse: If he was single at the time you bought him, he alone must be set free. But if he was married at the time, both he and his wife must be given their freedom.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔno nko na ɔbae a, ɔno nko na ɔnkɔ; sɛ ɔyɛ ɔwarefo a, ne yere no ne no nkɔ.

english_verse: If you give him a wife, and they have children, only the man himself must be set free; his wife and children remain the property of his owner.
translation_verse: Sɛ ne wura ama no ɔyere, na wawo mmabanin anaa mmabea ama no a, ɔbea no ne ne mma no nyɛ ne wura de, na ɔno nko nkɔ.

english_verse: But suppose the slave loves his wife and children and his owner so much that he won't leave them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ akoa no ka sɛ: Medɔ me wura ne me yere ne me mma, mempɛ sɛ mefa me ho mikodi a,

english_verse: Then he must stand beside either the door or the doorpost at the place of worship, while his owner punches a small hole through one of his ears with a sharp metal rod. This makes him a slave for life.
translation_verse: ɛnne ne wura no mfa no mmra Onyankopɔn anim, na ɔmfa no mmra ɔpon ho anaa apongua ho, na ne wura no mfa fitii mfiti n'asom, na ɔnsom no daa.

english_verse: A young woman who was sold by her father doesn't gain her freedom in the same way that a man does.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima bi tɔn ne babea kɔyɛ afenaa a, ɛnne ɔmmfa ne ho nnkodi sɛ nkoa no.

english_verse: If she doesn't please the man who bought her to be his wife, he must let her be bought back. He cannot sell her to foreigners; this would break the contract he made with her.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnsɔ ne wura a ogyee no aware no ani a, ɔmma wommegye no, na onni ho kwan sɛ ɔbɛtɔn no ama ɔnanani bi, efisɛ wadaadaa no.

english_verse: If he selects her as a wife for his son, he must treat her as his own daughter.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ogye no aware ma ne ba a, ɔnyɛ no sɛ ɔba.

english_verse: If the man later marries another woman, he must continue to provide food and clothing for the one he bought and to treat her as a wife.
translation_verse: Sɛ ogye ɔfoforo ma no a, ɔmmma n'anoduan, ne nkataho ne n'aware so nnhuan.

english_verse: If he fails to do any of these things, she must be given her freedom without paying for it. Murder and Other Violent Crimes The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na sɛ wanyɛ ade abiɛsa yi amma no a, ɛnne omfi nkɔ kwa; sika bi nni mu. Okum a ɛnam nsapa so

english_verse: But if you did not intend to kill someone, and I, the Lord, let it happen anyway, you may run for safety to a place that I have set aside.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wantɛw no na Onyankopɔn na ama ne nsa apa a, ɛnne meyi baabi mama wo, na waguan akɔ hɔ.

english_verse: If you plan in advance to murder someone, there's no escape, not even by holding on to my altar. You will be dragged off and killed.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi hyɛ da kɔtoa ne yɔnko kum no anifere mu a, yi no m'afɔremuka ho na onwu.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for kidnapping. If you sell the person you kidnapped, or if you are caught with that person, the penalty is death.
translation_verse: Nea owia onipa tɔn no anaasɛ wohu no ne nsam no, okum na wonkum no.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for cursing your father or mother.
translation_verse: Nea ɔdome n'agya anaa ne na no, okum na wonkum no.

english_verse: and later has to use a stick when walking outside, you must pay for the loss of time and do what you can to help until the injury is completely healed. That's your only responsibility.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔsɔre bio so ne poma mu nantew fi adi a, ɛnne nea ɔbɔɔ no no ho nyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ, ne mmere a wasɛe no nko ho ka na ontua, na ɔsa na ɔmma wɔnsa no yare.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for beating to death any of your slaves.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi bɔ n'akoa anaa n'afenaa abaa na ɔtɔ ne nsa ano a, ɔwere na wonni no.

english_verse: However, if the slave lives a few days after the beating, you are not to be punished. After all, you have already lost the services of that slave who was your property.
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ ɔtena hɔ da koro anaa nnanu a, wonnni no were, efisɛ ɔyɛ ne sika.

english_verse: Suppose a pregnant woman suffers a miscarriage as the result of an injury caused by someone who is fighting. If she isn't badly hurt, the one who injured her must pay whatever fine her husband demands and the judges approve.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mmarima reko na wɔkɔpem onyinsɛnfo, na ɔba no fi, na bɔne bi amma akyiri a, ogye na wonnye no nea ɔbea no kunu de bɛto no so no, na ɔmma sɛnea atemmufo no bɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: But if she is seriously injured, the payment will be life for life,
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɔne bi ba akyiri a, ɛnne ma ɔkra nsi ɔkra ananmu,

english_verse: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
translation_verse: aniwa nsi aniwa ananmu, ɛse nsi ɛse ananmu, nsa nsi nsa ananmu, ɛnan nsi ɛnan ananmu,

english_verse: burn for burn, cut for cut, and bruise for bruise.
translation_verse: ɔhyew nsi ɔhyew ananmu, apirakuru nsi apirakuru ananmu, atape nsi atape ananmu.

english_verse: If you hit one of your slaves and cause the loss of an eye, the slave must be set free.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi bɔ n'akoa aniwa anaa n'afenaa aniwa na ɛsɛe a, n'aniwa no nti ɔmfa ne ho nkodi.

english_verse: The same law applies if you knock out a slave's tooth—the slave goes free.
translation_verse: Na sɛ otu n'akoa se anaa n'afenaa se a, ne se no nti ɔmma ɔmfa ne ho nkodi. Awuranom asodi

english_verse: A bull that kills someone with its horns must be killed and its meat destroyed, but the owner of the bull isn't responsible for the death.
translation_verse: Sɛ nantwi pem ɔbarima anaa ɔbea ma owu a, ɛnne wonsiw nantwi no abo, na wonnni ne nam, na nantwi no wura no ho nyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you own a bull that has been in the habit of attacking people, but you have refused to keep it fenced in. If that bull kills someone, both you and the bull must be put to death by stoning.
translation_verse: Na sɛ nantwi no yɛ asisi dedaw, na wɔama ne wura no ate, na wanhwɛ no so, na wakokum ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a, wonsiw nantwi no abo, na ne wura no nso, wonkum no.

english_verse: pieces of silver for the loss of the slave, and the bull must be killed by stoning.
translation_verse: Sɛ wobegye no mpata a, ɔmma ade biara a wobegye no mfa nnye ne kra.

english_verse: This same law applies if the bull gores someone's son or daughter.
translation_verse: Ɔbabanin na osii no oo, ɔbabea na osii no oo, atɛn yi ara na wɔmfa mmu no.

english_verse: If the bull kills a slave, you must pay the slave owner
translation_verse: Sɛ nantwi no si akoa anaa afenaa a, ɔmma ne wura dwetɛ, nnwetɛbona aduasa, na wonsiw nantwi no abo.

english_verse: Suppose someone's ox or donkey is killed by falling into an open pit that you dug or left uncovered on your property.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi kobue abura ano anaasɛ obi kotu amoa na wankata so, na nantwi anaa afurum kɔhwe mu a,

english_verse: You must pay for the dead animal, and it becomes yours.
translation_verse: amoa no wura no nhyɛ ananmu, na ɔmma wɔn wura no sika, na funu no nyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: If your bull kills someone else's, yours must be sold. Then the money from your bull and the meat from the dead bull must be divided equally between you and the other owner.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi nantwi si ne yɔnko nantwi na owu a, wɔntɔn nantwi nikanfo no na wɔnkyɛ ne tiade no mu, na funu no nso wɔnkyɛ.

english_verse: If you refuse to fence in a bull that is known to attack others, you must replace any animal it kills, but the dead animal will belong to you.
translation_verse: Anaasɛ, sɛ wonim sɛ nantwi no yɛ asisi dedaw na ne wura no anhwɛ no so a, ɔmfa nantwi nsi nantwi no ananmu, na funu no nyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: If you steal an ox and slaughter or sell it, you must replace it with five oxen; if you steal a sheep and slaughter it or sell it, you must replace it with four sheep.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi kowia nantwi anaa oguan kum anaa ɔtɔn no a, ɔmfa anantwi anum nsi nantwi biako no ananmu, ne nguan anan nsi oguan biako no ananmu.

english_verse: If you allow any of your animals to stray from your property and graze in someone else's field or vineyard, you must repay the damage from the best part of your own harvest of grapes and grain.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi ma wodi afuw anaa bobe turo bi mu ade anaa ogyaa n'aboa ma okodi obi afuw mu ade a, ɔmfa n'ankasa afuw mu nnepa ne ne bobe turo mu nnepa bi na ensi ananmu.

english_verse: If you carelessly let a fire spread from your property to someone else's, you must pay the owner for any crops or fields destroyed by the fire.
translation_verse: Sɛ ogya dɛw na ɛkɔso nsɔe mu, na ɛhyew awi afiafi kuw anaa awi a egyina hɔ anaa afuw a, ɔhyɛ na nea ɔsɔɔ ogya no nhyɛ ananmu.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor asks you to keep some silver or other valuables, and they are stolen from your house. If the thief is caught, the thief must repay double.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi de sika anaa nneɛma ma ne yɔnko asie na wowia wɔ onipa no fi na wohu owifo no a, ommu mmɔ ho nhyɛ ananmu.

english_verse: But if the thief isn't caught, some judges will decide if you are the guilty one.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔanhu owifo no a, wɔmfa ofiwura no mmra Onyankopɔn anim mmɛhwɛ sɛ ɔmfaa ne nsa nkaa ne yɔnko no ade no anaa.

english_verse: Suppose two people claim to own the same ox or donkey or sheep or piece of clothing. Then the judges must decide the case, and the guilty person will pay the owner double.
translation_verse: Mmarato ho asɛm biara, nantwi de oo, afurum de oo, oguan de oo, atade de oo, ade a ayera biara a obi bɛka sɛ “ɛne no” de oo, Onyankopɔn anim ara na wɔmfa wɔn baanu asɛm no mmra. Nea Onyankopɔn bebu no fɔ no, ɔmmɔ ho abien nhyɛ ne yɔnko no ananmu.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor who is going to be away asks you to keep a donkey or an ox or a sheep or some other animal, and it dies or gets injured or is stolen while no one is looking.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi de afurum, sɛ nantwi, sɛ oguan, sɛ aboa bi ma ne yɔnko asie, na owu anaa opira anaasɛ wɔka no to wuram na obi anhu a,

english_verse: If you swear with me as your witness that you did not harm the animal, you do not have to replace it. Your word is enough.
translation_verse: AWURADE ntam mmra wɔn baanu ntam, sɛ ɔmfaa ne nsa nkaa ne yɔnko ade anaa? Na ɔdede no mpene na obiako no nhyɛ ananmu.

english_verse: But if the animal was stolen while in your care, you must replace it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ owia na wowiae wɔ ne nkyɛn a, ɔnhyɛ ɔdede no ananmu.

english_verse: If the animal was attacked and killed by a wild animal, and you can show the remains of the dead animal to its owner, you do not have to replace it.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔtetew na aboa bi tetew no a, ɔmfa mmra mmedi adanse; na ɔnnhyɛ nea wɔatetew no no ananmu.

english_verse: Suppose you borrow an animal from a neighbor, and it gets injured or dies while the neighbor isn't around. Then you must replace it.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi kɔfɛm biribi ne yɔnko nkyɛn na opira anaasɛ owu, na ɔdede no ho nni mu a, ɔhyɛ na ɔnhyɛ ananmu.

english_verse: But if something happens to the animal while the owner is present, you do not have to replace it. If you had leased the animal, the money you paid the owner will cover any harm done to it. Laws for Everyday Life The Lord said:
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔdede no ho wom a, ɔnnhyɛ ananmu; sɛ wɔbɔɔ no paa a, na n'apaadi na ɛma ɛbae. Abrabɔ ne nyamesom ho mmara

english_verse: Suppose a young woman has never had sex and isn't engaged. If a man talks her into having sex, he must pay the bride price and marry her.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi kɔdaadaa ababaa a wonnyee no aware ne no da a, ma ɔmma tiade na ɔnware no.

english_verse: But if her father refuses to let her marry the man, the bride price must still be paid.
translation_verse: Sɛ n'agya mpene sɛ ɔde no ma no a, ɔnkari sika mma, sɛnea wɔma mmaabun tiade no.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for witchcraft.
translation_verse: Mma ɔbayifo nntena ase.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for having sex with an animal.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔne aboa bɛda no, okum na wonkum no.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for offering sacrifices to any god except me.
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɛbɔ afɔre ama onyame biara na ɛnyɛ AWURADE nko no, wɔnsɛe no korakora.

english_verse: Do not mistreat or abuse foreigners who live among you. Remember, you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Na ɔhɔho de, mmɔ no atirimmɔden, nso nhyɛ no so, efisɛ mo nso moakɔyɛ ahɔho Misraim asase so pɛn.

english_verse: Do not mistreat widows or orphans.
translation_verse: Monnhyɛ ɔbeakunafo anaa ayisaa so.

english_verse: If you do, they will beg for my help, and I will come to their rescue.
translation_verse: Sɛ wohyɛ wɔn so, na wosu frɛ me pɛ a, otie na metie wɔn sufrɛ no,

english_verse: In fact, I will get so angry that I will kill your men and make widows of their wives and orphans of their children.
translation_verse: na m'abufuw ano ayɛ den, na mede nkrante makum mo, na mo yerenom adannan akunafo, na mo mma ayeyɛ nyisaa.

english_verse: Don't charge interest when you lend money to any of my people who are in need.
translation_verse: Sɛ wofɛm me man mu ɔbrɛfo bi a ɔne wo wɔ hɔ sika a, nyɛ no sɛ ɔpempensifo; munnnye no mfɛntom.

english_verse: Before sunset you must return any coat taken as security for a loan,
translation_verse: Sɛ wugye wo yɔnko ntama awowa a, san fa ma no ansa na owia akɔtɔ,

english_verse: because that is the only cover the poor have when they sleep at night. I am a merciful God, and when they call out to me, I will come to help them.
translation_verse: efisɛ ɛno nko ne ne nkataho, ne honam ntama. Dɛn na ɔmfa nna? Na sɛ, osu frɛ me a, metie, efisɛ mmɔborohunufo ne me.

english_verse: Don't speak evil of me or of the ruler of your people.
translation_verse: Nka abususɛm ntia Onyankopɔn, na wo man mu panyin nso, nnome no.

english_verse: Don't fail to give me the offerings of grain and wine that belong to me. Dedicate to me your first-born sons
translation_verse: Wo nnɔbae ne wo nnuaba mu nsu mu adekan no, ntwentwɛn sɛ wode bɛma. Wo mmabanin mu mmakan no, fa ma me.

english_verse: and the first-born of your cattle and sheep. Let the animals stay with their mothers for seven days, then on the eighth day give them to me, your God.
translation_verse: Saa ara na yɛ w'anantwi ne wo nguan; nnansɔn na ɔne ne na ntena, da a ɛto so awotwe no, fa no brɛ me.

english_verse: You are my chosen people, so don't eat the meat of any of your livestock that was killed by a wild animal. Instead, feed the meat to dogs.
translation_verse: Na monyɛ nnipa kronkron mma me, na munnni nam bi a wɔatetew mu wɔ wuram; montow nkyene mma akraman.

english_verse: Always tell the truth in court, even if everyone else is dishonest and stands in the way of justice.
translation_verse: Nni nnipa dodow akyi nkɔyɛ bɔne, nanso nkasa asɛm bi mu nkom nkodi nnipa dodow akyi nnan asɛm ani.

english_verse: And don't favor the poor, simply because they are poor.
translation_verse: Na ohiani nso, nhwɛ n'anim wɔ n'asɛm mu.

english_verse: If you find an ox or a donkey that has wandered off, take it back where it belongs, even if the owner is your enemy.
translation_verse: Sɛ wokɔto wo tamfo nantwi anaa n'afurum sɛ wafom kwan a, fa no san brɛ no.

english_verse: If a donkey is overloaded and falls down, you must do what you can to help, even if it belongs to someone who doesn't like you.
translation_verse: Sɛ wuhu nea okyi wo afurum sɛ ɔhyɛ n'adesoa ase a, hwɛ yiye na woannyaw no amma no, ɔsan na wo ne no nsan no.

english_verse: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.
translation_verse: Nnan wo hiani asɛm ani wɔ atemmu mu.

english_verse: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.
translation_verse: Twe wo ho fi atosɛm mu kɔ akyirikyiri. Na nkum nea ɔnyɛɛ bɔne bi ne ɔtreneeni, efisɛ meremmu ɔbɔnefo bem.

english_verse: Don't accept bribes. Judges are blinded and justice is twisted by bribes.
translation_verse: Nso nnye ayɛyɛde, na ayɛyɛde fura aniwa a ehu ade, na ɛkyea treneefo nsɛm.

english_verse: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like. Laws for the Sabbath The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na nhyɛ ɔhɔho so, na mo ara munim ɔhɔho kra, efisɛ mo nso moayɛ ahɔho Misraim asase so pɛn.

english_verse: Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
translation_verse: Mfe asia na dua w'asase so aduan, na boaboa nnɔbae no ano sie;

english_verse: but let the land rest during the seventh year. The poor are to eat what they want from your fields, vineyards, and olive trees during that year, and when they have all they want from your fields, leave the rest for wild animals.
translation_verse: na nea ɛto so ason no so de, ma ɛnhome na ɛnna hɔ kwa, na wo man mu ahiafo nni, na nea wobegyaw no, wuram mmoadoma mmedi. Saa ara na yɛ wo bobe turo ne wo ngodua turo.

english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: Nnansia na fa yɛ w'adwuma, na ɛda a ɛto so ason no, fa home; ma wo nantwi ne w'afurum nhome, na w'afenaa ba ne wo hɔho nya ahomegye.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Nea maka mo nyinaa, munni so. Na anyame foforo din nso, mommmɔ, mommma wɔnnte wɔ mo anom. Afahyɛ akɛse horow abiɛsa no (Eksodɔs

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: Mfa m'afɔre mogya mmɔ afɔre ngu mmɔkaw so, na mma ade nnkye m'afahyɛ mu srade so.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Worenhu nea ɔpɔn anaa obonin wɔ w'asase so; wo nna dodow no mɛma adu.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: ne otwa nnapa no, w'ade a wuduae w'afum no mu aba a edi kan de no; ne anoboa nnapa no, afe awiei a woaboaboa w'adwumade ano afi mfuw mu no.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: Wo mmarima nyinaa mmepue AWURADE Nyakopɔn anim mpɛn abiɛsa afirihyia.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: Mpɛn abiɛsa na hyɛ fa ma me afirihyia mu.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: Di apiti nnapa no. Nnansɔn na di apiti, sɛnea mehyɛɛ wo no, ɔsram Abib a ɛte sɛ Oforisuo mu bere a wɔahyɛ no, efisɛ ɛno mu na wufii Misraim bae; nso obi mmfa nsapan mmmepue m'anim;

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: W'asase so aba a edi kan mu adekan, fa bra AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn fi. Nnoa oguan ba wɔ ne na nufusu mu. Bɔhyɛ ne Nhyehyɛe ahorow

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, meresoma ɔbɔfo adi w'anim akɔhwɛ wo ɔkwan mu, na ɔde wo akodu nea masiesie hɔ no.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Hwɛ wo ho yiye wɔ n'anim, na tie ne nne; nnwen nhyɛ no, na ɔremfa mo mmarato mfiri mo, efisɛ me din wɔ no mu.

english_verse: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wutie ne nne ampa na woyɛ nea meka nyinaa a, ɛnne mɛyɛ w'atamfo tamfo na mahiahia w'ahohiafo ho.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: Na me bɔfo no bedi w'anim de wo akodu Amorifo ne Hetifo ne Perisifo ne Kanaanfo ne Hewifo ne Yebusifo so, na matu wɔn magu.

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: Nsɔre wɔn anyame na nsom wɔn, na nyɛ wɔn nneyɛe nso, na ka wɔn gu korakora, na bubu wɔn adum.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Na monsom AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn na wahyira w'aduan ne wo nsu so, na mayi ɔyare mafi wo mu.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: Mɛma me ho hu adi w'anim, na mama aman a wobɛkɔ wɔn so no nyinaa agyigya, na mama w'atamfo nyinaa adan wɔn akyi akyerɛ wo.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Na mɛsoma nkotokurodu adi w'anim, na wɔapam Hewifo ne Kanaanfo ne Hetifo no wɔ w'anim.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Merempam wɔn w'anim afe koro, na asase no annan amamfo, na wuram mmoadoma ammɛdɔɔso anhyɛ wo;

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: nkakrankakra na mɛpam wɔn w'anim akosi sɛ wobɛdɔɔso na woagye asase no.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Na metwa wo hye mafi mmɛw po ano akosi Filistifo po ano, na afi sare so akosi asu no ano; na meyi asase no sofo mahyɛ mo nsa na woapam wɔn afi w'anim.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Wo ne wɔn ne wɔn anyame mmpam.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Mma wɔnntena w'asase so, na wɔamma woanyɛ me ho bɔne; na sɛ wosom wɔn anyame a, ampa ɛbɛyɛ wo afiri.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Na Mose de, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Foro bra AWURADE nkyɛn, wo ne Aaron, Nadab ne Abihu ne Israel mpanyimfo mu aduɔsɔn, na mommɛsɔre wɔ akyirikyiri.

english_verse: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.”
translation_verse: Na Mose nko ntwiw mmɛn AWURADE, na wɔn de, wonntwiw mmmɛn, na ɔman no ne no mmforo mmma.

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Na Mose bae bɛkaa AWURADE nsɛm no nyinaa ne atemmusɛm no nyinaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no. Na ɔman mu no nyinaa de nne koro gyee so sɛ: Nsɛm a Awurade aka nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Mose kyerɛw Awurade nsɛm no nyinaa. Na otuaa ahema sii afɔremuka bepɔw no ase, ne adum dumien, sɛ Israel mmusuakuw dumien no ano te.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔsomaa Israelfo no mu mmerante na wɔde anantwinini kɔbɔɔ ɔhyɛw afɔre ne asomdwoe afɔre maa AWURADE.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Na Mose de mogya no fa guguu nyowa mu, na mogya no fa no nso ohwie guu afɔremuka no so.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa apam nhoma no, na ɔkenkan guu ɔman no asom. Ɛnna wose: Nea AWURADE aka no nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ na yebetie.

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Na Mose faa mogya no petee ɔman no so, na ose: Hwɛ, apam a AWURADE ne mo apam wɔ nsɛm yi nyinaa so no mogya ni.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Ɛnna Mose ne Aaron, Nadab ne Abihu ne Israel mpanyimfo mu aduɔsɔn foro kɔe.

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: Na wohuu Israel Nyankopɔn no; na ne nan ase te sɛ ade a wɔde hoa bo a emu tew ayɛ, na ne hanahana te sɛ ɔsoro pa ara.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Na wanteɛ ne nsa anka Israelfo mu atitiriw no; na wɔhwɛɛ Onyankopɔn, na wodidii na wɔnomee.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Foro bra me nkyɛn bepɔw no so bɛtena ha, na mɛma wo abo pon ne mmara ne ahyɛde a makyerɛw, na woakyerɛkyerɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Na Mose sɔree, ɔne n'abofra Yosua, na Mose foro kɔɔ Onyankopɔn bepɔw no so.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ mpanyimfo no sɛ: Mo de, montena ha ntwɛn yɛn nkosi sɛ yɛbɛsan aba mo nkyɛn; na hwɛ, Aaron ne Hur ne mo na ɛwɔ hɔ; sɛ obi wɔ asɛm bi di a, momma ɔmmra wɔn nkyɛn.

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Na Mose foro kɔɔ bepɔw no so, na omununkum bɛkataa bepɔw no so.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE anuonyam bɛtenaa Sinai bepɔw so, na omununkum no kataa so nnansia, na ɛda a ɛto so ason no, ofi omununkum no mu frɛɛ Mose.

english_verse: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: ne bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fufu ne mmirekyi nwi,

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Israelfo no na wɔmmɛma me soma afɔrebɔde. Obiara a ne koma ka no nkyɛn na munnye me soma afɔrebɔde.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Na eyi ne soma afɔrebɔde a munnye wɔn nkyɛn no: sika ne dwetɛ ne kɔbere mfrafrae,

english_verse: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: ne adwennini nhoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ ne sukraman nhoma ne ɔkanto nnua,

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: apopobibiri abo ne abo a wɔde besisi asɔfotade no ne adɛbo no mu no.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Na ma wɔnyɛ tenabea kronkron mma me na mentena wɔn mu.

english_verse: The lamp on the top and those at the end of each of its six branches must be made so as to shine toward the front of the lampstand.
translation_verse: Na yɛ ɛso akanea asɔn, na wɔmfa n'akanea no nsisi so, na ɛnnɛw wɔ anim nkyerɛ fa hɔ.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Na fa sika amapa dura ho, emu ne ɛho nyinaa na dura, na yɛ sika hankare twa ho hyia.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Na gu sika nkaa anan, na fa tuatua ne nan anan no ho; nkaa abien nni ɔfa ha, na nkaa abien nni ɔfa ha.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Na fa ɔkanto sinsen mpoma, na fa sika dura ho.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Na fa poma no wurawura nkaa no mu wɔ adaka no nkyɛn mu, na wɔmfa nsoa adaka no.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Mpoma no nwurawura adaka no ho nkaa no mu; wonnyiyi mmfi mu.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Na yɛ kerub biako wɔ ti ha ne kerub biako wɔ ti ha. Mpata agua no mu na momma kerubim no nyi adi wɔ ne ti abien no so.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Na fa mpata agua no si adaka no so, na adaka no mu na fa Adanse a mede mɛma wo no hyɛ.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Na ɛhɔ na me ne wo behyia, na mafi mpata agua no so wɔ kerubim abien a wɔwɔ Adanse adaka no so no ntam maka wo nneɛma a mɛhyɛ wo sɛ fa kyerɛ Israelfo no nyinaa. Ɔpon no ho nhyehyɛe (Eksodɔs

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Na yɛ ɛho mfomfamho a ne trɛw te sɛ nsam hyia, na fa sika hankare twa mfomfamho no ho hyia.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Na yɛ sika nkaa anan, na fa nkaa no sisi ntwea anan a ɛwowɔ ne nan ho no so.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Na fa ɔkanto sinsen mpoma no, na fa sika duradura ho, na wɔde asoa ɔpon no.

english_verse: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold
translation_verse: Na fa sika amapa yɛ kaneadua; ɔboro adwuma na fa yɛ kaneadua no, ne nan ne ne dua; ɛho nhwiren no nkuramu, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren no mfi ɛno ara mu.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Ɛho kukuduuduu ne ɛho nsa no mfi mu ara, ne nyinaa sika amapa na wɔmfa nyɛ no ɔboro adwuma biako.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Na ɛho adabaw ne ho nso nkukuwa nyɛ sika amapa.

english_verse: The lampstand and its equipment will require
translation_verse: Sika amapa dwetikɛse biako na wɔmfa nyɛ, ne ɛho nneɛma yi nyinaa.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Na hwɛ na yɛ no sɛnea ne nsusuwso a wɔde akyerɛ wo bepɔw no so no te no.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Na fa bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira nwene nkyeremu fa yɛ ntamadan no ano nkataano.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Ntama no biako tenten nyɛ basafa dunum, na ntama no biako tɛtrɛtɛ nyɛ basafa abien; ntama dubiako no nsusuwii nyɛ biako.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Na tenabea no, yɛ no ntama du a ɛyɛ asaawa fitaa a wɔafira ne bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi. Yɛ emu kerubim a ɛyɛ ntamanwene mu adwinni.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Wɔmfa ntama no anum ntoatoa so, biako ntoa biako so; na ntama no anum nso ntoatoa so, biako ntoa biako so.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Na fa ntama no mu anum toatoa yɛ no biako, na fa asia nso toatoa yɛ no biako, na bukaw ntama a ɛto so asia no ma ɛnkata ntamadan no so wɔ anim.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Na fa adwennini nhoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ yɛ ntamadan no nkataso, na fa sukraman nhoma yɛ ɛno so nkataso.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Na fa mpata agua no si Adanse adaka no so wɔ kronkron mu kronkronbea hɔ.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na fa ɔkanto yɛ tenabea no ntaaboo a esisi hɔ.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: ne ne dwetɛ nnyinaso aduanan, ntaaboo no mmiako mmiako ase nnyinaso abien abien.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Na tenabere no akyi fam a ɛkyerɛ atɔe no, yɛ hɔ ntaaboo asia.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Na ɛmpam ho mfi fam nkɔ, nanso ɛnyɛ mu nkodu ne hin so wɔ nea kaa a edi kan no tua hɔ; saa na n'abien nyinaa nyɛ, na enni twea abien no so.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Na ɛnyɛ ntaaboo awotwe ne ne dwetɛ nnyinaso dunsia, taaboo biako ase nnyinaso abien ne taaboo biako no ase nnyinaso abien.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Na mfinimfini mmeamu a ɛfa ntaaboo no mfinimfini no ntwam mfi ti nkodu ti.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Na ntaaboo no, fa sika duradua ho, na fa sika yɛ ɛho nkaa no ma ɛnyɛ mmeamu no hyehyɛbea, na fa sika duradura mmeamu no ho nso.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Na si tenabea no sɛnea ne nsusuwso a wɔayi akyerɛ wo bepɔw no so no te no.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Na fa ɔpon no si mmɔhɔɔ no anim, na kaneadua no nni ɔpon no ntentenso wɔ tenabea no nkyɛn mu nifa fam, na fa ɔpon no si nkyɛn mu benkum fam.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Na fa mmɔhɔɔ no sensɛn nsoam no ase, na fa Adanse adaka no besi mmɔhɔɔ no akyi, na mmɔhɔɔ no ntwa kronkronbea ne kronkron mu kronkronbea no mu mma mo.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Na fa ɔkanto adum anum yɛ nkataano no, na fa sika duradura ho, na ne nkɔtɔkoro nyɛ sika, na fa kɔbere nnyinaso anum gu ase.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa mpoma no nwurawura nkaa no mu, na mpoma no nhyehyɛ afɔremuka no nkyɛn nkyɛn, na wɔde asoa.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Na yɛ ɛho nseaa a wɔde ne nso begu mu, ne ne sesaw ade ne ne nkora ne n'adinam ne ne nsramma kukuwa, ɛho nneɛma nyinaa, kɔbere na fa yɛ.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Fa ntaaboo yɛ, na emu nna ɔkwan. Sɛnea wɔakyerɛ wo bepɔw no so no, saa ara na wɔnyɛ no. Tenabea no adiwo (Eksodɔs

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: Na wo nso hyɛ Israelfo no na wɔmmrɛ wo ngodua aba a wɔasiw ngo gyenennyenen, na wɔmfa nsɔ kanea no, na akanea no nsisi so daa yi;

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Na adiwo no ano pon no nkataano nyɛ basafa du; wɔmfa bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira a ɛyɛ nkyeremu; n'adum anan ne ne nnyinaso anan.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Tenabea no ho som nyinaa mu adwinni nyinaa ne ne mmofunnua nyinaa ne adiwo no ho mmofunnua nyinaa nyɛ kɔbere. Kanea no ngo (Lewitikɔs

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: na Aaron ne ne mma nhwɛ so, ahyiae ntamadan no mu, ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ a ɛkata Adanse no anim no anim, mfi anwummere nkosi anɔpa wɔ AWURADE anim. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛde a Israelfo nni so, wɔn awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Afei, ma wo nua Aaron ne ne mmabanin mfi Israelfo mu mmra wo nkyɛn, na wɔabɛyɛ m'asɔfo: Aaron, Nadab ne Abihu, Eleasar ne Itamar, Aaron mma no.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Na ka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ nyansa koma a mede nyansa honhom mahyɛ wɔn mu amaama no nyinaa na wɔmpam Aaron ntade no, na wɔmfa nyɛ no kronkron, na onni me sɔfo.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Na ntade a wɔmpam ni: Adɛbo ne asɔfotade ne batakari ne atade yuu a wɔanwene no adamadam ne abotiri ne abɔso; na wɔmpam kronkronyɛ ntade mma wo nua Aaron ne ne mmabanin, na wɔnhyɛ nni me sɔfo.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa sika ne bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa nyɛ.

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: ne sika ntweaban abien; wɔw no mmɛsa yɛ no sɛ nhama, na fa ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mmɛsa no hyehyɛ mfofaano no so.

english_verse: and engrave on each of them the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Na abo no ano nyɛ sɛ Israel mma no din ano te, dumien, sɛ wɔn din no te; ɛnyɛ nsɔanode nkurukyerɛwee, sɛnea din no te mmiako mmiako, sɛ mmusuakuw dumien no te.

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: Na yɛ atemmu adɛbo, ntamanwene mu anyansadwuma, yɛ no sɛnea asɔfotade no yɛbea te; sika, bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira na fa yɛ.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Na fa abo sisi mu, abo kyerɛpɛn anan: kyerɛpɛn a edi kan nyɛ bogyanambo, akratebo ne ahabammonobo;

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛto so abien no nyɛ nsramabo, hoabo ne bɔwerɛbo;

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛto so abiɛsa no nyɛ akutuhonobo, mfrafraebo ne beredumbo;

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛto so anan no nyɛ sikabereɛbo, apopobibiribo ne ahwehwɛbo; ne nsisimu no, sika mfofaano ntwa ho nhyia.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Na mmɛsa abien no ano abien a aka no, fa toatoa mfofaano abien no mu, na fa hyehyɛ asɔfotade no mmati abien no so anim fam.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa bibiri nhama nkyekyere adɛbo no nkaa no nsuso asɔfotade no nkaa no mu, na ɛmfam asɔfotade no nkyekyeremu no atifi, na adɛbo no antwitwiw amfi asɔfotade no so.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: Na fa birisi nko ara yɛ asɔfotade no ase batakari.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Na tokuru nna mfinimfini wɔ n'atifi, na wɔmfa ntamabena a wɔanwene mman tokuru no ano nhyia te sɛ nkatabo mu tokuru, na ansuane.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Sika adɔmma ne ateaa aba, sika adɔmma ne ateaa aba ntwa batakari no mmuano ho nhyia.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Na Aaron nhyɛ nsom, na sɛ ɔhyɛn kronkronbea hɔ AWURADE anim na ofi adi a, wɔate ne nnyigyei na wanwu.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na boro sika amapa tratraa, na kurukyerɛw so sɛ nsɔanode nkurukyerɛwee sɛ: Kronkron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Na fa fam bibiri hama so, na ɛntena abotiri no so; abotiri no anim na ɛmfam.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Na ɛmfam Aaron moma so, na Aaron nsoa mmusu biara a aba akronkronne a Israelfo yɛ no kronkron, wɔn ayɛyɛde kronkron nyinaa mu no; na ɛntena ne moma so daa, na ama AWURADE ani asɔ wɔn.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma no nso, yɛ ntade ma wɔn, na yɛ abɔmu ma wɔn, na yɛ abotiri bi ma wɔn, na wɔn anim nyɛ nyam na wɔn ho nyɛ fɛ.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Na fa hyehyɛ wo nua Aaron ne ne mma a wɔka ne ho no, na sra wɔn ngo, na hyɛ wɔn asɔfo, na dwira wɔn, na wonni me sɔfo.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Na yɛ nwera ntwakoto ma wɔn, na ɛnkata wɔn adagyaw so mfi asen nkosi nsrɛkyiri.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma no, sɛ wɔreba ahyiae ntamadan no mu anaasɛ wɔrebɛn afɔremuka no abɛsom kronkronbea hɔ a, wɔnhyehyɛ, na wɔanni mmusu na wɔanwu; ɛnyɛ daa atɔremude mma no ne n'asefo a wobedi n'akyi no.

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Na fa nantwinini bɔ bɔne ho afɔre daa, na ɛnyɛ mpata. Na sɛ wɔrepata afɔremuka no so a, prapra ɛho bɔne, na sra no ngo fa yɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: ne apiti abodoo ne tetare a wɔagu mu ngo, ne apiti fam a wɔasra ho ngo; awisam na fa yɛ.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Na fa gu kɛntɛn biako mu, na engu kɛntɛn no mu na fa bra, ɛne nantwinini ne adwennini abien no.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Na fa Aaron ne ne mma no bra ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na fa nsu guare wɔn.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Na fa ntade no hyɛ Aaron, atade yuu ne asɔfotade ase batakari ne asɔfotade ne adɛbo no, na fa asɔfotade no nkyekyeremu no bɔ ne mu,

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: na fa ɔsra ngo hwie gu n'atifi fa sra no.

english_verse: caps, and sashes, then ordain them, because they and their descendants will always be priests.
translation_verse: Na fa abɔso bobɔ Aaron ne ne mma no mu, na bobɔ wɔn abotiri; na asɔfodwuma nyɛ wɔn de sɛ daa atɔremude: sɛɛ na hyɛ Aaron ne ne mma asɔfo.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Na ma wɔmfa nantwinini no mmra ahyiae ntamadan no anim, na Aaron ne ne mma no mfa wɔn nsa ngu nantwi no atifi.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Na kum nantwi no AWURADE anim, ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Na fa nantwi no mogya no bi, na fa wo nsatea bɔ mu sra afɔremuka no mmɛn no ho; na hwie mogya no nyinaa gu afɔremuka no ase.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Nantwi no nam ne ne nhoma ne ne bin de, fa ogya hyew nsra no akyi, ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔre.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Na fa odwennini biako, na Aaron ne ne mma no mfa wɔn nsa ngu odwennini no atifi.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na kum odwennini no, na fa ne mogya pete afɔremuka no ho hyia.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Na twitwa odwennini no asinasin, na hohoro n'ayamde ne ne nnyawa ho, na fa gu n'asinasin no ne ne ti so.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na hyew odwennini mu no nyinaa afɔremuka no so. Ɛyɛ AWURADE hyew afɔre, ade a eyi hua huamhuam, ɛyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔre.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Na fa odwennini biako no, na Aaron ne ne mma mfa wɔn nsa ngu odwennini no atifi.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na kum odwennini no, na fa ne mogya no bi, na fa ka Aaron aso nifa ne ne mma no aso nifa ano ne wɔn nsa nifa kokurobeti ano ne wɔn nan nifa kokurobeti ano, na fa mogya no pete afɔremuka no ho hyia.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na fa afɔremuka no so mogya no bi ne ɔsra ngo no bi, na fa petepete Aaron ne ne ntade so, ne ne mma no ne ne mma ntade nso so, na ennwira no ne ne ntade ne ne mma ne ne mma ntade no nso.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: Na afei fa odwennini no srade ne ne srade dua no ne srade a ɛkata n'ayamde ho ne nea ɛsensɛn ne mmerɛbo ho ne n'asaabo abien ne ɛho srade ne ne srɛ nifa no, efisɛ ɛyɛ asɔfohyɛ dwennini,

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: na fa ne nyinaa gu Aaron ne ne mma no nsam him di akɔneaba yɛ AWURADE anim ohim afɔre.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na gye wɔn nsam, na ka ano gya afɔremuka no so ɔhyew afɔre no so, na enyi hua huamhuam, AWURADE anim. Ɛyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔre.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na fa Aaron asɔfohyɛ dwennini no yan, na him yɛ ohim afɔre ma AWURADE, na ɛnyɛ wo kyɛfa.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Ne mma mu nea obesi n'ananmu adi sɔfo no nhyɛ no nnansɔn ansa na waba ahyiae ntamadan no mu abɛsom kronkronbea hɔ.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: Na fa asɔfohyɛ dwennini no, na noa ne nam no nea ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma no nni odwennini no nam ne kɛntɛn no mu abodoo no, ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Na wonni nneɛma a wɔde pata maa wɔn de hyɛɛ wɔn asɔfo na wɔde dwiraa wɔn no, nanso ɔhɔho nnni bi, efisɛ ɛyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Na sɛ asɔfohyɛ nam no ne abodoo no bi ka ma ade kye so a, ɛnne fa ogya hyew nea ɛkae no; wonnni, efisɛ ɛyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: Na sɛɛ na yɛ Aaron ne ne mma no, sɛnea mahyɛ wo yi nyinaa; nnansɔn na fa hyɛ wɔn asɔfo.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Nnansɔn na pata afɔremuka no so yɛ no kronkron, na afɔremuka no ayɛ akronkronne mu kronkron. Obiara a ɔka afɔremuka no nyɛ kronkron. Daa hyew afɔre

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Fa oguan ba no biako bɔ afɔre anɔpa, na fa oguan ba biako no bɔ afɔre anwummere;

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Na oguammaa biako no, fa no bɔ afɔre anwummere, na yɛ no sɛ anɔpa aduan afɔre no ne ɛho ahwiesa no, na enyi hua huamhuam, ɛyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔre.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Na mɛma ahyiae ntamadan ne afɔremuka no ayɛ kronkron, na mɛma Aaron ne ne mma ayɛ kronkron, na wɔadi me asɔfo.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Na mɛtena Israelfo mu, na mayɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn,

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: na wɔahu sɛ mene AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn a miyii wɔn fii Misraim asase so sɛ mɛtena wɔn mu no, mene AWURADE, wɔn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Na aduhuam a worebɛyɛ yi, munnsusuw so nnyɛ bi mmfa: Ɛnyɛ wo kronkron mma AWURADE.

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.
translation_verse: ne ɔhyew afɔremuka no ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa ne asankasɔn no ne ne ntaase no ho;

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: Na yɛ aduhuamhyew muka, ɔkanto na fa yɛ.

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.
translation_verse: Na fa sika amapa dura ɛso ne ɛho ne ne mmɛn no ho hyia; na yɛ sika hankare twa ho hyia.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Na yɛ ɛho sika nkaa abien wɔ ne hankare no ase, wɔ n'afanu, na wɔmfa mpoma nwurawura mu, na wɔde asoa.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Na fa ɔkanto sinsen mpoma no, na duradura ho sika.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Na fa si mmɔhɔɔ a ɛwɔ Adanse adaka no ho no anim wɔ mpata agua a esi Adanse no so no anim, nea me ne wo behyia hɔ no.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Monnhyew so aduhuam foforo bi, ɔhyew afɔre anaa aduan afɔre, na munnhwie ahwiesa nso nngu so.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Na daa afirihyia mu pɛnkoro Aaron mfa bɔne ho mpata afɔre mogya no bi mpata wɔ ne mmɛn no so; daa afe ɔmpata wɔ so pɛnkoro, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu: ɛyɛ akronkronne mu ade kronkron ma AWURADE. Akra mpata

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: Sɛ wubu Israelfo ano hwehwɛ wɔn dodow a, wɔn kan yi mu no wɔn nyinaa mfa wɔn kra mpata ade mma AWURADE, na, sɛ wɔkan wɔn a, owuyare bi amma wɔn mu.

english_verse: , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma mfa nhohoro wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan ho.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
