translation_verse: Na gyigye mpata sika no Israelfo no nsam, na fa ma ahyiae ntamadan no mu som no, na ɛnyɛ Israelfo no nkae, AWURADE anim, na wɔmfa mpata mma mo kra. Asankasɔn

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛyɛ bi a ɛte sɛ ɛno ahuam ahwɛ no, wobetwa no afi ne man mu akyene.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: na dwira ho ma ɛnyɛ akronkronne mu ade kronkron; obiara a ɔka no nyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: for dedicating the tent and chest,
translation_verse: Na fa sra ahyiae ntamadan no ne Adanse adaka no,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: ne ɔpon no ne ɛho nneɛma no nyinaa ne kaneadua no ne ɛho nneɛma no ne aduhuamhyew muka no,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Na sra Aaron ne ne mma no ngo yɛ wɔn kronkron, na wonni me asɔfo.

english_verse: and say to the people of Israel: “This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ka kyerɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Eyi nyɛ ɔsra ngo kronkron mma me, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu,

english_verse: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.
translation_verse: wonnhwie nngu onipa honam so, na munnsusuw so nnyɛ bi a ɛte sɛ ɛno; ɛyɛ kronkron, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma mo.

english_verse: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord's people.” The Sweet-Smelling Incense
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛfra bi a ɛte sɛ ɛno anaasɛ ɔde bi bɛka ɔhɔho no, wobetwa no afi ne man mu akyene.

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: na fa yɛ aduhuam a wɔhyew, adufrafo nyansa so adufrae a wɔaposa a ɛyɛ gyenennyenen ne kronkron.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Na siw bi fekɔfekɔ, na fa bi si Adanse no anim ahyiae ntamadan no mu, nea me ne wo behyia no: Ɛnyɛ mo akronkronne mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, mabɔ Hur ba Uri ba Besalel a ofi Yuda abusuakuw mu din mafrɛ no,

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Na me ara, hwɛ, mafa Ahisamak ba Oholiab a ofi Dan abusuakuw mu maka ne ho; na nnipa a wɔwɔ nyansa koma nyinaa, mede nyansa mahyɛ wɔn komam na wɔnyɛ nea mahyɛ wo yi nyinaa;

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: Na wo nso ka kyerɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Me home nna no ara na munni; na ɛyɛ me ne mo ntam sɛnkyerɛnne, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu, na moahu sɛ me AWURADE na meyɛ mo kronkron.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Nnansia na wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma, na da a ɛto so ason no yɛ ɔhome mu homeda a ɛyɛ kronkron ma AWURADE; obiara a ɔyɛ adwuma homeda no, okum na wobekum no.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Me ne Israel ntam sɛnkyerɛnne ne no de kosi daa; na nnansia na AWURADE de yɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase, na da a ɛto so ason no ɔhomee na odwudwoo ne koma.

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Na ɔne Mose wiee kasa Sinai bepɔw so no, ɔmaa no adanse apon abien, abopon a wɔde Nyankopɔn nsatea akyerɛw so.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Na wotuaa ahema bobɔɔ ɔhyew afɔre ne asomdwoe afɔre; na ɔman no tenaa ase didi nomee, na wɔsɔre gorui.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Na Mose kae sɛ: Monyɛ mo ho kronkron mma AWURADE nnɛ, sɛ obiara bɛsɔre ahyɛ ne ba ne ne nua po, na mode nhyira aba mo so nnɛ.

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Na ɔman no hui sɛ Mose akyɛ na onsian mfi bepɔw no so mma no, ɔman no boaa wɔn ho ano baa Aaron nkyɛn besee no sɛ: Sɔre yɛ anyame ma yɛn, na wonni yɛn anim, efisɛ Mose yi, ɔbarima a okoyii yɛn fii Misraim bae no de, yennim nea ayɛ no.

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Aaron ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Munyiyi sika nkaa a ɛwowɔ mo yerenom ne mo mmabanin ne mo mmabea asom mfa mmrɛ me.

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Na ogyei wɔ wɔn nsam, na ɔde pɛe yeyɛe, na ɔyɛɛ no nantwi a wɔagu; na wɔkae sɛ: Israel, eyinom ne wo anyame a woyii wo fii Misraim asase so bae no.

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na Aaron hui no, osii afɔremuka wɔ n'anim; na Aaron paee sɛ: Ɔkyena ne AWURADE afahyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sian kɔ, na wo man a wode wɔn fi Misraim asase so bae no redi asɛmmɔne;

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: wɔaman afi ɔkwan a mekyerɛɛ wɔn no so ntɛm; wɔayɛ nantwi ba a wɔagu, na wɔasɔre no abɔ afɔre ama no aka sɛ: Israel, eyinom ne wo anyame a woyii wo fii Misraim asase so bae no.

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Mahu ɔman yi, na hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔn kɔn asen; na afei ma me kwan na me bo nhuru nhyɛ wɔn, na memmene wɔn, na memfa wo menyɛ ɔman kɛse.

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Na Mose paa AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn kyɛw sɛ: AWURADE, ɛdɛn nti na wo bo huru hyɛ ɔman a wode ahoɔden kɛse ne nsa a ɛyɛ den koyii wɔn Misraim asase so bae no?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛn nti na Misraimfo nka sɛ: Adwemmɔne bi nti na obeyii wɔn kɔe sɛ okokum wɔn mmepɔw so na wapra wɔn afi asase ani? San fi w'abufuhyew no mu, na ma bɔne a worebɛyɛ wo man no nyɛ wo yaw.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Kae Abraham, Isak ne Israel, wo nkoa a wokaa wɔn wo ankasa wo ntam ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mɛma w'asefo adɔɔso sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, na asase a maka ho asɛm yi nyinaa, mede mɛma w'asefo na wɔadi so akosi daa, no.

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE nuu ne ho wɔ bɔne a ɔkae sɛ ɔrebɛyɛ ne man no ho.

english_verse: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.
translation_verse: Na apon no yɛ Onyankopɔn adwuma, na kyerɛw no yɛ Onyankopɔn kyerɛw a wɔakurukyerɛw apon no so.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Na Yosua tee sɛ ɔman no rebɔ ose na wɔreyɛ gyegyeegye no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ɔko gyegyeegye wɔ nsra no mu.

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Na ose: Ɛnyɛ nkonimdi ho sebɔ gyegyeegye na ɛnyɛ nkogu ho nteɛm gyegyeegye, na mmom dwomsogye gyegyeegye na mete yi.

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Na Mose bɛn nsra no na ohuu nantwi ba ne asaw no ara pɛ, ne bo fuwii, na ɔtow apon a ɛwɔ ne nsam no gui ma ɛbobɔe bepɔw no ase.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa nantwi ba a wɔyɛe no de gya hyewee, na ɔyam no muhumuhu de petee nsu ani maa Israelfo no nomee.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Dɛn na ɔman yi yɛɛ wo na wode bɔne kɛse aba wɔn so yi?

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Aaron se: Mma me wura bo mmfuw, wo ara wunim ɔman yi sɛ bɔne ara na wɔde asi wɔn anim.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yɛ anyame ma yɛn na wonni yɛn anim, efisɛ Mose yi, ɔbarima a okoyii yɛn fii Misraim asase so bae no, yennim nea ayɛ no.

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Na misee wɔn sɛ: Wɔn a wɔwɔ sika bi no, wonyi. Na wɔde maa me, na metow guu gya mu, na nantwi ba yi fii mu bae.

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: ogyinaa nsraban no tia kae sɛ: Nea ɔwɔ AWURADE afa mmra me nkyɛn. Na Lewifo nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ho ano baa ne nkyɛn.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn se: Momfa mo nkrante mmobɔ mo asen, na muntwa mu nkɔ, na monsan mmra, mfi nsra no tia nkɔ tia, na munkunkum mo nuanom ne mo nnamfonom ne mo afipamfo.

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Na Lewifo no yɛe sɛnea Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no, na ɛda no ɔman no mu nnipa bɛyɛ mpensa totɔe.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Na ade kyee no, Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Mo de, moayɛ bɔne kɛse, na afei mɛforo makɔ AWURADE nkyɛn, ebia metumi mapata ama mo bɔne no.

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Na Mose san kɔɔ AWURADE nkyɛn kɔkae sɛ: Ao, bɔne kɛse na ɔman yi ayɛ, na wɔayɛ sika anyame afa.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Na afei, sɛ wode wɔn bɔne no bekyɛ a! Na sɛ ɛnte saa a, popa me nso fi wo nhoma a woakyerɛw no mu ɛ!

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Nea wayɛ me bɔne no, ɔno na mɛpopa no mafi me nhoma mu.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Na afei kɔ, na kogya ɔman no kɔ nea maka makyerɛ wo no; hwɛ, me bɔfo bedi w'anim; nanso da a mɛba mabɛhwɛ wɔn no, metua wɔn wɔn bɔne so ka.

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔayɛ nantwi ba a Aaron yɛe no nti, AWURADE haw ɔman no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sim fi ha kɔ, wo ne ɔman a wukoyii wɔn fii Misraim bae no, kɔ asase a mekaa ɛho ntam mekyerɛɛ Abraham, Isak ne Yakob sɛ: w'asefo na mede mɛma wɔn, no so.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: kɔ asase a nufusu ne ɛwo sen so no so; na merentena wo mu ne wo nkɔ, efisɛ woyɛ ɔman a wo kɔn asen, na mammene wo ɔkwan no mu.

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kɔka kyerɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Moyɛ ɔman a mo kɔn asen; sɛ metena mo mu kakraa bi me ne mo kɔ a, anka mɛhyew mo; na afei munyi mo ho ahokekade, na minhu nea mɛyɛ mo.

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Ɛnna Israelfo no yiyii wɔn ho ahokekade fi bepɔw Horeb ho hɔ ara.

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Na Mose faa ntamadan no de kosii nsra no akyi akyirikyiri, na ɔfrɛɛ no ahyiae ntamadan. Na obiara a ɔhwehwɛ AWURADE no fi adi kɔ ahyiae ntamadan no a ɛwɔ nsra no akyi no ho.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Mose fi adi kɔ ntamadan no ho a, ɔman no nyinaa sɔresɔre kogyinagyina wɔn ntamadan ano, na wɔde Mose akyi hwɛ ara kosi sɛ ɔhyɛn ntamadan no mu.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ne Mose di nhwɛanim kasa sɛ onipa ne ne yɔnko kasa. Na ɔsan ba nsra no mu a, ne somfo Nun ba Yosua a ɔyɛ abofra no de, omfi ntamadan no mu.

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ: Hwɛ wo ara na woka kyerɛ me sɛ: Fa ɔman yi kɔ, nanso womma minhu nea wobɛsoma no na ɔne me akɔ. Nanso wo ara na woaka sɛ: Mede wo din minim wo, na woanya m'anim dom nso.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Enti mesrɛ wo, sɛ manya w'anim dom a, ma minhu wo kwan ɛ, na mahu wo, na manya w'anim dom; na hu sɛ nkurɔfo yi yɛ wo man a!

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kae sɛ: M'anim ne wo bɛkɔ, na mama woakɔhome.

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ w'anim ne yɛn renkɔ a, ɛnne mfa yɛn mfi ha nkɔ.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Na ɛdɛn na wɔde behu wɔ ha sɛ me ne wo man yi anya w'anim dom, ɛnyɛ wo kɔ a wo ne yɛn bɛkɔ no? Na me ne wo man yi adɛnsow wɔ aman a wɔwɔ asase ani nyinaa mu.

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Asɛm a woaka yi nso, mɛyɛ, efisɛ woanya m'anim adom, na mede wo din minim wo.

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Na ose: Mɛma me papa nyinaa asen w'anim, na mɛpae me din YHWH wɔ w'anim; na medom nea medom no, na mihu nea mihu no mmɔbɔ no mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: Na ose: Wuntumi nhu m'anim, efisɛ onipa renhu m'anim nnya nkwa.

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE se: Hwɛ, ɔkwan wɔ me nkyɛn ha, na gyina ɔbotan no so;

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: na sɛ m'anuonyam resen a, mede wo mɛhyɛ ɔbo tokuru mu, na mede me nsa makata wo so masen ansa,

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: na mayi me nsa, na woahu m'akyi fam; na m'anim de, worenhu.

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kae sɛ: Hwɛ, me de, merepam apam: wo man no nyinaa anim na mɛyɛ anwonwade a wɔnyɛɛ bi da asase nyinaa so ne amanaman nyinaa mu, na ɔman a wɔwɔ wɔn mu no nyinaa ahu AWURADE nnwuma, na ade a merebɛyɛ wo no bɛyɛ hu.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Na siesie wo ho sie anɔpa, na foro bra Sinai bepɔw so anɔpa, na gyina hɔ twɛn me bepɔw no atifi.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Mma obiara nnka wo ho mmforo mmma, na mma wonnhu obiara nso bepɔw no so baabiara, na mma nguan anaa anantwi mmmedidi bepɔw no ho.

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na osen abopon abien sɛ kan de no, na Mose tuaa ahema foro kɔɔ Sinai bepɔw no so, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na ɔfaa abopon abien no kuraa ne nsam.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE betwaam n'anim, na ɔpaee sɛ: YHWH, YHWH , Onyankopɔn mmɔborohunufo ne ɔdomfo, nea n'abodwo kyɛ na n'adɔeyɛ ne ne nokware dɔɔso pii,

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mose yɛɛ ntɛm kotow fam sɔree;

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: na ɔkae sɛ: AWURADE, sɛ manya w'anim dom a, mesrɛ wo, ma AWURADE ntena yɛn mu ne yɛn nkɔ, efisɛ wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔn kɔn asen; na fa yɛn amumɔyɛ ne yɛn bɔne firi yɛn, na fa yɛn yɛ wo de. AWURADE ne wɔn yɛ apam (Eksodɔs

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Afe mu mpɛn abiɛsa na wo mmarima nyinaa mmepue AWURADE Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn, no anim.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: Na nsɔre onyame foforo bi, efisɛ AWURADE a ne din ne oninkufo no yɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufo:

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: Ade biara a ebue ɔyafunu ano ne wo mmoa nyinaa mmakan a wɔyɛ anini no, nantwi oo, oguan oo, me dea.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: Nyɛ anyame a wɔagu mfa. Afahyɛ abiɛsa no

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Di nea mehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so. Hwɛ, meretu Amorini ne Kanaanni ne Hetini ne Perisini ne Hewini ne Yebusini no afi w'anim.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Hwɛ wo ho yiye na wo ne nea ɔte asase a worekɔ so no so no ampam, na wɔammɛdan wo mu afiri;

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: na mmom mummubu wɔn afɔremuka na mummuru wɔn ɔbo adum, na muntwitwa wɔn Asera nnua ngu.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: na wo ne nea ɔte asase no so ampam, na wodi wɔn anyame akyi bɔ aguaman na wɔbɔ wɔn anyame afɔre a, obi ammɛfrɛ wo na woankodi n'afɔrebɔde no bi,

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: Di apiti nnapɔnna no: nnansɔn na di apiti, sɛ mehyɛɛ wo no, ɔsram Abib mu, efisɛ ɔsram Abib mu na wufi Misraim bae.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Na afurum abakan de, fa oguan ba sesa no, na sɛ woansesa no a, ɛnne bu ne kɔn mu. Wo mmammarima mu mmakan nyinaa, sesa gye wɔn; na obiara mmfa ne nsapan mmmepue m'anim.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: Nnansia na yɛ adwuma, na ɛda a ɛto so ason no de, home, fɛntɛm bere mu ne otwa bere mu na home.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Na hyɛ wo nnapɛn fa no, awitwa bere mu adekan de no, ɛne anoboa afahyɛ no, afedan mu.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Na metu amanaman no afi w'anim, na matrɛw w'ahye mu; na woreforo akopue AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim afirihyia mu mpɛn abiɛsa no a, obiara ani remmere w'asase.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: Mfa mmɔkaw nka w'afɔre a wobɔ no mogya ho, na mma ade nnkye twam afahyɛ afɔre no so.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: W'asase so adekan a ɛbɛba kan no fa bra AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn fi. Nnoa oguan ba ne na nufu mu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kyerɛw nsɛm yi fa, efisɛ nsɛm yi so na migyina me ne wo ne Israelfo no apam. Mose de abopon no ba

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Na Mose fi Sinai bepɔw so resian no, na adanse apon abien no kura ne nsam; nanso na Mose onnim sɛ ɔne AWURADE kasae nti, n'anim were ahyerɛn.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne Israelfo no nyinaa huu Mose no, na hwɛ, n'anim were hyerɛn; na wosuroe sɛ wɔbɛbɛn no.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Na Mose frɛɛ wɔn, na Aaron ne asafo no mu mpanyimfo no nyinaa san baa ne nkyɛn, na Mose ne wɔn kasae.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Na ɛno akyi no, Israelfo no nyinaa twiw bae, na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn nea AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no Sinai bepɔw so no nyinaa.

english_verse: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne wɔn wiee ɔkasa no, ɔde nkataanim kataa n'anim.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Mose rekɔ AWURADE anim ne no akɔkasa a, oyi nkataanim no de kosi sɛ obefi adi; na ofii adi bɛkaa nea wɔahyɛ no no kyerɛɛ Israelfo no.

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no huu Mose anim were no sɛ ahyerɛn; na ɔde nkataanim no san kataa n'anim kosii sɛ ɔkɔɔ mu ne no kɔkasae.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Nnansia na wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma, na ɛda a ɛto so ason no nyɛ mo homeda kronkron a mode home ma AWURADE; obiara a ɔbɛyɛ mu adwuma no, wobekum no.

english_verse: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath. Offerings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:

english_verse: blue, purple, or red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: ne bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa ne mmirekyi nwi,

translation_verse: ne adwennini nhoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ ne sukraman nhoma ne ɔkanto nnua,

translation_verse: ne kanea no ho ngo ne nnuhuam a wɔde bɛyɛ ɔsra ngo ne ɔhyew aduhuam,

translation_verse: ne aduhuamhyew muka no ne ne mpoma ne ɔsra ngo no ne ɔhyew aduhuam no ne tenabea no ano nkataano no;

translation_verse: Na Israelfo asafo no nyinaa fii Mose anim kɔe.

translation_verse: Na wɔbae, obiara a ne koma kanyan no, ne obiara a ne honhom kaa no, na wɔde AWURADE soma afɔrebɔde bae sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ ahyiae ntamadan no ne ɛho som nneɛma nyinaa ne ntade kronkron no.

english_verse: Everyone brought their blue, purple, and red wool, their fine linen, and their cloth made of goat hair, as well as their ram skins dyed red and their fine leather.

translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ kɔbere nkɔtɔkorɔ aduonum de toatoaa ntamadan no, na ayɛ biako.

translation_verse: Na ɔde bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira yɛɛ mmɔhɔɔ; ɔyɛɛ no ntamanwene mu adwinni a kerubim wɔ mu.

translation_verse: na n'adum anan ne ne kɔbere nnyinaso anan, ne nkoropɛe yɛ dwetɛ, na ne ti nnuraho ne ne mmeae nso yɛ dwetɛ.

The two of them completed the work that the Lord had commanded to be done. Moses put Aaron's son Ithamar in charge of the Levites who kept record of the metals used for the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na nea ɔka ne ho ne Ahisamak ba Oholiab a ofi Dan abusuakuw mu a ɔyɛ sika ne dua dwumfo ne ɔnwemfo a ɔde bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa di ntama mu adwinni.

english_verse: Two thousand four hundred and twenty-five kilograms of bronze were given.
translation_verse: Na ɔtow kɔbere no ano si dwetikɛse aduɔsɔn ne nnwetɛbona mpennu ahannan.

english_verse: the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.

english_verse: Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Na bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi no, wɔde yɛɛ ɔsom ntade a wɔde bɛsom kronkronbea hɔ, na wɔyɛɛ Aaron ntade kronkron no, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: and on each of them was engraved the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Na abo no ano du Israel mma no din ano, dumien, sɛ wɔn din te; ɛyɛ nsɔanode nkurukyerɛwee, sɛnea din no te mmiako mmiako, sɛ mmusuakuw dumien no te.

english_verse: The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest.
translation_verse: Na wɔboroo sika tratraa twitwaa no nteanteaa sɛ wɔde rebɛsesa bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa no mu adi no adwinni.

english_verse: Onyx stones were placed in gold settings, and each one was engraved with the name of one of Israel's sons.
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛɛ apopobibiri abo a esisi sika nnwinne mu a wɔakurukyerɛw so nsɔanode nkurukyerɛwee, sɛnea Israel mma din te.

english_verse: Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus
translation_verse: Na ɔde fam asɔfotade no mmati so sɛ ɛnyɛ Israelfo no nkae abo, sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no. Adɛbo no yɛ (Eksodɔs

english_verse: The words “Dedicated to the Lord” were engraved on a narrow strip of pure gold,
translation_verse: Na wɔboroo sika amapa tratraa de yɛɛ abɔanim kronkron no, na wɔkyerɛw so nkyerɛwee sɛ nsɔanode so nkurukyerɛwee sɛ: Kronkron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: The breastpiece was made with the same materials and designs as the priestly vest.
translation_verse: Na ɔde adwinni nwenee adɛbo no sɛ asɔfotade no adwinni no te, sika bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira;

english_verse: The priestly robe was made of blue wool
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ asɔfotade no ase batakari no, wɔde birisi na ɛnwenee ne nyinaa.

english_verse: a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row;
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛto so abien yɛ nsrama bo, hoa bo ne bɔwerɛ bo;

english_verse: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row;
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛto so abiɛsa yɛ akutuhono bo, mfrafrae bo ne beredum bo;

english_verse: and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting,
translation_verse: na kyerɛpɛn a ɛto so anan yɛ sikabereɛbo, apopobibiribo ne ahwehwɛbo; ne nsisimu no wɔyɛɛ ho sika nnwinne hyiae.

english_verse: Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Na wɔde mmɛsa abien no ano abien a aka no toatoaa nnwinne abien no mu, na wɔde hyehyɛɛ asɔfotade no mmati abien no so, anim fam.

english_verse: and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash.
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛɛ sika nkaa abien bio de hyehyɛɛ asɔfotade no afaafa abien no so anim fam wɔ ase a ɛbɛn ne ntoae, nguguso no nkyekyeremu no so.

english_verse: To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Clothes for the Priests (Exodus
translation_verse: Na wɔde bibiri nhama kyekyeree adɛbo nkaa no susoo nguguso no nkaa no mu sɛ ɛmfam asɔfotade no nkyekyeremu no atifi, na adɛbo no antwitwiw amfi asɔfotade no so, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Asɔfotade afoforɔ no yɛ (Eksodɔs

english_verse: which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Work Is Completed (Exodus
translation_verse: Na wɔde bibiri hama kyekyere fam abotiten no so, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Adwuma no wie (Eksodɔs

english_verse: When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_verse: Na Mose hwɛɛ adwuma no nyinaa, na hwɛ, wɔayɛ no sɛnea AWURADE hyɛe no, saa pɛ na wɔyɛe. Na Mose hyiraa wɔn.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Na batakari no tokuru da ne mfinimfini te sɛ nkatabo mu tokuru, wɔde ntamabena ban tokuru no ano hyiae, na ansuane.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
translation_verse: adɔmma ne ateaa aba, adɔmma ne ateaa aba didi so ara batakari no mmuano so hyia, na wɔde asom, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
translation_verse: ne adenwene abɔmu a wɔde asaawa fitaa a wɔafira ne bibiri ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne adidi yɛe, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;
translation_verse: adanse adaka ne ne mpoma ne mpata agua no;

english_verse: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛɛ ahyiae ntamadan no ho adwuma nyinaa wiei, na Israelfo yɛe sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa; saa ara na wɔyɛe.

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Na wɔde tenabea no brɛɛ Mose: ntamadan no ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa, ne nkɔtɔkoro, ne nsisiho ntaaboo, ne mmeamu ne ne nsisimu adum ne ne nnyinaso;

english_verse: the covering of tanned ram skins and fine leather; the inside curtain;
translation_verse: ne adwennini nhoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ nkataso ne sukraman nhoma nkataso, ne ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no;

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: ɔpon no ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa ne kyerɛ abodoo no;

english_verse: the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: kaneadua kronkron no, n'akanea a wɔasiesie sisi so ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa ne kanea no ngo;

english_verse: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
translation_verse: ne sika afɔremuka ne ɔsra ngo ne ɔhyew aduhuam ne ntamadan no ano nkataano no;

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: kɔbere afɔremuka no ne ɛho kɔbere ntontan no, ne mpoma ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa; asankasɔn no ne ne ntaase;

english_verse: the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent;
translation_verse: adiwo no mmɔhɔɔ, n'adum ne ne nnyinaso ne adiwo no abobow ano nkataano, ne ntampehama ne ne mmofunnua, ne ahyiae ntamadan no tenabea no som ho nneɛma nyinaa;

english_verse: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons.
translation_verse: ɔsom ntade a wɔde som kronkronbea hɔ ne ɔsɔfo Aaron ntade kronkron ne ne mma ntade a wɔde bedi asɔfo no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: Ɔsram a edi kan no da a edi kan no na si ahyiae ntamadan no tenabea no.

english_verse: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.
translation_verse: Na fa adanse adaka no si mu, na fa ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no kata adaka no ani.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Na fa ɔpon no kɔ mu, na siesie nea wɔde sisi so no; na fa kaneadua no kɔ mu, na fa n'akanea sisi so.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Na fa sika aduhuamhyew muka no kosi adanse adaka no anim; na fa tenabea no ano nkataano no sɛn hɔ.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Na fa ɔhyew afɔremuka no si ahyiae ntamadan tenabea no ano.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Na fa asankasɔn no si ahyiae ntamadan no ne afɔremuka no ntam, na fa nsu gu mu.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Na sisi adiwo no hyia, na fa adiwo no abobow ano nkataano no sɛn hɔ.

english_verse: Use the sacred olive oil to dedicate to me the tent and everything in it.
translation_verse: Na fa ɔsra ngo no sra tenabea no ne emu ade nyinaa, na yɛ ɛno ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa kronkron na ɛnyɛ akronkronne.

english_verse: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment
translation_verse: Na sra ɔhyew afɔremuka no ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa ngo, na yɛ afɔremuka no kronkron, na afɔremuka no nyɛ akronkronne mu adekronkron.

english_verse: and with the bowl and its stand.
translation_verse: Na sra asankasɔn ne ne ntaase no ngo, na yɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Na fa Aaron ne ne mma no bra ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na fa nsu guare wɔn.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Na fa ntade kronkron no hyɛ Aaron, na sra no ngo yɛ no kronkron, na onni me sɔfo.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Na fa ne mma nso bra, na hyehyɛ wɔn ntade,

english_verse: and ordain them in the same way, so they and their descendants will always be my priests.
translation_verse: na sra wɔn ngo sɛnea wosraa wɔn agya no, na wonni me asɔfo, na wɔn sra no nyɛ wɔn daa asɔfodi, wɔn awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Na afe a ɛto so abien no sram a edi kan no da a edi kan no, wosii tenabea no.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa Adanse no de hyɛɛ adaka no mu, na ɔde mpoma wurawuraa adaka no ho, na ɔde mpata agua no sii adaka no so;

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: na ɔde adaka no kɔɔ tenabea no mu, na osii ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no, na ɔde kataa adanse adaka no ano, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Na ɔde ɔpon no sii ahyiae ntamadan no mu, tenabea no nkyɛn mu a ɛkyerɛ benkum fam, wɔ ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no akyi;

english_verse: after which the bread was set on the table.
translation_verse: na osiesiee ɛso abodoo AWURADE anim, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔde akanea no sisii so AWURADE anim, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: Na ɔde sika afɔremuka no sii ahyiae ntamadan no mu, ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no anim;

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: na ɔhyew so aduhuam, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔde nkataano no sɛn tenabea no ano;

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: na ɔde ɔhyew afɔremuka no sii ahyiae ntamadan tenabea no ano, na ɔbɔɔ so ɔhyew afɔre ne aduan afɔre, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Na ɔde asankasɔn no sii ahyiae ntamadan no ne afɔremuka no ntam, na ɔde nsu guu mu sɛ wɔmfa nhohoro wɔn ho.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron ne ne mma no de hohoroo wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan ho;

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔkɔ ahyiae ntamadan no mu anaasɛ wɔrebɛbɛn afɔremuka no ho a, wɔhohoroo wɔn ho, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance. The Glory of the Lord
translation_verse: Na osii adiwo no de twaa tenabea no ne afɔremuka no ho hyiae, na ɔde adiwo no abobow ano mmɔhɔɔ no sɛn hɔ. Na Mose wiee adwuma no. Omununkum bɛkata tenabea no so

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛnna omununkum no bɛkataa ahyiae ntamadan no so, na AWURADE anuonyam bɛhyɛɛ tenabea no ma.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Na Israelfo akwantu no nyinaa mu, omununkum no ma ne ho so fi tenabea no so a, na wɔkɔ wɔn anim;

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: na sɛ omununkum no amma ne ho so a, ɛnne wontu ara kosi da a ɛma ne ho so.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Efisɛ wɔn akwantu no nyinaa mu na AWURADE mununkum no wɔ tenabea no so awia, na ogya wɔ mu anadwo, Israel fi no nyinaa anim.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto ɔhyew afɔre no atifi, na ɛnsɔ ani mma no na ɛmpata mma no.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na onkum nantwi ba no, AWURADE anim, na Aaron mma, asɔfo no, mfa mogya no mmra, na wɔmfa mpete afɔremuka a ɛwɔ ahyiae ntamadan no ano no so nhyia.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Na ongua ɔhyew afɔre no nhoma, na ontwitwa no asinasin.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Aaron mma no nsiesie mmabaa wɔ afɔremuka no so na wɔnsɔ ano.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔnhohoro n'ayamde ne ne nnyawa ho wɔ nsu mu; na ɔsɔfo no nhyew ne nyinaa afɔremuka no so, na ɛnyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛde no fi nguan mu, nguanten anaa mmirekyi mu, na ɔde rekɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔre a, onini a odi mu na ɔmfa mmra.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na onkum no afɔremuka no nkyɛn mu atifi fam, AWURADE anim, na Aaron mma, asɔfo no, mfa ne mogya mpete afɔremuka no so nhyia.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ayamde ne nnyawa no, ɔmfa nsu nhohoro ho; na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nyinaa mmra mmɛhyew afɔremuka no so; ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛde no fi ntakraboa mu na ɔde rebɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre ama AWURADE a, ɔmfa nturukuku anaa mmorɔnoma mma nyɛ n'ayɛyɛde mmra.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa mmra afɔremuka no ho, na ɔntew ne ti, na ɔnhyew afɔremuka no so, na wonkyi ne mogya ngu afɔremuka no ho.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Na onyi ne mene ase ne nea ɛwɔ mu ntow nkyene afɔremuka no nkyɛn apuei fam, nea nso gu hɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na onsuan ne mu, ne ntaban ho, nanso ɔnntew mu, na ɔsɔfo no nhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so, wɔ ogya no so, ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi de aduan afɔre ayɛyɛde rebrɛ AWURADE a, n'ayɛyɛde no nyɛ asikresam, na ongu so ngo, na ɔmfa ohuamfufu nto so.

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mmrɛ Aaron mma no, asɔfo no, na ɔsɔfo no mfa asikresam ne ngo no nsa mama, ne ohuamfufu no nyinaa, na ɔnhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so sɛ nkae ade. Ɛyɛ ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Na aduan afɔre no mu nea ɛbɛka no nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea. AWURADE gya mu akronkronne mu ade kronkron ne no.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wode aduan afɔre ayɛyɛde a wɔato no fononoo mu reba a, fa asikresam apiti a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw tetare ne apiti fam a wɔagu so ngo bra.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Na sɛ w'ayɛyɛde no yɛ aduan afɔre a wɔakyew no dade so a, ma ɛnyɛ asikresam apiti a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw;

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: bubu mu asinasin, na hwie ngo gu so; aduan afɔre ne no.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Na sɛ w'ayɛyɛde no yɛ kutu mu aduan afɔre a, fa asikresam ne ngo yɛ.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na fa aduan afɔre a wɔde nneɛma yi ayɛ no brɛ AWURADE; na wɔde brɛ ɔsɔfo no a, ɔmfa mmra afɔremuka no ho.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nyi ayɛyɛde no so nkae ade no, na ɔnhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so, ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ma AWURADE ne no.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Na aduan afɔre no nkae nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea; akronkronne mu adekronkron a efi AWURADE gya afɔre mu ne no.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Aduan afɔre a mode bɛbrɛ AWURADE no nyinaa, mommfa mmɔkaw nnyɛ; na monnhyew mmɔkaw biara ne ɛwo biara sɛ ogya afɔre mma AWURADE.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Momfa nneɛma yi mmrɛ AWURADE sɛ aba a edi kan mu afɔrebɔde, nanso wɔmmfa bi mmma afɔremuka no so sɛ emmeyi hua huamhuam.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na w'aduan afɔre ayɛyɛde nyinaa, to mu nkyene, na mma wo Nyankopɔn apam nkyene mmpa w'aduan afɔre mu; fa nkyene ka w'ayɛyɛde nyinaa ho.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wode aba a edi kan ayɛyɛde rebrɛ AWURADE a, fa aburow mmɛtem a wɔato no ogya mu atutu apa ho yɛ w'aba a edi kan mu ayɛyɛde;

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: na fa ngo gu so, na fa ohuamfufu to so: aduan afɔre ne no.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew aburow mfuamfua a wɔapa ho no bi ne ngo no bi ne ohuamfufu no nyinaa sɛ nkae ade: ɛyɛ ogya afɔre a wɔbɔ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi ayɛyɛde yɛ asomdwoe afɔre, na anantwi no bi na ɔde reba a, onini oo, ɔbere oo, nea odi mu na ɔmfa no mmra AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n'ayɛyɛde no atifi, na onkum no, ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na Aaron mma no, asɔfo no, mfa mogya no mpete afɔremuka no so nhyia.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne asaabo abien no ne srade a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛbo so ntontan no; omfi asaabo ho nyi.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma no nhyew, afɔremuka no so, mpae ɔhyew afɔre a egu ogya no so no, na ɛnyɛ ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛde a ɔde rebɛbɔ asomdwoe afɔre ama AWURADE no yɛ nguan no bi a, onini oo, ɔbere oo, nea odi mu na ɔmfa mmra.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɛ n'ayɛyɛde no yɛ oguammaa na ɔde reba a, ɔmfa mmra AWURADE anim;

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n'ayɛyɛde no atifi, na onkum no ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na Aaron mma no mfa ne mogya mpete afɔremuka no so nhyia.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne asaabo abien no ne srade a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛbo so ntontan no; omfi asaabo ho nyi.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so: ɛyɛ aduan afɔre a wɔbɔ no gya so ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛde no yɛ abirekyi a, ɔmfa mmra AWURADE anim;

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n'atifi, na onkum no, ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na Aaron mma no mfa ne mogya mpete afɔremuka no so nhyia.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne asaabo abien no, ne srade a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛbo so ntontan no; omfi asaabo ho nyi.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so, ɛyɛ ogya afɔreduan a eyi hua huamhuam; srade no nyinaa yɛ AWURADE dea.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛde, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu ne mo tenabea nyinaa sɛ munnni srade anaa mogya biara.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatea mmɔ mogya no mu, na ɔmpete mogya no bi mpɛn asɔn, AWURADE anim, kronkronbea ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no anim.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto ɔpapo no atifi, na onkum no nea wokum ɔhyew afɔre no wɔ AWURADE anim: bɔne ho afɔre nen.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatea nka mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyew afɔremuka no mmɛn ho, na onhwie ne mogya nyinaa ngu ɔhyew afɔremuka no ase.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo sɛ: Sɛ obi anhyɛ da na ɔyɛ nneɛma a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu biara no, na ɔkɔyɛ emu biara a,

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: sɛ nso ɛyɛ ɔsɔfo a wɔasra no yɛ bɔne ma ɔman no di so a, ɛnne ne bɔne a ɔyɛe nti ma ɔmfa nantwi ba onini a odi mu mmrɛ AWURADE mmɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa nantwinini no mmra ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n'atifi, na onkum no, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo a wɔasra no no mfa nantwi no mogya no bi nkɔ ahyiae ntamadan no mu,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa mogya no bi nkeka aduhuamhyew muka a ɛwɔ AWURADE anim, ahyiae ntamadan mu no mmɛn ho, na onhwie nantwi no mogya nyinaa ngu ɔhyew afɔremuka a ɛwɔ ahyiae ntamadan ano no ase.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: nantwinini mu no nyinaa, mfi nkɔ nsra no akyi, nea ɛhɔ tew, nea wohwie nso gu, na ɔmfa ogya nhyew wɔ mmabaa so; nea wohwie nso gu na wɔnhyew. Ɔman mu no

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Israel asafo nyinaa fom, na asɛm no ahintaw ɔman no, na wɔyɛ nneɛma a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu bi, na wodi so,

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: na wohu bɔne a wɔayɛ de afom no a, ɛnne asafo no mfa nantwi ba onini mmra mmɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre, na wɔmfa no mmra ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Na asafo no mu mpanyimfo mfa wɔn nsa ngu nantwinini no atifi, na wonkum nantwi no, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo a wɔasra no no mfa nantwinini no mogya no bi nhyɛn ahyiae ntamadan no mu,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatea mmɔ mogya no mu mfa mpete mpɛn asɔn, AWURADE anim, ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no anim,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa mogya no bi nkeka afɔremuka a esi AWURADE anim, ahyiae ntamadan no mu no mmɛn ho, na onhwie mogya no nyinaa ngu ɔhyew afɔremuka a esi ahyiae ntamadan ano no ase.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ɛnne ɔmfa n'ayɛyɛde a ɛyɛ ɔpapo a odi mu mmra;

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatea mfa bɔne ho afɔre no mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyew afɔremuka no mmɛn ho, na onhwie ne mogya no ngu ɔhyew afɔremuka no ase.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na ɔnhyew ne srade nyinaa wɔ ɔhyew afɔremuka no so sɛ asomdwoe afɔre srade no; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, ne bɔne no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no. Ɔmanfo no

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ɛnne, ne bɔne a wayɛ no nti, ɔmfa n'ayɛyɛde, abirekyibere a odi mu mmra mmɛma;

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔne ho afɔre no atifi, na onkum bɔne ho afɔre no, nea wokum ɔhyew afɔre hɔ.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Na onyi ɛho srade sɛnea woyi asomdwoe afɔre de no, na ɔsɔfo no nhyew wɔ ɔhyew afɔremuka no so, na enyi hua huamhuam mma AWURADE; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔde oguammaa bɛyɛ n'ayɛyɛde aba abɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre a, ɔmfa ɔbere a odi mu mmra;

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔne ho afɔre no atifi, na onkum no nyɛ bɔne ho afɔre, nea wokum ɔhyew afɔre hɔ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatea nka bɔne ho afɔre no mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyew afɔremuka no mmɛn ho, na onhwie mogya no nyinaa ngu afɔremuka no ase.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na onyi ne srade nyinaa, sɛnea woyi asomdwoe afɔre guammaa ho srade no, na ɔsɔfo no nhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so, sɛnea AWURADE gya afɔrebɔ te no; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, ne bɔne a wayɛ no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
translation_verse: anaasɛ sɛ obi ka afide biara, sɛ aboa bi a ne ho ntew funu, anaa afieboa bi a ne ho ntew funu, anaa aboaa bi a ne ho ntew funu, na onnim mpo a, ne ho agu fi, na odi so;

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: anaasɛ sɛ ɔka onipa ho fi bi, na sɛ afide a ama onii ko ho agu fi no te dɛn ara, na onnim mpo a, sɛ akyi no ohu a, odi so.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Sɛ asɛnhunu fi onipa anom anaasɛ ɔka ntam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ bɔne anaa papa bi, na onnim mpo a, sɛ akyi no n'ani ba ne ho so a, odi ade yi mu biara ho so;

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: na afei, sɛ odi ade yi mu biara ho so a, ɔnka nea wayɛ mu bɔne no,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: na ne bɔne a wayɛ no nti, ɔmfa n'asodi ho afɔre mmrɛ AWURADE, nguan mu ɔbere, oguanten anaa abirekyi, na ɛnyɛ bɔne ho afɔre, na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ ne bɔne no ho.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfo no, na ɔmfa nea ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔre no kan, na onkyim ne ti, nanso ɔnntew mmfi so;

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa bɔne ho afɔre no mogya no bi mpete afɔremuka no ho, na mogya no nkae no, ɔmfa ngu ɔhyew afɔremuka no ase: bɔne ho afɔre ne no.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne nsa anso nturukuku abien anaa mmorɔnoma mma abien so a, nea ɔmfa nyɛ ne bɔne a ɔyɛe ho ayɛyɛde ne asikresam olonka abupɛn du mu biako, na ɛnyɛ bɔne ho afɔre; ɔmmfa ngo nngu so, na ɔmmfa ohuamfufu nnto so, efisɛ ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔre.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfo no, na ɔsɔfo no mfa mu nsa ma nyɛ nkae ade, na ɔnhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so, sɛnea AWURADE gya afɔrebɔ te no; bɔne ho afɔre ne no.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, ne bɔne a wayɛ nneɛma yi biara mu no ho, na wɔde befiri no; na nkae no nyɛ ɔsɔfo no de, sɛ aduan afɔre. Asodi ho afɔre

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi anhyɛ da na ɔyɛ bɔne a ɛyɛ kusumdi AWURADE akronkronne ho a, ɛnne n'asodi afɔre a ɔmfa mmrɛ AWURADE ne odwennini a odi mu, sɛnea wobɛbɔ ne bo, dwetɛ nnwetɛbona mu, sɛnea kronkronbea dwetɛbona te; na ɛnyɛ asodi ho afɔre.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ne nwera atade, na ɔnhyɛ ne nwera twakoto nkata ne ho, na ɔnsesaw nso a ɔhyew afɔre gya no hyew gyawee afɔremuka no so no ngu afɔremuka no nkyɛn.

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: Eyi ne Aaron ne ne mma ayɛyɛde a wɔmfa mmrɛ AWURADE, ɛda a wɔsra no ngo no, asikresam olonka abupɛn du mu biako nyɛ daa ayɛyɛde, anɔpa de fa na anwummere de fa.

english_verse: In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong. Daily Sacrifices (Exodus
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ AWURADE anim, na wɔde ade biara a wayɛ a odi ho so no bɛkyɛ no. Ɔhyew afɔre ho mmara

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Mmarima a wofi asɔfo abusua kuw mu nyinaa nni bi; ɛyɛ akronkronne mu adekronkron.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Na ahina a wɔnoae wɔ mu no, wɔmmɔ, na sɛ kɔbere sɛn mu na wɔnoae a, wontwiw mu na wɔmfa nsu nhohoro mu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: Hyɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Eyi ne ɔhyew afɔre ho mmara, ɔhyew afɔre no ntena asammorofi, afɔremuka no so anadwo mu nyinaa nkosi anɔpa, na wɔmma afɔremuka no so gya no nnɛw wɔ so.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Na onyi ne ntade no, na ɔnhyɛ ntade foforo, na ɔmfa nso no mfi nkɔ nsra no akyi nkogu nea ɛhɔ tew.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Na wɔmma afɔremuka so gya no nnɛw, ennnum ara da, na ɔsɔfo no nsɔ mmabaa wɔ so daa anɔpa, na onsiesie ɔhyew afɔre no wɔ so, na ɔnhyew so asomdwoe afɔre ho srade no.

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Na eyi ne aduan afɔre ho mmara: Aaron mma no mfa mmra AWURADE anim wɔ afɔremuka no anim.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa aduan afɔre no asikresam no nsa ma, ne ngo no bi ne aduan afɔre no so huamfufu nyinaa, na ɔnhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so, na enyi hua huamhuam nyɛ nkae ade mma AWURADE.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Wɔmmfa mmɔkaw mmfra nnto; wɔn kyɛfa a mede mama wɔn wɔ me gya afɔre mu ne no; ɛyɛ akronkronne mu ade kronkron, sɛ bɔne ho afɔre ne asodi ho afɔre.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aaron mma mu mmarima nyinaa nni; ɛnyɛ AWURADE gya afɔre horow ho daa ahyɛde, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu; obiara a ɔka no nyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Wɔmfa ngo nkyew wɔ dadesanka mu; yɛ no nkyewa bra; yɛ no sɛ aduan afɔre a wɔatoto abubu mu asinasin bra, na enyi hua huamhuam mma AWURADE.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ Eyi ne bɔne ho afɔre ho mmara: Nea wokum ɔhyew afɔre aboa no, ɛhɔ ara na wonkum bɔne ho afɔre de no, AWURADE anim; akronkronne mu adekronkron ne no.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo a ɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔre no na onni; nea ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron na wonni wɔ ahyiae ntamadan no adiwo.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔka nam no nyɛ kronkron; na nea mogya no bi apete n'atade mu no nhoro nea ɛpetee mu no wɔ nea ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Na bɔne ho afɔre a wɔde ne mogya no bi ba ahyiae ntamadan mu bɛpata wɔ kronkronbea hɔ nyinaa, wonnni; wɔmfa ogya nhyew.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew ne nyinaa afɔremuka no so nyɛ AWURADE gya afɔre: asodi ho afɔre ne no.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa ayɛyɛde no mu biara biako mmra, na wɔmma so mma AWURADE, ɔsɔfo a ɔde asomdwoe afɔre mogya petee no na ɛnyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Na nam a aka biribi a ɛho ntew no, wonnni; wɔmfa ogya nhyew. Na nam no de, obiara a ne ho tew nni bi.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: Na eyi ne asodi ho afɔre ho mmara; ɛyɛ akronkronne mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Nea wokum ɔhyew afɔre aboa no, ɛhɔ ara na wonkum asodi ho afɔre no nso; na onhwie ne mogya mpete afɔremuka no so nhyia.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Na onyi ne srade nyinaa mmra: ne sradedua, ne srade a ɛkata ayamde ho no,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne asaabo abien, ne srade a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛbo so ntontan, omfi asaabo ho nyi;

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Mmarima a wofi asɔfo abusuakuw mu nyinaa nni; nea ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron na wonni; ɛyɛ akronkronne mu ade kronkron.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɔne ho afɔre te no, sɛ asodi ho afɔre nso te ne no, mmara koro na ɛda ho; ɔsɔfo a ɔde pata no, ɛnyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo a ɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔre ma obi no, ɔhyew afɔre a ɔbɔe no nhoma nyɛ ɔsɔfo no dea.

english_verse: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.
translation_verse: Na aduan afɔre a wɔto fononoo mu nyinaa, ne nea wosiesie no kutu mu ne kyew dade so nyinaa, ɔsɔfo a ɔde ba no na ɛnyɛ ne dea.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na aduan afɔre a wɔagu so ngo anaa nea ɛyɛ wosee nyɛ Aaron mma nyinaa de, obiara nnya sɛnea ne yɔnko nya. Asomdwoe afɔre

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Na eyi ne asomdwoe afɔre a wɔbɔ ma AWURADE no ho mmara.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔyɛ no aseda afɔre de ba a, aseda afɔre a ɔde ba no nyɛ apiti tetare a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw, ne apiti fam a wɔde ngo agu so ne asikresam tetare a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw akyew.

english_verse: You must also make some bread with yeast.
translation_verse: Mmɔkaw abodoo tetare na ɔmfa nka n'ayɛyɛde ne n'asomdwoe aseda afɔre no ho mmra.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Na n'asomdwoe aseda afɔre no nam no, wonni no da a wɔde bae no ara, wonnnyaw bi nnkosi adekyee.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛde no yɛ bɔhyɛ anaa ayamye ayɛyɛde a, wonni no da a ɔbɔ n'afɔre no, na sɛ ade kye bi so a, wonni ara;

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi di n'asomdwoe afɔre nam no bi da a ɛto so abiɛsa no a, ɛrensɔ ani, na wɔremmu mma nea ɔde bae no, ɛyɛ akyide, na ɔkra a obedi bi no bɛsoa ne mmusu.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Na ɔkra bi a ɔbɛka afide biara, onipa ho afide bi oo, aboa a ne ho ntew oo, akyide biara a ɛho ntew oo, na obedi AWURADE asomdwoe afɔre nam no bi no, wobetwa saa ɔkra no afi ne man mu akyene. Mogya ne srade ho akyiwade

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo sɛ Nantwi ne oguanten ne abirekyi srade biara, munnni.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
