translation_verse: Na aboa funu srade ne nea wɔatetew no srade, wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma biara, na odi na munnni.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Na obiara a obedi afieboa a wɔde bi bɛbɔ AWURADE gya afɔre srade no, wobetwa ɔkra a odi no afi ne man mu akyene.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Na mogya biara nso, anomaa de oo, atɔteboa de oo, munnni, mo tenabea biara mu;

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: ɔkra biara a obedi mogya biara no, wobetwa saa ɔkra no afi ne man mu akyene.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew srade no, afɔremuka no so, na ɔyan no nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Aaron mma mu nea ɔde asomdwoe afɔre mogya ne srade ba no, ɔno na ɔsrɛ nifa no nyɛ ne kyɛfa.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Na ohim yan ne ɛsoma srɛ no na mafa, Israelfo asomdwoe afɔre no mu, na mede mama ɔsɔfo Aaron ne ne mma sɛ wɔn daa kyɛfa a efi Israelfo nsam.

english_verse: These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained.
translation_verse: Eyi ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma ɔhyew afɔre ne aduan afɔre ne bɔne ho afɔre ne asodi ho afɔre ne nsamhyɛ afɔre ne asomdwoe afɔre

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: a AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose, Sinai bepɔw so, ɛda a ɔhyɛɛ Israelfo sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ayɛyɛde mmrɛ AWURADE, Sinai sare so no.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Na Mose faa nsamhyɛ afɔre dwennini no yan no, na ohim yɛɛ ohim afɔre, AWURADE anim; ɛyɛɛ Mose dea, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Fa Aaron ne ne mma ka ne ho, ne ntade no, ne ɔsra ngo no, ne bɔne ho afɔre nantwinini no ne adwennini abien no ne apiti kɛntɛn no.

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ma asafo no nyinaa mmɔ gua, ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Na Mose yɛe sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na ɔmaa asafo no bɔɔ gua, ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ asafo no sɛ: Eyi ne ade a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ.

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron ne ne mma no bae, na ɔde nsu hohoroo wɔn ho;

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: na ɔde atade yuu no hyɛɛ no, na ɔde abɔmu no bɔɔ n'asen, na ɔde batakari no hyɛɛ no, na ɔde asɔfotade no hyɛɛ no, na ɔde asɔfotade no nkyekyeremu no bɔɔ no so;

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: na ɔde adɛbo no hyehyɛɛ no, na ɔde Urim ne Tumim no hyɛɛ adɛbo no mu;

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔde abotiten no bɔɔ ne ti, na ɔde sikatɛre no, kronkronyɛ ahyehyɛde no, fam abotiten no anim, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Na Mose faa ɔsra ngo no de sraa tenabea no ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, na ɔyɛɛ no kronkron;

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: na ɔde bi petee afɔremuka no so mpɛn asɔn, na ɔsraa afɔremuka no ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa ne asankasɔn no ne ne ntaase no ngo de yɛɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ohwiee ɔsra ngo no bi guu Aaron atifi sraa no ngo de yɛɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose de Aaron mma no nso bae, na ɔhyehyɛɛ wɔn ntade, na ɔde abotiri bobɔɔ wɔn, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Na ɔma wɔde bɔne ho afɔre nantwinini no bae, na Aaron ne ne mma no de wɔn nsa guu bɔne ho afɔre nantwinini no atifi.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na okum no, na Mose de ne nsatea kaa mogya no bi kekaa afɔremuka no mmɛn ho hyiae, na oyii afɔremuka no ho bɔne, na ohwiee mogya no petee afɔremuka no ase de dwirae sɛ ɔde repata so.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa srade a ɛwɔ ayamde no ho nyinaa, ne mmerɛbo so ntontan no, ne asaabo abien no ne ɛho srade, na Mose hyewee wɔ afɔremuka no so.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na nantwinini no ankasa ne ne nhoma ne ne nam ne ne bin no, ɔde ogya hyewee, nsra no akyi, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Na ɔde ɔhyew afɔre dwennini no bae, na Aaron ne ne mma de wɔn nsa guu odwennini no atifi.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na okum no, na Mose hwiee mogya no petee afɔremuka no so hyiae,

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: na n'ayamde ne ne nnyawa no, ɔde nsu hohoroo ho; na Mose too odwennini mu no nyinaa mu gya, afɔremuka no so, ɔhyew afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ne no, AWURADE gya afɔre ne no, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Na ɔde odwennini a ɔto so abien no, nsamhyɛ afɔre dwennini no bae, na Aaron ne ne mma no de wɔn nsa guu odwennini no atifi.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Na okum no, na Mose faa ne mogya no bi de kaa Aaron aso nifa ano ne ne nsa nifa kokurobeti ne ne nan nifa kokurobeti ano.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔde Aaron mma no bae, na Mose de mogya no bi kekaa wɔn aso nifa ano ne wɔn nsa nifa kokurobeti ne wɔn nan nifa kokurobeti ano; na Mose hwiee mogya no petee afɔremuka no so hyiae.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa srade no ne sradedua no ne srade a ɛwɔ ayamde no ho nyinaa ne mmerɛbo so ntontan no ne asaabo abien no ne ɛho srade ne ɔsrɛ nifa no,

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔfaa apiti kɛntɛn a esi AWURADE anim no mu apiti tetare biako ne ngo abodoo tetare biako ne ɔfam biako de guu srade no ne ɔsrɛ nifa no so,

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔde ne nyinaa hyɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma no nsa, na ohim yɛɛ ohim afɔre, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Na Mose gyee wɔn nsam, na ɔtoo mu gya wɔ afɔremuka no so wɔ ɔhyew afɔre no so de yɛɛ nsamhyɛ afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam: ɛyɛ ogya afɔre a wɔbɔ maa AWURADE.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mose faa ɔsra ngo no bi ne afɔremuka no so mogya no bi de petee Aaron ne ne ntade ne ne mma ne ne mma ntade nyinaa so de dwiraa Aaron ne ne ntade ne ne mma ne ne mma ntade no.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Monnoa nam no ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na munni no hɔ ara, ɛne nsamhyɛ afɔre kɛntɛn no mu abodoo no, sɛnea mehyɛe sɛ Aaron ne ne mma nni no.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Na mummfi ahyiae ntamadan no ano nnansɔn, nkosi da a mo nsamhyɛ nna no bewie du, efisɛ nnansɔn na wɔde rehyɛ mo asɔfo.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Sɛnea wɔreyɛ nnɛ da yi no, AWURADE na ɔhyɛe sɛ wɔnyɛ mfa mpata mma mo.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Na montena ahyiae ntamadan no ano awia ne anadwo nnansɔn, na monwɛn sɛnea AWURADE ahyɛ no, na moanwuwu; na saa na wɔahyɛ me.

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma no dii nsɛm a AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛe no nyinaa so.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛto so awotwe no Mose frɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma no ne Israel mpanyimfo,

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: na ɔka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Fa nantwi ba a wode bɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔre ne odwennini a wode bɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, wonni mu, na fa bra AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no nso, kasa kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa ɔpapo mmɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔre, ne nantwi ba ne oguanten ba a wɔadi afe a wodi mu mmɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre,

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: ne nantwinini ne odwennini mmɛyɛ asomdwoe afɔre, na wɔmfa mmɔ afɔre, AWURADE anim, ne aduan afɔre a wɔagu so ngo, efisɛ ɛnnɛ na AWURADE beyi ne ho akyerɛ mo.

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Na wɔde nea Mose hyɛe no baa ahyiae ntamadan no anim, na asafo no nyinaa twiw bae begyinaa AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Na Mose kae sɛ: Eyi ne asɛm a AWURADE hyɛe no, monyɛ, na AWURADE anuonyam nyi ne ho nkyerɛ mo.

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ twiw bɛn afɔremuka no ho, na bɔ wo hyew afɔre ne wo bɔne ho afɔre, na pata ma wo ho ne ɔman no; na fa ɔman no ayɛyɛde bra, na pata ma wɔn, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛe no.

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Na Aaron twiw bɛn afɔremuka no ho, na okum ne bɔne ho afɔre nantwi ba no.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Na ne mma no de mogya no kɔmaa no, na ɔde ne nsatea bɔɔ mogya no mu de kekaa afɔremuka no mmɛn ho, na ohwiee mogya no petee afɔremuka no ase.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Na bɔne ho afɔre no mu srade ne asaabo ne mmerɛbo so ntontan no, ɔtoo mu gya, afɔremuka no so, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Na nam no ne nhoma no de, ɔde gya hyewee nsra no akyi.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na okum ɔhyew afɔre aboa no nso, na Aaron mma no de mogya no brɛɛ no, na ohwie petee afɔremuka no so hyiae.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Na wɔde ɔhyew afɔre no asinasin ne ne tiri no brɛɛ no, na ɔhyewee afɔremuka no so.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Na ɔhohoroo ayamde ne nnyawa no ho, na ɔhyewee ɔhyew afɔre a ɛwɔ afɔremuka no so no so.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔde ɔman no afɔre no bae, na ɔfaa bɔne ho afɔre papo a ɔyɛ ɔman no de no kum no de bɔɔ bɔne ho afɔre sɛ kan de no.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Na ɔde ɔhyew afɔre no bae, na ɔbɛyɛɛ no sɛnea yɛbea te no.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Na ɔde aduan afɔre no bae, na ɔfaa emu nsa ma hyewee afɔremuka no so kaa anɔpa ɔhyew afɔre no ho.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɛnna okum nantwinini ne odwennini a ɛyɛ ɔman no asomdwoe afɔre no, na Aaron mma no de mogya no brɛɛ no, na ohwie petee afɔremuka no so hyiae.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Na nantwinini ne odwennini no srade no, sradedua no ne nea ɛkata asaabo ho no ne mmerɛbo so ntontan no,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Na ɔyan no ne ɔsrɛ nifa no, Aaron him de yɛɛ ohim afɔre AWURADE anim, sɛnea Mose hyɛe no.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Aaron maa ne nsa so kyerɛɛ ɔman no, na ohyiraa wɔn. Na ɔbɔɔ bɔne ho afɔre, ɔhyew afɔre ne asomdwoe afɔre wiei no, osianee.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron hyɛn ahyiae ntamadan no mu; na wofii adi no, wohyiraa ɔman no. Ɛnna AWURADE anuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ogya fii AWURADE anim bɛhyew afɔremuka no so ɔhyew afɔre ne srade no. Na ɔman no nyinaa hui, na wɔde anigye huroe, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuw fam.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma Nadab ne Abihu fofaa wɔn gyasɔ ade, na wɔde ogya guguu mu, na wɔde aduhuam guguu so, na wɔde ananagya a ɔnhyɛɛ wɔn ho mmara baa AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Na ogya fii AWURADE anim bɛhyew wɔn, na wowuwui AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ ɛno ne nea AWURADE kae sɛ: Wɔn a wotwiw bɛn me no mu na mɛyɛ me ho kronkron, na ɔman no nyinaa anim na mɛhyɛ me ho anuonyam.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Na Aaron yɛɛ komm. Ɛnna Mose frɛɛ Aaron n'agya nuammarima Usiel mma Misael ne Elsafan bae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Muntwiw mmɛn, na mommɛsoa mo nuanom no mfi kronkronbea anim nkɔ nsra no akyi.

english_verse: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.
translation_verse: Na wotwiw bae bɛsoaa wɔn, wɔn ntade mu de wɔn kɔɔ nsra no akyi sɛnea Mose kae no.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma Eleasar ne Itamar sɛ: Mommpɛsɛw mo ti, na munnsunsuane mo ntade mu, na moanwuwu, na abufuw amma asafo no nyinaa so, nanso mo nuanom, Israel fi nyinaa, nsu wɔn a AWURADE de ogya ahyew wɔn yi.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Na mummfi ahyiae ntamadan no ano nso, na moanwuwu, efisɛ AWURADE sra ngo no wɔ mo so. Na wɔyɛɛ sɛnea Mose kae no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: Wo ne wo mma nyinaa, ansa na mobɛhyɛn ahyiae ntamadan no mu no, monnnom bobesa anaa nsa bi, na moanwuwu. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛde, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu,

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: na moahu ade kronkron ne ade a ɛnyɛ kronkron, ne ade a ɛho tew, ne nea ɛho ntew, ntam nsonoe,

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: na moakyerɛkyerɛ Israelfo ahyɛde a AWURADE nam Mose so ka kyerɛɛ wɔn nyinaa.

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma Eleasar ne Itamar a wɔkae no sɛ: Momfa AWURADE gya afɔre mu aduan afɔre a ɛkae no, na munni no apiti, afɔremuka no ho, efisɛ ɛyɛ akronkronne mu adekronkron.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Munni no nea ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, na ɛyɛ AWURADE gya afɔre ho kyɛfa ma wo ne wo mma, efisɛ saa na wɔahyɛ me.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Ɛsoma srɛ ne ohim yan no na wɔmfa nka srade a wɔhyew no ho mmra, na wonhim no ohim afɔre, AWURADE anim, na ɛnyɛ wo de ne wo mma de nyɛ daa kyɛfa, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛe no.

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Na bɔne ho afɔre papo no, Mose hwehwɛɛ no brɛɛ ara, nso na wɔahyew no dedaw. Na ne bo fuw Aaron mma Eleasar ne Itamar a wɔkae no, na ɔkae sɛ:

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛn nti na moanni bɔne ho afɔre no wɔ kronkronbea hɔ? Efisɛ ɛyɛ akronkronne mu ade kronkron, na ɛno na wɔde ama mo, sɛ monsoa asafo no mmusu no, na mompata mma wɔn, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Hwɛ, wɔamfa ne mogya no amma kronkronbea dan no mu. Anka ɛsɛ sɛ mudi no kronkronbea hɔ, sɛnea mehyɛɛ mo no.

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Na Aaron kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ a wɔde wɔn bɔne ho afɔre ne wɔn hyew afɔre aba AWURADE anim, na ade a ɛte sɛɛ abɛto me yi; na sɛ midi bɔne ho afɔre nnɛ a, ɛbɛsɔ AWURADE ani anaa?

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Na Mose tee no, ne koma tɔɔ ne yam.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron see wɔn sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: Monkasa nkyerɛ Israelfo sɛ: Eyinom ne mmoa a munni wɔ asase so mmoa nyinaa mu:

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Na ntuboa manyamanya a wɔwɔ nan anan anan nyinaa yɛ akyide ma mo.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: ɔdan-ne-na, ɔmampam, ɔketew, sare so ketew ne ɔbosomaketew.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne wɔn a wɔn ho ntew mma mo, mmoa a wɔwea nyinaa mu; sɛ wowu a, obiara a ɔka wɔn no ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: If something made of wood, cloth, or leather touches one of their dead bodies, it must be washed, but it is still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na ade biara a wɔn mu bi awu atɔ so no, ɛho ntew: dua ade biara oo, atade oo, nhoma oo, awere oo, ade biara a wɔde yɛ adwuma; wɔmfa nhyɛ nsu mu, na ɛho ntew kosi anwummere ansa na ɛho atew.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Na kuku biara a wɔn mu bi bɛhwe mu no, nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa ho ntew, na kuku no nso mommɔ no.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Aduan a wodi biara a nsu no bi begu mu no ho ntew, na anonne biara a wɔnom wɔ ade biara a ɛte saa mu no ho ntew.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na ade biara a wɔn funu ho biribi bɛhwe so, ɛho ntew; fononoo oo, muka oo, wɔmmubu: ɛho ntew, na mummu no sɛ ɛho ntew.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Nanso nsuaniwa anaa abura a nsu wom de, ɛho tew ara; na biribiara a ɛka wɔn funu na ɛho ntew.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔn funu ho biribi hwe kuade a wodua biara so a, ɛho tew;

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: na sɛ wɔde nsu gu kuade no so na wɔn funu ho biribi hwe so a, ɛho ntew mma mo.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mmoa a mudi no bi wu a, nea ɔka ne funu no ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na nea odi ne funu no bi no nhoro ne ntade, na ne ho ntew kosi anwummere; na nea ɔsoa ne funu no nhoro ne ntade, na ne ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Munnhura mo kra ho, mmoa a wɔwea no biara ho, na monnyɛ mo ho fi a ɛmma mo ho ntew wɔ wɔn ho.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn, enti montew mo ho na monyɛ kronkron, efisɛ meyɛ kronkron; enti mommma mo kra ho nnkum ade biara a ɛwea a ɛtwe ne ho ase no ho.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Na mene AWURADE a miyii mo Misraim asase so sɛ mɛyɛ mo Nyankopɔn no; enti monyɛ kronkron, efisɛ meyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔmfa mpae ade a ɛho ntew ne nea ɛho tew mu, ne mmoa a wodi ne mmoa a wonni mu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Sɛ ɔbea bi nyinsɛn na ɔwo ɔbabanin a, ne ho ntew nnansɔn sɛ n'asabu nna mu a ne ho ntew no.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Na da a ɛto so awotwe no, wontwa abofra no twetia.

english_verse: but her loss of blood keeps her from being completely clean for another
translation_verse: Na ɔntena ntannan mu adaduasa abiɛsa n'ahodwira mogya mu; ɔnnka adekronkron biara na ɔmmma kronkronbea hɔ kosi sɛ n'ahodwira nna bewie du.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔwo ɔbea a, ne ho ntew adapɛn abien sɛ n'asabu nna mu, na ɔntena ntannan mu adaduosia asia n'ahodwira mogya mu.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ahodwira nna no wie du ma ɔbabanin anaa ɔbabea no a, ɔmfa oguanten ba a wadi afe a wɔde bɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre, ne aborɔnoma ba anaa aturukuku a wɔde bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre mmra ahyiae ntamadan no ano mmɛma ɔsɔfo no.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mmra AWURADE anim, na ɔmpata mma no, na ne ho ntew mfi ne mogya gugu no mu. Eyi ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma ɔbea a wawo ɔbabarima anaa ɔbabea no.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne nsa anso ade a edu oguan ba no ano a, ɔmfa nturukuku abien anaa mmorɔnoma mma abien mmra mmɛma, biako nyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, na biako nso nyɛ bɔne ho afɔre, na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, na ne ho ntew.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: Sɛ biribi ba onipa honam were mu, sɛ ɔsoa oo, ntwintwamee oo, atape oo, na edidi ne honam were mu yɛ kwata ntotowee a, wɔmfa no mmrɛ ɔsɔfo Aaron anaa ne mma, asɔfo no mu biako.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ ɔhonam were mu ntotowee no, na ntotowee no so nwi adan fitaa, na ntotowee no atotɔ mu asen ne honam were no a, ɛyɛ kwata ntotowee; na ɔsɔfo no hwɛ no a, ommu no nea ne ho ntew.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛyɛ ne honam were mu atape fitaa, na sɛ wɔhwɛ na ɛntotɔɔ mu nsen ne were no, na ɛso nwi nnan fitaa a, ɛnne ɔsɔfo no nto ɔyarefo no mu nnansɔn.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Na ɛda a ɛto so ason no, ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ, na sɛ ohu sɛ ntotowee no te nea ɛte na ɛnyerɛwee ne were mu a, ɔsɔfo no nto no mu nnansɔn bio.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ no da a ɛto so ason no bio, na sɛ ntotowee no ani adum na ɛntrɛwee ne were mu a, ɔsɔfo no mmu no sɛnea ne ho tew, ɛyɛ ntwintwamee; na ɔnhoro n'atade na ne ho ntew.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na hwɛ, ntwintwamee no ayerɛw were no mu a, ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho ntew; ɛyɛ kwata.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Sɛ kwata ntotowee wɔ onipa bi ho a, wɔmfa no mmrɛ ɔsɔfo no.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na hwɛ, ɔsoa fitaa bi wɔ were no mu a adan nwi no fitaa, na anammono repuw nsoae no mu a,

english_verse: he will say, “This is leprosy. You are unclean and must stay away from everyone else.”
translation_verse: ɛyɛ kwata dedaw a ɛwɔ ne honam were mu, na ɔsɔfo no mmu no sɛ ne ho ntew; ɔnnto no mu; na ne ho ntew.

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na hwɛ, kwata no akata ne honam nyinaa so a, ommu ɔyarefo no sɛ ne ho tew; ne ho nyinaa adan fitaa a, ne ho tew.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ anammono no a, ommu no nea ne ho ntew; anammono no ho ntew, ɛyɛ kwata.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ ntotowee no adan fitaa a, ɛnne, ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho tew; ne ho atew.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: na ɔsoa fitaa bi anaa atape fitaa a ɛbere ba pobia no ananmu a, wɔmma ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ ɛhɔ atotɔ mu asen were no na emu nwi adan fitaa a, ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho ntew; ɛyɛ kwata ntotowee, apue wɔ pobia no mu.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ nwi fitaa bi nni mu, na ɛntotɔɔ mu nsen were no na ani dum a, ɔsɔfo no nto no mu nnansɔn;

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: na sɛ ɛyerɛw were no mu a, ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho ntew: ɛyɛ ntotowee.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ atape no te nea ɛte na ɛnyerɛwee a, ɛyɛ pobia no bon, na ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho tew.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Anaasɛ ogya kuru bi ba ɔhonam were no mu, na kuru no so bon puduw yɛ atape a ɛhoa fitaa na emu gyigye anaasɛ ɛhoa fitaa,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ atape no mu nwi adan fitaa na wɔhwɛ a atotɔ mu asen were no a, ɛyɛ kwata, na apue ogya kuru no mu, na ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho ntew, ɛyɛ kwata ntotowee.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ nwi fitaa nni atape no mu, na ɛntotɔɔ mu nsen were no, na ani dum a, ɔsɔfo no nto no mu nnansɔn.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na da a ɛto so ason no, ɔsɔfo no hu sɛ ayerɛw were no mu a, ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho ntew: ɛyɛ kwata ntotowee.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ atape no te nea ɛte na ɛnyerɛwee were no mu na ani dum a, ɛyɛ ɔsoa a ogya kuru no asoa, na ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho tew; na ɛyɛ ogya kuru no bon.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima anaa ɔbea bi, sɛ biribi tɔ n'atifi anaa ne bogyesɛ mu,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no hwɛ ntotowee no, na sɛ atɔ mu asen were no, na nwi kɔkɔɔ nhweanhweaa wɔ mu a, ɔsɔfo no mmu no sɛnea ne ho ntew; ɛyɛ ntutui, ɛyɛ eti anaa bogyesɛ mu kwata.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no hwɛ ntutui ntotowee no, na sɛ ɛhɔ ntɔɔ mu nsen were no, na nwi tuntum nso nni mu a, ɔsɔfo no nto nea ntutui atotow no no mu nnansɔn.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ ɔyarefo no da a ɛto so ason no, na sɛ ntutui no nyerɛwee na nwi kɔkɔɔ mmaa mu, na ntutui no ntɔɔ mu nsen were no a,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: onyi ne ho nwi na onnyi ntutui no so, na ɔsɔfo no nto nea ntutui ayɛ no no mu nnansɔn bio.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hu ntutui no da a ɛto so ason no, na sɛ ntutui no nyerɛwee were no mu na ɛhɔ ntɔɔ mu nsen were no a, ɛnne, ɔsɔfo no mmu no nea ne ho tew; na ɔnhoro ne ntade na ne ho atew.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no hwɛ no, na sɛ ntutui no ayerɛw were no mu a, ɔsɔfo no nnhwehwɛ nwi kɔkɔɔ no; ne ho ntew.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima anaa ɔbea, sɛ atape fitaa ba wɔn honam were mu,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ atape a ani dum fitaa wɔ wɔn honam were mu a, ɛyɛ yam a ayerɛw were mu; ne ho tew.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne mpampam anim fam na apa a, ɔyɛ tipae; ne ho tew.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ ntotowee fitaa a ɛbere asoa ne tipae no anaa ne mpampam pae no mu a ɛte sɛ ɔhonam were mu kwata a,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: Na ɔkwatani a ɔyare no wɔ ne ho no nsunsuane ne ntade mu, na ɔmpɛsɛw ne ti, na ɔnkata n'ano, na ɔnteɛm sɛ: Me ho ntew, me ho ntew!

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Nna dodow a ɔyare no wɔ ne ho no, ɔtew na ne ho ntew; ne nko na ɔntena, na nsra no akyi na ɔntena.

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Na ɔnhyew ntama no, sɛ nsa no anaa mfa no oo, anaa kuntu anaa asaawa anaa nhoma ade biara mu na ntotowee no wɔ oo, efisɛ ɛyɛ kwata a ɛsɛe ade.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ na wɔnhoro ade a ntotowee no wɔ mu no, na ɔnto mu nnansɔn bio.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Na ntotowee no horo akyi no ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ ntotowee no ani nsakrae na ɛnyerɛwee nso a, ɛho ntew, wɔmfa ogya nhyew; ani akukuw oo, akyi akukuw oo, ɛyɛ nwewee.

english_verse: But if the spot has faded after being washed, he will tear away the spot.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne horo akyi no ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ ntotowee no ani dum a, ɔntew mfi ntama no anaa nsa anaa mfa no mu.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wohu bio, ntama no mu, wɔ nsa anaa mfa anaa nhoma ade biara mu a, ɛyɛ kwata a ɛrepue, wɔmfa ogya nhyew nea ntotowee no wɔ mu no.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Na ntama no, mfa anaa nsa anaa nhoma ade biara a wobɛhoro na ntotowee no befi mu no, wɔnhoro bio na ɛho atew.

english_verse: These are the rules for deciding if clothing is clean or unclean after a spot appears on it.
translation_verse: Eyi ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma kwata ntotowee, kuntutam anaa asaawatam anaa nsa anaa mfa anaa nhoma ade biara mu, na wɔde abu no ade a ɛho tew anaa ade a ɛho ntew.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ mma wɔmfa nnomaa a wɔn ho tew abien animono ne kyeneduru dua ne adidi ne adwerɛ mma nea wɔbɛtew ne ho no mmra.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ mma wonkum nnomaa no mu biako, asanka bi mu, mmasu so.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Na anomaa nikanfo no de, ɔmfa no ne kyeneduru dua no ne adidi ne adwerɛ no, na ɔmfa ne nyinaa ne anomaa nikanfo no mmɔ anomaa a wɔakum no mmasu so no mogya mu,

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa mpete nea abɛtew ne ho afi ne kwata ho no so mpɛn asɔn, na ɔntew ne ho, na onnyaa anomaa nikanfo no mma ɔnkɔ wuram.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Na nea wɔatew ne ho no nhoro ne ntade na onyi ne nwi nyinaa koraa, na ɔmfa nsu nguare na ne ho atew; na ɛno akyi no, ɔmmra nsra no mu, nanso ɔntena ne ntamadan akyi nnansɔn.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛto so ason no, onyi ne ho nwi nyinaa, ne ti ne ne bogyesɛ ne ne ntɔnka nwi nyinaa na onyi; na ɔnhoro ne ntade, na ɔmfa nsu nguare ne honam na ne ho atew.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: Na ɛda a ɛto so awotwe no, ɔmfa nguanten mma abien a wodi mu, ne oguammaabere biako a wadi afe a odi mu, ne aduan afɔre asikresam olonka abupɛn du mu abiɛsa a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw, ne ngo toaa ma biako mmra.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo a ɔtew ne ho no mfa ɔbarima a wɔretew ne ho no ne nneɛma no mmegyina AWURADE anim, ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa nguanten no mu biako mmra, sɛ asodi ho afɔre, ne ngo toaa ma no, na onhim no ohim afɔre, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: na onkum oguanten ba no nea wokum bɔne ho afɔre ne ɔhyew afɔre hɔ, nea ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, efisɛ asodi ho afɔre no nso yɛ asɔfo no dea, te sɛ bɔne ho afɔre, ɛyɛ akronkronne mu adekronkron.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodi ho afɔre mogya no bi nkeka nea wɔretew ne ho no aso nifa ne ne nsa nifa kokurobeti ne ne nan nifa kokurobeti ano.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ngo toaa no mu bi nhwie ngu n'ankasa ne nsa benkum mu;

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatea nifa mmɔ ngo a ɛwɔ ne nsa benkum mu no mu, na ɔmfa ne nsatea nka ngo no bi mpete mpɛn asɔn, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: na ngo a ɛbɛka ne nsam no, ɔsɔfo no mfa bi nkeka nea wɔretew ne ho no aso nifa ne ne nsa nifa kokurobeti ne ne nan nifa kokurobeti ano, asodi ho afɔre mogya no so;

english_verse: If you are poor and cannot afford to offer this much, you may offer a ram as a sacrifice to make things right, together with
translation_verse: Na sɛ odi hia na ne nsa anso eyinom so a, ɛnne ɔmfa oguanten ba biako mmɛyɛ asodi ho afɔre nyɛ ohim afɔre mfa mpata mma no, ne aduan afɔre asikresam olonka abupɛn du mu biako a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw, ne ngo toaa ma,

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: ne nturukuku abien anaa mmorɔnoma mma abien a ne nsa bɛso so; biako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔre na biako nyɛ ɔhyew afɔre;

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: na n'ahodwira da a ɛto so awotwe no, ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfo no ahyiae ntamadan no ano, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Na onkum asodi ho afɔre guanten ba no, na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodi ho afɔre mogya no bi nkeka nea wɔretew ne ho no aso nifa ne ne nsa nifa kokurobeti ne ne nan nifa kokurobeti ano;

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ngo no ngu n'ankasa ne nsa benkum mu,

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatea nifa nka ngo a ɛwɔ ne nsa benkum mu no bi mpete mpɛn asɔn, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ngo a ɛwɔ ne nsam no bi nkeka nea wɔretew ne ho no aso nifa ne ne nsa nifa kokurobeti ne ne nan nifa kokurobeti ano, nea asodi ho afɔre no mogya no wɔ no;

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. translation_verse: ade a ne nsa bɛso so no mu biako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔre, na biako nyɛ ɔhyew afɔre mpae aduan afɔre no so, na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma nea wɔretew ne ho no, AWURADE anim.

translation_verse: Eyi ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma nea kwata atotow no a ne nsa nso n'ahodwira ade so no. Adan a wɔagu ho fi

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: Sɛ mudu Kanaan asase a mede merema mo sɛ munni so no so, na sɛ mede kwata ntotowee metoto mo dibea asase no so fi bi ho a,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: ɛnne ofi no wura no mmra mmɛka nkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no sɛ ɛyɛ me sɛ biribi a ɛte sɛ ntotowee wɔ me fi ho.

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no hwɛ ntotowee no, na sɛ ntotowee no wɔ ofi no fasu ho, nkekae apopobibiri anaa akɔkɔɔ, na ani atotɔ mu asen ɔfasu no a,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: ɔsɔfo no mfi ofi no mu mmra ɔpon ano, na ɔnto ofi no mu nnansɔn.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛda a ɛto so ason no, ɔsɔfo no san ba, na ɔbɛhwɛ, na sɛ ntotowee no ayerɛw ofi no fasu ho a,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: na wɔnwerɛwerɛw ofi no mu nhyia, na wɔmfa dɔte a wɔwerɛwee no nkogu kurow no akyi nea ɛhɔ ntew.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa abo foforo nhyehyɛ abo no ananmu, na wɔmfa dɔte foforo mma ofi no ho.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no ba na ɔbɛhwɛ, na sɛ ntotowee no ayerɛw ofi no mu a, ɛyɛ ofi no mu kwata a ɛsɛe ade; ɛho ntew.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Enti onnwiriw ofi no ngu fam, n'abo ne ne mpuran ne ofi no ho dɔte nyinaa, na ɔnsesaw mfi adi nkɔ kurow no akyi nkogu nea ɛhɔ ntew.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na nea ɔbɛkɔ ofi no mu nna a wɔato mu nyinaa mu no, ne ho ntew kosi anwummere,

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: na nea ɔda ofie hɔ no nhoro ne ntade, na nea odidi ofie hɔ no nhoro ne ntade.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ofi no ho ma akyi ɔsɔfo no ba bɛhwɛ, na sɛ ntotowee no nyerɛwee ofi no mu a, ɛnne ɔsɔfo no mmu ofi no sɛ ɛho tew, efisɛ ntotowee no asa.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Na onkum nnomaa no mu biako asanka mu, mmasu so,

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: na onnyaa anomaa animono no kurow no akyi mma ɔnkɔ wuram, na ɔmpata mma ofi no, na ɛho atew.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ bere a ade ho ntew ne bere a ɛho tew mu; eyi ne kwata ho mmara.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: Monkasa nkyerɛ Israelfo no nse wɔn sɛ, ɔbarima biara sɛ ne ho sen gu a, n'ahosen no nti ne ho ntew.

english_verse: Anything that he rests on or sits on is also unclean,
translation_verse: Nnae biara a nea ne ho sen no bɛda so no ho ntew, na ade biara a ɔbɛtena so no ho ntew.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na nea ɔka nea ne ho sen no honam no, ɔnhoro ne ntade na ɔmfa nsu nguare na ne ho ntew kosi anwummere;

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: na sɛ nea ne ho sen no fe ntasu gu nea ne ho tew so a, ɔnhoro ne ntade na ɔmfa nsu nguare, na ne ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na nea ɔsoa saa ade no nhoro ne ntade na ɔmfa nsu nguare, na ne ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔhosenfo no amfa nsu anhohoro ne nsa na ɔbɛka no no, ɔnhoro ne ntade na ɔmfa nsu nguare, na ne ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Na kuku a ɔhosenfo no bɛka no, wɔmmɔ, na dua ade biara de, wɔmfa nsu nhohoro ho.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔhosenfo no ho tew fi n'ahosen no mu a, ɔnkan nnansɔn ngu n'ahofi so, na ɔnhoro ne ntade, na ɔmfa mmasu nguare ne honam, na ne ho atew.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛto so awotwe no, ɔmfa nturukuku abien anaa mmorɔnoma mma abien mmra AWURADE anim, ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na ɔmfa mma ɔsɔfo no.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa biako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔre, na biako no nso ɔmfa nyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no AWURADE anim mfi n'ahosen no mu.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima bi ahoboa fi no mu a, ɔmfa nsu nguare ne honam nyinaa, na ne ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na ntama biara anaa nhoma biara a ahoboa begu mu no, wɔmfa nsu nhoro, na ɛho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea da na ahoboa gu no a, wɔmfa nsu nguare na wɔn ho ntew kosi anwummere. Mmea ahosen fi

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na ɔbea sɛ, ne ho sen na mogya fi ne honam mu gu a, ɔntena n'asabu mu nnansɔn, na obiara a ɔka no no ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: na sɛ biribi wɔ nnae no so anaasɛ ade a watena so no so a, obi ka a, ne ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima ne no da, na n'asabu ade no bi ka ne ho a, ne ho ntew nnansɔn, na ne nnae a ɔda so no nyinaa ho ntew.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Na ɔbea, sɛ ne ho sen mogya gu nna pii, na ɛnyɛ n'asabu bere, anaasɛ ne ho sen tra n'asabu nna no a, ɛnne n'ahosen a ɛho ntew nna no nyinaa ne ho ntew te sɛ n'asabu nna mu.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Ne nnae a ɔda so biara n'ahosen nna nyinaa mu nyɛ no sɛ n'asabu nnae, na ade biara a ɔtena so no ho ntew sɛ n'asabu mu de no.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔde ne nsa ka nneɛma no ho ntew, na ɔnhoro ne ntade na ɔmfa nsu nguare, ne ho ntew kosi anwummere.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne ho tew fi n'ahosen no mu a, ɔnkan nnansɔn mfa, na ɛno akyi no ne ho atew.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Na da a ɛto so awotwe no, ɔmfa nturukuku abien anaa mmorɔnoma mma abien mmrɛ ɔsɔfo, ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa biako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔre, na biako no ɔmfa mmɔ ɔhyew afɔre, na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, AWURADE anim, mfi n'ahosen a ɛho ntew no mu.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Na momma Israelfo no nyi wɔn ho mfi wɔn fi mu, na wɔanwuwu wɔn fi mu sɛ wɔrekogu me tenabea a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no ho fi.

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ wo nua Aaron sɛ, ɔnnhyɛn kronkronbea hɔ nnkɔ mmɔhɔɔ no akyi, mpata agua a ɛwɔ adaka no so no anim, bere nyinaa mu, na wanwu, efisɛ omununkum no mu na miyi me ho mekyerɛ, mpata agua no so.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Na eyi ne nea Aaron mfa nhyɛn kronkronbea hɔ, nantwininiforo a wɔde bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre, ne odwennini a wɔde bɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: Ɔnhyɛ nwera atade kronkron no, na nwera ntwakoto nkata ne ho, na nwera abomu no mmɔ n'asen, na ɔmmɔ nwera abotiten no, ɛne ntade kronkron no; ɔmfa nsu nguare ne ho ansa na ɔnhyɛ.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Na onnye Israel asafo no hɔ mpapo abien, na wɔmfa mmɔ bɔne ho afɔre, ne odwennini biako, na wɔmfa mmɔ ɔhyew afɔre.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mfa bɔne ho afɔre nantwinini a ɛyɛ ne de no mmra, na ɔmfa mpata mma n'ankasa ne ho ne ne fi.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa mpapo abien no mmegyina AWURADE anim, ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mmɔ mpapo abien no so ntonto, AWURADE ntonto biako ne Asase ntonto biako.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Na Aaron mfa ɔpapo a AWURADE ntonto bɔɔ no no mmra mmɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Na ɔpapo a Asasel ntonto bɔɔ no no, ɔmfa no animono nnyina AWURADE anim mfa mpata mma no na wonkogyaa no nkɔ sare so mma Asasel.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mfa bɔne ho afɔre nantwinini a ɛyɛ ne de no mmra mfa mpata mma n'ankasa ne ho ne ne fi, na onkum bɔne ho afɔre nantwinini a ɛyɛ ne de no.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa gyasɔ ade nnyansramma ma mfi afɔremuka no so, AWURADE anim, ne aduhuam a wɔasiw no fekɔfekɔ ne nsa abien ma, na ɔmfa nkɔ ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no akyi;

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: na ɔmfa aduhuam no ngu ogya no so, AWURADE anim, na aduhuam no wusiw nkata mpata agua a ɛwɔ Adanse no so no ho, na wanwu.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa nantwinini no mogya no bi, na ɔmfa ne nsatea nka mpete mpata agua no so anim fam, na ɔmfa ne nsatea nka mogya no bi mpete mpata agua no anim hɔ mpɛn asɔn.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Na onkum bɔne ho afɔre papo a ɔyɛ ɔman de no, na ɔmfa ne mogya nkɔ ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no akyi, na ɔmfa mogya no nyɛ sɛnea ɔde nantwinini no mogya yɛe no, na ɔmfa mpete mpata agua no so ne mpata agua no anim,

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: na ɔmpata mma kronkronbea no Israelfo no afide, ne wɔn mmara a wɔto, ne wɔn bɔne nyinaa nti; na saa na ɔnyɛ mma ahyiae ntamadan a esi wɔn mu esiane wɔn afide no nti.

english_verse: Only you are allowed in the sacred tent from the time you enter until the time you come out.
translation_verse: Na onipa biara nntena ahyiae ntamadan no mu, bere a ɔhyɛn hɔ kɔpata kronkronbea no mu, kosi sɛ obefi adi a wapata ama n'ankasa ne ne fi ne Israelfo asafo nyinaa.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Na omfi adi mmra afɔremuka a esi AWURADE anim no ho, na ɔmpata mma no, na ɔmfa nantwinini no mogya no bi ne ɔpapo no mogya no bi nkeka afɔremuka no mmɛn ho nhyia,

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne nsatea nka mogya no bi mpete so mpɛn asɔn, na ɔntew ho nyɛ no kronkron mfi Israelfo no afide mu.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔpata ma kronkronbea ne ahyiae ntamadan ne afɔremuka no wie a, ɔmfa ɔpapo animono no mmra.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mfa ne nsa abien ngu ɔpapo animono no atifi, na ɔnka Israelfo no mfomso nyinaa ne wɔn mmarato nyinaa sɛ wɔn bɔne nyinaa te no ngu ɔpapo no so, na ɔmma ɔbarima bi a ɔwɔ hɔ nkogyaa no nkɔ sare so,

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: na ɔpapo no nsoa wɔn mfomso nyinaa mfa nkɔ asase fo so, na onkogyaa ɔpapo no sare so.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa nsu nguare ne ho, nea ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, na ɔnhyɛ ne ntade na omfi adi nkɔbɔ ne hyew afɔre ne ɔman no hyew afɔre, na ɔmpata mma n'ankasa ne ho ne ɔman no.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔnhyew bɔne ho afɔre srade no afɔremuka no so.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Na nea ɔde ɔpapo no kɔe kogyaa no maa Asasel no nhoro ne ntade, na ɔmfa nsu nguare ne ho, na ɛno akyi ansa na ɔmmra nsra no mu.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Na bɔne ho afɔre nantwinini ne bɔne ho afɔre papo a wɔde wɔn mogya kɔɔ kronkronbea hɔ kɔpatae no, wɔmfa wɔn mfi nkɔ nsra no akyi, na wɔmfa ogya nhyew wɔn nhoma ne wɔn nam ne wɔn agyanan.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na nea ɔkɔ kɔhyewee no nhoro ne ntade na ɔmfa nsu nguare ne ho, na ɛno akyi ansa na ɔmmra nsra no mu.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Na eyi nyɛ mo daa ahyɛde: ɔsram a ɛto so ason no da a ɛto so du no, mommrɛ mo ho ase, okuromani oo, ɔhɔho a ɔbɛsoɛ mo mu oo, monnyɛ adwuma biara.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Na da no na wɔpata ma mo de dwira mo, na mo ho atew afi mo bɔne nyinaa mu, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ mo ɔhome mu homeda na mommrɛ mo ho ase; ɛyɛ daa ahyɛde.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Na mpata no, ɔsɔfo a wɔasra no ngo a wɔde ahyɛ ne nsa sɛ onni sɔfo nsi n'agya ananmu no na ɔmpata, na ɔnhyɛ nwera ntade no, ntade kronkron no,

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: na ɔmpata mma kronkronbea kronkron no, na ɔmpata mma ahyiae ntamadan ne afɔremuka no, na ɔmpata mma asɔfo no ne ɔman asafo mu no nyinaa.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na eyi nyɛ mo daa ahyɛde, na wɔde apata ama Israelfo no afi wɔn bɔne nyinaa mu pɛnkoro daa afirihyia. Na Mose yɛe sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa mma ahyiae ntamadan no ano mmɛyɛ ayɛyɛde mma AWURADE wɔ AWURADE tenabea anim no, wobebu mogya agu no so, waka mogya agu, na wobetwa saa onipa no afi ne man mu akyene,

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: na ama Israelfo de wɔn afɔre a wokum sare so no abrɛ asɔfo no ama wɔde abrɛ AWURADE, ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na wɔakum abɔ AWURADE asomdwoe afɔre.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa mogya no mpete AWURADE afɔremuka no so, ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na ɔnhyew srade no na enyi hua huamhuam mma AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Na wonnkum wɔn afɔrebɔde mmma mpapo abosom a wodi wɔn akyi aguamammɔ so no bio. Na ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛde mma wɔn, wɔn awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: na wamfa amma ahyiae ntamadan ano ammɛbɔ amma AWURADE no, wobetwa no afi ne man mu akyene. Wonnni mogya

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ofi Israel fi anaa ahɔho a wɔabɛsoɛ wɔn mu no mu a odi mogya biara no, mɛma m'ani asa saa ɔkra a odi mogya no, na matwa no afi ne man mu akyene.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Efisɛ ɔhonam biara nkwa wɔ mogya no mu, na mede ama mo, afɔremuka no so sɛ wɔmfa mpata mma mo ho; na mogya na wɔde pata ma ɔkra.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ofi Israel mma ne ahɔho a wɔabɛsoɛ mo mu a ɔyɛ ha kum aboa anaa anomaa a wodi no, onhwie ne mogya ngu na ɔmfa dɔte nkata so.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Na ɔhonam nyinaa kra de, ne mogya ne ne kra, enti na mise Israelfo sɛ: Munnni nam biara mogya, efisɛ ɔhonam nyinaa kra ne ne mogya; obiara a odi no, wobetwa no akyene.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na obiara a odi nea wawu anaasɛ nea wɔatetew no, okuromani oo, ɔhɔho oo, ɔnhoro ne ntade na ɔmfa nsu nguare, na ne ho ntew kosi anwummere ansa na ne ho atew;

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: na sɛ wanhoro ne ntade na wanguare a, ɛnne ɔnsoa ne mmusu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Misraim asase a motenaa hɔ no so nneyɛe de, monnyɛ. Na Kanaan asase a mede mo merekɔ hɔ no so nneyɛe nso, monnyɛ, na munnni wɔn ahyɛde so.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: M'atemmude na monyɛ, na monkora m'ahyɛde sɛ, mubedi so.

english_verse: Obey them and you will live. I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. Na monkora m'ahyɛde ne m'atemmude a onipa a ɔyɛ no benya mu nkwa no. Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: Obiara nnkɔ ne bogya biara a ɔyɛ ne honam no ho nnkoyi n'adagyaw so. Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: especially your own mother. This would disgrace your father.
translation_verse: Nyi w'agya anaa wo na adagyaw so; wo na ne no, nyi n'adagyaw so.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Nyi w'agya yere adagyaw so; w'agya adagyaw ne no.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: Wo nuabea a ɔyɛ w'agya ba anaa wo na ba no, wɔwoo no ofie oo, wɔwoo no baabi oo, nyi wɔn adagyaw so.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: Wo babanin babea anaa wo babea babea, nyi wɔn adagyaw so, efisɛ ɛyɛ w'adagyaw.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Nyi wo na nuabea adagyaw so, efisɛ ɔyɛ wo na honam.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Nyi w'agya nuabarima adagyaw so nkɔ ne yere ho; wo na kumaa ne no.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your daughter-in-law
translation_verse: Nyi w'ase adagyaw so; wo babarima yere ne no, nyi n'adagyaw so.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Nyi ɔbea bi ne ne ba adagyaw so; mfa ne babanin babea anaa ne babea babea nyi wɔn adagyaw so; ne honam ne wɔn; ɛyɛ abusude.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Na mma ɔbea ne ne nua nware, na wɔatwe kora, mmere a ɔda so te ase no, wubeyi n'adagyaw so aka ho.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Na nkɔ ɔbea a n'asabu mu ne ho ntewee no ho nkoyi n'adagyaw so.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Na wo ne wo yɔnko yere nnna, na mfa wo ho nsu mma no mfa ngu wo ne no ho fi.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Na mfa w'asefo mu bi mma ɔnnkɔfa ogya mu mmma Molek, na nhura wo Nyankopɔn din ho; mene AWURADE.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Na wo ne ɔbarima nnna, sɛ ɔbea; ɛyɛ akyide.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Mommfa nneɛma yi biara nngu mo ho fi, efisɛ eyinom nyinaa na amanaman a merebetu wɔn afi mo anim yi de agu wɔn ho fi,

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: na asase no so agu fi, enti na meretua ɛso amumɔyɛ no so ka, na asase no afe ɛsotefo no agu.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: efisɛ saa akyide yi nyinaa na asase no sofo a wodi mo kan no ayɛ, na asase no so agu fi;

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: na asase no amfe mo sɛ moagu ho fi, sɛnea ɛfee amanaman a wodii mo anim no.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Enti monhwɛ m'ahwɛde, na moanyɛ ahyɛde a wokyi a wodii mo anim yɛe no amfa angu mo ho fi: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo asafo no nyinaa na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Monyɛ kronkron, efisɛ me, AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn, meyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Monnan mo ho nnnkɔ abosonhuhuw no nkyɛn, na monnnyɛ ahoni a wɔagu sɛ anyame mmfa: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mobɔ asomdwoe afɔre ma AWURADE a, mommɔ no sɛnea ɛbɛma moasɔ ani:

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Da a mukum no ara na wonni, ne n'adekyee, na nea ɛbɛka akodu da a ɛto so abiɛsa no, wɔmfa ogya nhyew.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wodi no da a ɛto so abiɛsa a, ɛyɛ akyide, ɛnsɔ ani;

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: na nea odi no bɛsoa ne mmusu, efisɛ AWURADE akronkronne ho na wahura, na wobetwa saa ɔkra no afi ne man mu akyene.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mutwa mo asase so nnɔbae a, nwie wo nhanoa de twa, na nni w'afumde no mu mpɛpɛw;

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
