translation_verse: na wo bobe turo nso, nni mu mpɛpɛw, na wo turo mu aba a egugu fam no, ntase; gyaw ma ohiani ne ɔhɔho: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Mommmɔ korɔn na munnni kusum, na obi nntwa ne yɔnko nkontompo.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Na monnka me din ho ntam atoro mu, na woanhura wo Nyankopɔn din ho: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Nni wo yɔnko amim na mfow no. Mma wo paani akatua nnka wo nkyɛn mma ade nnkye.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Nnome ɔsotifo na mfa hintidua nto onifuraefo anim, na suro Onyankopɔn: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: Munntwa atemmu mu nkontompo: nhwɛ ɔbrɛfo anim na nyɛ nea ɛbɛsɔ otumfo ani; trenee mu na bu wo yɔnko atɛn.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Nkyin wo nkurɔfo mu nni nseku; nsɔre nhyɛ wo yɔnko mogya: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: Ntan wo nua wo koma mu; ɔka na ka wo yɔnko anim, na woansoa ne ho bɔne.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Nni were na nnya wo nkurɔfo mma ho menasepɔw, na dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Munni m'ahyɛde so. Mma w'afieboa nnni afrafra mmforo wɔn ho; w'afuw nso, mfa ade mfrafra nnua mu, na mma ntama horow abien nsaasaa nnka wo ho.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbarima bi ne ɔbea da na ɔde ne ho ka no, na ɔbea no yɛ afenaa a wɔde no ama obi aware, na ogye na wonnya nnyee no anaasɛ wonnya mfaa ne ho nkyɛɛ no a, wɔmpɛɛpɛɛmu ntwe wɔn aso, na wonnkum wɔn, efisɛ onnya nnee ne ho ɛ.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodi ho afɔre dwennini no mpata mma no, AWURADE anim, bɔne a wayɛ no nti, na wɔde ne bɔne a wayɛ no akyɛ no.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mudu asase no so na motɛw dua biara a wodi a, mummu n'aba no sɛ momonotode; mfe abiɛsa na ɛnyɛ mo momonotode, wonnni;

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: na afe a ɛto so anan no, ɛso aba nyinaa nyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE ayeyi;

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: na afe a ɛto so anum no, munni n'aba, na ne nnɔbae nkɔ so nnɔɔso mma mo: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Mommfa mogya nnka biribi ho nnni. Munnni adebisasɛm na munngoru abayigoru.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Monnsesa mo ho nkamaa mmma awufo, na munnkurukyerɛw mo ho nkyerɛwee bi: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: Nhura wo babea ho mma ɔmmmɔ aguaman, na asase no ammɔ aguaman, na mmusu anyɛ asase no so ma.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Munni me home nna na munsuro me kronkronbea no: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Monnnan mo ho nnkɔ ɔdebisafo nkyɛn, na monnhwehwɛ asumanfo akyi kwan mmfa nngu mo ho fi wɔ wɔn ho: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Fa obu ma ɔpanyin, yiw, na di akwakora ni, na suro wo Nyankopɔn: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi bɛsoɛ mo asase so a, monnhyɛ no so.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔho a wabɛtena mo mu nyɛ mo sɛ mo kuromani bi, na dɔ no sɛ wo ho, efisɛ moyɛɛ Misraim asase so ahɔho: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: nsɛnia tee, abrammo tee, olonka tee ne susutoa tee na munkura: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a miyii mo fii Misraim asase so no.

english_verse: and I command you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Na munni m'ahyɛde nyinaa ne m'atemmude nyinaa so nyɛ: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Obiara a ofi Israelfo anaa ahɔho a wɔabɛtena Israel mu a ɔde ne mma mu bi ma Molek no, okum na wonkum no; asase no sofo nsiw no abo mma onwu.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Na me nso mɛma m'ani asa onipa no, na matwa no afi me man mu akyene, efisɛ ɔde ne mma bi ama Molek de agu me kronkronbea no ho fi na wahura me din kronkron no ho.

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: me de, mɛma m'ani asa onipa no ne n'abusua, na metwa ɔno ne wɔn a wodi n'akyi aguamammɔ kwan so na wodi Molek akyi bɔ aguaman no nyinaa afi wɔn man mu agu.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔdan ne ho kɔ adebisafo anaa asumanfo nkyɛn kodi wɔn akyi aguamammɔ kwan so no, mɛma m'ani asa saa onipa no, na metwa no afi me man mu akyene.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Enti montew mo ho na monyɛ kronkron: na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Na munni m'ahyɛde so na monyɛ, Mene AWURADE a ɔyɛ mo kronkron no.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Sɛ obiara dome n'agya anaa ne na a, okum na wonkum no; wadome n'agya ne ne na: ne mogya gu n'atifi.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima a ɔfa ɔbarima bi yere na ɔne ne yɔnko yere sɛe aware no, okum na wonkum ɔbarima ne ɔbea awaresɛefo no.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne n'agya yere da no, wayi n'agya adagyaw so; okum na wonkum wɔn baanu nyinaa; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne n'ase a ɔyɛ ne ba yere da no, okum na wonkum wɔn baanu nyinaa; wɔayɛ akyide; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbarima bi da ɔbea nna no, wɔn baanu ayɛ akyide, okum na wonkum wɔn; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbarima bi fa ɔbea ne ne na nyinaa a, ɛyɛ abusude: wɔmfa ogya nhyew ɔno ne wɔn nyinaa, na abusude antena mo mu.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbea a ɔkɔ aboa biara ho kɔda hɔ ma no no, kum ɔbea no ne aboa no; okum na wonkum wɔn; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔfa ne nuabea a ɔyɛ n'agya ɔba anaa ne na ɔba na ohu n'adagyaw na ɔbea no nso hu n'adagyaw no, ɛyɛ animguasede, na wontwitwa wɔn ngu, wɔn man mma anim; wayi ne nuabea adagyaw so; ɔnsoa ne mmusu.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbrafo da na oyi n'adagyaw so na obue n'abura ano, na ɔno nso yi ne mogya abura so no, wontwitwa wɔn baanu nyinaa mfi wɔn man mu ngu.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Na nyi wo na nuabea anaa w'agya nuabea adagyaw so, efisɛ wayi ne bogya adagyaw so; wɔnsoa wɔn mmusu.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a ɔne n'agya nua yere da no, wayi n'agya nua adagyaw so, wɔnsoa wɔn bɔne, wɔrenwo mma na wɔawu.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Na obi fa ne nua yere ware a, ɛyɛ ade a ɛho ntew; wayi ne nua adagyaw so, wɔrennya ɔba.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Enti munni m'ahyɛde nyinaa ne m'atemmude nyinaa so na monyɛ, na asase a mede mo rekɔ hɔ akɔtena so no amfe mo angu.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Na mommfa aman a merebetu wɔn mo anim no ahyɛde so; na wɔayɛ eyinom nyinaa na wɔn ho ayɛ me nwini;

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: na mise mo sɛ: Mo na munni wɔn asase so, na mede mema mo sɛ momfa, asase a ɛsen nufusu ne ɛwo no. Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a mayi mo afi amanaman mu no.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Na monyɛ kronkron mma me, efisɛ me AWURADE meyɛ kronkron; na mapaw mo afi aman mu sɛ mommɛyɛ me dea.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a adebisa anaa akɔm honhom wɔ ne mu no, okum na wonkum wɔn; wonsiw wɔn abo; wɔn mogya gu wɔn atifi.

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron mma asɔfo no na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo mu biara nngu ne ho fi funu bi ho ne man mu,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: ne ne nuabea a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun a ɔbɛn no a onnya nnyaa okunu ɛ, ɔno ho na ɔmma ne ho nkum.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ ne nkurɔfo mu nipa titiriw nti, onngu ne ho fi, nanso onnhura ne ho.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Wonnyi wɔn mpampam na wɔnnwɛre wɔn bogyesɛ ano, na wɔnnsesa wɔn honam mu nkamaa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Wɔnyɛ kronkron mma wɔn Nyankopɔn, na wonnhura wɔn Nyankopɔn din ho, efisɛ wɔn na wɔde AWURADE gya afɔre, wɔn Nyankopɔn aduan, no ba; enti wɔnyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Wɔnnware ɔbea aguaman bi anaa nea ne ho ahura, nanso wɔnnware ɔbea a ne kunu ako no, efisɛ ɔyɛ kronkron ma ne Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Na bu no kronkron, efisɛ wo Nyankopɔn aduan na ɔde ba; ɔnyɛ onipa kronkron mma wo, efisɛ kronkron ne me AWURADE a ɔyɛ mo kronkron no.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo babea fi ase bɔ aguaman a, wahura n'agya ho, wɔmfa ogya nhyew no.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: Na ne nuanom mu sɔfo panyin a wɔahwie ɔsra ngo agu n'atifi na wɔde ahyɛ ne nsam sɛ ɔnhyɛ ntade no, ɔmmpɛsɛw ne ti na onnsunsuane ne ntade mu,

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: na ɔnnkɔ funu biara ho, n'agya ne ne na ho po ɔmmma ne ho nnkum.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Na ommfi kronkronbea hɔ, na onnhura ne Nyankopɔn kronkronbea ho, efisɛ ne Nyankopɔn sra ngo dwira no wɔ n'atifi: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Na ɔno de, ɔbaabun na ɔnware;

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: okunafo ne nea wɔako no ne nea ne ho ahura ne aguaman de, ɔnnware eyinom mu biara, na mmom ne man mu baabun na ɔnware.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Na onnhura n'asefo ho ne man mu; na mene AWURADE a meyɛ no kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Na obiara a odi dɛm no mmmɛn, onifuraefo oo, apakye oo, hwensin oo, nea ne honam biribi boro so oo,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: nea ne nan anaa ne nsa abu oo,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: afu oo, nea wakyenkyen oo, nea ɛtɛ si n'ani so oo, nea ɔyare ntwemu oo, ogyatɔfo oo, nea ne hwea aba abɔ oo,

english_verse: They may eat the food offerings presented to me,
translation_verse: Ne Nyankopɔn aduan, akronkronne mu ade kronkron ɛne akronkronne no de, onni bi.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no ho nko na ɔmmma, na afɔremuka no ho na onntwiw mmmɛn, efisɛ dɛm wɔ ne ho; na wanhura m'akronkronne no ho, efisɛ mene AWURADE a meyɛ wɔn kronkron.

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma no ne Israelfo no nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ wɔntwe wɔn ho mfi Israelfo akronkronne ho, na wonnhura me din kronkron no ho, ade a wɔyɛ no kronkron ma me no mu: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo awo ntoatoaso mu ɔbarima biara a ofi mo asefo nyinaa mu a ɔbɛn akronkronne a Israelfo ayɛ no kronkron ama AWURADE, na ne fi wɔ no so no, wobetwa saa ɔkra no afi m'anim akyene. Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Aaron asefo mu ɔbarima biara a ɔyɛ ɔkwatani anaa nea ne ho sen no nnni akronkronne no bi kosi sɛ ne ho bɛtew; na nea ɔka ade a funu agu ɛho fi anaa obi a ne ho nsu afi ne mu,

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: anaa obi a ɔka ade biara a ɛwea a ɛmma ne ho ntew anaa onipa a ne ho fi nti ne ho ntew no.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Na sɛ owia kɔtɔ a, ne ho tew, ɛno akyi ansa na onni akronkronne no bi, efisɛ ɛyɛ n'aduan.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Aboa funu anaa nea wɔatetew ne mu no, onnni mmfa nngu ne ho fi. Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Na wɔnhwɛ m'ahwɛde na wɔansoa ɛho bɔne, na sɛ wohura ho a, wɔanwuwu: Mene AWURADE a meyɛ wɔn kronkron no.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔho biara nnni akronkronne no bi, na nea wabɛtena ɔsɔfo bi nkyɛn anaa ɔpaani nnni akronkronne no bi.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo bi de ne sika tɔ onipa bi a, ɔno de, onni bi, ne nea wɔwoo no ne fi, wɔn na wonni n'aduan no bi.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo babea bi kɔware ɔhɔho bi a, onnni akronkronne soma afɔrebɔde no bi.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo babea bi yɛ okunafo anaasɛ wɔako no, na onni ba, na ɔsan ba n'agya fi sɛ ne mmofraase a, onni n'agya aduan no bi; na ɔhɔho biara de, onnni bi.

english_verse: and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi anhyɛ da, na odi akronkronne no bi a, ɔmfa n'abupɛn anum mu biako mpae so, na ɔnnan akronkronne no mma ɔsɔfo no.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: ade biara a dɛm wɔ ne ho no, mommfa mmma, efisɛ ɛrensɔ ani mma mo.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na wonnhura Israelfo akronkronne a wɔde bɔ afɔre ma AWURADE no ho,

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: na wɔmmma wɔnnsoa asodi bɔne bi wɔn akronkronne no di mu, efisɛ mene AWURADE a ɔyɛ wɔn kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma ne Israelfo nyinaa na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Obiara a ofi Israel fi anaa Israel mu ahɔho mu a ɔde n'ayɛyɛde bɛba, wɔn bɔhyɛ ade biara anaa wɔn ayamye ade biara a wɔde rebrɛ AWURADE abɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre:

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔde asomdwoe afɔre bɛbrɛ AWURADE sɛ ɔde rewie n'aboade ma anaa ayamye ade a efi anantwi anaa nguan mu no, ɔmma enni mu, na ɛnsɔ ani; ennni dɛm biara.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Na nantwi anaa oguan a ne ho biribi boro so anaasɛ watɔ ape no, ayamye afɔre de, fa no bɔ, na aboade de, ɛnsɔ ani.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Na nea wɔapɛtɛw, wɔabɔ, wɔatu, anaa wɔasa no, mommfa mmmrɛ AWURADE, na mo asase so nso monnyɛ sa.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Na ɔnanani bi nsam nso munnnye eyinom mu biara mmfa mmmɛyɛ mo Nyankopɔn aduan, efisɛ wɔn ho aka, dɛm wɔ wɔn ho, ɛrensɔ ani mma mo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: Nantwi, oguanten anaa abirekyi, sɛ wɔwo no a, ɔntena ne na ase nnansɔn, na efi da a ɛto so awotwe de rekɔ no, wɔde yɛ ayɛyɛde ma AWURADE gya afɔre a, ɛbɛsɔ ani.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Na munnkum nantwi anaa oguan ne ne ba nyinaa da koro.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mobɔ aseda afɔre ma AWURADE a, mommɔ no sɛnea ɛbɛma moasɔ ani;

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: da no ara na wonni; munnnyaw bi nnkosi anɔpa: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na munni me mmara nsɛm so na monyɛ. Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: AWURADE afahyɛ ahorow a mompae sɛ ɛnyɛ nhyia kronkron, m'afahyɛ nna no ni:

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Nnansia na wɔnyɛ adwuma, na da a ɛto so ason no yɛ ɔhome mu homeda, wonhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwuma biara, ɛyɛ AWURADE homeda mo tenabea nyinaa mu.

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Na ɛda no monnyɛ adwuma biara, efisɛ ɛyɛ mpata da a wɔpata ma mo, AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Na momfa ogya afɔre mmrɛ AWURADE nnansɔn. Da a ɛto so ason no, munhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwuma den biara.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ mudu asase a mede merema mo no so na mutwa ɛso nnɔbae a, momfa mo nnɔbae fi a edi kan no mmrɛ ɔsɔfo;

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: ne ɛho aduan afɔre: asikresam abupɛn du mu abien a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw, na ɛnyɛ AWURADE gya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam; ne ɛho ahwiesa, bobesa susutoa abupɛn anan mu biako.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Na munnni abodoo anaa awi a wɔato anaasɛ wɔasiw kosi da no ara a mode mo Nyankopɔn ayɛyɛde reba no. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛde mma mo awo ntoatoaso, mo tenabea nyinaa mu.

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Monnyɛ adwuma biara; ɛyɛ daa ahyɛde ma mo awo ntoatoaso, mo tenabea nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Na monkan nna mfa mfi homeda no adekyee da a mode ohim fi no ba no, ɛnyɛ adapɛn ason pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Momfa ohim abodoo abien mfi mo tenabea mmɛma; asikresam abupɛn du mu abien mmɔkaw na wɔmfa nto, na ɛnyɛ aduankan mma AWURADE.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Na momfa nguanten mma ason a wodi mu a wɔadi afe afe ne nantwiforo biako ne adwennini abien nka abodoo no ho; wɔnyɛ AWURADE ɔhyew afɔre, ne ɛho aduan afɔre ne ahwiesa, ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Na momfa ɔpapo biako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔre, ne nguanten mma abien a wɔadi afe afe mmɔ asomdwoe afɔre.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nhim wɔn ne aduankan abodoo no ne nguanten mma abien no na ɛnyɛ AWURADE anim him afɔre: ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE na wɔmfa mma ɔsɔfo no.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Na munhyia da no ara; ɛnyɛ nhyia kronkron, monnyɛ adwumaden biara. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛde mo tenabea nyinaa mu, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Na sɛ mutwa mo asase so nnɔbae a, nwie w'afuw nkwanse de twa, na nni wo nnɔbae no mu mpɛpɛw. Gyaw ma ohiani ne ɔhɔho. Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: ɔsram a ɛto so ason yi ara da a ɛto so du ne mpata da; munhyia nhyia kronkron, na mommrɛ mo ho ase, na momfa ogya afɔre mmrɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ ɔhome mu homeda ma mo, na mommrɛ mo kra ase ɔsram no da a ɛto so akron no anwummere; munni mo homeda no mfi anwummere nkosi anwummere.

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Na ɛda a edi kan no momfa nnua afɛfɛ so ade, berɛw ne nnua kusuu abaa ne nsukɔn so nnua, na mo ani nnye AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim nnansɔn.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo sɛ, ɔsram a ɛto so ason yi da a ɛto so dunum no yɛ asese afahyɛ nnansɔn ma AWURADE.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Nnansɔn na momfa ogya afɔre mmrɛ AWURADE; da a ɛto so awotwe no nyɛ mo nhyia kronkron, na momfa ogya afɔre mmrɛ AWURADE; ɛyɛ afahyɛ awiei, monnyɛ adwumaden biara.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne AWURADE afahyɛ horow a mompae sɛ wonhyia nhyia kronkron no, na wɔmfa ogya afɔre mmrɛ AWURADE, ɔhyew afɔre ne aduan afɔre ne okum afɔre ne ahwiesa, ebiara wɔ ne da mu.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Ɛsono AWURADE home nna no, na ɛsono mo ayɛyɛde, na ɛsono mo aboade nyinaa, na ɛsono mo ayamye ade nyinaa a mode ma AWURADE no.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Nso ɔsram a ɛto so ason no da a ɛto so dunum a moreboa asase so nnɔbae ano no, munni AWURADE nnapɔnna nnansɔn: da a edi kan no yɛ homeda, na ɛda a ɛto so awotwe no yɛ homeda.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Na momfa nni nnapɔnna mma AWURADE, nnansɔn daa afe; ɛyɛ daa ahyɛde ma mo awo ntoatoaso; ɔsram a ɛto so ason no mu na munni nnapɔnna yi.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Asese mu na montena nnansɔn, Israel man mma nyinaa ntena asese mu,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: na mo awo ntoatoaso ahu sɛ miyii Israelfo fii Misraim asase so no, asese mu na mema wɔtenae: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Na Mose paee AWURADE afahyɛ horow no kyerɛɛ Israelfo no.

english_verse: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, or a tooth for a tooth.
translation_verse: Obu nsi obu ananmu, aniwa nsi aniwa ananmu, ɛse nsi ɛse ananmu; sɛnea opiraa onipa no, saa ara na wɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Na nea okum afieboa no, onsi ananmu, na nea okum onipa no, wonkum no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: Hyɛ Israelfo no ma wɔmmrɛ wo ngodua aba a wɔasiw ngo kurunnyenn na wɔmfa nsɔ ɔkanea no, na ɔkanea no nsi so daa;

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Na fa asikresam to tetare dumien; olonka abupɛn du mu abien nyɛ tetare biako.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Na fa sensɛm so akyerɛpɛn abien, asia nyɛ kyerɛpɛn biako, sika amapa ɔpon a ɛho tew no so, AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Na fa ohuamfufu kurunnyenn toto akyerɛpɛn no so, na ɛnyɛ abodoo no so nkae ade, ogya afɔre a wɔsɔ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Daa homeda na onsiesie wɔ AWURADE anim daa yi, ɛyɛ Israelfo fam daa apam.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Na ɛnyɛ Aaron ne ne mma de, na wonni wɔ nea ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, efisɛ ɛyɛ akronkronne mu ade kronkron a efi AWURADE gya afɔre so ma no, ɛyɛ daa kyɛfa. Mmusu so asotwe

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Na Israelni bea no ba no kaa din no ho abususɛm, na ɔdomee. Na wɔde no brɛɛ Mose; nso ne na din de Selomit, Dibri ba a ofi Dan abusuakuw mu;

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: na wɔbɔɔ no dua mu sɛ enkosi sɛ obenya AWURADE anom asɛm aka akyerɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: Fa nea wadome no fi adi kɔ nsra no akyi, na wɔn a wɔtee no nyinaa mfa wɔn nsa ngu n'atifi, na asafo no nyinaa nsiw no abo.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Na nea ɔka AWURADE din ho abususɛm no, okum na wonkum no: osiw na asafo no nyinaa nsiw no abo; ɔhɔho oo, okuromani oo, sɛ ɔka din no ho abususɛm a, wonkum no.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi kum onipa biara a, okum na wonkum no.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Na nea okum afieboa no, onsi ananmu, ɔkra nsi ɔkra ananmu.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: Na nea opira ne yɔnko nipa no, sɛnea ɔyɛe no, wɔnyɛ no saa ara.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Atemmu koro nna hɔ mma mo: ɔhɔho nyɛ sɛ okuromani; na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfo no, na wɔde nea ɔdomee no fii adi kɔɔ nsra no akyi kosiw no abo. Na Israelfo yɛɛ sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Sɛ ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no akyi mfirihyia ano te na tɔ wo yɔnko nkyɛn ade, sɛ nnɔbae mfirihyia ano te na ɔntɔn mma wo.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Sinai bepɔw so sɛ

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Afe a ɛto so aduonum no nyɛ mo ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ Munnnua ade na munntwa ne ntwakae a efifi, na monntetew mo bobe hama a wɔampompan ho no so aba.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ mudu asase a mede merema mo no so a, asase no, nni ɔhome afe mma AWURADE.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: na afe a ɛto so ason no nyɛ ahomegye, mma asase no, ɛnyɛ ɔhome mma AWURADE: nnua w'afuw mu ade, na mpompan wo bobe turo mu nnua ho.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Wo ntwakae a efifi no, ntwa, na wo bobehama a woampempan ho no so akasiaw no, ntetew, ɛnyɛ ahomegye afe mma asase no.

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: anaasɛ n'agya nua anaa n'agya nua ba nnye no, anaasɛ n'abusua mu bogya bi nnye no, anaasɛ ne nsam wɔ biribi a, onnye ne ho.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Na ɔsram a ɛto so ason no da a ɛto so du no, ma wɔnhyɛn torobɛnto yiye, mpata da no na momma wɔnhyɛn torobɛnto ntwam mo asase nyinaa so.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Na monyɛ afe a ɛto so aduonum no afe kronkron, na mompae ahofadi, asase no so, mma ɛsotefo nyinaa; ɛnyɛ mo ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ, na mo mu biara nsan nkɔ n'agyapade mu, na obiara nsan nkɔ n'abusua mu.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Na ɛyɛ ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma mo. Munni mfuw so nnɔbae a ɛba afe no mu no.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: Ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe yi mu no, mo mu biara nsan nkɔ n'agyapade mu.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Mfe no dɔɔso a, to ne bo so, na mfe no sua a, tew ne bo so, efisɛ afe afe nnɔbae na ɔtɔn ma wo.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Na mo mu biara nnni ne yɔnko amim, na suro wo Nyankopɔn; na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Na asase no bɛbɔ n'aduan na moadi amee, na moatena so dwoodwoo.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Na sɛ moka sɛ: Dɛn na yebedi afe a ɛto so ason no mu? Hwɛ, yennua na yentwa yɛn nnɔbae a,

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: ɛnne, mɛhyɛ me nhyira mama mo afe a ɛto so asia no mu, na aba mfe abiɛsa aduan;

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: na mudua aduan afe a ɛto so awotwe no mu a, mubedi nnɔbae dedaw no akosi afe a ɛto so akron no mu; mubedi aduan dedaw no akosi sɛ ne nnɔbae bɛba.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Na wɔnntɔn asase no korakora, efisɛ asase no yɛ me dea na moyɛ me nkyɛn ahɔho ne atubrafo.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Na asase a mudi so nyinaa, momma asase no gye ho kwan.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Sɛ ehia wo nua na ɔtɔn n'ade bi a, ɛnne ne gyefo a ɔyɛ obusuani a ɔbɛn no mmra mmegye nea ne nua tɔnee no.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi nni gyefo na ne nsa aso na wanya nea ɛso gye a,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: ɛnne ommu mfe a ɔtɔnee no ano na ɔnhyɛ nea ɛboro so no ananmu mma nea ɔtɔn maa no no, na ɔnsan mmra n'ade ho.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne nsa anso nea ɛso ananmuhyɛ no so a, ɛnne ade a ɔtɔnee no ntena nea ɔtɔe no nsam nkosi ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no, na efi ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no mu no, ɔnsan mmra n'ade ho.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi tɔn ofi a wɔtena mu wɔ kurow a ɔfasu wɔ ho mu a wɔmma ne gye ho kwan nkosi ne tɔn no akyi afe; nna yi na ɔwɔ ne gye ho kwan.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wannye ma afe mu wie du a, ɛnne, ofi a ɛwɔ kurow a ɔfasu wɔ ho mu no nyɛ nea ɔtɔe no dea korakora, n'awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu; ɔdede no ntumi mmegye bio ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no mu.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na adan a ɛwowɔ nkuraa a ɔfasu nni ho ase de, wommu nka asase no so mfuw ho: wɔmma ne gye ho kwan, na wommegye ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no mu.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Na Lewifo nkurow a ɛyɛ nkurow a wodi so no mu afi de, Lewifo wɔ ne gye ho kwan daa.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Lewifo mu bi annye ne fi a wɔatɔn a ɛwɔ kurow a odi so mu a, ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no mu no ɔmfa n'ade, efisɛ Lewifo nkurow mu afi ne wɔn ade a wodi so, Israelfo mu.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na wɔn nkurow ho mfikyisaase de, wɔnntɔn na ɛyɛ wɔn ade a wodi so daa.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ehia wo nua na ɔpa abaw a, so no mu na ɔntena wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔhɔho ne otudanfo.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Mfa wo sika mma no nnye ɛho mfɛntom, na nhuruw w'aduan a woma no no:

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a miyii mo fii Misraim asase so sɛ mede Kanaan asase merema mo na mayɛ mo Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ehia wo nua a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn na wɔtɔn no ma wo a, nni no nya,

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: na mmom ɔntena wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔpaani ne otudanfo; nsom wo nkosi ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no so.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Ɛno na omfi wo nkyɛn, ɔno ne ne mma nyinaa, na ɔnsan nkɔ n'abusua mu ne n'agyanom ade a wodi so no ho.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛ me nkoa a miyii wɔn fii Misraim asase so; wɔnntɔn wɔn nkoatɔn.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Mfa anyadimɔ nhyɛ no so, na suro wo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: na moagyaw wɔn ama mo mma wɔ mo akyi ayɛ wɔn awunnyade ne ade a wodi so daa, na wɔnsom mo nkoasom; na mo nuanom Israelfo de, obiara mmfa anyadimɔ nnhyɛ ne nua so.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Na sɛ wo nkyɛn hɔho anaa otubrafo bi nsam wɔ biribi, na ehia wo nua a ɔne no wɔ hɔ, na wɔtɔn no ma ɔhɔho a watu abɛtena wo nkyɛn anaa ɔhɔho no abusua mu nipa bi a,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: ɛnne ne tɔn akyi no wɔmma ne gye ho kwan; ne nuanom mu biako nnye no,

english_verse: by paying your owner for the number of years you would still be a slave before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na ɔne nea ɔtɔɔ no no mmu akontaa mfi afe a wɔtɔn no maa no no so nkosi ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no so, na ne tiade nyɛ sɛnea mfe no dodow te, ɔne no asetena nyɛ sɛ ɔpaani nna.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Ɔne no asetena nyɛ sɛ ɔpaani de afe afe: ɔmmfa anyadimɔ nnhyɛ no so wɔ w'anim.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔamfa eyinom so annye no a, ɛnne ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no mu, ɔmfa ne ho nkodi, ɔno ne ne mma nyinaa.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Na me na Israelfo yɛ me nkoa; me nkoa a miyii wɔn fii Misraim asase so ne wɔn: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Munni me home nna, na munsuro me kronkronbea: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: ɛnne mɛma osu atotɔ ama mo ne bere mu, na asase no ama ne nnɔbae, na mfuw mu nnua asow aba;

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Na mɛma ɔmannwoe aba asase no so, na moada na obiara anyi mo hu; na mɛsɛe mmoa bɔne afi asase no so, na nkrante remfa mo asase so.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Na mobɛka mo atamfo agu, na wɔatotɔ mo anim wɔ nkrante ano;

english_verse: Your barns will overflow with grain each year.
translation_verse: Na mubedi aburow ne awi a akyɛ no, na foforo no nti moayi dedaw no agu.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Na mɛdan m'anim mama mo, na mɛma moawo na moadɔ, na mɛma me ne mo apam no agyina.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Na mede me tenabea mesi mo mu, na mo ho renyɛ me kra nwini.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Na mɛnantew mo mu, na mayɛ mo Onyankopɔn, na mo nso moayɛ me ɔman.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a miyii mo fii Misraim asase so sɛ monnyɛ nkoa bio, na mibubuu mo kɔndua na mema monantewee tee no. Asoɔden so akatua

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: na sɛ mopa m'ahyɛde, na m'atemmude yɛ mo kra nwini, na moanni me mmara nsɛm nyinaa so na mubu m'apam no so a,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: me nso nea mɛyɛ mo ni: Mɛma akomatude abɛto mo, samanwaw ne atiridii a ɛbɛma mo aniwa ayɛ siamoo na mo kra atotɔ piti, na mubedua mo adua kwa, na mo atamfo abedi.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Na mɛma m'ani asa mo, na moadi mo atamfo anim nkogu na wɔn a wokyi mo ahyɛ mo so, na obi ntaa mo po a, mobeguan.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Na sɛ eyinom mu moantie me ara a, ɛnne mo bɔne nti mɛtwe mo aso mpɛn ason maka ho,

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: na mabubu mo ahoɔden ahokyerɛ no. Na mɛyɛ mo soro sɛ dade, na mo asase ayɛ sɛ kɔbere,

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: na mo tumi asa kwa, na mo asase remma ne nnɔbae, na asase no so nnua rensow aba.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: Na sɛ mo ne me di asi ara na mompɛ sɛ mutie me a, mɛkɔ so mabɔ mo mpɛn ason sɛ mo bɔne te no.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Na mɛsoma wuram mmoa aba mo mu, na wɔagye mo nsam mma, na wɔasɛe mo afieboa, na wɔama moasua, na mo akwan ayɛ akwan fo.

english_verse: I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse.
translation_verse: ɛnne me nso me ne mo bedi asi, na me nso mo bɔne nti mabɔ mo mpɛn asɔn.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Na mede aweredi nkrante a ebedi m'apam no so were mɛba mo so, na moaboaboa mo ho ano akɔ mo nkurow mu, na mɛma ɔyaredɔm aba mo mu, na wɔde mo ahyɛ ɔtamfo nsa.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Na mebubu mo aduan dua, na mmea du ato mo abodoo fononoo biako mu, na wɔakari mo abodoo ama mo, na mubedi na moremmee.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: ɛnne mede abufuhyew ne mo bedi asi, na me nso mo bɔne no nti matwe mo aso mpɛn asɔn.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Na mubedi mo mmammarima nam, na mo mmabea nam nso moadi.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Na mɛsɛe mo sorɔnsorɔmmea, na matwitwa mo wia adum no agu, na matotow mo afunu agu mo abosonhunu afunu no so, na mo ho ayɛ me kra nwini.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na megu mo nkurow mayɛ no amamfo na masɛe mo kronkronbea, na merennye mo aduhuam no hua.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Na me ara mɛsɛe asase no ma mo atamfo a wɔbɛtena so no ani so ayɛ wɔn yaa;

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: na mo de, mɛbɔ mo apete wiase amanaman mu, na matwe nkrante madi mo akyi, na mo asase bɛda ntuw, na mo nkurow ayɛ fo.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Nna a ɛso bɛda ntuw nyinaa na ɛbɛhome, sɛ nna dodow a anhome, mo home mmere mu, bere a mote so no.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Na mubewuwu wɔ wiase amanaman mu, na mo atamfo asase amene mo.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na mo mu wɔn a wɔbɛka no ho behia wɔn wɔn amumɔyɛmu, mo atamfo asase so, na wɔn agyanom amumɔyɛ nso nti wɔn ho behia wɔn sɛ wɔn [agyanom no] ara.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: me nso me ne wɔn dii asi, na mede wɔn kɔɔ wɔn atamfo asase so; na sɛ afei wɔn koma momonoto no bɛbrɛ ase na wɔapene wɔn amumɔyɛ so asotwe no so a,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: ɛnne mɛkae me ne Yakob apam no, ne me ne Isak apam no nso; na ɛne Abraham apam no nso mɛkae, na mɛkae asase no.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Na asase no de, wobegyaw na anya ne home bere mu ahotɔ, sɛ wonni so nti ada ntuw; na wɔn de, esiane sɛ wɔpaa m'atemmude na m'ahyɛde yɛɛ wɔn kra nwini nti, wobenya wɔn amumɔyɛ so asotwe.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no, sɛ wɔwɔ wɔn atamfo asase so mpo a, merempa wɔn, na wɔn ho renyɛ me nwini na masɛe wɔn korakora, na mabu me ne wɔn ntam apam no so; na mene AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Na wɔn nti mɛkae apam a me ne wɔn agyanom a miyii wɔn fii Misraim asase so, wiase amanaman nyinaa anim, pamee sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn no: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne ahyɛde ne atemmude ne mmara a AWURADE nam Mose so de too ɔno ne Israelfo ntam, Sinai bepɔw so no.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ obi hyɛ bɔ titiriw bi ma AWURADE, nea ɛne nnipa bo yɛ pɛ a,

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: na sɛ wadi mfe aduosia anaasɛ nea ɛboro saa na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima a, wo bo nyɛ nnwetɛbona dunum, na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbea a, nnwetɛbona du.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Na asase no so aduan ntotoso du du a efi asase so aduan ne nnua so aba mu no nyinaa yɛ AWURADE dea; ɛyɛ kronkron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: Wɔnnsakra, na wɔmmfa papa nnsesa bɔne anaasɛ bɔne nnsesa papa; na sɛ ɛba sɛ wɔde aboa sesa aboa a, ɛnne ɛno ne nea wɔde sesae no nyinaa nyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: But if you decide to buy it back, you must pay an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛnea ɔyɛɛ no kronkron no begye ne fi no a, ɔmfa wo bo no dwetɛ abupɛn anum mu biako nto so, na ɛnyɛ ne de.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ohia ahia no a enti ontumi mma wo bo a wobɔe no a, wɔmfa no mmegyina ɔsɔfo no anim, na ɔsɔfo no mmɔ no bo; sɛnea nea wahyɛ bɔ no nsa bɛso so.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛyɛ afieboa a wɔde bi brɛ AWURADE sɛ ayɛyɛde no bi a, ade a wɔde bi brɛ AWURADE nyinaa yɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛyɛ aboa biara a ne ho ntew a wɔmmfa no mmrɛ AWURADE sɛ ayɛyɛde a, wɔmfa aboa no mmegyina ɔsɔfo anim,

english_verse: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ogye a, ɛnne ɔmfa wo bo no abupɛn anum mu biako nka ho.

english_verse: If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi yɛ ne fi kronkron sɛ ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE a, sɛ eye oo, enye oo, ɔsɔfo no mmɔ ne bo; sɛnea ɔsɔfo no bɛbɔ no, saa ara na ennyina.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi yɛ n'asase a odi so kronkron ma AWURADE a, wo bo bɔ no nyɛ sɛ n'aba te; bɔ atoko a wodua homer biako so bo nnwetɛbona aduonum.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Sɛ ofi ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe so yɛ n'asase no kronkron a, ennyina wo bo no so;

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: na sɛ ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no akyi na ɔyɛ n'asase no kronkron a, ɛnne ɔsɔfo no mmu n'akontaa mma no sɛ mfe a aka na ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no adu no te no, na wɔntew wo bo no so.

english_verse: If you decide to buy back the land, you must pay the price plus an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛ nea ɔyɛɛ asase no kronkron no pɛ sɛ ogye a, ɔmfa wo bo no dwetɛ abupɛn anum mu biako nto so, na ɛntena ne nsam;

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: na sɛ asase no nni wura ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no mu a, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE, sɛ asase a wɔahyira so de ama; ɛnyɛ ɔsɔfo no agyapade.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛyɛ asase a ɔtɔe na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ no kronkron ma AWURADE na ɛnyɛ awunnyade a,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: ɔsɔfo no mmu akontaa mma no nkyerɛ no bo no mu nea ɛbɛka akosi ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no so, na ɔmma wo bo a wobɔe no da no ara; ɛyɛ kronkron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe no so, asase no nsan nkɔyɛ nea ɔtɔe ne nkyɛn a ɛyɛ n'asase a odi so no dea.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na wo bo a wobɛbɔ nyinaa nyɛ sɛnea kronkronbea dwetɛbona no te; gera aduonu yɛ dwetɛbona biako.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: Na afieboa mu mmakan a wɔwo ma AWURADE no nko de, obi nnyɛ wɔn kronkron; nantwi oo, oguan oo, ɛyɛ AWURADE dea.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: Nso ahyirade biara a obi behyira so ama AWURADE, ade a ɔwɔ nyinaa mu no, onipa oo, aboa oo, n'asase a odi so oo, ɛno de wɔnntɔn, na wonnnye nso; ahyirade biara yɛ akronkronne mu adekronkron ma Awurade.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Obiara a wabu no kumfo no, wonnnye no; okum na wonkum no.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ogye ne ntotoso du du no bi a, ɔmfa abupɛn anum mu biako nto so.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Na anantwi ne nguan mu ntotoso du du nyinaa, nea ɛfa oguanhwɛfo poma ase nyinaa mu nea ɛto so du du no, ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Wɔmmpaw papa ne bɔne mu, na wɔnnsesa ebi nso; na sɛ obi bɛsesa ebi a, ɛnne ɛno ne nea wɔde resesa no nyinaa nyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE; wonnnye.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne mmara nsɛm a AWURADE de hyɛɛ Mose, Sinai bepɔw so, ma ɔde kɔmaa Israelfo no.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na Israelfo fii Misraim asase so akyi afe a ɛto so abien no, ɔsram a ɛto so abien no da a edi kan no, AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Sinai sare so wɔ ahyiae ntamadan no mu sɛ:

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: efi wɔn a wɔadi mfe aduonu so de rekɔ, Israel mu obiara a obetumi akɔ ɔsa. Wo ne Aaron nkan wɔn sɛ wɔn dɔm te,

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron faa mmarima a wɔabobɔ wɔn din yi,

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: na wohyiaa asafo no nyinaa boaa ano, ɔsram a ɛto so abien no da a edi kan, na wɔkaa wɔn awo ntoatoaso sɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn mpanyimfi te, wɔn din dodow, efi wɔn a wɔadi mfirihyia aduonu so de rekɔ, mmiako mmiako;

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no yɛɛ sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na Lewifo no de, wɔmmɔ adanse tenabea no ho nsra nhyia, na AWURADE abufuw amma Israelfo asafo no so; na Lewifo no nkura adanse tenabea no sohwɛ mu.

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Na Lewi mma de, sɛ wɔn agyanom abusuakuw te no, wɔankan wɔn amfra wɔn. Lewifo no ahyɛde

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Lewi abusuakuw no nko de, nkan wɔn, nanso mmu wɔn dodow ano mfra Israelfo,

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no mmobɔ nsra wɔn ara nsra mu ne wɔn afrankaa ho sɛ wɔn dɔm horow no te mmiako mmiako.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: Israelfo no mmobɔ nsra wɔn mu biara wɔ n'ankasa frankaa ho, ɛne wɔn mpanyimfi nsɛnkyerɛnne; ahyiae ntamadan no ntentenso na wɔmmɔ nsra no nhyia.

english_verse: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, ɔpeduonum anan ne ahannan.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, ɔpeduonum ason ne ahanan.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no yɛ, ɔpeduonum akron ne ahasa.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn, ɔpeduanan anum ne ahansia aduonum.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: Afei ahyiae ntamadan no ne Lewifo nsra no ntu nni nsra horow no ntam. Sɛnea wɔbɔ nsra no, saa ara na wontu, wɔn nyinaa wɔ wɔn dibea sɛ wɔn afrankaa no te.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, ɔpeduasa abien ne ahanu.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Eyinom ne Israelfo a wɔkan wɔn, sɛ wɔn mpanyimfi te; nsra ahorow no mu wɔn a wɔkan wɔn nyinaa, sɛ wɔn dɔm ahorow no te, si ɔpehansia ne abiɛsa ne ahanum aduonum.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, ɔpeduasa anum ne ahanan.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, ɔpeduanan biako ne ahanum.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ne dɔm a wɔkan wɔn no, ɔpeduonum abiɛsa ne ahanan.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Na Lewifo no de, wɔankan wɔn amfra Israelfo no, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no yɛe, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa. Wɔbɔɔ nsra, sɛ wɔn afrankaa no te, na saa nso na wotui, wɔn nyinaa sɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn mpanyimfi te no.

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne Aaron mma din: Nadab a ɔyɛ abakan, ne Abihu, Eleasar ne Itamar.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Na Nadab ne Abihu wuwui, AWURADE anim, sɛ wɔde ananagya bi kɔɔ AWURADE anim, Sinai sare so no, na wɔannya mma; na Eleasar ne Itamar dii asɔfo wɔn agya Aaron anim.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: They are assigned to help Aaron and his sons,
translation_verse: Na fa Lewifo no ma Aaron ne ne mma no, wɔde wɔn ama no koraa afi Israelfo mu.

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma no de, yi wɔn si hɔ na wonkura wɔn asɔfodi no mu; na ɔhɔho biara a otwiw bɛn ho no, wonkum no.

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose, Sinai sare so sɛ:

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: Kan Lewi mma no sɛnea wɔn mpanyimfi ne wɔn mmusua te, mmarima a wɔadi ɔsram ne akyiri nyinaa, kan wɔn.

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne Lewi mma sɛ wɔn din te: Gerson, Kohat ne Merari.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Na Kohat mma sɛ wɔn mmusua te ne: Amram ne Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Na Merari mma sɛ wɔn mmusua te ne: Mahli ne Musi. Eyinom ne Lewi mmusua no sɛ wɔn mpanyimfi te.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gerson de ne Libni abusua ne Simei abusua; eyinom ne Gersonfo mmusua no.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Na nea Gerson mma no nhwɛso wɔ, ahyiae ntamadan no, ne tenabea no ne ntamadan no, ne nkataso ne ahyiae ntamadan no ano nkataano no,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: ne adiwo no ho mmɔhɔɔ no ne adiwo a etwa tenabea no ne afɔremuka no ho hyia no ano nkataano ne ne ntampehama, ntamadan no ho adwuma nyinaa.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Na Kohat de ne Amramfo abusua, Iseharfo abusua, Hebronfo abusua ne Usielfo abusua; eyinom ne Kohatfo mmusua no.

english_verse: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Kohatfo mmusua no agya fi bapɔmma ne Usiel ba Elisafan.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Na nea wɔnhwɛ ne adaka no ɔpon no, kaneadua no afɔremuka no ne kronkronbea hɔ nneɛma a wɔde som no nyinaa ne mmɔhɔɔ no ne ɛho adwuma nyinaa.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Na Lewi mmapɔmma mu panyin ne ɔsɔfo Aaron ba Eleasar, ɔne wɔn a wɔhwɛ kronkronbea no so no mu panyin.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Merari de ne Mahli abusua ne Musi abusua; eyinom ne Merari mmusua no.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Merari mmusua no agya fi bapɔmma ne Abihail ba Suriel. Tenabea no nkyɛn na wɔmmɔ wɔn nsra atifi fam.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wɔmmɔ nsra, ahyiae ntamadan no anim, apuei no, ne Mose ne Aaron ne ne mmammarima a wɔhwɛ kronkronbea no so ma Israelfo no; na ɔhɔho a otwiw bɛn no, wonkum no.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was
translation_verse: Lewifo a wɔkan wɔn a Mose ne Aaron nam AWURADE asɛm so kan wɔn sɛ wɔn mmusua te no, mmarima a wɔadi ɔsram ne akyiri no nyinaa si ɔpeduonu abien. Lewifo gye mmakan

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ Kan Israelfo mu mmakan mmarima a wɔadi ɔsram ne akyiri nyinaa, na bu wɔn din dodow ano;

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: na fa Lewifo ma me, mene AWURADE fa si Israelfo mu mmakan nyinaa ananmu, ne Lewifo afieboa, si Israelfo afieboa mmakan nyinaa ananmu.

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Na Mose kanee Israelfo mu mmakan nyinaa sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: Fa Lewifo si Israelfo mu mmakan nyinaa ananmu ne Lewifo afieboa si wɔn afieboa ananmu, na Lewifo nyɛ me dea: Mene AWURADE.

english_verse: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra
translation_verse: Na Israelfo mmakan mu nnipa ahanu aduɔsɔn abiɛsa a wɔboro Lewifo so no agyede de,

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: gye obiara nnwetɛbona anum, sɛnea kronkronbea dwetɛbona te na gye, gera aduonu nyɛ dwetɛbona biako;

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: na fa dwetɛ a ɛyɛ wɔn a wɔboro wɔn so no agyede no ma Aaron ne ne mma.

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so de wɔn a wɔagye wɔn no ti dwetɛ no maa Aaron ne ne mma, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Eyi ne Kohat mma no ahyiae ntamadan no mu som adwuma: akronkronne mu ade kronkron no.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Na sɛ nsra no rebetu a, Aaron ne ne mma mmra mmeyi ntwamu mmɔhɔɔ no, na wɔmfa nkata adanse adaka no ho,

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: na wɔmfa sukraman nhoma nkataso nto so, na wɔmfa bibitama mu ntrɛw so, na wɔmfa ne mpoma no nwurawura mu.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa bibitama nkata anim pon no so, na wɔmfa nsanka no ne nsankawa ne nkora ne nkuruwa a wɔde hwie no nsisi so, na daa abodoo no nsisi so;

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa bibitama nkata kaneadua no ne n'akanea ne n'adabaw ne ne nso nkukuwa ne ne ngo ntoa a wɔde som no nyinaa ho.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa ɛno ne ɛho ade nyinaa nhyɛ sukraman nhoma nkataso mu, na wɔmfa nto mpata so.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa bibitama ntrɛw sika afɔremuka no so, na wɔmfa sukraman nhoma nkataso nkata ho, na wɔmfa ne mpoma nwurawura mu.
