english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa ɔsom nneɛma a wɔde som kronkronbea hɔ no nyinaa nhyɛ bibitama mu, na wɔmfa sukraman nhoma nkataso nkata ho, na wɔmfa nto mpata so.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Na afɔremuka no, wɔnsesaw so nso ngu, na wɔmfa ntama a ɛbere dum ntrɛw so,

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: na wɔmfa ɛho nneɛma a wɔde som so nyinaa, nsrama kukuwa ne adinam ne sofi ne nkora no, afɔremuka no ho nneɛma nyinaa, na wɔmfa sukraman nhoma nkataso ntrɛw so, na wɔmfa ɛho mpoma no nwurawura mu.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Na nsra no rebetu na Aaron ne ne mma no wie akronkronne no ne kronkronbea nneɛma no nyinaa ho kata a, ɛno akyi ansa na Kohat mma no nhyɛn mu nkɔma so, na wɔanka akronkronne no amma wɔanwuwu. Eyi ne Kohat mma adwuma, ahyiae ntamadan no mu.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Aaron ba Eleasar ahwɛde ne kanea ngo ne nnuhuam ne daa aduan afɔre ne ɔsra ngo no, tenabea no nyinaa ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa ne kronkronbea hɔ ne ɛho nneɛma sohwɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: wɔn na wɔnsoa: tenabea no ntama no ne ahyiae ntamadan no, ne nkataso ne sukraman nkataso a ɛwɔ so no, ne ahyiae ntamadan no ano nkataano no,

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: ne adiwo no ho mmɔhɔɔ ne adiwo a etwa tenabea ne afɔremuka no ho hyia no abobow ano nkataano no, ne ne ntampehama ne ɛho adwuma ho nneɛma nyinaa; na wɔnyɛ ho adwuma a ehia sɛ wɔyɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Eyi ne Gersonfo mma mmusua no ahyiae ntamadan no mu som adwuma, na wɔn adwuma no sohwɛ wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ba Itamar nsam.

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Na eyi ne nnosoa a wɔnsoa sɛ wɔn ahyiae ntamadan no mu adwuma: Tenabea no ntaaboo ne ne mmeae ne n'adum ne ne nnyinaso,

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: ne adiwo a ehyia ho no adum ne ne nnyinaso ne ne mmofunnua ne ne ntampehama ne ɛho nneɛma ne nea ɛkeka ho nyinaa; na monkan nneɛma a wɔnsoa no mmobɔ din mfa nhyɛ wɔn nsa.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Eyi ne Merari mma mmusua no adwuma, wɔn ahyiae ntamadan no mu adwuma nyinaa, wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ba Itamar nsam.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Sɛnea AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛe no na wɔde wɔn sisii wɔn som adwuma ne wɔn nnosoa ne nea wɔde hyehyɛɛ wɔn nsa no so mmiako mmiako; enti wɔkan wɔn sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Ɔbarima o, ɔbea o, muntu no, nsra no akyi na muntu wɔn nkɔ, na wɔangu mo nsra a mete mu wɔ mo mu no ho fi.

english_verse: The Israelites obeyed the Lord's instructions. The Penalty for Committing a Crime (Leviticus
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no yɛɛ saa, na wotutuu wɔn kɔɔ nsra no akyi; sɛnea AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose no, saa na Israelfo no yɛe. Asodide

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo sɛ: Ɔbarima anaa ɔbea yɛ bɔne tia onipa bi de fom AWURADE a,

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: ɔmpae mu nka ne bɔne a wayɛ no, na ontua n'asodide no aboten mfa abupɛn anum mu biako nto so, na ɔmfa mma onipa a wayɛ bɔne atia no no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na sɛ onipa no awu na onni obusuani a ɔbɛn no bi a wɔde asodide no bɛma no a, asodide no yɛ AWURADE dea, na wɔmfa mma ɔsɔfo no nka mpata dwennini a wɔde rebɛpata ama no no ho.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Na obiara akronkronne a ɔde ba no, ɛnyɛ ne de bio; na nea ɔde ma ɔsɔfo no nyɛ ɔsɔfo no dea. Ninkuntwe ho asɛm

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: na ninkuntwe honhom ba ɔbarima no so na ɔtwe ne yere no ho ninkunu, na ɔbea no agu ne ho fi, ampa anaasɛ ninkuntwe honhom ba no so na ɔtwe ne yere ho ninkunu na ɔbea no nguu ne ho fi a,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: ɛnne ɔbarima no mfa ne yere no mmra ɔsɔfo no anim. Na ɔmfa ɔbea no ho ayɛyɛde, atokosam olonka abupɛn du mu biako, mmra: onngu so ngo nanso ɔnnto so ohuamfufu, na ɛyɛ ninkuntwe ho aduan afɔre, nkae aduan afɔre a wɔde kae amumɔyɛ.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ɔbea no mmra mmegyina AWURADE anim.

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nsaw nsu kronkron ngu kuku bi mu, na ɔnsaw tenabea hɔ fam mfutuma bi, na ɔmfa ngu nsu no mu;

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nkyerɛw nnome yi ngu nhoma so, na ɔnhohoro ngu nsu nwenenwene no mu,

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: na ɔmma ɔbea no nnom nsu nwenenwene a ɛde nnome ba no, na nsu a ɛde nnome ba no nkɔ no mu nkɔyɛ nwenenwene.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nnye ɔbea no nsam ninkuntwe ho aduan afɔre no, na onhim aduan afɔre no AWURADE anim, na ɔmfa mmɛn afɔremuka no;

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no nsaw aduan afɔre no nsa ma ɛnyɛ nkae ade, na ɔnhyew wɔ afɔremuka no so, na ɛno akyi no ɔmma ɔbea no nnom nsu no.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔma ɔnom, na sɛ, wagu ne ho fi na wayɛ ne kunu bɔne a, ɛnne nsu a ɛde nnome ba no bɛhyɛn ne mu akɔyɛ no nwene, na ne yafunu ahon na n'asen atotɔ mu, na ɔbea no adan nnome, ne man mu.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbea no ho nguu fi ɛ, na ne ho tew a, ɛnne ne ho bɛyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ, na wanya mma.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: anaasɛ ninkuntwe honhom ba ɔbarima bi so na ɔtwe ne yere ho ninkunu a, ɔmfa ɔbea no mmegyina AWURADE anim, na ɔsɔfo no nyɛ no sɛnea mmara yi hyɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima no ho bɛyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ afi amumɔyɛ no ho, na ɔbea no asoa n'amumɔyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo no, Sɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea bi de ne ho kɔhyɛ ahotuafo mu hyɛ bɔ sɛ obetua ne ho ade de ne ho ama AWURADE a,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: ɛnne ontua ne ho bobesa ne nsa nyinaa; ɔnnnom bobesa a akaw ne nsa a akaw, na ade biara a wɔde bobe aba ayɛ nso, ɔnnnom, na bobe aba momono ne guanee nso, onnni;

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: N'ahotua bɔhyɛnna nyinaa mu no oyiwan bi nnka ne ti; ɔnyɛ kronkron nkosi sɛ nna a otuaa ne ho maa AWURADE no bewie du; onsiw atimum.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: Nna a watua ne ho ade ama AWURADE no, ɔnnkɔ funu ho.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi kowu mpofirim wɔ ne ho afrɛso ma ogu n'ahotua ti ho fi a, onyi ne ti n'ahodwira da a ɛne da a ɛto so ason no.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɛda a ɛto so awotwe no, ɔmfa nturukuku abien anaa mmorɔnoma mma abien mmrɛ ɔsɔfo no, ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa biako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔre, na biako nso ɔmfa nyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, na ɔmpata mma no sɛ funu no nti wafom, na ɔnyɛ ne ti kronkron bio da no ara.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Na ontua ne ho ade mma AWURADE n'ahotua nna no, na ɔmfa oguanten ba a wadi afe mmra mmɛbɔ asodi ho afɔre; na kan nna no ayera, efisɛ n'ahotua no ho agu fi.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: Na eyi ne ɔhotuafo ho mmara, ɛda a n'ahotua nna wie du no, wɔmfa no mmra ahyiae ntamadan no ano,

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa n'ayɛyɛde mmrɛ AWURADE: oguanten ba a wadi afe a odi mu biako mmɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre, ne oguammere biako a wadi afe a odi mu nso mmɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre, ne odwennini biako a odi mu mmɛbɔ asomdwoe afɔre;

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: ne apiti abodoo, asikresam tetare a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw ne apiti fam a wɔasra ho ngo kɛntɛn ne ɛho aduan afɔre ne ahwiesa.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa mmra AWURADE anim, na ɔmmɔ ne bɔne ho afɔre ne ne hyew afɔre.

english_verse: Then he will sacrifice the ram and offer the wine, grain, and bread.
translation_verse: Na ɔmfa odwennini no mmɔ AWURADE asomdwoe afɔre mpae apiti kɛntɛn no so, na ɔsɔfo no mmɔ n'aduan afɔre ne n'ahwiesa afɔre.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Na ɔhotuafo no nyi n'ahotua ti, ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na ɔmfa n'ahotua ti nwi no ngu asomdwoe afɔre no ase gya mu.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa odwennini no basa a wɔanoa ne kɛntɛn no mu apiti tetare biako ne apiti fam biako ngu ɔhotuafo a wayi n'ahotua ti no nsam;

english_verse: These are the requirements for Nazirites. However, if you can afford to offer more, you must do so. The Blessing for the People
translation_verse: Eyi ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma ɔhotuafo a n'ahotua no nti wahyɛ n'ayɛyɛde ho bɔ ama AWURADE, de ka nea ne nsa bɛso so ho; sɛ ne bɔ a ɔhyɛe te no, saa na ɔmfa n'ahotua mmara so nyɛ. Nhyira a wɔmfa nhyira ɔman no

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Sɛ munhyira Israelfo nka nkyerɛ wɔn ni:

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: AWURADE nhyira wo, na ɔnhwɛ wo so;

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: AWURADE ntew n'anim nkyerɛ wo, na ɔnnom wo;

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: AWURADE mma n'ani so nhwɛ wo, na ɔmma wo asomdwoe.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa me din nto Israelfo so, na me de, mehyira wɔn.

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Na Mose wiee tenabea no si, na ɔsraa ho ngo, na ɔyɛɛ no ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa ne afɔremuka no ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa kronkron, na ɔsraa ho ngo na ɔyɛɛ ho kronkron no,

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Israel mmapɔmma, wɔn mpanyimfi so atitiriw a wɔyɛ mmusuakuw no asafohempanyin a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔkan wɔn no so no de ayɛyɛde bae.

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: Na wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛde baa AWURADE anim: nteaseɛnam a ɛso wɔ nkataso asia ne anantwi dumien; mmapɔmma baanu de teaseɛnam biako, na obiara de nantwi biako; na wɔde baa tenabea no anim.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: Gye wɔn ayɛyɛde no, na wɔmfa nyɛ ahyiae ntamadan no ho adwuma, na fa ma Lewifo no, obiara sɛnea n'adwuma te.

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Na Mose de nteaseɛnam ne anantwi no maa Lewifo no,

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: na ɔde nteaseɛnam anan ne anantwi awotwe maa Merari mma, sɛ wɔn adwuma te, wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ba Itamar nsam;

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: na Kohat mma de, wamma wɔn bi, efisɛ wɔn adwuma ne sɛ wɔsoa kronkronbea no ho nneɛma no wɔn mmati so.

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Na mmapɔmma no de afɔremuka no adwirade bae, da a wɔsraa ho ngo no; na wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛde baa afɔremuka no anim.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Mmapɔmma no mfa wɔn afɔremuka dwira ho ayɛyɛde no mmra mmiako mmiako, obiara ne ne da.

english_verse: And so when the altar was dedicated to the Lord, these twelve leaders brought the following gifts:
translation_verse: na asomdwoe afɔre anantwi no nyinaa si anantwinini aduonu anan, adwennini aduosia, mpapo aduosia, nguanten mma a wɔadi afe afe aduosia. Eyi ne afɔremuka no sra akyi adwirade.

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: ɔpapo biako a wɔde rekɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔre;

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Da a ɛto so akron no, Benyamin mma bapɔmma Gideoni ba Abidan.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Na Mose hyɛn ahyiae ntamadan no mu sɛ ɔne AWURADE rekɔkasa no, ɔtee ɛnne no sɛ ɛkasa kyerɛ no fi mpata agua a ɛwɔ adanse adaka no so no so wɔ kerubim abien no ntam; na Awurade kasa kyerɛɛ no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Aaron sɛ Wode akanea no sisi akaneadua no so a, akanea ason no nnɛw wɔ so nkyerɛ anim.

english_verse: Aaron obeyed and placed the lamps as he was told.
translation_verse: Na Aaron yɛɛ saa: ɔde akanea no sisii kaneadua no so kyerɛɛ anim, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Na eyi ne kaneadua no yɛbea: Ɛyɛ sika a wɔaboro; efi n'ase kosi ne nhwiren so, ɛyɛ sika a wɔaboro ara nko; sɛ nhwɛso a AWURADE de kyerɛɛ Mose no te no, saa ara na ɔyɛɛ kaneadua no. Lewifo dwira

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Na sɛnea dwira wɔn ni: Fa bɔneyi nsu pete wɔn so, na wɔmfa oyiwan nyiyi wɔn ho nyinaa, na wɔnhoro wɔn ntade, na wɔmfa ntew wɔn ho.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na wɔmfa nantwinini ne ɛho aduan afɔre, asikresam a wɔde ngo afɔtɔw; na fa nantwinini foforo nso a wɔde bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na fa Lewifo no bra ahyiae ntamadan no ano, na ma Israelfo asafo mu no nyinaa mmɛbɔ gua;

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: na fa Lewifo no bra AWURADE anim, na Israelfo no mfa wɔn nsa ngu Lewifo no so:

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: na Aaron nhim Lewifo no, AWURADE anim, sɛ ohim afɔre a efi Israelfo nsam, na wɔntena ase nyɛ AWURADE som adwuma.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Na Lewifo no mfa wɔn nsa ngu anantwi no atifi, na fa biako bɔ bɔne ho afɔre, na fa biako nso bɔ AWURADE hyew afɔre, na pata ma Lewifo no.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: Na fa Lewifo no gyina Aaron ne ne mma no anim, na him wɔn yɛ ohim afɔre ma AWURADE.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Na tew Lewifo no fi Israelfo mu, na Lewifo no mmɛyɛ me de.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ɛno akyi ansa na Lewifo no mmra mmɛsom ahyiae ntamadan no ho. Na tew wɔn ho, na him wɔn yɛ ohim afɔre,

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: efisɛ ɔma na wɔde wɔn ama me afi Israelfo mu; mede wɔn masi ade a ebue yafunu ano nyinaa, Israelfo mu mmakan nyinaa, ananmu mafa.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo mu mmakan nyinaa, nnipa mu oo, afieboa mu oo, wɔyɛ me dea: da a mebobɔɔ Misraim asase so mmakan nyinaa no na meyɛɛ wɔn kronkron mefae;

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: na mafa Lewifo no masi Israelfo mu mmakan nyinaa ananmu;

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: na mede Lewifo no mama Aaron ne ne mma sɛ akyɛde afi Israelfo mu sɛ wɔnyɛ Israelfo adwuma, ahyiae ntamadan no mu, na wɔmpata mma Israelfo, na Israelfo no rebɛn kronkronbea hɔ a, ɔhaw bi amma wɔn so.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron ne Israelfo asafo mu no nyinaa yɛɛ Lewifo no sa; sɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose maa Lewifo no nyinaa no, saa na Israelfo no yɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Lewifo no yii wɔn ho bɔne, na wɔhoroo wɔn ntade, na Aaron him wɔn sɛ ohim afɔre, AWURADE anim, na Aaron pata maa wɔn de dwiraa wɔn ho.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ɛno akyi na Lewifo no bae bɛyɛɛ wɔn som adwuma ahyiae ntamadan no mu, Aaron ne ne mma no anim; sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose, Lewifo no ho no, saa na wɔyɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Nanso wonni mmoa wɔn nuanom no, ahyiae ntamadan no mu, nkura ɛsohwɛ no mu bi, na ɔsom adwuma no na wɔnnyɛ. Saa na hyehyɛ Lewifo no, wɔn asɛde no ho.

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Sinai sare so, wɔn Misraim asase so fi afe a ɛto so abien sram a edi kan no mu sɛ

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Ma Israelfo nni twam no ne bere mu.

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Ɔsram yi da a ɛto so dunan no anwummere, munni no ne bere mu sɛnea; n'ahyɛde ne n'akwan nyinaa so na munni.

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Na wodii twam no ɔsram a edi kan no da a ɛto so dunan no anwummere, Sinai sare so; sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa, saa na Israelfo no yɛe.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Na mmarima bi wɔ hɔ a wɔn ho akum funu bi ho, na wɔantumi anni twam no da no; na wɔbaa Mose ne Aaron anim da no ara;

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: na mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛn de, yɛn ho akum funu bi ho; dɛn nti na wɔkame yɛn sɛ yɛmmfa yɛn ayɛyɛde mmmrɛ AWURADE ne bere mu wɔ Israelfo mu?

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Munnyina hɔ na minkotie nea AWURADE bɛhyɛ ama mo.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo no sɛ Sɛ mo anaa mo asefo mu bi ho kum funu bi ho anaasɛ ɔwɔ akwantu mu akyirikyiri a, onni twam mma AWURADE ara.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Ɔsram a ɛto so abien no da a ɛto so dunan anwummere na wonni; apiti ne fan nwenenwene na wɔmfa nni:

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: wonnnyaw bi nnkosi anɔpa na wommmu ne dompe bi; wonni no twam no ho ahyɛde no nyinaa so.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Na nea ne ho tew na ontuu kwan na ɔpa twam no di no, wobetwa ɔkra no afi ne man mu akyene, efisɛ wamfa AWURADE ayɛyɛde no amma ne bere mu; saa onipa no nsoa ne bɔne.

english_verse: Anyone, including foreigners who live among you, can celebrate Passover, if they follow all the regulations. The Cloud over the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi bɛsoɛ mo mu a, onni twam mma AWURADE: twam ahyɛde ne ne yɛbea no so na onni; ɔhɔho oo, asase no soni oo, ahyɛde biako na ɛnna hɔ mma mo. Ogya ne omununkum fadum

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: na sɛ nnanu, sɛ ɔsram, sɛ nna bebree, na omununkum no di tenabea no so a esi so ara a, Israelfo no tena nsram na wontu; na sɛ ɛma ne ho so a, na wotu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: Yɛ dwetɛ ntorobɛnto abien, fa dwetɛ a wɔaboro na fa yɛ, na wɔde afrɛ asafo no aba, na wɔde ama wɔatu nsraban no akɔ.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔhyɛn n'abien nyinaa a, asafo no nyinaa ano nhyia wo nkyɛn ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔhyɛn biako a, mmapɔmma a wodi Israel apem apem so atitiriw no mmehyia wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: na sɛ mohyɛn osebɔ to so abien a, nsra a ɛdeda anafo fam no ntutu: wɔrebetu no, osebɔ nnyigyei na wɔnhyɛn.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔrebɛma asafo no abɔ gua a, monhyɛn, nanso ɛnyɛ osebɔ.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma asɔfo no na wɔnhyɛn ntorobɛnto no; na ɛnyɛ mo daa ahyɛde mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ morekɔ ɔsa mo asase so ne ahohiafo a wohiahia mo ho akɔko a, ɛnne momfa ntorobɛnto nhyɛn osebɔ, na wɔnkae mo, AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim, na wonnye mo nkwa, mo atamfo no nsam.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Na mo anigye nna ne mo afahyɛ a mohyɛ ne mo asram foforo no mu nso monhyɛn ntorobɛnto, mo hyew afɔre ne mo asomdwoe afɔre no so, na ɛnyɛ nkae mma mo, mo Nyankopɔn anim. Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. Israelfo fi Sinai kɔ Paran

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Na afe a ɛto so abien no sram a ɛto so abien no da a ɛto so aduonu no, omununkum no maa ne ho so fii adanse tenabea no so.

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no tutuu wɔn nsra siim fii Sinai sare so, na omununkum no kogyinaa Paran sare so.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Na eyi ne nea edi kan a wɔnam AWURADE asɛm a ɛnam Mose so no so tui.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Na Yuda mma nsra ɔfrankaa no tui kan, sɛ wɔn dɔm ahorow te; na ne dɔm no so na Aminadab ba Nahasɔn di;

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: na Isakar mma abusuakuw dɔm no so na Suar ba Netanel di;

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: na Sebulon mma abusuakuw dɔm no so na Helon ba Eliab di.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Ɛnna wohunhuan tenabea no, na Gerson mma ne Merari mma soasoaa tenabea no tui.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Na Ruben mma nsra ɔfrankaa no tui sɛ wɔn dɔm ahorow te; na ne dɔm no so na Sedeur ba Elisur di;

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: na Simeon mma abusuakuw dɔm no so na Surisadai ba Selumiel di;

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: na Gad mma abusuakuw dɔm no so na Deuel ba Eliasaf di.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Kohatfo no soasoaa akronkronne no tui; na wosii tenabea no de kosii sɛ wɔbae.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Na Efraim mma nsra ɔfrankaa no tui sɛ wɔn dɔm ahorow te; na ne dɔm no so na Amihud ba Elisama di;

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: na Manase mma abusuakuw dɔm no so na Pedahsur ba Gamaliel di;

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: na Benyamin mma abusuakuw dɔm no so na Gideoni ba Abidan di.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Ɛnna Dan mma nsra ɔfrankaa no tui bɔɔ nsra no nyinaa kyidɔm sɛ wɔn dɔm ahorow no te; na ne dɔm no so na Amisadai ba Ahieser di;

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: na Aser mma abusuakuw dɔm no so na Okran ba Pagiel di;

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: na Naftali mma abusuakuw dɔm no so na Enan ba Ahira di.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Eyi ne Israelfo tu a wotui sɛ wɔn dɔm ahorow te no.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ n'akonta Hobab a ɔyɛ Midianni Reuel ba no sɛ: Yɛretu akɔ nea AWURADE kaa ho asɛm sɛ, ɛha na mede mɛma mo no; bra ma yɛnkɔ, na yɛbɛyɛ wo yiye, efisɛ AWURADE aka Israel ho asɛmpa.

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Merenkɔ, na mmom m'ankasa m'asase so ne m'abusua mu na mɛkɔ.

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Na ose: Eyi de, nnyaw yɛn; na wo na wunim nea yɛbɛbɔ nsra, sare no so nti, yɛ yɛn kwankyerɛfo;

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: na sɛ wo ne yɛn nantew a, papa ko a AWURADE de bɛyɛ yɛn no, yɛde bɛyɛ wo bi.

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Ɛnna wotutu fii AWURADE bepɔw no ho nantew nnansa kwan, na AWURADE apam adaka no tu dii wɔn anim nnansa sɛ ɛrekɔkyerɛ wɔn asoɛe no;

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Na sɛ adaka no retu a, Mose ka sɛ AWURADE, sɔre na w'atamfo mmɔ mpete na wɔn a wokyi wo nguan w'anim.

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebegyina a, ɔka sɛ AWURADE, san bra Israel mpem mpem no nkyɛn.

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no yɛe sɛnea wɔrenwiinwii wɔn amane ho, AWURADE asom; na AWURADE tee no, ne bo hurui, na AWURADE gya bɛsɔe wɔn mu hyew nsra no ano ano.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no su frɛɛ Mose, na Mose paa AWURADE kyɛw, na ogya no dumii.

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Na afrafrafo a wɔwɔ wɔn mu no kɔn dɔɔ ade, na Israelfo no nso san sui bio sɛ: Hena na ɔbɛma yɛn nam adi?

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Yɛakae nsumunam a yedii Misraim kwa ne ɛfere ne anowatere ne fan ne gyeene ne anwoo no.

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Afei yɛn kra akisa, na biribiara koraa nni hɔ sɛ: Mana a etua yɛn aniwa mu yi.

english_verse: The manna was like small whitish seeds
translation_verse: Na mana no te sɛ wisa aba, na ɛho te sɛ bedola hyɛ ho.

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ ɛdɛn nti na wo ne w'akoa adi no bɔne, na ɛdɛn nti na mannya w'anim anuonyam, sɛ wode ɔman yi nyinaa adesoa ato me so yi?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: So me na minyinsɛn ɔman yi nyinaa anaasɛ me na mewoo wɔn, na wuse me sɛ: Turu wɔn wo koko so sɛnea ɔbayɛnfo turu akokoaa, fa kɔ asase a wokaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn agyanom no so?

english_verse: They keep whining for meat, but where can I get meat for them?
translation_verse: Ɛhe na menya nam mama ɔman yi nyinaa, sɛ wosusu gu me so sɛ: Ma yɛn nam na yenni yi?

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Me nko mintumi minkura ɔman yi nyinaa, efisɛ ɛyɛ duru sen me.

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Na sɛ saa na wo ne me bedi no a, ɛnne sɛ m'anim aba onyam w'anim a, okum mmom na kum me, na manhu amane no.

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Na mesian me ne wo abɛkasa, na mede honhom a ɛwɔ wo so no bi magu wɔn so na wɔne wo aso ɔman no adesoa no mu, na wo nko woankura.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Na ka kyerɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monyɛ mo ho kronkron nsie ɔkyena, na mubedi nam, efisɛ moakosu agu AWURADE asom sɛ: Hena na ɔbɛma yɛn nam adi? Anka eye ma yɛn wɔ Misraim mmom. Enti AWURADE bɛma mo nam adi:

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: na mmom ɛbɛkɔ akosi ɔsram, akosi sɛ ebefifi mo hwene mu na afono mo, esiane sɛ moapa AWURADE a ɔwɔ mo mu no, na moasusu n'anim aka sɛ: Ɛdɛn nti na yefii Misraim bae yi?

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: So wobekunkum nguan ne anantwi ama wɔn na aso wɔn? Anaasɛ wɔbɛboa ɛpo mu mpataa nyinaa ano ama wɔn na aso wɔn?

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: So wɔatwa AWURADE nsa so? Afei wubehu sɛ m'asɛm bɛba mu ama wo, anaasɛ ɛremma mu.

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Na mmarima baanu kaa nsra no mu, obiako din de Eldad na obiako no de Medad; na honhom no besisii wɔn so, na wɔfra nnipa a wɔkyerɛw wɔn din no mu, nanso wɔamfi adi ankɔ ntamadan no ho; enti wɔkaa adiyisɛm nsra no mu.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Na aberante bi tutuu mmirika bɛka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Eldad ne Medad reka adiyisɛm nsra no mu.

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Na Nun ba Yosua a ɔyɛ Mose somfo fi ne mmerantebere mu no gyee so sɛ: Me wura Mose, bra wɔn!

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Woretwe me ho ninkunu? Ka me nko a, anka AWURADE man nyinaa adannan adiyifo, na AWURADE de ne honhom agu wɔn so.

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: Na mframa fi AWURADE nkyɛn bɔe, na ɛkɔpraa mmoko fi ɛpo no ho beguu nsra no so, ɛbɛyɛ sɛ da koro kwan wɔ ɔfa ha ne da koro kwan wɔ ɔfa ha, nsra no ho, wɔn sorokɔ ne asase ani bɛyɛ sɛ basafa baako.

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no sɔree da mu no nyinaa ne anadwo no nyinaa ne n'adekyee ne adesae, na wɔkɔboaboaa mmoko no ano; nea onyaa nea esua koraa no po boaa homer du ano, na wɔhatahatae ara de twaa nsra no ho hyia.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Na nam no da so wɔ wɔn se mu a wonnya nwesawee no, AWURADE bo huru hyɛɛ ɔman no, na AWURADE de ɔyaredɔm kɛse pa bobɔɔ ɔman no.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Na wɔfrɛɛ hɔ sɛ: Kibrot-hataawa, efisɛ ɛhɔ na wosiee ɔman a ade dɔɔ wɔn kɔn no.

english_verse: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.
translation_verse: Na ɔman no tu fii Kibrot-hataawa kɔɔ Haserot, na wɔtenaa Haserot.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ɛnna AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ: Mose ne Aaron ne Miriam mpofirim sɛ: Mo baasa mumfi adi mmra ahyiae ntamadan no ho.

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: Na wɔn baasa no fii adi. Na AWURADE sianee omununkum dum mu begyinaa ntamadan no ano, na ɔfrɛɛ Aaron ne Miriam; na wɔn baanu fii adi.

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Muntie me nsɛm a sɛ AWURADE diyifo bi wɔ mo mu a, adehu mu na mema ohu me, ɔdae mu na mekasa mekyerɛ no:

english_verse: But my servant Moses is the leader of my people.
translation_verse: ɛnyɛ sɛ m'akoa Mose te ne no, Ɔno na mede me fi nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa;

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: ano ne ano na me ne no de kasa ohu mu, na ɛnyɛ mmebu mu, na ohu AWURADE suban: na ɛdɛn nti na moansuro sɛ mobɛkasa m'akoa Mose?

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bo fuw wɔn, na osiim kɔe.

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: Na omununkum no fii ntamadan no so, na hwɛ, Miriam ayare kwata sɛ sukyerɛma. Na Aaron dan n'ani hwɛɛ Miriam, no hwɛ, na wayare kwata.

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Mepa wo kyɛw, me wura. Mfa bɔne a yɛadi nkwaseasɛm ayɛ yi nto yɛn so.

english_verse: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead!”
translation_verse: Mma ɔnnyɛ sɛ funu a ofi ne na yam bae na ne honam fa asɛe dedaw.

english_verse: Moses prayed, “Lord God, please heal her.”
translation_verse: Na Mose su frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: O, Onyankopɔn ee, sa no yare ɛ!

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Na sɛ n'agya hinam n'ani so ntasu teta po a, anka n'ani renwu nnanson anaa? Wɔnto ne mu nnanson nsra no akyi, na ɛno akyi ansa na wɔmfa no mmra mu bio.

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Na wɔtoo Miriam mu nsra no akyi nnanson. Na ɔman no antu kosii sɛ wɔde Miriam baa mu bio.

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Na ɛno akyi no, ɔman no tu fii Haserot, na wɔkɔbɔɔ nsra Paran sare so.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: na ɛhɔ na yehuu abran akɛse no, , na yɛyɛɛ yɛn ankasa ani so sɛ mmebɛw, na saa nso na yɛyɛe wɔ wɔn ani so.

english_verse: “Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.”
translation_verse: Fa mmarima soma wɔn, na wɔnkɔsra Kanaan asase a mede merema Israelfo no; monsoma ɔbarima biako mfi wɔn agyanom abusuakuw biara mu, na wɔn mu biara nyɛ wɔn mu mmapɔmma no bi.

english_verse: So Moses sent twelve tribal leaders from Israel's camp in the Paran Desert
translation_verse: Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so somaa wɔn fii Paran sare so, wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmarima a wɔyɛ Israelfo mu atitiriw.

english_verse: Before Moses sent them into Canaan, he said: After you go through the Southern Desert of Canaan, continue north into the hill country
translation_verse: Na Mose somaa wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔsra Kanaan asase no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔfa anafo fam ha yi, na monkɔforo mmepɔw no;

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,
translation_verse: na monkɔhwɛ asase no sɛnea ɛte ne aman a wɔtete so no, sɛ wɔyɛ den anaasɛ wɔagurow, wosua anaasɛ wɔdɔɔso,

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: ne sɛnea asase no te, sɛ emu yɛ bɛtɛɛ anaa kyenkyerenn, sɛ nnua wɔ so anaasɛ ebi nni so; na momfa akokoduru ntetew asase no so aba bi mmra. Nso saa bere no yɛ bobe aba a edi kan bere.

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Na wosiim kɔe kɔsraa asase no fi Sin sare so kosii Rehob, nea wɔnam kɔ Hamat no.

english_verse: After exploring the land of Canaan for
translation_verse: Na adaduanan dui no, wɔsan fii asase no sra bae.

english_verse: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit
translation_verse: Na wɔbaa Mose ne Aaron ne Israelfo asafo no nyinaa nkyɛn Paran sare so wɔ Kades, na wɔbɔɔ wɔn kaseɛ kyerɛɛ wɔn ne asafo no nyinaa, na wɔde asase no so aba no kyerɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: and said: Look at this fruit! The land we explored is rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Na wɔbɔɔ wɔn amanneɛ kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛakɔ asase a wosomaa yɛn so no so, na ɛsen nufusu ne ɛwo ampa, na ɛso aba ni.

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.
translation_verse: Nanso amanfo a wɔtete asase no so no yɛ den, na nkurow no, wɔabɔ ho ban, ɛsosoe sɛ, na yehuu Anak mma nso wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Amalek te anafo fam asase so, na Hetifo ne Yebusifo ne Amorifo tete bepɔw so, na Kanaanfo tete mpoano ne Yordan ho.

english_verse: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, “Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it!”
translation_verse: Na Kaleb dwudwoo ɔman no maa Mose, na ɔkae sɛ Momma yɛnkɔ nkɔforo, na yɛnkɔfa asase no; na otumi de, yebetumi wɔn.

english_verse: But the other men replied, “Those people are much too strong for us.”
translation_verse: Na mmarima a wɔne no kɔe no kae sɛ: Yɛrentumi nkɔforo nhyɛ ɔman no, efisɛ wɔyɛ den sen yɛn.

english_verse: Then they started spreading rumors and saying, “We won't be able to grow anything in that soil. And the people are like giants.
translation_verse: Na wɔmaa asase a wɔkɔsrae no ho atenka bɔne trɛw Israelfo no mu sɛ: Asase a yɛfaa mu kɔsrae no yɛ asase a edi ɛsotefo, na nkurɔfo a yehuu wɔn wɔ so no nyinaa yɛ abran ara nko;

english_verse: and complained to Moses and Aaron, “We wish we had died in Egypt or somewhere out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no nyinaa nwiinwii hyɛɛ Mose ne Aaron, na asafo no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛkaa yɛn nko a, anka yewuwui Misraim asase so, anaa sare so ha mpo. Ɛkaa yɛn nko a, anka yɛawuwu.

english_verse: Is the Lord leading us into Canaan, just to have us killed and our women and children captured? We'd be better off in Egypt.”
translation_verse: Na ɛdɛn nti na AWURADE de yɛn reba asase yi so sɛ yɛmmɛtotɔ nkrante ano, na wɔmfa yɛn yerenom ne yɛn mma nnommum? So enye mma yɛn sɛ anka yɛbɛsan akɔ Misraim bio?

english_verse: Then they said to one another, “Let's choose our own leader and go back.”
translation_verse: Na wosisee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Momma yensi otitiriw na yɛnsan nkɔ Misraim.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron bowed down to pray in front of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Mose ne Aaron de wɔn anim butubutuw fam, Israelfo asafo bagua no nyinaa anim.

english_verse: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.
translation_verse: na wɔka kyerɛɛ Israelfo asafo no nyinaa sɛ: Asase a yetwaa mu kɔsrae no yɛ asase pa ara.

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛsɔ AWURADE ani a, ɔde yɛn bedu asase no so na ɔde ama yɛn, asase a ɛsen nufusu ne ɛwo no.

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!
translation_verse: AWURADE ani so atua ara nko na monntew, na munnsuro asase no sofo no, na wɔyɛ yɛn aduan; wɔn kataman afi wɔn so, na yɛn de, AWURADE di yɛn akyi, munnsuro wɔn.

english_verse: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent. Moses Prays for the People
translation_verse: Na asafo no nyinaa kae sɛ wonsiw Yosua ne Kaleb abo. Ɛnna AWURADE anuonyam puei ahyiae ntamadan no mu kyerɛɛ Israelfo no nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ɔman yi bɛtew me ahi akosi da bɛn? Na enkosi da bɛn na wɔrennye me nni, nsɛnkyerɛnne a mayɛ wɔn mu no nyinaa akyi?

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: Mede owuyare mɛbobɔ wɔn na masɛe wɔn, na mede wo mayɛ ɔman kɛse a ɛyɛ den sen wɔn.

english_verse: Show us your great power, Lord. You promised
translation_verse: Enti mesrɛ wo, ma AWURADE tumi no nyɛ kɛse, sɛnea wokae sɛ:

english_verse: that you love to show mercy and kindness. And you said that you are very patient, but that you will punish everyone guilty of doing wrong—not only them but their children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: AWURADE yɛ abufuw mu nyaa na n'adɔe dɔɔso: Ɔde amumɔyɛ ne mmarato kyɛ, nanso ommu nea odi fɔ no kumfɔ; na otua agyanom amumɔyɛ so ka de fa mma so kosi awo ntoatoaso abiɛsa ne anan so.

english_verse: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Fa ɔman yi amumɔyɛ kyɛ wɔn ɛ, sɛ wo dom kɛse no te, ne sɛnea wode afiri ɔman yi afi Misraim abedu ha yi no.

english_verse: But as surely as I live and my power has no limit,
translation_verse: nanso sɛ mete ase na AWURADE anuonyam bɛhyɛ asase nyinaa ma yi,

english_verse: I swear that not one of these Israelites will enter the land I promised to give their ancestors. These people have seen my power in Egypt and in the desert, but they will never see Canaan. They have disobeyed and tested me too many times.
translation_verse: ampa ara, wɔrenhu asase a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ wɔn agyanom no, na wɔn a wɔatew me ahi no mu biara nso renhu.

english_verse: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.
translation_verse: Na m'akoa Kaleb de, sɛ honhom a ɛso wɔ no mu na wadi m'akyi awie nti, mede no medu asase a ɔkɔɔ so no so, na n'asefo adi so.

english_verse: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites Are Punished for Complaining
translation_verse: Na Amalekfo ne Kanaanfo no te bon no mu nti, ɔkyena monnan mo ho ntu nkɔ sare so mmɛw po kwan so. Anwiinwiifo no asotwe

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: to give this message to the people of Israel: You sinful people have complained against me too many times! Now I swear by my own life that I will give you exactly what you wanted.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Me ara, sɛ mete ase yi, AWURADE na ose, sɛnea moakasa agu m'asom no, saa ara na mɛyɛ mo:

english_verse: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over
translation_verse: Num yi so ara na mo afunu bɛdeda; mo mu nnipa a wɔkan wɔn sɛnea mo nyinaa ano si fi wɔn a wɔadi mfe aduonu de rekɔ, mo a munwiinwii hyɛɛ me no,

english_verse: will enter the land that I solemnly promised to give you as your own—only Caleb and Joshua will go in.
translation_verse: morennu asase a mekaa ntam sɛ mede mo mɛtena so no so, gye Yefune ba Kaleb ne Nun ba Yosua.

english_verse: You were worried that your own children would be captured. But I, the Lord, will let them enter the land you have rejected.
translation_verse: Na mo mma a moka sɛ wɔbɛfa wɔn nnommum no, wɔn na mede wɔn mɛkɔ so, na wɔahu asase a moto ho mpe no.

english_verse: You will die here in the desert!
translation_verse: Na mo de, mo afunu bɛdeda sare yi so,

english_verse: So they got up early the next morning and got ready to head toward the hill country of Canaan. They said, “We were wrong to complain about the Lord. Let's go into the land that he promised us.”
translation_verse: Na wotuaa ahema foro kɔɔ bepɔw no atifi kae sɛ: Yɛn ni, yɛbɛforo akɔ nea AWURADE kae hɔ, efisɛ yɛayɛ bɔne.

english_verse: You sinful people who ganged up against me will die here in the desert.
translation_verse: Me, AWURADE, na maka: Ampa ara, eyi na mede bɛyɛ asafo bɔne a wɔahyia ahyɛ me yi nyinaa. Num yi so ara na wɔbɛsa, na wɔawuwu wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Ten of the men sent to explore the land had brought back bad news and had made the people complain against the Lord.
translation_verse: Na mmarima a Mose soma ma wɔkɔsraa asase no a wɔsan bae na wɔmaa asafo no nyinaa nwiinwii hyɛɛ no, sɛ wɔmaa asase no ho atenka bɔne, fi trɛwee no,

english_verse: So he sent a deadly disease that killed those men,
translation_verse: mmarima a wɔmaa asase no ho atenka bɔne fi trɛwee no wuwuu atɔfo wu, AWURADE anim,

english_verse: but he let Joshua and Caleb live. The Israelites Fail To Enter Canaan (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: gye Nun ba Yosua ne Yefune ba Kaleb a wɔfra mmarima a wɔkɔsraa asase no mu no nko. Asoɔden so asotwe

english_verse: But Moses replied, “You're disobeying the Lord! Your plan won't work,
translation_verse: Na Mose kae sɛ ɛdɛn na mofom AWURADE asɛm no so yi? Eyi de, ɛrenyɛ yie.

english_verse: The Amalekites and the Canaanites came down from the hill country, defeated the Israelites, and chased them as far as the town of Hormah.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Amalekfo ne Kanaanfo a wɔte bepɔw no so no sian bae bekunkum wɔn bobɔɔ wɔn pete koduu Horma.

english_verse: The people of Israel were very sad after Moses gave them the Lord's message.
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa nsɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ Israelfo no nyinaa; na ɔman no dii nkɔmmɔ pii.

english_verse: so don't even try it. The Lord refuses to help you, because you turned your backs on him. The Amalekites and the Canaanites are your enemies, and they will attack and defeat you.”
translation_verse: na Amalekfo ne Kanaanfo wɔ mo anim hɔ, na mobɛtotɔ nkrante ano; na sɛ moasan afi AWURADE akyi yi, AWURADE nso renni mo akyi.

english_verse: But the Israelites ignored Moses and marched toward the hill country, even though the sacred chest and Moses did not go with them.
translation_verse: Na wotintim wɔn anim foro kɔɔ bepɔw no atifi; na AWURADE apam adaka no ne Mose anka wɔn ho amfi nsra no mu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to give the Israelites the following laws about offering sacrifices:
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Sɛ mudu asase a morekɔtena so a me ara mede merema mo no so,

english_verse: Bulls or rams or goats are the animals that you may burn on the altar as sacrifices to please me. You may also offer sacrifices voluntarily or because you made a promise, or because they are part of your regular religious ceremonies. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: na morebɔ ogya afɔre a efi anantwi anaa nguan mu ama AWURADE a, sɛ ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre anaa okum afɔre a mode reyɛ aboade, anaa ɛyɛ ayamye afɔre anaa mo afahyɛ ase de, sɛ morema ayi hua huamhuam ama AWURADE a,

english_verse: If a bull is offered as a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing,
translation_verse: Na sɛ nantwi ba na wode rebɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre anaa okum afɔre de ayɛ aboade, anaasɛ wode rebɛbɔ asomdwoe afɔre ama AWURADE a,

english_verse: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.
translation_verse: ɛnne aduan afɔre a ɔmfa nka nantwi ba no ho ne asikresam abupɛn du mu abiɛsa a wɔde ngo susutoa fa afɔtɔw;

english_verse: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: na fa ahwiesa susutoa fa nso bra, na ɛnyɛ ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam ma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔyɛ ɔman mma nyinaa nyɛ ade yi sa mfa mmɔ ogya afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam mma AWURADE.

english_verse: This law will never change. I am the Lord, and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Mmara koro ne atemmude koro na ɛnna hɔ mma mo ne ɔhɔho a wabɛsoɛ mo mu nyinaa.

english_verse: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.
translation_verse: na ɛba sɛ mudi asase no so aduan no bi a, momma soma ade so mma AWURADE,

english_verse: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.
translation_verse: momfa mo mmɔre a edi kan bi tetare nyɛ soma ade; sɛ moyɛ awiporowbea soma ade no, saa ara na momma so;

english_verse: All your descendants must follow this law and offer part of the first batch of bread dough.
translation_verse: momfa mo mmɔrekan no bi mma AWURADE sɛ soma ade, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses to tell the people what must be done if they ever disobey his laws:
translation_verse: nea AWURADE nam Mose so ahyɛ mo nyinaa, fi da a AWURADE hyɛɛ mmara no de rekodu mo awo ntoatoaso so no,

english_verse: If all of you disobey one of my laws without knowing it, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice, a wine offering, and a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: na sɛ wɔfom awerɛfirim a ɔman no nnim a, ɛnne asafo no nyinaa mfa nantwinini biako mmɔ ɔhyew afɔre a eyi hua huamhuam mma AWURADE, ne n'aduan afɔre ne n'ahwiesa sɛ ne yɛbea te, ne ɔpapo biako, na ɔnyɛ bɔne ho afɔre.

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma Israelfo asafo no nyinaa, na wɔde bekyɛ wɔn; efisɛ ɛyɛ ɔfom; na wɔn de, wɔn fom no nti wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛde aba de rebɛbɔ AWURADE gya afɔre ne wɔn bɔne ho afɔre, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong without knowing it, you must sacrifice a year-old female goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔkra bi anhyɛ da na ɔyɛ bɔne a, ɛnne ɔmfa abirekyibere a wadi afe mmra mmɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre,

english_verse: The priest will then ask me to forgive you, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma ɔkra a ɔfomee awerɛfirim no, AWURADE anim, sɛ ɔrepata ama no; na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.
translation_verse: Mmara biako na ɛnna hɔ mma mo mma nea ɔyɛ biribi awerɛfirim: nea ɔyɛ Israelfo mu kuromani, ne ɔhɔho a wabɛsoɛ wɔn mu.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong on purpose, whether Israelite or foreigner, you have sinned against me by disobeying my laws. You will no longer belong to my people. A Man Put to Death for Gathering Firewood on the Sabbath
translation_verse: efisɛ wabu AWURADE asɛm animtiaa na wabu ne mmara asɛm so: otwa na wobetwa saa ɔkra no akyene, n'amumɔyɛ da no so. Wosiw homeda sɛefo abo

english_verse: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no wɔ sare so no, wokohuu ɔbarima bi a ɔrepɛ nnyina homeda;

english_verse: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.
translation_verse: na nnipa a wohuu no sɛ ɔrepɛ nnyina no de no brɛɛ Mose ne Aaron ne asafo no nyinaa;

english_verse: But no one knew what to do with him, so he was not allowed to leave.
translation_verse: na wɔbɔɔ no dua mu, efisɛ wonnya nkyerɛɛ nea wɔnyɛ no ɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death!”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Okum na wonkum ɔbarima no, asafo no nyinaa nsiw no abo wɔ nsra no akyi.

english_verse: So he was killed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Tassels on the People's Clothes
translation_verse: Ɛnna asafo no nyinaa de no fii adi kɔɔ nsra no akyi kosiw no abo ma owui, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. Nnwow ho mmara

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo, na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Wɔnyɛ wɔn ntama ano nnwow, wɔn awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu, na wɔmfa bibiri hama nsuso ntama ano nnwow no mu;

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: nea ɛbɛyɛ na moakae me mmara nsɛm nyinaa ayɛ, na moayɛ kronkron ama mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God who led you out of Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a miyii mo fii Misraim asase so sɛ mɛyɛ mo Nyankopɔn no: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Korah son of Izhar was a Levite from the Kohathite clan. One day he called together Dathan, Abiram, and On from the Reuben tribe, and the four of them decided to rebel against Moses. So they asked
translation_verse: na wɔne Israelfo mu mmarima ahanu aduonum a wɔyɛ asafo no mu mmapɔmma a wɔayi wɔn sɛ baguafo, nnipa a wɔwɔ din, sɔre tiaa Mose;

english_verse: and Aaron and said, “Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge?”
translation_verse: na wɔbɔɔ Mose ne Aaron so gua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Moayɛ bi! Asafo mu yi nyinaa yɛ nnipa kronkron, AWURADE wɔ wɔn mu biara mu; na ɛdɛn nti na moma mo ho so AWURADE bagua so?

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Na Mose tee no, ɔde n'anim butuw fam;

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ Kora ne n'asafo no nyinaa sɛ ɔkyena nko ara AWURADE bɛma wɔahu nea ɔyɛ ne de ne nea ɔyɛ kronkron a ɔbɛma wabɛn no; na nea ɔbɛfa no no, ɔno na ɔbɛma wabɛn no.

english_verse: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!
translation_verse: na momfa ogya ngu mu, na momfa aduhuam ngu so, AWURADE anim ɔkyena; na onipa a AWURADE beyi no no, ɔbɛyɛ kronkron. Afei de, ayɛ yie, mo Lewi mma!

english_verse: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?
translation_verse: So ɛyɛ mo ade ketewa sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn no atew mo afi Israel asafo ho sɛ ɔde mo rebɛn ne ho na moayɛ AWURADE tenabea no ho adwuma, na moagyina asafo no anim asom wɔn?

english_verse: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.
translation_verse: Na wama wo ne wo nuanom Lewi mma a wɔka wo ho nyinaa abɛn no, na morepɛ asɔfodi nso yi?

english_verse: You and your followers have rebelled against the Lord, not against Aaron.
translation_verse: Enti AWURADE na wo ne w'asafo nyinaa ahyia atia no; na Aaron de, hena ne no na munwiinwii hyɛ no?

english_verse: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: “We won't come!
translation_verse: Na Mose soma kɔfrɛɛ Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram; na wose: Yɛremma!

english_verse: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!
translation_verse: So ɛyɛ adewa sɛ woayi yɛn afi asase a ɛsen nufusu ne wo so rebekum yɛn sare so, na woredi yɛn so mmakomasɛm nso yi?

english_verse: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord, “Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Mose bo fuwii pii, na ɔka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Nnan w'ani nkyerɛ wɔn aduan afɔre. Minnyee wɔn nsam afurum biako po ɛ, nanso menyɛɛ wɔn mu biara bɔne bi ɛ.

english_verse: Then he said to Korah, “Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Kora sɛ: Wo ne w'asafo no nyinaa mmra AWURADE anim, wo ne wɔn ne Aaron mmra ɔkyena;

english_verse: Each of you take along your fire pan with incense in it and offer the incense to the Lord.”
translation_verse: na mo mu biara mfa ne kukuwa, na ɔmfa aduhuam ngu mu, na obiara mfa ne kukuwa mmra AWURADE anim, nkukuwa ahanu aduonum; na wo nso, ne Aaron, obiara mfa ne kukuwa mmra.

english_verse: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na wɔn mu biara faa ne kukuwa, na wɔsosɔɔ ogya guguu mu, na wɔde aduhuam guguu so de begyinagyinaa ahyiae ntamadan no ano, wɔne Mose ne Aaron.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory
translation_verse: Na Kora maa asafo mu no nyinaa bɔɔ wɔn so gua hyiae ntamadan no ano. Na AWURADE anuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ asafo mu no nyinaa.

english_verse: and said to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ:

english_verse: “Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once!”
translation_verse: Montwe mo ho mfi asafo yi mu, na memmene wɔn afrɛso.

english_verse: But the two men bowed down and prayed, “Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned?”
translation_verse: Na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuw fam kae sɛ: Onyankopɔn a woyɛ honam nyinaa ahonhom Nyankopɔn! So ɔbarima biako bɛyɛ bɔne na wo bo ahuru asafo mu no nyinaa?

english_verse: “Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translation_verse: Montwe mo ho so mfi Kora, Datan ne Abiram tenabea ho.

english_verse: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.
translation_verse: Na Mose sɔre siim kɔɔ Datan ne Abiram nkyɛn; na Israel mpanyimfo dii n'akyi kɔe.

english_verse: Then Moses warned the people, “Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ asafo no sɛ: Montwe mo ho mfi nnipa bɔnefo yi ntamadan ho ɛ, na monnka wɔn biribiara, na wɔampra mo ne wɔn bɔne nyinaa ankɔ.

english_verse: Moses said to the crowd, “The Lord has chosen me and told me to do these things—it wasn't my idea. And here's how you will know:
translation_verse: Na Mose kae sɛ: Eyi na mode behu sɛ AWURADE na ɔsomaa me sɛ menyɛ nneyɛe yi nyinaa, na emfi m'ankasa.

english_verse: If these men die a natural death, it means the Lord hasn't chosen me.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnipa nyinaa owu na eyinom bewuwu na nea ɛto nnipa nyinaa na ɛto wɔn a, ɛnne na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔsomaa me;

english_verse: But suppose the Lord does something that has never been done before. For example, what if a huge crack appears in the ground, and these men and their families fall into it and are buried alive, together with everything they own? Then you will know they have turned their backs on the Lord!”
translation_verse: na sɛ ade foforo na AWURADE bɛbɔ na asase bebue n'ano amene wɔn ne nea ɛwɔ wɔn nyinaa na wɔnam anikan asan akɔ asaman a, ɛnne munhu sɛ mmarima yi ayi AWURADE ahii.

english_verse: As soon as Moses said this, the ground under the men opened up
translation_verse: Na owiee nsɛm yi nyinaa ka no, wɔn ase asase paee,

english_verse: and swallowed them alive, together with their families and everything they owned. Then the ground closed back up, and they were gone.
translation_verse: na wɔne nea wɔwɔ nyinaa nam anikan sian kɔɔ asaman, na asase sram wɔn so, na wɔyerae wɔ ɔman asafo no mu.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites heard their screams, so they ran off, shouting, “We don't want that to happen to us!”
translation_verse: Na Israelfo a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia no nyinaa guanee, wɔn gyegyeegye no ano, kae sɛ: Anyɛ a, asase bɛmene yɛn nso!

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent a fire that burned up the
translation_verse: Na ogya fii AWURADE nkyɛn bɛhyew mmarima ahanu aduonum a wɔde aduhuam no bae no.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Tell Aaron's son Eleazar to take the fire pans from the smoldering fire and scatter the coals. The pans are now sacred,
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ ɔsɔfo Aaron ba Eleasar, na ɔntase nkukuwa no mfi nhyewee no mu, na dwiriw ogya no petepete; na ɛyɛ kronkron:

english_verse: because they were used for offering incense to me. Have them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar. Those men died because of their sin, and now their fire pans will become a warning for the rest of the community.”
translation_verse: Nnebɔneyɛfo yi a wɔayɛ wɔn kra ho bɔne nkukuwa no, na mommoro nyɛ abona atɛtrɛtɛ nkata afɔremuka no ho, efisɛ wɔde baa AWURADE anim, na ayɛ kronkron, na ɔnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne mma Israelfo.

english_verse: Eleazar collected the pans and had them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Eleasar faa kɔbere nkukuwa a wɔn a wɔahyew no de bae no, na wɔboro de yɛɛ afɔremuka no ho nkataho,

english_verse: just as the Lord had told Moses. The pans were a warning to the Israelites that only Aaron's descendants would be allowed to offer incense to the Lord. Anyone else who tried to would be punished like Korah and his followers. The Israelites Rebel and Are Punished
translation_verse: sɛ ɔnyɛ Israelfo nkae ade, na onipa foforo a omfi Aaron asefo mu no ammɛn ammɛhyew aduhuam, AWURADE anim, na anyɛ no sɛ Kora ne ne dɔm no, sɛnea AWURADE nam Mose so ka kyerɛɛ no no.

english_verse: The next day the people of Israel again complained against Moses and Aaron, “The two of you killed some of the Lord's people!”
translation_verse: Na n'adekyee no Israel asafo no nyinaa nwiinwii hyɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Mo na moakum AWURADE man.

english_verse: As the people crowded around them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the sacred tent, and the Lord appeared in his glory in the cloud covering the tent.
translation_verse: Na asafo no boaboaa wɔn ho ano hyɛɛ Mose ne Aaron no, wɔdannan wɔn ani kyerɛɛ ahyiae ntamadan no, na hwɛ, omununkum no akata so, na AWURADE anuonyam yii ne ho adi.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron walked to the front of the tent,
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron baa ahyiae ntamadan no anim.

english_verse: where the Lord said to them,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Stand back! I am going to wipe out these Israelites once and for all.” They immediately bowed down and prayed.
translation_verse: Monsɔre mfi asafo yi mu na memmene wɔn afrɛso. Na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuw fam.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron, “Grab your fire pan and fill it with hot coals from the altar. Put incense in it, then quickly take it to where the people are and offer it to the Lord, so they can be forgiven. The Lord is very angry, and people have already started dying!”
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Fa kukuwa no, na sɔ afɔremuka no so gya gu mu, na yɛ ntɛm fa kɔ asafo no nkyɛn kɔpata ma wɔn; na AWURADE bo afuw, ɔyaredɔm no afi ase.

english_verse: Aaron walked back and stood with Moses at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔyaredɔm no to twae, Aaron san baa Mose nkyɛn ahyiae ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: Place these sticks in the tent right in front of the sacred chest where I appear to you.
translation_verse: Na gyaw gu ahyiae ntamadan no mu, Adanse no anim, nea me ne mo hyia hɔ no.

english_verse: I will then choose a man to be my priest, and his stick will sprout. After that happens, I won't have to listen to any more complaints about you.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima a meyi no no poma bɛfefɛw, na mama me ho anwiinwii a Israelfo nwiinwii hyɛ mo no agyae.

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had commanded, and they gave him the walking sticks from the twelve tribal leaders, including Aaron's from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfo no; na wɔn mmapɔmma no nyinaa momaa no mpoma mmiako mmiako; mpoma dumien, sɛ wɔn mpanyimfi te no; na Aaron poma wɔ wɔn mpoma no mu.

english_verse: Moses took them and placed them in the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Mose gyaw mpoma no guu AWURADE anim, adanse ntamadan no mu.

english_verse: The next day when Moses went into the tent, flowers and almonds were already growing on Aaron's stick.
translation_verse: Na ade kyee a Mose kɔɔ adanse ntamadan no mu no, na hwɛ, Aaron poma a ɛyɛ Lewi fi de no afefɛw ayɛ frɔmfrɔm agu nhwiren na asow amandola aba abere.

english_verse: Moses brought the twelve sticks out of the tent and showed them to the people. Each of the leaders found his own and took it.
translation_verse: Na Mose tasee mpoma no nyinaa de fi AWURADE anim fii adi brɛɛ Israelfo no nyinaa, na wɔhwɛe, na wɔn mu biara faa ne poma.

english_verse: But the Lord told Moses, “Put Aaron's stick back! Let it stay near the sacred chest as a warning to anyone who might think of rebelling. If these people don't stop their grumbling about me, I will wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa Aaron poma no san bra Adanse no anim na wɔmfa nsie, na ɛnyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne mma asoɔdenfo no, na woatwa wɔn anwiinwii a wonwiinwii hyɛ me no to, na wɔanwuwu.

english_verse: The Israelites cried out to Moses, “We're done for
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛrewuwu, yɛresɛe, yɛn nyinaa resɛe!

english_verse: and doomed if we even go near the sacred tent!”
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛn AWURADE tenabea no wu: so yɛn nyinaa nwie sa?

english_verse: You must see that they perform their duties. But if they go near any of the sacred objects or the altar, all of you will die.
translation_verse: na wonkura w'adwuma no mu bi na wɔnyɛ ntamadan no ho nnwuma nyinaa; na kronkronbea nneɛma ne afɔremuka no ho nko na wɔmmmɛn, na wɔne mo nyinaa nso anwuwu.

english_verse: No one else is allowed to take care of the sacred tent or do anything connected with it.
