english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: na wɔforo koduu Eskol subon no mu, na wohuu asase no, na wobetuu Israelfo no koma, na wɔankɔ asase a AWURADE de ama wɔn no so;

english_verse: The Lord became very angry.
translation_verse: na AWURADE bo fuwii da no, na ɔkaa ntam sɛ:

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ mobɛyɛ eyi na moamia wɔ AWURADE anim akɔko,

english_verse: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bo fuw Israel, na ɔma wokyinkyinii sare so mfirihyia aduanan kosii sɛ awo ntoatoaso a wɔyɛɛ AWURADE anim bɔne no nyinaa wiee ɔsa.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Na Mose de Gilead maa Manase ba Makir, na ɔtenaa mu.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Na hwɛ, moasɔre agyina mo agyanom ananmu, mmarima nnebɔneyɛfo asefo, sɛ mode AWURADE abufuhyew no bi reka ho de aba Israel so ara.

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Sɛ mosan fi AWURADE akyi a, obegyaw ɔman no bio sare so, na moasɛe ɔman mu yi nyinaa.

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Ɛnna wotwiw bɛn no kae sɛ: Yebegyigye nguammuw wɔ ha ama yɛn mmoa, na yɛakyekye nkurow nso ama yɛn mma;

english_verse: where they can stay and be safe. Then we'll prepare to fight and lead the other tribes into battle.
translation_verse: na yɛn de, yɛamia aso akode mu adi Israelfo anim akosi sɛ yɛde wɔn bedu wɔn tenabea ansa; na yɛn mma ntenatena nkurow a ɛyɛ den no mu asase no sotefo no nti.

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: Yɛrensan mma yɛn afi de bɛkɔ akosi sɛ: Israelfo nyinaa benya wɔn agyapade mmiako mmiako adi so.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Na yɛne wɔn remfa agyapade wɔ Yordan agya ne akyiri, efisɛ yɛn agyapade abefi Yordan agya ha wɔ apuei fam ama yɛn.

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: na mo mu wɔn a wɔamia nyinaa betwa Yordan adi AWURADE anim akosi sɛ ɔbɛpam n'atamfo afi n'anim,

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Na sɛ moanyɛ saa a, hwɛ, na moayɛ AWURADE bɔne, na munhu yiye sɛ mo bɔne beyi mo ama.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Monkyekyere nkurow mma mo mma na munnyigye ban mma mo nguan, na nea afi mo anom no, monyɛ.

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Na Gad mma ne Ruben mma no ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wo nkoa bɛyɛ sɛnea me wura ahyɛ no:

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Yɛn mma ne yɛn yerenom ne yɛn nguan ne yɛn anantwi nyinaa ntena Gilead nkurow mu hɔ;

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: na wo nkoa mu wɔn a wɔamia rekɔ ɔsa nyinaa betwam adi AWURADE anim akɔko, sɛnea me wura kae no.

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ Gad mma ne Ruben mma ne mo twa Yordan, wɔn a wɔamia di AWURADE anim rekɔ ɔsa nyinaa, na wonya brɛ asase no ase mo anim a, ɛnne momfa Gilead asase mma wɔn na wonni so;

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: na sɛ wɔammia ne mo antwa a, ɛnne Kanaan asase so na wɔmma wonnya tenabea wɔ mo mu.

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Na Gad mma ne Ruben mma buae sɛ: Nea AWURADE aka akyerɛ wo nkoa no, saa ara na yɛbɛyɛ

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: Yɛn de, yebemia adi AWURADE anim atwam akɔ Kanaan asase so, na yɛn agyapade a yɛanya Yordan agya ha no atena yɛn hɔ.

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Mose de Amorifo hene Sihon ahenni ne Basan hene Og ahenni, asase no ne n'ahye mu nkurow, asase no so nkurow a atwa ahyia nyinaa maa Gad mma ne Ruben mma ne Yosef ba Manase abusuakuw fa.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Na Gad mma no kyekyeree Dibon ne Atarot ne Aroer,

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: ne Atrot-sofan ne Yaser ne Yogbeha,

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: ne Bet-nimra ne Bet-haran, nkurow a wɔatoto ho afasu ne nguammuw.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Na Ruben mma no kyekyee Hesbon ne Eleale ne Kiriataim,

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: ne Nebo ne Baal-meon a din no sakrasakrae, ne Sibma, na wɔtotoo nkurow a wɔkyekyeree no din.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Na Manase ba Makir mma siim kɔɔ Gilead kɔfae, na wɔpam Amorifo a wɔwɔ hɔ no.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Na Manase ba Yair siim kɔfaa wɔn atenae no, na ɔfrɛɛ no Yair atenae.

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Na Noba siim kɔfaa Kenat ne ɛho nkurowa, na ɔde ne din Noba too so.

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: Mose kyerɛw faako a wotu fii ne akwan a wotwae, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ no no; na eyinom ne wɔn akwantu mu asoɛe fi faako a wotutu fii no:

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Na Israelfo tu fii Rameses kɔbɔɔ nsra Sukot.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Sukot kɔbɔɔ nsra Etam a ɛwɔ sare so.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Etam dan baa Pi-hahirot a ɛwɔ Baal-sefon anim, na wɔbɔɔ nsra Migdol anim.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Pi-hahirot anim kotwaa ɛpo no kɔɔ sare so, na wɔnantew Etam sare so nnansa kwan kɔbɔɔ nsra Mara.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Elim kɔbɔɔ nsra mmɛw po ano.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii mmɛw po ano kɔbɔɔ nsra Sin sare so.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Alus kɔbɔɔ nsra Refidim; na ɛhɔ na ɔman no annya nsu annom.

english_verse: They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Refidim kɔbɔɔ nsra Sinai sare so.

english_verse: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Kades kɔbɔɔ nsra Hor bepɔw ho, Edom asase ano.

english_verse: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Aaron foro kɔɔ Hor bepɔw so, sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, kowui wɔ hɔ Israelfo Misraim asase so fi afe a ɛto so aduanan so, ɔsram a ɛto so anum no da a edi kan.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Na Kanaanhene Arad a ɔte Kanaan asase no anafo fam tee sɛ Israelfo no reba.

english_verse: and finally in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Na wotu fii Abarim mmepɔw so kɔbɔɔ nsra Moab tataw so, Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no.

english_verse: Their camp stretched from Beth-Jeshimoth to Acacia. The Lord's Command To Conquer Canaan
translation_verse: Na wɔbɔɔ Yordan so nsra fi Bet-yesimot kosii Habel-sitim, Moab tataw so. Ahyɛde wɔ Kanaanfo ho

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Moab tataw so, Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no sɛ:

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Sɛ mutwa Yordan kɔ Kanaan asase so a,

english_verse: you must force out the people living there. Destroy their idols and tear down their altars.
translation_verse: ɛnne mompam asase no sotefo nyinaa mfi mo anim, na monsɛe wɔn abo ahoni nyinaa, na wɔn ahoni a wɔagu no, monsɛe ne nyinaa, na monsɛe wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea nyinaa.

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: Na momfa asase no ntena so, na mo na mede asase no mama mo sɛ munni so.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Na momfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ asase no mu mma mo mmusuakuw no: abusuakuw a ɛso no, momma ne kyɛfa nso, na nea osua no, momma ne kyɛfa nsua; nea obiara ntonto bɛbɔ no, ɛhɔ na ɛnyɛ ne de; munnyigye mo kyɛfa sɛnea mo agyanom mmusuakuw te.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Na sɛ moampam asase no sotefo amfi mo anim a, ɛnne wɔn a mubegyaw wɔn no bɛdan mo aniwa mu nsɔe ne mo mfe mu nnunsin, na wɔahiahia mo ho, asase a mote so no so.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: Na sɛnea misusuwii sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn no, saa ara na mɛyɛ mo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: Hyɛ Israelfo no mmara na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ mudu Kanaan asase no so a, eyi ne asase a ɛbɛyɛ mo agyapade, Kanaan asase no sɛ n'ahye te.

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Mo anafo fam nkyɛn mu mfi Sin sare so Edom nkyɛn mu; na mo anafo fam hye mfi Nkyene-Po awiei wɔ apuei;

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: na mo hye no mmra Akrabim aforoe anafo fam, na entwam nkɔ Sin, na emfi ha nkɔ Kades-barnea anafo fam, na emfi nkɔ Hasar-adar ntwam nkɔfa Asmon.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Na ɔhye no nkɔntɔn mfi Asmon nkɔ Misraim subon no mu, na ano nkɔpem po no ano.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Na eyi nyɛ mo atifi fam hye: Mumfi po kɛse no ano mfa mo ani nkari Hor bepɔw,

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: na mumfi Hor bepɔw ho nkari nea wɔfa kɔ Hamat, na ɔhye no ano nkɔpem Sedad.

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: Na ɔhye no mfi hɔ nkɔ Sifron, na ano nkɔpem Hasar-enan; eyi na ɛnyɛ mo atifi fam hye.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Na monkari apuei fam hye mfi Hasar-enan nkɔ Sefam;

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: na ɔhye no mfi Sefam nsian nkɔ Ribla, Ain apuei, na ɔhye no nsian ara nkɔpem Kineret po no kɔn so, apuei.

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔhye no nsian nkodu Yordan, na ano nkɔpem Nkyene-Po ano. Eyi ne mo asase no sɛnea ɛho ahye te.

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Na Mose hyɛɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Eyi ne asase a momfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛmu nni so a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma mmusuakuw akron ne fa no.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Na Ruben mma abusuakuw, sɛ wɔn mpanyimfi te, ne Gad mma abusuakuw, sɛ wɔn mpanyimfi te, ne Manase abusuakuw fa no anya wɔn kyɛfa.

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: Mmusuakuw abien ne fa abusua no anya wɔn kyɛfa Yeriko, Yordan agya, anim fam ne apuei.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Mmarima a wɔnkyɛ asase no mu mma mo no din ni: ɔsɔfo Eleasar ne Nun ba Yosua.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Na munyiyi mmusuakuw nyinaa mu mmapɔmma mmiako mmiako, na wɔnkyɛ asase no mu.

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne wɔn a AWURADE hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkyɛ Kanaan asase mma Israelfo no.

english_verse: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Hyɛ Israelfo na wɔmfa wɔn agyapade a wɔanya no mu nkurow bi mma Lewifo na wɔntena mu, na nkurow no ho mfikyisaase nso momfa mma Lewifo.

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: Na nkurow no nyɛ wɔn tenabea, na ɛho mfikyisaase no nneda hɔ mma wɔn anantwi ne wɔn nyɛmmoa ne wɔn mmoa nyinaa.

english_verse: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure
translation_verse: Na munsusuw kurow no akyi apuei fam basafa apem, ne anafo fam basafa apem, ne atɔe fam basafa apem, ne atifi fam basafa apem, na kurow no nna ntam: eyi ne nkurow no ho mfikyisaase a ɛnyɛ wɔn dea.

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: Na nkurow a mode ma Lewifo no nyɛ guankɔbea nkurow asia a mode bɛma sɛ nnipakumfo nguan nkɔ hɔ; na momfa nkurow aduanan abien nka ho.

english_verse: so they will have a total of
translation_verse: Nkurow a mode bɛma Lewifo no nyinaa nyɛ nkurow aduanan awotwe ne ɛho mfikyisaase.

english_verse: Since the towns for the Levites must come from Israel's own tribal lands, the larger tribes will give more towns than the smaller ones. The Safe Towns (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na nkurow a mugye fi Israelfo agyapade mu ma Lewifo no, wɔn a wɔn de dɔɔso no, wɔn hɔ na munnye pii, na wɔn a wɔn de sua no, munnye wɔn hɔ kakra; obiara sɛnea n'agyapade a wanya no dodow te no na ɔmfa ne nkurow no bi mma Lewifo. Guankɔbea nkurow

english_verse: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revengefor his relative's death as soon as he finds you.
translation_verse: mogya ho werefo na onkum owudifo no; ɔto no a, onkum no.

english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Na nkurow a mubeyi no nyɛ mo guankɔbea nkurow asia.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo sɛ: Sɛ mutwa Yordan kɔ Kanaan asase no so a,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: munyiyi nkurow a ɛfata na ɛnyɛ guankɔbea nkurow mma mo, na onipakumfo a ne nsa apa obi ho no aguan akɔ hɔ.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Na nkurow no nyɛ guankɔbea mma mo mfi ɔweretɔfo nsam, na onipakumfo no anwu kosi sɛ obegyina asafo anim na wɔabu no atɛn ansa.

english_verse: three on each side of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Munyi nkurow abiɛsa mma Yordan agya, na munyi nkurow abiɛsa nso mma Kanaan asase no;

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: ɛnyɛ guankɔbea nkurow, na nkurow asia yi nyɛ guankɔbea mma Israelfo ne ɔhɔho ne ɔmamfrani a ɔte wɔn mu, na obiara a ne nsa apa onipa bi ho no aguan akɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Anaasɛ okura dua a ebetumi akum onipa na sɛ ɔde bɔ no ma owu a, ɔyɛ owudifo; okum na wonkum owudifo no;

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: anaasɛ nitan so na ɔde ne nsa bɔ no ma owu a, okum na wonkum nea ɔbɔɔ no no; ɔyɛ owudifo: mogya ho werefo, sɛ ɔto owudifo no a, onkum no.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: ɛnne asafo no nnyina saa ahyɛde yi so mmu onipakumfo no ne mogya ho werefo no ntam atɛn.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Na asafo no nyi onipakumfo no mfi mogya ho werefo no nsam, na asafo no mfa no nsan nkɔ ne guankɔbea kurow a oguan kɔɔ mu no mu, na ɔnkɔtena hɔ nkosi sɛ ɔsɔfo panyin a wɔasra no ɔsra ngo kronkron no bewu.

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: na mogya ho werefo no kɔto no ne guankɔbea kurow no hye akyi, na mogya ho werefo no kokum onipakumfo no a, onni mogya ho fɔ.

english_verse: You must stay inside the town until the high priest dies; only then can you go back home.
translation_verse: Na anka ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtena ne guankɔbea kurow no mu kosi sɛ ɔsɔfo panyin no bewu, na ɔsɔfo panyin no wu akyi no, onipakumfo no asan aba asase a ɛyɛ n'agyapade no so bio.

english_verse: The community of Israel must always obey these laws.
translation_verse: Na eyi nyɛ atemmu ahyɛde mma mo, mo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu, mo tenabea nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: Obiara a okum obi no, adansefo anom asɛm so na wɔmfa nkum onipakumfo no; na ɔdansefo biako nnni adanse nntia ɔkra bi mmma onnwu.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: Nso munnnye owudifo a odi fɔ sɛ wakum onipa bi no hɔ biribi mmfa nnnye no nkwa, na mmom okum na wonkum no.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Na munnnye agyede nso nnsi ne guankɔbea kurow mu guankɔ ananmu mmma ɔnnsan mmmɛtena asase no so kosi sɛ ɔsɔfo no bewu.

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Na Gilead, Makir ba, Manase ba mma abusua mu mpanyimfi so atitiriw a wofi Yosef mma mmusua mu no bae bɛkasae, Mose ne mmapɔmma no, Israelfo mpanyimfi so atitiriw no, anim,

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: na wose: AWURADE ahyɛ me wura sɛ wɔmfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ asase no mu mma Israelfo na wonni so, na me wura nyaa AWURADE anom mmara sɛ wɔmfa yɛn nua Selofehad agyapade mma ne mmabea.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔkɔyɛ Israelfo mmusuakuw mu mma bi yerenom a, ɛnne wɔn agyapade no befi yɛn agyanom agyapade mu, na wɔde akɔka abusuakuw ko a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn de no agyapade ho, na afi yɛn ntonto kyɛfa no mu;

english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: na sɛ edu Israelfo ahosɛpɛw afahyɛ afe so a, wɔde wɔn agyapade no bɛka abusuakuw a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn de no agyapade ho, na wɔayi wɔn agyapade afi yɛn agyanom abusuakuw agyapade mu.

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so hyɛɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Nea Yosef mma abusuakuw aka yi teɛ.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Eyi ne nea AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ Selofehad mmabea no ho: Obiara a wosusuw sɛ oye no, wɔnware no, nanso wɔn agyanom abusuakuw mu abusua bi mu na wɔnware,

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: na Israelfo agyapade bi amfi abusuakuw bi mu ankɔ abusuakuw foforo bi mu, na Israelfo mfomfam wɔn agyanom abusuakuw agyapade ho.

english_verse: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.
translation_verse: na agyapade bi amfi abusuakuw bi mu ankɔ abusuakuw foforo mu; na Israelfo mmusuakuw no mfomfam wɔn agyapade ho.

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: na Mahla, Tirsa ne Hogla ne Milka ne Noa, Selofehad mmabea no warewaree wɔn agya nuanom mma;

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: na wɔwarewaree wɔ Yosef ba Manase mma mmusua mu, na wɔn agyapade no kaa wɔn agya abusuakuw no mu.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne mmara nsɛm ne atemmude a AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛɛ Israelfo wɔ Moab tataw so, Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Na mo de, monnan mo ho ntu nkɔ sare so, Mmɛw-Po kwan so. Israelfo asoɔden

english_verse: Leave this place and go into the land that belongs to the Amorites and their neighbors the Canaanites. This land includes the Jordan River valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Southern Desert, the Mediterranean seacoast, the Lebanon Mountains, and all the territory as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Bepɔw yi ho tena adɔɔ mo so; monnan mo ho ntu nkɔ Amorifo bepɔw ne nsase a ɛbemmɛn ho wɔ Araba tataw so no so, bepɔw so ne tataw so ne nifa fam ne mpoano nyinaa, Kanaanfo asase so ne Lebanon so nkodu asu kɛse, asubɔnten Eufrate, ho.

english_verse: I give you this land, just as I promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Now you must go and take the land. Leaders Were Appointed (Exodus
translation_verse: Hwɛ, mede asase no mato mo anim; monkɔ nkɔfa asase a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom, Abraham, Isak ne Yakob, sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn ne wɔn asefo a wodi wɔn akyi no. Wosi atemmufo

english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Na mehyɛɛ mo nneɛma a monyɛ no nyinaa ho mmara bere no mu.

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: na munwiinwii mo ntamadan mu sɛ: Ɔtan so na AWURADE yii yɛn fii Misraim asase so, sɛ ɔde yɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifo nsa na wɔasɛe yɛn.

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: Na meka mekyerɛɛ mo bere no mu sɛ: Me nko mintumi minkura mo;

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: AWURADE mo agyanom Nyankopɔn mfa sɛ mote yi mmɔho apem nka mo ho, na onhyira mo sɛnea ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no.

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na me nko metumi masoa mo ne mo aperedi ho adesoa duruduru yi?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Ɛnna mede mo mmusuakuw mu atitiriw, mmarima anyansafo a wɔdɛnsow misisii mo so atitiriw, apem apem so mpanyin ne ɔha ɔha so mpanyin ne aduonum aduonum so mpanyin ne du du so mpanyin ne mo mmusuakuw so ahwɛfo.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Na mehyɛɛ mo atemmufo no mmara bere no mu sɛ: Muntie mo nuanom ntam nsɛm, na mummu atɛntrenee onipa ne ne nua ne ne hɔho ntam.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Monnhwɛ nnipa anim atemmu mu, muntie aketewa sɛ ɔkɛse, munnsuro onipa anim, efisɛ atemmu yɛ Onyankopɔn dea; na asɛm a ɛyɛ den sen mo na momfa mmrɛ me, na mintie.

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: nanso ɔno na odii mo anim ɔkwan so sɛ ɔrekɔsra mo nsrabɔbea ama mo, ogya mu anadwo, sɛ ɔrekyerɛ mo kwan a momfa so, ne omununkum mu awia. Onyankopɔn abufuw (Numeri

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: Na yetu fii Horeb, na yɛnantew faa sare kɛse a ɛso yɛ hu a muhui nyinaa so, Amorifo bepɔw kwan so, sɛnea AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ yɛn no, na yeduu Kades-barnea.

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna mo nyinaa mutwiw bɛn me kae sɛ: Ma yɛnsoma mmarima nni yɛn anim nkɔsra asase no mma yɛn, na wɔmmɛka ɔkwan ko a yɛbɛfa so ne nkurow a yebedu so no ho asɛm nkyerɛ yɛn.

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Na asɛm no sɔɔ m’ani sɛ, na mefaa mo mu nnipa dumien, abusuakuw biara mu nipa biako.

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: Na wɔdan wɔn ani foroo bepɔw no, na wokoduu Eskol subon mu, na wɔsrae.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa asase no so aba bi kura de sian brɛɛ yɛn; na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ yɛn bio sɛ: Asase a AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de rema yɛn no ye.

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nanso moampɛ sɛ moforo, na motew AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anom asɛm atua,

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Ɛhe na yɛmfa nkɔ? Yɛn nuanom atutu yɛn koma sɛ: Nnipa no sosoe na wɔwowaree sen yɛn, nkurow no yɛ akɛse a wɔatoto ho afasu akɔ ɔsoro, na bio nso yehuu Anakfo mma no wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a odi mo anim no, ɔno na ɔbɛko ama mo, sɛnea ɔyɛ maa mo Misraim wɔ mo anim no ara,

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: ne sare so a wuhui sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn kura wo sɛnea onipa kura ne ba, akwan a mofaa so no nyinaa so besii sɛ muduu ha yi.

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Na eyi mu nso, moannye AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anni,

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE tee mo nsɛm no, na ne bo fuwii, na ɔkaa ntam sɛ:

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Awo ntoatoaso bɔne yi mu nnipa yi mu biara renhu asase pa a mekaa ho ntam sɛ mede mɛma mo agyanom no!

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: Gye Yefune ba Kaleb, ɔno na obehu, na ɔno na mede asase a otiaa so no mɛma no ne ne mma, efisɛ wawie AWURADE akyidi.

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Me nso, mo nti AWURADE faa me abufuw kae sɛ: Wo nso, worenkɔ hɔ!

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Nun ba Yosua a ogyina w’anim no, ɔno na obedu hɔ; ɔno na hyɛ no den, na ɔno na ɔbɛkyɛ agyapade no ama Israel.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Na mo mma nketewa a muse wɔbɛyɛ nnommum ne mo mma a nnɛ wonnim papa ne bɔne no, wɔn na wobedu hɔ, wɔn na mede mɛma wɔn, na wɔn na wobedi so.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Ɛnna mubua see me sɛ: Yɛayɛ AWURADE bɔne, yɛn ara yɛbɛforo akɔko sɛnea AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ yɛn no nyinaa. Na mode mo akode miamiae no, ɛyɛɛ mo sɛ bepɔw no foro yɛ agoru.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mommforo nnkɔko, na minni mo mu, na moankɔtotɔ mo atamfo anim.

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Na mekasa mekyerɛɛ mo, na moantie, na motew AWURADE anom asɛm atua, na mutintim mo anim foroo bepɔw no.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Na Amorifo a wɔte bepɔw no so no fi behyiaa mo na wɔtaa mo sɛnea nnowa yɛ, na wokunkum mo Seir koduu Horma.

english_verse: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Ɛnna motenaa Kades dii nna pii, sɛ nna a mode tenaa hɔ te no.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: Moafa bepɔw yi ho bi ara, na monnan mo ho nkyerɛ benkum fam;

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: na hyɛ ɔman no sɛ: Morebetwam mo nuanom Esau mma a wɔte Seir no hye so, na wosuro mo, monhwɛ mo ho yiye,

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: mo ne wɔn nnni aperepere, na meremfa wɔn asase nammɔn biako po memma mo, efisɛ mede Seir bepɔw mama Esau sɛ n’atenae.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Momfa sika ntɔ wɔn nkyɛn aduan nni, na nsu nso momfa sika ntɔ wɔn nkyɛn nnom;

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Na yetwaa yɛn nuanom Esau mma a wɔte Seir no ho faa Araba tataw so kwan so fii Elat ne Esion-geber dan yɛn ho betwaam Moab sare so kwan so.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nhiahia Moab ho, na wo ne wɔn nnni aperepere nnko, na meremma wo wɔn asase no bi nni so, efisɛ mede Ar mama Lot mma sɛ wonni so.

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: Emifo na kan no wɔte so, ɔman a wɔso na wɔdɔɔso na wɔwowaree sɛ Anakfo;

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: wɔn nso, wobu wɔn abran akɛse sɛ Anakfo; Moabfo na wɔfrɛ wɔn Emifo.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na Seir nso kan no Horifo na ɛte hɔ, na Esau mma tuu wɔn na wɔsɛee wɔn, wɔn anim, na wɔtenaa wɔn ananmu, sɛnea Israel yɛɛ asase a ɛyɛ wɔn agyapade a AWURADE de maa wɔn no.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Na akofofo no nyinaa sae na wowuwu fii ɔman no mu no,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: Ɛnnɛ worebetwam wɔ Ar, Moab hye so,

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: na wudu Amon mma hye so a, nhiahia wɔn ho na wo ne wɔn nnni aperepere, na meremma wo Amon mma asase no bi nni so, efisɛ mede mama Lot mma sɛ wonni so.

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: Wobu ɛno nso abran akɛse asase; abran akɛse na ɛte so kan no, na Amonfo frɛ wɔn Samsumim,

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: sɛnea ɔyɛ maa Esau mma a wɔte Seir a ɔsɛee Horifo wɔn anim ma wotuu wɔn tenaa wɔn ananmu beduu nnɛ yi no.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Na Awifo nso a wɔtenaa nkuraankuraa koduu Gasa no, Kaftorim a wofi Kaftor bae no bɛsɛee wɔn tenaa wɔn ananmu. Wodi Amorifo hene Sihon so

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Monsɔre ntu nkotwa Arnon subon; hwɛ, mede Hesbonhene Sihon a ɔyɛ Amorini no ne n’asase mahyɛ wo nsa; fi ase di so na wo ne no nni aperepere na monko.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Ɛnnɛ da yi na mefi ase mede wo ho suro ne wo ho hu magu ɔsoro nyinaa ase aman a wɔbɛte wo nka so, na wɔn ho apopo na wɔn bo atutu w’anim.

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: Ma mintwam w’asase so; ɔkwan so ara na mɛfa, meremman nifa anaa benkum;

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: sɛnea Esau mma a wɔte Seir ne Moabfo a wɔte Ar yɛɛ me no, de bɛkɔ akosi sɛ metwa Yordan makɔ asase a AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de rema yɛn no so.

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, mafi ase mede Sihon ne n’asase mato w’anim, fi ase fa, na di n’asase so.

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Ɛnna Sihon fi behyiaa yɛn, ɔno ne ne man nyinaa, sɛ ɔne yɛn rebɛko wɔ Yahas.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de no hyɛɛ yɛn nsa, na yekunkum no ne ne mma ne ne man nyinaa.

english_verse: Then we captured and destroyed every town in Sihon's kingdom, killing everyone,
translation_verse: Na yɛfaa ne nkurow nyinaa saa bere no, na yɛsɛee nkurow no nyinaa pasaa, mmarima ne mmea ne mmofra, yɛannyaw oguanfo biara,

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: gye afieboa nko na yɛfow wɔn fae, ɛne nkurow a yɛfae no mu asade.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Efi Aroer a ɛda Arnon subon kɔn so ne kurow a ɛda subon no mu no so de kosi Gilead, kurow biara nni hɔ a ɛyɛ den sen yɛn; AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de ne nyinaa hyɛɛ yɛn nsa.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Gye Amonfo asase no nko ho na woantwiw ammɛn, Yabok subon nkyɛn mu nyinaa ne mmepɔw no so nkurow ne baabiara a AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn braa yɛn.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsuro no, na mede ɔne ne man nyinaa ne n’asase mahyɛ wo nsa, sɛ yɛ no sɛnea woyɛɛ Amorifo hene Sihon a ɔtenaa Hesbon no.

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Na yɛsɛee wɔn pasaa sɛnea yɛyɛɛ Hesbonhene Sihon no, yɛsɛee nkurow no ne mu mmarima, mmea ne mmofra nyinaa pasaa.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Na afieboa nyinaa ne nkurow no mu asade de, yɛfom fae.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Na yegyee asase no fii Amorifo ahemfo baanu a wɔwɔ Yordan agya no nsam saa bere no, efi Arnon subon so kosi Hermon bepɔw ho,

english_verse: Mount Hermon is called Mount Sirion by the people of Sidon, and it is called Mount Senir by the Amorites.
translation_verse: Sidonfo frɛ Hermon sɛ Sirion, na Amorifo frɛ no Senir,

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: asasetaw so nkurow nyinaa ne Gilead nyinaa ne Basan nyinaa kodu Salka ne Edrei, Basan hene Og ahenni no nkurow.

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: nkosi sɛ AWURADE bɛma mo nuanom ahome sɛ mo, na wɔn nso wɔadi asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema wɔn Yordan agya no so, ansa na moasan aba mo agyapade a mede mama mo no so.

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Na mesrɛɛ AWURADE saa bere no sɛ:

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: AWURADE, wo na woafi ase de wo kɛseyɛ ne wo nsa a ɛyɛ den no akyerɛ w’akoa, na onyame bɛn na ɔwɔ ɔsoro anaa asase so a obetumi ayɛ wo nnwuma ne wo mmaninne yi bi?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Mesrɛ wo, ma mintwa menkɔhwɛ asase pa a ɛwɔ Yordan agya no, bepɔw asase fɛfɛ no ne Lebanon.

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Nanso mo nti AWURADE bo fuw me, na wantie me; na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ɛdɔɔ wo so, nkɔ so ne me nkasa asɛm yi ho bio.

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Foro kɔ Pisga so, na ma w’ani so hwɛ atɔe ne benkum fam ne nifa ne apuei, na fa w’ani hwɛ, na Yordan yi de, worentwa.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Na fa adwuma yi hyɛ Yosua nsa, na hyɛ no den na hyɛ no baninha, efisɛ ɔno na ɔbɛkyɛ asase a wubehu no mu ama wɔn.

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Na yɛtenaa obon no mu, Bet-peor ntentenso.

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Na afei, Israel, tie ahyɛde ne atemmude a mekyerɛ mo sɛ monyɛ no, na moanya nkwa na moakɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo agyanom Nyankopɔn de rema mo no.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Mommfa hwee nnka asɛm a merehyɛ mo yi ho, nanso munnyi mu biribi, na moadi AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo yi so.

english_verse: You saw how he killed everyone who worshiped the god Baal Peor.
translation_verse: Mo aniwa ahu nea Baal-peor nti AWURADE yɛe, sɛ nnipa a wodii Baal-peor akyi nyinaa AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn sɛee wɔn fii mo mu;

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: na mo a mobataa AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ho no, mo nyinaa te ase nnɛ.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Wo ho yiye ara na hwɛ, na hwɛ wo kra yiye, na wo werɛ amfi nsɛm a w’ani ahu no, na wo nkwa nna nyinaa mu amfi wo komam, na ma wo mma ne wo mma mma nhu.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Ɛda a wugyina AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, Horeb so no na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Boaboa ɔman no ano ma me, na memma wontie me nsɛm a wonsua mfa nsuro me, nna a wɔde te ase, asase so nyinaa, na wɔmfa nkyerɛ wɔn mma:

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Na mutwiw bɛnee begyinaa bepɔw no ase, na bepɔw no de gya redɛw kɔ ɔsoro tɔnn, ne esum, omununkum ne esum kabii.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE fi ogya no mu kasa kyerɛɛ mo; nsɛm no nne no, mo ara motee, na suban bi na moanhu anka nne no ho.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa n’apam a ɔhyɛɛ mo sɛ monyɛ no kyerɛɛ mo, mmara nsɛm du no, na ɔkyerɛwee abopon abien so.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na me nso AWURADE hyɛɛ me bere no mu sɛ menkyerɛ mo ahyɛde ne atemmude a monyɛ, asase a moretwam akɔfa no so.

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Enti monhwɛ mo kra so yiye, efisɛ moanhu suban biara da no a AWURADE fi ogya no mu kasa kyerɛɛ mo Horeb so no.

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: Na moanni asɛmmɔne ankɔyɛ ohoni a wɔasen amfa, ade biara suban, ɔbarima anaa ɔbea nsɛso,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Na woamma w’ani so ankyerɛ ɔsoro anhwɛ owia ne ɔsram ne nsoromma, ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, na antwe wo ankɔsɔre wɔn ansom wɔn, nneɛma a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyekyɛ ama wiase amanaman nyinaa no.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Na mo de, AWURADE afa mo, na wayi mo afi dade fononoo mu, afi Misraim sɛ mommɛyɛ n’awunnyaman sɛ mote nnɛ da yi.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Na mo nti AWURADE nyaa me abufuw, na ɔkaa ntam sɛ merentwa Yordan na merenkɔ asase pa a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di so no so;

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: na me de, merebewu asase yi so, merentwa Yordan, na mo na mubetwa akɔfa asase pa no.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Monhwɛ mo ho yiye na mo werɛ amfi AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn apam a ɔne mo pamee no, na moanyɛ ohoni a ɛyɛ biribiara a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abra wo nsɛso amfa.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɛpansam mo agu amanaman mu, na ɛbɛka mo mu kakraa bi wɔ wiase aman a AWURADE de mo bɛkɔ hɔ no mu;

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: na ɛhɔ na mobɛsom anyame a ɛyɛ onipa nsa ano adwuma, nnua ne abo a enhu ade na ɛnte asɛm na ennidi na ente ade hua no.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Sɛ ehia wo na nneɛma yi nyinaa to wo nna a edi akyiri no mu a, wobɛsan aba AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn abetie ne nne;

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛ Onyankopɔn mmɔborohunufo, ɔrempa wo na ɔrensɛe wo, na ne werɛ remfi w’agyanom apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn no.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ofi soro ma wotee ne nne sɛ ɔreteɛ wo so, na asase so nso wama woahu ne gya kɛse no, na woate ne nsɛm afi gya mu.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Na esiane sɛ ɔdɔ w’agyanom nti, wapaw wɔn asefo a edi wɔn akyi, na ɔde n’anim ne ne tumi kɛse ayi wo afi Misraim,

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔrebetu aman a wɔso na wɔyɛ den sen wo afi w’anim, sɛ ɔde wo rekɔ hɔ de wɔn asase akɔma wo sɛ awunnyade, sɛ ɛte nnɛ da yi.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Enti hu nnɛ, na fa sie wo koma mu, sɛ AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn, nyame so wɔ ɔsoro, ne asase so wɔ fam; obi nni hɔ bio.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Na di n’ahyɛde ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so, na awie wo ne wo mma a wodi w’akyi yiye, na woakye ade, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so daa nyinaa. Mose yi guankɔbea nkurow abiɛsa

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: Yordan agya, obon no mu, Bet-peor ntentenso, Amorifo hene Sihon a ɔtenaa Hesbon a Mose ne Israelfo fi Misraim bae no, wokum no no asase so.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa n’asase ne Basan hene Og asase, Amorifo ahene baanu a wɔtenatenaa Yordan agya, apuei fam no, asase,

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: efi Aroer a ɛda Arnon subon kɔn so kosi Sion bepɔw a ɛne Hermon ho,

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: ne Araba tataw a ɛda Yordan agya apuei no nyinaa kodu Araba tataw so po no ano wɔ Pisga ase.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Na Mose frɛɛ Israel nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Israel, muntie ahyɛde ne atemmude a mereka magu mo asom nnɛ yi, na munsua, na munni so nyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ne yɛn yɛɛ apam Horeb so;

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: ɛnyɛ yɛn agyanom na AWURADE ne wɔn pam apam yi, na ɛyɛ yɛn a ɛnnɛ yɛn nyinaa tete ase yi ara.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: AWURADE fi ogya no mu ne mo dii nhwɛanim na ɔkasae, bepɔw no so.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Me de, na migyina AWURADE ne mo ntam saa bere no, sɛ merekyerɛ mo AWURADE asɛm, efisɛ musuroo ogya no anim na moamforo bepɔw no. Na ose:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a miyii wo fii Misraim asase so, nkoafi mu no.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Nnya anyame foforo nka me ho.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Nyɛ ohoni, ade a ɛwɔ wim ɔsoro ne nea ɛwɔ asase so ɛfam ne nea ɛwɔ nsu mu asase ase suban mfa: Nkotow wɔn na nsom wɔn.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Na me AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, meyɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufo a mitua agyanom amumɔyɛ so ka mefa mma so kosi awo ntoatoaso abiɛsa ne anan a wɔtan me so,

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: na meyɛ mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wodi me mmara nsɛm so adɔe.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn din ahuhude mu, na AWURADE remma nea ɔbɔ ne din ahuhude mu ho nyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Show respect for the Sabbath Day—it belongs to me.
translation_verse: Di homeda na yɛ no kronkron, sɛnea AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo no.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Nnansia na yɛ adwuma, na yɛ w’ade nyinaa;

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: na ɛda a ɛto so ason no yɛ homeda ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, nyɛ adwuma biara, wo ne wo babarima ne wo babea, ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa, ne wo nantwi ne w’afurum ne wo mmoa nyinaa, ne wo hɔho a ɔwɔ wo kurow apon mu: Na w’akoa ne w’afenaa ahome sɛ wo.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim asase so, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a wateɛ mu yii wo fii hɔ; enti na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛ wo sɛ di homeda no.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Di w’agya ne wo na ni, sɛnea AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo no, na wo nna aware na asi wo yiye, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ korɔn.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: Nsɛm yi na AWURADE fi ogya, omununkum ne esum kabii no mu de nne kɛse ka kyerɛɛ mo bagua no nyinaa, bepɔw no so, na wamfa bi anka ho; na ɔkyerɛwee wɔ abopon abien so de maa me.

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Na motee nne no fii esum no mu na bepɔw no redɛw no, mutwiw baa me nkyɛn, mo mmusuakuw mu atitiriw nyinaa ne mo mpanyimfo

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: bɛkae sɛ: Hwɛ, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ama yɛahu n’anuonyam ne ne kɛseyɛ, na yɛate ne nne afi ogya no mu, ɛnnɛ da yi na yɛahu sɛ Onyankopɔn ne onipa kasa nanso onya nkwa.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Na afei, ɛdɛn nti na yenwu? Efisɛ ogya kɛse yi rebɛhyew yɛn. Sɛ yɛte AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn nne bio a, yebewuwu.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Na ɔhonam nyinaa mu hena na wate Onyankopɔn teasefo no nne sɛ ɛrekasa afi ogya mu, sɛ yɛn, na wanya nkwa?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Wo na twiw bɛn hɔ, na tie nea AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛka nyinaa, na bɛka yɛn nea AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛka akyerɛ wo nyinaa, na yebetie na yɛayɛ.

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Na morekasa akyerɛ me no, AWURADE tee mo nsɛm no, na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mate ɔman yi nsɛm a wɔaka akyerɛ wo no, nea wɔaka nyinaa, wɔaka no yiye.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: O, sɛ anka wobenya koma a ɛte sɛɛ na wɔde asuro me adi me mmara nsɛm so nna nyinaa, na asi wɔn ne wɔn mma yiye daa ɛ!

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Kɔ na kɔka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Monsan nkɔ mo ntamadan mu.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Na wo de, gyina me nkyɛn ha, na menka mmara nsɛm ne ahyɛde ne atemmude a wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn no nyinaa menkyerɛ wo na wɔnyɛ wɔ asase a mede merema wɔn sɛ wɔmfa no so.

english_verse: Israel, you must carefully obey the Lord's commands.
translation_verse: Enti monhwɛ na monyɛ sɛnea AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ mo no; mommman nifa anaa benkum;

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: ɔkwan a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ mo no nyinaa so na monnantew na moanya nkwa, na asi mo yiye, na mo nna aware asase a morekonya no so.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: Na eyi ne mmara nsɛm, ahyɛde ne atemmude a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ mo na monyɛ asase a moretwam akɔfa no so,

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: na woasuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn adi n’ahyɛde ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo yi nyinaa so, wo ne wo ba ne wo ba ba, wo nkwa nna nyinaa, na wo nna aware.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Enti, Israel, tie, na hwɛ yɛ, na asi wo yiye, na woadɔɔso pii, sɛnea AWURADE w’agyanom Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ wo no, asase a nufusu ne ɛwo sen so no so.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Israel, tie, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ne AWURADE koro.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Na fa wo koma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa ne w’ahoɔden nyinaa dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mma yiye, na kasa ho, w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nantew mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔre mu;

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: na fa yɛ sɛnkyerɛnne kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ w’aniwa ntam nkae ntamabamma;

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nya de wo du asase a ɔkaa w’agyanom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wo no so, nkurow akɛse a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛnyɛ wo na wokyekyee,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: ne adan a nnepa nyinaa ayɛ no amaama a ɛnyɛ wo na wode hyehyɛɛ mu, ne mmura a wɔatutu a ɛnyɛ wo na wututui, bobe nturo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotetɛwee, na sɛ wudidi na womee a,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: hwɛ yiye na wo werɛ amfi AWURADE a oyii wo Misraim asase so fii nkoa fi no:

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, na ɔno na som no, na ne din ho ntam na ka;

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: munnni anyame foforo a wofi amanaman a wogugu mo ho no anyame mu akyi;

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufo, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abufuw annɛw anhyɛ wo, na wansɛe wo amfi asase ani.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Monnsɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, sɛnea mosɔɔ no hwɛe Masa hɔ no;

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: munni AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm ne n’adansesɛm ne n’ahyɛde a wahyɛ mo no so pɛpɛɛpɛ;

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔkyena bi wo ba bisa wo sɛ: Adansesɛm ne ahyɛde ne atemmude bɛn na AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de hyɛɛ mo yi a?

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ wo ba no sɛ: Yɛyɛɛ Farao nkoa Misraim, na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii yɛn fii Misraim;

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: na AWURADE maa nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwonwade akɛse a ɛyɛ hu baa Misraim, Farao ne ne fi nyinaa so wɔ yɛn anim;

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: na yɛn de, oyii yɛn fii hɔ sɛ ɔde yɛn reba, de asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ yɛn agyanom no abɛma yɛn.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: na sɛ yɛhwɛ di mmara nsɛm yi nyinaa so AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim, sɛnea ɔhyɛɛ yɛn no a, ɛbɛyɛ yɛn atreneefo.

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Enti di mmara nsɛm ne ahyɛde ne atemmude a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so, na yɛ.

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Na sɛe aman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn bɛma wo no nyinaa; mma w’ani nnhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na nsom wɔn anyame, efisɛ ɛno bɛyɛ afiri ama wo.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yi wɔn ma wo ma wukum wɔn a, ɛnne sɛe wɔn pasaa, wo ne wɔn mmpam, na nhu wɔn mmɔbɔ;

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Efisɛ ɔbɛdan wo ba ani afi m’akyi, na wɔasom anyame foforo, na AWURADE bo afuw mo, na wasɛe wo ntɛm.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Na mmom sɛ monyɛ wɔn ni: Munnwiridwiriw wɔn afɔremuka, na mummubu wɔn abo adum, na muntwitwa wɔn Asera nnua ngu, na momfa ogya nhyew wɔn ahoni.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Na ɔman kronkron ne wo ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; wo na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn apaw wo sɛ bɛyɛ ɔman a wafa ayɛ ne de aman a wɔwɔ asase ani nyinaa mu.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: na esiane sɛ AWURADE dɔ mo na odi ne ntam a ɔkaa mo agyanom no so nti na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii mo fii nkoafi fii Misraim hene Farao nsam.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Enti hu sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno ne Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn nokwafo a ɔkora apam ne adɔe ma wɔn a wɔdɔ no na wodi ne mmara nsɛm so kosi awo ntoatoaso apem so,

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: na otua wɔn a wɔtan no ka bɔ wɔn anim na ɔsɛe wɔn; ɔnyɛ nyaa mma nea ɔtan no, obetua no ka abɔ n’anim.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Wobehyira wo asen aman nyinaa; ɔbarima anaa ɔbea renyɛ obonin wo mu ne w’afieboa mu.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Na mfa akyide nkɔ wo fi, na woanyɛ abusude sɛ ɛno; ma ɛnyɛ wo tan na kyi, efisɛ ɛyɛ abusude.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: na wadɔ wo ahyira wo ama woadɔ, na wahyira wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’aburow ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ne w’anantwi mma ne wo nguan mma, asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’agyanom sɛ ɔde bɛma wo no so.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mutie atemmude yi na mudi so yɛ a, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nso bedi apam ne adɔe a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’agyanom no so ama wo,

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE beyi ɔyare nyinaa afi wo so, na ɔremfa Misraim yare bɔne a wunim no biara nto wo so, na ɔde bɛto wɔn a wɔtan wo nyinaa so.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wuse wo koma mu sɛ: Amanaman yi dɔɔso sen me, mɛyɛ dɛn na matumi matu wɔn a,

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: nsuro wɔn, na kae nea AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Farao ne Misraim nyinaa,

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: sɔhwɛ akɛse a w’aniwa hui ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwonwade ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a wateɛ mu a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de yii wo no; saa nso na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ aman a wusuro wɔn no nyinaa.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Nkotokurodu nso na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsoma akɔ wɔn mu akosi sɛ wɔn a wɔaka na wɔahintaw no bɛsɛe w’anim.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Mma wɔn anim nnyɛ wo hu, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn wɔ wo mu, Onyankopɔn kɛse a ne ho yɛ hu ne no.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Na ɔde wɔn ahene bɛhyɛ wo nsa, na woasɛe wɔn din afi ɔsoro ase; obiara rentumi nnyina w’anim de bɛkɔ akosi sɛ wobɛsɛe wɔn.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Wɔn anyame ahoni no, momfa ogya nhyew; mma w’ani mmmere ho dwetɛ ne sika, na mfa bi, na ansum wo afiri, efisɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyide.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa munni so na monyɛ, na moanya nkwa, na moadɔ, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom no adi so.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Na ɔbrɛɛ wo ase maa ɔkɔm dee wo, na ɔde mana a wunnim na w’agyanom nso nnim yɛn wo, na wama woahu sɛ, ɛnyɛ abodoo nko so na onipa nam bɛtena ase, na ade biara a efi AWURADE anom so na onipa nam tena ase.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Na hu wo koma mu sɛ, sɛnea onipa teɛ ne ba so no, saa ara na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn teɛ wo so.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Enti di AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so, sɛ wobɛnantew n’akwan so na woasuro no.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo rekɔ asase pa so, asase a ɛso wɔ nsubɔnten ne nsuaniwa ne atare a efifi abon ne mmepɔw mu sen,

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wudidi mee a, hyira AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, asase pa a ɔde ama wo no nti.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Hwɛ yiye na wo werɛ amfi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a worenni ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmude ne n’ahyɛde a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wudidi mee na wusisi adan pa tena mu,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: na w’anantwi ne wo nguan dɔ, na wo dwetɛ ne wo sika dɔɔso ma wo, na ade a wowɔ nyinaa dɔɔso a,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: wo koma amma ne ho so, na wo werɛ amfi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a oyii wo Misraim asase so fii nkoafi no;

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: ɔno na odii w’anim de wo faa sare kɛse a ɛso yɛ hu a awɔ a wɔhyehye, ne nkekantwɛre wɔ so so, ne nkyerekyerewa a nsu nni hɔ so; oyii nsu fii ɔbohemmaa botan mu maa wo;

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: ɔde mana a w’agyanom nnim ma wudii sare so, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo ase na wasɔ wo ahwɛ, na awiei no, wayɛ wo yiye,

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: na woanka wo koma mu sɛ: M’ahoɔden ne me nsa den na ama manya ahonyade yi,

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: na mmom kae AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔma wo ahoɔden a wode nya wo ho, na wama n’apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’agyanom no atim sɛ ɛte nnɛ yi.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Sɛ amanaman a AWURADE sɛe wɔn fi mo anim no, saa ara na mobɛsɛe, efisɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nne.

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Israel, tie! Worebetwa Yordan nnɛ akɔ akotu amanaman a wɔsosoe na wɔn ho yɛ den sen wo, afa nkurow akɛse a wɔatoto ho afasu akɔ soro,

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: ɔman kɛse a wɔwowaree, Anakfo mma a wunim wɔn na woate wɔn ho asɛm sɛ: Hena na obegyina Anak mma anim no?

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Na hu nnɛ sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ne nea odi w’anim retwa, sɛ ogya a ɛhyew; ɔno na ɔbɛsɛe wɔn, na wabrɛ wɔn ase, w’anim, na watu wɔn asɛe wɔn ntɛm, sɛnea AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ wo no.
