english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Kae, na mma wo werɛ mmfi, sɛnea wuyii AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abufuw sare so no; efi da a wufii Misraim asase so de besii sɛ mobaa ha yi, motew AWURADE anim atua.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Na Horeb nso muyii AWURADE abufuw, na ɛmaa AWURADE bo fuw mo sɛ anka ɔbɛsɛe mo;

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre sian fi ha ntɛm, na ɔman a wukoyii wɔn Misraim no di asɛmmɔne; wɔadan ntɛm afi ɔkwan a mehyɛɛ wɔn no so; wɔayɛ sika ohoni afa.

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mahu ɔman yi, na hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔn kɔn asen;

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: gyaa me ma mensɛe wɔn, na mempopa wɔn din mimfi ɔsoro ase, na mede wo mɛyɛ ɔman a ɛyɛ den na ɛso sen wɔn.

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Ɛnna medan me ho mifii bepɔw no so misianee, na bepɔw no redɛw ogya, na apam apon abien no kurakura me nsam;

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: na mihui, na hwɛ, moayɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn bɔne ayɛ nantwi ba a wɔagu afa: Moaman ntɛm afi ɔkwan a AWURADE hyɛɛ mo no so.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Ɛnna mefaa apon abien no metow fii me nsam gui, na mebobɔe wɔ mo anim.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Na AWURADE faa Aaron abufuw kɛse sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe no; na mepaa kyɛw memaa Aaron nso saa bere no.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Na mefaa mo bɔne a moyɛe a ɛne nantwi ba no, na mede ogya mehyewee, na misiw meyam no muhumuhu kosii sɛ efei sɛ mfutuma, na metow ne mfutuma no guu asu a efi bepɔw no so sen no mu.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Na Tabera ne Masa ne Kibrot-hataawa nso muyii AWURADE abufuw.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE somaa mo fi Kades-barnea kae sɛ: Momforo nkɔfa asase a mede mama mo no, motew AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anom asɛm no atua, na moannye no anni, na moantie ne nne.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: AWURADE anim atuatewfo ne mo fi da a mihuu mo.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Na mehwee AWURADE anim ase adaduanan ne anadwo aduanan; na mehwee ase, efisɛ AWURADE aka sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe mo;

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: na mepaa AWURADE kyɛw sɛ: AWURADE, nsɛe wo man ne w’agyapade a wode wo kɛseyɛ agye wɔn na wode nsa a ɛyɛ den ayi wɔn afi Misraim no.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Kae wo nkoa Abraham, Isak ne Yakob; nnan w’ani nhwɛ ɔman yi asoɔden ne wɔn amumɔyɛ ne wɔn bɔne,

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: na asase a wuyii yɛn fii so no sofo anka sɛ: AWURADE antumi amfa wɔn ankɔ asase a ɔkaa wɔn ɛho asɛm no so, na ɔtan a ɔtan wɔn nti na ɔde wɔn fi kɔe sɛ okokunkum wɔn sare so.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛ wo man ne w’agyapade a wode wo tumi kɛse ne wo nsa a woateɛ ayi wɔn.

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: Saa bere no na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sinsen abopon abien sɛ kan de no na fa foro bra me nkyɛn bepɔw no so, na yɛ dua adaka;

english_verse: When I had taken the second set of stones up the mountain, I spent
translation_verse: Na me de, migyinaa bepɔw no so sɛ kan no, adaduanan ne anadwo aduanan, na AWURADE tiee me saa bere no nso, na AWURADE ampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe wo.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: na mɛkyerɛw nsɛm a ɛwɔ kan apon a wobobɔe no so no mahyɛ apon no so, na fa sie adaka no mu.

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Na meyɛɛ ɔkanto adaka, na misinsen abopon abien sɛ kan de no, na meforoo bepɔw no a mikura apon abien no wɔ me nsam.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Na ɔkyerɛw apon no so sɛ kan nkyerɛwee no, nsɛm du no a AWURADE fi ogya no mu ka kyerɛɛ mo, bepɔw no so guabɔ da no, na AWURADE de maa me.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Na medan me ho misian mifii bepɔw no so, mede apon no mibesiee adaka a meyɛe no mu, na ɛwɔ hɔ sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ me no.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, ɔno na som no, na ne ho na bata, na ne din ho ntam na ka.

english_verse: When your ancestors went to live in Egypt, there were only
translation_verse: Akra aduɔsɔn na w’agyanom de sian kɔɔ Misraim, na afei AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ wo dodow sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo tu fii Beerot-bene-yaakan kɔɔ Mosera. Ɛhɔ na Aaron wui na wosiee no wɔ hɔ, na ne ba Eleasar sii n’ananmu dii sɔfo.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Efi hɔ na wotu kɔɔ Gudgoda, na wofi Gudgoda kɔɔ Yotba, asase a nsuten wɔ so.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Saa bere no na AWURADE yii Lewifo abusuakuw sɛ wɔnsoa AWURADE apam adaka no, na wonnyina AWURADE anim nsom no, na wɔmfa ne din nhyira, de abedu nnɛ da yi.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre kodi ɔman no anim ma wontu nkɔ nkɔfa asase a mekaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no. Osetie ho kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Na afei, Israel, dɛn na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn repɛ wo nkyɛn sɛ gye sɛ wusuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wonantew n’akwan nyinaa so, na wodɔ no, na wode wo koma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa som AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn,

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: na wudi AWURADE mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛde a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so, na ayɛ wo yiye?

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, ɔsoro ne ɔsoro mu soro yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dea, asase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Nanso w’agyanom nko na AWURADE bata wɔn ho sɛ ɔbɛdɔ wɔn, na wapaw wɔn asefo a wodi wɔn akyi a ɛne mo, afi aman nyinaa mu, sɛ ɛte nnɛ yi.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Enti muntwitwa mo koma twetia, na munnsen mo kɔn bio.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn yɛ anyame mu Nyankopɔn ne awurade mu Awurade, Onyankopɔn kɛse no, otumfo a ne ho yɛ hu a ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na onnye adammude;

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: obu atɛn ma ayisaa ne okunafo, na ɔdɔ ɔhɔho ma no aduan ne nkataho.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Enti monnɔ ahɔho, efisɛ moyɛɛ ahɔho Misraim asase so.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne w’ayeyi, na ɔne wo Nyankopɔn a wayɛ nneɛma akɛse a ɛyɛ hu a w’ani ahu yi ama wo.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Enti dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na hwɛ n’ahwɛde ne n’ahyɛde ne n’atemmude ne ne mmara nsɛm nna nyinaa.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Na munhu nnɛ, na menne mo mma a wonnim na wɔanhu no, munhu AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nteɛso, ne kɛseyɛ, ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne ne basa a wateɛ mu,

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: ne ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne ne nneyɛe a ɔyɛe Misraim a ɔde yɛɛ Misraim hene Farao ne n’asase nyinaa,

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: ne nea ɔyɛɛ Misraim dɔm ne n’apɔnkɔ ne ne nteaseɛnam a wɔde retiw mo a ɔmaa Mmɛw-Po mu nsu bu faa wɔn so, na AWURADE sɛee wɔn, de abedu nnɛ da yi,

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: ne nea ɔyɛɛ mo sare so besii sɛ muduu ha yi,

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: ne nea ɔyɛɛ Ruben ba Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram a asase buee n’anom menee wɔn ne wɔn afi ne wɔn ntamadan ne wɔn a wodii wɔn akyi nyinaa fii Israel nyinaa mfinimfini no;

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: na mo ani ahu AWURADE nneyɛe akɛse a ɔyɛe no nyinaa.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Enti munni mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so, na mo ho ayɛ den, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a moretwam akɔ so akɔfa no,

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: na mo nna aware asase a AWURADE kaa mo agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn ne wɔn asefo no so, asase a ɛsen nufusu ne ɛwo no.

english_verse: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.
translation_verse: Na asase a worekɔ akɔfa no nte sɛ Misraim asase a mufi so bae a wuguu w’aba na wode wo nan guguu so nsu sɛ ɛfan turo mu no;

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: na asase a moretwam akɔ so akɔfa no yɛ mmepɔw ne abon asase a ɛnom ɔsoro su mu nsu,

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hwɛ so daa yi, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani wɔ so fi afe mfiase kosi afe awiei.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Na sɛ mutie me mmara nsɛm a mede merema mo nnɛ yi, na mode mo koma nyinaa bɛdɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn na moasom no a,

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Monhwɛ mo ho yiye na wɔannaadaa mo koma, na moamman ankɔsom anyame foforo ansɔre wɔn,

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: na AWURADE abufuw annɛw anhyɛ mo, na wanto ɔsoro mu sɛ osu nntɔ na asase mmma ne nnɔbae, na moansɛe ntɛmso amfi asase pa a AWURADE de rema mo no so.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Enti momfa me nsɛm yi nsie mo koma ne mo kra mu, na fa yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ w’aniwa ntam nkae ntamabamma;

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: na momfa nkyerɛkyerɛ mo mma, na kasa ho w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nantew mu, ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔre mu;

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: na kyerɛw gu wo fi apongua ho ne w’aponkɛse so;

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: na wo nna ne wo mma nna adɔɔso asase a AWURADE kaa w’agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so, sɛ ɔsoro a ɛkata asase so yi nna te.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Na sɛ mubedi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo yi so ayɛ, na mobɛdɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anantew n’akwan nyinaa so na moabata ne ho a,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: ɛnne AWURADE betutu amanaman yi nyinaa afi mo anim, na moafa amanaman akɛse a wɔyɛ den sen mo.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Baabiara a mo nan betia no bɛyɛ mo de, efi sare so ne Lebanon, efi asu no, asubɔnten Eufrate, ho kosi akyiri po no ano bɛyɛ mo asase.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Obiara rentumi nnyina mo anim; AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de mo ho hu ne mo ho suro begu asase a mobɛfa so nyinaa so, sɛnea ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no. Nhyira ne nnome

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Sɛ mutie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi a, mubenya nhyira

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: na sɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm na moman fi ɔkwan a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi so kodi anyame foforo a munnim wɔn akyi a, nnome.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo du asase a worekɔ so akɔfa no so a, ka nhyira no Gerisim bepɔw so ne nnome no nso Ebal bepɔw so.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Na morebetwa Yordan akɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo no, na mobɛfa atena so.

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Enti monhwɛ yiye na monyɛ ahyɛde ne atemmude a mede meresi mo anim nnɛ yi nyinaa.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne ahyɛde ne atemmude a monhwɛ nyɛ asase a AWURADE w’agyanom Nyankopɔn de ma wo sɛ fa no so, nna a mode te asase so nyinaa.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛe na monsɛe faako a amanaman a morekotu wɔn no sonsom wɔn anyame hɔ no nyinaa, mmepɔw atenten so ne nkoko so ne dua momono biara ase;

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: na munnwiriw wɔn afɔremuka, na mummubu wɔn abo adum, na momfa ogya nhyew wɔn Asera nnua, na mommobɔ wɔn anyame ahoni, na monsɛe wɔn din mfi hɔ. Faako a wɔnsom Onyankopɔn

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Sɛ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn beyi de ne din ato hɔ no ne wo ntam ware a, ɛnne kum w’anantwi ne wo nguan a AWURADE de ama wo no bi, sɛnea mehyɛɛ wo no, na di wɔ wo kurom, sɛnea wo kra kɔn dɔ;

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: sɛnea wodi ɔwansan ne ɔforote no, saa ara nso na di; nea ne ho ntew ne nea ne ho tew nyinaa nni.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: nni, na ensi wo ne wo mma a wodi w’akyi yiye, sɛ woreyɛ nea ɛteɛ AWURADE ani so.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: na fa nam ne mogya no bɔ wo hyew afɔre, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔremuka so, na wonhwie w’afɔre no mogya ngu AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔremuka no so, na nam no de, di.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Hwɛ na tie nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nyinaa na ensi wo ne wo mma a wodi w’akyi yiye daa, sɛ woreyɛ nea eye na ɛteɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani so. Wonnni ahoni akyi

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a worekɔ hɔ akotu wɔn no fi w’anim, na wutu wɔn tena wɔn asase so a,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: hwɛ wo ho yiye na ɔsɛe a wɔasɛe wɔn afi w’anim no akyi no wɔn akyidi anyɛ wo afiri, na woammisa wɔn anyame akyi kwan sɛ: Amanaman yi sonsom wɔn anyame dɛn? Na me nso menyɛ sa.

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sa, na AWURADE akyide a ɔtan nyinaa na wɔayɛ ama wɔn anyame, na wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmabea mpo, wɔde ogya hyew wɔn ma wɔn anyame.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: Asɛm a merehyɛ mo nyinaa, monhwɛ nni so; mfa bi nka ho na nyi so bi.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: na sɛnkyerɛnne anaa anwonwade a ɔka kyerɛɛ wo no ba mu na ɔka sɛ: Ma yɛnkɔ nkodi anyame foforo a wunnim wɔn akyi nkɔsom wɔn, a,

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: ntie odiyifo anaa ɔdaesofo no nsɛm no, efisɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn resɔ mo ahwɛ na wahu sɛ mode mo koma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa dɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anaa.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn akyi na munni, na ɔno na munsuro no, na ne mmara nsɛm so na munni, na ne nne na muntie, na monsom no, na mommata ne ho.

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Na odiyifo anaa ɔdaesofo no, munkum no, efisɛ wakasa sɛ momman mfi AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a oyii mo fii Misraim asase so na ogyee mo fii nkoafi no ho de retwetwe wo afi ɔkwan a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo sɛ nantew mu no so; na tu bɔne no fi wo mu.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: na Israel nyinaa ntie na wonsuro, na wɔankɔ so anni wo mu asɛmmɔne a ɛte sɛɛ.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: Sɛ wote wo nkurow a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woatena mu no bi nka sɛ:

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: Mmarima mmabusufo bi asɔre wo mu adaadaa wɔn nkurɔfo sɛ: Momma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom anyame foforo a munnim wɔn, a,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: ɛnne pɛ mu hwehwɛ mu na bisabisa mu yiye; na hwɛ, sɛ asɛm no wom ampa sɛ wɔayɛ saa akyide yi wɔ wo mu a,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: okum na fa nkrante kum kurow no mufo; fa nkrante sɛe ɛno ne nea ɛwom nyinaa ne emu afieboa pasaa;

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: sɛ wubetie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne adi ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so ayɛ nea ɛteɛ, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani so a.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: na ɔman kronkron ne wo ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wo na AWURADE ayi wo sɛ yɛ n’ahode man, asase so aman nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Anomaa biara a ne ho tew no, munni.

english_verse: Don't eat any disgusting animals.
translation_verse: Nni akyide biara.

english_verse: You may eat the meat of cattle, sheep, and goats; wild sheep and goats; and gazelles, antelopes, and all kinds of deer.
translation_verse: ɔforote ne adowa ne ɔwansan ne ewi ne ɔtwe ne ɛkoɔ ne abere.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Na atɔteboa biara a ɔwɔ tɔte a emu apae, na ne tɔte mu apae nta abien, na opuw wesaw, mmoa mu no, ɔno na munni.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Nanso eyinom de, munnni, wɔn a wopuw wesaw ne wɔn a wɔn tɔte mu apae koraa no mu: Yoma ne adanko ne atwaboa, efisɛ wopuw wesaw de, nanso wɔn tɔte mu mpae: Wɔn ho ntew mma mo;

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: ne prako nso, efisɛ ne tɔte mu apae de, nanso ompuw nwesaw: Ne ho ntew mma mo. Munnni wɔn nam, na monnka wɔn afunu.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Eyi ne nea munni, nea ɛwɔ nsum nyinaa: Nea ɛwɔ ntɛtɛw ne abon nyinaa munni;

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: na biribiara a enni ntɛtɛw ne abon no, munnni: Ɛho ntew mma mo.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: Na ntuboa a wɔwea nyinaa ho ntew mma mo; munnni.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Ntuboa a wɔn ho tew nyinaa, munni.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Munnni aboa funu; fa ma ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo kurow apon mu ma onni anaasɛ tɔn ma ɔnanani, efisɛ woyɛ ɔman kronkron ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn. Nnoa aguammaa ne na nufu mu. Ntotoso du du ho mmara

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: W’ade a wuduae nnɔbae a w’afuw ma daa afirihyia no, yi so ntotoso du du;

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, faako a obeyi sɛ ne din ntena no na di w’aburow ne wo nsa ne wo ngo so ntotoso du du ne w’anantwi ne wo nguan mmakan, na woasua AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn suro nna nyinaa.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyira wo na sɛ ɔkwan no ware a wuntumi nsoa, efisɛ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔde ne din bɛto hɔ no ne wo ntam ware a,

english_verse: then sell this part and take the money there instead.
translation_verse: ɛnne dan no sika, na kyekyere sika no kura, na sim kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi no.

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Na fa sika no tɔ ade biara a wo kra kɔn dɔ, nantwi ne oguan ne bobesa ne nsa biara a ɛyɛ den ne ade biara a wo kra pɛ, na di no hɔ, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, na ma wo ne wo fi ani nnye.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Na Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kurow apon mu no, nnyaw no, efisɛ onni kyɛfa ne agyapade biara sɛnea wo de wowɔ.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Mfe abiɛsa awiei no, yi w’afe no mu nnɔbae so ntotoso du du gugu wo nkurow apon mu,

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: ma Lewini, efisɛ onni kyɛfa ne agyapade biara sɛnea wo de wowɔ, ne ɔhɔho ne ayisaa ne okunafo a wɔwɔ wo kurow apon mu mmra mmedi mmee, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo, wo nsa ano adwuma a woyɛ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: Sɛ wo nuanom mu biara dan wo mu hiani, wo kurow biara mu, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so a, mpirim wo koma, na mmua wo nsa ano nhyɛ wo nua hiani;

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔnkyɛ ade no ni: Ɔdefɛmfo biara a ɔde biribi afɛm ne yɔnko mfa nkyɛ no; ɔnnhyɛ ne yɔnko ne ne nua sɛ ontua, efisɛ wɔapae no adekyɛ afe ama AWURADE.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Ɔnanani de, hyɛ no ma ontua. Wo biribiara a ɛwɔ wo nua nkyɛn de, fa kyɛ no.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo sɛnea ɔka kyerɛɛ wo no, na wode afɛm amanaman pii, na wo de, worenkɔfɛm, na wubedi amanaman pii so, na wo de, wɔrenni wo so.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: na bue wo nsam ma no, na fɛm no nea ɛbɛso ne hia a ehia no no.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Hwɛ yiye na wo komam amma ahuhusɛm bi sɛ: Afe a ɛto so asɔn, adekyɛ afe no abɛn: Na woannya wo nua hiani no ho ani bɔne sɛ woremma no hwee, na wanteɛm amfrɛ AWURADE anhyɛ wo, na annan wo bɔne.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Yi wo yam ma no, na mma ɛnnyɛ wo koma ahi sɛ wobɛma no; na saa ade yi nti, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo, wo nnwuma nyinaa ne nea wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Na sɛ dɛm bi wɔ ne ho, ɔtɔ apakye anaasɛ n’ani afura, anaasɛ dɛmmɔne biara wɔ ne ho a, mfa no mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔre;

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Na sɛ woregya no kwan na wafa ne ho afi wo nkyɛn akodi a, mma ɔnnkɔ nsapan:

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Fa wo nguan, ne w’awiporowbea ade, ne wo nsa-kyi-amoa mu ade no bi kyɛ no; ade a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ahyira wo no bi na fa ma no.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ: Meremfi wo nkyɛn, na medɔ wo ne wo fi, efisɛ odi yiye wɔ wo nkyɛn a,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: ɛnne fa fitii fiti n’asom apongua ho na ɔnyɛ w’akoa daa; na w’afenaa nso yɛ no saa ara.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: W’anantwi ne wo nguan mmakan anini a wɔbɛwo no, yɛ wɔn kronkron ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn. Mfa wo nantwi abakan nyɛ adwuma, na ntwitwa wo nguan abakan ho;

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: wo kurow apon mu na di, nea ne ho ntew ne nea ne ho tew nyinaa nni, sɛ wodi ɔwansan ne ɔforote;

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: ne mogya nko na nni, hwie gu fam sɛ nsu.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Hwɛ ɔsram Abib na di Twam ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, efisɛ ɔsram Abib mu na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yii wo fii Misraim anadwo.

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Nnansia na di apiti, na da a ɛto so ason no nyɛ afahyɛ nhyiam mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; nyɛ adwuma biara.

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Enti kum Twam afɔre no ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, nguan ne anantwi, faako a AWURADE ayi sɛ ne din ntena hɔ no.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Nkum Twam no wɔ nkurow a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no mu biara mu,

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: gye faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn beyi sɛ ne din ntena hɔ no, ɛhɔ na kum Twam no anwummere a owia rekɔtɔ no, wo Misraim fi bere no mu;

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: na ma ɛmmen na di wɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ hɔ, na ade kye a, woasan akɔ wo ntamadan mu.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: na mfa ɔbo dum nsi hɔ mfa; na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyide ne no.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Ntɛw nnua biara mfa nyɛ Asera nnua wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔremuka a worebesi no ho;

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: na ma w’ani nnye AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, wo ne wo babarima ne wo babea ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne Lewini a ɔwɔ wo nkurow mu ne ɔhɔho ne ayisaa ne okunafo a wɔwɔ mo mu, faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn beyi sɛ ne din ntena hɔ no.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: obiara mma nea ne nsa bɛso so, sɛnea AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira a ɔde ahyira wo no te. Atemmufo ne atemmu ho asɛm

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Afirihyia biako mu mpɛn abiɛsa na wo mmarima nyinaa mmeyi wɔn ho adi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim faako a ɔbɛkyerɛ hɔ: Apiti nnapɔnna, adapɛn dapɔnna ne asese nnapɔnna mu; na wɔmmfa nsapan mmmeyi wɔn ho adi, AWURADE anim;

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mfa nantwi anaa oguan a ne ho wɔ dɛm anaa adebɔne biara mmɔ afɔre mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, efisɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyide.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: na wɔka kyerɛ wo na wote a, ɛnne pɛ mu yiye; na sɛ wuhu sɛ ɛyɛ nokware, na asɛm no wom sɛ wɔayɛ saa akyide yi wɔ Israel a,

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: na yi bɔne no fi Israel, na ɔman no nyinaa nte na wonsuro, na wɔanni ahantansɛm bio. Ɔhene paw ne n’asɛde

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wudu asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so na wofa tena so, na woka sɛ: Mesi me so hene sɛ amanaman a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no nyinaa a,

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: fa nea AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn beyi no no si wo so hene; wo nuanom mu bi na fa no si wo so hene; mfa ɔnanani bi a ɔnyɛ wo nua nsi wo so.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔmmma n’apɔnkɔ nnnɔɔso, na ɔmmma ɔman no nnsan nnkɔ Misraim nkɔpɛ apɔnkɔ dodow; na AWURADE aka akyerɛ mo sɛ monnsan mmfa ɔkwan yi so bio.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔmmma ne yerenom nnnɔɔso, na ne koma amman; saa ara na ɔmmma ne dwetɛ ne sika nnnɔɔso pii.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔte n’ahenni agua so a, ɔnhwɛ mmara yi nhoma a ɛda asɔfo ne Lewifo anim no so nkyerɛw bi mfa;

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: na ɛntena ne nkyɛn, na ɔnkenkan mu, ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na wasua AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn suro, ne mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa ne ahyɛde yi hwɛ ne ɛsodi,

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: na ne koma amma ne ho so ansen ne nuanom, na wamman amfi mmara nsɛm no ho ankɔ nifa anaa benkum, na ama ne nna aware n’ahenni mu, ɔno ne ne mma, Israel mu.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Mɛma odiyifo so mama wɔn wɔn nuanom mu sɛ wo; na mede me nsɛm mɛhyɛ n’anom, na waka nea mɛhyɛ no nyinaa akyerɛ wɔn;

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Wɔmmma asɔfo Lewifo, Lewi abusuakuw nyinaa nnnya kyɛfa ne agyapade biara Israel mu. Wobetumi adi AWURADE gya afɔre so ade no bi, ɛno nyɛ wɔn agyapade.

english_verse: because he has promised to provide for them in this way.
translation_verse: Na wɔrennya agyapade wɔn nuanom mu; AWURADE ne wɔn agyapade, sɛnea ɔhyɛɛ wɔn bɔ no.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Na eyi nyɛ asɔfo no kyɛfa a efi ɔman no nsam, mfi wɔn a wɔbɔ afɔre no nkyɛn, nantwi oo, oguan oo: Wɔmfa basa ne abogye ne ofuru mma ɔsɔfo no;

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: w’aburow, wo nsa ne wo ngo mu adekan ne wo nguan ho nwi a wutwa kan no, fa ma no,

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: efisɛ ɔno na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi no afi wo mmusuakuw nyinaa mu, sɛ onnyina nsom AWURADE din mu, ɔno ne ne mma, nna nyinaa.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Na sɛ Lewini bi fi wo nkurow no biara mu, fi Israel mu baabiara a wakɔsoɛ hɔ, na ɔde ne pɛ nyinaa ba bɛtena faako a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ hɔ a,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: ɛnne ɔnsom AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn din mu sɛ ne nuanom Lewifo a wogyina AWURADE anim hɔ nyinaa yɛ no.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: Sɛ wunya du asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so a, nsua amanaman no akyide no yɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: efisɛ AWURADE akyide ne wɔn a wɔyɛ eyinom nyinaa, na akyide yi nti na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn retu wɔn afi w’anim yi.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Wo ne AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ntena no mudi mu.

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Na amanaman yi a worekotu wɔn yi tie abayifo ne nkɔmhyɛfo, na wo de, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmaa wo kwan sɛ yɛ no sa. Wontie Odiyifo no

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Odiyifo a ofi wo mu a ofi wo nuanom mu te sɛ me na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma no so ama wo, ɔno na muntie no.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Sɛnea wubisaa AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn wɔ Horeb guabɔ da no sɛ: Mma mennte AWURADE me Nyankopɔn nne bio, na mma minnhu ogya kɛse yi bio, na manwu!

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nea wɔaka no wɔaka no yiye:

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: na obiara a ɔrentie me nsɛm a ɔbɛka me din mu no, me ara mebisa no ase.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na odiyifo a ɔbɛma ne ho so aka asɛm bi, me din mu, a menhyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnka ne nea ɔbɛkasa anyame foforo din mu no, odiyifo ko no bewu.

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Na sɛ woka wo koma mu sɛ: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yebehu asɛm a AWURADE nkae no?

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛ odiyifo no kasa AWURADE din mu na asɛm no amma anaasɛ amma mu a, na AWURADE nkae ne no; ahokyerɛ na odiyifo no de kasae, nsuro no.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: na sɛ wudi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so yɛ, na wodɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na wonantew n’akwan so nna nyinaa a, ɛnne yiyi nkurow abiɛsa bio ka abiɛsa yi ho fa,

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn asase rema wo no, na wutu wɔn tena wɔn nkurow ne wɔn adan mu a,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: sɛ ebia, obi ne ne yɔnko kɔ kwae mu akɔtow nnua, na ne nsa ma abonnua so de retwa dua, na dade no hɔn fi ne dua mu bɔ ne yɔnko no ma owu a, ɛnne onguan nkɔ nkurow yi biako mu na onnya nkwa;

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: na mogya ho werefo no amfa abufuhyew antiw onipakumfo no, na ɔkwan no ware nti, wankɔto no ankum no; nso na ɛnsɛ sɛ onipa no wu, efisɛ bere a atwam no na ɔntan ne yɔnko no.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ yiyi nkurow abiɛsa fa.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi tan ne yɔnko, na ɔtɛw no, tow hyɛ no so, na ɔbɔ no ade ma owu, na oguan kɔ nkurow yi biako mu a,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: ɛnne ne kurom mpanyimfo nsoma mma wɔnkɔfa no mfi hɔ, na wɔmfa no nhyɛ mogya ho werefo no nsa, na onwu.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mma w’aniwa nnhu no mmɔbɔ, na yi mogya a edi bem ho afobu fi Israel, na ensi wo yiye.

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ntwiw wo yɔnko hye a tetefo atwa, w’agyapade a woanya mu, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa no so. Adansefo ho asɛm

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Ɔdansefo biako nnsɔre nnhyɛ obi, amumɔyɛ biara anaa bɔne biara ho, bɔne biara a wɔyɛ mu: Adansefo baanu anaa baasa anom nsɛm so na asɛm biara nnyina.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔdansekurumfo bi sɔre hyɛ obi di no mfomso ho adanse a,

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Sɛ wutu sa ne w’atamfo akɔko na wuhu apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne ɔman a wɔdɔɔso sen wo a, nsuro wɔn, efisɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔde wo fi Misraim asase so bae no ka wo ho.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Na sɛ mobɛn dɔm no a, ɔsɔfo no ntwiw mmɛkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no,

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: na ɔnka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Israel, tie, morebɛn dɔm nnɛ ne mo atamfo akɔko, mommma mo koma nntutu, munnsuro na mo ho mmpopo, na mommma wɔn ho nnyɛ mo hu,

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: efisɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ne mo na ɛnam ne mo atamfo rekɔko ama mo na wagye mo.

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Na ahwɛfo no nkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no sɛ: Onii ko a wasi dan foforo na onnuruu mu afiforo no, ɔnsan nkɔ ne fi, na wantɔ ɔko mu na obi ankoduru mu.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Na onii ko a watɛw bobeturo na onnya nyii ano no, ɔnsan nkɔ ne fi, na wantɔ ɔko mu, na obi anyi ano.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Na onii ko a wagye ɔbea bi aware na onnya nhyiaa no no, ɔnsan nkɔ ne fi, na wantɔ ɔko mu na obi anhyia no.

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: Na ahwɛfo no nkɔ so nkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no sɛ: Onii ko a osuro na ne koma tutu no, ɔnsan nkɔ ne fi, na wamma ne nuanom koma annan sɛ ne de.

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ahwɛfo no wie ɔman no kasakyerɛ a, wɔmfa asafohene nsisi ɔman no ti.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Na amanaman yi nkurow a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di so no mu de, mma biribiara a ɛhome nnnya nkwa,

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: na sɛe wɔn pasaa: Hetifo ne Amorifo, Kanaanfo ne Perisifo, Hewifo ne Yebusifo, sɛnea AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo no.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na wɔankyerɛ mo wɔn akyide a wɔyɛ ma wɔn anyame no nyinaa bi yɛ, na moanyɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn bɔne.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: Sɛ wutua kurow bi nna pii ne no reko afa a, mfa akuma nsɛe ho nnua, na ɛso aba bi na di, na ntow ngu: So afuw mu dua yɛ onipa na woatua no?

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Nanso nnua a wunim sɛ ɛnyɛ nnua a wodi no de, sɛe no na twa fa yɛ kurow a ɛne wo di ako no ho ntuaban kosi sɛ wobɛbrɛ no ase.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: Sɛ wuhu obi a wɔakum no da wuram, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa no so, na wunnim nea okum no a,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: ɛnne wo mpanyimfo ne w’atemmufo mfi adi nkosusuw nkodu nkurow a ɛdeda nea wɔakum no no ho no so;

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: na kurow a ɛbɛn nea wɔakum no no ho no, saa kurow no mu mpanyimfo mfa nantwiforo a wɔmfaa no nyɛɛ adwuma na ɔntwee kɔndua pɛn,

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow
translation_verse: na kurow a ɛbɛn nea wɔakum no no mu mpanyimfo no nyinaa nhohoro wɔn nsa ngu nantwiforo a wɔabu ne kɔn mu osubon no mu no so,

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: na wɔmma wɔn nne so nka sɛ: Ɛnyɛ yɛn nsa na ehwiee mogya yi gui, na yɛn aniwa anhu;

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: Sɛ wutu sa ne w’atamfo rekɔko, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn ahyɛ wo nsa, na wofa wɔn mu nnommum,

english_verse: One of these prisoners may be a beautiful woman, and you may want to marry her. But first you must bring her into your home, and have her shave her head, cut her nails, get rid of her foreign clothes, and start wearing Israelite clothes. She will mourn a month for her father and mother, then you can marry her.
translation_verse: na onyi ne dommum atade mfi ne ho, na ɔntena wo fi nnyam n’agya ne ne na ɔsram mu, na ɛno akyi no woakɔ ne ho aware no na wayɛ wo ɔyere.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛba sɛ wompɛ no bio a, ma ɔmfa ne ho nkodi sɛnea ɔpɛ, na ɔtɔn de, ntɔn no nnye sika, wo ne no nnni no sɛ afenaa, efisɛ woagurow no.

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi wɔ ɔba ɔsoɔdenfo ne otuatewfo a ontie n’agya ne ne na asɛm, na wɔteɛ no so na ontie wɔn a,

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: ɛnne n’agya ne ne na nkyere no mfa no mfi adi nkɔ ne kurom mpanyimfo nkyɛn, kurow no pon ano,

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: na wɔnka nkyerɛ ne kurow no mu mpanyimfo no sɛ: Yɛn ba yi yɛ ɔsoɔdenfo ne otuatewfo, ontie yɛn asɛm, ɔyɛ ohohwini ne sabofo.

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na ne kurow no mu mmarima nyinaa nsiw no abo mma ɔntɔ; na yi bɔne no fi wo mu na Israel nyinaa nte na wonsuro.

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a ɛsɛ okum na wokum no de no sɛn dua bi so a,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: ne funu no nntena dua no so anadwo, osie na sie no da no ara; na nea wɔasɛn no no yɛ Onyankopɔn nnome, na woangu w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di so no ho fi.

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: Nhwɛ wo nua nantwi anaa ne guanten sɛ wɔrefom kwan, na ntwe wo ho mfi wɔn ho; fa wɔn san brɛ wo nua.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wo nua no mmɛn wo anaa wunnim no a, ɛnne fa no bra wo fi na ɔntena wo nkyɛn nkosi sɛ wo nua no bɛhwehwɛ no na woadan no ama no.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Na saa nso na yɛ n’afurum, na saa nso na yɛ ne ntama, na saa nso na yɛ wo nua ade biara a ayera a wubehu; ntwe wo ho mfi ho.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɔbea nnhyɛ ɔbarima ade, na ɔbarima nso mmfura ɔbea ntama, efisɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ eyi nyinaa yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyide.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Sɛ wusi dan foforo a, gye wo dan no atifi ban, na obi amfi hɔ anhwe ase, na woamfa mogya ho asodi amma wo dan no so.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Mfa ade horow abien nnua wo bobeturo mu, na woanyɛ w’adua a wuduae no ne bobeturo no mu nnɔbae nyinaa kronkron prɛko.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Mfa nantwi ne afurum mmɔ mu mfɛtɛw.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yɛ wo ntama a wode kata wo so ahinanan so nnwow. Ɔyere nsopa

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi ware yere na ɔkɔ ne ho, na ɔmpɛ no bio,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
translation_verse: na ɔde animguasesɛm to no so na ɔbɔ no dimmɔne sɛ: Maware ɔbea yi na mekɔɔ ne ho no, manto no ɔbaabun, a,

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: ɛnne abofra no n’agya ne ne na mfa abofra no baabunyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne mfi mmra kurow no mu mpanyimfo nkyɛn wɔ kurow no pon ano,

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: na abofra no n’agya nka nkyerɛ mpanyimfo no sɛ: Mede me ba mama ɔbarima yi aware, nso ɔmpɛ no bio,

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: na hwɛ, ɔde animguasesɛm ato no so sɛ: Manto wo ba no ɔbaabun; nso me ba no baabunyɛ ade ni. Na wɔntrɛw ntama no mu kurow no mu mpanyimfo no anim.

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Na kurom hɔ mpanyimfo no mfa ɔbarima no ntwe n’aso,

english_verse: because he accused his bride of not being a virgin. He will have to pay her father
translation_verse: na wonnye no dwetɛ nnwetɛbona ɔha mfa mma ababaa no agya, efisɛ wabɔ Israel mu baabun dimmɔne; na ɔnyɛ ne yere, na ɔnnko no ne nna nyinaa mu.

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Na sɛ asɛm yi yɛ nokwasɛm na wɔanhu abofra no ɔbaabun a,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: ɛnne wonyi ababaa no mmra n’agya fi abobow ano, na ne kurom mmarima nsiw no abo mma onwu, efisɛ wayɛ nkwaseade Israel mu sɛ wabɔ aguaman n’agya fi; na yi bɔne no fi wo mu.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: Sɛ wohu ɔbarima bi sɛ ɔne ɔbea a ɔyɛ obi yere da a, ɛnne wɔn baanu no nwu, ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbea no dae no ne ɔbea no; na yi bɔne no fi Israel.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: ɛnne momfa wɔn baanu no mfi adi nkɔ kurow no abobow ano, na munsiw wɔn abo mma wonwuwu: Ababaa no, sɛ ɔwɔ kurow mu na wanteɛm, ne ɔbarima no, sɛ wabrɛ ne yɔnko yere ase nti; na yi bɔne no fi wo mu.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima bi hu ababaa a wɔagye no aware wɔ wuram, na ɔbarima no kyere no ne no da a, ɛnne ɔbarima a ɔne no dae no nko na onwu,

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: na ababaa no de, nyɛ no hwee, bɔne a ɛsɛ owu nni ababaa no so, efisɛ sɛnea onipa sɔre hyɛ ne yɔnko kum no no, saa na asɛm yi te;

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: efisɛ wuram na ohuu no, na ababaa a wɔagye no aware no teɛɛm, na obi a obegye no nni hɔ.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbarima bi hu abofra a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun a wɔmfaa no mmaa aware na ɔkyere no ne no da na wohu no a,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima bi nnware n’agya yere, na onnyi ɔbea a ɔyɛ n’agya de adagyaw so.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Nea wɔapɛtɛw ne hwea ne nea ne barima atwa no mmma AWURADE bagua mu.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Aguaman ba bi mmma AWURADE bagua mu; n’awo ntoatoaso a ɛto so du po mmma AWURADE bagua mu.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Amonni anaa Moabni mmma AWURADE bagua mu; wɔn awo ntoatoaso a ɛto so du po mmma AWURADE bagua mu da,

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔamfa aduan ne nsu ammehyia mo ɔkwan mu, bere a mufi Misraim reba no, ne sɛ wɔkɔbɔɔ Beor ba Bileam a ofi Petor wɔ Mesopotamia paa sɛ ɔmmɛdome wo nti.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ampɛ sɛ otie Bileam, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dan nnome no nhyira maa wo, efisɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dɔ wo.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Nhwehwɛ wɔn asomdwoe ne wɔn papa da, wo nna nyinaa.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Nkyi Edomni, efisɛ ɔyɛ wo nua. Nkyi Misraimni, efisɛ woakɔyɛ n’asase so hɔho.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mma a wɔbɛwo ama wɔn no awo ntoatoaso a ɛto so abiɛsa mmra AWURADE bagua mu. Ɛdɔm ahotew

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛ wufi kɔbɔ w’atamfo so nsra a, hwɛ wo ho yiye adebɔne nyinaa ho.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ wo mu a ne ho ntew, nea ɛyɛɛ no anadwo ho a, ɛnne omfi nkɔ nsra no akyi, ɔmmma nsra no mu.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Na ɛrekɔ anwummere no, ɔmfa nsu nguare, na sɛ owia kɔtɔ a, ɔmmra nsra no mu.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: Na yɛ baabi, nsra no akyi fa, na woafi adi akɔ hɔ;

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: na nya ɔsosɔw wɔ w’ade mu, na sɛ wokɔkotow nsra no akyi hɔ a, wode afunu akotow so, na woakata nea afi wo mu no so.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: Efisɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nam wo nsra mu sɛ ɔregye wo, na ɔde w’atamfo ahyɛ wo nsa; enti ma wo nsra mu nyɛ kronkron, na wanhu wo mu aniwude bi, na wannan amfi w’akyi.

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: Mfa akoa a wafi ne wura nkyɛn abɛdɔm wo nhyɛ ne wura nsa;

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: ɔntena wo nkyɛn wɔ mo mu, wo nkurow mu biako a ɔbɛfa a eye ma no mu; nhyɛ no so.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: Israel mmabea mu biara nnnan aguaman, na Israel babarima biara nnnan aguaman.

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Mfa ɔbea guamanfo apɛde anaa ɔkraman apaade mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn fi wo bɔhyɛ biara mu, na n’abien no yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyide. Mfɛntom, bɔhyɛ ne tɔsofa ho mmara

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: Nnye wo nua sika ho mfɛntom, anaa aduan ho mfɛntom, anaa biribiara a wogye ɛho mfɛntom ho mfɛntom.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Ɔnanani nkyɛn na gye mfɛntom, na wo nua de, nnye no hɔ bi, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira wo nea wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu, asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Sɛ wohyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ a, nnodow ne tua ho, efisɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhwehwɛ wɔ wo hɔ, na adan wo bɔne.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Nanso woanhyɛ bɔ no koraa de a, ɛnyɛ bɔne mma wo.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Nea afi w’ano no, di so na yɛ, sɛnea wufi wo pɛ mu de w’ano ahyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ no.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: Sɛ wudu wo yɔnko bobeturo mu a, di aba no bi sɛnea wopɛ mee, na mfa bi ngu w’ade mu.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Sɛ wudu wo yɔnko awi a egyina hɔ mu a, fa wo nsa pompan mmɛtem no bi, na mma kantankrankyi so wɔ wo yɔnko awi so.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbarima bi ware yere, na ɛba sɛ onnya n’ani so anuonyam, efisɛ wahu ne ho aniwude bi a, ɛnne ɔnkyerɛw ɔko nhoma mma no na ɔmfa nhyɛ ne nsa, na onnya no kwan mfi ne fi.

english_verse: Later she married another man,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ofi ne fi kɔ na ɔkɔware ɔbarima bi,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ɛnne ne kan kunu a ogyaa no kwan no nnsan mmmɛware no bio, ne ho fi gu no akyi, efisɛ ɛno yɛ AWURADE anim akyide, na mfa bɔne ngu asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di so no so.

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbarima bi ware yere foforo a, ɔnnkɔ ɔsa, na wɔmmfa adwuma biara nnto no so; na ɔnne ne ho mma ne fi afirihyia, na ɔne ne yere a ɔwaree no no ani nnye.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Sɛ wohu obi a owia ne nuanom Israelfo mu nipa bi na odi no nya anaasɛ ɔtɔn no a, ɛnne owifo no nwu, na yi bɔne no fi wo mu.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: Hwɛ yiye kwata yare ho, na woahwɛ ayɛ sɛ asɔfo Lewifo no bɛkyerɛ mo no nyinaa pɛpɛɛpɛ; sɛnea mehyɛɛ wɔn no, saa na monhwɛ nyɛ.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kae nea AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Miriam ɔkwan so, bere a mufi Misraim reba no.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: adiwo na gyina, na onipa a wofɛm no ade no mfa awowa no mmrɛ wo wɔ adiwo.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: owia kɔtɔ a, dan awowa no kɔma no, na ɔmfa ne ntama nna, na onhyira wo, na ɛnyɛ wo trenee AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: Nhyɛ ɔpaani, ɔbrɛfo ne ohiani a ofi wo nuanom anaa ahɔho a wɔwɔ w’asase so, wo nkurow mu no mu so.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Da a ɔyɛ adwuma no ara na ma no n’apaade, na mma owia nnkɔtɔ so, efisɛ odi hia, na ɔde n’ani ato so; na wansu amfrɛ AWURADE anhyɛ wo, na annan wo bɔne.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn gyee wo fii hɔ; enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ di asɛm yi so.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Sɛ wutwa w’aduan w’afuw mu na wo werɛ fi afi bi afuw mu hɔ a, nsan nkɔfa; na ɛnyɛ ɔhɔho, ayisaa ne okunafo de, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo, wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa mu.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Sɛ woporow wo ngodua a, nsan nkɔtwee so; ma ɛnyɛ ɔhɔho, ayisaa ne okunafo de.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Sɛ wotew wo bobeturo mu aba a, nsan nkodi so mpɛpɛwa; ma ɛnyɛ ɔhɔho, ayisaa ne okunafo de.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim asase so; enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ di asɛm yi so.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mmaa aduanan na wɔnka no, ɛnntena so, na wantena so anhwe no mmaa pii ansen eyi, na wo nua annan w’ani so ɔhohorani.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima no mpɛ sɛ ɔware ne nua yere no a, ɛnne ne nua yere no nkɔ kurow pon ano mpanyimfo nkyɛn nkɔka sɛ: Me kunu ne nua mpɛ sɛ ɔma ne nua din tena Israel, ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ me okunu nua asɛde.

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Na ne kurom mpanyimfo no mfrɛ no nkasa nkyerɛ no; na sɛ ogyina hɔ ka sɛ: Mempɛ sɛ meware no, a,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: ɛnne ne nua yere no ntwiw mmɛn no mpanyimfo no anim, na ɔnsan ne nan mpaboa, na onhinam n’ani so ntasu nka sɛ: Saa na wɔnyɛ ɔbarima a ɔmpɛ sɛ osiesie ne nua fi.

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
