translation_verse: Sɛ mmarima reko, obi ne ne nua, na obiako yere twiw bɛn sɛ ɔrebegye ne kunu afi nea ɔrehwe no no nsam, na ɔteɛ ne nsa so ne barima mu a,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ɛnne twa ne nsa, mma w’ani nnhu no mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Nya abrammokwanmu a ɛteɛ, nya olonka a edu na ɛteɛ, na wo nna aware asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyide ne wɔn a wɔyɛ eyinom nyinaa, wɔn a wotwa nkontompo nyinaa. Wɔmpopa Amalek nkae

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: Kae nea Amalek yɛɛ wo ɔkwan so bere a mufi Misraim reba no:

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ɔbɛtoaa wo ɔkwan mu, bere a woatɔ piti na woabrɛ, na otwaa wɔn a aka w’akyi no nyinaa gui wɔ w’akyi, na wansuro Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Enti sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ma wo ɔhome fi w’atamfo a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia nyinaa nsam, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa tena so no so a, popa Amalek nkae fi ɔsoro ase; mma wo werɛ mmfi.

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: Na sɛ wunya du asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di so no so na wofa tena so a,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: fa asase no so adua a wubenya w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so no nyinaa aduankan no bi gu kyerɛnkyɛ mu, na fa kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ sɛ ne din ntena hɔ no,

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: na kɔ ɔsɔfo a ɔwɔ so saa bere no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ: Mepae mu nnɛ mekyerɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sɛ madu asase a AWURADE kaa yɛn agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma yɛn no so.

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no nnye kyerɛnkyɛ no mfi wo nsam mfa nsi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔremuka no anim.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Na gye so ka AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim sɛ: M’agya yɛ Aramni a anka okyinkyini, na ɔde nnipa kakraa bi sian kɔɔ Misraim kɔsoɛɛ hɔ hɔho, na ɔyɛɛ ɔman kɛse a wɔyɛ den na wɔdɔe wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Na Misraimfo yɛɛ yɛn bɔne na wɔhyɛɛ yɛn so na wɔde ɔsom dennen too yɛn so;

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: na yesu frɛɛ AWURADE yɛn agyanom Nyankopɔn, na AWURADE tiee yɛn nne, na ohuu yɛn ade mmɔbɔ a ɛyɛ ne yɛn haw ne yɛn ahoguan.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a wateɛm ne ahodwiriwde akɛse ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwonwade yii yɛn fii Misraim bae.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Na ɔde yɛn aba ha yi de asase yi ama yɛn, asase a ɛsen nufusu ne ɛwo.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Na afei, hwɛ, mede asase a wo, AWURADE, de ama me no so aduankan maba! Na fa si AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, na sɔre AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim,

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: na gye w’ani adepa a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ama wo ne wo fi no nyinaa ho, wo ne Lewini ne ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo mu no.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Sɛ wuwie wo nnɔbae mu ntotoso du du nyinaa yiyi, afe a ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛne ntotoso du du ma afe no mu, na wode ama Lewini ne ɔhɔho ne ayisaa ne okunafo ama wɔadi wo nkurow mu amee a,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: ɛnne ka wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim sɛ: Mayi akronkronne afi me fi, na mede mama Lewini ne ɔhɔho ne ayisaa ne okunafo nso, sɛ wo mmara a woahyɛ me no nyinaa te, mamfom wo mmara nsɛm no na me werɛ amfi;

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: minnii bi m’awerɛhow mu, na minyii bi, bere a me ho ntew, na memfaa bi memmaa owufo bi; matie AWURADE me Nyankopɔn nne, na mayɛ sɛnea woahyɛ me nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Fi wo tenabea kronkron ɔsoro brɛ w’ani ase hwɛ, na hyira wo man Israel ne asase a wode ama yɛn, sɛnea wokaa yɛn agyanom ntam no, asase a ɛsen nufusu ne ɛwo no.

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: Ɛnnɛ da yi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn rehyɛ wo sɛ: Yɛ ahyɛde ne atemmude yi, na fa wo koma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa di so na yɛ.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Ɛnnɛ woaka wɔ AWURADE ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ wo Nyankopɔn, na woanantew n’akwan so, na woadi n’ahyɛde ne ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmude so, na woatie ne nne;

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: na AWURADE nso aka wɔ wo ho nnɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ n’ankasa ne man, sɛnea wahyɛ wo bɔ no, na woadi ne mmara nsɛm nyinaa so,

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: na wama wo so akyɛn amanaman a ɔyɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa, de wo ayɛ ayeyi ne din ne anuonyam, na woayɛ ɔman kronkron ama AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sɛnea ɔkae no.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Israel mpanyimfo no hyɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Munni mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Na si hɔ afɔremuka ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, abo afɔremuka; mma dade so wɔ so;

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: abo amuamu na fa si AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔremuka, na bɔ so hyew afɔre ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn;

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: na bɔ asomdwoe afɔre di no hɔ, na gye w’ani AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne asɔfo Lewifo no kasa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinaa sɛ: Israel, monyɛ aso ntie; ɛnnɛ da yi woayɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ɔman;

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: enti tie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne, na di ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛde a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so. Wɔdome wɔ Ebal so

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Na Mose hyɛɛ ɔman no da no ara sɛ:

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ kurow mu, na nhyira aka wo wɔ afuw mu.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Nhyira bɛka wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba ne w’afieboa mma, w’anantwi mma ne wo nguan mma.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: Nhyira bɛka wo kyerɛnkyɛ ne wo mmɔre korow.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: Nhyira bɛka wo wo fieba mu, na nhyira bɛka wo w’adifi mu.

english_verse: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies and make them scatter in all directions.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɛma w’atamfo a wɔsɔre hyɛ wo adi ntwo, w’anim; wɔnam ɔkwan koro so befi abehyia wo, na wɔnam akwan ason so aguan w’anim.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɛhyɛ nhyira ma aba wo so, w’asan so, ne ade a wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu, na obehyira wo, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo no so.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Sɛ wudi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so na wonantew n’akwan so a, AWURADE de wo begyina hɔ ayɛ ɔman kronkron afa, sɛnea waka wo ntam no.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Na asase so aman nyinaa behu sɛ wɔde AWURADE din na ɛfrɛɛ wo, na wobesuro wo.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɛma nnepa abu wo so, wo yafunu mu aba mu ne w’afieboa aba mu ne w’asase so aba mu, asase a AWURADE kaa w’agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wo no so.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: AWURADE bebue n’adepa korabea a ɛyɛ ɔsoro no ama wo, na atɔ w’asase so su ne bere mu, na wahyira wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa; na wode bɛfɛm amanaman pii, na wo de, woremfɛm obi hɔ biribi.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Sɛ wutie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi sɛ wobɛhwɛ ayɛ a, ɛnne AWURADE de wo bɛyɛ ti, na ɛnyɛ dua, na wobɛkɔ soro ara, na woremmrɛ ase da;

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Na wo funu bɛyɛ wim nnomaa nyinaa ne asase so mmoa aduan, na obiara renka wɔn.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Na ɛbɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne ne anwonwade, wo ne w’asefo ho daa.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛhwɛ ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛde a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi ayɛ a, nnome yi nyinaa bɛba wo so abɛto wo.

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: Nnome bɛka wo, kurow mu, na nnome aka wo, wuram.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: Nnome bɛka wo kyerɛnkyɛ ne wo mmɔre korow.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Nnome bɛka wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’anantwi mma ne wo nguan mma.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nnome bɛka wo wo fieba mu, na nnome bɛka wo w’adifi mu.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɛma nnome, wibɔ ne adapaabɔ aba wo so nea wode wo nsa bɛka ayɛ nyinaa mu de akosi sɛ wo bra bɔne nti wɔbɛdwerɛw wo, na woasɛe ntɛm, efisɛ woagyaw me.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: AWURADE de otutuw ne nso bɛyɛ w’asase so su ma afi soro atɔ wo so de akosi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe wo.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: AWURADE bɛma woadi w’atamfo anim ntwo: Wonam ɔkwan koro so befi akohyia wɔn, na wonam akwan ason so aguan wɔn anim, na wɔbɛtow wo apete asase so ahenni nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: AWURADE de adammɔ ne anifurae ne komam ahodwiriw bɛbɔ wo.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Na wubesinsiane awia ketee sɛ onifuraefo sinsiane sum mu, na w’akwan renwie wo yiye, na ɔhyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo afow wo daa nyinaa, na obiara rennye wo.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Wobekum wo nantwi w’anim, na worenni bi; wɔbɛfa w’afurum w’anim, na wɔrennan mma wo; wɔde wo nguan bɛma w’atamfo, na worennya ogyefo.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Wɔde wo mmammarima ne wo mmabea bɛma ɔman bi, na w’aniwa bɛhwɛ, na wɔn hwɛ ama w’aniwa atɔ dwen daa adesae, efisɛ tumi bi nni wo nsam.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: W’asase so aba ne w’adwumade nyinaa, ɔman a wunnim wɔn na wobedi, na ɔhyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo na wɔapɛtɛw wo nna nyinaa;

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: na w’aniwa ade a wubehu no bɛbɔ wo dam.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: AWURADE de akuru bɔne bɛbɔ wo wo nankoroma ne srɛ so a wɔrentumi nsa mma wo fi wo nan ase kosi w’atifi.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: AWURADE de wo ne wo hene a wubesi no wo so no bɛkɔ ɔman a wo ne w’agyanom nnim so, na ɛhɔ na wobɛsom anyame foforo, nnua ne abo.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Na wobɛdan ahodwiriwde ne akasabebui ne ɛfene aman a AWURADE de wo bɛkɔ hɔ no nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Wode aba pii befi akɔ afum, na ketewaa bi na wobɛboa ano aba mu, efisɛ ntuntummɛ bedi.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Wobɛtɛw bobe nturo na woadɔw mu, na nsa de, worennom, na woremmoa aba no ano, efisɛ mmoa bedi.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Wubenya ngodua w’asase nyinaa so, na ngo de, worensra bi, efisɛ wo ngodua no bɛporow agu.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Wobɛwo mmammarima ne mmabea, na wɔrenyɛ wo de, efisɛ wɔbɛkɔ nnommumfa mu.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Wo nnua nyinaa ne w’asase so aba, mmɛbɛw bɛfa.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo mu bɛkɔ soro akyɛn wo ara, na wo de, wubesian aba famfamfam;

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: ɔno de, ɔbɛfɛm wo ade, na wo de, worennya bi mfɛm no; ɔno bɛyɛ ti, na wo de, woayɛ dua.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Na nnome yi nyinaa bɛba wo so na atiw wo abɛto wo akosi sɛ wobɛsɛe, efisɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wubedi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛde a ɔhyɛɛ wo no so.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ woamfa anigye ne koma pa ansom AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, taamudi mu nti,

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: wobɛsom w’atamfo a AWURADE bɛsoma aba wo so no, ɔkɔm ne osukɔm ne adagyaw ne nneɛma nyinaa mu hia mu; na ɔde dade kɔndua bɛto wo kɔn so akosi sɛ ɔbɛsɛe wo.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: AWURADE de ɔman bi befi akyirikyiri afi asase ano aba wo so ɔhareso, sɛnea ɔkɔre tu: Ɔman a wonte wɔn kasa,

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: ɔman a wɔn ani yɛ den a wɔnhwɛ akwakoraa anim na wɔnkyɛe aberante so.

english_verse: They will take your cattle, sheep, goats, grain, wine, and olive oil, then leave you to starve.
translation_verse: Na wobedi wo mmoa mma ne w’asase so aba akosi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe wo, na wɔrennyaw wo aburow, nsa anaa ngo, w’anantwi mma anaa wo nguan mma, akosi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe wo.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Na wɔbɛka wo ahyɛ mu wo nkurow apon nyinaa mu akosi sɛ w’afasu atenten a ɛyɛ den a wode wo ho too so bɛba fam, w’asase nyinaa so, na wɔbɛka wo ahyɛ mu wo nkurow nyinaa mu, w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ama wo no nyinaa so.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Na wubedi wo yafunu mu aba, wo mmammarima ne wo mmabea a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ama wo no nam, ahohia ne ahokyere a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyere wo no mu.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔremma wɔn mu biara ne mma nam a ɔredi no bi, efisɛ hwee nkae wɔ ne ho bio, ahohia ne ahokyere a wo tamfo bɛma wo ho akyere wo, wo nkurow nyinaa mu no mu.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: na obedi ne mma a wawo wɔn ne akyiriade wɔ kokoam, esiane ahohiahia ne ahokyere a wo tamfo bɛma aba wo so, wo nkurow apon nyinaa mu nti.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: Sɛ worenhwɛ nyɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw nhoma yi mu nyinaa, na worensuro din a ɛwɔ anuonyam na ɛho yɛ hu yi a ɛne AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no a,

english_verse: he will punish you and your descendants with incurable diseases,
translation_verse: ɛnne AWURADE bɛma wo haw ne w’asefo haw ayɛ nwonwa, ɔhaw akɛse a ɛkyɛ ne nyarewa bɔne a ɛkyɛ;

english_verse: like those you were so afraid of in Egypt.
translation_verse: na ɔde Misraim nyarewa a wusuro no bɛba wo so, na abɛfomfam wo ho;

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: nso ɔyare biara ne ɔhaw biara a wɔnkyerɛwee mmara yi nhoma mu no, AWURADE de bɛba wo so akosi sɛ ɔbɛsɛe wo.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Na mobɛka nnipa kakraa bi, nanso kan no na mo dodow te sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, efisɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Na sɛnea AWURADE ani gyee mo ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mo yiye na wama moadɔ no, saa ara nso na AWURADE ani begye mo ho sɛ ɔbɛsɛe mo na wadwerɛw mo; na wobetutu mo afi asase a morekɔ hɔ akodi so no so.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɛbɔ wo apete aman nyinaa mu afi asase ano akosi asase ano, na ɛhɔ na wobɛsom anyame foforo a wo ne w’agyanom nnim wɔn a ɛyɛ nnua ne abo;

english_verse: You will live in constant fear of death.
translation_verse: na wo nkwa bɛsɛn w’anim ahinhim, na wubesuro anadwo ne awia, na worennye wo nkwa nni.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Na wo koma mu suro a wubesuro ne w’aniwa mu ade a wubehu nti, anɔpa wobɛka sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ anadwofa ɛ! Na anadwofa nso wobɛka sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ anɔpa ɛ!

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE de wo bɛsan afa ahyɛn mu akɔ Misraim, ɔkwan a mekaa wo ɛho asɛm sɛ worenhu bio no so; na ɛhɔ na mobɛtontɔn mo ho ama mo atamfo sɛ nkoa ne mfenaa, na obiara rentɔ mo po.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Na muduu ha yi no, Hesbon hene Sihon ne Basan hene, Og fi behyiaa yɛn ne yɛn bɛkoe, na yekum wɔn;

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: na yɛfaa wɔn asase de maa Rubenfo ne Gadfo ne Manasefo abusuakuw fa sɛ wonni so.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Enti monhwɛ apam yi mu nsɛm yi nni so, na nea moyɛ nyinaa awie mo yiye.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: na muhuu wɔn akyide ne wɔn nnua ne abo ne dwetɛ ne sika ahoni a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no;

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: na monhwɛ yiye, na ɔbarima bi anaa ɔbea bi anaa abusua bi anaa abusuakuw bi antena mo mu a wɔn koma redan nnɛ afi AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ho, sɛ worekɔ akɔsom amanaman no anyame no, na ntini bi antena mo mu a ɛsow bɔre ne awɔnwene;

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: na sɛ ɔte nsew yi mu nsɛm no a, wanhyira ne ho ne koma mu anka sɛ: Menam me koma denyɛ mu de, nanso menya asomdwoe; na wɔansesaw nea wanom ne nea osukɔm de no ammom.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE beyi no afi Israel mmusuakuw nyinaa mu ama bɔne, sɛ apam a wɔakyerɛw mmara nhoma yi mu no mu nsew no nyinaa te.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: Na sɛ awo ntoatoaso a ɛbɛba, mo mma a wɔbɛsɔre adi mo akyi, ne ɔnanani a ofi akyirikyiri asase so bɛba no hu asase yi haw ahorow ne nyarewa a AWURADE de aba so,

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: sufre ne nkyene, ɔhyew a asase no nyinaa ahyew a wonnua so ade na ɛnsow, na wura biara mfifi so, sɛ Sodom ne Gomora, Adma ne Seboim butuw a AWURADE de n’abufuw ne n’abufuhyew butuwii no a, wɔbɛka ho asɛm,

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: na amanaman nyinaa bɛka sɛ: Ɛdɛn nti na AWURADE ayɛ asase yi sɛɛ yi? Abufuw kɛse hyewhyew yi yɛ dɛn?

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Na wɔbɛka sɛ: Efisɛ wɔagyaw AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn apam a oyii wɔn Misraim asase so no, ɔne wɔn pamee no,

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: na wɔakɔ akɔsom anyame foforo na wɔasɔre wɔn, anyame a wonnim wɔn na ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔde wɔn maa wɔn.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: enti na AWURADE atutu wɔn afi wɔn asase so abufuw ne aboɔhyew ne abohuru kɛse mu na watow wɔn agu asase bi so sɛ ɛte nnɛ yi.

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: Nneɛma a ahintaw yɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn dea, na nea wɔayi adi no yɛ yɛn ne yɛn mma dea kosi daa, sɛ yenni mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa so.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: Na sɛ nsɛm yi nyinaa, nhyira ne nnome a mede masi w’anim yi ba wo so, na wokae wɔ amanaman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn apam wo akɔ hɔ no nyinaa mu,

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: na wosan ba AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na wo ne wo mma tie ne nne sɛnea merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa, mo koma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa mu a,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Sɛ wo nnipa a wapam wɔn no wɔ ɔsoro ano po a, efi hɔ na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛboa w’ano, na efi hɔ na ɔbɛfa wo.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo bɛba asase a w’agyanom dii so no so, na woadi so, na wayɛ wo yiye, na wama woadɔ akyɛn w’agyanom.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn betwa wo koma ne w’asefo koma twetia, na wode wo koma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa adɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na woanya nkwa.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de nsew yi nyinaa begu w’atamfo ne wɔn a wokyi wo a wɔtaa wo no so.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Na wo de, wobɛsan abetie AWURADE nne, na woadi ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma woadi yiye ama biribiara abu wo so, wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa mu, wo yafunu mu aba mu ne wo mmoa mma mu ne w’asase so aba mu, efisɛ AWURADE ani begye wo ho bio ama woadi yiye sɛnea n’ani gyee w’agyanom ho no,

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: sɛ wutie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne, na wudi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛde a wɔakyerɛw mmara nhoma yi mu no so, na wode wo koma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa san ba AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a!

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Na mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyɛ den mma wo, nanso enni akyirikyiri;

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Na enni po agya nso na woaka sɛ: Hena na obetwa po ama yɛn akɔfa abrɛ yɛn ama yɛate ayɛ?

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Na asɛm no bɛn wo papaapa, ɛwɔ w’anom ne wo koma mu sɛ yɛ.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ mede nkwa ne papa ɛne owu ne bɔne masi w’anim,

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Ɛnnɛ mefrɛ ɔsoro ne asase midi mo adanse sɛ: Mede nkwa ne owu, nhyira ne nnome masi mo anim; enti fa nkwa, na wo ne w’asefo nnya nkwa,

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: na dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na tie ne nne na bata ne ho, efisɛ ɛne wo nkwa ne wo nna dodow, na woatena asase a AWURADE kaa w’agyanom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so.

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Na Mose kɔe kɔkaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israel nyinaa.

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Monyɛ den na monyɛ nnam, munnsuro na mommma wɔn ho nnyɛ mo hu, efisɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na ɔne wo nam; ɔrempa wo na ɔrennyaw wo.

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Na Mose frɛɛ Yosua, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no Israel nyinaa anim sɛ: Yɛ den na yɛ nnam, na wo na wode ɔman yi bɛkɔ asase a AWURADE kaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so, na wo na wobɛkyɛ ama wɔn.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Na AWURADE, ɔno na ɔredi w’anim, ɔno na obedi w’akyi, ɔrempa wo na ɔrennyaw wo; nsuro na mma wo bo nntu.

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mose kyerɛw mmara yi, na ɔde maa asɔfo no, Lewi mma a wɔsoa AWURADE apam adaka no, ne Israel mpanyimfo nyinaa.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Na wɔn mma a wonnim no ntie, na wonsua, nsuro AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn, nna a mode te asase a moretwa Yordan akɔ hɔ akodi so no so no nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, wo nna a worebewu abɛn; frɛ Yosua bra, na mummegyina ahyiae ntamadan no mu, na menhyɛ no mmara. Na Mose ne Yosua bae begyinaa ahyiae ntamadan no mu.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE de omununkum dum beyii ne ho adi ntamadan no mu, na omununkum dum no begyinaa ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, wo ne w’agyanom rekɔda, na ɔman yi bɛsɔre akodi asase a wɔrekɔ so hɔ no anananyame akyi aguamammɔ mu, na wɔagyaw me, na wɔato m’apam a me ne wɔn pamee no.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Na me bo befuw wɔn da no, na magyaw wɔn, na mayi m’ani mahintaw wɔn, na wɔamene wɔn, na bɔne pii ne ahohia horow bɛto wɔn ama wɔaka da no sɛ: So ɛnyɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn a onni yɛn mu nti na bɔne yi abɛto yɛn yi anaa?

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Na me de, bɔne a wɔayɛ no nyinaa, sɛ wɔaman akɔ anyame foforo nkyɛn nti, da no, ohintaw na mede m’ani mehintaw.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Na mede wɔn medu asase a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ wɔn agyanom a ɛsen nufusu ne ɛwo no so, na wobedidi amee na wɔayɛ akɛse, na wɔaman akɔ anyame foforo nkyɛn akɔsom wɔn, na wɔapo me na wɔato m’apam.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɔne pii ne ahohia horow bɛto wɔn a, dwom yi bɛyɛ ɔdansefo adi adanse wɔ wɔn anim, efisɛ ɛrempa wɔn asefo anom. Na minim wɔn adwene a wɔredwen nnɛ po, ansa na mede wɔn madu asase a mekaa ho ntam no so.

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na Mose kyerɛw dwom yi da no ara, na ɔkyerɛɛ Israelfo no.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE hyɛɛ Nun ba Yosua sɛ: Yɛ den na yɛ nnam; na wo na wode Israelfo bɛkɔ asase a mekaa wɔn ɛho ntam no so: Na me na medi w’akyi. Mose de mmara no hyɛ Lewifo nsa

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Na Mose kyerɛw mmara yi mu nsɛm de hyɛɛ nhoma mu wiei koraa no,

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Mose hyɛɛ Lewifo a wɔso AWURADE apam adaka no sɛ:

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Na me de, minim w’atuatew ne wo kɔn a asen; hwɛ, meda so ne mo te ase nnɛ yi po moyɛ AWURADE anim atuatewfo, na me wu akyi ɛ!

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Momma mo mmusuakuw mu mpanyimfo nyinaa ne mo ahwɛfo mmɛbɔ me nkyɛn gua, na menka nsɛm yi nyinaa mingu wɔn asom, na memfrɛ ɔsoro ne asase minni wɔn adanse.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Na minim sɛ me wu akyi no, ɔsɛe na mobɛsɛe, na moaman afi ɔkwan a mahyɛ mo no so, na bɔne abɛto mo daakye, efisɛ mobɛyɛ AWURADE anim bɔne, na mode mo nsa ano adwuma bɛhyɛ no abufuw.

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Na Mose kaa dwom yi mu nsɛm guu Israel bagua nyinaa asom de kosii sɛ owiei.

english_verse: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Ɔsoro, monyɛ aso, na merebɛkasa, na asase ntie m’anom nsɛm!

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Me kyerɛ nsosɔ sɛ nsu, na me kasa ngu sɛ obosu, sɛ wura so mfetema ne nhaban so hasu.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE din na mɛbɔ: Momfa nidi mma yɛn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: Ɔbotan no, n’adeyɛ yɛ pɛ, na n’akwan nyinaa yɛ trenee; ɔyɛ nokware Nyankopɔn na nkontompo nni no mu; ɔtreneeni ne teefo ne no.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Wɔadi no asɛmmɔne, wɔn nkekae nti, wɔnna so nyɛ ne mma, wɔyɛ awo ntoatoaso kɔntɔnkye a wɔakyea.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: So AWURADE na mutua no ka sɛɛ yi? Ɔman nkwaseafo a wonni ti! So ɛnyɛ ɔno ne w’agya a onyaa wo? Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ wo na ɔde wo tim hɔ.

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: Kae tete nteredee nna, hwɛ awo ntoatoaso dodow no mfe; bisa w’agya, na ɔnkyerɛ wo, wo mpanyimfo, na wɔnka nkyerɛ wo.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Ɔsorosoroni no kyekyɛɛ asase maa amanaman, ɔpaepaee Adam mma mu no, ɔde aman no ahye totoo hɔ sɛ Israelfo ano si.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kyɛfa ne ne man, Yakob ne n’agyapade a wɔasusuw ama no.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: Ohuu no sare asase so ne nkyerekyerewa so, sare pradada so nkekaboa su mu; otwaa ne ho hyiae, ɔhwɛɛ no so yiye, ɔkoraa no so sɛ n’aniwa kurutiayisi.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔkɔre hwanyan ne buw na otu bɔ ne mma so mfamfia no, ɔtrɛw ne ntaban mu faa no, ɔsoaa no ne ntakra so.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: AWURADE nko ara na ɔkyerɛɛ no kwan, na ɔnananyame bi anka ne ho.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: Ɔma ɔfaa asase sorɔnsorɔn so kɔe, na odii asase so nnɔbae; na ɔma ofew ɛwo fii ɔbotan mu, ne ngo fii abohemmaa mu,

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: anantwi nufusu ani srade, ne nguan nufusu, ne nguammuruwa srade, ne Basan adwennini ne mpapo de, ne awi asaabo mu srade, na wonom bobe aba mu mogya gyenennyenen.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: Na Yesurun dɔɔ srade, na ɔtow anankoti; woadɔ srade ayɛ kɛse, wo mu ayɛ duru; na ogyaw Onyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ no no, na obuu ne nkwagye botan no abomfiaa.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Wɔde ananafo anyame ma ɔtwee ninkunu, wɔde akyide huruu ne bo.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Wɔbɔɔ afɔre maa abosom a wɔnyɛ Onyankopɔn, anyame a wonnim wɔn, afoforo a ɛbae akyiri yi na wɔn agyanom amfɛre wɔn.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Ɔbotan a ɔwoo wo no, woannwen no so, na wo werɛ afi Onyankopɔn a ɔkyem woo wo no.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: Na ne mmabanin ne ne mmabea ho ahi nti AWURADE hui no, ɔpoo wɔn,

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: na ɔkae sɛ: Meyi m’ani mahintaw wɔn, mɛhwɛ nea wɔn akyiri bewie, na awo ntoatoaso kɔntɔnkye ne wɔn, mma a nokware nni wɔn mu.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Wɔn de, wɔde nea ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn ma metwee ninkunu, wɔde wɔn adehuhuw yi me ahi: Na me nso mede nea ɛnyɛ ɔman mɛma wɔatwe ninkunu, mede ɔman nkwasea bi na ɛbeyi wɔn ahi.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Na ogya asɔ m’abufuw mu, na ɛredɛw akodu asaman ase, na ɛrehyew asase ne ne nnɔbae, ɛde ogya ato mmepɔw nnyinaso mu.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Mɛboaboa mmusu ano agu wɔn so, mɛhwere m’agyan masɛe wɔn.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔm bɛfɔn wɔn, na ahoɔhyew ne ɔyare yawyaw bɛmene wɔn; na mɛsoma mmoa se aba wɔn mu, ne mfutuma mu awɔ bɔre.

english_verse: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.
translation_verse: Nkrante bɛfa wɔn mma abɔnten so, na ehu akum wɔn mpia mu, aberante ne ababaa, akokoaa ne nea wafuw dwen nyinaa.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Anka mise: Mehuw wɔn agu, mɛma wɔn nkae to atwa afi nnipa mu,

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔtamfo ahiiyi na misuro a, na wɔn ahohiafo annan me nsusuwii ani, na wɔanka sɛ: Yɛn nsa na adi nkonim na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔyɛɛ eyi nyinaa.

english_verse: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛ ɔman a nyansa abɔ wɔn, na nhumu bi nni wɔn mu.

english_verse: If you did, you could see where you are headed.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔyɛ anyansafo a, anka wɔbɛte eyi ase, na wɔahu wɔn awiekyiri.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn botan na watɔn wɔn na AWURADE ayi wɔn ama a, anka ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na obiakofo bɛtaa apem, na baanu ama ɔpedu aguan?

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Efisɛ wɔn botan nte sɛ yɛn botan, na yɛn atamfo po bu atɛn sa.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Na Sodom bobe mu na wɔn bobe fi, ɛne Gomora mfuwa mu; wɔn aba yɛ bɔre aba, wɔsow akasiaw a ɛyɛ nwene;

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: wɔn nsa yɛ atweaseɛ bɔre ne nhurutoa bɔre a ano yɛ den.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: So wɔnkoraa eyinom wɔ me nkyɛn, na wɔnsɔɔ ano m’adekorabea?

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Me na aweredi ne akatua wɔ me, ɛbere a wɔn nan bɛwatiriw no. Na wɔn dwerɛw da abɛn, na nea wɔahyɛ ama wɔn bɛba ntɛmntɛm.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bebu ne man atɛn, na ne nkoa ade bɛyɛ no mmɔbɔ, bere a obehu sɛ wɔagurow koraa, na akoa anaa ɔdehye nni hɔ bio.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Na ɔbɛka sɛ: Ɛhe na wɔn anyame no wɔ, ɔbotan a wɔde wɔn ho too so no?

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: Wɔn a wodii wɔn afɔre srade, na wɔnom wɔn ahwiesa no? Ma wɔnsɔre mmɛboa mo, ma wɔnyɛ mo so nkataso.

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: Afei munhu sɛ me ara mene no, na onyame bi nka me ho. Me na mikum, na mema nkwa, mipira, na me na mesa, na nea obetumi agye afi me nsam nni hɔ.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Na mema me nsa so mekɔ ɔsoro, na mise: Sɛ mete ase daa yi!

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: Sɛ mesew me nkrante nnyinamnyinam no na me nsa so atemmu mu a, medi wɔn a wɔne me di asi were, na matua m’atamfo ka.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Mɛma m’agyan abow mogya, na me nkrante adi nam: Atɔfo ne nnommum mogya, ɔtamfo ti a apɛsɛw no.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: Amanaman, mo ne ne man mmɔ ose, efisɛ obedi ne nkoa mogya so were, na ɔde aweredi betua n’atamfo ka, na wapata ama n’asase, ne man.

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa mo koma nto nsɛm a meredi mo ho adanse nnɛ yi so, na mode ahyɛ mo mma, sɛ wɔnhwɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa nni so.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Na ɛnyɛ mo asɛnhunu, na mmom ɛne mo nkwa, na asɛm yi so na monam bɛma mo nna aware asase a moretwa Yordan akodi so no so. Onyankopɔn soma Mose Nebo bepɔw so

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose da no ara sɛ:

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: Kɔforo Abarim bepɔw yi, Nebo bepɔw a ɛwɔ Moab asase so, Yeriko ntentenso no, na kɔhwɛ Kanaan asase a mede merema Israelfo sɛ wɔmfa no.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Na wu wɔ bepɔw a woreforo akɔ so no so, na wɔmmoaboa wo nkɔ wo nkurɔfo nkyɛn, sɛnea wo nua Aaron wui Hor bepɔw so na wɔboaboaa no kɔɔ ne nkurɔfo nkyɛn no,

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: efisɛ mofom me Israelfo mu, ɔham nsu a ɛwɔ Kades, Sin sare so no ho, esiane sɛ moanyɛ me kronkron Israelfo mu.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Na wubehu asase no w’anim, na ɔkɔ de, worenkɔ asase a mede merema Israelfo no so hɔ.

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Na eyi ne nhyira a Onyankopɔn nipa Mose de hyiraa Israelfo ansa na owui. Na ɔkae sɛ:

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: AWURADE fi Sinai bae, na opue fii Seir maa wɔn, ɔharan fii Paran bepɔw so; ofi akronkronfo pii mu na ɛbae, ogya a ɛyɛ mmara ma wɔn wɔ ne nifa mu.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Yiw, ɔdɔ ne man, n’akronkronfo nyinaa wɔ ne nsam. Na wɔn de, wɔboaboa wo nan ase, na wotie w’asɛm.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Mmara na Mose hyɛɛ yɛn, Yakob bagua agyapade;

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: Ruben nnya nkwa na onnwu, na ne mmarima nso nnyɛ ketewa.

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Na Yuda nso de ni, ose: AWURADE, tie Yuda nne, na fa no kɔ ne man nkyɛn; ma wo nsa nko mma no, na yɛ no ɔboafo fi n’ahohiafo nsam.

english_verse: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Na Lewi ho de, ɔkae sɛ: Wo nokware ne wo hann wɔ wo hotefo no, nea wosɔɔ no hwɛe Masa hɔ na wo ne no hamee Meriba asu ho no;

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: nea ɔkae wɔ n’agya ne ne na ho sɛ: Minnim wɔn! Na ɔpaa ne nuanom, na ɔpoo n’ankasa ne mma no. Na wodi wo nsɛm so, na wɔkora w’apam.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Wɔde w’atemmude bɛkyerɛ Yakob, na wɔde wo mmara akyerɛ Israel; wɔde aduhuam betua wo hwene ano, na wɔde afɔre amuamu begu w’afɔremuka so.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: AWURADE, hyira n’ahonyade so, na ma ne nsa ano adwuma nsɔ w’ani; bobɔ wɔn a wɔsɔre hyɛ no no dwonku, ne wɔn a wɔtan no, na wɔansɔre bio.

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Benyamin ho nso, ɔkae sɛ: AWURADE dɔfo bɛtena ne nkyɛn dwoodwoo; ɔkata no so daa nyinaa, na ɔbɛtena ne mmati so.

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Na Yosef ho nso, ɔkae sɛ: AWURADE nhyira n’asase; ɔmma no ɔsoro nnepa, obosu ne ebun a ɛtrɛw ase no de,

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: ne owia mu nnɔbae nnepa, ne nea asram ma efifi mu nnepa,

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: ne tete mmepɔw atifi ne daapem nkoko nnepa,

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: ne asase ne ne mayɛ mu nnepa, ne nea ɔte nkyɛkyerɛ no mu no anisɔ; wɔmma ɛmmra Yosef atifi, ne ne nuanom mu hotuafo no mpampam.

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: Ne nantwinini abakan, anuonyam wɔ no, na n’abɛn yɛ ɛkoɔ abɛn; ɛno na ɔde besunsum aman nyinaa agu akodu asase ano. Efraim dodow ne no, na Manase mpem ne no.

english_verse: Be happy, Zebulun, as your boats set sail; be happy, Issachar, in your tents.
translation_verse: Na Sebulon ho nso, ɔkae sɛ: Sebulon, ma w’ani nnye w’adifi mu, ne Isakar, wo ntamadan mu.

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛfrɛ aman akɔ bepɔw no so, ɛhɔ na wɔbɛbɔ trenee afɔre; na wobefew po mu mmoroso ne nwea mu ademude a ahintaw

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Na Gad ho nso, ɔkae sɛ: Nhyira ne nea ɔtrɛw Gad mu; obutuw hɔ sɛ gyatabere, ɔtetew basa ne mpampam;

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔpaw nea eye no fae, na ɛhɔ na wɔakora mmarahyɛfo no kyɛfa; na ɔnam di ɔman no atitiriw mu, ɔyɛ AWURADE treneede ne n’atemmude wɔ Israel.

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Na Dan ho nso, ɔkae sɛ: Dan yɛ gyataforo, ohuruw fi Basan.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Na Naftali ho nso, ɔkae sɛ: Naftali a anisɔ amee no, na AWURADE nhyira ayɛ no ma, fa ɛpo ne ahohuru asase no di so

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Na Aser ho nso, ɔkae sɛ: Wɔmfa mma nhyira Aser, ɔnyɛ nea ɔsɔ ani ne nuanom mu, na ɔmfa ne nan mmɔ ngo mu.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Dade ne kɔbere nyɛ w’adaban, sɛ wo nna te no, saa na w’ahotɔ nyɛ.

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: Obi nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ Yesurun Nyankopɔn! Ɔnam soro di boa wo, ɔde ne kɛseyɛ nam omununkum mu.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Tete Nyankopɔn ne wo tenabea, na ase na daapem abasa no wɔ. Na ɔbɛpam ɔtamfo w’anim, na waka sɛ: Dwerɛw wɔn.

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Na Israel bɛtena hɔ dwoodwoo, Yakob asubura no, ne nko na ɔbɛtena, ɔbɛtena aburow ne nsa asase so; ne soro nso bɛsosɔ obosu.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne wo, Israel, hena na ɔte sɛ wo, ɔman a wɔanya AWURADE mu nkwagye! Ɔyɛ wo boa kyɛm, na ɔyɛ wo kɛseyɛ nkrante. W’atamfo bɛbrɛ wɔn ho ase ama wo, na wo de, wubetiatia wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea so.

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Na Mose fii Moab tataw mu foro kɔɔ Nebo bepɔw so, Pisga atifi, wɔ Yeriko ntentenso, na AWURADE ma ohuu asase no nyinaa: Gilead de kosii Dan,

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: ne Naftali nyinaa, ne Efraim ne Manase asase, ne Yuda asase nyinaa de kosii akyiri po no ho;

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: ne nifa fam asase ne tataw a ɛyɛ nkyeresia kurow Yeriko bon no de kosii Soar.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Eyi ne asase a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ Abraham, Isak ne Yakob sɛ: W’asefo na mede bɛma wɔn no: Na mama wode w’aniwa ahu, na ɔkɔ de, worenkɔ hɔ.

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE akoa Mose wui wɔ hɔ, Moab asase so, sɛnea AWURADE kae no.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Na osiee no obon mu Moab asase so, Bet-peor ntentenso; na obiara nnim ne damoa de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Na Israelfo suu Mose, Moab tataw mu adaduasa, na wodii Mose su ne ne gyam nna no wiei.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Na nyansa honhom yɛɛ Nun ba Yosua ma, efisɛ Mose de ne nsa guu no so; na Israelfo tiee no, na wɔyɛe sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Na odiyifo bi ansɔre Israel mu bio a ɔte sɛ Mose a AWURADE huu no mmɔanim,

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwonwade nyinaa a AWURADE somaa no sɛ ɔnkɔyɛ Farao ne ne nkoa nyinaa ne n’asase nyinaa, Misraim asase so no fam,

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: ne nsa a ɛyɛ den nyinaa ne ahude akɛse nyinaa a Mose yɛe Israel nyinaa anim no mu.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE akoa Mose wu akyi no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Nun ba Yosua, Mose somfo no sɛ:

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: M’akoa Mose awu enti afei sɔre twa Yordan yi, na wo ne ɔman Israelfo yi nyinaa nkɔ asase a mede merema mo, no so.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: Baabiara a mo nan betia no, mo na mede mɛma mo, sɛnea meka mekyerɛɛ Mose no,

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: efi sare no so ne Lebanon yi ho de kosi asu kɛse no, asubɔnten Eufrate ano, Hetifo asase nyinaa de kosi po kɛse no ano wɔ nea owia kɔtɔ hɔ na ɛnyɛ mo hye.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Obi biara rennyina w’anim, wo nkwa nna nyinaa; sɛnea midii Mose akyi no, saa ara na medi w’akyi; merempa wo na merennyaw wo.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Mma mmara nhoma yi mmfi w’anom, na dwen ho awia ne anadwo, na woahwɛ ayɛ sɛnea wɔakyerɛw wɔ mu nyinaa te no. Na ɛno na wo kwan bɛyɛ dwoodwoo, na ɛno na ebesi wo yiye.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Ɛno menhyɛɛ wo sɛ yɛ den na yɛ nnam, nsuro, na mma wo bo nntu anaa? Efisɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn di w’akyi nea wokɔ nyinaa. Yosua Kyerɛ Ɔman Adikanfo no Nea wɔnyɛ

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Ɛnna Yosua hyɛɛ ɔman no ahwɛfo no sɛ:

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: Momfa nsra no mu, na monhyɛ ɔman no sɛ: Munsiesie akwansoduan nsie, na ɛha yi nnansa morebetwa Yordan yi akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo sɛ munni so no so.

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Na Rubenfo ne Gadfo ne Manase abusuakuw fa no de, Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ:

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: nkosi sɛ AWURADE de mo nuanom bɛtena ase sɛ mo, na wɔn nso wobedi asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema wɔn no so ansa na moasan aba mo sodi asase no so abedi so, sɛ AWURADE akoa Mose de maa mo, Yordan agya owiapuei hɔ no.

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Na wobuaa Yosua sɛ: Nea woahyɛ yɛn nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ, na baabiara a wosoma yɛn no, yɛbɛkɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛtew w’anom asɛm ho atua na ɔrentie wo nyɛ nea wobɛhyɛ yɛn nyinaa no, wonkum no. Den nko na wo ho nyɛ, na yɛ nnam.

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Na Nun ba Yosua somaa mmarima asraafo baanu fi Sitim ahintawee mu sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔhwɛ asase no ne Yeriko. Na wosiim kɔe, na woduu ɔbea aguaman bi a wɔfrɛ no Rahab fi, na wɔdaa hɔ.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Na obi kɔka kyerɛɛ Yeriko hene no sɛ: Hwɛ, mmarima bi a wofi Israelfo no mu aba ha anadwo yi rebɛsra asase yi.

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Na wɔn de, wonnya nkɔdae no, ɔbea no foro kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn ɔdan no atifi

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: kɔka kyerɛɛ mmarima no sɛ: Minim sɛ AWURADE de asase yi ama mo, na mo ho hu atɔ yɛn so, na asase yi sotefo nyinaa koma tutu mo anim.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Na yɛate sɛnea mo Misraim fi mu no AWURADE maa Mmɛw-Po mu nsu yowee mo anim, ne nea moyɛɛ Amorifo ahene baanu a wɔwɔ Yordan agya no, Sihon ne Og a mosɛee wɔn pasaa no.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Na yɛate, na yɛn koma atu, na ɔhome bi rensɔre bio obiara mu wɔ mo anim, efisɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno ne Nyankopɔn wɔ nyameso ɔsoro ne asase so ɛfam.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Na afei monka me AWURADE ntam sɛ, sɛ mayɛ mo yiye yi, mo nso mobɛyɛ m’agya ofi yiye, na momma me nokware sɛnkyerɛnne,

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: na momma m’agya ne me na ne me nuammarimanom ne me nuammeanom ne nea wɔwɔ nyinaa nnya nkwa, na munyi yɛn mfi wu mu.

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Na mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛn kra nsi mo ananmu nwu! Sɛ woanka yɛn asɛm yi ankyerɛ, na ɛba sɛ AWURADE de asase yi ma yɛn a, yɛne wo bedi no adɔe ne nokware so.

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔbea no de ntampehama twetwee wɔn faa mfɛnsere mu sisii fam, na ne dan si kurow no ho fasu so, na ɔfasu no so na ɔte.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Bepɔw so na monkɔ, na atiwfo no anto mo, na munhintaw hɔ nnansa nkosi sɛ atiwfo no bɛsan, na ɛno akyi no moakɔ mo kwan.

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Ɛnyɛ sɛnea mo nsɛm yi te. Na ogyaa wɔn kwan ma wɔkɔe; na ɔde hama kɔkɔɔ no kyekyeree mfɛnsere no mu.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Ɛnna wosiim koduu bepɔw no so, na wodii hɔ nnansa kosii sɛ atiwfo no sanee. Na atiwfo no hwehwɛɛ wɔn ɔkwan no so nyinaa, nanso wɔanhu wɔn.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Na mmarima baanu no sian fii bepɔw no so, na wotwa baa Nun ba Yosua nkyɛn, na wɔkaa nea ɛyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa kyerɛɛ no,

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: na wɔka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ, ampa ara, AWURADE de asase no nyinaa ahyɛ yɛn nsa, na afei nso asase no sofo nyinaa koma atu wɔ yɛn anim.

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Yosua sɔree anɔpahema, na wotu fii Sitim, na woduu Yordan ano, ɔno ne Israelfo nyinaa, na wɔdaa hɔ ansa na wotwae.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Na nnansa wiee du no, ahwɛfo no kyinii nsra no mu

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: nanso munsusuw ɔkwan bɛyɛ sɛ basafa apem nto mo ne no ntam, mommmɛn no, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na moahu ɔkwan ko a mobɛfa so, efisɛ momfaa ɔkwan yi so pɛn.

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Montew mo ho, na ɔkyena AWURADE bɛyɛ anwonwade wɔ mo mu.

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ asɔfo no sɛ: Monsoa apam adaka no nsen nni ɔman no anim. Na wɔsoaa apam adaka no dii ɔman no anim.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Ɛnnɛ da yi na mefi ase mayɛ wo kɛse Israel nyinaa ani so, na wɔahu sɛ, sɛnea midii Mose akyi no, saa ara na medi w’akyi.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Na wo de, hyɛ asɔfo a wɔso apam adaka no sɛ: Sɛ mudu Yordan nsu no ano a, munnyina Yordan mu.

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ Israelfo no sɛ: Muntwiw mmra ha, na muntie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nsɛm.

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Yosua kae sɛ: Eyi na mode behu sɛ Onyankopɔn teasefo no wɔ mo mu, na ɔpam na ɔbɛpam Kanaanfo ne Hetifo ne Hewifo ne Perisifo ne Girgasifo ne Amorifo ne Yebusifo no afi mo anim.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ asɔfo a wɔso Awurade, asase nyinaa wura no, adaka no anammɔn ka Yordan nsu no ara pɛ a, Yordan mu nsu a esian fi atifi ba no betwa, na abɔ kuw agyina hɔ.

english_verse: The Israelites packed up and left camp. The priests carrying the chest walked in front,
translation_verse: Na ɔman no tu fii wɔn ntamadan mu sɛ wɔrekotwa Yordan, na asɔfo a wɔso apam adaka no dii ɔman no anim,

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: na asɔfo a wɔso adaka no duu Yordan ano, na wɔn anan sii nsu no mu ara pɛ

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Nso na Yordan ayiri asram ne kɔn so awitwabere na asɔfo a wɔso apam adaka no gyinaa asase kesee so Yordan mfinimfini pintinn, na Israel nyinaa nam asase kesee so twae de kosii sɛ ɔman mu no nyinaa wiee Yordan twa.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Na ɔman mu no nyinaa twaa Yordan wiei no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ:

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: na monhyɛ wɔn sɛ: Montase abo dumien mfi Yordan mfinimfini ha mfi nea asɔfo no anan gyinae pintinn hɔ, na momfa ntwa, na munkogyaw wɔ mo asoɛe a mobɛsoɛ hɔ anadwo yi.

english_verse: Joshua chose twelve men; then he called them together
translation_verse: Ɛnna Yosua frɛɛ mmarima dumien a ɔpaw wɔn fii Israelfo mu no, abusuakuw biara mu onipa biako.

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monsen nni AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn adaka no anim nkɔ Yordan mfinimfini, na montase abo mmiako mmiako mmobɔ mo kɔn ho, sɛ Israelfo mmusuakuw no ano si, na eyi ayɛ mo mu sɛnkyerɛnne.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: Monka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ Yordan nsu no twae, AWURADE apam adaka no anim bere a apam adaka no twaa Yordan no, na abo yi nyɛ nkae mma Israelfo nkosi daa.

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no yɛɛ saa, sɛnea Yosua hyɛe no, na wɔtasee abo dumien Yordan mu, sɛnea AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua no, sɛ Israelfo mmusuakuw no ano si, na wɔde twa baa wɔn asoɛe, na wogyawee wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Na Yosua momaa abo dumien nso so sisii Yordan mu, nea asɔfo a wɔso apam adaka no anan sisii hɔ, na ɛwɔ hɔ de besi nnɛ.
