english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛfo bɛn na mo nso mutu, na yɛde abua ɔman yi a wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yi kɔndua a w’agya de too yɛn kɔn so no so ma ɛnyɛ hare, no?

english_verse: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene de asɛnnennen buaa ɔman no, na ogyaw mpanyimfo no fo a wotuu no no,

english_verse: He spoke bluntly and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn, sɛnea mmofra no tuu no fo no, sɛ: M’agya maa mo kɔndua yɛɛ duru, na me de, mɛto mo kɔndua no so; m’agya de mpire na ɛhwee mo, na me de, mede nkekantwɛre na mɛhwe mo.

english_verse: When the Israelites heard that Jeroboam was back, they called everyone together. Then they sent for Jeroboam and made him king of Israel. Only the people from the tribe of Judah remained loyal to David's family. Shemaiah Warns Rehoboam (
translation_verse: Na Israel nyinaa tee sɛ Yeroboam asan aba no, wɔsoma kohyiaa no baa asafo no mu, na wosii no Israel nyinaa so hene; obiara nni hɔ a odii Dawid fi akyi sɛ Yuda abusuakuw nko.

english_verse: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and take control of the whole country. So he called together
translation_verse: Na Rehoboam duu Yerusalem no, ɔboaboaa Yuda fi nyinaa ne Benyamin abusuakuw ano, nnipa a wɔapaw wɔn a wotu sa ɔpeha aduɔwɔtwe sɛ ɔne Israel fi rekɔko, na wɔadan ahenni no ama Solomon ba Rehoboam.

english_verse: Meanwhile, God told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn asɛm baa Onyankopɔn nipa Semaia nkyɛn sɛ:

english_verse: to give Rehoboam and everyone from Judah and Benjamin this warning:
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ Solomon ba Rehoboam, Yuda hene, ne Yuda ne Benyamin fi nyinaa ne ɔman no nkae sɛ:

english_verse: “Don't go to war against the people from Israel—they are your relatives. Go home! I am the Lord, and I made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord and went home. Jeroboam Makes Religious Changes
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Mommforo nnkɔ na mo ne mo nuanom Israelfo nnkɔko, monsan nkokɔ mo afi; na me na asɛm yi fi me. Na wotiee AWURADE asɛm no, na wɔsan kɔe, sɛ AWURADE asɛm no se no. Yeroboam abosonsom

english_verse: Jeroboam rebuilt Shechem in Ephraim and made it a stronger town, then he moved there. He also fortified the town of Penuel.
translation_verse: Na Yeroboam kyekyeree Sekem, Efraim bepɔw so tenaa mu; na ofii hɔ kɔkyekyeree Penuel.

english_verse: One day, Jeroboam started thinking, “Everyone in Israel still goes to the temple in Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord. What if they become loyal to David's family again? They will kill me and accept Rehoboam as their king.”
translation_verse: sɛ ɔman yi foro kɔbɔ afɔre AWURADE fi Yerusalem a, ɛnne ɔman yi koma bɛdan akɔ wɔn wura Rehoboam, Yuda hene, nkyɛn, na wɔakum me, na wɔasan akɔ Yuda hene Rehoboam nkyɛn.

english_verse: Jeroboam asked for advice and then made two gold statues of calves. He showed them to the people and said, “Listen everyone! You won't have to go to Jerusalem to worship anymore. Here are your gods who rescued you from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhene no tuu agyina, na ɔyɛɛ sika nantwi mma abien, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Moaforo akɔ Yerusalem bi ara! Israel, hwɛ, wo anyame a ɔde wo fi Misraim bae ni.

english_verse: Then he put one of the gold calves in the town of Bethel and the other in the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Na ɔde biako kosii Betel na ɔde biako nso kosii Dan.

english_verse: The people sinned because they started going to these places to worship.
translation_verse: Na asɛm yi dan bɔne, efisɛ ɔman no kɔɔ biako yi anim, Dan, [ne biako no nso anim wɔ Betel].

english_verse: Jeroboam built small places of worship at the shrines and appointed men who were not from the tribe of Levi to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea afi, na ɔde ɔman no mu nnipa hunu a womfi Lewifo mu sisii asɔfo.

english_verse: He also decided to start a new festival for the Israelites on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, just like the one in Judah. On that day, Jeroboam went to Bethel and offered sacrifices on the altar to the gold calf he had put there. Then he assigned the priests their duties.
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔɔ afɔre afɔremuka a ɔyɛe Betel no so, ɔsram a ɛto so awotwe da a ɛto so dunum no so, ɔsram a ɔno nko bɔɔ ne tirim hyɛe no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ dapɔnna maa Israelfo no, na ɔbɔɔ afɔre afɔremuka no so, na ɔhyew aduhuam.

english_verse: One day, Jeroboam was standing at the altar in Bethel, ready to make an offering. Suddenly one of God's prophets arrived from Judah and shouted: The Lord sent me with a message about this altar. A child named Josiah will be born into David's family. He will sacrifice on this altar the priests who make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on it.
translation_verse: Na ɔnam AWURADE asɛm so teɛɛm hyɛɛ afɔremuka no sɛ: Afɔremuka, afɔremuka, sɛ AWURADE se ni: Hwɛ, wɔbɛwo ɔba ama Dawid fi a ne din de Yosia, na wo so na ɔde sorɔnsorɔmmea asɔfo a wɔhyew wo so aduhuam no bɛbɔ afɔre, na wahyew nnipa nnompe wɔ wo so.

english_verse: You will know that the Lord has said these things when the altar splits in half, and the ashes on it fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Na ɔmaa sɛnkyerɛnne da no ara sɛ: Eyi ne sɛnkyerɛnne sɛ AWURADE na aka, hwɛ, afɔremuka no bɛpae, na nso a ɛwɔ so no ahwie agu.

english_verse: Jeroboam pointed at the prophet and shouted, “Grab him!” But at once, Jeroboam's hand became stiff, and he could not move it.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene tee Onyankopɔn nipa no asɛm a ɔteɛɛm hyɛɛ afɔremuka a ɛwɔ Betel no, Yeroboam teɛɛ ne nsa fii afɔremuka no so kae sɛ: Monkyere no. Na ne nsa a ɔteɛe no so no senee kyenkyenenn, na wantumi anka anto ne ho.

english_verse: The altar split in half, and the ashes fell to the ground, just as the prophet had warned.
translation_verse: Na afɔremuka no paee, na nso no fii afɔremuka no so gui sɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a Onyankopɔn nipa no de AWURADE asɛm kae no te no.

english_verse: “Please pray to the Lord your God and ask him to heal my hand,” Jeroboam begged. The prophet prayed, and Jeroboam's hand was healed.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔhene bua ka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Afei pa AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn kyɛw na srɛ ma me, na me nsa yi nyɛ yiye mma me! Na Onyankopɔn nipa no paa AWURADE kyɛw, na ɔhene nsa no yɛɛ yiye maa no, na ɛyɛe sɛ kan no.

english_verse: “Come home with me and eat something,” Jeroboam said. “I want to give you a gift for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Wo ne me nkɔ ofie, na kodwudwo wo ho, na mɛkyɛ wo ade.

english_verse: “No, I wouldn't go with you, even if you offered me half of your kingdom. I won't eat or drink here either.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn nipa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ: Sɛ wode wo fi fa bɛma me po a, me ne wo renkɔ, na merennidi na merennom wɔ ha,

english_verse: The Lord said I can't eat or drink anything and that I can't go home the same way I came.”
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔde AWURADE asɛm hyɛɛ me sɛ: Nnidi na nnom, na nsan mfa ɔkwan a wonam so kɔe no so.

english_verse: Then he started home down a different road. An Old Prophet from Bethel
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa ɔkwan foforo so, na wansan amfa ɔkwan a ɔnam so kɔɔ Betel no so.

english_verse: At that time an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons told him what the prophet from Judah had said and done.
translation_verse: Nso odiyifo akwakoraa bi te Betel; na ne ba kɔbɔɔ no nea Onyankopɔn nipa no bɛyɛe Betel da no nyinaa; nsɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no nso, wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn agya.

english_verse: “Show me which way he went,” the old prophet said, and his sons pointed out the road.
translation_verse: Na wɔn agya no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔfae? Na ne mma no huu ɔkwan a Onyankopɔn nipa a ofi Yuda bae no faa so.

english_verse: “Put a saddle on my donkey,” he told them. After they did, he got on the donkey
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne mma no sɛ: Monhyehyɛ afurum no mma me! Na wɔhyehyɛɛ afurum no maa no, na ɔtenaa no so,

english_verse: and rode off to look for the prophet from Judah. The old prophet found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, “Are you the prophet from Judah?” “Yes, I am.”
translation_verse: na osiim tiw Onyankopɔn nipa no, na ɔkɔtoo no sɛ ɔte odupɔn kɛse bi ase. Na obisaa no sɛ: Wone Onyankopɔn nipa a ofi Yuda bae no? Na obuae sɛ: Mene no.

english_verse: “Come home with me,” the old prophet said, “and have something to eat.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ma yɛnkɔ ofie na kodidi.

english_verse: “I can't go back with you,” the prophet replied, “and I can't eat or drink anything with you.
translation_verse: Na ose: Merentumi ne wo nsan na me ne wo renkɔ, nso me ne wo rennidi nnom wɔ ha, efisɛ wɔde AWURADE asɛm hyɛɛ me sɛ:

english_verse: The Lord warned me not to eat or drink or to go home the same way I came.”
translation_verse: Nnidi na nnom wɔ hɔ, nso nsan mfa ɔkwan a wonam so kɔe no so.

english_verse: The old prophet said, “I'm a prophet too. One of the Lord's angels told me to take you to my house and give you something to eat and drink.” The prophet from Judah did not know that the old prophet was lying,
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me nso meyɛ odiyifo sɛ wo, na ɔbɔfo bi de AWURADE asɛm aka akyerɛ me sɛ: Kɔsan no na ɔne wo mmra wo fi, na ommedidi na ɔnnom. Nanso atoro na odi kyerɛɛ no.

english_verse: so he went home with him and ate and drank.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔne no sanee, na okodidii ne fi, na ɔnom nsu.

english_verse: During the meal the Lord gave the old prophet
translation_verse: Na wɔte pon ho no, AWURADE asɛm baa odiyifo a ɔkɔsan no bae no nkyɛn,

english_verse: a message for the prophet from Judah: Listen to the Lord's message. You have disobeyed the Lord your God.
translation_verse: na ɔteɛɛm kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn nipa a ofi Yuda bae no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Sɛ woatew AWURADE anom asɛm ho atua na woanni mmara asɛm a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo no so,

english_verse: He told you not to eat or drink anything here, but you came home and ate with me. And so, when you die, your body won't be buried in your family tomb.
translation_verse: na woasan abedidi na woanom nsu faako a wɔka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ: Nnidi na nnom nsu, no nti, wo funu renkɔ w’agyanom da mu.

english_verse: After the meal the old prophet got a donkey ready,
translation_verse: Na odidii na ɔnom nsu wiei no, ɔhyehyɛɛ afurum no maa odiyifo a ɔkɔsan no bae no.

english_verse: and the prophet from Judah left. Along the way, a lion attacked and killed him, and the donkey and the lion stood there beside his dead body.
translation_verse: Na ɔrekɔ no, gyata behyiaa no ɔkwan no mu, na okum no, na ne funu no daa ɔkwan no mu, na afurum no gyina nkyɛn, na gyata no nso gyina funu no ho.

english_verse: Some people walked by and saw the body with the lion standing there. They ran into Bethel, telling everyone what they had seen.
translation_verse: Na hwɛ, nnipa retwam, na wohuu funu a ɛda ɔkwan no mu ne gyata a ogyina funu no ho no. Na wɔkɔe kɔkae kurow a odiyifo akwakoraa no te mu no mu.

english_verse: When the old prophet heard the news, he said, “That must be the prophet from Judah. The Lord warned him, but he disobeyed. So the Lord sent a lion to kill him.”
translation_verse: Na odiyifo a ɔkɔsan no fii ɔkwan no so no tee no, ɔkae sɛ: Onyankopɔn nipa a ɔtew AWURADE anom asɛm ho atua no ne no, na AWURADE de no ama gyata no ma watetew no akum no, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ no no te no.

english_verse: The old prophet told his sons to saddle his donkey, and when it was ready,
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne mma sɛ: Monhyehyɛ afurum no mma me. Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no.

english_verse: he left. He found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and lion standing there. The lion had not eaten the body or attacked the donkey.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔe kohuu funu no sɛ ɛda ɔkwan no mu, na afurum no ne gyata no gyinagyina funu no ho; gyata no nnii funu no, na ɔntetew afurum no nso ɛ.

english_verse: The old prophet picked up the body, put it on his own donkey, and took it back to Bethel, so he could bury it and mourn for the prophet from Judah.
translation_verse: Na odiyifo no maa Onyankopɔn nipa no funu no so de too afurum no so de no sanee, na odiyifo akwakoraa no de no kɔɔ ne kurow mu, sɛ okogyam no na wasie no.

english_verse: He buried the body in his own family tomb and cried for the prophet.
translation_verse: Na ɔde ne funu no too ne da mu, na wogyam no sɛ: Due, me nua!

english_verse: I'm sure that everything he said about the altar in Bethel and the shrines in Samaria will happen.”
translation_verse: Na asɛm a ɔnam AWURADE asɛm so teɛɛm hyɛɛ afɔremuka a ɛwɔ Betel no ne sorɔnsorɔmmea afi a ɛwɔ Samaria nkurow mu no nyinaa, ɛbɛba mu ampa.

english_verse: But Jeroboam kept on doing evil things. He appointed men to be priests at the local shrines, even if they were not Levites. In fact, anyone who wanted to be a priest could be one.
translation_verse: Asɛm yi akyi no Yeroboam ansan amfi ne kwammɔne so, na ɔsan faa ɔman no mu baabiara nnipa sisii sorɔnsorɔmmea asɔfo; obiara a ɔpɛ no, ɔde asɔfodi hyɛ ne nsa ma wɔyɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea asɔfo no bi.

english_verse: This sinful thing led to the downfall of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Na asɛm yi dan Yeroboam fi bɔne a ɛma wɔdwerɛw wɔn na wɔsɛee wɔn fii asase ani.

english_verse: About the same time, Abijah son of Jeroboam got sick.
translation_verse: Ɛbere no mu no, Yeroboam ba Abigya yaree.

english_verse: She got ready and left for Ahijah's house in Shiloh. Ahijah was now old and blind,
translation_verse: Na Yeroboam yere no yɛɛ saa, na osiim kɔɔ Silo, na oduu Ahia fi. Nso Ahia nhu ade, na akorabɔ nti n’aniwa agyen.

english_verse: But when Ahijah heard her walking up to the door, he said: Come in! I know you're Jeroboam's wife—why are you pretending to be someone else? I have some bad news for you.
translation_verse: Na Ahia tee ne nan ase sɛ ɔreba ɔpon ano no, ɔkae sɛ: Yeroboam yere, bra! Adɛn nti na woasakra wo ho ayɛ sɛ onipa foforo yi? Na me de, wɔde asɛnnennen asoma me wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: Give your husband this message from the Lord God of Israel: “Jeroboam, you know that I, the Lord, chose you over anyone else to be the leader of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Kɔka kyerɛ Yeroboam sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se ni: Esiane sɛ memaa wo so wo man no mu na misii wo me man Israel so panyin,

english_verse: I even took David's kingdom away from his family and gave it to you. But you are not like my servant David. He always obeyed me and did what was right.
translation_verse: na metew ahenni no fii Dawid fi mede memaa wo, nanso woanyɛ sɛ m’akoa Dawid a odii me mmara nsɛm so na ɔde ne koma nyinaa dii m’akyi sɛ ɔbɛyɛ nea ɛteɛ m’ani so no nko,

english_verse: “You have made me very angry by rejecting me and making idols out of gold. Jeroboam, you have done more evil things than any king before you.
translation_verse: na woayɛ bɔne asen wɔn a wodii w’anim nyinaa, na woakɔ akɔyɛ anyame foforo ne ahoni a wɔagu sɛ wode rehuru me bo, na woatow me akyene w’akyi nti,

english_verse: “Because of this, I will destroy your family by killing every man and boy in it, whether slave or free. I will wipe out your family, just as fire burns up trash.
translation_verse: hwɛ, mede bɔne bɛba Yeroboam fi so, na matwa Yeroboam fi barima biara ne Israel mu akoa ne ɔdehye, na mapra madi Yeroboam fi akyi sɛnea obi pra fi kosi sɛ ɛsa.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel will mourn at his funeral. But he will be the last one from Jeroboam's family to receive a proper burial, because he's the only one the Lord God of Israel is pleased with.
translation_verse: Na Israel nyinaa begyam no na wɔasie no, na ɔno nko ne Yeroboam de a ɔbɛkɔ ɔda mu, efisɛ ɔno mu na wɔahu adepa bi AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn fam, Yeroboam fi.

english_verse: The Lord will soon choose a new king of Israel, who will destroy Jeroboam's family. And I mean very soon.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɛma ɔhene so Israel so a ɔbɛsɛe Yeroboam fi. Ɛda no ni! Na dɛn na aba yi?

english_verse: years from Jerusalem, the city where the Lord had chosen to be worshiped. His mother Naamah was from Ammon.
translation_verse: Na Yeroboam yere no sɔre siim kɔɔ Tirsa; na oduu ɔdan no apongua ase de so no, abofra no wui.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel came and mourned at his funeral, just as the Lord's servant Ahijah had said. Jeroboam Dies
translation_verse: Na wosiee no, na Israel nyinaa gyam no, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa odiyifo Ahia so kae no te no.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including the battles he won, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Yeroboam ho nsɛm nkae, sɛnea odii ako ne sɛnea odii ne hene fae no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu.

english_verse: The people of Judah disobeyed the Lord and made him even angrier than their ancestors had.
translation_verse: Na Yuda yɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔde ninkuntwe hyɛɛ no sen nea wɔn agyanom de wɔn bɔne a wɔyɛe no hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: They also built their own local shrines and stone images of foreign gods, and they set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Na wɔn nso yeyɛɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea ne adum ne Asera nnua, nkoko sorɔnsorɔn nyinaa so ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase.

english_verse: Even worse, they allowed prostitutes at the shrines, and followed the disgusting customs of the foreign nations that the Lord had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Na mmarima nguaman nso wɔ asase no so; wɔyɛe sɛ amanaman a AWURADE tuu wɔn fii Israelfo anim no akyide nyinaa te.

english_verse: After Rehoboam had been king for four years, King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Rehoboam afe a ɛto so anum so no, Misraim hene Sisak foro baa Yerusalem so.

english_verse: He took everything of value from the temple and the palace, including Solomon's gold shields.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa AWURADE fi akorade ne ahemfi akorade, nyinaa kɔe; na ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Solomon yɛe no nyinaa nso.

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Rehoboam yɛɛ kɔbere akyɛm sisii ananmu, na ɔde hyɛɛ ammirikatufo a wɔhwɛ ahemfi pon ano no so asafohene nsa.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he was finished.
translation_verse: Na da biara a ɔhene rekɔ AWURADE fi no, ammirikatufo no kurakura, na wɔde san besie ammirikatufo pia mu.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Rehoboam ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe no nyinaa, so wɔankyerɛw Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: He and Jeroboam were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Na dɔmdi daa Rehoboam ne Yeroboam ntam daa.

english_verse: Rehoboam's mother Naamah was from Ammon, but when Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Abijam then became king.
translation_verse: Na Rehoboam tiw n’agyanom kɔɔ asaman, na wosiee no n’agyanom nkyɛn, Dawid kurow mu. Na ne na din de Naama a ɔyɛ Amonni. Na ne ba Abiam bedii n’ade.

english_verse: His own grandmother Maacah had made an idol of Asherah, and Asa took it and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Na ne na Maaka nso, otuu no fii ɔhemmeadi so, efisɛ ɔyɛɛ ohoni bi maa Asera; na Asa twaa ne honi no kɔhyewee Kidron subon mu.

english_verse: Abijam became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Na Nebat ba ɔhene Yeroboam afe a ɛto so dunwɔtwe mu na Abigya bedii Yuda so hene.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to strengthen the town of Ramah. Then he used these same stones and wood to fortify the town of Geba in the territory of Benjamin and the town of Mizpah.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔhene Asa ma wɔpaee Yuda nyinaa, wɔanyi obiara amfi mu, na wɔkɔsoaa Rama abo ne nnua a Basa de kyekyee no, na ɔhene Asa de kyekyee Geba-benyamin ne Mispa.

english_verse: Abijam did not truly obey the Lord his God as his ancestor David had done. Instead, he was sinful just like his father Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ bɔne a n’agya yɛe no ara bi, na ne koma anni mu AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn ho.

english_verse: David had always obeyed the Lord's commands by doing right, except in the case of Uriah. And since Abijam was David's great-grandson, the Lord kept Jerusalem safe and let Abijam have a son who would be the next king.
translation_verse: efisɛ Dawid yɛɛ nea ɛteɛ AWURADE ani so, na wamman amfi biribiara a ɔhyɛɛ no ho, ne nkwa nna nyinaa, gye Hetini Uria asɛm no nko mu.

english_verse: The war that had broken out between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continued during the time that Abijam was king. Everything else Abijam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Abigya ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, so wɔankyerɛw Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu? Na dɔmdi daa Abigya ne Yeroboam ntam.

english_verse: Abijam died and was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Asa became king. King Asa of Judah (
translation_verse: Na Abigya wui; na wosiee no Dawid kurow mu; na ne ba Asa bedii n’ade. Ɔhene Asa di Yuda so hene (

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔde n’agya akronkronne ne n’ankasa akronkronne baa AWURADE fi: Dwetɛ ne sika ne nnwinne.

english_verse: Asa was always at war with King Baasha of Israel.
translation_verse: Na dɔmdi daa Asa ne Israel hene Basa ntam wɔn nna nyinaa.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord, as David had done.
translation_verse: Na Asa yɛɛ nea ɛteɛ AWURADE ani so sɛ n’agya Dawid.

english_verse: Asa became king of Judah in the twentieth year of Jeroboam's rule in Israel,
translation_verse: Na Israel hene Yeroboam afe a ɛto so aduonu so no Asa bedii Yuda so hene.

english_verse: He forced the prostitutes at the shrines to leave the country, and he got rid of the idols his ancestors had made.
translation_verse: Na otutuu nguaman no fii asase no so, na oyiyii ahoni a n’agyanom yɛe no nyinaa.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was completely faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines.
translation_verse: Na sorɔnsorɔmmea no de, wanyi, nanso Asa koma dii mu AWURADE ho ne nna nyinaa.

english_verse: One time, Baasha invaded Judah and captured the town of Ramah. He started making the town stronger, so he could put troops there to stop people from going in and out of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Israel hene Basa foro baa Yuda so, na ɔbɛkyekyee Rama, sɛ ɔremma obi nni Yuda hene Asa nkyɛn ahyemfiri.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. He gave it to some of his officials and sent them to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Ɛnna Asa faa dwetɛ ne sika a ɛkae AWURADE fi akorade ne ɔhene fi akorade mu de hyɛɛ ne nkoa nsa, na ɔhene Asa de somaa wɔn kɔɔ Hesion ba Tabrimon ba Siria hene Ben-hadad a ɔte Damasko nkyɛn sɛ:

english_verse: “Our fathers signed a peace treaty. Why don't we do the same thing? This silver and gold is a present for you. So, would you please break your treaty with Baasha and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: Ma apam nna me ne wo ntam, ne m’agya ne w’agya ntam, hwɛ, merebrɛ wo dwetɛ ne sika ayɛyɛde, na kɔ kobubu wo ne Israel hene Basa apam no mu, na omfi me so nkɔ.

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, and Abel-Bethmaacah, and the territories of Chinneroth and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Na Ben-hadad tiee ɔhene Asa, na ɔsomaa asafohene a ɔwɔ no hyɛɛ Israel nkurow, na ɔbɔɔ Iyon ne Dan ne Abel-bet-maaka ne Kinerot nyinaa ne Naftali asase nyinaa.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he left Ramah and went back to Tirzah.
translation_verse: Na Basa tee no, ogyaee Rama kyekye, na ɔkɔtenaa Tirsa.

english_verse: Everything else Asa did while he was king, including his victories and the towns he rebuilt, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. When he got older, he had a foot disease.
translation_verse: Na Asa ho nsɛm nyinaa nkae ne ne mmaninne nyinaa ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa ne nkurow a ɔkyekyee, so wɔankyerɛw Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu? Nanso ne nkwakorabere mu no, ɔyaree ne nan.

english_verse: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Asa's second year as king of Judah, and he ruled two years.
translation_verse: Na Yeroboam ba Nadab bedii Israel so hene, Yuda hene Asa afe a ɛto so abien so. Na odii Israel so hene mfe abien.

english_verse: Nadab disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of his father, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔnantew n’agya kwammɔne no so, na ɔde ɔman Israel kɔɔ bɔne mu.

english_verse: The Lord's prophet Ahijah had earlier said, “Not one man or boy in Jeroboam's family will be left alive.” And, as soon as Baasha became king, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family,
translation_verse: Na obedii hene no, okunkum Yeroboam fi nnipa nyinaa, wannyaw obiara a ɔhome amma Yeroboam, sɛnea AWURADE nam n’akoa: Odiyifo Siloni Ahigya so kae no,

english_verse: because Jeroboam had made the Lord God of Israel angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛe, ne nea ɔmaa Israel yɛe ne abohuru a ɔde huruu AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn bo no nti na ɛbaa saa.

english_verse: Everything else Nadab did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Nadab ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, so wɔankyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: King Asa of Judah and King Baasha of Israel were always at war. King Baasha of Israel
translation_verse: Na akodi daa Asa ne Israel hene Baasa ntam wɔn nna nyinaa. Ɔhene Baasa di Israel so hene

english_verse: Baasha son of Ahijah became king of Israel in Asa's third year as king of Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asa afe a ɛto so abiɛsa so na Ahigya ba Baasa bedii Israel nyinaa so hene Tirsa, mfe aduonu anan.

english_verse: Baasha also disobeyed the Lord by acting like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔyɛɛ bɔne a Yeroboam yɛe no ara bi ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne.

english_verse: The Lord sent Jehu son of Hanani to say to Baasha:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE asɛm baa Hanani ba Yehu nkyɛn tiaa Baasa sɛ:

english_verse: Nobody knew who you were until I, the Lord, chose you to be the leader of my people Israel. And now you're acting exactly like Jeroboam by causing the Israelites to sin. What you've done has made me so angry
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ mama wo so afi mfutuma mu, na masi wo me man Israel so panyin, na woafa Yeroboam kwan so, na woama me man Israel ayɛ bɔne ma wɔde wɔn bɔne ahuru me bo yi nti,

english_verse: that I will destroy you and your family, just as I did the family of Jeroboam.
translation_verse: hwɛ, merepra Baasa ne ne fi akɔ, na mɛyɛ wo fi sɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam fi.

english_verse: Dogs will eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: Baasani a obewu kurow mu no, akraman na ebedi ne nam, na ne ni a obewu wuram no, wim nnomaa na ebedi ne nam.

english_verse: Baasha made the Lord very angry, and that's why the Lord gave Jehu this message for Baasha and his family. Baasha constantly disobeyed the Lord by following Jeroboam's sinful example—but even worse, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family! Everything else Baasha did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah became king. King Elah of Israel
translation_verse: Nanso AWURADE asɛm nam Hanani ba odiyifo Yehu so bae hyɛɛ Baasa ne ne fi, bɔne a ɔyɛe AWURADE ani so nyinaa, sɛ ɔde ne nsa ano adwuma yɛe sɛ Yeroboam fi de huruu ne bo, ne okum a okum no nti. Ɔhene Ela di Israel so hene

english_verse: Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel after Asa had been king of Judah for
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asa afe a ɛto so aduonu asia so na Baasa ba Ela bedii hene Tirsa mfe abien.

english_verse: Omri did more evil things than any king before him.
translation_verse: Na Omri yɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔyɛɛ bɔne sen wɔn a wodii n’anim nyinaa.

english_verse: Zimri commanded half of Elah's chariots, and he made plans to kill Elah. One day, Elah was in Tirzah, getting drunk at the home of Arza, his prime minister,
translation_verse: Na n’akoa Simri, ne nteaseɛnam fa so safohene, tew ne so atua; na ɔwɔ Tirsa anom nsa abow wɔ Arsa a odi ahemfi a ɛwɔ Tirsa no so no fi.

english_verse: when Zimri went there and killed Elah. So Zimri became king in the twenty-seventh year of Asa's rule in Judah.
translation_verse: Na Simri kɔɔ mu kɔbɔɔ no kum no, Yuda hene Asa afe a ɛto so aduonu ason so, na odii n’ade.

english_verse: As soon as Zimri became king, he killed everyone in Baasha's family. Not one man or boy in his family was left alive—even his close friends were killed.
translation_verse: Na obedii hene, na ɔtenaa ahengua so ara pɛ no, okum Basa fi nyinaa, obusuani oo, adamfo oo, wannyaw ɔbarima biara amma no.

english_verse: Baasha's family was completely wiped out, just as the Lord's prophet Jehu had warned.
translation_verse: Na Simri sɛee Baasa fi nyinaa sɛnea AWURADE nam odiyifo Yehu so ka kyerɛɛ Baasa no,

english_verse: Baasha and Elah sinned and caused the Israelites to sin, and they made the Lord angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Baasa bɔne nyinaa ne ne ba Ela bɔne a wɔyeyɛe na wɔde maa Israel yɛɛ bɔne sɛ wɔde wɔn ahuhude huruu AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, bo no nti.

english_verse: Everything else Elah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Zimri of Israel
translation_verse: Na Ela ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, so wɔankyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu? Ɔhene Simri di Israel so hene

english_verse: Zimri became king of Israel in Asa's twenty-seventh year as king of Judah, but he ruled only seven days from Tirzah. Israel's army was camped near Gibbethon in Philistia under the command of Omri. The soldiers heard that Zimri had killed Elah, and they made Omri their king that same day.
translation_verse: Na aman a wɔwɔ nsram no tee sɛ Simri atew atua akum ɔhene no, Israel nyinaa de ɔsahene Omri sii Israel so hene da no ara nsra no mu.

english_verse: At once, Omri and his army marched to Tirzah and attacked.
translation_verse: Na Omri fi Gibeton foro bae, na Israel nyinaa ka ne ho, na wobetuaa Tirsa.

english_verse: When Zimri saw that the town was captured, he ran into the strongest part of the palace and killed himself by setting it on fire.
translation_verse: Na Simri hui sɛ wɔagye kurow no no, ɔkɔɔ ahemfi aban no mu, na ɔde ogya hyew ahemfi no guu ne ho so, na owui,

english_verse: Zimri had disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: ne bɔne a ɔyɛe, de tiaa AWURADE, sɛ ɔnantew Yeroboam akwan so, ne nea ɔmaa ɔman Israel nso yɛe no nti.

english_verse: Everything else Zimri did while he was king, including his rebellion against Elah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Omri of Israel
translation_verse: Na Simri ho nsɛm nkae ne n’apam a ɔkɔe no, so wɔankyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: After Zimri died, some of the Israelites wanted Tibni son of Ginath to be king, but others wanted Omri.
translation_verse: Ɛno na Israel man mu paepaee afaafa abien. Ɔman no fa dii Ginat ba Tibni akyi sɛ wobesi no hene, na ɔfa nso dii Omri akyi.

english_verse: in the thirty-first year of Asa's rule in Judah. Omri ruled Israel for twelve years. The first six years he ruled from Tirzah,
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asa afe a ɛto so aduasa biako so na Omri bedii Israel so hene mfe dumien. Odii hene Tirsa mfe asia.

english_verse: He acted just like Jeroboam and made the Lord God of Israel angry by causing the Israelites to sin and to worship idols.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa Nebat ba Yeroboam akwan nyinaa ne ne bɔne a ɔmaa Israel yɛe no so, sɛ wɔde wɔn ahuhude behuru AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, no bo.

english_verse: Everything else Omri did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Omri ho nsɛm nkae, nea ɔyɛe ne mmaninne a ɔyɛe no, wɔakyerɛw no Israel ahemfo beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: Omri died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab became king. King Ahab of Israel
translation_verse: Na Omri wui, na wosiee no Samaria. Na ne ba Ahab bedii n’ade. Ɔhene Ahab di Israel so hene

english_verse: Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Na Omri ba Ahab bedii Israel so hene, Yuda hene Asa afe a ɛto so aduasa awotwe so. Ahab dii Israel so hene Samaria mfirihyia aduonu abien.

english_verse: Ahab did more things to disobey the Lord than any king before him.
translation_verse: Ahab yɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sen wɔn a wodii n’anim nyinaa.

english_verse: He acted just like Jeroboam. Even worse, he married Jezebel the daughter of King Ethbaal of Sidon and started worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Na wammu no hwee sɛ ɔbɛnantew Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne mu, na ɔkɔfaa Sidonfo hene Etbaal babea Yesebel waree, na ɔkɔe kɔsom Baal na ɔsɔree no.

english_verse: Ahab built an altar and temple for Baal in Samaria
translation_verse: Na osii afɔremuka maa Baal wɔ Baal fi wɔ Samaria.

english_verse: and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. Ahab did more to make the Lord God of Israel angry than any king of Israel before him.
translation_verse: Na Ahab yɛɛ Asera nnua, na ɔyɛɛ nneɛma pii kaa ho huruu AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, bo sen Israel ahene a wodii n’anim nyinaa.

english_verse: While Ahab was king, a man from Bethel named Hiel rebuilt the town of Jericho. But while Hiel was laying the foundation for the town wall, his oldest son Abiram died. And while he was finishing the gates, his youngest son Segub died. This happened just as the Lord had told Joshua to say many years ago.
translation_verse: Ne bere so na Betelni Hiel kyekyee Yeriko; n’abakan Abiram wui bere a ɔtoo fapem, na ne ba kumaa Segub nso wui bere a osisii ano apon no, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam Nun ba Yosua so kae no.

english_verse: Elijah was a prophet from Tishbe in Gilead. One day he went to King Ahab and said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord, the God of Israel. And I swear in his name that it won't rain until I say so. There won't even be any dew on the ground.”
translation_verse: Na Tisbini Elia a ofi Gilead atubrafo no mu ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn a migyina n’anim te ase yi, obosu anaa osu rentɔ mfe yi mu gye sɛ ɛnam m’asɛm so!

english_verse: Later, the Lord said to Elijah,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ:

english_verse: “Leave and go across the Jordan River so you can hide near Cherith Creek.
translation_verse: Fi ha kɔ, na dan wo ho kɔ apuei, na kohintaw asu Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan anim no ho.

english_verse: You can drink water from the creek, and eat the food I've told the ravens to bring you.”
translation_verse: Na wobɛnom asu no mu nsu, na mahyɛ nkwaakwaadabi sɛ wɔnhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Elijah obeyed the Lord and went to live near Cherith Creek.
translation_verse: Na osiim kɔyɛe sɛ AWURADE kae no, na ɔkɔe kɔtenaa asu Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan anim no ho.

english_verse: Ravens brought him bread and meat twice a day, and he drank water from the creek.
translation_verse: Na nkwaakwaadabi brɛɛ no abodoo ne nam anɔpa, ne abodoo ne nam anwummere, na ɔnom asu no mu nsu.

english_verse: But after a while, it dried up because there was no rain. Elijah Helps a Widow in Zarephath
translation_verse: Na nna bi akyi no, asu no yowee, efisɛ osu antɔ asase no so. Elia wɔ Sarefat bea kunafo bi nkyɛn

english_verse: The Lord told Elijah,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ:

english_verse: “Go to the town of Zarephath in Sidon and live there. I've told a widow in that town to give you food.”
translation_verse: Sɔre kɔ Sarefat a ɛyɛ Sidonfo de no, na kɔtena hɔ; na hwɛ, mahyɛ ɔbea kunafo bi hɔ sɛ ɔnhwɛ wo.

english_verse: When Elijah came near the town gate of Zarephath, he saw a widow gathering sticks for a fire. “Would you please bring me a cup of water?” he asked.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔre kɔɔ Sarefat. Na oduu kurow no pon ano no, na hwɛ, ɔbea kunafo no wɔ hɔ repɛ mmobaa. Na ɔfrɛɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔsaw nsu kakra gu biribi mu brɛ me na mennom.

english_verse: As she left to get it, he asked, “Would you also please bring me a piece of bread?”
translation_verse: Na ɔrekɔ akɔsaw no, frɛɛ no sɛ: Fa abodoo afono ma kura wo nsam brɛ me.

english_verse: The widow answered, “In the name of the living Lord your God, I swear that I don't have any bread. All I have is a handful of flour and a little olive oil. I'm on my way home now with these few sticks to cook what I have for my son and me. After that, we will starve to death.”
translation_verse: Na ose: Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn te ase yi, atode biara nni me nsam, gye asikresam nsa ma a ɛwɔ kuruwa mu ne ngo kakra a ɛwɔ toa mu, na hwɛ, merepɛ mmobaa abien bi makɔ makɔto, na me ne me ba adi na yɛawu.

english_verse: Elijah said, “Everything will be fine. Do what you said. Go home and fix something for you and your son. But first, please make a small piece of bread and bring it to me.
translation_verse: Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nsuro, kɔyɛ sɛ woaka no, nanso kɔfa bi yɛ ɔfam ketewaa bi ma me kan, na fa brɛ me, na ɛno akyi no yɛ wo ne wo ba de.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has promised that your jar of flour won't run out and your bottle of oil won't dry up before he sends rain for the crops.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn se ni: Asikresam kuruwa no so renhuan, na ngo toa no so rentew de bɛkɔ akosi da a AWURADE bɛma osu atɔ agu asase so.

english_verse: The widow went home and did exactly what Elijah had told her. She and Elijah and her family had enough food for a long time.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔe kɔyɛe sɛ Elia ka kyerɛɛ no no, na odii, ɔno ne ɔbea no ne ne fi, nna pii;

english_verse: The Lord kept the promise that his prophet Elijah had made, and she did not run out of flour or oil. Elijah Brings a Boy Back to Life
translation_verse: na asikresam kuruwa no so anhuan na ngo toa no so antew, sɛnea AWURADE nam Elia so kae no.

english_verse: Several days later, the son of the woman who owned the house got sick, and he kept getting worse, until finally he died.
translation_verse: Na nsɛm yi akyi no, ɔbea fiwura no babarima yaree, na ne yare no mu yɛɛ den pii kosii sɛ ahome biara anka no mu.

english_verse: The woman shouted at Elijah, “What have I done to you? I thought you were God's prophet. Did you come here to cause the death of my son as a reminder that I've sinned against God?”
translation_verse: Na ɔbea no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Wo Onyankopɔn nipa, dɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Wobaa me nkyɛn sɛ worebɛma wɔakae me bɔne na wɔakum me ba!

english_verse: “Bring me your son,” Elijah said. Then he took the boy from her arms and carried him upstairs to the room where he was staying. Elijah laid the boy on his bed
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa wo ba no brɛ me! Na ogyee no fii ne kokom de no kɔɔ abansoro pia a ɔte mu no mu, na ɔde no kɔtoo ne mpa so.

english_verse: and prayed, “Lord God, why did you do such a terrible thing to this woman? She's letting me stay here, and now you've let her son die.”
translation_verse: Na ɔteɛɛm frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, ɔbea kunafo yi nso a mabɛsoɛ ne nkyɛn yi, wode mmusu reba no so sɛ worekum ne ba yi?

english_verse: Elijah stretched himself out over the boy three times, while praying, “Lord God, bring this boy back to life!”
translation_verse: Na ɔteɛɛ ne mu butuw abofra no so mprɛnsa, na ɔteɛɛm frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, ma abofra yi kra nsan mmra no mu.

english_verse: The Lord answered Elijah's prayer, and the boy started breathing again.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE tiee Elia nne, na abofra no kra san baa no mu, na onyaa nkwa.

english_verse: Elijah picked him up and carried him downstairs. He gave the boy to his mother and said, “Look, your son is alive.”
translation_verse: Na Elia faa abofra no de no sian fii abansoro pia mu baa ɔdan no mu, na ɔde no brɛɛ ne na, na Elia se: Hwɛ, wo ba no anya nkwa.

english_verse: “You are God's prophet!” the woman replied. “Now I know that you really do speak for the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbea no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Afei na mahu sɛ Onyankopɔn nipa ne wo, na AWURADE asɛm a ɛwɔ w'anom no yɛ nokware.

english_verse: At that time Obadiah was in charge of Ahab's palace, but he faithfully worshiped the Lord. In fact, when Jezebel was trying to kill the Lord's prophets, Obadiah hid
translation_verse: na Yesebel retwitwa AWURADE adiyifo agu no, Obadia faa AWURADE adiyifo ha, na ɔde wɔn aduonum aduonum kosiee ɔbodan mu, na ɔde aduan ne nsu hwɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: and said, “We have to find something for our horses and mules to eat. If we don't, we will have to kill them. Let's look around every creek and spring in the country for some grass.
translation_verse: Na Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Obadia sɛ: Kokyini asase no so, nsuaniwa nyinaa ne nsubon nyinaa ho; ebia yebenya wura de agye apɔnkɔ ne mfurumpɔnkɔ bi nkwa, na yɛanhwere mmoa no.

english_verse: You go one way, and I'll go the other.” Then they left in separate directions.
translation_verse: Na wɔkyɛɛ asase no mu fae sɛ wɔrekyini so, Ahab nko faa ɔkwan biako so, na Obadia nko nso faa ɔkwan biako so.

english_verse: As Obadiah was walking along, he met Elijah. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down, and asked, “Elijah, is it really you?”
translation_verse: Na Obadia wɔ ɔkwan no so no, hwɛ, Elia ne no behyiae, na ohuu no, na ɔde n’anim butuw fam kae sɛ: Me wura Elia ni?

english_verse: Obadiah replied: King Ahab would kill me if I told him that. And I haven't even done anything wrong.
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Bɔne bɛn na mayɛ, na wo de, woreyi w’akoa ahyɛ Ahab nsa na wakum me yi?

english_verse: I swear to you in the name of the living Lord your God that the king has looked everywhere for you. He sent people to look in every country, and when they couldn't find you, he made the leader of each country swear that you were not in that country.
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn te ase yi, ɔman ne ahenni biara nni hɔ a me wura nsoma nkɔɔ hɔ nkɔhwehwɛɛ wo ɛ. Na sɛ wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Onni hɔ, a, ɔma ahenni no ne ɔman no ka ntam sɛ wonhuu wo ɛ.

english_verse: Do you really want me to tell him you're here?
translation_verse: Na afei, wo ara wuse: Kɔka kyerɛ wo wura sɛ: Elia aba.

english_verse: What if the Lord's Spirit takes you away as soon as I leave? When Ahab comes to get you, he won't find you. Then he will surely kill me. I have worshiped the Lord since I was a boy.
translation_verse: Na sɛ me de, mifi wo nkyɛn mekɔ a, AWURADE honhom bɛma wo so akɔ baabi a minnim, na sɛ meka mekyerɛ Ahab na wanhu wo a, obekum me. Na me, w’akoa de, mifi me mmofraase misuro AWURADE.

english_verse: Elijah said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord All-Powerful, and I swear in his name that I will meet with Ahab today.”
translation_verse: Na Elia kae sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE a migyina n’anim te ase yi, ɛyɛ dɛn ara a, nnɛ mede me ho mɛkyerɛ no.

english_verse: Obadiah left and told Ahab where to find Elijah. Ahab went to meet Elijah,
translation_verse: Ɛnna Obadia kɔe kohyiaa Ahab, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no; na Ahab kɔe kohyiaa Elia.

english_verse: and when he saw him, Ahab shouted, “There you are, the biggest troublemaker in Israel!”
translation_verse: Na Ahab huu Elia no, Ahab ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: So wo a wohaw Israel no ni?

english_verse: Elijah answered: You're the troublemaker—not me! You and your family have disobeyed the Lord's commands by worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Na ose: Menhaw Israel ɛ, na mmom wo ne w’agya fi, sɛ moagyaw AWURADE mmara nsɛm, na woakodi Baalim akyi.

english_verse: Call together everyone from Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel. Be sure to bring along the
translation_verse: Na afei soma kɔboaboa Israel nyinaa ano brɛ me Karmel bepɔw so, ne Baal adiyifo ahanan aduonum no, ne Asera adiyifo ahanan a wodidi Yesebel pon so no.

english_verse: Ahab got everyone together, then they went to meet Elijah on Mount Carmel.
translation_verse: Na Ahab soma kɔɔ Israelfo nyinaa mu kɔboaboaa adiyifo no ano kɔɔ Karmel bepɔw so. Elia ne Baal asɔfo

english_verse: Elijah stood in front of them and said, “How much longer will you try to have things both ways? If the Lord is God, worship him! But if Baal is God, worship him!” The people did not say a word.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Elia twiw baa ɔman no nyinaa nkyɛn bɛkae sɛ: Da bɛn na mubehinhim nsɛm abien ntam akosi? Sɛ AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn a, munni n’akyi: Sɛ Baal nso a, munni n’akyi ɛ! Na ɔman no ammua no asɛm biara.

english_verse: Bring us two bulls. Baal's prophets can take one of them, kill it, and cut it into pieces. Then they can put the meat on the wood without lighting the fire. I will do the same thing with the other bull, and I won't light a fire under it either.
translation_verse: Na momma wɔmma yɛn anantwinini abien, na ma wonyi nantwinini no biako mfa, na wontwitwa no asinasin, na wɔmfa ngu nnyina so, na ogya de, wɔmmfa nngu ase. Na me nso, mesiesie nantwinini biako no, na mede magu nnyina so, na meremfa ogya mingu ase.

english_verse: The prophets of Baal will pray to their god, and I will pray to the Lord. The one who answers by starting the fire is God. “That's a good idea,” everyone agreed.
translation_verse: Na mommɔ mo nyame din, na me nso memmɔ AWURADE din, na onyame a ɔde ogya begye so no, ɔno ne Nyankopɔn. Na ɔman no nyinaa gyee so sɛ: Ɔsɛmpa!

english_verse: Elijah said to Baal's prophets, “There are more of you, so you go first. Pick out a bull and get it ready, but don't light the fire. Then pray to your god.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Elia ka kyerɛɛ Baal adiyifo no sɛ: Munyi nantwinini biako mfa, na munsiesie no kan; na mo de, modɔɔso; na mommɔ mo nyame din, na ogya na mommfa nngu ase.

english_verse: They chose their bull, then they got it ready and prayed to Baal all morning, asking him to start the fire. They danced around the altar and shouted, “Answer us, Baal!” But there was no answer.
translation_verse: Na wɔfaa nantwinini a wɔde maa wɔn no, na wosiesiei; na wɔbɔɔ Baal din fii anɔpa koduu owigyinae sɛ: Baal, gye yɛn so! Nso wɔante ɛnne bi, na obi nso annye so. Na wohuruhuruw twaa afɔremuka a wɔyɛe no ho hyiae.

english_verse: At noon, Elijah began making fun of them. “Pray louder!” he said. “Baal must be a god. Maybe he's daydreaming or using the toilet or traveling somewhere. Or maybe he's asleep, and you have to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Na owigyinae no Elia yii wɔn ahii, na ɔkae sɛ: Momma mo nne so mfrɛ na onyame ne no! Sesɛɛ ɔredwen, anaasɛ wafi adi kogya n’anan, anaasɛ ɔnam kwan; ebia wada, na wanyan.

english_verse: The prophets kept shouting louder and louder, and they cut themselves with swords and knives until they were bleeding. This was the way they worshiped,
translation_verse: Na wɔde nne kɛse teɛteɛɛm, na wɔde nkrante ne mpeaw bobɔɔ wɔn ho akam, sɛ wɔn amanne te no, kosii sɛ mogya guu wɔn so.

english_verse: and they kept it up until time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no answer of any kind.
translation_verse: Na owigyinae twaa mu no, wɔkɔmee koduu sɛ ɛrekɔ aduan afɔrebɔ bere; nso wɔante ɛnne bi, na obi nso annye so, na obi antie wɔn.

english_verse: Elijah told everyone to gather around him while he repaired the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Elia ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Muntwiw mmɛn me! Na ɔman no nyinaa twiw bɛn no. Na osiesiee AWURADE afɔremuka a abubu no.

english_verse: Then he used twelve stones to build an altar in honor of the Lord. Each stone stood for one of the tribes of Israel, which was the name the Lord had given to their ancestor Jacob. Elijah dug a ditch around the altar, large enough to hold about
translation_verse: Na ɔde abo no sii afɔremuka, AWURADE din mu, na otwaa ɔka a ebedi aba a wogu susuw ade abien, afɔremuka no ho hyiae.

english_verse: He placed the wood on the altar, then they cut the bull into pieces and laid the meat on the wood. He told the people, “Fill four large jars with water and pour it over the meat and the wood.” After they did this,
translation_verse: Na ɔhyehyɛɛ nnyina no, na otwitwaa nantwinini no asinasin de guu nnyina no so kae sɛ: Momfa nsu nhyehyɛ nhina anan amaama, na mummehwie ngu ɔhyew afɔre ne nnyina no so!

english_verse: he told them to do it two more times. They did exactly as he said
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Monyɛ bio! Na wɔyɛe bio. Na ɔkae sɛ: Momma ɛnyɛ mprɛnsa! Na wɔma ɛyɛɛ mprɛnsa.

english_verse: until finally, the water ran down the altar and filled the ditch.
translation_verse: Na nsu no fofaa afɔremuka no ho hyiae, na ɔka no nso, ɔhyɛɛ no nsu ma.

english_verse: When it was time for the evening sacrifice, Elijah prayed: Our Lord, you are the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel. Now, prove that you are the God of this nation, and that I, your servant, have done this at your command.
translation_verse: Na afɔrebɔ bere mu no, odiyifo Elia twiw bae, na ɔkae sɛ: AWURADE, Abraham ne Isak ne Israel Nyankopɔn, nnɛ ma wonhu sɛ wo na wone Nyankopɔn Israel mu na mene w’akoa, na w’asɛm so na mayɛ ade yi nyinaa.

english_verse: Please answer me, so these people will know that you are the Lord God, and that you will turn their hearts back to you.
translation_verse: Gye me so, AWURADE, gye me so, na ɔman yi nhu sɛ wo AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn, na wo nso woama wɔn koma asan akyiri aba.

english_verse: The Lord immediately sent fire, and it burned up the sacrifice, the wood, and the stones. It scorched the ground everywhere around the altar and dried up every drop of water in the ditch.
translation_verse: Ɛnna AWURADE gya duru bɛhyew ɔhyew afɔre no ne nnyina no ne abo ne dɔte no, na ɛyow nsu a ɛwɔ ɔka no mu no.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what had happened, they all bowed down and shouted, “The Lord is God! The Lord is God!”
translation_verse: Na ɔman no nyinaa hui no, wɔde wɔn anim butubutuw fam kae sɛ: AWURADE, ɔno ne Nyankopɔn! AWURADE, ɔno ne Nyankopɔn!

english_verse: Just then, Elijah said, “Grab the prophets of Baal! Don't let any of them get away.” So the people captured the prophets and took them to Kishon River, where Elijah killed every one of them. It Starts To Rain
translation_verse: Na Elia kae sɛ: Monkyere Baal adiyifo no, mommma wɔn mu biara mmfi mu! Na wɔkyekyeree wɔn na Elia de wɔn sian kɔɔ Kison asu ho, na okum wɔn wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Elijah told Ahab, “Get something to eat and drink. I hear a heavy rain coming.”
translation_verse: Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Foro kɔ kodidi na nom. Na mete osu kɛse nka.

english_verse: Ahab left, but Elijah climbed back to the top of Mount Carmel. Then he stooped down with his face almost to the ground
translation_verse: Na Ahab foro kɔe sɛ okodidi na wanom. Na Elia de, ɔforo kɔɔ Karmel atifi na ɔkotow fam, na ɔde n’anim hyɛɛ ne nkotodwe ntam.

english_verse: and said to his servant, “Look toward the sea.” The servant left. And when he came back, he said, “I looked, but I didn't see anything.” Elijah told him to look seven more times.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abofra sɛ: Foro kɔ kɔhwɛ po fam. Na ɔforo kɔhwɛe, na ɔbɛkae sɛ: Hwee nni hɔ. Na ose: San kɔ mpɛn asɔn.

english_verse: After the seventh time the servant replied, “I see a small cloud coming this way. But it's no bigger than a fist.” Elijah told him, “Tell Ahab to get his chariot ready and start home now. Otherwise, the rain will stop him.”
translation_verse: Na nea ɛto so ason no, ɔkae sɛ: Hwɛ, omununkum ketewa bi te sɛ onipa nsa resɔre afi po mu. Na ose: Foro kɔka kyerɛ Ahab sɛ: Siesie [wo nteaseɛnam] na sian kɔ, na osu ansiw wo kwan.

english_verse: Ahab told his wife Jezebel what Elijah had done and that he had killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Na Ahab bɛkaa nea Elia yɛe no nyinaa kyerɛɛ ne yere Yesebel, ne sɛnea ɔde nkrante akunkum Baal adiyifo no nyinaa.

english_verse: She sent a message to Elijah: “You killed my prophets. Now I'm going to kill you! I pray that the gods will punish me even more severely if I don't do it by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Na Yesebel somaa ɔbɔfo kɔɔ Elia nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛɛ na anyame nyɛ me, na sɛɛ nso na wɔmfa nka ho, sɛ ɔkyena sesɛɛ na mama wo kra ayɛ sɛ wɔn mu biako de.

english_verse: Elijah was afraid when he got her message, and he ran to the town of Beersheba in Judah. He left his servant there,
translation_verse: Na ohuu saa no, ne nkwa nti ɔsɔre kɔe na okoduu Beer-seba a ɛyɛ Yuda de no, na ogyaw n’abofra no wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: then walked another whole day into the desert. Finally, he came to a large bush and sat down in its shade. He begged the Lord, “I've had enough. Just let me die! I'm no better off than my ancestors.”
translation_verse: Na ɔno de, ɔnantew sare so da koro kwan na ɔkɔtenaa sisia bi ase, na ɔsrɛe sɛ ne kra nwu. Na ɔkae sɛ: Ɛdɔɔso, afei, AWURADE, fa me kra, na minnye mensen m’agyanom.

english_verse: Then he lay down in the shade and fell asleep. Suddenly an angel woke him up and said, “Get up and eat.”
translation_verse: Na ɔde ne ho too hɔ dae, sisia bi ase. Na hwɛ, ɔbɔfo bi bɛkaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɔre didi!

english_verse: Elijah looked around, and by his head was a jar of water and some baked bread. He sat up, ate and drank, then lay down and went back to sleep.
translation_verse: Na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔfam a wɔato no nnyansramma so ne nsu kuruwa si n’atifi; na odidii na ɔnomee, na ɔtɔɔ hɔ dae.

english_verse: So Elijah sat up and ate and drank. The food and water made him strong enough to walk
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔre didii na ɔnomee, na ɔde aduan no mu ahoɔden nantewee adaduanan, awia ne anadwo, koduu Onyankopɔn bepɔw Horeb ho. Onyankopɔn yi ne ho adi Horeb

english_verse: and he spent the night there in a cave. The Lord Appears to Elijah While Elijah was on Mount Sinai, the Lord asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Na oduu ɔbodan no ho hɔ, na ɔsoɛɛ. Na hwɛ, AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Elia, dɛn na wowɔ yɛ wɔ ha?

english_verse: He answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: Na ose: Ninkunu na matwe mama AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, sɛ Israelfo agyaw w’apam: W’afɔremuka no, wɔadwiridwiriw, na w’adiyifo nso, wɔde nkrante akunkum wɔn; na me nko na maka, na wɔrehwehwɛ me akum me.

english_verse: “Go out and stand on the mountain,” the Lord replied. “I want you to be there when I pass by.” All at once, a strong wind shook the mountain and shattered the rocks. But the Lord was not in the wind. Next, there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Fi adi kogyina bepɔw no so AWURADE anim. Na hwɛ, AWURADE twaam, na mframa kɛse a ɛyɛ den paepaee mmepɔw na ebubuu abotan dii AWURADE anim; na ɛnyɛ mframa no mu na AWURADE wɔ; na mframa no akyi no asasewosow; na ɛnyɛ asasewosow no mu na AWURADE wɔ;

english_verse: Then there was a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. Finally, there was a gentle breeze,
translation_verse: na asasewosow no akyi no ogya; na ɛnyɛ ogya no mu na AWURADE wɔ; na ogya no akyi no na mframa a ɛbɔ brɛoo bi nne di.

english_verse: and when Elijah heard it, he covered his face with his coat. He went out and stood at the entrance to the cave. A voice asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Na Elia tee no, ɔde ne nguguso kataa n’ani, na ofi kogyinaa ɔbodan no ano. Na hwɛ, ɛnne bi baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Elia, dɛn na wowɔ yɛ wɔ ha?

english_verse: Elijah answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: Na ose: Ninkunu na matwe mama AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, sɛ Israelfo agyaw w’apam: W’afɔremuka no, wɔadwiridwiriw, na w’adiyifo nso, wɔde nkrante akunkum wɔn; na me nko na maka, na wɔrehwehwɛ me akum me.

english_verse: The Lord said: Elijah, you can go back to the desert near Damascus. And when you get there, appoint Hazael to be king of Syria.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ, san si wo kwan so kɔ Damasko sare so; na sɛ wudu a, sra Hasael ngo si no Siria so hene;

english_verse: Then appoint Jehu son of Nimshi to be king of Israel, and Elisha son of Shaphat to take your place as my prophet.
translation_verse: na Nimsi ba Yehu nso, sra no si Israel so hene; na Safat ba Elisa a ofi Abel-mehola no de, sra no si w’ananmu diyifo.

english_verse: Hazael will start killing the people who worship Baal. Jehu will kill those who escape from Hazael, and Elisha will kill those who escape from Jehu.
translation_verse: Na nea obefi Hasael nkrante ano no, Yehu bekum no, na nea obefi Yehu nkrante ano no, Elisa bekum no.

english_verse: Elijah left and found Elisha plowing a field with a pair of oxen. There were eleven other men in front of him, and each one was also plowing with a pair of oxen. Elijah went over and put his own coat on Elisha.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ofii hɔ kɔe. Na okohuu Safat ba Elisa sɛ ɔrefɛtɛw; anantwi mpamho dumien na edi n’anim, na ɔno ne nea ɛto so dumien na ɛrefuntum; na Elia sen baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtow ne nguguso guu no so.

english_verse: Elisha stopped plowing and ran after him. “Let me kiss my parents goodbye, then I'll go with you,” he said. “You can go,” Elijah said. “But remember what I've done for you.”
translation_verse: Na ogyaw anantwi no, na otuu mmirika dii Elia akyi kae sɛ: Ma menkɔkra m’agya ne me na, na mimmedi w’akyi! Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: San kɔ bio, na dɛn na mayɛ wo yi?

english_verse: Elisha left and took his oxen with him. He killed them and boiled them over a fire he had made with the wood from his plow. He gave the meat to the people who were with him, and they ate it. Then he left with Elijah and became his assistant.
translation_verse: Na ɔsan fii n’akyi kɔfaa anantwi mpamho no kunkum wɔn, na ɔde anantwi no adwumayɛ nnua no noaa nam no, na ɔde maa nkurɔfo no, na wodii; na ɔsɔre dii Elia akyi, na ɔsom no.

english_verse: They dressed in sackcloth and put ropes on their heads, then they went to Ahab and said, “Your servant Benhadad asks you to let him live.” “Is he still alive?” Ahab asked. “Benhadad is like a brother to me.”
translation_verse: Na wɔde ayitama kyekyeree wɔn asen, na wɔde ntampehama bobɔɔ wɔn ti, na wɔbaa Israel hene nkyɛn sɛ: W’akoa Ben-hadad se: Ma me kra nnya nkwa ɛ! Na ose: So ɔda so te ase? Ɔyɛ me nua.

english_verse: Benhadad sent a messenger to tell King Ahab of Israel,
translation_verse: Na ɔsomaa abɔfo baa Israel hene Ahab nkyɛn kurow no mu bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ Ben-hadad se ni:

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” Ahab replied, “everything I have is yours, including me.”
translation_verse: Na Israel hene buae sɛ: W’asɛm no wom, me wura ɔhene, wo na me ne nea mewɔ nyinaa wɔ wo.

english_verse: Later, Benhadad sent another messenger to say to Ahab, “I already told you to give me your silver and gold, your wives, and your children.
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔfo no san bae bio bɛkae sɛ: Sɛ Ben-hadad se ni: Sɛ masoma aba wo nkyɛn sɛ: Wo dwetɛ ne wo sika ne wo yerenom ne wo mma, fa ma me no,

english_verse: But tomorrow at this time, I will send my officials into your city to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will take everything else that you own.”
translation_verse: sɛ ɔkyena sesɛbere mesoma me nkoa ba wo nkyɛn a, wobekyini wo fi ne wo nkoa afi, na ade biara a ɛyɛ w’ani so fɛ no, wɔbɛfa akura wɔn nsam de akɔ.

english_verse: “Don't listen to him!” they answered. “You don't have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Na mpanyimfo no nyinaa ne ɔman no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ntie, na mpene nso.

english_verse: So Ahab sent someone to tell Benhadad, “Your Majesty, I'll give you my silver and gold, and even my wives and children. But I won't let you have anything else.” When Benhadad got his answer,
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Ben-hadad abɔfo no sɛ: Monkɔka nkyerɛ me wura ɔhene sɛ: Nea wubisaa w’akoa kan no nyinaa de, mɛyɛ, na asɛm yi de, mintumi menyɛ. Na abɔfo no kɔe kobuaa no asɛm no.

english_verse: he replied, “I'll completely destroy Samaria! There won't even be enough of it left for my soldiers to carry back in their hands. If I don't do it, I pray that the gods will punish me terribly.”
translation_verse: Na Ben-hadad soma baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛ Samaria mfutuma so dɔm a wodi m’anammɔn akyi yi nyinaa bɛyɛ obiara nsama a, sɛɛ na anyame nyɛ me, na sɛɛ nso na wɔmfa nka ho!

english_verse: Ahab then answered, “Benhadad, don't brag before the fighting even begins. Wait and see if you live through it.”
translation_verse: Na Israel hene buae sɛ: Monkɔka sɛ: Mma nea ɔhyɛ akode nnhoahoa ne ho sɛ nea oyi yɛ yi.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad and the other kings had been drinking in their tents. But when Ahab's reply came, he ordered his soldiers to prepare to attack Samaria, and they all got ready.
translation_verse: Na ɔtee asɛm yi no, na ɔne ahene no renom nsa asese mu, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Mommae mu! Na wɔbaee mu hyɛɛ kurow no.

english_verse: At that very moment, a prophet ran up to Ahab and said, “You can see that Benhadad's army is very strong. But the Lord has promised to help you defeat them today. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Na hwɛ, odiyifo bi twiw bɛn Israel hene Ahab sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: So woahu asafokuw kɛse yi nyinaa? Hwɛ, mede wɔn merehyɛ wo nsa nnɛ, na woahu sɛ mene AWURADE.

english_verse: “Who will fight the battle?” Ahab asked. The prophet answered, “The young bodyguards who serve the district officials.” “But who will lead them into battle?” Ahab asked. “You will!” the prophet replied.
translation_verse: Na Ahab kae sɛ: Ɛnam hena so? Na ose: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Ɛnam amankuw no mmapɔmma mmerante no so. Ɛnna ɔkae sɛ: Hena na ɔmfa nkɔbɔ ani? Na ose: Wo!

english_verse: At noon, King Ahab and his Israelite army marched out of Samaria, with the young soldiers in front. King Benhadad of Syria and the
translation_verse: Na amankuw mmapɔmma no mmerante no fii adi kan. Na Ben-hadad somae, na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mmarima afi adi afi Samaria reba.

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Benhadad ordered. “I don't care if they have come out to fight or to surrender.”
translation_verse: Na ose: Sɛ ɔmannwoe so na wofii adi a, monkyekyere wɔn animono, na sɛ ɔko so nso na wofii adi a, monkyekyere wɔn animono.

english_verse: and each of them attacked and killed an enemy soldier. The rest of the Syrian army turned and ran, and the Israelites went after them. Benhadad and some others escaped on horses,
translation_verse: Na wokunkum wɔn mmiako mmiako, na Siriafo no guanguanee, na Israel tiw wɔn, na Siria hene Ben-hadad tenaa ɔpɔnkɔ so ne apɔnkɔsotefo fi guanee.

english_verse: but Ahab and his soldiers followed them and captured their horses and chariots. Ahab and Israel's army crushed the Syrians.
translation_verse: Na Israel hene fii adi kunkum apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam no, na ɔde okunkɛse kum Siriafo.

english_verse: Later, the prophet went back and warned Ahab, “Benhadad will attack you again next spring. Build up your troops and make sure you have some good plans.” Syria Attacks Israel Again
translation_verse: Na odiyifo no twiw bɛn Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ na kɔhyɛ wo ho den, na hwɛ na hu nea wobɛyɛ; na afedan no Siriafo bɛforo aba wo so.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad's officials went to him and explained: Israel's gods are mountain gods. We fought Israel's army in the hills, and that's why they defeated us. But if we fight them on flat land, there's no way we can lose.
translation_verse: Na Siria hene nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wɔn nyame yɛ mmepɔw nyame, enti na wɔn ho yɛ den sen yɛn no; na sɛ yɛne wɔn kɔko asasetaw so de a, so anka yɛn ho renyɛ den nsen wɔn anaa?

english_verse: Here's what you should do. First, get rid of those
translation_verse: Na eyi na yɛ: Tutu ahene no fi wɔn tenabea, na fa amradofo sisi wɔn ananmu.

english_verse: Then get more soldiers, horses, and chariots, so your army will be as strong as it was before. We'll fight Israel's army on flat land and wipe them out. Benhadad agreed and did what they suggested.
translation_verse: Na wo de, kan dɔm bi fa, sɛ dɔm a woahwere no, ne apɔnkɔ sɛ apɔnkɔ no, ne nteaseɛnam sɛ nteaseɛnam no, na yɛne wɔn nkɔko asasetaw so, sɛ yɛn ho renyɛ den nsen wɔn anaa? Na otiee wɔn, na ɔyɛɛ saa.

english_verse: In the spring, Benhadad got his army together, and they marched to the town of Aphek to attack Israel.
translation_verse: Na ɔpɛ bere mfiase no, Ben-hadad kenkan Siriafo dɔm na ɔforo baa Afek sɛ ɔne Israel rebɛko.

english_verse: The prophet went to Ahab and said, “The Syrians think the Lord is a god of the hills and not of the valleys. So he has promised to help you defeat their powerful army. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn nipa no twiw bae bɛka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: Sɛnea AWURADE se ni: Esiane sɛ Siriafo aka sɛ: Mmepɔw nyame ne AWURADE, na ɔnyɛ abon mu nyame nti, mede asafokuw kɛse yi nyinaa mɛhyɛ wo nsa, na moahu sɛ mene AWURADE.

english_verse: For seven days the two armies stayed in their camps, facing each other. Then on the seventh day the fighting broke out, and before sunset the Israelites had killed
translation_verse: Na wɔbobɔɔ nsra, eyinom wɔ eyinom ntentenso. Na da a ɛto so ason no, wɔde dɔm no kɔbɔɔ anim, na Israelfo no kum Siriafo anammɔnmufo ɔpeha da koro.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we've heard that Israel's kings keep their agreements. We will wrap sackcloth around our waists, put ropes around our heads, and ask Ahab to let you live.”
translation_verse: Na ne nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛate sɛ Israel fi ahene yɛ ahene a wɔyɛ adɔe. Ma yɛmfa ayitama nkyekyere yɛn asen, na yɛmfa ntampehama mmobɔ yɛn ti, na yemfi nkɔ Israel hene nkyɛn; ebia obegye wo kra nkwa.

english_verse: Benhadad's officials were trying to figure out what Ahab was thinking, and when he said “brother,” they quickly replied, “You're right! You and Benhadad are like brothers.” “Go get him,” Ahab said. When Benhadad came out, Ahab had him climb up into his chariot.
translation_verse: Na mmarima no rehwehwɛ nsɛkyerɛnne, na wɔyɛɛ ntɛm gyee asɛm no, na wɔkae sɛ: Wo nuabarima ne Ben-hadad. Na ose: Monkɔfa no mmra! Na Ben-hadad fi baa ne nkyɛn; na ɔma ɔforo baa teaseɛnam no mu.

english_verse: Benhadad said, “I'll give back the towns my father took from your father. And you can have shops in Damascus, just as my father had in Samaria.” Ahab replied, “If you do these things, I'll let you go free.” Then they signed a peace treaty, and Ahab let Benhadad go. A Prophet Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Na Ben-hadad ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nkurow a m’agya gyee w’agya nsam no, mɛdan mama, na tew mmorɔn nso Damasko fa, sɛnea m’agya tewee Samaria no. Na Ahab kae sɛ: Me nso, mede apam megya wo kwan. Ɛnna ɔne no pamee, na ogyaa no kwan.

english_verse: About this time the Lord commanded a prophet to say to a friend, “Hit me!” But the friend refused,
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔbarima bi a ofi adiyifo mma mu de AWURADE asɛm ka kyerɛɛ ne yɔnko sɛ: Bɔ me ɛ! Na ɔbarima no ampene sɛ ɔbɔ no.

english_verse: and the prophet told him, “You disobeyed the Lord, and as soon as you walk away, a lion will kill you.” The friend left, and suddenly a lion killed him.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Esiane sɛ woantie AWURADE nti, hwɛ, wufi me nkyɛn ha rekɔ ara pɛ a, gyata bekum wo. Na ofii ne nkyɛn kɔe no, gyata huu no, na okum no.

english_verse: The prophet found someone else and said, “Hit me!” So this man beat him up.
translation_verse: Na ohuu ɔbarima foforo, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Bɔ me ɛ! Na ɔbarima no bɔɔ no.

english_verse: The prophet left and put a bandage over his face to disguise himself. Then he went and stood beside the road, waiting for Ahab to pass by.
translation_verse: Ɛnna odiyifo no kɔe kogyinaa ɔkwan no ho twɛn ɔhene, na ɔde n’ani akyi abotiri sakraa ne ho.

english_verse: When Ahab went by, the prophet shouted, “Your Majesty, right in the heat of battle, someone brought a prisoner to me and told me to guard him. He said if the prisoner got away, I would either be killed or forced to pay
translation_verse: Na ɔhene retwam no, ɔbɔn ɔhene no sɛ: W’akoa fi kɔɔ dɔm no mu, na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi manee de ɔbarima bi brɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ ɔbarima yi so, na sɛ ɔyera a, ɛnne wode wo kra besi ne kra ananmu, anaasɛ wobɛkari dwetɛ talente biako.

english_verse: But I got busy doing other things, and the prisoner escaped.” Ahab answered, “You will be punished just as you have said.”
translation_verse: Na w’akoa ani abere reyɛ ade bi no, oguanee. Ɛnna Israel hene kae sɛ: Sɛ w’atemmu te ne no, wo ara woabu.

english_verse: The man quickly tore the bandage off his face, and Ahab saw that he was one of the prophets.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔyɛɛ ntɛm yii abotiri no fii n’ani akyi, na Israel hene no huu no sɛ ofi adiyifo no mu.

english_verse: The prophet said, “The Lord told you to kill Benhadad, but you let him go. Now you will die in his place, and your people will die in place of his people.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Esiane sɛ woama onipa a mahyira no so afi wo nsa akɔ nti, wo kra besi ne kra ananmu, na wo man asi ne man ananmu.

english_verse: Naboth owned a vineyard in Jezreel near King Ahab's palace.
translation_verse: Na nsɛm yi akyi no, na Yesreelni Nabot wɔ bobeturo bi Yesreel a ɛwɔ Samaria hene Ahab ahemfi ho.

english_verse: One day, Ahab said, “Naboth, your vineyard is near my palace. Give it to me so I can turn it into a vegetable garden. I'll give you a better vineyard or pay whatever you want for yours.”
translation_verse: Na Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Nabot sɛ: Fa wo bobeturo no ma me, na memfa menyɛ fan turo, efisɛ ɛbɛn me fi ho, na mɛma wo bobeturo a eye sen no mahyɛ ananmu, anaasɛ wopɛ a, mɛma wo ɛso sika.

english_verse: Naboth answered, “This vineyard has always been in my family. I won't let you have it.”
translation_verse: Na Nabot ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: AWURADE mma eyi mpare me, sɛ mede m’agyanom awunnyade mɛma wo.

english_verse: So Ahab went home, angry and depressed because of what Naboth had told him. He lay on his bed, just staring at the wall and refusing to eat a thing.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Ahab kɔɔ ne fi, a na wakum n’anim na odi yaw, Yesreelni Nabot asɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ no no nti, sɛ osee no sɛ: Meremfa m’agyanom awunnyade memma wo. Na ɔdaa ne mpa so dan n’ani, na wannidi.

english_verse: Jezebel his wife came in and asked, “What's wrong? Why won't you eat?”
translation_verse: Na ne yere Yesebel baa ne nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdɛn na wo honhom abotow sɛɛ na wunnidi yi?

english_verse: “I asked Naboth to sell me his vineyard or to let me give him a better one,” Ahab replied. “And he told me I couldn't have it.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Efisɛ me ne Yesreelni Nabot kasae, na misee no sɛ: Fa wo bobeturo no ma me gye sika, anaasɛ nso sɛ wopɛ a, mɛma wo bobeturo mahyɛ ananmu. Na ose: Meremfa me bobeturo no memma wo.

english_verse: “Aren't you the king of Israel?” Jezebel asked. “Get out of bed and eat something! Don't worry, I'll get Naboth's vineyard for you.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna ne yere Yesebel ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ wo na wudi Israel so hene? Sɔre didi, na ma wo bo ntɔ wo yam na mede Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo no mɛma wo.

english_verse: The two liars came in and sat across from Naboth. Then they accused him of cursing God and the king, so the people dragged Naboth outside and stoned him to death.
translation_verse: Na mmarima mmahuhufo baanu bae bɛtenaa n’anim, na mmarima ahuhufo no dii Nabot adanse ɔman no anim sɛ: Nabot adome Onyankopɔn ne ɔhene. Na woyii no fii kurow no akyi kosiw no abo ma owui.

english_verse: The leaders of Jezreel sent a message back to Jezebel that said, “Naboth is dead.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna wɔsoma kɔɔ Yesebel nkyɛn sɛ: Wɔasiw Nabot abo, na wawu.

english_verse: As soon as Jezebel got their message, she told Ahab, “Now you can have the vineyard Naboth refused to sell. He's dead.”
translation_verse: Na Yesebel tee sɛ wɔasiw Nabot abo na wawu no, Ɔka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Sɔre kɔfa Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo a ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔde ma wo gye sika no di so, efisɛ Nabot nte ase bio, na wawu.

english_verse: Ahab got up and went to take over the vineyard. Elijah Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Na Ahab tee sɛ Nabot awu no, Ahab sɔree sɛ ɔresian akɔ Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo no mu akɔfa adi so. Elia hyɛ asotwe ho nkɔm

english_verse: The Lord said to Elijah the prophet,
translation_verse: Ɛnna AWURADE asɛm baa Tisbini Elia nkyɛn sɛ:

english_verse: “King Ahab of Israel is in Naboth's vineyard right now, taking it over.
translation_verse: Sɔre sian kohyia Israel hene Ahab a ɔwɔ Samaria no. Hwɛ, ɔwɔ Nabot bobeturo a wasian akɔ hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔfa adi so no mu;

english_verse: Go tell him that I say, ‘Ahab, you murdered Naboth and took his property. And so, in the very spot where dogs licked up Naboth's blood, they will lick up your blood.’ ” When Elijah found him,
translation_verse: na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Woadi awu, na woafa obi ade adi so? Na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Faako a akraman taforoo Nabot mogya no, ɛhɔ na akraman bɛtaforo wo nso wo mogya.

english_verse: Ahab said, “So, my enemy, you found me at last.” Elijah answered: Yes, I did! Ahab, you have managed to do everything the Lord hates.
translation_verse: Na Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: So woahu me, me tamfo? Na ose: Mahu wo, efisɛ woatɔn wo ho ayɛ nea ɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne.

english_verse: Now you will be punished. You and every man and boy in your family will die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: Mɛpra wo akɔ, na matwa Ahab babarima biara afi Israel mu, akoa anaa ɔdehye.

english_verse: Your whole family will be wiped out, just like the families of King Jeroboam and King Baasha. You've made the Lord very angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na mɛyɛ wo fi sɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam fi ne Ahigya ba Baasa fi, ohuru a woahuru me bo na woama Israel ayɛ bɔne ntia.

english_verse: And as for Jezebel, dogs will eat her body there in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Na Yesebel nso, AWURADE kaa ne ho asɛm sɛ: Akraman bedi Yesebel nam, Yesreelni fasu ho.

english_verse: Dogs will also eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: Ahabni a obewu kurow mu no, akraman na ebedi ne nam, na nea obewu wuram no, wim nnomaa na ebedi ne nam.

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: na kɔka sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene se ni: Momfa oyi nto nneduadan mu, na momma no ahohia aduan nni ne ahohia nsu nnom nkosi sɛ mɛba no dwoodwoo.

english_verse: Ahab asked his officials, “Why haven't we tried to get Ramoth in Gilead back from the Syrians? It belongs to us.”
translation_verse: Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: So munnim sɛ Ramot-gilead wɔ yɛn, na yɛn de, yɛte hɔ komm na yennye mfi Siria hene nsam?

english_verse: Then he asked Jehoshaphat, “Would you go to Ramoth with me and attack the Syrians?” “Just tell me what to do,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army and horses are at your command.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Wo ne me bɛkɔ Ramot-gilead sa anaa? Na Yehosafat ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene no sɛ: Mete sɛ wo, me man te sɛ wo man, m’apɔnkɔ te sɛ w’apɔnkɔ.

english_verse: But first, let's ask the Lord.”
translation_verse: Yehosafat ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: Bisa AWURADE asɛm nnɛ ɛ!

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Yehosafat kae sɛ: So AWURADE diyifo bi nni ha bio a yebebisa no hɔ ade?

english_verse: “We could ask Micaiah son of Imlah,” Ahab said. “But I hate Micaiah. He always has bad news for me.” “Don't say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
translation_verse: Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Ɔbarima biako bi da so wɔ hɔ a anka yebetumi abisa AWURADE afi ne nkyɛn, nanso metan no, efisɛ ɔnhyɛ me ho nkɔm pa, sɛ bɔne nko, ɛyɛ Imla ba Mikaia. Na Yehosafat se: Mma ɔhene nnka sa.

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Israel hene frɛɛ ogyaaseni bi, na ɔkae sɛ: Ma Imla ba Mikaia nnu ha ntɛm!

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria. They were listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Na Israel hene ne Yuda hene Yehosafat tete wɔn nhengua so hyehyɛ wɔn ntade, Samaria pon ano mprae so, na adiyifo no nyinaa hyehyɛɛ nkɔm wɔn anim.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Na Kenaana ba Sedekia ayɛ dade mmɛn, na ɔkae sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Eyinom na wode besum Siriafo de akosi sɛ wobewie wɔn sɛe.

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth, and they promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Na adiyifo no nyinaa hyehyɛɛ nkɔm saa sɛ: Kɔ Ramot-gilead na kodi siade, na AWURADE de ahyɛ ɔhene nsa.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔfo a ɔkɔfrɛɛ Mikaia no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, adiyifo no nyinaa de nokoro ka asɛmpa kyerɛ ɔhene, ma wo nsɛm nyɛ sɛ wɔn mu biako de, na ka nea eye!

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Na Mikaia kae sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE te ase yi, nea AWURADE bɛka akyerɛ me no, ɛno na mɛka. Mikaia hyɛ nkogu ho nkɔm

english_verse: Then Micaiah went to Ahab, and Ahab asked, “Micaiah, should I attack the Syrians at Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn. Na ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mikaia, so yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko anaasɛ yennyae? Na obuaa no sɛ: Kɔ na kodi nim, na AWURADE de ahyɛ ɔhene nsa.

english_verse: “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth!” Ahab shouted. “What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Na ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mpɛn ahe ara na menka wo ntam sɛ, nka me asɛm bi sɛ nokware nko AWURADE din mu?
