translation_verse: Monhwehwɛ mo wura mma no mu nea oye ne nea ɔteɛ, na momfa no ntena n’agya agua so, na monko mma mo wura fi.

english_verse: The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, “Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Na wosuroe pa ara kae sɛ: Hwɛ, ahene baanu no annyina n’anim, na yɛn de, yebegyina dɛn?

english_verse: The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
translation_verse: Na nea odi ofi no so ne nea odi kurow no so no, mpanyimfo ne mma gyigyefo no soma kɔɔ Yehu nkyɛn sɛ: Wo nkoa ne yɛn, na nea wobɛka akyerɛ yɛn nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ; yɛrensi ɔhene biara; yɛ nea wopɛ.

english_verse: Jehu then wrote another letter which said, “If you are on my side and will obey me, then prove it. Bring me the heads of the descendants of Ahab! And be here in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” The
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔkyerɛw wɔn nhoma a ɛto so abien sɛ: Sɛ mowɔ m’afa na mobetie me a, momfa nnipa no, mo wura mma no, ti mmra me nkyɛn ɔkyena sesɛɛ Yesreel. Nso ɔhene mma no si mmarima aduɔsn; kurow no mu nnipa akɛse no nkyɛn na wɔyɛn wɔn.

english_verse: When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, “Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔfo no ba bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wɔde ɔhene mma no ti no aba. Na ose: Monhɔre no akuw abien ɔpon no ano nkosi anɔpa.

english_verse: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, “You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men?
translation_verse: Na anɔpa no, ofii adi kogyinaa hɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Mudi bem, hwɛ, me na mepam me wura ti so na mikum no; na hena na okunkum eyinom nyinaa?

english_verse: Listen to me. Everything the Lord's servant Elijah promised about Ahab's family will come true.”
translation_verse: Munhu afei, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔkae Ahab fi ho no mu biara bɛba mu, na AWURADE ayɛ nea ɔnam n’akoa Elia so kae no.

english_verse: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Na Yehu kum Ahab fi nnipa a wɔkae nyinaa Yesreel, ne ne nnipa akɛse ne n’amannifo ne n’asɔfo nyinaa kosii sɛ wannyaw no obiara amma wamfi mu.

english_verse: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”
translation_verse: Yehu hyiaa Yuda hene Ahasia ne nuanom, na ɔkae sɛ: Henanom ne mo? Na wose: Ahasia ne nuanom ne yɛn, na yɛresan akɔ akɔhwɛ ɔhene mma ne ɔhemmea mma no sɛ wɔn ho te dɛn.

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all
translation_verse: Na ɔkaa sɛ: Monkyere wɔn anikan! Na wɔkyekyeree wɔn anikan, na wokunkum wɔn nguansesa dan no ho amoa no ho, nnipa aduanan abien, na wannyaw wɔn mu biara.

english_verse: As Jehu went on, he saw Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him, then said, “Jehonadab, I'm on your side. Are you on mine?” “Yes, I am.” “Then give me your hand,” Jehu answered. He helped Jehonadab into his chariot
translation_verse: Na ofi hɔ rekɔ no, ohuu Rekab ba Yehonadab sɛ ɔreba abehyia no; na okyiaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: So wodɔ me sɛ medɔ wo yi? Na Yehonadab se: Ɛte sa! Na Yehu se: Sɛ ɛte saa a, so me nsam ɛ! Na osoo mu; na ɔma ɔforo kɔɔ ne nkyɛn teaseɛnam no mu.

english_verse: and said, “Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord.” They rode together in Jehu's chariot
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Wo ne me nkɔ, na kɔhwɛ me ninkunu a metwe mema AWURADE. Na ɔma ɔtenaa ne teaseɛnam no mu.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Na oduu Samaria no, okum nnipa a wɔka maa Ahab, Samaria no nyinaa kosii sɛ ɔsɛee wɔn, sɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Elia no. Yehu sɛe Baal

english_verse: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.
translation_verse: Na Yehu boaboaa ɔman no nyinaa ano hyiae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ahab som Baal kakraa bi, Yehu de, ɔbɛsom no bebree.

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: Na afei, Baal adiyifo nyinaa, ne n’asomfo nyinaa ne n’asɔfo nyinaa, momfrɛ wɔn mmra me nkyɛn, mommma obiara nnka, na mewɔ afɔre kɛse mebɔ mema Baal; obiara a ɔbɛka no rennya nkwa. Na Yehu yɛɛ no anitew mu, sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe Baal asomfo.

english_verse: He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced,
translation_verse: Na Yehu kae sɛ: Mompae nhyia kronkron mma Baal. Na wɔpaee.

english_verse: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.
translation_verse: Na Yehu soma kokyinii Israel nyinaa, na Baal nkoa nyinaa bae, anka obiara. Na wɔbaa Baal fi, na Baal fi yɛɛ ma fi ano kɔpem ano.

english_verse: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ nea ɔhwɛ ntade dan so no sɛ: Yiyi ntade brɛ Baal nkoa no nyinaa. Na okoyii ntade no de brɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Yehu ne Rekab ba Yehonadab kɔɔ Baal fi, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Baal nkoa no sɛ: Mompɛɛpɛe mu nhu na AWURADE nkoa mu bi ammɛka mo ho ha sɛ Baal nkoa nko.

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Na owiee ɔhyew afɔre no bɔ no, Yehu ka kyerɛɛ awɛmfo ne akunini no sɛ: Monkɔ nkokunkum wɔn, mommma obiara mmfi. Na ammirikatufo ne akunini no de nkrante kunkum wɔn totow wɔn gui.

english_verse: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it
translation_verse: Na wɔkɔɔ Baal fi ban no mu, na woyii Baal fi adum abien no, na wɔhyewee;

english_verse: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
translation_verse: na woburuw Baal dum no gui, na woburuw Baal fi no gui, na wɔde yɛɛ tiafi de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
translation_verse: Nanso Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne akyi de, Yehu amfi, ɛne sika nantwi mma a ɛwɔ Betel ne Dan no.

english_verse: Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yehu sɛ: Esiane sɛ woayɛ yiye, sɛ woayɛ nea ɛteɛ m’ani so, na woayɛ Ahab fi sɛnea ɛwɔ me koma mu nyinaa nti: Wo mma a wɔbɛto so anan no bɛtena Israel agua so.

english_verse: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do. Jehu Dies
translation_verse: Nanso Yehu anhwɛ amfa ne koma nyinaa anni AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn mmara so: Wamfi Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho.

english_verse: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control
translation_verse: Nna no mu na AWURADE fii ase twitwaa Israel so, na Hasael kunkum wɔn Israel ahye nyinaa so,

english_verse: of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.
translation_verse: efi Yordan owiapuei, Gilead asase nyinaa, Gadfo ne Rubenfo ne Manasefo de, fi Aroer a ɛwɔ Arnon subon ano, ne Gilead ne Basan.

english_verse: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Yehu ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa ne ne mmaninne nyinaa, so wɔankyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king.
translation_verse: Na Yehu wui, na wosiee no Samaria; na ne ba Yehoahas bedii n’ade.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo no de ɔhene Dawid mpeaw ne akyɛm a ɛwɔ AWURADE fi no momaa asafohene no.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Na oyii ɔhene ba no fii adi, na ɔde ahemmotiri no bɔɔ ne ti, na ɔde adanse no hyɛɛ ne nsa, na wosii no hene, na wɔsraa no, na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn nsam sɛ: Ɔhene tiri nkwa!

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah. Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah (
translation_verse: Na ɔne no hintaw AWURADE fi mfe asia. Na Atalia dii asase no so hemmaa.

english_verse: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_verse: Yoas bedii hene no, na wadi mfirihyia ason.

english_verse: Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. They met him at the temple, and he asked them to make a promise in the name of the Lord. Then he brought out Joash
translation_verse: Na afe a ɛto so ason mu no, Yehoiada soma kɔfaa Karifo ne ammirikatufo no ɔha ha so asafohene baa ne nkyɛn AWURADE fi, na ɔne wɔn pamee, na ɔma wɔkekaa ntam AWURADE fi, na ɔde ɔhene ba no kyerɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ade a monyɛ ni: Mo mu nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu biako mmra mo dibea homeda, na mommɛwɛn ɔhene fi,

english_verse: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
translation_verse: na nkyɛmu biako ntena Sur pon ano, na nkyɛmu biako nso ntena ammirikatufo akyi pon no ano; na monwɛn ofi no mmɔ ho ban.

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Na mo mu asafokuw abien, wɔn a wofi wɔn dibea so homeda no nyinaa nwɛn AWURADE fi no, ɔhene ho.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Na muntwa ɔhene no ho nhyia, munkurakura mo akode; na nea ɔbɛba nkyerɛpɛn no mu no, wonkum no; na montena ɔhene ho, n’adifi ne ne muba mu.

english_verse: The commanders followed Jehoiada's orders. Each one called together his guards—those coming on duty and those going off duty.
translation_verse: Na asafohene no yɛe sɛnea ɔsɔfo Yehoiada hyɛe no nyinaa, na wɔfofaa wɔn nnipa a wɔbaa wɔn dibea so homeda ne wɔn a wofii mu homeda no, na wɔbaa ɔsɔfo Yehoiada nkyɛn.

english_verse: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
translation_verse: Na awenfo no gyinagyina hɔ kurakura wɔn akode, efi ɔdan no nifa twea so kosi ɔdan no benkum twea so, afɔremuka no ho ne ɔdan no ho, atwa ɔhene no ho ahyia.

english_verse: Queen Athaliah heard the crowd and went to the temple.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Atalia tee awɛmfo ne ɔman no gyegyeegye no, ɔbaa nkurɔfo no nkyɛn AWURADE fi;

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. The singers and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the people were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: na obehui, na hwɛ, ɔhene no gyina sumpii no so sɛnea amanne no te, na asafohene no ne ntorobɛntohyɛnfo wɔ ɔhene no nkyɛn, na asase no so nkurɔfo no nyinaa ani agye, na wɔhyenhyɛn ntorobɛnto. Ɛnna Atalia sunsuanee ne ntade mu, na ɔteɛɛm sɛ: Atirisopam, atirisopam?

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her!”
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Yehoiada hyɛɛ ɔha ha so asafohene a wɔhwɛ dɔm no so no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Munyi no mfa nkyerɛpɛn no mu mfi, na nea obedi n’akyi no, momfa nkrante nkum no. Na ɔsɔfo no kae sɛ: Wonnkum no AWURADE fi.

english_verse: So the commanders dragged her to the gate where horses are led into the palace, and they killed her there.
translation_verse: Enti wosoo no mu de no kɔfaa ɔkwan a apɔnkɔ nam so ba ahemfi no so, na wokum no hɔ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Yehoiada de apam too AWURADE ne ɔhene ne ɔman no ntam, sɛ wɔnnyɛ AWURADE man, na ɔde too ɔhene ne ɔman no nso ntam.

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Ɛnna asase no so nkurɔfo nyinaa kɔɔ Baal fi koburuw n’afɔremuka ne n’ahoni no, wobubuu no pasaa, na Baal sɔfo Matan nso, wokum no afɔremuka no anim. Na ɔsɔfo no de awɛmfo sisii AWURADE fi no ho.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa ɔha ha so safohene ne Karifo ne awɛmfo ne asase no so nkurɔfo nyinaa, na wɔde ɔhene no fii AWURADE fi san bɛfaa ammirikatufo pon ano kwan so baa ɔhene fi, na ɔtenaa ahengua no so.

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Na asase no so nkurɔfo nyinaa ani gyei, na kurow no mu dwoe; na Atalia de, wɔde nkrante kum no ɔhene fi hɔ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Yoas yɛɛ nea ɛteɛ AWURADE ani so ne nna a ɔsɔfo Yehoiada kyerɛkyerɛɛ no nyinaa.

english_verse: Joash became king of Judah in Jehu's seventh year as king of Israel, and he ruled
translation_verse: Yehu afe a ɛto so ason so na Yoas bedii hene, na odii hene mfirihyia aduanan Yerusalem. Na ne na din de Sibia a ofi Beer-seba.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Asodi afɔre sika ne bɔne ho afɔre sika de, wɔamfa amma AWURADE fi; ɛyɛ asɔfo no dea. Hasael tu Yerusalem so sa

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nanso sorɔnsorɔmmea no de, wɔanyi; ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔre na wɔhyew aduhuam sorɔnsorɔmmea no so.

english_verse: One day, Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money that has been given to the Lord's temple, whether from taxes or gifts,
translation_verse: Na Yoas ka kyerɛɛ asɔfo no sɛ: Akronkronne sika a wɔde ba AWURADE fi nyinaa ne obiara kra ti sika sɛ wɔbɔ no bo no, ne sika biara nso a ɛba obi koma mu sɛ ɔde bɛba AWURADE fi no,

english_verse: and use it to repair the temple whenever you see the need.”
translation_verse: asɔfo no nnyigye wɔ amannifo nkyɛn, na wɔmfa nsiesie ofi no faako a ayɛ gow no, baabiara a wobehu sɛ gow bi wɔ.

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Yoas afe a ɛto so aduonu abiɛsa so no, na asɔfo no nnya nsiesie ofi no mu adangow no ɛ.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔhene Yoas frɛɛ ɔsɔfo Yehoiada ne asɔfo no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛdɛn nti na monnsiesie ofi no mu adangow no? Afei munnnyigye sika mo amannifo nkyɛn bio, na munyi mma na wɔmfa mpompam ofi no adangow no.

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Na asɔfo no penee sɛ wɔrennye ɔman no hɔ sika, na wɔrempompam ofi no mu adangow no bio.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Ɛnna ɔsɔfo Yehoiada faa adaka bi, na otuu ne mmuaso mu tokuru, na ɔde sii afɔremuka no ho, nea wɔfa ba AWURADE fi no nifa; na asɔfo a wɔhwɛ ɔpon no ano no de sika a wɔde ba AWURADE fi no nyinaa guu mu.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wohu sɛ sika pii wɔ adaka no mu a, ɔhene kyerɛwfo ne ɔsɔfo panyin no foro ba, na wɔbɛkyekyere, na wɔkan sika a wohu AWURADE fi no.

english_verse: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers,
translation_verse: Na wɔde sika a wɔakari no hyɛɛ wɔn a wɔyɛɛ adwuma no a wɔde wɔn sisii AWURADE fi so ahwɛfo no nsa, na woyi maa nnua adwumfo ne adansifo a wɔyɛ AWURADE fi no,

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: ne abantofo, ne abotwafo, ne nea wɔde bɛtɔ nnua ne abo a wɔatwa, nea wɔde bɛpompam AWURADE fi adangow no, ne nea wɔde betua ofi no adangow no pempam ho ade a wɔhwere nyinaa ka.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔamfa sika a wɔde ba AWURADE fi no mu bi anyɛ AWURADE fi dwetɛ nsanka, adumgya, nkora, ntorobɛnto anaa sika ne dwetɛ ade biara.

english_verse: It went only to pay for repairs.
translation_verse: Na wɔde maa wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no, na wɔde pempam AWURADE fi no.

english_verse: The men in charge were honest, so no one had to keep track of the money.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔne nnipa a wɔde sika hyɛɛ wɔn nsa sɛ wɔmfa mma adwumayɛfo no ammu akontaa, efisɛ wɔyɛɛ no nokware mu.

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɛbere no mu na Siria hene Hasael foro bae ne Gat bɛkoe, na odii nkunim; na Hasael de n’ani kyerɛe sɛ ɔreforo aba Yerusalem.

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Yuda hene Yoas faa akronkronne a n’agyanom Yuda ahene Yosafat ne Yoram ne Ahasia yɛɛ no kronkron no nyinaa, ne n’akronkronne, ne sika a wohuu AWURADE fi ne ahemfi akorade mu nyinaa, na ɔsoma ma wɔde kɔmaa Siria hene Hasael; ɛnna ofii Yerusalem hɔ kɔe.

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Yoas ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, wɔakyerɛw no Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: Na ne nkoa Simeat ba Yosakar ne Somer ba Yosabad bɔɔ no na owui; na wosiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kurow mu; na ne ba Amasia bedii n’ade.

english_verse: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled
translation_verse: Yuda hene Ahasia ba Yoas afe a ɛto so aduonu abiɛsa so na Yehu ba Yoahas bedii Israel so hene Samaria mfe asɔn.

english_verse: and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Hiɛ apuei mfɛnsere no! Na ohiɛe. Na Elisa se: Tow! Na ɔtowee. Na ose: AWURADE nkonimdi agyan, Siria so nkonimdi agyan! Na wobɛbɔ Siria wɔ Afek akosi sɛ wobɛdwerɛw wɔn.

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na odii Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne akyi; wamfi ho.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bo fuw hyɛɛ Israel, na ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ Siria hene Hasael nsa, ne Hasael ba Ben-hadad nsa nna nyinaa.

english_verse: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz
translation_verse: Na Yoahas kotɔ srɛɛ AWURADE, na AWURADE tiee no, efisɛ ohuu ɔhaw a Siria hene de rehaw Israel no.

english_verse: by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE maa Israel ogyefo, na wofii Siriafo nsa ase, na Israelfo tenaa wɔn ntamadan mu sɛ kan no.

english_verse: Jehoash became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Yuda hene Yoas afe a ɛto so aduasa ason so na Yoahas ba Yoas bedii Israel so hene Samaria mfe dunsia.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Yoahas ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa ne ne mmaninne, so wɔankyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king. King Jehoash of Israel
translation_verse: Na Yoahas ne n’agyanom kɔdae, na wosiee no Samaria; na ne ba Yoas bedii n’ade. Yoas di Israel so hene

english_verse: “Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Israel hene no sɛ: Fa wo nsa so ta no mu. Na ɔde ne nsa soo mu; na Elisa de ne nsa guu ɔhene no nsa so.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by doing just like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, wamfi Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne nyinaa ho; ɛno ara na ɔyɛe.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Yoas ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa ne ne mmaninne, sɛ ɔne Yuda hene Amasia dii ako no, so wɔankyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king. Elisha the Prophet Dies
translation_verse: Na Yoas wui, na Yeroboam bɛtenaa n’agua so; na wosiee Yoas Samaria kaa Israel ahene ho. Elisa nkɔmhyɛ ne ne wu

english_verse: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
translation_verse: Nso na Elisa yare ne yare a ɔde wui no. Na Israel hene Yoas san baa ne nkyɛn besui n’anim, na ɔkae sɛ: M’agya, m’agya! Israel nteaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔsotefo!

english_verse: Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Tase agyan no! Na ɔtasee. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Israel hene no sɛ: Tow bɔ fam! Na ɔtow bɔɔ fam mprɛnsa, na ogyinae.

english_verse: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Onyankopɔn nipa no bo fuw no kae sɛ: Anka ɛsɛ sɛ wotow mpɛn anum anaa asia; ɛno na anka wobɛbɔ Siria akosi sɛ wobɛdwerɛw wɔn; enti nso mprɛnsa pɛ na wobɛbɔ Siria.

english_verse: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.
translation_verse: Na Elisa wui, na wosiee no. Na afe no dui no, Moabfo afowfo asafo baa asase no so.

english_verse: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up. Israel Defeats Syria
translation_verse: Na da bi a wɔrekosie onipa bi no, wohuu asafokuw bi, na wɔtow onipa no kyenee Elisa da mu; na onipa no kɔkaa Elisa nnompe pɛ, na onyaa nkwa, na ɔsɔre gyinaa ne nan so. Yoas di Ben-hadad so nkunim

english_verse: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Na Siria hene Hasael haw Israel, Yoahas nna nyinaa.

english_verse: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Nanso AWURADE dom wɔn, na ne yam hyehyee no maa wɔn, na ɔdan ne ho kyerɛɛ wɔn, n’apam a ɔne Abraham, Isak ne Yakob pamee no nti, na wampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe wɔn, na wantow wɔn ankyene amfi n’anim de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.
translation_verse: Na Siria hene Hasael wui; na ne ba Ben-hadad bedii n’ade.

english_verse: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Na Yoahas ba Yoas san kogyee Hasael ba Ben-hadad nsam nkurow a ɔde ɔko begyee n’agya Yoahas nsam no. Mpɛn abiɛsa na Yoas bɔɔ no, na ɔdan Israel nkurow no mae.

english_verse: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.
translation_verse: Ɔno na okogyee Israel hye san maa wɔn de fi Hamat de besii Araba po ano, sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn nam n’akoa, Amitai ba Yona, odiyifo a ofi Gat-hefer, so kae no.

english_verse: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Israel hene Yoahas ba Yoas afe a ɛto so abien so na Yuda hene Yoas ba Amasia bedii hene.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, wamfi Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne nyinaa ho.

english_verse: Jeroboam died and was buried, and his son Zechariah became king.
translation_verse: Na Yeroboam tiw n’agyanom Israel ahemfo no wɔ asamando, na ne ba Sakaria bedii n'ade.

english_verse: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ nea ɛteɛ AWURADE ani so, nanso ɛnte sɛ n’agya Dawid; sɛnea n’agya Yoas yɛɛ no nyinaa na ɔno nso yɛe.

english_verse: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nanso sorɔnsorɔmmea no de, wɔanyi. Ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔre na wɔhyew aduhuam sorɔnsorɔmmea no so.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.
translation_verse: Na ahenni no timii ne nsam no, okum ne nkoa a wokum n’agya ɔhene no.

english_verse: But the children of those officers were not killed. The Lord had commanded in the Law of Moses that only the people who sinned were to be punished, not their parents or children.
translation_verse: Na awudifo no mma no de, wankum wɔn, sɛnea wɔakyerɛw Mose mmara no mu sɛnea AWURADE hyɛɛ sɛ: Wonnkum agyanom, mma nti, nso wonnkum mma, agyanom nti, na mmom obiara bɔne so na wonkum no, no.

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Okum de, woakum Edom, na wo koma ama wo so. Ma w’anuonyam nnɔ wo so na tena wo fi, na ɛdɛn nti na wo ne mmusu rebedi aperepere na woahwe ase, wo ne Yuda nyinaa?

english_verse: One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Ɛbere no mu na Amasia somaa abɔfo kɔɔ Israel hene Yoas, Yehu ba Yehoahas ba, nkyɛn se: Bra ma yɛnsɔ yɛn ho nhwɛ.

english_verse: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Na Israel hene Yoas soma baa Yuda hene Amasia nkyɛn sɛ: Nsɔe dua a ɛwɔ Lebanon no soma kɔɔ kyeneduru a ɛwɔ Lebanon no nkyɛn sɛ: Fa wo babea ma me ba nware. Na wuram mmoa a wɔwɔ Lebanon no sen betiatiaa nsɔe dua no so.

english_verse: But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Na Amasia antie. Ɛnna Israel hene Yoas foro bae, na wobehyiaam koe, ɔno ne Yuda hene Amasia, wɔ Bet-semes a ɛyɛ Yuda dea hɔ.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Na Yuda gui Israel anim, na woguan kokɔɔ wɔn ntamadan mu.

english_verse: and Jehoash captured Amaziah. Jehoash then marched to Jerusalem and broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly
translation_verse: Na Israel hene Yoas kyeree Yuda hene Amasia, Ahasia ba Yoas ba, wɔ Bet-semes; na ɔbaa Yerusalem beburuw Yerusalem fasu fi Efraim pon no ho de kosii twea pon no ho basafa ahannan;

english_verse: He took the gold and silver, as well as everything of value from the Lord's temple and the king's treasury. He took hostages, then returned to Samaria.
translation_verse: na ɔfaa sika ne dwetɛ nyinaa, ne nnwinne a wohui AWURADE fi ne ahemfi akorade mu ne nnɔnwowa, na ɔsan kɔɔ Samaria.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Yoas ho nsɛm nkae, nea ɔyɛe ne ne mmaninne, ne sɛnea ɔne Yuda hene Amasia koe no, so wɔankyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Ɛnna Yuda man no nyinaa faa Asaria a wadi mfe dunsia no na wosii no hene sii n’agya Amasia ananmu.

english_verse: Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath. King Jeroboam the Second of Israel
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree Elat na ɔdan maa Yuda, na akyiri no ɔhene no wu kɔɔ n’agyanom nkyɛn wɔ asaman. Yeroboam a ɔto so abien di Israel so hene

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel in the fifteenth year of Amaziah's rule in Judah. Jeroboam ruled
translation_verse: Yuda hene Amasia, Yoas ba, afe a ɛto so dunum so na Israel hene Yeroboam, Yoas ba, bedii hene, Samaria, mfe aduanan biako.

english_verse: The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE huu Israel amanehunu sɛ ɛyɛ nwene papa, na ɔdehye ne akoa nyinaa kɔ, na Israel nni boafo bi.

english_verse: And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.
translation_verse: Nso AWURADE nkae sɛ ɔbɛpopa Israel din afi ɔsoro ase, na ɔnam Yoas ba Yeroboam so gyee wɔn.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Yeroboam ho nsɛm nkae, ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa ne ne mmaninne, sɛnea ɔkoe ne sɛnea ɔdan Damasko ne Hamat a ɛyɛ Yuda de no maa Israel no, wɔakyerɛw no Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu.

english_verse: Everything else Pekahiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Pekah of Israel
translation_verse: Na Pekahia ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu. Peka di Israel so hene

english_verse: Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asaria afe a ɛto so aduonum mu na Menahem ba Pekahia bedii Israel so hene Samaria mfe abien.

english_verse: Azariah obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ nea ɛteɛ AWURADE ani so, sɛ n’agya Amasia yɛe no nyinaa;

english_verse: But Azariah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: gye sorɔnsorɔmmea no na wɔanyi; ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔre na wɔhyew aduhuam sorɔnsorɔmmea no so.

english_verse: The Lord punished Azariah with leprosy for the rest of his life. He wasn't allowed to live in the royal palace, so his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bɔɔ ɔhene no ma ɔyaree kwata de kosii ne wuda; na ɔkɔtenaa ofi foforo a ne nkutoo te mu, na ɔhene ba Yotam na odii ofi no so na ɔyɛɛ ɔkannifo wɔ asase no so.

english_verse: Everything else Azariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Asaria ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, so wɔankyerɛw Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: Azariah died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jotham then became king. King Zechariah of Israel
translation_verse: Na Asaria wui, na wosiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kurow mu; na ne ba Yotam bedii n’ade. Sakaria di Israel so hene

english_verse: Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, but he ruled only six months from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asaria afe a ɛto so aduasa awotwe so na Yeroboam ba Sakaria bedii Israel so hene Samaria, asram asia.

english_verse: Shallum son of Jabesh plotted against Zechariah and killed him in public. Shallum then became king.
translation_verse: Na Yabes ba Salum bɔɔ ne ho pɔw, na ɔbɔɔ no ɔman no anim kum no, na obedii n’ade.

english_verse: So the Lord had kept his promise to Jehu that the next four kings of Israel would come from his family. Everything else Zechariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Shallum of Israel
translation_verse: Ɛno ne AWURADE asɛm no a ɔka kyerɛɛ Yehu sɛ: W’awo ntoatoaso a ɛto so anan mu mma bɛtena Israel agua so. Na ɛbae sa. Salum di Israel so hene

english_verse: Shallum became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's rule in Judah. But only one month after Shallum became king,
translation_verse: Yabes ba Salum bedii hene, Yuda hene Usia afe a ɛto so aduasa akron mu; na odii hene ɔsram wɔ Samaria.

english_verse: Menahem became king of Israel in Azariah's thirty-ninth year as king of Judah, and he ruled Israel ten years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asaria afe a ɛto so aduasa akron mu na Gadi ba Menahem bedii Israel so hene mfe du Samaria.

english_verse: He constantly disobeyed the Lord by following the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, wamfi Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho ne nna nyinaa.

english_verse: During Menahem's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria invaded Israel. He agreed to help Menahem keep control of his kingdom, if Menahem would pay him over
translation_verse: Asaria hene Pul baa asase no so, na Menahem maa Pul dwetɛ talente apem, sɛ ɔmmoa no nhyɛ ne nsam den ahenni no mu.

english_verse: Jotham followed the example of his father by obeying the Lord and doing right.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ nea ɛteɛ AWURADE ani so, sɛ n’agya Usia yɛɛ nyinaa na ɔyɛe;

english_verse: Everything else Menahem did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Menahem ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, so wɔankyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: Menahem died, and his son Pekahiah became king. King Pekahiah of Israel
translation_verse: Na Menahem wui, na ne ba Pekahia bedii n’ade. Pekahia di Israel so hene

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and caused the Israelites to sin, just as Jeroboam son of Nebat had done.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne. Wamfi Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and followed the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne. Wamfi Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho.

english_verse: During Pekah's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria marched into Israel. He captured the territories of Gilead and Galilee, including the towns of Ijon, Abel-Bethmaacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor, as well as the entire territory of Naphtali. Then he took Israelites from those regions to Assyria as prisoners.
translation_verse: Israel hene Peka bere so na Asaria hene Tiglat-pileser ba bɛfaa Iyon ne Abel-bet-maaka ne Yanoa ne Kedes ne Hasor ne Gilead ne Galilea, Naftali asase nyinaa, na otuu wɔn kɔɔ Asiria.

english_verse: In the twentieth year of Jotham's rule in Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah and murdered him. Hoshea then became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Ela ba Hosea pam Remalia ba Peka tiri so, na ɔbɔɔ no kum no, na obedii n’ade Usia ba Yotam afe a ɛto so aduonu mu.

english_verse: Everything else Pekah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Jotham of Judah (
translation_verse: Na Peka ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛɛ nyinaa, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw Israel ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu. Yotam di Yuda so hene (

english_verse: Jotham son of Azariah became king of Judah in the second year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Israel hene Remalia ba Peka afe a ɛto so abien mu na Yuda hene Usia ba Yotam bedii hene.

english_verse: It was Jotham who rebuilt the Upper Gate that led into the court around the Lord's temple. But the local shrines were not destroyed, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: gye sorɔnsorɔmmea na wɔanyi, ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔre na wɔhyew aduhuam sorɔnsorɔmmea no so. Ɔno na osii AWURADE fi pon a ɛkorɔn no.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Yotam ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, so wɔankyerɛw Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: During his rule, the Lord let King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel start attacking Judah.
translation_verse: Nna no mu na AWURADE fii ase somaa Siria hene Resin ne Remalia ba Peka baa Yuda so.

english_verse: Jotham died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Na Yotam wui, na wosiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, n’agya Dawid kurow mu, na ne ba Ahas bedii n’ade.

english_verse: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Remalia ba Peka afe a ɛto so dunson mu na Yuda hene Ahas a ɔyɛ Yotam ba bedii hene.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Hezekiah became king.
translation_verse: Na Ahas wui, na wosiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kurow mu; na ne ba Hesekia bedii n’ade.

english_verse: Uriah did everything Ahaz told him.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Uria yɛɛ sɛnea ɔhene Ahas hyɛɛ no nyinaa.

english_verse: and was even more sinful than the kings of Israel. He sacrificed his own son, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: Na ɔfaa Israel ahene kwan so, na ne ba po ɔma ɔfaa ogya mu, sɛ amanaman a AWURADE tuu wɔn fii Israelfo anim no akyide te no.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Na ɔbobɔɔ afɔre na ɔhyew nnuhuam sorɔnsorɔmmea ne nkoko so ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase.

english_verse: Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria that said, “Your Majesty, King Rezin and King Pekah are attacking me, your loyal servant. Please come and rescue me.”
translation_verse: Na Ahas somaa abɔfo kɔɔ Asaria hene Tiglat-pileser nkyɛn sɛ: W’akoa ne wo ba ne me; foro bra begye me Siria hene ne Israel hene a wɔasɔre ahyɛ me yi nsam.

english_verse: Along with the message, Ahaz sent silver and gold from the Lord's temple and from the palace treasury as a gift for the Assyrian king.
translation_verse: Na Ahas faa dwetɛ ne sika a wohui AWURADE fi ne ɔhene fi akorade mu no soma ma wɔde kɔmaa Asaria hene sɛ ayɛyɛde.

english_verse: As soon as Tiglath Pileser received the message, he and his troops marched to Syria. He captured the capital city of Damascus, then he took the people living there to the town of Kir as prisoners and killed King Rezin.
translation_verse: Na Asaria hene tiee no, na Asaria hene foro baa Damasko, na ɔbɛfae, na otuu wɔn kɔtenaa Kir, na okum Resin.

english_verse: Later, Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser. And while Ahaz was there, he saw an altar and sent a model of it back to Uriah the priest, along with the plans for building one.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Ahas siim kohyiaa Asaria hene Tiglat-pileser wɔ Damasko. Na okohuu afɔremuka a ɛwɔ Damasko no, na ɔhene Ahas de afɔremuka no nsɛso ne nsusuwso sɛnea ne yɛbea nyinaa te soma brɛɛ ɔsɔfo Uria.

english_verse: Uriah followed the plans and built an altar exactly like the one in Damascus, finishing it just before Ahaz came back.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Uria sii afɔremuka no sɛnea ɔhene Ahas soma fii Damasko brɛɛ no no, saa na ɔsɔfo Uria yɛ siee ɔba a ɔhene Ahas fi Damasko bae no.

english_verse: When Ahaz returned, he went to see the altar and to offer sacrifices on it. He walked up to the altar
translation_verse: Na ɔhene fi Damasko bae no, ɔhene behuu afɔremuka no, na ɔhene twiw bɛn afɔremuka no, na ɔbɔɔ so ɔhyew afɔre.

english_verse: and poured wine over it. Then he offered sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessings.
translation_verse: Na ɔhyew ne hyew afɔre ne n’aduan afɔre, na ohwiee n’ahwiesa, na ɔde n’asomdwoe afɔre mogya petee afɔremuka no so.

english_verse: After that, he had the bronze altar moved aside, so his new altar would be right in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Na kɔbere afɔremuka a esi AWURADE anim no, otwiw fii asɔredan no anim, afɔremuka foforo no ne AWURADE dan no ntam, de kosii afɔremuka no nkyɛn mu benkum fam.

english_verse: He told Uriah the priest: From now on, the morning and evening sacrifices as well as all gifts of grain and wine are to be offered on this altar. The sacrifices for the people and for the king must also be offered here. Sprinkle the blood from all the sacrifices on it, but leave the bronze altar for me to use for prayer and finding out what God wants me to do.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Ahas hyɛɛ ɔsɔfo Uria sɛ: Afɔremuka kɛse no so na hyew anɔpa hyew afɔre ne anwummere aduan afɔre ne ɔhene hyew afɔre ne n’aduan afɔre ne asase yi sofo nyinaa hyew afɔre ne wɔn aduan afɔre ne wɔn ahwiesa, na fa ɔhyew afɔre mogya nyinaa ne okum afɔre mogya nyinaa pete so; na kɔbere afɔremuka no nsi me hɔ na minnwen ho.

english_verse: Ahaz also had the side panels and the small bowls taken off the movable stands in the Lord's temple. He had the large bronze bowl, called the Sea, removed from the bronze bulls on which it rested and had it placed on a stand made of stone.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Ahas twitwaa nnaka no nhyehyɛmu no, na oyiyii so aguasɛn no, fii kɔbere anantwi a ɛwɔ ase no so, na ɔde sii abonsɛwee bi so.

english_verse: He took down the special tent that was used for worship on the Sabbath and closed up the private entrance that the kings of Judah used for going into the temple. He did all these things to please Tiglath Pileser.
translation_verse: Na ɔkwan a wɔakata so a wɔfa so homeda a wɔyɛe ofi no mu ne ɔhene mfikyikwan no, Asaria hene nti oyi kɔtoo AWURADE fi.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Ahas ho nsɛm nkae, nea ɔyɛe no, so wɔankyerɛw Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu?

english_verse: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz's rule in Judah, and he ruled nine years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Ahas afe a ɛto so dumien mu na Ela ba Hosea bedii Israel so hene Samaria mfe akron.

english_verse: Hoshea disobeyed the Lord and sinned, but not as much as the earlier Israelite kings had done.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, nanso ɛnte sɛ Israel ahene a wodii n’anim no.

english_verse: During Hoshea's rule, King Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel; he took control of the country and made Hoshea pay taxes.
translation_verse: Ɔno so na Asaria hene Salmaneser bae, na Hosea yɛɛ no akoa, na ɔmaa no ayɛyɛde.

english_verse: But later, Hoshea refused to pay the taxes and asked King So of Egypt to help him rebel. When Shalmaneser found out, he arrested Hoshea and put him in prison. Samaria Is Destroyed and the Israelites Are Taken to Assyria
translation_verse: Na Asaria hene hui sɛ Hosea apam ne tiri so na wasoma abɔfo akɔ Misraim hene So nkyɛn, efisɛ wamfa ayɛyɛde ankɔma Asaria hene sɛ ɔyɛ daa afe no; ɛnna Asaria hene bɛkyeree no kɔtoo nneduadan mu.

english_verse: Shalmaneser invaded Israel and attacked the city of Samaria for three years,
translation_verse: Na Asaria hene tu baa asase no nyinaa so, na ɔbaa Samaria bɛkaa no hyɛɛ mu mfe abiɛsa.

english_verse: before capturing it in the ninth year of Hoshea's rule. The Assyrian king took the Israelites away to Assyria as prisoners. He forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Hosea afe a ɛto so akron mu na Asaria hene faa Samaria, na otuu Israel kɔɔ Asiria, na ɔde wɔn koduaa Hala ne Habor, Gosan asubɔnten ho, ne Media nkurow mu. Asaria tukɔ

english_verse: All of this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from Egypt, where they had been slaves. They worshiped foreign gods,
translation_verse: Na ɛbaa saa, efisɛ Israelfo ayɛ AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn a oyii wɔn fii Misraim asase so Misraim hene Farao nsam bae no bɔne, na wɔakɔsom anyame foforo,

english_verse: followed the customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel, and were just as sinful as the Israelite kings.
translation_verse: na wɔanantew amanaman a AWURADE tuu wɔn fii Israelfo anim no ahyɛde ne Israel ahene de a wɔhyehyɛe no mu.

english_verse: Even worse, the Israelites tried to hide their sins from the Lord their God. They built their own local shrines everywhere in Israel—from small towns to large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no nam ase dii nsɛm a ɛmfata ne AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn dii asi, na wosisii sorɔnsorɔmmea, wɔn nkurow nyinaa mu, efi awɛmfo abantenten so kosi kurow a afasu atwa ho ahyia so,

english_verse: They also built stone images of foreign gods and set up sacred poles for the worship of Asherah on every hill and under every shady tree.
translation_verse: na wosisii adum ne Asera nnua, nkoko a ɛkorɔn nyinaa so ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase maa wɔn;

english_verse: They offered sacrifices at the shrines, just as the foreign nations had done before the Lord forced them out of Israel. They did sinful things that made the Lord very angry.
translation_verse: na ɛhɔ na wɔhyew nnuhuam, sorɔnsorɔmmea nyinaa, sɛ amanaman a AWURADE tutuu wɔn fii wɔn anim no, na wodii nsɛmmɔne de huruu AWURADE bo.

english_verse: Even though the Lord had commanded the Israelites not to worship idols, they did it anyway.
translation_verse: Na wɔsonsom ahonihunu a AWURADE aka wɔn ɛho asɛm sɛ: Munnni saa asɛm yi, no.

english_verse: So the Lord made sure that every prophet warned Israel and Judah with these words: “I, the Lord, command you to stop doing sinful things and start obeying my laws and teachings! I gave them to your ancestors, and I told my servants the prophets to repeat them to you.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE nam n’adiyifo nyinaa ne adehufo nyinaa so dii Israel ne Yuda adanse sɛ: Monsan mfi mo akwammɔne no so, na munni me mmara nsɛm ne m’ahyɛde so, sɛ mmara a mehyɛɛ mo agyanom a menam me nkoa adiyifo no so mema wɔde brɛɛ mo no nyinaa.

english_verse: But the Israelites would not listen; they were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to worship the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔantie, na wosinsen wɔn kɔn sɛ wɔn agyanom a wɔannye AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn anni no.

english_verse: They ignored the Lord's warnings and commands, and they rejected the solemn agreement he had made with their ancestors. They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves. The Lord had told the Israelites not to do the things that the foreign nations around them were doing, but Israel became just like them.
translation_verse: Na wɔpoo n’ahyɛde ne n’apam a ɔne wɔn agyanom pamee ne n’adanse a odii wɔn no, na wokodii ahuhude akyi dii ahuhusɛm, na wokodii amanaman a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia a AWURADE hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnyɛ sɛ wɔn no akyi.

english_verse: The people of Israel disobeyed all the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves and set up a sacred pole for Asherah; they also worshiped the stars and the god Baal.
translation_verse: Na wogyaw AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm nyinaa, na wɔyɛɛ ahoni a wɔagu, nantwi mma abien, na wɔyɛɛ Asera nnua, na wɔsɔree ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, na wɔsom Baal.

english_verse: They used magic and witchcraft and even sacrificed their own children. The Israelites were determined to do whatever the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Na wɔmomaa wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmabea fofaa ogya mu, na wɔhyehyɛɛ nkɔm bisabisaa ade, na wɔde wɔn ho mae sɛ wɔbɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne de ahuru ne bo.

english_verse: The Lord became so furious with the people of Israel that he allowed them to be carried away as prisoners. Only the people living in Judah were left,
translation_verse: Enti AWURADE faa Israel abufuw sɛ, na oyii wɔn fii n’anim, wannyaw obi sɛ Yuda abusuakuw nko.

english_verse: but they also disobeyed the Lord's commands and acted like the Israelites.
translation_verse: Yuda nso anni AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so, na wɔnantew Israel ahyɛde a wɔyɛe no mu.

english_verse: So the Lord turned his back on everyone in Israel and let them be punished and defeated until no one was left.
translation_verse: Enti na AWURADE poo Israel asefo nyinaa, na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn ase, na ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ afowfo nsa kosii sɛ ɔtow wɔn fii n’anim gui.

english_verse: Earlier, when the Lord took the northern tribes away from David's family, the people living in northern Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. Jeroboam caused the Israelites to sin and to stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Israel tew fii Dawid fi ho, na wɔde Nebat ba Yeroboam sii hene, na Yeroboam twee Israel fii AWURADE akyidi ho ma wɔyɛɛ bɔne kɛse.

english_verse: The people kept on sinning like Jeroboam,
translation_verse: Na Israelfo kɔnantew Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛe no nyinaa mu; wɔamfi ho,

english_verse: until the Lord got rid of them, just as he had warned his servants the prophets. That's why the people of Israel were taken away as prisoners to Assyria, and that's where they remained. Foreigners Are Resettled in Israel
translation_verse: de kosii sɛ AWURADE yii Israel fii n’anim, sɛnea ɔnam ne nkoa adiyifo no nyinaa so kae no. Ɛno na wotuu Israel fii n’asase so kɔɔ Asaria de besi nnɛ. Samaria asefi

english_verse: The king of Assyria took people who were living in the cities of Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and forced them to move to Israel. They took over the towns where the Israelites had lived, including the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Na Asaria hene kɔfaa nnipa fii Babel ne Kuta ne Awa ne Hamat ne Sefarwaim de wɔn beduaa Samaria nkurow mu sii Israelfo no ananmu, na wodii Samaria so na wɔtenaa ne nkurow mu.

english_verse: At first these people did not worship the Lord, so he sent lions to attack them, and the lions killed some of them.
translation_verse: Na wɔn hɔ tena mfiase mu no na wonsuro AWURADE; na AWURADE somaa agyata baa wɔn mu a wokunkum wɔn mu binom.

english_verse: A messenger told the king of Assyria, “The people you moved to Israel don't know how to worship the god of that country. So he sent lions that have attacked and killed some of them.”
translation_verse: Na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Asaria hene sɛ: Amanaman a woatutu wɔn de wɔn abedua Samaria nkurow mu yi, wonnim asase no so Nyankopɔn no atemmude, enti wasoma agyata aba wɔn mu, na hwɛ, wɔrekunkum wɔn, esiane sɛ wonnim asase no so Nyankopɔn no atemmude.

english_verse: The king replied, “Get one of the Israelite priests we brought here and send him back to Israel. He can live there and teach them about the god of that country.”
translation_verse: Ɛnna Asaria hene no hyɛe sɛ: Momma asɔfo a moatu wɔn hɔ no mu biako nkɔ hɔ, na wɔnkɔ nkɔtena hɔ, na ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn asase no so Nyankopɔn no atemmude.

english_verse: One of the Israelite priests was chosen to go back to Israel. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Na asɔfo a wotuu wɔn fii Samaria no mu biako ba bɛtenaa Betel, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn sɛnea wonsuro AWURADE.

english_verse: But in towns all over Israel, the different groups of people made statues of their own gods, then they placed these idols in local Israelite shrines.
translation_verse: Nanso amanaman no yeyɛɛ wɔn anyame, na wɔde wɔn sisii sorɔnsorɔmmea adan a Samariafo yeyɛe no mu, ɔman biara, wɔn nkurow a wɔte mu no mu.

english_verse: The people from Babylonia made the god Succoth-Benoth; those from Cuthah made the god Nergal; those from Hamath made Ashima;
translation_verse: Na Babelfo no yɛɛ Sukot-benot, na Kutfo no yɛɛ Nergal, na Hamatfo no yɛɛ Asima,

english_verse: those from Avva made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the people from Sepharvaim sacrificed their children to their own gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.
translation_verse: na Awifo no yɛɛ Nibhas ne Tartak, na Sefarwifo de ogya hyehyew wɔn mma maa Adramelek ne Anamelek, Sefarwaim anyame no.

english_verse: They worshiped their own gods, just as they had before they were taken away to Israel. They also worshiped the Lord, but they chose their own people to be priests at the shrines.
translation_verse: Wosuroo AWURADE na wɔsonsom wɔn ankasa anyame, sɛ amanaman a wotuu wɔn fii hɔ bae no amanne te.

english_verse: Everyone followed their old customs. None of them worshiped only the Lord, and they refused to obey the laws and commands that the Lord had given to the descendants of Jacob, the man he named Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛde besi nnɛ, wɔyɛ wɔn kan nneyɛe no ara. Wonsuro AWURADE, na nso wonni ahyɛde ne atemmude ne mmara ne ɛmom a AWURADE hyɛɛ Yakob a ɔtoo no din Israel no mma no so.

english_verse: At the time when the Lord had made his solemn agreement with the people of Israel, he told them: Do not worship any other gods! Do not bow down to them or offer them a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Wɔn na AWURADE ne wɔn pamee, na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Munnsuro anyame foforo na monnsɔre wɔn na monnsom wɔn, na mommmɔ wɔn afɔre,

english_verse: Worship only me! I am the one who rescued you from Egypt with my mighty power. Bow down to me and offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: na mmom AWURADE a ɔde ahoɔden kɛse ne basa a wateɛ mu koyii mo fii Misraim asase so bae no, ɔno na munsuro no, na ɔno na monsɔre no, na ɔno na mommɔ no afɔre.

english_verse: Never worship any other god, always obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Na ahyɛde ne atemmude ne mmara ne ɛmom a ɔkyerɛw maa mo no, munni so nyɛ nna nyinaa, na munnsuro anyame foforo.

english_verse: and remember the solemn agreement between us. I will say it again: Do not worship any god
translation_verse: Na apam a me ne mo pamee no, mommma mo werɛ mmfi, na munnsuro anyame foforo,

english_verse: except me. I am the Lord your God, and I will rescue you from all your enemies.
translation_verse: na mmom AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn na munsuro no, na ɔno na obeyi mo afi mo atamfo nyinaa nsam.

english_verse: But the people living in Israel ignored that command and kept on following their old customs.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔantie, na mmom sɛ wɔn kan atemmude te no ara na wɔyɛe.

english_verse: They did worship the Lord, but they also worshiped their own idols. Their descendants did the same thing.
translation_verse: Sɛɛ na amanaman yi suroo AWURADE, na wɔsonsom wɔn ahoni a wɔasinsen no, wɔn mma ne wɔn mma mma nso, sɛnea wɔn agyanom yɛe no, saa ara na wɔn nso wɔyɛ de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhene se ni: Mommma Hesekia nnnyigye mo, na ɔrentumi nnye mo ne nsam,

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah! Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Munntie Hesekia, na sɛ Asaria hene se ni: Mo ne me nni asomdwoesɛm, na mumfi mmra me nkyɛn, na munni mo bobe ne mo borɔdɔma no bi, na monnom mo mmura mu nsu,

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Afei, so mekwatii AWURADE na mebaa ha yi sɛ merebɛsɛe ha anaa? AWURADE na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Tu kɔ asase yi so kɔsɛe no.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord, just as his ancestor David had done.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ nea ɛteɛ AWURADE ani so, sɛnea n’agya Dawid yɛe nyinaa.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines, then tore down the images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. He also smashed the bronze snake Moses had made. The people had named it Nehushtan and had been offering sacrifices to it.
translation_verse: Ɔno na oyiyii sorɔnsorɔmmea no, na obubuu adum no, na otwitwaa Asera nnua no gui, na obubuu kɔbere a Mose yɛe no; na ɛde besi saa bere no na Israelfo hyew aduhuam ma no, na wɔfrɛɛ no Nehustan.

english_verse: Hezekiah trusted the Lord God of Israel. No other king of Judah was like Hezekiah, either before or after him.
translation_verse: AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn so na ɔde ne ho toe, na n’akyi no obiara amma sɛ ɔno, Yuda ahene nyinaa mu, na obiara anni n’anim saa.

english_verse: He was completely faithful to the Lord and obeyed the laws the Lord had given to Moses for the people.
translation_verse: Na ɔbataa AWURADE ho, wansan amfi n’akyi, na odii mmara nsɛm a AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no so.

english_verse: The Lord helped Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. He even rebelled against the king of Assyria, refusing to be his servant.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE dii n’akyi; baabiara a ofi kɔ no, onya siade; na ɔtew Asaria hene so atua, na wansom no.

english_verse: Hezekiah defeated the Philistine towns as far away as Gaza—from the smallest towns to the large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Ɔno na okunkum Filistifo koduu Gasa ne ɛho asase de fi awɛmfo abantenten so kosii kurow a afasu atwa ho ahyia so.

english_verse: During the fourth year of Hezekiah's rule, which was the seventh year of Hoshea's rule in Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria led his troops to Samaria, the capital city of Israel. They attacked
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Hesekia afe a ɛto so anan a ɛyɛ Israel hene Ela ba Hosea afe a ɛto so ason mu no, Asaria hene Salmaneser foro baa Samaria so bɛtoaa no ne no koe,

english_verse: and captured it three years later, in the sixth year of Hezekiah's rule and the ninth year of Hoshea's rule.
translation_verse: na mfe abiɛsa akyi no wɔfae; Hesekia afe a ɛto so asia a ɛne Israel hene Hosea afe a ɛto so akron no mu na wɔfaa Samaria.

english_verse: All of that happened because the people of Israel had not obeyed the Lord their God. They rejected the solemn agreement he had made with them, and they ignored everything that the Lord's servant Moses had told them. King Sennacherib of Assyria Invades Judah (
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔantie AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔtoo n’apam ne nea AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛe no nyinaa, na wɔantie na wɔanyɛ. Senakerib tua Yerusalem

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards, raise your own grain, and have plenty of olive oil and honey. Believe me, you won't starve there. Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him.
translation_verse: nkosi sɛ mɛba mabɛfa mo akɔ asase a ɛte sɛ mo asase yi so, awi ne nsa asase, aduan ne bobe nturo asase, ngodua ne ɛwo asase so, na moanya nkwa na moanwu. Na sɛ Hesekia to mo tɛkrɛmakyene sɛ: AWURADE begye yɛn a, munntie.

english_verse: One of the Assyrian commanders told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Na Rabsake ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monka nkyerɛ Hesekia sɛ: Sɛ ɔhenkɛse no, Asaria hene no, se ni: Ɛdɛn koraa na wode wo ho to so yi?

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Na sɛ moka kyerɛ me sɛ: AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn so na yɛde yɛn ho to a, so ɛnyɛ ɔno na Hesekia ayi ne sorɔnsorɔmmea ne n’afɔremuka, na wase Yuda ne Yerusalem sɛ: Afɔremuka yi anim na monsɔre no?

english_verse: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah's rule in Judah, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city, except Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Hesekia afe a ɛto so dunan mu na Asaria hene Senakerib tu baa Yuda nkurow a ɛyɛ den nyinaa so bɛfae.

english_verse: Hezekiah sent this message to Sennacherib, who was in the town of Lachish: “I know I am guilty of rebellion. But I will pay you whatever you want, if you stop your attack.” Sennacherib told Hezekiah to pay ten tons of silver and one ton of gold.
translation_verse: Na Yuda hene Hesekia soma kɔɔ Asaria hene nkyɛn wɔ Lakis sɛ: Mayɛ bɔne; san fi me so: Na nea wode bɛto me so no, mɛsoa. Na Asaria hene hyɛe sɛ Yuda hene Hesekia ntua dwetɛ dwetikɛse ahasa ne sika dwetikɛse aduasa.

english_verse: So Hezekiah collected all the silver from the Lord's temple and the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Na Hesekia de dwetɛ a wohui AWURADE fi ne ahemfi akorade mu no nyinaa mae.

english_verse: He even stripped the gold that he had used to cover the doors and doorposts in the temple. He gave it all to Sennacherib.
translation_verse: Ɛbere no mu na Hesekia twitwaa AWURADE aban apon ne adum ho sika a Yuda hene Hesekia duraduraa ho no, na ɔde maa Asaria hene.

english_verse: The king of Assyria ordered his three highest military officers to leave Lachish and take a large army to Jerusalem. When they arrived, the officers stood on the road near the cloth makers' shops along the canal from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Asaria hene somaa ne sahene, anaa Tartan, ne Rabsaris anaa opiani ne ɔhene nsahyɛfo panyin anaa Rabsake fi Lakis ne dɔm a emu yɛ duru baa ɔhene Hesekia nkyɛn Yerusalem; na wɔforo baa Yerusalem; na wobegyinaa atifi tare a ɛwɔ Ɔtamahorofo asasewa no tempɔn ho no suka ho.

english_verse: They called out to Hezekiah, and three of his highest officials came out to meet them. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Na wɔbɛfrɛɛ ɔhene. Ɛnna Hilkia ba Eliakim a odi ofi no so ne ɔkyerɛwfo Sebna ne ɔsɛnkafo Yoa, Asaf ba, fii adi kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn.

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Wususuw sɛ anosɛm nko yɛ akodi ho nyansa ne mmaninyɛ! Na afei, ɛhena so na wode wo ho to a enti wotew me so atua yi?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Afei, hwɛ, wode wo ho to demmire a abu yi so, ɛne Misraim a sɛ obi tweri no a, ɛwɔ ne nsam hwirew mu. Saa na Misraim hene Farao te ma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to no so nyinaa.

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people. He will give you
translation_verse: Na afei wo ne me wura Asaria hene nyɛ apam ɛ, na mɛma wo apɔnkɔ mpennu, kyerɛ sɛ wubetumi ama nnipa atenatena wɔn so.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Na nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔsotefo nti wode wo ho akɔto Misraim so yi, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na woatumi aka me wura nkoa nketewa mu safohene biako po agu?

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Na Hilkia ba Eliakim ne Sebna ne Yoa ka kyerɛɛ Rabsake sɛ: Wo ne wo nkoa nkasa Arameik kasa, na yɛn de, yɛte, na wo ne yɛn nnkasa Yuda kasa, nkurɔfo a wɔboa ɔfasu so no asom.

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you.”
translation_verse: Na Rabsake ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: So wo wura, nni wo nkyɛn, na me wura somaa me sɛ memmɛka nsɛm yi? So ɛnyɛ mmarima a wɔtete ɔfasu so yi nkyɛn, sɛ wonni wɔn ankasa sɛbew na wɔnnom wɔn dwensɔ sɛ mo ara?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Ɛnna Rabsake gyinae na ɔde nne kɛse teɛɛm Yuda kasa mu kae sɛ: Muntie ɔhenkɛse no, Asaria hene no, asɛm:

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: nanso mommma Hesekia mmma mommfa mo ho nnto AWURADE so sɛ: Ogye na AWURADE begye yɛn, na wɔremfa kurow yi nhyɛ Asaria hene nsa.

english_verse: Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: So amanaman anyame no mu bi agye n’asase afi Asaria hene nsam pɛn?

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? What about the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Ɛhe na Hamat ne Arpad anyame no wɔ? Ɛhe na Sefarwaim, Hena ne Iwa anyame no wɔ? So wɔagye Samaria me nsam anaa?

english_verse: None of these gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord your God can do any better?
translation_verse: Nsaase no so anyame nyinaa mu henanom na wɔagye wɔn asase afi me nsam, na AWURADE begye Yerusalem afi me nsam anaa?

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Hilkia ba Eliakim a odi ofi no so no ne ɔkyerɛwfo Sebna ne ɔsɛnkaefo Yoa, Asaf ba, de wɔn ntade a wɔasunsuane mu baa Hesekia nkyɛn bɛkaa Rabsake nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Na ɔresɔre ne nyame Nisrok fi no, ne mma Adramelek ne Sareser de nkrante kum no, na wofii mu guan kɔɔ Ararat asase so; na ne ba Esar-hadon bedii n'ade.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Hesekia tee no, osunsuanee ne ntade mu na ofuraa atweatam na osiim kɔɔ AWURADE fi.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (Isaiah
translation_verse: Ɛhe na Hamat hene ne Arpad hene ne Sefarwaim kurow ne Hena ne Iwa hene no wɔ?

english_verse: He told Prime Minister Eliakim, Assistant Prime Minister Shebna, and the senior priests to dress in sackcloth and tell the prophet Isaiah:
translation_verse: Na ɔsomaa Eliakim a odi ofi no so ne ɔkyerɛwfo Sebna ne asɔfo mu mpanyin a wofurafura ayitam kɔɔ Amos ba odiyifo Yesaia nkyɛn,

english_verse: These are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ Hesekia se ni: Ahohia ne asotwe ne nsopa da ne nnɛ, na mma adu awotwaa ano, na ahoɔden nni hɔ a wɔde bɛwo.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Ebia AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛte Rabsake a ne wura Asaria hene asoma no sɛ ɔmmɛsopa Onyankopɔn teasefo no nsɛm, na nsɛm a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ate no nti watwe n’aso. Enti ma wo mpaebɔ so ma nkae a wɔwɔ hɔ no.

english_verse: When these leaders went to Isaiah,
translation_verse: Na ɔhene Hesekia nkoa no baa Yesaia nkyɛn.

english_verse: he told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Na Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ monka nkyerɛ mo wura ni: Sɛ AWURADE se ni: Nsuro nsɛm a wotee a Asaria hene nkoa de abɛyaw me no anim.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, mede honhom bi mɛhyɛ no mu, na wate nsɛm bi, na wasan akɔ n’asase so, na mama watɔ nkrante ano n’asase so.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Na Rabsake sanee, na ɔkɔtoo Asaria hene sɛ ɔne Libna reko, efisɛ wate sɛ watu afi Lakis.

english_verse: About this same time the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Na ɔtee Etiopia hene Tirhaka nka sɛ: Hwɛ, watu ne wo rebɛko. Na ɔsan somaa abɔfo baa Hesekia nkyɛn bio sɛ:

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: Sɛ monkɔka nkyerɛ Yuda hene Hesekia ni: Mma wo Nyankopɔn a wode wo ho ato no so no nnnyigye wo sɛ: Wɔremfa Yerusalem nhyɛ Asaria hene nsa.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Hwɛ, wo ara woate nea Asaria ahene ayeyɛ nsaase nyinaa, asɛe no pasaa, na wo na wobegye wo anaa?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: So amanaman a m’agyanom asɛe wɔn, Gosan ne Haran ne Resef ne Edenfo a wɔwɔ Telasar no anyame no gyee wɔn anaa?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Na Hesekia gyee nhoma no abɔfo no nsam, na ɔkenkanee; na ɔforo kɔɔ AWURADE fi, na Hesekia trɛw mu too AWURADE anim.

english_verse: Isaiah went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, I heard your prayer about King Sennacherib of Assyria.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Amos ba Yesaia soma kɔɔ Hesekia nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn se ni: Nea wobɔɔ me ɛho mpae Asaria hene Senakerib ho no, mate.

english_verse: He prayed: Lord God of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: Na Hesekia bɔɔ AWURADE anim mpae sɛ: AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn a wote Kerubim so, wo nko ne Nyankopɔn asase so ahenni nyinaa so; wo na woyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Ɛwom, AWURADE, Asaria ahene asɛe amanaman ne wɔn nsaase,

english_verse: They destroyed the idols of wood and stone that the people of those nations had made and worshiped.
translation_verse: na wɔatotow wɔn anyame agu ogya mu, efisɛ wɔnyɛ anyame, na ɛyɛ onipa nsa ano adwuma, dua ne ɔbo nko, na wɔasɛe wɔn.

english_verse: But you are our Lord and our God! We ask you to keep us safe from the Assyrian king. Then everyone in every kingdom on earth will know that you are the only God. The Lord's Answer to Hezekiah (Isaiah
translation_verse: Enti, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn fi ne nsam, na asase so ahenni nyinaa nhu sɛ wo AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn, wo nkutoo ara nko!

english_verse: Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: Eyi ne asɛm a AWURADE aka agu no so: Ɔbaabun Sion babea no bu wo animtiaa yi wo ahii, w’akyi na Yerusalem babea rewosow ne ti.

english_verse: That same night the Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed
translation_verse: Na anadwo no ara AWURADE bɔfo fi kokum Asaria nsra mu nnipa ɔpeha aduɔwɔtwe anum; na wɔsɔree anɔpa no, na hwɛ, wɔn nyinaa yɛ afunu.

english_verse: Sennacherib, you cursed, shouted, and sneered at me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Hena na woasopa no na woayaw no? Na hena so na woama wo nne so na woama w’ani atra wo ntɔn? Wode ahyɛ Israel kronkronni no.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And this is how you bragged about yourself: “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: W’abɔfo so na wonam asopa Awurade aka sɛ: Mede me nteaseɛnam dodow no mɛforo makɔ mmepɔw atifi, Lebanon mu noho tɔnn, na metwitwa ne nkyeneduru atenten ne ɔpopaw a ɛyɛ fɛ no agu na makodu n’atenae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri, ne kwaebirentuw mu.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Me na matutu mmura manom amannɔne nsu, na mede manammɔn mu mayow Misraim nsubɔnten nyinaa.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all this long ago. And you don't even realize that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: So wontee sɛ mifi meyɛe akyɛ, na mifi tete mmere mu na mehyɛɛ no saa? Afei na mama aba mu, sɛ wɔnsɛe nkurow a afasu atwa ho ahyia mma ɛnnan akurofo akuwakuw,

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or tender young grass growing on a flat roof, scorched before it matures.
translation_verse: na emufo a wɔagurow no ho adwiriw wɔn na wɔn ani awu, na wɔadannan mfuwa so ahaban ne wura momono, adan atifi wura, ne awi a amma ne ho so na akisa.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: Na w’asetena ne w’adifi ne wo muba no, minim, ɛne wo dam a wobɔ me so no.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ wobɔ me so dam, na w’ahoahoa aforo abedu m’asom nti, mede me darewa mɛhyɛ wo hwenem na mede me nnareka bɛto w’anom, na masan wo mafa ɔkwan a wonam so bae no so akɔ.

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Na eyi nyɛ wo sɛnkyerɛnne: Afe yi mu munni ntwakae a efifii, na afe a ɛto so abien no mu, nea ebedi akyiri aba. Na afe a ɛto so abiɛsa mu no, mungu na muntwa, na montɛw bobe nturo, na munni mu aba.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Na Yuda fi mu wɔn a wɔagye wɔn afi mu a wɔaka no, wobegye ntini bio, na wɔasow aba.
