english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Na Yerusalem nkae bi befi, na nnipa a wɔafi mu anya nkwa nso afi Sion bepɔw so, AWURADE ninkuntwe na ɛbɛyɛ eyi.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Enti sɛ AWURADE se Asaria hene ho ni: Ɔremma kurow yi mu, na ɔrentow agyan mma ha, na ɔremfa ɔkyɛm mmehyia no, na ɔrenhɔre pempe nhyɛ no.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔkwan a ɔnam so bae no so na ɔnam bɛsan akɔ, na kurow yi de, ɔremma mu, AWURADE na ose.

english_verse: I will protect it for myself and for my servant David. The Death of King Sennacherib (Isaiah
translation_verse: Na mɛwaw kurow yi ani magye no, me ara ne m’akoa Dawid nti a! Asiriafo di nkogu

english_verse: After this King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ɛnna Asaria hene Senakerib sii mu sanee, na ɔkɔtenaa Niniwe.

english_verse: Hezekiah died, and his son Manasseh became king.
translation_verse: Na Hesekia wui, na ne ba Manase bedii n’ade.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ao, AWURADE, kae sɛnea manantew w’anim nokware ne koma a ɛyɛ pɛ mu, na mayɛ nea eye w’ani so. Na Hesekia suu osu kɛse.

english_verse: Before Isaiah got to the middle court of the palace,
translation_verse: Na Yesaia nnya mfii mfinimfini abangua no mu no, AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ:

english_verse: the Lord sent him back to Hezekiah with this message: Hezekiah, you are the ruler of my people, and I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will heal you, so that three days from now you will be able to worship in my temple.
translation_verse: San kɔka kyerɛ Hesekia, me man so hwɛfo no, sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE, w’agya Dawid Nyankopɔn se ni: Mate wo mpaebɔ, mahu wo nusu, hwɛ, me na mɛsa wo yare. Da a ɛto so abiɛsa no wobɛforo akɔ AWURADE fi.

english_verse: “What did you show them?” Isaiah asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkae sɛ: Dɛn na wɔahu wo fi? Na Hesekia buae sɛ: Nea ɛwɔ me fi nyinaa, wɔahu; biribi nni m’akorade mu a mamfa mankyerɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Then Isaiah said to the king's servants, “Bring some mashed figs and place them on the king's open sore. He will then get well.”
translation_verse: Na Yesaia se: Momfa borɔdɔma tɔw mmra. Na wɔde ba bɛtaree pɔmpɔ no so, na onyaa nkwa.

english_verse: Isaiah replied, “The Lord will prove to you that he will keep his promise. Will the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway go forward ten steps or back ten steps?”
translation_verse: Na Yesaia se: Eyi nyɛ wo AWURADE nsam sɛnkyerɛnne sɛ AWURADE bɛyɛ ade a waka no: Sunsuma no nkɔ anim ntrapoe du anaasɛ ɛnsan n’akyi ntrapoe du?

english_verse: “It's normal for the sun to go forward,” Hezekiah answered. “But how can it go back?”
translation_verse: Na Hesekia se: Ɛyɛ hare ma sunsuma sɛ esian ntrapoe du, dabi, na ma sunsuma no nsan n’akyi ntrapoe du.

english_verse: Isaiah prayed, and the Lord made the shadow go back ten steps on the stairway built for King Ahaz. The Lord Is Still with Hezekiah (Isaiah
translation_verse: Ɛnna odiyifo Yesaia frɛɛ AWURADE, na ɔmaa sunsuma no san n’akyi ntrapoe du, Ahas owia dɔn so ntrapoe a asian dedaw no so. Hesekia ahokyerɛ

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah had been sick, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Ɛbere no mu no, Babel hene Baladan ba Merodak-baladan somae ma wɔde nhoma ne ayɛyɛde brɛɛ Hesekia, efisɛ ɔtee sɛ Hesekia yaree.

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Na Hesekia gyee wɔn, na ɔkyerɛɛ wɔn n’akorade dan nyinaa, dwetɛ ne sika ne nnuhuam ne ngo pa ne n’akode dan nyinaa ne nea wohu n’akorade mu nyinaa. Biribi nni ne fi ne nea odi so nyinaa mu a Hesekia amfa ankyerɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Isaiah asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Ɛnna odiyifo Yesaia baa ɔhene Hesekia nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nnipa yi se dɛn, na ɛhe na wofi baa wo nkyɛn yi? Na Hesekia se: Wofi akyirikyiri asase bi so na ɛbae, wofi Babel.

english_verse: Then Isaiah told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ Hesekia sɛ: Tie AWURADE asɛm:

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: Hwɛ, nna bi reba a wɔbɛsoa nea ɛwɔ wo fi nyinaa ne nea w’agyanom akora de abedu nnɛ yi akɔ Babel; biribiara renka, AWURADE na ose.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Na wo mma a wobefi wo mu a wobɛwo wɔn no mu binom, wɔbɛfa wɔn na wɔakɔyɛ Babel hene aban mu apiafo.

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told Isaiah, “The message you brought me from the Lord is good.” Hezekiah Dies (
translation_verse: Ɛnna Hesekia ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia sɛ: AWURADE asɛm a woaka no ye. Na ɔkae sɛ: So ɛnyɛ sɛ asomdwoe ne nokware na ɛbɛba me bere so?

english_verse: Everything else Hezekiah did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he made the upper pool and tunnel bring water into Jerusalem, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Hesekia ho nsɛm nkae ne ne mmaninne nyinaa ne sɛnea ɔyɛɛ ɔtare ne suka na ɔde nsu no baa kurow no mu no, wɔakyerɛw Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu.

english_verse: Amon disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Manasseh had done.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sɛnea n’agya Manase yɛe no,

english_verse: Now I, the Lord God of Israel, will destroy both Jerusalem and Judah! People will hear about it but won't believe it.
translation_verse: sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn se ni: Hwɛ, mede bɔne mereba Yerusalem ne Yuda so a obiara a ɔbɛte no, n’aso abien mu bɛyɛ no yɔnn.

english_verse: He rebuilt the local shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He built altars for the god Baal and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah, just as King Ahab of Israel had done. And he faithfully worshiped the stars in heaven.
translation_verse: Na ɔsan sisii sorɔnsorɔmmea a n’agya Hesekia asɛesɛe no no, na osisii afɔremuka maa Baal, na ɔyɛɛ Asera dua sɛnea Israel hene Ahab yɛe no, na ɔsɔree ɔsoro asafo nyinaa na ɔsom wɔn.

english_verse: In the temple, where only the Lord was supposed to be worshiped, Manasseh built altars for the worship of pagan gods
translation_verse: Na osisii afɔremuka AWURADE fi a AWURADE kaa ho asɛm sɛ: Yerusalem na mede me din mɛto hɔ, no mu.

english_verse: and the stars. He placed these altars in both courts of the temple,
translation_verse: Na osisii afɔremuka maa ɔsoro asafo nyinaa AWURADE fi abangua abien no so;

english_verse: and even set up the pole for Asherah there. Manasseh practiced magic and witchcraft; he asked fortunetellers for advice and sacrificed his own son. He did many sinful things and made the Lord very angry. Years ago the Lord had told David and his son Solomon: Jerusalem is the place I prefer above all others in Israel. It belongs to me, and there I will be worshiped forever.
translation_verse: Na ɔde Asera ohoni a ɔyɛe no sii ofi no mu, ofi a AWURADE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Dawid ne ne ba Solomon no sɛ: Ofi yi ne Yerusalem a mayi Israel mmusuakuw nyinaa mu no mu na mede me din mɛto daa;

english_verse: If my people will faithfully obey all the commands in the Law of my servant Moses, I will never make them leave the land I gave to their ancestors.
translation_verse: nanso meremma Israel anan ntu nkyin mfi asase a mede mama wɔn agyanom no so bio. Na nea wɔnyɛ nko ne sɛ: Wɔhwɛ yɛ sɛnea mahyɛ wɔn nyinaa ne sɛ mmara a m’akoa Mose hyɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa te no.

english_verse: But the people of Judah disobeyed the Lord. They listened to Manasseh and did even more sinful things than the nations the Lord had wiped out.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔantie, na Manase de wɔn yerae ma wɔyɛɛ bɔne sen amanaman a AWURADE sɛee wɔn fii Israel anim no.

english_verse: One day the Lord said to some of his prophets:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE nam ne nkoa adiyifo no so kae sɛ:

english_verse: King Manasseh has done more disgusting things than the Amorites, and he has led my people to sin by forcing them to worship his idols.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ Yuda hene Manase ayɛ saa akyide yi, na wayɛ bɔne asen nea Amorifo a wodii n’anim yɛe nyinaa, na ɔde n’abosonhuhu ama Yuda nso ayɛ bɔne nti,

english_verse: Jerusalem is as sinful as Ahab and the people of Samaria were. So I will wipe out Jerusalem and be done with it, just as someone wipes water off a plate and turns it over to dry.
translation_verse: Na mɛtwe Samaria susuhama mu, ne Ahab fi so taahama mu aba Yerusalem so, na mɛpopa Yerusalem mu sɛnea wɔpopa asanka mu, wɔpopa na wɔdan butuw;

english_verse: I will even get rid of my people who survive. They will be defeated and robbed by their enemies.
translation_verse: na mɛpo m’agyapade nkae no, na mede wɔn mahyɛ wɔn atamfo nsa, na wɔayɛ dwow ade ne afow ade ama wɔn atamfo nyinaa,

english_verse: My people have done what I hate and have not stopped making me angry since their ancestors left Egypt.
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔayɛ m’ani so bɔne na wɔahuru me bo fi da a wɔn agyanom fii Misraim bae de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: Manasseh was guilty of causing the people of Judah to sin and disobey the Lord. He also refused to protect innocent people—he even let so many of them be killed that their blood filled the streets of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na mogya a edi bem nso Manase kaa pii pa ara gui kosii sɛ ɔde hyɛɛ Yerusalem ma fi ano kɔpem ano, ɛsono ne bɔne a ɔmaa Yuda yɛe, sɛ wɔyɛɛ nea enye AWURADE ani so no.

english_verse: Everything else Manasseh did while he was king, including his terrible sins, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Manase ho nsɛm nkae ne nea ɔyɛe nyinaa ne ne bɔne a ɔyɛe no, wɔakyerɛw Yuda ahene beresosɛm nhoma no mu.

english_verse: He died and was buried in Uzza Garden near his palace, and his son Amon became king. King Amon of Judah (
translation_verse: Na Manase ne n’agyanom kɔdae, na wosiee no ne fi turo a ɛne Usa turo no mu; na ne ba Amon bedii n’ade. Amon di Yuda so hene (

english_verse: refused to be faithful to the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: na ogyaw AWURADE, n’agyanom Nyankopɔn, na wannantew AWURADE kwan mu.

english_verse: Some of Amon's officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.
translation_verse: Na Amon nkoa pam ne tiri so, na wokum ɔhene no ne fi.

english_verse: Gedaliah said to them, “Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.”
translation_verse: Na Gedalia kaa wɔn ne wɔn mmarima ntam na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Munnsuro Kaldeafo nkoa no, montena asase yi so, na monsom Babel hene, na ebewie mo yiye.

english_verse: Ishmael was from the royal family. And about two months after Gedaliah began his rule, Ishmael and ten other men went to Mizpah. They killed Gedaliah and his officials, including those from Judah and those from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Na ɔsram a ɛto so ason no, Elisama ba Netania ba Ismael a ofi ahemmusua mu bae, na mmarima du ka ne ho, na wɔbɛbobɔɔ Gedalia ma owui, ne Yudafo ne Kaldeafo a wɔka ne ho Mispa no nso.

english_verse: After that, the army officers and all the people in Mizpah, whether important or not, were afraid of what the Babylonians might do. So they left Judah and went to Egypt. Jehoiachin Is Set Free (Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ɛnna nkurɔfo no nyinaa, efi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so, ne dɔm so asafohene no, sɔre kɔɔ Misraim, efisɛ wosuro Kaldeafo no. Ɔdom a wɔde dom Yehoiakin (Yeremia

english_verse: Evil-Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: na ɔne no kasaa ɔkasa pa, na ɔmaa n’agua so ma ɛkyɛn ahene a wɔne no wɔ Babel no agua,

english_verse: Jehoiachin was even allowed to wear regular clothes, and he ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: na ɔma oyii ne dua-mu-nna ntade, na ɔne no didii daa, ne nkwa nna nyinaa;

english_verse: Japheth was the father of Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Yafet mma ne: Gomer ne Magog ne Madai ne Yawan ne Tubal ne Mesek ne Tiras.

english_verse: Abraham and his slave woman Keturah had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Na Abraham yefam Ketura mma: Ɔwoo Simran ne Yoksan ne Medan ne Midian ne Yisbak ne Sua. Na Yoksan mma ne: Seba ne Dedan.

english_verse: Ethiopia was also the father of Nimrod, the world's first mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Na Kus woo Nimrod, ɔno na ofii ase yɛɛ otumfo asase so.

english_verse: Egypt was the ancestor of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
translation_verse: Na Misraim woo Ludim ne Anamfo ne Lehabim ne Naftuhim

english_verse: Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
translation_verse: Na Gomer mma ne: Askenas ne Rifat ne Togarma.

english_verse: Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
translation_verse: Na Yawan mma ne: Elisa ne Tarsis, Kitifo ne Dodanfo.

english_verse: Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Na Kus mma ne: Seba ne Hawila ne Sabta ne Raama ne Sabteka. Na Rama mma ne: Seba ne Dedan.

english_verse: Canaan's oldest son was Sidon; his other son was Heth.
translation_verse: Na Kanaan woo n’abakan Sidon ne Het,

english_verse: Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Sem mma ne: Elam, Asur ne Arfaksad, Lud, Aram, Us, Hul, Geter ne Mesek.

english_verse: Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather.
translation_verse: Na Arfaksad woo Selah, na Selah woo Eber.

english_verse: the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Ebal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: ne Ofir ne Hawila ne Yobab: Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Yoktan mma.

english_verse: Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
translation_verse: Abraham mma ne: Isak ne Ismael.

english_verse: Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. Esau's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: Na Midian mma ne: Efa ne Efer ne Hanok ne Abida ne Eldaa. Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Ketura mma.

english_verse: Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
translation_verse: Na Abraham woo Isak. Isak mma ne: Esau ne Israel. Edomfo awo ntoatoaso ne wɔn ahene (Gyenesis

english_verse: Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation_verse: Esau mma ne: Elifas, Reuel ne Yeus ne Yalam ne Kora.

english_verse: Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah.
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne ahene a wodii Edom asase so ansa na obi dii Israelfo so hene: Beor ba Bela, na ne kurow din de Dinhaba.

english_verse: Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
translation_verse: Na Seir mma ne: Lotan ne Sobal ne Sibon ne Ana ne Dison ne Eser ne Disan.

english_verse: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
translation_verse: Na Lotan mma ne: Hori ne Homam. Na Timna ne Lotan nuabea.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
translation_verse: Sobal mma ne: Alian ne Manahat ne Ebal, Sefi ne Onam. Na Sibon mma ne: Aya ne Ana.

english_verse: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation_verse: Ana mma ne: Dison. Na Dison mma ne Hamran ne Esban ne Yitran ne Keran.

english_verse: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
translation_verse: Eser mma ne: Bilhan ne Saawan ne Yaakan. Dison mma ne: Us ne Aran.

english_verse: After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.
translation_verse: Na Bela wui, na Serah ba Yobab a ofi Bosra bedii n’ade.

english_verse: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.
translation_verse: Na Yobab wui, na Husam a ofi Teman asase so bedii n’ade.

english_verse: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.
translation_verse: Na Husam wui, na Bedad ba Hadad a okum Midian, Moab petee mu no bedii n’ade. Na ne kurow din de Awit.

english_verse: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;
translation_verse: Na Hadad wui, na Samla a ofi Masreka bedii n’ade.

english_verse: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;
translation_verse: Na Samla wui, na Saul a ofi Rehobot a ɛda asu ho bedii n’ade.

english_verse: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.
translation_verse: Na Saul wui, na Akbor ba Baal-hanan bedii n’ade.

english_verse: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
translation_verse: Na Baal-hanan wui, na Hadad bedii n’ade. Na ne kurow din de Pai, na ne yere din de Mehetabel, Me-sahab babea Matred ba.

english_verse: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translation_verse: Na Hadad wui. Na Edom atitiriw ni: Otitiriw Timna, otitiriw Alia, otitiriw Yetet,

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: Otitiriw Oholibama, Otitiriw Ela, otitiriw Pinon,

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: Otitiriw Kenas, Otitiriw Teman, otitiriw Mibsar,

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Yuda mma ne: Er ne Onan ne Sela. Baasa yi na Kanaanni Sua babea wo maa no. Na Yuda abakan Er yɛ AWURADE anim ɔbɔne, na okum no.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Na n’ase Tamar woo Peres ne Serah maa no. Yuda mma nyinaa si baanum.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Peres mma ne: Hesron ne Hamul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Na Serah mma ne: Simri ne Etan ne Heman ne Kalkol ne Dara, wɔn nyinaa si baanum.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Na Etan mma ne: Asaria.

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Na Hesron mma a wɔwoo wɔn maa no ne Yerahmeel ne Ram ne Kelubai.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Ram woo Aminadab, na Aminadab woo Nahson, Yuda mma bapɔmma no,

english_verse: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz,
translation_verse: na Nahson woo Salma, na Salma woo Boas,

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: na wɔn nuammeanom ne Seruia ne Abigail; na Seruia mma ne: Abisai ne Yoab ne Asahel; wosi baasa.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Na Abigail woo Amasa, na Amasa n’agya ne Ismaelni Yeter.

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Na Hesron ba Kaleb ne ne yere Asuba ne Yeriot woe; na ne mma ni: Yeser ne Sobab ne Ardon.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Na Asuba wui, na Kaleb faa Efrat waree, na ɔwoo Hur maa no.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Na Hur woo Uri, na Uri woo Besalel.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Na Hesron wui wɔ Kaleb-efrata akyi no, Hesron yere Abigya woo Ashur a ɔyɛ Tekoa n’agya maa no.

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Na Hesron abakan Yerahmeel mma ne: Abakan Ram ne Buna ne Oren ne Osem ne Ahia.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Na Yerahmeel wɔ ɔyere foforo bi a ne din de Atara, ɔne Onam ne na.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Na Yerahmeel abakan Ram mma ne: Maas ne Yamin ne Eker.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Na Onam mma ne Samai ne Yada. Na Samai mma ne: Nadab ne Abisur.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Na Abisur yere din de Abihail, na ɔwoo Ahban ne Molid maa no.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Na Nadab mma ne: Seled ne Apaim, na Seled wui a wannyaw mma.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Na Apaim mma ne: Yisi. Na Yisi mma ne: Sesan. Na Sesan mma ne: Ahlai.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Na Samai ne nua Yada mma ne: Yeter ne Yonatan. Na Yeter wui a wannyaw mma.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Na Yonatan mma ne: Pelet ne Sasa. Eyinom ne Yerahmeel mma.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Na Sesan de ne babea maa n’akoa Yarha aware, na ɔwoo Atai maa no.

english_verse: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.
translation_verse: Na Atai woo Natan, na Natan woo Sabad.

english_verse: Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron,
translation_verse: Na Yerahmeel ne nua Kaleb mma ne: N’abakan Mesa a ɔne Sif agya, ne Hebron agya Maresa mma.

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Na Hebron mma ne: Kora ne Tapua ne Rekem ne Sema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Na Sema woo Raham, Yorkeam n’agya. Na Rekem woo Samai.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Na Samai ba ne: Maon; na Maon yɛ Bet-sur n’agya.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Na Kaleb yefam Efa woo Haran ne Mosa ne Gases. Na Haran woo Gases.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Na Yahdai mma ne: Regem ne Yotam ne Gesan ne Pelet ne Efa ne Saaf.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Na Kaleb yefam Maaka woo Seber ne Tirhana,

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: na ɔwoo Saaf a ɔyɛ Madmana n’agya, Sewa a ɔyɛ Makbena n’agya, ne Gibea n’agya. Na Kaleb babea ne Aksa.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Na Sobal a ɔyɛ Kiriat-yearim n’agya wɔ mma: Wɔne Haroe ne Menuhotfo fa.

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: Na Kiriat-yearim mmusua ne Yitrifo ne Putifo ne Sumatifo ne Misraifo de no, eyinom mu na Sorafo ne Estaolfo fi.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salma mma ne: Betlehem ne Netofafo, Atrot-bet-yoab ne Manahatfo fa, ne Sorifo no;

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: ne kyerɛwfo mmusua a wɔte Yabes no: Tirafo, Simeafo, Sukafo; wɔne Kenifo a wɔyɛ Hamat a ɔyɛ Rekab fi agya no asefo.

english_verse: more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.
translation_verse: ne ba Ahas, ne ba Hesekia, ne ba Manase,

english_verse: David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: ne Elisama ne Eliada ne Elifelet, wɔyɛ baakron,

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: wɔn nyinaa Dawid mma, ɛsono yefamnom mma. Na Tamar yɛ wɔn nuabea.

english_verse: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Na Yosia mma ne: N’abakan Yohanan. Yehoiakim tia abien, Sedekia to so abiɛsa, Salum to so anan.

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Na Yehoiakim mma ne: Ne ba Yekonia, ne ba Sedekia.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Na Yekonia mma ne: Asir, ne ba Sealtiel,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: ne Malkiram, ne Pedaia, ne Senasar, Yekamia, Hosama, ne Nedabia.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Na Pedaia mma ne: Serubabel ne Simei. Na Serubabel mma ne: Mesulam ne Hanania ne wɔn nuabea Selomit;

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: ne Hasuba, ne Ohel, ne Berekia ne Hasadia, Yusab-hesed, wɔyɛ baanum.

english_verse: Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah,
translation_verse: Na Hanania mma ne: Pelatia ne Yesaia; Refaia mma, Arnan mma, Obadia mma, Sekania mma.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Na Sekania mma ne: Semaia. Na Semaia mma ne: Hatus ne Yigal ne Baria ne Nearia ne Safat, wɔyɛ baasia.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Na Nearia mma ne: Elioenai ne Hiskia ne Asrikam, wɔyɛ baasa.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Na Elioenai mma ne: Hodawia ne Eliasib ne Pelaia ne Akub ne Yohanan ne Delaia ne Anani, wɔyɛ baason.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Yuda mma ne: Peres, Hesron ne Karmi ne Hur ne Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Na Sobal ba Reaia woo Yahat, na Yahat woo Ahumai ne Lahad, eyinom ne Sorafo mmusua.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Na Ashur a ɔyɛ Tekoa n’agya wɔ yerenom baanu, Hela ne Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Na Naara woo Ahusam ne Hefer ne Temeni ne Haahastari maa no; eyinom ne Naara mma.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Na Hela mma ne: Seret, Yesohar ne Etnan.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Na Kos woo Anub ne Sobeba ne Aharhel Harum ba mmusua.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Na Yabes nyaa anuonyam sen ne nuanom; na ne na too no din Yabes sɛ: Mede yaw na ɛwoo no.

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Na Yabes frɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn sɛ: Oo, sɛ anka wubehyira me na woatrɛw me hye mu na wo nsa adi m’akyi na woamma bɔne bi ammɛyɛ me na ɛyaw bi ammɛka me ɛ! Na Onyankopɔn maa nea ɔsrɛe no bae.

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Na Kelub, Suha ne nua, woo Mehir a ɔne Eston agya.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Na Eston woo Bet-rafa ne Pasea ne Tehina, Ir-nahas agya; eyinom ne Reka nkurɔfo.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Na Kenas mma ne: Otniel ne Seraia; na Otniel mma ne: Hatat.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Na Yefune ba Kaleb mma ne: Iru, Ela ne Naam; na Ela mma ne: Kenas.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Na Hodia yere a ɔyɛ Naham ne nuabea mma ne: Garmini Keila n’agya ne Maakatni Estemoa n’agya.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Na Simon mma ne: Amnon ne Rina, Ben-hanan ne Tilon. Na Yisi mma ne: Sohet ne Ben-sohet.

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Wɔn ne nkukunwemfo ne wɔn a wɔte Netaim ne Gedera wɔ ɔhene nkyɛn, n’adwuma mu hɔ na wɔte. Simeon asefo

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simeon mma ne: Nemuel ne Yamin, Yarib, Serah ne Saul;

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: ne ba Salum, ne ba Mibsam, ne ba Misma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Na Misma mma ne: Ne ba Hamuel, ne ba Sakur, ne ba Simei.

english_verse: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.
translation_verse: ne Bet-markabot ne Hasar-susim ne Bet-biri ne Saaraim. Eyinom ne wɔn nkurow beduu Dawid ahenni so.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Na wɔn nkuraa ne Etam ne Ain, Rimon ne Token ne Asan: Nkurow anum;

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: ne wɔn nkuraa a ɛwowɔ nkurow yi ho nyinaa de kosii Baal. Eyi ne wɔn tenabea horow ne wɔn mmusua nkanee.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: eyinom a wɔabobɔ wɔn din yi yɛ wɔn mmusua mu mmapɔmma, na wɔn mpanyimfi trɛwee pii.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: Na wosiim kɔɔ nea wɔnam kɔ Gedor, obon no apuei fam sɛ wɔkɔhwehwɛ adidibea ama wɔn nguan.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Na wohuu adidibea frɔmfrɔm a eye, na asase no mu trɛw haharaa, na ɛso dwo komm; na wɔn a wɔtete hɔ kan no fi Ham.

english_verse: but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
translation_verse: Ɛnna eyinom a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din no kɔe, Yuda hene Hesekia bere so, kɔtoaa Maonfo a wohuu wɔn wɔ hɔ no ne wɔn ntamadan, na wokunkum wɔn pasaa de besii nnɛ, na wɔtenatenaa wɔn afa hɔ, efisɛ adidibea wɔ hɔ ma wɔn nguan.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Na wokokunkum Amalek aguanfo no nkae, na wɔtenaa hɔ de besii nnɛ.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Na Israel abakan Ruben mma, na ɔno ne abakan de, nanso (Sɛ ɔne n’agya mpena bi dae nti, wɔde n’abakanyɛ no maa Israel ba Yosef mma no, enti wɔankyerɛw wɔn abakanyɛ no, anato nhoma mu.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Ruben, Israel abakan no mma ne: Hanok Palu, Hesron ne Karmi.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: ne ba Beera a Asaria hene Tilgat-pilneser tuu no kɔe no; ɔno ne Rubenfo bapɔmma.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Na apuei fam nso ɔtenae de kosii sare a efi asubɔnten Eufrate ho no ano; na wɔn mmoakuw dɔɔso Gilead asase so.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Na Saul bere so no, wɔne Hagarfo dii ako, na wɔtotɔe wɔn nsa ano, na wɔtenatenaa wɔn ntamadan mu Gilead apuei fam nyinaa. Gad asefo: Hagarfo

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Yoel di ti, na Safam di hɔ, ne Yanai ne Safat wɔ Basan.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne Bus ba Yahdo ba Yesisai ba Mikael ba Gilead ba Yaroa ba Huri ba Abihail mma;

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Guni ba Abdiel ba Ahi di wɔn mpanyimfi so ti.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Na wɔtenaa Gilead a ɛwɔ Basan ne ɛso nkurowa mu ne Saron nkuraa nyinaa mu, nea wɔn hye kɔsoe.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɔkyerɛw wɔn nyinaa anato Yuda hene Yotam bere so ne Israel hene Yeroboam bere so.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Na wɔne Hagarfo ne Yetur ne Nafis ne Nodab dii ako,

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: na wonyaa mmoa ne wɔn koe, na wɔde Hagarfo ne wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho no nyinaa hyɛɛ wɔn nsa, efisɛ wɔteɛɛm frɛɛ Onyankopɔn ɔko no mu, na otiee wɔn, sɛ wɔn ani da no so nti.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Na apirafo pii totɔe, na Onyankopɔn nkyɛn na ɛdɔm no fi bae. Na wɔtenatenaa wɔn afa hɔ de kosii otukɔ no mu. Manase abusuakuw fa

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Na Manase abusuakuw fa no mma tenaa asase no so fii Basan de kosii Baal-hermon ne Senir ne Hermon bepɔw ho; wɔdɔɔso.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne wɔn mpanyimfi atitiriw: Efer ne Yisi ne Eliel ne Asriel ne Yeremia ne Hodawia ne Yahdiel, nnɔmmarima a wotumi, nnipa a wɔwɔ din, wɔn mpanyimfi so atitiriw.

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔfom wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn, na wokodii asase no so aman a Onyankopɔn sɛee wɔn, wɔn anim, no anyame akyi aguamammɔ so;

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: ɛnna Israel Nyankopɔn hwanyan Asaria hene Pul ne Asaria hene Tilgat-pilneser honhom, na otuu Rubenfo ne Gadfo ne Manase abusuakuw fa no de wɔn koduaa Hala ne Habor ne Harsa ne asubɔnten Gosan ho de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Na Kehat mma ne: Amram, Yishar ne Hebron ne Usiel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Na Amram mma ne: Aaron ne Mose ne Miriam. Na Aaron mma ne: Nadab ne Abihu, Eleasar ne Itamar.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: na Yosadak de, AWURADE maa Nebukadnesar betuu Yuda ne Yerusalem kɔe no, ɔkɔe bi. Lewi asefo

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Lewi mma: Gersom, Kehat ne Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne Gersom mma din: Libni ne Simei.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Na Kehat mma ne: Amram, Yishar ne Hebron ne Usiel.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi. Na eyinom ne Lewifo mmusua, sɛ wɔn agyanom te no:

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: ne ba Tahat, ne ba Uriel, ne ba Usia ne ne ba Saul.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Na Elkana mma ne: Amasai ne Ahimot,

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: ne ba Eliab, ne ba Yeroham, ne ba Elkana.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Na Samuel mma ne: Abakan Wasni, ne Abigya.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: ne ba Sima, ne ba Hagia, ne ba Asaia. Nnwontofo Heman, Asaf ne Etan

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne wɔn a Dawid de sisii AWURADE fi dwom so, fi bere a adaka no nyaa ahomee no,

english_verse: These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
translation_verse: na wɔde dwonto somee ahyiae ntamadan no tenabea no anim de kosii sɛ Solomon sii AWURADE fi no Yerusalem, na wogyinagyinaa wɔn afa wɔn som no mu.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Na wɔn nuanom, Lewifo no, wɔde wɔn maa Onyankopɔn fi tenabea no som nyinaa.

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ne ne mma ne wɔn a wɔhyew afɔre ɔhyew afɔremuka ne aduhuamhyew muka no so, wɔyɛ kronkronbea adwuma no nyinaa, na wɔpata ma Israel sɛ Onyankopɔn akoa Mose hyɛe no ara.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne wɔn tenabea horow sɛ wɔn nkurow a afasu atwa ho ahyia no te, wɔn ahye mu: Aaron mma, Kehatfo abusua no nyaa wɔn ntonto kyɛfa,

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: na wɔmaa wɔn Hebron, Yuda asase so, ne ɛho mfikyisaase a etwa ho hyia;

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: na kurow no ho mfuw ne ɛho nkuraa no de, wɔde maa Yefune ba Kaleb.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Na Benyamin abusuakuw mu nso: Geba ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Alemet ne ɛho asase, ne Anatot ne ɛho nsaase. Wɔn nkurow nyinaa si dumiɛnsa, wɔn mmusua no mu.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Na Kohat mma nkae no, abusuakuw no abusua mu no, wɔde ntonto maa wɔn nkurow du fi Manase abusuakuw fa no mu.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Na Gersom mma, sɛ wɔn mmusua te no, wɔde Isakar abusuakuw ne Aser abusuakuw ne Naftali abusuakuw ne Manase abusuakuw a ɛwɔ Basan no mu nkurow dumiɛnsa maa wɔn.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Merari mma, sɛ wɔn mmusua te no, wɔde ntonto yii Ruben abusuakuw ne Gad abusuakuw ne Sebulon abusuakuw mu nkurow dumien maa wɔn.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Na Israelfo no de nkurow no ne ɛho mfikyisase momaa Lewifo no,

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: na wɔde ntonto yiyii Yuda mma abusuakuw ne Simeon mma abusuakuw ne Benyamin mma abusuakuw mu nkurow a wɔabobɔ din yi.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Na Kohat mma mmusua no bi nyaa wɔn kyɛfa mu nkurow wɔ Efraim abusuakuw mu,

english_verse: And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
translation_verse: ne Manase abusuakuw fa no mu: Aner ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Bileam ne ɛho asase, wɔde maa Kohat mma a wɔkae no abusua.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Na wɔde Golan a ɛwɔ Basan ne ɛho mfikyisaase ne Astarot ne ɛho asase a ɛwɔ Manase abusuakuw fa no abusua mu no maa Gersom mma;

english_verse: The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: ne Hukok ne ɛho asase, ne Rehob ne ɛho asase;

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: ne Naftali abusuakuw mu: Kedes a ɛwɔ Galilea ne ɛho mfikyisaase, ne Hamon ne ɛho asase, ne Kiriataim ne ɛho asase.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Na wɔde Rimono ne ɛho mfikyisase ne Tabor ne ɛho asase a ɛwɔ Sebulon abusuakuw mu no maa Merari mma nkae;

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Na Isakar mma ne: Tola ne Pua, Yasub ne Simron, wɔyɛ baanan.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Na Tola mma ne: Usi ne Refaia ne Yeriel ne Yahmai ne Yibsam ne Samuel, wɔn na wɔyɛ Tola mpanyimfi atitiriw, mmarima a wotumi, wɔn awo ntoatoaso mu. Dawid bere so na wɔn dodow si ɔpeduonu abien ne ahansia.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Na wɔn agya Efraim gyam wɔn nna pii, na ne nuanom bae bɛkyekyee ne werɛ.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Na Usi mma ne: Yisrahia; na Yisrahia mma ne: Mikael ne Obadia ne Yoel, Yisia, wɔn baanum nyinaa yɛ atitiriw.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Sofa mma ne: Suah ne Harnefer ne Sual ne Beri ne Yimra;

english_verse: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of
translation_verse: Na wɔn nuanom a wofi Isakar mmusua nyinaa mu no nyinaa ano si mmarima akofo ɔpeduɔwɔtwe ason a wɔkan wɔn, sɛ wɔn awo ntoatoaso te no.

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Benyamin de: Bela ne Beker ne Yediael, wɔyɛ baasa.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Na Bela mma ne: Esbon ne Usi ne Usiel ne Yerimot ne Iri, wɔyɛ baanum, wɔn mpanyimfi so atitiriw, mmarima akofofo. Wɔn nkanee si ɔpeduonu abien ne aduasa anan.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Na Beker mma ne: Semira ne Yoas ne Eliesa ne Elioenai ne Omri ne Yeremot ne Abigya ne Anatot ne Alamet. Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Beker mma.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Na Efraim mma ne: Sutela ne Bered, ne ba, ne Tahat, ne ba, ne Elada, ne ba, ne Tahat, ne ba,

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Na Yediael mma ne: Bilhan. Na Bilhan mma ne: Yeus ne Benyamin ne Ehud ne Kenaana ne Setan ne Tarsis ne Ahisahar.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: na Ulam mma ne: Bedan. Eyinom ne Manase ba Makir ba Gilead mma.

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Naftali mma ne: Yahsiel ne Guni ne Yeser ne Salum, Bilha mma.

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manase mma ne: Asriel a ne yere woo no, na ne yefam Aramni woo Makir a ɔyɛ Gilead n’agya; na Makir waree Hupim ne Supim nuabea a ne din de Maaka.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Na ne babarima a otia abien din de Selofehad; na Selofehad nyaa mmabea [nko].

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Na Makir yere Maaka woo babarima a ɔtoo no din Peres, na ne nua din de Seres. Na ne mma ne: Ulam ne Rakem;

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Na ne nuabea Moleket woo Is-dod ne Abieser ne Mahla.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Na Semida mma ne: Ahian ne Sekem ne Likhi ne Aniam.

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: ne Sabad, ne ba, ne Sutela, ne ba, ne Eser ne Elad. Na Gat mmarima a wɔwoo wɔn asase no so no kum wɔn, efisɛ wosian kɔe sɛ wɔkɔfa wɔn mmoakuw akɔ.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔɔ ne yere ho, na onyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Beria, efisɛ adebɔne na ɛbaa ne fi.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Na ne babea ne Seera a ɔkyekyee anafo ne atifi Bet-horon ne Usen-seera.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Na ne ba ne Refa ne Resef, ne ba Tela, ne ba Tahan,

english_verse: Nun, and Joshua.
translation_verse: ne ba Nun, ne ba Yosua.

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Na wɔn agyapade ne wɔn tenabea ne Betel ne ɛho nkurowa ne apuei fam Naaran ne atɔe fam Geser ne ɛho nkurowa ne Sekem ne ɛho nkurowa kodu Gasa ne ɛho nkurowa.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Na Manase mma nkyɛn mu no, wɔwɔ Bet-sean ne ɛho nkurowa, Tanak ne ɛho nkurowa, Megido ne ɛho nkurowa, Dor ne ɛho nkurowa. Eyinom mu na Israel ba Yosef mma te.

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Aser mma ne: Yimna ne Yiswa ne Yiswi ne Beria ne wɔn nuabea Sera.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Na Beria mma ne: Heber ne Malkiel, ɔne Birsait agya.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Na Heber woo Yaflet ne Somer ne Hotam ne wɔn nuabea Sua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Na Yaflet mma ne: Pasak ne Bimhal ne Aswat. Eyinom ne Yaflet mma.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Na Semer mma ne: Ahi ne Rohga, Yehuba ne Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Na ne nua Helem mma ne: Sofa ne Yimna ne Seles ne Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: Beser ne Hod ne Sama ne Silsa ne Yitran ne Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Na Yeter mma ne: Yefune ne Pispa ne Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Na Ula mma ne: Arah ne Haniel ne Risia.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Aser mma mpanyimfi so atitiriw, mmarima akofofo a wɔapaw wɔn, mmapɔmma mu atitiriw; na wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa ɔsakɔ sɛnea wɔn awo ntoatoaso te no si mmarima ɔpeduonu asia.

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Na Benyamin woo Bela, n’abakan, Asbel a otia abien, ne Ahara a ɔto so abiɛsa,

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Na Bela mma ne: Adar ne Gera ne Abihud,

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: ne Abisua ne Naaman ne Ahoa,

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: ne Gera ne Sefufan ne Huram.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Na Elpaal mma ne: Eber ne Misam ne Semed a ɔkyekyee Ono ne Lod ne ɛho nkurowa,

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: ne Beria ne Sema, wɔn ne Ayalonfo agyanom atitiriw, wɔn na wɔpam Gatfo.

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
translation_verse: ne Mikael ne Yispa ne Yoha ne Beria mma.

english_verse: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: ne Ismerai ne Yislia ne Yobab ne Elpaal mma.

english_verse: Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.
translation_verse: ne Adaia ne Beraia ne Simrat ne Simei mma.

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: ne Yaaresia ne Elia ne Sikri ne Yeroham mma.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne agyanom atitiriw, wɔn awo ntoatoaso so atitiriw. Eyinom tenaa Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wɔtenaa Gibeon ne Gibeon n’agya [Yeiel] a ne yere din de Maaka,

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: ne n’abakan Abdon ne Sur ne Kis ne Baal ne Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: ne Gedor ne Ahio ne Seker.

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: Na Miklot woo Simea; na wɔn nso tenaa wɔn nuanom ntentenso, Yerusalem, kaa wɔn nuanom ho.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Na Ner woo Kis, na Kis woo Saul, na Saul woo Yonatan ne Malkisua ne Abinadab ne Esbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Na Yonatan ba ne Merib-baal, na Merib-baal woo Mika.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Na Mika mma ne: Piton ne Melek ne Tarea ne Ahas.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Na Ahas woo Yehoada, na Yehoada woo Alemet ne Asmawet ne Simri. Na Simri woo Mosa.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Na Asel woo mmammarima baasia, na wɔn din ni: Asrikam, Bokeru ne Ismael ne Searia ne Obadia ne Hana. Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Asel mma.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Na ne nua Esek mma ne: N’abakan Ulam, Yeus a otia abien, ne Elifelet a ɔto so abiɛsa.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Na Ulam mma yɛ mmarima ahoɔdenfo a wotumi, wokuntun ta, na wɔwɔ mma bebree ne mmanananom ɔha aduonum. Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Benyamin mma asefo.

english_verse: And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites.
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wɔtenaa asase no so kan, wɔn agyapade mu, wɔn nkurow mu ne Israel, asɔfo, Lewifo ne nsɔfokwaa.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na Yerusalem de, Yuda mma ne Benyamin mma ne Efraim ne Manase mma no mu binom na wɔtenatenaa hɔ:

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Na aponanohwɛfo no: Salum ne Akub ne Talmon ne Ahiman ne wɔn nuanom; Salum na odi ti.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: Na ɛde besi sesɛɛ wɔwɔ ɔhene pon ano apuei fam, wɔn ne Lewi mma nsra ano ahwɛfo.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Kora ba Ebiasaf ba Kore ba Salum ne ne nuanom a wofi n’agya fi, Korafo no, na ɛwɔ ɔsom adwuma no so wɛn ntamadan no pon ano, se wɔn agyanom hwɛɛ AWURADE nsra no so wɛn emu hyɛn no.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Na Eleasar ba Pinehas na odi wɔn so bapɔmma kan no, na AWURADE dii n’akyi.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Meselemia ba Sakaria ne ahyiae ntamadan no ponanohwɛfo.

english_verse: and now they guarded the temple gates.
translation_verse: Na wɔne wɔn mma wɔ apon no ano AWURADE fi, ntamadan fi no, wɛn;

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: mframa anan no ano na apon ano hwɛfo no wɔ, apuei, atɔe, atifi fam ne anafo fam.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛsɛ wɔn nuanom a wɔwɔ wɔn nkuraa ase no sɛ wɔba nnanson nnanson bɛka eyinom ho;

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔde adwuma no ahyɛ aponanohwɛfo mpanyin baanan, Lewifo no, nsa, na wɔn na wɔhwɛ Onyankopɔn fi mpumpunu ne adekora adan no so.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn fi no ho ho na wɔtetee hyia anadwo, na wɔn so na ɔwɛn no da, na wɔn nso na wohiɛhiɛ daa anɔpa.

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Na wɔn mu binom hwɛ ɔsom nneɛma no so, na wobu ano de ba mu, na wobu ano de fi adi.

english_verse: But only the priests could mix the spices.
translation_verse: Na asɔfo mma no binom de nneɛma frafra yɛ nnuhuam sra ngo no.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Na Matitia a ofi Lewi mma mu a ɔyɛ Korani Salum abakan no, wɔde no sii kyew nnade mu atode to so.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na Kehatfo mma a wɔyɛ wɔn nuanom no mu binom hwɛ kyerɛ abodoo no so, siesie no daa homeda.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Na eyinom ne nnwontofo no, Lewifo mu agyanom atitiriw a wɔte mpumpunu no mu, nyɛ adwuma foforo biara, efisɛ wɔyɛ adwuma no awia ne anadwo.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Eyinom ne Lewifo mu agyanom atitiriw, atitiriw sɛ wɔn mmusua te. Eyinom na wɔtete Yerusalem. Gibeonfo: Saul fifo (

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: Na Miklot woo Simea. Na wɔn nso tenaa wɔn nuanom ntentenso Yerusalem, wɔne wɔn nuanom.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wɔte Gibeon ne Gibeon agya Yeiel, na ne yere din de Maaka;

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: na n’abakan Abdon, ne Sur ne Kis ne Baal ne Ner ne Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: ne Gedor ne Ahio ne Sakaria ne Miklot.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Na Ner woo Kis, na Kis woo Saul, na Saul woo Yonatan ne Malkisua ne Abinadab ne Esbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Na Mika mma ne: Piton ne Melek ne Tahrea ne Ahas.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Na Asel wɔ mmammarima baasia, na wɔn din ni: Asrikam, Bokeru ne Ismael ne Searia ne Obadia ne Hanan. Eyinom ne Asel mma.

english_verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: Mfiase no Onyankopɔn bɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase.

english_verse: The earth was barren, with no form of life; it was under a roaring ocean covered with darkness. But the Spirit of God was moving over the water. The First Day
translation_verse: Na asase yɛ basaa a na ɛda mpan, na sum kata bun no ani, na Onyankopɔn Honhom butuw nsu no ani.

english_verse: God said, “I command light to shine!” And light started shining.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn hyɛe se, “Ɛnyɛ hann,” na ɛyɛɛ hann.

english_verse: God looked at the light and saw that it was good. He separated light from darkness
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn huu sɛ hann no ye, na ɔtew hann no fii sum no ho.

english_verse: and named the light “Day” and the darkness “Night.” Evening came, then morning—that was the first day. The Second Day
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn frɛɛ hann no se, “adekyee,” na sum no nso se, “adesae.” Ade sae na ade kyee, da a edi kan ne no.

english_verse: God said, “I command a dome to separate the water above it from the water below it.”
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn kae se, “Nkyemu mmra nsu no ntam, na ɛnkyekyɛ nsu no mu.”

english_verse: and named it “Sky.” Evening came, then morning—that was the second day. The Third Day
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn too atifi nkyɛmu no din wim. Na ade sae, na ade kyee; eyi ne da a ɛto so abien.

english_verse: God said, “I command the water under the sky to come together in one place, so there will be dry ground.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn kae se, “Nsu a ɛwɔ nkyɛmu no ase no ano mmoa wɔ faako, na asase kesee nna ne ho adi.” Na ɛyɛɛ saa.

english_verse: God named the dry ground “Land,” and he named the water “Ocean.” God looked at what he had done and saw that it was good.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn too beae kesee ne din “asase.” Na nsu a ɛboaa ne ho ano no nso, ɔtoo no din “ɛpo.” Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.

english_verse: God said, “I command the earth to produce all kinds of plants, including fruit trees and grain.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Afei Onyankopɔn kae se, “Afifide mfifi wɔ asase so; afifide a ɛsow aba, nnuaba ahorow a ɛsow aba ne nea nʼaba hyehyɛ mu nyinaa mfifi wɔ asase so.” Na ɛyɛɛ saa.

english_verse: The earth produced all kinds of vegetation. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Afifide a ɛsow aba ne nnua fifii wɔ asase so na nʼaba no nyin yɛɛ nnua ne afifide sɛ ne sɛso. Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the third day. The Fourth Day
translation_verse: Na ade sae, na ade kyee. Eyi ne da a ɛto so abiɛsa.

english_verse: God said, “I command lights to appear in the sky and to separate day from night and to show the time for seasons, special days, and years.
translation_verse: Na Onyankopɔn kae se, “Hann mmra nkyɛmu a ɛwɔ wim no mu, na ɛmmɛpae adekyee ne adesae mu. Na ɛmmɛyɛ nnyinaso mma bere nkyekyɛmu, nna ne mfe,

english_verse: I command them to shine on the earth.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: na ɛmma hann mmra nkyɛmu a ɛwɔ wim no mu, na ahyerɛn wɔ asase so.” Na ɛyɛɛ saa.

english_verse: God made two powerful lights, the brighter one to rule the day and the other to rule the night. He also made the stars.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn yɛɛ akanea akɛse abien a ɛyɛ owia ne ɔsram sɛ, owia no nni adekyee so na ɔsram no nni anadwo so. Ɔbɔɔ nsoromma nso.

english_verse: Then God put these lights in the sky to shine on the earth,
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn de akanea akɛse abien yi sii nkyɛmu a ɛwɔ wim no mu sɛ ɛnhyerɛn wɔ asase so,

english_verse: to rule day and night, and to separate light from darkness. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: na wonni adekyee ne adesae no so, na ɛntew hann no mfi sum no ho. Na Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fourth day. The Fifth Day
translation_verse: Na ade sae, na ade kyee. Da a ɛto so anan ne no.

english_verse: God said, “I command the ocean to be full of living creatures, and I command birds to fly above the earth.”
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn kae se, “Abɔde a nkwa wɔ mu nhyɛ nsu no ma, na nnomaa ntu mfa asase ne nkyɛmu a ɛwɔ wim no so.”

english_verse: So God made the giant sea monsters and all the living creatures that swim in the ocean. He also made every kind of bird. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Enti Onyankopɔn bɔɔ po mu mmoa akɛse ne mmoa ahorow nyinaa a wɔwɔ nkwa na wɔkeka wɔn ho ne nnomaa ahorow nyinaa. Na Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.

english_verse: Then he gave the living creatures his blessing—he told the ocean creatures to increase and live everywhere in the ocean and the birds to increase everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn hyiraa abɔde no nyinaa so, kae se, “Monwo na monyɛ bebree na monhyɛ po no mu nsu no ma, na nnomaa ase ntrɛw wɔ asase so.”

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fifth day. The Sixth Day
translation_verse: Na ade sae, na ade kyee. Da a ɛto so anum ne no.

english_verse: God said, “I command the earth to give life to all kinds of tame animals, wild animals, and reptiles.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn kae se, “Abɔde a nkwa wɔ mu ahorow nyinaa ne wɔn sɛso, anantwi ne mmoa a wɔwea wɔn afuru so ne mmoa ahorow a wɔyɛ keka a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa mmra asase so.” Na ɛyɛɛ saa.

english_verse: God made every one of them. Then he looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn bɔɔ mmoa ahorow, anantwi ahorow ne wɔn sɛso ne mmoa a wɔwea wɔn afuru so ne wɔn sɛso. Na Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.

english_verse: God said, “Now we will make humans, and they will be like us. We will let them rule the fish, the birds, and all other living creatures.”
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn kae se, “Momma yɛmmɔ onipa sɛ yɛn sɛso, na onni po mu mpataa, wim nnomaa, anantwi ne mmoa a wɔyɛ keka ne biribiara a ɛwea nʼafuru so wɔ asase so no so.”

english_verse: So God created humans to be like himself; he made men and women.
translation_verse: Enti Onyankopɔn bɔɔ onipa sɛ ne sɛso; Onyankopɔn sɛso so na ɔbɔɔ wɔn; ɔbarima ne ɔbea na ɔbɔɔ wɔn.

english_verse: God gave them his blessing and said: Have a lot of children! Fill the earth with people and bring it under your control. Rule over the fish in the ocean, the birds in the sky, and every animal on the earth.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn hyiraa wɔn, ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Monwo na monyɛ asase so ma, na munni biribiara so. Munni po mu mpataa ne wim nnomaa ne abɔde biara a nkwa wɔ mu a ɛwɔ asase so no nyinaa so.”

english_verse: And I have given the green plants as food for everything else that breathes, including animals, both wild and tame, and birds. And so it was.
translation_verse: Mede nhabammono nyinaa ama aboa biara a ɔwɔ asase so, anomaa biara a ɔwɔ wim, biribiara a ɛwea nʼafuru so, biribiara a nkwa wɔ mu wɔ asase so sɛ wɔn aduan.” Na ɛyɛɛ saa.

english_verse: God looked at what he had done. All of it was very good! Evening came, then morning—that was the sixth day.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ nea wayɛ nyinaa huu sɛ ɛyɛ papa. Na ade sae, na ade kyee. Eyi ne da a ɛto so asia.

english_verse: So the heavens and the earth and everything else were created. The Seventh Day
translation_verse: Eyi ne ɔkwan a Onyankopɔn faa so bɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa.

english_verse: By the seventh day God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Eduu da a ɛto so ason no, na Onyankopɔn awie nnwuma a ofii ase yɛe no nyinaa. Enti da a ɛto so ason no, ogyee nʼahome.

english_verse: God blessed the seventh day and made it special, because on that day he rested from his work.
translation_verse: Enti Onyankopɔn hyiraa da a ɛto so ason no, na ɔtew ho, efisɛ saa da no na Onyankopɔn gyee nʼahome fii adebɔ nnwuma no nyinaa mu.

english_verse: That's how God created the heavens and the earth. The Garden of Eden When the Lord God made the heavens and the earth,
translation_verse: Eyi ne ɔsoro ne asasebɔ ho asɛm. Bere a Awurade Nyankopɔn bɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase no.

english_verse: no grass or plants were growing anywhere. God had not yet sent any rain, and there was no one to work the land.
translation_verse: Na afifide biara nni asase so, na wuram nnua biara nso nni hɔ. Efisɛ, na Awurade Nyankopɔn mmaa osu ntɔɔ wɔ asase so, na onipa nso nni asase so a ɔbɛyɛ so adwuma.

english_verse: But streams came up from the ground and watered the earth.
translation_verse: Nanso nsuti puepue fifii asase mu bɛfɔw asase ani nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord God took some soil from the ground and made a man. God breathed life into the man, and the man started breathing.
translation_verse: Awurade Nyankopɔn de asase no so dɔte nwen onipa, na ɔhomee nkwa home guu ne hwenem, maa onipa no bɛyɛɛ ɔteasefo.

english_verse: The Lord made a garden in a place called Eden, which was in the east, and he put the man there.
translation_verse: Afei Awurade Nyankopɔn yɛɛ turo wɔ Eden apuei fam, na ɛhɔ na ɔde onipa a ɔnwen no no tenae.

english_verse: The Lord God filled the garden with all kinds of beautiful trees and fruit trees. Two other trees were in the middle of the garden. One of these gave life—the other gave the wisdom to know the difference between right and wrong.
translation_verse: Awurade Nyankopɔn maa nnua ahorow nyinaa fifi fii asase no mu; nnua a ɛyɛ fɛ na wodi. Na nkwa dua ne papa ne bɔnehu dua sisi turo no mfimfini.

english_verse: From Eden a river flowed out to water the garden, then it divided into four rivers.
translation_verse: Na asu sen fii Eden bɛfɔw turo no mu afifide no; efi hɔ a, na saa asu no mu apaapae ayɛ nsubɔnten anan.

english_verse: The first one is the Pishon River that flows through the land of Havilah,
translation_verse: Wɔtoo asu a apaapae no mu nea edi kan no din Pison. Na ɛkɔntɔn fa Hawila asase a sikakɔkɔɔ wɔ so no so nyinaa.

english_verse: where pure gold, rare perfumes, and precious stones are found.
translation_verse: Na saa asase no so sikakɔkɔɔ ye. Na ɛhyɛ a ɛyɛ huam ne apopobibiribo nso wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: The second is the Gihon River that winds through Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Asubɔnten a ɛto so abien no din de Gihon. Na ɛno ara na ɛkɔntɔnkɔntɔn fa Kus asase ho nyinaa.

english_verse: The Tigris River that flows east of Assyria is the third, and the fourth is the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Asu a ɛto so abiɛsa no, na wɔfrɛ no Tigris a ɛsen kɔ asase kɛse Asiria apuei fam no. Asu a ɛto so anan no nso, na wɔfrɛ no Eufrate.

english_verse: The Lord God put the man in the Garden of Eden to take care of it and to look after it.
translation_verse: Awurade Nyankopɔn faa onipa no de no kɔtenaa Eden turo mu hɔ sɛ ɔnyɛ mu adwuma, na ɔnhwɛ so.

english_verse: But the Lord told him, “You may eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: Na Awurade Nyankopɔn bɔɔ onipa no kɔkɔ se, “Wowɔ ho kwan sɛ wudi dua biara so aba wɔ turo yi mu ha;

english_verse: except the one that has the power to let you know the difference between right and wrong. If you eat any fruit from that tree, you will die before the day is over!”
translation_verse: nanso wunni ho kwan sɛ wudi papa ne bɔnehu dua no so aba. Da a wubedi no, nea ɛbɛyɛ biara no, wubewu.” Onyankopɔn Bɔ Hawa

english_verse: The Lord God said, “It isn't good for the man to live alone. I will make a suitable partner for him.”
translation_verse: Afei Awurade Nyankopɔn kae se, “Enye sɛ onipa nko tena; mɛbɔ ɔboafo a ɔfata no ama no.”

english_verse: So the Lord God made him fall into a deep sleep, and he took out one of the man's ribs. Then after closing the man's side,
translation_verse: Enti Awurade Nyankopɔn maa onipa daa nnahɔɔ. Bere a onipa daa saa no, oyii ne mfe mu mparow baako, na ɔde honam taree baabi a oyii mparow hɔ no.

english_verse: the Lord made a woman out of the rib. The Lord God brought her to the man,
translation_verse: Afei Awurade Nyankopɔn de mfe mu mparow baako a oyi fii onipa mu no bɔɔ ɔbea, de no maa onipa no.

english_verse: and the man exclaimed, “Here is someone like me! She is part of my body, my own flesh and bones. She came from me, a man. So I will name her Woman!”
translation_verse: Na Adam kae se, “Mʼankasa me dompe ne me honam bi ni. Wɔbɛfrɛ oyi ɔbea efisɛ ɔbarima mu na woyii no fii.”

english_verse: That's why a man will leave his own father and mother. He marries a woman, and the two of them become like one person.
translation_verse: Eyi nti na ɔbarima gyaw nʼagya ne ne na de ne ho kɔbɔ ne yere ho sɛnea wɔn baanu no bɛyɛ nnipa koro.

english_verse: Although the man and his wife were both naked, they were not ashamed.
translation_verse: Saa bere no, na ɔbarima ne ne yere nyinaa ho da hɔ, nanso na wɔmfɛre.

english_verse: The snake was sneakier than any of the other wild animals that the Lord God had made. One day it came to the woman and asked, “Did God tell you not to eat fruit from any tree in the garden?”
translation_verse: Na ɔwɔ yɛ ɔdaadaafo wɔ wuram mmoadoma a Awurade Nyankopɔn abɔ wɔn no nyinaa mu. Ɔwɔ no kɔɔ ɔbea no nkyɛn kobisaa no se, “Enti ɛyɛ ampa ara sɛ, Onyankopɔn se, ‘Munnni turo yi mu aduaba biara?’ ”

english_verse: The woman answered, “God said we could eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: Ɔbea no buaa ɔwɔ se, “Yetumi di nnua a ɛwɔ turo yi mu no so aduaba biara,

english_verse: except the one in the middle. He told us not to eat fruit from that tree or even to touch it. If we do, we will die.”
translation_verse: nanso Onyankopɔn kae se, ‘Ɛnsɛ sɛ yedi dua a esi turo no mfimfini no so aduaba, na ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛde yɛn nsa mpo ka, anyɛ saa a yebewu.’ ”

english_verse: “No, you won't!” the snake replied.
translation_verse: Na ɔwɔ no ka kyerɛɛ ɔbea no se, “Morenwuwu.

english_verse: “God understands what will happen on the day you eat fruit from that tree. You will see what you have done, and you will know the difference between right and wrong, just as God does.”
translation_verse: Mmom, Onyankopɔn nim sɛ, da a mubedi no ara pɛ, mo ani bɛba mo ho so, ama moayɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn, na moahu papa ne bɔne.”

english_verse: The woman stared at the fruit. It looked beautiful and tasty. She wanted the wisdom that it would give her, and she ate some of the fruit. Her husband was there with her, so she gave some to him, and he ate it too.
translation_verse: Bere a ɔbea no huu sɛ dua a esi mfimfini no so aba no wodi a, ɛbɛyɛ yie, na ɛyɛ akɔnnɔ, na afei ɛtew ani no, ɔtew bi dii, de bi maa ne kunu a na ɔne no wɔ hɔ no, maa ɔno nso dii.

english_verse: At once they saw what they had done, and they realized they were naked. Then they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.
translation_verse: Wodi wiee no, wɔn baanu ani baa wɔn ho so, na wohuu sɛ wɔn nyinaa da adagyaw. Enti wɔkekaa nhaban sisii anim, de kataa wɔn adagyaw so.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon, when the breeze began to blow, the man and woman heard the Lord God walking in the garden. So they hid behind some trees. Sin Brings a Curse
