translation_verse: me nso, metia mo apɛde, na me ara mʼankasa mɛtwe mo aso mpɛn ason wɔ mo bɔne ho.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Menam ɔko so bebu mʼapam so ako atia mo de atua mo so ka. Mubeguan akɔ mo nkurow mu, na mede nyarewa bɛtoa mo wɔ hɔ. Na mo atamfo bedi mo so.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Mɛsɛe mo nnuan a mubenya nyinaa akosi sɛ mpo, fononoo baako brodo a ɛbɛto no na mmusuakuw du bedi. Aduan kakra a mubedi no akyi, ɔkɔm bɛde mo.

english_verse: Then if you don't stop rebelling,
translation_verse: “ ‘Na sɛ mokɔ so yɛ asoɔden a,

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: mo bɔne nti, me bo befuw mo na matwe mo aso a emu yɛ den mmɔho ason.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mɛsɛe mo sorɔnsorɔmmea. Metwitwa mo aduhuam afɔremuka agu, na mahyehyɛ mo afunu wɔ mo ahoni a enni nkwa no so; na mɛpo mo.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mɛma mo nkurow ayɛ amamfo na masɛe baabi a mosom nyinaa, na mapo mo ohuam afɔrebɔ no.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, mɛma mo asase so ada mpan na mo atamfo atena so, na nea mɛyɛ mo no ayɛ mo nwonwa.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Mɛbɔ mo apete aman no a morekɔ so nyinaa so, na mede ɔko asɛe mo. Mo asase bɛda mpan na wɔasɛe mo nkurow.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Bere a asase no da mpan nyinaa, ebenya home a moamma annya wɔ Homeda dodow a motenaa so no.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Obiara rentaa wɔn nanso ehu nti, wobehintihintiw wɔn ho wɔn ho te sɛnea wɔreguan afi akono a wonni tumi biara a wɔde begyina wɔn atamfo anim no.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Mobɛyera wɔ aman mu, na mo atamfo asɛe mo.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔbɛka no, wɔn bɔne nti, wɔn ho bɛyeraw wɔn wɔ atamfo nsase so, bɔne a wɔn agyanom yɛe no nti.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: Sɛ me nso mitia wɔn sɛ nea ɛsɛ na mede wɔn kɔ wɔn atamfo asase so a, afei, wɔn komaden no ano bɛbrɛ ase, na wobetua wɔn bɔne so ka.

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: Afei, mɛkae apam a mene Yakob, Isak ne Abraham ayɛ, na mɛkae asase no.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Asase no da hɔ dinn no, ebedi ne homeda. Nanso akyiri no, wobenya wɔn asotwe sɛ wɔanni me nhyehyɛe so na wɔpoo mʼahyɛde.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Na nea wɔyɛɛ no nyinaa akyi no, merensɛe wɔn ne mʼapam no korakora, efisɛ mene Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Mɛkae tete apam a me ne wɔn agyanom a miyii wɔn fii Misraim, bere a amanaman nyinaa rehwɛ no yɛe no. Me Awurade ne wɔn Nyankopɔn.’ ”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne mmara ne ahyɛde a Awurade nam Mose so de maa Israelfo no wɔ Sinai Bepɔw so no.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo no se, ‘Sɛ onipa bi hyɛ bɔ sɛ ɔde obi bɛma Awurade a, na sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ otua sika mmom a,

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Ɔbarima a wadi boro mfe aduosia no wobetua dwetɛ gram ɔha aduoson (

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: “ ‘Asase no so nnɔbae nkyɛmu du mu baako, sɛ ɛyɛ aburow anaa aduaba no yɛ Awurade dea. Ɛyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔsesa saa aboa no. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔde nea eye sesa nea enye anaa sɛ ɔde nea enye sesa nea eye. Sɛ ɛba sɛ wɔyɛ saa nsesae yi a, wɔbɛfa no sɛ mmoa abien no nyinaa ho tew.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Na sɛ obi yɛ ohiani a ɔrentumi ntua saa sika yi a, ɔde saa onipa no bɛba ɔsɔfo anim, na ɔsɔfo no akyerɛ no sika a obetumi atua.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ ɔde aboa hyɛ bɔ sɛ afɔrebɔde a ɛfata ma Awurade a, saa aboa no a ɔde ama Awurade no bɛyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Sɛ aboa a ɔde rema Awurade no ho ntew na ɛmfata sɛ wɔde yɛ afɔrebɔde ma Awurade a, ɛsɛ sɛ ne wura no de brɛ ɔsɔfo,

english_verse: If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ obi de ne fi ma Awurade na sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsan gye a, ɔsɔfo no bɛsese ahu sɛ eye anaasɛ enye. Bo biara a ɔsɔfo no bɛkyerɛ no na ɛsɛ sɛ wotua.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ ɔbarima bi pɛ sɛ ɔde nʼabusua asase fa bi bɔ afɔre ma Awurade a, wobegyina aba kɛntɛnma dodow a ebehia sɛ wobedua wɔ so no so atwa asase no bo; aba kɛntɛnma biara bo yɛ dwetɛ gram ahannum ne aduoson (

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Mfirihyia Aduonum Afahyɛ mu no, sɛ obi de nʼafuw kyɛ a, ne bo no rensesa.

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔde asase no ma wɔ Mfirihyia Aduonum Afahyɛ no akyi a, ɔsɔfo no begyina mfe a aka ansa na Mfirihyia Aduonum Afahyɛ a edi so no so asese ne bo no, na wobetumi atew so.

english_verse: If you decide to buy back the land, you must pay the price plus an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbarima no pɛ sɛ ogye nʼasase a, ɔsɔfo no bo a ɔbɛbɔ no, obetua ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonu aka ho ansa na asase no abɛyɛ ne dea bio.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔdan asase no ma wɔ Mfirihyia Aduonum Afahyɛ no mu a, ɛbɛyɛ asase kronkron. Wɔde bɛto hɔ ama Awurade. Ɛbɛyɛ asɔfo no agyapade.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ obi de asase a watɔ ma Awurade, na sɛ asase no nyɛ nʼabusua asase a,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: ɔsɔfo no begyina mfe a aka ama wɔadi Mfirihyia Aduonum Afahyɛ no so asese ne bo. Ɛsɛ sɛ onipa ko no tua ka no da no ara, na ɛyɛ afɔrebɔde kronkron ma Awurade.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Mfirihyia Aduonum Afahyɛ no du so a, asase no bɛsan akɔ nea ɔtɔnee no anaasɛ nea na ɔyɛ asase no wura no nkyɛn.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Wɔbɛsese ho ka no nyinaa wɔ nnwetɛbona a wogye wɔ hyiadan mu no ho, a ɛyɛ gram dubaako.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɛnsɛ sɛ obiara de aboa bi abakan ma Awurade, efisɛ abakan biara, sɛ ɔyɛ nantwi anaa oguan no, yɛ Awurade de dedaw.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ade biara a wɔde ama Awurade no, sɛ ɛyɛ nnipa, mmoa anaa abusuasase no, ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔtɔn anaa wɔsan gye, efisɛ biribiara a ɛte saa no yɛ kronkron ma Awurade.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: “ ‘Onipa biara a Awurade ayi no ama ɔsɛe no, wɔmmfa biribi ntua ne ti ka. Ɛsɛ sɛ wokum no.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔsan tɔ saa aduaba anaa aburow no a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde ne bo nkyɛmu anum mu baako ka ho.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Anantwi ne nguan no ntotoso du du nyinaa, aboa biara a ɔto so du a ɔfa oguanhwɛfo nsam no yɛ kronkron ma Awurade.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Aboa a ɔto so du a wɔde bɛma Awurade no, wɔnnhwɛ sɛ oye anaa onye, na wɔmmfa biribiara nsi nʼanan mu, efisɛ sɛ wɔde biribiara si anan mu a, ne nyinaa bɛyɛ kronkron, a obiara rentumi nnye bio.’ ”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne ahyɛde a Awurade de maa Mose wɔ Sinai Bepɔw so sɛ ɔnka nkyerɛ Israelfo no.

translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: ɔbarima no de ne yere no bɛkɔ ɔsɔfo anim a ɔbea no ho afɔrebɔde a ɛyɛ atokosiam a wɔmfaa ohuam ngo mfrae lita abien ka ho. Efisɛ ɛyɛ ninkutwe afɔrebɔ. Ɛno na ɛbɛma nokware ada adi ama wɔahu sɛ ɔbea no di fɔ anaa odi bem.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: “Ɔsɔfo no de ɔbea no bɛba Awurade anim,

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na wasaw Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu mfutuma de afra nsu kronkron a egu asuhina kɛse bi mu no.

english_verse: Next, he will remove her veil, then hand her the barley offering, and say, “If you have been faithful to your husband, this water won't harm you. But if you have been unfaithful, it will bring down the Lord's curse—you will never be able to give birth to a child, and everyone will curse your name.” Then the woman will answer, “If I am guilty, let it happen just as you say.”
translation_verse: Ɔbɛma no aka ntam sɛ onnim asɛm no ho hwee na waka akyerɛ no se, sɛ wo ne ɔbarima biara nnae ka wo kunu nko ara ho de a, ɛno de, wo ho ntew mfi nsu nwenweenwen a ɛde mmusu ba yi ho. Na sɛ woabɔ aguaman a, ɛno de, Awurade bɛdome wo wɔ wo nkurɔfo mu. Ɔbɛma wo srɛ aporɔw na wo yafunu ahon. Na ɔbea no bɛka se, ‘Yiw, saa na ɛsɛ sɛ ɛba.’

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: “Ɔsɔfo no bɛkyerɛw nnome yi nyinaa agu nhoma bi mu na wahohoro agu nsu nwenweenwen no mu.

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbea no nom nsu no na sɛ ɔnom wɔ bere a wayɛ bɔne a, ɛyɛ nwenweenwen wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Afei, ɔsɔfo no begye ninkunu afɔrebɔde no afi ɔbea no nsam na wahinhim wɔ Awurade anim na ɔde akɔ afɔremuka no so.

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛsaw ne nsa ma de asi ne nyinaa anan na wahyew no wɔ afɔremuka no so na wama ɔbea no anom nsu no.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Sɛ ne ho agu fi na wabɔ aguaman atia ne kunu a, nsu a wanom no bɛyɛ nwenweenwen wɔ ne mu na ne yafunu ahon na ne srɛ aporɔw na wayɛ nnome wɔ ne nkurɔfo mu.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔyɛ kronkron a ɔmmɔɔ aguaman a, wɔrenhaw no, na ɛrenkyɛ, obenyinsɛn.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: de hwehwɛ mu hu sɛ odi ne kunu nokware anaa onni no nokware no ho. Ɔde no bɛba Awurade anim na ɔsɔfo no adi dwuma a wɔabobɔ so no nyinaa.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Wɔrenni ne kunu no asɛm wɔ baabiara sɛ wama ɔyare bɔne bi aba ne yere so, efisɛ ɛyɛ ɔno ara na ɔma ɛbaa saa.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Awurade san ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo no se, sɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea kɔyɛ Nasareni de tew ne ho wɔ Awurade anim a,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: ɛno akyi, saa bere a ɔwɔ ahotew no mu no, onni ho kwan sɛ ɔnom nsa a ɛyɛ den anaa bobesa anaa nsa a emu kaw.

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: “Saa bere no mu no, ɛnsɛ sɛ oyi ne tinwi, efisɛ ɔyɛ kronkron na wɔatew ne ho ama Awurade; ɛno nti na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔma ne tinwi fuw no.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: “Ne bɔhyɛ no nna no mu a watew ne ho ama Awurade no, onni ho kwan sɛ ɔkɔ owufo ho.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: “Sɛ obi wu tɔ ne nkyɛn de gu ne ho fi a, nnanson akyi no, ɛsɛ sɛ oyi ne tinwi a ɛho agu fi no. Afei, wobedwira ne ho afi fi a owufo no de aka no no ho.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Nʼadekyee a ɛyɛ da a ɛto so awotwe no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde nturukuku abien anaa mmorɔnoma mma abien brɛ ɔsɔfo wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no kwan ano.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo no de nnomaa no mu baako bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre na ɔde ɔbaako abɔ ɔhyew afɔre, na ayɛ mpata ama nea ne ho agu fi no. Na da no ara, ɛsɛ sɛ oti ne bɔhyɛ mu na ɔsan ma ne tinwi no fuw bio.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Nna dodow a odii wɔ ne bɔhyɛ a edi kan no mu no nyinaa ahyew agu. Ɔbɛhyɛ Awurade bɔ foforo de afi ase, na ɔde odwennini ba a wadi afe bɛba abɛbɔ afɔdi ho afɔre.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: “Da a ne bɔhyɛ a ɛtew ɔno ne Awurade ntam no wie du no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔkɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na ɔbɛbɔ ɔhyew afɔre ama Awurade. Ɔde oguan ba a wadi afe a onnii dɛm na ɛbɛbɔ saa afɔre no. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde oguammere a wadi afe a onnii dɛm bɔ bɔne ho afɔre na ɔde odwennini a onnii dɛm bɔ asomdwoe afɔre.

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Nneɛma a ɔde bɛka ho no ne brodo a mmɔkaw mfra mu, asikresiam tetare a wɔde ngo afra; brodo ntrantraa bi a mmɔkaw mfra mu a wɔde ngo ayɛ so a aduan ne nsa afɔrebɔde ka ho.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Ɛsɛ sɛ Ɔsɔfo no de saa afɔrebɔde yi nyinaa ba Awurade anim na wabɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre ne ɔhyew afɔre.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: “Afei, ɔhotuafo no beyi ne tinwi a afuw kuhaa no; ɛno ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔnhyɛ bɔhyɛ no ase bio. Wɔbɛyɛ eyi wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no ano, na wɔde nwi no agu asomdwoe afɔre a wɔrebɔ no wɔ gya mu no ahyew no.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: “Wɔayi ɔbarima no tinwi no awie no, ɔsɔfo no de odwennini no basa a wɔatoto tetare a mmɔkaw nni mu no baako ne brodo ntrantraa a mmɔkaw nni mu bɛhyɛ ɔbarima no nsam.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo no behim akɔ nʼanim aba nʼakyi wɔ Awurade anim a ɛkyerɛ ma a ɔde rema Awurade. Ne nyinaa yɛ kyɛfa a ɛho tew ma ɔsɔfo no. Wɔbɛyɛ no sɛnea wɔyɛ odwennini no basa mu mfe mparow a wohim no wɔ Awurade anim no. Eyi akyi no, ɔhotuafo no tumi nom bobesa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔayi no afi ne bɔhyɛ no mu.

english_verse: These are the requirements for Nazirites. However, if you can afford to offer more, you must do so. The Blessing for the People
translation_verse: “Eyinom ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma Nasareni a wahyɛ nʼahofama ho bɔ awie, na ɔde afɔrebɔ ahorow brɛ Awurade. Saa afɔrebɔ yi akyi no, otumi de afɔrebɔde biara a ɔrebɛyɛ Nasareni no, ɔhyɛɛ ho bɔ sɛ ɔde bɛba no ba.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mmabarima no se, ɛsɛ sɛ wohyira Israelfo yi sononko sɛ:

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: “ ‘Awurade nhyira mo na ɔnhwɛ mo so.

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Awurade ntew nʼanim nkyerɛ mo na ɔnnom mo.

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Awurade mma nʼani so nhwɛ mo na ɔmma mo asomdwoe.’

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: “Saa na ɛsɛ sɛ Aaron ne ne mmabarima hyira Israelfo, na mʼankasa nso mehyira wɔn.”

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Da a Mose wiee Ahyiae Ntamadan no hyehyɛ no, ɔsraa ho nyinaa ngo, tew mu nneɛma nyinaa ho. Ɔsan sraa afɔremuka ne ho nkuku ne nkaka nyinaa ngo, tew ho nso.

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Afei, Israel mpanyimfo ne mmusuakuw no mu mpanyin a wɔhwɛɛ nnipakan no so no nyinaa de wɔn afɔrebɔde bae.

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: Wɔde nteaseɛnam asia a wɔakatakata ho ne anantwi dumien na ɛbae. Na nteaseɛnam no baako biara yɛ mpanyimfo baanu de, a nantwi baako yɛ wɔn mu biara de. Wɔde ne nyinaa maa Awurade wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no anim.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Gye wɔn akyɛde no na fa nteaseɛnam no yɛ Ahyiae Ntamadan no ho adwuma. Fa ma Lewifo no na obiara mfa nni dwuma biara a ɛsɛ sɛ odi.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Enti Mose de nteaseɛnam no ne anantwi no maa Lewifo no.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: na ɔmaa Merari ne ne nkurɔfo nso nteaseɛnam anan ne anantwi awotwe a Aaron babarima Itamar na na odi so panyin.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Wɔamma Kohat nkurɔfo nteaseɛnam no bi, efisɛ na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsoa wɔn kyɛfa a ɛfa Ahyiae Ntamadan no ho nneɛma no ho no wɔ wɔn mmati so.

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Mpanyimfo a wodi anim no nso de nsrabɔ akyɛde beguu afɔremuka no anim da a wɔresra afɔremuka no ngo no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se, “Kyekyɛ nna a obiara de nʼafɔrebɔde bɛba afɔremuka no so.”

english_verse: And so when the altar was dedicated to the Lord, these twelve leaders brought the following gifts:
translation_verse: Asomdwoe afɔre nneɛma a wɔde bae ni: nantwininimma aduonu anan, adwennini aduosia, mmirekyi aduosia, adwennini a wɔn mu biara adi afe aduosia.

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: ɔpapo sɛ bɔne ho afɔre

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Ne nnankron so no, Gideoni babarima Abidan a ɔda Benyamin abusuakuw ano no de nʼafɔrebɔde bae.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Bere a Mose kɔɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu sɛ ɔne Awurade rekɔkasa no, ɔtee nne bi fi soro a ɛrekasa kyerɛ no fi Mpata Beae no atifi hɔ, wɔ adaka no ho baabi a kerubim abien no sisi no ntam. Awurade faa saa kwan yi so kasa kyerɛɛ no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Aaron se, ‘Sɛ wosɔ akanea ason a ɛwɔ kaneadua no so no a, sɔ no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, ɛbɛtow ne hann no akɔ kaneadua no nʼanim.’ ”

english_verse: Aaron obeyed and placed the lamps as he was told.
translation_verse: Aaron yɛɛ saa; ɔsɔɔ akanea no ma ɛtow hann kɔɔ kaneadua no anim, sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Sɛnea Wosi yɛɛ kaneadua no ni: Sikakɔkɔɔ a wɔaboro na wɔde yɛ fii nʼase kosi ne soro. Wɔyɛɛ no sɛnea Awurade kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ wɔnyɛ no ara pɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn ho ni yɛ eyi: Fa ahodwira nsu pete wɔn so. Ma wonyi wɔn ho nwi nyinaa, na wɔnhoro wɔn nneɛma nyinaa, na ama wɔn ho atew.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Afei, ma wɔmfa nantwinini ba ne aduan afɔrebɔde a ɛyɛ asikresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu a wɔde ngo afra a nantwinini ba baako ka ho a wɔde no bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre mmra.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Frɛ Israelfo no nyinaa hyia na fa Lewifo no bra Ahyiae Ntamadan no pon ano.

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na mpanyimfo a wotuatua mmusuakuw no ano no de wɔn nsa begu wɔn so.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ Aaron yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne bi sɛ ɔde wɔn rema Awurade sɛ akyɛde a efi Israel manfo nyinaa nkyɛn, na asiesie Lewifo no ama wɔayɛ Awurade adwuma.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: “Afei, Lewifo mpanyimfo no de wɔn nsa begu nantwimma no apampam na wɔde wɔn ama Awurade. Wɔde ɔbaako bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre na wɔde ɔbaako nso abɔ ɔhyew afɔre de ayɛ mpata ama Lewifo no.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: Afei, wɔde Lewifo no bɛma Aaron ne ne mma te sɛnea wɔde afɔrebɔde biara fa asɔfo so de ma Awurade no.”

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Mobɛfa saa kwan yi so ayi Lewifo no afi Israelfo no mu ama me, na wɔayɛ me dea.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Sɛ motew wɔn ho na mofa saa kwan yi so de wɔn ma me a, afei, wobedi ahyɛmfiri wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu, adi wɔn dwuma.

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: Israelfo mu nyinaa, wɔn na wɔyɛ me nkurɔfo, na magye wɔn ato mu asi Israelfo mmakan nyinaa anan, Israelni bea biara abakan barima.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Israel abakan biara yɛ me de; nnipa ne mmoa nyinaa. Bere a mikunkum Misraimfo mmakan nyinaa no ara na mefaa wɔn de wɔn yɛɛ me nkurɔfo.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Mafa Lewifo no asi Israelfo mmakan nyinaa anan mu.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Na mede Lewifo no bɛkyɛ Aaron ne ne mmabarima. Lewifo no na wɔbɛyɛ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu nnwuma kronkron a anka ɛsɛ sɛ Israelfo no na wɔyɛ, na wɔn na wɔbɛbɔ afɔre ama nkurɔfo de ayɛ mpata ama wɔn sɛnea sɛ Israelfo no kɔ kronkronbea hɔ a ɔyaredɔm biara renka wɔn.”

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Mose ne Aaron ne Israelfo no nyinaa faa ɔkwan a Awurade kyerɛɛ Mose no so pɛpɛɛpɛ de Lewifo no maa Awurade.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Lewifo no dwiraa wɔn ho, horoo wɔn nneɛma. Na Aaron de wɔn hyɛɛ Awurade nsa sɛ ohim afɔre na ɔyɛɛ wɔn ho mpata adwuma de tew wɔn ho.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ɛno akyi no, Lewifo no kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu a na Aaron ne ne mmabarima no hwɛ wɔn so Wɔyɛɛ biribiara sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose sɛ wɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔpɔn a, wotumi adi dwuma wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan mu hɔ de boa wɔn nuanom, mmom wɔn ankasa de, ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ da yɛ adwuma. Eyi ne ɔkwan a momfa so mma Lewifo no adwuma nyɛ.”

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: “Ma Israelfo no nni Twam Afahyɛ no wɔ ne bere ano.

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Munni no wɔ ne bere ano, na mofa ne mmara akwan ahorow no nyinaa so nni wɔ ɔsram yi da a ɛto so dunan no anwummere.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: na wɔyɛɛ saa wɔ Sinai Nweatam no so wɔ ɔsram a edi kan no da a ɛto so dunan no anwummere. Na Israelfo no yɛɛ biribiara pɛpɛɛpɛ sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Nanso na nnipa no bi fi ayi aba a esiane sɛ wɔde wɔn ho aka owufo nti na wɔn ho agu fi. Eyi nti wɔantumi anni Twam Afahyɛ no bi. Enti wɔbaa Mose ne Aaron nkyɛn da no ara

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: bɛka kyerɛɛ Mose se, “Yɛde yɛn ho aka funu ama yɛn ho agu fi, nanso dɛn nti na yɛne Israelfo nyinaa rentumi mfa yɛn afɔrebɔde mmrɛ Awurade sɛnea nhyehyɛe no te no?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Mose buaa wɔn se, “Montwɛn mma mimmisa sɛnea Awurade mmara no ka fa mo ho.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo no se, Obiara a obeso funu mu, sɛ ɔyɛ nnɛmma anaa ofi awo ntoatoaso a ɛreba no mu wɔ Twam Afahyɛ bere a ɛbɛma ne ho agu fi anaa ɔnam akwantu so nti wɔantumi amma no tumi di Awurade Twam Afahyɛ no,

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: nanso ɔsram a ɛto so abien no da a ɛto so dunan no anwummere na ɛsɛ sɛ wodi. Saa bere no na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔwe oguamma no a brodo a mmɔkaw nni mu ka ho a naban nweenwen ka ho.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wogyaw bi ma ade kye so, anaa wɔbɔ ne dompe mu. Na ɛsɛ sɛ wodi Twam Afahyɛ no mmara no nyinaa so pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Nanso obiara a ne ho nguu fi anaa obi a ontuu kwan nanso wanni Twam Afahyɛ no wɔ ne bere ano no, ɛsɛ sɛ wotwa no asu afi Israelfo no mu wɔ afɔre a wamma ammɛbɔ amma Awurade bere a ɛsɛ mu no nti. Wɔbɛsoa wɔn afɔdi ho sodi.

english_verse: Anyone, including foreigners who live among you, can celebrate Passover, if they follow all the regulations. The Cloud over the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: “Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhɔho a ɔfra mo mu no fa mmara koro no ara so di Awurade Twam Afahyɛ no. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhɔho ne okuroni nyinaa di mmara koro no so.” Ogyamununkum

english_verse: The Lord used this cloud to tell the Israelites when to move their camp and where to set it up again. As long as the cloud covered the tent, the Israelites did not break camp. But when the cloud moved, they followed it, and wherever it stopped, they camped and stayed there,
translation_verse: Sɛ egyina baabi kyɛ a, wɔn nso gyina hɔ kyɛ. Na sɛ egyina hɔ nna kakraa bi a, wɔn nso gyina hɔ nna kakraa bi saa ara, efisɛ saa na Awurade ahyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Sɛ omununkum no ba Ahyiae Ntamadan no atifi na edi nnaanu, ɔsram anaa afe a, saa nna no ara so na Israelfo no hwɛ de tena hɔ. Nanso enya tu ara pɛ a, na wɔn nso atu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Fa dwetɛ a wɔaboro yɛ ntorobɛnto abien, na ɛyɛ a wɔahyɛn de afrɛ nnipa no, na edu ntamadan no tu so nso a, wɔahyɛn.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔhyɛn ntorobɛnto abien no a, nnipa no behu sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔboa wɔn ho ano wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔhyɛn baako pɛ a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ Israel mmusua no mu mpanyimfo na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔba wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: Sɛ mohyɛn nea ɛto so abien no a, mmusuakuw a wɔwɔ anafo fam no bedi so. Monhyɛn no ntiantia mu mfa nkyerɛ sɛ wɔnkɔ.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mofrɛ nnipa no ama wɔabehyia a, momfa ɔkwan foforo so nhyɛn ntorobɛnto no.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: “Aaron mmabarima asɔfo nko ara na wɔbɛma wɔn kwan ama wɔahyɛn ntorobɛnto no. Eyi yɛ mmara a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ama awo ntoatoaso a ɛbɛba no nyinaa.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Sɛ mudu Bɔhyɛ Asase no so na mo ne mo atamfo a wɔhyɛ mo so no ko a mohyɛn ntorobɛnto no. Na, Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn bɛkae mo na wagye mo afi mo atamfo nsam.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Anigyebere mu nso, monhyɛn ntorobɛnto no. Afe mu dapɔnna nso, monhyɛn. Ɔsram biara mfiase nso, monhyɛn mfa nnye mo ani wɔ ɔhyew afɔre ne asomdwoe afɔre ho. Sɛ moyɛ saa a, ɛbɛkae Onyankopɔn apam a ɔne mo wɔ no. Na mene Awurade mo Nyankopɔn.”

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Ɔsram a ɛto so abien no da a ɛto so aduonu no a ɛyɛ mfe abien a Israelfo fii Misraim no, omununkum no pagyaw ne ho fii Ahyiae Ntamadan no so,

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: enti Israelfo no fii Sinai sare so hɔ dii omununkum no akyi kosii sɛ ekogyinaa Paran sare so.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu no duu no, Awurade nam Mose so ka kyerɛɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Akwantu no mu no, mmusua a wɔhyɛ Yuda abusuakuw no ase, a Aminadab babarima Nahson tua ano na otuu wɔn frankaa ma wodii kan.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Wɔn a wodii so ne Isakar abusuakuw a Suar babarima Netanel di wɔn anim.

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: Sebulon abusuakuw na wodii hɔ a Helon babarima Eliab na na odi wɔn anim.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Wotutuu Ahyiae Ntamadan no, na Gerson ne Merari mmusua a wofi Lewifo mu no soaa Ahyiae Ntamadan no dii wɔn afa wɔ santen no mu.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Ruben abusuakuw tuu wɔn frankaa de dii so a Sedeur babarima Elisur di wɔn anim.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Wɔn a na wodi so ne Simeon abusuakuw a Surisadai babarima Selumiel di wɔn anim;

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Gad abusuakuw nso, na Deguel babarima Eliasaf na odi wɔn anim.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Na Kohatfo no nso na na wodi hɔ a wɔsoso kronkronbea hɔ nneɛma. Na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhyehyɛ Ahyiae Ntamadan no wɔ beae foforo hɔ ansa na wɔadu hɔ.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Wɔn a na wodi so ne Efraim abusuakuw a na wodi wɔn frankaa no akyi a Amihud babarima Elisama na odi wɔn anim;

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Wɔn a na wodi so ne Manase abusuakuw a Pedahsur babarima Gamaliel di wɔn anim;

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: na Benyamin abusuakuw na na wodi so a Gideoni babarima Abidan di wɔn anim.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Wɔn a na wotwa to koraa no ne Dan abusuakuw a wɔyɛ wɔn nyinaa awɛmfo na Amisadai babarima Ahieser da wɔn ano na frankaa di wɔn anim.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Okran babarima Pagiel na na odi Aser abusuakuw anim,

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: na Enan babarima Ahira nso di Naftali abusuakuw anim.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Saa nhyehyɛe yi na Israel mmusuakuw yi faa so tuu wɔn kwan no.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Afei, Mose ka kyerɛɛ nʼase Hobab, Midiani Reuel ba se, “Eyi nyinaa akyi no, yɛrekɔ beae a Awurade kae se, ‘Mede bɛma mo no.’ Bra na yɛnkɔ na yɛbɛhwɛ wo so yiye; efisɛ Awurade ahyɛ Israelfo nnepa ho bɔ.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Obuae se, “Dabi, merenkɔ; merekɔ mʼasase so ne mʼabusuafo nkyɛn.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Nanso Mose kae se, “Mesrɛ wo, nnyaw yɛn. Wo na wunim faako a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛtena wɔ sare no so, na wubetumi ayɛ yɛn kwankyerɛfo.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wo ne yɛn kɔ a, nneɛma pa a Awurade de bɛma yɛn no nyinaa, wubenya bi.”

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Enti wofi Awurade Bepɔw so nantew nnansa. Awurade Apam Adaka no dii wɔn anim hwehwɛɛ baabi a wɔbɛsoɛ maa wɔn.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Bere biara a wɔbɛma adaka no so asi mu no, Mose teɛ mu se, “Awurade, sɔre! Ma wʼatamfo nhwete; ma wɔn nyinaa nguan mfi wʼanim.”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Bere biara a wɔbɛsoɛ adaka no, ɔka se, “Awurade, san bra Israelfo mpempem a wontumi nkan wɔn no mu.”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Ankyɛ biara na nnipa no fii ase nwiinwii sɛ nneɛma nkɔ yiye mma wɔn, na Awurade tee. Nʼabufuw sɔree wɔ wɔn anwiinwii no ho. Eyi nti, Awurade maa ogya bɛhyew beae a na wɔte hɔ no mfikyiri baabi.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Wɔteɛteɛɛ mu frɛɛ Mose sɛ ommegye wɔn no, ɔbɔɔ mpae srɛɛ Awurade maa wɔn na ogya no dumii.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Efi saa bere no, wɔtoo beae hɔ din se Tabera a ne nkyerɛase ne “Ahyewee,” efisɛ ogya a efi Awurade nkyɛn no hyew wɔn atenae hɔ.

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Misraimfo a na wɔwɔ wɔn ntam no kɔn dɔɔ nneɛma pa a na ɛwɔ Misraim no. Eyi amma Israelfo no ani ansɔ baabi a na wɔwɔ hɔ no, enti wosui se, “Hena na ɔbɛma yɛn aduan adi?

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Yɛkae nsumnam a yɛwee wɔ Misraim mpoano no. Saa ara nso na na yenya kokumba, ɛfere, gyeene ne galik di no.

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Nanso mprempren de, yɛn anom ato; yenhu hwee sɛ mana nko ara.”

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Mose bisaa Awurade se, “Adɛn nti na wode ɔhaw sɛɛ aba wʼakoa so? Dɛn na mayɛ atia wo a na wode saa nnipa a wɔte sɛɛ yi nyinaa adesoa abɛsoa me?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: Me na minyinsɛn nnipa yi nyinaa? Me na mewoo wɔn? Adɛn nti na wuse minturu wɔn wɔ me nsa so sɛ nkokoaa nkosi sɛ yebedu asase a wohyɛɛ wɔn agyanom ho bɔ no so?

english_verse: They keep whining for meat, but where can I get meat for them?
translation_verse: Ɛhefa na merekɔfa nam abrɛ nnipa yi? Wosu kyerɛ me se, ‘Ma yɛn nam nwe!’

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Me nko ara rentumi nsoa ɔman yi! Adesoa no mu yɛ duru ma me dodo!

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Na sɛ saa na wo ne me bedi no de a, mesrɛ, kum me, sɛ manya wʼanim anuonyam a, na mma minnhyia mʼankasa me sɛe.”

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Mɛba hɔ na me ne wo abɛkasa na honhom a ɛwɔ wo so no, mɛfa na mede akogu wɔn nso so bi; ɛba saa a, wɔne wo bɛsoa nnipa no adesoa sɛnea ɛrenyɛ wo nko ara wʼadesoa.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ nnipa no se: Munnwira mo ho na ɔkyena, mubenya nam awe. Ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Awurade ate mo sufrɛ a ɛfa nneɛma a mugyaw no Misraim no ho na ɔrebɛma mo nam na mobɛwe.

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: Na ɔsram baako mu, mobɛwe nam ara ama afono mo ama afa mo hwene mu. Efisɛ moapo Awurade a ɔka mo ho wɔ ha no, na moasu wɔ nʼanim se, adɛn nti na yefii Misraim?’ ”

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Sɛ yekum nguan ne anantwi ma wɔn a ɛbɛso wɔn ana? Sɛ wɔkyere po mu nam nyinaa ma wɔn a ɛbɛso wɔn ana?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Na Awurade bisaa Mose se, “So Awurade basa yɛ tiaa dodo ana? Afei wubehu sɛ mʼasɛm yɛ nokware anaa ɛnyɛ nokware.”

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Nanso na mpanyimfo aduɔson no mu baanu a wɔfrɛ wɔn Eldad ne Medad da so wɔ wɔn atenae hɔ. Na bere a honhom no baa wɔn so wɔ hɔ no, wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Mmerante bi tuu mmirika kɔbɔɔ Mose asɛm a asi no ho amanneɛ

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: na Nun babarima Yosua a na wɔayi no sɛ ɔnyɛ Mose boafo no ampene so, na ɔkae se, “Me wura Mose, ma wonnyae!”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Mose bisaa no se, “Me ho na woretwe ninkunu yi? Ɛkaa me nko a, na anka Awurade nkurɔfo nyinaa yɛ adiyifo a Awurade de ne honhom agu wɔn nyinaa so!”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: Na Awurade bɔɔ ahum maa ɛde mmoko fi po mu beguu atenae hɔ ne ɛho mmaa nyinaa. Baabiara a obi bɛfa no, na nnomaa yi bi atu nenam asase ani bɛyɛ anammɔn anan.

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Enti da mu no nyinaa, nnipa kyekyeree mmoko no bi kunkum wɔn awia ne anadwo ne nʼadekyee nso. Nea wannya bi no koraa na onyaa susukoraa ɔha! Mmoko buu so wɔ atenae hɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Na nnipa no fii ase wee mmoa no bi no, Awurade bo san fuw wɔn maa ɔde ɔyaredɔm kum wɔn mu fa kɛse no ara.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Enti wɔtoo beae hɔ din se Kibrot-Hataawa a nkyerɛase ne, “Akɔnnɔ ɔda” efisɛ wɔn a na wɔn ani bere nam na wɔn kɔn adɔ Misraim tena no na wosiee wɔn wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.
translation_verse: Ɔman no tu fii Kibrot-Hataawa hɔ kɔtenaa Haserot.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ntɛm so, Awurade frɛɛ Mose, Aaron ne Miriam kɔɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu. Ɔhyɛɛ wɔn se, “Mo baasa no mommra Ahyiae Ntamadan mu ha.” Enti wobegyinagyinaa Awurade anim.

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade nam omununkum fadum mu sian ba begyinaa Ahyiae Ntamadan no kwan ano, na ɔfrɛɛ Aaron ne Miriam. Bere a wotwiw kɔɔ wɔn anim no,

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: ɔkae se, “Muntie me nsɛm: “Sɛ odiyifo wɔ mo mu a, Me, Awurade, menam anisoadehu so da me ho adi kyerɛ no, me kasa kyerɛ no wɔ dae mu.

english_verse: But my servant Moses is the leader of my people.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛnte saa wɔ me somfo Mose ho. Me fi nyinaa mu no, ɔyɛ ɔnokwafo.

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: Me ne no kasa anim ne anim, kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛnyɛ abisae mu. Na ohu Awurade sɛnea ɔte. Adɛn nti na moansuro sɛ mobɛkasa atia me somfo Mose?”

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: Awurade bo fuw wɔn dennen pa ara na ofii hɔ kɔe.

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: Bere a omununkum no fii Ahyiae Ntamadan no atifi no, kwata beduruu Miriam ho fitaa sɛ sukyerɛmma. Aaron twaa nʼani huu sɛ ɔwɔ ɔhonam ani yare a ɛyɛ fi no,

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: ɔka kyerɛɛ Mose se, “Me wura, mesrɛ wo, nnyina saa bɔne a yɛnam nkwaseasɛm so adi yi so ntwe yɛn aso.

english_verse: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead!”
translation_verse: Mma no nyɛ sɛ akokoaa a wawu wɔ ne yam a ne fa aporɔw.”

english_verse: Moses prayed, “Lord God, please heal her.”
translation_verse: Na Mose teɛɛ mu frɛɛ Awurade se, “Onyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo sɛ sa no yare!”

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Awurade buaa Mose se, “Sɛ nʼagya tew ntasu guu nʼanim a, anka nʼanim rengu ase nnanson? Munyi no mfi atenae ha nkɔhyɛ baabi nnanson na akyiri no, obetumi asan aba.”

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Enti wotwaa Miriam asu fii atenae hɔ ma okodii nnanson. Nnipa no twɛn kosii sɛ wɔsan de no bae ansa na wɔretu kwan no bio.

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Ɛno akyi no, wofii Haserot bɛbɔɔ atenae wɔ Paran sare so.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: Yehuu Anakfo no bi a efi awo ntoatoaso mu wɔyɛ abran no. Sɛ yɛne wɔn gyina hɔ a, na yɛayɛ te sɛ nketekre wɔ yɛn ani so. Na saa ara nso na yɛyɛɛ wɔ wɔn ani so.”

english_verse: “Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.”
translation_verse: “Soma akwansrafo na wɔnkɔ Kanaan asase so; asase a mede rema Israelfo no. Soma mmusuakuw dumien no mu biara ntuanoni.”

english_verse: So Moses sent twelve tribal leaders from Israel's camp in the Paran Desert
translation_verse: Enti Mose yɛɛ sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ no no. Ɔsomaa mmarima dumien a wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmusuakuw ntuanofo fi wɔn atenae wɔ Paran sare so.

english_verse: Before Moses sent them into Canaan, he said: After you go through the Southern Desert of Canaan, continue north into the hill country
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Monkɔ atifi fam wɔ Negeb bepɔw no so.

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,
translation_verse: Monhwɛ sɛnea ɛhɔ asase no te; na monhwɛ wɔn a wɔte hɔ no nso tebea sɛ wɔwɔ ahoɔden anaa wɔyɛ mmerɛw, sɛ wɔdɔɔso anaa wosua.

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: Dɔte no te dɛn? Srade wɔ mu anaasɛ ɛyɛ kwaboo? Nnua wɔ so anaasɛ nnua nni so? Mommɔ mmɔden na momfa ɛhɔ nnɔbae no bi mmra.” Saa bere no na wɔretew bobe aba kan.

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Enti wɔkɔsraa asase no fi Sin sare so kosii Rehob a ɛbɛn Hamat no.

english_verse: As they went through the Southern Desert, they came to the town of Hebron, which was seven years older than the Egyptian town of Zoan. In Hebron, they saw the three Anakim clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai.
translation_verse: Wɔfaa atifi fam kɔfaa Negeb beduu Hebron. Ɛhɔ na wohuu Anak asefo a wɔfrɛ wɔn Ahiman, Sesai ne Talmai. Hebron yɛ kurow dedaw. Wɔkyekyeree saa kurow no mfe ason ansa na wɔrekyekyere Soan a ɛwɔ Misraim no.

english_verse: After exploring the land of Canaan for
translation_verse: Adaduanan akyi no, wofii wɔn akwansra no mu bae.

english_verse: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit
translation_verse: Wɔkaa nea wokohui nyinaa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Israel nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Paran sare so wɔ Kades na wɔde aduaba a wɔde bae no kyerɛe.

english_verse: and said: Look at this fruit! The land we explored is rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Asɛm a wɔbɛkae ne sɛ, “Yeduu asase a wosomaa yɛn sɛ yɛnkɔsra so no so, na ɛwo ne nufusu sen wɔ so ampa! Ɛso aduaba a yɛde bae ni.

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.
translation_verse: Nanso na nnipa a wɔtete hɔ no yɛ den. Wɔn nkurow no soso na wɔabɔ ho ban nso. Yehuu Anak asefo wɔ hɔ mpo.

english_verse: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Amalekfo te anafo na Hetifo, Yebusifo ne Amorifo nso tete mmepɔw so. Na Kanaanfo nso tete Ntam Po no ne Yordan subon ho.”

english_verse: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, “Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it!”
translation_verse: Na Kaleb bɔɔ nnipa no ano wɔ Mose anim kae se, “Momma yɛmforo nkɔ hɔ prɛko pɛ na yɛnkɔfa asase no, efisɛ yebetumi adi wɔn so nkonim.”

english_verse: But the other men replied, “Those people are much too strong for us.”
translation_verse: Nanso mmarima a wɔne no kɔe no kae se, “Yɛrentumi nkɔtoa saa nnipa yi; wɔn ho yɛ den sen yɛn.”

english_verse: Then they started spreading rumors and saying, “We won't be able to grow anything in that soil. And the people are like giants.
translation_verse: Na wɔde asɛm a ɛmma akomatɔyam fa asase a wɔkɔsraa so no ho tene faa Israelfo no mu nyinaa. Wose, “Asase a yɛkɔsraa so no sofo no yɛ awudifo nkutoo. Nnipa a yehuu wɔn wɔ hɔ no yɛ abran.

english_verse: and complained to Moses and Aaron, “We wish we had died in Egypt or somewhere out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Wɔde nne koro nwiinwii tiaa Mose ne Aaron. Wɔkae se, “Sɛ yewuwuu wɔ Misraim anaa sare so ha a, anka eye.

english_verse: Is the Lord leading us into Canaan, just to have us killed and our women and children captured? We'd be better off in Egypt.”
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na Awurade de yɛn reba ha sɛ yɛmmɛtotɔ wɔ mfoa ano? Wɔbɛfow yɛn yerenom ne yɛn mma. So ennye mma yɛn sɛ yɛbɛsan akɔ Misraim ana?”

english_verse: Then they said to one another, “Let's choose our own leader and go back.”
translation_verse: Na wosisee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ, “Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛpaw ɔkannifo na yɛsan kɔ Misraim.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron bowed down to pray in front of the crowd.
translation_verse: Afei, Mose ne Aaron de wɔn anim butubutuu fam wɔ Israelfo a wɔahyia hɔ no nyinaa anim.

english_verse: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.
translation_verse: na wɔka kyerɛɛ Israelfo no nyinaa se, “Asase a yɛfaa mu no yɛ asase pa yiye.

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛsɔ Awurade ani a, ɔde yɛn bedu asase no so dwoodwoo, asase bere a nufusu ne ɛwo sen wɔ so, na ɔde bɛma yɛn.

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!
translation_verse: Monnyɛ dɔm ntia Awurade. Na munnsuro nnipa a wɔwɔ asase no so no nso, efisɛ yɛbɛmemene wɔn. Wonni bammɔ, nanso Awurade ka yɛn ho. Munnsuro wɔn.”

english_verse: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent. Moses Prays for the People
translation_verse: Nanso mmuae a nnipa no mae ara ne sɛ, wobesiw wɔn abo. Afei, Awurade anuonyam baa Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu kyerɛɛ Israelfo no nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.
translation_verse: Awurade bisaa Mose se, “Nnipa yi bebu me animtiaa akosi da bɛn? Anwonwade dodow a mayɛ akyerɛ wɔn yi nyinaa akyi no, wonnye me nni ara?

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: Mɛma ɔyaredɔm abeduru wɔn na asɛe wɔn, nanso mɛyɛ mo ɔman kɛse a ɛwɔ ahoɔden sen wɔn.”

english_verse: Show us your great power, Lord. You promised
translation_verse: “Afei Awurade nna nʼahoɔden adi, sɛnea wahyɛ no:

english_verse: that you love to show mercy and kindness. And you said that you are very patient, but that you will punish everyone guilty of doing wrong—not only them but their children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: ‘Awurade yɛ nyaa wɔ nʼabufuw mu, na ne dɔ ne bɔne ne atuatew so bɔnefakyɛ no boro so. Nanso onnyaw ɔfɔdifo a ɔntwe nʼaso; ɔtwe mma aso wɔ agyanom bɔne ho kosi awo ntoatoaso abiɛsa ne nan mu.’

english_verse: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Wo dɔ kɛse no nti, fa saa nnipa yi bɔne kyɛ wɔn sɛnea wode akyɛ wɔn afi Misraim abesi saa bere yi.”

english_verse: But as surely as I live and my power has no limit,
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ mete ase yi, na Awurade anuonyam ahyɛ asase nyinaa ma yi,

english_verse: I swear that not one of these Israelites will enter the land I promised to give their ancestors. These people have seen my power in Egypt and in the desert, but they will never see Canaan. They have disobeyed and tested me too many times.
translation_verse: wɔn mu biara renhu asase a mekaa ntam de hyɛɛ wɔn agyanom bɔ no. Wɔn a wobuu me animtiaa no mu biara renhu.

english_verse: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.
translation_verse: Nanso sɛnea ɛsono mʼakoa Kaleb honhom na ofi ne koma nyinaa mu di mʼakyi no nti mede no bɛkɔ asase a ɔkɔɔ so no so, na nʼasefo benya ɛhɔ mu kyɛfa.

english_verse: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites Are Punished for Complaining
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ Amalekfo na Kanaanfo tete abon mu no nti, ɔkyena, momfa mo ani nkyerɛ Po Kɔkɔɔ no nkɔ sare no so.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Awurade bisaa Mose ne Aaron se,

english_verse: to give this message to the people of Israel: You sinful people have complained against me too many times! Now I swear by my own life that I will give you exactly what you wanted.
translation_verse: Enti ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Awurade na ose, sɛ mete ase yi, mɛyɛ nea metee sɛ moreka no ama mo.

english_verse: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over
translation_verse: Mo nyinaa mubewuwu wɔ sare no so: Efi wɔn a wɔadi mfe aduonu rekɔ no a wɔkan wɔn bi na wɔka ho nwiinwii tiaa me no.

english_verse: will enter the land that I solemnly promised to give you as your own—only Caleb and Joshua will go in.
translation_verse: Mo mu biara renkɔ Bɔhyɛ Asase no so. Wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ hɔ ara ne Yefune babarima Kaleb ne Nun babarima Yosua.

english_verse: You were worried that your own children would be captured. But I, the Lord, will let them enter the land you have rejected.
translation_verse: Moka se mo mma bɛyɛ nnipa a wɔte asase no so no nkoa. Mede wɔn bɛkɔ asase no so dwoodwoo ama wɔakɔfa nea muse mompɛ no.

english_verse: You will die here in the desert!
translation_verse: Na mo de, mo amu na ɛbɛka sare so ha.

english_verse: So they got up early the next morning and got ready to head toward the hill country of Canaan. They said, “We were wrong to complain about the Lord. Let's go into the land that he promised us.”
translation_verse: Wɔsɔree anɔpahema sɛ wɔrekɔ Bɔhyɛ Asase no so. Wɔkae se, “Yɛahu sɛ yɛayɛ bɔne, nanso yɛasiesie yɛn ho sɛ yɛbɛkɔ asase a Awurade hyɛɛ yɛn ho bɔ no so.”

english_verse: Ten of the men sent to explore the land had brought back bad news and had made the people complain against the Lord.
translation_verse: Enti mmarima a Mose somaa wɔ ma wɔkɔsraa asase no so no, wɔn a wɔsan ba bɛbɔɔ amanneɛ bɔne a ɛnam so maa nnipa no nyinaa nwiinwii tiaa me no,

english_verse: So he sent a deadly disease that killed those men,
translation_verse: wɔde ɔyare bɔne kunkum saa mmarima a wɔde amanneɛ bɔne tenee wɔ Awurade anim no.

english_verse: but he let Joshua and Caleb live. The Israelites Fail To Enter Canaan (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Akwansrafo no nyinaa, Nun ba Yosua ne Yefune ba Kaleb nko ara na wɔtenaa ase.

english_verse: But Moses replied, “You're disobeying the Lord! Your plan won't work,
translation_verse: Nanso Mose kae se, “Adɛn na morebu Awurade ahyɛde so? Eyi renyɛ ye!

english_verse: The Amalekites and the Canaanites came down from the hill country, defeated the Israelites, and chased them as far as the town of Hormah.
translation_verse: Na Amalekfo ne Kanaanfo a wɔte bepɔw no so no sian ba bɛtow hyɛɛ wɔn so boroo wɔn ara kosii Horma.

english_verse: The people of Israel were very sad after Moses gave them the Lord's message.
translation_verse: Mose kɔkaa nsɛm a Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no kyerɛɛ nnipa no no, wɔn nyinaa werɛ howee yiye.

english_verse: so don't even try it. The Lord refuses to help you, because you turned your backs on him. The Amalekites and the Canaanites are your enemies, and they will attack and defeat you.”
translation_verse: Amalekfo ne Kanaanfo no behyia mo wɔ hɔ wɔ hɔ? Esiane sɛ moapa Awurade nti, ɔrenka mo ho na mobɛtotɔ wɔ afoa no.”

english_verse: But the Israelites ignored Moses and marched toward the hill country, even though the sacred chest and Moses did not go with them.
translation_verse: Nanso wofii wɔn nsusuwii mu foro kɔɔ bepɔw no so a amfa wɔn ho sɛ Awurade Apam adaka no ne Mose mu biara antu amfi atenae hɔ bi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: to give the Israelites the following laws about offering sacrifices:
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfo no se, ‘Sɛ mokɔtena asase a mede rema mo no so

english_verse: Bulls or rams or goats are the animals that you may burn on the altar as sacrifices to please me. You may also offer sacrifices voluntarily or because you made a promise, or because they are part of your regular religious ceremonies. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: na mopɛ sɛ mobɔ ɔhyew afɔre anaa afɔre biara a wɔbɔ a eyi hua a ɛsɔ Awurade ani a, ɛsɛ sɛ afɔrebɔde no yɛ aboa a ofi mo nguankuw anaa nantwibuw mu. Sɛ ɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔre, anaa afɔrebɔ a wɔde hyɛ bɔ, anaa afɔrebɔ a efi ɔpɛ mu, anaa afɔrebɔ a wɔbɔ no afirihyia mu nnapɔnna bi mu no a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde aduan afɔrebɔde ka ho.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a young ram or goat, you must also offer a kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil as a grain sacrifice. A liter of wine must also be poured on the altar.
translation_verse: Oguamma biara a wɔde bɔ ɔhyew afɔre no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nsa afɔrebɔde a ɛyɛ bobesa lita baako ka ho.

english_verse: If a bull is offered as a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing,
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ wosiesie nantwi ba ma ɔhyew afɔre anaa afɔrebɔde de hyɛ bɔ sononko bi anaa ayɔnkofa asikresiam afɔre a worebɔ ama Awurade a,

english_verse: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.
translation_verse: fa atoko afɔrebɔde a ɛyɛ asikresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu lita asia ne fa ne ngo lita abien ka nantwi no ho

english_verse: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: a bobesa lita abien ka ho sɛ ɔnom afɔrebɔde. Eyi bɛyɛ aduan afɔrebɔ a ebeyi hua asɔ Awurade ani.

english_verse: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɛsɛ sɛ Israelni biara fa saa ɔkwan yi so siesie ne aduan afɔrebɔ a eyi hua na ɛsɔ Awurade ani na ɔde ba.

english_verse: This law will never change. I am the Lord, and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Mmara baako na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mo ne ahɔho a wɔtete mo mu no nyinaa.’ ”

english_verse: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.
translation_verse: na mudi asase no so aduan a, momfa bi mmɔ afɔre mma Awurade.

english_verse: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.
translation_verse: Atoko a mobɛyam a edi kan no, momfa nto ɔfam nto nkyɛn sɛ akyɛde sɛnea moyɛ atoko otwakan no wɔ awiporowbea no.

english_verse: All your descendants must follow this law and offer part of the first batch of bread dough.
translation_verse: Awo ntoatoaso a ɛbɛba no nyinaa mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ mode saa afɔre a efi mo aduan a edi kan a moanya mu yi ma Awurade. Bɔne A Wɔanhyɛ Da Anyɛ Ho Afɔrebɔ

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses to tell the people what must be done if they ever disobey his laws:
translation_verse: mmara ahorow a Awurade nam ne so de ama mo yi so, efi da a Awurade de maa mo de fa awo ntoatoaso a ɛbɛba no nyinaa mu,

english_verse: If all of you disobey one of my laws without knowing it, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice, a wine offering, and a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: na sɛ wɔnam awerɛfiri so fom a nnipa no nyinaa nnim a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔman no nyinaa de aduan afɔrebɔde ne ɔnom afɔrebɔde ne ɔpapo a wɔde no bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre ka ho.

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,
translation_verse: Na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsɔfo no yɛ mpata ma Israelfo nyinaa na wɔde wɔn bɔne akyɛ wɔn; efisɛ, ɛyɛ mfomso, na wɔnam ɔhyew afɔrebɔ so abɔ afɔre wɔ Awurade anim a wɔn bɔne afɔrebɔde ka ho.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong without knowing it, you must sacrifice a year-old female goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nanso sɛ onipa baako bi yɛ mfomso awerɛfiri mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde abirekyibere ba a wadi afe bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔre.

english_verse: The priest will then ask me to forgive you, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsɔfo no yɛ mpata ma nea ɔfom no wɔ Awurade anim na wɔde ne bɔne akyɛ no.

english_verse: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.
translation_verse: Saa mmara yi wɔ hɔ ma Israelfo ne ananafo a wɔte mo mu no nyinaa.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong on purpose, whether Israelite or foreigner, you have sinned against me by disobeying my laws. You will no longer belong to my people. A Man Put to Death for Gathering Firewood on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Mpɛn dodow a wabu Awurade asɛm animtiaa na wahyɛ da abu Awurade mmara so no, ɛsɛ sɛ woyi no fi Israelfo no mu; na ne bɔne gu ne ti so.’ ” Homeda Sobu Ho Asotwe

english_verse: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Bere a Israelfo no wɔ sare so no, wɔkyeree wɔn mu baako sɛ ɔrebubu mmabaa homeda.

english_verse: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔkyeree no no de no kɔɔ Mose ne Aaron ne atemmufo no anim,

english_verse: But no one knew what to do with him, so he was not allowed to leave.
translation_verse: na wɔde no too afiase, efisɛ na wonhu ɔkwan pɔtee a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde no fa so.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death!”
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se, “Ɛsɛ sɛ wokum saa onipa no. Nnipa no nyinaa nsiw no abo wɔ atenae no akyi baabi.”

english_verse: So he was killed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Tassels on the People's Clothes
translation_verse: Enti wɔde no kɔɔ atenae no akyi baabi kosiw no abo sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.
translation_verse: “Kasa kyerɛ Israelfo no se: Awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu no, momma biribi nsensɛn mo ntade ano na momfa hama tuntum nkyekyere sɛ nkae ade ntetare ntade no ano.

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: Ɛbɛkae mo ama moadi me mmara nyinaa so na wɔbɛtew mo ho ama mo Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God who led you out of Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mene Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn a mede mo fi Misraim asase so bae sɛ mɛyɛ mo Nyankopɔn. Mene Awurade mo Nyankopɔn no.”

english_verse: Korah son of Izhar was a Levite from the Kohathite clan. One day he called together Dathan, Abiram, and On from the Reuben tribe, and the four of them decided to rebel against Moses. So they asked
translation_verse: na wɔsɔre tiaa Mose. Na mpanyimfo atitiriw ahannu aduonum a wɔn nyinaa fra agyinatukuw no mu no ka ho.

english_verse: and Aaron and said, “Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge?”
translation_verse: Wɔkɔɔ Mose ne Aaron hɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Mo ahomaso no amee yɛn; monnyɛ kronkron nsen obiara. Awurade na wayi obiara a ɔwɔ Israel ha na ɔka yɛn nyinaa ho. Tumi bɛn na mowɔ sɛ moma mo ho so sɛ moyɛ mpanyimfo a ɛsɛ sɛ yetie mo na afei moma mo ho so sen obiara wɔ bere a yɛn nyinaa yɛ Awurade mma?”

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Mose tee saa asɛm no, ɔde nʼanim butuw fam.

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: Ɔka kyerɛɛ Kora ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho no se, “Anɔpa, Awurade bɛkyerɛ mo wɔn a wɔyɛ ne dea ne nea ɔyɛ kronkron ne nea wayi no sɛ ɔmmɛn no.

english_verse: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!
translation_verse: na ɔkyena monhyew aduhuam wɔ mu wɔ Awurade anim. Na nea Awurade bɛpaw no no na ɔbɛyɛ ɔkronkronni. Afei de, Lewifo moayɛ ama aboro so!”

english_verse: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?
translation_verse: Yi a Israel Nyankopɔn ayi wo afi nnipa bebree mu ama woabɛn no pɛɛ no, a woyɛ Awurade Ahyiae Ntamadan mu adwuma, na wutumi gyina nnipa anim yɛ asɔfodwuma no sua ma wo ana?

english_verse: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.
translation_verse: Ɔde wo ne wo mfɛfo Lewifo nyinaa abɛn no pɛɛ, nanso afei de, woagyina pintinn sɛ woregye asɔfodwuma no nso.

english_verse: You and your followers have rebelled against the Lord, not against Aaron.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ Awurade na wo ne wʼakyidifo abɔ mu atia no no. Hena ne Aaron a wunwiinwii tia no?”

english_verse: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: “We won't come!
translation_verse: Afei Mose frɛɛ Eliab mmabarima Datan ne Abiram, nanso wobuae se, “Yɛremma!

english_verse: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!
translation_verse: So esua ma wo sɛ wode yɛn fi yɛn asase a nufusu ne ɛwo sen wɔ so no so de yɛn aba sare so sɛ worebekum yɛn ana? Na afei, wopɛ sɛ wohyɛ yɛn so nso!

english_verse: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord, “Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.”
translation_verse: Mose bo fuw na ɔka kyerɛɛ Awurade se, “Nnye wɔn afɔrebɔde biara! Minwiaa wɔn afurum baako mpo na menyɛɛ wɔn mu biara bɔne bi.”

english_verse: Then he said to Korah, “Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ Kora se, “Ɔkyena wo ne wʼakyidifo no nyinaa mmra Awurade anim wɔ ha; wo ne wɔn ne Aaron.

english_verse: Each of you take along your fire pan with incense in it and offer the incense to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Obiara mfa nʼaduhuamyɛfo nkuku a aduhuam gu so mmra. Obiara mfa aduhuamyɛfo kuku mmra. Ne nyinaa dodow yɛ ahannu aduonum; na momfa mmra Awurade anim. Mo ne Aaron na ɛsɛ sɛ mode ba.”

english_verse: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Enti wɔn mu biara de nʼaduhuamyɛfo kuku a wasɔ aduhuam wɔ mu bae na wɔne Mose ne Aaron begyinagyinaa Ahyiae Ntamadan no ano.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory
translation_verse: Bere a Kora aboa nʼakyidifo a wɔasɔre atia wɔn no nyinaa ano wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no ano no, Awurade daa nʼanuonyam adi kyerɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa.

english_verse: and said to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron se,

english_verse: “Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once!”
translation_verse: “Montwe mo ho mfi saa nnipa yi ho na manya kwan asɛe wɔn prɛko.”

english_verse: But the two men bowed down and prayed, “Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned?”
translation_verse: Nanso Mose ne Aaron de wɔn anim butubutuw fam wɔ Awurade anim. Wɔsrɛe se, “Ao, Onyankopɔn, amansan nyinaa Nyankopɔn, sɛ onipa baako yɛ bɔne a, na ɛsɛ sɛ wo bo fu nnipa no nyinaa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered Moses,
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose se,

english_verse: “Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ nnipa no se, ‘Mumfi Kora, Datan ne Abiram ntamadan no mu.’ ”

english_verse: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.
translation_verse: Enti Mose kɔɔ Datan ne Abiram ntamadan no mu a na Israel mpanyimfo di nʼakyi. Ɔka kyerɛɛ nnipa no se,

english_verse: Then Moses warned the people, “Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.”
