translation_verse: Na Seir mmabarima yɛ Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Eser ne Disan.

english_verse: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
translation_verse: Na Lotan mmabarima yɛ Hori ne Homam. Na Lotan nuabea din de Timna.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
translation_verse: Na Sobal mmabarima yɛ Alian, Manahat, Ebal, Sefi ne Onam. Sibeon mmabarima yɛ Aya ne Ana.

english_verse: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation_verse: Na Ana babarima yɛ Dison. Na Dison mma yɛ Hemdan, Esban, Yitran ne Keran.

english_verse: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
translation_verse: Na Eser mmabarima yɛ Bilhan, Saawan ne Akan. Na Disan mmabarima yɛ Us ne Aran. Edom Sodifo

english_verse: After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.
translation_verse: Na Bela wui no, Serah babarima Yobab a ofi Bosra bedii nʼade sɛ ɔhene.

english_verse: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.
translation_verse: Na Yobab wui no, Husam a ofi Teman asase so bedii nʼade sɛ ɔhene.

english_verse: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.
translation_verse: Husam wu akyi no, Hadad a ɔyɛ Bedad babarima a okodii Midian so nkonim wɔ Moab asase so no na odii nʼade sɛ ɔhempɔn. Wɔtoo nʼahenkurow no din Hawit.

english_verse: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;
translation_verse: Hadad wui no, Samla a ofi Masreka kuropɔn mu bɛyɛɛ ɔhene.

english_verse: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;
translation_verse: Samla wui no, Saulo a ofi Rehobot a ɛda asu Eufrate ho no bedii hene.

english_verse: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.
translation_verse: Na Saulo wui no, Akbor babarima Baal-Hanan bedii hene.

english_verse: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
translation_verse: Baal-Hanan wui no, Hadad tenaa kuropɔn Pai mu dii hene. Na ne yere a wɔfrɛ no Mehetabel no yɛ Matred babea ne Me-Sahab nso nena.

english_verse: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translation_verse: Na Hadad nso wui. Na Edom mmusua no ntuanofo ne Timna, Alia, Yetet,

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: Oholibama, Ela, Pinon,

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: Kenas, Teman, Mibsar,

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Yuda ne Kanaannibea Bat-Sua woo mmabarima baasa. Na wɔn din de Er, Onan ne Sela. Nanso na abakan Er no yɛ omumɔyɛfo nti, Awurade kum no.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Akyiri no, Yuda ne nʼase kunafo Tamar woo nta. Na wɔn din de Peres ne Serah. Enti Yuda woo mmabarima baanum.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Na Peres mmabarima din de Hesron ne Hamul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Serah mmabarima din de Simri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol ne Dara; wɔyɛ baanum.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Akar a ɔyɛ Karmi babarima ne Serah asefo no mu baako nam fa a ɔfaa asade a wogyaw maa Awurade no so, de amanehunu baa Israelfo so.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Na Etan babarima ne Asaria. Efi Yuda Nana Barima Hesron So Kosi Dawid So

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Hesron mmabarima din de Yerahmeel, Ram ne Kaleb.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Ram yɛ Aminadab agya. Aminadab yɛ Nahson a na ɔyɛ Yuda ntuanoni no agya.

english_verse: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz,
translation_verse: Nahson yɛ Salma agya. Na Salma nso yɛ Boas agya.

english_verse: Jesse had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem, and David.
translation_verse: Ne babarima a ɔto so asia no din de Osem na Dawid na na ɔto so ason.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: Na wɔn nuabeanom din de Seruia ne Abigail. Na Seruia woo mmabarima baasa a wɔn din yɛ Abisai, Yoab ne Asahel.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Abigail waree ɔbarima bi a ne din de Yeter a ɔyɛ Ismaelni na wɔwoo ɔbabarima a wɔtoo no din Amasa. Hesron Babarima Kaleb Asefo

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Na Hesron babarima Kaleb wɔ yerenom baanu a wɔne Asuba ne Yeriot. Na Asuba mmabarima din de Yeser, Sobab ne Ardon.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Asuba wu akyi no, Kaleb waree Efrata. Wɔwoo ɔbabarima too no din Hur.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Hur woo Uri. Uri nso woo Besaleel.

english_verse: was the father of Jair, who ruled
translation_verse: Segub woo Yair a odii nkurow aduonu abiɛsa so wɔ Gilead asase so no.

english_verse: Some time later the nations of Geshur and Aram captured
translation_verse: Na eyinom nyinaa yɛ Makir a ɔyɛ Gilead agya no asefo.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Hesron wuu wɔ kurow Kaleb-Efrata mu akyi no, ne yere Abia woo ɔbabarima a wɔtoo no din Asur . Hesron Ba Yerahmeel Asefo

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Hesron abakan Yerahmeel mmabarima a ɔwoo wɔn no din yɛ Ram , Buna, Oren, Osem ne Ahiya.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Na Yerahmeel wɔ ɔyere a ɔto so abien a wɔfrɛ no Atara, na ɔno na ɔwoo Onam.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Ram a ɔyɛ Yerahmeel abakan no mmabarima yɛ Maas, Yamin ne Eker.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam mmabarima yɛ Samai ne Yada. Na Samai mmabarima yɛ Nadab ne Abisur.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Na Abisur ne ne yere Abihail mmabarima yɛ Ahban ne Molid.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Na Nadab mmabarima yɛ Seled ne Apaim. Seled wui a wanwo mma;

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: na Apaim de, ɔwoo ɔbabarima a wɔfrɛ no Yisi. Na Yisi woo Sesan. Na Sesan nyaa nʼaseni bi a wɔfrɛ no Ahlai.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Na Samai nuabarima Yada woo Yeter ne Yonatan. Na Yeter wui a wanwo ba biara,

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Sesan de ne mmabea no mu baako maa Yarha aware na wɔwoo ɔbabarima too no din Atai.

english_verse: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.
translation_verse: Atai woo Natan na Natan woo Sabad.

english_verse: Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama. The Descendants of Caleb
translation_verse: Salum woo Yekamia, na Yekamia woo Elisama. Hesron Babarima Kaleb Asefo

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Na Hebron mmabarima yɛ Kora, Tapua, Rekem ne Sema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Na Sema woo Raham. Raham woo Yorkeam. Na Rekem woo Samai.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Na Samai woo Maon. Maon woo Bet-Sur.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Na Kaleb mpena Efa woo Haran, Mosa ne Gases. Na Haran woo Gases.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Na Yahdai mmabarima yɛ Regem, Yotam, Gesan, Pelet, Efa ne Saaf.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kaleb mpena foforo bi a wɔfrɛ no Maaka woo Seber ne Tirhana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Ɔsan woo Saaf a na ɔyɛ Madmana agya ne Sewa a na ɔyɛ Makbena ne Gibea agya. Na Kaleb woo ɔbabea a ne din de Aksa.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Sobal a ɔyɛ Kiriat-Yearim agya no mmabarima yɛ Haroe a ne fa yɛ Manahatini

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: na ne fa a aka no fi Kiriat-Yearim mmusua mu. Sobal asefo a wɔka ho ne Yitrifo, Putifo, Sumatifo ne Misraimfo, wɔn mu na Sorafo ne Estaolfo fi.

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: ne akyerɛwfo mmusua a wɔte Yabes no, Tirafo, Simeafo ne Sukatfo. Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Kenifo, Hamat a ɔyɛ Rekab agya no asefo.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: Eyinom ne Dawid mmabarima a ne mpena mma nka ho. Na Dawid wɔ ɔbabea bi a wɔfrɛ no Tamar. Salomo Asefo

english_verse: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Na Yosia mmabarima ne Yohanan a ɔyɛ abakan, Yehoiakim to so abien, Sedekia to so abiɛsa, na Salum to so anan.

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Yehoiakim babarima Yehoiakyin na odii nʼade, na ɔno nso ne wɔfa Sedekia bedii nʼade. Yehoiakyin Asefo

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Yehoiakyin a Babiloniafo kyeree no kɔtoo afiase no mmabarima ne Sealtiel,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: Malkiram, Pedaia, Senasar, Yekamia, Hosama ne Nedabia.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Na Pedaia mmabarima yɛ Serubabel ne Simei. Na Serubabel mmabarima yɛ Mesulam ne Hanania. Na ɔwɔ ɔbabea nso a ne din de Selomit.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Na ne mmabarima baanum bi nso din ne Hasuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia ne Yusab-Hesed.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Na Sekania asefo yɛ Semaia ne ne mmabarima Hatus, Igal, Baria, Nearia ne Safat. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ baasia.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Na Nearia mmabarima din de Elioenai, Hiskia ne Asrikam. Na wɔyɛ baasa.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Na Elioenai mmabarima din de Hodawia, Eliasib, Pelaia, Akub, Yohanan, Delaia ne Anani. Na wɔyɛ baason.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Yuda asefo no bi din de Peres, Hesron, Karmi, Hur ne Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Sobal babarima Reaia na ɔwoo Yahat. Yahat woo Ahumai ne Lahad. Eyinom na na wɔyɛ Sorafo mmusua.

english_verse: Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
translation_verse: Penuel a na ɔyɛ Gedor agya ne Eser a na ɔyɛ Husa agya. Eyinom na na wɔyɛ Hur a na ɔyɛ Efrata abakan ne Betlehem agya no asefo.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Na Tekoa agya a ne din de Ashur no wɔ yerenom baanu a wɔfrɛ wɔn Hela ne Naara.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: ne Kos a nʼasefo ne Anub, Hasobeba ne Harum babarima Aharhel, Harum ne ne mmusua nyinaa.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Yabes a ɔyɛɛ ɔkɛse sen ne nuabarimanom nyinaa. Ne na too no din Yabes, efisɛ onyaa ɔyaw wɔ nʼawo mu.

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Yabes ne obi a ɔbɔɔ mpae kyerɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn se, “Ao, hyira me na trɛw mʼahye mu. Mesrɛ wo, ka me ho wɔ nea mɛyɛ biara mu, na yi me fi ɔhaw ne ɔyaw nyinaa mu.” Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ nʼabisade no maa no.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenas mmabarima ne Otniel ne Seraia. Otniel mmabarima ne Hatat ne Meonotai.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Meonotai woo Ofra. Na Seraia woo Yoab a ofii Adwumfo Bon ase, efisɛ na adwumfo pii tete hɔ.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Na Yefune babarima Kaleb mmabarima yɛ Iru, Ela ne Naam. Na Ela babarima yɛ Kenas.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Na Hodia yere yɛ Naham nuabea. Ne mmabarima no mu baako na ɔwoo Keila a ɔyɛ Garmini na ɔbaako nso woo Estemoa a ɔyɛ Maakatni.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Simon mmabarima ne Amnon, Rina, Ben-Hanan ne Tilon. Na Yisi asefo no ne Sohet ne Ben-Sohet. Yuda Babarima Sela Asefo

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Na wɔyɛ nkukunwemfo a na wɔte Netaim ne Gedera. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ nnwuma ma ɔhene. Simeon Asefo

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Na Simeon mmabarima no din de Nemuel, Yamin, Yarib, Serah ne Saulo.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Na Saulo asefo yɛ Salum, Mibsam ne Misma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Na Misma asefo yɛ Hamuel, Sakur ne Simei.

english_verse: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.
translation_verse: Bet-Markabot, Hasar-Susim, Bet-Biri ne Saaraim. Na saa nkurow yi nyinaa hyɛɛ wɔn ase kosii ɔhene Dawid bere so.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Wɔn asefo nso tenaa Etam, Ain, Rimon, Token ne Asan a ɛyɛ nkurow anum yi so,

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: ne ne nkuraa a atwa ho ahyia no kosii Baal. Na wɔn atenae ni, na wɔahyehyɛ saa din yi nyinaa wɔ wɔn anato nkrataa mu.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: Din a yɛabobɔ yi yɛ ntuanofo a wɔdeda Simeon mmusuakuw a wɔyɛ adefo no ano no bi.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: Wɔkɔɔ Gedor fam a na ɛwɔ obon no apuei fam sɛ wɔrekɔpɛ asase pa ama wɔn mmoa adidi so.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Wonyaa mmoa adidibea pa wɔ hɔ. Na asase no so dwo na basabasayɛ biara nni hɔ. Na Ham asefo no bi akɔtena Gedor fa mu hɔ dedaw.

english_verse: but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
translation_verse: Yudahene Hesekia bere so no, Simeon ntuanofo no ko dii hɔ so, sɛee Ham ne Meunifo afi pasaa. Wokum obiara a na ɔte hɔ, faa asase no, efisɛ, na wɔpɛ sɛ wonya mmoa didibea pa no.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Amalekfo kakra a wɔkae no, wokunkum wɔn nyinaa, faa hɔ, na wɔtenaa hɔ.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Na Israel babarima panyin ne Ruben. Nanso esiane sɛ wammu nʼagya, na ɔne nʼagya mpenanom no mu baako kɔdae no nti, ɔde nʼabakanyɛ maa ne nua Yosef mmabarima. Esiane saa asɛm yi nti, wɔamfa Ruben din anka anato no ho sɛ abakan.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Israel abakan Ruben no mmabarima ne: Hanok, Palu, Hesron ne Karmi.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: ne Beera. Bere a Asiriahene Tilgat-Pilneser de Rubenfo kɔɔ nnommumfa mu no, Beera na na odi Rubenfo no anim.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: ne Asas babarima Bela a ɔyɛ Sema babarima a ɔyɛ Yoel babarima. Saa Rubenfo yi tenaa beae a efi Aroer de kosi Nebo ne Baal-Meon.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ na wɔwɔ anantwi bebree wɔ Gilead asase so no nti, wodidi kɔɔ apuei fam wɔ nweatam a ɛtrɛw kɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate no ho.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Ɔhene Saulo bere so, Rubenfo dii Hagarfo so nkonim wɔ ɔko mu. Enti wotu kɔɔ Hagarfo atenae a ɛwɔ Gilead apuei fam hɔ no. Gad Asefo

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Basan asase so no, na Gad asefo na wɔtete asase a edi Rubenfo de no so. Wɔtrɛw kɔɔ apuei fam kosii Saleka.

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Na Yoel na otua wɔn ano wɔ Basan asase so. Na Safam, Yanai ne Safat yɛ nʼaboafo.

english_verse: Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
translation_verse: Na wɔn abusuafo a wɔyɛ ntuanofo ma mmusua afoforo ason din ne: Mikael, Mesulam, Seba, Yorai, Yakan, Sia ne Eber.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Huri babarima Abihail a ɔyɛ Yaroa babarima, Gilead babarima, Mikael babarima, Yesisai babarima Yahdo babarima, Bus babarima.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Abdiel babarima Ahi, Guni babarima no na na ɔyɛ wɔn mmusua no ntuano.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Gadfo no tenaa Gilead asase a ɛwɔ Basan ne ne nkuraa ne Saron tataw no nyinaa so.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Yudahene Yotam ne Israelhene Yeroboam bere so na wɔkyerɛw eyinom nyinaa guu abusuadua nkrataa mu. Yordan Apuei Fam Mmusuakuw

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Wɔko tiaa Hagarfo, Yeturfo, Nafisfo ne Nodabfo.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Wosu frɛɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔko no mu, na otiee wɔn mpaebɔ, efisɛ wɔde wɔn ho too ne so. Enti wodii Hagarfo no ne wɔn dɔm nyinaa so nkonim.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Wokunkum Hagarfo no bebree wɔ ɔko no mu, efisɛ na Onyankopɔn reko tia wɔn. Enti wɔtenaa wɔn asase so kosii sɛ wotwaa wɔn asu.

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Manase abusua fa no trɛw wɔ asase no so fi Basan kosii Baal-Hermon, Senir ne bepɔw Hermon ho. Na wɔdɔɔso yiye.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Eyinom ne wɔn mmusua no ntuanofo: Efer, Yisi, Eliel, Asriel, Yeremia, Hodawia ne Yahdiel. Na wɔn mu biara agye din sɛ ɔkofo kɛse ne ɔkannifo.

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Nanso na wonni nokware, na wobuu wɔn agyanom ne Onyankopɔn apam no so. Wɔsom aman a Onyankopɔn sɛee wɔn no anyame.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Enti Israel Nyankopɔn de hyɛɛ Asiriahene Pul koma mu sɛ ɔnko mfa asase no, na ɔnkyekyere Rubenfo, Gadfo ne Manasefo abusua fa sɛ nneduafo. Asiriafo no twaa wɔn asu kɔɔ Halah, Habor, Hara ne Asubɔnten Gosan ho a wɔda so te hɔ besi nnɛ.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Na Kohat asefo nso yɛ: Amram, Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Na Amram mma yɛ: Aaron, Mose ne Miriam. Na Aaron mmabarima yɛ: Nadab, Abihu, Eleasar ne Itamar.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Wotwaa Yehosadak asu bere a Awurade de Yudafo ne Yerusalemfo kɔɔ nnommum mu a na wɔhyɛ Nebukadnessar ase no. Lewifo Mmusua

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Na Lewi mmabarima din de Gersom, Kohat ne Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Na Libni ne Simei ka Gersom asefo ho.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Na Amram, Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel ka Kohat asefo no ho.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Na Mahli ne Musi ka Merari asefo no ho. Eyinom ne Lewifo mmusua sɛnea wɔn mpanyimfo nnidiso te.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Na Elkana asefo ne: Amasai, Ahimot,

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: Eliab, Yeroham, Elkana ne Samuel.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Na Samuel mmabarima din ne: Yoel a ɔyɛ ɔpanyin ne Abiya a ɔto so abien no.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: Simea, Hagia ne Asaia. Asɔredan Mu Nnwom Ho Nimdefo

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Dawid maa saa nnipa a wɔn din didi so yi dii Awurade fi nnwom anim, bere a wɔde Apam Adaka no sii hɔ no.

english_verse: These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
translation_verse: Wɔde nnwom kaa wɔn som ho wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu hɔ kosii sɛ Salomo sii Awurade asɔredan no wɔ Yerusalem. Afei, wɔnam mmara a wɔde maa wɔn so dii wɔn dwuma wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Wɔmaa wɔn abusuafo a wɔyɛ Lewifo no nso dwuma ahorow bi dii wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan a ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn fi no mu.

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Aaron ne nʼasefo nko na wɔsom sɛ asɔfo. Na wɔde afɔrebɔde gu ɔhyew afɔremuka ne ohuam afɔremuka so, na wodi dwuma biara a ɛfa kronkron mu kronkron hɔ ho. Wɔnam mmara a Onyankopɔn somfo Mose de maa wɔn no so, yɛɛ mpata maa Israel.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Eyi ne abakɔsɛm a ɛfa nkurow ne asase a wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so de maa Aaron ne nʼasefo a wofi Kohat abusua mu no.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Na Hebron ne mmoa adidibea nsase a atwa ho ahyia wɔ Yuda no ka ho.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Nanso mfuw ne nkuraa a atwa ho ahyia no de, wɔde maa Yefune babarima Kaleb.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Na wɔmaa wɔn Gibeon, Geba, Alemet ne Anatot fii Benyamin asase mu a mmoa adidibea ka emu biara ho. Enti nkurow dumiɛnsa na wɔde maa Aaron asefo.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Na Kohat asefo a wɔkae no nso, wonyaa nkurow du a wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so fii Manase abusua fa no asase so.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Gerson asefo nam ntontobɔ kronkron so nyaa nkurow dumiɛnsa fii Isakar, Aser ne Naftali nsase so. Wonyaa bi nso fii Basan pɔw mu a ɛyɛ Manase de, a ɛwɔ Yordan apuei fam no.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Merari asefo nam ntontobɔ kronkron so, nyaa nkurow dumien fii Ruben, Gad ne Sebulon nsase so.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Enti Israelfo de saa nkurow yi ne mmoa adidibea yi nyinaa maa Lewifo.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so na wɔde nkurow a ɛwowɔ Yuda, Simeon ne Benyamin nsase so mae sɛnea wɔaka dedaw no.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Saa nkurow yi ne ɛho mmoa adidibea na Kohat asefo nya fii Efraim asase so:

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Gerson asefo nyaa kurow a wɔfrɛ no Golan a ɛwɔ Basan no fii Manase abusua fa asase so a Astarot ka ho, a ne nyinaa mmoa adidibea da ho.

english_verse: The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Hukok ne Rehob a na emu biara mmoa adidibea ka ho.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Naftali asase so, wɔde Kedes a ɛwɔ Galilea, Hamon ne Kiriataim maa wɔn, a na mmoa adidibea ka emu biara ho.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Merari asefo nkae no nyaa Yokneam, Karta, Rimon ne Tabor nkurow, fi Sebulon asase so, a na mmoa adidibea ka biara ho.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Na Isakar mmabarima baanan no din de Tola, Pua, Yasub ne Simron.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Tola mmabarima no ne: Usi, Refaia, Yeriel, Yahmai, Yibsam ne Samuel. Na wɔn mu biara yɛ wɔn agyanom mmusua ntuanofo. Ɔhene Dawid bere so no, na mmarima dodow a wɔwɔ saa mmusua yi mu a wɔyɛ asraafo no dodow yɛ mpem aduonu abien ne ahansia (

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Wɔn agya Efraim suu wɔn kyɛe yiye, na nʼabusuafo bɛkyekyee ne werɛ.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Na Usi babarima din de: Yisrahia. Na Yisrahia mmabarima din de: Mikael, Obadia, Yoel ne Yisia a na wɔn baanum tuatua mmusua ano.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Na Sofa mmabarima din de: Suah, Harnefer, Sual, Beri, Yimra,

english_verse: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of
translation_verse: Mmarima a na wɔwɔ hɔ a wofi Isakar mmusua no nyinaa mu a wɔyɛ asraafo no dodow yɛ mpem aduɔwɔtwe ason (

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Na Benyamin mmabarima baasa no din de: Bela. Beker ne Yediael.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Na Bela mmabarima yɛ: Esbon, Usi, Usiel, Yerimot ne Iri. Na saa akofo baanum yi yɛ mmusua ntuanofo. Nnipa a wofi wɔn asefo mu yɛɛ asraafo no dodow yɛ mpem aduonu abien ne aduasa anan (

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Na Beker mmabarima din de: Semira, Yoas, Elieser, Elioenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abia, Anatot ne Alemet.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Efraim asefo ne: Sutela, Bered, Tahat, Elada, Tahat,

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Na Yediael babarima ne: Bilhan. Na Bilhan mmabarima ne: Yeus, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Setan, Tarsis ne Ahisahar.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Na Ulam babarima din de: Bedan. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ Gileadfo a wɔyɛ Manase babarima Makir asefo.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Na Ir mmabarima ne Supim, ne Hupim. Aher na ɔwoo Husim. Naftali Asefo

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Na Naftali mmabarima yɛ: Yahsiel, Guni, Yeser ne Silum. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ Yakob yere Bilha asefo. Manase Asefo

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manase mmabarima a ɔne ne mpena Aramni wowoo wɔn ne Asriel ne Makir. Makir na ɔwoo Gilead.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Makir pɛɛ ɔyerenom maa Hupim ne Supim. Na wɔfrɛ Makir nuabea se Maaka. Na Makir asefo no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Selofehad wowoo mmabea nko ara.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Makir yere Maaka woo ɔbabarima a ɔtoo no din Peres. Na ne nuabarima din de Seres. Peres mmabarima din de Ulam ne Rekem.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Makir nuabea Moleket woo Is-Hod, Abieser ne Mahla.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Na Semida mmabarima yɛ: Ahian, Sekem, Likhi ne Aniam. Efraim Asefo

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: Sabad ne Sutela. Wokunkum Efraim mmabarima Eser ne Elad wɔ Gat, efisɛ wɔpɛe sɛ wowia nyɛmmoa fi akuafo a wɔbɛn hɔ no.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Ɛno akyi no, Efraim kɔɔ ne yere ho, na onyinsɛn woo ɔbabarima. Efraim too no din Beria esiane abɛbrɛsɛ a nʼabusuafo faa mu no nti.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Efraim woo ɔbabea too no din Seer. Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree nkurow Bet-Horon Anafo, Atifi ne Usen-Seera.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Efraim asefo nnidiso ne Refa, Resef, Tela, Tahan,

english_verse: Nun, and Joshua.
translation_verse: Nun ne Yosua.

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Efraim asefo no tenaa asase Bet-El ne ne nkurow a atwa afa anafo fam, Naaran a ɛda apuei fam, Geser ne ne nkuraa a ɛda atɔe fam ne Sekem ne ne nkuraa a atwa ho ahyia, kɔfa atifi fam, de kosi Aya a nkuraa ka ho no so.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Manase hye so no, na nkurow a ɛdeda hɔ yɛ Bet-Sean, Taanak, Megido, Dor ne wɔn nkuraa a atwa ho ahyia no. Israel ba Yosef asefo tenaa saa nkurow yi so. Aser Asefo

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Na Aser mmabarima yɛ: Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi ne Beria. Na wɔwɔ onuabea a ne din de Sera.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Na Beria mmabarima din de: Heber ne Malkiel a ɔwoo Birsait no.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Na Heber mmabarima din de Yaflet, Somer ne Hotam. Na wɔwɔ onuabea a ne din de Sua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Na Yaflet mmabarima din de: Pasak, Bimhal ne Aswat.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Na Semer mmabarima din de: Ahi, Rohga, Hubah ne Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Na ne nuabarima Helem mmabarima din de: Sofa, Yimna, Seles ne Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: Beser, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Yitran ne Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Na Yeter mmabarima din de: Yefune, Pispa ne Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Na Ula mmabarima din de: Arah, Haniel ne Risia.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Na Aser asefo no mu biara yɛ wɔn agyanom abusua panyin. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ akofo pa ne ntuanofo a wodi mu. Na mmarima mpem aduonu asia (

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Benyamin mmabarima na wodidi so yi: Bela , Asbel, Ahra,

english_verse: Nohah, and Rapha.
translation_verse: Noha ne Rafha.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bela mmabarima yɛ: Adar, Gera, Abihud,

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: Abisua, Naaman, Ahoa,

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: Gera, Sefufan ne Huram.

english_verse: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
translation_verse: Ehud mmabarima ne Naaman, Ahiya ne Gera. Gera a na ɔyɛ Usa ne Ahihud agya no na bere a wɔretu no odii wɔn anim.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Elpaal mmabarima yɛ: Eber, Misam ne Semed a ɔkyekyeree Ono ne Lod ne wɔn nkuraa no,

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Beria ne Sema. Na wɔyɛ mmusua ntuanofo a na wɔte Ayalon, na wɔpam ɔmanfo a wɔte Gat no.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne agyanom mmusua ntuanofo a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din wɔ wɔn mu biara anato nkrataa mu. Na wɔn nyinaa tenaa Yerusalem. Saulo Abusua

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Yeiel tenaa Gibeon. Na ne yere din de Maaka

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: a na ne babarima abakan din de Abdon. Na Yeiel mmabarima a wɔaka no din de Sur, Kis, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Seker,

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: ne Miklot a ɔyɛ Simea agya. Na saa abusuafo yi tete bemmɛn wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Ner na ɔwoo Kis. Kis na ɔwoo Saulo, Saulo na ɔwoo Yonatan, Malki-Sua, Abinadab ne Esbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Yonatan babarima ne: Merib-Baal na Merib-Baal woo Mika.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mika mmabarima ne: Piton, Melek, Tarea ne Ahas.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Ahas woo Yehoada na Yehoada woo Alemet, Asmawet ne Simri. Na Simri woo Mosa.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Asel woo mmabarima baasia a wɔne: Asrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia ne Hanan. Na eyinom yɛ Asel mma.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulam mmabarima nyinaa yɛ akofo a wɔakwadaw akodi mu, wɔyɛ agyantowfo antoamfom. Na wɔwɔ mma ne nananom bebree a na wɔn nyinaa dodow yɛ ɔha aduonum. Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Benyamin asefo.

english_verse: And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔsan ba bɛfaa wɔn agyapade wɔ wɔn nkurow dedaw mu no yɛ mpapahwekwa. Wɔne asɔfo, Lewifo ne asɔredan mu aboafo no bi na wɔbae.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nnipa a wofi Yuda, Benyamin, Efraim ne Manase mmusuakuw mu ba bɛtenaa Yerusalem.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: Asɔfo a wɔsan bae no bi ne Adaia a ɔyɛ Yeroham babarima a na ɔno nso yɛ Pashur babarima na ɔno nso yɛ Malkia babarima ne Masai a ɔyɛ Adiel babarima na ɔno nso yɛ Yahsera babarima na ɔno nso yɛ Mesulam babarima a ɔno nso yɛ Mesilemit babarima na ɔno nso yɛ Imer babarima.

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Apon ano hwɛfo a wɔsan bae no yɛ: Salum, Akub, Talmon, Ahiman ne wɔn abusuafo. Salum na na ɔyɛ ɔpon ano hwɛfo panyin.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: Kan no nso, na anka wɔn na wɔhwɛ ɔhene pon a ɛkyerɛ apuei fam no so. Na saa mmarima no som sɛ Lewifo atenae apon ano ahwɛfo.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Salum yɛ Kore babarima a ɔyɛ Ebiasaf a ofi Kora abusua mu aseni. Na ɔne nʼabusuafo a wɔyɛ Korafo no na na wɔwɛn ɔkwan a ɛkɔ kronkronbea hɔ no, sɛnea na wɔn mpanyimfo wɛn Ahyiae Ntamadan wɔ Awurade atenae hɔ no.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Eleasar babarima Pinehas na kan no na ɔhwɛ apon ano ahwɛfo no so, na Awurade ka ne ho.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Akyiri no, Meselemia babarima Sakaria na na ɔwɛn ɔkwan a ɛkɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan no mu no ano.

english_verse: guards, all of them listed in the family records in their towns. Their ancestors had been chosen by King David and by Samuel the prophet to be responsible for this work,
translation_verse: ) a na wɔakyerɛw wɔn din wɔ wɔn anato nkrataa mu wɔ wɔn nkuraa. Dawid ne Samuel a na ɔyɛ ɔdehufo no ama wɔn dibea a ɛsom bo.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Wɔde apon ano ahwɛfo no gyinagyinaa afanan no nyinaa a ɛyɛ apuei, atɔe, atifi ne anafo.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Bere ano bere ano, na wɔn abusuafo a wɔwɔ nkuraa no bɛboa wɔn wɔ wɔn nnanson nnanson dwumadi mu.

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: Na saa Lewifo apon ano ahwɛfo mpanyimfo baanan no adwuma no yɛ nea ekura asodi kɛse, efisɛ wɔn na na wɔhwɛ adan ne sikakoradan a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn fi hɔ no so.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Wɔwɛn Onyankopɔn fi hɔ anadwo, efisɛ na ɛyɛ wɔn asɛde. Afei, na ɛyɛ wɔn adwuma sɛ da biara anɔpa wobuebue apon no.

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Na apon ano ahwɛfo no bi adwuma ne sɛ, wɔhwɛ nneɛma ahorow a wɔde yɛ ɔsom adwuma no so. Sɛ wɔrekɔfa, na wɔresan de akogu hɔ no nyinaa, wɔhwɛ sɛ bi renyera.

english_verse: But only the priests could mix the spices.
translation_verse: Nanso na asɔfo no na wodi nnuhuam no ne kurobow no ho dwuma.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Lewini a wɔfrɛ no Matitia a ɔyɛ Korani Salum abakan no na na ɔto brodo a wɔde bɔ afɔre no.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na nnipa bi a wofi Kohat abusua mu nso na na wɔhwɛ, siesie brodo a wɔde to pon Homeda no.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Nnwom ho nimdefo a na wɔn nso yɛ Lewifo atitiriw no nyinaa, na wɔtete Asɔredan no mu. Na wɔmma wɔnnyɛ dwuma foforo biara, esiane wɔn adwuma a wɔyɛ no mmere nyinaa nti.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Na saa nnipa yi nyinaa tete Yerusalem. Na wɔyɛ Lewifo mmusua no nyinaa ntuanofo a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din ahyɛ wɔn anato krataa mu. Ɔhene Saulo Anato

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: Miklot na ɔyɛ Simeam agya. Na saa abusuafo yi tete bemmɛn wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Yeiel tenaa Gibeon. Na ne yere din de Maaka,

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: a na ne babarima abakan din de Abdon. Na Yeiel mmabarima a wɔaka no din de Sur, Kis, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Sakaria ne Miklot.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Ner na ɔwoo Kis. Kis na ɔwoo Saulo, Saulo na ɔwoo Yonatan, Malki-Sua, Abinadab ne Esbaal.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Asel woo mmabarima baasia a wɔne: Asrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia ne Hanan. Na eyinom yɛ Asel mma.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Afei, Filistifo no bɛtow hyɛɛ Israel so, maa Israelfo no guanee. Wokunkum wɔn mu pii wɔ bepɔw Gilboa so.

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Na Saulo wui, efisɛ wanni Awurade nokware. Wanni Awurade ahyɛde so, na mpo, ɔkɔɔ asamanfrɛ

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Filistifo no kaa Saulo ne ne mmabarima hyɛe. Wokunkum wɔn mu baasa a wɔne Yonatan, Abinadab ne Malki-Sua.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Ɔko no ano yɛɛ den twaa Saulo ho hyiae, maa Filistifo agyantowfo no nyaa Saulo piraa no yiye.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Saulo fi apinisi mu ka kyerɛɛ nʼakodekurafo no se, “Twe wʼafoa, fa wɔ me kum me na Filistifo abosonsomfo yi ammɛto me, angu mʼanim ase.” Nanso na nʼakodekurafo no suro nti, wanyɛ saa. Enti Saulo twee ɔno ara nʼafoa, de kum ne ho.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Bere a nʼakodekurafo no huu sɛ Saulo awu no, ɔno nso de nʼafoa kum ne ho.

english_verse: Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti, Saulo ne ne mma mmarima baasa no wuwuu hɔ ara, maa nʼahenni nnidiso no baa awiei.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
translation_verse: Bere a Israelfo a wɔwɔ Yesreel bon no mu no huu sɛ wɔadi wɔn asraafo no so, na Saulo ne ne mmabarima baasa no awuwu no, woguan gyaa wɔn nkurow hɔ. Ɛno nti, Filistifo no kɔfaa wɔn nkurow no.

english_verse: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa,
translation_verse: Ade kyee a Filistifo no kɔɔ sɛ wɔrekoyiyi atɔfo no ho nneɛma no, wohuu sɛ Saulo ne ne mmabarima no amu gugu bepɔw Gilboa so.

english_verse: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.
translation_verse: Enti woyiyii Saulo akode fii ne ho, twaa ne ti. Afei wɔbɔɔ Saulo wu no ho dawuru maa wɔn ahoni ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Filistia nyinaa tee.

english_verse: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
translation_verse: Wɔde nʼakode no guu wɔn anyame no abosonnan mu, na wɔkyekyeree ne ti no fam Dagon asɔredan no fasu ho.

english_verse: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation_verse: Nanso Yabes Gileadfo tee nea Filistifo ayɛ Saulo no,

english_verse: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: wɔn akofo kɔfaa Saulo ne ne mmabarima baasa no amu baa Yabes. Na wosiee wɔn amu wɔ odum dua bi a ɛwɔ Yabes ase, na wodii mmuada nnanson.

english_verse: instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: wɔ bere a anka ɛsɛ sɛ obisa Awurade nkyɛn akwankyerɛ. Ɛno nti, Awurade kum no, de nʼahenni hyɛɛ Yisai babarima Dawid nsa.

english_verse: The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
translation_verse: Nnipa a wofi Yebus no ka kyerɛɛ Dawid se, “Worentumi mma ha da biara da.” Nanso Dawid faa aban a na ɛwɔ Sion a wɔfrɛ no Dawid Kurow no.

english_verse: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives,
translation_verse: Na Israel nyinaa kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Hebron kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Yɛn nyinaa yɛ wʼabusuafo.

english_verse: So we have come to crown you king of Israel.” David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said. David Captures Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Enti Hebron hɔ, Dawid ne Israel ntuanofo yɛɛ apam wɔ Awurade anim. Wɔsraa no ngo, sii no Israelhene sɛnea Awurade nam Samuel so hyɛɛ ho bɔ no. Dawid Ko Fa Yerusalem

english_verse: David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
translation_verse: Dawid ka kyerɛɛ nʼakofo no se, “Mo mu biara a obedi anim na yɛakɔtow ahyɛ Yebusifo no so no na ɔbɛyɛ mʼakofo so sahene.” Na Dawid, nuabea Seruia babarima Yoab dii ɔko no anim, nti ɔbɛyɛɛ Dawid asraafo so sahene.

english_verse: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
translation_verse: Eyinom ne Dawid dɔmmarima ntuanofo. Wɔne Israel nyinaa bɔɔ mu, sii gyinae sɛ wɔde Dawid bɛyɛ wɔn so hene sɛnea Awurade ahyɛ bɔ afa Israel ho no.

english_verse: Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town.
translation_verse: Na Dawid ne Israel nyinaa kɔɔ Yerusalem anaa Yebus, sɛnea na wɔfrɛ hɔ kan no, efisɛ Yebusifo na wɔkɔtenaa asase no so kan kyekyeree.

english_verse: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.
translation_verse: Dawid tenaa aban no mu, na ɛno nti na wɔfrɛɛ hɔ Dawid kurow no.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Na Dawid tumi yɛɛ kɛse, efisɛ na Asafo Awurade ka ne ho. Dawid Dɔmmarima

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Da bi a na okura kontibaa nko ara no, okum Misraimni ɔkofo bi a na ne tenten yɛ anammɔn ason ne fa. Na ne peaw no mu pipiripi te sɛ ntamanwemfo nsadua. Benaia huam peaw no fii Misraimni no nsam, de kum no.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Dawid fi akɔnnɔ mu kae se, “Ao me kɔn dɔ nsu pa a ɛwɔ abura a ɛwɔ Betlehem no bi; nea ɛbɛn ɔpon ano no bi.”

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Nea ɔto so abien wɔ Baasa no mu no yɛ Dodo babarima Eleasar a ɔyɛ Ahoa aseni.

english_verse: During a battle against the Philistines at Pas-Dammim, all the Israelite soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Bere a Dawid sɔre tiaa Filistifo wɔ Pas-Damim no, na ɔka ne ho. Ɔko no sii wɔ baabi a na ɛyɛ atokofuw nko, na Israel asraafo no guanee.

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: Nanso Eleasar ne Dawid gyinaa wɔn anan so wɔ afuw no mfimfini, bɔɔ Filistifo no gui. Na Awurade ma wodii nkonim de gyee wɔn.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Da bi a Dawid wɔ ɔbotan bi a ɛbɛn Adulam ɔbodan ho no, na Filistifo asraafo akyere nsraban wɔ Refaim bon mu. Baasa no a na wɔka Aduasa no a wonim de wɔ Dawid asraafo mu no sian kohyiaa no wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress,
translation_verse: Saa bere no na Dawid te ɔko ahintawee mu hɔ a na Filistifo asraafokuw bi akɔtena Betlehem.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: teɛɛ mu se, “Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛnom saa nsu yi. Ɛsom bo sɛ saa mmarima yi a wɔde wɔn ho bɔɔ afɔre kɔsaw brɛɛ me no mogya.” Enti Dawid annom. Eyi yɛ Baasa no mmaninsɛm no bi nhwɛso. Dawid Dɔmmarima Aduasa No

english_verse: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed
translation_verse: Yoab nuabarima Abisai na na otua Aduasa no ano. Ɔko baako bi mu no, ɔde ne peaw kunkum atamfo no mu ahaasa. Saa mmaninsɛm yi nti na ogyee din sɛ Baasa no.

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Abisai na na ne din ahyeta yiye wɔ Aduasa no mu sɛ wɔn sahene, nso na ɔnka Baasa no ho.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Na Yehoiada babarima Benaia a ofi Kabseel no nso wɔ hɔ. Na ɔno nso di mmarimasɛm. Ɔyɛɛ bebree a emu baako ne sɛ okunkum Moab akofo akɛse baanu bi. Bere foforo bi nso, ɔtaa gyata maa aboa no kɔtɔɔ amoa mu. Na sukyerɛmma ama fam ayɛ toro nanso ɔkyeree gyata no kum no.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Eyinom na Yehoiada babarima Benaia yɛe, ma ogyee din te sɛ Baasa no.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: Wɔhyɛɛ no anuonyam sen nkae a wɔka Aduasa no ho no, nso na ɔmfra Baasa no mu. Na Dawid yɛɛ no ne ho awɛmfo no so sahene.

english_verse: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.
translation_verse: Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ agyantowfo antoamfomfo. Na wotumi de wɔn nsa benkum ne nifa nyinaa tow agyan ne ahwimmo. Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ Saulo abusuafo a wofi Benyamin abusuakuw mu.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Gadfo akofo akokodurufo bi a wɔakwadaw akodi mu guan kɔɔ Dawid afa bere a na ɔwɔ aguaabɔ mu wɔ sare so no. Na wɔyɛ nimdefo wɔ nkatabo ne peaw akodi mu a wɔn ho yɛ hu sɛ gyata, na wɔn ho yɛ hare te sɛ mmepɔw so atwe.

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Saa dɔmmarima a wofi Gad yi yɛ asahene. Nea ɔnyɛ den koraa no, otumi ne asraafo ɔha ko, na nea ɔyɛ den no tumi ne asraafo apem ko.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Afe no mfiase a Asubɔnten Yordan ayiri no, wotwa kɔpam nnipa a wɔtete tataw so wɔ nʼapuei ne nʼatɔe konkɔn so nyinaa fii hɔ.

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Afoforo a wofi Benyamin ne Yuda no baa Dawid nkyɛn wɔ hintabea hɔ.

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: Dawid kohyiaa wɔn kae se, “Sɛ moaba asomdwoe so sɛ morebɛboa me a, yɛyɛ nnamfo. Na sɛ moaba sɛ morebeyi me ama mʼatamfo wɔ bere a menyɛɛ bɔne bi a, yɛn agyanom Nyankopɔn nhwɛ mmu mo atɛn.”

english_verse: Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag.
translation_verse: Manase mmarima no bi tew wɔn ho kɔdɔm Dawid, bere a na ɔne Filistifo no rekɔko atia Saulo no. Nanso asɛm no ani dan a Filistifo ntuanofo ampene so sɛ Dawid ne ne mmarima no bɛka wɔn ho akɔ. Wodwinnwen ho ara no, wɔma wɔsan wɔn akyi kae se, “Sɛ Dawid dan nʼani kɔ Saulo afa de tia yɛn a, yɛn nkwa na yɛde betwa so.”

english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
translation_verse: Wɔboaa Dawid ma ɔtaa afowfo no, efisɛ na wɔyɛ akokodurufo ne akofo akɛse a wɔbɛyɛɛ asahene wɔ nʼakofo mu.

english_verse: from Ephraim, who were not only brave, but also famous in their clans;
translation_verse: ) a wɔn mu biara agye din wɔ nʼabusua mu.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Nnipa bi a wofi akyiri te sɛ Isakar, Sebulon, ne Naftali de nnuan tenaa wɔn mfurum, yoma ne anantwi so bae. Wɔde asikresiam, ɔfam, ɛhyɛ, nsa, ngo, anantwi ne nguan bebree baa afahyɛ no ase. Anigye a enni kabea baa Israel asase so.

english_verse: All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing.
translation_verse: Saa asraafo yi nyinaa kɔɔ amia mu na wɔkɔɔ Hebron a wɔn botae ara ne sɛ wɔde Dawid bɛyɛ Israelhene. Nokware, Israel nyinaa adwene kɔɔ bɛnkorɔ mu sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ Dawid na ɔyɛ wɔn hene.

english_verse: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.
translation_verse: Wɔne Dawid didi nomee nnansa, efisɛ na wɔn abusuafo no ayɛ ahoboa rehwɛ wɔn kwan.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: Afei, Dawid ne Israelfo no nyinaa kɔɔ Baala a na wɔfrɛ no Kiriat-Yearim a ɛwɔ Yuda no sɛ wɔrekɔfa Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka a wɔde ahyɛ kerubim ntam na Awurade din da so no aba.

english_verse: Some time later, David talked with his army commanders,
translation_verse: Dawid ne ne mpanyimfo a nʼasraafo so asahene ne mmapɔmma nyinaa ka ho, tuu agyina.

english_verse: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?”
translation_verse: Afei, na Dawid suro Onyankopɔn, na obisae se, “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi de Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka yi aba abɛhwɛ so?”

english_verse: The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
translation_verse: Bagua no penee saa asɛm yi so efisɛ wohuu sɛ, wɔyɛ saa a, eye.

english_verse: David gathered everyone from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Enti Dawid frɛɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Israel nyinaa, efi ɔman no ti kosi ti, sɛ wɔmmɛka ne ho na wɔmfa Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka no mfi Kiriat-Yearim mmra.

english_verse: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart,
translation_verse: Wɔde Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka no sii teaseɛnam foforo so de fii Abinadab fi a Usa ne Ahio rekyerɛ kwan.

english_verse: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translation_verse: Dawid ne Israelfo nyinaa fii wɔn ahoɔden mu too nnwom, bɔɔ mmɛn ahorow a bi yɛ asanku, mmɛnta, akasae, nnawuru ne ntorobɛnto dii ahurusi, Onyankopɔn anim.

english_verse: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.
translation_verse: Nanso woduu Nakon awiporowbea no, anantwi no anan toto maa Usa teɛɛ ne nsa sɛ ɔreteɛ Apam Adaka no.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na Awurade abufuw sɔre tiaa Usa ma owui, efisɛ ɔde ne nsa aka Apam Adaka no. Enti Usa wuu wɔ Onyankopɔn anim hɔ ara.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: Dawid bo fuwii, efisɛ Awurade abufuw atia Usa. Ɔtoo beae hɔ din Peres-Usa a wɔda so frɛ hɔ saa de besi nnɛ.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: Enti Dawid yɛɛ nʼadwene sɛ ɔnna mmfa Apam Adaka no nkɔ Dawid kurow no mu. Mmom, ɔde kɔɔ Gatni, Obed-Edom fi wɔ Gat.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka no sii Obed-Edom abusuafo nkyɛn asram abiɛsa. Na Awurade hyiraa no ne ne fifo nyinaa.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: Enti Dawid ne nʼakofo kɔɔ Baal-Perasim kodii Filistifo no so wɔ hɔ. Dawid teɛɛ mu se, “Onyankopɔn ayɛ! Ɔnam me so ama mabɔ awura mʼatamfo mu te sɛ, nsuyiri a ano yɛ den.” Enti, wɔtoo beae hɔ din Baal-Perasim .

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: Enti Dawid yɛɛ nea Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ no, na ɔkaa Filistifo asraafo no guu fi Gibeon de kosii Geser.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.
translation_verse: Afei, Tirohene Huram somaa abɔfo ne abo adansifo ne nnua dwumfo kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn sɛ, wonkosi ahemfi mma no. Afei, Huram san de sida nnua a wɔbɛpae kɔe.

english_verse: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Afei, Dawid waree mmea bebree wɔ Yerusalem, na ɔwowoo mmabarima ne mmabea bebree.

english_verse: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_verse: Na Dawid din hyetaa baabiara, na Awurade maa aman no nyinaa suroo Dawid.

english_verse: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.
translation_verse: Bere a Filistifo tee sɛ wɔasra Dawid ngo ama wadi Israel nyinaa so hene no, wɔboaboaa wɔn asraafo nyinaa ano sɛ, wɔrebɛkyere no. Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid se wɔreba ne so, enti ɔno nso ne ne mmarima fii kurow no mu kohyiaa wɔn.

english_verse: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Na Filistifo no abedu Refaim bon asɛe hɔ pasaa.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: Enti Dawid bisaa Onyankopɔn se, “Mimpue na me ne Filistifo no nkɔko? Wode wɔn bɛhyɛ me nsa ana?” Awurade buae se, “Yiw, wo ne wɔn nkɔko, na mɛma woadi wɔn so nkonim.”

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Filistifo no gyaw wɔn ahoni nyinaa hɔ nti, Dawid hyɛ ma wɔhyew ne nyinaa.

english_verse: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Nanso ankyɛ biara, Filistifo no san baa obon no mu bio bɛsɛee hɔ.

english_verse: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.
translation_verse: Dawid bisaa Onyankopɔn nea ɔnyɛ bio. Onyankopɔn buae se, “Nkɔ tee nkɔtow nhyɛ wɔn so. Mmom, fa wɔn ho kosi wɔn akyi na montow nhyɛ wɔn so wɔ baabi a ɛbɛn baka nnua no.

english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Na sɛ mote nnyigye bi te sɛ nnipa bi a wɔrebɔ nsra anan ase wɔ baka nnua no atifi a, montow nhyɛ wɔn so. Ɛno na ɛbɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ, Onyankopɔn adi mo anim rekɔka Filistifo no agu.”

english_verse: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.
translation_verse: Afei, Dawid sisii adan bebree wɔ Dawid kurom. Bio, osiesiee baabi, sii ntamadan wɔ hɔ a ɔde Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka no besi.

english_verse: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.
translation_verse: Dawid frɛɛ Israelfo nyinaa kɔɔ Yerusalem sɛ wɔmfa Apam Adaka no nkosi faako a wɔasiesie ama no no.

english_verse: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:
translation_verse: Eyinom ne asɔfo ne Lewifo a wɔfrɛɛ wɔn no:

translation_verse: ), a Asaia da wɔn ano.

english_verse: Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and
translation_verse: Wɔn a wofi Gersom abusua mu no, na wɔn dodow yɛ ɔha aduasa (

english_verse: of his relatives;
translation_verse: ), a Yoel da wɔn ano.

english_verse: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and
translation_verse: Na Elisafan asefo yɛ ahannu (

english_verse: of his relatives;
translation_verse: ) a Semaia da wɔn ano.

english_verse: Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and
translation_verse: Na Hebron asefo yɛ aduɔwɔtwe (

english_verse: of his relatives; and
translation_verse: ) a Eliel tua wɔn ano.

english_verse: Amminadab, the leader of the Uzziel clan, with
translation_verse: Na Usiel asefo yɛ ɔha ne dumien (

english_verse: of his relatives.
translation_verse: ) a Aminadab tua wɔn ano.

english_verse: David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar.
translation_verse: Afei, Dawid frɛɛ asɔfo Sadok ne Abiatar ne saa Lewifo mpanyimfo yi: Uriel, Asaia, Yoel, Semaia, Eliel ne Aminadab.

english_verse: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ kan no mo Lewifo ansoa Apam Adaka no nti, Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn, abufuw sɔre tiaa yɛn. Yɛammisa Onyankopɔn ɔkwan pa a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛfa so soa.”

english_verse: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest
translation_verse: Enti asɔfo no ne Lewifo no dwiraa wɔn ho, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi de Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn Apam Adaka no akɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
translation_verse: Na Lewifo no soaa Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka no wɔ wɔn mmati so a, nnua a wɔde soa no hyehyɛ ho pɛpɛɛpɛ, sɛnea Mose hyɛɛ wɔn no.

english_verse: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.
translation_verse: Dawid hyɛɛ Lewifo mpanyimfo no nso sɛ wɔntew Lewifo nnwontofo kuw, wɔn a wonim nnwonto, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ nnwonto ho nimdeɛ na wɔmfa mmɛnta, mmɛn, asankuten ne kyɛnkyɛn mmɛto anigye nnwom.

english_verse: Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah. Finally, David chose priests to walk in front of the sacred chest and blow trumpets. They were Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer. The Sacred Chest Is Brought to Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Sebania, Yosafat, Netanel, Amasai, Sakaria, Benaia ne Elieser a wɔn nyinaa yɛ asɔfo no na wɔbɛto santen adi Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka no anim, ahyɛn ntorobɛnto no. Woyii Obed-Edom ne Yehia sɛ wɔnwɛn Apam Adaka no. Wɔsoa Apam Adaka No Kɔ Yerusalem

english_verse: David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Enti Dawid ne Israel mpanyimfo ne asraafo so asahene no de ahokeka a ɛso bi nni kɔɔ Obed-Edom fi sɛ wɔrekɔfa Awurade Apam Adaka no akɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation_verse: Na esiane sɛ akyinnye biara nni ho sɛ Awurade ka Lewifo a wɔso Awurade Apam Adaka no ho no nti, wɔde anantwinini ason ne adwennini ason bɔɔ afɔre.

english_verse: David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth.
translation_verse: Wɔhyɛɛ Dawid sirikyi atade fɛfɛ bi. Saa ara na Lewifo a wɔsoaa Apam Adaka no, nnwontofo no ne Kenania a ɔyɛ nnwontofo no kwankyerɛfo no nso yɛe. Na Dawid hyɛ asɔfo nguguso bi nso.

english_verse: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Enti Israel nyinaa de ahokeka, osebɔ, mmɛnhyɛn ne ntorobɛntohyɛn, akasaewosow, mmɛnta ne asankutenbɔ de Awurade Apam Adaka no kɔɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Na bere a Awurade Apam Adaka no wuraa Dawid kurow mu no, Saulo babea Mikal too nʼani hwɛɛ fam, fii ne mfɛnsere mu. Bere a ohuu sɛ ɔhene Dawid resaw na ɔde anigye rehuruhuruw no, obuu no animtiaa wɔ ne koma mu.

english_verse: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
translation_verse: Dawid wiee no, ohyiraa nkurɔfo no wɔ Awurade din mu.

english_verse: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
translation_verse: Na ɔkyɛɛ Israelfo mmea ne mmarima nyinaa aduan. Obiara nyaa brodo mua, namkum ne bobe aba ɔfam.

english_verse: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Dawid yii saa Lewifo yi sɛ wonni nnipa no anim wɔ ɔsom mu, wɔ Awurade Apam Adaka no anim, na wɔmfa so nsrɛ ne nhyira, na wɔnna Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn ase na wɔnkamfo no.

english_verse: Asaph was their leader, and Zechariah was his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and another man named Jeiel were appointed to play small harps and stringed instruments. Asaph himself played the cymbals,
translation_verse: Asaf a na ɔda kuw yi ano no bɔɔ kyɛnkyɛn no. Na nʼabediakyirifo yɛ Sakaria a ɔto so abien, afei Yeiel, Semiramot, Yehiel, Matitia, Eliab, Benaia, Obed-Edom ne Yahasiel. Wɔn na wɔbɔɔ mmɛnta ne asankuten.

english_verse: and the two priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets every day in front of the sacred chest. David's Song of Praise (Psalms
translation_verse: Na Asɔfo Benaia ne Yahasiel taa bɔ ntorobɛnto wɔ Onyankopɔn Apam Adaka no anim. Dawid Aseda Dwom

english_verse: We must never forget his agreement and his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ɔkae nʼapam daa nyinaa, asɛm a ɔhyɛ maa awo ntoantoaso apem no.
