translation_verse: Sɛ ebetumi a teɛ wo nsa fa ka ne honam ne ne nnompe, na ɔbɛdome wo wɔ wʼanim!”

english_verse: “All right!” the Lord replied. “Make Job suffer as much as you want, but just don't kill him.”
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Satan se, “Eye, ɔwɔ wo nsam na ne nkwa de gyaa mu ma no.”

english_verse: Satan left and caused painful sores to break out all over Job's body—from head to toe.
translation_verse: Enti Satan fii Awurade anim, na ɔmaa akuru a ɛyɛ yaw totɔɔ Hiob ho fi ne nʼanan ase kosii nʼapampam.

english_verse: Then Job sat on the ash-heap to show his sorrow. And while he was scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery,
translation_verse: Afei, na kyɛmfɛre na Hiob de twiw ne ho, bere a ɔte nsõ mu.

english_verse: his wife asked, “Why do you still trust God? Why don't you curse him and die?”
translation_verse: Ne yere bisaa no se, “Woda so kura wo pɛpɛyɛ no mu ara? Dome Onyankopɔn, na wu!”

english_verse: Job replied, “Don't talk like a fool! If we accept blessings from God, we must accept trouble as well.” In all that happened, Job never once said anything against God. Job's Three Friends
translation_verse: Na Hiob buaa no sɛ, “Wokasa sɛ ɔbea a ɔyɛ ɔkwasea. Ade pa de yɛagye afi Onyankopɔn nsam na ade bɔne na yɛmpo ana?” Eyi nyinaa mu no, Hiob anka asɛm bɔne. Hiob Nnamfo Baasa No

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamah were three of Job's friends, and they heard about his troubles. So they agreed to visit Job and comfort him.
translation_verse: Bere a Hiob nnamfo baasa bi a wɔne Temanni Elifas, Suhini Bildad ne Naamani Sofar tee amanehunu a aba Hiob so no, wofii wɔn afi mu, hyia yɛɛ adwene sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ no na wɔakyekye ne werɛ.

english_verse: When they came near enough to see Job, they could hardly recognize him. And in their great sorrow, they tore their clothes, then sprinkled dust on their heads and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Wohuu Hiob fii akyiri no, wɔanhu sɛ ɛyɛ ɔno; wɔhyɛɛ ase twaa agyaadwo, sunsuan wɔn ntade mu, tuu mfutuma guu wɔn ti so.

english_verse: For seven days and nights, they sat silently on the ground beside him, because they realized what terrible pain he was in.
translation_verse: Na wɔne no tenaa fam nnanson, awia ne anadwo. Na obiara ankasa, efisɛ wohuu sɛ nʼamanehunu no nyɛ adewa.

english_verse: Finally, Job cursed the day of his birth
translation_verse: Akyiri no Hiob kasae, na ɔdomee da a wɔwoo no.

english_verse: Blot out the day of my birth and the night when my parents created a son.
translation_verse: “Ma da a wɔwoo me no nyera, ne anadwo a wɔkae se, ‘Wɔawo ɔbabarima no!’

english_verse: and send thick, gloomy shadows to fill it with dread.
translation_verse: Ma sum ne owusum nnye no mfa; ma omununkum nkata so; na sum mmunkam ne hann so.

english_verse: Erase that night from the calendar and conceal it with darkness.
translation_verse: Ma sum kabii nnye saa anadwo no mfa; ma wonyi saa anadwo no mfi asranna so na wɔmmfa nhyɛ ɔsram biara mu.

english_verse: Don't let children be created or joyful shouts be heard ever again in that night.
translation_verse: Saa anadwo no nyɛ obonin; mma wɔnnte anigye nteɛmu wɔ mu.

english_verse: Let those with magic powers place a curse on that day.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔdome nna no nnome saa da no; wɔn a wɔayɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛkanyan dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn no.

english_verse: Darken its morning stars and remove all hope of light,
translation_verse: Ma nʼanɔpa nsoromma nnuru sum; na ɔntwɛn adekyee kwa a onhu anɔpawia nsensanee a edi kan no,

english_verse: because it let me be born into a world of trouble. Why Didn't I Die at Birth?
translation_verse: efisɛ anto nea ɔwoo me no awotwaa mu ama wawo me na anka mʼani renhu saa abɛbrɛsɛ yi.

english_verse: Why was I accepted and allowed to nurse at my mother's breast?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na nkotodwe gyee me ne nufu sɛ minnum?

english_verse: Now I would be at peace in the silent world below
translation_verse: Anka sesɛɛ meda hɔ asomdwoe mu; anka mada regye mʼahome

english_verse: with kings and their advisors whose palaces lie in ruins,
translation_verse: me ne wiase ahemfo ne fotufo, wɔn a wosisii adan maa wɔn ho na nnɛ yi abubu no,

english_verse: and with rulers once rich with silver and gold.
translation_verse: me ne ahenemma a na wɔwɔ sika kɔkɔɔ, wɔn a wɔde dwetɛ hyɛɛ wɔn afi mu ma.

english_verse: I wish I had been born dead and then buried, never to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Anaasɛ adɛn nti na wɔansie me sɛ ɔpɔnba, te sɛ akokoaa a wanhu adekyee hann da?

english_verse: In the world of the dead, the wicked and the weary rest without a worry. *
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na amumɔyɛfo gyae basabasayɛ, na abrɛfo nya ahomegye.

english_verse: where captives and slaves are free at last. Why Does God Let Me Live?
translation_verse: Nketewa ne akɛse wɔ hɔ, na akoa de ne ho fi ne wura nsam.

english_verse: Why does God let me live when life is miserable and so bitter?
translation_verse: “Adɛn nti na wɔma mmɔborɔfo hann, na ɔkra mu ahohiahiafo nya nkwa,

english_verse: I keep longing for death more than I would seek a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔn kɔn dɔ owu nanso ɛmma, wɔn a wɔbrɛ hwehwɛ owu sen sɛnea wɔhwehwɛ nnwetɛbona,

english_verse: Nothing could make me happier than to be in the grave.
translation_verse: wɔn a anigye ahyɛ wɔn ma na wodu ɔda mu a wodi ahurusi.

english_verse: Why do I go on living when God has me surrounded, and I can't see the road?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na wɔde nkwa ma onipa a ne kwan ahintaw, nea Onyankopɔn aka no ahyɛ mu?

english_verse: Moaning and groaning are my food and drink,
translation_verse: Ahomekokogu adan mʼaduan; na mʼapinisi gu te sɛ nsu.

english_verse: and my worst fears have all come true.
translation_verse: Nea na misuro no aba me so; nea na ɛbɔ me hu no ato me.

english_verse: I have no peace or rest— only troubles and worries.
translation_verse: Minni ahotɔ, minni asomdwoe; minni ahomegye na mmom, ɔhaw nko ara.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Na Temanni Elifas buaa Hiob se,

english_verse: Please be patient and listen to what I have to say. *
translation_verse: “Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔne wo kasa a, worennya ntoboase ana? Hena na wobetumi aka nʼano ato mu?

english_verse: But now you feel discouraged when struck by trouble.
translation_verse: Na afei a ɔhaw aba no, wʼaba mu abu; adwira wo, na wo werɛ ahow.

english_verse: You respect God and live right, so don't lose hope!
translation_verse: So ɛnsɛ sɛ wo nyamesuro yɛ wʼahotoso na wʼakwan a ɛho nni asɛm no yɛ wʼanidaso ana?

english_verse: In my experience, only those who plant seeds of evil harvest trouble,
translation_verse: Sɛnea mahu no, wɔn a wofuntum bɔne ne wɔn a wodua ɔhaw no twa so aba.

english_verse: and then they are swept away by the angry breath of God.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn home ano, wɔsɛe; nʼabufuw turuw a wɔyera.

english_verse: They may roar and growl like powerful lions. But when God breaks their teeth,
translation_verse: Gyata betumi abobɔ mu na wɔaworo so, nanso wɔabubu gyata akɛse no se.

english_verse: they starve, and their children are scattered. A Secret Was Told to Me
translation_verse: Gyata annya hanam a owu, na gyatabere mma no bɔ hwete.

english_verse: A secret was told to me in a faint whisper—
translation_verse: “Wɔbɛkaa kokoamsɛm bi kyerɛɛ me na mʼaso tee no sɛ asomsɛm.

english_verse: I was overcome by sleep, but disturbed by dreams;
translation_verse: Wɔ anadwo daeso basabasa mu, bere a nnipa adeda nnahɔɔ no,

english_verse: and my hair stood on end, as a wind blew past my face.
translation_verse: Honhom bi twaa mʼani so, na me ho nwi sɔre gyinae.

english_verse: It stopped and stood still. Then a form appeared— a shapeless form. And from the silence, I heard a voice say,
translation_verse: Egyinae, nanso, manhu nʼabɔsu. Biribi begyinaa mʼanim, na metee nne bɔkɔɔ bi a ɛrebisa se,

english_verse: “No humans are innocent in the eyes of God their Creator.
translation_verse: ‘Onipa desani betumi ateɛ asen Onyankopɔn? Na mpo ɔhoɔdenfo betumi ayɛ kronkron asen ne Yɛfo ana?

english_verse: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.
translation_verse: Sɛ Onyankopɔn ntumi mfa ne ho nto nʼankasa asomfo so, sɛ ɔka nʼabɔfo mfomso kyerɛ wɔn a,

english_verse: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?
translation_verse: na nkantom wɔn a wɔtete dɔte afi mu, wɔn a wɔn fapem sisi mfutuma mu na wɔdwerɛw wɔn ntɛm so sen abubummaba!

english_verse: Born after daybreak, you die before nightfall and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Efi anɔpahema kosi anwummere wobubu wɔn mu nketenkete; na wɔyera korakora a obiara nhu wɔn bio.

english_verse: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
translation_verse: So wommiamia wɔn ntamadan ahama mu, a ɛno nti wowuwu a wonni nyansa ana?’

english_verse: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!
translation_verse: “Wobɛfrɛ a frɛ, na hena na obegye wo so? Akronkronfo no mu hena nkyɛn na wobɛkɔ?

english_verse: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
translation_verse: Ahisɛm kum ɔkwasea, na anibere kum atetekwaa.

english_verse: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
translation_verse: Mʼankasa mahu ɔkwasea a ɔrefefɛw, nanso mpofirim, wɔdomee ne fi.

english_verse: and leaving their children helpless in court.
translation_verse: Ne mma ne bammɔ ntam kwan ware, wɔdwerɛw wɔn wɔ asennii a wonni ɔkamafo.

english_verse: Then hungry and greedy people gobble up their crops and grab their wealth.
translation_verse: Nea ɔkɔm de no no di ne nnɔbae, na ɔfa fi nsɔe mu mpo, na nea osukɔm de no no pere di nʼahode akyi.

english_verse: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
translation_verse: Ahokyere mpue mmfi dɔte mu na ɔhaw nso mfifi mmfi fam.

english_verse: it's all part of life, like sparks shooting skyward.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔwo nnipa to ɔhaw mu mpɛn dodow a gyaframa turuw kɔ soro no.

english_verse: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
translation_verse: “Nanso sɛ ɛyɛ me a, anka meguan atoa Onyankopɔn; na mede mʼasɛm ato nʼanim.

english_verse: His miracles are marvelous, more than we can count.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ anwonwade a wontumi nhwehwɛ mu, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a wontumi nkan ne dodow.

english_verse: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔ osu gu asase so; na ɔde kɔ wuram.

english_verse: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
translation_verse: Ɔde ahobrɛasefo si nea ɛkorɔn, na ɔma wɔn a wodi awerɛhow nya asomdwoe.

english_verse: God swiftly traps the wicked
translation_verse: Ɔsɛe aniferefo nhyehyɛe, ma wɔn nsa si fam.

english_verse: in their own evil schemes, and their wisdom fails.
translation_verse: Ɔkyere anyansafo wɔ wɔn anifere mu, na ɔbɔ anitewfo nhyehyɛe gu.

english_verse: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
translation_verse: Sum duru wɔn awia ketee; na wɔkeka wɔ owigyinae mu te sɛ anadwo.

english_verse: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
translation_verse: Ogye ahiafo fi afoa a ɛhyɛ wɔn anom; ogye wɔn fi ahoɔdenfo nkyehama mu.

english_verse: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
translation_verse: Enti ahiafo wɔ anidaso, na ntɛnkyew ka nʼano to mu.

english_verse: Consider yourself fortunate if God All-Powerful chooses to correct you.
translation_verse: “Nhyira ne onipa a Onyankopɔn teɛ no, enti mmu Otumfo nteɛteɛ no animtiaa.

english_verse: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
translation_verse: Efisɛ ɔno na opira na ɔno ara akyekyere; opira nanso ne nsa sa yare.

english_verse: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
translation_verse: Obegye wo afi ɔhaw ahorow asia mu; ason so no, bɔne biara renka wo.

english_verse: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔm ba a, obegye wo afi owu mu, na ɔko mu nso, obegye wo afi afoa ano.

english_verse: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛbɔ wo ho ban afi ntwirii ho na sɛ ɔsɛe ba a ɛnsɛ sɛ wusuro.

english_verse: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
translation_verse: Wobɛserew ɔsɛe ne ɔkɔm; na ɛnsɛ sɛ wusuro asase so mmoa.

english_verse: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
translation_verse: Wo ne afuw so abo bɛyɛ apam, na emu nkekaboa nso ne wo bɛtena asomdwoe mu.

english_verse: Your home will be secure, and your sheep will be safe.
translation_verse: Wubehu sɛ wo ntamadan wɔ bammɔ; na sɛ wosese wʼahode a wubehu sɛ hwee nyeraa ɛ.

english_verse: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
translation_verse: Wubehu sɛ wo mma bɛyɛ bebree; na wʼase bɛfɛe sɛ asase so sare.

english_verse: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
translation_verse: Wode ahoɔden bɛkɔ ɔda mu, te sɛ afiafi a wɔaboa ano wɔ otwabere mu.

english_verse: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.
translation_verse: “Yɛahwehwɛ eyi mu, na ɛyɛ nokware ɛno nti tie na fa toto wʼabrabɔ ho.”

english_verse: It's impossible to weigh my misery and grief!
translation_verse: “Sɛ wobetumi akari mʼawerɛhowdi na me haw nso wɔde agu nsania so a,

english_verse: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
translation_verse: anka emu bɛyɛ duru asen nwea a ɛwɔ po mu nyinaa, enti ɛnyɛ nwonwa sɛ me nsɛm ayɛ hagyahagya.

english_verse: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.
translation_verse: Otumfo agyan no wɔ me mu, me honhom nom ano bɔre no; wɔahyehyɛ Onyankopɔn ahunahuna nyinaa atia me.

english_verse: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?
translation_verse: Wuram afurum su wɔ bere a wanya sare ana, na nantwi nso su wɔ bere a wanya nʼaduan ana?

english_verse: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
translation_verse: So wodi aduan a nkyene nni mu? Na ɔdɛ bi wɔ nkesua mu fufu mu ana?

english_verse: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
translation_verse: Mempɛ sɛ mede me nsa ka; aduan a ɛte saa no bɔ me yare.

english_verse: How I wish that God would answer my prayer
translation_verse: “Ao sɛ me nsa bɛka mʼabisade, sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛyɛ nea mʼani da so no ama me,

english_verse: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
translation_verse: ɛne anka mɛkɔ so anya saa awerɛkyekye yi, a ɛyɛ anigye a mewɔ wɔ ɔyaw a entwa da yi mu, ne Ɔkronkronni no nsɛm a mimmuu so yi.

english_verse: Why should I patiently hope when my strength is gone?
translation_verse: “Ahoɔden bɛn na mewɔ a enti ɛsɛ sɛ minya anidaso? Daakye nneɛma pa bɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ minya ntoboase?

english_verse: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
translation_verse: Mewɔ ahoɔden sɛ ɔbo ana? Me honam yɛ kɔbere mfrafrae ana?

english_verse: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
translation_verse: So mewɔ tumi bi a mede bɛboa me ho saa bere yi a nkonimdi apare me yi ana?

english_verse: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
translation_verse: “Obiara a ɔbɔ nʼadamfo ayamye sɛn no gyaw Otumfo no ho suro.

english_verse: like streams that swell with melting snow,
translation_verse: bere a sukyerɛmma renan na mparuwbo nso redan nsu,

english_verse: then suddenly disappear in the summer heat.
translation_verse: nanso owiabere mu no ɛsen bio na ɔhyew nti nsu no tu yera.

english_verse: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
translation_verse: Akwantufo man fi wɔn akwan so; wɔforo kɔ nsase a awuwu so ma wowuwu.

english_verse: thought they would find water. But they were disappointed,
translation_verse: Wɔn ho yeraw wɔn, efisɛ na wɔwɔ awerehyɛmu; woduu hɔ, na wɔn anidaso yɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
translation_verse: Afei, wo nso woakyerɛ sɛ wo so nni mfaso; wuhu biribi a ɛyɛ hu na wusuro.

english_verse: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
translation_verse: So maka pɛn se, ‘Me nti momma biribi, sɛ mumfi mo ahode mu ntua me ti so sika,

english_verse: or to purchase my freedom from brutal enemies?
translation_verse: sɛ munnye me mfi mʼatamfo nsam, ne atirimɔdenfo nkyehama mu ana?’

english_verse: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
translation_verse: “Monkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mɛyɛ komm; monkyerɛ me mfomso a mayɛ.

english_verse: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
translation_verse: Nokwareka yɛ yaw, na mo adwenkyerɛ no kosi dɛn?

english_verse: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
translation_verse: So mokyerɛ sɛ mubesiesie sɛ nea meka no, na moafa mʼahometew nsɛm sɛ mframa ana?

english_verse: Why, you would sell an orphan or your own neighbor!
translation_verse: Mpo mobɛbɔ ayisaa so ntonto, na mode mo adamfo adi nsesagua.

english_verse: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
translation_verse: “Afei momfa ahummɔbɔ nhwɛ me. Metumi adi atoro wɔ mo anim ana?

english_verse: Stop accusing me falsely; my reputation is at stake.
translation_verse: Montɔ mo bo ase, mummu ntɛnkyew; monsan nnwen ho, efisɛ eyi fa me pɛpɛyɛ ho.

english_verse: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛsɛm wɔ mʼano ana? Minnim papa ne bɔne ntam nsonoe ana?

english_verse: Why is life so hard? Why do we suffer?
translation_verse: “Asase so som nyɛ den mma onipa ana? Ne nkwanna nte sɛ ɔpaani de?

english_verse: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
translation_verse: Sɛnea akoa ani gyina anwummere sunsuma, anaasɛ ɔpaani ho pere no nʼakatua ho no,

english_verse: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
translation_verse: saa ara na wɔatwa asram hunu ato me hɔ, ne anadwo a ɔhaw wɔ mu ama me.

english_verse: I pray for night to end, but it stretches out while I toss and turn.
translation_verse: Sɛ meda a, midwen bisa se, ‘Bere bɛn na ade bɛkye?’ Nanso anadwo twa mu nkakrankakra, na mepere kosi ahemadakye.

english_verse: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
translation_verse: Asunson ne aporɔporɔw afura me nipadua, me were atetew na ɛrefi nsu.

english_verse: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
translation_verse: “Me nna kɔ ntɛm sen ɔnwemfo akurokurowa, na ɛkɔ awiei a anidaso biara nni mu.

english_verse: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, kae sɛ me nkwanna te sɛ ɔhome; na mʼani renhu anigye bio da.

english_verse: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
translation_verse: Ani a ehu me mprempren no renhu me bio; mobɛhwehwɛ me, nanso na minni hɔ bio.

english_verse: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
translation_verse: Sɛnea omununkum yera na etu kɔ, saa ara na nea ɔkɔ ɔda mu no nsan mma bio.

english_verse: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɔrensan mma ne fi da biara da bio; nʼatenae renkae no bio.

english_verse: And so, I cry out to you in agony and distress.
translation_verse: “Ɛno nti meremmua mʼano; mifi me honhom ahoyeraw mu akasa, mefi me kra ɔyaw mu anwiinwii.

english_verse: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
translation_verse: So meyɛ ɛpo anaa aboa kɛse a ɔwɔ bun mu, na mode me ahyɛ ɔwɛmfo nsa yi?

english_verse: but you torture me with terrible dreams. *
translation_verse: ɛno mpo na wode adaeso yi me hu na wode anisoadehu hunahuna me,

english_verse: I'd rather choke to death than live in this body.
translation_verse: ɛno nti mepɛ ɔsɛn ne owu, sen me nipadua yi.

english_verse: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
translation_verse: Mimmu me nkwa; mentena ase afebɔɔ. Munnyaa me; na me nna nka hwee.

english_verse: What makes you so concerned about us humans?
translation_verse: “Ɔdesani ne hena a ne ho hia wo sɛɛ, na wʼani ku ne ho,

english_verse: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
translation_verse: na wohwehwɛ ne mu anɔpa biara na wosɔ no hwɛ bere biara?

english_verse: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
translation_verse: Worennyi wʼani mfi me so da, anaasɛ worennyaa me bere tiaa bi mpo ana?

english_verse: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
translation_verse: Sɛ mayɛ bɔne a, dɛn na mayɛ wo, Ao adesamma so wɛmfo? Adɛn nti na watu wʼani asi me so? Mayɛ adesoa ama wo ana?

english_verse: Why do you refuse to forgive? Soon you won't find me, because I'll be dead.
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na wonkata me mmarato so na womfa me bɔne nkyɛ me? Ɛrenkyɛ biara, mɛda mfutuma mu. Wobɛhwehwɛ me nanso na minni hɔ bio.”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Na Suhini Bildad buae se:

english_verse: How long will you talk and keep saying nothing?
translation_verse: “Wobɛkɔ so aka saa nsɛm yi akosi da bɛn? Wo nsɛm yɛ mframa huhuw.

english_verse: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn kyea atɛntrenee ana? Otumfo kyea nea ɛteɛ ana?

english_verse: He made your children pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Bere a wo mma yɛɛ bɔne tiaa no no, ogyaw wɔn maa wɔn bɔne so akatua.

english_verse: So why don't you turn to him
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ wode wʼani bɛto Onyankopɔn so na woabɔ Otumfo no mpae,

english_verse: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
translation_verse: sɛ woyɛ kronkron, na woteɛ a, wo nti, ɔbɛma ne ho so mprempren na wama wo asi wo dedaw mu.

english_verse: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
translation_verse: Wo mfiase bɛyɛ nkakrankakra na daakye woanya ama abu so.

english_verse: Our ancestors were wise, so learn from them.
translation_verse: “Bisa awo ntoatoaso a atwa mu no, na hwehwɛ nea wɔn agyanom hui,

english_verse: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
translation_verse: na wɔwoo yɛn nkyɛe na yennim hwee, yɛn nna wɔ asase yi so te sɛ sunsuma.

english_verse: But they will instruct you with great understanding.
translation_verse: Wɔrenkyerɛkyerɛ wo na wɔrenka nkyerɛ wo ana? Wɔremfi wɔn ntease mu nka nsɛm bi ana?

english_verse: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.
translation_verse: Bere a ɛrenyin a wontwae no, ɛhyew ntɛm so sen sare.

english_verse: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
translation_verse: Saa na wɔn a wɔn werɛ fi Onyankopɔn no awiei te; saa ara na wɔn a wonni nyamesu no anidaso nkosi hwee.

english_verse: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—
translation_verse: Biribiara a nʼani da so no nni ahoɔden; nea ɔde ne ho to so no yɛ ananse ntontan.

english_verse: they take hold and fall because it's so flimsy.
translation_verse: Otweri ne ntontan, nanso ɛtetew; oso mu dennen, nanso ɛnyɛ yie.

english_verse: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ afifide a wogugu so nsu yiye a esi owia mu, ɛtrɛtrɛw ne mman mu wɔ turo no so;

english_verse: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.
translation_verse: Ne ntin nyin fa abotan ho, na ɛhwehwɛ ɔkwan kɔ abo mu.

english_verse: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ wotu fi ne sibea a, saa beae no nnim no bio na ɛka se, ‘Minhuu wo da.’

english_verse: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
translation_verse: Ampa ara ne nkwa twa mu, na afifide foforo nyin asase no so.

english_verse: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
translation_verse: “Ampa ara Onyankopɔn mpo onipa a ne ho nni asɛm na ɔnhyɛ amumɔyɛfo nsa mu den.

english_verse: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛma woaserew bio, na wode ahosɛpɛw ateɛteɛ mu.

english_verse: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Wɔde aniwu befura wɔn a wɔtan wo, na amumɔyɛfo ntamadan bɛsɛe.”

english_verse: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
translation_verse: “Yiw, minim sɛ eyi yɛ nokware. Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔdesani bɛteɛ wɔ Onyankopɔn anim?

english_verse: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn yiyi ano a, ɔrentumi nyi nsɛm apem mu baako mpo ano.

english_verse: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
translation_verse: Ne nyansa mu dɔ, na ne tumi so. Hena na ɔne no adi asi na ne ho baabiara anti?

english_verse: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
translation_verse: Otutu mmepɔw a wonnim ho hwee obubu wɔn fa so wɔ nʼabufuw mu.

english_verse: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
translation_verse: Ɔwosow asase fi ne sibea, na ɔma ne nnyinaso wosow biribiri.

english_verse: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
translation_verse: Ɔkasa kyerɛ owia na ɛnhyerɛn, na ɔsɔw nsoromma hyerɛn ano.

english_verse: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea,
translation_verse: Ɔno nko ara na ɔtrɛw ɔsoro mu, na ɔnantew po asorɔkye so.

english_verse: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne Nyankrɛnte, Akokɔbeatan ne ne mma Yɛfo; anafo fam nsorommakuw no.

english_verse: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ anwonwade a wontumi nte ase, nsɛnkyerɛnne a wontumi nkan.

english_verse: God walks right past me, without making a sound.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnam me ho a, minhu no; sɛ ɔsen a, minhu no.

english_verse: And if he grabs something, who can stop him or raise a question?
translation_verse: Sɛ ohwim kɔ a, hena na osiw no kwan? Hena na obetumi abisa no se, ‘Dɛn na woreyɛ yi?’

english_verse: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nkora nʼabufuw so; Rahab aboafo mpo ho popo wɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
translation_verse: “Na me ne hena a mene no beyiyi ano? Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nsɛm a me ne no de begye akyinnye?

english_verse: Even though I am innocent, I can only beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Sɛ minnim ho hwee mpo a, merentumi nyi nʼano; ɛno ara ne sɛ mɛsrɛ ahummɔbɔ afi me temmufo nkyɛn.

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Mpo, sɛ mefrɛ no na ɔba a, minnye nni sɛ obetie mʼasɛm.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: Ɔde asorɔkye bɛhwe me ama mʼapirakuru adɔɔso kwa.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: Ɔremma minnya mʼahome, bio, ɔde awerɛhow bɛhyɛ me ma tɔ.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛyɛ ahoɔden asɛm a, ɔyɛ ɔhoɔdenfo! Na sɛ ɛba atɛntrenee nso a, hena na ɔne no bedi asi?

english_verse: Even if I were innocent, God would prove me wrong.
translation_verse: Sɛ midi bem mpo a, mʼano bebu me kumfɔ; sɛ me ho nni asɛm a, ebebu me fɔ.

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: “Ɛwɔ mu sɛ midi bem de, nanso mimmu me ho; abrabɔ afono me.

english_verse: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa yɛ pɛ; ɛno nti na meka se, ‘Ɔsɛe nea ne ho nni asɛm ne omumɔyɛfo.’

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Bere a amanehunu de owu aba no, ɔserew nea ne ho nni asɛm no abawpa.

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Bere a asase akɔ amumɔyɛfo nsam no, ofura ɛso atemmufo ani. Sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno a, na ɛyɛ hena?

english_verse: My life is speeding by, without a hope of happiness.
translation_verse: “Me nna ho yɛ hare sen ommirikatufo; ɛsen kɔ a anigye kakra mpo nni mu.

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Etwa mu kɔ sɛ akorow a wɔde paparɔso ayɛ te sɛ akɔre a wɔretow akyere wɔn hanam.

english_verse: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
translation_verse: Sɛ meka se, ‘Me werɛ mfi mʼanwiinwii, mɛsakra me nsɛnka, na maserew a,’

english_verse: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
translation_verse: me yaw ahorow no bɔ me hu ara. Na minim sɛ, woremmu me bem.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: Woabu me fɔ dedaw nti, adɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehaw me ho kwa?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Mpo sɛ ɛba sɛ mede samina guare na mede samina hohoro me nsa ho a,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: wobɛtow me akyene dontori amoa mu, ama mʼatade mpo akyi me.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: “Ɔnyɛ onipa te sɛ me na mayi nʼano, na yɛakogyina asennii abobɔ yɛn nkuro.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Sɛ anka obi wɔ hɔ a obesiesie yɛn ntam na waka yɛn baanu abɔ mu,

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: obi a obeyi Onyankopɔn abaa afi me so, na nʼahunahuna ammɔ me hu bio.

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: Anka mɛkasa a merensuro no, nanso saa tebea a mewɔ mu yi de, mintumi.

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: “Abrabɔ afono me; enti mɛka mʼasɛm a meremfa hwee nsie na mɛkasa afi me kra yawdi mu.

english_verse: Don't just condemn me! Point out my sin.
translation_verse: Mɛka akyerɛ Onyankopɔn se: Mmu me kumfɔ, na mmom kyerɛ kwaadu a wobɔ me.

english_verse: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ wo fɛ sɛ wohyɛ me so, de po wo nsa ano adwuma, na woserew hwɛ amumɔyɛfo nhyehyɛe?

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Wowɔ ɔhonam mu ani ana? Wuhu ade te sɛ ɔdesani ana?

english_verse: Is your life as short as ours?
translation_verse: Wo nkwanna te sɛ ɔdesani anaa wo mfe te sɛ onipa hoɔdenfo,

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: a enti ɛsɛ sɛ wohwehwɛ me mfomso na wopɛɛpɛɛ me bɔne mu?

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu, wunim sɛ minni fɔ, na obiara nso ntumi nnye me mfi wo nsam.

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Kae sɛ wonwen me sɛ dɔte. Na wobɛdan me ayɛ me mfutuma bio ana?

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: So woanhwie me sɛ nufusu na woammɔ me toa sɛ srade,

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: amfa were ne honam ankata me ho ankeka nnompe ne ntin antoatoa mu ana?

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Womaa me nkwa, yii ayamye kyerɛɛ me, na ɔhwɛsie mu wohwɛɛ me honhom so.

english_verse: You have not explained all of your mysteries,
translation_verse: “Nanso eyi na wode siee wo koma mu, na minim sɛ na eyi wɔ wʼadwene mu.

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: Sɛ meyɛɛ bɔne a anka wobɛhwɛ me na wobɛma me so asotwe.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mema me ti so a, wodɛɛdɛɛ me sɛ gyata, na bio woda wʼanwonwatumi no adi tia me.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: Wode nnansefo foforo betia me na woma wʼabufuw ano yɛ den wɔ me so; wʼasraafo tu ba me so bere biara.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: “Adɛn nti na woma wɔwoo me? Ɛkaa me nko a anka miwui ansa na ani bi rehu me.

english_verse: and been carried to the grave without ever breathing.
translation_verse: Sɛ anka mamma nkwa yi mu, anaasɛ wɔsoaa me fi awotwaa mu de me kɔɔ ɔda mu tee!

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: So ɛnkaa kakraa bi na me nna kakraa no to ntwaa ana? Gyaa me na minya anigye bere tiaa bi

english_verse: before I travel to the land
translation_verse: ansa na makɔ koransan kusuuyɛ ne sunsuma kabii asase so,

english_verse: of darkness and despair, the place of no return.
translation_verse: asase a ɛyɛ anadwo sum kabii, sum kabii ne sakasaka, baabi a ɛhɔ hann mpo te sɛ sum.”

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Na Naamani Sofar buae se,

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Wo nsɛm hunu no bɛma nnipa ayɛ komm ana? Sɛ wudi fɛw a obiara nka wʼanim ana?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Woka kyerɛ Onyankopɔn se, ‘Me gyidi ho nni asɛm na meyɛ pɛ wɔ wʼani so.’

english_verse: But I wish God would speak
translation_verse: Ao, anka mepɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn kasa, anka ɔnkasa ntia wo

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: na ommue nyansa mu ahintasɛm so nkyerɛ wo, efisɛ nyansa turodoo yɛ afanu. Hu sɛ Onyankopɔn werɛ afi wo bɔne no bi mpo.

english_verse: Can you understand the mysteries surrounding God All-Powerful?
translation_verse: “Wubetumi ate Onyankopɔn anwonwade ase ana? Wubetumi abɔre ahu nea Otumfo no tumi kɔpem ana?

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Ɛkorɔn sen ɔsoro, dɛn na wubetumi ayɛ? Emu dɔ sen ɔda ase tɔnn, dɛn na wubetumi ahu?

english_verse: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
translation_verse: Ne nsusuwii mu ware sen asase na ɛtrɛw sen po.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɔba de wo bɛto afiase ansa na osi nkongua a, hena na obetumi asiw no kwan?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Ampa ara ohu nnipa nnaadaafo; na sɛ ohu bɔne a, ɔnhyɛ ne nsow ana?

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Nanso ogyimifo rentumi nyɛ onyansafo da na wɔawo afurum ba sɛ onipa.

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: “Na sɛ wode wo koma ma no na wopagyaw wo nsa kyerɛ no,

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: sɛ wugyaa bɔne a wukura no mu na woamma amumɔyɛ antena wo ntamadan mu a

english_verse: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
translation_verse: ɛno de, bɔne nni wo ho, wobɛma wo ti so; wubegyina pintinn a worensuro.

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: Wo werɛ befi wʼahokyere, na wɔbɛkae no sɛ nsu a asen kɔ.

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: Abrabɔ bɛhyerɛn asen owigyinae, na sum bɛyɛ sɛ adekyee hann.

english_verse: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
translation_verse: Wubenya bammɔ, efisɛ anidaso wɔ hɔ; wobɛhwɛ wo ho ahyia, na wahome asomdwoe mu.

english_verse: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
translation_verse: Wobɛda ahome, na obi renhunahuna wo, na bebree bɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo ani befura, wɔrentumi nguan; na wɔn anidaso bɛdan owu ahomegu.”

english_verse: Job said to his friends:
translation_verse: Na Hiob buae se,

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: “Akyinnye nni ho, mo ne nnipa no na muwu a na nyansa asa!

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Nanso mewɔ adwene sɛ mo ara monnsen me. Hena na onnim saa nneɛma yi nyinaa?

english_verse: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
translation_verse: “Mayɛ aserewde ama me nnamfonom, mefrɛɛ Onyankopɔn na obuae, aserewde teta bi, nanso meteɛ na me ho nni asɛm.

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Nnipa a wɔn ho tɔ wɔn no bu amanehunu animtiaa sɛnea wobu wɔn a wɔn nan rewatiri no awiei animtiaa no.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Wɔmmfa wɔn nsa nka akorɔmfo ntamadan, na wɔn a woyi Onyankopɔn abufuw wɔ bammɔ na Onyankopɔn bɔ nea ɔde ma wɔn ho ban.

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: “Bisa mmoa no, na wɔbɛkyerɛ wo anaasɛ wim nnomaa no, na wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Wɔn nyinaa mu hena na onnim sɛ Awurade nsa na ayɛ eyi.

english_verse: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
translation_verse: Ne nsam na abɔde nyinaa home wɔ ne adesamma nyinaa home.

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: So aso nsɔ nsɛm nhwɛ sɛnea tɛkrɛma ka aduan hwɛ no ana?

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Wonnya nyansa mfi mpanyin nkyɛn, na ɛnyɛ onyinkyɛ na ɛde ntease ba ana?

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: “Nyansa ne tumi yɛ Onyankopɔn de; afotu ne ntease yɛ ne dea.

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: Nea obubu gu no, obiara rentumi nsi; nea ɔde no to afiase no, obiara rentumi nyi no.

english_verse: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔma osu gyae tɔ a, asase no so yɛ wosee; sɛ ogyaa osutɔ mu a, ɛsɛe asase no.

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Ahoɔden ne nkonimdi yɛ ne de osisifo ne nea wosisi no no nso yɛ ne de.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: Ɔpa afotufo ho ntama ma wɔkɔ na ɔma atemmufo yɛ nkwasea.

english_verse: and makes slaves of kings.
translation_verse: Ɔworɔw ahemfo nkyehama na ɔde abɔso bɔ wɔn asen.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: Ɔpa asɔfo ho ntama, na otu nnipa a wɔn ase atim akyɛ gu.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: Ɔde animguase gu atitiriw so na otintim gye ahoɔdenfo nsam akode.

english_verse: he makes nations strong, then shatters their strength.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ aman akɛse, na ɔsɛe wɔn; ɔtrɛw aman mu, na ɔhwete wɔn mu.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: Ogye wiase akannifo adwene fi wɔn nsam; na ɔma wokyinkyin asase wosee a ɔkwan nna so so.

english_verse: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
translation_verse: Wɔkeka wɔ sum mu a wonni kanea; na ɔma wɔtɔ ntintan sɛ asabowfo.”

english_verse: I know and understand every bit of this.
translation_verse: “Mʼani ahu eyinom nyinaa, mʼaso ate, na ate ase.

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Nea wunim no, me nso minim; wonyɛ abomfiaa mma me.

english_verse: But I prefer to argue my case with God All-Powerful—
translation_verse: Nanso mepɛ sɛ mekasa kyerɛ Otumfo no na mekyerɛkyerɛ mʼasɛm mu kyerɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Mode atoro mmom na asra me ho; mo nyinaa moyɛ ayaresafo a munsi hwee!

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Sɛ mobɛyɛ komm koraa a ɛno na ɛbɛyɛ nyansa ama mo!

english_verse: and listen to my argument.
translation_verse: Afei muntie mʼano asɛm; muntie mʼanoyi.

english_verse: Are you telling lies for God
translation_verse: Mobɛka amumɔyɛsɛm ama Onyankopɔn ana? Mobɛka nnaadaasɛm ama no ana?

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Mobɛkyea mo aso ama no? Mobɛka Onyankopɔn asɛm ama no ana?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhwehwɛ mo mu a, ebesi mo yiye ana? Mubetumi adaadaa no sɛnea modaadaa nnipa no ana?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Sɛ mokyeaa mo aso wɔ kokoa mu a, sɛnea ɛte biara, ɔbɛka mo anim

english_verse: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.
translation_verse: Nʼanuonyam mmɔ mo hu ana? Ne ho suro ntɔ mo so ana?

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Mo kasatɔmmɛ yɛ mmɛbu a ɛte sɛ nsõ; mo anoyi yɛ dɔte twann anoyi.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: “Monyɛ komm mma menkasa; na nea ɛbɛyɛ me biara mmra me so.

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na mede me ho to amane mu na mede me nkwa to me nsam?

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ okum me de, nanso ne so na mʼani bɛda; ampa ara medi mʼakwan ho adanse wɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: Nokware, eyi na ɛbɛyɛ me nkwagye, efisɛ nea onsuro Onyankopɔn no rentumi nkɔ nʼanim!

english_verse: Listen carefully to my words!
translation_verse: Muntie me nsɛm yi yiye; monyɛ aso mma nea meka.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Afei a masiesie me nkurobɔ yi, minim sɛ medi bem.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Obi betumi abɔ me kwaadu ana? Sɛ ɛte saa de a, anka mɛyɛ komm na mawu.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn, yɛ saa nneɛma abien yi pɛ ma me, na afei meremfa me ho nhintaw wo:

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Ɛno de, samena me na mɛba, anaa ma menkasa na bua me.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Mfomso ne bɔne dodow ahe na mayɛ? Kyerɛ me me mfomso ne me bɔne.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na wode wʼanim asie me na wudwen sɛ meyɛ wo tamfo?

english_verse: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
translation_verse: Wobɛyɛ ahaban a mframa rebɔ no ayayade ana? Wobɛtaa ntɛtɛ a awo ana?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Wokyerɛw sobo a ɛyɛ yaw tia me, na woka me mmabunmmere mu bɔne nyinaa gu me so.

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: Wode nkyehama gu mʼanan; wohwɛ mʼanammɔnkwan nyinaa so yiye na wode agyiraehyɛde ayeyɛ mʼanammɔn mu.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: “Enti onipa nkwa sa te sɛ ade a aporɔw, te sɛ atade a nwewee adi.

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: “Nnipa a ɔbea awo wɔn nna yɛ tiaa bi na ɔhaw ahyɛ mu mma.

english_verse: We are flowers that fade and shadows that vanish.
translation_verse: Ɔfefɛw te sɛ nhwiren na etwintwam; ɔte sɛ sunsuma a ɛretwa mu akɔ, ɔntena hɔ nkyɛ.

english_verse: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
translation_verse: Woma wʼani kɔ saa onipa yi so? Wode no bɛba wʼanim abebu no atɛn ana?

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Hena na obetumi ayi nea ɛyɛ kronkron afi fi mu? Obiara nni hɔ.

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Woahyehyɛ onipa nkwa nna; woahyɛ nʼasram dodow ato hɔ na woahyɛ no bere a ɔrentumi ntra.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: Enti yi wʼani fi ne so na ɔnyɛ nea ɔpɛ, kosi sɛ obewie nʼadwuma sɛ ɔpaani.

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: “Dua mpo anidaso wɔ hɔ ma no: Sɛ wotwa a, ɛbɛfefɛw bio, na ne mman foforo no rempenpan.

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: nanso, onya nsu a ɛfefɛw, na eyiyi mman sɛ dua a wɔatɛw.

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Sɛnea nsu tu yera wɔ po mu no, anaa sɛnea suka mu yowee no,

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: saa ara na onipa tɔ fam na ɔnsɔre bio; enkosi sɛ ɔsoro betwa mu no, nnipa rensɔre na wɔrennyan wɔn mfi wɔn nna mu.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: “Sɛ anka wode me besie ɔda mu de me ahintaw kosi sɛ wʼabufuw betwa mu! Sɛ anka wobɛhyɛ me bere na afei woakae me!

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa wu a ɔbɛba nkwa mu bio ana? Mʼaperedi nna mu nyinaa mɛtwɛn akosi sɛ me foforoyɛ bɛba.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Wobɛfrɛ na megye wo so; wʼani begyina abɔde a wo nsa ayɛ.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Afei wobɛkan mʼanammɔntu na worenni me bɔne akyi.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛsɔ me bɔne ano wɔ kotoku mu, na woakata mʼamumɔyɛ so.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: “Nanso sɛnea mmepɔw so hohoro na ɛpompono na ɔbotan nso twe fi ne sibea no,

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: sɛnea nsu yiyi abo ho na osuhweam twe dɔte kɔ no saa ara na wosɛe onipa anidaso.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Wutintim ne so prɛko pɛ, na otwa mu kɔ; wosakra ne nipasu na wugya no kwan.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔhyɛ ne mmabarima anuonyam a, onnim; na sɛ wɔbrɛ wɔn ase a, onhu.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɔno ara were mu yaw na ɔtee na ɔno ara ne ho na ogyam.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Na Temanni Elifas buae se,

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Ɔde nsɛm huhuw begye akyinnye, aka nsɛm a mfaso biara nni so ana?

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Wototo onyamesuro ase mmom na wusiw Onyankopɔn som ho kwan.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Wo bɔne kyerɛ wʼano nea ɔnka; na woafa anitew tɛkrɛma.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Wʼankasa wʼano bu wo kumfɔ, ɛnyɛ me de; wʼankasa wʼano di adanse tia wo.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: “Wone onipa a wɔwoo wo dii kan ana? Wɔwoo wo ansa na wɔrewo nkoko ana?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Wutie Onyankopɔn afotu ana? Wo nko ara na wunim nyansa ana?

english_verse: Do you know and understand something we don't?
translation_verse: Dɛn na wunim a, yennim? Nhumu bɛn na wowɔ a yenni?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Nea wafuw dwen ne akwakoraa wɔ yɛn afa wɔn a wɔanyinyin sen wʼagya mpo.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn awerɛkyekye ne nsɛm a wɔka no brɛoo kyerɛ wo no sua ma wo ana?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na wo koma atwe wo akɔ adɛn nti na wʼani asɔ gya,

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: na woadan wʼabufuw agu Onyankopɔn so na woma saa nsɛm yi pue fi wʼano?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nni ahotoso wɔ nʼakronkronfo mu ɔsorosoro mpo nyɛ kronkron wɔ nʼani so,

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: na me ne onipa debɔneyɛfo ne omumɔyɛfo a ɔnom bɔne sɛ nsu.

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: “Tie me, na mɛkyerɛ wo mu; ma menka nea mahu nkyerɛ wo,

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo kɔ ahohia mu, ne nkwanna nyinaa, na basabasayɛni nso, ne mfe a wɔahyehyɛ ama no nyinaa.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Nnyigyei a ɛyɛ hu hyɛ nʼasom ma; na sɛ ɛyɛ sɛ nneɛma rekɔ yiye ma no a, akorɔmfo tow hyɛ ne so.

english_verse: Darkness, despair, and death are their destiny.
translation_verse: Ɔpa abaw sɛ obeguan afi sum mu; wɔabɔ no ato hɔ ama afoa.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Okyinkyin hwehwɛ aduan; onim sɛ sum da no abɛn.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw ne ahoyeraw yi no hu; ɛhyɛ ne so sɛ ɔhene a wasiesie ne ho ama ɔko,

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: efisɛ ɔteɛteɛ ne nsa kyerɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔma ne ho so tia Otumfo,

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: wɔde nkatabo a mu piw na ɛyɛ den kɔ ne so a, onsuro obiara.

english_verse: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
translation_verse: nanso ɔbɛtena nkurow a agu so na watena afi a obi nte mu, afi a ɛrebubu mu.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Ɔrenguan sum no; ogyaframa bɛhyew ne mman, na Onyankopɔn anom ahomegu bɛsoa no akɔ.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔde ne ho to nneɛma huhuw so de daadaa ne ho, efisɛ ɔrennya hwee mfi mu.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛyɛ sɛ bobedua a wɔaporow so aba a ennyin ɛ, te sɛ ngodua a ne nhwiren reporow gu fam.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Na abɔnefo fekuw a wonnim Onyankopɔn no rensow aba, na ogya bɛhyew wɔn a wɔdɔ kɛtɛasehyɛ no ntamadan.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Wonyinsɛn ɔhaw na wɔwo bɔne; wɔn awotwaa siesie nnaadaa.”

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: “Mate nsɛm bebree a ɛte sɛ eyinom; na mo nyinaa moyɛ ogyamserewfo!

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Anka me nso metumi akasa sɛ mo, sɛ mo na mowɔ me tebea yi mu a, anka metumi akeka nsɛm a ɛyɛ dɛ atia mo na mabu mo animtiaa.

english_verse: But I would offer hope and comfort instead.
translation_verse: Nanso anka mɛhyɛ mo den; anka awerɛkyekye nsɛm a ebefi mʼanom no bɛma mo ahotɔ.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: “Nanso sɛ mekasa a ɔyaw a mete no remmrɛ ase; na sɛ mankasa nso a, ɛrennyae.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, ampa ara woama mabrɛ woasɛe me fi pasaa.

english_verse: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
translation_verse: Woakyekyere me, ama abɛyɛ adansedi; me so tew ara na ɛtew na edi adanse tia me.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn tow hyɛ me so tetew me wɔ nʼabufuw mu na ɔtwɛre ne se gu me so; nea ɔne me anya no pɔkyere nʼani hwɛ me.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn de me ama abɔnefo watow me ato amumɔyɛfo nsam.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Na biribiara kɔ yiye ma me, nanso ɔdwerɛw me; osoo me kɔn mu, tow me hwee hɔ. Ɔde me asi nʼani so;

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: nʼagyantowfo atwa me ho ahyia, ohwirew mʼasaabo mu a wanhu me mmɔbɔ maa me bɔnwoma petee fam.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: “Mapam atweaatam akata me were so na masie mʼanintɔn wɔ mfutuma mu.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Agyaadwotwa ama mʼani ayɛ kɔɔ; sunsuma kabii atwa mʼani ho ahyia,

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: nanso me nsa nyɛɛ basabasayɛ biara na me mpaebɔ yɛ kann.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: “Asase, nkata me mogya so; na mma me sufrɛ to ntwa da!

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Mprempren mpo, me danseni wɔ ɔsoro; me kamafo wɔ soro hɔ.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Me dimafo yɛ mʼadamfo bere a mʼaniwa tew nisu gu Onyankopɔn so yi;

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: ogyina onipa anan mu di ma no wɔ Onyankopɔn anim sɛnea obi di ma nʼadamfo no.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: “Mfe kakraa bi akyi ansa na metu kwan akɔ koransan.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Me honhom atɔ beraw, me nna so atwa, na ɔda retwɛn me.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Ampa ara fɛwdifo atwa me ho ahyia; ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ wɔn atutuwpɛ.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: “Ao Onyankopɔn, hyɛ me bɔ a wuhia. Hena bio na ɔbɛma me bammɔ?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Wɔato wɔn adwene mu a wɔnte asɛm ase; enti woremma wonni nkonim.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi sopa ne nnamfonom de gye akatua a, ɛbɛhwere ne mma aniwa.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn de me ayɛ asɛm a ɛda obiara ano, obi a wɔte ntasu gu nʼani so.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Awerɛhow ama mʼani ayɛ siamoo me nipadua nyinaa yɛ sunsuma.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ atreneefo nwonwa; wɔn a wodi bem tia wɔn a wonni nyamesu.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Nanso atreneefo bɛkɔ wɔn anim, na wɔn a wɔn nsa ho tew no bɛkɔ so anya ahoɔden.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: “Mo nyinaa monsan mmra mmɛsɔ nhwɛ! Na merennya onyansafo wɔ mo mu.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Me nna atwa mu, me nhyehyɛe apansam. Nanso me koma apɛde

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: ma anadwo dan awia; sum mu koraa no hann bɛn.

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Sɛ ofi a mʼani da so nkutoo ne ɔda, sɛ mesɛw me kɛtɛ wɔ sum mu,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: sɛ meka kyerɛ porɔwee se, ‘Wo yɛ mʼagya,’ ne osunson se, ‘Me na’ anaa ‘Me nuabea’ a,

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: na afei mʼanidaso wɔ he? Hena na obetumi anya anidaso bi ama me?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ebesian akɔ owu pon ano ana? Yɛn nyinaa besian akɔ mfutuma mu ana?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Na Suhini Bildad buae se,

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Bere bɛn na wubegyae kasa tenten yi? Dwene ho yiye, na afei yebetumi akasa.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na wofa yɛn sɛ anantwi na wususuw sɛ yennim nyansa yi?

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: Wo a wode abufuw tetew wo mu nketenkete, wo nti na yemfi asase so anaasɛ wonnwiriw abotan mfi wɔn sibea ana?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: “Omumɔyɛfo kanea adum; na ne gya nnɛw bio.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Nʼanammɔntu mu ahoɔden ano bɛbrɛ ase; nʼankasa nhyehyɛe hwe no ase.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Afiri so ne nantin na eso ne mu dennen.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Atoyerɛnkyɛm kɔn dɔ no; na sɛ ɔhwe ase a, amanehunu retwɛn no.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Ɛwewe ne honam ani baabi; na owu di kan sɛe nʼakwaa.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Wɔtwe no fi ne ntamadan bammɔ mu na wɔde no brɛ ahunahunahene.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Ogya te ne ntamadan mu; na wɔabɔ sufre a ɛredɛw apete nʼatenae.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Ne ntin wuwu wɔ ase na ne mman nso wu wɔ soro.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Wɔka no fi hann mu kɔ sum mu na wɔpam no fi wiase.

english_verse: without any children to carry on their name.
translation_verse: Onni mma anaa nananom wɔ ne nkurɔfo mu, na nʼaseni biara renka wɔ baabi a ɔtenae.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, sɛɛ na omumɔyɛfo atenae te; sɛɛ ne beae a nea onnim Onyankopɔn no te.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Mobɛhyɛ me ɔyaw na mode nsɛm abubu me akosi da bɛn?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Mpɛn du ni a moasopa me; mo ani nwu sɛ motow hyɛ me so.

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛyɛ nokware sɛ mafom ɔkwan a, me mfomso yɛ me nko ara asɛm.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Sɛ ampa sɛ mobɛma mo ho so asen me na mode mʼanimguase ayɛ adanse atia me a,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: ɛno de munhu sɛ Onyankopɔn ayɛ me bɔne na ɔde ne tan atwa me ho ahyia.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: “Ɛwɔ mu, misu se, ‘Wɔafom me’ de, nanso obiara mmua me; meteɛ mu pɛ mmoa, nanso atɛntrenee biara nni hɔ.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Wasiw me kwan enti mintumi nsen; ɔde sum aduru mʼakwan so.

english_verse: God rips me apart, uproots my hopes,
translation_verse: Wasɛe me akwannuasa nyinaa so de awie me; watu mʼanidaso ase te sɛ dua.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Nʼabufuw huru tia me; na wakan me afra nʼatamfo mu.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: Nʼakofo ba anibere so; wosisi mpie de tia me na wotwa me ntamadan ho hyia.

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: “Wayi me nuabarimanom afi me ho; na mʼamanifo atwe wɔn ho koraa.

english_verse: and I am forgotten.
translation_verse: Mʼabusuafo kɔ; na me nnamfonom werɛ afi me.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Mʼahɔho ne me mmaawa bu me sɛ ɔhɔho; mete sɛ ɔnanani ma wɔn.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Mefrɛ me somfo, na ommua; mpo, metew mʼano srɛ no.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Me home bɔn me yere; me ho afono mʼankasa nuabarimanom.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Mpo, mmarimaa nkumaa bu me animtiaa; sɛ mipue a wodi me ho fɛw.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Me nnamfo ankasa nyinaa kyi me; mʼadɔfo asɔre atia me.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Maka were ne nnompe, nea mede aguan nkutoo ne me se akyi nam.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: “Munhu me mmɔbɔ, me nnamfonom, munhu mmɔbɔ, na Onyankopɔn nsa abɔ me.

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na motaa me sɛnea Onyankopɔn yɛ no? Na mommfa me honam yi saa ara?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: “Ao, sɛ anka wɔde me nsɛm bɛhyɛ nhoma mu, anka wɔbɛkyerɛw wɔ nhoma mmobɔwee so,

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Minim sɛ me dimafo te ase, na awiei no ɔbɛsɔre agyina asase so.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Na wɔasɛe me were awie no, mefi me were mu ahu Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Me ara mehu no mede mʼani, na ɛnyɛ obi foforo ani, behu no. Sɛnea me koma ho pere wɔ me mu!

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: “Sɛ moka se, ‘Yɛbɛteetee no, efisɛ ɔhaw no fi ɔno ara a,’

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: ɛsɛ sɛ mo ankasa musuro afoa no na abufuw nam afoa so de asotwe bɛba, na mubehu sɛ atemmu wɔ hɔ.”

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Na Naamani Sofar buae se,

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: Me tirim mu ntew me, na ɛhyɛ me sɛ mimmua efisɛ me ho yeraw me yiye.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Mate animka bi a egu me ho fi, na ntease a minya no hyɛ me sɛ mimmua.

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: sɛ amumɔyɛfo ani gye bere tiaa bi mu, na wɔn a wonsuro nyame nso anigye nkyɛ.

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ nʼahohoahoa kodu ɔsoro, na ne ti kɔpem omununkum koraa a,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: ɔbɛyera afebɔɔ te sɛ nʼankasa nʼagyanan; na wɔn a wohuu no no bebisa se, ‘Ɔwɔ he?’

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Ani a ehuu no no renhu no bio; na ne sibea nso renhu no bio.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Ne mma bɛpata ahiafo; ɛsɛ sɛ nʼankasa de nʼahonya san ma.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ne mmerantebere mu ahoɔden a ahyɛ ne nnompe ma no ne no bɛkɔ mfutuma mu.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: “Ɛwɔ mu sɛ bɔne yɛ nʼanom dɛ na ɔde sie ne tɛkrɛma ase,

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: nanso, nʼaduan bɛyɛ nwen wɔ ne yafunu mu; ɛbɛyɛ ɔwɔ ano bɔre wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛfe ahonyade a ɔmenee no; Onyankopɔn bɛma ne yafunu apuw agu.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Ɔbɛfefe awɔ bɔre; Ɔnanka se bekum no.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ɔrennya nsuwansuwa no nnom nsubɔnten a nufusu ne ɛwo sen wɔ mu no.

english_verse: Their hard work will result in nothing gained,
translation_verse: Ɔbɛdan nea ɔbrɛ nyae no aba a ɔrenni bi; ɔremfa nʼaguadi mu mfaso nnye nʼani.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Wafom nneɛma nyinaa awie; ne nkɔso nnu baabiara.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Nʼadedodow nyinaa mu no, ɔbɛkɔ ɔhaw mu; na amanehunu a emu yɛ den bɛto no.

english_verse: and God will make them swallow his blazing anger.
translation_verse: Bere a nʼafuru ayɛ ma no, Onyankopɔn bɛtɔ nʼabufuw gya agu ne so na wabobɔ no basabasa.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ oguan fi dade akode ano nanso bɛmma a ano yɛ kɔbere mfrafrae bɛwɔ no.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Ɔtwe bɛmma no fi nʼakyi, ano hyɛnhyɛn no fi ne brɛbo mu. Ehu bɛba ne so;

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: sum kabii retwɛn nʼademude. Ogya a ɛnnɛw mu bɛhyew no, na asɛe nea aka wɔ ne ntamadan mu.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Ɔsoro bɛda nʼafɔdi adi, na asase asɔre atia no.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Nsuyiri bɛtwe ne fi akɔ, saa ara na asuworo bɛyɛ Onyankopɔn abufuwhyew da no.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Eyi ne nkrabea a Onyankopɔn de ma amumɔyɛfo, agyapade a Onyankopɔn de ato hɔ ama wɔn ne no.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: Muntie me nsɛm no yiye. Momma eyi nyɛ awerɛkyekye a mode ma me.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Munnya ntoboase mma me bere a merekasa, na sɛ mekasa wie a, monkɔ so nni fɛw.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: “Minwiinwii hyɛ onipa ana? Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ minya ntoboase?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Monhwɛ me, na mo ho nnwiriw mo; momfa mo nsa nkata mo ano.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Sɛ midwen eyi ho a, mebɔ hu; na me ho popo.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na amumɔyɛfo tena nkwa mu? Wonyin kyɛ na wɔkɔ so di tumi.

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Wohu wɔn mma a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no nkɔso, wohu wɔn nenanom.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw nni wɔn afi mu, na ehu nni hɔ; Onyankopɔn asotwe mma wɔn so.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Wɔn anantwinini nnyɛ asaadwe; na wɔn anantwibere nwo a wɔmpɔn.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Wɔka wɔn mma bɔ mu te sɛ nguankuw; na emu mmotafowa no huruhuruw.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Wɔto nnwom wɔ akasae ne sanku so; na wɔde atɛntɛbɛn nnyigyei gye wɔn ani.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Wodi yiye wɔn nkwanna mu na wɔkɔ ɔdae mu asomdwoe mu.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔka kyerɛ Onyankopɔn se, ‘Fi yɛn so! Yɛmpɛ sɛ yehu wʼakwan.

english_verse: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?
translation_verse: Hena ne otumfo no a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsom no? Sɛ yɛbɔ no mpae a mfaso bɛn na yebenya?’

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔn nkɔso no nni wɔn nsam, enti metwe me ho fi amumɔyɛfo afotu ho.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: “Nanso mpɛn ahe na wodum amumɔyɛfo kanea? Mpɛn ahe na amanehunu ba wɔn so, nea Onyankopɔn fi nʼabufuw mu de ba no?

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Mpɛn ahe na wɔyɛ sɛ sare wɔ mframa ano, te sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframaden bi apra wɔn?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Wɔka se, ‘Onyankopɔn kora onipa asotwe so de twɛn ne mma.’ Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtwe onipa no ankasa aso ma ohu.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Ma ɔno ankasa ani nhu ne sɛe; ma Otumfo abufuwhyew no nka nʼani.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Dɛn na ɛfa wɔn ho fa wɔn abusuafo a woagyaw wɔn akyi no ho bere a asram a wɔatwa ama no aba awiei no?

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: “Obi betumi akyerɛ Onyankopɔn nyansa, wɔ bere a obu atitiriw mpo atɛn?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Ɔfoforo nso de ɔkra mu yawdi wu, a wanka asetena pa anhwɛ da.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Wosie wɔn nyinaa wɔ mfutuma koro mu, ma asunson nnunu wɔn nyinaa.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: “Mahu mo adwene, ɔkwan a mobɛfa so afom me.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Moka se, ‘Onipa kɛse no fi wɔ he, ntamadan a omumɔyɛfo no tenaa mu no?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: sɛ onipa bɔne nya ne ti didi mu amanehunu da, na wogye wɔn abufuwhyew da no ana?

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Hena na ɔde ne suban si nʼanim? Hena na otua no nea wayɛ so ka?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Wɔsoa no kɔ ɔda mu, na wɔwɛn nʼaboda.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: “Enti ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mode mo nsɛnhunu bɛkyekye me werɛ? Mo mmuae nyɛ hwee sɛ atoro!”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Na Temanni Elifas buae se,

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn benya onipa so mfaso ana? Mpo onyansafo so bɛba no mfaso ana?

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ ɔtreneeni a, anigye bɛn na Otumfo no benya? Sɛ wʼakwan ho nni asɛm a, mfaso bɛn na obenya?

english_verse: Is he correcting you for worshiping him?
translation_verse: “Wo kronkronyɛ nti na ɔka wʼanim na ɔbɔ wo kwaadu ana?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ wʼamumɔyɛ na ɛso? Ɛnyɛ wo bɔne na ɛdɔɔso dodo?

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Wopɛɛ bammɔ fii wo nuanom nkyɛn a emfi hwee so; wopaa nnipa ho ntama ma wɔdaa adagyaw.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Woamma abrɛfo nsu annom na wode aduan kamee nea ɔkɔm de no,

english_verse: although you were rich, respected, and powerful.
translation_verse: nanso na woyɛ obi a ɔwɔ tumi, wɔ nsase, onuonyamfo a ɔte so.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Wopam akunafo ma wɔkɔɔ nsapan na womaa ayisaa nso ahoɔden sae.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: ɛno nti na sum kabii aduru a wunhu ade, na asorɔkye akata wo so yi.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: “So Onyankopɔn nni ɔsoro akyirikyiri ana? Hwɛ sɛnea ɔsoro akyirikyiri nsoromma korɔn!

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Nanso woka se, ‘Dɛn na Onyankopɔn nim? Sum yi mu na obu atɛn ana?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Omununkum kabii akata nʼanim nti onhu yɛn bere a ɔnenam ɔsoro kontonkurowi mu.’

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: So wobɛkɔ so afa ɔkwan dedaw a abɔnefo anantew so no so ana?

english_verse: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
translation_verse: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn se, ‘Gyaa yɛn! Dɛn na Otumfo betumi ayɛ yɛn?’

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛyɛ ɔno na ɔde nnepa hyɛɛ wɔn afi mu, nti metwe me ho fi amumɔyɛfo afotu ho.

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: Atreneefo hu wɔn asehwe ma wɔn ani gye; na wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm serew wɔn ka se,

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Wɔasɛe yɛn atamfo, na ogya ahyew wɔn agyapade.’

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Tie akwankyerɛ a efi nʼanom, na fa ne nsɛm sie wo koma mu.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Sɛ wosan kɔ Otumfo no nkyɛn a obegye wo ato mu bio: sɛ wuyi amumɔyɛsɛm fi wo ntamadan mu

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: na wotow wo sika mpɔw gu mfutuma mu ne Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ gu abotan a ɛwɔ abon mu no so a,

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: ɛno de Otumfo bɛyɛ wo sikakɔkɔɔ ɔbɛyɛ dwetɛ ankasa ama wo.

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: Afei nokware wubenya anigye wɔ Otumfo mu na wobɛpagyaw wʼani akyerɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Wobɛbɔ no mpae, na obetie wo, na wubedi wo bɔhyɛ so.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Nea woyɛ wʼadwene sɛ wobɛyɛ no bɛba mu, na hann bɛtɔ wʼakwan so.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnipa hwe ase na woka se, ‘Ma wɔn so!’ a, obegye wɔn a wɔahwe ase no nkwa.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Obegye abɔnefo mpo, ɔnam wo nsa a ɛho nni fi so begye wɔn.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Nnɛ mpo, mʼanwiinwii mu da so yɛ den; ne nsa ayɛ den, mʼapinisi nyinaa akyi.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Sɛ minim baabi a mehu no; anaasɛ metumi akɔ ne tenabea a

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Anka mɛte mmuae a ɔde bɛma me, na madwen nea ɔbɛka ho.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Ɔbɛsɔre atia me dennen ana? Dabi, ɔremmɔ me kwaadu.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ de, nnipa trenee betumi aka nʼasɛm wɔ nʼanim, na wobegye me afi me temmufo nsam afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: “Nanso sɛ mekɔ apuei fam a onni hɔ; sɛ mekɔ atɔe fam nso a minhu no.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ atifi fam a minhu no; sɛ ɔdan ne ho kɔ anafo fam a, mʼani nhye ne ho.
