english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Nanso onim ɔkwan a menam so; na sɛ ɔsɔ me hwɛ a mepue sɛ sikakɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Madi nʼanammɔn akyi pɛɛ; na manantew nʼakwan so a mamman.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: “Nanso obiara nni hɔ ka ne ho, na hena na obetumi atia no? Ɔyɛ biribiara a ɔpɛ.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Ɔde ne mmaransɛm di dwuma tia me; ɔda so kora nhyehyɛe a ɛte sɛɛ bebree.

english_verse: makes me tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn ama me koma abotow; Otumfo ama mabɔ huboa.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Nanso sum no mma menka mʼano nto mu, sum kabii a ɛkata mʼanim no.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: “Adɛn nti na Onyankopɔn nhyɛ bere mma atemmu? Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wonim no no hwɛ saa da no anim nanso ɛmma da?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Nnipa yiyi abo a wɔde ato ɔhye; na wɔde nguankuw a wɔawia kɔ hɔ adidi.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Wɔpam ayisaa mfurum na wogye akunafo anantwi sɛ awowaside.

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: Wosum ahiafo fi kwan so na wɔhyɛ asase no so ahiafo ma wɔkɔtetɛw.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Sɛnea sare so mfurum yɛ no saa ara na ahiafo no yɛ wɔn adwuma de pɛ aduan; asase kesee no so na wonya aduan ma wɔn mma.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Wɔboaboa mmoa aduan ano wɔ mfuw no so na wodi mpɛpɛ wɔ amumɔyɛfo bobe nturo mu.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Wonni ntama, na wɔda adagyaw anadwo; wonni hwee a wɔde kata wɔn ho wɔ awɔw mu.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Mmepɔw so osu tɔ fɔw wɔn kyam na wɔtetare abotan no ho, efisɛ wonni nnae.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Wɔtew ayisaa fi nufu ano; na wɔfa ohiani abotafowa de si ne ka anan mu.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Wɔnenam adagyaw a wonni ntama; wɔsoa awi afiafi, nanso ɔkɔm de wɔn ara.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Wokyi ngo wɔn adan mu; wotiatia nsakyiamoa mu, nanso osukɔm de wɔn.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔrewuwu no apinisi fi kuropɔn no mu, na apirafo kra su pɛ mmoa. Nanso Onyankopɔn mfa bɔne nto obiara so.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Sɛ adekyee hann no kɔ a, owudifo no sɔre na okum ohiani ne mmɔborɔni; anadwo, mu owiawia ne ho sɛ ɔkorɔmfo.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Ɔwaresɛefo twɛn bere a anim rebiribiri; ɔka se, ‘obiara renhu me,’ na ɔde nʼanim hintaw.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Sum mu na nnipa bubu apon wura afi mu, na adekyee, wɔtoto wɔn ho apon mu; wɔne hann nni hwee yɛ.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Sum kabii yɛ adekyee ma wɔn nyinaa; wɔne sum mu nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu fa nnamfo.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: “Nanso wɔte sɛ ahuru a ɛte nsu ani; wɔadome wɔn kyɛfa wɔ asase no so, enti obiara nkɔ bobe nturo no mu.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ɔhyew ne ɔpɛ hwim sukyerɛmma a anan kɔ no, saa ara na ɔda de wɔn a wɔayɛ bɔne kɔ ne no.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Awotwaa werɛ fi wɔn, na osunson di wɔn nam; nnipa bɔne de wɔnnkae wɔn bio na mmom wobubu te sɛ dua.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Wɔde ɔbea bonin a onni ba yɛ hanam, na wonhu akunafo mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nam ne tumi so twe atumfo kɔ; ɛwɔ mu sɛ wonya asetena pa de, nanso wonni nkwa ho bɔhyɛ.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Otumi ma wɔn tena ase asomdwoe mu, nanso nʼani wɔ wɔn akwan so.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Wɔma wɔn so bere tiaa bi, na afei wonni hɔ bio; wɔbrɛ wɔn ase boaboa wɔn ano sɛ nnipa nyinaa; wotwitwa wɔn gu te sɛ aburow ti.

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: “Sɛ eyi nte saa a, hena na obetumi agye me akyinnye na ama nea maka no ayɛ nsɛnhunu?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Na Suhini Bildad buae se,

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Tumi ne suro wɔ Onyankopɔn; ɔno na ɔhyehyɛ pɛpɛyɛ wɔ ɔsorosoro.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Wobetumi akan nʼakofo ana? Hena na ne hann nhyerɛn wɔ ne so?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Mpo sɛ ɔsram nhyerɛn na nsoromma nyɛ kronn wɔ nʼani so a,

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: na nkantom onipa a ɔte sɛ nsaammoa, onipa ba a ɔyɛ osunson bi kɛkɛ!”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Woaboa nea onni tumi! Woagye basa a enni ahoɔden!

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Woatu nea onnim nyansa fo! Na woada nhumu pa ara adi!

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Hena na ɔboaa wo ma wokaa saa nsɛm yi? Hena honhom na ɛkasa faa wo mu?

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: “Awufo wɔ ahoyeraw kɛse mu, wɔn a wɔwɔ nsu ase ne nea ɛte mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Asaman da adagyaw Onyankopɔn anim; Ɔsɛe nso nni nkataso.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛw wim atifi fam kata nea ɛda mpan so; na ɔde asase sensɛn ohunu so.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ nsu boa hyɛ ne omununkum mu, nanso nsu no mu duru ntumi mpae no.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛw ne omununkum mu de kata ɔsram ani.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Ɔhyɛ agyirae wɔ nsu so de to ɔhye wɔ hann ne sum ntam.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Ɔsoro nnyinaso wosow, na nʼanimka ma wɔn ho dwiriw wɔn.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne tumi wosow po ne nyansa mu, otwitwaa Rahab mu asinasin.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne home maa wim tewee; na ne nsa wɔɔ ɔwɔ a ɔrewea.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Eyinom yɛ ne nnwuma kakraa bi; ne tumi kakraa bi kɛkɛ! Na hena na obetumi ate ne tumi mmubomu no ase?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Sɛ Onyankopɔn te ase yi, nea wammu me atɛntrenee no, Otumfo a wama madi me kra mu awerɛhow,

english_verse: I will tell only the truth.
translation_verse: mʼano renka amumɔyɛsɛm, na me tɛkrɛma rentwa nkontompo.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Merennye nto mu da sɛ nea woka no yɛ nokware; merenka me mudi nhyɛ, kosi sɛ mewu.

english_verse: because each day my conscience agrees that I am innocent.
translation_verse: Mekura me trenee mu, merennyaa mu; sɛ mete ase yi, me tiboa remmu me fɔ.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: “Ma mʼatamfo nyɛ sɛ amumɔyɛfo, na wɔn a wokyi me nyɛ sɛ atorofo.

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: So Onyankopɔn tie wɔn sufrɛ bere a amanehunu aba wɔn so no ana?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: So wɔn ani begye wɔ Otumfo no mu? Wobesu afrɛ Onyankopɔn bere biara ana?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: “Mɛma mo Onyankopɔn tumi ho nkyerɛkyerɛ; meremfa Otumfo no akwan nhintaw.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Mo ankasa moahu eyinom nyinaa. Afei nsɛnhunu yi ase ne dɛn?

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: “Eyi ne nea Onyankopɔn ahyɛ ato hɔ ama omumɔyɛfo, agyapade a otirimɔdenfo nya fi Otumfo no nkyɛn:

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔwɔ mma dodow dɛn ara, wɔn nkrabea ne afoa; na nʼasefo rennidi mmee da.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Ɔyaredɔm besie wɔn a wɔbɛka wɔ nʼakyi, na wɔn akunafo rensu wɔn.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ ɔhɔre dwetɛ te sɛ mfutuma na ɔboa ntama ano sɛ dɔte,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: nea ɔpɛ gu hɔ no, atreneefo na wobefura na pɛpɛyɛfo no nso akyekyɛ dwetɛ no.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Ofi a osi no te sɛ ananse abubummaba, ɛte sɛ pata bi a ɔwɛmfo abɔ.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Ɔda hɔ te sɛ ɔdefo, nanso ɔrenna saa bio; ɔbɛtew nʼani no na ne nyinaa atu ayera.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ahunahuna ba ne so sɛ nsuyiri; ahum hwim no kɔ anadwo.

english_verse: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
translation_verse: Apuei mframa soa no kɔ, na onni hɔ bio; ɛtwe no fi ne tenabea.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔ no a ahummɔbɔ nni mu bere a ɔreguan afi ne tumi ase.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Ɔde fɛw bɔ ne nsam na ɔpam no fi ne tenabea.”

english_verse: Gold and silver are mined, then purified;
translation_verse: “Beae a wotu dwetɛ wɔ hɔ ne beae a wɔnan sika kɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Wotu dade fi fam, na wɔnan kɔbere fi dadebo mu.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Onipa ma sum ba awiei; na ɔhwehwɛ kɔ akyirikyiri asase mu kɔhwehwɛ dadebo wɔ sum kabii mu.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Asase a ɛbɔ aduan no, wɔdan ase no te sɛ nea wɔde ogya na ayɛ;

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Ɔkɔre biara nnim saa kwan a ahintaw no, akoroma biara ani nhuu ɛ.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Mmoa ahantanfo nsi hɔ na gyata nkɔdɛɛdɛɛ wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Onipa nsa paapae abotan dennen na ɔma mmepɔw ase da hɔ.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Otwa aka fa abotan mu, na ohu nʼademude nyinaa.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Ɔhwehwɛ baabi a nsubɔnten ti wɔ na ɔda nneɛma a ahintaw adi.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Na ebun ka se, ‘Enni me mu’; na po nso se, ‘Enni me nkyɛn.’

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Wɔrentumi mfa sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa ntɔ, na wɔrentumi mfa dwetɛ nkari ne bo.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Wɔrentumi mfa ahwehwɛ anaa sikakɔkɔɔ ntoto ho, na wɔrentumi mfa sikakɔkɔɔ nnwinne nsesa.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛbɔ ahene panyin ne ahwehwɛbo din; nyansa bo sen nhene pa.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Etiopia akraatebo ne no nsɛ; wɔrentumi mfa sikakɔkɔɔ kronkron ntɔ.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Wɔde asie abɔde biara ani, wɔde asie wim nnomaa mpo.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛe ne Owu ka se, ‘Yɛate no huhuhuhu kɛkɛ.’

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn te ɔkwan a ɛkɔ hɔ ase, na ɔno nko ara na onim faako a ɛte,

english_verse: he alone sees everything beneath the heavens.
translation_verse: efisɛ ɔhwɛ kodu nsase ano na ohu biribiara a ɛwɔ ɔsoro ase.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Bere a ɔhyɛɛ mframa ano den too hɔ na osusuw nsuwa no,

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: bere a ɔkaa no ɔhyɛ so kyerɛɛ osutɔ na otwaa kwan maa aprannaa no,

english_verse: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.
translation_verse: afei ɔhwɛɛ nyansa na ɔkarii no hwɛe; na ogyee no too mu na ɔsɔɔ no hwɛe.

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ onipa se, ‘Awurade suro, ɛno ne nyansa; na sɛ wokyi bɔne, yɛ ntease.’ ”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Mʼani agyina asram a atwa mu no, nna a Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ me so no,

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: bere a ne kanea hyerɛn mʼatifi na mede ne kanea nantewee sum mu no!

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Ao, nna a misii so no, bere a Onyankopɔn adamfofa a emu yɛ den hyiraa me fi,

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: bere a na nufusu mu srade afɔw mʼakwan na abotan hwiee ngo sɛ nsu maa me no.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: “Bere a na mekɔ kuropɔn pon ano mekɔtena mʼagua so wɔ ɔmanfo aguabɔbea,

english_verse: the young leaders stepped aside, *
translation_verse: mmerante hu me a, wogyina nkyɛn na mpanyimfo sɔre gyina hɔ;

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: atitiriw gyae kasa na wɔde wɔn nsa kata wɔn ano;

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: mmapɔmma tɛm dinn, na wɔn tɛkrɛma ka wɔn dudom.

english_verse: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔte me nka nyinaa ka me ho asɛmpa, na wɔn a wohu me nyinaa kamfo me,

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: efisɛ meboaa ahiafo a wosu pɛɛ mmoa, ne ayisaa a wonni aboafo.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Onipa a na ɔrewu no hyiraa me; na memaa akunafo ani gyee wɔn koma mu.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Mede trenee furaa sɛ mʼadurade; atɛntrenee yɛɛ me nkataso ne mʼabotiri.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Meyɛɛ aniwa maa anifuraefo, ne anan maa mmubuafo.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Meyɛɛ ahiafo agya; na mekaa ahɔho asɛm maa wɔn.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Mibubuu amumɔyɛfo se na mihwim wɔn a wodi wɔn nya no fii wɔn anom.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: “Medwenee sɛ, ‘Mewu wɔ mʼankasa me fi mu, na me nna dɔɔso sɛ nwea.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Me ntin beduu nsu ano, na obosu agugu me mman so anadwo mu nyinaa.

english_verse: or like an archer's new bow.
translation_verse: Mʼanuonyam rempa da, na agyan ayɛ foforo wɔ me nsam daa.’

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: “Nnipa hwehwɛɛ sɛ wotie me, wɔyɛɛ dinn, twɛn mʼafotu.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekasa wie a wɔnnkasa bio, efisɛ me nsɛm tɔɔ wɔn asom yiye.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Wɔtwɛn me sɛnea wɔtwɛn osu a ɛpete, na wɔmenee me nsɛm sɛ osutɔ bere nsu.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: Sɛ meserew mekyerɛ wɔn a, wɔntaa nnye nni; mʼanimtew som bo ma wɔn.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mebɔɔ kwan maa wɔn na metenaa ase sɛ wɔn hene; metenaa ase sɛ ɔhene a ɔwɔ nʼasraafo mu; meyɛɛ sɛ obi a ɔkyekye agyaadwotwafo werɛ.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: “Nanso mprempren wɔserew me, nnipa a manyin sen wɔn, na wɔn agyanom mfata sɛ wɔne me nguan ho akraman tena.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Ohia ne ɔkɔm ama wɔn ho atetew, wɔnantew asase kesee ne asase bonin so anadwo.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Wɔboaboaa nkyenhaban ano wɔ nkyɛkyerɛ mu, na wɔde sare so nnua ntin yɛɛ wɔn aduan.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Wɔn mfɛfo pam wɔn fii wɔn mu, na wohuroo wɔn sɛ akorɔmfo.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Wɔhyɛɛ wɔn ma wɔtenaa suka a emu awo, abotan ne fam ntokuru mu,

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: wosuu sɛ mfurum wɔ wuram na wɔfofɔree so wɔ ɔdɔtɔ ase.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Kuw a wɔmfra na wonni din, wɔpam wɔn fii asase no so.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: “Na nnɛ yi wɔn mmabarima de dwom bɔ me akutia; mayɛ abusude wɔ wɔn mu.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Wokyi me na wontwiw mmɛn me; wɔmmfɛre sɛ wɔtete ntasu gu mʼanim.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Afei a Onyankopɔn abubu me tadua na ɔde amanehunu aba me so yi, wɔyɛ nea wɔpɛ wɔ mʼanim.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Abusuakuw no tow hyɛ me so wɔ me nifa so; wosum mʼanan mfiri, na wosisi mpie tia me.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Wosisiw mʼakwan; na wonya me sɛe me na obiara mmoa me.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ahunahuna ma me ho dwiriw me; mʼanuonyam atu kɔ sɛnea mframa abɔ agu, me bammɔ atu ayera sɛ omununkum.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: “Na mprempren, me nkwa resa; na amanehununna akyekyere me.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Anadwo wowɔ me nnompe mu; ɔyaw a ɛwe me no nnyae.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn fi ne tumi mu yɛ sɛ adurade ma me; omia me te sɛ mʼatade kɔn.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Ɔtow me kyene dontori mu na ɔma me yɛ sɛ mfutuma ne nsõ.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn, misu mefrɛ wo, nanso wummua me. Mesɔre gyina, nanso wohwɛ me kɛkɛ.

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: Wuhwim me na wode mframa pia me; wudenkyidenkyi me wɔ ahum mu.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Minim sɛ wode me bɛkɔ owu mu, faako a woahyɛ ama ateasefo nyinaa no.

english_verse: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
translation_verse: “Ampa ara obiara mfa ne nsa nka onipa a ɔrebrɛ bere a ɔresu pɛ mmoa wɔ nʼamanehunu mu.

english_verse: I mourned for the poor and those who suffered.
translation_verse: Mansu amma wɔn a wɔwɔ ɔhaw mu ana? Me kra werɛ anhow amma ahiafo ana?

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Nanso bere a mʼani da papa so no, bɔne bae; bere a mepɛɛ hann no sum na edurui.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Me yafunu mu a ɛwowɔ me no nnyae da; na nna a amanehunu wɔ mu da mʼanim.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Menenam a mabiri, nanso ɛnyɛ sɛ owia na ahyew me; migyina aguabɔbea na misu pɛ mmoa.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Madan nnompo nuabarima, me ne mpatu na ɛbɔ.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Me honam ani biri na ehuanhuan; atiridii ama me ho adɔ.

english_verse: My only songs are sorrow and sadness.
translation_verse: Me sanku bɔ kwadwom, na mʼatɛntɛbɛn ma agyaadwotwa nnyigyei.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: “Me ne mʼani yɛɛ apam sɛ meremfi akɔnnɔ mu, nhwɛ ababaa.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ ɔsɛe mma amumɔyɛfo, atoyerɛnkyɛm mma wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne ana?

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Onhu mʼakwan na ɔnkan anammɔn biara a mitu ana?

english_verse: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
translation_verse: “Sɛ manantew wɔ nkontompo mu anaasɛ matu mmirika adi nnaadaasɛm akyi a,

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.

translation_verse: Wowɔ abasa te sɛ Onyankopɔn de, na wo nne betumi abobɔ mu sɛ ne de ana?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Ɛno de fa anuonyam ne ɔhyerɛn hyehyɛ wo ho, na fura nidi ne kɛseyɛ.

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Hwie wʼabufuwhyew mmoroso no gu, hwɛ ɔhantanni biara na brɛ no ase,

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Sie wɔn nyinaa bɔ mu wɔ mfutuma mu; kata wɔn anim wɔ ɔda mu.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Na afei mʼankasa megye ato mu sɛ wo ara wo basa nifa betumi agye wo nkwa.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: “Hwɛ susono, nea meyɛɛ no kaa wo ho na ɔwe sare te sɛ nantwi.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Hwɛ ahoɔden a ɔwɔ wɔ nʼasen mu ne ahoɔden a ɛwɔ ne yafunu so were mu!

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Ne dua hinhim sɛ sida; ne srɛ mu ntin yɛ peperee.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Ne nnompe te sɛ kɔbere mfrafrae dorobɛn, nʼabasa ne ne nʼanan te sɛ nnade praban.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Odi Onyankopɔn nsa ano adwuma mu kan, nanso ne Yɛfo betumi de nʼafoa akɔ ne so.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Nkoko fifi wɔn nnɔbae ma no, na wuram mmoa nyinaa goru bɛn hɔ.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Nsɔensɔe nnua ase na ɔda, na dontori mu demmire akata no so.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Nsɔensɔe nwini no kata ne so; na nsunoa nnua twa ne ho hyia.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Nsu nworoso nhaw no; mpo sɛ Yordan bobɔ ba nʼano a, onni ɔhaw.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Obi betumi akyere no animono; anaa obi betumi de afiri ayi no na wabɔre ne hwene mu ana?

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: “So wubetumi de darewa atwe ɔdɛnkyɛmmirampɔn anaa wubetumi de hama akyekyere ne tɛkrɛma?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: So wubetumi de hama afa ne hwenem, anaasɛ wubetumi de darewa aso nʼabogye mu?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Ɔbɛpene ne wo ayɛ apam ama wode no ayɛ wʼakoa afebɔɔ ana?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Wubetumi de no ayɛ abɛbɛ te sɛ anomaa anaa wubetumi asa no hama de no ama wo mmabea?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: So aguadifo bɛpɛ sɛ wode no bedi nsesagua? Wɔbɛkyekyɛ ne mu ama aguadifo ana?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Wubetumi de mpeaw awowɔ ne were mu anaasɛ wode mpataa mpɛmɛ bɛwowɔ ne ti ho?

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Wode wo nsa ka no a, wobɛkae sɛnea ɔbɛwosow ne ho, nti worenyɛ saa bio!

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Ɔkwan biara nni hɔ a wobɛfa so akyere no; ani a ɛbɔ ne so kɛkɛ no ma nnipa dwudwo.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Obiara ntumi nsi ne bo nhwanyan no. Afei hena na obetumi ne me adi asi?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Hena na mede no ka a ɛsɛ sɛ mitua? Biribiara a ɛhyɛ ɔsoro ase no yɛ me de.

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: “Me werɛ remfi sɛ mɛka nʼakwaa, nʼahoɔden ne ne bɔbea fɛfɛ no ho asɛm.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Hena na obetumi aworɔw ne ho ahama, na hena na ɔde nnareka bɛkɔ ne ho?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Hena na obetumi abue nʼabogye, a ɛse a ɛyɛ hu ayɛ no ma no?

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: Nʼakyi wɔ bona a ɛsesa so, ɛtetare so a ɔkwan nna mu koraa;

english_verse: firmly bound and closer together
translation_verse: sɛnea ɛtetare so fa no nti, mframa biara mfa ntam.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Ɛtoatoa mu denneennen a emu ntumi ntetew.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnwansi a, ɛpepa gya; nʼaniwa aba te sɛ adekyeenim hann.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Agyatɛn turuw fi nʼanom na nsramma turuturuw fi mu.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Wusiw sen fi ne hwene mu te sɛ ɔsɛn a esi gya so.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Ne home ma gyabiriw ano sɔ, na ogyaframa tu fi nʼanom.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Ne kɔn mu wɔ ahoɔden ankasa; wɔn a wohu no no aba mu bu.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Ne were a abubu agu so no yɛ peperee; ayɛ pemee a ɛnka ne ho.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔsɔre a, ahoɔdenfo bɔ huboa; sɛ ɔwosow ne ho a woguan.

english_verse: No sword or spear can harm it,
translation_verse: Afoa wɔ no a, ɛnka no, peaw, pɛmɛ ne agyan nso saa ara.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Ɔfa dade sɛ wura bi na kɔbere mfrafrae te sɛ dua a awu bi ma no.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Agyan mma no nguan; ahwimmo mu aboa yɛ ntɛtɛ ma no.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Kontibaa te sɛ sare wɔ nʼani so; na ɔserew pɛmɛ nnyigyei.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Abon a ano yɛ nnam tuatua ne yafunu so. Ɔtwe ne ho ase wɔ fam fa dontori mu a, eyiyi akam.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: Ɔma bun mu huru sɛ nsu a ɛwɔ ɛsɛn mu na onunu po mu sɛ srade a ɛwɔ kuku mu.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɛfa no, ɛhɔ nsu no pa yerɛw yerɛw; na obi besusuw sɛ po bun adan ayɛ dwen.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Asase so biribiara ne no nsɛ. Ɔyɛ abɔde a onsuro hwee.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Ommu wɔn a wɔyɛ ahantan no mu biara; ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ ahomaso no nyinaa so hene.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Minim sɛ wutumi yɛ nneɛma nyinaa; obiara rentumi nsɛe wo nhyehyɛe.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Wubisa se, ‘Hena ni a onni nimdeɛ nso osiw mʼafotu ho kwan?’ Ampa ara mekaa nneɛma a mente ase no ho nsɛm, nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa ma me.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: “Wokae se, ‘Tie na menkasa; mebisa wo nsɛm na ɛsɛ sɛ woma me mmuae.’

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Mate wo nka pɛn, na mprempren de, mʼani ahu wo.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Na Awurade kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Hiob wiei no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Temanni Elifas se, “Me bo afuw wo ne wo nnamfonom baanu no, efisɛ moanka me ho asɛm a ɛyɛ nokware sɛnea me somfo Hiob kae no.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Afei, momfa anantwi ason ne adwennini ason, na monkɔ me somfo Hiob nkyɛn, na monkɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔre mma mo ho. Me somfo Hiob bɛbɔ mpae ama mo, na metie ne mpaebɔ no na merenyɛ mo sɛnea ɛfata mo nkwaseasɛm no, nsɛm a moka faa me ho no nyɛ nokware sɛnea me somfo Hiob yɛe no.”

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Enti Temanni Elifas ne Suhini Bildad ne Naamani Sofar yɛɛ sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn no; na Awurade tiee Hiob mpaebɔ.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Hiob bɔɔ mpae maa ne nnamfonom akyi no, Awurade san yɛɛ no ɔdefo bio na ɔde nʼahode a na ɔwɔ kan no mmɔho abien maa no.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Afei, ne nuabarimanom, ne nuabeanom nyinaa ne obiara a na onim no dedaw no baa ne fi ne no bedidii. Wɔkyekyee ne werɛ wɔ amanehunu a Awurade ma ɔkɔɔ mu no ho, na wɔn mu biara brɛɛ no dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ kaa.

english_verse: The Lord now blessed Job more than ever; he gave him
translation_verse: Awurade hyiraa Hiob nkwa awiei sen ne mfiase. Onyaa nguan mpem dunan, yoma mpem asia, anantwinini mpamho apem ne mfurum abere apem.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Bio onyaa mmabarima baason ne mmabea baasa.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Asase no so nyinaa, na mmaa biara nni hɔ a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ sɛ Hiob mmabea no, na wɔn agya de wɔn kaa wɔn nuabarimanom no ho maa wɔn agyapade.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Afei owui a na wabɔ akwakoraa pa ara.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne onipa a ontie amumɔyɛfo afotu na onni nnebɔneyɛfo nhwɛso akyi na ɔntena fɛwdifo tenabea.

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Na mmom, Awurade mmara sɔ nʼani, na osusuw ho awia ne anadwo.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ dua a wɔatɛw wɔ asuten ho, na ɛsow nʼaba ne bere mu a nʼahaban no nguan da. Nea ɔyɛ biara yɛ yiye.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Nanso nnebɔneyɛfo nte saa; wɔte sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ gu.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Enti amumɔyɛfo rentumi nnyina atemmu no ano, na nnebɔneyɛfo nso rentena atreneefo asafo mu.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Efisɛ Awurade kyerɛ ɔtreneeni kwan nanso amumɔyɛfo kwan de, ɛbɛyera.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na amanaman no hyehyɛ bɔne ho na nnipa no bɔ pɔw hunu yi?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Asase so ahemfo sɔre gyina na sodifo ka wɔn ho bɔ mu tia Awurade ne Nea Wɔasra no no.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Wɔka se, “Momma yemmubu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn na yɛntow wɔn mpokyerɛ ngu.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Nea ɔte agua so wɔ ɔsoro no serew; Awurade di wɔn ho fɛw.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Afei ɔka wɔn anim wɔ nʼabufuw mu, hunahuna wɔn wɔ nʼabufuwhyew mu, ka se,

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “Masi me Hene wɔ Sion, me bepɔw kronkron no so.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Mɛpae mu aka Awurade ahyɛde: Ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Woyɛ me Ba; nnɛ mayɛ wʼAgya.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Bisa me, na mede amanaman nyinaa bɛyɛ wʼagyapade, asase ano nyinaa bɛyɛ wo de.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Wode dade ahempema bedi wɔn so; na woabobɔ wɔn sɛ ɔnwemfo ahina.”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Enti mo ahemfo, munsua nyansa; monkae kɔkɔbɔ yi, mo asase sodifo.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Momfa osuro nsom Awurade na monsɛpɛw mo ho ahopopo mu.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Mumfew Ɔba no ano, na ne bo amfuw na mo akwan de mo bɛkɔ ɔsɛe mu, efisɛ nʼabufuwhyew tumi sɔre mpofirim. Nhyira ne wɔn a woguan toa no nyinaa.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Awurade, hwɛ sɛnea mʼatamfo dɔɔso fa! dodow no ara na wɔsɔre tia me!

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Bebree no ara ka fa me ho se, “Onyankopɔn rennye no.”

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Nanso wo, Awurade, woyɛ nkatabo a atwa me ho ahyia mʼanuonyam, nea Ɔpagyaw me ti.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Meteɛ mu su frɛ Awurade, na ogye me so fi ne bepɔw kronkron no so.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Metɔ hɔ na meda a, minyan bio, efisɛ Awurade ma migyina.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Merensuro atamfo mpem mpem a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Sɔre, Awurade! Gye me, me Nyankopɔn! Bobɔ mʼatamfo nyinaa abogye; na tutu amumɔyɛfo se.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Sɛ misu frɛ wo a, gye me so, me trenee Nyankopɔn. Ma me ɔhome wɔ mʼahohia mu; hu me mmɔbɔ na tie me mpaebɔ.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Enkosi da bɛn na mobɛdan mʼanuonyam ahohora? Enkosi da bɛn na mobɛdɔ nneɛma hunu na moadi ahoni ahuhuw akyi?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Hu sɛ Awurade ayi nea ɔwɔ nyamesu ama ne ho; Awurade betie, sɛ misu mefrɛ no a.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Sɛ mo bo fuw a, monnyɛ bɔne; sɛ modeda mo mpa so a, monyɛ komm na monhwehwɛ mo koma mu.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Mommɔ afɔre a ɛfata na momfa mo werɛ nhyɛ Awurade mu.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Nnipa bebree bisa se: “Hena na ɔde yiyeyɛ bɛbrɛ yɛn?” Awurade, ma wʼanim hann no nhyerɛn yɛn so.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Fa anigye mmoroso hyɛ me koma ma bere a wɔn aburow ne nsa foforo abu so no.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mɛtɔ hɔ, na mada asomdwoe mu, efisɛ wo nko ara, Awurade, na woma metena dwoodwoo. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo sɛ wɔmfa atɛntɛbɛn nto.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Awurade, yɛ aso ma me nsɛm na dwen mʼapinisi ho.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Tie me mmoa ho sufrɛ, me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn, efisɛ wo na mebɔ wo mpae.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Awurade, wote me nne anɔpa; anɔpa, mede mʼadesrɛ ba wʼanim na mede anidaso twɛn.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Wonyɛ Onyankopɔn a wʼani gye bɔne ho; na amumɔyɛfo rentumi ne wo ntena.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Ahantanfo rentumi nnyina wʼanim; wukyi wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne nyinaa.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Wosɛe wɔn a wɔka atosɛm; Awurade kyi mogyapɛfo ne asisifo.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Nanso me, wo mmɔborɔhunu bebrebe nti, mɛba wo fi; na nidi mu na mɛkotow akyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Awurade kyerɛ me kwan wɔ wo trenee mu mʼatamfo nti, bɔ wo kwan tee wɔ mʼanim.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Wɔn anom asɛm baako mpo nyɛ nokware; ɔsɛe ahyɛ wɔn koma ma. Wɔn menewa yɛ ɔda a so abue wɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma ka nnaadaasɛm.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, bu wɔn fɔ! Ma wɔn pɔw bɔne nyɛ wɔn asehwe. Pam wɔn; esiane wɔn bɔne dodow no nti, efisɛ wɔasɔre atia wo.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Nanso ma wɔn a woguan ba wo nkyɛn no ani nnye; ma wɔmfa anigye nto dwom daa. Trɛw wo bammɔ mu wɔ wɔn so, na wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no ma wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Awurade, ampa ara, wuhyira atreneefo; na wode wʼayamye twa wɔn ho hyia sɛ nkatabo. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo sɛ ɔmfa sankuhama nto wɔ Seminit nne so.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Awurade nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabufuw mu, na ntwe mʼaso nso wɔ wʼabufuwhyew mu.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Hu me mmɔbɔ, Awurade, efisɛ meyɛ mmrɛw; Awurade sa me yare na me nnompe wɔ ahoyeraw mu.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Me kra wɔ ahohia mu. Enkosi da bɛn, Ao Awurade, enkosi da bɛn?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: San bra, Awurade, na begye me nkwa; gye me, wo dɔ a enni nhuammɔ no nti.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Obi a wawu no renkae wo da, hena na ofi ɔda mu kamfo wo?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Apinisi ama mayɛ mmerɛw. Anadwo mu nyinaa mede agyaadwotwa fɔw me mpa, na me nusu fɔw me sumii.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Awerɛhow ama mʼani so ayɛ me kusuu. Ɛredum; mʼatamfo nyinaa nti.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Mo nnebɔneyɛfo, montwe mo ho mfi me ho! efisɛ Awurade ate me sufrɛ.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Awurade ate me mmɔborɔsu; Awurade tie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Mʼatamfo nyinaa anim begu ase na wɔn ho adwiriw wɔn; na wɔapatuw de fɛre asan wɔn akyi.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Awurade me Nyankopɔn, miguan toa wo; Gye me fi wɔn a wɔtaa me nyinaa nsam,

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a wɔbɛtetew me mu sɛ gyata na wɔatetew me mu asinasin a obiara rentumi nnye me.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: sɛ mayɛ bɔne atia nea ɔne me te yiye, anaasɛ mabɔ me tamfo korɔn kwa a,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: ɛno de ma mʼatamfo ntaa me na wɔmmɛto me; ma wontiatia me so wɔ fam, na wɔmma me funu nna mfutuma mu.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: Sɔre wɔ wʼabufuw mu, Awurade! Sɔre tia mʼatamfo abufuw. Nyan, me Nyankopɔn; hyɛ atɛntrenee mmara.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Ma nnipadɔm mmetwa wo ho nhyia. Fi ɔsoro hɔ di wɔn so;

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: ma Awurade mmu nnipa no atɛn. Bu me atɛn, Awurade sɛnea me trenee te, sɛnea me nokwaredi te, Ao, Ɔsorosoroni.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn treneeni, wo a wohwehwɛ adwene ne koma mu, fa amumɔyɛfo basabasayɛ bra awiei na ma atreneefo nnya bammɔ.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Me nkatabo ne Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn nea ogye koma mu treneeni no.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn yɛ otemmufo treneeni, Onyame a ɔda nʼabufuwhyew adi da biara.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Sɛ wansesa nʼadwene a, ɔbɛsew nʼafoa ano; obekuntun ne tadua na ɔde bɛmma ahyɛ mu.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: Wasiesie nʼakode a ɛyɛ hu; ayɛ ne bɛmma a ɛredɛw no krado.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Nea onyinsɛn amumɔyɛ na basabasayɛ ahyɛ no ma no, ɔwo nnaadaa.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Nea otu tokuru, na oyi mu dɔte no hwe tokuru a watu no mu.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw a ɔde ba no dan bɔ nʼankasa so; ne basabasayɛ bɔ nʼankasa ti so.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mede aseda bɛma Awurade, ne trenee nti, na mato ayeyi dwom ayi Awurade, Ɔsorosoroni no din ayɛ. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo se wɔnto no “gittit” sanku nne so.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Awurade, yɛn Awurade, wo din kɛseyɛ ada adi wiase mmaa nyinaa. Wode wʼanuonyam atimtim ɔsoro nohɔ,

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: mmofra ne nkokoaa mpo de wɔn ano kamfo wo, wʼatamfo nti; na wode bɔ atamfo ne aweretɔfo ano.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Sɛ mehwɛ wo ɔsorosoro, wo nsateaa ano adwuma; ɔsram ne nsoromma a wode obiara asi nʼafa a,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: onipa ne hena a wokae no, na onipa ba nso ne hena a wʼani ku ne ho?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Wobɔɔ no ma ɔyɛɛ akumaa kakra sen abɔfo na wode wʼanuonyam ne nidi abɔ no abotiri.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Woyɛɛ no ɔsodifo maa wo nsa ano nnwuma wode nneɛma nyinaa ahyɛ nʼanan ase:

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: nguankuw ne anantwikuw nyinaa ne wuram mmoa nso,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: wim nnomaa ne po mu mpataa, nea ɛnenam po mu akwan so nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Awurade, yɛn Awurade, wo din yɛ kɛse wɔ asase nyinaa so! Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔto no sɛnea wɔto “Ɔba no wu”.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Awurade, mefi me koma nyinaa mu ada wo ase. Mɛka wʼanwonwade no nyinaa.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Mɛma mʼani agye na madi ahurusi wɔ wo mu. Mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo din, Ɔsorosoroni.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Mʼatamfo san wɔn akyi; wɔtetew hwe, na wowuwu wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Woadi mʼasɛm ama me, na menya mʼahofadi; woatena wʼahengua so, abu atɛntrenee.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Woatwe amanaman no aso, na woasɛe amumɔyɛfo. Woapepa wɔn din a wɔrenkae wɔn bio.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛe a enni awiei ato ɔtamfo no, woatutu wɔn nkuropɔn; na wɔnkae wɔn bio mpo.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Awurade di hene daa daa; wasi nʼatemmu ahengua.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛn; ɔde atɛntrenee bedi nnipa no so.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ guankɔbea ma wɔn a wodi wɔn nya no, ɔyɛ abandennen wɔ ahohia mmere mu.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wonim wo din no de wɔn ho bɛto wo so, efisɛ, wo Awurade, wunnyaw obiara a ɔhwehwɛ wo no mu da.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Monto ayeyi dwom mma Awurade a ɔte ahengua so wɔ Sion; mompae mu nka nea wayɛ wɔ amanaman no mu.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Na ɔkae nea ɔtɔ mogya so were no; ommu nʼani ngu ɔbrɛfo sufrɛ so.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Awurade, hwɛ sɛnea mʼatamfo teetee me! Hu me mmɔbɔ na yi me fi owu apon ano,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: na matumi apae mu aka wʼayeyi wɔ Ɔbabea Sion apon ano, na madi ahurusi wɔ wo nkwagye no mu hɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Amanaman mufo atɔ amoa a wɔatu no mu; afiri a wosum hintaw no ayi wɔn anan.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo san kɔ ɔda mu, amanaman a wɔn werɛ fi Onyankopɔn nyinaa.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛnyɛ daa na ne werɛ befi ohiani, anaasɛ mmɔborɔni anidaso bɛyera korakora.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Sɔre! Awurade, mma ɔdesani nni nkonim, bu amanaman no atɛn wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Bɔ wɔn hu, Awurade; na ma wonhu sɛ, wɔyɛ adesa bi kɛkɛ.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Adɛn, Awurade, na wugyina akyirikyiri saa? Adɛn na wode wo ho ahintaw wɔ amanehunu mmere mu yi?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo de ahantan taataa mmɔborɔfo, wɔn a ne nneyɛe mfiri yiyi wɔn no.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔde nea ne koma hwehwɛ hoahoa ne ho; ohyira odifudepɛfo na oyi Awurade ahi.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Ahantan nti omumɔyɛfo nhwehwɛ Awurade; ne nsusuwii mu no Onyankopɔn nsi hwee.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Nʼakwan nyinaa mu odi yiye; ɔma ne ho so, na wo mmara mfa no ho; na odi nʼatamfo nyinaa ho fɛw.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se: “Hwee remma minhinhim; mʼani begye daa, na merenkɔ amanehunu mu da.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Nnome, atoro ne ahunahuna ahyɛ nʼanom ma; Ɔhaw ne mmusu hyɛ ne tɛkrɛma ase.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ɔtɛw bɛn nkuraa no; ofi ahintawee kum nea onnim hwee, ohintaw hwɛ wɔn a ɔrehwehwɛ wɔn ayɛ wɔn bɔne no.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ gyata a wahintaw; ɔtɛw sɛ ɔbɛkyere mmɔborɔni; ɔkyere wɔn twe wɔn ase de wɔn kɔ ne bon mu.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Ɔdwerɛw wɔn a ɔkyere wɔn no ma wɔtɔ beraw; na ɔde nʼahoɔden ka wɔn hyɛ.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se, “Onyankopɔn werɛ afi; wayi nʼani afi so na onhu.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Sɔre, Awurade! Ma wo nsa so, Onyankopɔn. Mma wo werɛ mfi wɔn a wonni aboafo.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na omumɔyɛfo yi Onyankopɔn ahi? Adɛn nti na ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se, “Ɔremfrɛ me akontaabu so?”

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Nanso wo, Onyankopɔn, wuhu amanehunufo haw; na wayɛ wʼadwene sɛ wobɛhwɛ. Mmɔborɔni de ne ho ma wo; wo na woyɛ ayisaa boafo.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Bubu omumɔyɛfo ne ɔbɔnefo aprɛw; frɛ no na ommebu nʼamumɔyɛ ho nkontaa, nʼamumɔyɛ a anka wɔrenhu no.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔhene daa nyinaa; amanaman no bɛyera nʼasase so.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Awurade, wutie mmɔborɔfo adesrɛ; wohyɛ wɔn nkuran, na wutie wɔn sufrɛ,

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: na wudi ma ayisaa ne nea wɔhyɛ no so, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔdesani a ofi asase mu renhunahuna bio. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Awurade mu na mede me werɛ ahyɛ. Adɛn na wutumi ka kyerɛ me se, “Tu te sɛ anomaa kɔ wo bepɔw so.

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Na hwɛ, amumɔyɛfo akuntun wɔn ta mu, na wɔde wɔn mmɛmma asisi ahama so sɛ wɔbɛtow wɔ sum mu de awɔ koma mu ahotefo.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔresɛe fapem no a, dɛn na ɔtreneeni betumi ayɛ?”

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Awurade wɔ nʼasɔredan kronkron no mu; Awurade te ne soro ahengua so. Ɔhwɛ nnipa mma, nʼani hwehwɛ wɔn mu.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Awurade hwehwɛ ɔtreneeni mu, na amumɔyɛfo ne wɔn a wɔpɛ basabasayɛ de, ne kra kyi wɔn.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛtɔ ogyatannaa ne sufre a ɛredɛw agu amumɔyɛfo so; na mframa a mu yɛ hyew bɛyɛ wɔn kyɛfa.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni, na ɔpɛ atɛntrenee; wɔn a wɔteɛ no behu nʼanim. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo se wɔnto no wɔ “Seminit” sanku nne so.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Boa yɛn, Awurade, na nyamesurofo asa; nokwafo ayera wɔ nnipa mu.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Obiara di atoro kyerɛ ne yɔnko; wɔn ano a ɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ no ka nnaadaasɛm.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Ma Awurade ntwa nnaadaa ano ne tɛkrɛma biara a ɛhoahoa ne ho nkyene;

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: nea ɛka se, “Yɛde yɛn tɛkrɛma bedi nkonim; yɛn ano bedi ama yɛn, na hena na odi yɛn so tumi?”

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: “Esiane ɔhyɛ a wɔde hyɛ mmɔborɔni ne ohiani apinisi no nti, mɛsɔre afei,” Awurade na ose. “Mɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi wɔn a wɔhaw wɔn no ho.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Awurade asɛm yɛ nokware te sɛ dwetɛ a wɔasɔn so wɔ fononoo mu, na wɔahoa ho mpɛn ason.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Awurade, wobɛkora mmɔborɔni na woabɔ yɛn ho ban afi saa nnipa yi ho afebɔɔ.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo nenam sɛnea wɔpɛ, bere a adesamma de nidi ma afide. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Awurade enkosi da bɛn? Wo werɛ befi me afebɔɔ ana? Enkosi da bɛn na wode wʼanim behintaw me?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Enkosi da bɛn na mene mʼadwennwene bedi aperepere na awerɛhow ahyɛ me koma mu daa? Mʼatamfo nni me so nkonim nkosi da bɛn?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Twa wʼani hwɛ me na bua me, Awurade, me Nyankopɔn. Ma mʼani so nyɛ hann, na manna owu nna.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Me tamfo bɛka se, “Madi ne so nkonim.” Na mʼahohiahiafo bedi ahurusi bere a mahwe ase.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Nanso mede me ho to wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no so; me koma di ahurusi wɔ wo nkwagye mu.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Mɛto dwom ama Awurade, efisɛ ɔne me adi no yiye. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo no.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea ka wɔ ne koma mu se, “Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ.” Wɔaporɔw, na wɔn nneyɛe yɛ fi na wɔn mu biara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ade pa.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Awurade fi ɔsoro hwɛ adesamma wɔ fam sɛ obehu wɔn mu bi a wɔwɔ ntease, anaa ebinom a wɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Enti abɔnefo rensua nyansa ana? Wɔwe me nkurɔfo te sɛnea nnipa di aduan. Wonnsu mfrɛ Awurade?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Nanso wonni, ehu akyekyere wɔn, efisɛ Onyankopɔn te wɔn a wɔteɛ mu.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Mo nnebɔneyɛfo sɛe ahiafo nhyehyɛe, nanso, Awurade ne wɔn guankɔbea.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ao, Israel nkwagye mfi Sion mmra! Awurade bɛsan de ne nkurɔfo agyapade ama wɔn. Na Yakob adi ahurusi, na Israel ani agye!

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Awurade, hena na ɔbɛtena wo kronkronbea ntamadan no mu? Hena na ɔbɛtena wo bepɔw kronkron no so?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Nea ne ho nni asɛm na ɔyɛ nea ɛteɛ, nea ɔka nokware a efi ne koma mu

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne tɛkrɛma nsɛe nnipa nea ɔnyɛ ne yɔnko bɔne na ommu ne yɔnko nipa abomfiaa,

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: nea obu afideyɛni animtiaa na ɔde nidi ma wɔn a wosuro Awurade, nea odi ne ntam so, bere a etia no mpo,

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: nea ɔde ne sika bɔ bosea a onnye nsiho na onnye adanmude ntia nea odi bem. Nea ɔyɛ eyinom no renhinhim da.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Bɔ me ho ban, me Nyankopɔn, na wo mu na minya guankɔbea.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Meka kyerɛɛ Awurade se, “MʼAwurade ne wo; minni ade pa biara ka wo ho.”

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Ahotefo a wɔwɔ asase no so de, wɔne anuonyamfo a mʼanigye wɔ wɔn mu.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wodi anyame afoforo akyi no, wɔn awerɛhow bɛdɔɔso. Merengu mogya nsa mma saa anyame no na meremfa mʼano mmɔ wɔn din.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Awurade, wode me kyɛfa ne me kuruwa ama me; woama me kyɛfa anya bammɔ.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Mʼahye akɔdeda mmeae a eye ama me; ampa ara mewɔ agyapade a ho yɛ anigye.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Mɛkamfo Awurade a otu me fo; na anadwo mpo, me koma kyerɛkyerɛ me.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Mihu Awurade wɔ mʼani so daa nyinaa. Esiane sɛ ɔwɔ me nsa nifa nti, merenhinhim da.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti, me kra ani gye, na mede me tɛkrɛma di ahurusi; me nipadua nso bɛhome asomdwoe mu,

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: efisɛ, worennyaw me awufo mu. Na woremma wo Kronkronni no mporɔw.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Woakyerɛ me nkwagye kwan, na wobɛma mʼani agye wɔ wʼanim, na anigye a ɛrensa da wɔ wo nifa so.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Awurade, tie me trenee abisade; tie me sufrɛ. Yɛ aso ma me mpaebɔ; nea emfi nnaadaa anofafa mu.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Ma me bembu mfi wo; ma wʼani nhu nea ɛyɛ pɛ.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Wopɛɛpɛɛ me koma mu, wohwehwɛ me mu anadwo, na wosɔ me hwɛ de, nanso wubehu sɛ minsusuw bɔne bi ɛ; mʼano nkaa bɔne bi ɛ.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Nnipa nneyɛe fam no, anom asɛm nti matwe me ho afi basabasayɛfo akwan ho.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Menam wʼakwan so daa; me nan nhintiw ɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Misu mefrɛ wo, Onyankopɔn na wubegye me so; yɛ aso ma me na tie me mpaebɔ.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Da wo dɔ nwonwaso no adi; wo a wode wo nsa nifa gye wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no nkwa fi wɔn atamfo nsam no.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Hwɛ me so sɛ obi a wodɔ no; fa me sie wo ntaban nwini no ase,

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: fi amumɔyɛfo a wɔretaataa me no nsam, mʼatamfo a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Wopirim wɔn koma, na wɔkasa ahantan so.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wɔadi me ntɛntɛ, afei wɔatwa me ho ahyia; wɔn ani abere sɛ wɔbɛbɔ me ahwe fam.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Wɔte sɛ gyata a hanam ho kɔm de no, te sɛ gyata kɛse bi a wabutuw wɔ ahintawee.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Sɔre, Awurade! Wone wɔn mfa mmɔ ani na ka wɔn hyɛ; fa wʼafoa no gye me fi amumɔyɛfo no nsam.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Awurade, fa wo nsa gye me fi nnipa a wɔte sɛɛ nsam; asase so nnipa a wɔn akatua wɔ nkwa yi mu no. Womma ɔkɔm nne wɔn a wʼani ku wɔn ho; wɔn mmabarima wɔ bebree, na wɔkora agyapade ma wɔn mma.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Na me trenee mu, mehu wʼanim; sɛ minyan na mihu wo a me koma bɛtɔ me yam. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me botantim; mʼaban ne me gyefo; me Nyankopɔn yɛ me botan. Ne mu na minya me hintabea. Ɔyɛ me nkatabo, me nkwagye abɛn ne mʼabandennen.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Misu frɛ Awurade; ɔno na ayeyi sɛ no, efisɛ ogye me fi mʼatamfo nsam.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Owu nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kyekyeree me; na ɔsɛe asorɔkye bu faa me so.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Mʼahohia mu, misu frɛɛ Awurade. Misu frɛɛ me Nyankopɔn hwehwɛɛ mmoa. Ofi nʼasɔrefi hɔ tee me nne; me sufrɛ baa nʼanim, na ɛkɔɔ nʼasom.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Asase wosowee na ehinhimii, na mmepɔw fapem wosowee wosuroe, efisɛ na ne bo afuw.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Wusiw fii ne hwene mu; ogyaframa fii nʼanom, na nnyansramma dɛw fii mu.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ofii ɔsoro baa fam; na omununkum kabii duruu nʼanan ase.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ɔte kerubim so tu kɔɔ soro; gyaagyaa ne ho wɔ mframa ntaban so.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ɔde sum kataa ne ho, osu a amuna tumm atwa ne ho ahyia.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Hann kɛse hyerɛn wɔ nʼanim, na omununkum a mparuwbo ne anyinam wɔ mu fii ne ho hyerɛn mu bae.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Awurade bobɔɔ mu fii ɔsoro; Ɔsorosoroni no nne gyigyee bio.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Po mu abon ho yiyii na asase nnyinaso ho daa hɔ, esiane wʼanimka ne ahomegu a efi wo hwene mu no nti, Awurade.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ofi soro baa fam besoo me mu; ɔtwee me fii nsu a mu dɔ mu.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Ogyee me fii me tamfo hoɔdenfo nsam, wɔn a wɔn ani sa me, na wɔn ho yɛ den dodo ma me no.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Wɔbaa me so wɔ mʼamanehunu da mu, nanso Awurade maa me so,

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: wode me baa baabi a hɔ trɛw; ogyee me, efisɛ nʼani sɔɔ me.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me adi no sɛnea me trenee te; wahwɛ me nsa a ho tew so atua me ka.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Manantew Awurade akwan so. Mentwee me ho mfii me Nyankopɔn ho nkɔyɛɛ bɔne ɛ.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Madi ne mmara nyinaa so: mimmuu nʼahyɛde so.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Me ho nni asɛm wɔ Onyankopɔn anim, na matwe me ho afi bɔne ho.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Awurade agyina me treneeyɛ ne me nsa a ho tew wɔ nʼanim no so atua me ka.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Woda wo ho adi sɛ ɔnokwafo kyerɛ wɔn a wodi nokware, wɔn a wodi mu nso wokyerɛ wɔn sɛ wodi mu.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Woyɛ kronkron ma wɔn a wɔyɛ kronkron, na amumɔyɛfo de, wukyi wɔn.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Wugye ahobrɛasefo nkwa, na wobrɛ ahantanfo ase.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Awurade, woma me kanea hyerɛn. Yiw, woma me sum dan hann.

english_verse: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.
translation_verse: Wʼahoɔden a wode ma me nti, mitumi ka asraafo gu; me Nyankopɔn nti, mitumi foro ɔfasu.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn de, nʼakwan yɛ pɛ; Awurade bɔhyɛ nyinaa ba mu. Ɔyɛ nkatabo ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ bammɔ wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Na hena na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn ka Awurade ho? Hena na ɔyɛ Ɔbotan no? Gye sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn no.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔma me ahoɔden, na ɔma me kwan yɛ pɛ.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɔma mʼanammɔn ho yɛ hare sɛ ɔforote de. Ɔma me gyina sorɔnsorɔmmea.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Osiesie me ma ɔko, na me basa tumi kuntun kɔbere mfrafrae tadua.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Wode wo ogye boa me nkatabo, na wo nsa nifa ma me gyina. Wobrɛ wo ho ase ma meyɛ ɔkɛse.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Woabɔ kwan tɛtrɛɛ ama mʼanan sɛnea me nkotodwe rengurow.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Metaa mʼatamfo kɔtoo wɔn; mansan mʼakyi kosii sɛ mesɛee wɔn.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Mɛdwerɛw wɔn, na wɔantumi ansɔre, wɔhwehwee ase wɔ mʼanan ase.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Wode akodi ahoɔden maa me; womaa mʼatamfo bɔɔ wɔn mu ase wɔ me nan ase.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Womaa mʼatamfo dan wɔn ho guanee, na mesɛe wɔn a wɔtan me.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Wosu hwehwɛɛ mmoa, nanso obiara ammegye wɔn, wɔfrɛɛ Awurade, nanso wammua.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Meyam wɔn sɛ mfutuma a mframa bɔ gu; mihwiee wɔn guu sɛ mmɔnten so dontori.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Woagye me afi nnipa no ɔfow mu, woayɛ me amanaman no ti; nnipa a minnim wɔn abɛyɛ mʼasomfo.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Wɔn nyinaa botobotow; wofi wɔn abandennen mu ba ahopopo so.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Awurade te ase! Ayeyi nka me Botan! Wɔmma Onyankopɔn, me Gyefo no din so!

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne Onyankopɔn a ɔtɔ were ma me, ɔno na ɔka amanaman hyɛ mʼase,

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: ɔno na ogye me fi mʼatamfo nsam. Wopagyaw me sii mʼatamfo so, wugyee me fii basabasayɛfo nsam.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti, mɛkamfo wo wɔ amanaman mu, Ao Awurade. Mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo din.
