english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Wode nkonimdi akɛse ama wo hene; woda ɔdɔ a ɛnsa da adi kyerɛ nea woasra no ngo, wode kyerɛ Dawid, ne nʼasefo afebɔɔ. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɔsoro ka Onyankopɔn anuonyam! Wim pae mu ka ne nsa ano adwuma,

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Da biara, wɔkasa; anadwo biara, wɔda nimdeɛ adi.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Wonni ɔkasa, wɔnnka nsɛm; wɔnnte wɔn nne.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Wɔn nne akodu asase so mmaa nyinaa, na wɔn nsɛm nso akodu asase ano. Onyankopɔn asi ntamadan ama owia wɔ ɔsoro hɔ.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Ɛte sɛ ayeforokunu a ofi ne pia mu, te sɛ ɔbran a ne ho pere no sɛ obetu ne mmirika.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Epue wɔ ɔsoro fa baabi na atwa ne ho akosi ano; biribiara nsiw ne hyew ho kwan.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Awurade mmara yɛ pɛ, ɛkanyan ɔkra no. Ahotoso wɔ Awurade nhyehyɛe mu, ɛma nea onnim nyansa hu nyansa.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Awurade ahyɛde teɛ; ɛma koma mu anigye. Awurade ɔhyɛ nsɛm mu da hɔ; na ebue ani.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ kronkron, ɛte hɔ daa. Awurade mmara nsɛm yɛ nokware na ne nyinaa teɛ.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Ɛsom bo sen sikakɔkɔɔ ɛsen sikakɔkɔɔ kann; ɛyɛ dɛ sen ɛwo, ɛsen ɛwo a efi ɛwokyɛm mu.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Wɔnam so bɔ wo somfo kɔkɔ se, sodi so akatua yɛ bebree.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Hena na ohu nʼankasa mfomso? Fa me mfomso a ahintaw kyɛ me.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Bɔ wʼakoa ho ban fi ɔboayɛ bɔne ho, na anhyɛ me so. Ɛno na ɛbɛma madi bem, a merenni fɔ wɔ bɔne akɛse ho.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Ma mʼanom nsɛm ne me koma mu adwene nyɛ nea ɛsɔ wʼani, Awurade me Botan ne me Gyefo. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Awurade ntie wo wɔ wʼahohia mu; Yakob Nyankopɔn din mmɔ wo ho ban.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɔmfa mmoa mfi kronkronbea hɔ mmrɛ wo, na omfi Sion mmɛhyɛ wo den.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Ɔnkae wʼafɔrebɔ nyinaa, na ɔmma wo hyew afɔre nsɔ nʼani.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Ɔmma wo nea wo koma pɛ, na wo nhyehyɛe nyinaa nyɛ yiye.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Yɛbɛbɔ ose bere a woadi nkonim, na yɛama yɛn frankaa so wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn din mu. Awurade nyɛ wʼabisade nyinaa mma wo.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Afei mahu sɛ Awurade ma nea wasra no no nkonimdi, ofi ne kronkronbea wɔ ɔsoro gye no so, ɔde ne nkonimdi tumi a ɛwɔ ne nsa nifa mu no.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Ebinom de wɔn ho to wɔn nteaseɛnam so na afoforo nso, wɔn apɔnkɔ so, nanso yɛn de, yɛde yɛn ho to Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn din so.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Wɔbrɛ wɔn ase ma wɔhwehwe ase, na yɛn de, yɛsɔre gyina kirebenn.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Awurade, ma ɔhene nkonimdi! Yɛfrɛ a, gye yɛn so! Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Awurade, ɔhene di anigye wɔ wʼahoɔden mu. Nʼani gye mmoroso wɔ nkonimdi a woma no nti!

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Woama no nea ne koma pɛ; woamfa nʼabisade ankame no.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Wode nhyira a edi mu hyiaa no na wode sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa ahenkyɛw hyɛɛ no.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Obisaa wo hɔ nkwa, na wode maa no, nna tenten a enni awiei.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Nkonimdi a woma no nti, nʼanuonyam so; wode kɛseyɛ ne nidi adom no.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, woama no nhyira a ɛnsa da na woama no ahosɛpɛw wɔ wʼanim anigye mu.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Ɔhene no de ne ho to Awurade so; Ɔsorosoroni no nokware dɔ no nti, ɔrenhinhim.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Wo nsa bɛka wʼatamfo nyinaa; wo nsa nifa beso wɔn a wokyi wo no mu.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Bere a wubeyi wo ho adi no wobɛyɛ wɔn sɛ fononoo a mu adɔ. Awurade fi nʼabufuwhyew mu bɛmene wɔn, na ne gya no ahyew wɔn.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Wobɛtɔre wɔn ase wɔ asase so, na wɔn asefo afi adesamma mu.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ wɔbɔ pɔw tia wo na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe bɔne, nanso wɔrenni nkonim;

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: efisɛ wobɛma wɔasan wɔn akyi bere a woatwe bɛmma akyerɛ wɔn so no.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Yɛma wo so, Awurade, wɔ wʼahoɔden mu; yɛbɛto nnwom na yɛakamfo wo kɛseyɛ. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔto no sɛnea wɔto “Adekyee forote” dwom.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn, adɛn nti na woagyaw me? Adɛn nti na me nkwagye ne wo ntam aware, adɛn na mʼapinisi nsɛm ne wo ntam aware?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn, misu frɛ wo awia, nanso wunnye me so, mefrɛ wo anadwo, nanso minnya ɔhome.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔasi wo hene sɛ Ɔkronkronni; wo na Israel kamfo wo.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Wo mu na yɛn agyanom de wɔn werɛ hyɛe; wogyee wo dii, na wugyee wɔn.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Wosu frɛɛ wo na wugyee wɔn, wɔde wɔn ho too wo so na woanni wɔn nhuammɔ.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Nanso meyɛ osunson, na menyɛ onipa nnipa bɔ me ahohora na wobu me animtiaa.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Obiara a ohu me di me ho fɛw; wotwa me adapaa, wosow wɔn ti ka se:

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “Ɔde ne ho to Awurade so; ma Awurade mmegye no. Ma ɔmmɛboa no, efisɛ ɔwɔ no mu anigye.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Wo na wuyii me fii awotwaa mu bae na womaa me de me ho too wo so bere a mitua me na nufu ano mpo.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Efi mʼawo mu na wɔde me too wo so; efi me na yafunu mu, woayɛ me Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Ntwe wo ho mfi me ho! Efisɛ amane abɛn na ɔboafo nni baabi.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Anantwinini bebree atwa me ho ahyia; Basan anantwinini a wɔn ho yɛ den atwa me ho ahyia.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Gyata a wɔbobɔ mu na wɔtetew wɔn hanam mu abuebue wɔn anom tɛtrɛɛ de kyerɛ me.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Wɔahwie me agu sɛ nsu, na me nnompe nyinaa ahodwow. Me koma adan amane; anan wɔ me mu.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Mʼanom ayow te sɛ kyɛmfɛre mu. Na me tɛkrɛma atare mʼanom. Wode me to owu mfutuma mu.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Akraman atwa me ho ahyia, nnebɔneyɛfo kuw atwa me ahyia, wɔahwirew me nsa ne mʼanan mu.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Me nnompe nyinaa gu petee mu; Mʼatamfo hwɛ me haa na wɔserew me.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Wɔkyɛ me atade mu fa, na wɔbɔ me ntama so ntonto.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Na wo, Awurade, ntwe wo ho; wone mʼahoɔden, bra ntɛm bɛboa me.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Gye me kra fi afoa ano; gye me nkwa a ɛsom bo no fi akraman tumi ase.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Gye me nkwa fi gyata anom; gye me fi ɛko mmɛn so.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛbɔ wo din akyerɛ me nuanom; mɛkamfo wo wɔ wɔn a wɔahyia hɔ no nyinaa anim.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, mo a musuro no no! Mo a moyɛ Yakob asefo, monhyɛ no anuonyam! Mo Israel asefo nyinaa, munni no ni!

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Ommuu nʼani nguu ɔmanehunufo ateetee so ɛ, ɔmfaa nʼanim nhintaw no; na mmom watie ne sufrɛ a ɔde rehwehwɛ mmoa no.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Me botae a mede yi wo ayɛ wɔ bagua mu no fi wo; medi me bɔhyɛ so wɔ wɔn a wosuro wo no anim.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Ahiafo bedidi na wɔamee; wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade beyi no ayɛ, mo koma nnya nkwa daa.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Asase ano nyinaa bɛkae akɔ Awurade nkyɛn, na amanaman no mmusua nyinaa bɛkotow nʼanim,

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: efisɛ tumi wɔ Awurade na odi amanaman so hene.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Asase so adefo nyinaa bedidi na wɔasɔre no; wɔn a wɔkɔ dɔte mu nyinaa bebu nkotodwe nʼanim, wɔn a wɔrentumi mma nkwa mu.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Nkyirimma nyinaa bɛsom no; wɔbɛka Awurade ho asɛm akyerɛ awo ntoatoaso a edidi so.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka ne trenee akyerɛ nnipa a wonnya nwoo wɔn efisɛ ɔno na wayɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me hwɛfo, hwee renhia me.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Ɔma meda wura frɔmfrɔm adidibea; ogya me kɔ nsu a ɛho dwo ho,

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: odwudwo me kra. Ɔde me fa akwantrenee so, ne din nti.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Sɛ menam owu sum kabii mu mpo a, minsuro bɔne bi, efisɛ wo ne me na ɛwɔ hɔ; wʼabaa ne wo pema na ɛkyekye me werɛ.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Woto me pon wɔ mʼatamfo anim. Wode ngo fɔw me tirim; me kuruwa yɛ ma bu so.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Yiye ne adɔe nko na ebedi mʼakyi me nkwanna nyinaa; na mɛtena Awurade fi daa.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Asase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ Awurade de; wiase ne wɔn a wɔte mu nyinaa wɔ no;

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: efisɛ ɔno na ɔtoo ne fapem wɔ po so na ɔde sii nsu ani.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Hena na obetumi aforo Awurade bepɔw no? Hena na obetumi agyina ne tenabea kronkron hɔ?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Nea ɔyɛ ade trenee na ne koma mu tew, nea ne kra nni ahoni akyi na ɔnka ntamhunu.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Obenya Awurade nsam nhyira ne bembu a efi ne Nkwagye Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Saa na awo ntoatoaso a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no te wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wʼanim no, Yakob Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mo aponkɛse, momma mo ti so; wɔmma mo so, mo tete apon, na Anuonyam Hene nhyɛn mu.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Hena ne saa Anuonyam Hene yi? Ɔno ne Awurade hoɔdenfo ne otumfo no Awurade a ɔyɛ ɔko mu nkonimdifo.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Momma mo ti so, mo aponkɛse momma wɔn so, mo tete apon, na anuonyam Hene no nkɔ mu.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Hena ne saa anuonyam Hene yi? Asafo Awurade no, ɔno ne anuonyam Hene no.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Awurade, me Nyankopɔn, wo mu na mede me werɛ hyɛ.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Wo so, me Nyankopɔn, na mede me ho to, mma mʼanim ngu ase, na mma mʼatamfo nso nni me so nkonim.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Awurade, na minhu wʼatempɔn.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Fa wo nokware no so kyerɛkyerɛ me, efisɛ woyɛ Onyankopɔn, me Gyefo, na mʼani da wo so daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Kae, Awurade, wo mmɔborɔhunu ne wo dɔ kɛse a ɛwɔ hɔ fi tete no.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Nkae me mmabun bere mu bɔne ne mʼatuatew akwan; kae me sɛnea wʼadɔe te, Awurade, efisɛ wuye.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Awurade ye na ɔteɛ; enti ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfo nʼakwan.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Ɔde ahobrɛasefo fa ɔkwan pa so na ɔkyerɛ wɔn nʼapɛde.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Awurade akwan nyinaa yɛ ɔdɔ ne nokwaredi ma wɔn a wodi nʼapam mu ahyɛde so.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Awurade, me bɔne so de, nanso wo din nti, fa kyɛ me.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Enti hena ne onipa a osuro Awurade? Ɔbɛkyerɛ no ɔkwan a wabɔ ama no.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Obedi yiye wɔ ne nkwanna mu, na nʼasefo afa asase no sɛ wɔn agyapade.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Awurade da nʼatirimsɛm adi kyerɛ wɔn a wosuro no; na ɔma wohu nʼapam.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Mʼani da Awurade so daa, efisɛ ɔno nko ara na obeyi mʼanan afi afiri mu.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Dan wʼani hwɛ me, na dom me, efisɛ meyɛ ankonam na meyɛ mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Me koma mu dadwen adɔɔso; yi me dadwen fi me so.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Hwɛ me haw ne mʼahohiahia na yi me bɔne nyinaa fi me so.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛnea mʼatamfo adɔɔso ne ɔtan kɛse a wɔde tan me!

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Bɔ me nkwa ho ban na gye me; mma mʼanim ngu ase, efisɛ me guankɔbea ne wo.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Ma trenee ne nokware mmɔ me ho ban, efisɛ mʼani da wo so.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Gye Israel, Onyankopɔn, fi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Bu me bem, Awurade, efisɛ, mabɔ bra a asɛm nni ho: mede me ho too Awurade so na manhinhim.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Sɔ me hwɛ, Awurade, hwehwɛ me koma ne mʼadwene mu.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Wʼadɔe wɔ mʼanim daa na mɛnantew wo nokware mu.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Me ne nnaadaafo ntena na me ne nyaatwomfo nso nni hwee yɛ.

english_verse: or go with evil crowds.
translation_verse: Mikyi nnebɔneyɛfo guabɔ na mempɛ sɛ me ne amumɔyɛfo tena.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Mehohoro me nsa wɔ bembu mu, na mekɔ wʼafɔremuka ho ahyia, Awurade,

english_verse: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
translation_verse: na mepae mu ka wʼayeyi na meka wʼanwonwade nyinaa.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Mʼani gye ofi a wote mu ho, Awurade, faako a wʼanuonyam wɔ no.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Mfa me kra nka nnebɔneyɛfo de ho nkɔ, ne me nkwa nka mogyapɛfo de ho,

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: wɔn a amumɔyɛ nhyehyɛe wɔ wɔn nsam na adanmude ayɛ wɔn nsa nifa ma.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nanso mebɔ ɔbra a ho tew; hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me nkwa.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mʼanan sisi asase tamaa so; na guabɔ kɛse ase na mɛkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me hann ne me nkwagye; hena na minsuro no? Awurade ne me nkwa ahoɔden, na hena anim na me ho mpopo?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnipa bɔne bɔ toa me pɛ sɛ wokum me, sɛ mʼatamfo tow hyɛ me so a, wobehintihintiw ahwehwe ase.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Sɛ dɔm mpo twa me ho hyia a, me koma rentu; mpo sɛ wotu me so sa a, ɛno mu koraa na minya awerehyɛmu.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Ade baako na mibisa Awurade; na ɛno na mehwehwɛ; sɛ mɛtena Awurade fi me nkwanna nyinaa, na mahwɛ Awurade ahoɔfɛ na mahwehwɛ no wɔ nʼasɔrefi.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Hiada mu no, ɔde me besie nʼatenae dwoodwoo; ɔbɛkora me wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan kronkron mu ɔde me si ɔbotan so wɔ sorosoro.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɛma me ti so wɔ atamfo a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no so; mede anigye bɛbɔ afɔre wɔ nʼAhyiae Ntamadan mu; na mɛto dwom, ahyehyɛ nnwom ama Awurade.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Awurade, sɛ misu frɛ wo a, tie me! Hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me so!

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Me koma ka wɔ wo ho se, “Hwehwɛ nʼanim!” Wʼanim, Awurade na mɛhwehwɛ.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Mfa wʼanim nhintaw me, mfa abufuw mpam wo somfo me boafo ne wo. Mpo me, na nnyaw me, mʼAgyenkwa Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Mʼagya ne me na begyaw me hɔ de, nanso Awurade begye me.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Awurade; fa me fa ɔkwan tee so, me nhyɛsofo nti.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Nnyaa me mma sɛnea mʼatamfo pɛ, nnansekurumfo sɔre tia me na wopuw awurukasɛm.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Meda so wɔ saa anidaso yi sɛ: mehu Awurade ayamye wɔ ateasefo asase so.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Twɛn Awurade. Hyɛ wo ho den na ma wo bo nyɛ duru na twɛn Awurade.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Wo na misu frɛ wo, Awurade me Botan; nsiw wʼaso wɔ me ho. Sɛ woyɛ komm a, mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔasian kɔ amoa mu no.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Tie me mmɔborɔsu bere a mefrɛ wo apɛ mmoa, bere a mema me nsa so kyerɛ wo Tenabea Kronkron hɔ.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Mfa me mfra amumɔyɛfo mu ntwe me nkɔ, mfa me nka wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no ho. Wɔne wɔn yɔnkonom kasa fɛfɛ, nanso wɔde ɔtan sie wɔn koma mu.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Sɛ wommu nea Awurade ayɛ ne nea ɔde ne nsa ayɛ no nti ɔbɛbrɛ wɔn ase na ɔremma wɔnnsɔre bio.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Ayeyi nka Awurade, efisɛ watie me mmɔborɔsu.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Awurade ne mʼahoɔden ne me nkatabo me koma wɔ ne mu ahotoso, na ɔboa me. Me koma di ahurusi na mede dwonto bɛda no ase.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ahoɔden ma ne nkurɔfo; ne nkwagye nsraban ma nea wɔasra no ngo.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Gye wo nkurɔfo na hyira wʼagyapade; yɛ wɔn hwɛfo, na wo ne wɔn nnantew afebɔɔ.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Momfa mma Awurade no, mo ɔsoro abɔde, momfa anuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Momfa anuonyam a ɛfata Awurade din mma no; monsɔre Awurade wɔ nʼanuonyam kronkron mu.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Awurade nne wɔ nsu no so; anuonyam Nyankopɔn bobɔ mu, Awurade bobɔ mu wɔ nsu akɛse so.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Awurade nne mu wɔ tumi; Awurade nne mu wɔ anuonyam.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Awurade nne bubu sida; Awurade nne bubu Lebanon sida mu nketenkete

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ɔma Lebanon huruhuruw te sɛ nantwi ba, na Sirion nso sɛ ɛko ba.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Awurade nne pa ma anyinam gya dɛw.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Awurade nne wosow sare so; Awurade wosow Kades sare.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Awurade nne kyinkyim adum na ɛma kwae yɛ kwaterekwa. Nʼasɔredan mufo nyinaa teɛ mu ka se, “Anuonyam nka Onyankopɔn!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Awurade di hene wɔ nsuyiri so; wɔasi Awurade hene afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Awurade ma ne nkurɔfo ahoɔden, na ɔde asomdwoe hyira wɔn. Dwom a wɔto de buee Asɔredan no ano.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Mɛma wo so, Awurade, efisɛ, woayi me afi bun mu na woamma mʼatamfo anserew me.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Awurade me Nyankopɔn, misu frɛɛ wo sɛ boa me na wosaa me yare.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Monto ayeyi nnwom mma Awurade; mo a moyɛ nʼahotewfo! Monkamfo ne din kronkron no.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Nʼabufuw nkyɛ, na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa; agyaadwotwa bɛwɔ hɔ anadwo, nanso ahosɛpɛw bɛba anɔpa.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Metee nka sɛ mewɔ bammɔ no, mekae se, “Merenhinhim da.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Awurade, woyɛɛ me adom no womaa me bepɔw gyinaa pintinn na wode wʼanim hintaw me no, me koma tui.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Wo, Awurade na mefrɛɛ wo; wo hɔ na misu mesrɛɛ mmɔborɔhunu se:

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ me sɛe so, sɛ mɛkɔ amoa mu? Mfutuma beyi wo ayɛ ana? Ɛbɛpae mu aka wo nokwaredi ana?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Wodan mʼagyaadwotwa yɛɛ no asaw; wuyii mʼatweaatam fii me ho na wode anigye furaa me,

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: sɛ me koma bɛto nnwom ama wo na ɛrenyɛ komm. Awurade me Nyankopɔn, meyi wo ayɛ daa. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Wo mu, Awurade na manya guankɔbea; mma mʼanim ngu ase; fi wo trenee mu gye me.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Yɛ aso ma me, bra ntɛm begye me; yɛ me bammɔ botan, aban a mʼatamfo nsa renka me.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ me botan ne mʼaban nti, wo din nti di mʼanim na kyerɛ me kwan.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Gye me fi afiri a wɔasum me no mu, efisɛ wo ne me guankɔbea.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Wo nsam na mede me kra hyɛ; gye me bio, Awurade, Onyankopɔn nokwafo.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mikyi wɔn a wɔsom abosom huhuw; mede me ho to Awurade so.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Mʼani begye na madi ahurusi wɔ wo dɔ mu, efisɛ wuhu mʼamanehunu, na wunim me kra mu haw.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Womfaa me nhyɛɛ ɔtamfo no nsa mmom wode me nan asisi petee mu.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Hu me mmɔbɔ, Awurade, efisɛ me ho yeraw me; awerɛhow ama mʼani so ayɛ kusuu ɔyaw ama me kra ne me honam ayɛ mmerɛw.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Ɔyawdi retew me nkwa so, na abooboo tew me mfe so; ɔhaw nti mʼahoɔden kɔ fam, na me nnompe nso ahodwow.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Mʼatamfo nyinaa nti, mayɛ ahohora wɔ me nnamfonom mu; nnipa a wonim me suro me, na wɔn a wohu me mmɔnten so guan.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Obiara werɛ afi me te sɛ nea mawu; mayɛ sɛ kuku a abɔ.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Mete asomsɛm dodow a wɔka ahunahuna atwa me ho ahyia. Wɔrepam me ti so, na wɔbɔ pɔw sɛ wobekum me.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Nanso mede me ho ato wo so, Awurade; meka se, “Woyɛ me Nyankopɔn.”

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Me mmere wɔ wo nsam gye me fi mʼatamfo ne wɔn a wɔtaa me no nsam.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Tew wʼanim kyerɛ wo somfo; gye me wɔ wo dɔ a enni huammɔ no mu.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Mma mʼanim ngu ase, Awurade, efisɛ masu afrɛ wo; mmom, ma amumɔyɛfo anim ngu ase na wɔnna wɔn nna mu komm.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Mua atorofo ano, efisɛ wɔde ahantan ne animtiaabu kasa tia atreneefo.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Wo papayɛ dɔɔso, ɛno na woakora ama wɔn a wosuro wo no ɛno na wode ma wɔn a woguan toa wo no wɔ nnipa anim.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Wode wɔn sie wʼanim bammɔ mu fi nnipa nsusuwii bɔne ho; wo tenabea hɔ na wode wɔn sie dwoodwoo fi tɛkrɛma a ɛbɔ sobo ho.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Ayeyi nka Awurade! Sɛ wayi ne dɔ nwonwaso akyerɛ me bere a na mewɔ kuropɔn a atamfo atwa ho ahyia no mu no.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Mebɔɔ huboa no mekae se: “Woayi wʼani afi me so!” Nanso wotee me mmɔborɔsu bere a mekotow srɛɛ wo no.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Monnɔ Awurade mo a moyɛ nʼahotewfo nyinaa! Awurade kora wɔn a wodi nokware so, na ahomasofo de, otua wɔn ka pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Monyɛ den na momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam, mo a mowɔ anidaso wɔ Awurade mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn amumɔyɛ akyɛ wɔn, na wɔakata wɔn bɔne so.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Nhyira nka onipa a Awurade mmu ne bɔne ngu no so na nnaadaa nni ne honhom mu.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Bere a meyɛɛ komm no, me nnompe yɛɛ mmrɛw, apini a misii no da mu nyinaa nti.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Awia ne anadwo wo nsa yɛɛ den wɔ me so; mʼahoɔden sae te sɛ awia bere mu ɔhyew.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Afei, migyee me bɔne too mu. Mankata mʼamumɔyɛ so. Mekae se, “Mɛka me bɔne akyerɛ Awurade,” na wode me bɔne ho afɔdi kyɛɛ me.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Enti, ma agyidifo nyinaa mmɔ wo mpae bere a wohu wo; ampa ara sɛ asu akɛse yiri a, ɛrenka no.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Wone me hintabea; wobɛbɔ me ho ban wɔ amanehunu mu na wode nkwagye nnwom atwa me ho ahyia.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Mɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo ɔkwan a wobɛfa so metu wo fo na mahwɛ wo so.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔpɔnkɔ anaa afurumpɔnkɔ a onni ntease nti wɔde nnareka ne hama na ɛdannan no, sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛba wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo amanehunu dɔɔso, nanso Awurade adɔe a ɛnsa da no twa onipa a ɔde ne ho to no so no ho hyia.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Momfa ahurusi nto dwom mma Awurade, mo atreneefo, ɛfata sɛ wɔn a wɔteɛ no yi no ayɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Momfa sanku nkamfo Awurade; monto dwom mma no wɔ sankuten so.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Monto dwom foforo mma no. Momfa nimdeɛ mmɔ sanku no na monteɛ mu ahurusi so!

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Awurade asɛm teɛ na ɛyɛ nokware odi nokware wɔ nea ɔyɛ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Awurade dɔ treneeyɛ ne atɛntrenee. Nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ahyɛ asase so ma.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Awurade asɛm so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsorosoro, nʼanom home so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsoro asafo.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: Ɔka po nsu boa ano kuw; na ɔde bun sie nea hɔ dɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Momma asase sofo nyinaa nsuro Awurade; na wiasefo nyinaa mfa nidi mma no.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔkasa ma ɛbaa mu na ɔhyɛ ma egyinaa pintinn.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Awurade sɛe amanaman no nhyehyɛe; ɔma adesamma nsusuwii yɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Nanso Awurade nhyehyɛe tim hɔ daa, ne koma mu botae wɔ hɔ ma awo ntoatoaso.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne ɔman a ne Nyankopɔn ne Awurade, nnipa a oyii wɔn sɛ nʼagyapade no.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Awurade hwɛ adesamma nyinaa fi ɔsoro.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ofi nʼatenae hwɛ wɔn a wɔte asase so nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne nea ɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa koma, na osusuw nea wɔyɛ nyinaa ho.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ ɔhene asraafo dɔm kɛse na ebegye no; ɔkofo biara nni hɔ a ofi nʼahoɔden mu guan.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Ɔpɔnkɔ mu ahotoso yɛ ɔkwa wɔ nkwagye mu; nʼahoɔden nyinaa akyi no, ɔrentumi nnye nkwa.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Nanso Awurade ani wɔ wɔn a wosuro no no so, wɔn a wɔwɔ anidaso wɔ ne dɔ a ɛnsa da no mu,

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Yɛde anidaso twɛn Awurade; ɔyɛ yɛn boafo ne yɛn nkatabo.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Ne mu na yɛn koma di ahurusi, efisɛ yɛde yɛn ho to ne din kronkron no so.

english_verse: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.
translation_verse: Ma wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ntena yɛn so, Awurade, sɛnea anidaso a yɛwɔ wɔ mu no te.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Mede aseda bɛma Awurade bere nyinaa; nʼayeyi wɔ mʼanom daa.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Me kra bɛhoahoa ne ho wɔ Awurade mu; ma amanehunufo nte na wonni ahurusi.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Mo ne me nkamfo Awurade; momma yɛmmɔ mu nkamfo ne din!

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Mefrɛɛ Awurade na ogyee me so; na ogyee me wɔ nea misuro nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔhwɛ nʼanim no hyerɛn na wɔn anim rengu ase da.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Ohiani yi frɛe, na Awurade tiee no; na ogyee no fii nʼahohia nyinaa mu.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Awurade bɔfo wɛn wɔn a wosuro no, na ogye wɔn.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Monka nhwɛ na munhu sɛ Awurade ye. Nhyira ne onipa a oguan toa no.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Munsuro Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼahotefo, na wɔn a wosuro no no nhia hwee.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Gyata yɛ mmerɛw na ɔkɔm de wɔn, nanso wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no, ade pa biara remmɔ wɔn.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Mommra, me mma, monyɛ aso mma me; mɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo Awurade ho suro.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Mo mu hena na ɔpɛ nkwa na ɔpɛ sɛ ohu nna pa bebree?

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: Ɛne ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔka kasa bɔne, na ɛsɛ sɛ ogyae atorotwa.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Twe wo ho fi bɔne ho, na yɛ papa; hwehwɛ asomdwoe na tiw no.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Awurade ani wɔ atreneefo so na otie wɔn mpaebɔ;

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Awurade ani sa wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne, sɛ obeyi wɔn nkae afi asase yi so.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Atreneefo teɛ mu su, na Awurade tie wɔn; oyi wɔn fi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔn koma abotow na ogye wɔn a wɔadwerɛw wɔn wɔ honhom mu no nkwa.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Onipa trenee behu amane bebree nanso Awurade gye no fi ne nyinaa mu;

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: ɔbɔ ne nnompe nyinaa ho ban, sɛnea mu baako mpo mu remmu.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Awurade gye nʼasomfo nkwa; wɔn a woguan toa no no mu biara renkɔ afɔbu mu.

english_verse: Shield me and help me.
translation_verse: Fa wo nkatabo ne wʼakode; na sɔre bra bɛboa me.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Twe peaw ne abonnua wɔ wɔn a wɔtaa me no so. Ka kyerɛ me kra se, “Mene wʼagyenkwa.”

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum me no, ma wɔn anim ngu ase; wɔn a wɔbɔ me sɛe ho pɔw no, ma wɔmfa aniwu nsan wɔn akyi.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ gu wɔn a Awurade bɔfo repam wɔn no.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn akwan so nnuru sum na ɛso ɛnyɛ toro, na Awurade bɔfo ntaa wɔn.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ wɔde ɔtan sum me afiri kwa, na wotuu amoa maa me a menyɛɛ wɔn hwee no nti

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: ma ɔsɛe mmefu wɔn mu na ɔtan no a wɔde hintaw no nyi wɔn, na ma wɔnhwe amoa no mu nsɛe.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Afei me kra ani begye wɔ Awurade mu na wasɛpɛw ne ho wɔ ne nkwagye mu.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Me nipadua nyinaa bɛteɛ mu aka se, “Hena na ɔte sɛ wo, Awurade? Wugye ohiani fi ahoɔdenfo nsam, ne nea onni bi fi apoobɔfo nsam.”

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Adansekurumfo sɔre; wobisa me nneɛma a minnim ho hwee ho asɛm.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Wɔde bɔne tua papa a meyɛ so ka na wɔma me kra yɛ basaa.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Nanso bere a wɔyaree no, mifuraa atweaatam na mede akɔnkyen brɛɛ me ho ase. Bere a me mpaebɔ ho mmuae nnya mmae no,

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: mekɔɔ so twaa adwo, sɛnea meyɛ ma mʼadamfo anaa onuabarima. Mede awerɛhow sii me ti ase te sɛ nea meregyam me na.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Nanso bere a mihintiw no wɔde anigye boaa wɔn ho ano; afowfo twaa me ho hyiae a minnim, na wodii me ho nseku a wɔantwa so da.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Awurade, wobɛhwɛ wɔn akosi da bɛn? Gye me nkwa fi wɔn sɛe mu, gye me nkwa a ɛsom bo no fi saa gyata yi nsam.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Na mɛda wo ase wɔ guabɔ kɛse ase; wɔ nnipa dodow mu na mɛkamfo wo.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Mma mʼatamfo a wɔtan me kwa no nhwɛ me haw nserew. Mma wɔn a menyɛɛ wɔn hwee nanso wɔtan me no mmfa adwene bɔne mmu me anikyiw.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Wɔnnkasa asomdwoe so, na mmom, wɔde ntwatoso tia nnipa a wɔmpɛ wɔn ho asɛm wɔ asase yi so.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Wɔhwɛ me haw ka se, “Yiw! Yiw, yɛde yɛn ankasa ani ahu.”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Awurade, woahu na mmua wʼano. Ntwe wo ho nkɔ akyiri, Awurade.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: Di mʼasɛm ma me wɔ wo trenee no mu, Awurade me Nyankopɔn; mma wɔnnhwɛ me haw nserew.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Mma wɔnnwene nka se, “Yiw, nea yɛpɛ ni!” anaa wɔnnka se, “Yɛanya no.”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔhwɛ me haw serew me wɔ mʼahohiahia mu no nyinaa anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa; ma wɔn a wodi me so akokurokosɛm no nhyɛ aniwu ne animguase atade.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wodi ahurusi wɔ me bembu ho no mfa anigye ne ahosɛpɛw nteɛ mu bere nyinaa mu; ma wɔnka se, “Momma Awurade so, ɔno na nʼani gye ne somfo yiyedi ho.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Me tɛkrɛma bɛka wo trenee, ne wʼayeyi, da mu nyinaa. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Na ɔno ankasa ani so no ɔdaadaa no ho dodo, nti ɛmma onhu ne bɔne nnyae yɛ.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Nʼanom nsɛm yɛ atirimɔden ne nnaadaa; onnim nyansa bio na wayɛ papa.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ɔda ne mpa so mpo a ɔbɔ pɔw bɔne; na ogyaa ne ho ma bɔne kwan na ɔmpo nea enye.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Awurade, wʼadɔe du ɔsorosoro wo nokwaredi du wim tɔnn.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Wo trenee te sɛ mmepɔw akɛse. Wʼatɛntrenee mu dɔ sɛ po bun. Ao Awurade, wokora nnipa ne mmoa nyinaa so.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no som bo! Nnipa mu akɛse ne nketewa nya guankɔbea wɔ wo ntaban nwini ase.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Wodi nea abu so wɔ wo fi, woma wɔnom fi wʼanika asuten no mu.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Wo nkyɛn na nkwa asuti wɔ; wo hann mu na yehu hann.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Kɔ so dɔ wɔn a wonim wo, ma wo trenee ntena wɔn a wɔteɛ, koma mu.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Mma ɔhantanni nan ntia me anaa omumɔyɛfo nsa nnsunsum me.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛnea nnebɔneyɛfo ahwehwe ase, wɔdeda hɔ a wɔrentumi nsɔre bio.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Nhaw wo ho, nnebɔneyɛfo nti; mma wʼani mmmere wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne;

english_verse: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
translation_verse: Wɔte sɛ sare, ɛrenkyɛ na ahyew, wɔte sɛ dua amono, ɛrenkyɛ na awu.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Fa wo ho to Awurade so na yɛ papa. Tena asase no so na ma wʼani nka asomdwoe adidibea hɔ.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Ma wʼani nnye wɔ Awurade mu na wama wo nea wo koma pɛ.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Fa wʼakwan hyɛ Awurade nsam; na fa wo ho to no so, na ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ:

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: ɔbɛma wo treneeyɛ ahyerɛn sɛ adekyee, na wʼatɛntrenee ayɛ sɛ owigyinae.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Yɛ komm wɔ Awurade anim na tɔ wo bo ase twɛn no, nhaw wo ho wɔ wɔn a asi wɔn yiye ho efisɛ wɔnam bɔne akwan so.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Mma wo bo mmfuw na gyae abufuwhyew; nhaw wo ho, ekowie bɔne nko ara.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Wobetwa nnebɔneyɛfo agu, nanso wɔn a wɔn ani da Awurade so no wobenya asase no adi so.

english_verse: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found,
translation_verse: Ɛrenkyɛ, nnebɔneyɛfo bɛyera. Wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn, nanso wɔrenhu wɔn.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Nanso ahobrɛasefo benya asase no adi so na wɔanya asomdwoe mmoroso.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo bɔ pɔw bɔne tia atreneefo na wɔtwɛre wɔn se gu wɔn so;

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: nanso Awurade serew amumɔyɛfo, na onim sɛ wɔn nna abɛn.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo twe afoa na wokuntun wɔn ta mu sɛ wobekum ahiafo ne mmɔborɔfo, sɛ wobekum wɔn a wɔn akwan teɛ.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔn afoa bɛwowɔ wɔn ankasa koma mu, na wɔn ta mu abubu.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Kakra a atreneefo wɔ no som bo sen amumɔyɛfo bebree ahonya;

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Awurade nim wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm no nna, na wɔn agyapade bɛtena hɔ daa.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Ahohiahia bere mu wɔremmrɛ. Ɔkɔm bere mu wobenya ama abu so.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Nanso amumɔyɛfo bɛyera. Awurade atamfo bɛyɛ sɛ nwura mu nhwiren; wobetu ayera sɛ wusiw.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo pɛ bosea, na wontua, nanso ɔtreneeni de ahummɔbɔ ma;

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Wɔn a Awurade ahyira wɔn no benya asase no adi so, na wobetwa wɔn a ɔdome wɔn no agu.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Sɛ Awurade ani sɔ onipa akwan a, ɔma nʼanammɔntu si pi.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Sɛ ohintiw a ɔrenhwe ase, efisɛ Awurade kura no wɔ ne nsam.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Na meyɛ aberante, na mprempren mabɔ akwakoraa, na minhuu ɔtreneeni a Awurade apa nʼakyi anaasɛ ne mma resrɛ aduan.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Bere biara ɔyɛ adɔe, na ɔde fɛm kwa; na ne mma benya nhyira.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Twe wo ho fi bɔne ho na yɛ papa na wobɛtena asase no so afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Efisɛ, Awurade pɛ nea ɛteɛ, na ɔrennyaw ne nkurɔfo anokwafo no. Wobenya bammɔ daa nyinaa. Nanso amumɔyɛfo asefo de, wobetwa wɔn agu.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Atreneefo benya asase no adi so na wɔatena so afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni ano ka nyansasɛm, na ne tɛkrɛma ka nea ɛteɛ.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Ne Nyankopɔn mmara wɔ ne koma mu; wɔn anan nwatiri.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo tetɛw atreneefo hwehwɛ sɛ wobekum wɔn,

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: nanso Awurade nnyaa wɔn mma wɔn, na ɔremma wommu wɔn kumfɔ wɔ asennii.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Montwɛn Awurade na monhwɛ nʼakwan. Ɔbɛma mo so na moanya asase no adi so; sɛ wotwitwa amumɔyɛfo no gu a, mubehu.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Mahu omumɔyɛfo a ɔyɛ basabasa sɛ ɔredi yiye sɛ dua amono a esi asase pa so,

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: nanso ankyɛ na nʼawiei bae a wonhu no bio; mehwehwɛɛ no, nanso manhu no.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Susuw nea ɔyɛ pɛ ho, na hwɛ nea ɔteɛ; na asomdwoe nipa benya asetena pa daakye.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔbɛsɛe nnebɔneyɛfo nyinaa; na wɔbɛtɔre wɔn asefo ase.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Atreneefo nkwagye fi Awurade ɔne wɔn aban wɔ amanehunu bere mu.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Awurade boa wɔn na ogye wɔn; oyi wɔn fi amumɔyɛfo nsam, na ogye wɔn nkwa, efisɛ wohintaw wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: Awurade, nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabufuw mu na ntwe mʼaso wɔ wʼabufuwhyew mu.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Wo bɛmma hwirew me mu, na wo nsa adwerɛw me.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Wʼabufuwhyew no nti ahoɔden biara nni me mu; me bɔne nti, me nnompe ahodwow.

english_verse: are so heavy that I am crushed.
translation_verse: Mʼafɔdi amene me te sɛ adesoa a mu yɛ duru dodo.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Mʼakuru bɔn na aporɔw esiane me bɔne mu agyimisɛm nti.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Makotow na wɔabrɛ me ase; da mu nyinaa menantenantew twa agyaadwo.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Mʼakyi dompe mu yaw boro so: ahoɔden biara nni me nipadua mu.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Mabrɛ na mapɛtɛw koraa. Me koma mu yaw ma misi apini.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Awurade, nea merehwɛ anim nyinaa da wʼanim; mʼapinisi nhintaw wo.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Me koma bɔ kitirikitiri, na mʼahoɔden asa mpo mʼaniwa aduru sum.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Mʼapirakuru nti me nnamfonom ne me yɔnkonom mmɛn me; mʼafipamfo twe wɔn ho fi me ho.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum me no sum me mfiri, wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhaw me no di me sɛe ho nkɔmmɔ da mu nyinaa wodwen nnaadaasɛm ho.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Mete sɛ ɔsotifo a ɔnte asɛm, mete sɛ mum a ontumi nkasa.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Mayɛ sɛ obi a ɔnte asɛm, nea nʼano ntumi mma mmuae.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Awurade, meretwɛn wo; Awurade me Nyankopɔn, wubegye me so.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Mekae se, “Mma wɔn ani nnye; anaa wɔmma wɔn ho so bere a mʼanan awatiri no.”

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Mereyɛ mahwe ase, na me yaw da so wɔ me mu.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Meka me mfomso kyerɛ; me bɔne hyɛ me so.

english_verse: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me,
translation_verse: Bebree na wɔyɛ mʼatamfo; wɔn a wɔtan me kwa no dɔɔso.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔde bɔne tua me papa so ka no, bɔ me ahohora bere a mereyɛ papa.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Awurade nnyaw me. Me Nyankopɔn, nkɔ akyiri!

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Bra ntɛm bɛboa me, Awurade, mʼAgyenkwa. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo no. Yedutun.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Mekae se, “Mɛhwɛ mʼakwan yiye na mamfa me tɛkrɛma anyɛ bɔne; mɛto mʼano nnareka bere a amumɔyɛfo bɛn me yi.

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Enti meyɛɛ komm a manka asɛm papa biara mpo nanso mʼapinisi mu yɛɛ den.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: Me koma ho guan no wɔ me mu. Midwinnwen no, ogya dɛwee; afei mede me tɛkrɛma kasae se:

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: “Awurade, ma minhu me nkwa awiei ne me nna dodow; ma minhu sɛnea me nkwa si twa mu ntɛm so.

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Woayɛ me nna sɛ nsateaa baako pɛ; na me mfe dodow nyɛ hwee wɔ wʼani so. Onipa nkwa yɛ ɔhome bi kɛkɛ.

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Onipa redi akɔneaba nyinaa no, ɔte sɛ sunsuma bi kwa; ɔhaw ne ho nanso ɔyɛ kwa; ɔboa ahonya ano na onnim nea ɛbɛyɛ ne de.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: “Afei Awurade, dɛn na merehwehwɛ? Mʼanidaso wɔ wo mu.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Gye me fi me bɔne nyinaa mu; mma mennyɛ nkwaseafo aserewde.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Meyɛɛ komm, na mammue mʼano, efisɛ wo na woayɛ eyi.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Yi wʼasotwe fi me so; wo nsa ano amanehunu amene me.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Woka nnipa anim, na wotwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho; wosɛe wɔn ahonya te sɛ nwewee; onipa biara yɛ ɔhome kɛkɛ.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: “Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ, tie me sufrɛ; nsiw wʼaso wɔ me su ho. Me ne wo te hɔ sɛ ɔnanani, sɛnea na mʼagyanom nyinaa te no.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Yi wʼani fi me so na manya nkwa bio, ansa na mafi ha a mente ase bio.” Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Mede boasetɔ twɛn Awurade; na ɔhwɛɛ me, na ɔtee me sufrɛ.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: Oyii me fii amoa a mu yɛ toro mu, fii dɔte ne dontori mu; ɔde mʼanan sii ɔbotan so na ɔmaa me baabi pa gyinae.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ɔde dwom foforo hyɛɛ mʼanom, ayeyi dwom a yɛde ma yɛn Nyankopɔn. Bebree behu na wɔasuro, na wɔde wɔn werɛ ahyɛ Awurade mu.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne onipa a ɔde Awurade yɛ nʼahotoso, nea ɔmfa nʼani nto ahomaso so, ne wɔn a wɔman di anyame huhuw akyi.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: Awurade me Nyankopɔn woayɛ anwonwade bebree. Nneɛma a wohyehyɛ maa yɛn no obiara ntumi nka ne nyinaa nkyerɛ wo; sɛ meka se mereka ne nyinaa ho asɛm a ɛbɛdɔɔso dodo.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Na mekae se, “Mini, maba, sɛnea wɔakyerɛw afa me ho wɔ nhoma mmobɔwee no mu no.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn, mepɛ sɛ meyɛ wʼapɛde; wo mmara wɔ me koma mu.”

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Meka wo trenee ho asɛm wɔ guabɔ kɛse ase; mimmua mʼano, Awurade, sɛnea wunim no.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Memmfa wo trenee ho asɛm nsie me koma mu; meka wo nokware ne wo nkwagye ho asɛm. Mankata wʼadɔe ne wo nokware so wɔ guabɔ kɛse no ase.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Awurade, nyi wʼahummɔbɔ mfi me so; ma wʼadɔe ne wo nokware mmɔ me ho ban daa.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw bebree atwa me ho ahyia; mʼamumɔyɛ abu afa me so enti minhu ade bio. Ɛdɔɔso sen me ti so nwi, na me koma abotow wɔ me mu.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Awurade, ma ɛnsɔ wʼani sɛ wubegye me; Awurade, bra ntɛm bɛboa me.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum me no nyinaa, ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa; ma wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ mesɛe no mfa aniwu nsan wɔn akyi.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔka, “Ɔtwea! Ɔtwea!” kyerɛ me no nsan wɔn akyi, esiane wɔn aniwu nti.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Nanso ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinaa nsɛpɛw wɔn ho na wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu; ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagye no nka da biara se, “Awurade yɛ ɔkɛse!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Nanso meyɛ ohiani ne mmɔborɔni; ma Awurade nnwen me ho. Wo ne me boafo ne me gyefo; wo ne me Nyankopɔn, bra ntɛm. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne onipa a mmɔborɔni asɛm ho hia no; Awurade gye no wɔ amanehunu bere mu.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛbɔ ne ho ban na wakora ne kra; obehyira no wɔ asase no so; ɔrennyaa no mma nʼatamfo apɛde.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛhwɛ no wɔ ne yare mpa so na wagye no asi hɔ.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Mekae se, “Ao Awurade hu me mmɔbɔ; sa me yare, efisɛ mayɛ bɔne atia wo.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Mʼatamfo de adwene bɔne ka fa me ho se: “Da bɛn na obewu ama ne din ayera?”

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Bere biara a obi ba me nkyɛn no, ɔka atosɛm, na ne koma hɔre dinsɛe; ofi adi kɔ a, ɔde kodi nseku.

english_verse: My enemies whisper about me. They think the worst,
translation_verse: Mʼatamfo nyinaa keka asomsɛm fa me ho; wosusuw bɔne ma me na wɔka se:

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: “Ɔyare bɔne bi abɔ no; ɔrensɔre mfi nea ɔda hɔ bio.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Mpo me yɔnko pa ara a mede me ho too no so, nea me ne no too nsa didii no, asɔre atia me.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Nanso wo, Awurade, hu me mmɔbɔ; ma me so, na mintua wɔn so ka.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Minim sɛ wʼani sɔ me, na me tamfo renni me so nkonim.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Me nokwaredi mu, wukura me mu na wode me gyina wʼanim afebɔɔ.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, nnɛ ne daa nyinaa. Amen! ne Amen! Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: ) Longing for God
translation_verse: Koramma “maskil” dwom.

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ɔforote pere hwehwɛ nsuwansuwa no, saa ara na me kra pere hwehwɛ wo, me Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn ho sukɔm de me kra, Onyankopɔn teasefo no. Da bɛn na metumi akohyia Onyankopɔn?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Me nisu ayɛ mʼaduan awia ne anadwo, na da mu nyinaa nnipa bisa me se: “Wo Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: Saa nneɛma yi na mekae bere a mereka me koma mu nsɛm; sɛnea na midi asafokuw anim, na yɛde anigye nteɛteɛmu ne aseda nnwom nantew yuu bɔ mu kɔ Onyankopɔn fi wɔ afahyɛ da no.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow? Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa? Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so, na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ, mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: Me kra abotow wɔ me mu, enti mɛkae wo fi Yordan asase so, Hermon mmepɔw so, fi Bepɔw Misar so.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Ebun kɔ bun mu wɔ wo nsu a ɛworo gu no nnyigyei mu; wʼasorɔkye nyinaa abu afa me so.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Adekyee mu, Awurade kyerɛ nʼadɔe, adesae mu, ne dwom ba me nkyɛn, mpae a mebɔ srɛ me nkwa Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Mibisa Onyankopɔn, me Botan no se, “Adɛn nti na wo werɛ afi me? Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ menantenantew twa adwo, mʼatamfo nhyɛso nti?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Me nnompe te ɔdesani yawdi, mʼahohiahiafo ateetee nti, daa nyinaa wobisa me se, “Wo Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow? Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa? Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so, na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ, mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn, bu me bem, na ka mʼasɛm a etia ɔman a wonsuro wo no ma me; gye me fi nnaadaafo ne amumɔyɛfo nsam.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Woyɛ Onyankopɔn, mʼabandennen. Adɛn nti na woapo me? Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ menantenantew twa adwo mʼatamfo nhyɛso nti?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Soma wo hann ne wo nokware ma wɔnkyerɛ me kwan; ma wɔmfa me mmra wo Bepɔw Kronkron no so, faako a wote no.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Afei, mɛkɔ Onyankopɔn afɔremuka anim, mʼanigye ne mʼahosɛpɛw Nyankopɔn nkyɛn. Mede sanku beyi wo ayɛ, Onyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow? Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa? Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so, na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ, mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn. Dwom a wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, yɛde yɛn aso ate; yɛn agyanom aka akyerɛ yɛn; nea woyɛɛ wɔ wɔn bere so, wɔ tete mmere no mu.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Wode wo nsa pam amanaman no na wobɔɔ yɛn agyanom atenase; wodwerɛw nnipa no na womaa yɛn agyanom dii yiye.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ wɔn afoa na wɔde nyaa asase no, na ɛnyɛ wɔn nsa na ɛmaa wɔn nkonimdi; ɛyɛ wo nsa nifa, wo basa, ne wʼanim hann, efisɛ na wodɔ wɔn.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Woyɛ me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn, nea ɔhyɛ nkonimdi ma Yakob.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Ɛnam wo so na yɛpam yɛn Atamfo; wo din mu na yetiatia wɔn a wokyi yɛn no so.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Memmfa me ho nto mʼagyan so, mʼafoa remfa nkonimdi mmrɛ me;

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: na wo na woma yedi yɛn atamfo so wugu wɔn a wɔtan yɛn no anim ase.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn mu na yɛhoahoa yɛn ho da mu nyinaa, na yɛbɛkamfo wo din no daa daa.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Nanso mprempren woapo yɛn abrɛ yɛn ase; wone yɛn asraafo nkɔ ɔsa bio.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Woma yeguan fii dɔm anim, ma yɛn atamfo fom yɛn agyapade.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Wuyii yɛn maa sɛ wonkum yɛn sɛ nguan na woahwete yɛn wɔ amanaman no mu.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Wotɔn wo nkurɔfo fofoofow, na woannya mfaso biara amfi mu.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Woayɛ yɛn ahohorade ama yɛn afipamfo, animtiaabude ne aserewde ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Mʼanimguase di mʼanim daa, na aniwu akata mʼanim,

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: esiane wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora na wɔkasa tia me de yi me ahi, esiane ɔtamfo a nʼani abere sɛ ɔbɛtɔ were no nti.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: Eyinom nyinaa too yɛn de, nanso yɛn werɛ mfii wo, na yemmuu wʼapam no nso so ɛ.
