english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Yɛn koma ntwe mfii wo ho; na yɛn anan nso mman mfii wo kwan so ɛ.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Nanso wodwerɛw yɛn yɛɛ yɛn sakraman tu na wode sum kabii kataa yɛn so.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Sɛ na yɛn werɛ afi yɛn Nyankopɔn din anaa sɛ yɛatrɛw yɛn nsam akyerɛ ananafo nyame a,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: anka Onyankopɔn behu, efisɛ onim koma mu ahintasɛm.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Nanso wo nti wokum yɛn daa nyinaa; wobu yɛn sɛ nguan a wɔrekokum wɔn.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Nyan, Awurade! Adɛn nti na woada? Keka wo ho! Nnyaw yɛn hɔ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na wode wʼanim ahintaw na wo werɛ fi yɛn ahohia ne nhyɛso?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Wɔabrɛ yɛn ase kɔ dɔte mu na yɛn nipadua aka afam dɔte.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Sɔre bɛboa yɛn; wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no nti, gye yɛn. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔde “lilie” sanku dwontobea na ɛtoe.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Botae bi a edi mu akanyan me koma bere a merebɔ ɔhene mmran no; me tɛkrɛma yɛ ɔkyerɛwfo kunini bi kyerɛwdua.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Wudi mu koraa wɔ mmarima mu na wɔde adom bi asra wʼano, esiane sɛ Onyankopɔn ahyira wo afebɔɔ no nti.

english_verse: Mighty king, glorious ruler, strap on your sword
translation_verse: Fa wʼafoa bɔ wo nkyɛn mu, okokuroko; fa anuonyam ne kɛseyɛ fura.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Fa wo kɛseyɛ mu kɔ wʼanim nkonimdi so wɔ nokware, ahobrɛase ne trenee mu; ma wo nsa nifa nna wo nnwuma a ɛyɛ nwonwa no adi.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Ma wo bɛmma nnamnam no nhwirew ɔhene atamfo koma mu; na ma amanaman nhwe wʼanan ase.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, wʼahengua no bɛtena hɔ daa daa; trenee ahempema bɛyɛ wʼahenni no ahempema.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Wodɔ trenee na wukyi bɔne. Ɛno nti Onyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn de wo asi wo mfɛfo so, na ɔde anigye ngo asra wo.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Kurobow, pɛprɛ ne bɛwewonua hua agye wo batakari mu nyinaa; sanku so nnwom a efi ahemfi a wɔde asonse asiesie ho mu ma wʼani gye.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Ahemfo mmabea ka wo mmea atitiriw ho; wo nsa nifa so na ayeforo dehye a ɔhyɛ Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ gyina.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Ɔbabea tie, dwene ho, na yɛ osetie; ma wo werɛ mfi wo nkurɔfo ne wo papa fi.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Wʼahoɔfɛ asɔ ɔhene no ani; di no ni, efisɛ ɔno ne wo wura.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Tiro Babea de ayɛyɛde bɛba; mmarima adefo bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ wo.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Ɔhene babea a ɔwɔ ne pia mu no yɛ onuonyamfo wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ abobɔ nʼatade yuu mu.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Ɔhyɛ ntade a wɔadi mu adwinni na wɔde no kɔma ɔhene; ne mfɛfo mmabun di nʼakyi na wɔde wɔn nyinaa brɛ wo.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Wɔde ahosɛpɛw ne anigye kɔ mu; wɔhyɛn ɔhempɔn no ahemfi.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wo mmabarima besi wʼagyanom anan mu wobɛyɛ wɔn mmapɔmma wɔ asase no so nyinaa.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mɛma wɔakae wo wɔ awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu; ɛno nti amanaman bɛkamfo wo daa nyinaa. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn ne yɛn guankɔbea ne yɛn ahoɔden, amanehunu mu boafo a ɔwɔ hɔ bere biara.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Enti sɛ asase ani dan butuw, na mmepɔw tutu kogu po ase a, yɛrensuro,

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: sɛ po bɔ asorɔkye na ehuru na ɛma nkoko wosow mpo a, yɛrensuro.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Asuten bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsuwansuwa de anigye ba Onyankopɔn kuropɔn mu, beae kronkron a Ɔsorosoroni no te.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn te kuropɔn no mu, na ɔrenhwe ase; Onyankopɔn bɛboa no anɔpahema.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Amanaman yɛ hoo, na ahenni hwehwe ase; ɔma ne nne so ma asase nan.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Asafo Awurade ka yɛn ho. Yakob Nyankopɔn yɛ yɛn aban.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Bra bɛhwɛ Awurade nnwuma, ɔsɛe a ɔde aba asase no so.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: Ɔma akodi gyae kosi asase ano. Obubu agyan mu na ɔsɛe peaw; ɔde ogya hyew nkatabo.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: Monyɛ komm na munhu sɛ me ne Onyankopɔn; wɔbɛma me so wɔ amanaman no mu, wɔbɛma me so wɔ asase so.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Asafo Awurade ka yɛn ho; Yakob Nyankopɔn yɛ yɛn aban. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Amanaman nyinaa, mommɔ mo nsam; momfa anigye nteɛ mu mfrɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Awurade Ɔsorosoroni no ho yɛ nwonwa, Ɔyɛ Ɔhene kɛse wɔ asase nyinaa so!

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Ɔde amanaman hyɛɛ yɛn ase, na ɔde nnipa hyɛɛ yɛn anan ase.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Oyii yɛn agyapade maa yɛn, nea ɛyɛ Yakob a ɔdɔ no no ahohoahoade.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn aforo kɔ soro wɔ anigye nteɛteɛmu mu, Awurade wɔ torobɛnto nnyigyei mu.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Efisɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ asase nyinaa so Hene. Monto ahurusi nnwom mma no.

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn di hene wɔ amanaman no so; Onyankopɔn te nʼahengua kronkron so.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Amanaman no mu akunini boaboa wɔn ho ano sɛ Abraham Nyankopɔn nkurɔfo, efisɛ asase so ahemfo yɛ Onyankopɔn de; na wɔma no so kɛse.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔkɛse na ɔsɛ nkamfo, wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn kuropɔn mu, ne bepɔw kronkron so.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Ne sorokɔ ma ɛyɛ fɛ, ɛyɛ wiase nyinaa anigyede. Bepɔw Sion te sɛ Safon sorɔnsorɔmmea, Ɔhenkɛse no kuropɔn.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn te nʼabankɛse mu wada ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ nʼabandennen.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Bere a ahemfo yi boaa wɔn ho ano, na wotuu ɔsa bɔɔ mu no,

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: wohuu no ma ɛyɛɛ wɔn ahodwiriw, na wɔde ehu guanee.

english_verse: They trembled all over like women giving birth
translation_verse: Wɔbɔɔ huboa wɔ hɔ, ɔyaw a ɛte sɛ ɔbea a awo aka no.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: Wosɛe wɔn sɛ Tarsis ahyɛn a apuei mframa abɔ adwira wɔn.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Sɛnea yɛate no, saa ara na yɛahu wɔ Asafo Awurade kuropɔn no mu, yɛn Nyankopɔn kuropɔn mu; Onyankopɔn ma etim hɔ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: Wʼasɔredan no mu; Ao, Onyankopɔn, na yɛdwene wo dɔ a enni huammɔ da no ho,

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, wʼayeyi du asase ano te sɛ wo din te; trenee ayɛ wo nsa nifa mu ma.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Sion bepɔw di ahurusi, Yuda nkuraase no ani gye esiane wʼatemmu no nti.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Nantew Sion na twa ho hyia, kan nʼabantenten dodow,

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: dwene nʼafasu ho yiye, hwɛ nʼabankɛse no, na woaka ho asɛm akyerɛ nkyirimma.

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: Saa Onyankopɔn yi yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn daa daa; ɔbɛyɛ yɛn kwankyerɛfo akosi awiei mpo. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Muntie, mo saa nnipa yi nyinaa; monyɛ aso, mo a mowɔ wiase yi mu nyinaa,

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: nea ɔyɛ abomfiaa ne nea odi mu, adefo ne ahiafo nyinaa.

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Mʼano bɛka anyansasɛm; nsɛm a efi me koma mu bɛma nhumu.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mɛbrɛ mʼaso ase atie mmebusɛm; na sanku na mede bɛkyerɛ mʼabisae ase.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ misuro, bere a nna bɔne aba, bere a amumɔyɛfo nnaadaafo atwa me ho ahyia,

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ahonya so na wɔde wɔn ade dodow hoahoa wɔn ho?

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Onipa biara rentumi nnye ne yɔnko nkwa na ɔrentumi mfa mpata biara mma Onyankopɔn,

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: nkwa ho mpata bo yɛ den, akatua biara renso,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛbɛma no atena ase afebɔɔ a ɔrenhu porɔwee.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Obiara nim pefee sɛ anyansafo wu; saa ara na nkwaseafo ne agyimifo nso wu, na wogyaw wɔn ahonya hɔ ma afoforo.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Wɔn nna bɛyɛ wɔn afi afebɔɔ, wɔn atenae wɔ awo ntoatoaso bere a enni awiei mu, ɛmfa ho sɛ wɔde wɔn din atoto nsase so.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Na onipa ahonya nyinaa akyi no, ɔrentena hɔ daa; ɔte sɛ mmoa a wowu no ara.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Eyi ne nea ɛda hɔ ma wɔn a wogye wɔn ho di, ne wɔn akyidifo a wɔfoa wɔn nsɛm so.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Wɔte sɛ nguan, na wɔbɛkɔ ɔda mu, na owu de wɔn bɛyɛ nʼaduan. Atreneefo bedi wɔn so anɔpa; wɔn nipadua bɛporɔw wɔ ɔda mu, na wɔne wɔn adan akɛse no ntam akwan bɛware.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Nanso Onyankopɔn begye me afi ɔda mu; ampa ara, ɔde me bɛkɔ ne nkyɛn.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa nya ne ho a, mma ɛnnhaw wo; na sɛ ne fi anigye yɛ bebree a, mma ɛnnhaw wo;

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: efisɛ, sɛ owu a ɔremmfa hwee nkɔ, nʼanuonyam ne no renkɔ amoa mu.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Mpo ɔte ase no, ɔfaa no sɛ wɔahyira no, efisɛ wɔkamfo nnipa bere a wodi yiye,

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: nanso ɔbɛkɔ akɔka nʼagyanom ho, wɔn a wɔrenhu nkwa hann ara da no.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔwɔ ahonya na onni nhumu no te sɛ mmoa a wowu.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Tweduampɔn, Onyankopɔn, Awurade no kasa, na ɔfrɛ asase nyinaa efi apuei kosi atɔe.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn hyerɛn fi Sion kurow a ne fɛ wie pɛyɛ.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Yɛn Nyankopɔn reba nanso ɔrenyɛ komm; ogya a ɛhyew nneɛma di nʼanim, ahum a ɛretu atwa ne ho ahyia.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Ɔfrɛ ɔsorosoro ne asase, sɛ ɔrebu ne nkurɔfo atɛn;

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: Ɔka se, “Boaboa nnipa a wɔatew wɔn ho no ano ma me; wɔn a wɔnam afɔrebɔ so ne me yɛɛ apam no.”

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne trenee, na Onyankopɔn ankasa ne otemmufo.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: “Muntie, me nkurɔfo, na mɛkasa, medi adanse atia wo, Israel; Mene Onyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn no.

english_verse: Although you offer sacrifices and always bring gifts,
translation_verse: Merenka mo anim wɔ mo afɔrebɔde anaa mo hyew afɔre a ɛwɔ mʼanim daa no ho.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Anantwinini a wofi mo mfuw so anaa mpapo a wofi mo buw mu ho nhia me,

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: efisɛ kwae mu aboa biara yɛ me de, anantwi a wɔwɔ nkoko mpempem so nso saa ara.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Minim anomaa biara a ɔwɔ mmepɔw no so, na wuram abɔde nyinaa yɛ me de.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔkɔm dee me a, anka merenka nkyerɛ mo; efisɛ, wiase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ me de.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Mewe anantwinini nam, na menom mpapo mogya ana?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Momfa aseda afɔre mma Onyankopɔn, na munni bɔ a mohyɛɛ Ɔsorosoroni no so,

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: na momfrɛ me hiada; na megye mo na moahyɛ me anuonyam.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Nanso amumɔyɛfo de, Onyankopɔn bisa wɔn se, “Adɛn nti na moka me mmara na mʼapam da mo ano?

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Mukyi me nkyerɛkyerɛ, na motow me nsɛm gu mo akyi.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Sɛ muhu ɔkorɔmfo a mode mo ho bɔ no; na mo ne nguaman nso bɔ.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Mode mo ano yɛ bɔne, na mode mo tɛkrɛma boaboa nnaadaa ano.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Mokasa tia mo nuabarima bere biara na mosopa mo ankasa na ba.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Moayɛ eyinom nyinaa; nanso manka hwee, enti mususuw sɛ mete sɛ mo. Nanso mɛka mo anim, na mede mo sobo asi mo anim.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: “Munnwen eyi ho, mo a mo werɛ fi Onyankopɔn, anyɛ saa a, mɛtetew mo mu nketenkete a obiara remmegye mo;

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɔ aseda afɔre no hyɛ me anuonyam, na osiesie kwan sɛnea mɛda Onyankopɔn nkwagye adi akyerɛ no.” Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn hu me mmɔbɔ, sɛnea wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no te; wʼahummɔbɔ kɛse no nti, pepa me mmarato.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Hohoro mʼamumɔyɛ nyinaa na tew me ho fi me bɔne mu!

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Na mahu me mmarato, na mekae me bɔne daa.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Mayɛ mfomso atia wo; atia wo nko ara na mayɛ nea ɛyɛ bɔne wɔ wʼani so, enti wudi bem wɔ wʼatemmu mu na woteɛ wɔ wʼatemmu mu.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Ampa ara wɔwoo me wɔ bɔne mu, na bɔne mu na me na nyinsɛn me.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Ampa ara nokware na wohwehwɛ wɔ me mu. Wokyerɛ me nyansa a mu dɔ.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Fa adwerɛ hohoro me ho, na me ho afi; guare me, na mɛhoa asen sukyerɛmma.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ma mente ahosɛpɛw ne anigye nka; na ma nnompe a woabubu no nni ahurusi.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Kata wʼani wɔ me bɔne ho na pepa mʼamumɔyɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, bɔ koma a mu tew wɔ me mu, na yɛ honhom a atim no foforo wɔ me mu.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Mpam me mfi wʼanim, na nyi wo Honhom Kronkron mfi me mu.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Fa wo nkwagye mu anigye no ma me bio, na ma me ɔpɛ honhom a ɛbɛma magyina.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Afei mɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfo wʼakwan, na amumɔyɛfo bɛsan aba wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me fi mogya ho afɔdi mu. Onyame a wugye me nkwa, na me tɛkrɛma bɛto wo trenee ho dwom.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Awurade, bue mʼano fafa, na mede mʼano bɛpae mu aka wʼayeyi.

english_verse: Offerings and sacrifices are not what you want.
translation_verse: Wompɛ afɔrebɔ, anka mɛbɔ; wʼani nnye ɔhyew afɔre ho.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn afɔre yɛ honhom a abotow, Onyankopɔn, worempo ahonu ne ahobrɛase koma.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Ma ɛnyɛ wo fɛ sɛ wobɛma Sion anya nkɔso wɔ wʼanigye mu; na woasi Yerusalem afasu.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Afei wʼani begye ɔtreneeni afɔrebɔ ho, ɔhyew afɔre a edi mu; na wɔde anantwinini bɛbɔ afɔre wʼafɔremuka so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛse, adɛn nti na wohoahoa wo ho wɔ wo bɔne ho? Adɛn nti na wohoahoa wo ho da mu nyinaa, wo a woyɛ animguasede wɔ Onyankopɔn ani so?

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Wo tɛkrɛma bɔ ɔsɛe ho pɔw; ɛte sɛ oyiwan a ano yɛ nam yiye. Wo a wutwa nkontompo nko ara.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Wʼani gye bɔne ho sen papa, wopɛ atoro sen sɛ wobɛka nokware.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Wodɔ asɛm biara a ɛde ɔhaw ba, wo tɛkrɛma daadaafo!

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Ampa ara Onyankopɔn de ɔsɛe a enni awiei bɛbrɛ wo; ɔbɛtwe wo afi wo ntamadan mu na watetew wo mu; Ɔbɛtɔre wʼase wɔ ateasefo asase so.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Atreneefo behu eyi na wɔasuro; wɔbɛserew no na wɔaka se,

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Hwɛ, onipa no ni, nea wamfa Onyankopɔn anyɛ nʼabandennen na mmom ɔde ne ho too nʼahonya dodow so, na onyaa ahoɔden de sɛee afoforo no!”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Nanso mete sɛ ngodua a ɛrenyin wɔ Onyankopɔn fi: mede me ho to Onyankopɔn dɔ a ɛnsa da no so daa nyinaa.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Meyi wo ayɛ daa wɔ nea woayɛ nti; wo din so na mʼani bɛda, efisɛ eye. Meyi wo ayɛ wɔ wʼahotefo anim. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔde “mahalat” sanku nne na ɛto.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea ka wɔ ne koma mu se, “Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ.” Porɔwee adi wɔn, na wɔn akwan yɛ animguase. Obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ade pa.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn fi ɔsoro hwɛ adesamma wɔ fam sɛ obehu wɔn mu bi a wɔwɔ ntease, anaa ebinom a wɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Nanso nnipa nyinaa atwe wɔn ho afi Onyankopɔn ho; wɔn nyinaa ayɛ bɔne. Obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ papa. Ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Enti abɔnefo rensua nyansa ana? Wɔwe me nkurɔfo sɛnea nnipa di aduan. Wonnsu mfrɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Wɔn na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ huboa wɔ faako a ehu nni. Onyankopɔn hwetee wɔn a wɔtow hyɛɛ wo so no nnompe mu; wuguu wɔn anim ase, efisɛ Onyankopɔn buu wɔn animtiaa.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ao, Israel nkwagye mfi Sion mmra! Awurade bɛsan de ne nkurɔfo agyapade ama wɔn. Na Yakob adi ahurusi, na Israel ani agye! Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔbɔ no sanku so.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me wɔ wo din mu; fa wo tumi bu me bem.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ; tie mʼanom nsɛm.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Ahɔho retow ahyɛ me so. Atirimɔdenfo rehwehwɛ me akum me; nnipa a wɔmmfa Onyankopɔn nyɛ hwee.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn ne me boafo; Awurade ne me hwɛfo.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ma mmusu nkyim mmra wɔn a wodi me ho nseku no so; wo nokwaredi mu, sɛe wɔn.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Mefi me pɛ mu abɔ afɔre ama wo; Awurade, meyi wo din ayɛ, efisɛ eye.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Woagye me afi me haw nyinaa mu, na mʼani ahu nkonimdi wɔ mʼatamfo so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔde sanku na ɛto.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ, mmu wʼani ngu me nkotosrɛ so,

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: tie me na gye me so. Me dadwen haw me na ama mayɛ basaa,

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: esiane nea me tamfo reka, esiane omumɔyɛfo ahunahuna nti; efisɛ wɔde amanehunu ba me so; na wofi wɔn abufuw mu kum me.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: Me koma wɔ ahoyeraw mu; na owu huboa aba me so.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Ehu ne ahopopo akyekyere me. Ahodwiriw abu afa me so.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Mekae se, “Ao, sɛ mewɔ ntaban sɛ aburuburu a, anka metu akɔ ama me ho atɔ me,

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: anka metu akɔ akyirikyiri akɔtena sare so;

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: anka mɛyɛ ntɛm akɔ me hintabea, faako a mframahweam ne ahum mmɛn koraa.”

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: Awurade, ma amumɔyɛfo nyɛ basaa, na ma wɔn kasa ntoto, efisɛ mihu basabasayɛ ne aperepere wɔ kuropɔn no mu.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Awia ne anadwo wɔtetɛw nʼafasu ho; adwemmɔne ne asisi wɔ mu.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Adesɛefo dɔm reyɛ adwuma wɔ kuropɔn no mu. Ahunahuna ne nnaadaa wɔ ne mmɔnten so daa.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛyɛɛ ɔtamfo na ɔresopa me a, anka metumi agyina ano; sɛ ɛyɛɛ ɔtamfo na ɔrema ne ho so atia me a, anka metumi de me ho ahintaw no.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛyɛ wo, ɔdesani te sɛ me, me yɔnko, mʼadamfo kann,

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ma owu mmɛfa mʼatamfo mpofirim; ma wɔnkɔ ɔda mu anikann, efisɛ bɔne te wɔn mu.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Nanso misu frɛ Onyankopɔn, na Awurade gye me nkwa.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Anwummere, anɔpa ne awia, mede mmɔborɔnne su frɛ no, na ɔte me nne.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne ho bɔ afɔre ma minya me ti didi mu wɔ ako a wodi tia me no mu, mpo dodow na wɔsɔre tia me.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn a wɔasi no hene afebɔɔ no, ɔbɛte wɔn nka na wahaw wɔn, ɔbɛhaw nnipa a wɔnsakra wɔn akwan da na wonsuro Onyankopɔn nso.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Me yɔnko tow hyɛ ne nnamfonom so; na obu nʼapam so.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ tɛkrɛmawo, nanso ɔtan wɔ ne koma mu. Nʼano asɛm dwudwo sen ngo, nanso ɛyɛ afoa a wɔatwe.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Fa wo haw to Awurade so na ɔno na obegye wo; ɔremma ɔtreneeni nhwe ase.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Nanso wo, Onyankopɔn, wobɛbrɛ amumɔyɛfo ase ama wɔakɔ ɔporɔw amoa mu; mogyapɛfo ne nnaadaafo renni wɔn nkwanna mu fa. Nanso me de, mede me ho to wo so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔto no sɛnea wɔto “Aburuburu a osi Akyirikyiri Odum so,” nne so.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, hu me mmɔbɔ na nnipa taa me anibere so; da mu nyinaa womia wɔn taa no mu.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Sɛ mebɔ hu a, mede me ho bɛto wo so.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn a mekamfo nʼasɛm no, mede me ho to Onyankopɔn so, na merensuro. Dɛn na onipa desani betumi ayɛ me?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Da mu nyinaa wogye mʼano si bɔne; bere biara wɔbɔ pɔw sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Wɔbɔ pɔw, wɔtetɛw, wɔhwɛ mʼanammɔntu, susuw sɛ wobekum me.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Wɔn amumɔyɛ nti mma wɔmmfa wɔn ho nni; Onyankopɔn, brɛ amanaman no ase wɔ wʼabufuw mu.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Kyerɛw me kwadwom to hɔ; sese me nusu wɔ wo nhoma mmobɔwee no mu. Enni nea woakyerɛw ato hɔ no mu ana?

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Sɛ mepɛ mmoa fi wo hɔ a, mʼatamfo bɛsan wɔn akyi. Eyi bɛma mahu sɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ mʼafa.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: mede me ho to Onyankopɔn so; na merensuro. Dɛn na ɔdesani betumi ayɛ me?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Me Onyankopɔn, mehyɛ bɔ a mahyɛ wo no ase, mede mʼaseda afɔre bɛbrɛ wo.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Efisɛ, woagye me afi owu mu, na mʼanan anhintiw, na matumi anantew Onyankopɔn anim wɔ nkwa hann no mu. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo no. Wɔto no sɛnea wɔto “Mma Wɔnnsɛe No” nne so.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Hu me mmɔbɔ, me Onyankopɔn, hu me mmɔbɔ, na wo mu na me kra nya guankɔbea. Wo ntaban nwini ase na mɛpɛ guankɔbea kosi sɛ amanehunu no betwa mu.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔsoma fi ɔsoro hɔ begye me nkwa, ɔka wɔn a wɔtaa me anibere so no anim; Onyankopɔn soma ne dɔ ne ne nokware.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Gyata atwa me ho ahyia; meda mmoa a wɔwe nam amono mu, nnipa a wɔn se te sɛ mpeaw ne mmɛmma na wɔn tɛkrɛma te sɛ afoa a ɛyɛ nnam.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wo so tra ɔsoro, na ama wʼanuonyam aba asase nyinaa so.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Wɔtrɛw asau mu de sum mʼanan afiri, ahohiahia brɛɛ me ase. Wotuu amoa wɔ me kwan mu, nanso wɔn ankasa akɔtotɔ mu.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, me koma agyina pintinn, me koma yɛ pintinn; mɛto dwom na mayi wo ayɛ.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Me kra nyan! Sanku ne bɛnta, munnyan! Me nso menyan anɔpahema.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Awurade, mɛkamfo wo wɔ aman no mu; mɛto wo ho nnwom wɔ nnipa mu.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Wʼadɔe so, ɛkorɔn sen ɔsoro; wo nokwaredi du wim.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, wɔmma wo so mmoro ɔsoro; ma wʼanuonyam nkata asase nyinaa so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔto no sɛnea wɔto “Mma Wɔnnsɛe No” sanku nne so.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: So mo asodifo, ampa ara sɛ, moka asɛm a ɛteɛ ana? Mubu atɛntrenee wɔ nnipa mu ana?

english_verse: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.
translation_verse: Dabi da! Modwene ntɛnkyew wɔ mo koma mu na mo nsa de akakabensɛm ba asase so.

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo fom kwan fi awo mu; wɔyɛ mmaratofo fi awotwaa mu na wodi atoro.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Wɔn ano bɔre te sɛ ɔwɔ de, ɛte sɛ ɔprammiri a wawɛn nʼaso,

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: a ɔnte ntafowayifo dwom, na ne dwom dɛdɛ no mpo mfa ne ho.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, bubu ɛse a egu wɔn anom, Awurade, tutu gyata no sebɔmmɔfo no gu!

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Ma wontwa mu nkɔ sɛ sunsuan; sɛ wɔtwe wɔn agyan a, ma wɔn bɛmma no ano nwu.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ nwaw horɔdɔhorɔdɔ bi a ɔrenan agu wɔ bere a ɔretene no. Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ɔba a owu wɔ awoe a onhu owia koraa.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Ansa na mo nkuku bɛte nsɔe ano yaw, sɛ ɛyɛ amono anaa awo no, wɔbɛpra amumɔyɛfo akɔ.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔtɔ were ma atreneefo a wɔn ani begye, na wɔbɛhohoro wɔn anan ho wɔ amumɔyɛfo mogya mu.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Afei nnipa bɛka se, “Ampa ara atreneefo kɔ so nya wɔn akatua; na ampa ara Onyankopɔn bi wɔ hɔ a obu wiase atɛn.” Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Gye me fi amumɔyɛfo nsam. Gye me nkwa fi mogyapɛfo nsam.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛnea wɔatɛw rehwehwɛ me akum me! Nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ hu bɔ pɔw bɔne tia me a emfi me mfomso anaa bɔne bi, Awurade.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: Menyɛɛ mfomso bi, nanso wɔayɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ me so. Sɔre begye me; hwɛ mʼamanehunu!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Wo, Awurade Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn, ma wo ho so na twe amanaman no nyinaa aso; nhu amumɔyɛfo nkontompofo no mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Wɔsan ba anwummere, wɔbobɔ mu sɛ akraman, na wokyinkyin kuropɔn no mu.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Hwɛ nea wɔfe fi wɔn anom, wɔn anofafa mu nsɛm ano yɛ nnam sɛ mfoa, na wosusuw se: “Hena na ɔbɛte yɛn nka?”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Nanso wo Awurade, woserew wɔn; wudi saa aman no nyinaa ho fɛw.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Wone mʼAhoɔden, mehwɛ wo kwan; wo, Onyankopɔn, ne mʼabandennen,

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: me Nyankopɔn a metumi atweri no. Onyankopɔn bedi mʼanim na ɔbɛma mahwɛ wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora no haw.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Nanso nkum wɔn, Awurade, yɛn nkatabo, na me nkurɔfo werɛ amfi wɔn. Wo tumi mu no tutu wɔn ase, na brɛ wɔn ase.

english_verse: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
translation_verse: Bɔne a efi wɔn anom, ne wɔn ano nsɛm nti ma wɔn ahomaso nkyekyere wɔn. Abususɛm a wɔka ne atoro a wotwa nti,

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: sɛe wɔn wɔ abufuwhyew mu, kosi sɛ wɔn ase bɛtɔre. Afei ɛbɛma asase so mmaa nyinaa ahu sɛ Onyankopɔn di Yakob so.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Wɔsan ba anwummere, wɔbobɔ mu sɛ akraman, na wokyinkyin kuropɔn no mu.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Wokyinkyin pɛ aduan na sɛ wɔammee a, wosu bobɔ mu.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nanso mɛto wʼahoɔden ho dwom, mɛto wʼadɔe ho dwom anɔpa; efisɛ woyɛ mʼabandennen, me guankɔbea wɔ ahohia mmere mu.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: Ao mʼAhoɔden, mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo; wo, Onyankopɔn, ne mʼabandennen, me Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔdɔ. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔto no sɛnea wɔto “Susan Edut.”

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, woapo yɛn, woabɔ yɛn agu; wo bo afuw yɛn, nanso gye yɛn bio!

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Woawosow asase no na woapae mu; toatoa nea abubu no, efisɛ ɛrehinhim.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Woama wo nkurɔfo ahu mmere bɔne; woama yɛn nsa a ɛma yɛtɔ ntintan.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔn a wosuro wo de, woama wɔn frankaa so sɛ wontu ntia agyan no.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Gye yɛn nkwa na fa wo nsa nifa boa yɛn, na ama wɔn a wodɔ wɔn no anya nkwa.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn akasa afi ne kronkronbea se, “Nkonim mu, mɛkyɛ Sekem mu, na masusuw Sukot bon no.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead yɛ me de; Manase nso saa ara; Efraim yɛ me dade kyɛw, Yuda yɛ mʼahempema.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab yɛ me guasɛn, Edom so na metow me mpaboa gu; na meteɛ mu nkonimdi so gu Filistifo so.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Hena na ɔde me bɛkɔ kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu? Hena na obedi mʼanim akɔ Edom?

english_verse: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, ɛnyɛ wo na woapo yɛn na wo ne yɛn asraafo nkɔ ɔsa bio ana?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Boa yɛn tia ɔtamfo no, na ɔdesani mmoa nka hwee.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, tie me sufrɛ; tie me mpaebɔ.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Mifi asase ano frɛ wo, mefrɛ wo, efisɛ me koma atɔ beraw; fa me kɔ ɔbotan a ɛware sen me no so.

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: Woayɛ me guankɔbea, aban a ɛyɛ den ma ɔtamfo no.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Me kɔn dɔ sɛ metena wo ntamadan no mu afebɔɔ na manya guankɔbea wɔ wo ntaban nwini ase.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Woate me bɔ a mehyɛe no, Onyankopɔn; na wode wɔn a wosuro wo din no agyapade ama me.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: To ɔhene nkwanna mu bebree; na ne mfe mfi awo ntoatoaso nkodu awo ntoatoaso.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Ma onni hene wɔ Onyankopɔn anim daa fa wʼadɔe ne wo nokware bɔ ne ho ban.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Afei mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo din daa na madi me bɔhyɛ so daa nyinaa. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. De ma Yedutun.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Me kra wɔ ahomegye wɔ Onyankopɔn nko ara mu; me nkwagye fi ne nkyɛn.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Ampa, ɔyɛ me botan ne me nkwagye; ɔyɛ mʼabandennen, hwee renhinhim me da.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Mobɛkɔ so ahyɛ onipa so akosi da bɛn, mo nyinaa besum me ahwe fam ana? Ɔfasu a akyea yi, ban a ɛrebu yi?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Ampa, wɔayɛ adwene se wobetu no afi ne dibea a ɛkorɔn no so; wɔn ani gye atorodi ho. Wɔde wɔn ano hyira na wɔn koma mu de, wɔdome.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Yiw me kra, gye wʼahome wɔ Onyankopɔn nko ara mu; na ne mu na mʼanidaso wɔ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Ampa, ɔyɛ me botan ne me nkwagye; ɔyɛ mʼabandennen, hwee renhinhim me.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Me nkwagye ne mʼanuonyam gyina Onyankopɔn so; ɔyɛ me botan a ɛkorɔn, ne me guankɔbea.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Mo nnipa, momfa mo ho nto ne so daa; monka mo koma mu nsɛm nyinaa nkyerɛ no, efisɛ Onyankopɔn ne yɛn guankɔbea.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Nnipa nyinaa te sɛ home; akɛse ne nkumaa nyinaa nka hwee; sɛ wɔkari wɔn wɔ nsania so a, wɔnka hwee; wɔn nyinaa bɔ mu a wɔyɛ home nko.

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Mommfa mo ho nto asisi so na monnhoahoa mo ho akorɔnne ho; ɛwɔ mu sɛ mo ahonya dɔɔso de, nanso mommfa mo koma nto so.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: Asɛm baako na Onyankopɔn aka, nsɛm abien na mate sɛ, wo, Onyankopɔn, na wowɔ ahoɔden,

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: na wo, Awurade, na woyɛ adɔe, ampa ara wubetua obiara ka sɛnea nʼadwuma te.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Wo, Onyankopɔn, ne me Nyankopɔn Mehwehwɛ wo anibere so; wo ho sukɔm de me kra, me nipadua ani agyina wo, wɔ asase a awo na asade nni mu so, faako a nsu nni.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Mahu wo wɔ Kronkronbea hɔ mahu wo tumi ne wʼanuonyam.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ wʼadɔe di mu sen nkwa nti mʼanofafa bɛhyɛ wo anuonyam.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Sɛ mete ase yi, mɛkamfo wo, na wo din mu na mɛma me nsa so.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Me kra bɛmee sɛnea wadi aduan papa bi; mede anofafa a ɛto dwom beyi wo ayɛ.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Meda me mpa so a, mekae wo. Anadwo dasu mu nyinaa, midwen wo ho.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Efisɛ wone me boafo, wo ntaban ase nwini mu na mɛto dwom.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Me kra bata wo ho; na wo nsa nifa kura me mu.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔpɛ me akum me no bɛsɛe; wɔbɛkɔ asase ase tɔnn.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛdan wɔn ama afoa na wɔbɛyɛ aduan ama sakraman.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔhene bedi ahurusi wɔ Onyankopɔn mu; wɔn a wɔka ntam wɔ Onyankopɔn din mu nyinaa bɛkamfo no, na wobemua atorofo ano. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn, tie me, bere a mereka me haw; bɔ me kra ho ban fi ɔtamfo ahunahuna ho.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Fa me sie fi amumɔyɛfo agyinatu ho, ne nnebɔneyɛfo pɔwbɔ ho.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Wɔsew wɔn tɛkrɛma sɛ afoa na wɔde atirimɔden nsɛm sɔn sɛ mmɛmma werɛmfo.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Wɔhyehyɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho nkuran wɔ wɔn amumɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ho, wɔka sɛnea wobesum wɔn mfiri asie; wɔka se, “Hena na obehu yɛn?”

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Wɔbɔ ntɛnkyew ho pɔw na wɔka se, “Yɛayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛso nni koraa!” Ampa ara onipa koma ne nʼadwene yɛ anifere.

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Nanso Onyankopɔn bɛto bɛmma abɔ wɔn; na wɔbɛhwe fam prɛko pɛ.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛdan wɔn ankasa tɛkrɛma atia wɔn na ɔde wɔn aba ɔsɛe mu; na wɔn a wobehu wɔn nyinaa de animka bɛbɔ wɔn ti nko.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Adesamma nyinaa besuro; wɔbɛpae mu aka Onyankopɔn nnwuma na wɔasusuw nea wayɛ ho.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ma atreneefo nni ahurusi wɔ Awurade mu na wɔmpɛ guankɔbea wɔ no mu; ma wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew nyinaa nyi no ayɛ! Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Yɛn Nyankopɔn, ayeyi retwɛn wo wɔ Sion, na yebedi yɛn bɔ a yɛahyɛ wo no so.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Wo a woyɛ mpaebɔ tiefo, wo nkyɛn na nnipa nyinaa bɛba.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Bere a yɛn bɔne menee yɛn no, wo na wode yɛn mmarato kyɛɛ yɛn.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wuyi wɔn ma wɔbɛn wo sɛ wɔntena wʼadiwo hɔ! Nneɛma pa a ɛwɔ wo fi ahyɛ yɛn ma, nea ɛwɔ wʼasɔredan kronkron mu no.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Wode trenee nnwuma a ɛyɛ nwonwa ma yɛn mmuae, Onyankopɔn, yɛn agyenkwa, asase so mmaa nyinaa anidaso ne po so akyirikyiri nso.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Wonam wo tumi so yɛɛ mmepɔw de daa wʼahoɔden adi.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: Wudwudwoo po asorɔkye ano, asorɔkye no mmobɔwee, ne amanaman no hooyɛ.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔte akyirikyiri no suro wʼanwonwade; faako a ade kye, nea anwummere yera, wofrɛ ahurusi nnwom wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Wohwɛ asase no gugu so nsu; woma no yɛ asase pa ma ɛboro so. Wode nsu hyɛ Onyankopɔn nsuwansuwa ma sɛnea ɛbɛma nnipa no aduan, efisɛ saa ne nea woahyɛ.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Wofɔw nea woafuntum hɔ no fɔkyee na wokaa nkɔmoa no kataa so; wode nsu petee so ma no yɛɛ bɛtɛɛ na wuhyiraa so afifide.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Wode nnɔbae bebree wiee afe no, na wo nteaseɛnam yɛɛ ma buu so.

english_verse: Desert pastures blossom, and mountains celebrate.
translation_verse: Sare so nwura dɔɔso na anigye baa nkoko so.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Nguankuw ahyɛ adidibea hɔ ma na awi akata aku no so; wɔbɔ ose, to ahosɛpɛw dwom. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Asase nyinaa momfa ahosɛpɛw nteɛ mu mma Onyankopɔn!

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Monto ne din anuonyamhyɛ ho dwom; momma nʼayeyi nyɛ anuonyamhyɛ!

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Munse Onyankopɔn sɛ, “Wo nneyɛe yɛ nwonwa dodo! Wo tumi so mmoroso a wʼatamfo nyinaa de osuro kotow wʼanim.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Asase nyinaa kotow wo; wɔto ayeyi dwom ma wo, wɔto dwom kamfo wo din.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Mommra mmɛhwɛ nea Onyankopɔn ayɛ; anwonwade a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa po yɛɛ asase kesee; wɔnantew twaa nsu no mommra mma yenni ahurusi wɔ no mu.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne tumi di hene daa daa, na ɔde nʼani nso hwɛ aman so. Mma atuatewfo nsɔre ntia no.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Aman nyinaa, munhyira yɛn Nyankopɔn, momma wɔnte mo nkamfo no nnyigyei;

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: wahwɛ yɛn nkwa so na wamma yɛn anan anwatiri.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Na wo, Onyankopɔn, wosɔɔ yɛn hwɛe; na wonan yɛn sɛ dwetɛ.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Wode yɛn koguu afiase na wode nneɛma a ɛyɛ duru too yɛn akyi.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Womaa yɛn atamfo twiw faa yɛn so; yɛfaa ogya ne nsu mu, nanso wode yɛn baa faako a nnepa abu so.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Mede ɔhyew afɔre bɛba wʼasɔredan mu na madi bɔ a mahyɛ wo no so,

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Mede mmoa a wɔadɔ srade bɛbɔ afɔre ama wo; adwennini ayɛyɛde; mede anantwinini ne mpapo bɛbɔ afɔre.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Mommra mmetie, mo a musuro Onyankopɔn nyinaa; momma menka nea wayɛ ama me nkyerɛ mo.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Mede mʼano su frɛɛ no; na me tɛkrɛma yii no ayɛ.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Sɛ mede bɔne hyɛɛ me koma mu a, anka Awurade antie me.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Nanso nokware, Onyankopɔn atie me, wate me mpaebɔ.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka Onyankopɔn, a wampo me mpaebɔ na wanyi nʼadɔe amfi me so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔde sanku na ɛto.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nnom yɛn na onhyira yɛn ɔmma nʼanim nhyerɛn wɔ yɛn so,

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: na ɔmma wonhu nʼakwan wɔ asase so, ne ne nkwagye wɔ amanaman no nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Ma adesamma nyi wo ayɛ, Onyankopɔn; ma nnipa nyinaa nkamfo wo.

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Ma amanaman ani nnye na wɔnto ahosɛpɛw dwom, efisɛ wudi nnipa no so trenee mu na woma asase so amanaman no akwankyerɛ.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Ma adesamma nyi wo ayɛ, Onyankopɔn; ma nnipa nyinaa nkamfo wo!

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Afei asase no bɛbɔ ne nnɔbae, na Onyankopɔn, yɛn Nyankopɔn ahyira yɛn.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn behyira yɛn, na asase mmaa nyinaa besuro no. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Ma Onyankopɔn nsɔre, ma nʼatamfo nhwete; wɔn a wɔtan no no nguan mfi nʼanim.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Sɛnea mframa bɔ wusiw gu no, saa ara na bɔ wɔn gu; sɛnea srade nan wɔ ogya so no, saa ara na amumɔyɛfo nyera mfi Onyankopɔn anim.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Nanso ma atreneefo ani nnye na wɔnsɛpɛw wɔn ho wɔ Onyankopɔn anim; ma wɔn ho ntɔ wɔn na wonni ahurusi.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: To dwom ma Onyankopɔn, to dwom yi ne din ayɛ. Ma nea ɔnantew omununkum so no din so. Ne din ne Awurade; ma wʼani nnye wɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Ayisaa agya ne nea odi akunafo asɛm ma wɔn ne Onyankopɔn a ɔte nʼatenae kronkron hɔ.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Ɔma ohiani tena mmusua mu, na ɔde nnwonto yi nneduafo ma wɔde wɔn ho; na atuatewfo de, wɔtena asase a awo so.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, bere a wudii wo nkurɔfo anim, bere a wode wɔn faa sare so no,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: asase wosowee, na ɔsoro tuee osu guu fam, wɔ Onyankopɔn, Sinai Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no anim.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: Womaa osu tɔɔ bebree, Ao, Onyankopɔn, guu wʼagyapade a abotow no so ma ɛyɛɛ frɔmfrɔm.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Wo nkurɔfo bɔɔ atenase wɔ so, Onyankopɔn, wonam wʼadɔe bebree no so hwɛɛ ahiafo.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Awurade kaa asɛm no, na dodow no ara ne wɔn a wɔpaee mu kae;

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Ahemfo ne wɔn asraafo guan ntɛm so; mmea a wɔwɔ fie no kyɛ asade.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Mpo bere a woda nguanban mu no, wɔde dwetɛ duraa mʼaborɔnoma ntaban ho, de sikakɔkɔɔ a ɛhyerɛn guu wɔn ntakra so.”

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Bere a Otumfo bɔɔ ahene a wɔwɔ asase no so hwetee no, na ɛte sɛ sukyerɛmma a agu Bepɔw Salmon so.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Basan mmepɔw gyinagyina hɔ, Basan mmepɔw so yɛ abonkyiabonkyi.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Wo bepɔw abonkyiabonkyi, adɛn nti na wode ani bɔne hwɛ bepɔw a Onyankopɔn ayi sɛ obedi so hene, faako a Awurade ankasa bɛtena afebɔɔ?

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nteaseɛnam yɛ mpem mpem ne mpem mpem mu mpem; Awurade fi Sinai aba ne kronkronbea.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Bere a woforo kɔɔ soro no, wode nnommum kaa wo ho; wunyaa ayɛyɛde fii nnipa hɔ, fii atuatewfo hɔ mpo, sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtena hɔ, Awurade Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Ayeyi nka Awurade, nka Onyankopɔn yɛn Agyenkwa, nea ɔsoa yɛn nnesoa da biara no.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ Onyankopɔn a ogye nkwa; na Awurade mu na owu tow fom yɛn.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Ampa ara Onyankopɔn bɛdwerɛw nʼatamfo ti, wɔn a wɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne ti kusuu no.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Awurade ka se, “Mede wɔn befi Basan aba; mede wɔn befi po bun mu aba,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: na moanantew wɔn a wokyi mo no mogya mu na mo akraman tɛkrɛma anya wɔn kyɛfa.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, yɛahu wo santen yuu no, me Nyankopɔn ne me Hene santen yuu no a ɔde reba ne kronkronbea hɔ.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Nnwontofo no wɔ anim, na asankubɔfo no nso di so, na mmabaa a wɔrewosow akasae nso ka wɔn ho.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Monkamfo Onyankopɔn wɔ asafo kɛse no mu; monkamfo Awurade wɔ Israel nnipakuw no mu.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Abusuakuw ketewa, Benyamin na odi wɔn kan, Yuda mmapɔmma kuw kɛse no di so, na Sebulon ne Naftali mmapɔmma aba.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ wo tumi, Onyankopɔn; da wʼahoɔden adi kyerɛ yɛn, sɛnea woayɛ pɛn no.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wʼasɔredan a ɛwɔ Yerusalem nti ahemfo de ayɛyɛde bɛbrɛ wo.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Ka aboa a ɔhyɛ mfea mu no anim, ne anantwinini kuw a wɔhyɛ amanaman no nantwimma mu no. Brɛ wɔn ase kosi sɛ wɔde dwetɛ mpɔw bɛba. Bɔ wɔn a wɔn ani gye ɔko ho no pansam.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Ananmusifo befi Misraim aba, na Kus de ne ho bɛma Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Wiase ahemman, monto dwom mma Onyankopɔn, monto ayeyi nnwom mma Awurade,

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: monto mma nea ɔte tete ɔsorosoro so no, na ɔde nne kɛse bobɔ mu no.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Mompae mu nka Onyankopɔn tumi, nea ne kɛseyɛ kata Israel so no, na ne tumi wɔ soro ɔsoro no.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Wo ho yɛ hu, Onyankopɔn, wɔ wo kronkronbea hɔ; Israel Nyankopɔn de tumi ne ahoɔden ma ne nkurɔfo. Ayeyi nka Onyankopɔn! Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔto no sɛ “Sukooko.”

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me nkwa na nsu no abɛdeda me kɔn mu.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Meremem wɔ dontori a mu dɔ mu, wɔ baabi a mʼanan nnya sibea. Madu bun mu na nsu abu afa me so.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: Mafrɛ abrɛ rehwehwɛ mmoa. Me mene mu ayow. Mʼani so ayɛ kusuu, na merehwehwɛ me Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔtan me kwa no dɔɔso sen me ti so nwi; wɔn a wɔtan me kwa no dɔɔso, wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me no. Wɔhyɛ me sɛ mennan nea minnwiae no mma.

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: Wo, Onyankopɔn, nim me nkwaseasɛm; mʼafɔdi nhintaw wo.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Wo nti migyina animka ano, na aniwu kata mʼanim.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Mete sɛ ɔhɔho wɔ me nuanom mu, mete sɛ ɔmamfrani wɔ me na mmabarima mu,

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: na wo fi ho mmɔdemmɔ hyɛ me so, wɔn a wɔbɔ wo ahohora no animtiaabu bɛda me so.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Sɛ mitwa adwo na midi mmuada a wɔbɔ me ahohora;

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: sɛ mifura atweaatam a nnipa de me yɛ aserewde.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔtete ɔpon no ano no serew me, na akɔwensafo de me din to dwom.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Nanso mɛbɔ wo mpae, Awurade, wɔ wʼadom bere mu; wɔ wʼadɔe kɛse no nti, Ao, Onyankopɔn, fa wo nokware nkwagye no gye me so.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Yi me fi dontori no mu, mma memmem wɔ mu; gye me fi wɔn a wɔtan me no nsam, ne nsu bun mu.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Mma nsu nnyiri mmfa me anaa bun mmene me anaa amoa nkata me so.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Awurade, gye me so fi wʼadɔe a eye no mu; wʼadom nti, dan bɛhwɛ me.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mfa wʼanim nhintaw wo somfo; gye me so ntɛm, na mewɔ ɔhaw mu.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Twiw bɛn me na gye me; gye me nkwa, mʼatamfo nti.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Wunim sɛnea wɔkasa tia me, gu mʼanim ase na wotiatia mʼanim; wʼani tua mʼatamfo nyinaa.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Kasatia ahyɛ me koma so ama mayɛ sɛ obi a onni ɔboafo; mepɛɛ awerɛkyekye, nanso mannya bi, mepɛɛ ɔwerɛkyekyefo, nanso manhu bi.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Wɔde bɔnwoma guu mʼaduan mu, osukɔm dee me no, wɔmaa me nsa nwenweenwen.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn didipon a esi wɔn anim nyi wɔn sɛ afiri; ma ɛnyɛ akatua ne afide mma wɔn.

english_verse: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn ani so nyɛ wɔn kusuu na wɔanhu ade, na ma wɔn akyi nkuntun afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Hwie wʼabufuwhyew gu wɔn so; na ma wʼabufuw huhuhuhu no mmra wɔn so.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn fi nyɛ amamfo; mma obiara ntena wɔn ntamadan mu.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Wɔtaa wɔn a wupira wɔn no, wɔka wɔn a wupira wɔn no yawdi ho asɛm.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Fa amumɔyɛ mu amumɔyɛ ho sobo bɔ wɔn; mma wonnya wo nkwagye mu kyɛfa.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Pepa wɔn din fi nkwa nhoma no mu, mfa wɔn din nka atreneefo de ho.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Mewɔ ɔyaw ne ahohiahia mu; Onyankopɔn, ma wo nkwagye no mmɔ me ho ban.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Mede dwonto beyi Onyankopɔn din ayɛ na mede aseda ahyɛ no anuonyam.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Eyi bɛsɔ Awurade ani yiye asen nantwi, asen nantwinini a otua mmɛn na ɔwɔ tɔte.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Mmɔborɔni behu na nʼani agye, mo a mohwehwɛ Onyankopɔn no koma benya nkwa.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Awurade tie wɔn a ade ahia wɔn, na ommu ne nkurɔfo nneduafo animtiaa.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Ma ɔsoro ne asase nkamfo no, po ne nea ɛkeka ne ho wɔ mu nyinaa,

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: efisɛ Onyankopɔn begye Sion nkwa na wakyekye Yuda nkuropɔn no bio. Afei nnipa bɛtena mu na ayɛ wɔn de;

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Nʼasomfo asefo na wɔbɛfa hɔ, na wɔn a wɔdɔ ne din no bɛtena hɔ. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm gye me nkwa; Awurade bra ntɛm bɛboa me.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra no anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa; ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me sɛe no nyinaa mfa animguase nsan wɔn akyi.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔka, “Ɔtwea! Ɔtwea!” kyerɛ me no nsan wɔn akyi, esiane wɔn aniwu nti.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Nanso ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinaa nsɛpɛw wɔn ho na wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu; ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagye no nka da biara se, “Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔkɛse!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Me de meyɛ ohiani a minni ɔboafo; Ao, Onyankopɔn, bra me nkyɛn ntɛm. Wo ne me boafo ne me gyefo; Awurade, ntwentwɛn wʼanan ase.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm gye me nkwa; Awurade bra ntɛm bɛboa me.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra no anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa; ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me sɛe no nyinaa mfa animguase nsan wɔn akyi.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔka, “Ɔtwea! Ɔtwea!” kyerɛ me no nsan wɔn akyi, esiane wɔn aniwu nti.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Nanso ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinaa nsɛpɛw wɔn ho na wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu; ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagye no nka da biara se, “Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔkɛse!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Me de meyɛ ohiani a minni ɔboafo; Ao, Onyankopɔn, bra me nkyɛn ntɛm. Wo ne me boafo ne me gyefo; Awurade, ntwentwɛn wʼanan ase.

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo mu na maguan ahintaw; mma mʼanim ngu ase da.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Wo trenee no nti, yi me na gye me; tie me na gye me nkwa.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Yɛ me nkwagye botan, faako a metumi akɔ daa; hyɛ ma wommegye me nkwa, na wone me botan ne mʼabandennen.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn, gye me fi amumɔyɛfo nsam, gye me fi nnebɔneyɛfo ne atirimɔdenfo nsam.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Na woayɛ mʼanidaso, Asafo Awurade, mʼahotoso fi me mmabun bere mu.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Mede me ho ato wo so fi awo mu; wo na wuyii me fii me na yafunu mu. Mɛkamfo wo daa.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Mayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ama bebree, nanso wo ne me guankɔbea dennen.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Wo nkamfo ahyɛ mʼanom ma, mekamfo wʼanuonyam da mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Ntow me nkyene bere a mabɔ akwakoraa; mʼahoɔden sa wɔ me mu a, nnyaw me.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: Efisɛ mʼatamfo kasa tia me wɔn a wɔtwɛn sɛ wobekum me no bɔ mu pam me ti so.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: Wɔka se, “Onyankopɔn agyaw no mu; momma yentiw no na yɛnkyere no, na obiara nni hɔ a obegye no.”

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn, mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ akyiri; Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me.

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔbɔ me sobo no nsɛe wɔ animguase mu; wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wopira me no ma ahohora ne animguase nkata wɔn so.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Nanso me de, menya anidaso daa; mɛkɔ so akamfo wo.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Mɛka wo trenee ho asɛm, ne wo nkwagye da mu nyinaa, nanso minnim ano.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Otumfo Awurade, mɛba abɛpae mu aka wo nnwuma akɛse no; mɛpae mu aka wo trenee, wo nko ara de no, akyerɛ.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, efi me mmabun bere na wokyerɛkyerɛɛ me, na ebesi nnɛ yi meka wʼanwonwade a woayɛ kyerɛ.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Mpo sɛ mebɔ akwakoraa na mifuw dwen a, Onyankopɔn, nnyaw me, kosi sɛ mɛka wo tumi ho asɛm akyerɛ nkyirimma, ne wo kɛseyɛ akyerɛ wɔn a wɔbɛba nyinaa.
