english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, wo trenee du ɔsorosoro, wo a woayɛ nneɛma akɛse. Onyankopɔn, hena na ɔte sɛ wo?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Mmom woama mahu ɔhaw bebree a ɛyɛ yaw; nanso wobɛma me nkwa bio; na wubeyi me bio, afi asase yam.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Wobɛhyɛ me anuonyam bebree na woakyekye me werɛ bio.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Mede sanku bɛkamfo wo me Nyankopɔn, wo trenee nti mɛto wʼayeyi dwom wɔ sankuten so, Israel Kronkronni.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mʼanofafa de anigye bɛteɛ mu bere a meto dwom kamfo wo, me a woagye me no.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Me tɛkrɛma bɛka wo trenee nnwuma da mu nyinaa, efisɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhaw me no kɔ animguase ne basaayɛ mu.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, fa wʼatɛntrenee dom ɔhene no, na fa wo trenee ma ɔhene babarima.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔde trenee bebu wo nkurɔfo atɛn, obebu wo nkurɔfo a wɔrehu amane no atɛntrenee.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Mmepɔw no de yiyedi bɛbrɛ nnipa no, nkoko no de trenee bɛba.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛko ama nnipa no mu amanehunufo na wagye wɔn a wonni bi mma nkwa; ɔbɛdwerɛw nhyɛsofo.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Owia ne ɔsram da so wɔ hɔ yi wobesuro wo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛyɛ sɛ osu a ɛtɔ gu asase a wɔadɔw so so, te sɛ obosu a egugu asase so.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Atreneefo benyin frɔmfrɔm wɔ ne bere so; yiyedi bebu so akosi da a ɔsram nni hɔ bio.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Obedi hene afi po akosi po, afi Asubɔnten Efrata akosi asase ano.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Sare so mmusua bɛkotow nʼanim na nʼatamfo adi mfutuma.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tarsis ne mpoano ahemfo a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri de sonkahiri bɛbrɛ no; Saba ne Seba ahemfo de ayɛyɛde bɛbrɛ no.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Ahemfo nyinaa bɛkotow no, amanaman nyinaa bɛsom no.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Na obegye mmɔborɔfo a wosu frɛ no, ne amanehunufo a wonni ɔboafo.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Obehu wɔn a wɔayɛ mmrɛw ne ahiafo mmɔbɔ na wagye ahiafo nkwa.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Obegye wɔn afi nhyɛso ne akakabensɛm ase, efisɛ wɔn mogya som bo wɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Ɔhene nkwa so! ma wɔmfa sikakɔkɔɔ mfi Seba mmrɛ no. Ma nnipa mmɔ mpae mma no na wonhyira no da mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Aburow mmu so wɔ asase no so nyinaa; nnuan mmu so wɔ nkoko so, ma nʼaba mmɔ sɛ Lebanon; na enyin sɛ mfuw so sare.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Ne din bɛtena hɔ daa; ɛntena hɔ nkyɛ sɛ owia. Wɔbɛfa no so ahyira amanaman no, na wɔbɛfrɛ no nhyira.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka Awurade Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn! Ɔno nko ara na ɔyɛ anwonwade.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka ne din a anuonyam ahyɛ no ma no daa daa. Ma nʼanuonyam nhyɛ wiase nyinaa ma. Amen! Amen!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Yisai ba Dawid mpaebɔ no awiei ni.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: Asaf dwom.

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Ampa ara Onyankopɔn ye ma Israel, oye ma wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew.

english_verse: But I almost stumbled and fell,
translation_verse: Nanso me de, anka me nan reyɛ awatiri; anka merehwere me nnyinaso,

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: efisɛ mʼani beree ahantanfo bere a mihuu amumɔyɛfo yiyedi no.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Wonni aperepere; na wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne apɔwmuden.

english_verse: and they don't have troubles like everyone else.
translation_verse: Dadwen a ɛtaa ba nnipa so biara nna wɔn so; ɔdesani haw biara nna wɔn so.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Enti ahantan yɛ wɔn kɔnmuade, na wofura akakabensɛm.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Wɔn koma a apirim no mu na nnebɔne fi; na wɔn amumɔyɛ adwene nni awiei.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Wɔserew afoforo na wɔka wɔn ho nsɛm a enye; wɔde nhyɛso hunahuna afoforo wɔ ahomaso mu.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Wɔn ano ka ɔsoro nsɛm, na wɔn tɛkrɛma agye asase afa.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti wɔn nkurɔfo kɔ wɔn nkyɛn na wonya nsu nom ma ebu so.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Wobisa se, “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Onyankopɔn ahu? Na Ɔsorosoroni no wɔ nhumu ana?”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Sɛɛ na amumɔyɛfo no te, hwee mfa wɔn ho, na wɔkɔ so pɛ ahonyade.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Ampa ara, mannya hwee amfi me komamtew mu; me nsa a enni fɔ no ayɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Da mu nyinaa mihu amane; anɔpa biara wɔtwe mʼaso.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekae se, “Mɛkasa saa” a, anka midii wo mma no huammɔ.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Mebɔɔ mmɔden sɛ mɛte eyinom nyinaa ase, nanso na ɛhyɛ me so

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: kosii sɛ mekɔɔ Onyankopɔn kronkronbea hɔ; ɛhɔ na metee nea awiei no ɛbɛba wɔn so no ase.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Ampa ara wode wɔn gu faako a hɔ yɛ toro wode wɔn hwe fam sɛe wɔn pasaa.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Sɛnea wɔsɛe prɛko pɛ, na ehu hwim wɔn kɔ no.

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Ɛte sɛ adaeso, bere a onipa anyan, Awurade, sɛ wokanyan wo ho a, wubebu wʼani agu wɔn so sɛ biribi a enni hɔ.

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: meyɛɛ sɛ obi a onnim hwee na onni adwene; meyɛɛ sɛ aboa gyimfo wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Nanso na me ne wo wɔ hɔ bere biara; na wode wo nsa nifa aso me mu.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Wode wʼafotu kyerɛ me kwan; na akyiri no, wode me bɛkɔ anuonyam mu.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Hena na mewɔ wɔ ɔsoro ka wo ho? Na biribiara nni asase so a mepɛ ka wo ho.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Me honam, ne me koma bedi me huammɔ, nanso Onyankopɔn ne me koma ahoɔden ne me kyɛfa daa nyinaa.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔmmɛn wo no bɛyera. Wosɛe wɔn a wonni wo nokware nyinaa.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Nanso me de, minim sɛ eye sɛ wobɛbɛn Onyankopɔn. Mede Otumfo Awurade ayɛ me guankɔbea; mɛka wo nneyɛe nyinaa akyerɛ.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, adɛn nti na woapo yɛn koraa yi? Adɛn nti na wʼabufuw hyew wʼadidibea nguan?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Kae nkurɔfo a wotɔɔ wɔn teteete no, abusua a ɛyɛ wʼagyapade a wugyee wɔn no, Bepɔw Sion, faako a wote hɔ.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Dan wʼanammɔntu kyerɛ saa nnwiriwii a ɛto ntwa da yi, ɔtamfo no de saa ɔsɛe yi nyinaa aba wo kronkronbea no so.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Wʼatamfo bobɔɔ mu wɔ faako a wuhyiaa yɛn no; wɔasisi wɔn mfrankaa sɛ agyiraehyɛde wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ wɔn sɛ nnipa a wɔrehwim mmonnua de abubu nnua a ayɛ nkyɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: Wɔde wɔn mmonnua ne nname bubuu nnua a wɔasen adi ho adwinni no.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Wɔhyew wo kronkronbea no dwerɛbee; woguu faako a wo Din te no ho fi.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Wɔkaa wɔ wɔn koma mu se, “Yebetiatia wɔn so ayɛ wɔn pasaa!” Wɔhyew baabiara a wɔsom Onyankopɔn wɔ asase no so.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Wɔmmaa yɛn nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛyɛ nwonwa biara; adiyifo no asa, na yɛn mu biara nnim nna dodow a ebedi.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, wʼatamfo bɛserew wo akosi da bɛn? Wɔn a wokyi wo no begu wo din ho fi daa ana?

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na woatwe wo nsa, wo nsa nifa no? Yi fi wʼatade mmobɔwee no mu na sɛe wɔn.

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Nanso Onyankopɔn yɛ me hene fi tete; wode nkwagye ba asase so.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ wo na wode wo tumi paee po mu no; wopɛtɛw nsu mu ɔwɔ no ti.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Wopɛtɛw Lewiatan no ti na wode no maa sare so abɔde sɛ wɔn aduan.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Wo na womaa nsuwa ne nsuti tuei; na womaa nsubɔnten a ɛsen yoyowee.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Adekyee wɔ wo na adesae nso yɛ wo dea; wode owia ne ɔsram sisii hɔ.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ wo na wototoo asase so ahye nyinaa; wobɔɔ ahohuru ne awɔw mmere.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Awurade, kae sɛnea ɔtamfo no aserew wo, sɛnea nkwaseafo agu wo din ho fi.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Mmfa wʼaborɔnoma nkwa mma nkekaboa; mma wo werɛ mfi wo nkurɔfo a wɔrehu amane no nkwa afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Ma wʼapam no ho nhia wo, efisɛ akakabensɛm ahyɛ asase no so sum mu ma.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Mma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no mmfa animguase nsan; ma ahiafo ne mmɔborɔfo nkamfo wo din.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, ma wo ho so na ka wo ara wʼasɛm; kae sɛnea nkwaseafo serew wo da mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, yɛda wo ase, yɛda wo ase, efisɛ wo Din abɛn; nnipa ka wʼanwonwade kyerɛ.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: Woka se, “Me na mehyɛɛ bere a ɛsɛ no; ɛyɛ me na mibu atɛntrenee.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Sɛ asase ne so nnipa nyinaa wosow a, me na mema nʼafadum gyina hɔ pintinn.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Meka kyerɛ ahantanfo se, ‘Monnhoahoa mo ho bio,’ na meka kyerɛ amumɔyɛfo nso se, ‘Mommma mo mmɛn so.

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: Mommma mo mmɛn so ntia ɔsoro; mommfa animtiaabu nkasa.’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Obiara mmfi apuei anaa atɔe anaa sare no so a obetumi ama obi so.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn na obu atɛn: Ɔbrɛ ɔbaako ase, na ɔma ɔfoforo so.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Kuruwa bi hyɛ Awurade nsam nsa bi a etwa ahuru a wɔde nnuhuam afra ahyɛ no ma; ohwie, na asase so amumɔyɛfo nyinaa nom ma ɛka ase puw.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Me de, mɛpae mu aka eyi daa daa; mɛto ayeyi dwom ama Yakob Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Mebubu amumɔyɛfo nyinaa mmɛn, na atreneefo mmɛn de, wɔbɛma so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔde sanku na ɛto.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn din ahyeta wɔ Yuda; ne din so wɔ Israel.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Ne ntamadan si Salem, ne tenabea wɔ Sion.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na obubuu mmemma a ɛpa gya, nkatabo ne afoa, akode nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You are more glorious than the eternal mountains.
translation_verse: Wo ho hann no hyerɛn, na woso sen mmepɔw a mmoadoma ahyɛ mu ma no.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Mmarima akokodurufo deda hɔ a wɔagye wɔn ho nneɛma, wɔadeda awufo nna; na akofo no mu baako mpo ntumi mma ne nsa so.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Yakob Nyankopɔn, wokaa wɔn anim no apɔnkɔ no ne nteaseɛnam no adeda dinn.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Wo nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ wosuro wo. Sɛ wo bo fuw a hena na obetumi agyina wʼanim?

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: bere a wo, Onyankopɔn, sɔre buu atɛn, de gyee amanehunufo wɔ asase no so no.

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: Ampa ara wʼabufuwhyew a etia nnipa no de ayeyi brɛ wo, na wɔn a wotumi gyina ano no nya kɔkɔbɔ.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Monhyɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn no bɔ na munni so; momma nsase a atwa ne ho ahyia mfa ayɛyɛde mmrɛ Ɔbaako a ɛsɛ sɛ wosuro no no.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Ɔbrɛ sodifonom honhom ase; na asase so ahemfo suro no. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔde ma Yedutun.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Misu mefrɛɛ Onyankopɔn srɛɛ mmoa; misu mefrɛɛ no sɛ ontie me.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Bere a mewɔ ahohiahia mu no, mehwehwɛɛ Awurade; metrɛw me nsa a ɛmpa abaw mu anadwo na me kra ampene sɛ wɔbɛkyekye ne werɛ.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn mekaee wo, na misii apini; medwenee, na me honhom tɔɔ beraw.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Woamma mʼani ankum; amanehunu dodow nti, mantumi ankasa.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Medwenee nna a atwam no ho, teteete mfe no ho;

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Enti, Awurade bɛpo yɛn daa? Ɔrenhu yɛn mmɔbɔ bio ana?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da atu ayera koraa ana? Na ne bɔhyɛ no, amma mu koraa ana?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn werɛ afi sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmɔborɔhunufo ana? Ɔde abufuw atwe nʼayamhyehye no asan ana?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Afei misusuwii se, “Eyi de, mɛsrɛ: mfe a Ɔsorosoroni no teɛɛ ne nsa nifa mu no.”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Mɛkae nneɛma a Awurade ayɛ; yiw, mɛkae wo tete anwonwade no.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Mɛdwene wo nnwuma nyinaa ho na masusuw wo nneyɛe akɛse nyinaa ho.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, wʼakwan yɛ kronkron. Onyame bɛn na ɔso sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn?

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Wone Onyankopɔn a woyɛ anwonwade; wokyerɛ wo tumi wɔ aman mu.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Wode wo tumi nsa no gyee wo nkurɔfo, Yakob ne Yosef asefo no.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, nsu no huu wo, nsu no huu wo na wɔpopoe; bun no mpo ho wosowee.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Omununkum tɔɔ nsu, aprannaa gyigyee wɔ ɔsoro; na wo bɛmma paa gya dii akɔneaba.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Wʼaprannaa bobɔɔ mu wɔ mfɛtɛ no mu, wʼanyinam hyerɛn wiase; asase popoe, na ɛwosowee.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Wode wo kwan faa po mu, wode faa nsu kɛse mu, nanso wɔanhu wʼanammɔn.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Wonam Mose ne Aaron abasa so, dii wo nkurɔfo anim sɛ nguankuw.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Me nkurɔfo, muntie me nkyerɛkyerɛ; monyɛ aso mma mʼanom nsɛm.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Mɛkasa wɔ abebu mu, mɛka ahintasɛm, teteete nneɛma no,

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: nneɛma a yɛate na yɛahu; nneɛma a yɛn agyanom aka ho asɛm akyerɛ yɛn.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yɛremfa nkame wɔn mma; yɛbɛka akyerɛ nkyirimma Awurade nneyɛe a ɛfata nkamfo no, ne tumi ne anwonwade a wayɛ no.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Ɔyɛɛ ahyɛde maa Yakob na ɔyɛɛ mmara wɔ Israel, nea ɔhyɛɛ yɛn nenanom sɛ wɔnkyerɛ wɔn mma,

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nkyirimma besua, mpo mmofra a wonnya nwoo wɔn, na wɔn nso akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mma.

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: Afei wɔde wɔn ho bɛto Onyankopɔn so, na wɔn werɛ remfi ne nneyɛe, na wobedi nʼahyɛde so.

english_verse: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
translation_verse: Wɔrenyɛ sɛ wɔn nenanom, a na wɔyɛ asoɔdenfo ne atuatewfo, wɔn a wonni Onyankopɔn nokware wɔ wɔn koma mu na woyɛ honhom mu atorofo ma no no.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ na Efraim mmarima kurakura agyan, nanso ɔko da no woguanee;

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Wɔanni Onyankopɔn apam no so, wɔampɛ sɛ wodi ne mmara no so.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Wɔn werɛ fii nea wayɛ, anwonwade a wayɛ akyerɛ wɔn no.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛɛ anwonwade wɔ wɔn nenanom anim, wɔ Soan mantam a ɛwɔ Misraim asase so.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Ɔkyɛɛ po mu na ɔde wɔn faa mu. Ɔmaa nsu no gyinaa sɛ afasu.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Ɔde omununkum dii wɔn anim awia na ɔde ogyatɛn dii wɔn anim anadwo nyinaa.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Ɔpaee ɔbotan mu wɔ sare so, na ɔmaa wɔn nsu a ɛdɔɔso sɛ po;

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa asuti fii abotan mu na ɔmaa nsu sen sɛ nsubɔnten.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne tiaa no, wɔsɔre tiaa Ɔsorosoroni no wɔ sare no so.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Wɔhyɛɛ da kaa aduan a wɔpɛ, de sɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Wɔkasa tiaa Onyankopɔn se, “Onyankopɔn betumi ato pon wɔ sare so ana?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Ɔde ade bɔɔ ɔbotan mu no, nsu tue fii mu, na nsuwa sen buu so. Na obetumi ama yɛn aduan nso? Obetumi ama ne nkurɔfo nam ana?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Bere a Awurade tee nea wɔreka no, ne bo fuw yiye; ne gya beguu Yakob so, na nʼabufuwhyew sɔre tiaa Israel,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: efisɛ na wonni Onyankopɔn mu gyidi anaasɛ ne nkwagye mu ahotoso.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔkasa kyerɛɛ ɔsoro wɔ ɔhyɛ so; na obuee ɔsorosoro apon.

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔɔ mana guu fam maa nnipa no sɛ wunni, ɔmaa wɔn ɔsoro aduan.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Nnipa dii abɔfo aduan; ɔmaa wɔn aduan a wobetumi adi nyinaa.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Ogyaa apuei mframa fi ɔsoro, na ofi ne tumi mu bɔɔ atɔe mframa.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔɔ nam sɛ mfutuma guu wɔn so, nnomaa a wotu bebree sɛ mpoano nwea.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Ɔma wɔbaa fam kɔɔ wɔn atenae, ne wɔn ntamadan ho nyinaa.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Wodidi maa aduan no boroo wɔn so efisɛ ɔmaa wɔn nea wɔhwehwɛ.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Nanso ansa na wobefi aduan a wɔhwehwɛ no ho, bere a ɛhyehyɛ wɔn anom mpo no,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn abufuw sɔree wɔn so; okum ahoɔdenfo a wɔwɔ wɔn mu twitwaa Israel mmerante gui.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Eyinom nyinaa akyi, wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne; nʼanwonwade akyi no, wɔannye anni.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Enti otwaa wɔn nna so te sɛ ahuru yɛɛ wɔn mfe awiei huhuuhu.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Bere biara a Onyankopɔn bekum wɔn no, wɔhwehwɛ no na wɔpere wɔn ho san ba ne nkyɛn.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Wɔkaee sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ wɔn botan, sɛ Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn no yɛ wɔn Gyefo.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Nanso wɔde wɔn ano bɛdaadaa no, na wɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma atwa atoro akyerɛ no;

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: wɔn koma nni no nokware, na wonni nʼapam no so.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Nanso na ɔyɛ ahummɔbɔ; ɔde wɔn amumɔyɛ kyɛɛ wɔn a wansɛe wɔn. Mpɛn pii, ɔtwentwɛn nʼabufuw so na wanhwie nʼabufuwhyew nyinaa.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Ɔkaee sɛ wɔyɛ ɔhonam ara kwa, mframa bi a ɛbɔ twa mu na ɛnsan nʼakyi.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Mpɛn ahe na wɔansɔre antia no wɔ sare no so hɔ, na mpɛn ahe na wɔamma ne werɛ anhow wɔ asase wosee no so!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ bere biara; na woyii Israel Ɔkronkronni no abufuw.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔn werɛ fii ne tumi no, da a ogyee wɔn fii wɔn nhyɛsofo nsam no,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: da a ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne nwonwaso wɔ Misraim no ne nʼanwonwade wɔ Soan mantam mu no.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa wɔn nsubɔnten dan mogya; wɔantumi annom wɔn nsuten mu nsu.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa nwansenadɔm baa wɔn so bɛhaw wɔn na mpɔtorɔ nso bɛsɛee wɔn asase.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa tɛwtɛw bedii wɔn mfuw so aduan na ɔde wɔn nnɔbae nso maa mmoadabi.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Ɔde mparuwbo sɛee wɔn bobe na ɔde sukyerɛmma sɛee wɔn ankye nnua.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔde sukyerɛmma kum wɔn anantwi ɔde anyinam kum wɔn nyɛmmoa.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Ohwiee nʼabufuwhyew guu wɔn so, abufuw, anibere ne ɔtan; abɔfo asɛefo kuw no.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔɔ kwan maa nʼabufuw; na wamfa wɔn nkwa ankyɛ wɔn, mmom, ɔde wɔn maa ɔyaredɔm.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: Okunkum Misraimfo mmakan nyinaa, Ham ntamadan mu nnipa mu abakan.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Nanso oyii ne nkurɔfo fii mu sɛ nguankuw; odii wɔn anim sɛ nguan wɔ sare no so.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Odii wɔn anim dwoodwoo, enti wɔansuro; nanso wɔn atamfo de, po asorɔkye bu faa wɔn so.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Sɛɛ na ɔyɛ de wɔn baa nʼasase kronkron no ahye so, bepɔw asase a ɔde ne nsa nifa gyee no.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Ɔpam amanaman a wɔwɔ wɔn anim no na ɔkyekyɛɛ wɔn nsase no mu maa wɔn sɛ wɔn agyapade; ɔbɔɔ Israel mmusuakuw no atenase wɔ wɔn afi mu.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe, na wɔsɔre tiaa Ɔsorosoroni no; na wɔanni ne mmara so.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ sɛ wɔn agyanom, wɔanni nokware na wɔannya gyidi, ahotoso nni wɔn mu na wɔte sɛ agyan a asɛe.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Wɔde wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea hyɛɛ no abufuw na wɔn ahoni maa ne ninkutwe mu yɛɛ den.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn tee wɔn nka no, ne bo fuwii; na ɔpoo Israel korakora.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Ogyaw nʼatenae a ɛwɔ Silo no, ntamadan a wasi wɔ nnipa mu no.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: Ɔde Apam Adaka a ɛyɛ ne tumi no kɔɔ nnommum mu, nʼanuonyam kɔɔ atamfo nsam.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne nkurɔfo maa afoa; ne bo fuw nʼagyapade yiye.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Ogya hyew wɔn mmerante kum wɔn, na wɔn mmabaa annya ayeforohyia dwom anto;

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Wɔn asɔfo wuwuu afoa ano, na wɔn akunafo antumi ansu.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Afei Awurade sɔree sɛnea ofi nna mu no, sɛnea ɔbarima a wabow nsa nyan fi nnahɔɔ mu no.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: Ɔbobɔɔ nʼatamfo ma woguan kɔɔ wɔn akyi; ɔhyɛɛ wɔn aniwu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Afei ɔpoo Yosef ntamadan no, na wamfa Efraim abusuakuw no nso;

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Na mmom, ɔfaa Yuda abusuakuw no, Bepɔw Sion a ɔdɔ no no.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Osii ne kronkronbea te sɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea, te sɛ asase a etim hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Oyii ne somfo Dawid, ɔfrɛɛ no fii nguannan mu;

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: fii nguan akyi na ɔde no bae se ɔmmɛyɛ oguanhwɛfo mma ne nkurɔfo Yakob, mma Israel a wɔyɛ nʼagyapade.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Na Dawid de koma pa hwɛɛ wɔn so na ɔde ne nimdeɛ dii wɔn anim.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, amanaman no atow ahyɛ wʼagyapade so; wɔagu wʼasɔredan kronkron no ho fi, wɔama Yerusalem adan nnwiriwii.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Wɔde wʼasomfo afunu ayɛ aduan ama wim nnomaa, na wɔde wʼahotefo nam ama asase so mmoa.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Wɔahwie mogya agu te sɛ nsu wɔ Yerusalem ho nyinaa, na obiara nni hɔ a obesie awufo no.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Yɛayɛ animtiaabude ama yɛn mfɛfo, fɛwdi ne nsopa ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: Awurade, enkosi da bɛn? Wo bo befuw afebɔɔ ana? Wo ninkunu bɛdɛw sɛ ogya akosi da bɛn?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Hwie wʼabufuw gu amanaman a wonnye wo nto mu no so, ahenni a wɔmmɔ wo din no;

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔakum Yakob na wɔasɛe nʼatenae.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Mfa yɛn agyanom bɔne so asotwe mma yɛn; ma wo mmɔborɔhunu mmra yɛn so ntɛm, na yɛwɔ ahohiahia mu.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn yɛn Agyenkwa, boa yɛn, wo din no anuonyam nti; gye yɛn na fa yɛn bɔne kyɛ yɛn wo din nti.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ amanaman ka se, “Wɔn Nyankopɔn wɔ he?” Yɛn anim ha ara, ma wonhu wɔ amanaman mu sɛ wotɔ wʼasomfo mogya a wɔahwie agu no so werɛ.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Ma nneduafo no apinisi nnu wʼanim; fa wo basa ahoɔden no kora wɔn a wɔabu wɔn kumfɔ no.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Awurade, ahohora a yɛn mfɛfo asum agu wo so no, tua wɔn so ka mpɛn ason.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Na yɛn a yɛyɛ wo nkurɔfo, wʼadidibea nguan no, beyi wo ayɛ daa nyinaa; efi awo ntoatoaso kosi awo ntoatoaso, yɛbɛkɔ so aka wʼayeyi akyerɛ. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo sɛ wɔnto no “Sonannim Edut” sanku nne so.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Israel guanhwɛfo, tie yɛn, wo a wudii Yosef anim sɛnea wodi nguankuw anim; wo a wote ahengua so wɔ kerubim ntam no, hyerɛn

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: wɔ Efraim, Benyamin ne Manase anim. Kanyan wo tumi; bra begye yɛn nkwa.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio; ma wʼanim nhyerɛn yɛn so, na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, wʼabufuw bɛdɛw akosi da bɛn, wʼabufuw a etia wo nkurɔfo mpaebɔ no?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Wode nusu yɛɛ aduan maa wɔn dii; wode nusu kuruwama maa wɔn nomee.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Wode yɛn ayɛ nea yɛn mfɛfo ko ho, na yɛn atamfo serew yɛn.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Asafo Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio; ma wʼanim nhyerɛn wɔ yɛn so, na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Wutuu bobe fi Misraim beduae; wopam amanaman no na wuduae.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Wosiesiee asase no baabi maa no, egyee ntin na ɛtrɛw asase no so.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Ne nwini kataa mmepɔw no so ne mman kataa sida akɛse no so.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Ɛdennan trɛw kɔɔ Po no so, na ɛfefɛw trɛw koduu Asubɔnten no ho.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na woabubu nʼafasu ama wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ no tetew ne bobe aba no?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Kɔkɔte fi wuram bɛsɛe no pasaa na mmoadoma a wɔwɔ sare so de yɛ wɔn aduan.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Asafo Nyankopɔn, san bra yɛn nkyɛn! fi ɔsoro hɔ hwɛ na wubehu! Hwɛ saa bobe yi so,

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: ntin a wo nsa nifa adua no, ɔbabarima a woatetew no ama wo ho no.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Wɔatwa wo bobe no ato fam, ato mu gya ama ahyew; wʼanimka ma wo nkurɔfo ase tɔre.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Fa wo nsa kata ɔbarima a ɔwɔ wo nifa no so, onipa ba a woatetew no ama wo ho no.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Afei yɛrentwe yɛn ho mfi wo nkyɛn; kanyan yɛn, na yɛbɛbɔ wo din.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio, na ma wʼanim nhyerɛn yɛn so, na wɔagye yɛn nkwa. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo sɛ wɔnto sɛ “gittit” sanku nne so.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Monto ahurusi dwom mma Onyankopɔn yɛn ahoɔden; mommɔ ose mma Yakob Nyankopɔn no!

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Momma nnwom no so na monwosow akasaa. Mommɔ sanku ne bɛnta dɛdɛ no.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Monhyɛn mmentia ɔsram foforo da no, ne ne kurokumatwa mu, yɛn Aponto da no;

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Otintimii sɛ nhyehyɛe maa Yosef bere a ɔsɔre tiaa Misraim no, faako a yɛtee kasa a yɛnte ase no.

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: Ɔka se, “Miyii adesoa no fii wɔn mmati so, ne wɔn nsa fii kɛntɛn ho.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Mo ahohiahia mu mofrɛɛ me na migyee mo, migyee mo so wɔ aprannaa mu; mesɔɔ mo hwɛɛ wɔ Meriba nsu ho.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: “Me nkurɔfo, muntie me kɔkɔbɔ yi, Israel, sɛ mubetie me a!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ɛnsɛ sɛ munya anyame foforo bi wɔ mo mu; ɛnsɛ sɛ mokotow ananafo anyame.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Mene Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn a miyii mo fii Misraim asase so no. Mummue mo anom tɛtrɛɛ na mɛhyɛ mu ma.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: “Nanso me nkurɔfo rentie me; Israel remmrɛ ne ho ase mma me.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Enti migyaa wɔn maa wɔn komaden sɛ wɔnyɛ nea wɔpɛ biara.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: “Sɛ me nkurɔfo tie me, na Israel nantew mʼakwan so a,

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: anka medi wɔn atamfo so ama wɔn ntɛm na mama me basa so atia wɔn a wokyi wɔn!

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔtan Awurade no de osuro bɛkotow no, na wɔn asotwe to rentwa da.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Nanso wɔde atoko mu atoko papa bɛma mo adi; mede ɔbotan mu wo bɛma mo amee.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn di hene wɔ ɔsoro asafo mu; obu atɛn wɔ “anyame” mu.

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Wobɛbɔ wɔn a wɔnteɛ ho ban na woayɛ nhwɛanim ama amumɔyɛfo akosi da bɛn?

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Monka mmɔborɔfo ne ayisaa asɛm mma wɔn; mommɔ ahiafo ne wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so yiyedi ho ban.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Munnye ɔbrɛfo ne ahiafo; munnye wɔn mfi amumɔyɛfo nsam.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: “Anyame no nnim de, na wɔnte hwee ase. Wokyinkyin wɔ sum mu; na asase fapem nyinaa wosow.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: “Mekae se, ‘Moyɛ “anyame;” mo nyinaa yɛ Ɔsorosoroni no mma.’

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Nanso mubewuwu sɛ nnipa pɛ; na moahwe ase sɛ ɔsodifo biara.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, sɔre, bu wiase atɛn; efisɛ amanaman nyinaa yɛ wo de.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, ntena hɔ komm; mmua wʼano, Ao, Onyankopɔn, keka wo ho.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛnea wʼatamfo keka wɔn ho fa, na wɔn a wɔmpɛ wʼasɛm nso ama wɔn ti so.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Wɔde anifere repam atia wo nkurɔfo, wɔrepam atia wɔn a wo koma da wɔn so no.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Wɔka se, “Mommra na yɛnsɛe wɔn sɛ ɔman, sɛnea wɔrenkae Israel din bio.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Wɔde adwene koro bɔ pɔw; na wɔpam tia wo,

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Edom ntamadan ne Ismaelfo, Moabfo ne Hagarfo,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gebalfo ne Amonfo ne Amalekfo, Filistifo ne Tirofo.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Asiria mpo akɔka wɔn ho de wɔn ahoɔden akɔhyɛ Lot asefo de no mu den.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Yɛ wɔn sɛnea woyɛɛ Midian, sɛnea woyɛɛ Sisera ne Yabin wɔ asubɔnten Kison ho no,

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔsɛe wɔ En-Dor na wɔdan nwura no.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Yɛ wɔn atitiriw sɛ Oreb ne Seeb, ne wɔn mmapɔmma nyinaa sɛ Seba ne Salmuna,

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: a wɔkae se, “Momma yɛmfa Onyankopɔn adidibea nsase no no.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn, yɛ wɔn sɛ mfɛtɛ mu mfutuma, sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ gu.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Sɛnea ogya hyew kwae, na ogyatannaa so nkoko mu hyew no no,

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: saa ara na fa wʼahum taa wɔn na fa wo mframa a ano yɛ den no hunahuna wɔn.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ma animguase nka wɔn, na ama nnipa ahwehwɛ wo din akyi kwan, Awurade.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wonni yaw; ma wonwuwu wɔ animguase mu.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Ma wonhu sɛ wo a wo din de Awurade no, wo nko ara ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase nyinaa so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo sɛ wɔnto no wɔ gittit sanku nne so.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Awurade Asafo, wʼatenae hɔ yɛ ahomeka!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Me kra pere, mpo ɛtɔ beraw, sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Awurade adiwo; me koma ne me honam teɛ mu frɛ Onyankopɔn teasefo.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Mpo akasanoma anya ofi, na asomfena nso anwen ne berebuw, faako a obesow ne mma wɔ beae bi a ɛbɛn wʼafɔremuka, Awurade Asafo, me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔte wo fi; na wɔkamfo wo din daa.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔwɔ wo mu ahoɔden, na wɔde wɔn koma fi akwantu ase kɔhwehwɛ wo.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔfa Baka Bon no mu a wɔma hɔ yɛ nsuwansuwa; asusow bere nsu so taataa hɔ.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Wɔkɔ no ahoɔden so bere nyinaa, kosi sɛ wɔn mu biara bepue Onyankopɔn anim wɔ Sion.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ; Yakob Nyankopɔn, yɛ aso ma me.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, hwɛ yɛn nkatabo; fa ahummɔbɔ hwɛ nea woasra no ngo no.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Wʼadiwo hɔ da koro tena ye sen nnafua apem wɔ baabi foforo; mepɛ sɛ mɛyɛ ɔponanohwɛfo wɔ Onyankopɔn fi sen sɛ mɛtena amumɔyɛfo ntamadan mu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Efisɛ Awurade Nyankopɔn yɛ owia ne kyɛm; Awurade hu mmɔbɔ na ɔhyɛ anuonyam; ɔmmfa ade pa biara nkame wɔn a wɔteɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: Asafo Awurade, nhyira nka onipa a ɔde ne ho to wo so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Wo Awurade, wodom wʼasase; wode Yakob ahonyade san maa no.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Wode wo nkurɔfo bɔne kyɛɛ wɔn na wokataa wɔn nnebɔne nyinaa so.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Wode wʼabufuw nyinaa too nkyɛn na wodan fii wʼabufuwhyew ho.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: San gye yɛn bio, Onyankopɔn, yɛn Gyefo, na ma wʼani nnye yɛn ho.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Wo bo befuw yɛn akosi daa ana? Wʼabufuw bɛtoa so akɔ awo ntoantoaso nyinaa so ana?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Worenhyɛ yɛn den bio, na ama wo nkurɔfo asɛpɛw wɔn ho wɔ wo mu ana?

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Metie nea Awurade Nyankopɔn bɛka; ɔde asomdwoe hyɛ ne nkurɔfo, ahotefo no bɔ, enti ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsan kɔ agyimisɛm ho.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, ne nkwagye bɛn wɔn a wosuro no, na nʼanuonyam bɛtena yɛn asase so.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔ ne nokwaredi behyia, na trenee ne asomdwoe befew wɔn ho wɔn ho ano.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Nokwaredi bepue afi asase no so, na trenee ahwɛ afi ɔsoro.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛma yɛn nea eye ampa ara na yɛn asase bɛma ne nnɔbae.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Trenee di nʼanim siesie ɔkwan ma nʼanammɔntu.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Awurade, tie me na gye me so, efisɛ meyɛ ohiani ne mmɔborɔni.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Bɔ me nkwa ho ban, efisɛ mede me ho ama wo. Wo ne me Nyankopɔn, gye wʼakoa a ɔde ne ho to wo so.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Awurade, hu me mmɔbɔ, na misu frɛ wo daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Ma wʼakoa ani nnye, na wo Awurade, wo nkyɛn na mema me kra so ba.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Awurade, wuye na wode bɔne kyɛ, wowɔ ɔdɔ mmoroso ma wɔn a wosu frɛ wo nyinaa.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ; tie me mmɔborɔsu.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Mɛfrɛ wo mʼahohia da mu, na wubegye me so.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: Awurade, onyame bi nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ wo; na wɔn nnwuma biara nto wo de.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Awurade, aman a woakyekyere nyinaa bɛba abɛsom wo wɔ wʼanim; wɔbɛba abɛhyɛ wo din anuonyam.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Woyɛ ɔkɛse na woyɛ anwonwa nnwuma; wo nko ara ne Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Awurade, kyerɛ me wʼakwan, na mɛnantew wo nokware mu; ma memfa me koma nyinaa mma wo na masuro wo din.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Mede me koma nyinaa meyi wo ayɛ, Awurade me Nyankopɔn na mahyɛ wo din anuonyam daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Efisɛ ɔdɔ a wode dɔ me no so; woayi me afi owu amoa mu tɔnn.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, ahomasofo atow ahyɛ me so; basabasayɛfo kuw rehwehwɛ me akum me, nnipa a wɔmmfa wo nyɛ hwee no.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Nanso wo, Awurade, woyɛ mmɔborɔhunufo ne ɔdomfo Nyankopɔn, wo bo kyɛ fuw, na wʼadɔe ne wo nokware dɔɔso.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Dan wʼani hwɛ me na dom me; fa wʼahoɔden ma wʼakoa na gye wʼafenaa babarima nkwa.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Ma me wo papayɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnne, na mʼatamfo nhu na wɔn anim ngu ase na wo, Awurade, wo na woaboa me akyekye me werɛ.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Wato ne fapem wɔ bepɔw kronkron no so;

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Awurade dɔ Sion apon no sen Yakob atenae nyinaa.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: “Mede Rahab ne Babilonia bɛka wɔn a wɔyɛ osetie ma me no ho, Filistia, Tiro ne Kus nso na maka se, ‘Wɔwoo eyinom wɔ Sion.’ ”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Ampa ara wɔbɛka afa Sion ho se, “Wɔwoo oyi ne ɔno wɔ no mu, na Ɔsorosoroni no ankasa de no betim hɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛkyerɛw wɔ nnipa dinkyerɛw nhoma no mu se, “Wɔwoo oyi wɔ Sion.”

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Na wɔbɛto dwom se, “Me ntin nyinaa wɔ wo mu.” Kora mma dwom a wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo sɛ wɔnto no “Mahalat Leannot” sanku so.

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Awurade, woyɛ me nkwagye Nyankopɔn misu wɔ wʼanim adekyee ne adesae.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Ma me mpaebɔ nnu wʼanim; brɛ wʼaso ase tie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Ɔhaw ahyɛ me kra ma na me nkwa rebɛn owu.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Wɔkan me fra wɔn a wɔrekɔ ɔda mu no; mete sɛ obi a onni ahoɔden.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Wɔayi me asi nkyɛn wɔ awufo mu, te sɛ atɔfo a wɔdeda ɔda mu, wɔn a wonkae wɔn bio, na wonhwɛ wɔn bio.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Woatow me akyene ɔda ase tɔnn, wɔ sum kabii mu.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Wʼabufuwhyew ayɛ duru wɔ me so; woama wʼasorɔkye nyinaa abu afa me so.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Woafa me nnamfonom a wɔbɛn me afi me nkyɛn woama me ho ayɛ wɔn ahi. Woaka me ahyɛ mu na mintumi nguan;

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: awerɛhow ama mʼani so ayɛ kusuu. Awurade misu frɛ wo da biara; metrɛw me nsam kyerɛ wo.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Woyɛ anwonwade kyerɛ awufo ana? Wɔn a wɔawuwu no sɔre kamfo wo ana?

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Wɔka wʼadɔe ho asɛm wɔ ɔda mu, anaasɛ wo nokware ho asɛm wɔ ɔsɛe kurom ana?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Wohu wʼanwonwade wɔ beae a hɔ aduru sum, anaa wo trenee nnwuma no wɔ awerɛfiri asase so ana?

english_verse: Each morning I pray to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Nanso Awurade, misu frɛ wo sɛ boa me; me mpaebɔ du wʼanim adekyee mu.

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Adɛn, Awurade, na wopo me na wode wʼanim hintaw me?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Mahu amane fi me mmofraase na mabɛn owu; wʼahunahuna ama mabrɛ na mapa abaw.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Wʼabufuwhyew abu afa me so; wʼahunahuna asɛe me.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Daa nyinaa wotwa me ho hyia sɛ nsuyiri, na wɔabu afa me so koraa.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Woafa me yɔnkonom ne mʼadɔfo afi me nkyɛn kɔ; na sum ayɛ mʼadamfo a ɔbɛn me pɛɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Mɛto Awurade adɔe ho dwom daa daa; mede mʼano bɛda wo nokwaredi adi awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Mɛka se wʼadɔe no tim hɔ daa nyinaa, na woatim wo nokwaredi wɔ ɔsoro hɔ ankasa.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Wokae se, “Mene onipa a mayi no no ayɛ apam; maka ntam akyerɛ me somfo Dawid.

english_verse: David, one of your descendants will always be king.”
translation_verse: ‘Mɛma wʼase atim hɔ daa na wʼahengua nso atim wɔ awo ntoantoaso nyinaa mu.’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Awurade, ɔsorosorofo kamfo wʼanwonwade, na wo nokwaredi nso, wɔkamfo wɔ ahotefo asafo mu.

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Na hena na ɔne wo Awurade sɛ wɔ ɔsoro hɔ? Hena na ɔte sɛ Awurade wɔ ɔsoro abɔde mu?

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Akronkronfo agyinatufo mu, wosuro Onyankopɔn; wɔde osuro kɛse ma Onyankopɔn wɔ akronkronfo nhyiamu ase.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, hena na ɔte sɛ wo? Wo, Awurade, woyɛ ɔkɛse na wo nokwaredi atwa wo ho ahyia.

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Wudi po a ɛworo no so; nʼasorɔkye bobɔ kɔ soro a, wobrɛ no ase.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Wodwerɛw Rahab sɛ atɔfo no mu baako; wode wo basa dennen no bɔɔ wʼatamfo pansamee.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Ɔsoro wɔ wo, na asase nso wɔ wo; wiase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa wo na wufii ase.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Wobɔɔ atifi ne anafo. Tabor ne Hermon de ahosɛpɛw to dwom ma wo din.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Wʼahengua no fapem yɛ trenee ne atɛntrenee; adɔe ne nokwaredi di wʼanim.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔasua sɛnea wɔbɔ wo abodin, wɔn a wɔnantew wʼanim hann no mu, Awurade.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Wogye wɔn ani wɔ wo din mu da mu nyinaa; wodi ahurusi wɔ wo trenee mu.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Wone wɔn anuonyam ne ahoɔden, na wʼadom nti yɛyɛ nkonimdifo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, yɛn kyɛm wɔ Awurade, na yɛn hene wɔ Israel Kronkronni no.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Da bi wokasaa wɔ anisoadehu mu, kyerɛɛ wʼahotefo se, “Madom ɔkofo bi ahoɔden; mapagyaw aberante bi afi nnipa no mu.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Mahu Dawid, me somfo; mede me ngo kronkron no asra no.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Me nsa bɛwowaw no; ampa ara me basa bɛhyɛ no den.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Ɔtamfo biara renhyɛ no sɛ ontua tow; omumɔyɛfo biara rentumi nhyɛ no so.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Mɛdwerɛw nʼatamfo wɔ nʼanim na mabobɔ nʼahohiahiafo ahwe fam.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Me nokware adɔe bɛka ne ho, na me din mu, wɔbɛma nʼabɛn so.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Mɛtrɛw nʼahye mu akosi po so, na ɔde ne nsa nifa bɛto nsubɔnten so.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Ɔbɛfrɛ me aka se, ‘Wone mʼagya, me Nyankopɔn, me nkwagye botan.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Mɛyɛ no mʼabakan, asase so ahene nyinaa no mu ɔkɛse.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Mɛma mʼadɔe a mewɔ ma no no atena hɔ daa, na apam a me ne no ayɛ nso bɛtena hɔ daa.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Mɛma nʼase atim afebɔɔ, nʼahengua nso betim hɔ akosi sɛ ɔsoro betwa mu.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ne mmabarima po me mmara na sɛ wɔanni mʼahyɛde so,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: sɛ wobu mʼahyɛde so na sɛ wɔanni me hyɛ nsɛm so a,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: ɛno de mede abaa bɛtwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho na wɔn amumɔyɛ nso mede mmaatwa atwe wɔn aso;

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Nanso merennyae mʼadɔe a meyɛ ma no no na mɛkɔ so adi no nokware.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Meremmu mʼapam no so na merensesa nea mede mʼano aka no.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Menam me din kronkron no so aka ntam prɛko, na merentwa Dawid atoro da,

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: meremma nʼase ntɔre da na nʼahengua nso betim wɔ mʼanim te sɛ owia;

english_verse: and moon appear in the sky.”
translation_verse: ebetim hɔ daa te sɛ ɔsram, ɔdanseni nokwafo a ɔwɔ wim no.”

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Nanso woapo no, woapa nʼakyi, wo bo afuw nea woasra no ngo no.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Woagu apam a wo ne wo somfo pamee no, woagu nʼahenkyɛw ho fi wɔ mfutuma mu.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ nyinaa fow no fa; na wayɛ aniwude ama ne mfɛfo.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Woama nʼatamfo nsa nifa so; ama wɔn nyinaa di ahurusi.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Woama nʼafoa ayɛ ɔkwa, na woannyina nʼakyi wɔ ɔko mu.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wode nʼanuonyam aba awiei na woatow nʼahengua akyene fam.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Woatwa ne mmerantebere nna so na wode animguase nguguso akata no so.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: Awurade, enkosi da bɛn? Na wode wo ho behintaw? Wʼabufuwhyew bɛkɔ so adɛw akosi da bɛn?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Kae sɛnea me nkwanna twa mu ntɛm so. Efisɛ woabɔ yɛn nyinaa sɛ ade a etwa mu ntɛm so!

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Hena na ɔbɛtena ase a ɔrenwu da? Anaasɛ hena na obetumi agye ne ho afi owu tumi nsam?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Awurade, ɛhe na wo tete adɔe kɛse no wɔ, nea wufi wo nokwaredi mu de kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid no?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Kae, Awurade, sɛnea wɔadi wo somfo ho fɛw ne sɛnea manya koma ama amanaman no akutiabɔ,

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Awurade, akutiabɔ a wʼatamfo de adi fɛw de adi nea woasra no ngo no anammɔntu biara ho fɛw.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ayeyi nka Awurade daa! Amen, Amen.

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nipa Mose mpaebɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo na woayɛ yɛn tenabea awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Ansa na wɔrebɛbɔ mmepɔw anaasɛ worebɛda asase ne wiase adi no, na woyɛ Onyankopɔn fi mmeresanten kosi mmeresanten.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Woma adesamma san dan mfutuma, ka se, “Mo adesamma, monsan nkɔ mfutuma mu.”

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Mfirihyia apem yɛ wʼani so sɛ da koro a abɛsen mprempren, anaasɛ anadwo mu dɔnhwerew kakraa bi.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Wopra nnipa kɔ, wɔ owu nna mu; wɔte sɛ sare a afefɛw anɔpa,

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: ɛfefɛw yɛ frɔmfrɔm anɔpa de, nanso anwummere ɛwo na etwintwam.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Yɛresa wɔ wʼabufuw ano na wʼanibere abɔ yɛn hu.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Wode yɛn amumɔyɛ asi wʼanim, na yɛn kokoa mu bɔne da wʼanim hann no mu.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Yɛn nna nyinaa twa mu wɔ wʼabufuwhyew mu; na yɛde awerɛhowdi na ewie yɛn mfe.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Yɛn nkwa nna si mfe aduɔson, anaasɛ aduɔwɔtwe, sɛ yɛwɔ ahoɔden a; na mu ahohoahoade yɛ ɔhaw ne awerɛhow, na etwa mu ntɛmntɛm, na yetu kɔ.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Sɛ anka yebehu sɛ wʼabufuw mu tumi te ɛ! Wʼabufuwhyew kɛse te sɛnea wo ho suro te.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Ma yenhu yɛn nna kan sɛnea ɛte, na yɛanya nyansa koma.

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: Tɔ wo bo ase, Awurade, enkosi da bɛn? Hu wʼasomfo mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Ma wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no mmee yɛn adekyee mu, na yɛde anigye ato dwom adi ahurusi yɛn nna nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Ma yɛn ani nnye nna bebree sɛ nna dodow a wode yɛn kɔɔ amanehunu mu no, sɛ mfirihyia dodow a yehuu ateetee no.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Ma wʼasomfo nhu wo nneyɛe na wɔn mma nhu wʼanuonyam.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Ma Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn adom no ntena yɛn so; na yɛn nsa ano adwuma nyɛ yiye mma yɛn; yiw, ma yɛn nsa ano adwuma nyɛ yiye.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nea ɔte Ɔsorosoroni no hintabea no biara bɛhome wɔ Otumfo no nwini ase.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: Mese Awurade se, “Ɔyɛ me guankɔbea ne mʼabandennen, me Nyankopɔn a mewɔ no mu ahotoso.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, obegye wo afi firisumfo afiri ne owuyare mu.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne ntakra bɛkata wo so; na ne ntaban ase na wubenya guankɔbea; ne nokware bɛyɛ wo nkatabo ne wo kyɛm.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Worensuro ɔdasu mu ɔsɛe, anaa bɛmma a etu awia,

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: anaa owuyare a ɛba sum mu, anaa ɔyaredɔm a ɛsɛe ade wɔ owigyinae bere.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Apem bɛtotɔ wo nkyɛn mu, na mpem du atotɔ wo nifa a, wo de, ɛremmɛn wo.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Wʼaniwa nko ara na wode bɛhwɛ na woahu nnebɔneyɛfo asotwe.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Sɛ woka se, “Awurade ne me guankɔbea,” na wode Ɔsorosoroni no hɔ yɛ wo tenabea a,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: ɔhaw biara remmunkam wo so, na ɔsɛe biara remmɛn wo ntamadan.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Efisɛ Onyankopɔn bɛsoma nʼabɔfo abɛbɔ wo ho ban na wɔabɛwɛn wo wʼakwan nyinaa mu;

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: wɔde wɔn nsa bɛma wo so, na wo nan ampem ɔbo.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Wubetiatia gyata ne aprammiri so, wobɛnantew gyataforo ne ɔwɔ so.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Awurade ka se, “Esiane sɛ ɔdɔ me nti, megye no; mɛbɔ ne ho ban, efisɛ ogye me din to mu.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛfrɛ me na megye ne so; mɛka ne ho wɔ amanehunu mu, megye no na mahyɛ no anuonyam.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Mɛma nkwa nna a ɛware amee no na makyerɛ no me nkwagye.”

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Eye sɛ wɔkamfo wo Awurade na wɔto dwom de hyɛ wo anuonyam, Ɔsorosoroni,

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: na wɔpae mu ka wʼadɔe anɔpa ne wo nokware anadwo,

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: wɔ hama du sanku so ne sankuten nnwom mu.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo nneyɛe ma mʼani gye; mede anigye to nnwom, wo nsa ano nnwuma nti.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Awurade, wo nnwuma yɛ akɛse, na wo nyansa mu dɔ!

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Agyimifo nnim na nkwaseafo nte ase,

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: amumɔyɛfo benyin sɛ sare na abɔnefo bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm de, nanso wɔbɛsɛe wɔn pasaa.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Na wo Awurade, wɔayɛ wo ɔkɛse afebɔɔ.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Awurade, ampa ara, wʼatamfo bɛyera; na wɔbɛhwete abɔnefo nyinaa.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Woama me ahoɔden te sɛ ɛko; woahwie ngohuam papa agu me so.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Mahu mʼatamfo nkogu a wɔadi, mate sɛnea mʼatamfo atirimɔdenfo aguan afi akono.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Atreneefo bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm te sɛ abedua, wobenyin sɛ Lebanon sida;

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: nea wɔadua wɔ Awurade fi, wobenyin frɔmfrɔm wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn adiwo hɔ.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛkɔ so asow aba, onyinkyɛ mu mpo, wɔbɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ ahabammono,

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: de akyerɛ sɛ, “Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni; ɔyɛ me botan, na atirimɔdensɛm biara nni ne mu.”
