english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Awurade di hene, wɔde tumi ahentade ahyɛ no; wɔde tumi ahentade ahyɛ Awurade na wɔde ahoɔden ayɛ nʼakode. Wɔde wiase atim hɔ pintinn; na wɔrentumi ntutu.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Wʼahengua tim hɔ fi tete; na wowɔ hɔ fi mmeresanten.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Awurade, po ama wɔn ho so, po ama wɔn nne so; po ama wɔn asorɔkye a ɛbɔ dennen no so.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Nea ɔwɔ tumi sen nsu akɛse mmubomu, nea ɔwɔ tumi sen po nworoso, Awurade a ɔte ɔsoro no yɛ ɔkɛse.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo nhyehyɛe gyina hɔ pintinn; kronkronyɛ hyɛ wo fi anuonyam daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: Awurade, Onyankopɔn a wotɔ were, Onyankopɔn a wotɔ were, hyerɛn.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Sɔre, asase so Temmufo, tua ahantanfo ka sɛnea ɛfata wɔn.

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: Awurade, enkosi da bɛn, amumɔyɛfo nnye wɔn ani nkosi da bɛn?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Wɔkasa ahantan so; ahohoahoa ahyɛ abɔnefo nyinaa ma.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: Awurade, wɔdwerɛw wo nkurɔfo; wɔhyɛ wʼagyapade so.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Wokunkum akunafo ne ananafo; na wodi ayisaa awu.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Wɔka se, “Awurade nhu, Yakob Nyankopɔn ayi nʼani.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: Monhwɛ yiye, mo agyimifo a mowɔ nnipa no mu; nkwaseafo, da bɛn na mubehu nyansa?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɔɔ aso no rente asɛm ana? Nea ɔyɛɛ ani no renhu ade ana?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Nea ɔteɛteɛ aman so no rentwe aso ana? Nea ɔkyerɛkyerɛ onipa no nnim nyansa ana?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Awurade nim onipa nsusuwii; onim sɛ enkosi hwee.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Awurade, nhyira ne onipa a woteɛteɛ no so, onipa a wokyerɛ no wo mmara no;

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Woma ɔhome fi amanehunu nna mu, kosi sɛ wobetu amoa ama amumɔyɛfo.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Awurade rempo ne nkurɔfo; na ɔrennyaw nʼagyapade hɔ da.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Atemmu begyina treneeyɛ so bio, na wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew nyinaa bedi so.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Hena na ɔbɛsɔre atia amumɔyɛfo ama me? Hena na ɔbɛsɔre atia abɔnefo ama me?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Sɛ Awurade ammoa me a, anka mekɔɔ owu kommyɛ mu ntɛm so.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Bere a mekae se, “Me nan rewatiri” no, Awurade, wo dɔ no soo me mu.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Bere a me dadwen dɔɔso no, wʼawerɛkyekye maa me kra abotɔyam.

english_verse: who gang up to murder innocent victims.
translation_verse: Wɔka bɔ mu tia atreneefo na wɔn a wodi bem no, wobu wɔn kumfɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Nanso Awurade yɛ mʼaban; na me Nyankopɔn ayɛ ɔbotan a ne mu na minya ahintawee.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Obetua wɔn nnebɔne no so ka na wɔn amumɔyɛ nti wasɛe wɔn; Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛsɛe wɔn.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Mommra mma yɛnto dwom wɔ anigye so mma Awurade; momma yɛmmɔ ose mma yɛn nkwagye Botan no.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Momma yɛmfa aseda mmra nʼanim, na yɛmfa ahosɛpɛw nnwom mma no so.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Efisɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn kɛse, ɔhenkɛse wɔ anyame nyinaa so.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Ne nsam na asase mu nneɛma nyinaa wɔ, na mmepɔw mpampam wɔ no.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Po wɔ no, ɔno na ɔbɔe, na ne nsa na ɛnwenee asase kesee no.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: Mommra, mma yɛnkotow nsom no. Momma yemmu nkotodwe wɔ Awurade yɛn Yɛfo no anim!

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn; yɛyɛ ne didibea nnipa, ne nguankuw a ɔhwɛ wɔn so. Nnɛ, sɛ mote ne nne a,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: mummpirim mo koma sɛnea moyɛɛ wɔ Meriba no, sɛnea moyɛɛ da no wɔ Masa, sare no so no,

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ no, mo mpanyimfo sɔɔ no hwɛe, a na wonim nea meyɛ maa wɔn.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Me bo fuw saa nnipa no mfe aduanan na mekae se, “Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn koma aman afi me ho, na wɔanhu mʼakwan.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Ɛno nti mekaa ntam wɔ mʼabufuw mu se, “Wɔrenhyɛn mʼahomegye mu da.”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade; asase nyinaa monto dwom mma Awurade.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Monto dwom mma Awurade, monkamfo ne din; mompae mu nka ne nkwagye no daa daa.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Monka nʼanuonyam wɔ amanaman mu, monka nʼanwonwade a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔkɛse na nkamfo fata no; ɛsɛ sɛ wosuro no sen anyame nyinaa.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Aman so anyame nyinaa yɛ ahoni bi kwa, nanso Awurade na ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Anuonyam ne kɛseyɛ wɔ nʼanim; ahoɔden ne anuonyam wɔ ne kronkronbea hɔ.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Momfa mma Awurade, amanaman mmusuakuw, momfa anuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Momfa anuonyam ne din a ɛfata mma Awurade; momfa afɔrebɔde nhyɛn nʼadiwo hɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Monsɔre Awurade wɔ ne kronkronyɛ fɛfɛ mu; asase nyinaa momma mo ho mpopo wɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Monka nkyerɛ aman nyinaa se, “Awurade di hene.” Wɔabɔ asase atim hɔ pintinn, wɔrentumi ntutu; ɔde pɛpɛyɛ bebu nnipa atɛn.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Momma ɔsorosoro ani nnye, na asase nni ahurusi; momma po ne mu nneɛma nyinaa nworo;

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Momma mfuw ne so nneɛma nyinaa mmɔ ose; momma kwae mu nnua nyinaa mfa ahosɛpɛw nto nnwom.

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: Momma abɔde nyinaa nni ahurusi wɔ Awurade anim, efisɛ ɔreba, ɔreba abebu asase no atɛn. Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛn na woabu nnipa nso atɛn wɔ ne nokware mu.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Awurade di hene, ma asase ani nnye; ma akyirikyiri mpoano ahorow no nsɛpɛw wɔn ho.

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Omununkum ne sum kabii atwa no ho ahyia; trenee ne atɛntrenee yɛ nʼahengua no fapem.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Ogya di nʼanim na ɛhyew nʼatamfo wɔ afanan nyinaa.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Nʼanyinam hyerɛn wiase; asase hu na ne ho popo.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Mmepɔw nan sɛ nku wɔ Awurade anim, Awurade a asase nyinaa wɔ no no anim.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne trenee kyerɛ na aman nyinaa hu nʼanuonyam.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ahonisomfo nyinaa anim agu ase, wɔn a wɔde abosomhuhuw hoahoa wɔn ho no, anyame nyinaa monsɔre no.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Sion te, na ne ho sɛpɛw no na Yuda nkuraa ani gye Awurade, esiane wʼatɛntrenee nti.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Wo, Awurade ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase so nyinaa; wɔama wo so pa ara wɔ anyame nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ Awurade no nkyi bɔne, ɔbɔ ne nkurɔfo a wɔyɛ nokwafo no ho ban na ogye wɔn fi amumɔyɛfo nsam.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Hann hyerɛn wɔ atreneefo so na anigye ba wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew no so.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Momma mo ani nnye Awurade mu, mo a moyɛ atreneefo, na monkamfo ne din kronkron no.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade, efisɛ wayɛ anwonwade bebree; ne nsa nifa ne ne basa kronkron no anya nkwagye ama no.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Awurade ama wɔahu ne nkwagye na wada ne trenee adi akyerɛ amanaman no.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wakae nʼadɔe ne ne nokware a odi kyerɛɛ Israelfo no; asase ano nyinaa ahu yɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagye.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asase nyinaa mommɔ ose mma Awurade, momfa nnwonto nni ahurusi;

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Momfa sanku nto dwom mma Awurade, sanku ne nnwonto nnyigyei,

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: momfa torobɛnto ne adwennini mmɛn, nteɛ mu ahosɛpɛw so wɔ Awurade, yɛn hene no anim.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Momma po ne abɔde a ɛwɔ mu nyinaa nhuru so; asase ne wɔn a wɔte so nyinaa.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Momma nsubɔnten mmɔ wɔn nsam, mmepɔw nka mmom nto ahurusi nnwom;

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: ma wɔnto nnwom wɔ Awurade anim, efisɛ ɔreba abebu wiase atɛn. Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛn na ɔde pɛpɛyɛ abu nnipa atɛn.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Awurade di hene, momma amanaman no ho mpopo; ɔte nʼahengua so wɔ kerubim ntam, ma asase nwosow.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Awurade a ɔwɔ Sion yɛ ɔkɛse; wɔama no so wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnkamfo wo din a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwonwa no, ɔyɛ ɔkronkron.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔhene no yɛ ɔkɛse, ɔdɔ atɛntrenee, woama pɛpɛyɛ atim; wayɛ nea eye na ɛteɛ wɔ Yakob mu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Momma Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn so na monsɔre no wɔ ne nan ntiaso anim; ɔyɛ ɔkronkron.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron ka nʼasɔfo no ho, na Samuel ka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ ne din no ho; wɔfrɛɛ Awurade, na ogyee wɔn so.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Ofi omununkum dum mu kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn; wodii mmara ne ahyɛde a ɔmaa wɔn no so.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn, wugyee wɔn so; woyɛɛ bɔnefakyɛ Nyankopɔn maa Israel, nanso wotwee wɔn aso wɔ wɔn nnebɔne ho.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Momma Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn so na monsɔre no wɔ ne bepɔw kronkron no so, na Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔkronkron.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Mommɔ ose mma Awurade, asase nyinaa.

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Momfa ahosɛpɛw nsom Awurade; momfa anigye nnwom mmra nʼanim.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Munhu sɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn; ɔno na ɔyɛɛ yɛn, na yɛyɛ ne de; yɛyɛ ne nkurɔfo ne ne didibea nguan.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Momfa aseda nhyɛn nʼapon mu, na momfa nkamfo nkɔ nʼadiwo; momfa aseda mma no, na monkamfo ne din.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Awurade ye; na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa; ne nokwaredi kodu awo ntoatoaso nyinaa so.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Mɛto wo dɔ ne wo trenee ho nnwom; Awurade, mɛto ayeyi nnwom ama wo.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Mɛhwɛ yiye abu ɔbra a ho tew; da bɛn na wobɛba me nkyɛn? Mede koma a afɔdi nni mu bɛhwɛ me fi so.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Merennye ade a ɛyɛ tan biara nto mu. Mikyi nnipa a wonni gyidi nneyɛe; meremfa me ho mmata ho.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Nnipa a wɔn koma yɛ kɔntɔnkye remmɛn me; me ne bɔne nni hwee yɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Obiara a odi ne yɔnko ho nseku wɔ kokoa mu no, ɔno na mɛsɛe; nea ɔwɔ ahantan ani ne ahomaso koma, ɔno na merennyigye no so.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Mʼani bɛkɔ anokwafo a wɔwɔ asase no so no so na me ne wɔn atena; nea ne nantew ho nni asɛm no ɔno na ɔbɛsom me.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Nea ɔyɛ ɔdaadaafo biara rentena me fi; nea otwa nkontompo no rennyina mʼanim.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Adekyee biara, mɛsɛe amumɔyɛfo a wɔwɔ asase yi so nyinaa; na mapam ɔdebɔneyɛni biara afi Awurade kuropɔn mu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ; na ma me mmoa ho sufrɛ nnu wʼanim.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Mmfa wʼanim nhintaw me bere a mewɔ ahohia mu. Brɛ wʼaso ase ma me; na sɛ misu frɛ wo a, gye me so ntɛm.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Me nkwanna reyera te sɛ wusiw; me nnompe adɔ sɛ nyansramma.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Me koma abotow na akisa sɛ sare; na me kɔn nnɔ aduan.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Mʼapinisi dennen nti maka ɔhonam ne nnompe.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Mete sɛ sare so patu, te sɛ patu a ɔte nnwiriwii mu.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Da mu nyinaa mʼatamfo bɔ me akutia. Wɔn a wodi me ho fɛw no bɔ me din de dome.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Mede nsõ ayɛ mʼaduan na mede nusu fra me nsu mu

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: esiane wʼabufuwhyew dennen no nti, woama me so, ayi me asi nkyɛn.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Me nkwa nna te sɛ anwummere sunsuma; na mehyew sɛ sare.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Nanso wo Awurade, woyɛ ɔhene daa daa; na wo din a ahyeta no te hɔ daa awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Wobɛsɔre na woahu Sion mmɔbɔ; bere adu sɛ wuhu no mmɔbɔ; bere a wohyɛe no aso.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Nʼabo som bo ma wʼasomfo; ne mfutuma hyɛ wɔn awerɛhow.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Amanaman no besuro Awurade din; asase so ahemfo nyinaa bedi wʼanuonyam ni.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Awurade bɛkyekyere Sion bio, na wapue wɔ nʼanuonyam mu.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Obetie mmɔborɔfo mpaebɔ; na ɔremmu nʼani ngu wɔn sufrɛ so.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Monkyerɛw eyi mma nkyirimma, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wonnya nwoo wɔn no bɛkamfo Awurade;

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: “Awurade hwɛɛ fam fi ne kronkronbea wɔ ɔsoro hɔ; ofi ɔsoro hwɛɛ asase,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: sɛnea ɔbɛte nneduafo apinisi, na wɔagyaa wɔn a wɔabu wɔn kumfɔ no.”

english_verse: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord,
translation_verse: Enti wɔbɛpae mu abɔ Awurade din wɔ Sion na wɔakamfo no wɔ Yerusalem,

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: bere a amanaman ne ahenni ahorow behyia mu na wɔasom Awurade.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa me yɛɛ mmerɛw wɔ bere a merenyin. Otwaa me nkwa nna so.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Enti mekae se, “Me Onyankopɔn, mfa me nkɔ, wɔ me nkwa nna mfimfini; wo mfe wɔ hɔ daa kodu awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Mfiase no wotoo asase fapem, na ɔsoro yɛ wo nsa ano adwuma.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa betwa mu na wo de, wobɛtena hɔ daa; wɔbɛtetew te sɛ atade. Wobɛsesa wɔn te sɛ ntama, na wɔbɛtow wɔn agu.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Nanso wote sɛnea wote, na wo mfe to rentwa da.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Wʼasomfo mma bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim; na wɔn asefo ase betim wɔ wʼanim.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Me kra, kamfo Awurade; na me mu ade nyinaa nkamfo ne din kronkron no.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Me kra, kamfo Awurade, na mma wo werɛ mmfi ne nneyɛe pa nyinaa,

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔde wo mfomso nyinaa kyɛ wo na ɔsa wo nyarewa nyinaa,

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: ogye wo nkwa fi ɔda mu, na ɔde adɔe ne mmɔborɔhunu bɔ wo abotiri,

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: ɔde nnepa ma wo sɛ wʼapɛde, na wo mmerantebere yɛ foforo sɛ ɔkɔre.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ adetrenee, na obu wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so nyinaa atɛntrenee.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Ɔkyerɛɛ Mose nʼakwan, na ɔmaa Israelfo huu ne nneyɛe.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Mmɔborɔhunufo ne ɔdomfo ne Awurade, ne bo kyɛ fuw na nʼadɔe dɔɔso.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Ɔrenkɔ so mmɔ sobo, na ɔrennya yɛn ho menasepɔw nkosi daa;

english_verse: he doesn't punish us as our sins deserve.
translation_verse: Ɔnhwɛ yɛn bɔne ne yɛn nni sɛnea ɛfata na ontua yɛn nnebɔne so ka sɛnea ɛte.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Na sɛnea ɔsoro ne asase ntam ware no, saa ara na nʼadɔe so wɔ wɔn a wosuro no no so.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Sɛnea apuei ne atɔe ntam ware no, saa ara na wama yɛn ne yɛn mmarato ntam kwan aware.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Sɛnea agya yam hyehyew no wɔ ne mma ho no, saa ara na Awurade yam hyehye no ma wɔn a wosuro no no;

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: na onim sɛnea wɔyɛɛ yɛn, ɔkae se yɛyɛ mfutuma.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Ɔdesani de, ne nna te sɛ sare, ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ nwura mu nhwiren;

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: sɛ mframa bɔ fa ne so a, na onni hɔ, na ne sibea nkae no bio.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Nanso efi mmeresanten kosi nnasanten Awurade adɔe wɔ wɔn a wosuro no so, na ne trenee wɔ wɔn mma mma so,

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Awurade asi nʼahengua wɔ ɔsoro, na nʼahenni di ade nyinaa so.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼabɔfo, mo atumfo a moyɛ nʼahyɛde, mo a mutie nʼasɛm.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, nʼasomfo a moyɛ nʼapɛde.

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, ne nnwuma nyinaa; nea ɛwɔ nʼahenni mu nyinaa. Me kra, kamfo Awurade!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Me kra, kamfo Awurade! Awurade me Nyankopɔn, woyɛ ɔkɛse! Wɔafura wo tumi ne anuonyam.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Ɔde hann akata ne ho sɛ atade; ɔtrɛw ɔsoro mu te sɛ ntamadan,

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: na ɔde ne mpia mu mpuran sisi nsu so. Ɔde omununkum yɛ ne teaseɛnam na ɔde nantew mframa ntaban so.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Ɔsoma nʼabɔfo sɛ mframa, na ɔsoma nʼasomfo sɛ ogyaframa.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Ɔde asase asi ne fapem so na ɛrenhinhim da.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Wode bun kataa so sɛ atade na nsu gyinaa mmepɔw no so.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Nanso wʼanimka maa nsu no guanee, wʼaprannaa nnyigyei maa woguanee;

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Wɔsen faa mmepɔw so, kɔɔ aku mu tɔnn, koguu faako a wode ama wɔn no.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Wotoo ɔhye a wɔrentumi ntra; na wɔammɛkata asase so bio.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Ɔma nsuwa sen fa abon mu, ɛsen fa mmepɔw ntam.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Wɔma wuram mmoa nyinaa nsu nom; atorɔm de kum wɔn sukɔm.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Wim nnomaa nwen wɔn berebuw wɔ nsu no ho; na wɔto nnwom wɔ nnua no mman so.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Ofi ne soro mpia mu tɔ nsu gugu mmepɔw so; ne nnwuma so aba mee asase.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Ɔma sare fifi ma anantwi, na ɔbɔɔ nnua maa onipa sɛ onnua na ɛmma aduan mfi asase mu:

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: nsa a ɛma onipa koma tɔ ne yam, ngo a ɛma onipa anim tɔ so, ne aduan a ekura onipa koma.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Wogugu Awurade nnua no so yiye, Lebanon sida a oduae no.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Ɛsow na nnomaa yɛ wɔn mmerebuw, na asukɔnkɔn nso yɛ nʼatenae wɔ ɔpepaw nnua no mu.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Mmepɔw atenten no yɛ wuram mmirekyi de; na abotan yɛ guankɔbea ma ewi.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Ɔsram kyerɛ bere nkyekyɛmu, na owia nim bere a ɔkɔtɔ.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Wode sum ba ma ɛyɛ adesae na kwae mu mmoa nyinaa kɔ ahayɛ.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Gyata bobɔ mu pɛ wɔn hanam, wɔhwehwɛ wɔn aduan fi Onyankopɔn hɔ.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Owia pue ma wɔsan wɔn akyi; wɔsan kɔdeda wɔn atu mu.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Afei, onipa kɔ nʼadwuma so kɔyɛ adwuma ara kosi anwummere.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo nnwuma dɔɔso! Nyansa mu na woyɛɛ ne nyinaa; wʼabɔde ahyɛ asase so ma.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Po na ɛda hɔ tɛtrɛɛ tamaa yi, a abɔde bebree a enni ano; akɛse ne nketewa ahyɛ no ma.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: So na ahyɛn di akɔneaba, na ɔdɛnkyɛmmirampɔn a woyɛɛ no di agoru.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Wɔn nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan sɛ wobɛma wɔn wɔn aduan wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Wode ma wɔn a, wɔtase; wubue wo nsam a nnepa mee wɔn.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Wode wʼanim hintaw wɔn a, wɔbɔ hu; sɛ wugye wɔn home a, wowuwu na wɔsan kɔ mfutuma mu.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Sɛ wode wo Honhom no ma wɔn a na wɔabɔ wɔn, na woyɛ asase ani foforo.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Ma Awurade anuonyam ntena hɔ daa; ma Awurade ani nnye ne nnwuma ho,

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: nea ɔhwɛ asase na ɛwosow, na ɔde ne nsa ka mmepɔw a wusiw fi mu ba.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɛto dwom ama Awurade me nkwa nna nyinaa; sɛ mete ase yi, mɛto ayeyi dwom ama me Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Ɔmma me mpaebɔ nsɔ nʼani bere a meregye mʼani wɔ Awurade mu yi.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Ma nnebɔneyɛfo nyera wɔ asase so; na amumɔyɛfo ase nhyew. Me kra, kamfo Awurade. Kamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Da Awurade ase na da ne kɛseyɛ adi. Ma wiase nyinaa nhu nea wayɛ.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Monto dwom mma no, monto ayeyi dwom mma no; monka nʼanwonwade no nyinaa.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Monhoahoa mo ho wɔ ne din kronkron mu; momma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no nnya koma mu anigye.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Momma mo ani nna Awurade ne nʼahoɔden no so; na monhwehwɛ nʼanim bere biara.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Monkae anwonwade a wayɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne, ne atɛn a obui,

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Abraham mma, Onyankopɔn asomfo, Yakob mma a wapaw wɔn.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn. Nʼahenni da adi wɔ asase so nyinaa.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ɔkae nʼapam daa nyinaa, asɛm a ɔhyɛ maa awo ntoantoaso apem no,

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: Ɔkae se, “Mede Kanaan asase no bɛma wo sɛ kyɛfa a ɛbɛyɛ wʼagyapade.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Ɔkaa eyi bere a na wɔnnɔɔso, ahɔhokuw ketewa bi a wɔwɔ Kanaan.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Wofii aman so kɔɔ aman so; fii ahemman mu kɔɔ ahemman mu.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Wamma obi anhyɛ wɔn so; wɔn nti, ɔkaa ahene anim se:

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: “Mommfa mo nsa nka wɔn a masra wɔn ngo; na monnyɛ mʼadiyifo bɔne bi.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ɔkɔm baa asase no so na ɔsɛee akwan a wɔfa so nya wɔn aduan nyinaa;

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: na ɔsomaa ɔbarima bi dii wɔn anim, Yosef a wɔtɔn no sɛ akoa no.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Wɔde mpokyerɛ guu ne nʼanan, na wɔde dade nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn hyɛɛ ne kɔn,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: kosii sɛ nea ɔhyɛɛ ho nkɔm no baa mu, kosii sɛ Awurade asɛm no daa no adi sɛ ɔyɛ ɔnokwafo.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Ɔhene no soma ma wokoyii no; aman no sodifo gyaa no.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛɛ no ne fi so wura nea ɔwɔ nyinaa sodifo,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ne mmapɔmma nea ɔpɛ na ɔnkyerɛ ne mpanyimfo nyansa.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Na Israel kɔɔ Misraim; Yakob kɔtenaa Ham asase so sɛ ɔnanani.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Awurade maa ne nkurɔfo ase dɔe; ɔyɛɛ wɔn bebree dodo maa wɔn atamfo,

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: wɔn a ɔdan wɔn koma sɛ wɔntan ne nkurɔfo na wɔmpam nʼasomfo ti so.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Ɔsomaa ne somfo Mose, ne Aaron a na wayi no no.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne nwonwaso wɔ wɔn mu, nʼanwonwade wɔ Ham asase so.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔsomaa sum, na ɔmaa asase duruu sum, efisɛ na wɔatew nʼasɛm no so atua.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa wɔn nsu nyinaa dan mogya, nam so kum mu mpataa.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Mpɔtorɔ bɛhyɛɛ asase no so ma, na wɔhyɛn ɔman no sodifo mpia mu.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Ɔkasae, na nwansena bebree ne ntontom baa ɔman no mu baabiara.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa wɔn osu dan mparuwbo a anyinam nenam mu wɔ ɔman no nyinaa mu;

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛee wɔn bobe ne borɔdɔma nnua na obubuu ɔman no so nnua pasaa.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Ɔkasae, na mmoadabi bae, tɛwtɛw a wontumi nkan wɔn;

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: wɔwee ahabammono biara a ɛwɔ wɔn asase no so, na wodii wɔn mfuw so nnuan.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Afei okunkum wɔn asase so mmakan nyinaa, wɔn mmarimayɛ mu aba a edi kan nyinaa.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Oyii Israel a ɔso dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ fii wɔn mmusuakuw mu a obiara ho antɔ kyima.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Misraim ani gyei, bere a wɔkɔe, efisɛ na Israelfo ho hu atɔ wɔn so.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛw omununkum mu kataa wɔn so, na ogya maa wɔn hann anadwo.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Wobisae, na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn mparuwbo ɔmaa ɔsoro aduan mee wɔn.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Obuee ɔbotan mu maa nsu fii mu bae; na ɛsen faa sare no so sɛ asubɔnten.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Ɔkaee ne bɔ kronkron bi a ɔhyɛɛ ne somfo Abraham no.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Oyii ne nkurɔfo maa wɔn ani gyei; wɔn a wapaw wɔn no dii ahurusi;

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: ɔde amanaman no nsase maa wɔn, na nea ebinom abrɛ anya no bɛyɛɛ wɔn agyapade

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: na wɔahwɛ nʼahyɛde adi ne mmara so. Munyi Awurade ayɛ.

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade! Monna Awurade ase na oye; na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Hena na obetumi aka nneɛma akɛse a Awurade ayɛ? Anaasɛ obetumi aka ne nkamfo awie?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔkɔ so bu atɛntrenee, na daa wɔyɛ nea eye.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Awurade, sɛ wuhu wo nkurɔfo mmɔbɔ a kae me, sɛ wugye wɔn nkwa a, boa me,

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: na manya wɔn a wapaw wɔn no yiyedi mu kyɛfa, na manya wo manfo anigye no mu kyɛfa, na me ne wʼagyapade no abɔ mu de nkamfo ama wo.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Yɛayɛ bɔne sɛnea yɛn nenanom yɛe no; yɛayɛ mfomso na yɛadi atirimɔdensɛm.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Bere a yɛn nenanom wɔ Misraim no, wɔannwene wo nsɛnkyerɛnne ho; wɔankae wʼadɔe bebrebe no, na wɔtew atua wɔ Po Kɔkɔɔ no ho.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Nanso ne din nti ogyee wɔn nkwa, sɛnea ɔbɛda ne tumi kɛse no adi.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Ɔteɛɛ Po Kɔkɔɔ no ma ɛyowee; ɔde wɔn faa bun mu te sɛ sare so.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Nsu kataa wɔn atamfo so; na ɔbaako mpo annya nkwa.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Afei wogyee ne bɔhyɛ no dii na wɔtoo nʼayeyi nnwom.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Nanso ntɛm so, wɔn werɛ fii nea wayɛ na wɔantwɛn nʼagyinatu.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Akɔnnɔ bɛhyɛɛ wɔn mu wɔ sare so hɔ, asase paradada no so na wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe,

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: enti ɔmaa wɔn nea wobisae, nanso ɔde ɔfɔn yare baa wɔn so.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Na nsraban mu hɔ wɔn ani beree Mose ne Aaron a Awurade atew ne ho no.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Asase mu bue ma ɛmenee Datan na esiee Abiram asafo no.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Ogya tɔɔ wɔn akyidifo no mu; ogyatannaa hyew amumɔyɛfo no.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ nantwi ba wɔ Horeb na wɔkotow ohoni a wɔde fagude ayɛ.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Wɔsesaa wɔn Anuonyam wɔde nantwinini, a ɔwe sare nsɛsode.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Wɔn werɛ fii Onyankopɔn a ogyee wɔn nkwa, nea ɔyɛɛ nneɛma akɛse wɔ Misraim no,

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɔyɛɛ wɔ Ham asase so ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu wɔ Po Kɔkɔɔ ho no.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Enti ɔkae se ɔbɛsɛe wɔn, nanso Mose a ɔyɛ nea wapaw no no, sɔre gyinaa Onyankopɔn ne nnipa no ntam; ɔsrɛ de dwudwoo nʼabufuwhyew no ano sɛnea ɔrensɛe wɔn.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Afei wɔn ani ansɔ asase fɛfɛ no; na wɔannye ne bɔhyɛ no anni.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Wonwiinwii wɔ wɔn ntamadan mu na wɔanyɛ osetie amma Awurade.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Enti ɔmaa ne nsa so kaa ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn se ɔbɛma wɔatotɔ wɔ sare no so,

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: ɔbɛma wɔn asefo atotɔ wɔ amanaman mu na wabɔ wɔn ahwete nsase nyinaa so.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Wɔde wɔn ho bɔɔ Baal-Peor ho na wodii afɔrebɔde a wɔde ama anyame a wonni nkwa;

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: wɔde wɔn atirimɔdensɛm hyɛɛ Awurade abufuw na ɔyaredɔm sii wɔn mu.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Na Pinehas sɔre dii akagyinamu, na wosiw ɔyaredɔm no ano.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Meriba nsu ho nso, wɔhyɛɛ Awurade abufuw, na wɔn nti, ɔhaw baa Mose so,

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔtew Onyankopɔn Honhom anim atua, na asɛm a wannwene ho fii Mose anom.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Wɔansɛe nnipa no sɛnea Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn no,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: nanso wɔde wɔn ho frafraa amanaman no yɛɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no bi.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Wɔsom wɔn ahoni, na ɛbɛyɛɛ afide maa wɔn.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Wɔde wɔn mmabarima ne wɔn mmabea bɔɔ afɔre maa abosom.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Wɔkaa mogya a edi bem gui, wɔn mmabarima ne wɔn mmabea mogya a wɔde bɔɔ afɔre maa Kanaan ahoni no maa asase no ho guu fi.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Wɔde nea wɔyɛɛ no guu wɔn ankasa ho fi; wɔnam nea wɔyɛɛ no so bɔɔ aguaman.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Enti Awurade bo fuw ne nkurɔfo; na okyii nʼagyapade.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Ɔdan wɔn maa amanaman no, na wɔn atamfo dii wɔn so.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Wɔn atamfo hyɛɛ wɔn so na wɔkaa wɔn hyɛɛ wɔn tumi ase.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Mpɛn bebree, Awurade gyee wɔn, nanso wɔkɔɔ so tew atua na wɔsɛe wɔ wɔn bɔne mu.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Nanso ohuu wɔn ahohiahia bere a wosu frɛɛ no no.

english_verse: You kept your agreement and were so merciful
translation_verse: Wɔn nti ɔkaee nʼapam no, na ofii nʼadɔe kɛse no mu huu wɔn mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa asodifo a wɔafa wɔn nnommum no nyaa ahummɔbɔ maa wɔn.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Gye yɛn, Awurade yɛn nkwagye Nyankopɔn, na boaboa yɛn ano fi amanaman so, na yɛada wo din kronkron no ase, na yɛde nkamfo ahyɛ wo anuonyam.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ayeyi nka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, emfi mmeresanten nkosi nnasanten. Momma nnipa no nyinaa nka se, “Amen!” Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna Awurade ase na oye; na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Momma wɔn a Awurade agye wɔn nka saa, wɔn a wagye wɔn afi ɔtamfo nsam no;

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: wɔn a ɔboaboaa wɔn ano fii nsase so no, efi apuei kosi atɔe, atifi kosi anafo.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Ebinom kyinkyinii wɔ nsase pradada so, a wɔanhu ɔkwan ankɔ kuropɔn no mu, faako a wobetumi anya atenae.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔm ne osukɔm dee wɔn na wɔtotɔɔ beraw.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Afei wosu frɛɛ Awurade wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu, na ogyee wɔn fii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: Ɔde wɔn faa ɔkwan tee so baa kuropɔn a wotumi tena mu no mu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da ne nʼanwonwade a ɔyɛ ma nnipa no ho,

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: ɔma wɔn a osukɔm de wɔn nsu na ɔde nnepa hyɛ wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn ma.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Ebinom tenaa sum ne awerɛhow mu, nneduafo a wɔde dade nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn agu wɔn,

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔatew Onyankopɔn nsɛm ho atua na wɔabu Ɔsorosoroni no agyinatu animtiaa.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Enti ogyaa wɔn maa adwumaden; wohintihintiwii, na wɔannya ɔboafo.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Afei wosu frɛɛ Awurade wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu, na ogyee wɔn fii wɔn ahohia mu.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Oyii wɔn fii sum ne awerɛhow mu, na obubuu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da ne nʼanwonwade a ɔyɛ ma nnipa no ho,

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: efisɛ obubu kɔbere mfrafra apon na otwitwa nnadeban mu.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Ebinom bɛyɛɛ nkwaseafo, wɔn atuatew nti, na wohuu amane, wɔn nnebɔne nti.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Wokyii aduan nyinaa na wotwiw bɛnee owu pon ano.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Afei wosu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn amanehunu mu na ogyee wɔn fii wɔn ahohia mu.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Ɔsomaa nʼasɛm na ɔsaa wɔn yare; na ogyee wɔn fii ɔda mu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da ne nʼanwonwade a ɔyɛ ma nnipa no ho.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Momma wɔmmɔ aseda afɔre na wɔmfa ahurusi nnwom nka ne nnwuma ho asɛm.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Ebinom tenaa ahyɛn mu wɔ po so; wɔyɛ aguadifo wɔ nsu akɛse so.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Wohuu Awurade nnwuma, nʼanwonwade a ɛwɔ bun mu.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔkasa maa ahum tui na ekukuru asorɔkye.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Wokukuru kɔɔ ɔsorosoro na wosian kɔɔ bun mu tɔnn; wɔn amanehunu mu no wɔn koma tui.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Wokyim totɔɔ ntintan sɛ asabowfo; na wonhu nea wɔnnyɛ bio.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Afei wosu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn amanehunu mu, na ogyee wɔn fii wɔn ahohia mu.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ahum no yɛɛ dinn; po so asorɔkye ano brɛɛ ase.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Wɔn ani gyei, bere a ɛyɛɛ dinn no, na ɔkyerɛɛ wɔn ɔkwan de wɔn koduu gyinabea a wɔpɛ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da ne nʼanwonwade a ɔyɛ ma nnipa no ho.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Wɔmma no so wɔ asafo no mu na wɔnkamfo no wɔ mpanyimfo nhyiamu ase.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Ɔdan nsubɔnten maa no yɛɛ sare, asuten yɛɛ asase wosee,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: na asasebere dan nkyenenkyene, wɔn a wɔte asase no so amumɔyɛ nti.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ɔdan sare so maa no yɛɛ nsuwansuwa na nkyɛkyerɛ yɛɛ sɛ nsuten anan mu;

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na ɔde wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn kɔsoɛe, na wɔkyekyeree kuropɔn tenaa mu.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ mfuw ne bobe nturo na ɛmaa wɔn nnɔbae bebree.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Ohyiraa wɔn na wɔn ase dɔe. Wamma wɔn nyɛmmoa dodow so anhuan.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Afei wɔn dodow so huanee na nhyɛso, amanehunu ne awerɛhow brɛɛ wɔn ase;

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: nea obu abirɛmpɔn animtiaa no ma wokyinkyin asase kesee a ɔkwan nni hɔ so.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔmaa ahiafo so fii wɔn ahohia mu na ɔmaa wɔn mmusua dɔɔ sɛ nguankuw.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Atreneefo hu ma wɔn ani gye, nanso amumɔyɛfo nyinaa mua wɔn ano.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Momma nea ɔyɛ onyansafo no mmu eyinom, na onsusuw Awurade adɔe kɛse no ho.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Munnyan, sanku ne bɛnta! Menyan anɔpahema.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Awurade, mɛkamfo wo wɔ aman mu; mɛto wo ho nnwom wɔ nnipa no mu.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Wʼadɔe so, ɛkorɔn sen ɔsoro; wo nokwaredi du wim.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wo so tra ɔsoro, na ama wʼanuonyam aba asase nyinaa so.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Fa wo nsa nifa gye yɛn na boa yɛn, na ama wɔn a wodɔ wɔn no anya nkwa.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn akasa afi ne kronkronbea se, “Nkonim mu na mɛkyɛ Sekem mu na masusuw Sukot Bon.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead yɛ me de; Manase nso saa ara; Efraim yɛ me dade kyɛw, Yuda yɛ mʼahempema.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab yɛ me guasɛn, Edom so na metow me mpaboa gu; na meteɛ mu nkonimdi so gu Filistifo so.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Hena na ɔde me bɛkɔ kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu? Hena na obedi mʼanim akɔ Edom?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, ɛnyɛ wo na woapo yɛn na wo ne yɛn asraafo nkɔ ɔsa bio ana?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Boa yɛn tia ɔtamfo no, na ɔdesani mmoa nka hwee.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn wɔ yɛn afa yi, yebedi nkonim, na obetiatia yɛn atamfo so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo no.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Me Nyankopɔn a mekamfo wo, nyɛ komm,

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: na amumɔyɛfo ne nkontompofo atu wɔn ano agu me so; wɔde atoro tɛkrɛma akasa atia me.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Wɔde nitansɛm atwa me ho ahyia na wɔtow hyɛ me so a menkaa wɔn.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Wɔka nsɛm to me so de tua mʼadɔeyɛ so ka, nanso meyɛ obi a mepɛ mpaebɔ.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Wɔde bɔne tua me papayɛ so ka, na wɔde ɔtan tua mʼadɔeyɛ so ka.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Ma onipa bɔne bi nsɔre ntia no; na Satan nnyina ne nsa nifa so.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Wodi nʼasɛm a, ma onni fɔ, na ne mpaebɔ mmu no kumfɔ.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Ma ne nkwa nna nyɛ kakraa bi; na ɔfoforo nsi nʼanan mu sɛ ɔkannifo.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Ma ne mma nyɛ ayisaa na ne yere nyɛ okunafo.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Ma ne mma nkyinkyin nsrɛsrɛ ade; ma wɔmpam wɔn mfi wɔn afi a abubu no mu.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Ma ɔdefirifo bi mfa nea ɔwɔ nyinaa; na ananafo mfom nʼadwuma so aba.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Mma obiara nhu no, anaa ne ayisaa mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Ma nʼase nhyew, na wɔn din nyera wɔ awo ntoatoaso a ɛreba no mu.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnkae nʼagyanom nnebɔne wɔ Awurade anim; na ne na bɔne no ntena hɔ daa.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Wɔn bɔne nyinaa nka Awurade anim, na wɔankae wɔn bio wɔ asase so.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Efisɛ wannwene da sɛ ɔbɛyɛ adɔe, na mmom ɔtaa ahiafo mmɔborɔfo ne wɔn a wɔn werɛ ahow de kɔɔ owu mu.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Nʼani gyee sɛ ɔbɛdome enti nnome mmra no so; wampɛ sɛ obehyira enti nhyira mmɔ no.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Ɔhyɛɛ nnome sɛ atade; ɛno kɔɔ ne nipadua mu sɛ nsu, ne ne nnompe mu sɛ ngo.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Ma ɛnyɛ sɛ atade a ɛkyekyere ne ho, ne abɔso a ɛbɔ no daa.

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Ma eyi nyɛ Awurade akatua a ɔde ma me sobobɔfo, wɔn a wɔka nsɛmmɔne fa me ho no.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nanso wo Asafo Awurade, wo din nti wo ne me nni no yiye; fi wʼadɔe mu gye me.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Efisɛ meyɛ ohiani ne nea onni bi, na me koma atɔ beraw wɔ me mu.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Mitwaa mu sɛ anwummere sunsuma; wopia me kyene sɛ mmoadabi.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Mmuadadi ama me nkotodwe mu agugow; mafɔn, na ama aka me nnompe.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Mayɛ aserewde ama wɔn a wɔbɔ me sobo; sɛ wohu me a, wɔwosow wɔn ti.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Boa me, Awurade me Nyankopɔn; gye me sɛnea wʼadɔe te.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Ma wonhu sɛ ɛyɛ wo nsa, na wo na woayɛ, Awurade.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛdome, nanso wubehyira; sɛ wɔtow hyɛ me so a wɔn anim begu ase, nanso wo somfo ani begye.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Mʼatamfo befura animguase; na akyekyere wɔn ho sɛ atade.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mede mʼano bɛma Awurade so ayɛ no kɛse; mɛkamfo no wɔ dɔm mu.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Efisɛ ogyina ohiani nsa nifa so sɛ obegye no nkwa afi wɔn a wobu no kumfɔ nsam.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me Wura se, “Tena me nifa so kosi sɛ mede wʼatamfo bɛyɛ wʼanan ase ntiaso.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛterɛw wʼahempema dennen mu afi Sion; na wubedi hene wɔ wʼatamfo so.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Wʼasraafo beyi wɔn koma mu da a wobɛkɔ ɔsa. Tumi kronkron bɛyɛ wʼadurade na wo mmabun bɛba wo nkyɛn sɛnea obosu gugu anɔpahema.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Awurade aka ntam na ɔrensesa nʼadwene: “Woyɛ daapem sɔfo sɛ Melkisedek sɛso.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Awurade wɔ wo nifa so; ɔbɛdwerɛw ahemfo wɔ nʼabufuwhyew da no.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Obebu amanaman atɛn aboaboa awufo ano; na wadwerɛw asodifo a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛnom asuwa a ɛda ɔkwankyɛn mu nsu enti obedi nkonim. Ɔhene no bɛnom asuwa a ɛda ɔkwankyɛn mu nsu, na wanya ahoɔden, na wagyina nkonimdi mu.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade! Mefi me koma nyinaa mu ama Awurade so wɔ atreneefo aguabɔ ne asafo no mu.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Awurade nnwuma yɛ akɛse; wɔn a wɔn ani gye ho nyinaa susuw ho.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Ne nnwuma yɛ tumi ne anuonyam, na ne trenee wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Ɔma yɛkae nʼanwonwade; Awurade yɛ ɔdomfo ne mmɔborɔhunufo.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Ɔma wɔn a wosuro no no aduan; ɔkae nʼapam no daa.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Wakyerɛ ne nkurɔfo tumi a ɛwɔ ne nnwuma mu, sɛ ɔde aman afoforo nsase ama wɔn.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ne nsa ano nnwuma yɛ nokware na ɛteɛ; nʼahyɛde nyinaa mu wɔ ahotoso.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Etim hɔ daa daa, nokware ne trenee mu na ɔyɛe.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Ɔde ogye maa ne nkurɔfo; ɔde nʼapam sii hɔ afebɔɔ, ne din yɛ kronkron na ɛyɛ hu.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ nyansa mfiase; wɔn a wodi nʼahyɛde so nyinaa wɔ nhumu pa. Ɔno na daa ayeyi wɔ no.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Nhyira nka onipa a osuro Awurade na onya nʼahyɛde mu anigye pii.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Ne mma bɛyɛ atumfo wɔ asase no so; atreneefo awo ntoatoaso benya nhyira.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Ahonya ne sika wɔ ne fi, na ne trenee tena hɔ daa.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Sum mu mpo hann pue ma nnipa a wɔteɛ, ma ɔdomfo, mmɔborɔhunufo ne ɔnokwafo.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Yiyedi bɛba wɔn a wɔn tirim yɛ mmerɛw na wɔde fɛm kwa, wɔn a wɔde atɛntrenee yɛ wɔn nneɛma no so.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ampa ara ɔrenhinhim da biara da; wɔbɛkae onipa trenee daa.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔte asɛmmɔne a, ɛmmɔ no hu; ne koma si pi wɔ Awurade mu ahotoso mu.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Ne koma wɔ bammɔ, na onsuro; awiei no ɔde nkonimdi behyia nʼatamfo.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔtow nʼakyɛde pete aman so ma ahiafo nea wohia, nʼadɔe no tena hɔ daa; wɔbɛkae wɔn daa na wɔahyɛ wɔn anuonyam.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo behu ama ayɛ no yaw, ɔbɛtwɛre ne se na wafɔn; omumɔyɛfo tirimpɔw bɛyɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Monkamfo Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼasomfo no, monkamfo Awurade din.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnkamfo Awurade din, mprempren ne daa nyinaa.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Efi faako a owia pue kosi faako a ɛkɔtɔ, ma wɔnkamfo Awurade din.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Wɔama Awurade so aman nyinaa so, nʼanuonyam tra ɔsorosoro.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Hena na ɔte sɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn, Ɔbaako no a odi hene wɔ ɔsorosoro,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔbɔ ne mu ase hwɛ ɔsorosoro ne asase?

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Ɔma ahiafo so fi mfutuma mu na ɔma onnibi so fi nso siw so;

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: ɔde wɔn tena mmapɔmma mu, wɔn nkurɔfo mmapɔmma mu.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ obonin atenase wɔ ne fi sɛ ɔbeatan a nʼani gye. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Bere a Israelfo fii Misraim, na Yakobfifo fii ananafo asase so no,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda bɛyɛɛ Awurade kronkronbea na Israel bɛyɛɛ nʼaheman.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Po no hwɛe, na eguanee, Yordan san nʼakyi;

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Mmepɔw huruhuruwii sɛ adwennini, nkoko nso huruhuruwii sɛ nguantenmma.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Dɛn na ɛbae, ɛpo, na wuguanee? Yordan, adɛn, na wosan wʼakyi?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Mmepɔw, adɛn, na muhuruhuruw sɛ adwennini, na mo nkoko, muhuruhuruw sɛ nguantenmma yi?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Asase, ma wo ho mpopo wɔ Awurade anim, wɔ Yakob Nyankopɔn anim,

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔmaa ɔbotan no dan asubura, na ɔbotan dennen dan nsuwa aniwa no.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ yɛn, Awurade, ɛnyɛ yɛn, na wo din na anuonyam nka, wʼadɔe ne wo nokwaredi nti.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Adɛn nti na aman no bisa se, “Wɔn Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Yɛn Nyankopɔn wɔ ɔsoro; nea ɔpɛ biara na ɔyɛ.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔn ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a wɔde onipa nsa na ayɛ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wontumi nkasa; wɔwɔ ani, nanso wonhu ade.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm; wɔwɔ hwene, nanso wɔnte hua.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ nsa, nanso wɔnte nka; wɔwɔ anan, nanso wɔnnantew. Wontumi mma nnyigyei bi mfi wɔn mene mu.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ ahoni no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara, saa ara na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so no bɛyɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Mo Israelfo nyinaa, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so, ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ao Aaronfi, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so, ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Mo a musuro no, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so, ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: Obehyira wɔn a wosuro Awurade, nketewa ne akɛse nyinaa.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Awurade mma wʼase nnɔ, wo ne wo mma.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Awurade nhyira wo, ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfo no.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Ɔsorosoro tɔnn yɛ Awurade de, nanso asase de, ɔde ama onipa.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ awufo na wɔkamfo Awurade wɔn a wɔkɔ fam dinn no.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Yɛn na yɛma Awurade so nnɛ ne daa nyinaa. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Medɔ Awurade efisɛ, ɔtee me nne. Ɔtee me mmɔborɔsu.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ ɔbrɛɛ nʼaso ase maa me nti, mɛfrɛ no wɔ bere a mete ase yi.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Owu ahama bebaree me, ɔda ho yawdi baa me so, ɔhaw ne awerɛhow hyɛɛ me so.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Afei mebɔɔ Awurade din kae se, “Awurade, gye me nkwa!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔdomfo ne ɔtreneeni; ayamhyehye ahyɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn ma.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Awurade bɔ ɔwɛmfo ho ban; bere a mewɔ ahohia mu no, ogyee me.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Nya abotɔyam bio, me kra, efisɛ Awurade ne wo adi no yiye.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Na wo, Awurade, woagye me kra afi owu mu; woamma mʼani amporow nisu, na woamma mʼanan anhintiw

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: sɛ mɛnantew Awurade anim wɔ ateasefo asase so.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Migye dii; ɛno nti mekae se, “Mewɔ ahohia kɛse mu.”

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Na mʼahokyere mu mekae se, “Nnipa nyinaa yɛ atorofo.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Dɛn na metumi de atua Awurade ka wɔ ne papa a wayɛ me nyinaa?

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Medi bɔ a mahyɛ Awurade no nyinaa so wɔ ne nkurɔfo nyinaa anim.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Awurade nkoa nokwafo wu som bo wɔ Awurade ani so.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: Awurade, ampa ara meyɛ wo somfo; meyɛ wo somfo, wʼafenaa babarima; woayi me afi me mpokyerɛ mu.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Mɛbɔ aseda afɔre ama wo na mabɔ Awurade din.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Medi me ntam a maka Awurade no so wɔ ne nkurɔfo nyinaa anim,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: wɔ adiwo a ɛwɔ Awurade fi no, wɔ wʼanim, Yerusalem. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Mo aman nyinaa, monkamfo Awurade; mo nnipa nyinaa, momma ne din so.

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Na nʼadɔe so wɔ yɛn so, na Awurade nokwaredi wɔ hɔ daa. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Monna Awurade ase efisɛ oye, na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Momma Israel nka se, “Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Momma Aaronfi nka se, “Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Momma wɔn a wosuro Awurade nka se, “Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Mʼahohia mu, misu frɛɛ Awurade; ogyee me so, na ɔma me dee me ho.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me boafo; enti merensuro. Dɛn na onipa betumi ayɛ me?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me wɔ hɔ; ɔyɛ me boafo. Mede nkonimdi bɛhwɛ mʼatamfo.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Eye sɛ yebehintaw wɔ Awurade mu, sen sɛ yɛde yɛn ho bɛto onipa so.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amanaman no nyinaa twaa me ho hyiae, nanso Awurade din mu mitwitwaa wɔn gui.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wotwaa me ho hyiaa wɔ baabiara, nanso Awurade din mu, mitwitwaa wɔn gui.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Wɔkyere guu me so sɛ nnowa, nanso wɔhyew ntɛm so sɛ nsɔe a ogya atɔ mu; Awurade din mu mitwitwaa wɔn gui.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
