translation_verse: Wosum me kɔɔ mʼakyi a anka mereyɛ ahwe ase, nanso Awurade boaa me.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ mʼahoɔden ne me bammɔ; wayɛ me nkwagye.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Osebɔ ne nkonimdi gyigye wɔ atreneefo ntamadan mu se, “Awurade nsa nifa ayɛ nneɛma akɛse!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Wɔama Awurade nsa nifa so; Awurade nsa nifa ayɛ nneɛma akɛse!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Merenwu, mmom mɛtena ase na mapae mu aka nea Awurade ayɛ.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Awurade atwe mʼaso dennen, nanso onyaa me mmaa owu ɛ.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Bue trenee apon ma me; na mɛhyɛn mu na mede aseda ama Awurade.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Awurade ponkɛse ni; ɛhɔ na atreneefo bɛfa ahyɛn mu.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Mɛda wo ase, efisɛ wugyee me so; na woayɛ me nkwagye.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Ɔbo a adansifo no poe no, abɛyɛ tweatibo.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Awurade na wayɛ eyi, na ɛyɛ nwonwa wɔ yɛn ani so.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Nnɛ yɛ da a Awurade ayɛ. Momma yɛn ani nnye na yenni ahurusi.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Awurade, gye yɛn nkwa; Awurade, ma yɛn nkonimdi.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne nea ɔnam Awurade din mu reba. Yehyira wo fi Awurade fi.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn, na wama ne hann ahyerɛn yɛn so. Momfa nnua mman nkura na yɛnto afɔrebɔ santen nkɔ afɔremuka no mmɛn ho.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Woyɛ me Nyankopɔn na meyi wo ayɛ; wone me Nyankopɔn na mɛma wo so.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Monna Awurade ase, efisɛ oye; na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔn akwan yɛ pɛ, na wɔnantew sɛnea Awurade mmara kyerɛ.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔkora nʼahyɛde, na wofi wɔn koma nyinaa mu hwehwɛ no.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Wɔnyɛ mfomso biara; na wɔnam nʼakwan so.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Woayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ pa ato hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi so pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Ao, sɛ anka mʼakwan besi pi, ayɛ osetie wɔ wo hyɛ nsɛm ho ɛ!

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Sɛ midwen wo mmaransɛm no nyinaa ho a, ɛno de, anka mʼanim rengu ase.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Mede koma a mu tew bɛkamfo wo bere a meresua wo mmara a ɛteɛ no.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Medi wo hyɛ nsɛm so; na nnyaw me korakora. Awurade Mmara Ho Osetie

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Aberante bɛyɛ dɛn na nʼakwan ho atew? Ɛsɛ sɛ odi wʼasɛm so.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Mede me koma nyinaa hwehwɛ wo; mma me mman mfi wo mmara nsɛm ho.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Mede wʼasɛm asie me koma mu sɛnea merenyɛ bɔne ntia wo.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Awurade, ayeyi nka wo; kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Mede mʼano ka mmara a efi wʼanom nyinaa.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Mʼani gye sɛ midi wʼahyɛde so, sɛnea obi ani gye ahonya bebree ho no.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Midwinnwen wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho na mehwehwɛ wʼakwan mu.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Mʼani gye wo hyɛ nsɛm ho; na merentoto wʼasɛm ase. Awurade Mmara Mu Ahotɔ

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Yɛ wo somfo yiye; na matena ase adi wʼasɛm so.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Bue mʼani na minhu anwonwade a ɛwɔ wo mmara no mu.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Meyɛ ɔnanani wɔ asase so; mfa wo mmaransɛm no nhintaw me.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Me kra tɔ beraw bere biara, wo mmara ho anigyina nti.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Woka ahantanfo anim, wɔn a wɔadome wɔn, na wɔman fi wo mmaransɛm ho no.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Yi wɔn animka ne animtiaabu fi me mu, efisɛ midi wʼahyɛde so.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ sodifo hyia di me ho nseku, nanso wo somfo bedwinnwen wʼahyɛde ho.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Wʼahyɛde yɛ mʼanigyede na ɛyɛ me fotufo. Awurade Mmara Sodi Ho Bɔhyɛ

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Woabrɛ me ase ma meda mfutuma mu; kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼasɛm no te.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Mesesee mʼakwan na wugyee me so; kyerɛkyerɛ me wʼahyɛde.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Ma mente nea ɛwɔ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ase; na mesusuw wʼanwonwade ho.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Awerɛhow ama me kra atɔ beraw; hyɛ me den sɛnea wʼasɛm no kyerɛ.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Yi me fi nnaadaa akwan so; na fa wo mmara so dom me.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Mafa nokware kwan no so; mede me koma abata wo mmara ho.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Awurade, mikura wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dennen, mma mʼanim ngu ase.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Mitu mmirika wɔ wo mmaransɛm kwan no so, efisɛ woama mʼadwene mu adɔ. Ntease Ho Mpaebɔ

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Kyerɛkyerɛ me, Awurade, na minni wo hyɛ nsɛm so, na medi so akosi awiei.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Ma me ntease, na medi wo mmara so, na mede me koma nyinaa bedi so.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ me wo mmaransɛm kwan no na hɔ na minya anigye.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Dan me koma kɔ wʼahyɛde ho na ɛnyɛ pɛsɛmenkominya so mfaso ho.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Yi mʼani fi nneɛma hunu so; na kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼasɛm te.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Di bɔ a woahyɛ wo somfo no so, na wasuro wo.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Yi animguase a ɛbɔ me hu no fi hɔ, efisɛ wo mmara yɛ papa.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Mʼani agyina wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no! Kyɛe me nkwa so wɔ wo trenee mu. Awurade Mmara Mu Ahotoso

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Awurade, ma wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no mmra me so, wo nkwagye no, sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Afei mebua nea oyi me ahi no, efisɛ mewɔ wʼasɛm mu ahotoso.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Nyi nokwasɛm no mfi mʼanom, efisɛ mʼanidaso wɔ wo mmara mu.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Medi wo mmara so bere biara akosi daa apem.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Mede ahofadi bɛnantew, efisɛ mahwehwɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Mɛka wʼahyɛde ho asɛm wɔ ahemfo anim na wɔrengu mʼanim ase,

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: efisɛ mʼani gye wo mmaransɛm ho, na medɔ no.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mede nidi ma wo mmaransɛm a medɔ no, na midwinnwen wo hyɛ nsɛm ho. Awurade Mmara No Mu Ahotoso

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Kae asɛm a woaka akyerɛ wo somfo, efisɛ woama me anidaso.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Mʼawerɛkyekye wɔ mʼamanehunu mu ne sɛ: Wo bɔhyɛ kyɛe me nkwa so.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ahantanfo bu me animtiaa bebree, nanso mennan mfi wo mmara ho.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Awurade mekae wo tete mmara no, na minya awerɛkyekye wɔ mu.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Abufuw hyɛ me ma, esiane amumɔyɛfo a wɔapo wo mmara nti.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Wo hyɛ nsɛm yɛ me dwom tiban wɔ baabiara a mesoɛ.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Awurade, anadwo mekae wo din, na medi wo mmara so.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Eyi ne ade a meyɛ da biara, midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so. Ahofama Wɔ Awurade Mmara Sodi Mu

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo ne me kyɛfa; mahyɛ bɔ sɛ medi wo nsɛm so.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mede me koma nyinaa ahwehwɛ wo; hu me mmɔbɔ sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Madwene mʼakwan ho na madan mʼanammɔntu akyerɛ wʼahyɛde.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mɛyɛ ntɛm, merentwentwɛn sɛ medi wo mmara nsɛm so.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu, amumɔyɛfo de hama kyekyere me, nanso me werɛ remfi wo mmara.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Ɔdasu mu, mesɔre de wʼaseda ma wo, wo mmara a ɛteɛ nti.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Meyɛ wɔn a wosuro wo nyinaa adamfo, wɔn a wodi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Awurade, wʼadɔe ahyɛ asase so ma; kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm. Awurade Mmara Sodi So Mfaso

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Wo ne wo somfo nni no yiye sɛnea wʼasɛm te, Awurade.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Kyerɛkyerɛ me nimdeɛ ne atemmu pa, efisɛ migye wo mmara nsɛm no di.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Mefom ɔkwan ansa na mihuu amane, na mprempren de midi wʼasɛm so.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Wuye, na nea woyɛ nso ye; kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Ahantanfo de atoro asra me ho de, nanso mede me koma nyinaa di wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Wɔn koma yɛ den na wonni ɔtema, nanso mʼani gye wo mmara ho.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Eye sɛ mihuu amane sɛnea mesua wo hyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Mmara a efi wʼanom no som bo ma me sen dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ mpem mpem. Nokware A Ɛwɔ Awurade Mmara Mu

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Wo nsa na ɛbɔɔ me na ɛnwenee me; ma me ntease a mede besua wo mmara nsɛm.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔn a wosuro wo no hu me a, ma wɔn ani nnye, efisɛ mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Awurade, minim sɛnea wo mmara te, na nokwaredi mu na woatwe mʼaso.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ma wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no nkyekye me werɛ sɛnea bɔ a woahyɛ wo somfo no te no.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Ma wʼayamhyehye mmra me so, na minnya nkwa, efisɛ mʼani ka wo mmara ho.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Ma ahantanfo ani nwu sɛ wɔfom me kwa nti nanso mesusuw wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wosuro wo no mmra me nkyɛn, wɔn a wɔte wo mmara ase no.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Ma me koma nnya bembu wɔ wo hyɛ nsɛm ho, na mʼanim angu ase. Ogye Mpaebɔ

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Wo nkwagye ho anigyina ama me kra atɔ piti, nanso mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Mahwɛ wo bɔhyɛ anim ama mʼani abu; meka se, “Da bɛn na wobɛkyekye me werɛ?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ mete sɛ nsa kotoku a ɛsɛn wusiw ano de, nanso me werɛ mfi wo hyɛ nsɛm no.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Wo somfo ntwɛn nkosi da bɛn? Da bɛn na wobɛtwe wɔn a wɔtaa me no aso?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Ahantanfo atu amoa de asum me afiri, a ɛne wo mmara bɔ abira.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa mu wɔ ahotoso; boa me, efisɛ nnipa taa me kwa.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛkaa kakraa bi a anka woyii me fii asase so, nanso minnyaee wo nkyerɛkyerɛ sodi.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼadɔe te, na medi nkyerɛkyerɛ a efi wʼanom no so. Awurade Mmara Mu Gyidi

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Awurade, wʼasɛm no wɔ hɔ daa; egyina hɔ pintinn wɔ ɔsorosoro.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Wo nokwaredi kɔ so wɔ awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu; wode asase sii hɔ, na etim hɔ.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Wo mmara wɔ hɔ besi nnɛ, na nneɛma nyinaa som wo.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Sɛ mʼani anka wo mmara no ho a, anka mʼamanehunu akum me.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Me werɛ remfi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no, efisɛ ɛno so na wonam akyɛe me nkwa so.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Gye me nkwa, na meyɛ wo de; na mahwehwɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo retwɛn sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me, nanso, misusuw wʼahyɛde ho.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Ao, medɔ wo mmara no yiye! Midwinnwen ho da mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Wo mmara nsɛm ma mihu nyansa sen mʼatamfo, efisɛ ɛwɔ me nkyɛn daa.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Mewɔ nhumu sen mʼakyerɛkyerɛfo nyinaa, efisɛ midwinnwen wʼahyɛde ho.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Mewɔ ntease sen mpanyimfo, efisɛ midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Memfaa mʼanan nsii ɔkwan bɔne biara so sɛnea metumi ayɛ osetie ama wʼasɛm.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Memman mfii wo mmara ho, efisɛ wʼankasa na woakyerɛkyerɛ me.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: Wo nsɛm yɛ me dɛ, ɛyɛ dɛ sen ɛwo wɔ mʼanom.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Minya ntease fi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu; enti mikyi ɔkwan bɔne biara. Awurade Mmara Yɛ Kanea

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Wʼasɛm yɛ mʼanan ase kanea ne me kwan so hann.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Maka ntam ahyɛ mu kena se medi wo trenee mmara no so.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mahu amane bebree; kyɛe me nkwa so, Awurade, sɛnea wʼasɛm te.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Awurade, ma wʼani nsɔ mʼanom nkamfo a efi me pɛ mu, na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mmara.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ daa metoto me nkwa ase de, nanso me werɛ remfi wo mmara.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo asum me afiri, nanso memfom mfii wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Wʼahyɛde yɛ mʼagyapade afebɔɔ; ɛma me koma ani gye.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Me koma ayɛ krado sɛ ɛbɛhwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm so akosi awiei. Awurade Mmara Mu Bammɔ

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mikyi nnipa a wɔn adwene yɛ wɔn ntanta, na medɔ wo mmara.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Wone me guankɔbea ne me kyɛm; mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Mumfi me so nkɔ, mo nnebɔneyɛfo, na minni me Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so!

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Wowaw me sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te, na mɛtena nkwa mu; mma mʼanidaso nyɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: So me mu, na menya ogye; na bere biara mɛhwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm no.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Wopo wɔn a wɔfom wo hyɛ nsɛm nyinaa, na wɔn nnaadaa no yɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Wotow amumɔyɛfo nyinaa gu sɛ afide; enti medɔ wʼahyɛde.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Wo ho suro ma me ho popo; wo mmara abɔ me hu. Awurade Mmara Ho Setie

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Mayɛ nea ɛteɛ na ɛyɛ pɛ. Nnyaa me mma wɔn a wɔhyɛ me so!

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Hwɛ ma wo somfo nni yiye; mma ahantanfo nhyɛ me so.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Mahwɛ wo nkwagye anim ama mʼani abu, ɛrehwehwɛ wo bɔhyɛ a ɛteɛ no.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Wo ne wo somfo nni no sɛnea wʼadɔe te, na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Meyɛ wo somfo; ma me nhumu na mate wʼahyɛde ase.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Awurade, bere aso sɛ woyɛ biribi; wɔrebu wo mmara so.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ medɔ wo mmara nsɛm sen sikakɔkɔɔ, anaa sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa,

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: na midwen sɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ nyinaa ye nti, mikyi ɔkwan bɔne biara. Pere Sɛ Wubedi Awurade Mmara So

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Wʼahyɛde yɛ nwonwa; enti midi so.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Wo nsɛm asete ma hann; na ɛma ntetekwaa nya ntease.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Mibue mʼanom na migu ahome, na mʼani gyina wo mmara nsɛm.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Dan wʼani hwɛ me na hu me mmɔbɔ sɛnea woyɛ daa ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Tutu mʼanammɔn sɛnea wʼasɛm no te; mma bɔne biara nni me so.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Gye me fi nnipa nhyɛso mu, na madi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ma wʼanim nhyerɛn wo somfo so na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Nsuten nisu aguare me, efisɛ nnipa nni wo mmara so. Awurade Mmara Yɛ Pɛ

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni ne wo, Awurade, na wo mmara nso yɛ pɛ.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Ahyɛde a woayɛ no yɛ trenee; ɛyɛ nea wonya mu ahotoso pa ara.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Abufuw ahyɛ me ma, efisɛ mʼatamfo bu wɔn ani gu wo nsɛm so.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Wɔasɔ wo bɔhyɛ ahorow no ahwɛ pa ara, na wo somfo dɔ wɔn.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ menka hwee na memfra de, nanso me werɛ mfi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Wo trenee wɔ hɔ daa, na wo mmara no yɛ nokware.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw ne awerɛhow aba me so, nanso wo mmara nsɛm ma me ahosɛpɛw.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Wʼahyɛde yɛ nokware daa; ma me ntease na manya nkwa. Ogye Mpaebɔ

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Awurade, mede me koma nyinaa mefrɛ wo, gye me so, na medi wo hyɛ nsɛm no so.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Misu mefrɛ wo, gye me nkwa na midi wʼahyɛde so.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mesɔre anɔpahema, na misu pɛ mmoa; mede me werɛ ahyɛ wo nsɛm mu.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Mʼani gu so anadwo nyinaa, na misusuw wo bɔhyɛ ho.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Tie me nne sɛnea wʼadɔe no te; Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo mmara te.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔhyehyɛ atirimɔdensɛm no abɛn, nanso wɔne wo mmara ntam ware.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo de, wobɛn me, na wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokware.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Mmere bi a atwa mu no, misuaa wʼahyɛde a wode tim hɔ sɛ ɛntena hɔ daa no. Mmoa Ho Mpaebɔ

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Hwɛ mʼamanehunu na gye me nkwa efisɛ me werɛ mfii wo mmara no.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Di mʼasɛm ma me na gye me; kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Nkwagye ne atirimɔdenfo ntam kwan ware, efisɛ wɔnhwehwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm no.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Awurade, wʼayamhyehye yɛ kɛse; kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo mmara no te.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Atamfo a wɔteetee me dɔɔso, nanso memman mfii wo nhyehyɛe ho.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mehwɛ wɔn a wonni gyidi no a wɔn ho yɛ me nwini, efisɛ wonni wʼasɛm so.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛnea mʼani gye wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho; Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼadɔe te.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Wo nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokware; na wo mmara a ɛteɛ no to rentwa da. Nya Ahofama Ma Awurade Mmara

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Sodifo taataa me kwa, nanso ɛyɛ wʼasɛm nko ara na misuro.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Mʼani gye wo bɔhyɛ ho te sɛ obi a wanya asade kɛse.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mikyi nkontompo na medɔ wo mmara.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Mekamfo wo mpɛn ason da biara, wo mmara a ɛteɛ no nti.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔdɔ wo mmara no wɔ asomdwoe mmoroso, na biribiara rentumi mma wonhintiw.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Awurade, metwɛn wo nkwagye, na midi wo mmara nsɛm so.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Midi wʼahyɛde so na medɔ no yiye.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne wʼahyɛde so, na wunim mʼakwan nyinaa. Mmoa Ho Mpaebɔ

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Awurade, ma me sufrɛ nnu wʼanim; ma me ntease sɛnea wʼasɛm no te.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ma me nkotosrɛ nnu wʼanim; na gye me sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Ma nkamfo nhyɛ mʼanom ma; efisɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Ma me tɛkrɛma nto wʼasɛm ho dwom, efisɛ wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ trenee.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Ma wo nsa nyɛ krado mmɛboa me, efisɛ maso wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Awurade, mʼani agyina wo nkwagye, na wo mmara yɛ mʼanigyede.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Ma mentena nkwa mu na matumi akamfo wo, na wo mmara nso awowaw me.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Mafom kwan sɛ oguan a wayera. Hwehwɛ wo somfo, efisɛ me werɛ mfii wo mmara nsɛm no ɛ.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Misu frɛ Awurade wɔ mʼahohiahia mu, na ogye me so.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Awurade, gye me fi atoro ano, ne nnaadaa tɛkrɛma nsam.

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Dɛn na ɔbɛyɛ wo, na dɛn na ɛka ho bio, wo nnaadaa tɛkrɛma?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Ɔde asraafo bɛmma a ano yɛ nnam ne nnyansramma bɛtwe wʼaso.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Nnome nka me sɛ metena Mesek, na mete Kedar ntamadan mu!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Matena wɔn a wokyi asomdwoe mu akyɛ dodo.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Meyɛ asomdwoe nipa; nanso sɛ mekasa a, wɔde yɛ ɔko.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Mema mʼani so kyerɛ mmepɔw no, ɛhe na me mmoa fi bɛba?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Me mmoa fi Awurade, ɔsoro ne asase yɛfo no.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Ɔremma wo nan nwatiri, nea ɔhwɛ wo no rentɔ nko.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, nea ɔhwɛ Israel no rentɔ nko na ɔrenna.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Awurade hwɛ wo so; Awurade ne wo nwini wɔ wo nsa nifa so;

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Owia rensɛe wo wɔ adekyee mu, na ɔsram nso rensɛe wo anadwo.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛbɔ wo ho ban afi ɔsɛe nyinaa ho, ɔbɛhwɛ wo nkwa so;

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛhwɛ wʼadifi ne wo fieba so mprempren ne daa.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Me ne wɔn a wosee me sɛ, “Ma yɛnkɔ Awurade fi” no ani gyei.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Yegyinagyina wʼaponkɛse ano, Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Wɔakyekyere Yerusalem yiye sɛ kuropɔn wahyehyɛ mu nneɛma fɛfɛ.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na mmusuakuw no kɔ, Awurade mmusuakuw no, Wɔkɔkamfo Awurade din, sɛnea nhyehyɛe a wɔde ama Israel no te.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na atemmu nhengua no sisi, Dawid fi nhengua no.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Monsrɛ asomdwoe mma Yerusalem se, “Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo no nnya bammɔ.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Ma asomdwoe mmra wʼafasu mu na bammɔ mmra wʼaban mu.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Me nuanom ne me nnamfonom nti, mɛka se, “Asomdwoe ntena wo mu.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn fi nti, mɛhwehwɛ wo yiyeyɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Mema mʼani so kyerɛ wo, wo a wʼahengua si ɔsoro.

english_verse: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
translation_verse: Sɛnea nkoa ani hwɛ wɔn wura nsa no, sɛnea afenaa ani hwɛ nʼawuraa nsa no no, saa ara na yɛn ani hwɛ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn kosi sɛ obehu yɛn mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, Awurade, hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, na wɔabu yɛn animtiaa bebree.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Ahomasofo fɛwdi ama yɛabrɛ dodo, ahantanfo animtiaabu afono yɛn.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afa a, ma Israel nka,

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afa bere a nnipa tow hyɛɛ yɛn so,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: bere a wɔn abufuw sɔre tiaa yɛn a anka wɔmemenee yɛn anikann;

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: anka nsuyiri no bebu afa yɛn so, anka ɔhweam no bɛtwe yɛn akɔ,

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: anka nsu a ano yɛ den no bɛpra yɛn kɔ.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Ayeyi nka Awurade a wamma ho kwan amma wɔamfa wɔn se antetew yɛn mu.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Yɛaguan sɛ anomaa afi ofirisumfo afiri mu; wɔabubu afiri no, ama yɛaguan.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Yɛn mmoa wɔ Awurade din mu, ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfo no.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Awurade so no te sɛ Bepɔw Sion, a ɛnwosow na etim hɔ daa no.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Sɛnea mmepɔw atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia no, saa ara na Awurade atwa ne nkurɔfo ho ahyia mprempren ne daa.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo ahempema renka asase a wɔde ama atreneefo no so, sɛ ɛba saa a, atreneefo nam wɔn so bɛyɛ bɔne.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Awurade wɔn a wɔyɛ papa no, yɛ wɔn papa, wɔn a wɔteɛ wɔ koma mu no, yɛ wɔn papa.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wɔman fa akwan kɔntɔnkye so no de, Awurade betwa wɔn ne nnebɔneyɛfo asu. Asomdwoe nka Israel.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Bere a Awurade de Sion fi nnommum san bae no, yɛyɛɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔsosoo adae.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Ɔserew hyɛɛ yɛn anom ma, anigye nnwom hyɛɛ yɛn tɛkrɛma so ma. Na wɔkaa wɔ amanaman no mu se, “Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛse ama wɔn.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛse ama yɛn, na anigye ahyɛ yɛn ma.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Awurade, san fa yɛn siade ma yɛn, te sɛ nsuwansuwa a ɛwɔ Negeb no.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wodua no nusu mu no de anigye nnwom betwa.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔde osu fi adi so aba a wɔrekodua no, de anigye nnwom bɛsan aba a wɔsoso nnɔbae afiafi.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Sɛ Awurade ansi ɔdan no a, adansifo no yɛ ho adwuma kwa. Sɛ Awurade ammɔ kuropɔn no ho ban a, awɛmfo no wɛn kwa.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Sɛ wosɔre anɔpahema na wotena kosi anadwo, na woyɛ adwumaden pɛ wʼano aduan a, ɛyɛ ɔkwa, efisɛ wɔn a ɔdɔ wɔn no, ɔma wɔn wɔ wɔn nnae mu.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mma yɛ agyapade a efi Awurade hɔ, na mma yɛ akatua a efi no.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Mma a wɔwo wɔn mmabun bere mu no te sɛ agyan a ɛhyɛ ɔsraani nsam.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne onipa a nʼagyan kotoku ayɛ ma. Nʼanim rengu ase bere a wahyia nʼatamfo wɔ kurow pon ano no.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne wɔn a wosuro Awurade, na wɔnantew nʼakwan so.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Wubedi wʼadwuma so aba; nhyira ne yiyedi bɛyɛ wo de.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Wo yere bɛyɛ sɛ bobe a ɛsow aba wɔ wo fi; na wo mmabarima ayɛ sɛ ngodua a afifi atwa wo pon ho ahyia.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Yiw, sɛɛ ne nea wobehyira onipa a osuro Awurade no.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Awurade nhyira wo mfi Sion na ɔmma wunhu Yerusalem yiyeyɛ; wo nkwanna nyinaa.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ɔmma wo ntena ase nhu wo mma mma. Asomdwoe nka Israel.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: “Wɔahyɛ me so pii afi me mmofraase, ma Israel nka ɛ.

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Wɔahyɛ me so pii afi me mmofraase, nanso wontumi nnii me so nkonim ɛ.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Fɛntɛmfo afɛntɛm mʼakyi ayɛ wɔn nkɔmoa atenten.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Nanso Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni; watwitwa amumɔyɛfo hama afi me ho ama made me ho.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔtan Sion nyinaa mfa animguase nsan wɔn akyi.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnnyɛ sɛ sare a ɛwɔ ɔdan atifi, a ennyin na ɛhyew;

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mma wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ no nka se, “Awurade nhyira mmra mo so; yehyira mo wɔ Awurade din mu.”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Awurade, mifi bun mu su frɛ wo;

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Awurade, tie me nne. Wɛn wʼaso ma me nkotosrɛ.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Awurade, sɛ wubu yɛn bɔne ho nkontaa a, anka hena na obetumi agyina ano?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Nanso wowɔ bɔnefakyɛ; ɛno nti wosuro wo.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Metwɛn Awurade, me mu ade nyinaa twɛn, na nʼasɛm mu na mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so, efisɛ Awurade wɔ adɔe a enni huammɔ na ogye ankasa wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Ɔno ankasa begye Israel afi wɔn bɔne nyinaa mu.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: Awurade, ahomaso nni me koma mu, na mʼani ntraa me ntɔn ɛ; memma nsɛm akɛse nhaw me anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa dodo ma me.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Na mmom, mama me kra anya abotɔyam te sɛ akokoaa a ɔda ne na so renum no, te sɛ akokoaa a otua nufu ano no, saa ara na me kra ayɛ wɔ me mu.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so, mprempren ne daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Awurade kae Dawid ne ɔhaw ahorow a ogyinaa ano no.

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: Ɔkaa Awurade ntam, na ɔhyɛɛ nea ɔyɛ Otumfo ma Yakob no bɔ se,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Merenhyɛn me fi na merenkɔda me mpa so,

english_verse: or close my eyelids,
translation_verse: meremma nna mmfa me na meremma mʼani nkum,

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: kosi sɛ menya baabi ama Awurade, baabi a nea ɔyɛ Otumfo ma Yakob No bɛtena.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Yɛtee wɔ Efrata, yɛbɛtoo so wɔ Yaar mfuw so.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: “Momma yɛnkɔ nʼatenae; momma yɛnsom wɔ ne nan ntiaso hɔ.

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: ‘Awurade, sɔre bra wʼahomegyebea, wo ne wo tumi adaka no.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Ma trenee nyɛ sɛ ntade mma wʼasɔfo; ma wʼahotefo nto ahurusi nnwom.’ ”

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Wo somfo Dawid nti, nyi wʼani mfi nea woasra no ngo no so.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid, nokware ntam a ɔntwe nsan se, “Wʼasefo no mu baako na mede no bɛtena wʼahengua so.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wo mmabarima di mʼapam so na wotie me nkyerɛkyerɛ a, ɛno de wɔn mmabarima bɛtena wʼahengua so afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Awurade ayi Sion, ɔde hɔ ayɛ nʼatenae:

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: “Ɛha ne mʼahomegyebea daa nyinaa; ɛha na mɛtena adi hene, efisɛ ha na mepɛ,

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: mede nneɛma pa bebree behyira no na mama nʼahiafo adidi amee.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Mede nkwagye befura nʼasɔfo, na nʼahotewfo ato ahurusi nnwom daa.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: “Mɛma obirɛmpɔn bi apue wɔ Dawid ahenni mu, na mede kanea asi hɔ ama nea masra no ngo no.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Mede aniwu befura nʼatamfo, nanso wɔbɛhyɛ no ahenkyɛw a ɛhyerɛn.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Hwɛ oye a eye ne fɛ a ɛyɛ sɛ anuanom bɔ mu tena faako!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Ɛte sɛ ngo a ɛsom bo a wɔahwie agu apampam, na esian kogu bɔgyesɛ mu, esian kogu Aaron bɔgyesɛ mu, ma bi kogu nʼatade kɔn mu.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Ɛte sɛ Hermon bosu a ɛtɔ gu Bepɔw Sion so. Ɛhɔ na Awurade ahyɛ ne nhyira, nkwa a to ntwa da no.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Awurade asomfo nyinaa, monkamfo Awurade, mo a mosom wɔ Awurade fi anadwo nyinaa.

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Momma mo nsa so wɔ kronkronbea hɔ na monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Awurade a ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase no, mfi Sion nhyira mo.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Monkamfo Awurade din; monkamfo no, mo Awurade asomfo,

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: mo a mosom wɔ Awurade fi, wɔ adiwo a ɛwɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn fi.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade efisɛ oye; monto ayeyi nnwom mma ne din, na ɛno na ɛyɛ anisɔ.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Awurade ayi Yakob sɛ ɔnyɛ ne de, wayi Israel sɛ nʼade a ɛsom bo.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Minim sɛ Awurade so; Ɔso sen anyame nyinaa.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ nea ɔpɛ biara wɔ ɔsoro ne asase so, po ne mu bun nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Ɔma omununkum ma ne ho so fi asase ano ba; ɔsoma anyinam ka osu ho na ɔma ahum tu fi ne koradan mu.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Okum Misraim mmakan, nnipa ne mmoa mmakan.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Ɔsomaa ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne nʼanwonwade baa mo mfimfini, Misraim, de tiaa Farao ne nʼasomfo nyinaa.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Ɔsɛee amanaman pii, na okunkum ahemfo akɛse,

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Amorifo hene, Sihon Basan hene, Og ne Kanaan ahemfo nyinaa,

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: na ɔde wɔn nsase maa sɛ agyapade ɔde maa ne nkurɔfo Israelfo.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo din wɔ hɔ daa. Awurade wo din ahyeta awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Awurade bedi ama ne nkurɔfo na obehu nʼasomfo mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Amanaman no ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a wɔde onipa nsa na ayɛ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wontumi nkasa, wɔwɔ ani, nanso wonhu ade;

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm, na ɔhome nso nni wɔn anom.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ ahoni no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara, saa ara na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so no bɛyɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, mo Israelfo nyinaa; monkamfo Awurade, Aaron fi;

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: monkamfo Awurade, Lewi fi; monkamfo Awurade, mo a musuro no.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Mumfi Sion nkamfo Awurade, monkamfo nea ɔte Yerusalem no. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna Awurade ase na oye. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna anyame mu Nyankopɔn no ase. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna awuranom mu Awurade no ase. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno nko ara na ɔyɛ anwonwade akɛse. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ofi ne ntease mu bɔɔ ɔsoro. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔtrɛw asase mu de kataa nsu so. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔbɔɔ akanea akɛse no. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔɔ owia sɛ enni adekyee so. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa;

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔɔ sram ne nsoromma sɛ wonni adesae so no. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na okunkum Misraimfo mmakan, Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na oyii Israelfo fii wɔn mu no. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔde nsa kɛse ne basa a wateɛ mu. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔpaee Po Kɔkɔɔ no mu no, Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na ɔde Israelfo faa mfimfini no. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔpraa Farao ne nʼasraafo guu Po Kɔkɔɔ mu no. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na odii ne nkurɔfo anim wɔ sare no so. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na okum ahemfo akɛse no, Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na okum ahemfo akunini no. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Okum Amorifo hene, Sihon, Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ne Basanhene, Og. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Na ɔde wɔn nsase maa sɛ agyapade. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔde maa ne somfo Israel sɛ agyapade. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔkaee yɛn, yɛn mmerɛwyɛ mu. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Na ogyee yɛn fii yɛn atamfo nsam. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔma abɔde biara aduan. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn no ase. Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Babilonia nsubɔnten ho, ɛhɔ na yɛtena suu bere a yɛkaee Sion no.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ konkɔn so nnua mu na yɛde yɛn asanku sensɛnee,

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: ɛhɔ na yɛn nnommumfafo kaa se yɛnto nnwom, yɛn ahohiafo hwehwɛɛ anigye nnwom fii yɛn nkyɛn; wɔkae se, “Monto Sion nnwom baako nkyerɛ yɛn!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛatumi ato Awurade nnwom, bere a yɛwɔ ananafo asase so?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, sɛ me werɛ fi wo a ma me nsa nifa werɛ mfi sankubɔ.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Sɛ mankae wo a, ma me tɛkrɛma nka ntare mʼanom sɛ mamfa Yerusalem sɛ mʼanigyede kɛse pa ara a.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Kae, Awurade, nea Edomfo yɛɛ da a Yerusalem hwee ase no. Wɔteɛɛ mu se, “Munnwiriw, munnwiriw ngu fam nkɔka ne fapem!”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Ɔbabea Babilonia, wɔadome wo akɔ ɔsɛe mu, nea otua wo ka bio ani gye wɔ nea wode ayɛ yɛn no ho.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Nea ɔkyere wo nkokoaa de wɔn dwiradwira abotan no ani gye.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Awurade, mede me koma nyinaa ayi wo ayɛ; mɛto wʼayeyi dwom wɔ “anyame” no anim.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Mede mʼani bɛkyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no, akotow wo na makamfo wo din wɔ wʼadɔe a enni huammɔ ne wo nokwaredi nti, efisɛ woama wʼahyɛde no so yiye; ama asen wo titiriwyɛ.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Bere a misu frɛɛ wo no, wugyee me so; woma minyaa akokoduru ne nnamyɛ.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Awurade, sɛ ahemfo a wɔwɔ wiase nyinaa te nea woahyɛ no a, ma wɔnkamfo wo.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnto Awurade akwan ho nnwom, na Awurade anuonyam yɛ kɛse.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ Awurade wɔ ɔsorosoro de, nanso ɔhwɛ mmɔborɔfo, na ahantanfo de, ohu wɔn wɔ akyirikyiri.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ menam ɔhaw mu de, nanso wobɔ me nkwa ho ban; woteɛ wo nsa wɔ mʼatamfo abufuw so, na wode wo nsa nifa gye me nkwa.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Awurade bɛma nea wahyehyɛ ama me no aba mu; Awurade, wʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa, nnyaa wo nsa ano nnwuma akyidi. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Awurade, woahwehwɛ me mu na woahu me.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Wunim mʼasetena ne me sɔre; wufi akyirikyiri hu mʼadwene mu.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Wunim mʼadifi ne me nnae mu; wunim mʼakwan nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Ansa na mebue mʼano akasa no Awurade, na wunim ne nyinaa dedaw.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Woakata me ho nyinaa ahyia na wobɔ me ho ban.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Saa nimdeɛ yi yɛ me nwonwa dodo, ɛkɔ soro dodo ma me sɛ medu ho.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Ɛhe na metumi afi wo honhom anim akɔ? Ɛhe na metumi aguan afi wʼanim akɔ?

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Sɛ mede adekyee ntaban tu na mekɔtena po akyi nohɔ a,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: mpo hɔ na wo nsa begya me akɔ, na wo nsa nifa beso me mu.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Na meka se, “Ampa ara sum mmɛkata me so na hann nnan adesae ntwa me ho nhyia a,”

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: sum mpo nyɛ sum mma wo; na anadwo bɛhyerɛn sɛ awia; sum ne hann yɛ wo pɛ.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Na wo na wobɔɔ me honhom wonwen me wɔ me na awotwaa mu.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Mekamfo wo, efisɛ woyɛɛ me anwonwakwan so a ɛyɛ hu; wo nnwuma yɛ nwonwa. Minim ɛno yiye pa ara.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Wɔamfa me bɔbea anhintaw wo bere a wɔyɛɛ me kokoa mu no; bere a wɔnwenee me wɔ asase bun mu no,

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: wʼani huu me, bere a meyɛ mogyatɔw no. Nna dodow a woatwa ama me no, wɔakyerɛw ne nyinaa wɔ wo nhoma mu ansa na mu baako reba mu.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, wo nsusuwii som bo ma me! woka ne nyinaa bɔ mu a, ɛtrɛw dodo!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Sɛ mise mɛkan a, ne dodow bɛboro mpoano nwea, sɛ minyan a, me ne wo wɔ hɔ ara.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Sɛ anka, Onyankopɔn, wubekunkum amumɔyɛfo ɛ! Mumfi me so, mo a moyɛ mogyapɛfo!

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Wɔde adwemmɔne ka wo ho asɛm; wʼatamfo mmmɔ wo din pa.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Awurade, metan wɔn a wɔtan wo, na mikyi wɔn a wɔsɔre tia wo no ana?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Minni hwee sɛ ɔtan a mewɔ ma wɔn; mefa wɔn sɛ mʼatamfo.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Hwehwɛ me mu, Onyankopɔn, na hu me koma; sɔ me hwɛ, na hu mʼadwene.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛ bɔne bi wɔ me mu a, na di mʼanim fa daa nkwa kwan so. Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Awurade, gye me fi nnebɔneyɛfo nsam; bɔ me ho ban fi basabasayɛfo nsam,

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: wɔn a wodwen bɔne wɔ wɔn koma mu na wɔhwanyan ɔko mu da biara.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Wɔsew wɔn tɛkrɛma ano te sɛ ɔwɔ de; nhurutoa bɔre wɔ wɔn ano.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Awurade, yi me fi amumɔyɛfo nsam; bɔ me ho ban fi basabasayɛfo a wodwen sɛ wobetwintwan mʼanan mu no ho.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Ahantanfo asum me afiri; wɔatrɛtrɛw wɔn asau ahama mu wɔasunsum me mfiri wɔ me kwan so.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Awurade, meka kyerɛ wo se, “Wone me Nyankopɔn.” Awurade, tie me mmɔborɔsu.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Otumfo Awurade, me gyefo hoɔdenfo, wokata me ti so wɔ ɔko da,

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: nyɛ amumɔyɛfo abisade mma wɔn, Awurade; mma wɔn nhyehyɛe nnyɛ yiye.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Wɔatwa me ho ahyia, nanso, ma amumɔyɛsɛm a efi wɔn anom no nsɛe wɔn.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Ma nnyansramma ngu wɔn so; ma wɔntow wɔn ngu ogya mu, ngu dontori amoa mu a wɔrensɔre bio.

english_verse: Chase those cruel liars away! Let trouble hunt them down.
translation_verse: Mma dinsɛefo ase ntim asase no so; ma amanehunu ntaataa kitikitiyɛfo.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Minim sɛ Awurade bu ahiafo atɛntrenee na odi onnibi asɛm ma no.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, atreneefo bɛkamfo wo din na wɔn a wɔnam tee no bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Awurade, misu frɛ wo, bra me nkyɛn ntɛm so. Sɛ misu frɛ wo a, gye me so.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ma me mpaebɔ mmra wʼanim sɛ aduhuam; ma me nsa a mema so no nyɛ sɛ anwummere afɔrebɔ.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Awurade, ma ɔwɛmfo nwɛn mʼano; na wɛn mʼano pon.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Mma wɔnntwe me koma nnkɔ nea ɛyɛ bɔne ho, na ankɔyɛ nea amumɔyɛfo yɛ no bi, mma me ne abɔnefo nni wɔn nnɔkɔnnɔkɔwade.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Ma ɔtreneeni mmɔ me, ɛyɛ ayamye; ma ɔnka mʼanim, ɛyɛ me ti so ngo. Me ti rempo. Me mpaebɔ da so tia abɔnefo nneyɛe daa.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Wɔbɛtow wɔn sodifo afi ɔbotan so abɛhwe fam; na amumɔyɛfo behu sɛ me nsɛm no yɛ nokware.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka se, “Sɛnea obi funtum na otutu asase no, saa ara na wɔabɔ yɛn nnompe ahwete ɔda ano.”

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Nanso Otumfo Awurade, mʼani wɔ wo so; wo mu na mihintaw, nnyaw me mma owu.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Bɔ me ho ban fi mfiri a wɔasunsum me no ho, mfiri a abɔnefo asunsum no.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Ma amumɔyɛfo no ankasa ɔtan nyi wɔn, bere a mitwa mu kɔ dwoodwoo no.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Meteɛ mu su frɛ Awurade; mema me nne so su frɛ Awurade sɛ onhu me mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Mihwie mʼahiasɛm gu nʼanim; meka me haw kyerɛ no.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Sɛ me kra tɔ beraw wɔ me mu a, ɛyɛ wo na wunim me kwan. Ɔkwan a menam so no nnipa asum me afiri.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Hwɛ na hu, obiara nni me nifa so; mʼasɛm mfa obiara ho; minni guankɔbea bi; me nkwa mfa obiara ho.

english_verse: Help! They are chasing me, and they are too strong.
translation_verse: Tie me sufrɛ, na mewɔ ahohia kɛse mu; gye me fi mʼataafo nsam, efisɛ wɔn ho yɛ den sen me.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Yi me fi mʼafiase, na makamfo wo din. Afei atreneefo betwa me ho ahyia esiane wo papa a woayɛ me no nti.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ, tie me mmɔborɔsu; fi wo nokwaredi ne trenee mu bra bɛboa me.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Mfa wʼakoa nkɔ atemmu mu, na ɔteasefo biara nteɛ wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Ɔtamfo no taa me, ɔbɔ me hwe fam; ɔma me tena sum mu te sɛ wɔn a wowuwuu dedaada.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti me honhom atɔ beraw wɔ me mu; na me koma di yaw wɔ me mu.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Mekae tete nna no; midwinnwen wo nnwuma ne nea wo nsa ayɛ nyinaa ho.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Mema me nsa so kyerɛ wo; wo ho sukɔm de me kra sɛ asase kesee.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Awurade, gye me so ntɛm; me honhom tɔ piti. Mfa wʼanim nhintaw me anyɛ saa a mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔkɔ amoa mu no.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Ma mente wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ho asɛm daa anɔpa, na mede me ho ato wo so. Kyerɛ me ɔkwan a memfa so, na wo na mema me kra so kyerɛ.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Awurade gye me fi mʼatamfo nsam, na wo mu na mede me ho hintaw.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ me na menyɛ wʼapɛde, na wo ne me Nyankopɔn; ma wo honhom pa no nkogya me asasetaw so.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo din nti, kyɛe me nkwa so; wo trenee mu, yi me fi ɔhaw mu.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Fi wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no mu mua mʼatamfo ano; na sɛe wɔn a wokyi me no nyinaa, na meyɛ wo somfo.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Nkamfo nka Awurade, me Botan, nea ɔma me nsa akodi ho ntetewee, ne me nsateaa ma ɔsa.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ mʼadɔe Nyankopɔn ne mʼabandennen, me bammɔ ne me gyefo, me kyɛm a mewɔ guankɔbea wɔ no mu, ɔno na ɔka nnipa hyɛ mʼase.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Awurade, hena ne onipa a wʼani ku no ho onipa ba a wudwen ne ho yi?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Onipa te sɛ ɔhome; ne nna te sɛ sunsuma a ɛretwa mu.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Awurade, fi ɔsoro hɔ na sian bra fam; fa wo nsa ka mmepɔw, na emfi wusiw.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Soma anyinam na bɔ atamfo no hwete; to wo mmɛmma no ma wonguan.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Teɛ wo nsa fi ɔsoro bra fam; gye me na yi me fi nsu akɛse ho, fi ananafo nsam,

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: wɔn a atoro ayɛ wɔn anom ma, na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nnaadaa.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn, mɛto dwom foforo ama wo; mɛto dwom wɔ sanku a ahama du gu so so ama wo,

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: ama Ɔbaako a ɔde nkonimdi ma ahemfo, na ogye ne somfo Dawid fi afoawerɛmfo ano.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Gye me na yi me fi ananafo nsam, wɔn a atoro ayɛ wɔn anom ma na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nnaadaa.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Afei yɛn mmabarima mmerantebere mu bɛyɛ sɛ afifide a wɔahwɛ so yiye, na yɛn mmabea bɛyɛ sɛ adum a wɔasen de asiesie ahemfi.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Yɛn asan bɛyɛ amaama; aduan ahorow biara bɛba so. Yɛn nguan dodow so bɛto mpem mpem, wɔn so bɛto mpem du du wɔ yɛn mfuw so;

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: yɛn anantwi bɛtwe nnesoa duruduru. Wɔrennwiriw afasu, yɛrenkɔ nkoasom mu, na agyaadwotwa remma yɛn mmɔnten so.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka nnipa a ɛbɛba mu saa ama wɔn. Nhyira nka nnipa a wɔn Nyankopɔn ne Awurade.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Mɛma wo so, me Nyankopɔn, Ɔhenkɛse; mɛkamfo wo din daa daa.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Da biara, mɛkamfo wo; na mama wo din so daa daa.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Awurade so, na ɔsɛ nkamfo kɛse; obiara ntumi nsusuw ne kɛseyɛ.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Awo ntoatoaso baako bɛkamfo wo nnwuma akyerɛ afoforo; wɔbɛka wo nnwuma akɛse ho asɛm.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka wʼanuonyam ne wo tumi a ɛheran no ho asɛm, na mɛdwene wʼanwonwadwuma ho.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka wo nnwuma a ɛyɛ hu no mu tumi ho asɛm; na mapae mu aka wo nneyɛe akɛse no akyerɛ.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛhyɛ wo papayɛ mmoroso no ho fa, na wɔde anigye ato wo trenee ho dwom.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔdomfo ne mmɔborɔhunufo; ne bo kyɛ fuw na nʼadɔe dɔɔso.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Awurade ye ma obiara; na ɔwɔ ahummɔbɔ ma nʼabɔde nyinaa.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Awurade, wʼabɔde nyinaa bɛkamfo wo; na wʼahotefo bɛma wo so.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka wʼahenni no anuonyam ho asɛm na wɔaka wo mmaninyɛ ho asɛm,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nnipa behu wo nnwuma akɛse ne wʼahenni anuonyam a ɛheran no.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Wʼahenni yɛ daa ahenni, na wo tumidi wɔ hɔ ma awo ntoantoaso nyinaa. Awurade di ne bɔhyɛ nyinaa so, na ɔwɔ ɔdɔ ma biribiara a wayɛ.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Awurade wowaw wɔn a wɔhwe ase na ɔpagyaw wɔn a wɔn nnesoa ama wɔakom.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Aniwa nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan, na woma wɔn, wɔn aduan wɔ ne bere mu.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Wubue wo nsam, na woma biribiara a ɛwɔ nkwa no nʼapɛde.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Awurade teɛ wɔ nʼakwan nyinaa mu; na ɔyɛ adɔe ma nea wayɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa, wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nokware mu nyinaa.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ wɔn a wosuro no no apɛde ma wɔn; otie wɔn sufrɛ na ogye wɔn.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Awurade hwɛ wɔn a wɔdɔ no no nyinaa so, nanso amumɔyɛfo de, ɔbɛsɛe wɔn nyinaa.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Mʼano bɛkamfo Awurade. Ma abɔde nyinaa nkamfo ne din kronkron no daa daa.

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
