translation_verse: Mɛkamfo Awurade me nkwanna nyinaa; mɛto ayeyi dwom ama me Nyankopɔn, sɛ mete ase yi.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Mommfa mo ho nto mmapɔmma so, adesamma a wɔrentumi nnye nkwa.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔn honhom tu kɔ a, wɔsan kɔ dɔte mu, saa da no ara wɔn nsusuwii nyinaa yɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne nea ne boafo ne Yakob Nyankopɔn, nea nʼanidaso wɔ Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn mu.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfo, po ne biribiara a ɛwɔ mu nyinaa Awurade a ɔyɛ nokwafo daa no.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: Odi ma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so, na ɔma wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn aduan. Awurade gyaa nneduafo,

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Awurade ma anifuraefo hu ade. Awurade ma wɔn a wɔakom no so, Awurade dɔ atreneefo.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Awurade hwɛ ahɔho so, na ɔwowaw ayisaa ne akunafo, na amumɔyɛfo akwan de, ɔdan ani.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Awurade di hene daa daa, Ao, Sion, wo Nyankopɔn, wɔ awo ntoatoaso nyinaa so. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Eye sɛ wɔto ayeyi nnwom ma yɛn Nyankopɔn, ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛfata dodo sɛ wɔkamfo no!

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Awurade kyekyere Yerusalem; Ɔboaboa Israel nnommum ano.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Ɔsa wɔn a wɔn koma abotow no yare, na ɔkyekyere wɔn akuru.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Ɔkyerɛ nsoromma dodow a ɛwɔ hɔ, na ɔde obiara din frɛ no.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Yɛn Awurade so, na ne tumi yɛ kɛse; yɛrente nʼase nwie.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Awurade wowaw ahobrɛasefo na ɔtotow amumɔyɛfo hwehwe fam.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Monto aseda nnwom mma Awurade. Momfa sanku nto dwom mma yɛn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Ɔde omununkum kata ɔsoro ani; ɔma asase osu ma sare nyin wɔ nkoko so.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Ɔma anantwi aduan, na sɛ kwaakwaadabimma su a, ɔma wɔn aduan.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ ɔpɔnkɔ ahoɔden na nʼani sɔ na ɛnyɛ onipa ahoɔden nso.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Na mmom, Awurade ani sɔ nnipa a wosuro no, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no so no.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Momma Awurade so, Yerusalem; kamfo wo Nyankopɔn, Sion,

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: ɔma wʼapon akyi adaban yɛ den, na ohyira wo nkurɔfo a wɔte wo mu.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ɔma wʼahye so dwo, na ɔde awi ankasa ma wo.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Ɔsoma nʼahyɛde kɔ asase so; nʼasɛm tu mmirika ntɛm so.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛw sukyerɛmma mu sɛ oguan ho nwi, na ɔpete obosu sukyerɛmma sɛ nsõ.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Ɔtotow mparuwbo gu fam sɛ mmosea. Hena na obetumi agyina nʼawɔw dennen no ano?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Ɔsoma nʼasɛm no ma ɛnan no; ɔhwanyan ne mframa, na nsu sen.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Wada nʼasɛm adi akyerɛ Yakob, ne mmara ne ɔhyɛ nsɛm akyerɛ Israel.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔnyɛɛ eyi maa ɔman foforo biara ɛ; wonnim ne mmara. Monkamfo Awurade!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade! Monkamfo Awurade mfi ɔsorosoro, monkamfo no wɔ ɔsoro sorɔnsorɔmmea.

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nʼabɔfo nyinaa, monkamfo no, ne ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, monkamfo no.

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Owia ne ɔsram, monkamfo no, nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn nyinaa, monkamfo no.

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Monkamfo no, ɔsoro mu soro ne mo nsu a mowɔ ɔsoro atifi.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Momma wɔn nyinaa nkamfo Awurade din, efisɛ ɔno na ɔhyɛ ma wɔbɔɔ wɔn.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɔde wɔn sisii hɔ afebɔɔ; na ɔmaa ɔhyɛ nsɛm bi a ɛrentwa mu da.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade mfi asase so, mo po kɛse mu abɔde ne po bun nyinaa,

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: anyinam ne mparuwbo, sukyerɛmma ne omununkum, ahum a moyɛ nʼapɛde,

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: mo mmepɔw ne nkoko nyinaa, nnua a ɛsow aba ne sida nyinaa,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: nwura mu mmoa ne anantwi, abɔde nketewa ne nnomaa a wotu,

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: asase ne amanaman nyinaa so ahemfo, mo mmapɔmma ne asase sodifo nyinaa,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: mmerante ne mmabaa, mmasiriwa ne mmofra nso.

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnkamfo Awurade din, na ne din so sen din biara; nʼanuonyam korɔn wɔ asase ne ɔsoro so.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Wapagyaw mmɛn bi ama ne nkurɔfo, nʼahotewfo nyinaa nkamfo; Israelfo, nnipa a wɔda ne koma so no nkamfo. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade, monkamfo no wɔ ahotefo asafo mu.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Ma Israel ani nnye ne Yɛfo mu. Ma Sion mma ani nnye wɔn Hene mu.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Ma wɔmfa asaw nkamfo ne din na wɔmfa sanku ne akasaa nto dwom mma no.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Na Awurade ani sɔ ne nkurɔfo; ɔde nkwagye kyɛw hyɛ ahobrɛasefo.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Momma ahotefo nni ahurusi wɔ anuonyam yi mu; na wɔnto ahosɛpɛw dwom wɔ wɔn mpa so.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nkamfo nhyɛ wɔn anom, na ɛnyɛ afoa anofanu wɔ wɔn nsam,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nkyekyere wɔn ahemfo, ne dade mpokyerɛ ngu wɔn atitiriw,

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: sɛ wɔmfa mmu atɛn, sɛnea wɔakyerɛw atia wɔn no. Eyi ne nʼahotewfo nyinaa anuonyam. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Monkamfo Awurade wɔ ne kronkronbea; monkamfo no wɔ ɔsoro tumi mu.

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Monkamfo no wɔ ne tumi mu nneyɛe ho; monkamfo no wɔ ne kɛseyɛ a ɛboro biribiara so no ho.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Momfa torobɛnto nnyigyei nkamfo no, momfa asanku ne bɛnta nkamfo no,

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: momfa akasaa ne asaw nkamfo no, momfa sankuten ne atɛntɛbɛn nkamfo no,

english_verse: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
translation_verse: momfa kyɛnkyɛn mmobɔmu so nkamfo no, momfa kyɛnkyɛn nnyigyei nkamfo no.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Momma nea ɛhome nyinaa nkamfo Awurade. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Ne botae ne sɛ ɛbɛkyerɛ nnipa nyansa ne ahohyɛso; ne sɛ ɛbɛboa ama wɔate nsɛm a emu dɔ ase;

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: sɛ wobenya akwankyerɛ wɔ abrabɔ pa mu, a ɛbɛma wɔayɛ ade pa, nea ɛteɛ na ho nni asɛm;

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛbɛma nea nʼadwene mu nnɔ anya nyansa na mmabun anya nimdeɛ ne adwene,

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: anyansafo ntie na wɔmfa nka nea wonim ho, na nea ɔwɔ nhumu nya akwankyerɛ a

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: ɛbɛma wate mmɛ ne kasammebu, anyansafo nsɛnka ne abisaa ase.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ nimdeɛ mfiase, na nkwaseafo bu nyansa ne ahohyɛso animtiaa. Nyansapɛ Ho Afotusɛm Nnaadaa Ho Kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Me ba, tie wʼagya akwankyerɛ na mpo wo na nkyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Ɛbɛyɛ wo ti anuonyam abotiri ne wo kɔn mu atweaban.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ nnebɔneyɛfo twetwe wo a, mma wɔn ho kwan.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔka se, “Bra ma yɛnkɔ; ma yɛnkɔtetɛw na yenkum obi, ma yɛnkɔtɛw ntwɛn mmɔborɔni bi;

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: ma yɛmmemene wɔn anikann sɛ ɔda, koraa, te sɛ wɔn a wɔkɔ ɔda mu;

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: yebenya nneɛma a ɛsom bo ahorow na yɛde asade ahyɛ yɛn afi ma;

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: fa wo ho bɛhyɛ mu, na wubenya wo kyɛfa wɔ ahonyade no mu.”

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: Me ba, wo ne wɔn nnantew, mfa wo nan nsi wɔn akwan so;

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Wɔn anan de ntɛmpɛ kɔ bɔne mu, na wɔde ahoɔhare ka mogya gu.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: So nni mfaso sɛ obi besum nnomaafiri wɔ beae a anomaa biara hu!

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Saa nnipa yi tetɛw pɛ wɔn ankasa mogya; wɔtetɛw wɔn ankasa wɔn ho!

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Saa na wɔn a wodi akorɔnne akyi no awiei te; ɛma wɔhwere wɔn nkwa! Nyansa A Wɔpo Ho Kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Nyansa teɛ mu wɔ mmɔnten so, ɔma ne nne so wɔ aguabɔbea,

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: ɔteɛ mu wɔ afasu no atifi, ɔkasa wɔ kuropɔn no apon ano se,

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Mo adwenharefo, mobɛyɛ adwenhare akosi da bɛn? Fɛwdifo bedi fɛw akosi da bɛn? Nkwaseafo bekyi nimdeɛ akosi da bɛn?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Sɛ mutiee mʼanimka a, anka mekaa me koma mu nsɛm nyinaa kyerɛɛ mo ma muhuu me nsusuwii.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: sɛ mopoo mʼafotu, na moampɛ mʼanimka nti,

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: sɛ abɛbrɛsɛ bi bu fa mo so te sɛ ahum, na amanehunu bi bɔ fa mo so sɛ mfɛtɛ, na awerɛhow ne ɔhaw mene mo a,

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: “Afei wɔbɛfrɛ me, nanso meremmua; wɔbɛhwehwɛ me, nanso wɔrenhu me.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ wokyii nimdeɛ na wɔampɛ sɛ wobesuro Awurade,

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔpoo mʼafotu, na wobuu me nteɛso animtiaa nti,

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: wobedi wɔn akwan so aba; na wɔn nhyehyɛe mu aduan bɛmee wɔn.

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: Na ntetekwaafo asoɔden bekum wɔn, na nkwaseafo tirimudɛ bɛsɛe wɔn;

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Nanso obiara a obetie me no, ɔbɛtena ase asomdwoe mu na ne ho bɛtɔ no a ɔrensuro ɔhaw biara.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ wutie me nsɛm, na woma me mmaransɛm tena wo mu a,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: sɛ wowɛn wʼaso ma nyansa na wode wo koma ma ntease,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: na woma wo nne so frɛ nhumu na wusu frɛ ntease,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: na sɛ wohwehwɛ no te sɛnea wohwehwɛ dwetɛ na wohwehwɛ no sɛnea worepɛ ademude a ahintaw a,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ɛno na wobɛte Awurade suro ase na woahu Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Awurade ma nimdeɛ, na nʼanom na nyansa ne ntease fi ba.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Ɔkora nkonimdi ma wɔn a wɔteɛ, ɔyɛ kyɛm ma wɔn a wɔn akwan yɛ pɛ,

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: ɔwɛn nea ɔyɛ pɛ kwan, na ɔbɔ wɔn a wodi no nokware no akwan ho ban.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ɛno na wobɛte nea eye ne nea ɛyɛ pɛ, ne nea ɛfata, ɔkwan biara a eye ase.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Afei nyansa bewura wo koma mu, na nimdeɛ ayɛ ahomeka ama wo kra.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Adwene bɛbɔ wo ho ban na ntease ahwɛ wo so.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Nyansa beyi wo afi amumɔyɛfo akwan mu, ebeyi wo afi nnipa a wɔn nsɛm yɛ basabasa nsam,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔaman afi akwan pa so akɔnantew sum akwan so no,

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔn ani gye bɔneyɛ ho, na wodi ahurusi wɔ bɔne mu basabasayɛ ho,

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔn akwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye na wɔyɛ abonsam wɔ wɔn akwan mu.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Nimdeɛ begye wo afi ɔbea waresɛefo no nsam, afi ɔbea warefo huhuni a ɔka nnaadaasɛm ho,

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: nea wagyaa ne mmabaabere mu kunu na wapo apam a ɔyɛɛ wɔ Onyankopɔn anim no.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ne fi yɛ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ owu mu na nʼakwan kɔ awufo honhom nkyɛn.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔkɔ ne nkyɛn no nsan mma anaasɛ ɔrensi nkwa akwan so.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Enti wubedi nnipa pa anammɔn akyi na woanantew atreneefo akwan so.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Efisɛ wɔn a wɔteɛ bɛtena asase no so, na wɔn a asɛm nni wɔn ho no na wɔbɛka hɔ;

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: na wobetwa amumɔyɛfo afi asase no so, na wɔatɔre atorofo ase.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Me ba, mma wo werɛ mfi me nkyerɛkyerɛ, kora me mmara wɔ wo koma mu,

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: na ɛbɛma wo nkwa aware, mfe bebree na ɛde yiyedi abrɛ wo.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Mma adɔe ne nokware mmfi wo nkyɛn fa yan wo kɔn mu kyerɛw gu wo koma pon so.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Na wubenya adom ne din pa wɔ Onyankopɔn ne nnipa anim.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Fa wo koma nyinaa to Awurade so, na mfa wo ho nto wʼankasa ntease so;

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: hu no wʼakwan nyinaa mu, na ɔbɛteɛ wʼakwan.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Nnye wo ho nni sɛ woyɛ onyansafo; suro Awurade na kyi bɔne.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Ɛde ahoɔden bɛbrɛ wo nipadua, na ayɛ aduan ama wo nnompe.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Fa wʼahonya hyɛ Awurade anuonyam, ne wo nnɔbae a edi kan nyinaa;

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: na ɛno na ɛbɛma wo pata ayɛ ma abu so, na nsa foforo abu afa wʼahina so.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ Awurade teɛ wo so a, tie no yiye, na mmu nʼanimka so,

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Efisɛ, obiara a Awurade pɛ nʼasɛm no, ɔtwe nʼaso, sɛnea agya teɛ ɔba a ɔdɔ no no.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka onipa a ohu nyansa, onipa a onya ntease,

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: efisɛ, nimdeɛ so mfaso sen dwetɛ, na nea efi mu ba sen sikakɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Ne bo yɛ den sen bota; na worentumi mfa wʼapɛde biara ntoto no ho.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Nkwa tenten wɔ ne nsa nifa mu; ahonyade ne anuonyam wɔ ne nsa benkum mu.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Nʼakwan yɛ ahomeka, na nʼanammɔnkwan nyinaa yɛ asomdwoe.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ nkwadua ma wɔn a woso ne mu; wɔn a wokura no mu no benya nhyira.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nyansa mu na Awurade yɛɛ asase fapem, na ntease mu na ɔde ɔsoro tim hɔ.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Efi ne nimdeɛ mu na ɔkyekyɛɛ ebun mu, na omununkum nso tɔɔ obosu.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Me ba, fa atemmu pa ne nhumu sie, na mma emfi wʼani so;

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: ɛbɛyɛ nkwa ama wo, nnwinne a ɛma wo kɔn anuonyam wie pɛyɛ.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Afei wo kwan so bɛyɛ wo dwoodwoo, na wo nan renhintiw;

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: sɛ woda a worensuro; sɛ woda a wʼani bekum.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Nsuro mpofirim amanehunu anaa ɔsɛe a ɛba amumɔyɛfo so,

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: efisɛ Awurade bɛwɔ wʼafa na ɔbɛkora wo nan afi afiri mu.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Mfa ade pa nkame wɔn a wɔfata, bere a tumi wɔ wo nsam.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Nka nkyerɛ wo yɔnko se: “Kɔ na bra; mede bɛma wo ɔkyena” wɔ bere a wowɔ no saa bere no.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Mpam ɔhaw mma wo yɔnko bere a ɔne wo te yiye.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Mmɔ obi sobo kwa bere a ɔnyɛɛ wo bɔne biara ɛ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Mma wʼani mmere basabasayɛfo, na mfa nʼakwan no mu biara,

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: efisɛ Awurade kyi basabasayɛfo na ɔde ne werɛ hyɛ ɔtreneeni mu.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Odi fɛwdifo a wɔyɛ ahantan no ho fɛw, na ɔdom ahobrɛasefo ne wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Anyansafo benya anuonyam adi, nanso nkwaseafo de, ɔma wɔn anim gu ase.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Me mma, muntie me, muntie agya nkyerɛkyerɛ; monyɛ aso na moanya ntease.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Mema mo adesua a ɛkɔ anim, enti munnnyaa me nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Efisɛ na me nso, meyɛ mʼagya babarima, meda so yɛ akokoaa no, na me na ani gye me ho.

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me se, “Ma me nsɛm nni wo koma mu dɛm, di me nkyerɛkyerɛ so na wubenya nkwa.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Nya nyansa, nya ntease; mma wo werɛ mfi me nsɛm anaa ntwe wo ho mfi ho.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Nnyaw nyansa hɔ, na ɛbɛbɔ wo ho ban; dɔ no, na ɛbɛhwɛ wo so.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nyansa boro biribiara so; enti hwehwɛ nyansa. Ɛwɔ mu sɛ ne bo te sɛ wʼahode nyinaa de, nanso nya ntease.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Di no ni na ɛbɛma wo so; yɛ no atuu, na ɛbɛhyɛ wo anuonyam.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Ɔde nkonimdi nhwiren hankare begu wo ti so na wama wo ahenkyɛw a ɛyɛ fɛ.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Me ba, tie na fa nea meka no, na wo nkwanna bɛyɛ bebree.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Mɛkyerɛ wo nyansa kwan so na mede wo afa akwan a ɛteɛ so.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Sɛ wonantew a, wʼanammɔntu bɛkɔ waa na sɛ wutu mmirika a, worenhintiw.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Di nkyerɛkyerɛ so; na nnyaa mu, bɔ ho ban yiye, efisɛ ɛyɛ wo nkwa.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Ntu wo nan nsi amumɔyɛfo kwan so na nnantew abɔnefo kwan so.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Kwati no, ntu kwan mfa so; dan fi so na kɔ wo kwan.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Efisɛ wɔnyɛɛ bɔne a wontumi nna; na wɔn nna tew yera kosi sɛ wɔbɛma obi ahwe ase.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Wodi amumɔyɛsɛm brodo, na wɔnom kitikitiyɛ nsa.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Atreneefo kwan te sɛ adekyee hann a edi kan, ɛkɔ so hyerɛn yiye kodu awia ketee.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Nanso amumɔyɛfo kwan te sɛ sum kabii; wonnim nea ɛma wohintiw.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Me ba, yɛ aso ma nea meka; tie me nsɛm no yiye.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Mma emfi wʼani so, fa sie wo koma mu;

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: efisɛ, ɛyɛ nkwa ma wɔn a wohu ne akwahosan ma nipadua no nyinaa.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa akyi, bɔ wo koma ho ban, efisɛ, ɛno ne wo nkwa asuti.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Mma oburu kasa mfi wʼano; mma nkontomposɛm mmɛn wʼano koraa.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Hwɛ wʼanim tee, na ma wʼani nkɔ nea ɛwɔ wʼanim no so.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔkwan tamaa ma wʼanan na fa akwan a atim so.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Mman mfa nifa anaa benkum; twe wo nan fi bɔne ho.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Me ba, yɛ aso ma me nyansa; tie me nhumu nsɛm no yiye,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: sɛnea ɛbɛma woahwɛ yiye, na wʼano akora nimdeɛ.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Efisɛ ɔbea aguaman ano sosɔ ɛwo, na ne kasa yɛ fɔmm sen ngo;

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: nanso awiei no, ɛyɛ nwen sen bɔnwoma, ɛyɛ nam sɛ afoa anofanu.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Nʼanan kɔ owu mu; nʼanammɔntutu kɔ ɔda mu tee.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Onsusuw ɔkwan a ɛkɔ nkwa mu ho; nʼakwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye, nanso onnim.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Enti afei, me mma, muntie me; Monntwe mo ho mmfi nea meka ho.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Ɔkwan a ɛmmɛn no no na momfa so; mommmɛn ne fi pon ano,

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a, mode mo ahoɔden bɛma afoforo na mode mo mfe ama otirimɔdenfo,

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a, ahɔho bɛfom mo ahonyade na mo brɛ de ahonya akɔ afoforo fi.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Mo nkwanna akyi, mubesi apini, bere a mo honam ne mo nipadua asa no.

english_verse: and shout, “I hated advice and correction!
translation_verse: Na moaka se, “Na mikyi ahohyɛso! Me koma ampɛ nteɛso!

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Manyɛ osetie amma mʼakyerɛkyerɛfo na mantie me kwankyerɛfo asɛm.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Madu ɔsɛe ano wɔ asafo no nyinaa mu.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Nom nsu fi wʼankasa ahina mu, nsu a ɛteɛ fi wʼankasa abura mu.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: So ɛsɛ sɛ wʼasuti yiri fa mmɔnten so na wo nsuwa kokɔ ɔman aguabɔbea ana?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Ma ɛnyɛ wo nko ara de, a wo ne ahɔho nkyɛ da.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wʼasubura na wʼani nnye wo mmrantebere mu yere ho.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ ɔtwe bere dɔfo, ɔwansan nuonyamfo; ma ne nufu nsɔ wʼani daa na ne dɔ nkyekyere wo.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Me ba, adɛn nti na woma ɔbea aguaman kyekyere wo? Adɛn nti na woda ɔbarima foforo bi yere kokom?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Awurade hu onipa akwan nyinaa, na ɔhwehwɛ ne nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo nnebɔne sum no afiri; na ne bɔne ahama kyekyere no papee.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Wobewu, esiane ahohyɛso a wonni nti, na wɔayera, esiane wɔn agyennyentwisɛm nti.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ woadi akagyinamu ama ɔyɔnko bi, sɛ wode wo biribi asi awowa ama obi,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: sɛ nea wokae ayi ka ama wo na sɛ wʼano asɛm afiri ayi wo a,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: ɛno de yɛ eyi, me ba, na fa tetew wo ho, sɛ ɔyɔnko nsa aka wo no nti: fa ahobrɛase kɔ nʼanim; na kɔ so pa wo yɔnko no kyɛw!

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Mma wʼani nkum na ntɔ nko.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Gye wo ho, sɛnea ɔforote guan fi ɔbɔmmɔfo nsam anaa sɛnea anomaa guan fi ofirisumfo afiri mu no.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofo, kɔ ɔtɛtea nkyɛn; hwɛ nʼakwan, na hu nyansa!

english_verse: Ants don't have leaders,
translation_verse: Onni ɔsahene, onni ɔhwɛfo anaa sodifo bi,

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: nanso ɔde aduan sie wɔ ahuhurubere mu, ɔboaboa nnuan ano wɔ twabere.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Nna kakra, nkotɔ kakra, nsa a woabobɔw de rehome kakra,

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: ɛbɛma ohia aba wo so sɛ ɔkwanmukafo na ahokyere atow akyere wo sɛnea okura otuo.

english_verse: Worthless liars go around
translation_verse: Onipa teta ne ohuhuni a odi atoro kyin,

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: nea ɔde ne koma mu nnaadaa bɔ pɔw bɔne, na ɔde mpaapaemu ba bere biara.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti amanehunu bɛba no so prɛko pɛ; wɔbɛsɛe no mpofirim, a wɔrenya ano aduru.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Nneɛma asia na Awurade mpɛ, nneɛma ason na ɛyɛ nʼakyiwade:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: ani a ɛtra ntɔn, atoro tɛkrɛma, nsa a ɛka mogya a edi bem gu,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: koma a edwen amumɔyɛ ho, anan a etutu mmirika kɔyɛ bɔne,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: ɔdansekurumni a odi atoro ne onipa a ɔde mpaapaemu ba anuanom mu. Aguamammɔ Ho Kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: Obey the teaching of your parents—
translation_verse: Me ba, tie wʼagya ahyɛde na nnyaa wo na nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Fa kyekyere wo koma ho daa; na fa kyekyere wɔ kɔn mu.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Wonantew a, ɛbɛkyerɛ wo kwan; sɛ woda a, ɛbɛwɛn wo; sɛ wunyan a, ɛbɛkasa akyerɛ wo.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Na saa ahyɛde yi yɛ kanea saa nkyerɛkyerɛ yi yɛ hann, na ahohyɛso nteɛso yi yɛ nkwa kwan,

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: ɛtwe wo fi ɔbea a onni suban pa no ho, fi ɔbeawarefo huhuni tɛkrɛmadɛ ho.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Mma wo kɔn nnɔ nʼahoɔfɛ, mma nʼani akyideda no ntwetwe wo,

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: efisɛ oguamanfo ma wʼanuonyam yɛ sɛ brodosin, na obi yere gyigye wo kɔ owu mu.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Obi betumi asɔ gya agu ne srɛ so a nhyew nʼatade ana?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Obi betumi anantew nnyansramma so a mpumpunnya mmobɔ nʼanan ho ana?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Saa na ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbarima foforo yere da no te; obiara a ɔde ne nsa bɛka no no, remfa ne ho nni da.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Nnipa mmu ɔkorɔmfo a wakowia ade animtiaa sɛ ɔkɔm de no na ɔde rekodwudwo ano nti.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Mmom, sɛ wɔkyere no a, ɛsɛ sɛ otua mmɔho ason; sɛ ɛbɛma wahwere ne fi agyapade nyinaa mpo a.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima a ɔsɛe aware no nni adwene; obiara a ɔyɛ saa no sɛe ne ho.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Ɔhwe ne animguase na obenya, na nʼahohora rempepa da.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Ninkutwe hwanyan okunu abufuw na sɛ ɔtɔ were a, ahummɔbɔ biara nni mu.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Ɔrennye mpata biara; na ɔbɛpo adanmude, sɛ ɛso sɛ dɛn mpo a.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Me ba, fa me nsɛm sie na kora mʼahyɛde wɔ wo mu.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Di mʼahyɛde so na wubenya nkwa; bɔ me nkyerɛkyerɛ ho ban sɛ nea wodɔ no.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Kyekyere bɔ wo nsateaa ho; kyerɛw no yiye gu wo koma pon so.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ nyansa se, “Woyɛ me nuabea,” na frɛ ntease wo busuani;

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛtwe wo afi ɔbeawaresɛefo ho, afi ɔbeawarefo huhuni nsɛmmɔdɛ ho.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Me fi mfɛnsere ano, mede mʼani faa mfɛnsere mu.

english_verse: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
translation_verse: Na ɔnam borɔn a ɛbɛn ɔbea no fi so a nʼani kyerɛ ɔbea no fi

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbea bi fi behyiaa no a wasiesie ne ho sɛ oguamanfo a nnaadaa wɔ ne koma mu.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: (Ɔyɛ hyirenn na hwee mfa ne ho, ɔntena fie koraa;

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: nnɛ wohu no mmɔnten so, ɔkyena na ɔte aguabɔbea, ɔtetɛw wɔ mmantwea mmantwea.)

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Osoo ne mu few nʼano, wamfɛre, na ɔkae se,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Mewɔ asomdwoe afɔrebɔde wɔ fie; nnɛ madi me bɔhyɛ so.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Enti mebae sɛ merebehyia wo; mehwehwɛɛ wo na mahu wo!

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Mato me mpa, mede nwera a wɔahyɛ no aduru a efi Misraim.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mede nnuhuam apete me mpa so: kurobow, pɛprɛ ne dupapo.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Bra, ma yɛmfa ɔdɔ mmɔ ɔdɔ mu nkosi anɔpa;

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Me kunu nni fie; watu kwan na ɔbɛkyɛ.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Ɔde sika a ɛdɔɔso hyɛɛ ne sika kotoku ma na ɔremma kosi ɔsram no kurokumatwa bere mu.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Ɔde tɛkrɛmakyene bɔɔ no adafa; ɔde nnaadaa nyaa no ne no dae.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Odii nʼakyi prɛko pɛ te sɛ nantwi a ɔrekɔ akumii, anaa ɔwansan a ɔde ne ti rekɔhyɛ hankare fi mu

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: kosi sɛ bɛmma bɛwɔ ne brɛbo mu, te sɛ anomaa a ɔrekɔtɔ anomaa afiri mu na onnim sɛ ɔbɛhwere ne nkwa.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Na afei, me mma, muntie me; monyɛ aso mma nea meka.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Mommma mo koma mpatiri nkɔ no so na momman mmfa nʼakwan so.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Bebree na wɔnam no so ahwehwe ase; wɔn a wakum wɔn dɔɔso pa ara.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ne fi yɛ ɔda tempɔn a ɛkɔ owu pia mu.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Tie: Nyansa refrɛ. Ntease ma ne nne so.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Ɔkwan no so, sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ, nkwantanan no so, ɛhɔ na egyina,

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: apon a ɛkɔ kuropɔn no mu no ho, ɛteɛ mu wɔ abobow ano hɔ se,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Ao, mo nnipa na meteɛ mu refrɛ; meteɛ mu frɛ adesamma nyinaa.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Mo a moyɛ ntetekwaa, momma mo ani ntew; mo a moyɛ nkwaseafo, munnya ntease.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Muntie, na mewɔ nsɛm pa bi ka kyerɛ mo; mibue mʼano ka nea eye.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Mʼano ka nea ɛyɛ nokware, efisɛ mʼanofafa kyi amumɔyɛsɛm.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Mʼanom nsɛm nyinaa yɛ pɛ; biara nni mu a ɛyɛ nkontompo anaa nnaadaasɛm.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa mu da hɔ ma nea ɔwɔ nhumu; ɛho nni asɛm ma wɔn a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Mompo dwetɛ na momfa mʼakwankyerɛ, momfa nimdeɛ na mompo sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Efisɛ nimdeɛ som bo sen bota, na worentumi mfa nea wopɛ biara ntoto no ho.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: “Me, nyansa, mene anitew na ɛte; nimdeɛ ne nhumu wɔ me.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Sɛ wosuro Awurade ɛne sɛ wokyi bɔne; mikyi ahantan ne ahomaso, ɔbra bɔne ne nnaadaasɛm.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Afotu ne atemmu pa wɔ me; mewɔ ntease ne tumi.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Me so na ahemfo nam di ade na sodifo nam me so hyehyɛ mmara a ɛyɛ pɛ;

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Mmapɔmma de me bu ɔman ne atitiriw nyinaa a wodi asase so hene.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Medɔ wɔn a wɔdɔ me, na wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me no hu me.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Ahonyade ne anuonyam wɔ me nkyɛn, ahode a ɛkyɛ ne yiyedi nso saa ara.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Mʼaba ye sen sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa; nea efi me mu boro dwetɛ a wɔasɔn so so.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Trenee akwan so na menam, atɛntrenee akwan so,

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: mede ahode ma wɔn a wɔdɔ me na mehyɛ wɔn adekoradan amaama.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: “Awurade bɔɔ me sɛ nʼabɔde mu abakan dii ne tete nneyɛe anim;

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: oyii me sii hɔ fi tete, ansa na wiase refi ase.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Wɔwoo me ansa na wɔrebɔ po kakraka no, ansa na wɔreyɛ nsuti a nsu ahyɛ no ma no,

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: ansa na wɔde mmepɔw resisi hɔ; wɔwoo me ansa na nkoko reba,

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: ansa na ɔbɔɔ asase ne ne mfuw anaa dɔte biara a ɛwɔ asase so.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Mewɔ hɔ ansa na wɔbɔɔ ɔsoro, bere a otwaa ɔhye too ebun no ani no,

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: bere a ɔbɔɔ omununkum wɔ soro na ɔde ebun mu nsuti tintim hɔ dennen no;

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: bere a otwaa ɔhye maa po sɛnea nsu no rentra ne hye, ne bere a otwaa asase fapem no,

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: na meyɛ odwumfo a mete ne nkyɛn. Anigye hyɛɛ me ma daa na midii ahurusi wɔ nʼanim bere biara,

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: na mʼani gye wɔ ne wiase nyinaa mu na mʼani ka wɔ adesamma mu.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: “Enti me mma, muntie me; nhyira ne wɔn a wɔnantew mʼakwan so.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Muntie mʼakwankyerɛ na munhu nyansa; mummmu mo ani ngu so.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne onipa a otie me, ɔwɛn mʼabobow ano daa, na ɔtwɛn wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ohu me no nya nkwa, na onya anisɔ fi Awurade nkyɛn.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Na nea wanhwehwɛ me no haw ne ho na wɔn a wɔtan me no dɔ owu.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nyansa asi ne fi; wasisi nʼafadum ason.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Wasiesie ne nam de afra ne nsa, wato ne pon.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Wasoma ne mmaawa, na ɔfrɛ fi kuropɔn no sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ se,

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: “Momma ntetekwaafo nyinaa mmra ha!” Ɔka kyerɛ wɔn a wonni atemmu se,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Mommra mmedi mʼaduan na monnom nsa a mafra no.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Munnyaw mo ntetekwaasɛm no na mubenya nkwa; monnantew ntease akwan so.”

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: Nea ɔteɛteɛ ɔfɛwdifo no frɛ ahohorabɔ; na nea ɔka amumɔyɛfo anim no nya ɔyaw.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti, nka ɔfɛwdifo anim na ɔmmɛtan wo; ka onyansafo anim na ɔbɛdɔ wo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Ma onyansafo akwankyerɛ na ɔbɛkɔ so ahu nyansa; kyerɛkyerɛ ɔtreneeni na ɔde bɛka nʼadesua ho.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ nyansa mfiase Ɔkronkronni no ho nimdeɛ yɛ ntease.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Me mu na wo nna bɛdɔɔso, na wɔde mfe bɛka wo nkwa ho.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ onyansafo a, wubenya wo nyansa so mfaso; sɛ woyɛ ɔfɛwdifo a, wo nko ara na wubehu amane.

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Ɔbea ɔkwasea yɛ ɔkasafo; onni ahohyɛso na onni nimdeɛ.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Ɔte ne fi pon ano, na ɔte akongua a esi kuropɔn no sorɔnsorɔmmea,

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Momma ntetekwaafo nyinaa mmra ha” ɔka kyerɛ wɔn a wonni atemmu se,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Nsu a wowia no yɛ fremfrem na aduan a wodi no ahintawee no yɛ dɛ!”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Nanso wonnim koraa sɛ awufo wɔ hɔ sɛ nʼahɔho wɔ ɔda no ase tɔnn.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Salomo mmebusɛm: Ɔba nyansafo ma nʼagya ani gye, na ɔba kwasea brɛ ne na awerɛhow.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ɔkwan bɔne so ahonya nni bo, nanso trenee gye onipa fi owu mu.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Awurade remma ɔkɔm nne ɔtreneeni na omumɔyɛfo de, ɔka nʼadepa gu.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Nsa a ɛnyɛ adwuma ma onipa di hia, nanso nsiyɛfo nsa de ahonya ba.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Nea ɔboaboa nnɔbae ano wɔ ahuhurubere no yɛ ɔba nyansafo na nea ɔda wɔ twabere mu no yɛ ɔba nimguaseni.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Atreneefo hyɛ nhyira kyɛw na akakabensɛm ayɛ omumɔyɛfo anom ma.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni nkae yɛ nhyira, na omumɔyɛfo din bɛporɔw.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Koma mu nyansafo tie ɔhyɛ nsɛm, na ɔkwasea kasafo hwe ase.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Ɔnokwafo nantew dwoodwoo, na nea ɔfa akwan kɔntɔnkye so no ho bɛda adi.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Nea ɔde nitan bu nʼani no de ɔhaw ba, na ɔkwasea kasafo hwe ase.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni anom yɛ nkwa asuti, na akakabensɛm ayɛ omumɔyɛfo anom ma.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Ɔtan kanyan mpaapaemu, nanso ɔdɔ kata mfomso nyinaa so.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Wohu nyansa wɔ nhumufo anom, na abaa fata nea onni adwene akyi.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Adefo ahonya yɛ wɔn kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban, nanso ahiafo hia yɛ wɔn asehwe.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Atreneefo akatua de nkwa brɛ wɔn, na nea amumɔyɛfo nya no de asotwe brɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Nea otie ntetew pa no kyerɛ nkwa kwan, na nea ɔpo nteɛso no di afoforo anim yera kwan.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Nea ɔkata nitan so no yɛ ɔtorofo, na nea odi nseku no yɛ ɔkwasea.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Mfomso mpa ɔkasa bebree mu, na nea ɔkora ne tɛkrɛma no yɛ onyansafo.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni tɛkrɛma yɛ dwetɛ ankasa nanso omumɔyɛfo koma nni bo.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Atreneefo ano ma bebree aduan, na atemmu a nkwaseafo nni nti wowuwu.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Awurade nhyira de ahonya ba, na ɔmfa ɔbrɛ mmata ne nya ho.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Bɔneyɛ yɛ anigyede ma ɔkwasea, nanso nea ɔwɔ nimdeɛ anigye wɔ nyansa mu.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Nea amumɔyɛfo suro no bɛba wɔn so; na nea atreneefo pɛ no, wɔde bɛma wɔn.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Sɛ ahum no betwa mu a, amumɔyɛfo yera, nanso atreneefo gyina hɔ pintinn afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Sɛnea nsa keka ɛse, na wusiw kɔ aniwa no, saa ara na ɔkwadwofo yɛ ma wɔn a wɔsoma no.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Awurade suro ma nkwa tenten, nanso wotwa amumɔyɛfo nkwa so.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Atreneefo anidaso de ahotɔ ba, nanso amumɔyɛfo anidaso nkosi hwee.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Awurade kwan yɛ guankɔbea ma ɔtreneeni, nanso ɛyɛ ɔsɛe ma wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Wɔrentɔre atreneefo ase da, nanso amumɔyɛfo renka asase no so.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nyansa fi ɔtreneeni anom ba nanso tɛkrɛma a ɛdaadaa no, wobetwa akyene.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni ano nim ade a ɛfata na omumɔyɛfo ano nim nea ɛyɛ nnaadaasɛm nko ara.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Awurade kyi asisi nsania, na nʼani gye nokware nkaribo ho.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Ahantan ba a, animguase na edi so, nanso ahobrɛase de nyansa ba.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ahonya nka hwee wɔ abufuwhyew da no, nanso trenee gye nkwa fi owu mu.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wonni bɔne no trenee bɔ kwan tee ma wɔn, nanso amumɔyɛfo amumɔyɛsɛm brɛ wɔn ase.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Pɛyɛfo treneeyɛ gye wɔn, nanso akɔnnɔ bɔne afiri yi nkontompofo.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Sɛ omumɔyɛfo wu a, nʼanidaso yera; nea osusuw sɛ obenya afi ne tumi mu nyinaa no yɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Wogye ɔtreneeni fi amane mu, na ɛba omumɔyɛfo so mmom.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Nea onsuro Onyame de nʼano sɛe ne yɔnko, nanso ɔtreneeni nam nimdeɛ so fi mu.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Sɛ atreneefo di yiye a, kuropɔn no di ahurusi; nanso amumɔyɛfo wu a, wɔbɔ ose.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Pɛyɛfo nhyira ma kuropɔn no kɔ so, nanso amumɔyɛfo ano ma ɛbɔ.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Onipa a onni adwene no bu ne yɔnko animtiaa, nanso nea ɔwɔ nhumu no to ne tɛkrɛma nnareka.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Nsekudi sɛe ahotoso, nanso nea wɔwɔ ne mu ahotoso no kora ahintasɛm.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Ɔman a enni akwankyerɛ no bɔ, nanso afotufo dodow ma nkonimdi ba.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Nea odi akagyinamu ma ɔfoforo no behu amane, na nea ɔmmfa ne nsa nhyɛ awowasi ase no aso mu dwo no.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Ɔbea a ne yam ye no, wɔde obu ma no, nanso mmarima atirimɔdenfo nya ahode nkutoo.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Ɔyamyefo ye ma ne ho, na otirimɔdenfo de ɔhaw ba nʼankasa so.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo nya akatua a ennyina, nanso nea ogu trenee aba no twa aba a edi mu.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Nea ɔyɛ nokware treneeni no nya nkwa, nanso nea ɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne no kɔ owu mu.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Awurade kyi nnipa a wɔn koma akyea, na nʼani gye wɔn a wɔn akwan ho nni asɛm no ho.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Gye to mu sɛ, amumɔyɛfo benya wɔn akatua, na atreneefo benya wɔn ti adidi mu.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Ɔbea hoɔfɛfo a ontumi nsi gyinae no te sɛ sika kaa a ɛhyɛ prako hwene mu.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Atreneefo apɛde wie yiye, nanso amumɔyɛfo anidaso wie abufuwhyew.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Obi yɛ adɔe, na onya ne ho bebree; obi nso yɛ pɛpɛe, nanso ehia no.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Ɔyamyefo bɛkɔ so anya ne ho; na nea ɔma ebinom mee no nso bɛmee.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nnipa dome nea ɔde atoko sie, na nhyira ba nea ɔtɔn ne de so.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Nea ɔhwehwɛ papa akyi kwan no nya anisɔ, na nea ɔhwehwɛ bɔne no, bɔne ba ne so.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Nea ɔde ne ho to nʼahonyade so no bɛhwe ase, na ɔtreneeni bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ ahabammono.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Nea ɔde ɔhaw bɛto nʼabusua so no bedi mframa ade, na ɔkwasea bɛyɛ onyansafo somfo.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni aba yɛ nkwadua, na nea ogye akra no yɛ onyansafo.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Kyerɛwsɛm no ka se, “Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobegye onipa pa nkwa; na wɔn a wonnye asɛm no nni ne nnebɔneyɛfo no de, dɛn na ɛbɛba wɔn so?”

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔpɛ ahohyɛso no pɛ nimdeɛ, na nea okyi nteɛso no yɛ ogyimifo.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Nnipa pa nya Awurade nkyɛn adom, na Awurade bu amumɔyɛfo fɔ.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛsɛm rentumi mma onipa ase ntim, na wɔrentumi ntu ɔtreneeni ase.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Ɔyere a ɔwɔ suban pa yɛ ne kunu ahenkyɛw, nanso ɔyere nimguasefo te sɛ porɔwee wɔ ne kunu nnompe mu.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Atreneefo nhyehyɛe yɛ pɛ, na amumɔyɛfo afotu yɛ nnaadaa.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo nsɛm da hɔ twɛn mogya, na ɔtreneeni kasa yi wɔn fi mu.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Wotu amumɔyɛfo gu na wɔyera, nanso atreneefo fi gyina pintinn.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Wɔkamfo onipa sɛnea ne nyansa te na nnipa a wɔn adwene yɛ kɔntɔnkye de, wobu wɔn animtiaa.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Eye sɛ wobɛyɛ wo ho sɛ ɔteta nanso wowɔ ɔsomfo, sen sɛ wobɛyɛ wo ho sɛ obi, nanso wunni aduan.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni ma ne nyɛmmoa nea wɔpɛ, na amumɔyɛfo nneyɛe a eye pa ara yɛ atirimɔden.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Nea ɔyɛ nʼasase so adwuma no benya aduan bebree, na nea odi nsɛm huhuw akyi no nni adwene.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo pɛ abɔnefo asade, nanso ɔtreneeni ase dɔ.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔnefo anosɛm yi no sɛ afiri, nanso ɔtreneeni nya ne ho tetew wɔ ahohia mu.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Nneɛma pa fi onipa anom aba mu hyɛ no ma sɛnea ne nsa ano adwuma ma no akatua no.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea akwan teɛ nʼani so, na onyansafo tie afotu.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Nkwaseafo bo nkyɛ fuw, nanso mmadwemma bu wɔn ani gu animka so.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ɔdanseni nokwafo di adanse turodoo, na nea odi adansekurum no twa nkontompo.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Nsɛm hunu keka wowɔ te sɛ afoa nanso onyansafo tɛkrɛma ma abodwo.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Ano a ɛka nokware no tim hɔ daa, na atoro tɛkrɛma renkyɛ koraa.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Nnaadaa hyɛ wɔn a wodwen bɔne ho no koma mu, na wɔn a wɔpɛ asomdwoe nya ahosɛpɛw.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw biara rento ɔtreneeni, nanso amanehunu mee amumɔyɛfo.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Awurade kyi ano a etwa atoro, na nʼani gye nnipa a wodi nokware ho.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni mmɔ ne nimdeɛ ho dawuru nanso ɔkwasea koma da agyimisɛm adi.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Nsa a ɛyɛ adwuma no bedi tumi, nanso akwadworɔ wie nkoasom mu.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Koma a ɛpere ade ho ma onipa botow, nanso nkuranhyɛsɛm bi hyɛ no den.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni wɔ ntoboase wɔ ayɔnkofa mu, nanso amumɔyɛfo kwan ma wɔfom.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Onihawfo ntoto ne hanam, nanso nsiyɛfo ahonyade som bo ma wɔn.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Trenee kwan mu wɔ nkwa; na owu nni saa kwan no so.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Ɔba nyansafo tie nʼagya nkyerɛkyerɛ; na ɔfɛwdifo ntie animka.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Nneɛma pa a efi onipa anom no ma no anigye, na wɔn a wonni nokware no kɔn dɔ kitikitiyɛ.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Nea ɔkora nʼano no kora ne nkwa so, nanso nea ɔkasa a onsusuw ho no bɛba ɔsɛe mu.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Onihawfo pere hwehwɛ nanso onya hwee, na nea ɔyɛ adwuma no nya nea ɔpɛ biara.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Atreneefo kyi nea ɛnyɛ nokware, nanso amumɔyɛfo de aniwu ne ahohora ba.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Trenee bɔ ɔnokwafo ho ban, na amumɔyɛsɛm tu ɔbɔnefo gu.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Obi yɛ ne ho sɛ ɔdefo, a nso onni hwee, ɔfoforo yɛ ne ho sɛ ohiani, nso ɔwɔ ahonya bebree.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Obi ahonya betumi agye no nkwa, nanso ohiani nte ahunahuna biara.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Atreneefo kanea hyerɛn pa ara, nanso wodum amumɔyɛfo kanea.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Ahantan de ntɔkwaw nko ara na ɛba, na wohu nyansa wɔ wɔn a wotie afotu mu.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Ahonya a ɛnam ɔkwammɔne so no hwere ntɛm so, na nea ɔboa sika ano nkakrankakra no ma ɛdɔɔso.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Anidaso a wotu hyɛ da no bɔ koma ɔyare, nanso anigyinade a nsa aka no yɛ nkwadua.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Nea otwiri akwankyerɛ no betua so ka, nanso wɔma nea ɔde obu ma mmara no akatua.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Onyansafo nkyerɛkyerɛ te sɛ nkwa asuti, eyi onipa fi owu afiri mu.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Nhumu pa de adom ba, nanso atorofo akwan so yɛ den.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Ɔbadwemma biara yɛ nʼade wɔ nimdeɛ mu, nanso ɔkwasea da nʼagyimisɛm adi.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Ɔsomafo mumɔyɛfo tɔ amane mu, nanso ɔnanmusini nokwafo de abodwo ba.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Nea ɔpo nteɛso no kɔ ohia ne animguase mu, na wɔhyɛ nea otie nteɛso no anuonyam.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Akɔnnɔde a nsa aka ma ɔkra ani gye, nanso nkwaseafo kyi sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi bɔne ho.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Nea ɔne onyansafo nantew no hu nyansa, na nea ɔne nkwaseafo bɔ no hu amane.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw di ɔbɔnefo akyi, na nkɔso yɛ ɔtreneeni akatua.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Onipa pa de agyapade gyaw ne nenanom, na wɔkora ɔbɔnefo ahonyade so ma ɔtreneeni.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ohiani afum nnɔbae tumi ba pii, nanso ntɛnkyew pra kɔ.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Nea ɔkyɛe nʼabaa so no tan ne ba, na nea ɔdɔ no no hwɛ sɛ ɔbɛteɛ no.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Atreneefo didi ma wɔn koma mee, nanso ɔkɔm de amumɔyɛfo.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Ɔbea nyansafo si ne dan, nanso ɔbea kwasea de nʼankasa ne nsa dwiriw ne de gu fam.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Nea ne nantew teɛ no suro Awurade, na nea nʼakwan kyea no bu no animtiaa.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea kasa ma wɔbɔ nʼakyi abaa, nanso anyansafo ano bɔ wɔn ho ban.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Faako a anantwi nni no, adididaka no mu da mpan, na nantwi ahoɔden mu na nnɔbae pii fi ba.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ɔdanseni nokwafo rennaadaa, ɔdansekurumni hwie atoro gu hɔ.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Ɔfɛwdifo hwehwɛ nyansa nanso onya, nanso wɔn a wɔwɔ nhumu nya nimdeɛ ntɛm.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Twe wo ho fi ɔkwasea ho, efisɛ, worennya nimdeɛ mfi nʼano.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Anitewfo nyansa ne sɛ wɔbɛdwene wɔn akwan ho, na nkwaseafo agyimisɛm yɛ nnaadaa.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Nkwaseafo de bɔne ho adwensakra di fɛw, na wɔn a wɔteɛ mu na anisɔ wɔ.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Koma biara nim ɔyaw wɔ ne mu, na obi foforo rentumi ne no nkyɛ nʼanigye.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛsɛe amumɔyɛfo fi, nanso teefo ntamadan bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Ɔkwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɛteɛ wɔ onipa ani so, nanso awiei no, ɛkɔ owu mu.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ɔserew mu mpo, koma tumi di yaw, na anigye tumi wie awerɛhow.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Akyirisanfo benya akatua sɛnea wɔn akwan te, na onipa pa nso benya ne de.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Atetekwaa gye biribiara di, nanso onitefo dwene nʼanammɔntu ho.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Onyansafo suro Awurade na oguan bɔne, nanso ɔkwasea yɛ asowui ne basabasa.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Onipa a ne bo nkyɛ fuw no yɛ nkwaseade, na wɔtɔn nea ɔpam apam bɔne no.

english_verse: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
translation_verse: Ntetekwaafo agyapade ne gyimi, na wɔde nimdeɛ bɔ anitewfo abotiri.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Nnipa bɔnefo bɛkotow nnipa pa anim, na amumɔyɛfo akotow atreneefo apon ano.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ahiafo de, wɔn yɔnkonom mpo mpɛ wɔn anim ahwɛ, nanso adefo wɔ nnamfonom bebree.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Nea obu ne yɔnko animtiaa yɛ bɔne, na nhyira nka nea ne yam ye ma ohiani.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: So wɔn a wɔbɔ pɔw bɔne nyera kwan ana? Nanso wɔn a wɔhyehyɛ nea eye no nya adɔe ne nokware.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Adwumadenyɛ nyinaa de mfaso ba, na kasahunu de, ɛkɔ ohia mu.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Anyansafo ahonya ne wɔn abotiri, na nkwaseafo agyimisɛm sow gyimi aba.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔdanseni nokwafo gye nkwa, nanso ɔdansekurumni yɛ ɔdaadaafo.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Nea osuro Awurade no wɔ bammɔ a mu yɛ den, na ɛbɛyɛ guankɔbea ama ne mma.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ nkwa asuti, eyi onipa fi owu afiri mu.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Ɔman mu nnipa dodow yɛ ɔhene anuonyam, nanso sɛ asomfo nni hɔ a mmapɔmma no sɛe.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔwɔ abodwokyɛre wɔ ntease a mu dɔ, na nea ne bo fu ntɛm no da agyimisɛm adi.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Koma mu asomdwoe ma nipadua nkwa, na anibere ma nnompe porɔw.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Nea ɔhyɛ ahiafo so no bu wɔn Yɛfo animtiaa, nanso nea ohu ohiani mmɔbɔ no hyɛ Onyankopɔn anuonyam.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
