translation_verse: Sɛ amanehunu ba a amumɔyɛfo hwe ase, nanso owu mu mpo atreneefo wɔ guankɔbea.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Nyansa te ntease koma mu, na nkwaseafo mu mpo, oyi ne ho adi.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Trenee pagyaw ɔman, na bɔne yɛ animguase ma nnipa nyinaa.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Ɔhene ani sɔ ɔsomfo nyansani, na ɔsomfo nimguasefo hyɛ no abufuw.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Mmuae pa sianka abufuwhyew, nanso asɛm a ano yɛ den hwanyan abufuw mu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Onyansafo tɛkrɛma yi nimdeɛ ayɛ, nanso ɔkwasea ano woro agyimisɛm.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Awurade ani hu baabiara, na ɛhwɛ amumɔyɛfo ne apapafo.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Tɛkrɛma a ɛde abodwo ba yɛ nkwadua, nanso nnaadaa tɛkrɛma dwerɛw honhom.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea mfa nʼagya nteɛso nyɛ hwee, na nea otie nteɛso no kyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ onitefo.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Ahonya bebree wɔ ɔtreneeni fi, nanso amumɔyɛfo adenya de ɔhaw brɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Anyansafo ano trɛtrɛw nimdeɛ mu, nanso ɛnyɛ saa na nkwaseafo koma te.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Awurade kyi amumɔyɛfo afɔrebɔ, nanso teefo mpaebɔ sɔ nʼani.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Awurade kyi amumɔyɛfo akwan, nanso ɔdɔ wɔn a wotiw trenee.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Asotwe dennen wɔ hɔ ma nea ɔman fi ɔkwan no so, nea ɔtan nteɛso no bewu.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Owu ne Ɔsɛe da Awurade anim, na nnipa koma mu de, onim ma ɛboro so.

english_verse: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
translation_verse: Anigye koma ma anim yɛ sereserew, na koma a abotow dwerɛw honhom.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Nhumufo koma hwehwɛ nimdeɛ, nanso ɔkwasea ano ka agyimisɛm.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so nna nyinaa yɛ mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ, nanso anigye koma wɔ daa ahosɛpɛw mu.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Ketewa bi a yenya a Awurade suro ka ho no ye sen ahonyade bebree a ɔhaw bata ho.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Nhabamma aduan a ɔdɔ wɔ mu no ye sen nantwi sradenam a ɔtan bata ho.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Nea ne bo fuw ntɛm no de mpaapaemu ba, nanso nea ɔwɔ ntoboase pata ntɔkwaw.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Nsɔe ama onihawfo kwan asiw, nanso teefo kwan yɛ ɔtempɔn.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Ɔba nyansafo ma nʼagya ani gye, nanso ɔba kwasea bu ne na animtiaa.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Agyimisɛm ma nea onni adwene ani gye, nanso nea ɔwɔ ntease no fa ɔkwan a ɛteɛ so.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Nhyehyɛe a enni afotu no sɛe, nanso afotufo bebree ma ɛyɛ yiye.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔma mmuae a ɛfata no ani gye, asɛm a ɛba bere pa mu no nso ye.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Onyansafo asetena mu kwan ma no nkɔso, esiw ne da mukɔ ho kwan.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Awurade sɛe ɔhantanni fi, na ɔma akunafo ahye yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Awurade kyi amumɔyɛfo nsusuwii, nanso nʼani sɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ kronkron no de.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Odifudepɛfo de ɔhaw brɛ nʼabusua, nanso nea okyi kɛtɛasehyɛ no benya nkwa.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni koma kari ne mmuae, nanso omumɔyɛfo ano woro bɔne.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Anim a ɛtew ma koma nya ahomeka, na asɛm pa ma nnompe ahoɔden.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Nea otie animka a ɛma nkwa no ne anyansafo bɛbɔ mu atena ase.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Nea ɔmfa ahohyɛso no bu ne ho animtiaa, na nea otie nteɛso no nya nhumu.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Awurade suro kyerɛ onipa nyansa, ahobrɛase di anuonyam anim.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Koma mu nhyehyɛe yɛ onipa de, na tɛkrɛma mmuae fi Awurade.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ onipa sɛ nʼakwan nyinaa yɛ kronkron, nanso Awurade na ɔpɛɛpɛɛ adwene mu.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Fa nea woyɛ nyinaa hyɛ Awurade nsam, na wo nhyehyɛe besi yiye.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ biribiara ma nʼankasa botae, mpo, ɔhwɛ omumɔyɛfo so kosi amanehunu da.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Awurade kyi koma mu ahantanfo nyinaa. Nya saa ntease yi sɛ, wɔremfa wɔn ho nni.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Wɔnam ɔdɔ ne nokware so pata bɔne; onipa nam Awurade suro so yi bɔne akwa.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa akwan sɔ Awurade ani a, ɔma nʼatamfo mpo ne no tena asomdwoe mu.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Kakraa bi a wɔnam trenee kwan so nya no ye sen mfaso pii a wɔnam ntɛnkyew so nya.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Onipa yɛ ne nhyehyɛe wɔ ne koma mu, nanso Awurade na ɔhwɛ nʼanammɔntu.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔhene anom kasa te sɛ nkɔmhyɛ, enti ɛnsɛ sɛ nʼano ka nea ɛnyɛ atɛntrenee.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Nsania ne abrammo a asisi nni mu fi Awurade; nkaribo a ɛwɔ kotoku mu no, ɔno na ɔyɛe.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Ahemfo kyi bɔneyɛ, efisɛ ahengua si trenee so.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Ɔhene abufuwhyew yɛ owu somafo, nanso onyansafo bedwudwo ano.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhene anim tew a, ɛyɛ nkwa, nʼadom te sɛ asusowbere mu omununkum.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Eye sɛ wubenya nyansa sen sɛ wubenya sikakɔkɔɔ, sɛ wubenya nhumu sen sɛ wubenya dwetɛ!

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni tempɔn kwati bɔne; nea ɔhwɛ nʼakwan yiye no bɔ ne nkwa ho ban.

english_verse: Too much pride will destroy you.
translation_verse: Ahantan di ɔsɛe anim, na ahomaso honhom nso di asehwe anim.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Eye sɛ wobɛyɛ honhom mu hiani wɔ wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so mu sen sɛ wo ne ahantanfo bɛkyɛ asade.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Nea ɔyɛ osetie ma nkyerɛkyerɛ no nya nkɔso; nhyira nka nea ɔde ne ho to Awurade so.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Wɔfrɛ koma mu anyansafo se nhumufo, na kasa pa ma nkyerɛkyerɛ kɔ so.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Ntease yɛ nkwa asuti ma wɔn a wɔwɔ bi, nanso agyimisɛm de asotwe brɛ nkwaseafo.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Onyansafo koma kyerɛ nʼano kwan, na nʼanofafa ma nkyerɛkyerɛ kɔ so.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Abodwosɛm te sɛ ɛwokyɛm; ɛyɛ ɔkra dɛ, na ɛsa nnompe yare.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Ɔkwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɛteɛ wɔ onipa ani so, nanso awiei no, ɛkɔ owu mu.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Apaafo akɔnnɔ ma wɔyɛ adwumaden; efisɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wokum wɔn kɔm.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Ohuhuni bɔ pɔw bɔne, ne kasa te sɛ ogya a ɛhyew ade.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Onipa kɔntɔnkye de mpaapaemu ba, na ɔsututufo tetew nnamfonom ntam.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Kitikitiyɛni daadaa ne yɔnko, na ɔde no fa ɔkwammɔne so.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Nea obu nʼani no redwene bɔneyɛ ho; na nea omua nʼano no ani wɔ bɔne so.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Dwen yɛ anuonyam abotiri; trenee mu asetena na ɛde ba.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Nea ɔwɔ abodwokyɛre no ye sen ɔkofo, na nea ɔmfa abufuw ye sen nea ɔko fa kuropɔn.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Wɔbɔ ntonto de hwehwɛ nea Awurade pɛ, nanso ne gyinaesi biara fi Awurade.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Aduan sakoo a asomdwoe wɔ ho ye sen ofi a aponto ahyɛ no ma nanso basabasayɛ wɔ mu.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Ɔsomfo nyansafo bedi ɔba nimguasefo so, na obenya ne kyɛfa wɔ agyapade no mu sɛ anuanom no mu baako.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Kyɛmfɛre wɔ hɔ ma dwetɛ na fononoo wɔ hɔ ma sikakɔkɔɔ nanso Awurade na ɔsɔ koma hwɛ.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo tie nsusuwii bɔne; ɔtorofo yɛ aso ma adwene bɔne tɛkrɛma.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Nea odi ahiafo ho fɛw no bu wɔn Yɛfo animtiaa; na nea ɔfoa amanehunu so no benya asotwe.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Nananom yɛ mmasiriwa anuonyam, na awofo yɛ wɔn mma ahohoahoa.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Anotew nye mma ɔkwasea, saa ara na ano a edi atoro mfata ɔhene.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Nea ɔma adanmude no hu sɛ ɛyɛ suman; osusuw sɛ nkonimdi bɛba bere biara.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Nea obu nʼani gu mfomso so no ma ɔdɔ kwan, na nea ɔkɔ so bɔ so no tetew nnamfonom ntam.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Animka sɔ onipa a ɔwɔ nhumu ani sen mmaa ɔha a wɔbɔ ɔkwasea.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Onipa bɔnefo ani wɔ atuatew nko ara so na wɔbɛsoma odwumayɛni tirimuɔdenfo akɔ no so.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Eye sɛ wubehyia sisi a wɔawia ne mma sen ɔkwasea a ɔregyimi.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi de bɔne tua papa so ka a, bɔne rempa ne fi da.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Ntɔkwaw mfiase te sɛ nea wɔretue suka; enti gyae ma ɛnka na ankɔfa ɔham amma.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Sɛ wobegyaa nea odi fɔ ne sɛ wobebu nea odi bem kumfɔ no, Awurade kyi nʼabien no nyinaa.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Sika a ɛwɔ ɔkwasea nsam so nni mfaso, efisɛ onni botae biara sɛ obehu nyansa.

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Adamfo kyerɛ ɔdɔ bere nyinaa mu, wɔwo onuabarima ma ahokyere bere.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Nea ɔpɛ ntɔkwaw no dɔ bɔne; nea osi ɔpon tenten no frɛfrɛ ɔsɛe.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔwɔ porɔwee koma no nnya nkɔso; nea ɔwɔ nnaadaa tɛkrɛma no tɔ amane mu.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Nea ɔwo ɔbakwasea no di awerɛhow, ɔbakwasea agya nni anigye.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Koma mu anigye yɛ aduru, ɛsa ɔyare, nanso honhom a abotow no yoyow nnompe.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo gye adanmude wɔ sum ase de kyea atɛntrenee.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔwɔ nhumu no ani kɔ nyansa so, na ɔkwasea toto nʼani kosi asase ano.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Ɔbakwasea hyɛ nʼagya awerɛhow, na ɔma nea onyinsɛn no no di yaw.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Enye sɛ wɔtwe nea odi bem aso, anaasɛ wotwa adwumayɛfo mmaa wɔ wɔn nokwaredi nti.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Onimdefo dwene nʼanom kasa ho, na nea ɔwɔ nhumu no wɔ abodwo.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Ɔhonamkani yɛ pɛsɛmenkominya; na nea ɛmfa atɛntrenee mma no turuw ɔham.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea nni nhumu ho anigye, na mmom nea ɔpɛ ara ne sɛ ɔde nʼadwene bɛto gua.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Onipa anom nsɛm yɛ nsu a emu dɔ, na nyansa asuti yɛ asuwa a ɛrefi ahuru.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Enye sɛ wodi ma omumɔyɛfo anaasɛ wobu nea odi bem ntɛnkyew.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nkwaseafo ano de akasakasa ba, na wɔn ano frɛfrɛ ɔhwe.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Nkwaseafo ano yɛ wɔn ara wɔn sɛe, na wɔn anofafa yɛ wɔn ara wɔn kra afiri.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Osekuni ano asɛm te sɛ aduan a ɛyɛ dɛ; ɛhyɛnhyɛn onipa akwaa mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Nea ɔtoto nʼadwuma ase no yɛ ɔsɛefo nuabarima.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Awurade din yɛ abantenten a ɛyɛ den; ahotefo guan kɔtoa na wonya bammɔ.

english_verse: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.
translation_verse: Adefo ahonyade ne wɔn kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔfa no sɛ ɔfasu tenten a wontumi mforo.

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Ansa na onipa bɛhwe ase no onya ahomaso koma, na ahobrɛase di anuonyam anim.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Nea ontie asɛm ansa na wama mmuae no, ɛno ne ne gyimi ne nʼanimguase.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Onipa honhom na ɛhyɛ no den wɔ ɔyare mu na honhom a abotow de, hena na ɔpɛ?

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Nhumu koma nya nimdeɛ; na anyansafo aso nso hwehwɛ.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Akyɛde bue kwan ma nea ɔde ma na ɛde no ba atitiriw anim.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ nea ɔbɔ ne nkuro kan no sɛ nʼasɛm yɛ dɛ, kosi sɛ ɔfoforo bɛba abebisa no nsɛm no mu.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Ntontobɔ twa akyinnyegye so, na ɛpata atamfo.

english_verse: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
translation_verse: Onua a wɔafom no no asɛm yɛ den sen kuropɔn a ɛwɔ bammɔ, akyinnyegye te sɛ abankɛse apon a wɔabram akyi.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Onipa anom asɛm so aba ma ɔyafunu mee, nnɔbae a nʼanofafa twa no mee no.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Tɛkrɛma kura nkwa ne owu tumi, na wɔn a wɔdɔ no no bedi nʼaba.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nea wanya yere no anya ade pa na onya adom fi Awurade hɔ.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ohiani srɛ ahummɔbɔ, nanso ɔdefo de kasaden bua no.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima a ne nnamfonom dɔɔso betumi ahwe ase, nanso adamfo bi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛfam ne ho asen onua.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ohiani a ne nantew ho nni asɛm no ye sen ɔkwasea a nʼasɛm mfa kwan mu.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Mmɔdemmɔ a nimdeɛ nka ho no nye, saa ara na ntɛmpɛ a ɛma obi yera kwan nso nye.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Onipa agyimisɛm sɛe nʼabrabɔ, nanso ne koma huru tia Awurade.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Ahonya frɛfrɛ nnamfonom bebree; nanso ohiani adamfo gyaw no hɔ.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.
translation_verse: Adansekurumni benya nʼakatua, na nea otwa nkontompo remfa ne ho nni.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Nnipa pii pɛ adom fi sodifo nkyɛn, na nea ɔkyɛ ade yɛ obiara adamfo.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ohiani abusuafo nyinaa po no, na saa ara na ne nnamfonom po no! Mpo ɔhwehwɛ wɔn, pɛ sɛ ɔpa wɔn kyɛw, nanso onhu wɔn baabiara.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Nea onya nyansa no dɔ ne kra; nea ɔpɛ nhumu no nya nkɔso.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Adansekurumni benya asotwe, na nea otwa nkontompo no bɛyera.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Onipa nyansa ma no ntoboase; ɛyɛ anuonyam ma obi sɛ obebu nʼani gu mfomso bi so.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Ɔhene abufuw te sɛ gyata mmubomu, na nʼadom te sɛ sare so bosu.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Ɔba kwasea yɛ nʼagya ɔsɛe, ɔyere tɔkwapɛfo te sɛ ɔdan a ne nwini to ntwa da.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Afi ne ahonyade yɛ agyapade a efi awofo, na ɔyere nimdefo fi Awurade.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Akwadworɔ de nnahɔɔ ba, na ɔkɔm de ɔkwadwofo.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Nea odi nkyerɛkyerɛ so no bɔ ne nkwa ho ban, na nea ogyaagyaa ne ho no bewu.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Nea ɔyɛ adɔe ma ohiani no yɛ de fɛm Awurade, na obetua no nea ɔyɛ no so ka.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Teɛ wo ba, na ɛno mu na anidaso wɔ, na nyɛ wɔn a wɔde no kɔ owu mu no mu baako.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ onipa a ne koma haw no no nya so asotwe; sɛ woka ma no a, wobɛyɛ bio.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Tie afotu na gye nkyerɛkyerɛ to mu, na awiei no, wubehu nyansa.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Nhyehyɛe bebree wɔ onipa koma mu, nanso nea Awurade pɛ no na ɛba mu.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Nea onipa pɛ ne nokware dɔ; eye sɛ wobɛyɛ ohiani sen sɛ wobɛyɛ ɔtorofo.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Awurade suro kɔ nkwa mu; na onipa de abotɔyam home a ɔhaw bi nni mu.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofo de ne nsa si aduan mu, na ɛyɛ no anihaw sɛ obeyi akɔ nʼano.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Twa ɔfɛwdifo mmaa, na atetekwaa bɛfa adwene; ka nea ɔwɔ nhumu anim, na obenya nimdeɛ.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɔ nʼagya korɔn na ɔpam ne na no yɛ ɔba a ɔde aniwu ne animguase ba.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ wugyae nkyerɛkyerɛ tie a, wobɛman afi nimdeɛ nsɛm ho.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Adansekurumni di atɛntrenee ho fɛw; na omumɔyɛfo ano mene bɔne.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Wɔasiesie asotwe ama fɛwdifo, ne mmaabɔ ama nkwaseafo akyi.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Nsa yɛ ɔfɛwdifo na nsaden yɛ ɔtɔkwapɛfo; na obiara a nsa bɛma wafom kwan no nyɛ onyansafo.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Ɔhene abufuwhyew te sɛ gyata mmubomu; na nea ɔhyɛ no abufuw no de nkwa twa so.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ onipa anuonyam sɛ ɔbɛkwati akasakasa, nanso ogyimifo biara pɛ ntɔkwaw.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Onihawfo mfuntum nʼasase wɔ ne bere mu; enti edu twabere a onya hwee.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Onipa koma botae yɛ asubun, nanso nea ɔwɔ nhumu no twetwe ma epue.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Nnipa dodow no ara ka se wɔwɔ ɔdɔ a ɛnsa da, na hena na obetumi ahu ɔnokwafo?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni bu ɔbra kronkron; nhyira nka ne mma a wɔba wɔ nʼakyi.

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhene tena nʼahengua so bu atɛn a, ɔde nʼani huhuw bɔne nyinaa so gu.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Hena na obetumi aka se, “Mapra me koma mu; meyɛ kronkron na minni bɔne?”

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Nkaribo ne susudua a ɛnyɛ papa no, Awurade kyi nʼabien no nyinaa.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Mpo wɔnam abofra nketewa nneyɛe so hu wɔn, saa ara na ne suban yɛ kronkron ne papa no.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Mma nna nyɛ wo dɛ, na woanni hia; nna, na wubenya aduan ama abu so.

english_verse: Everyone likes to brag about getting a bargain.
translation_verse: Adetɔni ka se, “Enye, enye!” nanso sɛ ɔkɔ a ɔde nea watɔ no hoahoa ne ho.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Fa obi a odi ɔhɔho akagyinamu atade; sɛ ɔregyina ɔbea huhufo akyi a, fa si awowa.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Aduan a wonya no ɔkwan bɔne so no yɛ onipa anom dɛ, nanso akyiri no, ɛdan mmosea wɔ nʼanom.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Pɛ afotu yɛ wo nhyehyɛe; sɛ wutu ɔsa a, nya ho akwankyerɛ.

english_verse: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
translation_verse: Osekuni da kokoamsɛm adi; enti twe wo ho fi onipa a ɔkasa bebree ho.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi dome nʼagya anaasɛ ne na a, wobedum ne kanea wɔ sum kabii mu.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Agyapade a wɔpere ho nya no, renyɛ nhyira akyiri no.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Nka se, “Metua wo saa bɔne yi so ka!” Twɛn Awurade, na obegye wo.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Awurade kyi nkaribo a ɛnyɛ papa, na asisi nsania nso nsɔ nʼani.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Awurade na ɔkyerɛ onipa anammɔntu. Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na obi bɛte nʼankasa akwan ase?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Obi pɛ ntɛm hyɛ bɔ, ansa na wadwene ho a, osum ne ho afiri.

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Ɔhene nyansafo hu amumɔyɛfo; na ɔde awiyam afiri hankare fa wɔn so.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Awurade kanea hwehwɛ onipa honhom mu, ɛhwehwɛ ne mu baabiara.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔ ne nokwaredi bɔ ɔhene ho ban; nʼadɔe ma nʼahengua tim.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Mmerante anuonyam ne wɔn ahoɔden, tidwen nso ne mmasiriwa anuonyam.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Ɔhwe ne apirakuru hohoro amumɔyɛ, mmaatwa tew koma mu.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Ɔhene koma da Awurade nsam; ɔkyerɛ no ɔkwan te sɛ asuten ma ɔkɔ baabiara a ɔpɛ.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Onipa akwan nyinaa teɛ wɔ nʼani so, nanso Awurade na ɔkari koma.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ ade pa ne ade a ɛteɛ a, ɛsɔ Awurade ani sen afɔrebɔ.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Ani a ɛtra ntɔn ne ahomaso koma, ne amumɔyɛfo asetena nyinaa yɛ bɔne!

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Ahonya a nkontompo tɛkrɛma de ba no, ɛyɛ omununkum a etwa mu kɔ, na ɛsan yɛ owu afiri.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo basabasayɛ bɛtwe wɔn akɔ, efisɛ wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nea ɛteɛ.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Onipa a odi fɔ no akwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye, na nea ne ho nni asɛm no nneyɛe teɛ.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Suhyɛ twɔtwɔw ase baabi tena ye sen sɛ wo ne ɔyere tɔkwapɛfo bɛtena fie.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo kɔn dɔ bɔne; onni ahummɔbɔ mma ne yɔnko.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔtwe ɔfɛwdifo aso a, ntetekwaafo hu nyansa, sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ onyansafo a, onya nimdeɛ.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni no hu nea ɛrekɔ so wɔ omumɔyɛfo fi, na ɔde omumɔyɛfo no kɔ ɔsɛe mu.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa sisiw nʼaso wɔ mmɔborɔni su ho a, ɔno nso besu afrɛ, na wɔrennye no so.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Kokoa mu adekyɛ dwudwo koma, kɛtɛasehyɛ nso pata abufuwhyew.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Sɛ wubu atɛntrenee a, atreneefo ani gye, nanso ɛyɛ ahunahuna ma abɔnefo.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔman fi nhumu kwan so no bɛhome wɔ awufo fekuw mu.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Nea odi ahosɛpɛw akyi no bɛyɛ ohiani; nea ɔpɛ nsa ne ngo no rennya ne ho da.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo de wɔn nkwa to hɔ ma atreneefo, na atorofo yɛ saa ma wɔn a wɔyɛ pɛ.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Eye sɛ wobɛtena sare so, sen sɛ wo ne ɔyere tɔkwapɛfo a ne koma haw no no bɛtena.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Nnuan pa ne ngo ayɛ onyansafo fi ma, nanso ɔkwasea di nea ɔwɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Nea otiw trenee ne ɔdɔ no nya nkwa, yiyedi ne anuonyam.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Onyansafo tow hyɛ ahoɔdenfo kuropɔn so, na odwiriw abandennen a wɔn werɛ hyɛ mu no gu fam.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nea ɔkora nʼano ne ne tɛkrɛma no twe ne ho fi amanenya ho.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Ɔhantanni a ɔma ne ho so no, ne din ne “Ɔfɛwdifo” ɔde ahantan ntraso yɛ ade.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Nea ɔkwadwofo kɔn dɔ no bɛyɛ owu ama no, efisɛ ne nsa mpɛ adwumayɛ.

english_verse: But people who obey God are always generous.
translation_verse: Da mu nyinaa ɔpere sɛ obenya bebree, nanso ɔtreneeni de, ɔma a ɔnnodow ho.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo afɔrebɔ yɛ akyiwade, ne titiriw ne sɛ ɔde adwemmɔne bata ho.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Ɔdansekurumni bɛyera, na wɔbɛsɛe obiara a otie no no nso.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Amumɔyɛfo di akakabensɛm, na ɔtreneeni de, osusuw nʼakwan ho.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyansa, nhumu ne nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ a ebetumi ayɛ yiye atia Awurade.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Wosiesie apɔnkɔ ma ɔko da, nanso nkonimdi yɛ Awurade dea.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ abofra ɔkwan a ɔmfa so, na sɛ onyin a ɔremfi so.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Adefo di ahiafo so, na boseagyefo yɛ nea ɔde fɛm somfo.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Nea odua amumɔyɛsɛm no twa ɔhaw na wɔbɛsɛe nʼabufuwhyew abaa.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔyamyefo benya nhyira efisɛ ɔne ahiafo kyɛ nʼaduan.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Pam ɔfɛwdifo na basabasayɛ nso bɛkɔ; ntɔkwaw ne animka to atwa.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Obi a ɔdɔ koma a mu tew na ne kasa ho yɛ nyam no, benya ɔhene afa no adamfo.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofo ka se, “Gyata bi wɔ mfikyiri hɔ!” anaasɛ, “Wobekum me wɔ mmɔnten so.”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Ɔbea waresɛefo anom yɛ amoa donkudonku; nea ɔhyɛ Awurade abufuw ase no bɛtɔ mu.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Agyimisɛm kyekyere abofra koma ho, nanso nteɛso abaa bɛpam no akɔ akyiri.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Obi besisi ohiani de apɛ ahonya, anaa ɔbɛkyɛ ɔdefo ade, ne nyinaa de no kɔ ohia mu. Anyansasɛm

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Yɛ aso na tie anyansasɛm yi; fa wo koma di me nkyerɛkyerɛ akyi,

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: efisɛ eye sɛ wokora saa nsɛm yi wɔ wo koma mu, na ne nyinaa ada wʼano.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wode wo ho bɛto Awurade so, merekyerɛkyerɛ wo nnɛ, yiw ɛyɛ wo.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Menkyerɛw mmɛ aduasa mmaa wo, nea ɛyɛ afotusɛm ne nimdeɛ,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo nokware ne nea akyinnye nni ho, sɛnea wubenya mmuae pa ama nea ɔsomaa wo no ana?

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ahiafo korɔn, sɛ wɔyɛ ahiafo nti, na nsisi wɔn a wonni bi wɔ asennii,

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: efisɛ Awurade bedi wɔn asɛm ama wɔn, na wafom afa wɔn a wɔfom ahiafo fa.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Mfa obi a ne koma yɛ den no adamfo, na mfa wo ho mmɔ nea ne bo nkyɛ fuw,

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a, wubesua nʼakwan na woakɔtɔ afiri mu.

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Nyɛ nea ɔde ne nsa hyɛ krataa ase di akagyinamu anaasɛ odi akagyinamu;

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: na sɛ wunni nea wɔde tua a wobehuam wo mpa mpo afi wʼase.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Ntutu tete abo a wɔde ato hye, nea wo nenanom de sisii hɔ no.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Wuhu obi a ne nsa akokwaw nʼadwuma ho ana? Ahemfo anim na ɔbɛsom, na ɔrensom wɔ mpapahwekwa anim.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Nni obi a ɔyɛ pɛpɛe aduan, nni nʼakɔnnɔ aduan akyi;

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Sɛ wo ne ɔhene bi to nsa didi a, hwɛ nea esi wʼanim no yiye,

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ adidibrada a, hyɛ wo ho so.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Nni nʼaduan akɔnnɔ akɔnnɔ no akyi, efisɛ saa aduan no daadaa nnipa.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: efisɛ ɔyɛ obi a bere biara osusuw sika ho. Ɔka se, “Didi na nom,” nanso ɛnyɛ ne koma mu.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Mmiri wo mogya ani mpɛ sika; hu nyansa na tɔ wo bo ase.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Wʼani bɔɔ sika so ara pɛ, na atu ayera, ampa ara ebefuw ntaban na atu akɔ wim sɛ ɔkɔre.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Kakra a woadi no wobɛfe, na ɛno nti wo nkamfo so remma mfaso.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Nkasa nkyerɛ ɔkwasea, efisɛ ɔremfa nyansa a ɛwɔ wo kasa mu no.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Ntutu tete abo a wɔde ato hye ngu, na ntra ɔhye nkɔ ayisaa mfuw mu,

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Me ba, tie, na hu nyansa, ma wo koma mfa ɔkwantrenee so.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Mfa wo ho mmɔ akɔwensafo anaasɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ nam mmoroso ho,

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: efisɛ, akɔwensafo ne adidibradafo bɛyɛ ahiafo, na anikum fura wɔn ntamagow.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Tie wʼagya a ɔwoo wo no, na sɛ wo na bɔ aberewa a, mmu no animtiaa.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Tɔ nokware na ntɔn da; nya nyansa, ahohyɛso ne nhumu.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Ɔtreneeni agya wɔ anigye bebree; nea ɔwɔ ɔba nyansafo no ani gye ne ho.

english_verse: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
translation_verse: Ma wʼagya ne wo na ani nnye; ma ɔbea a ɔwoo wo no nnya ahosɛpɛw.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Me ba, fa wo koma ma me na ma wʼani nkɔ mʼakwan ho,

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: na oguamanfo yɛ amoa donkudonku ɔyere huhuni yɛ ɔdaadaafo.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Ɔtɛw, twɛn, te sɛ ɔkwanmukafo, na ɔma mmarima mu atorofo dɔɔso.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Hena na wɔadome no? Hena na odi awerɛhow? Hena na odi aperepere? Hena na onwiinwii? Hena na ɔwɔ atape nko ara? Hena na mogya ada nʼani so?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔkyɛ nsa ho, na wɔka nsa a wɔafrafra hwɛ.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Nhwɛ nsa ani kɔkɔɔ no haa, bere a ɛretwa yerɛw yerɛw wɔ kuruwa mu, na ɛkɔ yɔɔ no.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Awiei no, ɛka te sɛ ɔwɔ na ɛwɔ bɔre te sɛ ahurutoa.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Wʼani behu nneɛma a wunhuu da, na woadwene nneɛma basabasa ho.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Wobɛtɔ ntintan te sɛ hyɛn mu dwumayɛni a, okura hyɛn dua a, ɛrehinhim mu den, na ehinhim wɔ po so.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Na wobɛka se, “Wɔbɔ me, nanso mimpira. Wɔboro me, nanso mente ɔyaw biara. Bere bɛn na menyan akɔpɛ nsa anom bio?”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Nhaw wo ho wɔ abɔnefo nti, na mma wʼani mmere amumɔyɛfo nso,

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Mma wʼani mmere amumɔyɛfo, mfa wo ho mmɔ wɔn;

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Efisɛ wɔn koma dwene atirimɔdensɛm ho, na wɔn ano ka nea ɛde basabasayɛ ba ho asɛm.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: efisɛ, ɔbɔnefo nni anidaso biara daakye, na wobedum amumɔyɛfo kanea.

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Wɔde nyansa na esi fi, na nhumu mu na wɔma etim;

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: ɛnam nimdeɛ so na wonya ademude a ɛho yɛ na na ɛyɛ fɛ hyehyɛ nʼadan mu.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Me ba, suro Awurade ne ɔhene, na mfa wo ho mmɔ atuatewfo ho,

english_verse: Wisdom brings strength, and knowledge gives power.
translation_verse: Onyansafo wɔ tumi a ɛso, na onimdefo nyin ahoɔden mu;

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: nea ɔretu sa hia akwankyerɛ, nea ɔrehwehwɛ nkonimdi no hia afotufo pii.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: efisɛ saa baanu yi de, ɔsɛe bɛba wɔn so mpofirim; na hena na onim amanehunu ko a wobetumi de aba? Anyansafo Nsɛnka A Ɛkeka Ho

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Nyansa wɔ soro dodo ma ɔkwasea; wɔ apon ano aguabɔ mu no, ɛnsɛ sɛ wobue wɔn ano.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Eyinom nso yɛ anyansafo Nsɛnka: Atemmu a nhwɛanim wɔ mu no nye:

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔbɔ pɔw bɔne no, wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔkɔtwebrɛfo.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Ogyimifo nhyehyɛe yɛ bɔne, nnipa kyi ɔfɛwdifo.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛka akyerɛ nea odi fɔ se, “Wo ho nni asɛm” no, nnipa bɛdome no na amanaman remmɔ no din pa.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Sɛ wʼaba mu gow wɔ ɔhaw mu a, na wʼahoɔden sua!

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wobu afɔdifo fɔ no, ebesi wɔn yiye, na nhyira bɛba wɔn so.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Gye wɔn a wɔde wɔn rekɔ akokum wɔn no nkwa; na sianka wɔn a wɔtɔ ntintan kɔ akumii.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Sɛ woka se, “Na yennim eyi ho hwee a,” nea ɔkari koma hwɛ no nhu ana? Nea ɔbɔ wo nkwa ho ban no nnim ana? Ɔrentua nea obiara ayɛ so ka ana?

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Mmuae pa te sɛ mfewano.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: Me ba, di ɛwo, efisɛ eye; ɛwokyɛm mu wo yɛ wʼanom dɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Hu nso sɛ nyansa yɛ wo kra dɛ; sɛ wunya a, wowɔ anidaso ma daakye, na wʼanidaso renyɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Wie wo mfikyidwuma na siesie wo mfuw; ɛno akyi, si wo fi.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Nkɔtɛw ɔtreneeni fi sɛ ɔkwanmukafo, na nkɔtow nhyɛ nʼatenae so,

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ ɔtreneeni hwe ase mpɛn ason de, nanso ɔsɔre bio, na amumɔyɛfo de amanehunu baako ma wɔhwe ase.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Nni adanse ntia ɔyɔnko a ɔnyɛɛ wo hwee, na mfa wʼano nnaadaa.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Sɛ wo tamfo hwe ase a mma ɛnyɛ wo dɛ; na sɛ ohintiw a mma wo koma nni ahurusi,

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: efisɛ Awurade behu wʼadwene na ɔrempɛ na obeyi nʼabufuwhyew afi no so.

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Nka se, “Nea wayɛ me no me nso mɛyɛ no bi; nea ɔyɛe no mitua no so ka.”

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Menantew faa onihawfo afuw ho, twaa mu wɔ nea onni adwene bobeturo nso ho;

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: nsɔe afuw wɔ baabiara, wura afuw akata asase no so, na abo afasu no nso abubu.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Mede me koma kɔɔ nea mihuu no so na misuaa biribi fii mu:

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: nna kakra, nkotɔ kakra, nsa a woabobɔw de rehome kakra

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Eyinom yɛ Salomo mmebusɛm nkekaho a Yudahene Hesekia afotufo kyerɛwee:

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn anuonyamhyɛ sɛ wɔde asɛm sie; sɛ wɔpɛɛpɛɛ asɛm mu nso hyɛ ahemfo anuonyam.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ɔsoro korɔn na asase mu dɔ no, saa ara na wɔrentumi nhwehwɛ ahemfo koma mu.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyi dwetɛ ho fi a, na ato nea ɛkɔ dwetɛdwumfo nsam;

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Yi amumɔyɛfo fi ɔhene anim, na trenee bɛma nʼahengua atim.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Mma wo ho so wɔ ɔhene anim, na mpere dibea wɔ atitiriw mu;

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Eye ma no sɛ ɔbɛka akyerɛ wo se, “Bra soro ha,” sen sɛ ɔbɛbrɛ wo ase wɔ otitiriw bi anim. Nea wode wʼani ahu no

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: mpɛ ntɛm mfa nkɔ asennii, na sɛ awiei no wo yɔnko gu wʼanim ase a dɛn na wobɛyɛ?

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Sɛ wo ne wo yɔnko di asɛm a nna obi foforo ahintasɛm adi,

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a, nea ɔbɛte no begu wʼanim ase na din bɔne a wubenya no rempepa da.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Asɛm a wɔka no sɛnea ɛfata no te sɛ sika kɔkɔɔ a wɔabɔ sɛ aprɛ de atuatua dwetɛ nsiesiei mu.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Sikakɔkɔɔ asokaa anaa sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa ahyehyɛde te sɛ onyansafo animka a ɔde ma nea ɔyɛ aso ma no.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Sɛnea sukyerɛmma ma wim dwo wɔ otwabere mu no, saa ara na ɔsomafo nokwafo te ma wɔn a wɔsoma no no; na ɔma ne wuranom akomatɔyam.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Omununkum ne mframa a ɛmfa osu mma no te sɛ onipa a ɔde akyɛde a ɔmmfa mma hoahoa ne ho.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Ntoboase ma sodifo ti da, na tɛkrɛmabere tumi bu dompe mu.

english_verse: Eating too much honey can make you sick.
translation_verse: Sɛ wunya ɛwo a, nni ntra so, ne bebrebe bɛma woafe.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Ntaa nkɔ wo yɔnko fi, wo ho fono no a, ɔbɛtan wo.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Onipa a odi adansekurum tia ne yɔnko no te sɛ kontibaa, afoa anaa bɛmma a ano yɛ nnam.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Ɛse a ɛyare ɔkekaw anaa nan a ɛyɛ apakye te sɛ nea wode wo ho to ɔtorofo so hiada mu.

english_verse: Singing to someone in deep sorrow is like pouring vinegar in an open cut.
translation_verse: Nea ɔto dwom kyerɛ ɔwerɛhowni no, te sɛ nea ɔpa ntama gu awɔwbere mu anaa te sɛ nsa nyinyanyinya a wohwie gu apirakuru so.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔkɔm de wo tamfo a, ma no aduan nni; sɛ osukɔm de no a, ma no nsu nnom.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ saa a, wobɛsosɔ nnyansramma agu nʼatifi, na Awurade bɛma wo akatua.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Sɛnea atifi fam mframa de osu ba no, saa ara na tɛkrɛma a edi nseku de omuna ba.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Eye sɛ wobɛtena suhyɛ twɔtwɔw ase baabi, sen sɛ wo ne ɔyere tɔkwapɛfo bɛtena fie.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Nsuonwini a ɔkra a atɔ beraw nya no te sɛ anigyesɛm a efi akyirikyiri.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Asuti a afono anaa abura a ayɛ pɔtɔɔ te sɛ ɔtreneeni a ogyaa ne ho ma amumɔyɛfo.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Enye sɛ wodi ɛwo ntraso, saa ara na ɛnyɛ anuonyam sɛ obi bɛhwehwɛ nsɛm a mu dɔ mu.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Onipa a onni ahohyɛso no te sɛ kuropɔn a nʼafasu abubu agu fam.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Sɛnea sukyerɛmma te ahuhurubere anaasɛ osu wɔ otwabere no, saa ara na anuonyam mfata ɔkwasea.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Sɛnea apatuprɛw tu anaasɛ asomfena tu dannan ne ho no, saa ara na nnuabɔ hunu nsi hwee.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Ɔkafo abaa wɔ hɔ ma ɔpɔnkɔ, nnareka wɔ hɔ ma afurum, na abaa wɔ hɔ ma nkwaseafo akyi.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Nhwɛ ɔkwasea agyimisɛm so mma no mmuae, anyɛ saa a wo nso bɛyɛ sɛ ɔno.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Gyina ɔkwasea agyimisɛm so ma no mmuae, anyɛ saa a ɛbɛyɛ no sɛ onim nyansa.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Sɛ wode nkra bi soma ɔkwasea a, ɛte sɛ wutwitwa wʼankasa wʼanan anaasɛ wonom awuduru.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Apakye nan a awu na ɛsensɛn hɔ no, yɛ mmebusɛm a ɛda ɔkwasea ano.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Ɔbo a wɔakyekyere afam ahwimmo so te sɛ anuonyam a wɔde ama ɔkwasea.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Nsɔe dua a ɔkɔwensani kita no te sɛ mmebusɛm a ɛda ɔkwasea ano.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɔ ɔkwasea anaa obi hunu paa no te sɛ agyantowni a opira nnipa kwa.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ɔkraman san kɔ ne fe ho no, saa ara na ɔkwasea ti nʼagyimisɛm mu.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Wuhu obi a ɔyɛ onyansafo wɔ nʼankasa ani so ana? Anidaso pii wɔ ɔkwasea mu sen no.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofo ka se, “Gyata wɔ ɔkwan no mu, gyatakeka nenam mmɔnten no so!”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ɔpon di akɔneaba wɔ ne mpontare so no, saa ara na ɔkwadwofo twa ne ho wɔ ne mpa so.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofo de ne nsa si aduan mu, na ɛyɛ no anihaw sɛ obeyi akɔ nʼano.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofo yɛ onyansafo wɔ ɔno ankasa ani so sen nnipa baason a wodwen asɛm ho na wɔabua.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Obi a oso ɔkraman aso twe no no te sɛ obi a ɔretwa mu na ɔde ne ho kɔfra ntɔkwaw a ɛmfa ne ho mu.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: Ɔbɔdamfo a ɔtotow atuo anaa agyanwerɛmfo no

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: te sɛ obi a, ɔdaadaa ne yɔnko na ɔka se, “Na mede redi agoru!”

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Nnyansin hi a ogya dum; nseku nni hɔ a ntɔkwaw to twa.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Sɛnea gyabiriw dan nnyansramma na nnyina dan ogya no, saa ara na ɔtɔkwapɛfo hyɛ ntɔkwaw mu takramugya.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Osekuni ano asɛm te sɛ aduan a ɛyɛ dɛ; ɛhyɛnhyɛn onipa akwaa mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ama kata asankagow ho no saa ara na tɛkrɛmadɛ kata amumɔyɛ koma so.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Onipa bɔne kasa te sɛ nea oye, nanso nnaadaa ahyɛ ne koma ma.

english_verse: Everyone will see through those evil plans.
translation_verse: Ebia nnaadaa bɛkata nʼadwemmɔne so, nanso nʼamumɔyɛsɛm bɛda adi wɔ bagua mu.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa tu amoa a, ɔbɛtɔ mu; sɛ onipa pirew ɔbo a, ɛbɛsan aba no so.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Atoro tɛkrɛma kyi wɔn a ogu wɔn ho fi, na adɛfɛdɛfɛ ano de ɔsɛe ba.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Mfa ɔkyena nhoahoa wo ho, na wunnim nea ɛda bi de bɛba.

english_verse: Don't brag about yourself— let others praise you.
translation_verse: Ma ɔfoforo nkamfo wo; na ɛnyɛ wo ankasa; ma emfi ɔfoforo anom na ɛnyɛ wo.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Ɔbo mu yɛ duru, na nwea yɛ adesoa, nanso ɔkwasea abufuwhyew yɛ duru sen emu biara.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Abufuw tirim yɛ den, na abufuwhyew sɛe ade, na hena na obetumi agyina ninkutwe ano?

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Animka a ɛda gua ye sen ɔdɔ a asuma.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Apirakuru a efi adamfo nkyɛn no ye sen ɔtamfo mfewano bebrebe.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Ɛwo nyɛ nea wamee akɔnnɔ, nanso nea ɛyɛ nwen mpo yɛ nea ɔkɔm de no no nʼanom dɛ.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Onipa a wayera ne fi kwan, te sɛ anomaa a wafi ne berebuw mu rekyinkyin.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Ngo ne aduhuam ma koma ani gye, adamfo ho anigye fi nʼafotu pa a ɔma.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Nnyaa wʼadamfo ne wʼagya adamfo mu, nkɔ wo nuabarima fi bere a ɔhaw ato wo, na ɔyɔnko a ɔbɛn wo no ye sen onuabarima a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Me ba, hu nyansa na ma me koma ani nnye; ɛno na ɛbɛma manya mmuae ama obiara a obu me animtiaa.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Mmadwemma hu asiane na wohintaw, nanso ntetekwaafo kɔ wɔn anim kɔtɔ mu.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Fa atade a ɛhyɛ obi a odi ɔhɔho akagyinamu; sɛ ɔregyina ɔbea huhufo akyi a, fa si awowa.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi teɛ mu hyira ne yɔnko anɔpahema a, wɔbɛfa no sɛ ɛyɛ nnome.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Ɔyere tɔkwapɛfo te sɛ ahumtuda nsusosɔ wɔ ɔdan a enwin so;

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: sɛ wopata no a, ɛte sɛ nea wopata mframa anaa wode wo nsa beso ngo mu.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Dade sew dade, saa ara na onipa sew ɔfoforo.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nea ɔhwɛ borɔdɔma dua so no bedi so aba, na nea ɔsom ne wura no, wɔbɛhyɛ no anuonyam.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Sɛnea nsu yi animdua kyerɛ no, saa ara na onipa koma da onipa no adi.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Sɛnea Owu ne Ɔsɛe bo ntɔ da no, saa ara, na onipa ani nso bo ntɔ da.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Kyɛmfɛre wɔ hɔ ma dwetɛ na fononoo wɔ hɔ ma sikakɔkɔɔ, nanso wɔnam nkamfo a onipa nya so na ɛsɔ no hwɛ.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Sɛ wowɔw ɔkwasea wɔ ɔwaduru mu, sɛ wode ɔwɔma wɔw no te sɛnea wusiw aburow a, worentumi nyi agyimisɛm mfi ne ho.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Ma ɛnyɛ wo asɛnhia sɛ wubehu wo nguankuw tebea, na ma wʼani nkɔ wo anantwikuw so;

english_verse: because wealth and honor don't last forever.
translation_verse: efisɛ, ahonya ntena hɔ daa, na ahenkyɛw ntena hɔ mma awo ntoantoaso nyinaa.

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Sɛ wotwa sare no na foforo fifi, na wɔboaboa nkoko so sare no ano a,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: ɛno de, nguantenmma no bɛma wo ntama, na mmirekyi ama sika a ɛtɔ mfuw.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Wubenya mmirekyi nufusu bebree ama wo ne wʼabusuafo adi ne aduan ama wo mmaawa.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo guan bere a obiara ntaa no, nanso atreneefo koko yɛ duru sɛ gyata.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Atuatewman nya sodifo pii, nanso onipa a ɔwɔ nhumu ne nimdeɛ ma mmara yɛ adwuma.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Sodifo a ɔhyɛ ahiafo so no te sɛ osu mu ahum a ennyaw nnɔbae bi wɔ akyi.

english_verse: Lawbreakers praise criminals, but law-abiding citizens always oppose them.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔpo mmara no kamfo amumɔyɛfo, na wɔn a wodi mmara so no siw wɔn kwan.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Abɔnefo nte atɛntrenee ase, nanso wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no, te ase yiye.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ohiani a ne nantew ho nni asɛm ye sen ɔdefo a nʼakwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Nea odi mmara so yɛ ɔba a ɔwɔ nhumu, nanso nea ɔne adidibradafo bɔ no gu nʼagya anim ase.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Nea ogye mfɛntom mmoroso de nya ne ho no, ɔboaboa ano ma nea ɔbɛyɛ ahiafo adɔe.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi nni mmara so a, ne mpaebɔ mpo yɛ akyiwade.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Nea odi atreneefo anim de wɔn fa ɔkwan bɔne so no bɛhwe ɔno ankasa afiri mu, nanso wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm no benya agyapade a eye.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Ɔdefo tumi yɛ onyansafo wɔ nʼankasa ani so, nanso ohiani a ɔwɔ nhumu no hu sɛnea ɔte.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Sɛ atreneefo di nkonim a, nnipa di ahurusi pii; nanso sɛ amumɔyɛfo nya tumi a nnipa kohintaw.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔkata ne bɔne so no nnya nkɔso, na nea ɔka ne bɔne na ogyae yɛ no nya ahummɔbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka nea osuro Awurade bere nyinaa, nanso nea opirim ne koma no tɔ amane mu.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Omumɔyɛfo a odi nnipa a wonni mmoa so no te sɛ gyata a ɔbobɔ mu anaa sisi a nʼani abere.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ɔsodifo tirimɔdenfo nni adwene, na nea okyi mfaso a wɔnam ɔkwan bɔne so nya no benya nkwa tenten.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Nea awudi ma ne tiboa bu no fɔ no bɛyɛ ɔkobɔfo akosi ne wu da; wɔmma obiara nsiw no kwan.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Nea ne nantew ho nni asɛm no, wogye no fi ɔhaw mu, nanso nea nʼakwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye no bɛhwe ase mpofirim.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nea ɔyɛ nʼasase so adwuma no benya aduan pii, nanso wɔn a wodi nnaadaasɛm akyi no benya wɔn so ne wɔn hia.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Wobehyira onipa nokwafo pii, na nea ɔpere pɛ ahonyade no remfa ne ho nni.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Nhwɛanim nye, nanso aduan kakraa bi nti nnipa bɛyɛ bɔne.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Nea ɔyɛ pɛpɛe pere sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔdefo na onnim sɛ ohia retwɛn no.

english_verse: Honest correction is appreciated more than flattery.
translation_verse: Nea ɔka obi anim no bɛsɔ nnipa ani akyiri no asen nea ɔwɔ tɛkrɛmadɛ.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Nea ɔbɔ nʼagya anaa ne na korɔn na ɔka se, “Ɛnyɛ bɔne no,” ɔne ɔsɛefo na ɛbɔ.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Odifudepɛfo de mpaapaemu ba na nea ɔde ne ho to Awurade so no benya nkɔso.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Nea ogye ne ho di no yɛ ɔkwasea, na nea ɔnantew nyansa mu no wobegye no.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Nea ɔma ahiafo no, hwee renhia no, nanso nea obu nʼani gu wɔn so no nya nnome pii.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Sɛ amumɔyɛfo nya tumi a, nnipa kohintaw; na sɛ amumɔyɛfo ase tɔre a, atreneefo ase dɔ.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Obi a ɔkɔ so yɛ tufoante wɔ animka pii akyi no wɔbɛsɛe no mpofirim a wɔrennya ano aduru.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Sɛ atreneefo di yiye a, nnipa no di ahurusi; sɛ amumɔyɛfo di nnipa so a, wusi apini.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔdɔ nyansa no ma nʼagya anigye, nanso nguamanfo yɔnko sɛe nʼahonya.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Ɔhene nam atɛntrenee so ma ɔman no asomdwoe, nanso nea ɔde adifudepɛ gye adanmude no bɔ ɔman no.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔdaadaa ne yɔnko no sum ne nan afiri.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Ɔdebɔneyɛni bɔne sum no afiri, nanso ɔtreneeni betumi ato dwom ama nʼani agye.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Ahiafo atɛntreneebu ho hia atreneefo, nanso amumɔyɛfo nni saa ɔtema no.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Sɛ onyansafo de ɔkwasea kɔ asennii a, ɔkwasea no bobɔ mu kasa di fɛw, na asomdwoe mma.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Mogyapɛfo kyi ɔnokwafo, na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wobekum nea ɔteɛ.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea da abufuw nyinaa adi, nanso onyansafo hyɛ ne ho so.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔsodifo tie nkontomposɛm a, nʼadwumayɛfo nyinaa bɛyɛ amumɔyɛfo.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Ohiani ne ɔsohyɛfo nyinaa wɔ saa ade baako yi: Awurade ma wɔn baanu nyinaa ani a wɔde hu ade.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhene di ahiafo asɛm yiye a, nʼahengua betim hɔ daa.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Nteɛso abaa ma nyansa, na abofra a wɔde ne pɛ ma no no, gu ne na anim ase.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Sɛ amumɔyɛfo di yiye a, bɔne nso kɔ so, na atreneefo behu wɔn asehwe.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Teɛ wo ba, na ɔbɛma wo asomdwoe; ɔbɛma wo kra ani agye.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Sɛ anisoadehu nni hɔ a nnipa no yɛ basaa; na nhyira nka nea odi mmara so.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Wɔmfa anom nsɛm kɛkɛ nteɛ ɔsomfo; ɔte ase de, nanso ɔremfa.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Wuhu obi a ɔpɛ ntɛm kasa ana? Ɔkwasea wɔ anidaso sen no.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi kokɔ ne somfo fi ne mmofraase a, awiei no ɔde awerɛhow na ɛbɛba.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Onipa a ne bo afuw de mpaapaemu ba, na nea ne bo nkyɛ fuw no yɛ bɔne pii.

english_verse: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Onipa ahomaso brɛ no ase, nanso nea ɔwɔ ahobrɛase no nya anuonyam.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Nea ɔboa ɔkorɔmfo no haw ɔno ankasa ho. Wɔama waka ntam nti osuro sɛ obedi adanse.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Onipa ho suro betumi ayɛ afiri, na nea ɔde ne ho to Awurade so no, wobegye no.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bebree hwehwɛ sɛ wobenya ɔhene ne no akasa, nanso onipa nya atɛntrenee fi Awurade nkyɛn.

english_verse: Good people and criminals can't stand each other.
translation_verse: Atreneefo kyi atorofo; na amumɔyɛfo kyi wɔn a wɔn akwan teɛ.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Yake babarima Agur nsɛm a ɔkae a ɛyɛ nkuranhyɛ: Saa ɔbarima yi ka kyerɛɛ Itiel ne Ukal se:

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: “Me na minnim hwee koraa wɔ nnipa mu, minni onipa ntease.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Minsuaa nyansa, na minni Ɔkronkronni no ho nimdeɛ nso.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Hena na waforo akɔ ɔsoro na wasian aba fam? Hena na wabɔ mframa boa wɔ ne nsam? Hena na ɔde nʼatade abɔ nsu boa? Hena na ɔbɔɔ asase tamaa yi? Ne din de dɛn, na ne babarima nso din de dɛn? Sɛ wunim a ka kyerɛ me!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn asɛm biara yɛ nokware; ɔyɛ nkatabo ma wɔn a woguan toa no.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Mfa biribi nka nʼasɛm ho, anyɛ saa a ɔbɛka wʼanim ama woayɛ ɔtorofo.

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: “Awurade, nneɛma abien na mehwehwɛ afi wo nkyɛn; mfa nkame me ansa na mawu:

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: ma me ne atoro ne nnaadaasɛm ntam nware koraa; mma mennyɛ ohiani anaa ɔdefo; nanso ma me me daa aduan nkutoo.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Anyɛ saa a, ebia minya me ho pii a ɛbɛma mapa wo na maka se, ‘Hena ne Awurade?’ Anaa mɛyɛ ohiani na mabɔ korɔn, na ama magu me Nyankopɔn din ho fi.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: “Nsɛe ɔsomfo din nkyerɛ ne wura; sɛ woyɛ saa a, ɔbɛdome wo na wubetua so ka.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: “Nnipa bi dome wɔn agyanom, na wonhyira wɔn nanom nso;

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔteɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa ani so nanso wɔnhohoroo wɔn ho fi no;

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔn ani tra ntɔn, na wobu animtiaa;

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: “Amemem wɔ mmabea baanu a wɔteɛ mu se, ‘Fa ma! Fa ma!’ “Nneɛma abiɛsa na ɛmmee da anan na ɛnka da se, ‘Eye!’

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
