translation_verse: Eyi yɛ nokwasɛm. Mepɛ sɛ wuti saa asɛm yi mu yiye na ama wɔn a wogye Onyankopɔn di no ahu sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn bere di dwuma pa. Eyinom nyinaa ye na so wɔ mfaso ma nnipa.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Nanso munnnye nkwasea akyinnye. Saa ara nso na monnto ana, nkasakasa, nham wɔ mmara ho; so nni mfaso biara.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Bɔ obi a ɔde mpaapaemu ba no kɔkɔ nea edi kan ne ne nea ɛto so abien, na ɛno akyi no twe wo ho fi ne ho.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ wuhu sɛ obi a ɔte saa no asɛe, na bɔne a ɔyɛ no da adi wɔ ne ho.

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Sɛ mesoma Artema anaa Tihiko wo nkyɛn a, bɔ mmɔden bra me nkyɛn wɔ Nikopoli, na hɔ na mabɔ me tirim sɛ mɛtena awɔwbere no.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Bɔ mmɔden gya mmaranimfo Sena ne Apolo kwan yiye na anhia wɔn hwee.

english_verse: Our people should learn to spend their time doing something useful and worthwhile.
translation_verse: Ma yɛn nkurɔfo no nsua sɛnea wɔde wɔn adagyew yɛ nnwuma pa de boa. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔtena ase kwa.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔne me wɔ ha nyinaa kyiakyia wo. Kyia wɔn a wɔdɔ yɛn wɔ gyidi mu ma yɛn. Adom nka mo nyinaa.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Saa nhoma yi fi Paulo a esiane Kristo Yesu nti ɔyɛ odeduani ne yɛn nuabarima Timoteo nkyɛn, Yɛde kɔma yɛn adamfo ne yɛn yɔnko Filemon

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: ne asafo a wohyia wɔ wo fi no ne yɛn nuabea Apia ne yɛn yɔnko sraani Arkipo no:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Adom ne asomdwoe a efi yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo.

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Onua Filemon, bere biara a mebɔ mpae no mebɔ bi ma wo na meda me Nyankopɔn nso ase.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Mete ɔdɔ a wodɔ Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo ne gyidi a wowɔ wɔ Awurade Yesu mu no.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Sɛnea wo ne afoforo kura gyidi koro mu no, mebɔ mpae sɛ wɔn nso behu nhyira a Kristo de ama yɛn no nyinaa.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Onua pa, wo dɔ no ama me anigye na ahyɛ me nkuran nso. Woakanyan Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo.

english_verse: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
translation_verse: Sɛ meyɛ wo nua wɔ Kristo mu nti, metumi de akokoduru ahyɛ wo, ama woayɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ,

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: nanso me Paulo a meyɛ akwakoraa ne Kristo Yesu deduani fi ɔdɔ mu mprempren

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: resrɛ wo ama me ba Onesimo a ɔbɛyɛɛ me ba, bere a na meda afiase no.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Bere bi a atwa mu no na ne so nni mfaso mma wo, nanso mprempren de, ne so wɔ mfaso ma me ne wo.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: Merema ɔno a ɔyɛ mʼankasa me koma no asan aba wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Esiane asɛmpa no nti, mepɛe sɛ ɔtena me nkyɛn bere a meda afiase yi, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obesi wʼanan mu aboa me.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Nanso na mempɛ sɛ mefi wʼakyi ayɛ biribi, sɛnea ɛrenyɛ sɛ adɔe biara a wobɛyɛ no fi ɔhyɛ mu na mmom efi ɔpɛ pa mu nti.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Ebia na Onesimo fii wo nkyɛn bere tiaa bi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubegye no ato mu bio afebɔɔ.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mprempren ɔnyɛ ɔsomfo kɛkɛ efisɛ ɔkyɛn ɔsomfo. Ɔyɛ onua pa wɔ Kristo mu. Ɔsom bo ma me. Saa ara nso na ɔbɛsom bo ama wo sɛ ɔsomfo ne onua wɔ Awurade mu.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Enti sɛ wudwen me ho sɛ wo ne me bɔ mu di dwuma a, saa ara nso na gye no to mu sɛnea wubegye me no ara no.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Sɛ wayɛ wo biribi anaasɛ ɔde wo ka bi a, bu tia me.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Me Paulo, mʼankasa me nsa ano nkyerɛw ni. Metua wo ka, na mmom mma wo werɛ mfi sɛ wo nipadua no ankasa de me ka.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Enti me nua, mesrɛ wo sɛ, Awurade nti, yɛ me saa adɔe yi; ka me koma hyew sɛ wo nua wɔ Kristo mu.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Mewɔ anidaso sɛ, nea merekyerɛw wo yi, wobɛyɛ ama aboro nea merebisa wo yi so.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Afei pɛ ɔdan ma me, efisɛ minim sɛ Onyankopɔn betie mo mpaebɔ ama mabɛka mo ho bio.

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafra a Kristo Yesu nti ɔne me da afiase no kyia wo.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Saa ara nso na Marko, Aristarko, Dema ne Luka nso kyia wo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka wo honhom.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Mmere a atwa mu no, na Onyankopɔn nam akwan ahorow bebree so fa adiyifo so kasa kyerɛ yɛn mpanyimfo no.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Mmom, mmere a edi akyiri no de, ɔnam ne Ba no so akasa akyerɛ yɛn. Ɔyɛ obi a Onyankopɔn nam ne so bɔɔ wiase. Na ɔno na Onyankopɔn ayi no sɛ awiei no, nneɛma nyinaa bɛyɛ ne de.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Ɔnam hyerɛn a Onyankopɔn anuonyam hyerɛn no so haran. Ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn sɛso pɛpɛɛpɛ, na ɔde nʼasɛm a tumi wɔ mu no so wiase mu. Ɔtew nnipa ho fii wɔn bɔne mu wiei no, ɔtenaa Otumfo Nyankopɔn nifa so wɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Ɛno nti ɔyɛɛ ɔkɛse sen abɔfo no, efisɛ din a Onyankopɔn de too no no yɛ kɛse sen wɔn de no.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Efisɛ Onyankopɔn nso anka ankyerɛ nʼabɔfo no mu biara se, “Woyɛ me Ba; nnɛ mayɛ wʼAgya.” Na wanka ankyerɛ ɔbɔfo biara se, “Mɛyɛ wʼAgya na woayɛ me Ba.”

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Bere a Onyankopɔn pɛɛ sɛ ɔsoma nʼabakan no ba wiase no, ɔsan kae se, “Ɛsɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn abɔfo nyinaa som no.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Asɛm a Onyankopɔn ka faa abɔfo no ho ne sɛ, “Onyankopɔn soma nʼabɔfo sɛ mframa, na ɔsoma nʼasomfo sɛ gyaframa.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Nea ɛfa Ɔba no ho no, Onyankopɔn kae se, “Ao, Onyankopɔn, wʼahengua bɛtena hɔ daa nyinaa; wʼAhenni yɛ atɛntrenee.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Wodɔ trenee, na wukyi bɔne, ɛno nti Onyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn no, de wo asi wo mfɛfo so, na ɔde anigye ngo asra wo.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn san kae se, “Mfiase no wotoo asase fapem, na ɔsoro yɛ wo nsa ano adwuma.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa betwa mu; na wo de, wobɛtena hɔ daa; wɔbɛtetew sɛ atade.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Wɔbɛbobɔw no sɛ ntama; na wɔbɛsesa no sɛ ntade. Nanso wote sɛnea wote, na wo mfe to rentwa da.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn anka ankyerɛ nʼabɔfo no se, “Montena me nifa so nkosi sɛ mede mo atamfo bɛyɛ mo anan ase ntiaso.”

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Sɛ saa a, na abɔfo no yɛ dɛn? Wɔn nyinaa yɛ ahonhom a wɔsom Onyankopɔn na ɔsoma wɔn ma wɔkɔboa wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ nkwagye no.

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Eyi nti na ɛsɛ sɛ yeso nokware a yɛate no mu dennen, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a biribi rentu yɛn aso.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Nsɛm a abɔfo no kae no yɛ nokware, enti obiara a wanni so no nyaa asotwe a ɛfata no.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛantie saa nkwagye yi a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛatumi aguan? Awurade no ankasa na odii kan kaa saa nkwagye yi ho asɛm na wɔn a wotiee no no ama yɛahu sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Saa bere koro no ara mu na Onyankopɔn nam ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne nʼanwonwadwuma so dii ho adanse. Bio, ɔkyɛɛ Honhom Kronkron no sɛnea ɔpɛ.

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn amma abɔfo anni wiase a na wayɛ nʼadwene sɛ ɔrebɛbɔ no so; saa wiase a yɛka ho asɛm no.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Na mmom wɔaka wɔ Kyerɛwsɛm no mu baabi se, “Onipa ne hena a wokae no; na onipa ba nso ne hena a wʼani ku ne ho?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Wobɔɔ no ma ɔyɛɛ akumaa kakra sen abɔfo; na wode wʼanuonyam ne nidi abɔ no abotiri,

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: sɛ onni nneɛma nyinaa so.” Ɛka se Onyankopɔn bɔɔ onipa sɛ, “Nneɛma nyinaa sodifo,” eyi da no adi sɛ biribiara ka ho. Nanso yenhu sɛ mprempren onipa di nneɛma nyinaa so.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Nanso yehu Yesu! Mmere tiaa bi, wɔbɔɔ no hyɛɛ abɔfo ase sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a esiane Onyankopɔn ahummɔbɔ nti ɛsɛ sɛ owu ma nnipa nyinaa no. Yehu no sɛ esiane owu a owui no nti, wɔahyɛ no anuonyam.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Eye sɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔbɔɔ nneɛma nyinaa na ɔhwɛ so no bɛma Yesu afa nʼamanehunu no mu ayɛ pɛ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛma ne mma nyinaa akɔ saa anuonyam no mu bi. Efisɛ Yesu no nko ara ne Onipa a obedi wɔn anim akɔ nkwagye no mu.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ɔma nnipa yɛ kronkron fi wɔn bɔne mu. Na ɔne wɔn a wayɛ wɔn kronkron no nyinaa wɔ Agya baako. Ɛno nti na Yesu mfɛre sɛ ɔfrɛ wɔn anuanom no.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Ɔka se, “Mɛka wo ho asɛm akyerɛ me nuanom, mɛkamfo wo wɔ wɔn a wɔahyia hɔ no nyinaa anim.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Ɔsan ka bio se, “Mede me ho bɛto Onyankopɔn so.” Na ɔno nso ka se, “Mma a Onyankopɔn de wɔn ama me no ni.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ mma no wɔ ɔhonam ne mogya nti, Yesu nso baa onipa tebea mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔnam ne wu no so bɛsɛe ɔbonsam a okura owu tumi no ahoɔden.

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: Na ɔnam so agye wɔn a esiane sɛ wosuro owu nti, wɔayɛ akoa wɔ wɔn asetena nyinaa mu no.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ nokware turodoo sɛ ɛnyɛ abɔfo na ɔboa wɔn. Na mmom sɛnea Kyerɛwsɛm no ka no, “Ɔboa Abraham asefo.”

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Eyi kyerɛ sɛ ɔkwan biara so no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ sɛ ne nuanom, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛyɛ wɔn Sɔfopanyin nokwafo ne mmɔborɔhunufo wɔ Onyankopɔn som mu, na anam so ma wɔde nnipa bɔne akyɛ wɔn.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Enti afei, obetumi aboa wɔn a wɔasɔ wɔn ahwɛ no, efisɛ wɔsɔɔ ɔno ankasa hwɛe, ma ohuu amane.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Me nuanom akronkronfo a Onyankopɔn afrɛ mo, munnwen Yesu a yegye no to mu sɛ Ɔsomafo no ho.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: Na odii Onyankopɔn a oyii no sɛ ɔnyɛ saa adwuma yi no nokware sɛnea Mose nso dii nokware wɔ Onyankopɔn fi no.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Wɔahu sɛ Yesu fata anuonyam sen Mose, sɛnea onipa a osi ofi nya anuonyam sen ofi no ankasa no.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Ofi biara obi na osii. Na Onyankopɔn nso na wabɔ nneɛma nyinaa.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Mose dii Onyankopɔn nokware sɛ ɔsomfo wɔ ne fi na ɔkaa nsɛm a Onyankopɔn bɛka daakye no nyinaa.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Nanso Kristo de, odi nokware sɛ Ɔba a ɔhwɛ Onyankopɔn fi so. Sɛ yɛma yɛn bo yɛ duru na yɛwɔ gyidi wɔ yɛn anidaso mu a, na yɛyɛ ne fi no.

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Enti Honhom Kronkron no ka se, “Sɛ nnɛ mote Onyankopɔn nne a,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: monnyɛ asoɔden te sɛ nea moyɛɛ bere a mosɔre tiaa Onyankopɔn no; sɛnea moyɛɛ da a na mowɔ sare so a mosɔɔ no hwɛe no.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na mo nenanom sɔɔ no hwɛe, nanso wohuu nea meyɛɛ no mfe aduanan mu no.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Ne saa nti me bo fuw saa nnipa no, na mekae se, ‘Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn koma aman afi me ho, na wɔanhu mʼakwan.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Ɛno nti mekaa ntam wɔ mʼabufuw mu se, ‘Wɔrenhyɛn mʼahomegye mu da.’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Me nuanom, monhwɛ yiye na mo mu bi annya koma bɔne a ɔrennye Onyankopɔn nni a ɛbɛma watwe ne ho afi Onyankopɔn teasefo no ho.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Na mmom sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a bɔne rennaadaa mo mu ebinom na wɔnyɛ asoɔden nti, da biara mommoaboa mo ho mo ho wɔ mmere dodow a asɛm “Nnɛ” a ɛwɔ Kyerɛwsɛm mu no fa yɛn ho no.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yeso gyidi a yɛwɔ no mu dennen sɛnea yɛde fi mfiase no a na yɛwɔ kyɛfa wɔ Kristo mu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Kyerɛwsɛm no ka se, “Sɛ nnɛ mote Onyankopɔn nne a, monnyɛ asoɔden te sɛ nea moyɛɛ bere a mosɔre tiaa Onyankopɔn no.”

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Ɛhefo na wɔtee Onyankopɔn nne na wɔsɔre tiaa no no? Nnipa a Mose dii wɔn anim fi Misraim no nyinaa.

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Bere a Onyankopɔn kaa ntam se, “Wɔremma me home mu da” no, na ɔreka akyerɛ ɛhefo? Na ɔreka akyerɛ wɔn a wɔyɛɛ asoɔden no.

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Afei, yehu sɛ wɔantumi ankɔ ɔhome no mu, efisɛ wɔannye anni.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Afei esiane sɛ bɔhyɛ a ɛfa ne mu home ho no da so gyina hɔ nti, momma yɛnhwɛ yiye na mo mu bi antɔ sin wɔ mu.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Efisɛ wɔaka asɛmpa no akyerɛ yɛn sɛnea wɔka kyerɛ wɔn no. Nanso wɔammu asɛm a wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn no, efisɛ wɔn a wotiee no no annye anni.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Na yɛn a yɛagye adi no nko ara na yɛkɔ saa ɔhome no mu sɛnea Onyankopɔn aka se, “Enti mifi mʼabufuw mu ka ntam se, ‘Wɔrenhyɛn asase a anka mede wɔn rekɔ so no mu da.’ ” Ɔkaa saa asɛm yi de, nanso efi bere a ɔbɔɔ wiase no, na wawie ɔhome dwumadi no dedaw.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Na Kyerɛwsɛm no mu baabi wɔ hɔ a wɔka biribi fa da a ɛto so ason no ho se, “Da a ɛto so ason no, Onyankopɔn home fii ne nnwuma nyinaa mu.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Wɔkaa saa asɛm koro yi ara bio se, “Wɔrenhyɛn asase a anka mede wɔn rekɔ so no mu da.”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wodii kan tee Asɛmpa no annya saa ahome no, efisɛ wɔannye anni. Afoforo bi nso wɔ hɔ a wama wɔn kwan sɛ wonnya ɔhome no.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Enti Onyankopɔn aka se wayi da bi ato hɔ a wɔfrɛ no “Nnɛ.” Mfe bebree akyi no, ɔnam Dawid so kaa wɔ Kyerɛwsɛm no mu se, “Nnɛ, sɛ mote Onyankopɔn nne a mummpirim mo koma.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Sɛ Yosua dii nnipa no anim de wɔn kɔɔ Onyankopɔn home mu a, anka akyiri no Onyankopɔn anka da foforo ho asɛm.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ɛte no, ɔhome da so wɔ hɔ ma Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo, sɛnea Onyankopɔn homee da a ɛto so ason no.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛhome wɔ Onyankopɔn mu no bɛhome afi nʼankasa ne nnwuma mu, sɛnea Onyankopɔn home fii ne nnwuma mu no.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Enti momma yɛmmɔ yɛn ho mmɔden na yɛatumi akɔ Onyankopɔn home mu. Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛn mu bi yɛ asoɔden sɛnea wɔyɛɛ asoɔden a enti wɔankɔ mu no.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn asɛm yɛ nkwa, na ahoɔden wɔ mu. Ɛyɛ nnam sen afoa anofanu. Ehwirew mu kosi sɛ ɛpaapae honhom ne ɔkra, apɔw so ne hon mu. Ɛyɛ koma nsusuwii ne adwene temmufo.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Biribiara nni hɔ a wɔde sie Onyankopɔn ma ɛyɛ yiye. Abɔde mu biribiara da nʼanim na ɔno na ɛsɛ sɛ yebu ho akontaa kyerɛ. Yesu Yɛn Sɔfopanyin

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti, momma yenso gyidi a yɛka ho asɛm no mu den. Efisɛ yɛwɔ Ɔsɔfopanyin kɛse wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Yenni Ɔsɔfopanyin bi a ontumi nhwɛ yɛn mmerɛwyɛ ho nhu yɛn mmɔbɔ. Yɛwɔ obi a wɔasɔ no ahwɛ wɔ akwan ahorow nyinaa so sɛ yɛn ara, nanso wanyɛ bɔne.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Momma yensi yɛn bo na yɛmmra Onyankopɔn ahengua a adom wɔ mu no anim, na ɛno na ɛbɛma yɛanya ahummɔbɔ ne adom a ɛbɛboa yɛn wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Woyii Ɔsɔfopanyin biara fii nnipa bi mu na wasi wɔn anan mu de wɔn akyɛde ne wɔn bɔne ho afɔre asom Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ nʼankasa yɛ mmerɛw wɔ akwan ahorow pii so no nti, otumi tɔ ne bo ase ma wɔn a wonnim na wɔyɛ mfomso no.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Ne mmerɛwyɛ nti, sɛ ɔrebɔ bɔne ho afɔre a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbɔ ma ne ho ne afoforo nso.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Obiara ntumi nyi ne ho mfa nhyɛ ne ho anuonyam sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔsɔfopanyin. Onyankopɔn frɛ nko na onipa nam so bɛyɛ Ɔsɔfopanyin sɛnea wɔfrɛɛ Aaron no.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Saa ara nso na Kristo annye anto ne ho so sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔsɔfopanyin amfa anhyɛ ne ho anuonyam. Na mmom Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Woyɛ me Ba; nnɛ, mayɛ wʼAgya.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ɔsan kaa wɔ baabi foforo se, “Wobɛyɛ ɔsɔfo akosi daa sɛnea Melkisedek asɔfokwan nhyehyɛe te no.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Yesu baa ɔhonam mu wɔ asase so no, ɔbɔɔ mpae nam nkotosrɛ so de nʼabisade too Onyankopɔn a obetumi agye no afi owu mu no anim. Esiane sɛ odwo na ɔde ne ho nyinaa som no no nti, Onyankopɔn tiee no.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn Ba de, nanso ɔnam nʼamanehunu so suaa ahobrɛase.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: Na owiee pɛyɛ no, wɔn a wotie no no nam ne so nya nkwagye a enni awiei,

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: na Onyankopɔn ada no adi sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔsɔfopanyin sɛnea Melkisedek asɔfokwan nhyehyɛe te no.

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Yɛwɔ eyi ho nsɛm pii ka, nanso emu kyerɛkyerɛ yɛ den, efisɛ mo ntease yɛ den.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Moayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ adwuma no akyɛ, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ munya obi ma ɔkyerɛkyerɛ mo Onyankopɔn ho asɛm fi ne mfiase. Anka ɛsɛ sɛ saa bere yi mudi aduan a ɛyɛ den, nanso nufusu na eye ma mo.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Obiara a nufusu ye ma no no da so yɛ akokoaa a onnim nea eye ne nea enye.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Aduan a ɛyɛ den ye ma mpanyimfo a wɔatetew wɔn na wɔahu nsonoe a ɛda papa ne bɔne ntam no.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Momma yennyae Kristo mfiase ho nkyerɛkyerɛ na yensua ne ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ anim no. Ɛho nhia bio sɛ yɛbɛkɔ so akyerɛkyerɛ nea enti a ɛsɛ sɛ yenu yɛn ho wɔ nneyɛe a ɛde owu brɛ yɛn ne nea enti a ɛsɛ sɛ yenya Onyankopɔn mu gyidi no ho.

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: Ɛho nhia nso sɛ yɛbɛkɔ so akyerɛkyerɛ asubɔ, nsa a wɔde gu nnipa so, awufosɔre ne daa atemmu ho nsɛm bio.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn hyira asase a ɛnom osu a ɛtɔ gu so na ɛma afifide yɛ yie ma wɔn a wɔn nti woduae no.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Na sɛ nsɔe ne nwura hunu fifi wɔ so a, enye mma hwee. Onyankopɔn bɛdome no na wɔde ogya asɛe no.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Nanso me nnamfonom, nsɛm a yɛaka yi nyinaa akyi no, yenim pefee sɛ ade pa bi a nkwagye bata ho befi mo mu aba.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nyɛ nea ɔnteɛ. Ne werɛ remfi adwuma a moyɛe anaa ɔdɔ a modaa no adi maa no ne mmoa a mode boaa mo mfɛfo Kristofo na mugu so de boa wɔn no.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Nea yɛrehwehwɛ ne sɛ mo mu biara bɛboa no mmɔdemmɔ so de akosi awiei sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mo nsa bɛka ade a mo ani da so no.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Yɛmpɛ sɛ moyɛ anihaw. Na mmom, yɛpɛ sɛ yehu mo sɛ agyidifo a mowɔ boasetɔ na mo nsa aka bɔ a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ mo no. Abraham So Nhwɛso

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Bere a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Abraham bɔ no, ɔkaa nea wahyɛ ho bɔ no ho ntam. Esiane sɛ na obiara nni hɔ a ɔkorɔn sen no no nti, ɔde ɔno ara ne din na ɛkaa saa ntam no.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: Ɔkaa ntam no se, “Mehyɛ wo bɔ sɛ, mehyira wo na mama wʼase adɔ.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Na Abraham wɔ ntoboase nti, ne nsa kaa bɔ a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa ka ntam a, ɔde obi a ɔkorɔn sen no din na ɛka saa ntam no de siesie nnipa ntam.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn pɛɛ sɛ ɔda no adi pefee kyerɛ wɔn a na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn nsa ka ne bɔhyɛ no se ɔrensesa nʼatirimsɛm, nti ɔkaa ntam de hyɛɛ bɔhyɛ no mu den.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Saa nneɛma abien yi na ɛrentumi nsesa na Onyankopɔn ntumi nni ho atoro. Enti yɛn a yɛnam ne so anya nkwa no, wɔhyɛ yɛn nkuran sɛ yenso yɛn anidaso no mu yiye.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Yɛwɔ saa anidaso yi sɛ ɔkra sɛkyɛ. Etim hɔ, na ɛma yɛhyɛn tra ntwamtam no kosi Kronkron mu Kronkron hɔ.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Yesu asi yɛn anan mu adi yɛn kan kɔ hɔ. Wayɛ Ɔsɔfopanyin afebɔɔ sɛnea Melkisedek asɔfokwan nhyehyɛe te no.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Na saa Melkisedek yi yɛ Salemhene, na ɔsan yɛ Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn sɔfo. Bere a Abraham fi ɔko a okum ahemfo ano reba no, Melkisedek hyiaa no hyiraa no.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Abraham maa no nʼasade no mu nkyɛmu du mu baako. Melkisedek din no nkyerɛase a edi kan no ne Trenee Hene. Esiane sɛ na ɔyɛ Salem hene no nti, wɔkyerɛɛ ne din no ase sɛ Asomdwoe hene.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Obi nnim Melkisedek agya, ne na, ne ne mpanyimfo ho asɛm. Saa ara na obi nnim nʼawo ne ne wu nso ho asɛm. Ɔsɛ Onyankopɔn Ba, na ɔda so yɛ ɔsɔfo daadaa.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Eyi di ho adanse sɛ na ɔyɛ onipa kɛse a Agya Abraham mpo tumi ma no nʼasade mu nkyɛmu du mu baako.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Nanso Lewi asefo a wɔyɛ asɔfo no Mmara na ɛhyɛ wɔn sɛ wonnye nkyɛmu du mu baako mfi wɔn ara wɔn nkurɔfo Israelfo a wɔn nso yɛ Abraham asefo no nkyɛn.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Melkisedek nyɛ Lewi aseni, nanso ogyee nkyɛmu du mu baako fii Abraham nkyɛn hyiraa no ma onyaa Onyankopɔn bɔhyɛ no.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Akyinnye biara nni ho sɛ nea ɔma nhyira so sen nea ogye nhyira.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Wɔde nnipa akatua nkyɛmu du mu baako ma asɔfo a wowu, gye Melkisedek a Kyerɛwsɛm no ka se ɔte ase.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Enti nokware, Abraham tuaa nkyɛmu du no, Lewi a nʼasefo gye nkyɛmu du no nso nam Abraham so tuaa bi maa Melkisedek.

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Na wɔnwoo Lewi ɛ, nanso esiane sɛ na ɔhyɛ ne nena Abraham mu saa bere no a Melkisedek hyiaa no no nti na otuae.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Esiane Lewi asɔfodi nti na wɔde Mmara no maa Israelfo. Ɛno nti sɛ Lewifo asɔfodi no tumi de pɛyɛ brɛ nnipa a, anka ho nhia sɛ wɔbɛfa ɔsɔfo foforo bi sɛ Melkisedek a omfi Aaron abusua mu.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛba sɛ asɔfodi no sesa a, ɛma ho mmara no nso sesa.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Nanso yɛn Awurade a wɔka saa asɛm yi nyinaa fa ne ho no fi abusua foforo mu. Ne busuani biara nnii ɔsɔfo wɔ afɔremuka ho da.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛnnahɔ sɛ wɔwoo no too Yuda abusua mu, na Mose kaa asɔfo ho asɛm no nso, wammɔ nʼabusua din da.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Asɛm no da ne ho adi pefee, efisɛ ɔsɔfo foforo bi aba a ɔte sɛ Melkisedek.

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: Ɔno de, ɛnnam onipa mmara so na wɔhyɛɛ no ɔsɔfo, na mmom wɔnam nkwa a enni awiei tumi so na ɛyɛɛ no ɔsɔfo.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Kyerɛwsɛm no ka se, “Wobɛyɛ ɔsɔfo akosi daa sɛnea Melkisedek asɔfokwan nhyehyɛe te no.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Wɔatow mmara dedaw no akyene, efisɛ sintɔ bi wɔ mmara no mu, na so nni mfaso nso,

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: efisɛ Mose Mmara no antumi amma biribiara anni mu, na wɔde anidaso pa bi a yɛnam so bɛn Onyankopɔn aba.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Yesu de, ɔnam ntam so bɛyɛɛ ɔsɔfo bere a Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Awurade aka ntam; na ɔrensesa nʼadwene a ese, ‘Wobɛyɛ ɔsɔfo daa nyinaa no.’ ”

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: Saa ntam yi nti, Yesu gyina mu ma yɛn, na ɛma yɛne Onyankopɔn apam no di mu.

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Nsonoe foforo bi nso wɔ hɔ. Na saa asɔfo no dɔɔso, efisɛ na wowuwu a wontumi ntoa wɔn adwuma so.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Nanso esiane sɛ Yesu wɔ hɔ daa no nti, ɔwɔ asɔfodi a ɛtena hɔ daa.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Enti otumi gye wɔn a wɔnam ne so ba Onyankopɔn nkyɛn no nnɛ ne daa, efisɛ, ɔte hɔ daa srɛ Onyankopɔn ma wɔn.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Yesu ne Ɔsɔfopanyin a ɔboa yɛn wɔ yɛn ahiasɛm mu. Ɔyɛ kronkron. Onni mfomso biara wɔ ne mu, na ɔnyɛ bɔne. Wɔatew no afi nnebɔneyɛfo ho na wɔama no so aboro ɔsoro so.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Ɔnte sɛ asɔfo mpanyin a wɔaka no a, daa afɔre a wɔbɔ no kan no wɔbɔ wɔ wɔn bɔne a wayɛ ho ansa na afei, wabɔ afoforo de no. Ɔbɔɔ afɔre baako pɛ a ɔde ne ho na ɛbɔe.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Mose Mmara no yi nnipa a wɔmfata sɛ wɔyɛ asɔfo mpanyin, nanso Onyankopɔn bɔ a ɔde ntam kaa ho no a ɛbaa wɔ Mmara no akyi no yii Ɔba no a ɔyɛ pɛ daa nyinaa no.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Asɛm a yegyina so kasa no ne sɛ: Yɛwɔ Ɔsɔfopanyin a ɔte Otumfo a ɔwɔ ɔsoro no ahengua no nifa,

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: na ɔsom sɛ Ɔsɔfopanyin wɔ Kronkronbea a ɛyɛ nokware ntamadan a ɛnyɛ onipa biara na osii, sɛ Awurade no mu hɔ.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Woyi Ɔsɔfopanyin biara sɛ ɔmfa akyɛde ne mmoa mmɔ Onyankopɔn afɔre. Ɛno nti, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn Sɔfopanyin nya biribi a ɔde bɛbɔ afɔre.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Sɛ Yesu wɔ asase so a, anka ɔrenyɛ ɔsɔfo koraa efisɛ asɔfo wɔ hɔ a wɔde afɔrebɔde ma, sɛnea Yudafo mmara kyerɛ no.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Nanso dwuma a wodi sɛ asɔfo no yɛ ɔsoro nsusuwso bi kwa. Eyi nti na wɔbɔɔ Mose kɔkɔ bere a ɔpɛɛ sɛ osi ntamadan no, Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Si no sɛnea merekyerɛ wo wɔ bepɔw no so pɛpɛɛpɛ.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Afei de, wɔama Yesu asɔfodwuma a ɛso kyɛn wɔn de no. Yesu yɛ apam a ɛkyɛn so a wogyina bɔhyɛ a ɛkyɛn so so hyɛe no ntamgyinafo.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Sɛ na apam a edi kan no ye a, anka ɛho nhia sɛ wɔbɛyɛ apam a ɛto so abien no.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nanso Onyankopɔn huu mfomso wɔ ne nkurɔfo ho bere a ɔkae se, “Nna bi reba, Awurade na ose, a me ne Israelfo ne Yuda abusuakuw bɛhyehyɛ apam foforo.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Ɛrenyɛ sɛ apam a me ne wɔn agyanom yɛɛ no bere a misoo wɔn nsa dii wɔn anim fii Misraim no. Wɔanni apam a me ne wɔn hyehyɛɛ no ho nokware, ɛno nti mantew mʼani anhwɛ wɔn, Awurade na ose.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Afei eyi ne apam a me ne Israelfo bɛhyehyɛ wɔ bere a ɛreba no mu, Awurade na ose: Mede me mmara bɛhyɛ wɔn adwene mu na makyerɛw agu wɔn koma mu. Mɛyɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn na wɔayɛ me nkurɔfo.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Wɔn mu biara renka nkyerɛ ne yɔnko anaa ne kuromni se, ‘Hu Awurade!’ Efisɛ wɔn nyinaa behu me fi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Mehu wɔn mmɔbɔ wɔ wɔn bɔne ho; na merenkae wɔn bɔne bio.” Nhyehyɛe Dedaw No

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Frɛ a wɔfrɛ saa apam yi “Foforo” no ama nea wɔyɛɛ kan no ayɛ dedaw; na biribiara a enyin yɛ dedaw no nkyɛ yera.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Na apam a edi kan no wɔ mmara a wɔnam so som. Saa ara nso na na wɔwɔ baabi a nnipa asiesie a wɔsom.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Wosii ntamadan a wɔatwa mu abien. Ɔdan a edi kan no a wɔfrɛ no Kronkronbea no na kaneadua, ɔpon ne brodo a wɔatew ho a wɔde ma Onyankopɔn no wɔ.

english_verse: Behind the curtain was the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ntwamu no akyi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Kronkron mu Kronkron no,

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: na sika aduhuamyɛfo afɔremuka ne Apam Adaka a wɔde sika adura ho nyinaa wɔ. Saa adaka no mu na na sika pɔre a mana ne Aaron pema a ɛfefɛwee ne apam bopon no wɔ.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Adaka no so hɔ nso na anuonyam Kerubim a wɔatrɛw wɔn ntaban mu akata adaka no nkataso no so si. Nanso yɛrentumi nka nneɛma yi ho asɛm nkɔ akyiri mprempren.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Saa na wɔahyehyɛ nneɛma no. Da biara na asɔfo no kɔ ɔdan a edi kan no mu kɔyɛ wɔn adwuma;

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: nanso na Ɔsɔfopanyin no nko ara na ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔkɔ Kronkron mu Kronkron hɔ pɛnkoro pɛ afe biara. Ɔde mogya a ɔde bɔ ɔno ankasa ne ne nkurɔfo mfomso ho afɔre ka ne ho kɔ.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Honhom Kronkron no nam saa ɔkwan yi so kyerɛ yɛn sɛ, wonnya mmuee ɔkwan a wɔde kɔ Kronkron mu Kronkron hɔ wɔ bere a Ntamadan no ne mu nneɛma da so wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ mfonitwa ma nnɛ bere yi. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ akyɛde ne mmoa a na wɔde bɔ afɔre ma Onyankopɔn no rentumi mma wɔn a wɔsom no koma mu nyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: Wɔde nnuan, anonne ne nneɛma ahorow a wɔde dwira wɔn ho na edi dwuma no. Eyi yɛ ɔhonam fam nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ adwuma kosi bere a nhyehyɛe foforo bɛba.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Nanso Kristo aba dedaw sɛ Ɔsɔfopanyin ama nneɛma pa a yɛwɔ dedaw yi. Ntamadan a ɔsom wɔ mu no so, na edi mu kyɛn dedaw no. Ɛnyɛ nnipa na wɔyɛe. Afei nso emfi adebɔ yi mu.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: Bere a Kristo kɔɔ ntamadan no mu a ɔkɔɔ Kronkronbea hɔ pɛnkoro no, wamfa mmirekyi ne anantwi mogya na ɛkɔbɔɔ afɔre. Mmom, ɔno ara de ne mogya na ɛbɔɔ afɔre de gyee nkwa a enni awiei maa yɛn. Nhyehyɛe Foforo No

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mmirekyi ne anantwinini mogya ne anantwibere nsõ a wɔde dwira wɔn a wɔn ho agu fi tew wɔn ho kɔ ɔhonam ahofi mu a,

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: mpɛn ahe na Kristo a ɔnam Honhom so, de ne ho bɔɔ afɔre a ɛho nni dɛm maa Onyankopɔn no mogya rentew mo ho mfi nnwuma bɔne mu, na monkɔsom Onyankopɔn a ɔte ase no ana?

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Eyi nti na Kristo yɛ apam foforo no ntamgyinafo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a Onyankopɔn afrɛ wɔn no benya nhyira a enni awiei sɛnea Onyankopɔn ahyɛ bɔ no. Eyi aba saa, efisɛ owu bi asi a egye nnipa fi wɔn bɔne a wɔyɛɛ bere a na wɔwɔ apam a edi kan no mu no mu.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Sɛ nsamansew bi wɔ hɔ a, ɛsɛ sɛ wotumi kyerɛ sɛ onipa a ɔhyɛɛ saa nsamansew no awu.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa a ɔhyɛɛ nsamansew no te ase a, saa nsamansew no nka hwee. Bere a wawu no na ɛka biribi.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti na apam a edi kan no wɔnam mogya so na wɔhyɛɛ no den no.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Nea edi kan no, Mose kaa mmaransɛm no nyinaa, sɛnea ɛwɔ mmara no mu no kyerɛɛ nnipa no. Nantwi mma mogya ne nsu ne kuntu kɔkɔɔ ne sommɛ na ɔde petee nwoma mmobɔwee no ne nnipa no nyinaa so

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: kae se, “Eyi ne mogya a ɛsɔw apam a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ mo sɛ munni so no ano.”

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Saa ara na Mose petee mogya guu ntamadan no ne nneɛma a wɔde som no nyinaa so ne no.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Nokware, sɛnea mmara no kyerɛ no, ɛkame ayɛ sɛ mogya na etumi tew ade nyinaa ho, na saa ara nso na gye sɛ mogya ahwie agu ansa na bɔnefakyɛ aba.

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Saa ɔkwan yi ara so na wɔnam ma biribiara a ɛyɛ ɔsoro nhwɛsode no ho tew. Nanso, ɔsoro nneɛma no ankasa de, afɔre a eye kyɛn eyinom na wɔde tew ho.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Efisɛ Kristo ankɔ kronkronbea a nnipa de wɔn nsa na ayɛ a ɛyɛ ade kann ho nhwɛso no hɔ. Ɔkɔɔ ɔsoro ankasa na osi yɛn anan mu wɔ Onyankopɔn anim hɔ.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Afe biara Yudafo Sɔfopanyin de aboa mogya kɔ Kronkronbea hɔ. Nanso Kristo amfa ne ho amma mpɛn bebree saa.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔyɛɛ saa a, anka efi adebɔ mfiase no, obehu amane mpɛn bebree. Mmom, waba prɛko a nneɛma nyinaa reba awiei, na ɔnam afɔre a ɔde ne ho bɔe no so apepa bɔne.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara wu prɛko pɛ, na ɛno akyi Onyankopɔn abu no atɛn.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Saa ara na wɔde Kristo nso bɔɔ afɔre baako pɛ de gyee dodow no ara wɔ wɔn bɔne mu. Ɔbɛba ne mprenu so a ɔremmegye nnebɔneyɛfo na mmom, ɔbɛba abegye wɔn a wɔretwɛn no no nkwa.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Mmara no yɛ nneɛma pa nsusuwso a ɛreba, na mmom ɛnyɛ nneɛma pa no ankasa nen. Wɔbɔ afɔre koro no ara afe biara, efisɛ saa afɔre koro a wɔbɔ no afe afe no rentumi mma nnipa a wɔsom no nyɛ pɛ da.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnipa a wɔresom Onyankopɔn no tumi fi wɔn bɔne mu yɛ pɛ a, ɛno de anka wɔrenni bɔne ho fɔ bio, na ne saa nti afɔrebɔ nyinaa to betwa.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Esiane saa nti, bere a Kristo rebɛba wiase no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn se: “Wompɛ afɔrebɔ ne ayɛyɛde nanso woasiesie ɔhonam ama me.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Wʼani nnnye ɔhyew ne bɔne afɔre anaa afɔre a wɔbɔ de pepa bɔne ho.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Afei mekae se, ‘Mewɔ ha rebɛyɛ nea wopɛ sɛ meyɛ sɛnea wɔakyerɛw afa me ho wɔ Mmara nhoma no mu no.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Kan no ɔkae se, “Wompɛ, na wʼani nso nnnye afɔrebɔ ne ayɛyɛde a wɔde pepa bɔne ho.” Ɛwɔ mu, na Mmara no kyerɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ saa.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkae se, “Mewɔ ha rebɛyɛ nea wopɛ sɛ meyɛ.” Ɛno nti, Onyankopɔn agu tete afɔrebɔ no nyinaa na ɔde Kristo afɔrebɔ no asi anan mu.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Da biara Yudani sɔfo sɔre yɛ nʼasɔfodwuma na wabɔ afɔre mpɛn pii. Nanso saa afɔre yi rentumi mpepa bɔne.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Kristo de, ɔbɔɔ bɔne ho afɔre. Afɔre a ɛtena hɔ daa nyinaa. Na ɛno akyi, ɔtenaa Onyankopɔn nifa so.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na ɔretwɛn mprempren kosi sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛma nʼatamfo ayɛ nʼanan ase ntiaso.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Ɔnam afɔrebɔ baako so ama nnebɔneyɛfo ho atew daa nyinaa.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Na Honhom Kronkron no nso di adanse. Nea edi kan no, ɔka se,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Eyi ne apam a me ne wɔn bɛpam wɔ bere a ɛreba no mu. Awurade na ose: Mede me mmara bɛhyɛ wɔn koma mu na makyerɛw agu wɔn adwene mu.”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Na afei waka se, “Merenkae wɔn bɔne ne wɔn amumɔyɛ bio.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔde eyinom nyinaa kyɛ a, na afɔre a wɔbɔ de pepa bɔne no ho nhia bio. Momma Yɛmmɛn Onyankopɔn

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Anuanom, esiane Yesu wu no nti, yɛade yɛn ho koraa sɛ yɛbɛkɔ Kronkronbea hɔ.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Ɔnam ɔno ara ne honam so abue ɔkwan foforo a nkwa wɔ mu ama yɛn.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Yɛwɔ ɔsɔfo kɛse bi a ɔhwɛ Onyankopɔn fi so.

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: Momma yɛmfa koma pa ne gyidi a mu yɛ den ntwiw mmɛn Onyankopɔn. Efisɛ wɔde Yesu mogya atew yɛn tiboa afɔbu ho, na wɔde nsu a ɛyɛ kronkron aguare yɛn nipadua.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Momma yennyina gyidi a yɛaso mu no mu dennen, efisɛ nea ɔhyɛɛ yɛn bɔ no yɛ ɔnokwafo.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Momma yɛn ho yɛn ho asɛm nhia yɛn na yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho yɛn ho na yɛnyɛ papa.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Mommma yennnyae yɛn ho yɛn ho nhyiamu da sɛnea afoforo bi yɛ no. Mmom, momma yɛnhyɛ yɛn ho yɛn ho nkuran denneennen, efisɛ mo ara muhu sɛ ɛrenkyɛ na da no aba.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Sɛ mohyɛ da kɔ so yɛ bɔne a, afɔrebɔ biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛpepa mo bɔne, efisɛ wɔada nokware no adi akyerɛ yɛn.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Nea ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wotia Onyankopɔn ara ne atemmu ne ogya a ɛbɛba abɛhyew wɔn no.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Obiara a obu Mose Mmara no so no, sɛ nnansefo baanu anaa baasa adansedi nti, wobu atɛn tia no a, wobekum no a wɔrenhu no mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Na obi a watiatia Onyankopɔn Ba no so, na ɔmmfa Onyankopɔn mogya apam no a egyee no fii bɔne mu no nyɛ hwee anaa nea otiatia Honhom a ɔma adom no anim no, dɛn na ɛbɛto no? Asotwe a onii no benya no nyɛ adewa.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Yenim sɛ Onyankopɔn kae se, “Me na aweretɔ wɔ me, na me na mitua ka,” na ɔno ara na ɔsan kae se, “Awurade bebu ne nkurɔfo atɛn.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn a ɔte ase no nsam amanenya yɛ hu.

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Monkae ahohia a mokɔɔ mu bere a muhuu hann no, mumiaa mo ani huu ɔko bebree mu amane.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Ebi ne sɛ, wɔyeyaw mo mpɛn pii, guu mo anim ase wɔ bagua mu; na ɛtɔ da bi mpo a, na moasiesie mo ho sɛ mobɛka wɔn a wɔrehu amane no ho.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Mo ne nneduafo daa afiase na wɔfaa mo ahode nyinaa no mpo, munyaa ho boasetɔ, efisɛ munim sɛ ɛyɛ dɛn ara a mowɔ ade pa bi a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Mommma mo koma ntutu na moanhwere mo akatua.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ motɔ mo bo ase na moatumi ayɛ Onyankopɔn apɛde ama mo nsa aka nea wɔahyɛ mo ho bɔ no.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Efisɛ Kyerɛwsɛm no ka se, “Ɛrenkyɛ koraa na nea ɛsɛ sɛ ɔba no aba; ɔrentwentwɛn.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Na, “Nea ɔteɛ no fi gyidi mu benya nkwa, na sɛ ɔtwe ne ho a, me kra ani rensɔ no.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Yɛnyɛ nnipa a yɛsan yɛn akyi na yɛyera. Mmom yɛwɔ gyidi na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Gyidi yɛ ahotoso a yɛwɔ wɔ nneɛma a yɛn ani da so ne awerehyɛmu a yɛwɔ wɔ nneɛma a yɛn ani nhu mu.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Gyidi a na tetefo no wɔ nti na wonyaa adanse pa.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Gyidi na ɛma yɛte ase sɛ ɛnam Onyankopɔn asɛm so na wɔbɔɔ wiase. Ɛma yehu sɛ wɔbɔɔ nea wohu fii nea wonhu mu.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Ɛnam gyidi so na Habel bɔɔ afɔre a ɛsɔ ani kyɛn nea Kain de maa Onyankopɔn no. Ne gyidi nti, Onyankopɔn buu no sɛ onipa trenee, na nʼakyɛde no sɔɔ Onyankopɔn ani. Na ɛno so na ɔnam wui a nnɛ mpo ɔda so kasa.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti, wɔfaa Henok kɔɔ ɔsoro a wanhu owu. Obiara anhu no, efisɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔfaa no kɔe. Kyerɛwsɛm no ka se ansa na wɔrebɛfa Henok akɔ no, na wasɔ Onyankopɔn ani.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Obiara a onni gyidi rentumi nsɔ Onyankopɔn ani. Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara a ɔba Onyankopɔn nkyɛn no nya gyidi sɛ Onyankopɔn te ase na ɔdom wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no no.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na ɛmaa Noa tee Onyankopɔn kɔkɔ a ɔbɔ faa daakye nneɛma a bi nsii da no ho, otiee Onyankopɔn yɛɛ adaka a mu na wogyee ɔno ne ne fifo nkwa. Ɛnam so maa Onyankopɔn buu wiase fɔ, na Noa de, ne nsa kaa trenee a wonya fi gyidi mu no.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na bere a Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham se ɔnkɔ asase a wahyɛ ho bɔ sɛ ɔde bɛma no no so no, otiei na ɔkɔe. Ogyaw ne man hɔ kɔe a na onnim faako a ɔrekɔ.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti ɔtenaa asase a na Onyankopɔn ahyɛ no ho bɔ no so sɛ ɔhɔho. Ɔne Isak ne Yakob a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ wɔn bɔ koro no ara bi tenaa ntamadan mu.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Nanso na Abraham retwɛn kurow kɛse bi a Onyankopɔn akyekyere a ne fapem rensɛe da mu akɔtena.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na Sara nso de nyaa tumi nyinsɛnee, bere a na wanyin na ontumi nwo no. Ɔde ne ho too Onyankopɔn so se obedi ne bɔhyɛ so.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Ɛno nti, ɛwɔ mu sɛ na Abraham regye nna awu de, nanso nʼasefo adɔɔso sɛ wim nsoromma ne mpoano nwea.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Gyidi mu na saa nnipa yi nyinaa wuwui. Ɛwɔ mu sɛ wɔn nsa anka bɔ a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ wɔn no de, nanso wohuu no wɔ akyirikyiri yɛɛ no atuu, gye dii sɛ wɔyɛ ahɔho ne amamfrafo wɔ asase so.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔka saa no da no adi pefee sɛ wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn ankasa wɔn man.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Wɔannwene ɔman a wogyaw wɔ wɔn akyi no ho. Sɛ wɔyɛɛ no saa a, anka wobetumi anya ɔkwan asan wɔn akyi akɔ hɔ.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Na mmom, ɔman pa a ɛyɛ ɔsoro man no na na wɔrepere. Enti ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn aniwu sɛ ɔma wɔfrɛ no wɔn Nyankopɔn, efisɛ wasiesie ɔman bi ama wɔn.

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Na Abraham nim sɛ Onyankopɔn betumi anyan awufo afi owu mu, na ɔkwan bi so no, yebetumi aka se Onyankopɔn nyan Isak fii owu mu.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na ɛmaa Isak hyiraa Yakob ne Esau maa wɔn daakye asetena.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na ɛmaa Yakob hyiraa Yosef mma no nyinaa ansa na ɔrewu. Obutuw ne pema so sɔree Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na Yosef rebewu no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Israelfo se, wobetu afi Misraim, na ɔhyɛɛ nea sɛ owu a, wɔnyɛ nʼamu no.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na ɛmaa Mose awo akyi no, nʼawofo de no siee asram abiɛsa no. Wohuu sɛ na ɔyɛ sononko, enti na wɔansuro sɛ wobebu ɔhene no mmara so no.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na Mose nyin no, wampɛ sɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no Farao babea ba no.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: Na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn mma behu amane sen sɛ obegye nʼani wɔ bɔne mu mmere tiaa bi.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: Osusuw sɛ, sɛ ohu amane ma Kristo a, eye sen agyapade a ɛwɔ Misraim nyinaa, efisɛ na nʼani da ade pa bi so daakye.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na ɛmaa Mose tu fii Misraim a na onsuro ɔhene no abufuw. Omiaa nʼani sɛ ɔrensan nʼakyi, efisɛ na wahu Onyankopɔn a obi nhu no no.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na ɔhyɛɛ Twam Afahyɛ no ma wɔde mogya petee apon ho, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔsɛebɔfo no renkum Israelfo mmakan a wɔyɛ mmarima no.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na ɛmaa Israelfo no twaa Po Kɔkɔɔ sɛnea wɔnam asase kesee so no. Misraimfo no pɛɛ sɛ wotwa bi no, asu no bu faa wɔn so.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na Israelfo de nnanson twaa Yeriko afasu ho hyia dwiriw gui no.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Gyidi nti na wɔankum aguaman Rahab amfra wɔn a wonnye Onyankopɔn nni no, efisɛ ogyee akwansrafo no fɛw so. Gyidi Foforo Bi

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Afei dɛn na menka? Bere bebree nni hɔ sɛ mɛka Gideon, Barak, Samson, Yefta, Dawid ne Samuel ne adiyifo no ho asɛm.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: Wɔnam gyidi so koo amanko, dii nkonim ma wɔn nsa kaa nea Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ wɔn ho bɔ no. Wɔkataa gyata ano,

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: dum ogyatannaa, tetew wɔn ho fii afoawu ano. Na wɔyɛ mmerɛw, nanso wɔyɛɛ den. Na wɔyɛ den wɔ akono, enti wodii wɔn atamfo so.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Ɛnam gyidi so ma wonyan mmea bi awufo maa wɔn. Wɔyɛɛ afoforo bi nso ayayade sɛ anka wɔmpa Onyankopɔn na wonnyaa wɔn. Nanso wɔampo Onyankopɔn, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn nsa bɛka daakye wusɔre a ɛkyɛn so no.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Woguu afoforo anim ase, bɔɔ wɔn mmaa, na wɔkyekyeree ebinom de wɔn guu afiase.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Wosiw ebinom abo. Wɔde sradaa paee ebinom mu abien, de afoa kum bi. Wokyinkyin sɛ nnipa a nguan ne mmirekyi nwoma kata wɔn ho. Wɔyɛɛ mmɔbɔ. Wɔn ho hiaa wɔn na wohuu amane.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Wiase yi annye amma wɔn. Wokyinkyin sɛ atutenafo wɔ sare ne mmepɔw so, abodan ne asase so abon mu.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Wodii eyinom nyinaa ho adanse pa wɔ wɔn gyidi ho, nanso wɔn nsa anka bɔ a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ wɔn no,

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: efisɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ tirimupɔw papa bi ma yɛn, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yɛne wɔn nyinaa bɛbɔ mu anya bɔhyɛ no.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Yɛn de, yɛwɔ nnansefo bebree a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia. Momma yɛntwe yɛn ho mfi akwanside nyinaa ne bɔne a akyekyere yɛn denneennen no nyinaa ho na yɛnyere yɛn ho wɔ mmirikakansi a ɛda yɛn anim no mu.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Momma yɛmfa yɛn ani nto Yesu a yɛn gyidi mfiase ne nʼawie gyina ne so no so. Asennua no nti wampa abaw. Esiane anigye a na ɛretwɛn no no nti, animguasewu a owui wɔ asennua so no anhaw no. Enti mprempren ɔte Onyankopɔn ahengua no nifa so.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Dwene ɔhaw a ɔfaa mu no ho sɛ nnipa nnebɔneyɛfo tan a wɔtan no nso, otumi gyinaa ano no. Ɛno nti mommpa abaw.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Na mo ne bɔne ko mu no, monko nkoduu sɛ mubehwie mogya agu. Onyankopɔn Asotwe Fata Yɛn

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Mo werɛ afi nkuranhyɛsɛm a Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ mo, sɛnea agya kasa kyerɛ ne mma no? Se, “Me ba, sɛ Awurade teɛ wo a, tie no yiye, na sɛ ɔka wʼanim a, mpa abaw.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Efisɛ obiara a Awurade pɛ nʼasɛm no, ɔtwe nʼaso sɛnea agya teɛ ɔba a ɔdɔ no no.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Amanehunu biara a ɛbɛto mo no, munnhinhim na momfa no sɛ Agya no nteɛso, efisɛ mo amanehunu no kyerɛ nteɛso a Onyankopɔn wɔ ma ne mma. Na dɛn nti na agya ntwe ne mma aso?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Sɛ wanteɛ mo sɛ ne mma no bi a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ monnyɛ ne mma kann.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛn agyanom a wɔwɔ asase so twee yɛn aso ma yebuu wɔn a, mpɛn ahe na ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛbrɛ yɛn ho ase ma honhom mu Agya no na yetumi tena ase?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Yɛn agyanom a wɔwɔ asase so ha twee yɛn aso sɛnea wɔpɛ wɔ bere tiaa bi. Nanso yɛn yiyedi nti, Onyankopɔn yɛɛ saa sɛnea yɛn ho bɛtew.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔtwe yɛn aso a ɛma yɛn werɛ how wɔ saa bere no mu na yɛn ani nnye. Na akyiri no a wɔn a wɔfa saa asotwe no mu no nya wɔn ho ntease no, wonya asomdwoe na wɔtena ase trenee mu.

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Monhyehyɛ nsa ne nkotodwe a emu agugow no mu den.

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Munsiesie akwan na momfa so, na mpakye anyɛ mmubuafo, na mmom, wɔasa wɔn yare.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Mo ne nnipa nyinaa ntena ase asomdwoe mu, na mommɔ mmɔden ntena ase trenee mu. Anyɛ saa a, morenhu Awurade.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Monhwɛ yiye na mo mu bi annan nʼakyi ankyerɛ Onyankopɔn adom no. Monhwɛ yiye na mo mu bi anyɛ sɛ afifide a ɛyɛ nwen a enyin ma ne bɔnwoma no haw afoforo.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: Monhwɛ yiye na mo mu bi anyɛ oguamanfo ne obi a ɔmfɛre Onyankopɔn sɛ Esau a obuu nʼani guu nʼagyapade so tɔn nʼabakan a ɔyɛ de gyee aduan no.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Na afei eduu bere bi a ɔpɛɛ sɛ ne nsa ka nʼagya hɔ nhyira no, ɔde kamee no. Ɛwɔ mu sɛ ɔde nusu peree sɛ wanya adwensakra de, nanso anyɛ yiye. Onyankopɔn Anuonyam

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Munhyiaa nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu, ogyatannaa, awerɛhow, sum ne ahum sɛnea Israelfo no hyiaa wɔ Sinai Bepɔw no so bere a Onyankopɔn de ne mmara no mae no.
