translation_verse: Wɔmaa wɔn mu biara atade fitaa, na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se wɔntwɛn kakra nkosi sɛ wobekum wɔn nuanom asomfo abɛka wɔn ho.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Na mihuu sɛ Oguamma no tew nsɔwano a ɛto so asia no ano. Na asasewosow a ano yɛ den ba maa owia yɛɛ tumm sɛ birisii, na ɔsram yɛɛ kɔɔ sɛ mogya.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Na nsoromma tetew fii soro bɛhwee asase so te sɛnea mframa a ano yɛ den bɔ borɔdɔma bun ma ɛtetew gu fam pɛ.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Ɔsoro yeraa te sɛ nhoma a wɔabobɔw, na mmepɔw ne asupɔw fii wɔn atenae.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Na asase so ahemfo ne nnipa akɛse ne asafohene ne adefo ne ahoɔdenfo ne nkoa ne adehye nyinaa hintahintaw abodan ne mmepɔw mu abotan mu.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ mmepɔw no ne abotan no se, “Monkata yɛn so na momfa yɛn nsie, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nea ɔte ahengua no so no ani renhu yɛn, na yemfi Oguamma no abufuw ano.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Wɔn abufuw no da kɛse adu, na hena na obetumi agyina ano?”

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo no kae se, “Monnsɛe asase ne po anaa nnua kosi sɛ yɛde nsɔwano bɛhyɛ Onyankopɔn asomfo no agyirae.”

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: kae se, “Amen! Nhyira ne anuonyam ne nyansa ne aseda ne nidi ne tumi ne ahoɔden yɛ Onyankopɔn de daa daa! Amen!”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Eyi akyi no, mihuu nnipakuw a obiara ntumi nkan wɔn dodow. Wofifi aman ne mmusuakuw ne nkurɔfo ne kasa nyinaa mu a wogyinagyina ahengua no ne Oguamma no anim a wɔhyehyɛ ntade fitafitaa, kurakura berɛw.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Wɔteɛɛ mu se, “Yɛn nkwagye fi yɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔte ahengua no so ne Oguamma no.”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Na abɔfo no atwa ahengua no ne mpanyimfo no ne ateasefo baanan no ho ahyia. Afei wobutubutuw ahengua no anim, som Onyankopɔn

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Mpanyimfo no mu baako bisaa me se, “Ɛhefo na wɔhyehyɛ ntade fitafitaa yi, na wofi he?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Mibuae se, “Minnim, owura. Na wo na wunim.” Ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Eyinom ne wɔn a wɔafi ɔtaa mu. Wɔde Oguamma no mogya ahoro wɔn ntade ama ayɛ fitaa.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Na ɛno nti na, “wogyinagyina Onyankopɔn ahengua anim a wɔresom awia ne anadwo wɔ ne hyiadan mu yi. Nea ɔbɛtena ahengua no so no bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Osukɔm renne wɔn bio; ɔkɔm renne wɔn bio. Owia anaa ɔhyew biara renka wɔn bio.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Efisɛ Oguamma no a ɔwɔ ahengua no mfimfini no bɛyɛ wɔn guanhwɛfo de wɔn akɔ nkwa asuti ho. Na Onyankopɔn bɛpepa wɔn aniwa mu nisu nyinaa.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Bere a Oguamma no tew nsɔwano a ɛto so ason no, ɔsoro nyinaa tɛm dinn bɛyɛ dɔnhwerew fa.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu abɔfo baason a wogyinagyina Onyankopɔn anim. Wɔmemaa wɔn ntorobɛnto ason.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo foforo a na ɔwɔ sikakɔkɔɔ aduhuam adaka begyinaa afɔremuka no ho. Wɔmaa no aduhuam bebree sɛ ɔmfa mmɔ mpae nka Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo no de ho, na ɔmmɔ sikakɔkɔɔ a esi ahengua no anim no so afɔre.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Aduhuam no hua ne Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo mpae fi abɔfo no nsam kɔɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo no faa aduhuam adaka no de ogya a efi afɔremuka no so hyɛɛ no ma, tow kyenee asase so. Na aprannaa ne nne ahorow ne anyinam ne asasewosow bae.

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo baason a wokurakura ntorobɛnto ason no siesiee wɔn ho sɛ wɔrebɛhyɛn.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a odi kan no hyɛn ne torobɛnto. Na mparuwbo ne ogya a ɛne mogya adi afra tɔ guu asase so. Asase nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako hyewee. Nnua nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako hyewee, na wura amono nyinaa nso hyewee.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo a ɔto so abien no hyɛn ne torobɛnto. Wɔtow biribi a ɛte sɛ bepɔw kɛse a ɛredɛw kyenee po mu. Po no nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako dan mogya.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Na abɔde a ɛwɔ nkwa a ɛwɔ po no mu nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako wuwui, na ahyɛn mu nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako bobɔe.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo a ɔto so abiɛsa hyɛn ne torobɛnto. Nsoromma kɛse bi a ɛredɛw sɛ ogyatɛn tew fii ɔsoro bɛhwee nsu nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako mu.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Nsoromma no din de “Anwɔnwen.” Nsu no nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako yɛɛ nwen, na nnipa a wɔnomee no mu bebree wuwui, efisɛ na ayɛ nwen.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo a ɔto so anan no hyɛn ne torobɛnto. Na wɔbɔɔ owia nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako, ne ɔsram nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako ne nsoromma nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako sen ma no duruu sum, enti adekyee mu nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako anhyerɛn, na anadwo nso saa ara.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Na merehwɛ no, metee sɛ ɔkɔre bi a watu nam wim teɛ mu se, “Wɔn a wɔte asase so no nnue; wonnue, wonnue esiane torobɛnto a aka a abɔfo baasa no rebɛhyɛn no nti.”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo a ɔto so anum no hyɛn ne torobɛnto. Mihuu nsoromma a atew fi ɔsoro abɛhwe asase so. Wɔmaa no ebun a ase nni awiei safe.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Nsoromma no buee bun no, na wusiw kumɔnn fii mu sɛ fononoo kɛse bi, na wusiw no maa owia hann ne mframa a ɛwɔ hɔ no yɛɛ tumm.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Mmoadabi fii wusiw no mu baa asase so, na wɔmaa wɔn tumi sɛ nkekantwɛre.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se wɔnnsɛe sare anaa nnua anaa afifide biara. Na mmom, nnipa a Onyankopɔn nsɔwano no bi nni wɔn moma so no de, wotumi haw wɔn.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Wɔamma saa mmoadabi no kwan se wonkunkum saa nnipa yi. Na mmom, wɔmaa wɔn kwan se wɔnhaw wɔn asram anum. Wɔka wɔn a, wɔn ano yaw no te sɛ akekantwɛre de.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Saa asram anum no mu no, saa nnipa no bɛhwehwɛ owu, nanso wɔrennya. Wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wowu, nanso owu beguan afi wɔn nkyɛn.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Mmoadabi no te sɛ apɔnkɔ a wɔasiesie wɔn ama ɔko. Wɔwɔ biribi te sɛ sikakɔkɔɔ ahenkyɛw hyehyɛ wɔn ti. Na wɔn anim te sɛ nnipa anim.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Wɔn ti nwi te sɛ mmea ti nwi, na wɔn se nso te sɛ gyata se.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Wɔde biribi te sɛ dade nkatabo akatakata wɔn bo. Na nnyigyei a wɔn ntaban yɛ no te sɛ apɔnkɔ bebree a wɔretwe nteaseɛnam akɔ ɔko.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Bɔre wɔwɔ wɔn dua ano te sɛ akekantwɛre de. Na wɔn dua no nti na na wɔwɔ tumi a wɔde haw nnipa asram anum no.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ ɔhene a odi wɔn so, a ɔno ne ɔbɔfo a ɔhwɛ bun no so. Ne din wɔ Hebri kasa mu de “Abadon” na Hela kasa mu nso, ɛde “Apolion” .

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw baako atwa mu. Eyi akyi, ɔhaw abien bi bɛba. Ahohommɔne Anan No

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo a ɔto so asia no hyɛn ne torobɛnto. Metee nne bi fii sikakɔkɔɔ afɔremuka a esi Onyankopɔn anim no ntwea so nyinaa.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Nne no ka kyerɛɛ ɔbɔfo a ɔto so asia a okura torobɛnto no se, “Sansan abɔfo baanan a wɔasesa wɔn wɔ, Asubɔnten Eufrate ho no.”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Wɔsansan abɔfo baanan no. Wɔasiesie wɔn ama saa dɔnhwerew yi, saa da yi, saa ɔsram yi ne saa afe yi sɛ wonkunkum adesamma mu nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Wodii asraafo ɔpepem ahannu anim. Wɔbɔɔ wɔn dodow no ho amanneɛ ma metee.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Na mʼanisoadehu no mu no, mihuu apɔnkɔ no ne wɔn akafo. Na wɔn nkatabo no yɛ kɔɔ sɛ ogya, tumm, ne akokɔsrade sɛ sufre. Na ɔpɔnkɔ no ti te sɛ gyata ti na na ogya wusiw ne sufre fi wɔn anom.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Saa ɔhaw ahorow abiɛsa no a ɛyɛ ogya, wusiw ne sufre no a efi apɔnkɔ no anom bae no kum adesamma nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Efisɛ na apɔnkɔ no tumi nyinaa fi wɔn anom ne wɔn dua. Wɔn dua te sɛ awɔ a wɔwɔ ti a ɛno na na wɔde pira nnipa.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Adesamma a wɔkae no a ɔhaw no ankum wɔn no ansakra wɔn adwene amfi wɔn nsa ano nnwuma ho. Wɔannyae ahonhommɔne ne ahoni ne sika ne dwetɛ ne asanka ne abo ne nnua a enhu ade na ɛnte asɛm na entumi nnantew no som.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Saa ara nso na wɔansakra wɔn adwene amfi wɔn awudi ne wɔn aduto ne wɔn aguamammɔ ne wɔn akorɔmmɔ ho.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Afei mihuu ɔbɔfo hoɔdenfo foforo bi a ofi ɔsoro resian aba fam. Na ɔhyɛ omununkum mu a nyankontɔn bɔ ne ti. Na nʼanim te sɛ owia, na ne nan te sɛ ogya fadum.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Na nhoma ketewaa bi kura no a wabue mu. Ɔde ne nan nifa sii po so na benkum no si asase so.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Ɔde nne kɛse teɛɛ mu sɛnea gyata bobɔ mu. Ɔteɛɛ mu no, aprannaa ason kasae.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Wɔkasae no, na mepɛ sɛ mekyerɛw. Nanso metee nne bi fii ɔsoro a ɛkae se, “Ma nsɛm a aprannaa ason no kaa no nka wo tirim. Nkyerɛw!”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ ara ɔbɔfo a mihuu sɛ ogyina hɔ a ne nan baako si po so na baako si asase so no maa ne nsa nifa so kɔɔ soro,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: na ɔde Onyankopɔn a ɔte hɔ daa daa a ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase ne po ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa no din kaa ntam. Ɔbɔfo no kae se, “Beresɛe biara nni hɔ.

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔbɔfo a ɔto so ason no hyɛn ne torobɛnto no a, ansa na Onyankopɔn bewie nʼahintasɛm mu nhyehyɛe no, sɛnea ɔka kyerɛɛ nʼasomfo a wɔyɛ adiyifo no.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Afei nne a metee sɛ efi ɔsoro no kasa kyerɛɛ me bio se. “Kɔ na kogye nhoma a wɔabue mu a ɔbɔfo a ogyina po ne asase so no kitae no.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Mekɔɔ ɔbɔfo no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no se ɔmfa nhoma ketewa no mma me. Ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Gye na kɔwe. Ɛbɛkeka wɔ wo yam, nanso wʼanom de, ɛbɛyɛ dɛ te sɛ ɛwo.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Migyee nhoma ketewa no fii ne nsam wee, na ɛyɛɛ dɛ te sɛ ɛwo wɔ mʼanom. Nanso, memenee akyi no, ɛmaa me yam kaw me.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Afei wɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Kɔ so ka nea ɛbɛba kyerɛ aman bebree sofo, ɔkasahorow ne ahemfo nso.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Nanso mfa asɔredan no adiwo nka ho, efisɛ wɔde hɔ ama amanamanmufo, na wobetiatia kurow kronkron no so asram aduanan abien.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: Mɛsoma me nnansefo baanu a wofurafura atweaatam, na wɔaka Onyankopɔn asɛm saa nna apem ahannu ne aduosia no mu.”

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Saa nnansefo baanu no ne ngodua abien no ne akaneadua abien a esisi asase a ɛwɔ Awurade anim no so no.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ogya a efi wɔn anom bekunkum atamfo biara a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhaw wɔn no. Ɛno nti wobekum obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhaw wɔn no.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ tumi sɛ wɔto ɔsoro mu a osu rentɔ wɔ bere a wɔrehyɛ nkɔm no. Wɔwɔ tumi sɛ wɔdan nsu ma ɛyɛ mogya na wɔde ɔhaw to asase so mpɛn dodow biara a wɔpɛ.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔka wɔn asɛm no wie a, aboa a obefi bun no mu apue no ne wɔn bɛko. Obedi wɔn so akunkum wɔn

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: na wɔn amu no agu kurow kɛse no abɔnten so, wɔ faako a wɔbɔɔ wɔn Awurade nnadewa mu wɔ asennua no so a ɛhɔ din pa ne Sodom ne Misraim no.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Na nnipa a wofi aman so ne mmusuakuw ne ɔkasa ahorow ne aman bi so bɛhwɛ wɔn afunu nnansa ne fa, na wɔremma kwan mma wonsie wɔn.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Asase so nnipa ani begye sɛ saa nnipa baanu no awuwu. Wobegye wɔn ani na wɔamema wɔn ho wɔn ho akyɛde, efisɛ saa adiyifo baanu no na wɔde ɔhaw bɛtoo asase sofo so.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Nnansa akyi no, honhom a efi Onyankopɔn bewura wɔn mu na wɔasɔre. Na ehu kɛse bɛka obiara a obehu.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Afei nne a ano yɛ den fi ɔsoro bɛka se, “Mommra ɔsoro ha.” Na bere a wɔn atamfo rehwɛ wɔn no, wɔfaa omununkum mu kɔɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Saa bere koro no ara mu na asase wosow denneennen, kurow no nkyɛmu du mu baako sɛee, na nnipa mpem ason wuwuu wɔ asasewosow no mu. Nnipa a wɔaka no bɔɔ hu na wɔkamfoo Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ ɔsoro no kɛseyɛ.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Ɔhaw a ɛto so abien no atwa, nanso hwɛ, ɛrenkyɛ na ɔhaw a ɛto so abiɛsa aba. Torobɛnto A Ɛto So Ason

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo a ɔto so ason no hyɛn ne torobɛnto, na nne dennen fi ɔsoro kae se, “Tumi a wɔde di wiase so mprempren no yɛ yɛn Awurade ne ne Kristo no de, na obedi hene daa daa.”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: kae se, “Yɛda wo ase, Otumfo Onyankopɔn, wo a wowɔ hɔ na wowɔ hɔ dedaw, wonam wo tumi kɛse so afi ase redi hene!

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Aman bo fuwii, na wʼabufuwhyew no aba. Bere aso sɛ wobu awufo atɛn. Bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wobɔ wo nkoa, adiyifo ne wo nkurɔfo nyinaa a wosuro wo, akɛse ne nketewa no aba so no adu. Bere adu sɛ wosɛe wɔn a wɔsɛee asase no!”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn asɔredan a ɛwɔ ɔsoro no bue ma wohuu adaka a apam no wɔ mu no wɔ asɔredan no mu. Afei anyinam ne aprannaa paapaee, na asase wosowee na mparuwbo bebree nso tɔe.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Na ɔyem a ɔrebɛwo, na awoyaw nti na ɔresu.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Nsɛnkyerɛnne kɛse foforo bi daa ne ho adi wɔ ɔsoro: Ɔwɔ kɔkɔɔ kakraka bi a ne ti yɛ ason na ɔwɔ mmɛn du a ahenkyɛw hyehyɛ biara so.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne dua twee nsoromma a ɛwɔ ɔsoro no mu nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako tow wɔn guu fam. Ogyinaa ɔbea a ɔrewo no anim, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔwo ɔba no to hɔ ara pɛ, ɔbɛfa abofra no awe.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbea no woo abarimaa a ɔde nsa a ɛyɛ den bedi aman nyinaa so. Nanso wohwim abofra no kɔɔ Onyankopɔn ne nʼahengua ho.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Ɔbea no guan kɔɔ sare so baabi a Onyankopɔn asiesie ama no a wɔbɛhwɛ no yiye wɔ nnafua mpem ahannu aduosia mu.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Afei ɔko sii ɔsoro hɔ. Mikael ne nʼabɔfo ko tiaa ɔwɔ no, na ɔno nso ne nʼabɔfo ko tiae.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Nanso wodii ɔwɔ no so nkonim na wɔamma ɔne nʼabɔfo antena ɔsoro bio.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Wɔtow ɔwɔ kakraka no kyenee. Ɔno ne ɔwɔ dedaw no a wɔfrɛ no ɔbonsam a ɔdaadaa wiase nyinaa no. Wɔtow ɔno ne nʼabɔfo nyinaa guu asase so.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Afei metee nne dennen bi wɔ ɔsoro a ɛka se, “Afei na Onyankopɔn nkwagye aba! Afei na Onyankopɔn akyerɛ ne tumi sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔhene! Afei na nʼAgyenkwa no akyerɛ ne tumi, efisɛ yɛn nuanom no ahohorabɔni a ogyinaa Onyankopɔn anim bɔɔ wɔn ahohora awia ne anadwo no, wɔapam no afi ɔsoro.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Yɛn nuanom no nam Oguamma no mogya so ne nokware a ɔdaa no adi no so dii ne so nkonim. Na wɔasiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔde wɔn nkwa bɛto hɔ na wɔawuwu.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Enti mo ɔsoro ne mo a motete hɔ no, momma mo ani nnye. Afei asase ne po nnue! Efisɛ ɔbonsam no atoa mo na ne bo afuw efisɛ onim sɛ, ne bere a aka sua.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Bere a ɔwɔ no huu sɛ wɔatow no akyene asase so no, ɔtaa ɔbea a wawo abarimaa no.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa ɔbea no ɔkɔre ntaban akɛse abien, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obetumi atu akɔ faako a wɔasiesie ama no wɔ sare so hɔ a wɔbɛhwɛ no mfe abiɛsa ne fa sɛnea ɔwɔ no renni nʼakyi bio.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Afei ɔwɔ no puw nsu te sɛ asubɔnten dii ɔbea no akyi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, ɛbɛfa no.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Nanso asase boaa ɔbea no. Ebuee nʼanom nom nsu a ɔwɔ no puw guu hɔ no nyinaa.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ no bo fuw ɔbea no, enti ɔkɔ de ntɔkwaw kɔkaa ɔbea no asefo a wɔaka a ɛyɛ wɔn a wodi Onyankopɔn mmara so na wogye nokware a Yesu ada no adi no di no.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Na ɔwɔ no kogyinaa mpoano hɔ.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu sɛ aboa bi apue fi po no mu reba. Na ɔwɔ mmɛn du ne ti ason a na ahenkyɛw hyehyɛ mmɛn no biara so na din a egu Onyankopɔn ho fi bobɔ ti no ho.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Aboa a mihuu no no, na ɔte sɛ ɔsebɔ a ne nan te sɛ sisi, na nʼano nso te sɛ gyata. Ɔwɔ no de ɔno ankasa ahoɔden ne nʼahengua ne ne tumi nyinaa maa aboa no.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Mihuu sɛ na opirakuru kɛse bi aba ne ti baako ho a kuru no ayɛ sɛ nea awu. Aboa no ho yɛɛ wiasefo nyinaa nwonwa, enti wotu dii nʼakyi.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Nnipa nyinaa som ɔwɔ no efisɛ ɔde ne tumi nyinaa ama aboa no. Wɔsom aboa no nso kae se, “Hena na ɔte sɛ aboa no? Na hena na obetumi ne no ako?”

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Wɔmaa aboa no kwan ma ɔkaa abususɛm akɛseakɛse tiaa Onyankopɔn, na wɔmaa no tumi sɛ ɔnyɛ nea ɔpɛ biara asram aduanan abien.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Ofii ase domee Onyankopɔn, ne din, baabi a ɔte ne wɔn a wɔte ɔsoro nyinaa.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa no kwan ma ɔne Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo koe sɛ obedi wɔn so. Na wɔmaa no aman ne mmusuakuw ne nkurɔfo ne ɔkasa nyinaa so tumi.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Nnipa a wɔte asase so nyinaa bɛsom no: obiara a wɔankyerɛw ne din anhyɛ ateasefo nhoma a ɛwɔ Oguamma a wokum no ansa na wɔrebɔ wiase no mu.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: “Tie, wo a wowɔ aso, betie no.

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: “Obiara a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyere no no, wɔbɛkyere no. Obiara a ɛsɛ sɛ wokum no afoa ano no, wobekum no.” Eyi mu boasetɔ ne gyidi ho hia Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo.

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu aboa foforo a ɔrepue afi asase mu. Na ɔwɔ mmɛn abien te sɛ nguantenmma, nanso na ɔkasa te sɛ ɔwɔ no.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Osii aboa a odi kan no anan mu de ne tumi kɛse no dii dwuma, na ɔhyɛɛ asase ne so nnipa sɛ wɔnsom nea nʼapirakuru no awu no.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Aboa a ɔto so abien yi yɛɛ anwonwade akɛse bebree. Ɔmaa ogya fii soro baa asase so wɔ nnipa nyinaa anim.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Na ɔnam anwonwade a wɔmaa no ho kwan yɛe wɔ aboa a odi kan no anim no so daadaa nnipa a wɔte asase so nyinaa. Aboa no ka kyerɛɛ wiase nnipa nyinaa se, wonsi ohoni mfa nhyɛ aboa a wɔde afoa piraa no nanso nʼapirakuru no awu na ɔte ase no anuonyam.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa aboa a ɔto so abien no kwan ma ɔhomee nkwa guu aboa a odi kan honi no mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ohoni no betumi akasa, na wakum obiara a ɔnsom no no.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Aboa no hyɛɛ nnipa nyinaa, nketewa ne akɛse; adefo ne ahiafo, nkoa ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho sɛ wɔnhyɛ wɔn nsa nifa ho ne wɔn moma so agyirae.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Obiara nni ho kwan sɛ ɔtɔ anaa ɔtɔn, gye sɛ wɔde aboa no din anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne a egyina hɔ ma din no hyɛ ne ho agyirae.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Eyi hia ma nyansa. Obiara a onim nyansa no betumi ahu nsɛnkyerɛnne a egyina hɔ ma aboa no ase, efisɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne no gyina hɔ ma onipa din. Ne nsɛnkyerɛnne yɛ ahansia aduosia asia.

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Na metee nne bi fii ɔsoro a na ɛworo so te sɛ asuworoe a ano yɛ den, na ɛte sɛ aprannaa. Nne a metee no te sɛ dwom a sankubɔfo bi rebɔ wɔ ne sanku so.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Wɔtoo dwom foforo bi wɔ ahengua no ne ateasefo baanan no ne mpanyimfo no anim. Nnipa mpem ɔha aduanan anan a wɔagye wɔn afi asase so no nko ara na wotumi suae.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ mmarima bi a wɔamfa mmea angu wɔn ho fi, na wɔyɛ mmabun. Baabiara a Oguamma no bɛkɔ no na wodi nʼakyi. Wɔagye wɔn nkwa afi nnipa mu na wɔne nnipa a wodi kan a wɔde wɔn ama Onyankopɔn ne Oguamma no.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Wɔnka atosɛm, na mfomso nni wɔn ho. Abɔfo Baasa No

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu ɔbɔfo foforo sɛ watu nam sorosoro a ɔrekɔka asɛmpa a entwa mu da no akyerɛ asase so nnipa a aman ne mmusuakuw ne ɔkasa ne nkurɔfo nyinaa ka ho.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Ɔteɛɛ mu se, “Munsuro Onyankopɔn na monkamfo ne kɛseyɛ. Efisɛ bere no adu sɛ obu adesamma atɛn. Monsom nea ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro, asase, po ne asuti no!”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a ɔto so abien dii nea odi kan no akyi kae se. “Wahwe ase! Babilonia kɛse ahwe ase! Efisɛ wama amanaman nyinaa anom nʼaguamammɔ nsa no bi.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a ɔto so abiɛsa a odi baanu a wodi kan no akyi no teɛɛ mu kae se, “Obiara a ɔsom aboa no ne ne sɛso honi a na ɔma wɔhyɛ ne nsa ho anaa ne moma so agyirae

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: no ankasa bɛnom Onyankopɔn nsa, nʼabufuw nsa a ɔde nʼahoɔden nyinaa ahwie agu nʼabufuw kuruwa mu no. Wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔbɛyɛ saa no nyinaa ahoyeraw wɔ ogya ne sufre mu wɔ abɔfo ne Oguamma no anim.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Na ogya no wusiw a ɛhyɛ wɔn ahoyeraw no kɔ soro daa daa. Awia ne anadwo, ahomegye nni hɔ ma wɔn a wɔsom aboa no ne ne sɛso honi ne obiara a wɔde ne din ahyɛ no agyirae no.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Eyi nti na ɛsɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo ne wɔn a wodi Onyankopɔn mmara so, na wogye Yesu di no nya boasetɔ no.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Afei metee nne bi fii ɔsoro a ɛkae se, “Kyerɛw eyi. Nhyira ne awufo a wowu wɔ Awurade mu fi mprempren rekɔ yi.” Honhom no se, “Yiw, wɔbɛhome afi wɔn brɛ no mu; na wɔn nnwuma di wɔn akyi.”

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Mihuu omununkum fitaa bi na obi a ɔte sɛ Onipa Ba a sikakɔkɔɔ ahenkyɛw hyɛ no na okura kantankrankyi nnamnam bi wɔ ne nsam.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo foforo bi a ofii asɔredan no mu puei, na ɔteɛɛ mu kyerɛɛ nea ɔte omununkum no so no se, “Fa wo kantankrankyi no twa, efisɛ otwabere no adu, asase no asow aba a ɛsɛ sɛ wotwa!”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Enti nea ɔte omununkum so no hwim ne kantankrankyi wɔ asase so ma etwaa asase so nnɔbae.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu sɛ ɔbɔfo foforo bi a ofi ɔsoro asɔredan no mu apue a ɔno nso kura kantankrankyi nnamnam bi.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo foforo bi a ɔno nso hwɛ ogya no so no fi afɔremuka no mu puei. Ɔteɛɛ mu kyerɛɛ ɔbɔfo a okura kantankrankyi nnamnam no se, “Fa wo kantankrankyi nnamnam no na boaboa asase so bobe akuwakuw no ano, efisɛ nʼaba no abere.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Enti ɔbɔfo no hwim ne kantankrankyi no wɔ asase so de twitwaa bobe aba no na ɔde koguu Onyankopɔn abufuw nsakyiamoa kɛse no mu.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Wotiatiaa bobe no so wɔ nsakyiamoa a ɛwɔ kuropɔn no mfikyiri, na mogya fii bobe no mu sen sɛ asubɔnten, akwansin ahannu na mu dɔ nso bɛyɛ anammɔn anum.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Mihuu ade foforo bi a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwonwa wɔ ɔsoro. Na wɔyɛ abɔfo baason a wokura ɔhaw ason a ɛno ne ɔhaw a etwa to, efisɛ ɛno na ɛkyerɛ Onyankopɔn abufuw a etwa to no.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Afei mihuu biribi te sɛ ahwehwɛ po a wɔde ogya afra redɛw. Afei mihuu wɔn a wɔadi aboa no ne ne sɛso honi ne nea wɔde agyirae asi ne din anan mu no so nkonim. Na wogyinagyina ahwehwɛ po no ho a wokurakura asanku a Onyankopɔn de ama wɔn no.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Na wɔreto Onyankopɔn akoa Mose ne Oguamma no dwom se, “Awurade, Otumfo Nyankopɔn, wo nnwuma yɛ akɛse na ɛyɛ nwonwa Amansan hene, wʼakwan teɛ na ɛyɛ nokware.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Hena na ɔrensuro wo, Awurade? Hena na ɔrenka wo kɛseyɛ? Wo nko na woyɛ kronkron. Aman nyinaa bɛba abɛsom wɔ wʼanim, efisɛ obiara ahu wo nnwuma trenee no.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Eyi akyi no, mihuu sɛ asɔredan a ɛwɔ ɔsoro hɔ Kronkron mu Kronkron no abue a adanse ntamadan si mu.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Abɔfo baason a wɔmaa wɔn tumi sɛ wɔmfa ɔhaw ason mmra no pue fii asɔredan no mu a wɔhyehyɛ ntade fitafitaa a wɔbobɔ sikakɔkɔɔ abɔso wɔ wɔn koko so.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Afei ateasefo baanan no mu baako maa abɔfo baason no sikakɔkɔɔ nkuruwa ason a Onyankopɔn a ɔte ase daa daa no abufuw ahyɛ no ma.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Wusiw a efi Onyankopɔn anuonyam ne ne tumi mu no hyɛɛ asɔredan no ma. Na obiara antumi ankɔ asɔredan no mu kosii sɛ ɔhaw ason a abɔfo baason no de bae no to twae.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Afei metee nne bi sɛ ɛrekasa fi asɔredan mu hɔ kyerɛ abɔfo no se, “Monkohwie Onyankopɔn abufuw ason a ɛwɔ nkuruwa ason no mu no ngu asase so.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a odi kan no kohwiee ne kuruwa mu abufuw no guu asase so. Akuru a ɛyɛ hu na ɛyɛ yaw tutuu wɔn a wɔde aboa no ahyɛ wɔn ho agyirae no ne wɔn a wɔsom ne sɛso honi no nso.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a ɔto so abien no hwiee ne kuruwa mu abufuw guu po mu. Nsu no dan sɛ owufo mogya, na abɔde biara a nkwa wɔ mu wɔ po no mu no wui.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a ɔto so abiɛsa no hwiee ne kuruwa mu abufuw no guu nsubɔnten ne nsuwa mu maa ne nyinaa dan mogya.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Metee sɛ ɔbɔfo a ɔhwɛ nsu so no reka se, “Wʼatɛn a wubu no yɛ atɛntrenee. Ɔkronkronni a wowɔ hɔ na wowɔ ha dedaw,

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: efisɛ wɔahwie mo ahotefo ne adiyifo mogya agu, woama wɔn mogya sɛ wɔnnom, sɛnea ɛfata wɔn.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Afei metee nne bi wɔ afɔremuka no so se, “Yiw, Awurade, Otumfo Nyankopɔn, atɛn a wubu nyinaa yɛ atɛntrenee!”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a ɔto so anan no hwiee ne kuruwa mu abufuw no guu owia so na wɔmaa no tumi sɛ ɔnhye nnipa.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Owia hyew no anoden maa nnipa domee Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ saa ɔhaw yi nyinaa so tumi no din. Nanso wɔansakra wɔn adwene anhyɛ Onyankopɔn anuonyam.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo a ɔto so anum no hwiee ne kuruwa mu abufuw no guu aboa no ahengua no so. Sum duruu wɔ aboa no ahemman mu, na esiane ɔyaw nti, nnipa wee wɔn tɛkrɛma;

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: na esiane saa ɔyaw no ne akuru a etutuu wɔn no nti, wɔdomee ɔsoro Nyankopɔn. Nanso wɔantwe wɔn ho amfi wɔn bɔne ho.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a ɔto so asia no hwiee ne kuruwa mu abufuw no guu Asubɔnten Eufrate mu. Asu no yow dan ɔkwan maa ahemfo a wofi apuei no.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu ahonhommɔne abiɛsa bi a na wɔte sɛ mpɔtorɔ a na wofifi ɔwɔ no ne aboa no ne atoro diyifo no anom.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ ahonhommɔne a wɔyɛ anwonwade. Saa ahonhom abiɛsa yi kɔ ahene a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa nkyɛn kɔka wɔn nyinaa boa ano ma Otumfo Nyankopɔn ɔko da kɛse no.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: “Muntie! Mereba te sɛ ɔkorɔmfo. Nhyira ne nea ɔwɛn na ɔhwɛ ne ntade so, sɛnea ɔrennantew adagyaw ngu ne ho anim ase wɔ bagua mu!”

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Ahonhom no boaa ahene no ano wɔ baabi a Hebri kasa mu no wɔfrɛ hɔ Armagedon.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo a ɔto so ason no hwiee ne kuruwa no mu abufuw guu mframa mu. Nne dennen bi fi ahengua a ɛwɔ asɔredan no mu no so kae se, “Wɔawie.”

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Kurow kɛse no mu paee abiɛsa, na aman nyinaa nkurow akɛse sɛesɛee. Onyankopɔn kaee Babilonia Kokuroko no, na ɔmaa no nsa nomee; nsa a ɛyɛ nʼabufuw a ano yɛ den no fi ne kuruwa ano.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Asupɔw ne mmepɔw nyinaa yerae.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Abɔfo baason no mu ɔbaako a okura nkuruwa ason no baa me nkyɛn bɛkae se, “Bra na menkyerɛ wo ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so atwe oguamanfo kɛse a ɔte nsu pii so no aso.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Wiase ahene ne no bɔɔ aguaman, na asase so nnipa bobow wɔ nʼaguaman nsa no mu.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Honhom no faa me ma ɔbɔfo no de me kɔɔ sare so. Ɛhɔ na mihuu sɛ ɔbea bi te aboa kɔkɔɔ bi a wɔakyerɛw din a ɛyɛ abususɛm agu ne ho nyinaa. Na aboa no wɔ ti ason, ne mmɛn du.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Na ɔbea no hyɛ atadetam kɔkɔɔ a ɔde sika mpɔw a ɛhyerɛn ne nhene a ne bo yɛ den ahyehyɛ ne ho. Na okura sika kuruwa a afide ne aguamammɔ ho nneɛma ayɛ no ma tɔ.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Na wɔakyerɛw din bi wɔ ne moma so a ne nkyerɛase no wɔ ahintasɛm mu se, “Babilonia Kokuroko, Asase So Nguamanfo Ne Akyiwade Na.”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Na mihuu sɛ Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo ne Yesu akyidifo a wokum wɔn no mogya abow no. Mihuu no no, ɛyɛɛ me nwonwa.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo no bisaa me se, “Adɛn nti na ɛyɛ wo nwonwa? Mɛkyerɛ wo ahintasɛm nkyerɛase a ɛwɔ ɔbea no ne aboa no a ɔwɔ ti ason ne mmɛn du a ɔte ne so no.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Aboa a wuhuu no no na ɔte ase, nanso ɔnte ase bio. Ɔrebefi bun no mu aba ama wɔasɛe no. Sɛ nnipa a wɔte asase so a wɔankyerɛw wɔn din angu ateasefo nhoma no mu ansa na wɔrebɔ wiase no hu aboa no a, ɛbɛyɛ wɔn nwonwa. Na ɔte ase bere bi, nanso mprempren de, ɔnte ase na ɔbɛsan aba.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: “Nyansa ne ntease ho hia wɔ ha. Eti ason no gyina hɔ ma mmepɔw ason, mmepɔw a ɔbea no tena so. Wɔyɛ ahene baason nso

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: a wɔn mu baanum awuwu, na ɔbaako da so di hene na ɔbaako a ɔka ho no mmae. Na sɛ ɔba a obedi hene kakra.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Aboa no a anka na ɔte ase na afei de, ɔnte ase no yɛ ɔhene a ɔto so awotwe a ɔka baason a wodi kan no ho a ɔrekɔ ne sɛe mu.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: “Mmɛn du a wuhui no yɛ ahene du a womfii wɔn ahenni ase a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi na wɔne aboa no adi hene dɔnhwerew no.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Wɔn nyinaa wɔ botae baako, na wɔde wɔn ahoɔden ne wɔn tumi bɛma aboa no.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛko atia Oguamma no, na ɔno ne nʼakyidifo, agyidifo ne nokwafo a wɔafrɛ wɔn no bedi wɔn so, efisɛ ɔyɛ awuranom mu Awurade ne ahene mu Hene.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo no nso ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Nsu a wuhuu sɛ oguamanfo no te so no yɛ nkurow ne nkurɔfo akuwakuw ne aman ne ɔkasa ahorow.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Mmɛn du ne aboa a wuhuu no no bekyi oguamanfo no. Wɔbɛfa biribiara a ɛwɔ ne ho ama wada adagyaw. Wɔbɛwe ne nam na wɔde ogya ahyew no.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Efisɛ Onyankopɔn de ahyɛ wɔn koma mu se wɔbɛpene so de wɔn tumi ama aboa no na wadi hene kosi sɛ Onyankopɔn asɛm no bɛba mu de ahyɛ ne botae no ma.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔbea a wuhuu no no yɛ kurow kɛse a edi asase so ahene no so.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Eyi akyi no, mihuu ɔbɔfo foforo sɛ ofi ɔsoro reba fam. Na ɔwɔ tumi kɛse na nʼanuonyam hyerɛn wɔ asase so nyinaa.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Ɔteɛɛ mu denneennen se, “ ‘Wahwe ase! Babilonia Kokuroko ahwe ase!’ Adan ahonhommɔne tenabea ne ahonhom fi nyinaa ahintawee. Nnomaafi a wokyi wɔn nyinaa te ne mu.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Ɔde ne nsa a ɛyɛ nʼaguamammɔ a ano yɛ den no maa nnipa nyinaa nomee. Asase so ahene ne no bɔɔ aguaman, na asase so adwumayɛfo nam nʼahonya mmoroso so nyaa wɔn ho.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Afei metee sɛ nne foforo bi a efi ɔsoro reka se, “Mumfi, me nkurɔfo, na moamfa mo ho amfra bɔne a ɔyɛ no mu, na mo ne no ankyɛ nʼasotwe!

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Efisɛ wɔahyehyɛ ne bɔne sɛ soro tenten, na Onyankopɔn akae nʼawudi no.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Sɛnea ɔyɛɛ mo no, monyɛ no saa pɛpɛɛpɛ; nea ɔyɛɛ mo biara no, muntua ne so ka mprenu. Nsa a ɔde maa mo no, monhyɛ no nea ano yɛ den mmɔho abien.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Momma nʼayayade ne nʼawerɛhow nnɔɔso sɛ anuonyam ne ahonya a ɔpɛ maa ne ho no. Efisɛ daa ɔka se, ‘Mete ha sɛ ɔhemmea; menyɛ okunafo, na me werɛ renhow da!’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Eyi nti, nʼamanehunu a ɛyɛ ɔyare, awerɛhow ne ɔkɔm bɛba ne so da bi. Na wɔde ogya ahyew no, efisɛ Awurade Nyankopɔn a obu no atɛn no yɛ ɔkɛse.

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: “Sɛ asase so ahene a wɔne no bɔɔ aguaman, dii dɛ no hu hye a wɔrehyew no no wusiw a, wobesu atwa agyaadwo.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Nʼamanehunu no hu a ɛyɛ nti, wobegyina akyiri asu se, “ ‘Due! Due, Ao, kuropɔn, Ao Babilonia, kuropɔn a ɛwɔ tumi! Wʼatemmu aba dɔnhwerew baako pɛ mu.’

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: “Aguadifo a wɔwɔ asase so nso su no, efisɛ obiara ntɔ wɔn nneɛma bio.

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: Obiara ntɔ sikakɔkɔɔ ne dwetɛ, aboɔden abo ne nhene pa, nwera pa ne ɔtamkɔkɔɔ ne sirikyi ne tamkɔkɔɔ, ne nnua a ɛyɛ huam nyinaa ne asonse adwinne nyinaa, adwinne a wɔde nnua a ne bo yɛ den ayɛ, asanka ne dade ne abohemaa,

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: ne pɛprɛ ne mmorɔngo, nnuhuam ne kurobow, huamfufu ne nsa ne ngo, asikresiam muhumuhu ne awi, nyɛmmoa ne nguan ne apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne nkoa ne nnipa akra.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: “Aguadifo no bɛka se, ‘Nneɛma pa a wopere hwehwɛe no nyinaa ayera, na wʼahonya ne wʼanuonyam no kɔ, na wo nsa renka bio.’

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Aguadifo a wonyaa wɔn ho wɔ kurow no mu no begyina akyirikyiri efisɛ wosuro amane a ɔrehu no. Wobesu na wɔatwa agyaadwo,

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: na wɔaka se: “ ‘Due! Due, Ao, kuropɔn a ofura nwera pa ne tamkɔkɔɔ na sika ne aboɔdenmmo a nhene pa bobɔ mu.

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Dɔnhwerew pɛ, na saa ahonya dodow yi asɛe.’ “Hyɛn mu sahene ne hyɛn no mu nnipa, mu adwumayɛfo ne wɔn a wɔka ho a wonya wɔn anoduan fi hyɛn adwumayɛ mu no nyinaa gyinaa akyirikyiri.

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: Wosui wɔ bere a wohuu ogya a ɛrehyew no wusiw no, wɔteɛɛ mu kae se ‘Kuropɔn biara a ne kɛse te sɛɛ mmaa da.’ ”

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛtow mfutuma agu wɔn atifi na wɔasu, atwa agyaadwo se, “ ‘Due! Due, wo kuropɔn, wo a wɔn a wɔwɔ ahyɛn wɔ wo mu no nam wʼahonya so yɛɛ adefo. Na dɔnhwerew baako pɛ mu, woahwere biribiara!’

english_verse: The heavens should be happy with God's people and apostles and prophets. God has punished her for them.”
translation_verse: “Momma mo ani nnye wɔ ne ho, mo ɔsorofo! Momma mo ani nnye, Onyankopɔn nnipa! Momma mo ani nnye, asomafo ne adiyifo! Efisɛ Onyankopɔn abu no atɛn.”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔbɔfo hoɔdenfo bi faa ɔbo a ne kɛse bɛyɛ sɛ awiyammo tow kyenee po mu kae se, “Saa ahoɔden yi ara na wɔde bɛtow Babilonia kuropɔn no akyene, a wɔrenhu no bio.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Wɔrente sankubɔfo ne nnwontofo, atɛntɛbɛnhyɛnfo ne torobɛntohyɛnfo nka wɔ mu bio. Wɔrenhu odwumfo biara wɔ wo mu bio. Na wɔrente owiyamfo biara nka wɔ wo mu bio.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Kanea hann renhyerɛn wɔ wo mu bio. Wɔrente ayeforokunu ne ayeforo nne wɔ wo mu bio. Wʼaguadifo yɛ wiase mu nnipa atitiriw. Na wɔde wo ntafowayi adaadaa aman nyinaa.

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Ne mu na wohuu adiyifo ne ahotefo ne wɔn a wokum wɔn wɔ asase so no nyinaa mogya.”

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Eyi akyi no, metee nne bi te sɛ nnipakuw a wɔwɔ ɔsoro teɛ mu se, “Haleluya! Nkwagye ne anuonyam ne tumi wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn,

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: efisɛ nʼatemmu yɛ nokware, na eye sɛ obuu oguamanfo kɛse a ɔde nʼaguamammɔ asɛe asase no atɛn. Onyankopɔn atwe nʼaso, efisɛ okum nʼasomfo.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Na afei wɔteɛɛ mu bio se, “Haleluya! Wusiw befi kurow no mu akɔ ɔsoro daa daa.”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Afei nne bi fi ahengua no so bae se, “Monkamfo yɛn Nyankopɔn, mo a moyɛ nʼasomfo nyinaa, mo a musuro no, akɛse ne nkumaa!”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Afei metee nne bi te sɛ nnipadɔm a ɛte sɛ asuworo ne aprannaa a ɛrepaapae a ɛteɛ mu se, “Haleluya! Yɛn Tumfo Awurade Nyankopɔn di hene.

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Momma yɛn ho nsɛpɛw yɛn na yɛn ani nnye na yɛnhyɛ no anuonyam efisɛ Oguamma no ayeforohyia adu a nʼayeforokunu asiesie ne ho.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: Wɔde nwera pa a ani hyerɛn na ani tew maa no sɛ ɔnhyɛ.”

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɔfo no ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Kyerɛw sɛ, Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn wɔ Oguamma no ayeforohyia anwummere aponto ase.” Ɔka kaa ho se, “Eyi yɛ Onyankopɔn asɛm turodoo.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Mibutuw ne nan ase pɛɛ sɛ mesom no. Nanso ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Nyɛ saa, efisɛ meyɛ ɔsomfo te sɛ wo ne wo nuanom a wodi Yesu ho adanse no. Som Onyankopɔn efisɛ nokware a Yesu daa no adi no na ɛhyɛ adiyifo no nkuran.” Ahene Mu Hene

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu sɛ ɔsoro abue a ɔpɔnkɔ fitaa wɔ hɔ. Na nea ɔte ne so no din de “Ɔseadeɛyɛ ne Ɔnokwafo.” Nokware na ogyina so bu atɛn na ɔko ne ko.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: Nʼaniwa te sɛ ogya a ɛredɛw na ɔhyɛ ahenkyɛw bebree. Na ɔwɔ din bi a wɔakyerɛw agu ne ho, nanso na obiara nnim din no nkyerɛase ka ne ho.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhyɛ atade bi a wɔde anu mogya mu. Na ne din ne “Onyankopɔn Asɛm”

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Ɔsoro asraafo a wɔhyehyɛ nwera fitaa a ani tew a wɔtete apɔnkɔ fitafitaa so dii nʼakyi.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Afoa a ano yɛ nnam yiye a ɔde bedi aman so no fii nʼanom bae. Dade pema na ɔde bedi wɔn so. Sɛnea wotiatia bobe a ɛwɔ nsakyiamoa mu no so no, saa ara na obetiatia nnipa no so de akyerɛ Onyankopɔn Tumfo no abufuw.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Na wɔakyerɛw din agu nʼatade mu ne ne srɛ ho se, Ahene mu Hene ne Awuranom mu Awurade.

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Afei, mihuu ɔbɔfo bi a ogyina owia mu. Ɔteɛɛ mu guu nnomaa a wɔnam wim nyinaa so se, “Mommra mmehyia mu wɔ Onyankopɔn aponto kɛse no ase.

english_verse: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Mummedi ahemfo nam ne asafohene nam ne atumfo nam ne apɔnkɔ ne wɔn sotefo nam ne adehye ne nkoa ne akɛse ne nketewa nyinaa nam.”

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu aboa no ne asase so ahene ne wɔn asraafo a wɔaboa wɔn ho ano rekɔko atia nea ɔte ɔpɔnkɔ no so no ne ne dɔm.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Wɔkyeree aboa no ne nʼatoro adiyifo a ɔyɛɛ anwonwade maa no no. Saa anwonwade no so na ɔnam daadaa wɔn a wɔde aboa no ahyɛ wɔn agyirae ne wɔn a wɔsom aboa no honi no. Wɔtow aboa no ne atoro adiyifo no anikann guu ogya ɔtare a sufre na na ɛredɛw wɔ mu no mu.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Wɔde afoa a efi ɔpɔnkɔkafo no anom kunkum wɔn asraafo, na nnomaa no dii wɔn nam sɛnea wobetumi.

english_verse: Then the angel threw the dragon into the pit. He locked and sealed it, so
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo no tow no kyenee bun no mu, too mu safe sɔw ano sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mfe apem no betwa mu. Ɛno akyi na wobegyaa no kakra.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Afei mihuu nhengua ne wɔn a wɔtete so a wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wommu atɛn. Afei mihuu wɔn a esiane sɛ wɔada nokware ne Onyankopɔn asɛm a Yesu kae no adi nti, wɔatwitwa wɔn ti no akra. Wɔansom aboa no ne ne honi no. Saa ara nso na wɔamfa aboa no agyiraehyɛde ankeka wɔn moma so ne wɔn nsa ho. Wɔbaa nkwa mu ne Kristo bedii ahene mfe apem.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Nhyira bebree nka wɔn a wodii kan nyan wɔn fii awufo mu no. Owu a ɛto so abien no nni wɔn so tumi. Wɔbɛyɛ Onyankopɔn ne Kristo asɔfo. Na wɔne no bedi ahene mfe apem.

english_verse: At the end of the
translation_verse: Mfe apem no akyi na wobeyi ɔbonsam afi afiase hɔ;

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: na ɔbɛkɔ akɔdaadaa aman a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa a ɛyɛ Gog ne Magog. Ɔbonsam bɛboaboa wɔn a wɔn dodow bɛyɛ sɛ mpoano nwea ano de wɔn akɔ ɔko.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Wotuu sa kɔɔ asase so nyinaa kotwaa Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo atenae a ɛyɛ ɔman a ɔdɔ no no ho hyiae. Nanso ogya fi ɔsoro bɛsɛee wɔn.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Na wɔtow ɔbonsam a ɔdaadaa wɔn no nso too ogya tare ne sufre a wɔde aboa no ne atoro odiyifo no agu mu no mu. Na wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayade awia ne anadwo daa daa. Atemmu A Etwa To

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu ahengua fitaa kɛse bi ne nea ɔte so no. Asase ne ɔsoro guanee wɔ nʼanim, na wɔanhu wɔn bio.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Na mihuu awufo akɛse ne nketewa sɛ wogyinagyina ahengua no anim. Wobuebuee nhoma bebree mu, na wobuee nhoma foforo bi a ɛyɛ ateasefo nhoma no mu. Wobuu awufo no atɛn, sɛnea wɔn nnwuma te ne sɛnea wɔakyerɛw wɔ nhoma ahorow no mu no.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Afei po nso dannan nʼawufo mae. Owu ne asaman nso de wɔn awufo mae. Na wobuu wɔn nyinaa atɛn sɛnea wɔn nnwuma te.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Na wɔtow owu ne asaman guu ogya tare no mu. Saa ogya tare yi ne owuprenu no.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Na wɔtow obiara a wɔankyerɛw ne din angu nkwa nhoma no mu no kyenee ogya tare no mu.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Afei mihuu ɔsoro foforo ne asase foforo, na kan ɔsoro ne kan asase no atwa mu, na po nso nni hɔ bio.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Metee nne dennen bi fi ahengua no so se, “Afei, Onyankopɔn atenae wɔ nnipa mu. Ɔne wɔn bɛtena na wɔayɛ ne nkurɔfo. Onyankopɔn no ankasa ne wɔn bɛtena na wayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: Na ɔbɛpepa wɔn aniwa mu nusu nyinaa. Na owu nni hɔ bio, na awerɛhow ne osu ne yaw nni hɔ bio. Na kan nneɛma no atwa mu.”

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Afei nea ɔte ahengua no so no kae se, “Afei mereyɛ nneɛma nyinaa foforo!” Ɔka kyerɛɛ me nso se, “Kyerɛw eyi, efisɛ saa nsɛm yi yɛ nokware a wɔde wɔn ho to so.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Wɔawie! Me ne Alfa ne Omega, Mfiase ne Awiei no. Obiara a osukɔm de no no, mɛma no nsu a efi nkwa asuti mu anom kwa.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Obiara a obedi nkonim no benya eyi afi me nkyɛn. Mɛyɛ ne Nyankopɔn na ɔno nso ayɛ me ba.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nanso ahufo ne wɔn a wonnye nni ne akyiwadeyɛfo ne awudifo ne nguamanfo ne asumanfo ne abosonsomfo ne atorofo nyinaa benya wɔn kyɛfa wɔ ɔtare a ogya ne sufre dɛw wɔ mu no mu. Ɛno ne owuprenu no.” Yerusalem Foforo No

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Abɔfo baason a wokurakura nkuruwa ason a ɔhaw ason a etwa to no ahyɛ ma wɔ mu baako baa me nkyɛn bɛkae se, “Bra, na mɛkyerɛ wo Ayeforo a ɔyɛ Oguamma no yere no.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Honhom no faa me, na ɔbɔfo no de me kɔɔ bepɔw tenten bi atifi. Ɔkyerɛɛ me Yerusalem, Kurow Kronkron a efi ɔsoro, Onyankopɔn hɔ, resian aba fam.

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: Ɛhyerɛn Onyankopɔn anuonyam mu, na ne hyerɛn no te sɛ aboɔdemmo a ɛsɛ ahwehwɛbo a ani tew sɛ ahwehwɛ.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Na ne fasu no wɔ ahoɔden na ɛware yiye nso. Apon dumien gu ano a, abɔfo dumien na wɔhwɛ so. Na ɔpon biara so no wɔakyerɛw Israel mmusuakuw dumien no mu baako din.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Apon abiɛsa wɔ apuei; abiɛsa wɔ anafo; abiɛsa wɔ atifi na abiɛsa wɔ atɔe.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Wosii kurow no afasu sii abo dumien a wɔakyerɛw Oguamma no asomafo dumien no din wɔ so no so.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo a ɔkasa kyerɛɛ me no kura sikakɔkɔɔ pema susudua a wɔde besusuw kurow no, nʼapon ne nʼafasu.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Na kurow no yɛ ahinanan a ne tenten ne ne trɛw yɛ pɛ. Ɔbɔfo no de ne susudua no susuw kurow no. Na ne tenten yɛ kilomita mpem abien ne ahannan (

english_verse: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about
translation_verse: Ɔbɔfo no susuw ɔfasu no nso a na ne sorokɔ nso bɛyɛ sɛ mita aduosia.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Ahwehwɛbo na ɔde too afasu no. Na kurow no de, sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa a ɛhyerɛn te sɛ ahwehwɛ na wɔde toe.

english_verse: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald,
translation_verse: Wɔde aboɔdemmo ahorow a ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛhyehyɛɛ kurow no fapem. Fapem a edi kan yɛ ahwehwɛbo. Fapem a ɛto so abien yɛ hoabo. Fapem a ɛto so abiɛsa yɛ omununkumbo. Fapem a ɛto so anan yɛ ahabammono bo.

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: Fapem a ɛto so anum yɛ ɛtɔnbo. Fapem a ɛto so asia yɛ bogyanambo. Fapem a ɛto so ason yɛ sikabereɛbo. Fapem a ɛto so awotwe yɛ apopobibiribo. Fapem a ɛto so akron yɛ akraatebo. Fapem a ɛto so du yɛ dɛnkyɛmmo. Fapem a ɛto so dubaako yɛ wusiwbo. Fapem a ɛto so dumien yɛ beredumbo.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Na wɔde nhene pa dumien na ɛyɛɛ apon dumien no. Wɔde ahene pa baako na ɛyɛɛ apon no mu biara. Na kurow no abɔntenkɛse no yɛ sika ankasa, kurunnyenn sɛ ahwehwɛ.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
