english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Wo fam deɛ a wobɛyɛ ara ne sɛ, wobɛtie nsɛm a mɛhyɛ wo no na woayɛ ne nyinaa; na sɛ ɛba saa a, mɛpam Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Hetifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ no nyinaa afiri wʼanim.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Hwɛ wo ho so yie pa ara na wo ne ɔman a worekɔ mu no mufoɔ ampam, ɛfiri sɛ, sɛ woyɛ saa a, ɛbɛma wo nso woayɛ nnebɔne a wɔyɛ no bi.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Bubu wɔn abosonsom afɔrebukyia no. Sɛe wɔn aboɔ adum no na montutu wɔn abosom no ngu.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛdi Apiti Afahyɛ no nnanson sɛdeɛ meka kyerɛɛ wo no. Di no afe biara mu ɔbosome Abib mu. Saa bosome no mu na motu firii Misraim.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Afunumu ba a ɔyɛ abakan deɛ, wɔmfa no nsesa odwammaa. Na sɛ wompɛ sɛ wode no di nsesa deɛ a, bu ne kɔn mu. Mo mmammarima deɛ, monsesa wɔn nyinaa. “Obiara mma mʼanim a ɔnkura akyɛdeɛ bi.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: “Nnansia pɛ na momfa nyɛ adwuma. Ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no deɛ, monnni dwuma biara. Ofuntumberɛ anaa otwaberɛ mpo, momfa nna nsia nyɛ adwuma. Ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no, monhome.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Monkae na monni saa afahyɛ mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ afe mu no nyinaa. Yeinom ne: Otwaberɛ Afahyɛ , Atokoɔ a ɛdi ɛkan Afahyɛ ne Otwa Afahyɛ.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Sɛ mokɔ Awurade, mo Onyankopɔn, anim saa mprɛnsa no nyinaa afe biara mu a, obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛtoa mo abɛdi mo asase no so. Mɛpam saa aman no wɔ mo anim na matrɛ mo ahyeɛ mu.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: “Mommfa burodo a mmɔreka wɔ mu mmɔ me afɔdeɛ. Na Twam Afahyɛ ɛnam no nso, mommfa bi nsi hɔ mma adeɛ nkye so.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: “Sɛ motwa mo mfudeɛ a, momfa otwakane mu nyiyimu a ɛsɔ ani mmrɛ me; wɔde bɛma Awurade mo Onyankopɔn. “Nnoa abirekyie ba wɔ ne maame nufosuo mu.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ, “Twerɛ saa mmara a mede ama wo yi nyinaa gu hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛgyina hɔ ma me ne wo ne Israel apam.”

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Mose de twerɛ apono no fi Onyankopɔn nkyɛn resiane bepɔ no, na ɔnnim sɛ nʼanim rehyerɛn.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Esiane nʼanim hyerɛn a na ɛhyerɛn no enti, Aaron ne Israelfoɔ no hunuu Mose no, wɔsuroeɛ sɛ wɔbɛbɛn no.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Nanso, Mose frɛɛ wɔn baa ne nkyɛn maa Aaron ne ɔman no mu ntuanofoɔ ne no bɛkasaeɛ.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Akyire no, nnipa no nyinaa baa ne nkyɛn maa ɔde mmaransɛm a Awurade de maa no wɔ bepɔ no so hɔ no maa wɔn.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: na ɛberɛ biara a ɔbɛkɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan mu hɔ ne Awurade akɔkasa no, ɔyi nkatanimu no kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛsane aba bio; ɔba saa a, asɛm biara a Onyankopɔn aka akyerɛ no no, na ɔno nso aka akyerɛ nnipa no

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: a wɔhunu sɛ nʼanim ayɛ hyerɛn. Akyire no, ɔde nkatanimu no kata nʼanim bio kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Onyankopɔn nkyɛn na ɔne no akɔkasa.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Monyɛ adwuma nnansia. Na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no deɛ, momfa nhome; ɛyɛ ɛda kronkron a ɛsɛ sɛ mode som Awurade. Obiara a ɔbɛyɛ adwuma biara saa ɛda no, ɔbɛwu.

english_verse: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath. Offerings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɛda no, ogya mpo, monnsɔ bi ano wɔ mo afie mu.”

english_verse: The women who were good at weaving cloth brought the blue, purple, and red wool and the fine linen they had made.

english_verse: Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus
translation_verse: Saa aboɔdemmoɔ yi sisi asɔfotadeɛ no mmati so, na ɛyɛ nkaedeɛ de ma Awurade fa Israelfoɔ ho, na wɔyɛɛ ne nyinaa sɛdeɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ wɔnyɛ no no ara pɛ.

english_verse: The words “Dedicated to the Lord” were engraved on a narrow strip of pure gold,
translation_verse: Na afei, wɔboroo sikakɔkɔɔ amapa ma ɛyɛɛ trawa sɛ prɛte a wɔatwerɛ so: Kronkron Ma Awurade.

english_verse: The breastpiece was made with the same materials and designs as the priestly vest.
translation_verse: Adaaboɔ no, wɔpamm no te sɛ asɔfotadeɛ a wɔde nwera amapa yɛeɛ, na wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ ahoma ne asaawa tuntum, bibire ne koogyan anwene mu.

english_verse: The priestly robe was made of blue wool
translation_verse: Asɔfotadeɛ no fa kɛseɛ no ara deɛ, wɔde ntoma tuntum na ɛnwonoeɛ

english_verse: a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row;
translation_verse: Nsesasoɔ a ɛtɔ so mmienu no yɛ nsrammaboɔ, aboɔdemmoɔ ne dɛnkyɛmmoɔ.

english_verse: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row;
translation_verse: Deɛ ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no yɛ akutuhonoboɔ, mfrafraeɛboɔ ne beredumboɔ

english_verse: and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting,
translation_verse: ɛnna deɛ ɛtɔ so ɛnan no yɛ sikabereɛboɔ, apopobibirieboɔ ne ahwehwɛboɔ a emu biara wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ atwa ho ahyia.

english_verse: Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛkyekyere nhoma mmienu no ti de abobɔ sikakɔkɔɔ no a ɛbɔ asɔfotadeɛ no abatiri so no mu.

english_verse: and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash.
translation_verse: Wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ nkawa mmienu sosɔɔ asɔfotadeɛ no mmati ntaresoɔ no mu ma ɛbɛnee abɔwomu a wɔanwono no fɛfɛɛfɛ ne asɔfotadeɛ no ahyiaeɛ so.

english_verse: To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Clothes for the Priests (Exodus
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na adaaboɔ no bɛgyina pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ abɔwomu fɛfɛ no so enti, wɔde ntoma tuntum kyekyeree nkawa a ɛsosɔ adaaboɔ no ne asɔfotadeɛ no mu. Yeinom nyinaa, Awurade na ɔhyɛɛ Mose sɛ wɔnyɛ.

english_verse: which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Work Is Completed (Exodus
translation_verse: Wɔde ntoma tuntum na asina abɔnimu no abɔ abotire no mu sɛdeɛ Awurade kyerɛeɛ no.

english_verse: When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_verse: Na Mose hwɛɛ nnwuma no nyinaa hunuu sɛ biribiara ntɔ kyema wɔ ho no, ɔhyiraa wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ, sɛdeɛ Awurade kaeɛ no ara pɛ na wɔyɛeɛ.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: na wɔtwaa mfimfini tokuro pempam bi faa so maa ano no yɛɛ den sɛdeɛ wɔhyɛ a ɛrentete.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
translation_verse: Sɛ Aaron hyɛ asɔfotadeɛ yi a wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ nnɔmma ne ateaa aba agu ano a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔrekɔsom Awurade sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ Mose sɛ ɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
translation_verse: Bio, wɔde ntoma a ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛpam abɔwomu no na wɔde asaawa tuntum, bibire ne koogyan dii mu adwini sɛdeɛ Awurade kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ ɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;
translation_verse: adaka no a Mmaransɛm Edu no wɔ mu ne nnua a wɔde soa Mpata Dwa no;

english_verse: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.
translation_verse: Yei nyinaa akyi, wɔwiee Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no si sɛdeɛ Awurade kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ wɔnsi no no.

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Afei, wɔde Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ne emu nneɛma nyinaa brɛɛ Mose: Nkyerewa, nnyinasoɔ, mmeamu nnua, mpunan ne nsisisoɔ;

english_verse: the covering of tanned ram skins and fine leather; the inside curtain;
translation_verse: nnwennini nhoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ, abirekyie nhoma a wɔahyɛ, nsɛnanotam,

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: Ɛpono no ne ɛho nneɛma ne Hyiadan mu Burodo;

english_verse: the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: Sika nkaneadua ne nʼakanea, ɛho nneɛma ne ngo

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: Kɔbere afɔrebukyia, kɔbere otwidadeɛ, nnua no ne ɛho nneɛma, deɛ wɔsi mu nneɛma ne ne ntaamu;

english_verse: the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent;
translation_verse: ntwahotam a wɔde twa adihɔ hɔ ɔfasuo ho, ne ɛho nnua a ɛsosɔ mu, nnyinasodeɛ ne ntwahotam a ɛwɔ adihɔ ɛpono ano, ntampehoma ne nnadewa ne biribiara a wɔde boaa Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no sie.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: “Bosome a ɛdi ɛkan no ɛda a ɛdi ɛkan no na si Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Afei, fa ɛpono no bɛsi hɔ na fa ɛho nneɛma nyinaa gu so na fa kaneadua no bra na sɔ kanea no.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Fa sikakɔkɔɔ afɔrebukyia a wɔbɛhye aduhwam wɔ so no bɛsi Apam Adaka no anim. Fa ɛpono no nkatanimu sɛn Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ano.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: “Fa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia no si Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ɛkwan ano.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Fa atam no si Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam na hyɛ no nsuo ma.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Afei, siesie adihɔ bi twa Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ho hyia na fa nsɛnanimu no sɛn ne kwan no ano.

english_verse: Use the sacred olive oil to dedicate to me the tent and everything in it.
translation_verse: “Fa srango no na pete gu Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no so baabiara ne biribiara a ɛwɔ mu ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa ne nkonnwa so, na fa te ho.

english_verse: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment
translation_verse: Ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho nneɛma nyinaa nso, pete ɔsra ngo no bi gu so na te ho na ɛnyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Afei, fa Aaron ne ne mmammarima no bra Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ɛkwan ano na fa nsuo hohoro wɔn ho

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: na fa atadeɛ kronkron no hyɛ Aaron, na sra no ngo na ne ho nte na ɔmmɛyɛ me ɔsɔfoɔ.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Afei, fa ne mmammarima no bra na fa wɔn ntadeɛ hyehyɛ wɔn

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Enti, Mose kɔ kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade akyerɛ no no.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu bosome a ɛdi ɛkan no ɛda a ɛdi ɛkan no, wɔkekaa Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no sisii animu.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Ɔde aboɔ a wɔatwerɛ Mmaransɛm Edu no wɔ so no guu Apam Adaka no mu de nnua a wɔdebɛsoa no sosɔɔ mu. Ɔde ne nkatasoɔ a wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ ayɛ a ɛyɛ mpata nkatasoɔ no kataa so.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔde Apam Adaka no bɛsii Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu de ntwamutam no twaa mu, sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Afei, ɔde ɛpono no sii Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no atifi fam wɔ ntwamutam no akyi,

english_verse: after which the bread was set on the table.
translation_verse: de Ɔkyerɛ Burodo no too so wɔ Awurade anim sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: The lampstand was put along the south wall,
translation_verse: Ɔde kaneadua no sii ɛpono no nkyɛn wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no anafoɔ fam.

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔsɔɔ kanea no wɔ Awurade anim sɛdeɛ Awurade kyerɛɛ no no pɛpɛɛpɛ,

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: ɛnna ɔde sikakɔkɔɔ afɔrebukyia sii ntwamutam no ho pɛɛ wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu.

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Afei, wɔde ohwam hyee nnuhwam sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ɔde Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ano nsɛnanotam sɛnee ano.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: Ɔde afɔrebukyia a wɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ so no si bɛn Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan ɛkwan no ano, ɛnna ɔbɔɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Yei akyi, ɔde atam a wɔsi mu nneɛma no sii Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam na wɔhyɛɛ no nsuo ma sɛdeɛ asɔfoɔ no bɛnya bi ahohoro wɔn ho.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Mose ne Aaron ne Aaron mmammarima hohoroo wɔn nsa ho ne wɔn nan ase wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ biara a wɔbɛfa afɔrebukyia no ho akɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu no, wɔgyina hohoroo wɔn ho sɛdeɛ Awurade kyerɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance. The Glory of the Lord
translation_verse: Ɔsii biribi twaa Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ho hyiaeɛ na wɔde nsɛnanotam sɛnee ano. Enti Mose yɛɛ yei de wiee nʼadwumayɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Omununkum no bɛkataa Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no so maa Awurade animuonyam hyɛɛ no ma.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ biara a omununkum no bɛpagya ne ho atu atene no, na Israelfoɔ no nso di akyire.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛgyina a, na wɔn nso agyina kɔsi sɛ ɛbɛtu atene bio.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Awiaberɛ mu deɛ, Awurade omununkum no gyina Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no so na sɛ ɛduru anadwo a, na ogya asɔ wɔ omununkum no mu sɛdeɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa bɛhunu. Yei toaa so saa ara wɔ wɔn akwantuo no nyinaa mu.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses from the sacred tent and gave him instructions for the community of Israel to follow when they offered sacrifices. Sacrifices To Please the Lord The Lord said: Sacrifices to please me must be completely burned on the bronze altar. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices. If the animal is a bull, it must not have anything wrong with it. Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, and I will let you know if it is acceptable to me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ mo afɔrebɔdeɛ a mode rebɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no yɛ nantwie a ɔfiri mo nantwibuo mu a, momfa nantwie a ɔnnii dɛm na mommɔ saa afɔdeɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛsɔ Awurade ani. Fa aboa no kɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ɛpono ano na ɛhɔ na asɔfoɔ no bɛgye wʼayɛyɛdeɛ a wode rebrɛ Awurade no.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Afɔrebɔni no bɛkum aboa no wɔ hɔ wɔ Awurade anim. Na Aaron mmammarima asɔfoɔ no asɔ aboa no mogya de akyerɛ Awurade. Na wɔde mogya no apete afɔrebukyia a ɛsi Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan no ano no ne ɛho nyinaa.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Afei, asɔfoɔ no bɛpa aboa no ho nhoma na wɔabobɔ.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron mmammarima no bɛsɔ ogya wɔ afɔrebukyia no so.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Wɔnhohoro nʼayamdeɛ ne ne nan ho na asɔfoɔ no nhye no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so na ayɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ aboa a wɔde no rebɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no yɛ odwan anaa abirekyie a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ onini a ne ho nni dɛm biara.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔde no baeɛ no bɛkum no Awurade anim wɔ afɔrebukyia no atifi na Aaron mmammarima asɔfoɔ no apete mogya no agu afɔrebukyia no so ne ɛho nyinaa.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Wɔde nsuo bɛhohoro nʼayamdeɛ ne ne nan no ho ansa na asɔfoɔ no ahye no afɔrebukyia no so de ama Awurade; ɛfiri sɛ, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ sɔ Awurade ani.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔde anomaa bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a, ɔmfa nturukuku anaa mmorɔnoma mma.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛfa anomaa no de no akɔ afɔrebukyia no so na wate ne ti ahye no, na ne mogya no, ɔbɛsɔne agu afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛyi ne mene ase, atutu ne ntakra no na wato agu nsõ no mu wɔ afɔrebukyia no apueeɛ fam.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔbɛtwe nʼatabu mu ama emu ntini no atete asensɛn hɔ. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no ahye no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so na Awurade de anigyeɛ bɛgye saa afɔrebɔ yi.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: “ ‘Obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɔ aduane afɔdeɛ de ma Awurade no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde asikyiresiam a ɛyɛ fɛ a wahwie ngo agu so de aduhwam afra na ɛbɔ.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde asikyiresiam no nkaeɛ ma Aaron ne ne mmammarima sɛ wɔn aduane; nanso wɔfa ne nyinaa sɛ afɔdeɛ kronkron a wɔabɔ ama Awurade.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ wɔde burodo a wɔato no fononoo mu brɛ Awurade sɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde asikyiresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu a wɔde ngo afra ato a mmɔreka nni mu na ɛbɔ saa afɔdeɛ no. Motumi de burodo ntrawa dɛɛdɛ a mmɔreka nni mu na mode ngo afa so nso bɔ afɔdeɛ ma ɛyɛ yie.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Sɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ no yɛ aduane a wɔato no dadeɛ so a, asikyiresiam muhumuhu a mmɔreka mfra mu na mode ngo afra na momfa mmɔ saa afɔdeɛ no.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Mommubu mu asinasini na monhwie ngo ngu so na ɛnyɛ sɛ atokoɔ afɔdeɛ ara pɛ.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Sɛ monoa mo afɔdeɛ no wɔ kyɛnsee mu a, ɛno nso, momfa asikyiresiam muhumuhu a mode ngo afra na ɛmmɔ saa afɔdeɛ no.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Sɛ moyɛ aduane bi, sɛ motooɛ, sɛ mokyeeɛ anaasɛ mohoeɛ no, ɛsɛ sɛ mode saa afɔrebɔdeɛ no kɔma ɔsɔfoɔ na ɔno nso de kɔ afɔrebukyia no anim de kɔma Awurade.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Afɔrebɔdeɛ no mu kakra bi na ɛsɛ sɛ asɔfoɔ no hye, nanso Awurade ani bɛsɔ ade mu no nyinaa.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɛbɛka no yɛ asɔfoɔ no dea, nanso wɔfa no sɛ ne nyinaa yɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ kronkron a wɔabɔ de ama Awurade.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: “ ‘Afɔrebɔ a mode asikyiresiam na ɛbɔ no, mommfa mmɔreka mfra mu, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ biara a mobɛbɔ ama Awurade no, mode mmɔreka anaa ɛwoɔ fra mu.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Mode bɛbrɛ Awurade sɛ aduanekan afɔrebɔdeɛ, nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛsɔ Awurade ani.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Momfa nkyene mfra afɔrebɔdeɛ biara, ɛfiri sɛ, nkyene yɛ nkaedeɛ wɔ Onyankopɔn apam no mu.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ mode mo mfudeɛ a ɛdi ɛkan mu aba kane rebɛbɔ afɔdeɛ a, emu aburoo no monhwane ho na monkye na momfa mma Awurade.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Momfa ngo ne aduhwam nyɛ ho, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ atokoɔ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na asɔfoɔ no bɛhye aburoo no bi a wɔde ngo ne aduhwam afra no sɛ nkaedeɛ wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ obiara pɛ sɛ ɔbɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ma Awurade a, ɔtumi de nantwinini anaa nantwibereɛ bɔ, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ aboa no yɛ deɛ ne ho nni dɛm biara.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔde aboa no aba no de ne nsa bɛgu aboa no apampam na wakum no wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ano. Na Aaron mmammarima no apete aboa no mogya agu afɔrebukyia no ho,

english_verse: Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides,
translation_verse: na wɔahye aboa no ayamdeɛ ne ɛho sradeɛ nyinaa

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne ne sawa mmienu no ne ne sisia ne ne sawa kotokuo wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ abirekyie anaa odwan na mode bɛbɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ama Awurade a, ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛdɛm biara ba ne ho na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ onini anaa ɔbereɛ.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: momfa mo nsa ngu nʼapampam na monkum no wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan ano. Afei, Aaron mmammarima no bɛpete mogya no agu afɔrebukyia no ho nyinaa.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne sawa mmienu ne ɛho sradeɛ a ɛbɛn ne sisia ne ne berɛboɔ a wɔbɛyi ɛno ne ne sawa no ka ho.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛhye no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ aduane a ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ama Awurade.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ obi de abirekyie brɛ Awurade sɛ nʼafɔrebɔdeɛ a,

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: fa wo nsa gu aboa no apampam naku no wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan ano. Aaron mmammarima de aboa no mogya bɛpete afɔrebukyia no ho nyinaa.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne sawa mmienu ne ɛho sradeɛ a ɛbɛn nʼasene mu ne ne berɛboɔ a wɔbɛyi aka ne sawa no ho.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ. Awurade ani bɛsɔ saa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no. Kae sɛ sradeɛ no nyinaa yɛ Awurade dea.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: “ ‘Yei ne mmara a monni so daa nyinaa wɔ asase yi so baabiara. Monnni sradeɛ anaa mogya.’ ”

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne nsateaa baako bɛbɔ mogya no mu apete no mprɛnson wɔ Awurade anim wɔ ntoma a ɛsɛn kronkron mu kronkron no anim.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne nsa bɛgu aboa no apampam na wakum no wɔ beaeɛ a wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mmoa no de ama Awurade no. Yei yɛ ne bɔne ho afɔrebɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no de mogya no bi afɔre ne nsateaa baako ho na ɔde afɔre ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia mmɛn no ho. Afei, ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛhwie mogya no nkaeɛ no agu afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Afei Awurade hyɛɛ mmara foforɔ maa Mose sɛ:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ, ‘saa mmara yi na ɛwɔ hɔ ma obiara a wanhyɛ da na ɔbɛbu Awurade mmara no bi so.

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ bi anhyɛ da na ɔfom mmara bi na ɛnam so de afɔbuo ba nnipa no so a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde nantwinini ba a ɔnnii dɛm bɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ de ma Awurade.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde aboa no ba Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ɛpono ano na ɔde ne nsa gu nʼapampam na ɔkum no wɔ hɔ wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfoɔ no de aboa no mogya bɛkɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔsɔfoɔ no de mogya no bi bɛgu aduhwam no toa a ɛsi afɔrebukyia no so no wɔ Awurade anim wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu; mogya no a ɛbɛka no, wɔbɛhwie agu afɔrebukyia no ase de abɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan ano.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: wɔmfa nkɔ afahyɛbea bi a ɛhɔ te wɔ akyiri baabi a wɔde nsõ firi afɔrebukyia no so kɔ hɔ kɔhye no nnyensin so no.

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa yɛ bɔne a ɛtia Awurade, na sɛ ɛnyɛ boapa yɛ a, nnipa no nyinaa bɛdi ho fɔ.

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔhunu wɔn bɔne a, wɔde nantwie ba bɛba abɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔrebɔ saa afɔdeɛ no a, ɔman no mu mpanimfoɔ de wɔn nsa bɛgu aboa no apampam na wɔakum no wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no de ne mogya aba Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: na ɔde ne nsateaa baako abɔ mogya no mu apete no mprɛnson wɔ Awurade ne ntoma a ɛtwa ɛdan no mu no anim.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ɔde mogya bɛgu mmɛn a ɛtuatua afɔrebukyia no ho no so wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu wɔ Awurade anim. Afei ɔbɛhwie mogya a aka wɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no afɔrebukyia no ase no agu wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan ano.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Afei asɔfoɔ no bɛtwe nantwinini ba no de no akɔ beaeɛ foforɔ bi so akɔhye no wɔ hɔ te sɛ deɛ ɔrebɔ ɔbaakofoɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no. Nanso yei deɛ, ɛyɛ ɔman mu no nyinaa afɔrebɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Any tribal leader who disobeys me without knowing it is still guilty.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ mpanimfoɔ no bi yɛ bɔne a ɔnnim sɛ wafom Awurade Onyankopɔn mmara no baako

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: na wɔma no te ne ho ase a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde ɔpapo a ne ho nni dɛm ba sɛ nʼafɔrebɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔsɔfoɔ no de ne nsateaa baako bɛbɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ mogya no mu na ɔde afɔre afɔrebukyia a wɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ so no mmɛn no ho; na afei wɔahwie mogya no nkaeɛ agu afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Wɔbɛhye sradeɛ no nyinaa wɔ afɔrebukyia no so te sɛ deɛ wɔhye asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ sradeɛ no ara pɛ; ɛkyerɛ sɛ, ɔsɔfoɔ no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama ɔpanin ko no wɔ ne bɔne no ho na wɔde ne bɔne no bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ ɔpapahwekwaa bi yɛ bɔne a ɔnnim sɛ wafom a, ɔdi ho fɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔnya te ne ho ase ara pɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde abirekyibereɛ a ne ho nni dɛm ba ma wɔde pata ne bɔne no.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ɔde no bɛba beaeɛ a wɔde mmoa a wɔde wɔn ba ma wɔkum wɔn de wɔn bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ hɔ no, na ɔde ne nsa ato bɔne ho afɔrebɔdeɛ no apampam na wakum no.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛyi sradeɛ no nyinaa afiri mu te sɛ deɛ wɔfa bɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no ara. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛhye no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so. Na Awurade ani bɛsɔ. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ, ɔsɔfoɔ no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama saa onipa no na wɔde ne bɔne bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde odwammaa bɛbɔ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nso a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbereɛ a ɛdɛm biara nni ne ho.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no de mogya no bi afɔre ne nsateaa baako ho na ɔde afɔre ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia mmɛn no ho. Na wahwie mogya no nkaeɛ no agu afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛyɛ sradeɛ no sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ asomdwoeɛ odwammaa sradeɛ no. Ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛhye sradeɛ no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so te sɛ afɔdeɛ ahodoɔ a wɔde ogya bɔ ma Awurade no ara pɛ. Ɔsɔfoɔ no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama onipa ko no, na wɔde ne bɔne bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi anhyɛ da na ɔde ne nsa ka biribi a ɛfiri onipa mu a ɛho nte na ɔte ne ho ase sɛ wayɛ saa adeɛ no a, ɔdi ho fɔ.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi ka ntam a, sɛ ntam no yɛ anaa ɛyɛ ntanhunu no, sɛ ɔhunu sɛ ɛyɛ ntanhunu a, ɔdi ho fɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi di yeinom bi ho fɔ a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔka ne bɔne no mu nokorɛ

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: na ɔde odwanbereɛ anaa abirekyibereɛ bɔ afɔdeɛ ma Awurade. Ɔsɔfoɔ na ɔbɛbɔ onipa ko no bɔne no ho afɔdeɛ ama no. Ɔsɔfoɔ no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama no.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Ɔde bɛma ɔsɔfoɔ no na ɔde anomaa a ɔdi ɛkan no abɔ bɔne afɔdeɛ no. Ɔbɛkyinsa aboa no kɔn nanso ɔrente ne ti mfiri so,

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: na wapete ne mogya no bi agu afɔrebukyia no ho. Mogya no nkaeɛ no, ɔbɛhwie agu afɔrebukyia no ase. Yei ne afɔrebɔ kwan a ɛpepa bɔne.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ ɔyɛ ohiani buruburo a ɔrentumi mfa nturukuku anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmɛbɔ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ a, ɔde asikyiresiam papa lita mmienu ne fa bɛba sɛ ne bɔne ho afɔrebɔdeɛ. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔde ɔsra ngo fra. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔde aduhwam nso gu so, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ bɔne afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ɔde bɛma ɔsɔfoɔ no. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no asa ne nsabuo ma de asi ne nyinaa anan na wahye no afɔrebukyia no so ama Awurade sɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ biara. Yei bɛyɛ ne bɔne ho afɔrebɔ.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛba saa a, ɔsɔfoɔ no nam saa afɔrebɔ yi so bɛpata ama onipa no na wɔde ne bɔne no bɛkyɛ no. Asikyiresiam a aka no, wɔde bɛma ɔsɔfoɔ no te sɛ afudeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ no ara pɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “Sɛ obi anhyɛ da na ɔgu ade kronkron ho fi a, ɔde odwennini a ne ho nni dɛm a ɔfata sɛ mpatadeɛ wɔ ne fɔ no ho bɛba abɛbɔ Awurade afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Adeɛ kye a, ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛhyɛ nʼasɔfotadeɛ nahanaha wɔ aseɛ na wahyɛ atadetam korɔ no ara bi ngugusoɔ na wakɔpra ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nsõ no de agu afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn.

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Ɛda a wɔbɛsra Aaron ne ne mmammarima ngo no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde asikyiresiam lita mmienu ne fa brɛ Awurade. Wɔde fa bɛba anɔpa na wɔde fa aba anwummerɛ.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima biara a ɔfra asɔfoɔ no mu no bɛdi afɔrebɔdeɛ no bi—wɔn nko ara—ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ kronkron yie.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Kukuo a wɔnoaa ɛnam no wɔ mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ no; na sɛ ɛyɛ kɔbere nso a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwi mu, na wɔde nsuo hohoro mu nyinaa yie.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: “Fa saa mmara a ɛfa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ho yi ma Aaron ne ne mmammarima. ‘Wɔbɛgya ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ no wɔ ogya no so anadwo mu no nyinaa a afɔrebukyia ogya no gu so rehye.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔbɛsesa ne ntadeɛ no na wasoa nsõ no afiri beaeɛ hɔ de akɔgu beaeɛ foforɔ a wɔate hɔ no.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Saa ɛberɛ yi nyinaa ɛsɛ sɛ ogya a ɛwɔ afɔrebukyia no so no dɛre. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛdum. Anɔpa biara ɔsɔfoɔ no de ogya foforɔ bɛhyɛ mu na ɔde ɛda biara ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ agu so, na wahye sradeɛ a wɔde bɔ ɛda biara asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛberɛ biara ogya no kɔ so dɛre. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛdum.

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: “ ‘Atokoɔ afɔdeɛ ho mmara nso nie: Aaron mmammarima bɛgyina afɔrebukyia no anim na wɔde atokoɔ afɔrebɔ no ama Awurade.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛsa asikyiresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu no ne nsabuo ma na ɔde ngo ne aduhwam afra ahye no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ ananmusideɛ ama Awurade; na Awurade ani bɛsɔ.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Si so dua sɛ, sɛ wɔto a, wɔmmfa mmɔreka mfra mu. Mede saa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ maa me no bi ama asɔfoɔ no. Esiane sɛ ne nyinaa yɛ bɔne ne afɔdie ho afɔrebɔ enti, ɛyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aaron asefoɔ mmarima ne asɔfoɔ na wɔnni mfiri awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so nkɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so. Nanso asɔfoɔ no nko ara na wɔnni afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔabɔ no ogya so ama Awurade no.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Wɔde ngo bɛfra ato wɔ dadeɛ apaawa so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔto no yie na wɔde brɛ Awurade sɛ nʼafɔrebɔdeɛ a ɛsɔ nʼani yie.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mmammarima sɛ bɔne afɔrebɔ ho mmara nie: Saa afɔrebɔdeɛ yi ho yɛ kronkron yie enti ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkum no Awurade anim wɔ beaeɛ a wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ no.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔyɛ afɔrebɔ no ho adwuma no we afɔrebɔdeɛ no wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no adihɔ hɔ.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔate wɔn ho a wɔyɛ asɔfoɔ nko ara na wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔde wɔn nsa ka ɛnam no bi; na sɛ ɛba sɛ aboa no mogya bi pete wɔn ntadeɛ mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsi ntadeɛ no wɔ beaeɛ a wɔate ho hɔ.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔde bɔne ho afɔrebɔdeɛ no mogya no bi kɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan mu hɔ de kɔyɛ mpatadeɛ wɔ kronkronbea hɔ a, ɔsɔfoɔ biara renwe bi. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ogya hye aboa no nyinaa wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Asɔfoɔ no bɛhye no afɔrebukyia no so sɛ ɛfɔdie ho afɔdeɛ de ama Awurade.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Wɔde saa afɔrebɔdeɛ yi bi bɛgyina afɔrebukyia no anim na wɔahim no afɔrebukyia no anim akɔ fa aba fa de akyerɛ sɛ, wɔde ama Awurade. Afei, wɔbɛdane afɔrebɔdeɛ no ama ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔpete aboa a wɔde no bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ no mogya a ɔboa dwumadie no.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɛnam biara a ɛka biribi a wɔntee ho no, wɔnnwe; wɔnhye no. Ɛnam biara a aka deɛ, obiara a ne ho te wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔwe.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: “ ‘Amanneɛ a ɛfa bɔne afɔrebɔ a ɛyɛ kronkron no nie:

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛkum aboa a wɔde no rebɔ afɔdeɛ no wɔ beaeɛ a wɔkumm aboa a wɔde no bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no na wɔde ne mogya no apete afɔrebukyia no ho ahyia.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfoɔ no de aboa no mu sradeɛ nyinaa, ne dua,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ne sawa mmienu ne ne sisia sradeɛ ne ne berɛboɔ kotokuo no nyinaa bɛgu nkyɛn de abɔ saa afɔdeɛ no.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Mmarima a wɔfra asɔfoɔ no mu nko ara na wɔbɛwe ɛnam no bi. Wɔnwe no beaeɛ a ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ a ɛho te yie.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: “ ‘Amanneɛ korɔ no ara na wɔbɛfa so abɔ bɔne afɔdeɛ ne ɛfɔdie afɔdeɛ no. Ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔdi mmaratodeɛ no ho dwuma no na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔwe ɛnam no.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Sɛ afɔrebɔ no yɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔ a, wɔde aboa no ho nhoma no bɛma ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔbɛdi dwuma no.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Atokoɔ afɔrebɔ biara a aka no, sɛ wɔde ngo fra anaa wɔamfa ngo amfra a, ɛyɛ Aaron mmammarima nyinaa dea.

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: “ ‘Amanneɛ a ɛfa asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ sononko a wɔbɔ ma Awurade no nie:

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ ɛyɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ a, wɔmfa burodo a mmɔreka nni mu a wɔde ngo afra nka ho. Saa ara na wɔmfa burodo ntrawa bi a wɔde ngo agu so ne asikyiresiam mfrafraeɛ a wɔde afra ngo nka saa afɔrebɔdeɛ no ho.

english_verse: You must also make some bread with yeast.
translation_verse: Wɔmfa burodo a wɔde mmɔreka afra nka saa aseda asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ yi ho.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔde aboa no bɔ Awurade afɔdeɛ de ma no sɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔrebɔ de kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ anisɔ ne asedadeɛ a, wɔbɛwe ne nam ɛda no ara. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ebi ka na adeɛ kye a wɔawe.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: “ ‘Na sɛ obi de afɔrebɔdeɛ bi ba a ɛnyɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ na mmom, sɛ ɛyɛ bɔhyɛ anaa ɛfiri nʼakoma mu na ɔde rebrɛ Awurade deɛ a, deɛ ɛbɛka biara wɔ afɔrebɔ no akyi no, sɛ adeɛ kye so a, wɔtumi we.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi we deɛ adi nnansa no bi a, Awurade rennye afɔrebɔdeɛ no; na ɛrenni mu sɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ, na onipa a ɔde baeɛ sɛ wɔmfa mmɔ saa afɔdeɛ no rennya ho mfasoɔ biara. Ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔbɛwe no nso bɛdi ho fɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ ma Awurade; na onipa a ɔbɛwe saa ɛnam no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyi ne ho ano wɔ saa bɔne no ho.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔde ne nsa bɛka biribi a ɛho nte no, sɛ ɛyɛ onipa anaa aboa na ɔguu ho fi na ɔbɛdii asomdwoeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ no bi no, wɔbɛtwa no asuo, ɛfiri sɛ, wagu ade kronkron ho fi.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ wɔnnni sradeɛ, sɛ ɛfiri anantwie, nnwan anaa mmirekyie mu.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Sɛ yadeɛ bi bɔ aboa bi na ɔwu anaasɛ mmoa bɔne bi taataa aboa foforɔ bi so kum no a, wɔnnni ne sradeɛ na mmom, wɔmfa nyɛ ade foforɔ.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛdi sradeɛ a ɛfiri afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ no ogya so de ma Awurade no, wɔbɛtwa no asuo.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛyɛ saa no, wɔbɛtwa no asuo.”

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛhye sradeɛ no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so na ne yan no deɛ, Aaron ne ne mmammarima bɛfa,

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mmammarima no mu deɛ ɔde mogya ne sradeɛ a ɛfiri afɔrebɔdeɛ no mu bɛba afɔrebukyia no so na ɔbɛfa srɛ nifa no.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Mahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa ne yan no ne ne srɛ no mma sɛ akyɛdeɛ a ɛfiri Israelfoɔ nkyɛn a wɔde rebrɛ Aaron mmammarima. Ɛberɛ biara, wɔmfa saa afɔrebɔdeɛ no kyɛfa yi no mma Aaron ne ne mmammarima.”

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Awurade de saa mmara yi maa Mose wɔ Sinai Bepɔ so sɛ ɔno nso mfa mma Israelfoɔ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, wɔbɛhunu ɛkwan a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔfa so bɔ wɔn afɔdeɛ ahodoɔ no de ma Onyankopɔn wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ so hɔ.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Afei Mose faa ne yan no hinhim no Awurade anim; yei ne Mose kyɛfa wɔ ahoteɛ odwennini no mu sɛdeɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Afei fa Aaron ne ne mmammarima bra Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan no ano. Wɔmfa wɔn ntadeɛ, ɔsra ngo, nantwie ba a wɔde no bɛbɔ bɔne afɔdeɛ, nnwennini mmienu ne burodo a mmɔreka nni mu nkɛntɛmma mmienu

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na frɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa na wɔmmra hɔ bi.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Enti nnipa no nyinaa hyiaeɛ wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan ano.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Adeɛ a merebɛyɛ yi, Awurade na wahyɛ me sɛ menyɛ.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔfaa Aaron ne ne mmammarima de nsuo hohoroo wɔn ho,

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: de Aaron atadeɛ sononko a ne mmeamu ka ho de ne batakari a asɔfotadeɛ a wɔde tam a ɛyɛ fɛ ayɛ nʼabɔwomu hyɛɛ no.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Afei, Mose de adaaboɔ fam Aaron bo de Urim ne Tumim no hyɛɛ mu.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔɔ Aaron abotire a ɛwɔ sika abɔnimu kronkron sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ no ara pɛ.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Afei, Mose faa ɔsra ngo no de bi petee Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ankasa ne biribiara a ɛwɔ mu ho de tee ne nyinaa ho.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Ɔduruu afɔrebukyia no so no, ɔpetee so mprɛnson. Afei, ɔpetee nkukuo a ɛwɔ afɔrebukyia no so no ne atam ne ne ntaamu ho de tee ho.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔhwiee ɔsra ngo no guu Aaron tirim de tee ne ho sɛ ɔnhyɛ nʼadwuma ase.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɛdi hɔ ne sɛ, Mose de mmatakari no hyehyɛɛ Aaron mmammarima a abɔwomu ne ɛkyɛ ka ho sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔfaa nantwinini ba sɛ ɔde no rekɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ. Aaron ne ne mmammarima de wɔn nsa guu aboa no apampam,

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: ma Mose kumm no. Ɔde ne nsateaa baako bɔɔ ne mogya mu de yɛɛ afɔrebukyia mmɛn nan no ho ne afɔrebukyia no ankasa ho de tee ho, ɛnna ɔhwiee mogya no nkaeɛ no guu afɔrebukyia no ase de tee ho sɛ mpatadeɛ.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Ɔfaa nʼayamdeɛ ho sradeɛ ne ne berɛboɔ ho sradeɛ ne ne sawa mmienu no ne ɛho sradeɛ hyee ne nyinaa wɔ afɔrebukyia no so.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Wɔhyee nantwinini ba no ne ne nhoma ne nʼagyanan wɔ sraban no akyi sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Afei, ɔde odwennini maa Awurade sɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ. Aaron ne ne mmammarima de wɔn nsa guu aboa no apampam

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: na Mose kumm no de ne mogya no bi petee afɔrebukyia no ho nyinaa.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na ɔde nsuo hohoroo nʼayamdeɛ ne ne nan no ho hyee no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so maa ne nyinaa hyee pasaa wɔ Awurade anim. Ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛsɔɔ Awurade ani yie, ɛfiri sɛ, Mose dii Awurade akwankyerɛ no nyinaa so pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Afei, Mose de odwennini baako a ɔyɛ ahoteɛ dwennini baeɛ. Aaron ne ne mmammarima de wɔn nsa guu nʼapampam.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Mose kumm no na ɔde mogya no bi kaa Aaron aso nifa ase ne ne nsa nifa kokurobetie ne ne nan nifa kokurobetie.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔde mogya no bi yɛɛ Aaron mmammarima no nso aso nifa ase ne wɔn nsa nifa kokurobetie ne wɔn nan nifa kokurobetie. Ɔde mogya no nkaeɛ petee afɔrebukyia no ho nyinaa.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔfaa sradeɛ no, ne dua, ne ne mu sradeɛ, ne berɛboɔ kotokuo, ne sawa mmienu no ne ɛho sradeɛ ne nʼabati nifa

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: ɛnna ɔde saa burodo ntrawa a mmɔreka nni mu no baako nso ne burodo ntrawa no baako a wɔde ngo agu so ne burodo ntrawa baako a wɔfaa ne nyinaa firii kɛntɛn a wɔde bɛsii hɔ wɔ Awurade anim no mu guguu yeinom nyinaa so.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɔde yeinom nyinaa hyɛɛ Aaron ne ne mmammarima nsa sɛ wɔnhim no afɔrebukyia no anim sɛ ɔhim afɔrebɔ mma Awurade.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Mose gyee ne nyinaa firii wɔn nsam hyee no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so de maa Awurade; na afɔrebɔ no sɔɔ Awurade ani.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfaa ɔsra ngo no ne mogya a ɔde apete afɔrebukyia no so no bi de petee Aaron ne ne mmammarima ntadeɛ mu de tee Aaron ne ne mmammarima ne wɔn ntadeɛ ho maa Awurade dwumadie.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mmammarima no sɛ, “Monnoa ɛnam no wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan ano na momfa nni burodo a ɛwɔ kɛntɛn a asɔfohyɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ wɔ mu no sɛdeɛ meka kyerɛɛ mo no.

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Ɛnam ne burodo biara a ɛbɛka no, monhye.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Bio, ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔntena Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ano nnanson, mfa nwie asɔfohyɛ dwumadie no.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Mose kaa bio sɛ, deɛ ɔyɛɛ no ɛda no nyinaa no, Awurade na ɔhyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ mfa nyɛ mpata mma wɔn.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Ɔsane hyɛɛ Aaron ne ne mmammarima no sɛ wɔntena Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ano anadwo ne awia nnanson. Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Sɛ mofiri hɔ a, mobɛwuwu. Yei ne asɛm a Awurade aka.’ ”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Enti, Aaron ne ne mmammarima dii nsɛm a Awurade nam Mose so hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no nyinaa so.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Ahodwira no akyi ɛda a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, Mose frɛɛ Aaron ne ne mmammarima ne Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: Ɔka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ, ɔnkɔkyere nantwinini ba mfiri anantwie no mu na ɔmfa no mmɔ bɔne afɔdeɛ, na ɔnkyere odwennini a ne ho nni dɛm mfa no mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ. Ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmɔ saa afɔdeɛ yi nyinaa wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Afei Mose kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Monka nkyerɛ Israelfoɔ na wɔnyi ɔpapo mfa no mmɔ bɔne afɔdeɛ mma wɔn ho, na wɔmfa nantwie a wadi afe ne odwammaa a wadi afe a wɔn ho nni dɛm biara mmɔ wɔn ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no.

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: Bio, ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmfa nantwinini ne odwennini mmɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ na wɔmfa asikyiresiam a wɔde ngo afra mmɔ aduane afɔdeɛ. Ka kyerɛ ma wɔmfa saa afɔrebɔdeɛ yi nyinaa mma Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnnɛ, Awurade bɛyi ne ho adi akyerɛ mo.”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Enti wɔde saa nneɛma yi nyinaa baa Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no kwan ano sɛdeɛ Mose hyɛeɛ no. Nnipa no nyinaa bɛgyinagyinaa Awurade anim.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Sɛ modi Awurade mmara so a, mobɛnya nʼanimuonyam.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ ɔnkɔ afɔrebukyia no so na ɔnkɔbɔ bɔne ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no mfa nyɛ mpatadeɛ mma ne ho ansa na ato nnipa no sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Enti Aaron foro kɔɔ afɔrebukyia no so. Ɔkumm nantwie ba no de bɔɔ ɔno ara ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Ne mmammarima no de mogya no brɛɛ no ɛnna ɔde ne nsateaa baako bɔɔ mu fɔree mmɛn a ɛwɔ afɔrebukyia no ho no ɛnna ɔhwiee nkaeɛ no guu afɔrebukyia no ase.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔhyee sradeɛ, sawa, berɛboɔ, berɛboɔ nkotokuo a ɛfiri bɔne afɔrebɔdeɛ no mu sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Na ɛnam no deɛ, ɔhyee no ne ne nhoma wɔ sraban no akyi.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɛdi hɔ ne sɛ, ɔkumm ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ aboa no maa ne mmammarima sɔɔ mogya no maa ɔde petee afɔrebukyia no ho nyinaa,

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Wɔde aboa no brɛɛ no asinasini a ne ti ka ho. Ɔhyee aboa no akwaa biara wɔ afɔrebukyia no so.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔhoroo aboa no ayamdeɛ ne ne nan ho hyee no afɔrebukyia no so sɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa ɔmanfoɔ. Ɔkumm abirekyie nanso ɔfaa ɛkwan korɔ a ɔfaa so bɔɔ bɔne afɔdeɛ maa ne ho no so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa ne ho.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Saa ɛkwan no so na ɔfa bɔɔ wɔn ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ de maa Awurade sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn mmara kyerɛ no.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔbɔɔ atokoɔ afɔdeɛ no, ɔfaa ne nsabuo ma ɛnna ɔhyee no afɔrebukyia no so de kaa anɔpa ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔ no ho.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔkumm nantwie ne odwennini no a ɛyɛ nnipa no asomdwoeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ no. Aaron mmammarima no de mogya no brɛɛ no maa ɔde petee afɔrebukyia no ho nyinaa.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Ɔyii nantwie no ne odwennini no sradeɛ. Ɔyii wɔn padua mu sradeɛ ne wɔn ayamdeɛ sradeɛ, ne wɔn sawa ne wɔn berɛboɔ kotokuo.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Na ɔhim ayan no ne mmoa no mmati nifa no wɔ Awurade anim de kyerɛɛ sɛ afɔdeɛ no yɛ ne dea sɛdeɛ Mose hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Afei, Aaron trɛɛ ne nsam wɔ nnipa no so hyiraa wɔn, ɛnna ɔsiane firii afɔrebukyia no ho sii fam.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose ne Aaron kɔɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan mu hɔ na wɔsane baa bio no, wɔhyiraa nnipa no na Awurade animuonyam baa nnipa no nyinaa so.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ogya firi Awurade nkyɛn bɛhyee ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ no ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ afɔrebukyia no so no. Na nnipa no hunuu yei no, wɔn nyinaa teateaam butubutuu fam wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Na Aaron mma Nadab ne Abihu de ogya guu wɔn aduhwamhyeɛ adeɛ mu. Wɔde aduhwam no petee ogya no so ma wɔnam saa ɛkwan yi so buu Awurade mmara so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde ogya a ɛnyɛ deɛ Awurade ahyɛ baa nʼanim.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Enti ogya dɛreɛ firi Awurade nkyɛn bɛhyee wɔn.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ, “Awurade kaa sɛ, “ ‘Mede me ho kronkron bɛkyerɛ wɔn a wɔbɛn me na nnipa nyinaa ahyɛ me animuonyam no, aseɛ ne no.’” Na asɛm no tɔree Aaron mumu.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Afei, Mose soma ma wɔkɔfrɛɛ Misael ne Elsafan a wɔyɛ Aaron agya nuabarima mma brɛɛ no. Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Monkɔtwe nnipa a wɔahye no nyinaa mfiri Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no anim mfa wɔn nkɔ sraban no akyi.”

english_verse: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.
translation_verse: Na wɔkɔsoaa wɔn wɔ wɔn ntadeɛ mu sɛdeɛ Mose aka akyerɛ wɔn no.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mmammarima Eleasa ne Itamar sɛ, “Monnsu. Mommma mo tirinwi nsensɛn hɔ yuu mmfa nkyerɛ sɛ moretwa agyaadwoɔ. Monnsunsuane mo ntadeɛ mu nso. Sɛ moyɛ saa a, Onyankopɔn bɛkum mo nso na nʼabufuo bɛba Israelfoɔ nyinaa so. Nanso Israelfoɔ a wɔaka no deɛ, ɛsiane ogya a Awurade de baeɛ no enti, wɔtumi di Nadab ne Abihu wuo no ho awerɛhoɔ tumi su wɔn nso.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Na mommfiri Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ano, anyɛ saa a mobɛwuwu, ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade ngosra wɔ mo so.” Na wɔdii asɛm a Mose kaeɛ no so.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade hyɛɛ Aaron sɛ,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Sɛ wokɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu a, nnom bobesa anaa nsã a ano yɛ den. Woyɛ saa a, wobɛwu. Saa mmara yi ka wo mmammarima ne wʼasefoɔ nyinaa firi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Wo nnwuma ne sɛ, wobɛdi wo nkurɔfoɔ ntam nsɛm akyerɛ wɔn nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda deɛ ɛho te ne deɛ ɛyɛ teta ntam ne deɛ ɛyɛ kronkron ne deɛ ɛnyɛ kronkron ntam,

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: na kyerɛ wɔn mmara a Awurade nam Mose so de ama no nyinaa.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Afei, Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mmammarima Eleasa ne Itamar sɛ, “Sɛ mohye Awurade afɔrebɔdeɛ no nsabuo ma Awurade a, monni deɛ ɛbɛka no wɔ afɔrebukyia no ho. Monhwɛ sɛ mmɔka nni mu ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Enti monni no kronkronbea hɔ. Ɛyɛ wo ne wo mmammarima dea, na ɛyɛ wo ne wo mmammarima no kyɛfa a ɛfiri afɔdeɛ a wɔde ogya bɔ maa Awurade no mu. Yei na wɔahyɛ sɛ menyɛ.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Ne srɛ ne ne yan a wohim no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ka sradeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔhye de ma Awurade no ho. Afei ɛbɛyɛ wo ne wʼasefoɔ dea daa sɛdeɛ Awurade ahyɛ no.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Mose bisaa deɛ ayɛ abirekyie a wɔde no bɛbɔ bɔne afɔdeɛ no ho asɛm no, ɔhunuu sɛ wɔahye no. Ɛno enti, ne bo fuu Eleasa ne Itamar a na wɔyɛ Aaron mmammarima no.

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ, ‘Adɛn enti na moanwe bɔne afɔrebɔdeɛ no wɔ kronkronbea hɔ? Ɛyɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ kronkron! Wɔde maa mo sɛ momfa nyi nnipa no afɔdie na ɛnyɛ mpatadeɛ mma wɔn wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ wɔamfa ne mogya ankɔ kronkronbea hɔ no enti, anka mobɛtumi awe no hɔ ara sɛdeɛ mehyɛeɛ no.’ ”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Aaron srɛɛ Mose maa ne mma no sɛ, “Ɛnnɛ me mma no bɔɔ wɔn bɔne afɔdeɛ ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ maa Awurade. Nanso hwɛ asɛm yi a ato me. Sɛ mewee bɔne afɔdeɛ ɛnam yi bi ɛnnɛ a, anka Awurade ani bɛsɔ anaa?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Na Mose tee saa no, ɔgye too mu.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Motumi we aboa biara a ne tɔte mu apae na ɔpu wesa no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: “Monka nkyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ, ‘yei ne mmoa a mobɛtumi awe wɔ asase so mmoa no mu.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: efiewura, ɔmampam, ɔkoterɛ, srɛ so koterɛ, abosomakoterɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔde ne nsa bɛka wɔn mu bi funu no ho bɛyɛ fi kɔsi anwummerɛ

english_verse: If something made of wood, cloth, or leather touches one of their dead bodies, it must be washed, but it is still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: na biribiara a wɔn funu no ho bɛka no nso ho bɛgu fi, sɛ ɛyɛ dua, ntoma, kuntu, kotokuo; biribiara a wɔn ho bɛka no, wɔmfa ngu nsuo mu nkɔsi anwummerɛ. Ɛno akyi, wɔtumi de di dwuma bio.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
