english_verse: King Sihon had ruled from Heshbon, after defeating the Moabites and taking over their land north of the Arnon River gorge.
translation_verse: Na Hesbon yɛ Amorifoɔhene Sihon Kuropɔn. Sihon na ɛda bi ɔko tiaa Moabhene faa ne nsase nyinaa bɛsii Asubɔnten Arnon no.

english_verse: The Israelites sent this message to King Sihon of the Amorites:
translation_verse: Afei, Israelfoɔ tuu abɔfoɔ ma wɔde nkra yi kɔmaa Amorifoɔhene Sihon sɛ:

english_verse: Please let us pass through your territory. We promise to stay away from your fields and vineyards, and we won't drink any water from your wells. As long as we're in your land, we'll stay on the main road.
translation_verse: “Momma yɛntwa mu mfa mo ɔman yi mu. Yɛbɛfa ɛkwan tempɔn so, na yɛremfiri so kɔsi sɛ yɛbɛtra mo hyeɛ. Yɛrentiatia mo mfudeɛ so, yɛremfa yɛn nsa nka mo bobe nturo, na yɛrennom mo abura mu nsuo.”

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let Israel travel through his land. Instead, he called together his entire army and marched into the desert to attack Israel near the town of Jahaz.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔhene Sihon ampene so. Na mmom, ɔboaboaa nʼakodɔm ano kɔto hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ so wɔ ɛserɛ so hɔ ne wɔn koo wɔ Yahas.

english_verse: Israel defeated them and took over the Amorite territory from the Arnon River gorge in the south to the Jabbok River gorge in the north. Beyond the Jabbok was the territory of the Ammonites, who were much stronger than Israel.
translation_verse: Nanso Israelfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn faa wɔn asase a ɛfiri Asubɔnten Arnon kɔsi asuo Yabok ho toaa so kɔsii Amorifoɔ ahyeɛ so, nanso wɔkɔhyiaa Amon mma ahoɔdenfoɔ bi a wɔakyere sraban enti wɔantumi anko ankɔ wɔn anim bio.

english_verse: The Israelites settled in the Amorite towns, including the capital city of Heshbon with its surrounding villages.
translation_verse: Enti Israelfoɔ no faa Amorifoɔ no nkuro akɛseɛ nyinaa a Hesbon kuropɔn ne ne nkuraase nyinaa ka ho tenaa mu.

english_verse: That's why the Amorites had written this poem about Heshbon: Come and rebuild Heshbon, King Sihon's capital city!
translation_verse: Ne sei enti tete, anwensɛm twerɛfoɔ twerɛɛ yei faa ne ho sɛ, “Bra Hesbon, Sihon kuropɔn, yɛnkyekyere na ɛnsi ne dada mu.

english_verse: His armies marched out like fiery flames, burning down the town of Ar and destroying the hills along the Arnon River.
translation_verse: “Egya turi firii Hesbon Ogyaframa firii Sihon ahenkuro mu, Ɛhyee Ar kuropɔn a ɛwɔ Moab; ɛsɛee sodifoɔ a wɔwɔ Arnon mmepɔ so.

english_verse: You Moabites are done for! Your god Chemosh deserted your people; they were captured, taken away by King Sihon the Amorite.
translation_verse: Ao Moabfoɔ, mosɛeɛ bɛba mu! Wɔawie mo, mo a mosom Kemos! Kemos agya ne mmammarima sɛ atutenafoɔ, Ne ne mmammaa sɛ Amorifoɔhene Sihon nnommumfoɔ.

english_verse: We completely defeated Moab. The towns of Heshbon and Dibon, of Nophah and Medeba are ruined and gone.
translation_verse: “Yɛasɛe wɔn pasaa, ɛfiri Hesbon tɔnn kɔsi Dibon. Yɛasɛe wɔn ara akɔsi Nofa De kɔ ara kɔsi Medeba.”

english_verse: After the Israelites had settled in the Amorite territory,
translation_verse: Enti Israelfoɔ no tenaa Amorifoɔ asase so.

english_verse: Moses sent some men to explore the town of Jazer. Later, the Israelites captured the villages surrounding it and forced out the Amorites who lived there. Israel Defeats King Og of Bashan (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Mose somaa akwansrafoɔ sɛ wɔnkɔsrasra Yaser fa mu hɔ. Ɔde asraafoɔ toaa wɔn, faa wɔn nkuro nyinaa, pamoo Amorifoɔ no.

english_verse: The Israelites headed toward the region of Bashan, where King Og ruled, and he led his entire army to Edrei to meet Israel in battle.
translation_verse: Afei, wɔde wɔn ani kyerɛɛ kuro kɛseɛ Basan, nanso Basanhene Og de nʼasraafoɔ hyiaa wɔn wɔ Edrei.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Don't be afraid of Og. I will help you defeat him and his army, just as you did King Sihon who ruled in Heshbon. Og's territory will be yours.”
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ ɔnnsuro na wadi atamfoɔ no so dada. Awurade sane hyɛɛ Mose nkuran sɛ asɛm a ɛtoo ɔhene Sihon wɔ Hesbon no, saa asɛm korɔ no ara bi na ɛbɛto no.

english_verse: So the Israelites wiped out Og, his family, and his entire army—there were no survivors. Then Israel took over the land of Bashan.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, Israelfoɔ dii nkonim na wɔkumm ɔhene Og ne ne mmammarima ne ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa a anka wɔn mu baako mpo. Enti Israelfoɔ no tenaa asase no so.

english_verse: Israel moved from there to the hills of Moab, where they camped across the Jordan River from the town of Jericho. King Balak of Moab Hires Balaam To Curse Israel
translation_verse: Afei, Israelfoɔ no kɔɔ Moab tata so kɔtenaa Asubɔnten Yordan apueeɛ fam a ɛhɔ ne Yeriko di nhwɛanimu no.

english_verse: They said to the Midianite leaders, “That huge mob of Israelites will wipe out everything in sight, like a bull eating grass in a field.” So King Balak
translation_verse: Ntɛm ara, wɔne Midian mpanimfoɔ tuu agyina. Wɔkaa sɛ, “Saa dɔm yi bɛwe biribiara a wɔhunu sɛdeɛ nantwie we serɛ.” Enti, Moab ɔhene Balak

english_verse: sent a message to Balaam son of Beor who lived among his relatives in the town of Pethor near the Euphrates River. It said: I need your help. A large group of people has come here from Egypt and settled near my territory.
translation_verse: somaa nnipa ma wɔkɔɔ Beor babarima Balaam nkyɛn wɔ Petor a ɛbɛn Asubɔnten Eufrate ho. Ɔsrɛɛ Balaam sɛ ɔmmɛboa no. Ɔkaa sɛ, “Nnipadɔm bi firi Misraim aba. Wɔkata asase ani nyinaa na wɔrehunahuna me.

english_verse: They are too powerful for us to defeat, so would you come and place a curse on them? Maybe then we can run them off. I know that anyone you bless will be successful, but anyone you curse will fail.
translation_verse: Mɛsrɛ wo, bra na bɛdome wɔn ma me, ɛfiri sɛ wɔdɔɔso dodo. Ebia metumi adi wɔn so nkonim na mapam wɔn afiri asase no so. Na menim nhyira a ɛba wɔn a wohyira wɔn no so, ɛnna menim musuo a ɛba wɔn a wodome wɔn so.”

english_verse: The leaders of Moab and Midian left and took along money to pay Balaam. When they got to his house, they gave him Balak's message.
translation_verse: Nnipa a ɔsomaa wɔn no yɛ atitire a wɔfiri Moab ne Midian. Wɔfaa sika sɛ wɔde rekɔtua Balaam ka ama wadome Israelfoɔ. Enti wɔkɔɔ Balaam nkyɛn kɔkaa deɛ ɛhia Balak kyerɛɛ no.

english_verse: “Spend the night here,” Balaam replied, “and tomorrow I will tell you the Lord's answer.” So the officials stayed at his house.
translation_verse: Balaam kaa sɛ, “Monna ma adeɛ nkye mo. Adeɛ kye a, deɛ Awurade bɛkyerɛ me sɛ menyɛ no, mɛka akyerɛ mo.” Enti wɔdaeɛ.

english_verse: During the night, God asked Balaam, “Who are these people at your house?”
translation_verse: Anadwo no, Onyankopɔn baa Balaam nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ, “Saa nnipa yi yɛ ɛhefoɔ?”

english_verse: to ask me to go to Moab and put a curse on the people who have come there from Egypt. They have settled everywhere around him, and he wants to run them off.”
translation_verse: Na nnipadɔm bi firi Misraim aba ne hyeɛ so, na ɔpɛ sɛ mekɔ hɔ ntɛm so na mekɔdome wɔn sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, ɔbɛtumi adi wɔn so.”

english_verse: But God replied, “Don't go with Balak's messengers. I have blessed those people who have come from Egypt, so don't curse them.”
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Nkɔ. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wodome wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ, mahyira wɔn!”

english_verse: The next morning, Balaam said to Balak's officials, “Go on back home. The Lord says I cannot go with you.”
translation_verse: Adeɛ kyeeɛ no, anɔpa, Balaam ka kyerɛɛ nnipa no sɛ, “Monsane nkɔ fie! Awurade rempene mma mennyɛ saa.”

english_verse: The officials left and told Balak that Balaam refused to come.
translation_verse: Enti, ɔhene Balak ananmusifoɔ no sane wɔn akyi bɛbɔɔ amaneɛ sɛ ɔse ɔremma.

english_verse: Then Balak sent a larger group of officials, who were even more important than the first ones.
translation_verse: Balak sɔ hwɛɛ bio. Saa ɛberɛ no deɛ, ɔsomaa nnipa dodoɔ pa ara a animuonyamfoɔ a wɔkyɛn kane dɔm no fra wɔn mu.

english_verse: They went to Balaam and told him that Balak had said, “Balaam, if you come to Moab,
translation_verse: Wɔbaa Balaam nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ɔhene Balak se ɔsrɛ wo sɛ bra.

english_verse: I'll pay you very well and do whatever you ask. Just come and place a curse on these people.”
translation_verse: Ɔbɛhyɛ wo animuonyam na sika biara a wɔbɛgye no no nso, ɔbɛtua. Ka sika a wobɛgye! Ɔse, wo deɛ, bra na bɛdome saa nnipa no ma yɛn.”

english_verse: Balaam answered, “Even if Balak offered me a palace full of silver or gold, I wouldn't do anything to disobey the Lord my God.
translation_verse: Nanso, Balaam buaa sɛ, “Sɛ ɔma me ahemfie a wɔde dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ ahyɛ no ma tɔ koraa a, merentumi nyɛ biribiara mmu saa ahyɛdeɛ a Awurade a ɔyɛ me Onyankopɔn no ahyɛ no so.

english_verse: You are welcome to spend the night here, just as the others did. I will find out if the Lord has something else to say about this.”
translation_verse: Nanso, monna ha ma adeɛ nkye na yɛnhwɛ sɛ Awurade bɛka asɛm foforɔ bi aka deɛ waka dada no ho anaa.”

english_verse: That night, God said, “Balaam, I'll let you go to Moab with Balak's messengers, but do only what I say.”
translation_verse: Anadwo no, Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Balaam sɛ, “Sɔre na wo ne saa nnipa no nkɔ na mmom, hwɛ yie na yɛ deɛ mɛkyerɛ wo sɛ yɛ no nko ara.”

english_verse: So Balaam got up the next morning and saddled his donkey, then left with the Moabite officials. Balaam and His Donkey Meet an Angel
translation_verse: Adeɛ kyee anɔpa no, ɔhyehyɛɛ nʼafunumu, tenaa ne so ne wɔn hyɛɛ aseɛ kɔeɛ.

english_verse: Balaam was riding his donkey to Moab, and two of his servants were with him. But God was angry that Balaam had gone, so one of the Lord's angels stood in the road to stop him.
translation_verse: Nanso, Onyankopɔn bo fuu Balaam ahopere a ɔde kɔeɛ no; enti ɔsomaa ɔsoro Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ kɔgyinaa akwantemfi sɛ ɔnkum no wɔ hɔ. Ɛberɛ a Balaam ne asomfoɔ baanu rekorɔ no,

english_verse: When Balaam's donkey saw the angel standing there with a sword, it walked off the road and into an open field. Balaam had to beat the donkey to get it back on the road.
translation_verse: prɛko pɛ, Balaam afunumu no hunuu Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no sɛ ɔkura sekan gyina ɛkwan no mfimfini. Aboa no kwae faa wiram nanso Balaam kaa ne so sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, ɔbɛfa ɛkwan mu.

english_verse: Then the angel stood between two vineyards, in a narrow path with a stone wall on each side.
translation_verse: Baabi a na Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no gyina hɔ no yɛ bobefuo afasuo mmienu ntam.

english_verse: When the donkey saw the angel, it walked so close to one of the walls that Balaam's foot scraped against the wall. Balaam beat the donkey again.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a afunumu no hunuu Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no, ɔde ne ho twee ɔfasuo no ho maa Balaam nan pɛkyɛeɛ. Nanso, Balaam kɔɔ so hwee aboa no bio.

english_verse: The angel moved once more and stood in a spot so narrow that there was no room for the donkey to go around.
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no kɔɔ ɛkwan no anafoɔ kɔgyinaa baabi a ɛhɔ kyere pa ara a na afunumu no nnya baabi mfa.

english_verse: So it just lay down. Balaam lost his temper, then picked up a stick and whacked the donkey.
translation_verse: Enti, ɔbutuu ɛkwan no mu. Balaam de abufuo kaa aboa no mmaa.

english_verse: When that happened, the Lord told the donkey to speak, and it asked Balaam, “What have I done that made you beat me three times?”
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade hyɛɛ afunumu no ma ɔkasaeɛ! Ɔbisaa ne wura no sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na mayɛ enti a ɛsɛ sɛ wohwe me mprɛnsa?”

english_verse: “You made me look stupid!” Balaam answered. “If I had a sword, I'd kill you here and now!”
translation_verse: Balaam nso buaa no sɛ, “Ɛfiri sɛ, woama masɛ ɔkwasea. Na sɛ mekura sekan a, anka mɛkum wo.”

english_verse: “But you're my owner,” answered the donkey, “and you've ridden me many times. Have I ever done anything like this before?” “No,” Balaam admitted.
translation_verse: Afunumu no nso bisaa no sɛ, “Me ne wo tenaeɛ yi, mayɛ sei pɛn?” Ne wura no buaa sɛ, “Dabi.”

english_verse: Just then, the Lord let Balaam see the angel standing in the road, holding a sword, and Balaam bowed down.
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade buee Balaam ani ma ɔhunuu ɔsoro ɔbɔfoɔ no sɛ watwe sekan gyina ɛkwan no mfimfini enti ɔkɔbutuu nʼanim.

english_verse: The angel said, “You had no right to treat your donkey like that! I was the one who blocked your way, because I don't think you should go to Moab.
translation_verse: Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no bisaa no sɛ, “Adɛn enti na wohwe wʼafunumu no mprɛnsa saa? Maba sɛ merebɛka ama woagyae, ɛfiri sɛ, worepɛ adeɛ asɛe.

english_verse: If your donkey had not seen me and stopped those three times, I would have killed you and let the donkey live.”
translation_verse: Afunumu no hunuu me mprɛnsa a emu biara ɔkwae faa baabi; anyɛ saa a, anka mɛkum wo na magyaa no.”

english_verse: Balaam replied, “I was wrong. I didn't know you were trying to stop me. If you don't think I should go, I'll return home at once.”
translation_verse: Afei, Balaam ka kyerɛɛ Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no sɛ, “Mafom. Na mennim sɛ wowɔ hɔ. Sɛ wompɛ sɛ metoa mʼakwantuo no so deɛ a, meresane akɔ efie.”

english_verse: “It's all right for you to go,” the Lord's angel answered. “But you must say only what I tell you.” So Balaam went on with Balak's officials. King Balak Meets Balaam
translation_verse: Nanso, Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Wo ne nnipa no nkɔ, nanso asɛm a mɛka akyerɛ wo no nko na ka.” Enti Balaam ne wɔn kɔeɛ.

english_verse: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went to meet him at the town of Ir on the Arnon River, which is the northern border of Moab.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a ɔhene Balak tee sɛ Balaam reba no, ɔfirii kuro no mu kɔhyiaa no Asubɔnten Arnon ho wɔ ne hyeɛ so.

english_verse: Balak asked, “Why didn't you come when I invited you the first time? Did you think I wasn't going to pay you?”
translation_verse: Ɔbisaa Balaam sɛ, “Adɛn enti na wokyɛɛ saa? Anaasɛ, mehyɛɛ wo bɔ sɛ mɛhyɛ wo animuonyam no na wonnye nni?”

english_verse: “I'm here now,” Balaam answered. “But I will say only what God tells me to say.”
translation_verse: Balaam buaa sɛ, “Ɛwom sɛ maba deɛ, nanso menni tumi biara a mɛka asɛm biara agye asɛm a Onyankopɔn bɛka akyerɛ me sɛ menka no nko na mɛka.”

english_verse: They left and went to the town of Kiriath-Huzoth,
translation_verse: Balaam kaa ɔhene no ho ne no kɔɔ Kiria-Husot,

english_verse: where Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep and gave some of the meat to Balaam and the officials who were with him.
translation_verse: baabi a ɔhene Balak de anantwie ne nnwan bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na ɔde mmoa no bi maa Balaam ne ne mpanimfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa mmɔ afɔdeɛ no.

english_verse: The next morning, Balak took Balaam to the town of Bamoth-Baal. From there, Balaam could see some of the Israelites.
translation_verse: Adeɛ kyee anɔpa no, Balak faa Balaam de no kɔɔ Bamot-Baal atifi. Ɔfiri hɔ too nʼani hunuu sɛ Israelfoɔ no sam aseɛ hɔ.

english_verse: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars here, then bring seven bulls and seven rams.”
translation_verse: Balaam ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Si afɔrebukyia nson wɔ ha, na siesie anantwie mma nson ne nnwennini nson fa wɔn bɔ afɔdeɛ.”

english_verse: After Balak had done this, they sacrificed a bull and a ram on each altar.
translation_verse: Balak tiee Balaam asɛm no, enti ɔde nantwie ba ne odwennini ba bɔɔ afɔrebukyia nson no biara so afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Then Balaam said, “Wait here beside your offerings, and I'll go somewhere to be alone. Maybe the Lord will appear to me. If he does, I will tell you everything he says.” And he left.
translation_verse: Afei Balaam ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Sɔre gyina wo ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho na mɛhwɛ sɛ Awurade bɛhyia me, na asɛm a ɔbɛka akyerɛ me no nso, mɛka akyerɛ wo.” Enti, ɔforo kɔɔ apampam baabi.

english_verse: When God appeared to him, Balaam said, “I have built seven altars and have sacrificed a bull and a ram on each one.”
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na Onyankopɔn hyiaa no. Balaam ka kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ, “Masiesie afɔrebukyia nson. Mabɔ afɔrebukyia no biara so nantwie ba ne odwennini ba afɔdeɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Balaam a message, then sent him back to tell Balak.
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade de nkra maa Balaam sɛ ɔnkɔka nkyerɛ ɔhene Balak.

english_verse: When Balaam returned, he found Balak and his officials standing beside the offerings.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Balaam sane baeɛ no, na ɔhene no ne ahenemma a wɔfiri Moab no gyina ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho.

english_verse: Balaam said: “King Balak of Moab brought me from the hills of Syria to curse Israel and announce its doom.
translation_verse: Nkɔmhyɛ a Balaam de maaeɛ no nie: “Ɔhene Balak soma bɛfrɛɛ me firii Aram. Moabhene frɛɛ me firii apueeɛ fam nkokoɔ so. Ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Bra bɛdome Yakob ma me! Bra bɛka mmusuo a ɛbɛba Israelfoɔ so.’

english_verse: But I can't go against God! He did not curse or condemn Israel. *
translation_verse: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi madome wɔn a Onyankopɔn nnomee wɔn? Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi abu wɔn fɔ, nnipa a Awurade mmuu wɔn fɔ?

english_verse: “From the mountain peaks, I look down and see Israel, the obedient people of God.
translation_verse: Mehunu wɔn firi abotan atifi; mehwɛ wɔn firi nkokoɔ so. Mehunu nnipa a wɔte wɔn ho ase, a wɔayi wɔn afiri amanaman mu.

english_verse: They are living alone in peace. And though they are many, they don't bother the other nations. “I hope to obey God for as long as I live and to die in such peace.”
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtumi akan Yakob asefoɔ, wɔdɔɔso sɛ mfuturo? Hwan na ɔbɛtumi akan Israelfoɔ nkyɛmu ɛnan mu baako? Ma menwu sɛ ɔteneneeni; na mawieɛ nyɛ sɛ wɔn deɛ.”

english_verse: Balak said, “What are you doing? I asked you to come and place a curse on my enemies. But you have blessed them instead!”
translation_verse: Ɔhene Balak bisaa Balaam sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ me yi? Mede wo baa sɛ bɛdome mʼatamfoɔ, nanso woahyira wɔn!”

english_verse: Balaam answered, “I can say only what the Lord tells me.” Balaam's Second Message
translation_verse: Nanso, Balaam buaa sɛ, “Metumi aka biribi a Awurade nkaa sɛ menka anaa?” Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛtɔ So Mmienu

english_verse: Balak said to Balaam, “Let's go somewhere else. Maybe if you see a smaller part of the Israelites, you will be able to curse them for me.”
translation_verse: Afei, Balak ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Bra na yɛnkɔ baabi foforɔ. Yɛduru hɔ a, wobɛhunu ɔman Israel fa bi wɔ hɔ. Dome wɔn a wobɛhu wɔn wɔ hɔ no nyinaa.”

english_verse: So he took Balaam to a field on top of Mount Pisgah where lookouts were stationed. Then he built seven altars there and sacrificed a bull and a ram on each one.
translation_verse: Ɔhene Balak faa Balaam de no kɔɔ Sofim bepɔ Pisga atifi. Ɔsii afɔrebukyia nson wɔ hɔ. Ɛnna ɔde nantwie ba ne odwennini bɔɔ afɔrebukyia biara so afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: “Wait here beside your offerings,” Balaam said. “The Lord will appear to me over there.”
translation_verse: Afei, Balaam ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Gyina wo ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho wɔ ha na me nso merekɔhyia Awurade.”

english_verse: The Lord appeared to Balaam and gave him another message, then he told him to go and tell Balak.
translation_verse: Awurade hyiaa Balaam na ɔkaa asɛm a ɔnkɔka kyerɛɛ no.

english_verse: Balaam went back and saw him and his officials standing beside the offerings. Balak asked, “What did the Lord say?”
translation_verse: Enti, ɔsane baa baabi a ɔhene no ne Moab ahenemma no wɔ a wɔgyina wɔn ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho. Ɔhene no de ahopere bisaa sɛ, “Awurade aka sɛn?”

english_verse: Balaam answered: “Pay close attention to my words—
translation_verse: Nkɔmhyɛ a Balaam de maaeɛ no nie: “Balak, sɔre na tie; Sipor babarima tie me.

english_verse: God is no mere human! He doesn't tell lies or change his mind. God always keeps his promises.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nnyɛ onipa na wadi atorɔ; Ɔnyɛ onipa na wasesa nʼadwene. Wakasa a wanyɛ anaa? Wahyɛ bɔ bi pɛn a wanni so anaa?

english_verse: Israel's king is the Lord God. He lives there with them and intends them no harm.
translation_verse: “Menhunu amanehunu bi a ɛbɛba Yakob so. Ɔhaw biara nni hɔ mma Israel! Awurade, wɔn Onyankopɔn ka wɔn ho. Ɔne wɔn ɔhene!

english_verse: With the strength of a wild ox, God led Israel out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn ayi wɔn afiri Misraim; ɔte sɛ nantwie hoɔdenfoɔ ma wɔn.

english_verse: No magic charms can work against them— just look what God has done for his people.
translation_verse: Nnome biara renka Yakob, abayisɛm biara nni tumi wɔ Israel so. Na wɔbɛka wɔ Yakob ho sɛ, ‘Hwɛ anwanwadeɛ a Onyankopɔn ayɛ ama Israel!’

english_verse: They are like angry lions ready to attack; and they won't rest until their victim is gobbled up.”
translation_verse: Saa nnipa yi sɔre sɛ gyataburu. Wɔgyina hɔ sɛ gyata hoɔdenfoɔ. Ɔnnye nʼahome kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛwe nʼahaboa awie na wanom ne mogya nyinaa!”

english_verse: Balak shouted, “If you're not going to curse Israel, then at least don't bless them.”
translation_verse: Ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Balaam sɛ, “Sɛ worennome wɔn a, ɛnneɛ nhyira wɔn.”

english_verse: “I've already told you,” Balaam answered. “I will say only what the Lord tells me.” Balaam's Third Message
translation_verse: Nanso Balaam buaa no sɛ, “Manka ankyerɛ wo sɛ asɛm a Awurade bɛka akyerɛ me sɛ menka no na mɛka?” Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛtɔ So Mmiɛnsa

english_verse: Balak said to Balaam, “Come on, let's try another place. Maybe God will let you curse Israel from there.”
translation_verse: Afei, ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Balaam sɛ, “Mede wo bɛkɔ baabi foforɔ. Ebia, ɛhɔ bɛyɛ anisɔ ama Onyankopɔn sɛ wobɛgyina hɔ adome wɔn.”

english_verse: So he took Balaam to Mount Peor overlooking the desert north of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Enti, ɔhene Balak faa Balaam de no kɔɔ bepɔ Peor a ani kyerɛ anweatam no atifi pɛɛ so.

english_verse: Balaam said, “Build seven altars here, then bring me seven bulls and seven rams.”
translation_verse: Bio, Balaam ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ ɔnsi afɔrebukyia nson na ɔnsiesie nantwie mma nson ne nnwennini mma nson mma afɔrebɔ.

english_verse: After Balak had done what Balaam asked, he sacrificed a bull and a ram on each altar.
translation_verse: Ɔhene no yɛɛ deɛ Balaam kaeɛ no, enti ɔde nantwie ba ne odwennini ba bɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia nson no biara so.

english_verse: Balaam was sure that the Lord would tell him to bless Israel again. So he did not use any magic to find out what the Lord wanted him to do, as he had the first two times. Instead, he looked out toward the desert
translation_verse: Afei, Balaam hunuu sɛ Awurade pɛ sɛ ɔhyira Israel. Yei enti, wankɔ abisa sɛdeɛ ɔtaa yɛ no. Na mmom, ɔtoo nʼani hwɛɛ ɛserɛ no so,

english_verse: and saw the tribes of Israel camped below. Just then, God's Spirit took control of him,
translation_verse: hunuu sɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo no abobɔ wɔn atenaeɛ. Afei, Onyankopɔn honhom baa ne so,

english_verse: and Balaam said: “I am the son of Beor, and my words are true, so listen to my message!
translation_verse: na yei ne nkɔmhyɛ a ɔmaaeɛ: “Beor ba Balaam nkɔmhyɛ no nie; nkɔmhyɛ a ɛfiri ɔbarima a nʼani hunu adeɛ yie,

english_verse: It comes from the Lord, the God All-Powerful. I bowed down to him and saw a vision of Israel.
translation_verse: deɛ ɔte Onyankopɔn asɛm; deɛ ɔhunu anisoadeɛ a ɛfiri Otumfoɔ hɔ; na ɔda fam, a nʼani gu so:

english_verse: “People of Israel, your camp is lovely.
translation_verse: “Ao Yakob, mo ntomadan yɛ fɛ, Ao Israel, mo afie yɛ ahomeka.

english_verse: It's like a grove of palm trees or a garden beside a river. You are like tall aloe trees that the Lord has planted, or like cedars growing near water.
translation_verse: “Ɛsam mʼanim te sɛ mmɛfuo, te sɛ nturo frɔmfrɔm wɔ asubɔnten ho. Wɔte sɛ pɛperɛ a Awurade adua, te sɛ ntweneduro a ɛbɛn nsuo ho.

english_verse: You and your descendants will prosper like an orchard beside a stream. Your king will rule with power and be a greater king than Agag the Amalekite.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛnya nsuo bebree. Wɔn mma bɛnya deɛ ɛhia wɔn nyinaa. “Wɔn ɔhene bɛyɛ kɛse akyɛn Agag; wɔn ahennie bɛkorɔn.

english_verse: With the strength of a wild ox, God led you out of Egypt. You will defeat your enemies, shooting them with arrows and crushing their bones.
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn de wɔn firi Misraim aba; ɔtwee wɔn sɛ wiram nantwie. Ɔsɛe amanaman a wɔtia no nyinaa, ɔbubu wɔn nnompe mu asinasini, ɔto bɛmma wowɔ wɔn.

english_verse: Like a lion you lie down, resting after an attack. Who would dare disturb you? “Anyone who blesses you will be blessed; anyone who curses you will be cursed.”
translation_verse: Israel butu hɔ sɛ gyata; ɔte sɛ gyataburu, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi anyane no? “Ao Israel, nhyira nka obiara a ɔhyira wo, na nnome nka obiara a ɔdome wo.”

english_verse: When Balak heard this, he was so furious that he pounded his fist against his hand and said, “I called you here to place a curse on my enemies, and you've blessed them three times.
translation_verse: Ɔhene Balak bo fuu Balaam. Ɔde Abufuo bɔɔ ne nsam guu ne so teaam sɛ, “Mefrɛɛ wo sɛ bɛdome, mʼatamfoɔ nanso woahyira wɔn mprɛnsa.

english_verse: Leave now and go home! I told you I would pay you well, but since the Lord didn't let you do what I asked, you won't be paid.”
translation_verse: Firi me so kɔ! Sane kɔ wo nkyi! Meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ anka mɛhyɛ wo animuonyam, nanso, Awurade de akame wo!”

english_verse: that even if you offered me a palace full of silver or gold, I would still obey the Lord. And I explained that I would say only what he told me.
translation_verse: ‘Sɛ Balak ma me ahemfie a wɔde dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ ahyɛ hɔ ma koraa a, menni tumi sɛ mɛyɛ biribi atia Awurade apɛdeɛ.’ Meka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ asɛm a Awurade aka no nko ara na mɛka.

english_verse: So I'm going back home, but I'm leaving you with a warning about what the Israelites will someday do to your nation.” Balaam's Fourth Message
translation_verse: Afei, meresane akɔ me nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn. Nanso, deɛ ɛdi ɛkan no, ma menka deɛ Israelfoɔ no bɛyɛ wo nkurɔfoɔ daakye no nkyerɛ wo.” Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛdi Akyire No

english_verse: Balaam said: “I am the son of Beor, and my words are true, so listen to my message!
translation_verse: Yei ne nkɔmhyɛ a Balaam de maeɛ: “Beor ba Balaam nkɔmhyɛ no nie; nkɔmhyɛ a ɛfiri ɔbarima a nʼani hunu adeɛ yie,

english_verse: My knowledge comes from God Most High, the Lord All-Powerful. I bowed down to him and saw a vision of Israel.
translation_verse: deɛ ɔte Onyankopɔn asɛm; deɛ ɔwɔ nyansa a ɛfiri Ɔsorosoroni no deɛ ɔhunu anisoadeɛ a ɛfiri Otumfoɔ hɔ; na ɔda fam, a nʼani gu so:

english_verse: “What I saw in my vision hasn't happened yet. But someday, a king of Israel will appear like a star. He will wipe out you Moabites and destroy those tribes who live in the desert.
translation_verse: “Mɛhunu no, nanso ɛnyɛ seesei; mehwɛ no wɔ daakye akyirikyiri. Nsoromma bɛpue afiri Yakob mu! Ahempoma bɛfiri Israel mu. Ɔbɛyam Moabfoɔ tiri, na wapaapae Moab mma tikwankora.

english_verse: Israel will conquer Edom and capture the land of that enemy nation.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛfa Edom, na Seir a ɔyɛ ne ɔtamfoɔ no, wɔbɛdi ne so nkonim, na Israel bɛkɔ so adi nkonim.

english_verse: The king of Israel will rule and destroy the survivors of every town there.
translation_verse: Ɔhene bi bɛsɔre wɔ Yakob mu ɔno na ɔbɛsɛe Ir nkaeɛfoɔ.” Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛtɔ So Enum

english_verse: “And I saw this vision about the Amalekites: Their nation is now great, but it will someday disappear forever.
translation_verse: Afei, Balaam hwɛɛ Amalekfoɔ fie hyɛɛ nkɔm sɛ, “Amalek na na ɛyɛ aman nyinaa abakan, nanso ne hyɛberɛ ne ɔsɛeɛ!” Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛtɔ So Nsia

english_verse: “And this is what I saw about the Kenites: They think they're safe, living among the rocks,
translation_verse: Afei, ɔhwɛɛ Kenifoɔ hyɛɛ nkɔm sɛ, “Mo atenaeɛ yɛ pa ara, wanwono mo pirebuo wɔ abotan mu.

english_verse: but they will be wiped out when Assyria conquers them.
translation_verse: Nanso, wɔbɛsɛe Kenifoɔ ɛberɛ a Asurhene afa mo nnomum.” Balaam Nkɔmhyɛ A Ɛtɔ So Nson

english_verse: Ships will come from Cyprus, bringing people who will invade the lands of Assyria and Eber. But finally, Cyprus itself will be ruined.”
translation_verse: Ahyɛn bɛfiri Kipro mpoano aba Na abɛka Eber ne Asur ahyɛ. Nanso wɔn nso, wɔbɛsɛe wɔn pasaa.”

english_verse: After Balaam finished, he started home, and Balak also left.
translation_verse: Enti, Balaam ne Balak sane kɔɔ wɔn kurom.

english_verse: While the Israelites were camped at Acacia, some of the men had sex with Moabite women.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Israelfoɔ bɔɔ atenaseɛ wɔ Sitim no, wɔn mu mmarima no bi hyɛɛ aseɛ ne Moab mmabaawa no bɔɔ adwaman de guu wɔn ho fi.

english_verse: These women then invited the men to ceremonies where sacrifices were offered to their gods. The men ate the meat from the sacrifices and worshiped the Moabite gods.
translation_verse: Saa mmabaawa yi too nsa frɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmra wɔn afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ ma wɔn anyame no ase. Ankyɛre biara, mmarima no kɔɔ wɔn apontoɔ ase na wɔsomm Moab anyame.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with Israel because they had worshiped the god Baal Peor.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ tiawa bi akyi, Israelfoɔ no nyinaa kɔsom Baal-peor a ɔyɛ Moabfoɔ nyame. Yei maa Awurade bo fuu ne nkurɔfoɔ no yie.

english_verse: So he said to Moses, “Take the Israelite leaders who are responsible for this and have them killed in front of my sacred tent where everyone can see. Maybe then I will stop being angry with the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Ɔhyɛɛ saa mmara yi maa Mose sɛ, “Kunkum mpanimfoɔ a wɔtuatua Israel mmusuakuo no ano no nyinaa. Sɛn wɔn wɔ Awurade anim awia ketee sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, nʼabufuo a ano yɛ den no bɛfiri wɔn so.”

english_verse: Moses told Israel's officials, “Each of you must put to death any of your men who worshiped Baal.”
translation_verse: Enti, Mose hyɛɛ atemmufoɔ no ma wɔkunkumm wɔn a wɔsomm Baal-peor no nyinaa.

english_verse: Later, Moses and the people were at the sacred tent, crying, when one of the Israelite men brought a Midianite woman to meet his family.
translation_verse: Nanso, Israelni ɔhantanni bi de Midiani ababaawa bi baa wɔn atenaeɛ hɔ maa Mose ne nnipa no nyinaa hunuu no ɛberɛ a na wɔn nyinaa gyina Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no ɛpono akyi retwa adwo no.

english_verse: Phinehas, the grandson of Aaron the priest, saw the couple and left the crowd. He found a spear
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Pinehas a ɔyɛ Eleasa babarima a na ɔyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron nana hunuu yei no, ɔhuri sɔɔ pea mu

english_verse: and followed the man into his tent, where he ran the spear through the man and into the woman's stomach. The Lord immediately stopped punishing Israel with a deadly disease,
translation_verse: taa saa ɔbarima no so de no kɔwuraa ne ntomadan mu baabi a ɔfaa ɔbaa no. Ɔde pea no wowɔɔ ɔbarima no sane de wɔɔ ɔbaa no yafunu mu. Enti, ɔhaw no to twaa wɔ Israelfoɔ no mu,

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: “In my anger, I would have wiped out the Israelites if Phinehas had not been faithful to me.
translation_verse: “Eleasa babarima Pinehas a ɔyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron nana adwodwo mʼabufuo ano, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔbɔɔ mmɔden te sɛ me ara wɔ mʼanimuonyam ho, enti sɛdeɛ meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ mɛsɛe Israelfoɔ nyinaa no, magyae.

english_verse: But instead of punishing them, I forgave them. So because of the loyalty that Phinehas showed, I solemnly promise that he and his descendants will always be my priests.”
translation_verse: Saa apam yi mu, ɔno ne nʼasefoɔ bɛyɛ asɔfoɔ afebɔɔ, ɛfiri sɛ watwe me, ne Onyankopɔn, ho ninkunu wɔ Israelfoɔ mu de ayɛ mpata ama wɔn.”

english_verse: The Israelite man that was killed was Zimri son of Salu, who was one of the leaders of the Simeon tribe.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima a wɔkumm no ne Midiani ababaawa no, na ne din de Simri a na ɔyɛ Salu a ɔtua Simeon abusuakuo ano no babarima.

english_verse: And the Midianite woman killed with him was Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite clan leader named Zur.
translation_verse: Ɔbaa no nso, na ne din de Kosbi a na ɔyɛ Midianhene babarima Sur babaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: “The Midianites are now enemies of Israel, so attack and defeat them! They tricked the people of Israel into worshiping their god at Peor, and they are responsible for the death of Cozbi, the daughter of one of their own leaders.”
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, wɔfaa mo sɛ atamfoɔ, na wɔdaadaa mo ma mosomm Baal-peor, ne Kosbi a ɔyɛ Midian ntuanoni babaa a wɔkumm no wɔ Peor ɔyaredɔm ɛda no.”

english_verse: After the Lord had stopped the deadly disease from killing the Israelites, he said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron,
translation_verse: Ɔyaredɔm no akyi no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron babarima Eleasa sɛ,

english_verse: “I want you to find out how many Israelites are in each family. Then make a list of every man
translation_verse: “Monkan Israelfoɔ mmarima a wɔadi mfeɛ aduonu ne deɛ ɛboro saa nyinaa na monhwɛ dodoɔ a wɔbɛtumi akɔ ɔsa wɔ abusua biara mu.”

english_verse: Israel was now camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from the town of Jericho. Moses and Eleazar told them
translation_verse: Saa ɛberɛ no, na Israelman no nyinaa abɔ atenaeɛ wɔ Moab tata so, wɔ Asubɔnten Yordan ho a na wɔne Yeriko di nhwɛanimu. Enti Mose ne ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa kaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa nnipakan no ho kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ ntuanofoɔ no sɛ,

english_verse: Pallu was the father of Eliab
translation_verse: Na Palu yɛ Eliab aseni,

english_verse: and the grandfather of Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram who had been chosen by the people, but who followed Korah and rebelled against Moses, Aaron, and the Lord.
translation_verse: na Nemuel na ɔwoo Eliab, Datan ne Abiram. Saa Datan ne Abiram yi ara na wɔyɛ nnipa no ntuanofoɔ a wɔne Kora yɛɛ adwene tiaa Mose ne Aaron, de buu Awurade animtia.

english_verse: That's when the Lord made the earth open up and swallow Dathan, Abiram, and Korah. At the same time, fire destroyed
translation_verse: Na asase mu bue menee wɔn ne Kora. Egya firi Awurade nkyɛn bɛsɛee wɔn akyidifoɔ ahanu aduonum. Yei yɛɛ kɔkɔbɔ maa Israelman nyinaa.

english_verse: But the Korahite clan wasn't destroyed.
translation_verse: Nanso, Kora mmammarima deɛ, wɔanwuwu da no. Simeon Abusuakuo

english_verse: None of the people that Moses and Aaron had counted in the Sinai Desert were still alive,
translation_verse: Saa nnipa yi nyinaa, wɔn mu baako mpo nni hɔ a nnipakan a ɛdi ɛkan no, wɔkan no wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ so hɔ,

english_verse: Aaron was the father of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Aaron woo Nadab, Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: “Divide the land of Canaan among these tribes, according to the number of people in each one,
translation_verse: “Kyekyɛ asase no ma mmusua no sɛdeɛ wɔn dodoɔ teɛ.

english_verse: The total number of Israelite men listed was
translation_verse: Enti, nnipa dodoɔ a wɔkan wɔn no ano si mpem ahansia ne baako ahanson aduasa (

english_verse: so the larger tribes have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Ma abusua a ɛso no asase kɛseɛ na abusua a ɛsua no asase ketewa.

english_verse: I will show you what land to give each tribe, and they will receive as much land as they need, according to the number of people in it.”
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ ntonto wɔ agyapadeɛ no kyekyɛ so wɔ akuo akɛseɛ ne nketewa no mu.”

english_verse: as well as the clans of Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi, and Korah. Kohath the Levite was the father of Amram,
translation_verse: Yeinom nso yɛ Lewifoɔ mmusua: Libnifoɔ, Hebronfoɔ, Mahlifoɔ, Musifoɔ ne Korafoɔ. Kohat yɛ Amram tete agya;

english_verse: the husband of Levi's daughter Jochebed, who was born in Egypt. Amram and Jochebed's three children were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Lewi wɔ Misraim no, wɔwoo ɔbabaa a ne din de Yokebed. Kehat babarima Amram waree no. Wɔn na wɔwoo Aaron, Mose ne Miriam.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu had died when they offered fire that was unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nanso, ɛberɛ a Nadab ne Abihu de ogya a ɛnyɛ kronkron brɛɛ Awurade no, wɔwuwuiɛ.

english_verse: In the tribe of Levi there were
translation_verse: Nnipakan no mu na Lewifoɔ nyinaa dodoɔ yɛ mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa (

english_verse: men and boys at least a month old. They were not listed with the other tribes, because they would not receive any land in Canaan.
translation_verse: ). Wɔkan mmarima a wɔadi firi bosome kɔsi mpanimfoɔ so. Nanso, wɔammu Lewifoɔ no ano anka Israel nnipakan no ho, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔrekyɛ nsase no ama mmusuakuo no, wɔamma Lewifoɔ no bi.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar counted the Israelites while they were camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Enti, sɛdeɛ Mose ne ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa fa kyerɛɛ nnipa no ano wɔ Moab bepɔ a ɛbɛn Asubɔnten Yordan na ɛne Yeriko di nhwɛanimu no ne no.

english_verse: except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun. The Lord had said that everyone else would die there in the desert.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, na mfeɛ aduanan atwam enti na wɔn a wɔkan wɔn kane no nyinaa awuwu sɛdeɛ Awurade kaeɛ sɛ. “Wɔbɛwuwu wɔ ɛserɛ so” no. Wɔn a ɛkaa wɔn ara ne Yefune ba Kaleb ne Nun babarima Yosua.

english_verse: One day his daughters went to the sacred tent, where they met with Moses, Eleazar, and some other leaders of Israel, as well as a large crowd of Israelites. The young women said:
translation_verse: Na mmaa no yɛ Yosef babarima Manase abusuafoɔ fa bi. Na wɔn ase firi Makir a ɔyɛ Manase babarima no fie. Na Manase babarima Gilead yɛ wɔn nana nkansowa ɛnna ne babarima Hefer nso yɛ wɔn nana ɛnna wɔn babarima Selofehad yɛ wɔn agya.

english_verse: You know that our father died in the desert. But it was for something he did wrong, not for joining with Korah in rebelling against the Lord. Our father left no sons
translation_verse: Wɔkaa sɛ, “Yɛn agya wuu ɛserɛ so nanso na ɔnka wɔn a wɔne Kora yɛɛ dɔm tiaa Awurade a enti ɛmaa wɔwuwuiɛ no ho. Ɔno ankasa bɔne enti na ɔwuiɛ.

english_verse: to carry on his family name. But why should his name die out for that reason? Give us some land like the rest of his relatives in our clan, so our father's name can live on.
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na ɛsiane sɛ yɛn agya anwo ɔbabarima enti ne din ayera? Yɛgye di sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma yɛn agyapadeɛ a yɛn agya nuammarimanom anya no bi.”

english_verse: Moses asked the Lord what should be done,
translation_verse: Enti Mose de wɔn asɛm too Awurade anim.

english_verse: and the Lord answered:
translation_verse: Awurade buaa Mose sɛ,

english_verse: Zelophehad's daughters are right. They should each be given part of the land their father would have received.
translation_verse: “Asɛm a Selofehad mmammaa no ka no yɛ nokorɛ. Ma wɔn ne wɔn agya nuanom no asase. Fa agyapadeɛ a sɛ wɔn agya no te ase a anka ɔbɛnya no ma wɔn.

english_verse: If he has no daughter, his brothers will inherit the land.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔnni ɔbabaa nso a, ɛsɛ sɛ agyapadeɛ no kɔ ne nuammarima nkyɛn.

english_verse: But if he has no brothers, his father's brothers will inherit the land.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔnni nuammarima a, ɛkɔ ne wɔfanom nkyɛn.

english_verse: And if his father has no brothers, the land must be given to his nearest relative in the clan. This is my law, and the Israelites must obey it. Joshua Is Appointed Israel's Leader (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔnni wɔn mu biara bi a, ɛkɔ ne busuani bi a ɔbɛn no nkyɛn. Ɛsɛ sɛ Israelfoɔ di saa mmara a Awurade hyɛɛ Mose no so.” Wɔyi Yosua Sɛ Mose Abadiakyire

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “One day you will go up into the Abarim Mountains, and from there you will see the land I am giving the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ɛda bi, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ, “Kɔ bepɔ a ɛwɔ Abarim mmepɔ no so na to wʼani fa asubɔnten a ɛda hɔ no so ma ɛnkɔsi asase a mede maa Israelfoɔ no so.

english_verse: After you have seen it, you will die, just like your brother Aaron,
translation_verse: Sɛ wohwɛ wie a, wobɛwu sɛdeɛ wo nua Aaron wuiɛ no,

english_verse: because both of you disobeyed me at Meribah near the town of Kadesh in the Zin Desert. When the Israelites insulted me there, you didn't believe in my holy power.”
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, wosɔre tiaa me mmara wɔ Sin ɛserɛ so hɔ. Ɛberɛ a Israelfoɔ no sɔre tiaa me no, woamma wɔanhunu me kronkronyɛ wɔ nsuo no ho.” Na ɔretwe nʼadwene aba Meriba nsuo “Akoeɛ” a ɛwɔ Kades a ɛwɔ Sin ɛserɛ so no so.

english_verse: “You are the Lord God, and you know what is in everyone's heart. So I ask you to appoint a leader for Israel.
translation_verse: “Ao Awurade, Onyankopɔn a woyɛ nnipa nyinaa honhom ti ansa na worebɛfa me no, mesrɛ, yi obi si mʼanan

english_verse: Your people need someone to lead them into battle, or else they will be like sheep wandering around without a shepherd.”
translation_verse: a ɔde wɔn bɛkɔ ɔko na ɔbɛhwɛ wɔn so sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a Awurade nnipa bɛnya odwanhwɛfoɔ a ɔbɛhwɛ wɔn so.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Joshua son of Nun can do the job. Place your hands on him to show that he is the one to take your place.
translation_verse: Awurade buaa no sɛ, “Kɔ na kɔfrɛ Nun babarima Yosua a ɔwɔ Honhom no wɔ ne mu no,

english_verse: Then go with him and tell him to stand in front of Eleazar the priest and the Israelites. Appoint Joshua as their new leader
translation_verse: na fa no kɔ ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa nkyɛn, na nnipa no nyinaa rehwɛ mo no, fa nnipa no animdie so tumi hyɛ ne nsa.

english_verse: and tell them they must now obey him, just as they obey you.
translation_verse: Fa wo tumi ma no wɔ badwam sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, Israelfoɔ nyinaa bɛtie no.

english_verse: But Joshua must depend on Eleazar to find out from me what I want him to do as he leads Israel into battle.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔhia akwankyerɛ a ɛfiri Awurade hɔ a, Yosua bɛgyina ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa anim, na ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa abɔ ntonto kronkron de abisa Awurade apɛdeɛ. Saa ɛkwan yi so na Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no bɛfa so ahwehwɛ deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ.”

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions and took Joshua to Eleazar and the people,
translation_verse: Enti, Mose yɛɛ deɛ Awurade hyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ no. Ɔde Yosua kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne nnipa no nyinaa.

english_verse: then he placed his hands on Joshua and appointed him Israel's leader.
translation_verse: Mose de ne nsa guu no so, de nʼadwuma hyɛɛ ne nsa sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: na mode lita mmienu ne fa bɛka nnwammaa nson no biara ho.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices will please me.
translation_verse: na odwammaa biara nso, mode asikyiresiam lita mmienu ne ɛfa. Saa afɔrebɔdeɛ yi wɔde ogya na ɛbɛhye, na ɛbɛsɔ Awurade ani.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Offer sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, so that I will smell the smoke and be pleased.
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ, afɔrebɔdeɛ a mohye no wɔ afɔrebukyia so no yɛ mʼaduane a mʼani gye ho. ‘Enti, hwɛ na wɔmfa mmra wɔ ɛberɛ-ano-berɛ-ano na wɔmfa mmɔ afɔdeɛ sɛdeɛ mahyɛ no.

english_verse: Each day offer two rams a year old as sacrifices to please me. The animals must have nothing wrong with them;
translation_verse: Sɛ mobɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a, momfa nnwennini mma a wɔadi afe a wɔnni dɛm biara na ɛmmɔ Awurade afɔdeɛ no. Ɛda biara, momfa mmienu mmɔ afɔdeɛ. Mommɔ no wɔ berɛ-ano-berɛ ano.

english_verse: Along with each of them, one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Sɛ morebɔ saa afɔdeɛ no a, momfa aburoo lita mmienu ne fa a wɔayam no muhumuhu na wɔde ngo afra nka ho.

english_verse: Finally, along with each of these two sacrifices, a liter of wine must be poured on the altar as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ɔnom afɔrebɔdeɛ a ɛyɛ nsã a apae lita baako a odwammaa ka ho ka afɔrebɔdeɛ no ho a wɔbɛhwie agu beaeɛ bi a ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: On the first day of each month, bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Saa ara nso na ɛda a ɛdi ɛkan wɔ bosome biara mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ mobɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ foforɔ bi ka ho de ma Awurade. Afɔrebɔdeɛ no bɛyɛ nantwinini mma mmienu, odwennini baako ne nnwammaa nson a wɔadi afe a wɔnnii dɛm biara.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mode ka ho ne asikyiresiam lita nsia ne ɛfa a wɔayam no muhumuhu de ngo afra. Ɛno na mode bɛka nantwie baako biara ho. Afei, mode asikyiresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu lita ɛnan a wɔde ngo afra bɛbɔ aburoo afɔdeɛ a odwennini no ka ho;

english_verse: Celebrate Passover in honor of me on the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: “ ‘Afe biara bosome a ɛdi ɛkan no ɛda a ɛtɔ so dunan no nso, mobɛdi Awurade Twam Afahyɛ no.

english_verse: The following day will begin the Festival of Thin Bread, which will last for a week. During this time you must honor me by eating bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Ɛda a ɛdi so no, mobɛfiti aseɛ adi dapɔnna a wɔde anigyeɛ di no nnanson no, nanso, morenni burodo a mmɔreka wɔ mu.

english_verse: On the first day of this festival, you must rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: Afahyɛ no ɛda a ɛdi ɛkan no, nnipa no nyinaa bɛbɔ ahoteɛ dwa na obiara renyɛ adwuma biara.

english_verse: Bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. And then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Mode nantwie mma mmienu, odwennini baako ne nnwammaa a wɔadi afe a wɔnnii dɛm bɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ama Awurade.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Mode esiam lita nson a mode ngo afra bɛka nantwie baako biara ho. Afei, mode esiam lita enum bɛka odwennini no ho,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: na nnwan nson no biara nso, mode esiam lita mmiɛnsa aka ho.

english_verse: All of these are to be offered each day of the festival in additional to the regular sacrifices, and the smoke from them will please me.
translation_verse: Nna nson no mu ɛda biara adidie mu no, mobɛbɔ saa afɔdeɛ korɔ yi ara bi. Ɛbɛyɛ Awurade anisɔ yie.

english_verse: Then on the last day of the festival, you must once again rest from work and come together for worship. The Sacrifices during the Harvest Festival (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɛbɛyɛ ɛda kronkron bio a nnipa no nyinaa bɛhyia mu na saa ɛda no, obiara renyɛ adwuma biara.

english_verse: Offer two young bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ sononko a ɛsɔ ani na ɛsɛ sɛ saa ɛda no, mobɔ ma Awurade. Afɔrebɔdeɛ no bɛyɛ anantwie mma mmienu, odwennini baako ne nnwammaa anini a wɔadi mfeɛ nson.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Mode mo aburoo lita nsia ne fa a wɔayam no muhumuhu a mode ngo afra bɛka nantwie baako ho. Mode lita ɛnan bɛka odwennini no ho;

english_verse: Also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Afei, momfa ɔpapo baako nyɛ mpatadeɛ mma mo ho.

english_verse: The animals must have nothing wrong with them and are to be sacrificed along with the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Saa afɔdeɛ ahodoɔ sononko yi ka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, aburoo afɔdeɛ ne nsã afɔdeɛ no ho. Monhwɛ sɛ mmoa a mode wɔn rekɔbɔ saa afɔdeɛ no nnii dɛm biara ansa na mode wɔn abɔ saa afɔdeɛ no.

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, you must rest from your work and come together to celebrate at the sound of the trumpets.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no ɛda a ɛdi ɛkan wɔ afe biara mu no, monhyɛ totorobɛnto afahyɛ no. Nnipa no nyinaa de kommyɛ bɛhyia na obiara renyɛ adwuma biara.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Mode aburoo lita nsia ne fa a wɔayam no muhumuhu a wɔde ngo afra bɛbɔ aburoo afɔdeɛ no a nantwie no ka ho. Wɔde lita ɛnan bɛka odwennini no ho

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: ɛnna lita mmienu ne fa nso ka nnwammaa no baako biara ho.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ mosane de ɔpapo bɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ de yei yɛ mo mpatadeɛ.

english_verse: These sacrifices will be made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices and the sacrifices for the first day of the month. The smoke from these sacrifices will please me. The Sacrifices on the Great Day of Forgiveness (Leviticus
translation_verse: Saa afɔrebɔ sononko yi ka ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a mobɔ no bosome biara ne ɛda no deɛ no ho; afei nso, ɛka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a mobɔ a aburoo ne nsã afɔrebɔ ka ho no ho sɛdeɛ afɔrebɔ no ho mmara teɛ no. Ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛsɔ Awurade ani. Mpata Da Afɔrebɔ

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. On that day you must rest from all work and come together for worship. Show sorrow for your sins by going without food,
translation_verse: “ ‘Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no ɛda a ɛtɔ so edu no, ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa no nyinaa sane hyia bio. Ɛyɛ ɛda a ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa no nyinaa yɛ komm ahobrɛaseɛ mu wɔ Awurade anim, na ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔn mu biara yɛ adwuma biara.

english_verse: and bring to the altar one young bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Saa ɛda no, mobɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ama Awurade—nʼani bɛsɔ. Afɔrebɔdeɛ no yɛ nantwie ba baako, odwennini baako, nnwammaanini nson a wɔadi afe a wɔnnii dɛm biara.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Fa nantwie ba no siesie atokoɔ afɔdeɛ a mode asikyiresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu ne ngo lita nsia ne fa afra.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: Lita ɛnan na mode bɛka odwennini no ho ɛnna mode lita mmienu ne fa aka odwammaa baako biara ho.

english_verse: A goat must also be sacrificed for the sins of the people. You will offer these sacrifices in addition to the sacrifice to ask forgiveness and the regular daily sacrifices. The Sacrifices during the Festival of Shelters (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ mode ɔpapo baako bɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ. Yei ka bɔne afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ de pata ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ no daadaa a aduane afɔrebɔdeɛ ne nsã afɔdeɛ ka ho. Asese Afahyɛ

english_verse: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no ɛda a ɛtɔ so dunum no, ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa no nyinaa sane hyia bio. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛda no, obiara yɛ adwuma. Ɛyɛ nnanson afahyɛ ahyɛaseɛ wɔ Awurade anim.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the rams,
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ, sɛdeɛ moyɛ no daa no, mode atokoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ, asikyiresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu lita nsia ne fa ka anantwie mma dumiɛnsa no biara ho. Lita ɛnan ka nnwennini no baako biara ho

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: ɛnna lita mmienu ne fa aka nnwammaa dunan no baako biara ho.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These are to be offered in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ mode ɔpapo bɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a mobɔ no ho a aburoo ne nsã afɔdeɛ ka ho.

english_verse: For the next six days of the festival, you will sacrifice one less bull than the day before, so that on the seventh day, seven bulls will be sacrificed. The other sacrifices and offerings must remain the same for each of these days.
translation_verse: Afei, mode ɔpapo baako bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ a atokoɔ ne nsã afɔrebɔdeɛ ka ho aka daa afɔrebɔ no ho sɛdeɛ moyɛ no daa no.

english_verse: On the eighth day, you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɛda a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, frɛ nnipa no nyinaa na wɔnhyia kommyɛ so. Ɛnsɛ sɛ moyɛ adwuma biara saa ɛda no.

english_verse: Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Mommɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ. Awurade ani sɔ saa afɔdeɛ no. Momfa nantwie ba baako, odwennini baako, nnwammaanini a wɔadi afe a wɔnnii dɛm nson mmɔ afɔdeɛ.

english_verse: You must also offer the proper grain sacrifices and drink offerings of wine with each animal.
translation_verse: Na sɛ morebɔ saa afɔdeɛ no a, momfa atokoɔ ne nsã afɔrebɔdeɛ nka ho.

english_verse: And offer a goat as the sacrifice to ask forgiveness for the people. These sacrifices are made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Afei, mode ɔpapo baako bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ a atokoɔ ne nsã afɔrebɔdeɛ ka ho a daa afɔdeɛ a mobɔ no nso ka ho.

english_verse: You must offer all these sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, together with any offerings that are voluntarily given or given because of a promise.
translation_verse: “ ‘Sɛ mohyia didi afirinhyia no mu a, twa ara na ɛtwa sɛ mobɔ saa afɔdeɛ yi ma Awurade. Na ɛka mo afɔrebɔ a mobɔ fa ɛbɔ a moahyɛ anaa deɛ ɛfiri mo pɛ mu a ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, atokoɔ afɔdeɛ, nsã afɔdeɛ anaa asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho.’ ”

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel everything the Lord had told him about the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mose kaa saa mmara yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ no no.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to Israel's tribal leaders:
translation_verse: Afei, Mose hyiaa Israel mmusua no mu mpanimfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Awurade ahyɛ sɛ,

english_verse: When one of you men makes a promise to the Lord, you must keep your word.
translation_verse: sɛ obi hyɛ Awurade bɔ anaa ɔka ntam hyɛ bɔ no, ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔbu so. Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɔka sɛ ɔbɛyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Suppose a young woman who is still living with her parents makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ababaawa bi hyɛ Awurade bɔ anaa ɔka ntam hyɛ bɔ ɛberɛ a ɔda so te nʼagya fie,

english_verse: If her father hears about it and says nothing, she must keep her promise.
translation_verse: na nʼagya no te sɛ ne ba no ahyɛ bɔ, na wanka hwee a, ne bɔhyɛ no di mu.

english_verse: But if he hears about it and objects, then she no longer has to keep her promise. The Lord will forgive her, because her father did not agree with the promise.
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ ɛba sɛ nʼagya no si no bɔhyɛ no ho ɛkwan ɛda a ɔbɛte no a, ɔde sɛe bɔhyɛ no. Awurade de bɛkyɛ ababaawa no, ɛfiri sɛ, nʼagya ampene sɛ ɔbɛdi so.

english_verse: Suppose a woman makes a promise to the Lord and then gets married. If her husband later hears about the promise but says nothing, she must do what she said, whether she meant it or not.
translation_verse: na ne kunu no te saa bɔhyɛ no ho asɛm nanso wanka ho hwee ɛda no ara a, ne bɔhyɛ no di dwuma.

english_verse: But if her husband hears about the promise and objects, she no longer has to keep it, and the Lord will forgive her.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ne kunu no po bɔhyɛ bɔne no a, po a ɔpoeɛ no di mu enti, Awurade de bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: Widows and divorced women must keep every promise they make to the Lord.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɔbaa yɛ okunafoɔ anaa wɔagyaa no aware a, ɛkwan biara so, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔdi ne bɔhyɛ nyinaa so.

english_verse: Suppose a married woman makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: “Sɛ waware na ɔte ne kunu fie a ɛhɔ na ɔhyɛɛ ɛbɔ no,

english_verse: If her husband hears about the promise and says nothing, she must do what she said.
translation_verse: na ne kunu no teeɛ na wanka ho hwee a, ne bɔhyɛ no di mu.

english_verse: But if he hears about the promise and does object, she no longer has to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband would not allow her to keep the promise.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛda no ara a ɔteeɛ no, sɛ wampene so a, ne bɔhyɛ no nni mu na Awurade de bɛkyɛ no.

english_verse: Her husband has the final say about any promises she makes to the Lord.
translation_verse: Enti, ne kunu na ɔbɛsi so dua anaasɛ ɔbɛkasa atia bɔhyɛ no.

english_verse: But if he waits until the next day to stop her from keeping her promise, he is the one who must be punished.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔtwɛn ma ɛda koro fa so na sɛ ɔbɛka sɛ bɔhyɛ no nni mu a, ɛho asotwe biara a ɔbaa no penee so no bɛba ɔbarima no so.”

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave Moses about husbands and wives, and about young daughters who still live at home.
translation_verse: Yei ne mmara a Awurade nam Mose so de maa ɔbarima ne ne yere ne agya ne ne babaa a wɔn nyinaa te efie baako mu no.

english_verse: “Before you die, make sure that the Midianites are punished for what they did to Israel.”
translation_verse: “Esiane sɛ Midianfoɔ daadaa mo de mo kɔɔ abosonsom mu no enti, tɔ wɔn so awere. Yei akyi no wɔbɛwu na wɔakɔ wɔn agyanom nkyɛn.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “The Lord wants to punish the Midianites. So tell our men to prepare for battle.
translation_verse: Mose ka kyerɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ no sɛ, “Monyi mmarima no mu bi na wɔnkɔ Awurade aweretɔ sa a ɔde tia Midianfoɔ no.

english_verse: Twelve thousand men were picked from the tribes of Israel, and after they were prepared for battle,
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ saa nyaa mmarima mpem dumienu siesie wɔn maa ɔko no.

english_verse: Moses sent them off to war. Phinehas the son of Eleazar went with them and took along some things from the sacred tent and the trumpets for sounding the battle signal.
translation_verse: Afei Mose ma wɔkɔeɛ, nnipa apem baako a wɔfiri abusuakuo biara mu. Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa babarima Pinehas na ɔdii wɔn anim kɔɔ ɔko no. Wɔrekɔ no, wɔde kronkronneɛ a ɛwɔ kronkronbea hɔ ne totorobɛnto a wɔbɛhyɛn akanyane akodɔm no kɔeɛ.

english_verse: The Israelites fought against the Midianites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. They killed all the men,
translation_verse: Na sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no, wɔkumm Midian mmarima nyinaa wɔ ɔko no mu.

english_verse: including Balaam son of Beor and the five Midianite kings, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔkumm wɔn no bi ne Midian ahemfo baanum a wɔn edin de Ewi, Rekem, Sur, Hur ne Reba. Beor babarima Balaam nso, wɔkumm no.

english_verse: The Israelites captured every woman and child, then led away the Midianites' cattle and sheep, and took everything else that belonged to them.
translation_verse: Afei, Israel asraafoɔ no kyekyeree Midian mmaa ne mmɔfra nyinaa ne wɔn anantwie ne wɔn nnwan fom nneɛma pii kaa ho.

english_verse: They also burned down the Midianite towns and villages.
translation_verse: Wɔtoo Midian nkuro ne nkuraa nyinaa mu ogya, hyee no pasaa.

english_verse: Israel's soldiers gathered together everything they had taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals.
translation_verse: Wɔfaa asadeɛ ne afodeɛ a nnipa no ne mmoa ka ho.

english_verse: Then they returned to their own camp in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, where Moses, Eleazar, and the other Israelite leaders met the troops outside camp.
translation_verse: Mose ne ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne mpanimfoɔ a wɔtuatua nnipa no ano no kɔhyiaa nkonimdifoɔ no ɛkwan.

english_verse: Moses became angry with the army commanders
translation_verse: Nanso, Mose bo fuu mpanimfoɔ a wɔtuatua akodɔm no ano no.

english_verse: and said, “I can't believe you let the women live!
translation_verse: Ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ, “Adɛn enti na moankunkum mmaa no?

english_verse: You must put to death every boy and all the women who have ever had sex.
translation_verse: Monkunkum mmarimaa no nyinaa. Afei, monkunkum mmaa a wɔne mmarima adeda no nyinaa.

english_verse: But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.”
translation_verse: Mommfa mo nsa nka mmaayewa nketewa no. Wɔn deɛ, momfa wɔn na mo ne wɔn nkɔtena.

english_verse: Then Moses said to the soldiers, “If you killed anyone or touched a dead body, you are unclean and have to stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third and seventh days, you must go through a ceremony to make yourselves and your captives clean.
translation_verse: “Afei, momfiri atenaeɛ ha nkɔtena baabi nnanson, ɛfiri sɛ, mo nyinaa moakum nnipa anaa mode mo nsa aka efunu. Monnwira mo ho ne mo nneduafoɔ ne nnansa ne ne nnanson so.

english_verse: Then wash your clothes and anything made from animal skin, goat's hair, or wood.”
translation_verse: Monkae na monnwira mo ntadeɛ ne biribiara a wɔde aboa nwoma, abirekyie nwi anaa dua ayɛ.”

english_verse: Eleazar then explained, “If you need to purify something that won't burn, such as gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead, you must first place it in a hot fire. translation_verse: ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ka ogya sɛdeɛ ɛho bɛte. Yei akyi, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ahodwira nsuo dwira ho ma ɛho te. Nanso, biribiara a ɛrentumi nnyina ogya ano no deɛ, wɔmfa nsuo nnwira ho.

english_verse: Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and after that, you will be clean and may return to the camp.” Everything Taken from the Midianites Is Divided

translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every
translation_verse: Fa saa kyɛfa yi ma ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa na ɔnhim no afɔrebukyia no anim mfa mma Awurade.

english_verse: So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.”
translation_verse: Ɛno enti, yɛfiri deɛ yɛnyaa no ɔko no mu no bi mu rebɛda Awurade ase. Yɛn asedadeɛ no yɛ sika adwinneɛ, nkapo, nkawa, nsonkawa ne kɔnmuadeɛ. Yeinom bɛyɛ mpatadeɛ ama yɛn kra wɔ Awurade anim.”

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar followed the Lord's instructions
translation_verse: Enti, Mose ne ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa yɛɛ deɛ Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no.

english_verse: sheep and goats,

translation_verse: Afei, asraafoɔ mpanimfoɔ baa Mose nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ,

english_verse: and said, “Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing.
translation_verse: “Owura yɛabu nnipa a yɛde wɔn kɔɔ ɔko no nyinaa ano akyerɛ wo na yɛn mu baako koraa anyera.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar accepted the jewelry from the commanders,
translation_verse: Mose ne ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa gyee saa akyɛdeɛ yi a ɛyɛ sikakɔkɔɔ ne adwinneɛ firii asraafoɔ mpanimfoɔ no nkyɛn.

english_verse: This did not include the things that the soldiers had kept for themselves.
translation_verse: Na asraafoɔ no afa ɔko no mu nneɛma a wɔnyaeɛ no bi.

english_verse: So Moses and Eleazar placed the gold in the Lord's sacred tent to remind Israel of what had happened.
translation_verse: Enti Mose ne Eleasa gyee akyɛdeɛ no firii asraafoɔ mpanimfoɔ no hɔ, na wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ no baa Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu sɛ ɛnyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ mma Awurade sɛ Israelfoɔ yɛ ne dea.

english_verse: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ, sɛ asase no ho asɛm dwo brɛoo wɔ Awurade anim a, motumi sane ba. Ɛba saa a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ, moayɛ mo asɛdeɛ ama Awurade ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa. Na asase a ɛda apueeɛ no nso, Awurade de bɛma mo.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.
translation_verse: Na Ruben ne Gad mmusuakuo no wɔ nyɛmmoa pii, enti wohunuu sɛ Yaser ne Gilead nsase no bɛyɛ ama wɔn nnwan ne anantwie no,

english_verse: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said,
translation_verse: wɔkɔɔ Mose ne ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne nnipa no ntuanofoɔ no nkyɛn. Wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ,

english_verse: “The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep,
translation_verse: Saa nsase yi nyinaa, Awurade ako, agye ama Israelfoɔ. Ɛbɛyɛ ama yɛn nnwan ne yɛn anantwie.

english_verse: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛanya adom wɔ mo anim a, yɛsrɛ mo momfa saa asase yi mma yɛn sɛ yɛn kyɛfa na monnyae Asubɔnten Yordan fa nohoa a mopɛ sɛ mode ma yɛn no.”

english_verse: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?
translation_verse: Mose nso bisaa Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ no sɛ, “Mokyerɛ sɛ, mopɛ sɛ motena ha wɔ ɛberɛ a mo nuanom atwa mu rekɔko?

english_verse: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.
translation_verse: Mopɛ sɛ mobu nnipa a aka no aba mu ma wɔsane sɛ wɔrenkɔ asase a Awurade de ama wɔn no so no?

english_verse: This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.
translation_verse: Ade koro yi ara na mo agyanom yɛeɛ. Mesomaa wɔn firii Kades-Barnea sɛ wɔnkɔsra asase no

english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: nanso ɛberɛ a wɔwiee nsra no na wɔfiri Eskol subɔnhwa mu baeɛ no, wɔbuu nnipa no aba mu sɛ wɔrenkɔ Awurade Bɔhyɛ Asase no so.

english_verse: The Lord became very angry.
translation_verse: Na Awurade bo fuu wɔn enti ɔkaa ntam sɛ,

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose kaa sɛ, “Ɛyɛ. Sɛ mobɛyɛ sɛdeɛ moaka no, na mode akodeɛ ahyehyɛ mo ho ama Awurade ɔko no,

english_verse: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for
translation_verse: Awurade ma yɛkyinkyinii ɛserɛ no so hɔ mfirinhyia aduanan kɔsii sɛ saa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ amumuyɛfoɔ no nyinaa wuwuiɛ.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Enti, Mose de Gilead maa Makirfoɔ, Manase asefoɔ, ma wɔtenaa hɔ.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: “Nanso, monhwɛ, abɔnefoɔ, moreyɛ saa bɔne koro no ara bi. Esiane sɛ mo dɔɔso enti, Awurade bo a afu Israel no ano bɛyɛ den sen kane no.

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Sɛ motwe mo ho firi Onyankopɔn ho sei a, ɔbɛma nnipa no atena ɛserɛ so hɔ akyɛre na sɛ nnome bi ba wɔn so a, ɛho asodie da mo so.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Wɔteaam sɛ, “Ɛnte saa koraa! Yɛbɛyɛ yɛn nnwammuo na yɛakyekyere nkuro akɛseɛ asi nketewa no anan

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: Sɛ Israelfoɔ no nsa nkaa wɔn agyapadeɛ no a, yɛrentena ha.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Yɛmpɛ Yordan ho asase biara. Mmom, yɛpɛ asase a ɛda apueeɛ fam hɔ no.”

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: “Sɛ moanni asɛm a moaka no so a, na moayɛ bɔne atia Awurade, na sɛ ɛba saa a, monhunu sɛ, ɛho asotwe bɛba mo so.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Monkɔ so nkyekyere nkuro mma mo fiefoɔ na monyɛ nnwammuo mma mo nnwan na monni asɛm a mokaeɛ no nyinaa so.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Ruben ne Gad nkurɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ, “Yɛbɛdi wʼahyɛdeɛ no so pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Yɛn mma, yɛn yerenom, yɛn nnwan ne yɛn anantwie bɛtena Gilead nkuropɔn mu.

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nanso, yɛn a wɔakyere yɛn sɛ asraafoɔ no bɛko ama Awurade sɛdeɛ woaka no.”

english_verse: Then Moses said to Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders,
translation_verse: Enti, Mose penee so ka kyerɛɛ Eleasa, Yosua ne mpanimfoɔ a wɔtuatua Israel mmusuakuo ano no sɛ,

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: “Sɛ Gad ne Ruben abusuakuo mu mmarima nyinaa a wɔakyere wɔn ahyɛ sraa mu sɛ wɔnkɔko mma Awurade no ne me kɔ Yordan na sɛ wɔkɔko di nkonim wɔ hɔ a, momfa Gilead asase no mma wɔn;

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: na sɛ wɔankɔ a, ɛnneɛ wɔmpene so mfa nsase a mowɔ wɔ Kanaan asase so no bi.”

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Gad ne Ruben abusuafoɔ kaa bio sɛ, “Yɛbɛdi Awurade asɛm so;

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: yɛde akodeɛ bɛhyehyɛ yɛn ho adi Awurade akyi akɔ Kanaan nanso, yɛn ara yɛn asase bɛda Yordan fa ha.”

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Enti, Mose maa wɔde Amorifoɔhene Sihon ne Basanhene Og nsasetam ne wɔn nkuro akɛseɛ maa Gad, Ruben ne Yosef babarima Manase mmusuakuo.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Gad nkurɔfoɔ na wɔkyekyeree saa nkuro yi: Dibon, Atarot, Aroer.

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: Atrot-Sofan, Yaser Yogbeha,

translation_verse: Afei, Makir asefoɔ a wɔfiri Manase abusuakuo mu kɔɔ Gilead kɔko dii hɔ so pamoo Amorifoɔ a saa ɛberɛ no na wɔte hɔ no nyinaa.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Manase abusuakuo mu nnipa foforɔ bi a wɔfiri Yair nso tenatenaa Gilead nkuro bebree so, sesaa beaeɛ a wɔwɔ hɔ no din frɛɛ hɔ Hafrotyair.

english_verse: As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Yei ne akwantuo nhyehyɛeɛ a Israelfoɔ dii so ɛberɛ a Mose ne Aaron de wɔn firi Misraim no.

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: Mose twerɛɛ faako a wɔfaeɛ nyinaa sɛdeɛ Awurade kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ no. Yeinom ne mmea mmea a wɔsoɛɛ wɔ wɔn akwantuo no mu.

english_verse: Israel left the Egyptian city of Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month. This was the day after the Lord had punished Egypt's gods by killing the first-born sons in every Egyptian family. So while the Egyptians were burying the bodies, they watched the Israelites proudly leave their country.
translation_verse: Saa ɛberɛ no, na Misraimfoɔ no resie wɔn mmakan a Awurade kunkumm wɔn anadwo a adeɛ rebɛkye ama wɔatu ɛkwan no no. Awurade nam atemmuo nnwuma akɛseɛ yi so dii Misraimfoɔ anyame no nyinaa so nkonim.

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Wɔfirii Rameses no, wɔbaa Sukot.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Wɔfirii Sukot bɛbɔɔ atenaeɛ wɔ Etam, ɛserɛ no ano.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Wɔfirii Etam sane wɔn akyi baa Pihahirot a ɛne Baal-Sefon di nhwɛanimu, na wɔbɔɔ atenaeɛ wɔ bepɔ Migdol ho.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Wɔfiri Pihahirot, na wɔtwaa Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no kɔɔ ɛserɛ so. Wɔde nnansa nante kɔɔ Etam ɛserɛ so kɔbɔɔ atenaeɛ wɔ Mara.

english_verse: Next, they camped at Elim, where there were
translation_verse: Wɔfirii Mara no, wɔbaa Elim; baabi a na nsuwa dumienu ne mmɛdua aduɔson wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Wɔfirii Elim no, wɔbɔɔ atenaeɛ wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no ho.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Wɔfirii Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no ho, kɔbɔɔ atenaeɛ wɔ Sin anweatam so.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.

english_verse: They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Wɔfirii Refidim no, wɔkɔɔ Sinai ɛserɛ so.

english_verse: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
translation_verse: Wɔfirii Kades kɔbɔɔ atenaeɛ wɔ Bepɔ Hor so, wɔ Edom hyeɛ ano.

english_verse: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month,
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a wɔduruu Bepɔ Hor ase no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron sɛ ɔnkɔ bepɔ no atifi, na ɛhɔ na ɔkɔwuiɛ. Asɛm yi sii mfeɛ aduanan so a Israelfoɔ tu firii Misraim no.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.

translation_verse: Wɔwɔ saa beaeɛ hɔ no, wɔtenaa mmeaeɛ bebree a ɛbɛn Asubɔnten Yordan ho—ɛfiri Bet-Yesimot kɔsi Abel Sitim a ɛwɔ Moab tata so no.

translation_verse: Mede asase no ama mo. Momfa na montena so.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Mo mmusua mu nnipa dodoɔ so na wɔbɛhwɛ ama mo asase. Wɔn a wɔdɔɔso no, wɔbɛma wɔn asase kɛseɛ na wɔn a wɔsua no nso bɛnya asase ketewa.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: “Sɛ moampam nnipa a wɔte hɔ no a, wɔbɛyɛ mo ani ase mpe ne mo honam mu nkasɛɛ. Wɔbɛha mo wɔ asase no so.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: Na mede deɛ mahyɛ sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn no bɛyɛ mo.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ, ‘Sɛ mobɛduru Kanaan asase no so a, asase a mede rema mo sɛ mo ankasa asase no a, sɛi na mo ahyeɛ bɛyɛ:

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: “ ‘Asase no anafoɔ fam no bɛyɛ Sin ɛserɛ so a ɛda Edom ano. Anafoɔ hyeɛ no ano bɛfiri Nkyene Ɛpo no.

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: Ɛbɛtoa so akɔtra Akrabbim wɔ anafoɔ hɔ a ɛrekɔ Sin no. Nʼanafoɔ pa ara no bɛyɛ Kades-Barnea, na ɛfiri hɔ akɔsi Hasarada de akɔwie Asmon.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri Asmon a, ɛhyeɛ no bɛkɔ ara akɔsi Misraim asuwa no mu na ano akɔpem Po Kɛseɛ no ano.

english_verse: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Mo hyeɛ a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ no bɛyɛ Po Kɛseɛ a ɛda hɔ no.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Mo hyeɛ a ɛda atifi no bɛfiti aseɛ wɔ Po Kɛseɛ no ano, na atoa so akɔ apueeɛ fam akɔsi bepɔ Hor,

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Apueeɛ hyeɛ no bɛfiri Hasar-Enan anafoɔ akɔ Sefam

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: akɔsi Ribla wɔ Ain apueeɛ fam. Ɛfiri hɔ a, ɛbɛkɔ akɔpem Kineret ɛpo no wɔ apueeɛ fam,

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: na asiane afiri Asubɔnten Yordan, na akɔpem Nkyene Ɛpo no. “ ‘Sɛdeɛ mo asase ahyeɛ teɛ nie.’ ”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Afei Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ, “Yei ne asase a mobɛbɔ so ntonto akyekyɛ afa no. Awurade ahyɛ sɛ mmusua nkron ne fa a aka no na wɔbɛkyekyɛ mu afa.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Ruben ne Gad mmusuakuo no ne Manase abusua fa no deɛ, wɔama wɔn asase no bi

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: wɔ Yordan apueeɛ fam a ɛne Yeriko di nhwɛanimu no.” Ntuanofoɔ A Wɔbɛkyɛ Asase No

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ,

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Nnipa a wɔn edin didi so yi na mayi wɔn sɛ wɔnkyekyɛ asase no mu: ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa, Nun babarima Yosua.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Yi abusua biara mu ɔpanin baako na ɔmmoa wɔn nni saa dwuma yi.

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Saa nnipa yi na Awurade yii wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ nkyekyɛ Kanaan asase no mu mma Israelfoɔ no.

english_verse: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no na wɔmfa wɔn agyapadeɛ no mu bi a ɛyɛ nkuro ne ɛho mmoa adidibea mma Lewifoɔ.
