english_verse: and told them: Each year you must celebrate on both the fourteenth and the fifteenth of Adar,
translation_verse: hyɛɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ, wɔnni afirinhyia afahyɛ yi wɔ saa nnanu no mu.

english_verse: the days when we Jews defeated our enemies. Remember this month as a time when our sorrow was turned to joy, and celebration took the place of crying. Celebrate by having parties and by giving to the poor and by sharing gifts of food with each other.
translation_verse: Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, wɔnhyɛ saa nna no ho fa a adidie ne ɔnom ka ho, na wɔmma wɔn ho wɔn ho ne ahiafoɔ akyɛdeɛ. Yei bɛma Yudafoɔ no akae ɛberɛ a wɔnyaa ɔgyeɛ firii wɔn atamfoɔ nsam, wɔn awerɛhoɔ danee anigyeɛ, na wɔn su bɛyɛɛ ahosɛpɛ no.

english_verse: They followed Mordecai's instructions and set aside these two days every year as a time of celebration. The Reason for the Festival of Purim
translation_verse: Enti, Yudafoɔ no faa Mordekai adwenkyerɛ no, hyɛɛ afirinhyia amanneɛ no ase.

english_verse: Haman was the son of Hammedatha and a descendant of Agag. He hated the Jews so much that he planned to destroy them, but he wanted to find out the best time to do it. So he cast lots.
translation_verse: Na Hamedata, a ɔfiri Agag babarima Haman, a ɔyɛ Yudafoɔ ɔtamfoɔ no pamm sɛ ɔbɛyam wɔn, asɛe wɔn saa da no ne ɔbosome a ɔnam ntontobɔ so nyaeɛ no. .

english_verse: Esther went to King Xerxes and asked him to save her people. Then the king gave written orders for Haman and his sons to be punished in the same terrible way that Haman had in mind for the Jews. So they were hanged.
translation_verse: Nanso, Ɛster baa ɔhene anim no, ɔhyɛɛ mmara, nam so maa Haman adwemmɔne no bɔɔ ne tiri so, na wɔsɛnee no ne mmammarima wɔ dua no so.

english_verse: Queen Esther, daughter of Abihail, wanted to give full authority to Mordecai's letter about the Festival of Purim, and with his help she wrote a letter about the feast.
translation_verse: Na Ɔhemmaa Ɛster, Abihail babaa no ne Yudani Mordekai twerɛɛ krataa foforɔ a wɔde ɔhemmaa no tumi kɛseɛ foaa krataa no so de hyɛɛ Purim afahyɛ no mu den.

english_verse: You and your descendants must always remember to celebrate Purim at the time and in the way that we have said. You must also follow the instructions that we have given you about mourning and going without eating.
translation_verse: Saa nkrataa yi ma Purim Afahyɛ a ɛyɛ afirinhyiadeɛ a wɔdi no ɛnnɛ yi ara no tim. Yudani Mordekai ne Ɔhemmaa Ɛster na wɔhyɛɛ mmara no.

english_verse: These laws about Purim are written by the authority of Queen Esther.
translation_verse: Enti Ɛster ɔhyɛ no sii Purim ho nhyɛhyɛɛ so dua, na wɔtwerɛɛ ne nyinaa guu nkrataa mu.

english_verse: King Xerxes made everyone in his kingdom pay taxes, even those in lands across the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔhene Ahasweros hyɛɛ sɛ wɔntua toɔ wɔ nʼahemman mu, a mpo wɔn a wɔwɔ mpoano akyirikyiri no nyinaa ka ho.

english_verse: All the great and famous things that King Xerxes did are written in the record books of the kings of Media and Persia. These records also tell about the honors that the king gave to Mordecai.
translation_verse: Ne mmaninyɛ ne Mordekai akunini nneyɛɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔhene pagyaa no nyinaa no, wɔatwerɛ wɔ Media ne Persia ahemfo abakɔsɛm mu.

english_verse: Next to the king himself, Mordecai was the highest official in the kingdom. He was a popular leader of the Jews, because he helped them in many ways and would even speak to the king on their behalf.
translation_verse: Yudani Mordekai bɛyɛɛ ɔman panin a ne tumi di ɔhene Ahasweros ankasa deɛ akyi. Na ɔdi mu wɔ Yudafoɔ no mu. Na wɔbu no yie, ɛfiri sɛ, na ne nkurɔfoɔ yiedie yɛ nʼahiasɛm. Na ɔne ahemfie hɔfoɔ nyinaa tenaa yie.

english_verse: Many years ago, a man named Job lived in the land of Uz. He was a truly good person, who respected God and refused to do evil.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima bi tenaa ase wɔ Us asase so a na ne din de Hiob. Na ne ho nni asɛm na ɔyɛ pɛ; na ɔsuro Onyankopɔn, na ɔtwe ne ho firi bɔne ho.

english_verse: the Lord asked, “Satan, where have you been?” Satan replied, “I have been going all over the earth.”
translation_verse: Awurade bisaa Satan sɛ, “Wofiri he na wobaa ha?” Satan buaa Awurade sɛ, “Mefiri asase so akyinkyinakyinkyini ne emu akɔneabadie mu.”

english_verse: Job's sons took turns having feasts in their homes, and they always invited their three sisters to join in the eating and drinking.
translation_verse: Na ne mmammarima no to ɛpono nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ wɔ wɔn afie mu, na wɔto nsa frɛ wɔn nnuammaa baasa no ne wɔn bɔ mu didi, nom.

english_verse: After each feast, Job would send for his children and perform a ceremony, as a way of asking God to forgive them of any wrongs they may have done. He would get up early the next morning and offer a sacrifice for each of them, just in case they had sinned or silently cursed God. Angels, the Lord, and Satan
translation_verse: Sɛ apontoɔ nna no twam a, Hiob soma kɔfrɛ wɔn na wɔdwira wɔn ho. Ɔsɔre anɔpahema bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma wɔn mu biara, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdwene sɛ, “Ebia na me mma no ayɛ bɔne na wɔadome Onyankopɔn wɔ wɔn akoma mu.” Yei yɛ dwuma a na Hiob di no ɛberɛ-ano-berɛ ano. Hiob Sɔhwɛ A Ɛdi Ɛkan

english_verse: One day, when the angels had gathered around the Lord, and Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Ɛda bi, abɔfoɔ no de wɔn ho bɛkyerɛɛ Awurade, na Satan kaa wɔn ho baeɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil.”
translation_verse: Na Awurade bisaa Satan sɛ, “Wadwene me ɔsomfoɔ Hiob ho anaa? Obiara nte sɛ ɔno wɔ asase so, ne ho nni asɛm na ɔtene, ɔyɛ onipa a ɔsuro Onyankopɔn na ɔkyiri bɔne.”

english_verse: “Why shouldn't he respect you?” Satan remarked.
translation_verse: Satan buaa Awurade sɛ, “Hiob suro Onyankopɔn kwa anaa?

english_verse: “You are like a wall protecting not only him, but his entire family and all his property. You make him successful in whatever he does, and his flocks and herds are everywhere.
translation_verse: Wonnyee ban mfaa ɔno, ne fie ne biribiara a ɔwɔ ho anaa? Woahyira ne nsa ano adwuma so, enti ne nnwan ne nʼanantwie ase atrɛ asase no so.

english_verse: Try taking away everything he owns, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Na wo deɛ, tene wo nsa na sɛe deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, na ɔbɛgyina wʼanim na wadome wo.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “All right, Satan, do what you want with anything that belongs to him, but don't harm Job.” Then Satan left. Job Loses Everything
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa wɔ wo nsam, nanso ɔno ankasa deɛ, mfa wo nsateaa nka no.” Na Satan firii Awurade anim kɔeɛ.

english_verse: Job's sons and daughters were having a feast in the home of his oldest son,
translation_verse: Ɛda bi a Hiob mmammarima ne ne mmammaa redidi na wɔrenom bobesa wɔ wɔn nuabarima panin fie no,

english_verse: when someone rushed up to Job and said, “While your servants were plowing with your oxen, and your donkeys were nearby eating grass,
translation_verse: ɔbɔfoɔ bi baa Hiob hɔ, bɛkaa sɛ, “Anantwie no refɛntɛm na mfunumu no redidi wɔ wɔn nkyɛn no,

english_verse: a gang of Sabeans attacked and stole the oxen and donkeys! Your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Sebafoɔ bɛto hyɛɛ yɛn so, sesaa wɔn kɔɔeɛ. Wɔde afena kunkumm apaafoɔ no, na me nko ara na medwaneeɛ a merebɛbɔ wo saa amaneɛ yi.”

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a second one came running and said, “God sent down a fire that killed your sheep and your servants. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a ɔgu so rekasa no, ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ bi ba bɛkaa sɛ, “Onyankopɔn ogya firi soro abɛhye wo nnwan ne wo nnwanhwɛfoɔ no nyinaa, na me nko ara na medwaneeɛ a merebɛbɔ wo amaneɛ yi.”

english_verse: Before that servant finished speaking, a third one raced up and said, “Three gangs of Chaldeans attacked and stole your camels! All of your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Ɔgu so rekasa no, ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ bi bɛkaa sɛ, “Kaldeafoɔ de akorɔmfoɔ akuo mmiɛnsa baa wo nyoma so bɛsoaa wɔn kɔeɛ. Wɔde afena kunkumm asomfoɔ no na me nko ara na medwaneeɛ a merebɛbɔ wo amaneɛ yi.”

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a fourth one dashed up and said, “Your children were having a feast and drinking wine at the home of your oldest son,
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a ɔgu so rekasa no, ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ bi ba bɛkaa sɛ, “Na wo mmammarima ne wo mmammaa redidi na wɔrenom bobesa wɔ wɔn nuabarima panin fie,

english_verse: when suddenly a windstorm from the desert blew the house down, crushing all of your children. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: na prɛko pɛ, ahum bi bɔ firii ɛserɛ no so bɛdwiraa efie no ntwea ɛnan no. Efie no dwiri guu wɔn so na akunkum wɔn, na me nko ara na medwaneeɛ a merebɛbɔ wo amaneɛ yi.”

english_verse: When Job heard this, he tore his clothes and shaved his head because of his great sorrow. He knelt on the ground, then worshiped God
translation_verse: Yei maa Hiob sɔre gyinaa hɔ, sunsuanee nʼatadeɛ mu na ɔyii ne tirinwi. Afei ɔtenaa fam sɔree Awurade

english_verse: and said: “We bring nothing at birth; we take nothing with us at death. The Lord alone gives and takes. Praise the name of the Lord!”
translation_verse: kaa sɛ, “Adagya na mede mefiri me maame yam baeɛ, na adagya na mede bɛsane akɔ. Awurade de maeɛ, na Awurade afa; nhyira nka Awurade din!”

english_verse: In spite of everything, Job did not sin or accuse God of doing wrong.
translation_verse: Yei nyinaa mu no, Hiob anyɛ bɔne sɛ ɔbɛbɔ Onyankopɔn soboɔ.

english_verse: When the angels gathered around the Lord again, Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Ɛda foforɔ bi, abɔfoɔ no baa Awurade anim bio na Satan nso kaa wɔn ho baeɛ.

english_verse: and the Lord asked, “Satan, where have you been?” Satan replied, “I have been going all over the earth.”
translation_verse: Awurade bisaa Satan sɛ, “Wofiri he na wobaa ha?” Satan buaa Awurade sɛ, “Mefiri asase so akyinkyinakyinkyini ne emu akɔneabadie mu.”

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil. And he hasn't changed, even though you persuaded me to destroy him for no reason.”
translation_verse: Na Awurade bisaa Satan sɛ, “Woadwene mʼakoa Hiob ho anaa? Obiara nte sɛ ɔno wɔ asase so, ne ho nni asɛm na ɔtene. Ɔyɛ onipa a ɔsuro Onyankopɔn na ɔkyiri bɔne. Ɛwom sɛ wohyɛɛ me sɛ mensɛe no a menni nnyinasoɔ biara deɛ, nanso ɔda so gyina ne pɛpɛyɛ no mu.”

english_verse: Satan answered, “There's no pain like your own. People will do anything to stay alive.
translation_verse: Satan buaa Awurade sɛ, “Wedeɛ pere wedeɛ. Onipa de deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa bɛma de apere ne nkwa.

english_verse: Try striking Job's own body with pain, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛbɛtumi a tene wo nsa fa ka ne honam ne ne nnompe, na ɔbɛdome wo wɔ wʼanim!”

english_verse: “All right!” the Lord replied. “Make Job suffer as much as you want, but just don't kill him.”
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ, “Ɛyɛ, ɔwɔ wo nsam na ne nkwa deɛ, gyaa mu ma no.”

english_verse: Satan left and caused painful sores to break out all over Job's body—from head to toe.
translation_verse: Enti, Satan firii Awurade anim, na ɔmaa akuro a ɛyɛ yea totɔɔ Hiob ho firi ne nan ase kɔsii nʼapampam.

english_verse: Then Job sat on the ash-heap to show his sorrow. And while he was scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery,
translation_verse: Afei, na kyɛmferɛ na Hiob de dwi ne ho, ɛberɛ a ɔte nsõ mu.

english_verse: his wife asked, “Why do you still trust God? Why don't you curse him and die?”
translation_verse: Ne yere bisaa no sɛ, “Woda so kura wo pɛpɛyɛ no mu ara? Dome Onyankopɔn, na wu!”

english_verse: Job replied, “Don't talk like a fool! If we accept blessings from God, we must accept trouble as well.” In all that happened, Job never once said anything against God. Job's Three Friends
translation_verse: Na Hiob buaa no sɛ, “Wokasa sɛ ɔbaa a ɔyɛ ɔkwasea. Ade pa deɛ, yɛagye afiri Onyankopɔn nsam na ade bɔne na yɛmpo anaa?” Yei nyinaa mu, Hiob anka asɛm bɔne. Hiob Nnamfo Baasa No

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamah were three of Job's friends, and they heard about his troubles. So they agreed to visit Job and comfort him.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Hiob nnamfo baasa bi a wɔne Temanni Elifas, Suhini Bildad ne Naamani Sofar tee amanehunu a aba Hiob so no, wɔfirii wɔn afie mu, hyia yɛɛ adwene sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ no na wɔakyekye ne werɛ.

english_verse: When they came near enough to see Job, they could hardly recognize him. And in their great sorrow, they tore their clothes, then sprinkled dust on their heads and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Wɔhunuu Hiob firii akyiri no, wɔanhunu sɛ ɛyɛ ɔno; wɔhyɛɛ aseɛ twaa agyaadwoɔ, sunsuanee wɔn ntadeɛ mu, tuu mfuturo guu wɔn tiri so.

english_verse: For seven days and nights, they sat silently on the ground beside him, because they realized what terrible pain he was in.
translation_verse: Na wɔne no tenaa fam nnanson, awia ne anadwo. Na obiara ankasa, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔhunuu sɛ nʼamanehunu no nyɛ asɛmwa.

english_verse: Finally, Job cursed the day of his birth
translation_verse: Akyire no, Hiob kasaeɛ, na ɔdomee ɛda a wɔwoo no.

english_verse: Blot out the day of my birth and the night when my parents created a son.
translation_verse: “Ma ɛda a wɔwoo me no nyera, ne anadwo a wɔkaa sɛ, ‘Wɔawo ɔbabarima no!’

english_verse: and send thick, gloomy shadows to fill it with dread.
translation_verse: Ma esum ne owusum nnye no mfa; ma omununkum nkata so; na esum mmunkam ne hann so.

english_verse: Erase that night from the calendar and conceal it with darkness.
translation_verse: Ma esum kabii nnye saa anadwo no mfa; ma wɔnyi saa anadwo no mfiri asranna so na wɔmmfa nhyɛ ɔbosome biara mu.

english_verse: Don't let children be created or joyful shouts be heard ever again in that night.
translation_verse: Saa anadwo no nyɛ obonini; mma wɔnnte anigyeɛ nteam wɔ mu.

english_verse: Let those with magic powers place a curse on that day.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔdome nna no nnome saa ɛda no; wɔn a wɔayɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛkanyane dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn no.

english_verse: Darken its morning stars and remove all hope of light,
translation_verse: Ma nʼanɔpa nsoromma nnuru sum; na ɔntwɛne adekyeeɛ kwa a ɔnhunu anɔpa owia nsensaneɛ a ɛdi ɛkan,

english_verse: because it let me be born into a world of trouble. Why Didn't I Die at Birth?
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ anto deɛ ɔwoo me awotwaa mu ama wawo me, anka mʼani nhunu saa abɛbrɛsɛ yi.

english_verse: Why was I accepted and allowed to nurse at my mother's breast?
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na nkotodwe gyee me ne nufoɔ sɛ mennum?

english_verse: Now I would be at peace in the silent world below
translation_verse: Anka sɛsɛɛ meda hɔ asomdwoeɛ mu; anka mada regye mʼahome

english_verse: with kings and their advisors whose palaces lie in ruins,
translation_verse: me ne ewiase ahemfo ne fotufoɔ, wɔn a wɔsisii adan maa wɔn ho na ɛnnɛ yi abubuo no,

english_verse: and with rulers once rich with silver and gold.
translation_verse: me ne sodifoɔ a na wɔwɔ sika kɔkɔɔ, wɔn a wɔde dwetɛ hyɛɛ wɔn afie mu ma.

english_verse: I wish I had been born dead and then buried, never to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Anaasɛ adɛn enti na wɔansie me sɛ ɔpɔn ba, te sɛ abadomaa a wanhunu adekyeeɛ hann da?

english_verse: In the world of the dead, the wicked and the weary rest without a worry. *
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na amumuyɛfoɔ gyae basabasayɛ, na abrɛfoɔ nya ahomegyeɛ.

english_verse: where captives and slaves are free at last. Why Does God Let Me Live?
translation_verse: Nketewa ne akɛseɛ wɔ hɔ, na akoa de ne ho firi ne wura nsam.

english_verse: Why does God let me live when life is miserable and so bitter?
translation_verse: “Adɛn enti na wɔma mmɔborɔfoɔ hann, na ɔkra mu ahohiahiafoɔ nya nkwa?

english_verse: I keep longing for death more than I would seek a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Wɔn kɔn dɔ owuo, nanso ɛmma. Wɔbrɛ hwehwɛ owuo sene sɛdeɛ wɔhwehwɛ akoradeɛ.

english_verse: Nothing could make me happier than to be in the grave.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔwu a, wɔn ani gye na wɔduru damena mu a, wɔdi ahurisie.

english_verse: Why do I go on living when God has me surrounded, and I can't see the road?
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na wɔde nkwa ma onipa a ɔnni daakye, deɛ Onyankopɔn aka no ahyɛ mu?

english_verse: Moaning and groaning are my food and drink,
translation_verse: Ahomekokoguo adane mʼaduane; na mʼapinisie gu te sɛ nsuo.

english_verse: and my worst fears have all come true.
translation_verse: Deɛ na mesuro no aba me so; deɛ na ɛbɔ me hu no ato me.

english_verse: I have no peace or rest— only troubles and worries.
translation_verse: Menni ahotɔ, menni asomdwoeɛ; menni ahomegyeɛ na mmom, ɔhaw nko ara.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Na Temanni Elifas buaa Hiob sɛ,

english_verse: Please be patient and listen to what I have to say. *
translation_verse: “Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔne wo kasa a, worennya ntoboaseɛ mma no anaa? Hwan na wɔbɛtumi aka nʼano ato mu?

english_verse: But now you feel discouraged when struck by trouble.
translation_verse: Na afei a ɔhaw aba no, wʼaba mu abu; aba wo so, na wo ho adwiri wo.

english_verse: You respect God and live right, so don't lose hope!
translation_verse: Wo nyamesuro mma wo ahotosoɔ anaa, na wʼakwan a ɛho nni asɛm mma wo anidasoɔ anaa?

english_verse: In my experience, only those who plant seeds of evil harvest trouble,
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ mahunu no, wɔn a wɔfɛntɛm bɔne ne wɔn a wɔdua ɔhaw no, wɔtwa so aba.

english_verse: and then they are swept away by the angry breath of God.
translation_verse: Sɛ Onyankopɔn home a, wɔsɛe; nʼabufuo ma wɔyera.

english_verse: They may roar and growl like powerful lions. But when God breaks their teeth,
translation_verse: Agyata bɛtumi abobom na wɔapɔ so, nanso wɔbɛbubu gyata akɛseɛ no se.

english_verse: they starve, and their children are scattered. A Secret Was Told to Me
translation_verse: Gyata annya haboa a ɔwu, na gyatabereɛ mma no bɔ hwete.

english_verse: A secret was told to me in a faint whisper—
translation_verse: “Wɔbɛkaa kokoamsɛm bi kyerɛɛ me na mʼaso tee no sɛ asomusɛm.

english_verse: I was overcome by sleep, but disturbed by dreams;
translation_verse: Wɔ anadwo daeɛso basabasa mu, ɛberɛ a nnipa adeda nnahɔɔ no,

english_verse: and my hair stood on end, as a wind blew past my face.
translation_verse: Honhom bi twaa mʼani so, na me ho nwi sɔre gyinaeɛ.

english_verse: It stopped and stood still. Then a form appeared— a shapeless form. And from the silence, I heard a voice say,
translation_verse: Ɛgyinaeɛ, nanso, manhunu nʼabɔsuo. Biribi bɛgyinaa mʼanim, na metee nne bɔkɔɔ bi a ɛrebisa sɛ,

english_verse: “No humans are innocent in the eyes of God their Creator.
translation_verse: ‘Onipa dasani bɛtumi atene asene Onyankopɔn? Onipa bɛtumi ayɛ kronn asene ne Yɛfoɔ anaa?

english_verse: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.
translation_verse: Sɛ Onyankopɔn ntumi mfa ne ho nto nʼankasa asomfoɔ so, na sɛ ɔka nʼabɔfoɔ mpo anim a,

english_verse: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?
translation_verse: hwan ne onipa a wɔde dɔteɛ anwene no, a ne fapem sisi mfuturo mu na wɔdwerɛ no ntɛm so sene abubummabaa?

english_verse: Born after daybreak, you die before nightfall and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri anɔpahema kɔsi anwummerɛ wɔbubu wɔn mu nketenkete; na wɔyera korakora a obiara nhunu wɔn bio.

english_verse: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
translation_verse: Wɔtete wɔn ntomadan nhoma mu, ɛno enti wɔwuwu a wɔnnim.’

english_verse: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!
translation_verse: “Wopɛ a frɛ, na hwan na ɔbɛgye wo soɔ? Akronkronfoɔ no mu hwan nkyɛn na wobɛkorɔ?

english_verse: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
translation_verse: Ahisɛm kum ɔkwasea, na anibereɛ kum atetekwaa.

english_verse: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
translation_verse: Mʼankasa mahunu ɔkwasea a ɔrefefɛ, nanso, mpofirim, wɔdomee ne fie.

english_verse: and leaving their children helpless in court.
translation_verse: Ne mma ne banbɔ ntam ɛkwan ware, wɔdwerɛ wɔn wɔ asɛnniiɛ a wɔnnya ɔkamafoɔ.

english_verse: Then hungry and greedy people gobble up their crops and grab their wealth.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɛkɔm de noɔ no di ne nnɔbaeɛ, na ɔfa firi nkasɛɛ mu mpo, na deɛ osukɔm de noɔ no pere di nʼahodeɛ akyi.

english_verse: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
translation_verse: Ahokyere mmpue mfiri dɔteɛ mu na ɔhaw nso mmpue mfiri fam.

english_verse: it's all part of life, like sparks shooting skyward.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔwo nnipa to ɔhaw mu mpɛn dodoɔ a ogyaframa turi kɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
translation_verse: “Nanso sɛ ɛyɛ me a, anka mɛdwane atoa Onyankopɔn; na mede mʼasɛm ato nʼanim.

english_verse: His miracles are marvelous, more than we can count.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ anwanwadeɛ a wɔntumi nhwehwɛ mu, ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔntumi nkan ne dodoɔ.

english_verse: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔ nsuo gu asase so; na ɔde kɔ wira mu.

english_verse: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
translation_verse: Ɔde ahobrɛasefoɔ si deɛ ɛkorɔn, na ɔma wɔn a wɔdi awerɛhoɔ nya asomdwoeɛ.

english_verse: God swiftly traps the wicked
translation_verse: Ɔsɛe anifirefoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ, ma wɔn nsa si fam.

english_verse: in their own evil schemes, and their wisdom fails.
translation_verse: Ɔkyere anyansafoɔ wɔ wɔn anifire mu, na ɔbɔ anitefoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ gu.

english_verse: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
translation_verse: Esum duru wɔn awia ketee; na wɔkeka owigyinaeɛ te sɛ anadwo.

english_verse: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
translation_verse: Ɔgye ahiafoɔ firi afena a ɛhyɛ wɔn anomu; ɔgye wɔn firi ahoɔdenfoɔ nkyehoma mu.

english_verse: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
translation_verse: Enti, ahiafoɔ wɔ anidasoɔ, na ntɛnkyea ka nʼano to mu.

english_verse: Consider yourself fortunate if God All-Powerful chooses to correct you.
translation_verse: “Nhyira ne onipa a Onyankopɔn tene no, enti mmu Otumfoɔ ntenetene no animtiaa.

english_verse: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ, ɔno na ɔpira na ɔno ara akyekyere; ɔpira nanso ne nsa sa yadeɛ.

english_verse: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛgye wo afiri ɔhaw ahodoɔ nsia mu; nson so, a bɔne biara renka wo.

english_verse: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔm ba a, ɔbɛgye wo afiri owuo mu, na ɔko mu nso, ɔbɛgye wo afiri afena ano.

english_verse: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛbɔ wo ho ban afiri kasatwie ho na sɛ ɔsɛeɛ ba a, ɛnsɛ sɛ wosuro.

english_verse: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
translation_verse: Wobɛsere ɔsɛeɛ ne ɔkɔm; na ɛnsɛ sɛ wosuro asase so mmoa.

english_verse: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
translation_verse: Wo ne afuo so aboɔ bɛyɛ apam, na emu nkekaboa nso ne wo bɛtena asomdwoeɛ mu.

english_verse: Your home will be secure, and your sheep will be safe.
translation_verse: Wobɛhunu sɛ wo ntomadan wɔ banbɔ; na sɛ wosese wʼahodeɛ a, wobɛhunu sɛ hwee nyeraeɛ.

english_verse: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
translation_verse: Wobɛhunu sɛ wo mma bɛyɛ bebree; na wʼasefoɔ bɛdɔre sɛ ɛserɛ.

english_verse: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
translation_verse: Wode ahoɔden bɛkɔ damena mu, te sɛ afiafi a wɔaboa ano wɔ otwa berɛ mu.

english_verse: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.
translation_verse: “Yɛahwehwɛ yei mu, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ ɛno enti tie na fa toto wʼabrabɔ ho.”

english_verse: It's impossible to weigh my misery and grief!
translation_verse: “Sɛ wɔbɛtumi akari mʼawerɛhodie na me haw nso wɔde agu nsania so a,

english_verse: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
translation_verse: anka emu bɛyɛ duru asene anwea a ɛwɔ ɛpo mu nyinaa, enti ɛnyɛ nwanwa sɛ me nsɛm ayɛ hagyahagya.

english_verse: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.
translation_verse: Otumfoɔ agyan no awɔ me mu, me honhom nom ano awuduro no; wɔahyehyɛ Onyankopɔn ahunahuna nyinaa atia me.

english_verse: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?
translation_verse: Wiram afunumu su wɔ ɛberɛ a wanya ɛserɛ anaa, na nantwie nso su wɔ ɛberɛ a wanya nʼaduane anaa?

english_verse: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
translation_verse: Wɔdi aduane a nkyene nni mu anaa, na kosua mu fufuo nso ɔdɛ bi wɔ mu anaa?

english_verse: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
translation_verse: Mempɛ sɛ mede me nsa ka; aduane a ɛte saa no bɔ me yadeɛ.

english_verse: How I wish that God would answer my prayer
translation_verse: “Ao sɛ me nsa bɛka mʼabisadeɛ, sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛyɛ deɛ mʼani da so ama me.

english_verse: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ anka mɛkɔ so anya saa awerɛkyekyerɛ yi. Nanso, ɔyea yi nyinaa akyi no memmuu Ɔkronkronni no nsɛm so da.

english_verse: Why should I patiently hope when my strength is gone?
translation_verse: “Ahoɔden bɛn na mewɔ a enti ɛsɛ sɛ menya anidasoɔ? Daakye nneɛma pa bɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ menya ntoboaseɛ?

english_verse: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
translation_verse: Mewɔ ahoɔden sɛ ɛboɔ anaa? Me honam yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ anaa?

english_verse: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
translation_verse: Mewɔ tumi a mede bɛboa me ho anaa? Saa ɛberɛ yi a nkonimdie apare me yi?

english_verse: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
translation_verse: “Deɛ nʼanidasoɔ asa no hia ne nnamfonom mpaeɛbɔ, ɛnyɛ saa a, ɔbɛpa aba wɔ Otumfoɔ no suro ho.

english_verse: like streams that swell with melting snow,
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a sukyerɛmma renane na asukɔtweaa nso redane nsuo,

english_verse: then suddenly disappear in the summer heat.
translation_verse: nanso owiaberɛ mu no, ɛntene bio na ɔhyew enti nsuo no tu yera.

english_verse: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
translation_verse: Akwantufoɔ mane firi wɔn akwan so; wɔforo kɔ nsase bonini so na wɔwuwu.

english_verse: thought they would find water. But they were disappointed,
translation_verse: Wɔn ho yera wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔwɔ awerɛhyɛmu; wɔduruu hɔ, nanso wɔn anidasoɔ yɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
translation_verse: Afei wo nso woakyerɛ sɛ wo ho nni mfasoɔ; Woahunu mʼamanehunu no, na ama woasuro.

english_verse: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
translation_verse: Maka sɛ, ‘Momma me biribi? Maka sɛ momfiri mo ahodeɛ ntua me tiri so sika,

english_verse: or to purchase my freedom from brutal enemies?
translation_verse: anaasɛ monnye me mfiri mʼatamfoɔ nsam, ne atirimuɔdenfoɔ nkyehoma mu anaa?’

english_verse: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
translation_verse: “Monkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mɛyɛ komm; monkyerɛ me mfomsoɔ a mayɛ.

english_verse: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
translation_verse: Nokorɛka yɛ yea, na mo adwenkyerɛ no, ɛkɔsi sɛn?

english_verse: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
translation_verse: Mokyerɛ sɛ deɛ maka no nnyɛ nokorɛ, mofa obi a nʼabamu abu asɛm sɛ mframa anaa?

english_verse: Why, you would sell an orphan or your own neighbor!
translation_verse: Mpo mobɛbɔ awisiaa so ntonto, na mode mo adamfo adi nsesa dwa.

english_verse: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
translation_verse: “Afei momfa ahummɔborɔ nhwɛ me. Mɛtumi adi atorɔ wɔ mo anim anaa?

english_verse: Stop accusing me falsely; my reputation is at stake.
translation_verse: Monto mo bo ase, mommu ntɛnkyea; monsane nnwene ho, ɛfiri sɛ me pɛpɛyɛ ho aba akyinnyegyeɛ.

english_verse: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛsɛm wɔ mʼano anaa? Mennim papa ne bɔne ntam nsonsonoeɛ anaa?

english_verse: Why is life so hard? Why do we suffer?
translation_verse: “Asase so som nyɛ den mma onipa anaa? Ne nkwa nna nte sɛ ɔpaani deɛ?

english_verse: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ akoa ani gyina anwummerɛ sunsumma, anaasɛ ɔpaani ho pere no nʼakatua ho no,

english_verse: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
translation_verse: saa ara na wɔatwa abosome hunu ato me hɔ, ne anadwo a ɔhaw wɔ mu ama me.

english_verse: I pray for night to end, but it stretches out while I toss and turn.
translation_verse: Sɛ meda a, medwene bisa sɛ, ‘Ɛberɛ bɛn na adeɛ bɛkye?’ Nanso anadwo twam nkakrankakra, na mepere kɔsi ahemadakye.

english_verse: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
translation_verse: Asonsono ne aporɔporɔ ahyɛ me honam ma, me honam asɛe na ɛrefiri nsuo.

english_verse: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
translation_verse: “Me nna kɔ ntɛm sene ɔnwomfoɔ akurokurowa, na ɛkɔ awieeɛ a anidasoɔ biara nni muo.

english_verse: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, kae sɛ me nkwanna te sɛ ahomeɛ; na merennya anigyeɛ bio da.

english_verse: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
translation_verse: Ani a ɛhunu me seesei renhunu me bio; mobɛhwehwɛ me, nanso na menni hɔ bio.

english_verse: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ omununkum yera na ɛtu korɔ no, saa ara na deɛ ɔkɔ damena mu no nsane mma bio.

english_verse: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɔrensane mma ne fie da biara da; nʼatenaeɛ renkae no bio.

english_verse: And so, I cry out to you in agony and distress.
translation_verse: “Ɛno enti meremmua mʼano; mɛfiri me honhom ahoyera mu akasa, mɛfiri me kra ɔyea mu anwiinwii.

english_verse: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
translation_verse: Meyɛ ɛpo anaa aboa kɛseɛ a ɔwɔ ebunu mu anaa, na mode me ahyɛ ɔwɛmfoɔ nsa yi?

english_verse: but you torture me with terrible dreams. *
translation_verse: ɛno mpo na wode adaeɛso yi me hu na wode anisoadehunu hunahuna me,

english_verse: I'd rather choke to death than live in this body.
translation_verse: ɛno enti mepɛ akɔmfohyɛ ne owuo, sene me onipadua yi.

english_verse: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
translation_verse: Memmu me nkwa; mentena ase afebɔɔ. Monnyaa me; na me nna nka hwee.

english_verse: What makes you so concerned about us humans?
translation_verse: “Ɔdasani ne hwan a ne ho hia wo sei, na wʼani ku ne ho,

english_verse: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
translation_verse: na wohwehwɛ ne mu anɔpa biara na wosɔ no hwɛ ɛberɛ biara?

english_verse: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
translation_verse: Worenyi wʼani mfiri me so da, anaasɛ worennyaa me ɛberɛ tiawa bi mpo anaa?

english_verse: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
translation_verse: Sɛ mayɛ bɔne a, ɛdeɛn na mayɛ woɔ, Ao adasamma so wɛmfoɔ? Adɛn enti na watu wʼani asi me soɔ? Mayɛ adesoa ama wo anaa?

english_verse: Why do you refuse to forgive? Soon you won't find me, because I'll be dead.
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na wonkata me mmarato so na womfa me bɔne nkyɛ me? Ɛrenkyɛre biara, mɛda mfuturo mu. Wobɛhwehwɛ me nanso na menni hɔ bio.”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Ɛnna Suhini Bildad buaa sɛ:

english_verse: How long will you talk and keep saying nothing?
translation_verse: “Wobɛkɔ so aka saa nsɛm yi akɔsi da bɛn? Wo nsɛm yɛ mframa huhuo.

english_verse: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn kyea atɛntenenee anaa? Otumfoɔ kyea deɛ ɛtene anaa?

english_verse: He made your children pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a wo mma yɛɛ bɔne tiaa noɔ no, ɔgyaa wɔn maa wɔn bɔne so akatua.

english_verse: So why don't you turn to him
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ wode wʼani bɛto Onyankopɔn so na woabɔ Otumfoɔ no mpaeɛ,

english_verse: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
translation_verse: sɛ woyɛ kronn, na wotene a, wo enti, ɔbɛma ne ho so seesei na wama wo asi wo dada mu.

english_verse: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
translation_verse: Wo ahyɛaseɛ bɛyɛ nkakra nkakra na daakye woanya ama abu so.

english_verse: Our ancestors were wise, so learn from them.
translation_verse: “Bisa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a atwam no, na hwehwɛ deɛ wɔn agyanom hunuiɛ.

english_verse: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
translation_verse: Na wɔwoo yɛn nkyɛreeɛ na yɛnnim hwee. Yɛn nna wɔ asase yi so te sɛ sunsumma.

english_verse: But they will instruct you with great understanding.
translation_verse: Nanso adikanfoɔ no bɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo. Wɔbɛfiri wɔn nteaseɛ mu akyerɛ wo nyansa.

english_verse: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a ɛrenyini a wɔntwaeɛ no, ɛdwane ntɛm so sene ɛserɛ.

english_verse: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
translation_verse: Saa na wɔn a wɔn werɛ firi Onyankopɔn no awieeɛ teɛ; saa na wɔn a wɔnni nyamesu no anidasoɔ nkɔsi hwee.

english_verse: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—
translation_verse: Biribiara a nʼani da so no nni ahoɔden; deɛ ɔde ne ho to soɔ yɛ ananse ntontan.

english_verse: they take hold and fall because it's so flimsy.
translation_verse: Ɔtwere ne ntontan, nanso ɛtete; ɔsɔ mu denden nanso ɛnyɛ yie.

english_verse: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ afifideɛ a wɔgugu so nsuo yie a ɛsi owia mu. Ɛtrɛtrɛ ne mman mu wɔ turo no so;

english_verse: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.
translation_verse: Ne nhini nyini fa abotan ho, na ɛhwehwɛ ɛkwan kɔ aboɔ mu.

english_verse: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ wɔtu firi ne siberɛ a, saa beaeɛ no nnim no bio na ɛka sɛ, ‘Menhunuu wo da.’

english_verse: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
translation_verse: Ampa ara ne nkwa twam, na afifideɛ foforɔ nyini asase no so.

english_verse: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
translation_verse: “Ampa ara Onyankopɔn mpo onipa a ne ho nni asɛm na ɔnhyɛ amumuyɛfoɔ nsa mu dene.

english_verse: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛma woasere bio, na wode ahosɛpɛ ateateam.

english_verse: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Wɔde aniwuo bɛfira wɔn a wɔtan woɔ, na amumuyɛfoɔ ntomadan bɛsɛe.”

english_verse: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
translation_verse: “Aane, menim sɛ yei yɛ nokorɛ. Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔdasani bɛtene wɔ Onyankopɔn anim?

english_verse: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn yiyi a, ɔrentumi nyi nsɛm apem mu baako mpo ano.

english_verse: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
translation_verse: Ne nyansa mu dɔ, na ne tumi so. Hwan na ɔne no adi asie na ne ho baabiara anti?

english_verse: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
translation_verse: Ɔtutu mmepɔ a wɔnnim ho hwee ɔbubu wɔn fa so wɔ nʼabufuo mu.

english_verse: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
translation_verse: Ɔwoso asase firi ne siberɛ, na ɔma ne nnyinasoɔ woso biribiri.

english_verse: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
translation_verse: Ɔkasa kyerɛ owia na ɛnhyerɛn, na ɔsɔ nsoromma hyerɛn ano.

english_verse: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea,
translation_verse: Ɔno nko ara na ɔtrɛ ɔsoro mu, na ɔnante ɛpo asorɔkye so.

english_verse: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne Nwenwenente, Akokɔbaatan ne ne mma Yɛfoɔ; Nsorommabafan ne ewiem anafoɔ fam nsorommakuo no.

english_verse: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ anwanwadeɛ a wɔntumi nte aseɛ, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔntumi nkan.

english_verse: God walks right past me, without making a sound.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnam me ho a, menhunu no; sɛ ɔsene a, menhunu no.

english_verse: And if he grabs something, who can stop him or raise a question?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhwim kɔ a, hwan na ɔsi no kwan? Hwan na ɔbɛtumi abisa no sɛ, ‘Ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi?’

english_verse: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nkora nʼabufuo so; Rahab aboafoɔ mpo ho popo wɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
translation_verse: “Na me ne hwan a me ne no bɛyiyi? Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nsɛm a me ne no de bɛgye akyinnyeɛ?

english_verse: Even though I am innocent, I can only beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Sɛ menim mpo a, merentumi nyi nʼano; ɛno ara ne sɛ mɛsrɛ ahummɔborɔ afiri me ɔtemmufoɔ nkyɛn.

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Mpo, sɛ mefrɛ no na ɔba a, mennye nni sɛ ɔbɛtie mʼasɛm.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: Ɔde asorɔkye bɛdwerɛ me ama mʼapirakuro adɔɔso kwa.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: Ɔremma menya mʼahome, bio. Ɔde awerɛhoɔ bɛhyɛ me ma tɔ.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛba no ahoɔden a, ɔyɛ ɔhoɔdenfoɔ! Na sɛ ɛba atɛntenenee nso a, hwan na ɔbɛsamane no?

english_verse: Even if I were innocent, God would prove me wrong.
translation_verse: Sɛ medi bem mpo a, mʼano bɛbu me kumfɔ; sɛ me ho nni asɛm a, ɛbɛbu me fɔ.

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: “Ɛwom sɛ medi bem deɛ, nanso memmu me ho; abrabɔ afono me.

english_verse: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa yɛ pɛ; ɛno enti na meka sɛ, ‘Ɔsɛe deɛ ne ho nni asɛm ne omumuyɛfoɔ.’

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a amanehunu de owuo aba no, ɔsere deɛ ne ho nni asɛm no akomatuo.

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a asase akɔ amumuyɛfoɔ nsam no, ɔfira ɛso atemmufoɔ ani. Sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno a, na ɛyɛ hwan?

english_verse: My life is speeding by, without a hope of happiness.
translation_verse: “Me nna ho yɛ herɛ sene ommirikatufoɔ; ɛsene kɔ a anigyeɛ kakra mpo nni mu.

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Ɛtwam kɔ sɛ akodoɔ a wɔde paparɔs ayɛ te sɛ akɔdeɛ a wɔreto akyere wɔn ahaboa.

english_verse: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
translation_verse: Sɛ meka sɛ, ‘Me werɛ mfiri mʼanwiinwii, mɛsesa me nsɛm ka, na masere a,’

english_verse: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
translation_verse: me yea ahodoɔ no bɔ me hu ara. Na menim sɛ, woremmu me bem.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: Woabu me fɔ dada enti, adɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meha me ho kwa?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Mpo sɛ ɛba sɛ mede samina dware na mede samina hohoro me nsa ho a,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: wobɛto me atwene atɛkyɛ amena mu, ama mʼatadeɛ mpo akyiri me.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: “Ɔnyɛ onipa te sɛ me na mayi nʼano, na yɛakɔgyina asɛnniiɛ abobɔ yɛn nkuro.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Sɛ anka obi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛsiesie yɛn ntam na waka yɛn baanu abɔ mu a,

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: obi a ɔbɛyi Onyankopɔn abaa afiri me so, sɛdeɛ nʼahunahuna mmɔ me hu bio a,

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: anka mɛkasa a merensuro no, nanso saa tebea a mewɔ mu yi deɛ, mentumi.

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: “Abrabɔ afono me; enti mɛka mʼasɛm a meremfa hwee nsie na mɛkasa afiri me kra yeadie mu.

english_verse: Don't just condemn me! Point out my sin.
translation_verse: Mɛka akyerɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: Mmu me kumfɔ, na mmom kyerɛ kwaadu a wobɔ me.

english_verse: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
translation_verse: Sɛ wohyɛ me so a, ɛdeɛn na wonya? Adɛn enti na wopo wo nsa ano adwuma na wosere hwɛ amumuyɛfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ?

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Wowɔ ɔhonam mu ani anaa? Wohunu adeɛ te sɛ ɔdasani anaa?

english_verse: Is your life as short as ours?
translation_verse: Wo nkwa nna te sɛ ɔdasani anaa wo mfeɛ te sɛ onipa,

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: a enti ɛsɛ sɛ wohwehwɛ me mfomsoɔ na wopɛɛpɛɛ me bɔne mu?

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ wonim sɛ menni fɔ deɛ, nanso obiara nso rentumi nnye me mfiri wo nsam.

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Kae sɛ wonwonoo me sɛ dɔteɛ. Na wobɛdane me ayɛ me mfuturo bio?

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: Woanhwie me sɛ nufosuo no womaa me mu piiɛ sɛ kyiisi,

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: amfa wedeɛ ne honam ankata me ho ankeka nnompe ne ntini antoatoa mu anaa?

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Womaa me nkwa, yii ayamyɛ kyerɛɛ me, na ɔhwɛsie mu, wohwɛɛ me honhom so.

english_verse: You have not explained all of your mysteries,
translation_verse: “Nanso yei na wode siee wʼakoma mu; na menim sɛ na yei wɔ wʼadwene mu.

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: Sɛ meyɛɛ bɔne a anka wobɛhwɛ me na wobɛma me ɛso asotwe.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mepagya me ti a, wodɛɛdɛɛ me sɛ gyata, na bio woda wo tumi nwanwa no adi tia me.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: Wode adansefoɔ foforɔ bɛtia me na woma wʼabofuo ano yɛ den wɔ me so; wʼakodɔm tu ba me so ɛberɛ biara.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: “Adɛn enti na woma wɔwoo me? Ɛkaa me nko a anka mewuiɛ ansa na ani bi rehunu me.

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: Aka kakra na me nna atwam, gyaa me na menya anigyeɛ ɛberɛ tiawa bi

english_verse: before I travel to the land
translation_verse: ansa na makɔ koransane kusuuyɛ ne sunsumma kabii asase so,

english_verse: of darkness and despair, the place of no return.
translation_verse: asase a ɛyɛ anadwo sum kabii, sunsumma tumm ne sakasaka, baabi a ɛhɔ hann mpo te sɛ esum.”

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Na Naamani Sofar buaa sɛ,

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Wo nsɛm hunu no bɛma nnipa ayɛ komm anaa? Sɛ wodi fɛ a obiara renka wʼanim anaa?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Woka kyerɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ, ‘Me gyidie ho nni asɛm na meyɛ pɛ wɔ wʼani so.’

english_verse: But I wish God would speak
translation_verse: Ao, anka mepɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn kasa, anka ɔnkasa ntia wo

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: na ɔmmue nyansa mu ahintasɛm so nkyerɛ wo, ɛfiri sɛ nyansa turodoo yɛ afanu. Hunu yei sɛ, Onyankopɔn werɛ afiri wo bɔne no bi mpo.

english_verse: Can you understand the mysteries surrounding God All-Powerful?
translation_verse: “Wobɛtumi ate Onyankopɔn anwanwadeɛ ase anaa? Wobɛtumi abɔre ahunu deɛ Otumfoɔ no tumi kɔpem anaa?

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Ɛkorɔn sene ɔsoro, ɛdeɛn na wobɛtumi ayɛ? Emu dɔ sene damena ase tɔnn, ɛdeɛn na wobɛtumi ahunu?

english_verse: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
translation_verse: Ne nsusuiɛ mu ware sene asase na ɛtrɛ sene ɛpo.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɔba na ɔde wo to nneduadan mu ansa na wasi nkonnwa a, hwan na ɔbɛtumi asi no ɛkwan?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Ampa ara ɔhyɛ nnipa nnaadaafoɔ nso; na sɛ ɔhunu amumuyɛ a, ɔnhyɛ ne nso anaa?

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Nanso ogyimifoɔ rentumi nyɛ onyansafoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔrentumi nwo afunumu ba sɛ onipa no.

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: “Na sɛ wode wʼakoma ma no na wopagya wo nsa kyerɛ no,

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: sɛ wogyaa bɔne a wokura no mu na woamma amumuyɛ antena wo ntomadan mu a,

english_verse: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ, wobɛpagya wo ti a womfɛre; wobɛgyina pintinn a wonsuro.

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: Wo werɛ bɛfiri wʼahokyere, na ɛbɛyɛ wo sɛ nsuo a asene korɔ.

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: Wʼabrabɔ bɛhyerɛn asene owigyinaeɛ, na esum bɛyɛ sɛ adekyeɛ hann.

english_verse: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
translation_verse: Wobɛnya banbɔ, ɛfiri sɛ anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ; wobɛhwɛ wo ho ahyia, na wahome asomdwoeɛ mu.

english_verse: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
translation_verse: Wobɛda ahome, na obi renhunahuna wo, na bebree bɛhwehwɛ mmoa afiri wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ ani bɛfira, wɔrentumi nnwane; na wɔn anidasoɔ bɛdane owuo ahomeguo.”

english_verse: Job said to his friends:
translation_verse: Na Hiob buaa sɛ,

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: “Ampa ara mone nnipa no, na mowu a na nyansa asa!

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Nanso mewɔ adwene sɛ mo ara na monnsene me. Hwan na ɔnnim saa nneɛma yi nyinaa?

english_verse: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
translation_verse: “Mayɛ aseredeɛ ama me nnamfonom, mefrɛɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔbuaeɛ. Mayɛ aseredeɛ tata, nanso metene, na me ho nni asɛm.

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Nnipa a wɔn ho tɔ wɔn bu amanehunu animtiaa sɛdeɛ wɔbu wɔn a wɔn nan rewatiri no awieeɛ animtiaa.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Wɔmmfa wɔn nsa nka akorɔmfoɔ ntomadan, na wɔn a wɔma Onyankopɔn bo fuo no wɔ banbɔ na Onyankopɔn bɔ deɛ ɔde ma wɔn ho ban.

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: “Bisa mmoa no, na wɔbɛkyerɛ wo anaasɛ ewiem nnomaa no, na wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Wɔn nyinaa mu hwan na ɔnnim sɛ Awurade nsa na ayɛ yei.

english_verse: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
translation_verse: Ne nsam na abɔdeɛ nyinaa ahome wɔ ne adasamma nyinaa ahome.

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: Aso nsɔ nsɛm nnhwɛ, sɛdeɛ tɛkrɛma ka aduane hwɛ no anaa?

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Wɔnnya nyansa mfiri mpanin nkyɛn, na ɛnyɛ ɔnyinkyerɛ na ɛde nteaseɛ ba anaa?

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: “Nyansa ne tumi yɛ Onyankopɔn dea; afotuo ne nteaseɛ yɛ ne dea.

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbubu guo no, obiara rentumi nsi; deɛ ɔde no to nneduadan mu no, obiara rentumi nyi no.

english_verse: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔma osuo gyae tɔ a, asase no so yɛ wesee; sɛ ɔgyaa osutɔ mu a, ɛsɛe asase no.

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Ahoɔden ne nkonimdie wɔ no osisifoɔ ne deɛ wɔsisi noɔ nso wɔ no.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: Ɔpa afotufoɔ ho ntoma ma wɔkɔ na ɔma atemmufoɔ yɛ nkwasea.

english_verse: and makes slaves of kings.
translation_verse: Ɔworɔ ahemfo nkyehoma na ɔde abɔsoɔ bɔ wɔn asene.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: Ɔpa asɔfoɔ ho ntoma, na ɔtu nnipa a wɔn ase atim akyɛre gu.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: Ɔde animguaseɛ gu atitire so na ɔtintim gye ahoɔdenfoɔ nsam akodeɛ.

english_verse: he makes nations strong, then shatters their strength.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ aman akɛseɛ, na ɔsɛe wɔn; ɔtrɛ aman mu, na ɔhwete wɔn mu.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: Ɔgye ewiase akannifoɔ adwene firi wɔn nsam; na ɔma wɔkyinkyini asase wesee a ɛkwan nna soɔ so.

english_verse: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
translation_verse: Wɔhwehwɛ wɔ esum mu a wɔnni kanea; na ɔma wɔtɔ ntintan sɛ asabofoɔ.

english_verse: I know and understand every bit of this.
translation_verse: “Mʼani ahunu yeinom nyinaa, mʼaso ate, na ate aseɛ nso.

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Deɛ wonim no, me nso menim; wo nsene me.

english_verse: But I prefer to argue my case with God All-Powerful—
translation_verse: Nanso mepɛ sɛ mekasa kyerɛ Otumfoɔ no na me ne Onyankopɔn toatoa adwene wɔ mʼasɛm ho.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Mode atorɔ mmom na afɔre me ho; mo nyinaa moyɛ ayaresafoɔ a mo ho nni mfasoɔ!

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Sɛ mobɛyɛ komm koraa a ɛno na ɛbɛyɛ nyansa ama mo!

english_verse: and listen to my argument.
translation_verse: Afei montie mʼano asɛm; montie mʼanoyie.

english_verse: Are you telling lies for God
translation_verse: Mobɛka amumuyɛsɛm ama Onyankopɔn anaa? Mobɛka nnaadaasɛm ama no anaa?

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Mobɛkyea mo aso ama no? Mobɛka Onyankopɔn asɛm ama no anaa?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhwehwɛ mo mu a, ɛbɛsi mo yie anaa? Mobɛtumi adaadaa no sɛdeɛ modaadaa nnipa no anaa?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Sɛ mokyeaa mo aso wɔ kɔkoam a, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ biara, ɔbɛka mo anim.

english_verse: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.
translation_verse: Nʼanimuonyam mmɔ mo hu anaa? Ne ho suro nntɔ mo so anaa?

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Mo kasatɔmmɛ yɛ mmɛbuo a ɛte sɛ nsõ; mo anoyie yɛ dɔteɛ.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: “Monyɛ dinn, na menkasa; na deɛ ɛbɛyɛ me biara mmra me so.

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na mede me ho to amaneɛ mu na mede me nkwa to me nsam?

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ ɔkumm me deɛ, nanso ne so na mʼani bɛda; ampa ara mɛdi mʼakwan ho adanseɛ wɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: Nokorɛm, yei na ɛbɛyɛ me nkwagyeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ ɔnsuro Onyankopɔn no rentumi nkɔ nʼanim!

english_verse: Listen carefully to my words!
translation_verse: Montie me nsɛm yi yie; monyɛ aso mma deɛ meka.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Afei a masiesie me nkurobɔ yi, menim sɛ mɛdi bem.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Obi bɛtumi abɔ me kwaadu anaa? Sɛ ɛte saa deɛ a, anka mɛyɛ komm na mawu.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: “Ao Onyankopɔn, yɛ saa nneɛma mmienu yi pɛ ma me, na afei meremfa me ho nsuma wo:

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Afei samena me na mɛba, anaa ma menkasa na bua me.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Mfomsoɔ ne bɔne dodoɔ ahe na mayɛ? Kyerɛ me me mfomsoɔ ne me bɔne.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na wode wʼanim asie me na wodwene sɛ meyɛ wo ɔtamfoɔ?

english_verse: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
translation_verse: Wobɛyɛ ahahan a mframa rebɔ no ayayadeɛ anaa? Wobɛtaa ntɛtɛ a awoɔ anaa?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Wotwerɛ soboɔ a ɛyɛ yea tia me, na woka me mmabunuberɛ mu bɔne nyinaa gu me so.

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: Wode nkyehoma gu me nan; wohwɛ mʼanammɔnkwan nyinaa so yie na wode ahyɛnsodeɛ ayeyɛ mʼanammɔn mu.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: “Enti onipa nkwa sa te sɛ biribi a aporɔ, te sɛ atadeɛ a nweweboa adie.

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: “Onipa a ɔbaa awo no no ne nna yɛ tiaa bi na ɔhaw dɔɔso wɔ mu.

english_verse: We are flowers that fade and shadows that vanish.
translation_verse: Ɔfefɛ te sɛ nhwiren na ɛtwintwam; ɔte sɛ sunsum a ɛretwam akɔ, ɔntena hɔ nkyɛ.

english_verse: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
translation_verse: Woma wʼani kɔ saa onipa yi so? Wode no bɛba wʼanim abɛbu no atɛn anaa?

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtumi ayi deɛ ɛyɛ kronn afiri efi mu? Obiara nni hɔ.

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Woahyehyɛ onipa nkwa nna; woahyɛ nʼabosome dodoɔ ato hɔ na woahyɛ no ɛberɛ a ɔrentumi ntra.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: Enti, yi wʼani firi ne so na ɔnyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ, kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛwie nʼadwuma sɛ ɔpaani.

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: “Dua mpo anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ ma no: Sɛ wɔtwa a, ɛbɛfefɛ bio, na ne mman foforɔ no rempempan.

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: nanso, ɔnya nsuo a ɛfefɛ, na ɛyiyi mman sɛ dua a wɔatɛ.

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ nsuo tu yera wɔ ɛpo mu no, anaa sɛdeɛ nsuka mu weɛ no,

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: saa ara na onipa tɔ fam na ɔnsɔre bio; ɛnkɔsi sɛ ɔsoro bɛtwam no, nnipa rensɔre na wɔrennyane wɔn mfiri wɔn nna mu.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: “Sɛ anka wode me bɛsie damena mu de me ahinta kɔsi sɛ wʼabofuo bɛtwam! Sɛ anka wobɛhyɛ me berɛ na afei woakae me!

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa wu a, ɔbɛba nkwa mu bio anaa? Mʼaperedie nna mu nyinaa mɛtwɛn akɔsi sɛ me foforɔyɛ bɛba.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Wobɛfrɛ na mɛgye wo so; wʼani bɛgyina abɔdeɛ a wo nsa ayɛ.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Afei wobɛkan mʼanammɔntuo na worenni me bɔne akyi.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛsɔ me bɔne ano wɔ kotokuo mu, na woakata mʼamumuyɛ so.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: “Nanso, sɛdeɛ mmepɔ so hohoro na ɛdwirie na abotan nso twe firi ne siberɛ no,

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: sɛdeɛ nsuo yiyi aboɔ ho na osutɔ brane twe dɔteɛ kɔ no saa ara na wosɛe onipa anidasoɔ.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Wotintim ne so prɛko pɛ, na ɔtwam kɔ; wosakyera ne nipasu na wogya no kwan.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔhyɛ ne mmammarima animuonyam a, ɔnnim; na sɛ wɔbrɛ wɔn ase a, ɔnhunu.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɔno ara wedeɛ mu yea na ɔteɛ na ɔno ara ne ho na ɔgyam.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Na Temanni Elifas buaa sɛ,

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Ɔde nsɛm huhuo bɛdi anobaabaeɛ, aka nsɛm a ɛntu bunu biara anaa?

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Wototo onyamesuro ase mmom na wosi Onyankopɔn mu ahotosoɔ ho ɛkwan.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Wo bɔne kyerɛ wʼano deɛ ɔnka; na woafa aniteɛ tɛkrɛma.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Wo ankasa wʼano bu wo kumfɔ, ɛnyɛ me deɛ; wʼankasa wʼano di adanseɛ tia wo.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: “Wone onipa a wɔwoo wo dii ɛkan? Wɔwoo wo ansa na wɔrewo nkokoɔ?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Wotie Onyankopɔn afotuo anaa? Wo nko ara na wonim nyansa anaa?

english_verse: Do you know and understand something we don't?
translation_verse: Ɛdeɛn na wonim a, yɛnnim? Nhunumu bɛn na wowɔ a yɛnnie?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Deɛ wafu dwono ne akɔkoraa wɔ yɛn afa, wɔn a wɔanyini sene wʼagya mpo.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn awerɛkyekyerɛ ne nsɛm a wɔka no brɛoo kyerɛ wo no sua ma wo anaa?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na wʼakoma atwe wo korɔ adɛn enti na wʼani asɔ ogya,

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: na woadane wʼabofuo agu Onyankopɔn so na woma saa nsɛm yi pue firi wʼano?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nni ahotosoɔ wɔ nʼakronkronfoɔ mu. Ɔsorosoro mpo nnyɛ kronn wɔ nʼani so,

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: na nkantom onipa bɔnefoɔ ne omumuyɛfoɔ a ɔnom awurukasɛm sɛ nsuo.

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: “Tie me, na mɛkyerɛ wo mu; ma menka deɛ mahunu nkyerɛ wo,

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ kɔ ahohiahia mu ne nkwanna nyinaa. Na basabasayɛni nso, wɔahyehyɛ ne mfeɛ nyinaa ama no.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Nnyegyeɛ a ɛyɛ hu hyɛ nʼasom ma; na sɛ ɛyɛ sɛ nneɛma rekɔ yie ma no a, akorɔmfoɔ to hyɛ ne so.

english_verse: Darkness, despair, and death are their destiny.
translation_verse: Ɔpa aba sɛ ɔbɛdwane afiri esum mu; wɔabɔ no ato hɔ ama akofena.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Ɔkyinkyini hwehwɛ aduane; ɔnim sɛ esum da no abɛn.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw ne ahoyera yi no hu; ɛhyɛ ne so sɛ ɔhene a wasiesie ne ho ama ɔko,

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ ɔtenetene ne nsa kyerɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔma ne ho so tia Otumfoɔ.

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: Wɔde akokyɛm a emu pi na ɛyɛ den kɔ ne so a wɔnsuro no.

english_verse: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
translation_verse: nanso wɔbɛtena nkuro a aguo so na wɔatena afie a obi nte mu, afie a ɛrebubu mu.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Esum bɛduru wɔn; ogyaframa bɛkusa wɔn mman, na Onyankopɔn anom ahomeguo bɛsoa wɔn akɔ.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho to nneɛma huhuo so de daadaa wɔn ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔrennya hwee mfiri mu.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛyɛ sɛ bobedua a wɔapore so aba a ɛnnyiniiɛ, te sɛ ngo dua a ne nhyerɛnne repore gu fam.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Na abɔnefoɔ fekuo a wɔnnim Onyankopɔn no renso aba, na ogya bɛhye wɔn a wɔdɔ kɛtɛasehyɛ no ntomadan.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Wɔnyinsɛn ɔhaw na wɔwo amumuyɛ; wɔn awotwaa siesie nnaadaa.”

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: “Mate nsɛm bebree a ɛte sɛ yeinom; na mo nyinaa moyɛ gyamserefoɔ!

english_verse: So why don't you keep quiet? What's bothering you?
translation_verse: Mo kasa tentene no mma awieeɛ anaa? Ɛdeɛn na ɛha mo enti a mogu so redi anobaabaeɛ yi?

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Sɛ mo na mowɔ me tebea yi mu a, anka me nso mɛtumi akasa sɛ mo; anka mɛtumi akeka nsɛm a ɛyɛ dɛ atia mo na mabu mo animtiaa.

english_verse: But I would offer hope and comfort instead.
translation_verse: Nanso, anka mɛhyɛ mo den; anka awerɛkyekyerɛ nsɛm a ɛbɛfiri mʼanomu no bɛma mo ahotɔ.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: “Nanso sɛ mekasa a, ɔyea a mete no remmoto; na sɛ mankasa nso a, ɛrennyae.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, ampa ara woama mabrɛ; woasɛe me fie pasaa.

english_verse: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
translation_verse: Woakyekyere me, ma abɛyɛ adansedie; me so teɛ ara na ɛreteɛ, na ɛdi adanseɛ tia me.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn to hyɛ me so tete me wɔ nʼabufuo mu na ɔtwɛre ne se gu me so; deɛ ɔne me anya no pɔkyere nʼani hwɛ me.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn de me ama abɔnefoɔ. Wato me atwene amumuyɛfoɔ nsam.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Na biribiara kɔ yie ma me, nanso ɔdwerɛɛ me; ɔsɔɔ me kɔn mu, too me hwee hɔ. Ɔde me asi nʼani so;

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: nʼagyantofoɔ atwa me ho ahyia, ɔhwiree me sawa mu a wanhunu me mmɔbɔ maa me bɔnwoma pete guu fam.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: “Mapam ayitoma akata me wedeɛ so na masie mʼanintɔn wɔ mfuturo mu.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Agyaadwotwa ama mʼani ayɛ kɔɔ; sunsum kabii atwa mʼani ho ahyia.

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Nanso, me nsa nyɛɛ basabasayɛ biara na me mpaeɛbɔ yɛ kronn.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: “Ao asase, nkata me mogya so; na mma wɔnsie me sufrɛ!

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Seesei mpo, me danseni wɔ soro; Me ɔkamafoɔ wɔ soro hɔ.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Me ɔdimafoɔ yɛ mʼadamfo ɛberɛ a mesu gu Onyankopɔn soɔ yi;

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: ɔgyina onipa anan mu di ma no wɔ Onyankopɔn anim sɛdeɛ obi di ma nʼadamfo no.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: “Mfeɛ kakra bi akyi mɛtu kwan akɔ koransane.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Me sunsum atɔ piti, me nna so atwa, na damena retwɛn me.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Ampa ara fɛdifoɔ atwa me ho ahyia; ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ wɔn atutupɛ.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: “Ao Onyankopɔn, hyɛ me ɛbɔ a wopɛ. Hwan bio na ɔbɛma me banbɔ?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Woato wɔn adwene mu a wɔnte asɛm ase; enti woremma wɔnni nkonim.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi sopa ne nnamfonom de nya akatua a, ne mma ani bɛfira.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn de me ayɛ asɛm a ɛda obiara ano, obi a wɔte ntasuo gu nʼani so.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Awerɛhoɔ ama mʼani ayɛ samoo me bɔberɛ nyinaa yɛ sunsumma.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Ateneneefoɔ hunu me a, ɛyɛ wɔn nwanwa. Wɔn a wɔdi bem no bɛsɔre atia wɔn a wɔnni nyamesu.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Ateneneefoɔ bɛkɔ wɔn anim, na wɔn a wɔn nsa ho teɛ bɛkɔ so anya ahoɔden.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: “Mo nyinaa mo nsane mmra mmɛsɔ me nhwɛ! Na merennya onyansafoɔ wɔ mo mu.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Me nna atwam, me nhyehyɛeɛ apansam, saa ara na mʼakoma apɛdeɛ nso ayɛ.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Saa nnipa yi ma anadwo dane awia; esum mu koraa no, wɔka sɛ, ‘Hann abɛn,’

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Sɛ efie baako pɛ a mʼani da so ne damena, sɛ mesɛ me kɛtɛ wɔ esum mu,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: sɛ meka kyerɛ porɔeɛ sɛ, ‘Woyɛ mʼagya,’ na me kyerɛ ɔsonsono sɛ, ‘Me maame’ anaa ‘Me nuabaa’ a,

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: na afei mʼanidasoɔ wɔ he? Hwan na ɔbɛtumi anya anidasoɔ bi ama me?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ɛbɛsiane akɔ owuo ɛpono ano anaa? Yɛn nyinaa bɛsiane akɔ mfuturo mu anaa?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Na Suhini Bildad buaa sɛ,

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Ɛberɛ bɛn na wobɛgyae kasa tenten yi? Dwene ho yie, na afei yɛbɛtumi akasa.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na wofa yɛn sɛ anantwie na wosusu sɛ yɛnnim nyansa yi?

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: Wo a wode abufuo tete wo mu nketenkete, wo enti, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛfiri asase yi so anaasɛ wo enti, wɔnnwiri mmotan mfiri wɔn siberɛ anaa?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: “Omumuyɛfoɔ kanea adum; na ne ogya nnɛre bio.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Nʼanammɔntuo mu ahoɔden ano bɛbrɛ ase; nʼankasa nhyehyɛeɛ bɛhwe nʼase.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Afidie sɔ ne nantin na ɛsɔ ne mu denden.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Atoyerɛnkyɛm kɔn dɔ no; na sɛ ɔhwe ase a, amanehunu retwɛn no.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Ɛwewe ne honam ani baabi; na owuo di ɛkan sɛe nʼakwaa.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Wɔtwe no firi ne ntomadan banbɔeɛ mu na wɔde no brɛ ahunahunahene.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Ogya te ne ntomadan mu; na wɔabɔ sɔfe a ɛrederɛ apete nʼatenaeɛ.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Ne nhini wuwu wɔ aseɛ na ne mman nso wu wɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Wɔka no firi hann mu kɔ sum mu na wɔpam no firi ewiase.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Ampa ara sei na omumuyɛfoɔ atenaeɛ teɛ; sei ne beaeɛ a deɛ ɔnnim Onyankopɔn teɛ.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Mobɛhyɛ me aniɛyaa na mode nsɛm abubu me akɔsi da bɛn?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Mpɛn edu nie a moasopa me; mo ani nwu sɛ moto hyɛ me so.

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ sɛ mafom ɛkwan a, me mfomsoɔ yɛ me nko ara asɛm.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Sɛ ampa sɛ mobɛma mo ho so wɔ me so na mode mʼanimguaseɛ ayɛ adanseɛ atia me a,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ monhunu sɛ Onyankopɔn ayɛ me bɔne na ɔde nʼatena atwa me ho ahyia.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: “Ɛwom sɛ mesu sɛ, ‘Wɔafom me’ deɛ, nanso obiara mmua me; meteam pɛ mmoa, nanso atɛntenenee biara nni hɔ.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Wasi me ɛkwan enti mentumi mensene; wama mʼakwan so aduru sum.

english_verse: God rips me apart, uproots my hopes,
translation_verse: Wasɛe me akwannuasa nyinaa so de awie me; watu mʼanidasoɔ ase te sɛ dua.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Nʼabufuo huru tia me; na wakan me afra nʼatamfoɔ mu.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: Nʼakodɔm ba anibereɛ so; wɔsisi mpie de tia me na wɔtwa me ntomadan ho hyia.

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: “Wayi me nuammarima afiri me ho; na mʼamanifoɔ nso, watwe wɔn ho koraa.

english_verse: and I am forgotten.
translation_verse: Mʼabusuafoɔ kɔ; na me nnamfonom werɛ afiri me.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Mʼahɔhoɔ ne me mmaawa bu me sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ; mete sɛ ɔnanani ma wɔn.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Mefrɛ me ɔsomfoɔ, na ɔmmua; mpo, mete mʼano srɛ no.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Me home bɔn me yere; me ho afono mʼankasa nuammarima.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Mpo, mmarimmaa nkumaa bu me animtiaa; sɛ mepue a wɔdi me ho fɛw.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Me nnamfo berɛboɔ kyiri me; mʼadɔfoɔ asɔre atia me.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Maka honam ne nnompe, na ɛkaa kakraa bi, anka merewu.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: “Monhunu me mmɔbɔ, me nnamfonom, monhunu mmɔbɔ, na Onyankopɔn nsa abɔ me.

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na motaa me so, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ no? Na mommfa me honam mu yea yi saa ara?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: “Ao, anka wɔmfa me nsɛm nhyɛ nwoma mu, anka wɔntwerɛ wɔ nwoma mmobɔeɛ so,

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Menim sɛ me odimafoɔ te ase, na awieeɛ no ɔbɛsɔre agyina asase so.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Na sɛ me wedeɛ wie sɛe a, mede mʼani bɛhunu Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Me ara mɛhunu no mede mʼani, na ɛnyɛ obi foforɔ ani, bɛhunu no. Mʼakoma ho pere no wɔ me mu.

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: “Sɛ moka sɛ, ‘Yɛbɛteetee no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhaw no firi ɔno ara’ a,

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: ɛsɛ sɛ mosuro akofena no. Abufuo nam akofena so de asotwe bɛba, na mobɛhunu sɛ atemmuo wɔ hɔ.”

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Na Naamani Sofar buaa sɛ,

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Mate animka bi a ɛgu me ho fi, na nteaseɛ a menya no hyɛ me sɛ memmua.

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: “Ampa ara wonim sɛdeɛ nneɛma teɛ firi tete, ɛfiri ɛberɛ a wɔde nnipa duaa asase so,

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ ani gye ɛberɛ tiawa bi mu, na wɔn a wɔnnsuro nyame nso anigyeɛ nkyɛ.

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ nʼahohoahoa kɔduru ɔsoro, na ne tiri kɔpem omununkum deɛ,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: nanso, ɔbɛyera afebɔɔ te sɛ nʼankasa agyanan; na wɔn a wɔhunuu no no bɛbisa sɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ he?’

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Ani a ɛhunu noɔ no renhunu no bio; na ne siberɛ nso renhunu no bio.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Ne mma bɛsrɛ adeɛ afiri ahiafoɔ hɔ; ɛsɛ sɛ nʼankasa de nʼahonya sane ma.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ne mmeranteberɛ mu ahoɔden a ahyɛ ne nnompe ma no ne no bɛkɔ mfuturo mu.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: “Ɛwom sɛ bɔne yɛ nʼanom dɛ na ɔde sie ne tɛkrɛma ase;

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: nanso, nʼaduane bɛyɛ nwono wɔ ne yafunu mu; ɛbɛyɛ ɔtweaseɛ ano borɔ wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛfe ahonyadeɛ a ɔmeneeɛ no; Onyankopɔn bɛma ne yafunu apu agu.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Ɔbɛfefe awɔ borɔ; Ɔnanka se bɛkum no.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ɔrennya nsuwansuwa no nnom nsubɔntene a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ mu no.

english_verse: Their hard work will result in nothing gained,
translation_verse: Ɔbɛdane deɛ ɔbrɛ nyaeɛ no aba a ɔrenni bi; ɔremfa nʼadwadie mu mfasoɔ nnye nʼani.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Wafom nneɛma nyinaa awie; ne nkɔsoɔ nnuru baabiara.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Nʼadedodoɔ nyinaa mu no, ɔbɛkɔ ɔhaw mu; na amanehunu a emu yɛ den bɛto no.

english_verse: and God will make them swallow his blazing anger.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a nʼafuru ayɛ ma no, Onyankopɔn bɛtɔ nʼabufuo ogya agu ne so na wabobɔ no basabasa.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
