translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ ɔdwane firi dadeɛ akodeɛ ano nanso bɛmma a ano yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ bɛwɔ no.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Wɔbɛtwe bɛmma no firi nʼakyi, ano hyɛnhyɛn no bɛfiri ne brɛboɔ mu. Ehu bɛba ne so;

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: esum kabii bɛduru nʼakoradeɛ. Ogya a wɔmfite mu bɛhye no, na asɛe deɛ aka wɔ ne ntomadan mu.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Ɔsoro bɛda nʼafɔdie adi, na asase asɔre atia no.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Nsuyire bɛtwe ne fie akɔ, saa ara na nsuworosoɔ bɛyɛ Onyankopɔn abufuhyeɛ da no.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Yei ne hyɛberɛ a Onyankopɔn de ma amumuyɛfoɔ, awugyadeɛ a Onyankopɔn de ato wɔn hɔ.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: “Montie me nsɛm no yie. Momma yei nyɛ awerɛkyekyerɛ a mode ma me.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Monnya ntoboaseɛ mma me ɛberɛ a merekasa, na sɛ mekasa wie a, monkɔso nni fɛ.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: “Me nwiinwii hyɛ onipa anaa? Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ menya ntoboaseɛ?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Monhwɛ me, na mo ho nnwiri mo; momfa mo nsa nkata mo ano.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Sɛ medwene yei ho a, mebɔ hu; na me ho popo.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na amumuyɛfoɔ tena nkwa mu? Wɔnyini kyɛ na wɔkɔ so di tumi.

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Wɔhunu wɔn mma a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no nkɔsoɔ, wɔhunu wɔn nananom.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw nni wɔn afie na ehu nni hɔ; Onyankopɔn asotwe mma wɔn so.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Wɔn anantwinini nyɛ akrawa; na wɔn anantwibereɛ wo a, wɔmpɔn.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Wɔka wɔn mma bɔ mu te sɛ nnwankuo; na emu mmotafowa no hurihuri.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Wɔto nnwom wɔ akasaeɛ ne sankuo so; na wɔde atɛntɛbɛn nnyegyeeɛ gye wɔn ani.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Wɔdi yie wɔn nkwanna mu na wɔkɔ damena mu asomdwoeɛ mu.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔka kyerɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ, ‘Firi yɛn so! Yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛhunu wʼakwan.

english_verse: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?
translation_verse: Hwan ne otumfoɔ no a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsom no? Sɛ yɛbɔ no mpaeɛ a mfasoɔ bɛn na yɛbɛnya?’

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Nanso, wɔn nkɔsoɔ no nni wɔn nsam, enti metwe me ho firi amumuyɛfoɔ afutuo ho.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: “Nanso mpɛn ahe na wɔdum amumuyɛfoɔ kanea? Mpɛn ahe na amanehunu ba wɔn so, deɛ Onyankopɔn firi nʼabufuo mu de ba no?

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Mpɛn ahe na wɔyɛ sɛ ɛserɛ wɔ mframa ano, te sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa den bi apra wɔn?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Wɔka sɛ, ‘Onyankopɔn kora onipa asotwe so de twɛn ne mma.’ Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtwe ɔnipa no ankasa aso ma ɔhunu.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn ankasa ani nhunu wɔn sɛeɛ; ma Otumfoɔ abufuhyeɛ no nka wɔn ani.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Wɔn abusuafoɔ a wɔagya wɔn akyire no renya hwee nʼagyapadeɛ nyinaa bɛsɛe.

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: “Obi bɛtumi akyerɛ Onyankopɔn nyansa, wɔ ɛberɛ a ɔbu atitire mpo atɛn?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Ɔfoforɔ nso de ɔkra mu yeadie wu, a wanka asetena pa anhwɛ da.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Wɔsie wɔn nyinaa wɔ mfuturo korɔ mu, ma asonson korɔ no ara nuka wɔn.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: “Mahunu mo adwene, ɛkwan a mopɛ sɛ mobu me fɔ.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Mopɛ sɛ moka kyerɛ me sɛdeɛ asikafoɔ ne amumuyɛfoɔ, wɔn bɔne enti, wɔhwere wɔn agyapadeɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: Everyone, near and far, agrees
translation_verse: Nanso mommisa wɔn a wɔtu kwan; wɔbɛka akyerɛ mo sɛ

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: onipa bɔne nya ne ti didi mu amanehunu da, na wɔgyaa no ma no dwane abufuhyeɛ da.

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔtumi kasa nʼanim? Hwan na ɔtua no deɛ wayɛ so ka?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Wɔsoa no kɔ damena mu, na wɔwɛn nʼaboda.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: “Enti ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mode mo nsɛnhunu akyekyere me werɛ? Mo mmuaeɛ nyɛ hwee sɛ atorɔ!”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Na Temanni Elifas buaa sɛ,

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn bɛnya onipa ho mfasoɔ anaa? Mpo onyansafoɔ ho bɛba no mfasoɔ anaa?

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ ɔteneneeni a, anigyeɛ bɛn na Otumfoɔ no bɛnya? Sɛ wʼakwan ho nni asɛm a, mfasoɔ bɛn na ɔbɛnya?

english_verse: Is he correcting you for worshiping him?
translation_verse: “Wo kronnyɛ enti na ɔka wʼanim na ɔbɔ wo kwaadu anaa?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ wʼamumuyɛ na ɛsoɔ? Ɛnyɛ wo bɔne na ɛdɔɔso dodo?

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Wopɛɛ banbɔ firii wo nuanom nkyɛn a ɛnni nteaseɛ biara; wopaa nnipa ho ntoma ma wɔdaa adagya.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Woamma abrɛfoɔ nsuo annom na woamfa aduane amma deɛ ɛkɔm de no.

english_verse: although you were rich, respected, and powerful.
translation_verse: Nanso na woyɛ obi a ɔwɔ tumi, na ɔwɔ nsase, onimuonyamfoɔ a ɔte so.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Wopamoo akunafoɔ ma wɔkɔɔ nsapan na womaa nwisiaa nso ahoɔden saeɛ.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: adɛn enti na esum aduru a wonhunu adeɛ, na asorɔkye akata wo so.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn nni ɔsoro akyirikyiri? Hwɛ sɛdeɛ ɔsoro akyirikyiri nsoromma korɔn!

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Nanso woka sɛ, ‘Ɛdeɛn na Onyankopɔn nim? Esum yi mu na ɔbu atɛn anaa?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Omununkum kabii akata nʼanim enti ɔnhunu yɛn ɛberɛ a ɔnenam ɔsoro kɔntɔnkurowi mu.’

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Wobɛkɔ so afa ɛkwan dada a abɔnefoɔ anante soɔ no so?

english_verse: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
translation_verse: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ, ‘Gyaa yɛn! Ɛdeɛn na Otumfoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ yɛn?’

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Nanso, ɛyɛ ɔno na ɔde nnepa hyɛɛ wɔn afie mu, enti metwe me ho mefiri amumuyɛfoɔ afutuo ho.

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ hunu wɔn asehweɛ ma wɔn ani gye; na wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm sere wɔn ka sɛ,

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Wɔasɛe yɛn atamfoɔ, na ogya ahye wɔn agyapadeɛ.’

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: “Fa wo ho ma Onyankopɔn na nya asomdwoeɛ wɔ ne mu; saa ɛkwan yi so na yiedie bɛyɛ wo kyɛfa.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Tie akwankyerɛ a ɛfiri nʼanom, na fa ne nsɛm sie wʼakoma mu.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Sɛ wosane kɔ Otumfoɔ no nkyɛn a, ɔbɛgye wo atom bio: sɛ woyi amumuyɛsɛm firi wo ntomadan mu

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: na woto wo sika mpɔ gu mfuturo mu ne Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ gu abotan a ɛwɔ abɔn mu no so a,

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ Otumfoɔ bɛyɛ wo sikakɔkɔɔ; ɔbɛyɛ dwetɛ amapa ama wo.

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: Afei nokorɛm wobɛnya anigyeɛ wɔ Otumfoɔ mu na wobɛpagya wʼani akyerɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Wobɛbɔ no mpaeɛ, na ɔbɛtie wo, na wobɛdi wo bɔhyɛ so.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Deɛ woyɛ wʼadwene sɛ wobɛyɛ no bɛba mu, na hann bɛtɔ wʼakwan so.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnipa hwe ase na woka sɛ, ‘Ma wɔn so!’ a, ɔbɛgye wɔn a wɔahwe ase no nkwa.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛgye abɔnefoɔ mpo, ɔnam wo nsa a ɛho nni fi so bɛgye wɔn.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Ɛnnɛ mpo, mʼabooboodie mu da so yɛ den; ne nsa ayɛ den mʼapinisie nyinaa akyi.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Sɛ menim baabi a mɛhunu no; anaasɛ mɛtumi akɔ ne tenaberɛ a,

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Anka mɛte mmuaeɛ a ɔde bɛma me, na madwene deɛ ɔbɛka ho.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Ɔde tumi a ɛso bɛtia me anaa? Dabi, ɔremmɔ me kwaadu.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ deɛ nnipa tenenee bɛtumi aka nʼasɛm wɔ nʼanim, na wɔbɛgye me afiri me ɔtemmufoɔ nsam afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: “Nanso sɛ mekɔ apueeɛ fam a, ɔnni hɔ; sɛ mekɔ atɔeɛ fam nso a, menhunu no.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ atifi fam a, menhunu no; sɛ ɔdane ne ho kɔ anafoɔ fam a, mʼani nhye ne ho.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Nanso, ɔnim ɛkwan a me nam soɔ; na sɛ ɔsɔ me hwɛ a, mɛfiri mu aba sɛ sikakɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Madi nʼanammɔn akyi pɛɛ; na manante nʼakwan so a mammane.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: “Nanso ɔbiara nni hɔ ka ne ho, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi atia no? Ɔyɛ biribiara a ɔpɛ.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Ɔhwɛ ma ne ɔhyɛ nsɛm tia me; ɔda so kora nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛte sei bebree.

english_verse: makes me tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn ama mʼakoma aboto; Otumfoɔ ama mabɔ huboa.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Nanso esum no mma menka mʼano ntom, esum kabii a ɛkata mʼanim no mpo.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: “Adɛn enti na Onyankopɔn nhyɛ berɛ mma atemmuo? Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔnim noɔ no hwɛ saa da no anim ɛnso ɛmma da?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Nnipa yiyi aboɔ a wɔde ato hyeɛ; na wɔde nnwankuo a wɔawia kɔ hɔ adidi.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Wɔpam nwisiaa mfunumu na wɔgye akunafoɔ anantwie sɛ awowasideɛ.

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: Wɔsum ahiafoɔ firi ɛkwan so na wɔhyɛ asase no so ahiafoɔ ma wɔkɔtetɛ.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Ahiafoɔ no yɛ wɔn adwuma pɛ aduane te sɛ ɛserɛ so mfunumu no; asase wesee no so na wɔnya aduane ma wɔn mma.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Wɔboaboa mmoa aduane ano wɔ mfuo no so na wɔdi mpɛpɛ wɔ amumuyɛfoɔ bobe nturo mu.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Wɔnni ntoma, na wɔda kwaterekwa; wɔnni hwee a wɔde kata wɔn ho wɔ awɔ mu.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Mmepɔ so osutɔ fɔ wɔn twɔnn na wɔfomfam mmotan no ho ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni ahatasoɔ.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Wɔte awisiaa firi nufoɔ ano; na wɔfa ohiani abotafoa de si ne ka anan mu.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Wɔnenam adagya a wɔnni ntoma; wɔsoa ayuo afiafi, nanso ɛkɔm de wɔn ara.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Wɔkyi ngo wɔn adan mu; wɔtiatia nsakyimena mu, nanso osukɔm de wɔn.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔrewuwuo no apinisie firi kuropɔn no mu, na apirafoɔ kra su pɛ mmoa. Nanso Onyankopɔn mfa bɔne nto obiara so.

english_verse: Some rebel and refuse to follow the light.
translation_verse: “Ebinom wɔ hɔ a wɔsɔre tia hann no, wɔn a wɔnnim nʼakwan anaasɛ wɔnnante nʼatempɔn so.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Sɛ adekyeɛ hann no kɔ a, owudifoɔ no sɔre na ɔkum ohiani ne mmɔborɔni; adesaeɛ mu, ɔwiawia ne ho sɛ ɔkorɔmfoɔ.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Ɔwaresɛefoɔ twɛn ɛberɛ a adeɛ resa; ɔka sɛ, ‘obiara renhunu me,’ na ɔde nʼanim hinta.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Esum mu na nnipa bubu apono wura afie mu, na awiaberɛ mu no, wɔtoto wɔn ho ɛpono mu; wɔne hann nni hwee yɛ.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Esum kabii yɛ adekyeɛ ma wɔn nyinaa; wɔne esum mu nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu fa nnamfo.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: “Nanso wɔte sɛ ahuro a ɛtɛ nsuo ani; wɔadome wɔn kyɛfa wɔ asase no so, enti obiara nnkɔ bobe nturo no mu.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ ɔhyew ne ɔpɛ de sukyerɛmma a anane korɔ no, saa ara na damena de wɔn a wɔayɛ bɔne korɔ.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Awotwaa werɛ firi wɔn, na ɔsonsono di wɔn nam; nnipa bɔne deɛ, wɔnnkae wɔn bio na mmom wɔbubu te sɛ dua.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Wɔde ɔbaa bonini a ɔnni ba yɛ haboa, na wɔnhunu akunafoɔ mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nam ne tumi so twe atumfoɔ kɔ; ɛwom sɛ wɔnya asetena pa deɛ, nanso wɔnni nkwa ho bɔhyɛ.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Ɔtumi ma wɔn tena ase asomdwoeɛ mu, nanso nʼani wɔ wɔn akwan so.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Wɔma wɔn so berɛ tiawa bi, na afei wɔnni hɔ bio; wɔbrɛ wɔn ase boaboa wɔn ano sɛ nnipa nyinaa; wɔtwitwa wɔn gu te sɛ aburoo ti.

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: “Sɛ yei nte saa a, hwan na ɔbɛtumi agye me akyinnyeɛ na ama deɛ maka ayɛ nsɛnhunu?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Na Suhini Bildad buaa sɛ,

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Tumi ne suro wɔ Onyankopɔn; ɔno na ɔhyehyɛ pɛpɛyɛ wɔ ɔsorosoro.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Wɔbɛtumi akan nʼakodɔm anaa? Hwan na ne hann nto ngu ne soɔ?

english_verse: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Ɔdasani bɛtene Onyankopɔn anim sɛn, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na deɛ ɔbaa awo no ho bɛteɛ?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Mpo sɛ ɔsrane nhyerɛn na nsoromma ho nte wɔ nʼani so a,

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: na nkantom onipa a ɔte sɛ nsaama, onipa ba a ɔyɛ ɔsonsono kɛkɛ!”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Woaboa deɛ ɔnni tumi! Woagye basa a ɛnni ahoɔden!

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Woatu deɛ ɔnnim nyansa fo! Na woada nhunumu pa ara adi!

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔboaa wo ma wokaa saa nsɛm yi? Hwan honhom na ɛkasa faa wo mu?

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: “Awufoɔ wɔ ahoyera kɛseɛ mu, wɔn a wɔwɔ nsuo ase ne deɛ ɛte mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Asamando da adagya Onyankopɔn anim; Ɔsɛeɛ nso nni nkatasoɔ.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛ atifi fam ewiem wɔ deɛ ɛda mpan so; na ɔde asase sensɛn ohunu so.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Ɔkyekyere nsuo hyɛ ne omununkum mu, nanso nsuo no mu duru ntumi mpae no.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛ ne omununkum mu de kata ɔsrane ani.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Ɔhyɛ agyiraeɛ wɔ nsuo so de to hyeɛ wɔ hann ne esum ntam.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Ɔsoro nnyinasoɔ woso, na nʼanimka ma wɔn ho dwiri wɔn.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne tumi wɔsoo ɛpo ne nyansa mu, ɔtwitwaa ɛpobɔpɔn mu asinasini.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Ɔde nʼahomeɛ maa ewiem teeɛ; na ne nsa wɔɔ ɔtweaseɛ a ɔrewea.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Yeinom yɛ ne nnwuma mfeafeaho; ɔka asomusɛm brɛoo kyerɛ yɛn! Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi ate ne tumi mmobɔmu no ase.”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Sɛ Onyankopɔn te ase yi, ɔno a wammu me atɛntenenee, Otumfoɔ a wama madi me kra mu awerɛhoɔ;

english_verse: I will tell only the truth.
translation_verse: mʼano renka amumuyɛsɛm, na me tɛkrɛma rentwa nkontompo.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Merennye nto mu da sɛ deɛ woka no yɛ nokorɛ; merenka me mudie nhyɛ, kɔsi sɛ mɛwuo.

english_verse: because each day my conscience agrees that I am innocent.
translation_verse: Mɛkura me tenenee mu. Merennyaa mu; sɛ mete ase yi, me tiboa remmu me fɔ.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: “Ma mʼatamfoɔ nyɛ sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ, na wɔn a wɔkyiri me nyɛ sɛ atorofoɔ.

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Anidasoɔ bɛn na deɛ ɔnni nyamesu no wɔ wɔ ne wuo akyi, ɛberɛ a Onyankopɔn agye ne nkwa afiri ne nsam?

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn tie ne sufrɛ ɛberɛ a amanehunu aba ne so anaa?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Nʼani bɛgye wɔ Otumfoɔ mu? Ɔbɛsu afrɛ Onyankopɔn ɛberɛ biara anaa?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: “Mɛma mo Onyankopɔn tumi ho nkyerɛkyerɛ; meremfa Otumfoɔ no akwan nhinta.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Mo ankasa moahunu yeinom nyinaa. Afei nsɛnhunu yi ase ne sɛn?

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: “Yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn ahyɛ ato hɔ ama omumuyɛfoɔ, agyapadeɛ a otirimuɔdenfoɔ nya firi Otumfoɔ nkyɛn:

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔwɔ mma dodoɔ sɛn ara, wɔn hyɛberɛ ne akofena; na nʼasefoɔ rennidi mmee da.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Ɔyaredɔm bɛsie wɔn a wɔbɛka wɔ nʼakyi, na wɔn akunafoɔ rensu wɔn.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ ɔhɔre dwetɛ te sɛ mfuturo na ɔboa ntoma ano sɛ dɔteɛ deɛ,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: nanso deɛ ɔpɛ gu hɔ no, ateneneefoɔ na wɔbɛfira na pɛpɛfoɔ no nso akyekyɛ dwetɛ no.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Efie a ɔsi no te sɛ ananse afafa, ɛte sɛ pata bi a ɔwɛmfoɔ abɔ.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Ɔda hɔ te sɛ ɔdefoɔ, nanso ɔrenna saa bio; ɔbɛte nʼani no na ne nyinaa atu ayera.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ahunahuna ba ne so sɛ nsuyire; ahum hwim no kɔ anadwo.

english_verse: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
translation_verse: Apueeɛ mframa soa no kɔ, na ɔnni hɔ bio; ɛtwe no firi ne teberɛ.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔ no a ahummɔborɔ nni mu ɛberɛ a ɔredwane afiri ne tumi ase.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Ɔde fɛ bɔ ne nsam na ɔpamoo no firi ne teberɛ.”

english_verse: Gold and silver are mined, then purified;
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ deɛ wɔtu dwetɛ ne beaeɛ a wɔhoa sika kɔkɔɔ ho.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Wɔtu dadeɛ firi fam, na wɔnane kɔbere firi dadeben mu.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Onipa ma esum ba awieeɛ; na ɔhwehwɛ kɔ akyirikyiri asase mu kɔpɛ dadeben wɔ esum kabii mu.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Asase a ɛbɔ aduane no, wɔnane aseɛ no te sɛ deɛ wɔde ogya na ayɛ;

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Ɔkɔdeɛ biara nnim saa kwan a ahinta no, akorɔma biara ani nhunuiɛ.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Mmoa ahantanfoɔ nnante wɔ hɔ na agyata nkɔdɛɛdɛɛ wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Onipa nsa paapae abotan denden na ɔma mmepɔ ase da hɔ.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Ɔtwa aka fa abotan mu, na ɔhunu nʼademudeɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Ɔhwehwɛ baabi a nsubɔntene ti wɔ na ɔda nneɛma a ahinta adi.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Na ebunu ka sɛ, “Ɛnni me mu”; na ɛpo nso sɛ, “Ɛnni me nkyɛn.”

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Wɔrentumi mfa sikakɔkɔɔ amapa ntɔ, na wɔrentumi mfa dwetɛ nkari ne boɔ.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Wɔrentumi mfa ahwehwɛ anaa sikakɔkɔɔ ntoto ho, na wɔrentumi mfa sikakɔkɔɔ nnwinneɛ nsesa.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛbɔ ahwene panin ne ahwehwɛboɔ din; nyansa boɔ sene nhwene pa.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Etiopia akarateboɔ ne no nsɛ; wɔrentumi mfa sikakɔkɔɔ kronn ntɔ.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Wɔde asie abɔdeɛ biara ani, wɔde asie ewiem nnomaa mpo.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛeɛ ne Owuo ka sɛ, “Yɛate no huhuhuhu kɛkɛ.”

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn te ɛkwan a ɛkɔ hɔ ase, na ɔno nko ara na ɔnim baabi a ɛteɛ,

english_verse: he alone sees everything beneath the heavens.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ ɔhwɛ kɔduru nsase ano na ɔhunu biribiara a ɛwɔ ɔsoro ase.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a ɔhyɛɛ mframa ano den too hɔ na ɔsusuu nsuwa no,

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a ɔkaa no ɔhyɛ so kyerɛɛ osutɔ na ɔtwaa ɛkwan maa aprannaa no,

english_verse: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.
translation_verse: afei ɔhwɛɛ nyansa na ɔkarii no hwɛeɛ; na ɔgyee no too mu na ɔsɔɔ no hwɛeɛ.

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ onipa sɛ, “Awurade suro, ɛno ne nyansa; na sɛ wɔkyiri bɔne a, wowɔ nteaseɛ.”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Mafe abosome a atwam no, nna a Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ me soɔ no,

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a ne kanea hyerɛn mʼatifi na mede ne kanea menantee esum mu no!

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Ao, ɛnna a mesii soɔ no, ɛberɛ a Onyankopɔn adamfofa a emu yɛ den hyiraa me fie,

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a na nufosuo mu sradeɛ afɔ mʼakwan na abotan hwiee ngo sɛ nsuo maa me.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: “Ɛberɛ a na mekɔ kuropɔn ɛpono ano mekɔtena mʼadwa so wɔ ɔmanfoɔ adwaberem,

english_verse: the young leaders stepped aside, *
translation_verse: mmeranteɛ hunu me a, wɔgyina nkyɛn na mpanimfoɔ sɔre gyina hɔ;

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: atitire gyae kasa na wɔde wɔn nsa kata wɔn ano;

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: mmapɔmma tɛm dinn, na wɔn tɛkrɛma ka wɔn dodom.

english_verse: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔte me nka nyinaa ka me ho asɛmpa, na wɔn a wɔhunu me nyinaa kamfo me,

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, meboaa ahiafoɔ a wɔsu pɛɛ mmoa, ne nwisiaa a wɔnni aboafoɔ.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Onipa a na ɔrewuo no hyiraa me; na memaa akunafoɔ ani gyee wɔn akoma mu.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Mede tenenee firaa sɛ mʼaduradeɛ; atɛntenenee yɛɛ me nkatasoɔ ne mʼabotire.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Meyɛɛ aniwa maa anifirafoɔ, ne ɛnan maa abubuafoɔ.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Meyɛɛ ahiafoɔ agya; na mekaa ahɔhoɔ asɛm maa wɔn.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Mebubuu amumuyɛfoɔ se na mehwim wɔn a wɔdi wɔn nya no firii wɔn anom.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: “Medwenee sɛ, ‘Mɛwu wɔ mʼankasa me fie mu, na me nna adɔɔso sɛ anwea.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Me nhini bɛduru nsuo ano, na obosuo agugu me mman so anadwo mu nyinaa.

english_verse: or like an archer's new bow.
translation_verse: Mʼanimuonyam bɛkɔ so ayɛ frɔmm wɔ me so, na mʼahoɔden ayɛ foforɔ.’

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: “Nnipa hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔtie me, wɔyɛɛ dinn, twɛnee mʼafotuo.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekasa wie a wɔnnkasa bio, ɛfiri sɛ me nsɛm tɔɔ wɔn asom yie.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Wɔtwɛnee me sɛdeɛ wɔtwɛne osutɔ, na wɔmenee me nsɛm sɛ osutɔ berɛ nsuo.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: Wɔn abasa mu buiɛ no, mesere kyerɛɛ wɔn; mʼanimteɛ som bo ma wɔn.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mebɔɔ ɛkwan maa wɔn na metenaa ase sɛ wɔn ɔhene; metenaa ase sɛ ɔhene a ɔwɔ nʼakodɔm mu; meyɛɛ sɛ obi a ɔkyekyere agyaadwotwafoɔ werɛ.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: “Nanso seesei wɔsere me, nnipa a manyini sene wɔn, na wɔn agyanom mfata sɛ wɔne me nnwan ho nkraman tena.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Ohia ne ɛkɔm ama wɔn ho atete, wɔnante asase wesee ne asase bonini so anadwo.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Wɔboaboaa nkyenhahan ano wɔ nkyɛkyerɛ mu, na wɔde ɛserɛ so nnua nhini yɛɛ wɔn aduane.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Wɔn mfɛfoɔ pamoo wɔn firii wɔn mu, na wɔhuroo wɔn sɛ akorɔmfoɔ.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Wɔhyɛɛ wɔn ma wɔtenaa nsuka a emu awo, abotan ne ɛfam ntokuro mu.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Wɔsuu sɛ mfunumu wɔ wiram na wɔfoforee so wɔ ɔdɔtɔ ase.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Ekuo a wɔmfra na wɔnni din, wɔpam wɔn firii asase no so.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: “Na ɛnnɛ yi wɔn mmammarima de dwom bɔ me akutia; mayɛ abusudeɛ wɔ wɔn mu.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Wɔkyiri me na wɔnnka mma me ho; wɔmmfɛre sɛ wɔtete ntasuo gu mʼanim.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Afei a Onyankopɔn abubu me tadua na ɔde amanehunu aba me so yi, wɔyɛ deɛ wɔpɛ wɔ mʼanim.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Abusuakuo no to hyɛ me so wɔ me nifa so; wɔsum me nan mfidie, na wɔsisi apie tia me.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Wɔsisi mʼakwan; na wɔnya me sɛe me na obiara mmoa me.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ahunahuna ma me ho dwiri me; mʼanimuonyam atu kɔ sɛdeɛ mframa abɔ agu, me banbɔ atu ayera sɛ omununkum.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: “Na seesei, me nkwa resa; na amanehunu nna akyekyere me.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Anadwo wowɔ me nnompe mu; ɔyea a ɛwe me no nnyae.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn firi ne tumi mu yɛ sɛ aduradeɛ ma me; ɔmia me te sɛ mʼatadeɛ kɔn.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Ɔto me twene atɛkyɛ mu na ɔma me yɛ sɛ mfuturo ne nsõ.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: “Ao Onyankopɔn, mesu mefrɛ wo, nanso wommua me. Mesɔre gyina, nanso wohwɛ me kɛkɛ.

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: Wohwim me na wode mframa pia me; wodankyidankyi me wɔ ahum mu.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Menim sɛ wode me bɛkɔ owuo mu, baabi a woahyɛ ama ateasefoɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
translation_verse: “Ampa ara obiara mfa ne nsa nka onipa a ɔrebrɛ ɛberɛ a ɔresu pɛ mmoa wɔ nʼamanehunu mu.

english_verse: I mourned for the poor and those who suffered.
translation_verse: Mansu amma wɔn a wɔwɔ ɔhaw mu anaa? Me kra werɛ anho amma ahiafoɔ anaa?

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛberɛ a mʼani da papa so no, bɔne baeɛ; ɛberɛ a mepɛɛ hann no, esum na ɛduruuɛ.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Meyafunu mu a ɛwowɔ me no nnyae da; na nna a amanehunu wɔ mu da mʼanim.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,

translation_verse: sɛ mahwɛ owia a ɛhyerɛn anaa ɔsrane a ɛnam animuonyam mu,

translation_verse: Makata me bɔne so sɛdeɛ nnipa yɛ de mʼafɔdie ahyɛ mʼakoma mu?

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: Medwenee sɛ, ‘Ɛsɛ sɛ mpanimfoɔ kasa; ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔn ani afire kyerɛ nyansa.’

english_verse: now I truly realize wisdom comes from God.
translation_verse: Nanso honhom a ɛte onipa mu, Otumfoɔ no ahomeɛ no na ɛma nteaseɛ.

translation_verse: “Mo ho adwiri mo, monni hwee ka bio; mo nsɛm asa.

translation_verse: Me mu no, mete sɛ nsa a ɛhyɛ toa mu; Me te sɛ nsã kotokuo foforɔ a ɛrebɛpae.

translation_verse: Merebɛbue mʼano; me nsɛm aba me tɛkrɛma so.

translation_verse: Afei ɔbɛba nnipa mu abɛka sɛ, ‘Meyɛɛ bɔne na mekyeaa deɛ ɛtene, nanso wantwe mʼaso sɛdeɛ ɛfata me.

translation_verse: Wɔwuwu mmerɛ tiawa bi mu, wɔ anadwo dasuo mu; nnipa no ho woso na wɔsene kɔ; ahoɔdenfoɔ totɔ a ɛmfiri onipa.

translation_verse: Ɔtua wɔn amumuyɛsɛm so ka wɔ baabi a obiara bɛtumi ahunu wɔn,

translation_verse: “Adɛn enti na onipa nka nkyerɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ, ‘Mayɛ bɔne na merenyɛ bɔne bio.

translation_verse: Kyerɛ me na menhunu; na sɛ mayɛ bɔne a, merenyɛ saa bio.’

translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn gyina deɛ wode wʼano aka so tua wo ka, wɔ ɛberɛ a woayɛ sɛ worennu wo ho anaa? Ɛsɛ sɛ wosi gyinaeɛ, ɛnyɛ me; enti ka deɛ wonim kyerɛ me.

english_verse: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see
translation_verse: “Nnipa a wɔwɔ nteaseɛ pae mu ka, animdefoɔ a wɔtie me ka kyerɛ me sɛ,

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: ‘Hiob nnkasa nimdeɛ kwan so; aba biara nni ne kasa mu.’

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Ao, sɛ wɔsɔɔ Hiob hwɛeɛ kɔɔ akyiri a anka ɛyɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyiyii nsɛm ano sɛ omumuyɛfoɔ!

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Ɔde atuateɛ ka ne bɔne ho; ɔde ahantan bɔ ne nsam gu yɛn so na ɔma ne nsɛm a ɔka tia Onyankopɔn no dɔɔso.”

english_verse: Elihu said:
translation_verse: Afei, Elihu kaa sɛ:

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: “Wogye di sɛ yei fata? Woka sɛ, ‘Onyankopɔn bɛtwitwa agye me.’

english_verse: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?
translation_verse: Nanso wobisa no sɛ, ‘Mfasoɔ bɛn na mɛnya, na sɛ manyɛ bɔne a, mfasoɔ bɛn na mɛnya?’

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: “Mepɛ sɛ mebua wo ne wo nnamfonom nyinaa.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Sɛ wotene a, ɛdeɛn na wode ma noɔ anaasɛ ɛdeɛn na ɔnya firi wo nsam?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: Wʼamumuyɛ pira onipa a ɔte sɛ wo na wo tenenee pira nnipa mma nko ara.

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: “Nnipa su ɛberɛ a wɔwɔ nhyɛsoɔ ase; na wɔsrɛ mmoa firi deɛ ɔwɔ tumi nsam.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Nanso, obi mmisa sɛ, ‘Ɛhe na Onyankopɔn, me Yɛfoɔ no wɔ, deɛ ɔma nnwom anadwo no,

english_verse: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.
translation_verse: deɛ ɔkyerɛ yɛn nimdeɛ bebree sene asase so mmoa na ɔma yɛhunu nyansa sene ewiem nnomaa?’

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnipa su team a, ɔmmua, amumuyɛfoɔ ahantan enti.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Ampa ara Onyankopɔn rentie wɔn nkotosrɛ hunu no; na Otumfoɔ remmu.

english_verse: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.
translation_verse: Woka sɛ wonhunu no, nanso sɛ wotwɛn no a, ɔde atɛntenenee bɛba enti ɛsɛ sɛ wotwɛn no.

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Bio, woka sɛ nʼabufuo mmfa asotweɛ mma na nʼani nni amumuyɛsɛm akyi pii.

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: Enti Hiob bue nʼano ka nsɛm hunu; nimdeɛ a ɔnni enti, ɔkeka nsɛm bebree.”

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Monto mo bo ase kakra mma me, na mɛkyerɛ mo sɛ aka bebree a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛka ma Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Menya me nimdeɛ firi akyirikyiri; mɛka sɛ me Yɛfoɔ bu atɛntenenee.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Monnye ntom sɛ me nsɛm yɛ nokorɛ turodoo; na meyɛ obi a ne nimdeɛ so wɔ mo mu.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn so, nanso, ɔntwiri nnipa; ɔkorɔn na ɔnhinhim ne botaeɛ mu.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Ɔmma amumuyɛfoɔ ntena nkwa mu, na ɔde amanehunufoɔ kyɛfa ma wɔn.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Ɔnnyi nʼani mfiri ɔteneneeni so. Ɔma wɔne ahemfo di adeɛ na ɔma wɔn so afebɔɔ.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔde mpokyerɛ gu nnipa na amanehunu ahoma akyekyere wɔn papee a,

english_verse: God points out their sin and their pride,
translation_verse: ɔka deɛ wɔayɛ kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnam ahantan so ayɛ bɔne.

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: Ɔma wɔtie ntenesoɔ na ɔhyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnu wɔn ho wɔn bɔne ho.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔyɛ ɔsetie na wɔsom no a, wɔbɛdi yie wɔ wɔn ɛnna a aka no mu na wɔn mfeɛ nyinaa ayɛ anisɔ ama wɔn.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Na sɛ wɔantie no a, wɔbɛyera wɔ akofena ano, na wɔawuwu a wɔnni nimdeɛ.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: “Wɔn a wɔnnim Onyame no kora abufuo so; mpo sɛ ɔgu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a, wɔnsu mpɛ mmoa.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Nanso, wɔn a wɔhunu amane no, ɔgye wɔn; na ɔkasa kyerɛ wɔn wɔ wɔn haw mu.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: “Ɔregye wo afiri ahohiahia mu de wo akɔ petee mu a ahokyere nnie, deɛ wowɔ asomdwoeɛ, na nnuane pa ayɛ wo ɛpono so ma.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Nanso seesei, atemmuo a ɛfata amumuyɛfoɔ na aba wo so; atemmuo ne atɛntenenee asɔ wo mu.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Hwɛ yie na obi amfa ahonya annaadaa wo; mma adanmudeɛ kɛseɛ bi ntwe wo.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Wʼahonya anaasɛ mpo wʼahohaw bebrebe nyinaa enti, worenkɔ amanehunu mu anaa?

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Mpere anadwo ho, sɛ ɛmmɛpra nnipa mfiri wɔn afie mu.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Hwɛ na woannane ankɔ bɔne ho, deɛ ayɛ sɛ wopɛ sene amanehunu.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn yɛ kɛseɛ wɔ ne tumi mu. Hwan na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ sɛ ɔno?

english_verse: to guide or correct him. Others Have Praised God
translation_verse: Hwan na wahyehyɛ nʼakwan ama no anaa waka akyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Woayɛ mfomsoɔ.’

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Kae na kamfo nʼadwuma a nnipa de nnwontoɔ akamfo no.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Adasamma nyinaa ahunu; nnipa hwɛ haa firi akyirikyiri.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn yɛ kɛseɛ, ɛboro yɛn nteaseɛ so! Ne mfeɛ dodoɔ mu nni hwehwɛbea.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: “Ɔtwetwe nsuo a ɛsosɔ, ma ɛdane osutɔ gu asutene mu;

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtumi ate sɛdeɛ ɔtrɛtrɛ omununkum mu ase, sɛdeɛ ɔbobɔ mu firi nʼatenaeɛ?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛdeɛ ɔhwete nʼanyinam mu wɔ ne ho ma ɛkɔ ɛpo bunu mu.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Yei ne ɛkwan a ɔfa so di amanaman no so na ɔma aduane bu wɔn so.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Ɔde anyinam hyɛ ne nsam ma na ɔhyɛ no sɛ ɛnsi nʼagyiraeɛ.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Nʼaprannaa bɔ ahum a ɛreba no ho nkaeɛ; na anantwie mpo ma wɔhunu sɛ ɛreba.

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: “Yei ma mʼakoma bɔ paripari na ɛbɔ denden pa ara.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Tie! Tie ne nne mmobom, ne hooyɛ a ɛfiri nʼanom reba.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔgyaa nʼanyinam mu wɔ ɔsoro ase nyinaa na ɔma ɛkɔduru asase ano.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nne bobom ma no yɛ nwanwa; ɔyɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ a ɛboro yɛn adwene so.

english_verse: make us stop and think about God's power,
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ nnipa a wabɔ wɔn nyinaa bɛhunu nʼadwuma enti, ɔma obiara gyae nʼadwuma.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Wiram mmoa kɔtetɛ; wɔkɔhyehyɛ wɔn abɔn mu.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn ahome de nsukyeneeɛ ba, na nsuo hahanaa no kyene.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Ɔde fɔnwuni hyɛ omununkum ma; na ɔtwa nʼanyinam fa mu.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: Ɔde omununkum ba de bɛtwe nnipa aso, anaasɛ ɔma ɛtɔ gu asase so de kyerɛ nʼadɔeɛ.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: “Tie yei, Hiob; gyae na dwene Onyankopɔn anwanwadeɛ ho.

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Wonim sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn danedane omununkum, na ɔma anyinam tete firi mu?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Wonim sɛdeɛ omununkum sensɛn ewiem, deɛ ɔyɛ nyansaboakwa no anwanwadeɛ?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Mo a mote fifire wɔ mo ntadeɛ mu ɛberɛ a anafoɔ mframa ma asase no yɛ dinn no,

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: wobɛtumi aboa no ama watrɛ ewiem, a ɛyɛ dene sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ahwehwɛ?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: “Kyerɛ yɛn deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛka kyerɛ no; yɛrentumi nka yɛn asɛm, ɛsiane sɛ yɛnnim enti.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ Onyankopɔn nkaeɛ sɛ mepɛ sɛ me ne no kasa anaa? Onipa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔbɛmene no anaa?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Obiara rentumi nhwɛ owia, sɛdeɛ ɛhyerɛn wɔ ewiem ɛberɛ a mframa abɔ ama ewiem ateɛ.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Ɔfiri atifi fam ba wɔ animuonyam sononko mu; Onyankopɔn ba wɔ surokronkron tumi mu.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Yɛnhunu Otumfoɔ deɛ, nanso ne tumi yɛ kɛseɛ; nʼatɛntenenee ne teneneeyɛ kɛseɛ akyi mpo ɔnyɛ nhyɛsoɔ.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Ɛno enti nnipa de anidie ma no, na ɔmmu akoma mu anyansafoɔ biara.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade firi ahum mu buaa Hiob sɛ,

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Hwan ne deɛ ɔde nsɛm a nimdeɛ nni mu katakata mʼafotuo so?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Hyɛ wo ho den sɛ ɔbarima; mɛbisa wo nsɛm, na wobɛyi mʼano.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: “Ɛberɛ a metoo asase fapem no, na wowɔ he? Sɛ wonim a, ka ɛ.

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔsusuu ne tenten ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ? Ampa ara wonim! Hwan na ɔtwee susuhoma faa ani?

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Ɛdeɛn so na ɛgyina, anaasɛ hwan na ɔtoo ne tweatiboɔ no,

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: “Hwan na ɔkaa ɛpo hyɛɛ apono akyi, ɛberɛ a ɛpue firii yafunu mu,

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a mede omununkum yɛɛ nʼaduradeɛ na mede esum kabii kyekyeree noɔ,

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a metoo hyeɛ maa noɔ na mesisii nʼapono ne nʼadaban,

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a mekaa sɛ, ‘Ɛha ara na wobɛduru, ɛntra ha; ɛha na wʼahantan asorɔkyeɛ no mmɛso’?

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: “Woahyɛ mmara ama adekyeeɛ da? Anaa woakyerɛ no nʼafa,

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: sɛ ɛnkɔka asase ano na ɛntu amumuyɛfoɔ mfiri so?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Asase fa ne bɔberɛ sɛ dɔteɛ a ɛhyɛ nsɔano ase; na ɛso tebea da adi te sɛ atadeɛ.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Wɔde amumuyɛfoɔ hann akame wɔn, na wɔn abasa a wɔapagya no mu abu.

english_verse: Job, have you ever walked on the ocean floor?
translation_verse: “Woapɛɛpɛɛ mu ahunu nsutire a ɛpo firi mu ba anaa woanante ne bunu mu?

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Wɔde owuo apono akyerɛ wo? Woahunu owuo sunsumma apono anaa?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Woate ewiase a ɛda hɔ hahanaa no ase anaa? Sɛ wonim yeinom nyinaa a, ka kyerɛ me.

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: “Ɛhe na hann firi ba? Na ɛhe na esum nso kɔ?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Ampa ara wonim, ɛfiri sɛ na woawo wo dada. Woanyini yie!

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: “Woakɔ sukyerɛmma adekoradan mu da, anaa woahunu asukɔtweaa adekoradan

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: a makora so ama ahohiahia berɛ, ɔsa ne akodie nna?

english_verse: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?
translation_verse: Ɛkwan bɛn na ɛkɔ baabi a anyinam firi ba, anaa baabi a apueeɛ mframa firi na ɛbɔ fa asase so?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔtwaa ɛka maa osubransam, ne ɛkwan maa aprannaa mmobom,

english_verse: on empty deserts where no one lives?
translation_verse: sɛ ɛbɛtɔ agu asase a obiara nte soɔ so, anweatam a obiara nni soɔ,

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: na ama asase bonini a ɛyɛ wesee yi afɔ na ɛserɛ afifiri so?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Osutɔ wɔ agya anaa? Hwan na ɔyɛ agya ma obosuo?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Hwan yafunu mu na nsukyeneeɛ fire? Hwan na ɔwoo nsukyeneeɛ mporoporowa firi soro

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a nsuo kyene dane sɛ ɛboɔ, na ebunu ani kyene?

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: “Wobɛtumi de ahoma akyekyere Akokɔbaatan ne ne mma? Wobɛtumi asane Nwenwenente nhoma anaa?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Wobɛtumi de anɔpa nsoromma aba wɔ ne berɛ mu anaasɛ wobɛtumi ayi sisire ne ne mma afiri hɔ?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Wonim mmara a ɛfa ewiem ho? Wobɛtumi de Onyankopɔn ahennie aba asase so?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: “Wobɛtumi ama wo nne aduru omununkum so na wode nsuo akata wo ho anaa?

english_verse: or will lightning flash at your command?
translation_verse: Wobɛtumi ama anyinam atwa? Wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Yɛnnie anaa’?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔde nyansa ma akoma anaasɛ ɔde nteaseɛ hyɛ adwene mu.

english_verse: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔwɔ nyansa a wɔde kan omununkum? Hwan na ɔbɛtumi akyea ɔsoro nsuo nkotokuo,

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: “Wokɔ ahayɔ ma gyatabereɛ ma agyata didi mee

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a wɔbutubutu wɔn abɔn ano anaasɛ wɔtetɛ nnɔtɔ ase?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔma anene aduane ɛberɛ a ne mma su frɛ Onyankopɔn na wɔkyinkyini pɛ aduane?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: “Wonim ɛberɛ a bepɔ so mmirekyie wowoɔ? Woahwɛ, ahunu ɛberɛ a ɔforoteɛ nyinsɛn ne ba?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Wɔn mma nyini ahoɔden so wɔ wiram; na wɔgya wɔn awofoɔ hɔ a wɔnnsane nkɔ wɔn nkyɛn bio.

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: Mede asase bonini maa no sɛ ne fie, ne nkyene asase tamaa sɛ nʼatenaeɛ.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Ɔsere kurom gyegyeegyeyɛ no; na ɔnte ɔkafoɔ nteateam.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Ɔkyinkyini mmepɔ no so sɛ nʼadidibea; ɛhɔ na ɔkyin hwehwɛ wira mono biara.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: “Ɛkoɔ bɛpene sɛ ɔbɛsom wo anaa? Ɔbɛtena wo mmoa adididaka nkyɛn anadwo anaa?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Wobɛtumi asa no wɔ fentemfidie so? Ɔbɛfentem mmɔnhwa a ɛda wʼakyi anaa?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Wobɛtumi de wo ho ato no so ɛsiane nʼahoɔden dodoɔ nti? Wobɛgya wʼadwuma a ɛyɛ den ama no anaa?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Wogye di sɛ ɔde wʼaburo bɛba na waboa ano de akɔ ayuporobea anaa?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: “Sohori bɔ nʼataban mu anigyeɛ so, nanso wɔntumi mfa ntoto asukɔnkɔn deɛ ho.

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Ɔto ne nkosua gu asase so ma mfuturo ka no hye,

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: ɛmfa ne ho sɛ ɛnan bi bɛpɛkyɛ no, sɛ wiram aboa bi bɛtiatia so.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ ne mma atirimuɔden sɛdeɛ wɔnnyɛ ne dea; ɛmfa ne ho sɛ nʼadwuma bɛyɛ kwa,

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn amma no nyansa, wamma no nhunumu biara.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ ɔtrɛ ne ntaban mu tu mmirika a, ɔsere ɔpɔnkɔ ne ne sotefoɔ.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: “Wo na woma ɔpɔnkɔ no nʼahoɔden anaa wode ne kɔn mu nwi kuhaa no ma no?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Wo na woma no huri te sɛ ntutummɛ, na ɔde ne nkorɔmo hunahuna anaa?

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne nan tintim fam denden, na nʼani gye nʼahoɔden mu, na afei ɔbɔ wura ɔko mu.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ hu, na ɔnsuro biribiara; ɔhunu akofena a ɔnnwane.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Bɛmma woso wɔ ne nkyɛn mu bɔha mu, na pea ne pɛmɛ nso di ahim wɔ ne ho.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Ɔfiri ahopereɛ mu de nʼano sisi fam; na sɛ wɔhyɛn totorobɛnto a, ɔntumi nnyina faako.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Sɛ totorobɛnto hyɛne a ɔka sɛ, ‘Wiɛɛ!’ ɔte ɔko ho hwa firi akyirikyiri, ɔsahene no nteamu ne ɔko mu osebɔ.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: “Wo nyansa na ɛma akorɔma tuo na ɔtrɛ ne ntaban mu fa anafoɔ?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na ɔfiri kɔpɛ nʼaduane; nʼani hunu adeɛ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Mogya yɛ ne mma aduane, na baabi a atɔfoɔ wɔ no, ɛhɔ na ɔwɔ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Afei Awurade buaa Hiob sɛ,

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: “Deɛ ɔne Otumfoɔ no wɔ asɛm no bɛtene ne so anaa? Ma deɛ ɔbɔ Onyankopɔn kwaadu no mmua no ɛ!”

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Na Hiob buaa Awurade sɛ,

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: Makasa baako, nanso menni mmuaeɛ mprenu so, na merenkasa bio.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade firi ahum mu buaa Hiob sɛ,

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: “Hyɛ wo ho den sɛ ɔbarima; mɛbisa wo nsɛm, na ɛsɛ sɛ wobua me.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: “Wobɛka mʼatemmuo ho asɛm bɔne anaa? Wobɛbu me fɔ de abu wo ho bem?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Wowɔ abasa te sɛ Onyankopɔn deɛ, na wo nne bɛtumi abobom sɛ ne deɛ?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Ɛnneɛ fa animuonyam ne ɔhyerɛn hyehyɛ wo ho, na fira anidie ne kɛseyɛ.

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Hwie wʼabufuhyeɛ mmoroso no gu, hwɛ ɔhantanni biara na brɛ no ase,

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Sie wɔn nyinaa bɔ mu wɔ mfuturo mu; kata wɔn anim wɔ damena mu.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Na afei mʼankasa mɛgye atom sɛ wo ara wo basa nifa bɛtumi agye wo nkwa.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: “Hwɛ susono, deɛ meyɛɛ no kaa wo ho na ɔwe ɛserɛ te sɛ ɔnantwie.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Hwɛ ahoɔden a ɔwɔ wɔ nʼasene mu ne ahoɔden fufuo a ɛwɔ ne yafunu so wedeɛ mu!

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Ne dua hinhim sɛ ntweneduro; ne srɛ mu ntini yɛ peperee.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Ne nnompe te sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnorobɛn, nʼabasa ne ne nan te sɛ nnadeɛ praban.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Ɔdi Onyankopɔn nsa ano adwuma mu kan, nanso ne Yɛfoɔ bɛtumi de akofena akɔ ne so.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Nkokoɔ fifiri wɔn nnɔbaeɛ ma no, na wiram mmoa nyinaa goro bɛn hɔ.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Nkasɛɛ nkasɛɛ nnua ase na ɔda, na atɛkyɛ mu demmire akata no so.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Nkasɛɛ nkasɛɛ nwunu no hata ne so; na nsunoa nnua atwa ne ho ahyia.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Nsuo nworosoɔ nha no; mpo sɛ Yordan bobɔ ba nʼano a, ɔnni ɔhaw.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Obi bɛtumi akye no animono; anaa obi bɛtumi de afidie ayi no na wabɔne ne hwene mu?

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: “Wobɛtumi de darewa atwe ɔdɛnkyɛmmirampɔn anaa wobɛtumi de ahoma akyekyere ne tɛkrɛma?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Wobɛtumi de ahoma afa ne hwenemu, anaasɛ wobɛtumi de darewa asɔ nʼapantan mu?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Ɔbɛpene ne wo ayɛ apam ama wode no ayɛ wʼakoa afebɔɔ anaa?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Wobɛtumi de no ayɛ ayɛmmoa te sɛ anomaa anaa wobɛtumi asa no ahoma de no ama wo mmammaa?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Adwadifoɔ bɛpɛ sɛ wobɛtɔ no de no adi dwa anaa?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Wobɛtumi de mpea awowɔ ne wedeɛ mu anaasɛ wode mpataa pɛmɛ bɛwowɔ ne tiri ho?

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Wode wo nsa ka no a, wobɛkae sɛdeɛ ɔbɛwoso ne ho, enti worenyɛ saa bio!

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Ɛkwan biara nni hɔ a wobɛfa so akye no; ani a ɛbɔ ne so kɛkɛ no ma nnipa dwodwo.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Obiara ntumi nsi ne bo nhwanyane no. Afei hwan na ɔbɛtumi ne me adi asie?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Hwan na mede no ka a ɛsɛ sɛ metua? Biribiara a ɛhyɛ ɔsoro ase wɔ me.

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: “Me werɛ remfiri sɛ mɛka nʼakwaa, nʼahoɔden ne ne bɔberɛ fɛfɛ no ho asɛm.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtumi aworɔ ne ho nwoma, na hwan na ɔde nnareka bɛkɔ ne ho?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtumi abue nʼapantan, a ɛse a ɛyɛ hu ayɛ no ma no?

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: Nʼakyi wɔ abona a ɛsesa soɔ, ɛpipi so a ɛkwan nna mu koraa;

english_verse: firmly bound and closer together
translation_verse: sɛdeɛ ɛpipi so fa no enti, mframa biara mfa ntam.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Ɛtoatoa mu dendeenden a emu ntumi ntete.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnwansi a, ɛtete ogya; nʼaniwa aba te sɛ ahemadakye hann.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Egyatɛn turi firi nʼanom na nsramma turituri firi mu.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Wisie tene firi ne hwene mu te sɛ ɛsɛn a ɛsi ogya soɔ.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Nʼahomeɛ ma gyabidie ano sɔ, na egyadɛreɛ tu firi nʼanom.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Ne kɔn mu wɔ ahoɔden ankasa; wɔn a wɔhunu no no abasa mu tu.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Ne wedeɛ a abubu agu soɔ no yɛ peperee; ayɛ pemee a ɛnkeka ne ho.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔsɔre a, ahoɔdenfoɔ bɔ huboa; sɛ ɔporo ne ho a, wɔdwane.

english_verse: No sword or spear can harm it,
translation_verse: Akofena wɔ no a, ɛnka no, pea, pɛmɛ ne agyan nso saa ara.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Ɔfa dadeɛ sɛ wira bi na kɔbere mfrafraeɛ te sɛ dua a awuo bi ma no.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Agyan mma no nnwane; ahwimmoɔ mu aboa yɛ ntɛtɛ ma no.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Aporibaa te sɛ ɛserɛ wɔ nʼani so; na ɔsere pɛmɛ nnyegyeɛ.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Abon a ano yɛ nnam tuatua ne yafunu so. Ɔtwe ne ho ase wɔ fam fa atɛkyɛ mu a, ɛyiyi akam.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: Ɔma ebunu mu huru sɛ nsuo a ɛwɔ ɛsɛn mu na ɔnunu ɛpo mu sɛ sradeɛ a ɛwɔ kukuo mu.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbɛfa no, ɛhɔ nsuo no pa yerɛyerɛ; na obi bɛsusu sɛ ɛpo bunu adane ayɛ dwono.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Biribiara a ɛwɔ asase so ne no nsɛ. Ɔyɛ abɔdeɛ a ɔnsuro hwee.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔmmu wɔn a wɔyɛ ahantan no mu biara; ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ ahomasoɔ no nyinaa so ɔhene.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Menim sɛ wotumi yɛ nneɛma nyinaa; obiara rentumi nsɛe wo nhyehyɛeɛ.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Wobisa sɛ, ‘Hwan ni a ɔnni nimdeɛ nso ɔsi mʼafotuo ho ɛkwan?’ Ampa ara mekaa nneɛma a mente aseɛ ho nsɛm, nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwanwa ma me.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: “Wokaa sɛ, ‘Tie na menkasa; mɛbisa wo nsɛm na ɛsɛ sɛ woma me mmuaeɛ.’

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Mate wo nka pɛn, na seesei deɛ, mʼani ahunu wo.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Na Awurade kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Hiob wieeɛ no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Temanni Elifas sɛ, “Me bo afu wo ne wo nnamfonom baanu no, ɛfiri sɛ, moanka me ho asɛm a ɛyɛ nokorɛ sɛdeɛ me ɔsomfoɔ Hiob kaeɛ no.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Afei, momfa anantwie nson ne nnwennini nson, na monkɔ me ɔsomfoɔ Hiob nkyɛn, na monkɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mma mo ho. Me ɔsomfoɔ Hiob bɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama mo, na mɛtie ne mpaeɛbɔ no na merenyɛ mo sɛdeɛ ɛfata mo nkwaseasɛm no. Nsɛm a moka faa me ho no nyɛ nokorɛ sɛdeɛ me ɔsomfoɔ Hiob yɛeɛ no.”

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Enti, Temanni Elifas ne Suhini Bildad ne Naamani Sofar yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn no, na Awurade tiee Hiob mpaeɛbɔ.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Hiob bɔɔ mpaeɛ maa ne nnamfonom akyi no, Awurade sane yɛɛ no ɔdefoɔ bio na ɔde nʼahodeɛ a na ɔwɔ kane no mmɔho mmienu maa no.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Afei, ne nuammarima, ne nuammaa nyinaa ne obiara a na ɔnim no dada no baa ne fie ne no bɛdidiiɛ. Wɔkyekyeree ne werɛ wɔ amanehunu a Awurade ma ɔkɔɔ mu no ho, na wɔn mu biara brɛɛ no dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ kawa.

english_verse: The Lord now blessed Job more than ever; he gave him
translation_verse: Awurade hyiraa Hiob nkwa awieeɛ senee ne ahyɛaseɛ. Ɔnyaa nnwan ɔpedunan, nyoma mpem nsia, anantwinini mpamho apem ne mfunumu abereɛ apem.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Bio ɔnyaa mmammarima baason ne mmammaa baasa.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Asase no so nyinaa, na mmaa biara nni hɔ a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ sɛ Hiob mmammaa no, na wɔn agya de wɔn kaa wɔn nuammarima no ho maa wɔn agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Afei ɔwuiɛ a na wayɛ akora pa ara.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne onipa a ɔntie amumuyɛfoɔ afotuo na ɔnni nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nhwɛsoɔ akyi na ɔntena fɛdifoɔ tenabea.

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Na mmom, Awurade mmara sɔ nʼani, na ɔdwene ho awia ne anadwo.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ dua a wɔatɛ wɔ asutene ho, na ɛso nʼaba ne berɛ mu a nʼahahan no nnwan. Deɛ ɔyɛ biara yɛ yie.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Nanso nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nte saa; wɔte sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ guo.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Enti amumuyɛfoɔ rentumi nnyina atemmuo no ano, na nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nso rentena teneneefoɔ asafo mu.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade kyerɛ ɔteneneeni kwan nanso amumuyɛfoɔ kwan deɛ, ɛbɛyera.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na amanamanmufoɔ no bo afu? Adɛn enti na wɔsɛe mmerɛ yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ hunu yi?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Asase so ahemfo sɔre gyina na atumfoɔ bom tu agyina tia Awurade ne Deɛ Wɔasra no no.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Wɔka sɛ, “Momma yɛmmubu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn na yɛnto wɔn mpokyerɛ ngu.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔte adwa so wɔ soro no sere; Awurade di wɔn ho fɛw.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Afei ɔka wɔn anim wɔ nʼabufuo mu hunahuna wɔn wɔ nʼabufuhyeɛ mu, ka sɛ,

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “Masi me Ɔhene wɔ Sion, me bepɔ kronkron no so.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Mɛpae mu aka Awurade ahyɛdeɛ: Ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Woyɛ me Babarima; ɛnnɛ mayɛ wʼAgya.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Bisa me, na mede amanaman nyinaa bɛyɛ wʼagyapadeɛ, asase ano nyinaa bɛyɛ wo dea.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Wode dadeɛ ahempoma bɛdi wɔn so; na woabobɔ wɔn sɛ ɔnwomfoɔ ahina.”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Enti mo ahemfo, monsua nyansa; monkae kɔkɔbɔ yi, mo asase sodifoɔ.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Momfa suro nsom Awurade na monsɛpɛ mo ho ahopopoɔ mu.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Momfe Ɔba no ano, na ne bo amfu ansɛe mo wɔ mo akwan so, ɛfiri sɛ nʼabufuhyeɛ tumi sɔre ntɛm so. Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔdwane toa no nyinaa.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, hwɛ sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ dɔɔso fa! Dodoɔ no ara na wɔsɔre tia me!

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Bebree no ara ka fa me ho sɛ, “Onyankopɔn rennye no”.

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Nanso, Ao Awurade, woyɛ akokyɛm a atwa me ho ahyia wohyɛ me animuonyam na wopagya me ti.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Meteam su frɛ Awurade, na ɔgye me so firi ne bepɔ kronkron no so.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Metɔ hɔ na meda a, menyane bio, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade kora me so.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Merensuro atamfoɔ mpem mpem a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Sɔre, Ao Awurade! Gye me, Ao me Onyankopɔn! Bobɔ mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa apantan; na tutu amumuyɛfoɔ se.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Sɛ mesu frɛ wo a, gye me so, Ao, me tenenee Onyankopɔn. Ma me ahomegyeɛ wɔ mʼahohia mu; hunu me mmɔbɔ na tie me mpaeɛbɔ.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Ao mmarima, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na mo bɛdane mʼanimuonyam ahohora? Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na mobɛdɔ nneɛma hunu na moadi ahoni huhuo akyi?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Hunu sɛ Awurade ayi deɛ ɔwɔ nyamesu ama ne ho; Awurade bɛtie, sɛ mesu mefrɛ no a.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Mo bo fu a, monnyɛ bɔne; sɛ modeda mo mpa so a, monyɛ komm na monhwehwɛ mo akoma mu.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Mommɔ afɔdeɛ a ɛfata na momfa mo werɛ nhyɛ Awurade mu.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Nnipa bebree bisa sɛ: “Hwan na ɔbɛtumi ayɛ yɛn adɔeɛ?” Ao Awurade, ma wʼanim hann no nhyerɛn yɛn so.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Wode anigyeɛ mmorosoɔ ahyɛ mʼakoma ma asene ɛberɛ a wɔn aburoo ne nsã foforɔ abu so no.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mɛtɔ hɔ, na mada asomdwoeɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ, wo nko ara, Ao Awurade, na woma metena asomdwoeɛ mu. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa atɛntɛbɛn nto.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, yɛ aso ma me nsɛm na dwene mʼapinisie ho.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Tie me mmoa ho sufrɛ, me Ɔhene ne me Onyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wo na mebɔ wo mpaeɛ.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Ao, Awurade, wote me nne anɔpa; anɔpa, mede mʼadesrɛ ba wʼanim na mede anidasoɔ twɛn.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Wonyɛ Onyankopɔn a wʼani gye bɔne ho; na amumuyɛfoɔ rentumi ne wo ntena.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Ahantanfoɔ rentumi nnyina wʼanim; wokyiri wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne nyinaa.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Wosɛe wɔn a wɔka atorɔsɛm; Awurade kyiri mogyapɛfoɔ ne asisifoɔ.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Nanso me, wo mmɔborɔhunu bebrebe enti, mɛba wo fie; na anidie mu na mɛkoto akyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
