translation_verse: Ao Awurade kyerɛ me ɛkwan wɔ wo tenenee mu mʼatamfoɔ enti, bɔ wo kwan tee wɔ mʼanim.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Wɔn anom asɛm baako mpo nyɛ nokorɛ; ɔsɛeɛ ahyɛ wɔn akoma ma. Wɔn menewa yɛ damena a ɛso abue wɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma ka nnaadaasɛm.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Ao, Onyankopɔn, bu wɔn fɔ! Ma wɔn pɔ bɔne nyɛ wɔn ahweaseɛ. Pam wɔn ɛsiane wɔn bɔne dodoɔ no enti, ɛfiri sɛ wɔasɔre atia wo.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Nanso, ma wɔn a wɔdwane ba wo nkyɛn no ani nnye; ma wɔmfa anigyeɛ nto dwom daa. Trɛ wo banbɔ mu wɔ wɔn so, na wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no ma wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ampa ara, wohyira teneneefoɔ; na wode wʼayamyɛ twa wɔn ho hyia te sɛ akokyɛm. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ sɛ ɔmfa sankuhoma nto wɔ Seminit ɛnne so.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Ao, Awurade nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabofuo mu, na ntwe mʼaso nso wɔ wʼabufuhyeɛ mu.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Hu me mmɔbɔ, Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ mmrɛ; Ao Awurade sa me yadeɛ na me nnompe wɔ ahoyera mu.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Me kra wɔ ahohia mu. Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn, Ao Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Sane bra, Ao Awurade, na bɛgye me nkwa; gye me, wo dɔ a ɛnni hwammɔ no enti.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Obi a wawuo no renkae wo da, hwan na ɔfiri damena mu kamfo woɔ?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Apinisie ama mayɛ mmerɛ. Anadwo mu nyinaa mede agyaadwotwa fɔ me mpa na me nisuo fɔ me sumiiɛ.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Awerɛhoɔ ama mʼani so ayɛ me kusuu. Ɛredum mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa enti.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Mo nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, montwe mo ho mfiri me ho, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ate me sufrɛ.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Awurade ate me mmɔborɔ su; Awurade tie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa anim bɛgu ase na wɔn ho adwiri wɔn; na wɔapatu de fɛreɛ asane wɔn akyi.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Ao, Awurade me Onyankopɔn, medwane metoa wo; Gye me firi wɔn a wɔtaa me nyinaa nsam,

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a wɔbɛtete me mu sɛ gyata na wɔatete me mu asinasini a obiara rentumi nnye me.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: sɛ mayɛ bɔne atia deɛ ɔne me te yie anaasɛ mabɔ me ɔtamfoɔ korɔno kwa a,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ ma mʼatamfoɔ ntaa me na wɔmmɛto me; ma wɔntiatia me so wɔ fam na wɔmma me funu nna mfuturo mu.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: Sɔre wʼabufuo mu, Ao Awurade! Sɔre tia mʼatamfoɔ abufuo. Nyane, me Onyankopɔn; hyɛ atɛntenee mmara.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Ma nnipadɔm mmɛtwa wo ho nhyia. Firi soro hɔ di wɔn so;

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: ma Awurade mmu nnipa no atɛn. Bu me atɛn, Ao Awurade sɛdeɛ me teneneeyɛ teɛ, sɛdeɛ me nokorɛdie teɛ, Ao Ɔsorosoroni.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn teneneeni, wo a wohwehwɛ adwene ne akoma mu, fa amumuyɛfoɔ basabasayɛ bra awieeɛ na ma ateneneefoɔ nya banbɔ.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Mʼakokyɛm ne Ɔsorosoro Onyankopɔn deɛ ɔgye akoma mu teneneeni no.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔtemmufoɔ teneneeni, Onyame a ɔda nʼabufuo adi da biara.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Sɛ wansesa nʼadwene a, ɔbɛse nʼakofena ano; ɔbɛkuntunu ne tadua na ɔde bɛmma ahyɛ mu.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: Wasiesie ne kɔdiawuo akodeɛ; ayɛ ne bɛmma a ɛrederɛ no krado.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔnyinsɛn amumuyɛ na basabasayɛ ahyɛ no ma no, ɔwo nnaadaa.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔtu tokuro na ɔyi mu dɔteɛ no hwe tokuro a watu no mu.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw a ɔde ba no dane bɔ nʼankasa so; ne basabasayɛ bɔ nʼankasa tiri so.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mede aseda bɛma Awurade ne tenenee enti na mato ayɛyi dwom ayi Awurade, Ɔsorosoroni no din ayɛ. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔnto no “gittit” sankuo nne so.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, yɛn Awurade, wo din kɛseyɛ ada adi ewiase afanan nyinaa. Wode wʼanimuonyam atimtim ɔsoro nohoa,

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: mmɔfra ne nkɔkoaa mpo de wɔn ano kamfo wo, wʼatamfoɔ nti; na wode bɔ atamfoɔ ne weretɔfoɔ ano.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Sɛ mehwɛ wo soro, wo nsateaa ano adwuma; ɔsrane ne nsoromma a wode obiara asi nʼafa a,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: onipa ne hwan a wokae no, na onipa ba nso ne hwan a wʼani ku ne ho?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Wobɔɔ no ma ɔyɛɛ akumaa kakra sene abɔfoɔ na wode wʼanimuonyam ne anidie abɔ no abotire.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Woyɛɛ no sodifoɔ maa wo nsa ano adwuma wode nneɛma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nan ase:

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: nnwankuo ne nantwikuo nyinaa ne wiram mmoa nso,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: ewiem nnomaa ne ɛpo mu mpataa, deɛ ɛnenam ɛpo mu akwan so nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Ao, Awurade, yɛn Awurade, wo din yɛ kɛseɛ wɔ asase nyinaa so! Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ. Wɔto no sɛdeɛ wɔto “Ɔba no wuo”.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mefiri mʼakoma nyinaa mu mekamfo wo. Mɛka wʼanwanwadeɛ no nyinaa.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Mɛma mʼani agye na madi ahurisie wɔ wo mu. Mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama wo din, Ao Ɔsorosoroni.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Mʼatamfoɔ sane wɔn akyi; wɔtete hwe, na wɔwuwu wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Woadi mʼasɛm ama me, na mɛnya mʼahofadie; woatena wʼahennwa so, abu atɛntenenee.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Woatwe amanaman no aso, na woasɛe amumuyɛfoɔ. Woapepa wɔn din a wɔrenkae wɔn bio.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛeɛ a ɛnni awieeɛ ato ɔtamfoɔ no, woatutu wɔn nkuropɔn; na wɔnnkae wɔn bio mpo.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Awurade di ɔhene daa daa; wasi nʼatemmuo ahennwa.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Ɔde tenenee bɛbu ewiase atɛn; ɔde atɛntenenee bɛdi nnipa no so.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ dwanekɔbea ma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so, ɔyɛ abandenden wɔ ahohia mmrɛ mu.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔnim wo din no de wɔn ho bɛto wo so, ɛfiri sɛ, wo Awurade, wonnyaa obiara a ɔhwehwɛ wo no mu da.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Monto ayɛyie dwom mma Awurade a ɔte ahennwa so wɔ Sion; mompae mu nka deɛ wayɛ wɔ amanaman no mu.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Na ɔkae deɛ ɔtɔ mogya so were no; ɔmmu nʼani ngu ɔbrɛfoɔ sufrɛ so.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, hwɛ sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ teetee me! Hu me mmɔbɔ na yi me firi owuo apono ano,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: na matumi apae mu aka wʼayɛyie wɔ Ɔbabaa Sion apono ano na ɛhɔ, madi ahurisie wɔ wo nkwagyeɛ no mu.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Aman amanmufoɔ atɔ amena a wɔatu no mu; afidie a wɔsum hintaaeɛ no ayi wɔn nan.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ sane kɔ damena mu, amanaman a wɔn werɛ firi Onyankopɔn nyinaa.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Nanso ɛnyɛ daa na ne werɛ bɛfiri ohiani, anaa sɛ mmɔborɔni anidasoɔ bɛyera korakora.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Sɔre! Ao Awurade, mma ɔdasani nni nkonim, bu amanaman no atɛn wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Hunahuna wɔn, Ao Awurade; na ma wɔnhunu sɛ, wɔyɛ adasamma.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Adɛn enti, Ao Awurade, na wogyina akyirikyiri saa? Adɛn enti na wode wo ho ahinta wɔ amanehunu mmerɛ mu yi?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Ɔmumuyɛfoɔ de ahantan taataa mmɔborɔfoɔ, wɔn a mfidie a wɔasunsum yi wɔn.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔde deɛ nʼakoma hwehwɛ hoahoa ne ho; ɔhyira ɔdifodepɛfoɔ, na ɔyi Awurade ahi.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Ahantan enti, omumuyɛfoɔ nhwehwɛ Awurade; na Onyankopɔn nni ne nsusuiɛ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Nʼakwan nyinaa mu, ɔdi yie; ɔma ne ho so, na wo mmara mfa ne ho; na ɔdi nʼatamfoɔ nyinaa ho fɛw.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho sɛ: “Biribiara mma me nhinhim; mʼani bɛgye daa, na merenkɔ amanehunu mu da.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Nnome, atorɔ ne ahunahuna ahyɛ nʼanom ma; Ɔhaw ne mmusuo hyɛ ne tɛkrɛma ase.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ɔtɛ wɔ nkuraase; ɔfiri atɛeɛ kum deɛ ɔnnim hwee, na ɔhwɛ wɔn a ɔrepɛ wɔn akum wɔn.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ gyata a wahinta; ɔtɛ sɛ ɔbɛkyere mmɔborɔni; ɔkyere wɔn twe wɔn ase de wɔn kɔ ne bɔn mu.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Ɔdwerɛ wɔn a ɔkyere wɔn no ma wɔtɔ baha; na ɔde nʼahoɔden ka wɔn hyɛ.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho sɛ, “Onyankopɔn werɛ afi; wayi nʼani afiri so na ɔnhunu.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Sɔre, Awurade! Ma wo nsa so, Ao Onyankopɔn. Mma wo werɛ mfiri wɔn a wɔnni aboafoɔ.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na omumuyɛfoɔ yi Onyankopɔn ahi? Adɛn enti na ɔka kyerɛ ne ho sɛ, “Ɔremfrɛ me akontabuo so?”

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Nanso wo, Ao Onyankopɔn, wohunu amanehunu ne ɔhaw; na wayɛ wʼadwene sɛ wobɛhwɛ. Mmɔborɔni de ne ho ma wo; wo na woyɛ awisiaa ɔboafoɔ.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Bubu omumuyɛfoɔ ne ɔbɔnefoɔ aprɛ; frɛ no na ɔmmɛbu nʼamumuyɛ ho nkontaa, amumuyɛ a anka wɔrenhunu no.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔhene daa nyinaa; amanaman no bɛyera nʼasase so.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wotie awiɛmfoɔ adesrɛ; wohyɛ wɔn nkuran, na wotie wɔn sufrɛ,

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: na wodi ma awisiaa ne deɛ wɔhyɛ ne soɔ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔdasani a ɔfiri asase so renhunahuna obiara bio. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Awurade mu na mede me werɛ ahyɛ. Adɛn na wotumi ka kyerɛ me sɛ, “Tu te sɛ anomaa kɔ wo bepɔ so.

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Na hwɛ, amumuyɛfoɔ akuntunu wɔn tadua mu, na wɔde wɔn mmɛmma asisi nhoma so sɛ wɔbɛto wɔ esum mu de awɔ akoma mu ahotefoɔ.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔresɛe fapem no a, ɛdeɛn na ɔteneneeni bɛtumi ayɛ?”

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Awurade wɔ nʼasɔredan kronkron no mu; Awurade te ne soro ahennwa so. Ɔhwɛ nnipa mma, nʼani hwehwɛ wɔn mu.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Awurade hwehwɛ ɔteneneeni mu, na amumuyɛfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔpɛ basabasayɛ deɛ, ne kra kyiri wɔn.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛtɔ gyaframa ne sɔfe a ɛrederɛ agu Amumuyɛfoɔ so; na mframa a emu yɛ hyeɛ bɛyɛ wɔn kyɛfa.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔteneneeni, na ɔpɛ atɛntenenee; wɔn a wɔtene no bɛhunu nʼanim. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔnto no wɔ “Seminit” sankuo nne so.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Boa yɛn, Awurade, na nyamesurofoɔ asa; nokwafoɔ ayera wɔ nnipa mu.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Obiara di atorɔ kyerɛ ne yɔnko; wɔn ano a ɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ no ka nnaadaasɛm.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Ma Awurade ntwa nnaadaa ano ne tɛkrɛma biara a ɛhoahoa ne ho ntwene;

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔse, “Yɛde yɛn tɛkrɛma bɛdi nkonim; yɛn ano yɛ yɛn dea, na hwan ne yɛn wura?”

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: “Esiane nhyɛ a wɔde hyɛ mmɔborɔni no ne ohiani apenesie no enti, mɛsɔre afei,” Awurade na ɔseɛ. “Mɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afiri wɔn a wɔha wɔn ho.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Awurade asɛm yɛ nokorɛ te sɛ dwetɛ a wɔasɔne so wɔ fononoo mu, na wɔahoa ho mprɛnson.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wobɛkora yɛn na woabɔ yɛn ho ban afebɔɔ afiri saa abɔnefoɔ yi ho,

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: abɔnefoɔ a wɔnenam sɛdeɛ wɔpɛ ɛberɛ a adasamma de anidie ma afideɛ. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Ao, Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Wo werɛ bɛfiri me afebɔɔ anaa? Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na wode wʼanim bɛhinta me?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na mene mʼadwendwene bɛdi apereapereɛ na awerɛhoɔ ahyɛ mʼakoma mu daa? Mʼatamfoɔ nni me so nkonim nkɔsi da bɛn?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Te wʼani hwɛ me na bua me, Ao, Awurade, me Onyankopɔn. Ma mʼani so nyɛ hann, na manna owuo nna.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Me ɔtamfoɔ bɛka sɛ, “Madi ne so nkonim.” Na mʼahohiahiafoɔ bɛdi ahurisie ɛberɛ a mahwe ase.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Nanso mede me ho to wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no so; mʼakoma di ahurisie wɔ wo nkwagyeɛ mu.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Mɛto dwom ama Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ ɔne me adi no yie. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ no.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea ka wɔ nʼakoma mu sɛ, “Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ.” Wɔaporɔ, na wɔn nneyɛɛ yɛ fi na wɔn mu biara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ade pa.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Awurade firi ɔsoro hwɛ adasamma sɛ ɔbɛhunu wɔn mu bi a wɔwɔ nteaseɛ, anaa ebinom a wɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Enti nnebɔneyɛfoɔ rensua nyansa anaa? Wɔwe me nkurɔfoɔ te sɛ deɛ nnipa di aduane. Wɔnnsu mfrɛ Awurade?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Wɔn nie, ehu akyekyere wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn te wɔn a wɔtene mu.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Mo nnebɔneyɛfoɔ sɛe ahiafoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ, nanso, Awurade ne wɔn dwanekɔbea.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ao, ma Israel nkwagyeɛ mfiri Sion mmra! Awurade bɛsane de ne nkurɔfoɔ agyapadeɛ ama wɔn. Na Yakob adi ahurisie, na Israel ani agye!

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Awurade, hwan na ɔbɛsoeɛ wo kronkronbea hɔ? Hwan na ɔbɛtena wo bepɔ kronkron no so?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Deɛ ne ho nni asɛm na ɔyɛ deɛ ɛtene, deɛ ɔka nokorɛ a ɛfiri nʼakomam

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: na ɔmfa ne tɛkrɛma nsɛe nnipa deɛ ɔnnyɛ ne yɔnko bɔne na ɔmmu ne yɔnko onipa abomfiaa,

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: deɛ ɔbu afideyɛni animtiaa na ɔde anidie ma wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade, deɛ ɔdi ne ntam so ɛberɛ a ɛtia no mpo,

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: deɛ ɔde ne sika bɔ bosea a ɔnnye nsiho na ɔnnye adanmudeɛ ntia deɛ ɔdi bem. Deɛ ɔyɛ yeinom no renhinhim da.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Bɔ me ho ban, Ao Onyankopɔn, na wo mu na menya hintabea.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Meka kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ, “MʼAwurade ne wo; menni adepa biara ka wo ho.”

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Ahotefoɔ a wɔwɔ asase no so deɛ, wɔne animuonyamfoɔ a mʼanigyeɛ wɔ wɔn mu.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔdi anyame afoforɔ akyire no wɔn awerɛhoɔ bɛdɔɔso. Merenyi wɔn mogya apaeɛ no bi na meremfa mʼano memmɔ wɔn din.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Awurade, wode me kyɛfa ne me kuruwa ama me; woama me kyɛfa anya banbɔ.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Mʼahyeɛ akɔdeda mmea a ɛhɔ yɛ ahomeka; ampa ara mewɔ agyapadeɛ a ɛho yɛ anigye.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Mɛkamfo Awurade a ɔtu me fo; na anadwo mpo mʼakoma kyerɛkyerɛ me.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Mehunu Awurade wɔ mʼani so daa nyinaa. Esiane sɛ ɔwɔ me nsa nifa enti, merenhinhim da.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Ɛno enti, me kra ani gye, na mede me tɛkrɛma di ahurisie; me onipadua nso bɛhome asomdwoeɛ mu,

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, worennya me awufoɔ mu. Na woremma wo Kronkronni no mporɔ.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Woakyerɛ me nkwagyeɛ kwan, na wobɛma mʼani agye wɔ wʼanim, na anika a ɛrensa da wɔ wo nifa so.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Ao, Awurade tie me tenenee abisadeɛ; tie me sufrɛ. Yɛ aso ma me mpaeɛbɔ deɛ ɛmfiri nnaadaa anofafa mu.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Ma me bembuo a ɛfiri wo hɔ. Ma wʼani nhunu deɛ ɛyɛ pɛ.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Wopɛɛpɛɛ mʼakoma mu, wohwehwɛ me mu anadwo, na wosɔ me hwɛ deɛ, nanso worenhunu hwee; masi madwene pi sɛ mʼano renka bɔne.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Nnipa nneyɛɛ fam no, wʼanomu asɛm enti matwe me ho afiri basabasayɛfoɔ akwan ho.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Menam wʼakwan so daa; me nan nnwatiriiɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Mesu mefrɛ wo, Ao Onyankopɔn na wobɛgye me so; yɛ aso ma me na tie me mpaeɛbɔ.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Da wo dɔ nwanwasoɔ no adi wo a wode wo nsa nifa gye wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no nkwa firi wɔn atamfoɔ nsam.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Hwɛ me so sɛ obi a wodɔ no; fa me sie wo ntaban nwunu no ase

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: firi amumuyɛfoɔ a wɔretaataa me nsam, mʼatamfoɔ a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Wɔpirim wɔn akoma, na wɔkasa ahantan so.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wɔadi me ntɛtɛ, afei wɔatwa me ho ahyia; wɔn ani abere sɛ wɔbɛbɔ me ahwe fam.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Wɔte sɛ gyata a ahaboa ho kɔm de no, te sɛ gyata kɛseɛ bi a wabutu wɔ atɛeɛ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Sɔre, Ao Awurade! Wone wɔn mfa mmɔ ani na ka wɔn hyɛ; fa wʼakofena no gye me firi amumuyɛfoɔ no nsam.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade fa wo nsa gye me firi nnipa a wɔte sei nsam asase so nnipa a wɔn akatua wɔ nkwa yi mu. Womma ɛkɔm nne wɔn a wʼani ku wɔn ho; wɔn mmammarima wɔ bebree, na wɔkora agyapadeɛ ma wɔn mma.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Na me deɛ, me tenenee mu, mɛhunu wʼanim; sɛ menyane na mehunu wo a, mʼakoma bɛtɔ ne yam. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Medɔ wo, Ao Awurade, mʼahoɔden.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me botantim; mʼaban ne me gyefoɔ; me Onyankopɔn ne me botan Ne mu na menya me hintabea. Ɔyɛ mʼakokyɛm, me nkwagyeɛ abɛn ne mʼabandenden.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Mesu frɛ Awurade; ɔno na ayɛyie sɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔgye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Owuo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kyekyeree me; na ɔsɛeɛ asorɔkye bu faa me so.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Mʼahohia mu, mesu mefrɛɛ Awurade. Mesu mefrɛɛ me Onyankopɔn pɛɛ mmoa. Ɔfiri nʼasɔrefie hɔ tee me nne; me sufrɛ baa nʼanim, na ɛkɔɔ nʼasom.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Asase wosoeɛ na ɛhinhimeɛ, na mmepɔ fapem wosoeɛ wɔsuroeɛ ɛfiri sɛ na ne bo afu.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Wisie firii ne hwene mu; ogyaframa firii nʼanom, na egyasramma dɛre firii mu.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ɔfirii ɔsoro baa fam; na omununkum kabii duruu ne nan ase.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ɔte Kerubim so tu kɔɔ soro; gyaagyaa ne ho wɔ mframa ntaban so.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ɔde sum kataa ne ho, osu a amuna tumm atwa ne ho ahyia.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Hann kɛseɛ hyerɛn wɔ nʼanim, na omununkum a asukɔtweaa ne anyinam wɔ mu firii ne ho hyerɛn mu baeɛ.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Awurade bobɔɔ mu firii soro; Ɔsorosoroni no nne gyegyeeɛ bio.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Ɛpo mu mmɔnka ho yiyiiɛ na asase nnyinasoɔ ho daa hɔ, ɛsiane wʼanimka ne ahomeguo a ɛfiri wo hwene mu no enti, Ao Awurade.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ɔfiri ɔsoro baa ɛfam bɛsɔɔ me mu; ɔtwee me firii nsuo a emu dɔ mu.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Ɔgyee me firii me ɔtamfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ nsam, wɔn a wɔn ani sa me, na wɔn ho yɛ den dodo ma me no.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Wɔbaa me so wɔ mʼamanehunu da mu, nanso Awurade pagyaa me.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Ɔde me baa baabi a ɛhɔ trɛ; ɔgyee me, ɛfiri sɛ nʼani sɔɔ me.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me adi no sɛdeɛ me tenenee teɛ; wahwɛ me nsa a ɛho teɛ so atua me ka.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Manante Awurade akwan so. Mentwee me ho mfirii me Onyankopɔn ho nkɔyɛɛ bɔne.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Madi ne mmara nyinaa so: memmuu nʼahyɛdeɛ so.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Me ho nni asɛm wɔ Onyankopɔn anim, na matwe me ho afiri bɔne ho.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Awurade agyina me teneneeyɛ ne me nsa a ɛho teɛ wɔ nʼanim so atua me ka.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Woda wo ho adi sɛ ɔnokwafoɔ kyerɛ wɔn a wɔdi nokorɛ, wɔn a wɔdi mu nso wo kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wodi mu.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Woyɛ kronn ma wɔn a wɔyɛ kronn, na amumuyɛfoɔ deɛ, wokyiri wɔn.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Wogye ahobrɛasefoɔ nkwa, na wobrɛ ahantanfoɔ ase.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, woyɛ me kanea. Aane, woma me sum dane hann.

english_verse: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.
translation_verse: Wʼahoɔden a wode ma me enti, metumi ka akodɔm gu; me Onyankopɔn enti, metumi foro ɔfasuo.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn deɛ, nʼakwan yɛ pɛ; Awurade bɔhyɛ nyinaa ba mu. Ɔyɛ akokyɛm ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ banbɔ wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Na hwan na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn ka Awurade ho? Na hwan na ɔyɛ Ɔbotan no, gye sɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn no.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔma me ahoɔden, na ɔma me kwan yɛ pɛ.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɔma mʼanammɔn ho yɛ hare sɛ ɔforoteɛ deɛ. Ɔma me gyina sorɔnsorɔmmea.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Ɔsiesie me ma ɔko, na mʼabasa tumi kuntunu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ tadua.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Wode wo nkonimdie akokyɛm ma me, na wo nsa nifa kura me. Wobrɛ wo ho ase ma meyɛ kɛseɛ.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Woabɔ ɛkwan tɛtrɛɛ ama me nan sɛdeɛ ɛrenwatiri.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Metaa mʼatamfoɔ kɔtoo wɔn; mansane mʼakyi kɔsii sɛ mesɛee wɔn.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Mɛdwerɛ wɔn, na wɔantumi ansɔre, wɔhwehwee ase wɔ me nan ase.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Wode akodie ahoɔden maa me; womaa mʼatamfoɔ bɔɔ wɔn mu ase wɔ me nan ase.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Womaa mʼatamfoɔ danee wɔn ho dwaneeɛ, na mesɛe wɔn a wɔtan me.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Wɔsu pɛɛ mmoa, nanso obiara ammɛgye wɔn, wɔfrɛɛ Awurade, nanso wammua.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Meyamoo wɔn sɛ mfuturo a mframa bɔ guo; me hwiee wɔn guiɛ sɛ mmɔntene so atɛkyɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Woagye me afiri nnipa no ntohyɛsoɔ mu, woayɛ me amanaman no ti; nnipa a mennim wɔn abɛyɛ mʼasomfoɔ.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Wɔn nyinaa botoboto; wɔfiri wɔn abandenden mu ba ahopopoɔ so.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Awurade te ase! Ayɛyi nka me Botan! Wɔmma Onyankopɔn me Gyefoɔ no din so!

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne Onyankopɔn a ɔtɔ awere ma me, ɔno na ɔka amanaman hyɛ mʼase,

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔgye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam. Wopagyaa me sii mʼatamfoɔ so, wogyee me firii basabasayɛfoɔ nsam.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ɛno enti, mɛkamfo wo wɔ amanaman mu, Ao Awurade. Mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama wo din.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Wode nkonimdie akɛseɛ ama wo ɔhene; woda ɔdɔ a ɛnsa da adi kyerɛ deɛ woasra no ngo, wode kyerɛ Dawid, ne nʼasefoɔ afebɔɔ. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɔsoro ka Onyankopɔn animuonyam ho asɛm! Ewiem pae mu ka ne nsa ano adwuma,

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Ɛda biara, wɔkasa; anadwo biara, wɔkyerɛ nimdeɛ.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Ɔkasa anaa nsɛm nnim na wɔnnte wɔn nne.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔn asɛm akɔduru asase so mmaa nyinaa, wɔn nsɛm nso akɔduru asase ano. Wɔ ɔsoro hɔ, wasi ntomadan ama owia,

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: a ɔte sɛ ayeforɔkunu a ɔfiri ne pia mu, te sɛ ɔbrane a ne ho pere no sɛ ɔbɛtu ne mmirika.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Ɛpue wɔ ɔsoro fa baabi na atwa ne ho akɔsi ano; biribiara nhinta ne hyeɛ.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Awurade mmara yɛ pɛ, ɛkanyane ɔkra no. Ahotosoɔ wɔ Awurade nhyehyɛeɛ mu, ɛma deɛ ɔnnim nyansa hunu nyansa.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Awurade ahyɛdeɛ tene; ɛma akoma mu anigyeɛ. Awurade ɔhyɛ nsɛm mu da hɔ; na ɛbue ani.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ kronn, ɛte hɔ daa. Awurade mmaransɛm yɛ nokorɛ na ne nyinaa tene.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Ɛsom bo sene sikakɔkɔɔ sene sikakɔkɔɔ amapa mpo; ɛyɛ dɛ sene ɛwoɔ, sene ɛwoɔ a ɛfiri ɛwokyɛm mu.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Wɔnam so bɔ wo ɔsomfoɔ kɔkɔ sɛ, ɛsodie so akatua yɛ bebree.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔhunu nʼankasa mfomsoɔ? Fa me mfomsoɔ a ahinta kyɛ me.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Bɔ wʼakoa ho ban firi ɔboayɛ bɔne ho, na anhyɛ me so. Ɛno na ɛbɛma madi bem, a merenni fɔ wɔ bɔne akɛseɛ ho.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Ma mʼanom nsɛm ne mʼakoma mu mpaeɛbɔ nyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ wʼani, Ao Awurade me Botan ne me Gyefoɔ. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Awurade ntie wo wɔ wʼahohia mu; Yakob Onyankopɔn din mmɔ wo ho ban.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɔmfa mmoa mfiri kronkronbea hɔ mmrɛ wo na ɔmfiri Sion mmɛhyɛ wo den.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Ɔnkae wʼafɔrebɔ nyinaa na ɔmma wo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ nsɔ nʼani.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Ɔmma wo deɛ wʼakoma pɛ, na wo nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa nyɛ yie.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Yɛbɛbɔ ose ɛberɛ a woadi nkonim na yɛama yɛn frankaa so wɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn din mu. Awurade nyɛ wʼabisadeɛ nyinaa mma wo.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Afei mahunu sɛ Awurade gye deɛ wasra no no nkwa; ɔgye no so wɔ ne soro kronkron hɔ ɔde tumi a ɛfiri ne nsa nifa mu no ma no nkwagyeɛ.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Ebinom de wɔn ho to wɔn nteaseɛnam so na afoforɔ nso, wɔn apɔnkɔ so, nanso yɛn deɛ, yɛde yɛn ho to Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn din so.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Saa nkurɔfoɔ no, wɔbrɛ wɔn ase ma wɔhwehwe ase, na yɛn deɛ, yɛsɔre gyina pintinn.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade gye ɔhene nkwa! Na sɛ yɛfrɛ nso a, gye yɛn so. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ɔhene no anigye wɔ wʼahoɔden mu. Nʼani gye mmorosoɔ wɔ nkonimdie a wo ma no nti!

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Woama no deɛ nʼakoma pɛ; woamfa nʼabisadeɛ ankame no.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Wode nhyira a ɛdi mu hyiaa no na wode sikakɔkɔɔ amapa ahenkyɛ hyɛɛ no.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ɔbisaa wo hɔ nkwa, na wode maa no, nna tentene a ɛnni awieeɛ.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Nkonimdie a woma no enti, nʼanimuonyam so; wode kɛseyɛ ne anidie adom no.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, woama no nhyira a ɛnsa da na wo nsrahwɛ ama me ho ahosɛpɛ me.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Ɔhene no de ne ho to Awurade so; Ɔsorosoroni no nokorɛ dɔ no enti, Ɔhene renhinhim.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Wo nsa bɛka wʼatamfoɔ nyinaa; wo nsa nifa bɛsɔ wɔn a wɔkyiri woɔ mu.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a wobɛyi wo ho adi no wobɛyɛ wɔn sɛ fononoo a emu adɔ. Awurade firi nʼabufuhyeɛ mu bɛmene wɔn, na ne ogya no ahye wɔn.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Wobɛtɔre wɔn ase wɔ asase so, na wɔn asefoɔ afiri adasamma mu.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ wɔbɔ pɔ tia wo na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bɔne, nanso wɔrenni nkonim;

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ wobɛma wɔasane wɔn akyi ɛberɛ a woatwe bɛmma akyerɛ wɔn so.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Yɛma wo so, Ao Awurade, wɔ wʼahoɔden mu; yɛbɛto nnwom na yɛakamfo wo kɛseyɛ. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ. Wɔto no sɛdeɛ wɔto “Adekyeeɛ foroteɛ” dwom.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Me Onyankopɔn, me Onyankopɔn, adɛn enti na woagya me? Adɛn enti na me nkwagyeɛ ne wo ntam aware, adɛn na mʼapinisie nsɛm ne wo ntam aware?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Ao me Onyankopɔn, mesu frɛ wo awia, nanso wonnye me so, mefrɛ wo anadwo, nanso mennya ɔhome.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Nanso, wɔasi wo ɔhene sɛ Ɔkronkronni; wo na Israel kamfo woɔ.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Wo mu na yɛn agyanom de wɔn werɛ hyɛeɛ; wɔgyee wo diiɛ, na wogyee wɔn.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Wɔsu frɛɛ wo na wogyee wɔn, wɔde wɔn ho too wo so na woanni wɔn hwammɔ.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Nanso meyɛ ɔsonsono, na menyɛ onipa nnipa bɔ me ahohora na wɔbu me animtiaa.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔhunu me di me ho fɛw; wɔtwa me adapaa, woso wɔn ti ka sɛ:

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “Ɔde ne ho to Awurade so; ma Awurade mmɛgye no. Ma ɔmmɛboa no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔwɔ ne mu anigyeɛ.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Wo na woyii me firii awotwaa mu baeɛ na womaa mede me ho too wo so ɛberɛ a metua me maame nufoɔ ano mpo.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri mʼawoɔ mu na wɔde me too wo soɔ; ɛfiri me maame yafunu mu, woayɛ me Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Ntwe wo ho mfiri me ho! Ɛfiri sɛ amaneɛ abɛn na ɔboafoɔ nni baabi.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Anantwinini bebree atwa me ho ahyia; Basan anantwinini a wɔn ho yɛ den atwa me ho ahyia.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Gyata a wɔbobom na wɔtete wɔn ahaboa mu abuebue wɔn anom tɛtrɛɛ de kyerɛ me.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Wɔahwie me agu sɛ nsuo, na me nnompe nyinaa ahodwo. Mʼakoma adane ayɛ sɛ nku; anane afiri me mu.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Mʼahoɔden awe te sɛ kyɛmferɛ mu. Na me tɛkrɛma atare mʼanom. Wode me ato owuo mfuturo mu.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Nkraman atwa me ho ahyia nnebɔneyɛfoɔ kuo atwa me ho ahyia, wɔahwire me nsa ne me nan mu.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mɛtumi akan me nnompe nyinaa; Mʼatamfoɔ di me nhwɛhaa na wɔsere me.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Wɔkyɛ me atadeɛ mu fa, na wɔbɔ me ntoma so ntonto.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Na wo, Ao Awurade, ntwe wo ho. Ao mʼAhoɔden bra ntɛm bɛboa me.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Gye me kra firi akofena ano; gye me nkwa a ɛsom bo no firi nkraman tumi ase.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Gye me nkwa firi gyata anom; gye me firi ɛkoɔ mmɛn so.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mɛbɔ wo din akyerɛ me nuanom; mɛkamfo wo wɔ wɔn a wɔahyia hɔ no nyinaa anim.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, mo a mosuro no no! Mo a moyɛ Yakob asefoɔ, monhyɛ no animuonyam! Mo Israel asefoɔ nyinaa, monni no ni!

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Ɔmmuu nʼani nguu ɔmanehunufoɔ ateetee so, ɔmfaa nʼanim nhintaa no; na mmom watie ne sufrɛ a ɔde repɛ mmoa.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Me botaeɛ a mede yi wo ayɛ wɔ badwa mu no firi wo; mɛdi me bɔhyɛ so wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro wo no anim.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Ahiafoɔ bɛdidi na wɔamee; wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade bɛyi no ayɛ. Mo akoma nnya nkwa daa.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Asase ano nyinaa bɛkae akɔ Awurade nkyɛn, na amanaman no mmusua nyinaa bɛkoto nʼanim,

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ ahennie wɔ Awurade na ɔdi amanaman so ɔhene.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Asase so adefoɔ nyinaa bɛdidi na wɔasɔre no; wɔn a wɔkɔ dɔteɛ mu nyinaa bɛbu nkotodwe nʼanim, wɔn a wɔrentumi mma nkwa mu.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Nkyirimma nyinaa bɛsom no; wɔbɛka Awurade ho asɛm akyerɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka ne tenenee akyerɛ nnipa a wɔnnya nwoo wɔn ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na wayɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me hwɛfo, hwee renhia me.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Ɔma meda wira frɔmfrɔm adidibea mu; ɔgya me kɔ nsuo a ɛho dwoɔ ho,

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: ɔdwodwo me kra. Ɔde me fa akwantenenee so, ne din enti.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Sɛ menam owuo sum kabii mu mpo a, mensuro bɔne bi, ɛfiri sɛ, wo ne me na ɛwɔ hɔ; wʼabaa ne wo poma na ɛkyekyere me werɛ.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Woto me ɛpono wɔ mʼatamfoɔ anim. Wode ngo afɔ me tirim; me kuruwa ayɛ ma abu so.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Yie ne adɔeɛ nko na ɛbɛdi mʼakyi me nkwa nna nyinaa; na mɛtena Awurade fie daa.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ Awurade dea; ewiase ne wɔn a wɔte soɔ nyinaa wɔ no;

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔtoo ne fapem wɔ ɛpo so na ɔde sii nsuo ani.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtumi aforo Awurade bepɔ no? Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina ne tenabea kronkron hɔ?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔyɛ ade tenenee na nʼakoma mu teɛ, deɛ ne kra nni ahoni akyi na ɔnnka ntanhunu.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Ɔbɛnya Awurade nsam nhyira ne bembuo a ɛfiri ne Nkwagyeɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Saa na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no teɛ, wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wʼanim no, Ao Yakob Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mo apono, mommuebue mommuebue, mo tete apono, na Animuonyam Ɔhene nhyɛne mu.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Hwan ne saa Animuonyam Ɔhene yi? Ɔno ne Awurade ɔhoɔdenfoɔ ne otumfoɔ no; Awurade a ɔyɛ ɔko mu nkonimdifoɔ.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mommuebue, Ao mo apono mommuebue, mo tete apono, na animuonyam Ɔhene no nkɔ mu.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Hwan ne saa animuonyam Ɔhene yi? Asafo Awurade no, ɔno ne animuonyam Ɔhene no.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mema me kra so kyerɛ wo;

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: wo so, Ao me Onyankopɔn, na mede me ho to. Mma mʼanim ngu ase na mma mʼatamfoɔ nso nni me so nkonim.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Ao Awurade, na me nhunu wʼatempɔn.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Fa wo nokorɛ no so kyerɛkyerɛ me, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ Onyankopɔn, me Gyefoɔ, na mʼani da wo so daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Kae, Ao Awurade, wo mmɔborɔhunu ne wo dɔ kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ firi tete no.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Nkae me mmabunu berɛ mu bɔne ne mʼatuateɛ akwan; kae me sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ, Ao Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ wo yɛ.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ, na ɔtene; enti ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nʼakwan.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Ɔde ahobrɛasefoɔ fa ɛkwan pa so na ɔkyerɛ wɔn nʼapɛdeɛ.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Awurade akwan nyinaa yɛ ɔdɔ ne nokorɛdie ma wɔn a wɔdi nʼapam mu ahyɛdeɛ soɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, me bɔne so deɛ, nanso wo din enti, fa kyɛ me.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Enti hwan ne onipa a ɔsuro Awurade? Ɔbɛkyerɛ no kwan a wabɔ ama no.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛdi yie wɔ ne nkwa nna mu, na nʼasefoɔ afa asase no sɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Awurade da nʼatirimsɛm adi kyerɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no; na ɔma wɔhunu nʼapam.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Mʼani da Awurade so daa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno nko ara na ɔbɛyi me nan afiri afidie mu.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Dane wʼani hwɛ me, na dom me, ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ ankonam na meyɛ mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Mʼakoma mu dadwene adɔɔso; yi me dadwene firi me so.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Hwɛ me haw ne mʼahohiahia na yi me bɔne nyinaa firi me so.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ adɔɔso ne ɔtan kɛseɛ a wɔde tan me!

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Bɔ me nkwa ho ban na gye me. Mma mʼanim ngu ase, ɛfiri sɛ me dwanekɔbea ne wo.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Ma tenenee ne nokorɛ mmɔ me ho ban, ɛfiri sɛ mʼani da wo so.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Gye Israel, Ao Onyankopɔn, firi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Bu me bem, Ao Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ, mabɔ bra a asɛm nni ho: mede me ho too Awurade so na manhinhim.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Sɔ me hwɛ, Ao Awurade, hwehwɛ mʼakoma ne mʼadwene mu.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Wʼadɔeɛ wɔ mʼanim daa na mɛnante wo nokorɛ mu.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Me ne nnaadaafoɔ ntena na me ne nyaatwomfoɔ nso nni hwee yɛ.

english_verse: or go with evil crowds.
translation_verse: Mekyiri nnebɔneyɛfoɔ dwabɔ na mempɛ sɛ me ne amumuyɛfoɔ tena.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Mehohoro me nsa wɔ bembuo mu, na makɔ wʼafɔrebukyia ho ahyia, Ao Awurade,

english_verse: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
translation_verse: na mepae mu ka wʼayɛyie na meka wʼanwanwadeɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Mʼani gye efie a wote mu ho, Ao Awurade, baabi a wʼanimuonyam wɔ no.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Mfa me kra nka nnebɔneyɛfoɔ deɛ ho nkɔ. Mfa me nkwa nka mogyapɛfoɔ deɛ ho,

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: wɔn a amumuyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ wɔn nsam na adanmudeɛ ayɛ wɔn nsa nifa ma.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nanso mebɔ ɔbra a ɛho teɛ. Hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me nkwa.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Me nan sisi asase tamaa so; na dwabɔ akɛseɛ ase na mɛkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me hann ne me nkwagyeɛ; hwan na mensuro no? Awurade ne me nkwa ahoɔden, na hwan anim na me ho mpopoɔ?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnipa bɔne toa me pɛ sɛ wɔkum me a, sɛ mʼatamfoɔ to hyɛ me so a wɔbɛsuntisunti ahwehwe ase.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Sɛ dɔm mpo twa me ho hyia a, mʼakoma rentu; mpo sɛ wɔtu me so sa a, ɛno mu koraa na menya awerɛhyɛmu.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Adeɛ baako na mebisa Awurade; na ɛno na mehwehwɛ; sɛ mɛtena Awurade fie me nkwa nna nyinaa, na mahwɛ Awurade ahoɔfɛ na mahwehwɛ no wɔ nʼasɔrefie.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Wɔ hia ɛda mu no ɔde me sie nʼatenaeɛ; ɔkora me wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan mu. Ɔde me si ɔbotan so wɔ ɔsorosoro.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbɛma me tiri so wɔ atamfoɔ a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no so; mede anigyeɛ bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ nʼAhyiaeɛ Ntomadan mu; na mɛto dwom, ahyehyɛ nnwom ama Awurade.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Ao, Awurade, sɛ mesu frɛ wo a, tie me! Hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me so!

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Mʼakoma ka wɔ wo ho sɛ, “Hwehwɛ nʼanim!” Wʼanim, Ao Awurade na mɛhwehwɛ.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Mfa wʼanim nhinta me, mfa abufuo mpamo wo ɔsomfoɔ me ɔboafoɔ ne wo. Mpo me na nnya me, Ao me Nkwagyeɛ Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Mʼagya ne me maame bɛgya me hɔ deɛ, nanso Awurade bɛgye me.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Ao Awurade; fa me fa ɛkwan tee so, me nhyɛsofoɔ enti.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Nnyaa me mma sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ pɛ, adansekurumfoɔ sɔre tia me na wɔpu awurukasɛm.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Meda so wɔ saa anidasoɔ yi sɛ: mɛhunu Awurade ayamyɛ wɔ ateasefoɔ asase so.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Twɛn Awurade. Hyɛ wo ho den na ma wo bo nyɛ duru na twɛn Awurade.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Wo na mesu mefrɛ wo, Ao Awurade me Botan; nsi wʼaso wɔ me enti. Sɛ woyɛ komm a, mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔasiane kɔ amena mu no.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Tie me mmɔborɔ su ɛberɛ a mefrɛ wo pɛ mmoa ɛberɛ a mema me nsa so kyerɛ wo Tenabea Kronkron hɔ.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Mfa me mfra amumuyɛfoɔ mu ntwe me nkɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no. Wɔne wɔn yɔnkonom kasa fɛfɛ nanso wɔde ɔtan sie wɔn akoma mu.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔmmu deɛ Awurade ayɛ ne deɛ ɔde ne nsa ayɛ no enti, ɔbɛbrɛ wɔn ase na ɔremma wɔnnsɔre bio.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Ayɛyie nka Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ watie me mmɔborɔ su.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Awurade ne mʼahoɔden ne mʼakokyɛm; mʼakoma wɔ ne mu ahotosoɔ, na ɔboa me. Mʼakoma di ahurisie na mede dwomtoɔ bɛda no ase.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ahoɔden ma ne nkurɔfoɔ; ne nkwagyeɛ nsraban ma deɛ wɔasra no ngo.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Gye wo nkurɔfoɔ na hyira wʼagyapadeɛ; yɛ wɔn hwefoɔ, na wo ne wɔn nnante afebɔɔ.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Momfa mma Awurade no, Ao ɔsoro abɔdeɛ, momfa animuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Momfa animuonyam a ɛfata Awurade din mma no; monsɔre Awurade wɔ nʼanimuonyam kronkron mu.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Awurade nne wɔ nsuo no so; animuonyam Onyankopɔn bobom, Awurade bobom wɔ nsuo akɛseɛ so.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Awurade nne mu wɔ tumi; Awurade nne mu wɔ animuonyam.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Awurade nne bubu ntweneduro; Awurade nne bubu Lebanon ntweneduro mu nketenkete.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ɔma Lebanon hurihuri te sɛ nantwie ba, na Sirion nso sɛ ɛkoɔ ba.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Awurade nne pa ma anyinam ogya dɛre

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Awurade nne woso ɛserɛ so; Awurade woso Kades serɛ.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Awurade nne kyinkyim adum na ɛma kwaeɛ yɛ kwaterekwa. Nʼasɔredan mufoɔ nyinaa team ka sɛ, “Animuonyam nka Onyankopɔn!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Awurade di ɔhene wɔ nsuyire so; wɔasi Awurade ɔhene afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Awurade ma ne nkurɔfoɔ ahoɔden, na ɔde asomdwoeɛ hyira wɔn.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Mema wo so, Ao Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ, woayi me afiri ebunu mu na woamma mʼatamfoɔ ansere me.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn, mesu frɛɛ wo sɛ boa me na wosaa me yadeɛ.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Monto ayɛyie nnwom mma Awurade; mo a moyɛ nʼahotefoɔ! Monkamfo ne din kronkron no.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Nʼabufuo nkyɛre, na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa; agyaadwotwa bɛwɔ hɔ anadwo, nanso ahosɛpɛ bɛba anɔpa.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Metee nka sɛ mewɔ banbɔ no, mekaa sɛ, “Merenhinhim da.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, woyɛɛ me adom no womaa me bepɔ gyinaa pintinn na wode wʼanim hintaa me no, me bo tuiɛ.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Wo, Awurade na mefrɛɛ woɔ; wo hɔ na mesu mesrɛɛ mmɔborɔhunu sɛ:

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ me sɛeɛ ho, sɛ mɛkɔ amena mu? Mfuturo bɛyi wo ayɛ anaa? Ɛbɛpae mu aka wo nokorɛdie anaa?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Wodanee mʼagyaadwotwa yɛɛ no asa; woyii mʼayitoma firii me ho na wode anigyeɛ firaa me,

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: sɛ mʼakoma bɛto nnwom ama wo na ɛrenyɛ komm. Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn, mɛda wo ase daa. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Wo mu, Ao Awurade, na manya hintabea; mma mʼanim ngu ase; firi wo tenenee mu gye me.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Yɛ aso ma me, bra ntɛm bɛgye me; yɛ me banbɔ botan, aban a mʼatamfoɔ nsa renka me.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ me botan ne mʼaban enti, wo din enti, di mʼanim na kyerɛ me ɛkwan.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Gye me firi afidie a wɔasum me no mu, ɛfiri sɛ wo ne me dwanekɔbea.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Wo nsam na mede me kra hyɛ; gye me bio, Ao Awurade, Onyankopɔn nokwafoɔ.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mekyiri wɔn a wɔsom abosom huhuo; mede me ho to Awurade so.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Mʼani bɛgye na madi ahurisie wɔ wo dɔ mu, ɛfiri sɛ wohunu mʼamanehunu na wonim me kra mu haw.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Woamfa me amma ɔtamfoɔ no mmom wode me nan asisi petee mu.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Hu me mmɔbɔ, Ao Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ me ho yera me; awerɛhoɔ ama mʼani so ayɛ kusuu ɛyea ama me kra ne me honam ayɛ mmerɛ.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Ateeteeɛ rete me nkwa so na abooboo te me mfeɛ so; ɔhaw enti mʼahoɔden kɔ fam na me nnompe nso ahodwo.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa enti, mayɛ ahohora wɔ me nnamfonom mu; nnipa a wɔnim me suro me, na wɔn a wɔhunu me mmɔntene so dwane.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Obiara werɛ afiri me te sɛ deɛ mawuo; mayɛ sɛ kukuo a abɔ.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Mete dodoɔ no nsekuro. Ahunahuna atwa me ho ahyia. Wɔrepam me tiri so na wɔbɔ pɔ sɛ wɔbɛkum me.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Nanso, mede me ho ato wo so, Ao Awurade; meka sɛ, “Woyɛ me Onyankopɔn.”

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Me mmerɛ wɔ wo nsam gye me firi mʼatamfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔtaa me no nsam.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Te wʼanim kyerɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ; gye me wɔ wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no mu.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Mma mʼanim ngu ase, Ao Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ masu mafrɛ wo; mmom, ma amumuyɛfoɔ anim ngu ase na wɔnna wɔn damena mu komm.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Mua atorofoɔ ano, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde ahantan ne anintiabuo kasa tia teneneefoɔ.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Wo papayɛ dɔɔso, ɛno na woakora ama wɔn a wɔsuro woɔ no; ɛno na wode ma wɔn a wɔdwane toa woɔ no wɔ nnipa anim.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Wode wɔn sie wʼanim banbɔ mu firi nnipa nsusuiɛ bɔne ho; wo tenabea hɔ na wode wɔn sie dwoodwoo firi tɛkrɛma a ɛbɔ soboɔ ho.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Ayɛyi nka Awurade! Sɛ wayi ne dɔ nwanwasoɔ akyerɛ me ɛberɛ a na mewɔ kuropɔn a atamfoɔ atwa ho ahyia no mu.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Mebɔɔ huboa no, mekaa sɛ: “Woayi wʼani me so!” Nanso wotee me mmɔborɔ su ɛberɛ a mekoto srɛɛ woɔ no.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Monnɔ Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼahotefoɔ nyinaa! Awurade kora wɔn a wodi nokorɛ so, na ahomasofoɔ deɛ ɔtua wɔn ka pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Monhyɛ den na momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam, mo a mowɔ anidasoɔ wɔ Awurade mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn amumuyɛ akyɛ wɔn, na wɔakata wɔn bɔne so.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Nhyira nka onipa a Awurade mmu ne bɔne ngu ne so, na nnaadaa nni ne honhom mu.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a meyɛɛ komm no, me nnompe yɛɛ mmrɛ apinie a mesii no da mu nyinaa enti.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Awia ne anadwo wo nsa yɛɛ den wɔ me so; mʼahoɔden saeɛ sɛdeɛ awiaberɛ mu hyeɛ ma biribi yɛ mmerɛ.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Afei, megyee me bɔne too mu. Mankata mʼamumuyɛ so. Mekaa sɛ, “Mɛka me bɔne akyerɛ Awurade,” na wode me bɔne ho afɔdie kyɛɛ me.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Enti, ma obiara a ɔwɔ nyamesu mmɔ wo mpaeɛ ɛberɛ a wɔhunu woɔ; ampa ara sɛ nsuo akɛseɛ yiri a, ɛrenka no.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Wone me hintabea; wobɛbɔ me ho ban wɔ amanehunu mu na wode nkwagyeɛ nnwom atwa me ho ahyia.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Mɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo ɛkwan a wobɛfa soɔ mɛtu wo fo na mahwɛ wo so.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Nyɛ sɛ ɔpɔnkɔ anaa afunumpɔnkɔ a ɔnni nteaseɛ enti wɔde nnareka ne ahoma na ɛdanedane no sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛba wo nkyɛn.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔmumuyɛfoɔ amanehunu dɔɔso, nanso Awurade adɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no, ɛtwa onipa a ɔde ne ho to no so no ho hyia.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Momfa ahurisie nto dwom mma Awurade, mo teneneefoɔ, ɛfata sɛ wɔn a wɔtene no yi no ayɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Momfa sankuo nkamfo Awurade; monto dwom mma no wɔ sankuten so.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Monto dwom foforɔ mma no. Momfa nimdeɛ mmɔ sankuo no na monteam ahurisie so!

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Awurade asɛm tene, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ ɔdi nokorɛ wɔ deɛ ɔyɛ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Awurade dɔ teneneeyɛ ne atɛntenenee. Nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no ahyɛ asase so ma.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Awurade asɛm so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsorosoro, nʼanom homeɛ so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsoro asafo.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: Ɔka ɛpo nsuo boa ano kuo; na ɔde ebunu siee deɛ ɛhɔ dɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Momma asase sofoɔ nyinaa nsuro Awurade; na ewiasefoɔ nyinaa mfa anidie mma no.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔkasaeɛ na ɛbaa mu na ɔhyɛeɛ na ɛgyinaa pintinn.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Awurade sɛe amanaman no nhyehyɛeɛ; ɔma adasamma nsusuiɛ yɛ kwa.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Nanso, Awurade nhyehyɛeɛ tim hɔ daa, nʼakoma mu botaeɛ wɔ hɔ ma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne ɔman a ne Onyankopɔn ne Awurade, nnipa a ɔyii wɔn sɛ nʼagyapadeɛ no.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Awurade hwɛ adasamma nyinaa firi soro.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ɔfiri nʼatenaeɛ hwɛ wɔn a wɔte asase so nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne deɛ ɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa akoma, enti ɔnim deɛ wɔyɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ ɔhene akodɔm kɛseɛ na ɛbɛgye no; ɛnyɛ ɔkofoɔ ahoɔden na ɛbɛma no afiri mu afi.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Ɔpɔnkɔ mu ahotosoɔ yɛ kwa wɔ nkwagyeɛ mu; nʼahoɔden nyinaa akyi no, ɔrentumi nnye nkwa.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Nanso Awurade ani wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no no so, wɔn a wɔwɔ anidasoɔ wɔ ne dɔ a ɛnsa da no mu,

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Yɛde anidasoɔ twɛn Awurade; ɔyɛ yɛn ɔboafoɔ ne yɛn akokyɛm.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Ne mu na yɛn akoma di ahurisie, ɛfiri sɛ yɛde yɛn ho to ne din kronkron no so.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Mede aseda bɛma Awurade berɛ nyinaa; nʼayɛyie wɔ mʼanom daa.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Me kra bɛhoahoa ne ho wɔ Awurade mu; ma amanehunufoɔ nte na wɔn nni ahurisie.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Mo ne me nkamfo Awurade; momma yɛmmɔ mu nkamfo ne din!

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Mefrɛɛ Awurade na ɔgyee me so; na ɔyii me firii mʼakomatuo nyinaa mu.
