english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Woama yɛn mfɛfoɔ abu yɛn animtiaa, na yɛn atamfoɔ sere yɛn.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Ao Otumfoɔ Onyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio; ma wʼanim nhyerɛn yɛn so, na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Wode bobe firi Misraim baeɛ; wopamoo amanaman no na woduaaɛ.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Wosiesiee asase no baabi maa no, ɛgyee nhini na ɛtrɛɛ asase no so.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Ne nwunu kataa mmepɔ no so ne mman kataa ntweneduro akɛseɛ no so.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Ɛdendanee kɔɔ Ɛpo so, na ɛfefɛ kɔduruu Asubɔnten no ho.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na woabubu nʼafasuo ama wɔn a wɔtwam hɔ tete ne bobe aba no?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Kɔkɔte firi wiram bɛsɛe no pasaa na mmoadoma a ɛwɔ ɛserɛ so de yɛ wɔn aduane.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Ao Otumfoɔ Onyankopɔn, sane bra yɛn nkyɛn! Firi soro hɔ hwɛ na wobɛhunu! Hwɛ saa bobe yi so,

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: ntini a wo nsa nifa adua no, ɔbabarima a woatete no ama wo ho no.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Wɔatwa wo bobe no ato fam, ato mu ogya ama ahye; wʼanimka ma wo nkurɔfoɔ ase tɔre.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Fa wo nsa kata ɔbarima a ɔwɔ wo nifa no so, onipa ba a woatete no ama wo ho no.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Afei yɛrentwe yɛn ho mfiri wo nkyɛn; kanyane yɛn, na yɛbɛbɔ wo din.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Monto ahurisie dwom mma Onyankopɔn yɛn ahoɔden; mommɔ ose mma Yakob Onyankopɔn no!

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Momma nnwom no so na monwoso akasaeɛ. Mommɔ sankuo ne bɛnta dɛɛdɛ no.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Monhyɛne mmɛntia ɔsrane foforɔ da no, ne ɔsrane korokumatwa mu, yɛn Apontoɔ da no;

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Ɔtintimiiɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ maa Yosef ɛberɛ a ɔsɔre tiaa Misraim no, faako a yɛtee kasa a yɛnte aseɛ no.

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: Ɔka sɛ, “Meyii adesoa no firii mo mmatire so, ne mo nsa firii adwumaden ho.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Mo ahohiahia mu, mofrɛɛ me na megyee mo, megyee mo so wɔ aprannaa mu; me sɔɔ mo hwɛeɛ wɔ Meriba nsuo ho.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: “Ao me nkurɔfoɔ, montie me kɔkɔbɔ yi, Ao Israel, sɛ mobɛtie me a!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ɛnsɛ sɛ monya anyame foforɔ bi wɔ mo mu; ɛnsɛ sɛ mokoto ananafoɔ nyame.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Mene Awurade, mo Onyankopɔn a meyii mo firii Misraim asase so no. Mommue mo anom tɛtrɛɛ na mɛhyɛ mu ma.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: “Nanso me nkurɔfoɔ rentie me; Israel remmrɛ ne ho ase mma me.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Enti megyaa wɔn maa wɔn akomaden sɛ wɔnyɛ deɛ wɔpɛ biara.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: “Sɛ me nkurɔfoɔ tie me, na Israel nante mʼakwan so a,

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: anka mɛdi wɔn atamfoɔ so ama wɔn ntɛm na mama me basa so atia wɔn a wɔkyiri wɔn!

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔtane Awurade no de suro bɛkoto no, na wɔn asotwe to rentwa da.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Nanso, wɔde atokoɔ mu atokoɔ papa bɛma mo adi; mede ɔbotan mu woɔ bɛma mo amee.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn di ɔhene wɔ ɔsoro asafo mu; ɔbu atɛn wɔ “anyame” mu.

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Wobɛbɔ wɔn a wɔnteneɛ ho ban na woayɛ animhwɛ ama amumuyɛfoɔ akɔsi da bɛn?

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Monka mmɔborɔfoɔ ne nwisiaa asɛm mma wɔn; mommɔ ahiafoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so yiedie ho ban.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Monnye ɔbrɛfoɔ ne ohiani; monnye wɔn mfiri amumuyɛfoɔ nsam.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: “Wɔnnim hwee, na wɔnte hwee ase. Wɔkyinkyini wɔ esum mu; na asase fapem nyinaa woso.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: “Mekaa sɛ, ‘Moyɛ “anyame”; mo nyinaa yɛ Ɔsorosoroni no mma.’

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Nanso, mobɛwuwu sɛ nnipa pɛ; na moahwe ase sɛ sodifoɔ biara.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, sɔre na bɛbu ewiase atɛn; ɛfiri sɛ amanaman nyinaa yɛ wo dea.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, ntena hɔ komm; mmua wʼano, Ao Onyankopɔn, keka wo ho.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛdeɛ wʼatamfoɔ keka wɔn ho fa, na wɔn a wɔmpɛ wʼasɛm nso ama wɔn tiri so.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Wɔde anifire repam atia wo nkurɔfoɔ wɔrepam atia wɔn a wʼakoma da wɔn so no.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Wɔka sɛ, “Mommra na yɛnsɛe wɔn sɛ ɔman, sɛdeɛ wɔrenkae Israel din bio.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Wɔde adwene korɔ bɔ pɔ; na wɔpam tia wo,

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Edom ntomadan ne Ismaelfoɔ, Moabfoɔ ne Hagarfoɔ,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gebalfoɔ ne Amonfoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ, Filistifoɔ ne Tirofoɔ.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Asiria mpo akɔka wɔn ho de wɔn ahoɔden akɔhyɛ Lot asefoɔ deɛ mu kena.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Yɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Midian sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Sisera ne Yabin wɔ asubɔnten Kison ho no,

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔsɛee wɔ En-Dor na wɔdanee nwira no.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Yɛ wɔn atitire sɛ Oreb ne Seeb, ne wɔn mmapɔmma nyinaa sɛ Seba ne Salmuna,

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: a wɔkaa sɛ, “Momma yɛmfa Onyankopɔn adidibea nsase no.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ao me Onyankopɔn, yɛ wɔn sɛ twahoframa mu mfuturo, sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ guo.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ ogya hye kwaeɛ, na ogyaframa sɔ nkokoɔ mu hye no no,

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: saa ara na fa wʼahum taa wɔn na fa wo mframa a ano yɛ den no hunahuna wɔn.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ma animguaseɛ nka wɔn, na ama nnipa apɛ wo din akyiri ɛkwan, Ao Awurade.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wɔn abasa mu ntu; ma wɔnwuwu wɔ animguaseɛ mu.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Ma wɔnhunu sɛ wo a wo din de Awurade no, wo nko ara ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase so nyinaa. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔnto no wɔ gittit sankuo nne so.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Ao Asafo Awurade, wʼatenaeɛ hɔ yɛ ahomeka!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Me kra pere, mpo ɛtɔ piti, sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Awurade adihɔ; mʼakoma ne me honam team frɛ Onyankopɔn ɔteasefoɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Mpo akasanoma anya fie, na asomfena nso anwono ne pirebuo, baabi a ɔbɛhwane ne mma wɔ beaeɛ bi a ɛbɛn wʼafɔrebukyia, Ao Asafo Awurade, me Ɔhene ne me Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔte wo fie; na wɔkamfo wo din daa.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔwɔ wo mu ahoɔden, na wɔde wɔn akoma hyɛ akwantuo ase kɔhwehwɛ wo.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔfa Baka Bɔnhwa no mu a, wɔma hɔ yɛ nsuwansuwa; osutɔberɛ nsuo nso de nhyira pii kata asase no so.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Wɔkɔ no ahoɔden so berɛ nyinaa, kɔsi sɛ wɔn mu biara bɛpue Onyankopɔn anim wɔ Sion.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Ao Asafo Awurade, Onyankopɔn tie me mpaeɛbɔ; Ao Yakob Onyankopɔn, yɛ aso ma me.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, hwɛ yɛn akokyɛm; fa ahummɔborɔ hwɛ deɛ woasra no ngo no.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Wʼadihɔ hɔ da korɔ tena yɛ sene nnafua apem wɔ baabi foforɔ; mepɛ sɛ mɛyɛ ɔpono ano hwɛfoɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn fie sene sɛ mɛtena amumuyɛfoɔ ntomadan mu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade Onyankopɔn yɛ owia ne ɛkyɛm; Awurade hunu mmɔbɔ na ɔhyɛ animuonyam; ɔremfa ade pa biara nkame wɔn a wɔteneɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: Ao Asafo Awurade, nhyira nka onipa a ɔde ne ho to wo so. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade wohunuu wʼasase mmɔbɔ; wode Yakob ahonyadeɛ sane maa no.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Wode wo nkurɔfoɔ bɔne kyɛɛ wɔn na wokataa wɔn nnebɔne nyinaa so.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Wode wʼabofuo too nkyɛn na wodane firii wʼabufuhyeɛ ho.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Sane gye yɛn bio, Ao Onyankopɔn, yɛn Gyefoɔ, na ma wʼani nnye yɛn ho.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Wo bo bɛfu yɛn akɔsi daa anaa? Wʼabofuo bɛtoa so akɔ awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ nyinaa so anaa?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Worenhyɛ yɛn den bio, na ama wo nkurɔfoɔ asɛpɛ wɔn ho wɔ wo mu anaa?

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Mɛtie deɛ Awurade Onyankopɔn bɛka. Ɔde asomdwoeɛ hyɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ, ahotefoɔ no bɔ, enti ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsane kɔ agyimisɛm ho.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, ne nkwagyeɛ bɛne wɔn a wɔsuro no, na nʼanimuonyam bɛtena yɛn asase so.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔ ne nokorɛdie bɛhyia, na tenenee ne asomdwoeɛ bɛfe wɔn ho wɔn ho ano.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Nokorɛdie bɛpue afiri asase no so, na tenenee ahwɛ afiri soro.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛma yɛn deɛ ɛyɛ ampa ara na yɛn asase bɛma ne nnɔbaeɛ.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Tenenee di nʼanim siesie ɛkwan ma nʼanammɔntuo.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, tie me na gye me so, ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ ohiani ne mmɔborɔni.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Bɔ me nkwa ho ban, ɛfiri sɛ mede me ho ama wo. Wone me Onyankopɔn, gye wʼakoa a ɔde ne ho to wo so.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, hunu me mmɔbɔ, na mesu frɛ wo daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Ma wʼakoa ani nnye, na wo Awurade, wo nkyɛn na mema me kra so ba.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, woyɛ, na wode bɔne kyɛ, wowɔ ɔdɔ mmorosoɔ ma wɔn a wɔsu frɛ wo nyinaa.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, tie me mpaeɛbɔ; tie me mmɔborɔ su.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Mɛfrɛ wo mʼahohia da mu, na wobɛgye me so.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, onyame bi nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ wo; na wɔn nnwuma biara nto wo deɛ.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, aman a woakyekyere nyinaa bɛba abɛsom wo wɔ wʼanim; wɔbɛba abɛhyɛ wo din animuonyam.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Woyɛ kɛseɛ, na woyɛ anwanwa nnwuma; wo nko ara ne Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, kyerɛ me wʼakwan, na mɛnante wo nokorɛ mu; ma memfa mʼakoma nyinaa mma wo na masuro wo din.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Mede mʼakoma nyinaa mɛyi wo ayɛ, Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn na mahyɛ wo din animuonyam daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ, ɔdɔ a wode dɔ me no so; woayi me afiri owuo amena mu tɔnn.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, ahomasofoɔ ato ahyɛ me so; basabasayɛfoɔ kuo repɛ me akum me, nnipa a wɔmmfa wo nyɛ hwee no.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Nanso wo, Ao Awurade, woyɛ mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ Onyankopɔn, wo bo kyɛre fu, na wʼadɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ dɔɔso.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Dane wʼani hwɛ me na dom me; fa wʼahoɔden ma wʼakoa na gye wʼafenaa babarima nkwa.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Ma me wo papayɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, na mʼatamfoɔ nhunu na wɔn anim ngu ase na wo Ao Awurade, wo na woaboa me akyekye me werɛ.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Awurade ato ne fapem wɔ bepɔ kronkron no so;

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Awurade dɔ Sion apono no sene Yakob atenaeɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Wɔka wo ho animuonyamsɛm Ao Onyankopɔn kuropɔn:

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: “Mede Rahab ne Babilonia bɛka wɔn a wɔyɛ ɔsetie ma me no ho, Filistia, Tiro ne Kus nso mɛka sɛ, ‘Wɔwoo yeinom wɔ Sion.’ ”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Ampa ara wɔbɛka wɔ Sion ho sɛ, “Wɔwoo yei ne ɔno wɔ ne mu, na Ɔsorosoroni no ankasa de no bɛtim hɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛtwerɛ wɔ nnipa dintwerɛ nwoma no mu sɛ, “Wɔwoo yei wɔ Sion.”

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Na wɔbɛto dwom sɛ, “Me nhini nyinaa wɔ wo mu.” Kora mma dwom a wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔnto no “Mahalat Leannot” sankuo so.

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, me nkwagyeɛ Onyankopɔn mesu wɔ wʼanim adekyeeɛ ne adesaeɛ.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Ma me mpaeɛbɔ nnuru wʼanim; brɛ wʼaso ase tie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Ɔhaw ahyɛ me kra ma na me nkwa rebɛn owuo.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Wɔkan me fra wɔn a wɔrekɔ damena mu; mete sɛ obi a ɔnni ahoɔden.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Wɔayi me asi nkyɛn wɔ awufoɔ mu, te sɛ atɔfoɔ a wɔdeda ɛda mu, wɔn a wonkae wɔn bio, na wonhwɛ wɔn bio.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Woato me atwene damena ase tɔnn, wɔ esum kabii mu.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Wʼabofuhyeɛ ayɛ duru wɔ me so; woama wʼasorɔkye nyinaa abu afa me so.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Woafa me nnamfonom a wɔbɛn me afiri me nkyɛn woama me ho ayɛ wɔn ahi. Woaka me ahyɛ mu na mentumi nnwane;

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: awerɛhoɔ ama mʼani so ayɛ kusuu. Ao Awurade mesu frɛ wo da biara; metrɛ me nsam kyerɛ wo.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Woyɛ anwanwadeɛ kyerɛ awufoɔ anaa? Wɔn a wɔawuwu no sɔre kamfo wo anaa?

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Wɔka wʼadɔeɛ ho asɛm wɔ ɛda mu anaa, anaasɛ wo nokorɛ ho asɛm wɔ ɔsɛeɛ kurom?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Wɔhunu wʼanwanwadeɛ wɔ beaeɛ a ɛhɔ aduru sum, anaa wo tenenee nnwuma wɔ awerɛfirie asase so?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, adɛn nti na wopo me na wode wʼanim hinta me?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Mahunu amane firi me mmɔfraase na mabɛn owuo; wʼahunahuna ama mabrɛ na mapa aba.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Wʼabofuhyeɛ abu afa me so; wʼahunahuna asɛe me.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Daa nyinaa wɔtwa me ho hyia sɛ nsuyire, na wɔabu afa me so koraa.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Woafa mʼayɔnkofoɔ ne mʼadɔfoɔ afiri me nkyɛn kɔ; na esum ayɛ mʼadamfo brɛboɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Mɛto Awurade adɔeɛ ho dwom daa daa; mede mʼano bɛda wo nokorɛdie adi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Mɛka sɛ wʼadɔeɛ no tim hɔ daa nyinaa, na watim wo nokorɛdie wɔ ɔsoro hɔ ankasa.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Wokaa sɛ, “Me ne onipa a mayi no no ayɛ apam; maka ntam akyerɛ me ɔsomfoɔ Dawid.

english_verse: David, one of your descendants will always be king.”
translation_verse: ‘Mɛma wʼase atim hɔ daa na wʼahennwa nso atim wɔ awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ nyinaa mu.’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ɔsorosorofoɔ kamfo wʼanwanwadeɛ, na wo nokorɛdie nso, wɔkamfo wɔ ahotefoɔ asafo mu.

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Na hwan na ɔne wo Awurade sɛ wɔ ɔsoro hɔ? Hwan na ɔte sɛ Awurade wɔ ɔsoro abɔdeɛ mu?

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Akronkronfoɔ agyinatufoɔ mu, wosuro Onyankopɔn; wɔde suro ma no sene wɔn a wotwa ne ho hyia nyinaa.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade Onyankopɔn, hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ? Ao Awurade woyɛ kɛseɛ na wo nokorɛdie atwa wo ho ahyia.

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Wodi ɛpo a ɛreworo soɔ so; nʼasorɔkye bobɔ kɔ ɔsoro a, wobrɛ no ase.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Wodwerɛɛ Rahab sɛ atɔfoɔ no mu baako; wode wo basa denden no bɔɔ wʼatamfoɔ pansameeɛ.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Ɔsoro wɔ wo, na asase nso wɔ wo; ewiase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, wo na wohyɛɛ aseɛ.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Wobɔɔ atifi ne anafoɔ. Tabor ne Hermon de ahosɛpɛ to dwom ma wo din.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Wʼahennwa no fapem yɛ tenenee ne atɛntenenee; adɔeɛ ne nokorɛdie di wʼanim.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔasua sɛdeɛ wɔbɔ wo abɔdin, wɔn a wɔnante wʼanim hann no mu, Ao Awurade.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Wɔgye wɔn ani wɔ wo din mu da mu nyinaa; wɔdi ahurisie wɔ wo tenenee mu.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Wone wɔn animuonyam ne ahoɔden, na wʼadom enti yɛyɛ nkonimdifoɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, yɛn banbɔ firi Awurade hɔ, na Israel Kronkronni no ama yɛn Ɔhene.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Ɛda bi wokasaa wɔ anisoadehunu mu, kyerɛɛ wʼahotefoɔ sɛ, “Madom ɔkofoni bi ahoɔden; mapagya aberanteɛ bi afiri nnipa no mu.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Mahunu Dawid, me ɔsomfoɔ; mede me ngo kronkron no asra no.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Me nsa bɛwowa no; ampa ara mʼabasa bɛhyɛ no den.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Ɔtamfoɔ biara renhyɛ no sɛ ɔntua toɔ; omumuyɛfoɔ biara rentumi nhyɛ ne so.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Mɛdwerɛ nʼatamfoɔ wɔ nʼanim na mabobɔ nʼahohiahiafoɔ ahwe fam.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Me nokorɛ adɔeɛ bɛka ne ho, na me din mu, wɔbɛma nʼabɛn so.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Mɛtrɛ nʼahyeɛ mu akɔsi ɛpo so, na ɔde ne nsa nifa bɛto nsubɔntene so.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Ɔbɛfrɛ me aka sɛ, ‘Wone mʼagya, me Onyankopɔn, me nkwagyeɛ botan.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Mɛyɛ no mʼabakan, asase so ahene nyinaa no mu ɔkɛseɛ.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Mɛma mʼadɔeɛ a mewɔ ma no no atena hɔ daa, na apam a me ne no ayɛ nso bɛtena hɔ daa.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Mɛma nʼase atim afebɔɔ, nʼahennwa nso bɛtim hɔ akɔsi sɛ ɔsoro bɛtwam.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ne mmammarima po me mmara na sɛ wɔanni mʼahyɛdeɛ so,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔbu mʼahyɛdeɛ so na sɛ wɔanni me ɔhyɛ nsɛm so a,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: ɛno deɛ, mede abaa bɛtwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho na wɔn amumuyɛ nso mede mmaatwa atwe wɔn aso;

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Nanso, merennyae mʼadɔeɛ a meyɛ ma noɔ no na mɛkɔ so adi no nokorɛ.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Meremmu mʼapam no so na merensesa deɛ mede mʼano aka no.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Menam me din kronkron no so aka ntam prɛko, na merentwa Dawid atorɔ da.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Meremma nʼase ntɔre da na nʼahennwa nso bɛtim wɔ mʼanim te sɛ owia;

english_verse: and moon appear in the sky.”
translation_verse: ɛbɛtim hɔ daa te sɛ ɔsrane, ɔdansefoɔ nokwafoɔ a ɔwɔ ewiem no.”

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Nanso woapo no, woapa nʼakyi wo bo afu deɛ woasra no ngo no.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Woagu apam a wo ne wo ɔsomfoɔ pameeɛ no woagu nʼahenkyɛ ho fi wɔ mfuturo mu.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔtwam wɔ hɔ nyinaa fom no fa; na wayɛ aniwudeɛ ama ne mfɛfoɔ.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Woama nʼatamfoɔ nsa nifa so; ama wɔn nyinaa di ahurisie.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Woama nʼakofena ayɛ ɔkwa, na woannyina nʼakyi wɔ ɔko mu.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wode nʼanimuonyam aba awieeɛ na woato nʼahennwa atwene fam.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Woatwa ne mmeranteberɛ nna so na wode animguaseɛ ngugusoɔ akata ne so.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Wode wo ho bɛhinta afebɔɔ anaa? Wʼabofuhyeɛ bɛkɔ so adɛre akɔsi da bɛn?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Kae sɛdeɛ me nkwa nna twam ntɛm so. Ɛfiri sɛ woabɔ yɛn nyinaa sɛ adeɛ a ɛtwa mu ntɛm so!

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtena ase a ɔrenwu da? Anaasɛ hwan na ɔbɛtumi agye ne ho afiri owuo tumi nsam?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ɛhe na wo tete adɔeɛ kɛseɛ no wɔ, deɛ wofiri wo nokorɛdie mu de kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid no?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Awurade kae sɛdeɛ wɔadi wo ɔsomfoɔ ho fɛ ne sɛdeɛ manya akoma ama amanaman no akutiabɔ.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, akutiabɔ a wʼatamfoɔ de adi fɛw, de adi deɛ woasra no ngo no anammɔntuo biara ho fɛw.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ayɛyie nka Awurade daa! Amen, Amen.

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn onipa Mose mpaeɛbɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Awurade, wo na woayɛ yɛn tenabea awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Ansa na wɔrebɛbɔ mmepɔ anaasɛ worebɛda asase ne ewiase adi no, na woyɛ Onyankopɔn firi mmerɛsanten kɔsi mmerɛsanten.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Woma adasamma sane dane mfuturo, ka sɛ, “Ao adasamma, monsane nkɔ mfuturo mu.”

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Mfirinhyia apem yɛ wʼani so sɛ da koro a abɛsene seesei, anaasɛ anadwo mu dɔnhwereɛ kakraa bi.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Wopra nnipa kɔ, wɔ owuo nna mu; wɔte sɛ ɛserɛ a afefɛ anɔpa,

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: ɛfefɛ yɛ frɔmfrɔm anɔpa deɛ, nanso anwummerɛ ɛwo na ɛtwintwam.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Yɛresa wɔ wʼabofuo ano na wʼanibereɛ abɔ yɛn hu.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Wode yɛn amumuyɛ asi wʼanim, na yɛn kɔkoam bɔne da wʼanim hann no mu.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Yɛn nna nyinaa twam wɔ wʼabufuhyeɛ mu; na yɛde awerɛhoɔdie na ɛwie yɛn mfeɛ.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Yɛn nkwa nna si mfeɛ aduɔson, anaasɛ aduɔwɔtwe, sɛ yɛwɔ ahoɔden a; na emu ahohoahoadeɛ yɛ ɔhaw ne awerɛhoɔ, na ɛtwam ntɛm ntɛm, na yɛtu kɔ.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔnim wʼabofuo mu tumi? Wʼabofuhyeɛ yɛ kɛseɛ sɛdeɛ wo ho suro teɛ.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Ma yɛnhunu yɛn nna kan sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ, na yɛanya nyansa akoma.

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: Sane bra, Ao Awurade, ɛbɛkɔ so akɔsi da bɛn? Hunu wʼasomfoɔ mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Ma wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no mmee yɛn adekyeɛ mu, na yɛde anigyeɛ ato dwom adi ahurisie yɛn nna nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Ma yɛn ani nnye nna bebree sɛ nna dodoɔ a wode yɛn kɔɔ amanehunu mu no, sɛ mfirinhyia dodoɔ a yɛhunuu ateeteeɛ no.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Ma wʼasomfoɔ nhunu wo nneyɛɛ na wɔn mma nhunu wʼanimuonyam.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Ma Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn adom no ntena yɛn so; na yɛn nsa ano adwuma nyɛ yie mma yɛn aane, yɛn nsa ano adwuma nyɛ yie.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔte Ɔsorosoroni no hintabea bɛhome wɔ Otumfoɔ no nwunu mu.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: Mɛse Awurade sɛ, “Woyɛ me dwanekɔbea ne mʼabankɛseɛ, me Onyankopɔn a mewɔ wo mu ahotosoɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, ɔbɛgye wo afiri fidisumfoɔ afidie mu ne owuyadeɛ mu.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Ɔde ne ntakra bɛkata wo so; na ne ntaban ase na wobɛnya dwanekɔbea; ne nokorɛ bɛyɛ wo banbɔ ne wo kyɛm.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Worensuro anadwo mu ahunahuna, anaa bɛmma a ɛtu awia,

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: anaa owuyadeɛ a ɛba esum mu, anaa ɔyaredɔm a ɛsɛe owigyinaeɛ.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Apem bɛtotɔ wo nkyɛn mu, na ɔpedu bɛtotɔ wo nifa, nanso, wo deɛ, ɛrenka wo.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Wʼani nko ara na wode bɛhwɛ na woahunu nnebɔneyɛfoɔ asotwe.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Sɛ wode Ɔsorosoroni no yɛ wo tenabea, mpo Awurade a ɔyɛ me dwanekɔbea no a,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: ɔhaw biara remma wo so, na amanehunu biara remmɛn wo ntomadan.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛhyɛ nʼabɔfoɔ a wɔhwɛ wo so no abɛbɔ wo ho ban wʼakwan nyinaa mu;

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: wɔde wɔn nsa bɛpagya wo, na wo nan rensunti ɔboɔ.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Wobɛtiatia agyata ne aprammire so, wobɛnante gyataburuwa ne ɔtweaseɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Awurade ka sɛ, “Esiane sɛ ɔdɔ me enti, mɛgye no; mɛbɔ ne ho ban, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim me din.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛfrɛ me, na mɛgye ne so; mɛka ne ho wɔ amanehunu mu, mɛgye no, na mahyɛ no animuonyam.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Mɛma nkwa nna a ɛware amee no na makyerɛ no me nkwagyeɛ.”

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔkamfo wo Awurade na wɔto dwom de hyɛ wo animuonyam, Ao Ɔsorosoroni,

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: na wɔpae mu ka wʼadɔeɛ anɔpa ne wo nokorɛ anadwo,

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: wɔ ahoma edu sankuo so ne sankuten nnwom mu.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wo nneyɛɛ ma mʼani gye; mede anigyeɛ bɛto dwom, wo nsa ano nnwuma enti.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wo nnwuma yɛ akɛseɛ, na wo nyansa mu dɔ!

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Ogyimifoɔ nnim na nkwaseafoɔ nte aseɛ,

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: amumuyɛfoɔ bɛnyini sɛ ɛserɛ na abɔnefoɔ bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm deɛ, nanso wɔbɛsɛe wɔn pasaa.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Na wo Awurade, woyɛ kɛseɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade ampa ara, wʼatamfoɔ bɛyera; na wobɛhwete abɔnefoɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Woama me ahoɔden te sɛ ɛkoɔ; woahwie ngohwam papa agu me so.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Mahunu mʼatamfoɔ nkoguo a wɔadi, mate sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ atirimuɔdenfoɔ adwane afiri akono.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ateneneefoɔ bɛyɛ frɔmm te sɛ abedua, wɔbɛnyini sɛ Lebanon ntweneduro;

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: deɛ wɔadua wɔ Awurade fie, wɔbɛnyini frɔmfrɔm wɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn adihɔ hɔ.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛkɔ so aso aba, onyinkyerɛ mu mpo, wɔbɛyɛ frɔmm sɛ ahahammono,

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: de akyerɛ sɛ, “Awurade yɛ ɔteneneeni; ɔyɛ me botan, na atirimuɔdensɛm biara nni ne mu.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Awurade di ɔhene, wɔde tumi ahentadeɛ ahyɛ no; wɔde tumi ahentadeɛ ahyɛ Awurade na wɔde ahoɔden ayɛ nʼakodeɛ. Wɔde ewiase atim hɔ pintinn; na wɔrentumi ntutu.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Wʼahennwa tim hɔ firi tete; na wowɔ hɔ firi mmerɛsanten.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Woyɛ deɛ ɔwɔ tumi sene nsuo akɛseɛ aprannaa, deɛ ɔwɔ tumi sene ɛpo nworosoɔ. Awurade a ɔte ɔsoro no yɛ kɛseɛ.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wo nhyehyɛeɛ gyina hɔ pintinn; kronkronyɛ hyɛ wo fie animuonyam daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: Awurade, Onyankopɔn a wotɔ werɛ, Onyankopɔn a wotɔ werɛ, hyerɛn.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Sɔre, Ao wo a woyɛ asase so ɔtemmufoɔ, tua ahantanfoɔ ka sɛdeɛ ɛfata wɔn.

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn, amumuyɛfoɔ nnye wɔn ani nkɔsi da bɛn?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Wɔkasa ahantan so; ahohoahoa ahyɛ abɔnefoɔ nyinaa ma.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wɔdwerɛ wo nkurɔfoɔ; wɔhyɛ wʼagyapadeɛ so.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Wɔkunkumm akunafoɔ ne amanfrafoɔ; na wɔdi nwisiaa awu.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Wɔka sɛ, “Awurade nhunu, Yakob Onyankopɔn ayi nʼani.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: Monhwɛ yie, mo agyimifoɔ a mowɔ nnipa no mu; nkwaseafoɔ, da bɛn na mobɛhunu nyansa?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbɔɔ aso no, ɔrente asɛm anaa? Deɛ ɔyɛɛ ani no, ɔrenhunu adeɛ anaa?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔtenetene aman so no rentwe aso anaa? Deɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ onipa no nnim nyansa anaa?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Awurade nim onipa nsusuiɛ; ɔnim sɛ ɛnkɔsi hwee.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, nhyira ne onipa a wotenetene ne so, onipa a wokyerɛ no wo mmara no;

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Woma wɔn ɔhome firi amanehunu nna mu, kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛtu amena ama amumuyɛfoɔ.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Awurade rempo ne nkurɔfoɔ; na ɔrennya nʼagyapadeɛ hɔ da.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Atemmuo bɛgyina teneneeyɛ so bio, na wɔn a wɔn akoma mu teɛ nyinaa bɛdi so.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛsɔre atia amumuyɛfoɔ ama me? Hwan na ɔbɛsɔre atia abɔnefoɔ ama me?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Sɛ Awurade ammoa me a, anka mekɔɔ owuo kommyɛ mu ntɛm so.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a mekaa sɛ, “Menan rewatiri” no, Ao Awurade, wo dɔ no sɔɔ me mu.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a me dadwene dɔɔso no, wʼawerɛkyekye maa me kra abotɔyam.

english_verse: who gang up to murder innocent victims.
translation_verse: Awudifoɔ bɔ mu tia ateneneefoɔ na wɔn a wɔdi bem no, wɔbu wɔn kumfɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Nanso Awurade yɛ mʼaban; na me Onyankopɔn ayɛ ɔbotan a ne mu na menya ahintaeɛ.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛtua wɔn nnebɔne no so ka na wɔn amumuyɛ enti, wasɛe wɔn; Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn bɛsɛe wɔn.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Mommra mma yɛnto dwom wɔ anigyeɛ so mma Awurade; momma yɛmmɔ ose mma yɛn nkwagyeɛ Botan no.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Momma yɛmfa aseda mmra nʼanim, na yɛmfa ahosɛpɛ nnwom mma no so.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ, ɔhenkɛseɛ wɔ anyame nyinaa so.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Ne nsam na asase mu nneɛma nyinaa wɔ, na mmepɔ mpampam wɔ no.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Ɛpo wɔ no. Ɔno na ɔbɔeɛ, na ne nsa na ɛnwonoo asase kesee no.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: Mommra mma yɛnkoto nsom no. Momma yɛmmu nkotodwe wɔ Awurade yɛn Yɛfoɔ no anim!

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn; yɛyɛ nʼadidibea nnipa, ne nnwankuo a ɔhwɛ wɔn so. Ɛnnɛ, sɛ mote ne nne a,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: mommpirim mo akoma sɛdeɛ moyɛɛ wɔ Meriba no, sɛdeɛ moyɛɛ da no wɔ Masa, ɛserɛ no so no,

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ no, mo mpanimfoɔ sɔɔ me hwɛeɛ, a na wɔnim deɛ meyɛ maa wɔn.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Me bo fuu saa nnipa no mfeɛ aduanan na mekaa sɛ, “Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn akoma amane afiri me ho, na wɔanhunu mʼakwan.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Ɛno enti mekaa ntam wɔ mʼabufuo mu sɛ, “Wɔrenhyɛne mʼahomegyeɛ mu da.”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade; asase nyinaa monto dwom mma Awurade.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Monto dwom mma Awurade, na monkamfo ne din; mompae mu nka ne nkwagyeɛ no daa daa.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Monka nʼanimuonyam wɔ amanaman mu, monka nʼanwanwadeɛ a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ kɛseɛ na ɔfata ayɛyie; ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsuro no sene anyame nyinaa.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Anyame a wɔwɔ aman foforɔ so yɛ ahoni bi kwa, nanso Awurade na ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Animuonyam ne kɛseyɛ wɔ nʼanim; ahoɔden ne animuonyam wɔ ne kronkronbea hɔ.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Momfa mma Awurade, Ao amanaman mmusuakuo, momfa animuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Momfa animuonyam ne din a ɛfata mma Awurade; momfa afɔrebɔdeɛ nhyɛne nʼadihɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Monsɔre Awurade wɔ ne kronkronyɛ fɛfɛ mu; asase nyinaa momma mo ho mpopo wɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Monka nkyerɛ aman nyinaa sɛ, “Awurade di ɔhene.” Wɔabɔ asase atim hɔ pintinn na ɛnhinhim; ɔde pɛpɛyɛ bɛbu nnipa atɛn.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Momma ɔsorosoro ani nnye, na asase nni ahurisie; momma ɛpo ne emu nneɛma nyinaa nworo;

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: momma mfuo ne so nneɛma nyinaa mmɔ ose. Nnua a ɛwɔ kwaeɛm de ahosɛpɛ bɛto dwom;

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: wɔbɛto dwom wɔ Awurade anim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔreba, ɔreba abɛbu asase no atɛn. Ɔde tenenee bɛbu ewiase atɛn na woabu nnipa nso atɛn wɔ ne nokorɛ mu.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Awurade di ɔhene, ma asase ani nnye; ma nsupɔ ahodoɔ nsɛpɛ wɔn ho.

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Omununkum ne esum kabii atwa ne ho ahyia; tenenee ne atɛntenenee yɛ nʼahennwa no fapem.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Ogya di nʼanim na ɛhye nʼatamfoɔ wɔ afanan nyinaa.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Nʼanyinam hran ewiase; asase ahunu, na ne ho popo.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Mmepɔ nane sɛ nku wɔ Awurade anim, Awurade a asase nyinaa wɔ no no anim.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne tenenee kyerɛ na aman nyinaa hunu nʼanimuonyam.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ahonisomfoɔ nyinaa anim agu ase, wɔn a wɔde abosomhuhuo hoahoa wɔn ho no, anyame nyinaa monsɔre no.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Sion te, na ne ho sɛpɛ no na Yuda nkuraase ani gye Ao Awurade, ɛsiane wʼatɛntenenee enti.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Wo, Ao Awurade ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase so nyinaa; wɔama wo so pa ara wɔ anyame nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ Awurade no nkyiri bɔne, ɔbɔ ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔyɛ nokwafoɔ no ho ban na ɔgye wɔn firi amumuyɛfoɔ nsam.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Hann to gu teneneefoɔ so na anigyeɛ ba wɔn a wɔn akoma mu teɛ so.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Momma mo ani nnye Awurade mu, mo teneneefoɔ nyinaa, na monkamfo ne din kronkron no.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ wayɛ anwanwadeɛ bebree; ne nsa nifa ne ne basa kronkron no anya nkwagyeɛ ama no.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Awurade ama wɔahunu ne nkwagyeɛ na wada ne tenenee adi akyerɛ amanaman no.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wakae nʼadɔeɛ ne ne nokorɛ a ɔdi akyerɛ Israelfoɔ; asase ano nyinaa ahunu yɛn Onyankopɔn nkwagyeɛ.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asase nyinaa mommɔ ose mma Awurade, momfa nnwontoɔ nni ahurisie;

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Momfa sankuo nto dwom mma Awurade, sankuo ne nnwontoɔ nnyegyeɛ,

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: momfa totorobɛnto ne nnwennini mmɛn, nteam ahosɛpɛ so wɔ Awurade, yɛn ɔhene no anim.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Ɛpo ne abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ mu nyinaa monworo so; asase ne wɔn a wɔte soɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Momma nsubɔntene mmɔ wɔn nsam, mmepɔ nka mmom nto ahurisie dwom;

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: ma wɔnto dwom wɔ Awurade anim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔreba abɛbu ewiase atɛn. Ɔde tenenee bɛbu ewiase atɛn na ɔde pɛpɛyɛ abu nnipa atɛn.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Awurade di ɔhene, momma amanaman no ho mpopo; ɔte nʼahennwa so wɔ Kerubim ntam, ma asase nwoso.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Awurade a ɔwɔ Sion yɛ kɛseɛ; wɔama ne so wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnkamfo wo din a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwanwa no. Ɔyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔhene no yɛ kɛseɛ, ɔdɔ atɛntenenee, woama pɛpɛyɛ atim; wayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ na ɛtene wɔ Yakob mu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Momma Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn so na monsɔre no wɔ ne nan ntiasoɔ anim; ɔyɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aaron ka nʼasɔfoɔ no ho, na Samuel ka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ ne din no ho; wɔfrɛɛ Awurade, na ɔgyee wɔn so.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Ɔfiri omununkum dum mu kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn; wɔdii mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ a ɔmaa wɔn no so.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn, wogyee wɔn so; woyɛɛ bɔnefakyɛ Onyankopɔn maa Israel, nanso wɔtwee wɔn aso wɔ wɔn nnebɔne ho.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Momma Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn so na monsɔre no wɔ ne bepɔ kronkron no so, na Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn yɛ kronkron.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Mommɔ ose mma Awurade, asase nyinaa

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Momfa ahosɛpɛ nsom Awurade; momfa anigyeɛ nnwom mmra nʼanim.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Monhunu sɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn; ɔno na ɔyɛɛ yɛn, na yɛyɛ ne dea; yɛyɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ ne nʼadidibea nnwan.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Momfa aseda nhyɛne nʼapono mu na momfa nkamfo nkɔ nʼadihɔ; momfa aseda mma no, na monkamfo ne din.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ; na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa; ne nokorɛdie kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Mɛto wo dɔ ne wo tenenee ho dwom; Ao Awurade, mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama wo.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Mɛhwɛ yie abu ɔbra a ɛho teɛ. Dabɛn na wobɛba me nkyɛn? Mede akoma a afɔdie nni mu bɛnante me fie.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Meremfa mʼani nsi adeɛ a ɛyɛ tane biara so. Mekyiri nnipa a wɔnni gyidie; Me ne wɔn nni hwee yɛ.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Nnipa a wɔn akoma yɛ kontonkyi remmɛn me; me ne bɔne nni hwee yɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔdi ne yɔnko ho nsekuro wɔ kɔkoam no, ɔno na mɛsɛe; deɛ ɔwɔ ahantan ani ne ahomasoɔ akoma, ɔno na merennyegye ne so.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Mʼani bɛkɔ anokwafoɔ a wɔwɔ asase no soɔ no so na me ne wɔn atena; deɛ ne nanteɛ ho nni asɛm no, ɔno na ɔbɛsom me.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔyɛ ɔdaadaafoɔ biara rentena me fie; deɛ ɔtwa nkontompo no rennyina mʼanim.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Adekyeeɛ biara, mɛsɛe amumuyɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ asase yi so nyinaa; na mapam ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ biara afiri Awurade kuropɔn mu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade tie me mpaeɛbɔ; na ma me mmoa ho sufrɛ nnuru wʼanim.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Mfa wʼanim nhinta me ɛberɛ a mewɔ ahohiahia mu. Brɛ wʼaso ase ma me; na sɛ mesu mefrɛ wo a, gye me so ntɛm.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Me nkwa nna reyera te sɛ wisie; me nnompe hyehye te sɛ egya.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Mʼakoma aboto na akusa sɛ ɛserɛ; na me kɔn nnɔ aduane.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Mʼapinisie denden enti maka honam ne nnompe.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Mete sɛ ɛserɛ so patuo, te sɛ ɔpatuo a ɔte mmubuiɛ mu.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Ɛda mu nyinaa mʼatamfoɔ bɔ me akutia. Wɔn a wɔdi me ho fɛ no bɔ me din de dome.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Mede nsõ ayɛ mʼaduane na mede nisuo fra me nsuo mu

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: ɛsiane wʼabufuhyeɛ denden no enti, woama me so, ayi me asi nkyɛn.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Me nkwa nna te sɛ anwummerɛ sunsum; na mekusa sɛ ɛserɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Nanso, wo Awurade, woyɛ ɔhene daa daa; na wo din a ahyeta no te hɔ daa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Wobɛsɔre na woahunu Sion mmɔbɔ; berɛ aduru sɛ wohunu no mmɔbɔ; ɛberɛ a wohyɛeɛ no aso.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Nʼaboɔ som bo ma wʼasomfoɔ; ne mfuturo hyɛ wɔn awerɛhoɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Amanaman no bɛsuro Awurade din; asase so ahemfo nyinaa bɛdi wʼanimuonyam ni.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Awurade bɛkyekyere Sion bio, na wapue wɔ nʼanimuonyam mu.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛtie mmɔborɔfoɔ mpaeɛbɔ; na ɔremmu nʼani ngu wɔn sufrɛ so.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Montwerɛ yei mma nkyirimma, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wɔnnya nwoo wɔn bɛkamfo Awurade;

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: “Awurade hwɛɛ fam firi ne kronkronbea wɔ soro hɔ; ɔfiri soro hwɛɛ asase,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: sɛdeɛ ɔbɛte nneduafoɔ apinisie na wagyaa wɔn a wɔabu wɔn kumfɔ no.”

english_verse: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord,
translation_verse: Enti, wɔbɛpae mu abɔ Awurade din wɔ Sion na wɔakamfo no wɔ Yerusalem,

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a amanaman ne ahennie ahodoɔ bɛhyiam na wɔasom Awurade.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa me yɛɛ mmerɛ wɔ ɛberɛ a merenyini. Ɔtwaa me nkwa nna so.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Enti mekaa sɛ, “Ao me Onyankopɔn, mfa me nkɔ, wɔ me nkwa nna mfimfini; wo mfeɛ wɔ hɔ daa kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ahyɛaseɛ no, wotoo asase fapem, na ɔsoro yɛ wo nsa ano adwuma.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa bɛtwam, na wo deɛ, wobɛtena hɔ daa; wɔbɛtete te sɛ atadeɛ. Wobɛsesa wɔn te sɛ ntoma na wɔbɛto wɔn agu.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Nanso, wote sɛdeɛ woteɛ, na wo mfeɛ to rentwa da.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Wʼasomfoɔ mma bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim; na wɔn asefoɔ ase bɛtim wɔ wʼanim.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Ao me kra, kamfo Awurade; na me mu adeɛ nyinaa nkamfo ne din kronkron no.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Ao me kra, kamfo Awurade, na mma wo werɛ mfiri ne nneyɛeɛ pa nyinaa,

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔde wo mfomsoɔ nyinaa kyɛ woɔ na ɔsa wo nyarewa nyinaa,

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: ɔgye wo nkwa firi damena mu na ɔde adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu bɔ wo abotire,

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: ɔde nnepa ma wo sɛ wʼapɛdeɛ na wo mmeranteberɛ yɛ foforɔ sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ adetenenee na ɔbu wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so nyinaa atɛntenenee.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Ɔkyerɛɛ Mose nʼakwan, na ɔmaa Israelfoɔ hunuu ne nneyɛɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ ne Awurade, ne bo kyɛre fu na nʼadɔeɛ dɔɔso.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Ɔrenkɔ so mmɔ soboɔ, na ɔrennya yɛn ho menasepɔ nkɔsi daa;

english_verse: he doesn't punish us as our sins deserve.
translation_verse: Ɔrenhwɛ yɛn bɔne ne yɛn nni sɛdeɛ ɛfata na ɔrentua yɛn nnebɔne so ka sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Na sɛdeɛ ɔsoro ne asase ntam ware no, saa ara na nʼadɔeɛ so wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no so.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ ntam ware no, saa ara na wama yɛn ne yɛn mmarato ntam kwan aware.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ agya yam hyehye no ne mma ho no, saa ara na Awurade yam hyehye no ma wɔn a wɔsuro no,

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: na ɔnim sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ yɛn, ɔkae sɛ yɛyɛ mfuturo.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Ɔdasani deɛ, ne nna te sɛ ɛserɛ, ɔyɛ frɔmm sɛ wiram nhwiren;

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: sɛ mframa bɔ fa ne so a, na ɔnni hɔ, na ne sibea nnim no bio.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Nanso ɛfiri mmerɛsanten kɔsi nnasanten Awurade adɔeɛ wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no so, na ne tenenee wɔ wɔn mma mma so,

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Awurade asi nʼahennwa wɔ soro, na nʼahennie di adeɛ nyinaa so.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼabɔfoɔ, mo atumfoɔ a moyɛ nʼahyɛdeɛ, mo a motie nʼasɛm.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, nʼasomfoɔ a moyɛ nʼapɛdeɛ.

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, ne nnwuma nyinaa deɛ ɛwɔ nʼaheman mu nyinaa. Ao me ɔkra, kamfo Awurade!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Ao me ɔkra, kamfo Awurade! Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn, woyɛ ɔkɛseɛ! Wɔafira tumi ne animuonyam.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Ɔde hann akata ne ho sɛ atadeɛ; ɔtrɛ ɔsoro mu te sɛ ntomadan,

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: na ɔde ne mpia mpunan sisi nsuo so. Ɔde omununkum yɛ ne teaseɛnam na ɔde nante mframa ntaban so.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Ɔsoma nʼabɔfoɔ sɛ mframa, na ɔsoma nʼasomfoɔ sɛ ogyadɛreɛ.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Ɔde asase asi ne fapem so na ɛrenhinhim da.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Wode ebunu kataa so sɛ atadeɛ na nsuo gyinaa mmepɔ no so.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Nanso wʼanimka maa nsuo no dwaneeɛ, wʼaprannaa nnyegyeeɛ ma wɔdwaneeɛ;

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Wɔtenetenee faa mmepɔ so, kɔɔ mmɔnhwa mu tɔnn, kɔguu baabi a wode ama wɔn no.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Wotoo ɔhyeɛ a wɔrentumi ntra; na wɔammɛkata asase so bio.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Ɔma nsuwa tene fa abɔn mu; ɛtene fa mmepɔ ntam.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Ɔma wiram mmoa nyinaa nsuo nom; ɔma afunumu nsuo de kum wɔn sukɔm.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Ewiem nnomaa nwene wɔn pirebuo wɔ nsuo no ho; na wɔto nnwom wɔ nnua no mman so.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔfiri ne soro mpia mu tɔ nsuo gugu mmepɔ so; Awurade nnwuma so aba mee asase.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Ɔma ɛserɛ fifiri ma anantwie, na ɔbɔɔ nnua maa onipa sɛ ɔnnua na ɛmma aduane mfiri asase mu:

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: na onipa anya nsã ama nʼakoma atɔ ne yam, na onipa anya ngo ama nʼanim atɔ so, na aduane nso akura onipa akoma.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Wɔgugu Awurade nnua no so yie, Lebanon ntweneduro a ɔduaeɛ no.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Ɛso na nnomaa yɛ wɔn mpirebuo na asukɔnkɔn nso yɛ nʼatenaeɛ wɔ pepeaa nnua no mu.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Mmepɔ atentene no yɛ wiram mpɔnkye dea; na abotan yɛ dwanekɔbea ma amoakua.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Ɔsrane kyerɛ ɛberɛ nkyekyɛmu, na owia nim ɛberɛ a ɔkɔtɔ.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Wode esum ba ma ɛyɛ adesaeɛ na kwaeɛ mu mmoa nyinaa kɔ ahayɔ.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Gyata bobom pɛ wɔn ahaboa wɔhwehwɛ wɔn aduane firi Onyankopɔn hɔ.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Owia pue ma wɔsane wɔn akyi; wɔsane kɔdeda wɔn atuo mu.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Afei, onipa kɔ nʼadwuma so kɔyɛ adwuma ara kɔsi anwummerɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wo nnwuma dɔɔso! Nyansa mu na woyɛɛ ne nyinaa; wʼabɔdeɛ ahyɛ asase so ma.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Ɛpo na ɛda hɔ tɛtrɛɛ hahanaa yi, a abɔdeɛ bebree a ɛnni ano, akɛseɛ ne nketewa ahyɛ no ma.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Ɛso na ahyɛn di akɔneaba, na dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn a woyɛɛ no di agorɔ.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Wɔn nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan sɛ wobɛma wɔn wɔn aduane wɔ ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Wodema wɔn a, wɔtase; wobue wo nsam a, nnepa mee wɔn.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Wode wʼanim hinta wɔn a, wɔbɔ hu; sɛ wogye wɔn ahomeɛ a, wɔwuwu na wɔsane kɔ mfuturo mu.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Sɛ wode wo Honhom no ma wɔn a na wɔabɔ wɔn, na woyɛ asase ani foforɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Ma Awurade animuonyam ntena hɔ daa; ma Awurade ani nnye ne nnwuma ho,

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: deɛ ɔhwɛ asase na ɛwosoɔ, na ɔde ne nsa ka mmepɔ a wisie firi mu ba.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mɛto dwom ama Awurade me nkwa nna nyinaa; sɛ mete ase yi, mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama me Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Ɔmma mʼakoma mu mpaeɛbɔ nsɔ nʼani ɛberɛ a meregye mʼani wɔ Awurade mu yi.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Ma nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nyera wɔ asase so; na amumuyɛfoɔ ase nhye. Ao me ɔkra, kamfo Awurade. Kamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɛda Awurade ase na da ne kɛseyɛ adi. Ma ewiase nyinaa nhunu deɛ wayɛ.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Monto dwom mma no, monto ayɛyie dwom mma no; monka nʼanwanwadeɛ no nyinaa.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Monhoahoa mo ho wɔ ne din kronkron mu; momma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no nnya akoma mu anigyeɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Momma mo ani nna Awurade ne nʼahoɔden so; na monhwehwɛ nʼanim ɛberɛ biara.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Monkae anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, ne atemmuo a ɔbuiɛ,

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ao Abraham mma, Onyankopɔn ɔsomfoɔ, Ao Yakob mma a wapa wɔn.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn. Nʼahennie da adi wɔ asase so nyinaa.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ɔkae nʼapam daa nyinaa, asɛm a ɔhyɛ maa awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ apem no,

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: Ɔkaa sɛ, “Mede Kanaan asase no bɛma wo sɛ kyɛfa a ɛbɛyɛ wʼagyapadeɛ.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Ɔkaa yei ɛberɛ a na wɔnnɔɔso, ahɔhokuo ketewa bi a wɔwɔ Kanaan.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Wɔfirii aman so kɔɔ aman so; firii ahemman mu kɔɔ ahemman mu.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Wamma obi anhyɛ wɔn so; wɔn enti, ɔkaa ahene anim sɛ:

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: “Mommfa mo nsa nka wɔn a masra wɔn ngo; na monnyɛ mʼadiyifoɔ bɔne bi.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ɛkɔm baa asase no so na ɔsɛee akwan a wɔfa so nya wɔn aduane nyinaa;

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: na ɔsomaa ɔbarima bi dii wɔn anim, Yosef a wɔtɔn no sɛ akoa no.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Wɔde mpokyerɛ guu ne nan, na wɔde dadeɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn hyɛɛ ne kɔn,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: kɔsii sɛ deɛ ɔhyɛɛ ho nkɔm no baa mu, kɔsii sɛ Awurade asɛm no daa no adi sɛ ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Afei, ɔhene no soma ma wɔkɔgyaa no; aman no sodifoɔ gyaa no.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛɛ no ne fiefoɔ so wura, deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa sodifoɔ,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ne mmapɔmma deɛ ɔpɛ na ɔnkyerɛ ne mpanimfoɔ nyansa.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Afei, Israel kɔɔ Misraim; Yakob kɔtenaa Ham asase so sɛ ɔnanani.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Awurade maa ne nkurɔfoɔ ase dɔreeɛ; ɔyɛɛ wɔn bebree dodo maa wɔn atamfoɔ,

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: wɔn a ɔdanee wɔn akoma sɛ wɔntane ne nkurɔfoɔ na wɔmpam nʼasomfoɔ tiri so.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Ɔsomaa ne ɔsomfoɔ Mose, ne Aaron a na wayi noɔ no.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nwanwasoɔ wɔ wɔn mu, nʼanwanwadeɛ wɔ Ham asase so.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔsomaa esum, na ɔmaa asase duruu sum ɛfiri sɛ na wɔate nʼasɛm no so atua.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa wɔn nsuo nyinaa danee mogya, nam so kumm emu mpataa.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Mpɔtorɔ bɛhyɛɛ asase no so ma, na wɔhyɛnee ɔman no sodifoɔ mpia mu.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Ɔkasaeɛ, na nwansena bebree ne ntontom baa ɔman no mu baabiara.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa wɔn osutɔ danee ampariboɔ a anyinam nenam mu wɔ ɔman no nyinaa mu;

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛee wɔn bobe ne borɔdɔma nnua na ɔbubuu ɔman no so nnua pasaa.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Ɔkasaeɛ, na ntutummɛ baeɛ mmɛbɛ a wɔntumi nkan wɔn;

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: wɔwee nhahammono biara a ɛwɔ wɔn asase no so, na wɔdii wɔn mfuo so nnuane.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Afei ɔkunkumm wɔn asase so mmakan nyinaa, wɔn mmarimayɛ mu aba a ɛdi ɛkan nyinaa.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Ɔyii Israelfoɔ, a wɔso dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ, firii wɔn mmusuakuo mu a obiara ho antɔ kyima.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Misraim ani gyeeɛ ɛberɛ a wɔkɔeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na Israelfoɔ ho hu atɔ wɔn so.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛɛ omununkum mu kataa wɔn so, na ɔde ogya maa wɔn, sɛ ɛnyɛ hann anadwo.
