english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Wɔbisaeɛ, na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn mmoko. Ɔmaa ɔsoro aduane mee wɔn.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Ɔbuee ɔbotan mu maa nsuo firii mu baeɛ; na ɛtenee wɔ ɛserɛ no so sɛ asubɔnten.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Ɔkaee ne bɔhyɛ kronkron bi a ɔhyɛɛ ne ɔsomfoɔ Abraham no.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Ɔyii ne nkurɔfoɔ maa wɔn ani gyeeɛ. Wɔn a wapa wɔn no dii ahurisie;

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: ɔde amanaman no nsase maa wɔn, na deɛ ebinom abrɛ anya no bɛyɛɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: na wɔahwɛ nʼahyɛdeɛ adi ne mmara so. Monyi Awurade ayɛ.

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade! Monna Awurade ase na ɔyɛ; na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka nneɛma akɛseɛ a Awurade ayɛ? Anaasɛ ɔbɛtumi aka ne nkamfo awie?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔkɔ so bu atɛntenenee, na daa wɔyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, sɛ wohunu wo nkurɔfoɔ mmɔbɔ a kae me. Sɛ wogye wɔn nkwa a, boa me,

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: na manya wɔn a wapa wɔn no yiedie mu kyɛfa, na manya wo manfoɔ anigyeɛ no mu kyɛfa na me ne wʼagyapadeɛ no abɔ mu de nkamfo ama wo.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Yɛayɛ bɔne sɛdeɛ yɛn nananom yɛeɛ no; yɛayɛ mfomsoɔ na yɛadi atirimuɔdensɛm.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a yɛn nananom wɔ Misraim no, wɔannwene wo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ho; wɔankae wʼadɔeɛ bebrebe no, na wɔtee atua wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no ho.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Nanso, ne din enti ɔgyee wɔn nkwa, sɛdeɛ ɔbɛda ne tumi kɛseɛ no adi.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Ɔteaa Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no ma ɛwee; ɔde wɔn faa abunu mu te sɛ ɛserɛ so.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Nsuo kataa wɔn atamfoɔ so; na ɔbaako mpo annya nkwa.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Afei wɔgyee ne bɔhyɛ no diiɛ na wɔtoo nʼayɛyie dwom.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Nanso, ntɛm so, wɔn werɛ firii deɛ wayɛ na wɔantwɛn nʼagyinatuo.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Akɔnnɔ bɛhyɛɛ wɔn mu wɔ ɛserɛ so hɔ, na wɔ asase paradada no so, wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛeɛ,

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: enti ɔmaa wɔn deɛ wɔbisaeɛ, nanso, ɔde ɔfɔn yadeɛ baa wɔn so.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Na nsraban mu hɔ wɔn ani beree Mose ne Aaron a Awurade ate ne ho no.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Asase mu buee na ɛmenee Datan na ɛsiee Abiram asafo no.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Egya tɔɔ wɔn akyidifoɔ no mu; ogyaframa hyee amumuyɛfoɔ no.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ nantwie ba wɔ Horeb na wɔkotoo ohoni a wɔde fagudeɛ ayɛ.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Wɔsesaa wɔn Animuonyam. Wɔde nantwinini, a ɔwe ɛserɛ nsɛsodeɛ.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Wɔn werɛ firii Onyankopɔn a ɔgyee wɔn nkwa, deɛ ɔyɛɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ wɔ Misraim no,

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɔyɛɛ wɔ Ham asase so ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ ho no.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Enti ɔkaa sɛ ɔbɛsɛe wɔn, nanso Mose a ɔyɛ deɛ wapa noɔ no sɔre gyinaa Onyankopɔn ne nnipa no ntam; ɔsrɛɛ no, dwodwoo nʼabufuo no ano sɛdeɛ ɔrensɛe wɔn.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Afei, wɔn ani ansɔ asase fɛfɛ no; na wɔannye ne bɔhyɛ anni.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Wɔnwiinwii wɔ wɔn ntomadan mu na wɔannyɛ ɔsetie amma Awurade.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Enti ɔmaa ne nsa so kaa ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ ɔbɛma wɔn atotɔ wɔ ɛserɛ no so,

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: ɔbɛma wɔn asefoɔ atotɔ wɔ amanaman mu na wabɔ wɔn ahwete nsase nyinaa so.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Wɔde wɔn ho bɔɔ Baal-peor ho na wɔdii afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔde ama anyame a wɔnni nkwa;

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: wɔde wɔn atirimuɔdensɛm hyɛɛ Awurade abufuo na ɔyaredɔm sii wɔn mu.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Na Pinehas sɔre dii agyinamu, na Awurade sii ɔyaredɔm no ano.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Meriba nsuo ho nso, wɔhyɛɛ Awurade abufuo, na wɔn enti, ɔhaw baa Mose so,

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ wɔtee Onyankopɔn Honhom anim atua, na asɛm a wannwene ho firii Mose anomu.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Wɔansɛe nnipa no sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn no,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: nanso wɔde wɔn ho frafraa amanaman no yɛɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no bi.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Wɔsomm wɔn ahoni na ɛbɛyɛɛ afidie maa wɔn.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Wɔde wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmammaa bɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa abosom.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Wɔkaa mogya a ɛdi bem guiɛ; wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmammaa mogya a wɔde bɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa Kanaan ahoni no maa asase no ho guu fi.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Wɔde deɛ wɔyɛeɛ no guu wɔn ankasa ho fi; wɔnam deɛ wɔyɛeɛ no so bɔɔ adwaman.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Enti, Awurade bo fuu ne nkurɔfoɔ; na ɔkyirii nʼagyapadeɛ.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Ɔdanee wɔn maa amanaman no, na wɔn atamfoɔ dii wɔn so.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Wɔn atamfoɔ hyɛɛ wɔn so na wɔkaa wɔn hyɛɛ wɔn tumi ase.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Mpɛn bebree, Awurade gyee wɔn, nanso wɔkɔɔ so tee atua na wɔsɛe wɔ wɔn bɔne mu.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Nanso ɔhunuu wɔn ahohiahia ɛberɛ a wɔsu frɛɛ noɔ no;

english_verse: You kept your agreement and were so merciful
translation_verse: Wɔn enti, ɔkaee nʼapam no na ɔfirii nʼadɔeɛ kɛseɛ no mu hunuu wɔn mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa sodifoɔ a wɔafa wɔn nnommum no nyaa ahummɔborɔ maa wɔn.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Gye yɛn, Ao Awurade yɛn nkwagyeɛ Onyankopɔn, na boaboa yɛn ano firi amanaman so, na yɛada wo din kronkron no ase, na yɛde nkamfo ahyɛ wo animuonyam.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ayɛyie nka Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn, ɛmfiri mmerɛsanten nkɔsi nnasanten. Momma nnipa no nyinaa nka sɛ, “Amen!” Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna Awurade ase na ɔyɛ; na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Momma wɔn a Awurade agye wɔn nka saa, wɔn a wagye wɔn afiri ɔtamfoɔ nsam no,

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: wɔn a ɔboaboaa wɔn ano firii nsase soɔ no, ɛfiri apueeɛ kɔsi atɔeɛ, atifi kɔsi anafoɔ.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Ebinom kyinkyinii wɔ nsase paradada so, a wɔanhunu ɛkwan ankɔ kuropɔn no mu, baabi a wɔbɛtumi anya atenaeɛ.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔm ne sukɔm dee wɔn na wɔtotɔɔ baha.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Afei wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu, na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: Ɔde wɔn faa ɛkwan tee so baa kuropɔn a wɔtumi tena mu no mu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da ho ne nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɔyɛ ma nnipa.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Ɔma wɔn a sukɔm de wɔn nsuo na ɔde nnepa hyɛ wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn ma.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Ebinom tenaa esum ne awerɛhoɔ mu, nneduafoɔ a wɔde dadeɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn agu wɔn,

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, wɔtee Onyankopɔn nsɛm ho atua na wɔbuu Ɔsorosoroni no agyinatuo animtiaa.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Enti ɔgyaa wɔn maa adwuma den; wɔsuntisuntiiɛ na wɔannya ɔboafoɔ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Afei, wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu, na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Ɔyii wɔn firii esum ne awerɛhoɔ mu na ɔbubuu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da ho ne nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɔyɛ ma nnipa.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Ɔbubu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ apono na ɔtwitwa nnadeban mu.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Ebinom bɛyɛɛ nkwaseafoɔ, wɔn atuateɛ enti na wɔhunuu amane, wɔn nnebɔne enti.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Wɔkyirii aduane nyinaa na wɔtwe bɛnee owuo ɛpono ano.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Afei, wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn amanehunu mu na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Ɔsomaa nʼasɛm na ɔsaa wɔn yadeɛ; na ɔgyee wɔn firii ɛda mu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da ho ne nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɔyɛ ma nnipa.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Momma wɔmmɔ aseda afɔdeɛ na wɔmfa ahurisie nnwom nka ne nnwuma ho asɛm.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Ebinom tenaa ahyɛn mu wɔ ɛpo so; wɔyɛ adwadifoɔ wɔ nsuo akɛseɛ so.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Wɔhunuu Awurade nnwuma, nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɛwɔ ebunu mu.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔkasaeɛ maa ahum tui na ɛkukuruu asorɔkye.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Wɔpagya kɔɔ sorosoro na wɔsiane kɔɔ ebunu mu tɔnn; wɔn amanehunu mu no wɔn bo tui.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Wɔkyim totɔɔ ntintan sɛ asabofoɔ; na wɔnhunu deɛ wɔnnyɛ bio.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Afei, wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn amanehunu mu, na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ahum no yɛɛ dinn; ɛpo so asorɔkye ano brɛɛ ase.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Wɔn ani gyeeɛ ɛberɛ a ɛyɛɛ dinn no, na ɔkyerɛɛ wɔn ɛkwan de wɔn kɔduruu gyinabea a wɔpɛ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da ho ne nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɔyɛ ma nnipa.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Wɔmma ne so wɔ asafo no mu na wɔnkamfo no wɔ mpanimfoɔ nhyiamu ase.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Ɔdanee nsubɔntene maa no yɛɛ ɛserɛ, asutene yɛɛ asase wesee,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: na asasebereɛ danee nkyenenkyene, wɔn a wɔte asase no so amumuyɛ enti.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ɔdanee ɛserɛ so maa no yɛɛ nsuwansuwa na nkyɛkyerɛ yɛɛ sɛ asutene ananmu;

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na ɔde wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn kɔsoɛe, na wɔkyekyeree kuropɔn tenaa mu.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛɛ mfuo ne bobe nturo na ɛmaa wɔn nnɔbaeɛ bebree.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Ɔhyiraa wɔn na wɔn ase dɔreeɛ. Wamma wɔn ayɛmmoa dodoɔ so anhwan.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Afei wɔn dodoɔ so hwaneeɛ na nhyɛsoɔ, amanehunu ne awerɛhoɔ brɛɛ wɔn ase;

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: deɛ ɔbu aberempɔn animtiaa no ma wɔkyinkyinii asase bonini a ɛkwan nni hɔ so.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Nanso, ɔpagyaa ahiafoɔ firii wɔn ahohia mu na ɔmaa wɔn mmusua dɔree sɛ nnwankuo.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Ateneneefoɔ bɛhunu ama wɔn ani gye, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa bɛmua wɔn ano.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Momma deɛ ɔyɛ onyansafoɔ no mmu yeinom, na ɔnnwene Awurade adɔeɛ kɛseɛ no ho.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Monyane, sankuo ne bɛnta! Mɛnyane anɔpahema.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mɛkamfo wo wɔ aman no mu; mɛto wo ho dwom wɔ nnipa no mu.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Wʼadɔeɛ so, ɛkorɔn sene ɔsoro; wo nokorɛdie duru ewiem.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wo so tra ɔsoro, na ama wʼanimuonyam aba asase nyinaa so.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Fa wo nsa nifa gye yɛn na boa yɛn, na ama wɔn a wodɔ wɔn no anya nkwa.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn akasa afiri ne kronkronbea sɛ, “Nkonim mu na mɛkyɛ Sekem mu na masusu Sukot Bɔnhwa.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead yɛ me dea; Manase nso saa ara; Efraim yɛ me dadeɛ kyɛ, Yuda yɛ mʼahempoma.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab yɛ me dwaresɛn, Edom so na meto me mpaboa guo; Filistia so na mebɔ ose.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔde me bɛkɔ kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu? Hwan na ɔbɛdi mʼanim akɔ Edom?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, ɛnyɛ wo na woapo yɛn? Wo ne yɛn nsraadɔm renkɔ ɔsa bio anaa?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Boa yɛn tia ɔtamfoɔ no, na ɔdasani mmoa nka hwee.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn wɔ yɛn afa yi, yɛbɛdi nkonim, na ɔbɛtiatia yɛn atamfoɔ so. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ no.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn a mekamfo woɔ, mmua wʼano,

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: na amumuyɛfoɔ ne nkontompofoɔ atu wɔn ano agu me so; wɔde atorɔ tɛkrɛma akasa atia me.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Wɔde nitansɛm atwa me ho ahyia na wɔto hyɛ me so a menkaa wɔn.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Wɔka nsɛm to me so de tua me nnamfoyɛ so ka, nanso meyɛ obi a ɔpɛ mpaeɛbɔ.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Wɔde bɔne tua me papayɛ so ka, na wɔde ɔtan tua me nnamfoyɛ so ka.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Ma onipa bɔne bi nsɔre ntia no; na Satan nnyina ne nsa nifa so.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Wɔdi nʼasɛm a, ma ɔnni fɔ, na ne mpaeɛbɔ mmu no kumfɔ.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Ma ne nkwa nna nyɛ kakraa bi; na ɔfoforɔ nsi nʼanan mu sɛ ɔkandifoɔ.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Ma ne mma nyɛ nwisiaa na ne yere nyɛ okunafoɔ.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Ma ne mma nkyinkyini nsrɛsrɛ adeɛ; ma wɔmpam wɔn mfiri wɔn afie a abubuo no mu.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Ma ɔdefirifoɔ bi mfa deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa; na amanfrafoɔ mfom nʼadwuma so aba.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Mma obiara nhunu no mmɔbɔ Mma obiara nhunu ne nwisiaa nso mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Ma nʼase nhye, na wɔn din nyera wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛreba no mu.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnkae nʼagyanom nnebɔne wɔ Awurade anim; na ne maame bɔne no ntena hɔ daa.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Wɔn bɔne nyinaa nka Awurade anim, na wɔankae wɔn bio wɔ asase so.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ wannwene da sɛ ɔbɛyɛ adɔeɛ, na mmom ɔtaa ahiafoɔ mmɔborɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔn werɛ ahoɔ de kɔɔ owuo mu.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Nʼani gyee sɛ ɔbɛdome enti nnome mmra ne so; wampɛ sɛ ɔbɛhyira enti nhyira mmɔ no.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Ɔhyɛɛ nnome sɛ atadeɛ; ɛnonom kɔɔ ne onipadua mu sɛ nsuo, ne ne nnompe mu sɛ ngo.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Ma ɛnyɛ sɛ atadeɛ a ɛkyekyere ne ho, ne abɔsoɔ a ɛbɔ no daa.

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Ma yei nyɛ Awurade akatua a ɔde ma me kwaadubɔfoɔ, wɔn a wɔka nsɛmmɔne fa me ho no.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nanso, wo Ao Asafo Awurade, wo din enti, wo ne me nni no yie; firi wʼadɔeɛ mu gye me.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ ohiani ne deɛ onnibie, na mʼakoma atɔ baha wɔ me mu.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Metwam sɛ anwummerɛ sunsumma; wɔwoso me kyene sɛ ntutummɛ.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Abuadadie ama me kotodwe mu agogo; mafɔn na ama aka me nnompe.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Mayɛ aseredeɛ ama wɔn a wɔbɔ me soboɔ; sɛ wohunu me a, wɔwoso wɔn ti.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Boa me, Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn; gye me sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnhunu sɛ ɛyɛ wo nsa, na wo na woayɛ, Ao Awurade.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛdome, nanso wobɛhyira; sɛ wɔto hyɛ me so a, wɔn anim bɛgu ase, nanso wo ɔsomfoɔ ani bɛgye.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Animguaseɛ bɛdura mʼatamfoɔ ho; na akyekyere wɔn ho sɛ atadeɛ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mede mʼano bɛma Awurade so ayɛ no kɛseɛ; mɛkamfo no wɔ nnipadɔm mu.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ, ɔgyina onnibie nsa nifa so sɛ ɔbɛgye no nkwa afiri wɔn a wɔbu no kumfɔ nsam.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me Wura sɛ, “Tena me nifa so kɔsi sɛ mede wʼatamfoɔ bɛyɛ wo nan ntiasoɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛtrɛ wʼahempoma denden mu afiri Sion; na wobɛdi ɔhene wɔ wʼatamfoɔ so.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Wʼakodɔm bɛyi wɔn akoma mu ɛda a wobɛkɔ sa. Tumi kronkron bɛyɛ wʼaduradeɛ na wo mmabunu bɛba wo nkyɛn sɛdeɛ bosuo gugu anɔpahema.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Awurade aka ntam na ɔrensesa nʼadwene: “Woyɛ daapem ɔsɔfoɔ te sɛ Melkisedek sɛso.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Awurade wɔ wo nifa so; ɔbɛdwerɛ ahemfo wɔ nʼabufuhyeɛ da no.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛbu amanaman atɛn aboaboa afunu ano; na wadwerɛ sodifoɔ a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛnom asuwa a ɛda ɛkwan nkyɛn mu nsuo enti ɔbɛdi nkonim. Ɔhene no bɛnom asuwa a ɛda kwankyɛn mu nsuo, na wanya ahoɔden, na wagyina nkonimdie mu.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade! Mɛfiri mʼakoma nyinaa mu ama Awurade so wɔ ateneneefoɔ adwabɔ ne asafo no mu.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Awurade nnwuma yɛ kɛseɛ; wɔn a wɔn ani gye ho nyinaa susu ho.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Ne nnwuma yɛ tumi ne animuonyam, na ne tenenee wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Ɔma yɛkae nʼanwanwadeɛ; Awurade yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Ɔma wɔn a wosuro no no aduane; ɔkae nʼapam no daa.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Wakyerɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ tumi a ɛwɔ ne nnwuma mu, sɛ ɔde aman afoforɔ nsase ama wɔn.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ne nsa ano nnwuma yɛ nokorɛ na ɛtene; nʼahyɛdeɛ nyinaa mu wɔ ahotosoɔ.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Ɛtim hɔ daa daa, nokorɛ ne tenenee mu na ɔyɛeɛ.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Ɔde ɔgyeɛ maa ne nkurɔfoɔ; ɔde nʼapam sii hɔ afebɔɔ, ne din yɛ kronkron na ɛyɛ hu.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ nyansa mfitiaseɛ; wɔn a wɔdi nʼahyɛdeɛ so nyinaa wɔ nhunumu pa. Ɔno na daa ayɛyie wɔ no.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Nhyira nka onipa a ɔsuro Awurade na ɔnya nʼahyɛdeɛ mu anigyeɛ pii.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Ne mma bɛyɛ atumfoɔ wɔ asase no so; teneneefoɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ bɛnya nhyira.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Ahonya ne sika wɔ ne fie, na ne tenenee tena hɔ daa.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Esum mu mpo hann pue ma nnipa a wɔtene, ma ɔdomfoɔ, mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔnokwafoɔ.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Yiedie bɛba deɛ ne tirim yɛ mmrɛ na ɔde fɛm kwa. Yiedie bɛba deɛ ɔde atɛntenenee yɛ ne nneɛma so.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, ɔrenhinhim da biara da; wɔbɛkae onipa tenenee daa.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔte asɛmmɔne a, ɛmmɔ ne hu; nʼakoma atim wɔ Awurade mu ahotosoɔ mu.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Nʼakoma wɔ banbɔ, na ɔnsuro; awieeɛ no, ɔde nkonimdie bɛhyia nʼatamfoɔ.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔto nʼakyɛdeɛ pete aman so ma ahiafoɔ, ne tenenee wɔ hɔ daa; wɔbɛkae wɔn daa na wɔahyɛ wɔn animuonyam.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ bɛhunu ama ayɛ no yea, ɔbɛtwere ne se na wafɔn; omumuyɛfoɔ tirimpɔ bɛyɛ kwa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Ao, mo Awurade asomfoɔ, monkamfo no, monkamfo Awurade din.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnkamfo Awurade din, seesei ne daa nyinaa.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri baabi a owia pue kɔsi faako a ɔkɔtɔ, ma wɔnkamfo Awurade din.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Wɔama Awurade so aman nyinaa so, nʼanimuonyam tra ɔsorosoro.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔte sɛ Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn, Ɔbaako no a ɔdi ɔhene wɔ ɔsorosoro,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔbɔ ne mu ase hwɛ ɔsorosoro ne asase.

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Ɔma ahiafoɔ so firi mfuturo mu na ɔpagya onnibie firi nso sie so;

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: ɔde wɔn tena mmapɔmma mu, wɔn nkurɔfoɔ mmapɔmma mu.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ obonini atenaseɛ wɔ ne fie sɛ ɔbaatan a nʼani gyeɛ. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Israelfoɔ firii Misraim, na Yakob fiefoɔ firii ananafoɔ asase so no,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda bɛyɛɛ Awurade kronkronbea na Israel bɛyɛɛ nʼahemman.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Ɛpo no huruiɛ na ɛdwaneeɛ, Yordan sanee nʼakyi;

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Mmepɔ hurihurii sɛ nnwennini nkokoɔ nso hurihurii sɛ nnwammaa.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Ɛdeɛn na ɛbaeɛ, Ao ɛpo, na wodwaneeɛ, Ao Yordan, na wosanee wʼakyi,

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: mo mmepɔ, na mohurihuri sɛ nnwennini, na mo nkokoɔ, mohurihuri sɛ nnwammaa?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Asase, ma wo ho mpopo wɔ Awurade anim, wɔ Yakob Onyankopɔn anim,

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: ɔno na ɔmaa ɔbotan no danee asubura, na abotan a ɛyɛ den danee nsuwa nsuwa no.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ yɛn, Ao Awurade, ɛnyɛ yɛn na wo din na animuonyam nka, wʼadɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛdie enti.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Adɛn enti na aman no bisa sɛ, “Wɔn Onyankopɔn wɔ he?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Yɛn Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔsoro; deɛ ɔpɛ biara na ɔyɛ.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔn ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a wɔde onipa nsa na ayɛ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wɔntumi nkasa; wɔwɔ ani, nanso wɔnhunu adeɛ.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm; wɔwɔ hwene, nanso wɔnte hwa.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ nsa, nanso wɔnte nka; Wɔwɔ nan, nanso wɔnnante. Wɔntumi mma nnyegyeeɛ bi mfiri wɔn mene mu.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ ahoni no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara, saa ara na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so no bɛyɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ao Israelfoɔ, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so, ɔyɛ mo ɔboafoɔ ne kyɛm.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ao Aaron fie, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so, ɔyɛ mo ɔboafoɔ ne kyɛm.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Mo a mosuro no, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so, ɔyɛ mo ɔboafoɔ ne kyɛm.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Awurade kae yɛn na ɔbɛhyira yɛn: Ɔbɛhyira Israel fie, ɔbɛhyira Aaron fie

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛhyira wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade, nkumaa ne akɛseɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Awurade mma wʼase nnɔre, wo ne wo mma.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Awurade nhyira wo, ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfoɔ no.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Ɔsorosoro yɛ Awurade dea, nanso asase deɛ, ɔde ama onipa.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ awufoɔ na wɔkamfo Awurade, wɔn a wɔkɔ fam dinn no rentumi nkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Yɛn na yɛma Awurade so ɛnnɛ ne daa nyinaa. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Medɔ Awurade ɛfiri sɛ, ɔtee me nne. Ɔtee me mmɔborɔhunu su.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ ɔbrɛɛ nʼaso maa me enti, mɛfrɛ no wɔ ɛberɛ a mete ase yi.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Owuo nhoma kyekyeree me, ɛda ho ahometeɛ baa me so, ɔhaw ne awerɛhoɔ hyɛɛ me so.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Afei mebɔɔ Awurade din kaa sɛ, “Ao Awurade, gye me nkwa!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne ɔteneneeni; ayamhyehyeɛ ahyɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn ma.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Awurade bɔ ɔwɛmfoɔ ho ban; ɛberɛ a mewɔ ahohiahia mu no, ɔgyee me.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Nya abotɔyam bio, Ao me kra, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ne wo adi no yie.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Na wo, Ao Awurade, woagye me kra afiri owuo mu; woamma mʼani amporo nisuo, na woamma me nan ansunti,

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: sɛ mɛnante Awurade anim wɔ ateasefoɔ asase so.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Megye diiɛ; ɛno enti mekaa sɛ, “Mewɔ ahohia kɛseɛ mu.”

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Na mʼabasamtuo mu, mekaa sɛ, “Nnipa nyinaa yɛ atorofoɔ.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Ɛdeɛn na mɛtumi de atua Awurade ka wɔ ne papa a wayɛ ama me nyinaa?

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mɛdi ɛbɔ a mahyɛ Awurade no nyinaa so wɔ ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa anim.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Nʼahotefoɔ wuo yɛ aboɔden wɔ Awurade ani so.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ampa ara meyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ; meyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ, wʼafenaa babarima; wayi me afiri me mpɔkyerɛ mu.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Mɛbɔ aseda afɔdeɛ ama wo na mabɔ Awurade din.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Mɛdi me bɔ a mahyɛ Awurade no so wɔ ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa anim,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: wɔ adihɔ a ɛwɔ Awurade fie wɔ wo mfimfini, Ao Yerusalem. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Aman nyinaa, monkamfo Awurade; mo nnipa nyinaa, momma ne din so.

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nʼadɔeɛ so wɔ yɛn so, na Awurade nokorɛ wɔ hɔ daa. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Monna Awurade ase ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ, na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Momma Israel nka sɛ, “Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Momma Aaron fie nka sɛ, “Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Momma wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade nka sɛ, “Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Mʼahohiahia mu, mesu frɛɛ Awurade; ɔgyee me so, na ɔma me dee me ho.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me ɔboafoɔ; enti merensuro. Ɛdeɛn na onipa bɛtumi ayɛ me?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Awurade ne me wɔ hɔ; ɔyɛ me ɔboafoɔ. Mede nkonimdie bɛhwɛ mʼatamfoɔ.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ yɛbɛhinta wɔ Awurade mu sene sɛ yɛde yɛn ho bɛto onipa soɔ.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amanaman no nyinaa twaa me ho hyiaaɛ, nanso Awurade din mu metwitwaa wɔn guiɛ.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɔtwaa me ho hyiaeɛ wɔ baabiara, nanso Awurade din mu, metwitwaa wɔn guiɛ.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Wɔkyere guu me so sɛ nwowa, nanso wɔhyee ntɛm so sɛ nkasɛɛ a ogya atɔ mu; Awurade din mu metwitwaa wɔn guiɛ.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Wɔsum me kɔɔ mʼakyi a anka mereyɛ ahwe ase, nanso Awurade boaa me.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ mʼahoɔden ne me dwom; wayɛ me nkwagyeɛ.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Osebɔ ne nkonimdie gyegye wɔ ateneneefoɔ ntomadan mu sɛ, “Awurade nsa nifa ayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Wɔapagya Awurade nsa nifa so; Awurade nsa nifa ayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Merenwu, mmom mɛtena ase na mapae mu aka deɛ Awurade ayɛ.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Awurade atwe mʼaso denden, nanso ɔnnyaa me mmaa owuo.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Bue tenenee apono ma me; na mɛhyɛne mu na mede aseda ama Awurade.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Awurade ɛpono nie; ɛhɔ na ateneneefoɔ bɛfa ahyɛne mu.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Mɛda wo ase ɛfiri sɛ wogyee me so; na woayɛ me nkwagyeɛ.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Ɔboɔ a adansifoɔ no poeɛ no, abɛyɛ tweatiboɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Awurade na ayɛ yei, na ɛyɛ nwanwa wɔ yɛn ani so.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Ɛnnɛ yɛ ɛda a Awurade ayɛ. Momma yɛn ani nnye na yɛnni ahurisie.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, gye yɛn nkwa; Ao Awurade, ma yɛn nkɔsoɔ.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne deɛ ɔnam Awurade din mu reba. Yɛhyira wo firi Awurade fie.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn, na wama ne hann ahyerɛn yɛn so. Momfa nnua mman nkura na yɛnto afahyɛ santen nkɔ afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Woyɛ me Onyankopɔn, na meda wo ase; wone me Onyankopɔn, na mɛma wo so.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Monna Awurade ase, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ; na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔn akwan yɛ pɛ na wɔnante sɛdeɛ Awurade mmara kyerɛ.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔkora nʼahyɛdeɛ, na wɔfiri wɔn akoma nyinaa mu hwehwɛ no.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Wɔnnyɛ mfomsoɔ biara; na wɔnam nʼakwan so.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Woayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ pa ato hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔdi so pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Ao sɛ mʼakwan bɛyɛ tee sɛdeɛ wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm no teɛ.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Sɛ mehwɛ wʼahyɛdeɛ no a ɛnneɛ, anka mʼanim rengu ase.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Mede akoma a emu teɛ bɛkamfo wo ɛberɛ a meresua wo mmara a ɛtene no.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Mɛdi wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm so; na nnya me korakora. Awurade Mmara Ho Setie

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Aberanteɛ bɛyɛ dɛn na nʼakwan ho ate? Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔdi wʼasɛm so.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Mede mʼakoma nyinaa hwehwɛ wo; mma me mmane mfiri wo mmaransɛm ho.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Mede wʼasɛm asie mʼakoma mu sɛdeɛ merenyɛ bɔne ntia wo.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, nkamfo wɔ wo; kyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Mede mʼano ka mmara a ɛfiri wʼanomu nyinaa.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Mʼani gye sɛ medi wʼahyɛdeɛ so te sɛdeɛ obi anigye ahonya bebree ho no.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Medwendwene wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho na mehwehwɛ wʼakwan mu.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Mʼani gye wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm ho; na merentoto wʼasɛm ase. Awurade Mmara Mu Ahotɔ

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Yɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ yie; na matena ase adi wʼasɛm so.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Bue mʼani na menhunu anwanwadeɛ a ɛwɔ wo mmara no mu.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Meyɛ ɔnanani wɔ asase so; mfa wo mmaransɛm no nhinta me.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Me kra tɔ baha ɛberɛ biara wɔ wo mmara ho anigyina enti.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Woka ahantanfoɔ anim, wɔn a wɔadome wɔn, na wɔmane firi wo mmaransɛm ho no.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Yi kasatia ne animtiabuo firi me mu, ɛfiri sɛ medi wʼahyɛdeɛ so.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ sodifoɔ hyia di me ho nsekuro, nanso wo ɔsomfoɔ bɛdwendwene wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm ho.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Wʼahyɛdeɛ yɛ mʼanigyedeɛ na ɛyɛ me fotufoɔ. Awurade Mmara Sodie Ho Bɔhyɛ

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Woabrɛ me ase ma meda mfuturo mu. Kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm no teɛ.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Mesesee mʼakwan na wogyee me so; kyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Ma mente deɛ ɛwɔ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ase; na mɛdwendwene wʼanwanwadeɛ ho.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Awerɛhoɔ ama me ɔkra atɔ baha; hyɛ me den sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm no kyerɛ.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Yi me firi nnaadaa akwan so; na fa wo mmara so dom me.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Mafa nokorɛ kwan no so; mede mʼakoma adi wo mmara akyi.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mekura wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu denden mma mʼanim ngu ase.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Metu mmirika wɔ wo mmaransɛm kwan no so, ɛfiri sɛ wama mʼakoma atɔ me yam. Nteaseɛ Ho Mpaeɛbɔ

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Kyerɛkyerɛ me, Ao Awurade, na menni wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm so, na mɛdi so akɔsi awieeɛ.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Ma me nteaseɛ, na mɛdi wo mmara so, na mede mʼakoma nyinaa bɛdi so.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ me wo mmaransɛm kwan no na ɛhɔ na menya anigyeɛ.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Dane mʼakoma kɔ wʼahyɛdeɛ ho na ɛmfiri pɛsɛmenkomenya ho.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Yi mʼani firi nneɛma hunu so; na kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm teɛ.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Di ɛbɔ a woahyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ no so, na wasuro wo.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Yi animguaseɛ a ɛbɔ me hu no firi hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wo mmara yɛ papa.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Mʼani agyina wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no! Kyɛe me nkwa so wɔ wo tenenee mu. Awurade Mmara Ho Ahotosoɔ

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ma wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no mmra me so, wo nkwagyeɛ no sɛdeɛ wo bɔhyɛ no teɛ.

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Afei, mɛbua deɛ ɔyi me ahi no, ɛfiri sɛ mewɔ wʼasɛm mu ahotosoɔ.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Nyi nokwasɛm no mfiri mʼanom, ɛfiri sɛ mʼanidasoɔ wɔ wo mmara mu.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mɛdi wo mmara so ɛberɛ biara akɔsi daa apem.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Mede ahofadie bɛnante ɛfiri sɛ mahwehwɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Mɛka wʼahyɛdeɛ ho asɛm wɔ ahemfo anim na mʼanim rengu ase,

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ mʼani gye wo mmaransɛm ho na medɔ no.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mede anidie ma wo mmaransɛm a medɔ no, na medwendwene wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm ho. Awurade Mmara No Mu Ahotosoɔ

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Kae asɛm a woaka akyerɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ woama me anidasoɔ.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Mʼawerɛkyekyerɛ wɔ mʼamanehunu mu ne sɛ: Wo bɔhyɛ kyɛe me nkwa so.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ahantanfoɔ bu me animtia bebree, nanso mennane mfiri wo mmara ho.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade mekae wo tete mmara no, na menya awerɛkyekyerɛ wɔ mu.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Abufuo hyɛ me ma, ɛsiane amumuyɛfoɔ a wɔapo wo mmara enti.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm yɛ me dwom tiban wɔ baabiara a mesoɛ.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, anadwo mekae wo din, na mɛdi wo mmara so.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Yei ne adeɛ a meyɛ da biara, medi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so. Ahofama Wɔ Awurade Mmara So Die Mu

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wone me kyɛfa; mahyɛ bɔ sɛ mɛdi wo nsɛm so.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mede mʼakoma nyinaa ahwehwɛ wo; hunu me mmɔbɔ sɛdeɛ wo bɔhyɛ no teɛ.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Madwene mʼakwan ho na madane mʼanammɔntuo akyerɛ wʼahyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mɛyɛ ntɛm, merentwentwɛn sɛ mɛdi wo mmaransɛm soɔ.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ de ahoma kyekyere me nanso me werɛ remfiri wo mmara.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Ɔdasuom, mesɔre de wʼaseda ma wo wo mmara a ɛtene enti.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Meyɛ wɔn a wɔsuro woɔ nyinaa adamfo, wɔn a wɔdi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ soɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wʼadɔeɛ ahyɛ asase so ma; kyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm. Awurade Mmara So Die Ho Mfasoɔ

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Wo ne wo ɔsomfoɔ nni no yie sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm teɛ, Ao Awurade.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Kyerɛkyerɛ me nimdeɛ ne atemmuo pa, ɛfiri sɛ megye wo mmaransɛm no di.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Ansa na merebɛhunu amane no, mefomm ɛkwan, na seesei deɛ, medi wʼasɛm so.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Woyɛ, na deɛ woyɛ nso yɛ; kyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Ahantanfoɔ de atorɔ afɔre me ho, nanso mede mʼakoma nyinaa di wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Wɔn akoma yɛ den na wɔnni tema, nanso mʼani gye wo mmara ho.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ mehunuu amane sɛdeɛ mɛsua wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Mmara a ɛfiri wʼanomu no som bo ma me sene dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ mpempem. Nokorɛ A Ɛwɔ Awurade Mmara Mu

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Wo nsa na ɛbɔɔ me na ɛnwonoo me; ma me nteaseɛ a mede bɛsua wo mmaransɛm.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔn a wɔsuro wo no hunu me a, ma wɔn ani nnye, ɛfiri sɛ mede mʼanidasoɔ ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, menim sɛ wo mmara tene, na nokorɛdie mu na woatwe mʼaso.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ma wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da nkyekyere me werɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɔ a woahyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ no teɛ.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Ma wʼayamhyehyeɛ mmra me so, na mennya nkwa, ɛfiri sɛ mʼani ka wo mmara ho.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Ma ahantanfoɔ ani nwu wɔ bɔne a wɔyɛɛ me, nanso, mɛdwendwene wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔsuro wo no mmra me nkyɛn, wɔn a wɔte wo mmara ase no.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Ma mʼakoma nnya bembuo wɔ wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm ho, na mʼanim angu ase. Ɔgyeɛ Mpaeɛbɔ

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Wo nkwagyeɛ ho anigyina ama me ɔkra atɔ baha, nanso mede mʼanidasoɔ ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Mahwɛ wo bɔhyɛ anim ama mʼani abu; meka sɛ, “Da bɛn na wobɛkyekyere me werɛ?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ mete sɛ nsã kotokuo a ɛsɛn wisie ano deɛ, nanso me werɛ remfiri wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Wo ɔsomfoɔ ntwɛn nkɔsi da bɛn? Da bɛn na wobɛtwe wɔn a wɔtaa me no aso?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Ahantanfoɔ atu amena de asum me afidie, a ɛne wo mmara bɔ abira.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Wo mmaransɛm nyinaa mu wɔ ahotosoɔ; boa me ɛfiri sɛ nnipa teetee me kwa.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛkaa kakra bi na wɔyi me firi asase so, nanso mennyaa wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so die.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ, na mɛdi nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfiri wʼanomu no so. Awurade Mmara Mu Gyidie

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wʼasɛm no tim hɔ daa; ɛgyina hɔ pintinn wɔ ɔsorosoro.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Wo nokorɛdie kɔ so wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu; wode asase sii hɔ, na ɛtim hɔ.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Wo mmara wɔ hɔ bɛsi ɛnnɛ, na nneɛma nyinaa som wo.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Sɛ mʼani anka wo mmara no ho a, anka mʼamanehunu akum me.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Me werɛ remfiri wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno so na wonam akyɛe me nkwa so.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Gye me nkwa, na meyɛ wo dea; na mahwehwɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ retwɛn sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me, nanso, mɛdwendwene wʼahyɛdeɛ ho.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Ao medɔ wo mmara no! Medwendwene ho ɛda mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Wo mmaransɛm ma me hunu nyansa sene mʼatamfoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɛwɔ me nkyɛn daa.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Mewɔ nhunumu sene mʼakyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ medwendwene wʼahyɛdeɛ ho.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Mewɔ nteaseɛ sene mpanimfoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ medi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Memfaa me nan nsii ɛkwan bɔne biara so sɛdeɛ mɛtumi ayɛ ɔsetie ama wʼasɛm.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Memmane memfirii wo mmara ho, ɛfiri sɛ wʼankasa na woakyerɛkyerɛ me.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: Wo nsɛm yɛ me dɛ, ɛyɛ dɛ sene ɛwoɔ wɔ mʼanom.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Menya nteaseɛ firi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu; enti mekyiri ɛkwan bɔne biara. Awurade Mmara Yɛ Kanea

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Wʼasɛm yɛ me nan ase kanea ne mʼakwan so hann.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Maka ntam ahyɛ mu kena sɛ mɛdi wo tenenee mmara no so.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mahunu amane bebree; kyɛe me nkwa so, Ao Awurade, sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm teɛ.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ma wʼani nsɔ mʼanom nkamfo a ɛfiri me pɛ mu, na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mmara.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ daa metoto me nkwa ase, nanso me werɛ remfiri wo mmara.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ asum me afidie nanso memfom memfirii wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Wʼahyɛdeɛ yɛ mʼagyapadeɛ afebɔɔ; ɛma mʼakoma ani gye.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Mʼakoma ayɛ krado sɛ ɛbɛhwɛ wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm so akɔsi awieeɛ. Awurade Mmara Mu Banbɔ

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mekyiri nnipa a wɔn adwene yɛ wɔn ntanta, na medɔ wo mmara.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Wone me dwanekɔbea ne me kyɛm; mede mʼanidasoɔ ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Momfiri me so nkɔ, mo nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, na menni me Onyankopɔn mmaransɛm so!

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Wowa me sɛdeɛ wo bɔhyɛ no teɛ, na mɛtena nkwa mu; mma mʼanidasoɔ nyɛ kwa.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Sɔ me mu, na menya nkwagyeɛ; na ɛberɛ biara mɛhwɛ wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm no.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Wopo wɔn a wɔfom wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm nyinaa, na wɔn nnaadaa no yɛ ɔkwa.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Woyi amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa si nkyɛn sɛ dadeben; enti medɔ wʼahyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Wo ho suro ma me ho popo; wo mmara abɔ me hu. Awurade Mmara No Setie

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Mayɛ deɛ ɛtene na ɛyɛ pɛ. Nnyaa me mma wɔn a wɔhyɛ me soɔ!

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Hwɛ ma wo ɔsomfoɔ nni yie; mma ahantanfoɔ nhyɛ me so.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Mahwɛ wo nkwagyeɛ anim ama mʼani abu, ɛrehwehwɛ wo bɔhyɛ a ɛtene no.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Wo ne wo ɔsomfoɔ nni no sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Meyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ; ma me nhunumu na mate wʼahyɛdeɛ ase.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ɛberɛ aso sɛ woyɛ biribi; wɔrebu wo mmara so.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ medɔ wo mmaransɛm sene sikakɔkɔɔ, anaa sikakɔkɔɔ amapa,

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: na medwene sɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ nyinaa yɛ enti mekyiri ɛkwan bɔne biara. Pere Sɛ Wobɛdi Awurade Mmara So

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Wʼahyɛdeɛ yɛ nwanwa; enti medi so.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Wo nsɛm ase teɛ ma hann; na ɛma ntetekwaa nya nteaseɛ.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Mebue mʼanom na megu ahome, na mʼani gyina wo mmaransɛm.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Dane wʼani hwɛ me na hunu me mmɔbɔ sɛdeɛ woyɛ daa ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Tutu mʼanammɔn sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm no teɛ. Mma bɔne biara nni me so.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Gye me firi nnipa nhyɛsoɔ mu, na madi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ma wʼanim nhyerɛn wo ɔsomfoɔ so na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Nisuo adware me sɛ asutene ɛfiri sɛ nnipa nni wo mmara so. Awurade Mmara Yɛ Pɛ

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni ne wo, Ao Awurade, na wo mmara nso yɛ pɛ.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Ahyɛdeɛ a woayɛ no tene; ɛyɛ deɛ wɔnya mu ahotosoɔ pa ara.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Abufuo ahyɛ me ma, ɛfiri sɛ mʼatamfoɔ bu wɔn ani gu wo nsɛm no.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Wɔasɔ wo bɔhyɛ ahodoɔ no ahwɛ pa ara, na wo ɔsomfoɔ dɔ wɔn.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ mennka hwee na memfra deɛ, nanso me werɛ mfiri wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Wo tenenee wɔ hɔ daa na wo mmara no yɛ nokorɛ.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw ne ahohiahia aduru me, nanso wo mmaransɛm ma me ahosɛpɛ.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Wʼahyɛdeɛ yɛ nokorɛ daa; ma me nteaseɛ na manya nkwa. Ɔgyeɛ Mpaeɛbɔ

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mede mʼakoma nyinaa mefrɛ wo, gye me so, na mɛdi wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm no so.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Mesu mefrɛ wo, gye me nkwa na medi wʼahyɛdeɛ so.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mesɔre anɔpahema, na mesu pɛ mmoa; mede me werɛ ahyɛ wo nsɛm mu.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Mʼani gu so anadwo nyinaa, na mɛdwendwene wo bɔhyɛ ho.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Tie me nne sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ no teɛ; Ao Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wo mmara teɛ.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔhyehyɛ atirimuɔdensɛm no abɛn, nanso wɔne wo mmara ntam ware.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wo deɛ, wobɛn me, na wo mmaransɛm nyinaa yɛ nokorɛ.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bi a atwam no, mesuaa wʼahyɛdeɛ a wode timiiɛ hɔ sɛ ɛntena hɔ daa no. Mmoa Ho Mpaeɛbɔ

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Hwɛ mʼamanehunu na gye me nkwa ɛfiri sɛ me werɛ mfirii wo mmara no.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Di mʼasɛm ma me na gye me. Kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wo bɔhyɛ no teɛ.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Nkwagyeɛ ne atirimuɔdenfoɔ ntam kwan ware, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm no.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wʼayamhyehyeɛ yɛ kɛseɛ; kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wo mmara no teɛ.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Atamfoɔ a wɔteetee me dɔɔso, nanso memmane memfirii wo nhyehyɛeɛ ho.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mehwɛ wɔn a wɔnni gyidie no a, wɔn ho yɛ me nwunu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni wʼasɛm so.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛdeɛ mʼani gye wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho; Ao Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Wo nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokorɛ; na wo mmara a ɛtene no to rentwa da. Nya Ahofama Ma Awurade Mmara

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Sodifoɔ taataa me kwa, nanso ɛyɛ wʼasɛm nko ara na mesuro.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Mʼani gye wo bɔhyɛ ho te sɛ obi a wanya asadeɛ kɛseɛ.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mekyiri nkontompo na medɔ wo mmara.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Mekamfo wo mprɛnson da biara wo mmara a ɛtene no enti.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔdɔ wo mmara no wɔ asomdwoeɛ mmoroso, na biribiara rentumi mma wɔnsunti.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, metwɛn wo nkwagyeɛ, na medi wo mmaransɛm so.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Medi wʼahyɛdeɛ so na medɔ no yie.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Medi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne wʼahyɛdeɛ so, na wonim mʼakwan nyinaa. Mmoa Ho Mpaeɛbɔ

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ma me sufrɛ nnuru wʼanim; ma me nteaseɛ sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm no teɛ.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ma me nkotosrɛ nnuru wʼanim; na gye me sɛdeɛ wo bɔhyɛ no teɛ.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Ma nkamfo nhyɛ mʼanom ma; ɛfiri sɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Ma me tɛkrɛma nto wʼasɛm ho dwom, ɛfiri sɛ wo mmaransɛm nyinaa tene.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Yɛ ahoboa bɛboa me, ɛfiri sɛ masɔ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mʼani agyina wo nkwagyeɛ, na wo mmara yɛ mʼanigyedeɛ.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Ma me ntena nkwa mu na matumi akamfo wo, na wo mmara nso awowa me.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Mafom ɛkwan sɛ odwan a wayera. Hwehwɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ me werɛ mfirii wo mmaransɛm no.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Mesu frɛ Awurade wɔ mʼahohiahia mu, na ɔgye me so.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, gye me firi atorɔ ano ne nnaadaa tɛkrɛma nsam.

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Ɛdeɛn na ɔbɛyɛ wo, na ɛdeɛn na ɛka ho bio, Ao nnaadaa tɛkrɛma?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Ɔde asraafoɔ bɛmma a ano yɛ nnam ne gyasramma bɛtwe wʼaso.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Nnome nka me sɛ mabɛsoɛ Mesek, na mete Kedar ntomadan mu!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Matena ase akyɛre dodo wɔ wɔn a wɔkyiri asomdwoeɛ mu.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Meyɛ asomdwoeɛ onipa; nanso sɛ mekasa a, ɛyɛ ɔko ma wɔn.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Mema mʼani so kyerɛ mmepɔ no, ɛhe na me mmoa firi bɛba?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Me mmoa firi Awurade, ɔsoro ne asase yɛfoɔ no.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Ɔremma wo nan nwatiri, deɛ ɔhwɛ wo no, ɔrentɔ nko.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Ampa ara deɛ ɔhwɛ Israel no rentɔ nko na ɔrenna.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Awurade hwɛ wo so; Awurade ne wo nwunu wɔ wo nsa nifa so;

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Owia renhye wo wɔ awiaberɛ mu, na ɔsrane nso renha wo anadwo.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛbɔ wo ho ban afiri ɔhaw nyinaa ho, ɔbɛhwɛ wo nkwa so;

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛhwɛ wʼadifire ne wo efieba so, seesei ne daa.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a wɔsee me sɛ, “Ma yɛnkɔ Awurade fie” no, mʼani gyeeɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Yɛgyinagyina wʼapono ano, Ao Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Wɔakyekyere Yerusalem yie sɛ kuropɔn. Wɔahyehyɛ mu nneɛma fɛfɛ.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na mmusuakuo no korɔ, Awurade mmusuakuo no. Wɔkɔkamfo Awurade din sɛdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ama Israel no teɛ.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ na atemmuo nhennwa no sisi, Dawid fie nhennwa no.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Monsrɛ asomdwoeɛ mma Yerusalem sɛ, “Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo no nnya banbɔ.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Ma asomdwoeɛ mmra wʼafasuo mu na banbɔ mmra wʼabankɛsewa mu.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Me nuanom ne me nnamfonom enti, meka sɛ, “Asomdwoeɛ ntena wo mu.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn fie enti, mɛhwehwɛ wo nkɔsoɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Mema mʼani so kyerɛ wo, wo a wʼahennwa si ɔsoro.

english_verse: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ nkoa ani hwɛ wɔn wura nsa no, sɛdeɛ afenaa ani hwɛ nʼawurakwaa nsa no, saa ara na yɛn ani hwɛ Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛhunu yɛn mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, Ao Awurade, hunu yɛn mmɔbɔ, na wɔabu yɛn animtia bebree.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Ahomasofoɔ fɛdie ama yɛabrɛ dodo; ahantanfoɔ animtiabuo afono yɛn.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afa a, ma Israel nka.

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afa ɛberɛ a nnipa to hyɛɛ yɛn so,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a wɔn abufuo sɔree tiaa yɛn a, anka wɔmenee yɛn anikann;

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: anka nsuyire no bu faa yɛn so, anka ɔhweam no twee yɛn kɔeɛ,

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: anka nsuo a ano yɛ den no afa yɛn kɔ.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Nkamfoɔ nka Awurade a wɔamma ho kwan amma wɔamfa wɔn se antete yɛn mu.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Yɛadwane sɛ anomaa afiri afirisumfoɔ afidie mu; afidie no mu abubu, ama yɛanya ɛkwan adwane.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Yɛn mmoa wɔ Awurade din mu, ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfoɔ no.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
