translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Awurade so no te sɛ Bepɔ Sion, a ɛnwosoɔ na ɛtim hɔ daa.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ mmepɔ atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia no, saa ara na Awurade atwa ne nkurɔfoɔ ho ahyia seesei ne daa.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ ahempoma renka asase a wɔde ama teneneefoɔ so. Sɛ ɛba saa a, teneneefoɔ nam wɔn so bɛyɛ bɔne.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wɔn a wɔyɛ papa no, yɛ wɔn papa, wɔn a wɔtene wɔ akoma mu no, yɛ wɔn papa.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wɔmane fa akwan kɔntɔnkye so no deɛ, Awurade bɛpamo wɔn ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ. Asomdwoeɛ nka Israel.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a Awurade de Sion firi nnommum sane baeɛ no, yɛyɛɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔasoso adaeɛ.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Sereɛ hyɛɛ yɛn anomu ma, anigyeɛ nnwom yɛɛ yɛn tɛkrɛma so ma. Na wɔkaa wɔ amanaman no mu sɛ, “Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ ama wɔn.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ ama yɛn na anigyeɛ ahyɛ yɛn ma.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, sane fa yɛn ahonya ma yɛn, te sɛ nsuwa nsuwa a ɛwɔ Negeb no.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔdua no nisuo mu no de anigyeɛ nnwom bɛtwa.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔde osu firi adie na ɔsoa aba kɔdua no, ɔde anigyeɛ nnwom bɛsane aba a ɔso nnɔbaeɛ afiafi.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Sɛ Awurade ansi ɛdan no a, adansifoɔ no yɛ ho adwuma kwa. Sɛ Awurade ammɔ kuropɔn no ho ban a, awɛmfoɔ no wɛn kwa.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Ɔkwa ara na wosɔre anɔpahema na woyɛ adwumaden brɛ kɔsi anadwo, ansa na woanya wʼano aduane. Ɛyɛ kwa, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔn a ɔdɔ wɔn no, ɔma wɔda.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mmammarima yɛ agyapadeɛ a ɛfiri Awurade hɔ, na mma yɛ akatua a ɛfiri noɔ.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Mmammarima a wɔwo wɔn mmeranteberɛ mu no te sɛ agyan a ɛhyɛ ɔsraani nsam.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne onipa a nʼagyan kotokuo ayɛ ma. Wɔn anim rengu ase ɛberɛ a wɔahyia wɔn atamfoɔ wɔ kuro ɛpono ano.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade, na wɔnante nʼakwan so.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Wobɛdi wʼadwuma so aba; nhyira ne yiedie bɛyɛ wo dea.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Wo yere bɛyɛ sɛ bobe a ɛso aba wɔ wo fie; na wo mmammarima ayɛ sɛ ngo dua a afifiri atwa wo ɛpono ho ahyia.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Yei ne onipa a wɔahyira noɔ, deɛ ɔsuro Awurade no.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Awurade nhyira wo mfiri Sion wo nkwa nna nyinaa; na ɔmma wo nhunu Yerusalem nkɔsoɔ,

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: na ɔmma wo ntena ase nhunu wo mma mma. Asomdwoeɛ nka Israel.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: “Wɔahyɛ me so pii firi me mmɔfraase, ma Israel nka.

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Wɔahyɛ me so pii firi me mmɔfraase, nanso wɔntumi nnii me so nkonim.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Fentemfoɔ afentem mʼakyi ayɛ wɔn nkofie atentene.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Nanso Awurade yɛ ɔteneneeni; Watwitwa amumuyɛfoɔ nhoma afiri me ho.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Ma wɔn a wɔtan Sion nyinaa mfa animguaseɛ nsane wɔn akyi.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ɛserɛ a ɛwɔ ɔdan atifi, ɛnnyini na ahye;

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: Ɛremma otwafoɔ nya biribi wɔ ne nsam, na deɛ ɔboaboa ano nso renya hwee nʼabasa so.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mma wɔn a wɔtwam hɔ nnka sɛ, “Awurade nhyira mmra mo so; yɛhyira mo wɔ Awurade din mu.”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mefiri ebunu mu resu frɛ wo;

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Ao Awurade tie me nne. Wɛn wʼaso ma me nkotosrɛ.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, sɛ wobu yɛn bɔne ho nkonta a, anka hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina ano?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Nanso, wowɔ bɔnefakyɛ; ɛno enti wɔsuro wo.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Metwɛn Awurade, me kra twɛn, na nʼasɛm mu na mede mʼanidasoɔ ahyɛ.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Ao Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wɔ adɔeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ daa na ɔgyeɛ amapa wɔ ne mu.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Ɔno ankasa bɛgye Israel afiri wɔn bɔne nyinaa mu.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ahomasoɔ nni mʼakoma mu, na mʼani ntraa ntɔn; memma nsɛm akɛseɛ nha me anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwanwa dodo ma me.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Na mmom, mama me kra anya abotɔyam te sɛ akɔkoaa a ɔda ne maame so renum no, te sɛ akɔkoaa a ɔtua nufoɔ ano no, saa ara na me kra ayɛ wɔ me mu.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Ao Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so, seesei ne daa nyinaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade kae Dawid ne ɔhaw ahodoɔ a ɔgyinaa ano no.

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: Ɔkaa Awurade ntam na ɔhyɛɛ Yakob Otumfoɔ no bɔ sɛ,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Merenhyɛne me fie na merenkɔda me mpa so,

english_verse: or close my eyelids,
translation_verse: meremma nna mfa me na meremma mʼani nkum,

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: kɔsi sɛ menya baabi ama Awurade, baabi a Yakob Otumfoɔ no bɛtena.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Yɛtee wɔ Efrata, yɛbɛtoo so wɔ Yaar mfuo so.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: “Momma yɛnkɔ nʼatenaeɛ; momma yɛnsom wɔ ne nan ntiasoɔ hɔ.

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: ‘Ao Awurade, sɔre bra wʼahomegyebea, wo ne wo tumi Adaka no.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Ma tenenee nyɛ sɛ ntadeɛ mma wʼasɔfoɔ; ma wʼahotefoɔ nto ahurisie dwom.’ ”

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Wo ɔsomfoɔ Dawid enti, nyi wʼani mfiri deɛ woasra no ngo no so.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid, nokorɛ ntam a ɔrentwe nsane sɛ, “Wʼasefoɔ no mu baako na mede no bɛtena wʼahennwa so.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wo mmammarima di mʼapam so na wɔtie me nkyerɛkyerɛ a, ɛnneɛ wɔn mmammarima bɛtena wʼahennwa so afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Awurade ayi Sion, ɔde hɔ ayɛ nʼatenaeɛ:

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: “Ɛha ne mʼahomegyebea daa nyinaa; ɛha na mɛtena adi ɔhene, ɛfiri sɛ ɛha na mepɛ,

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: mede nneɛma pa bebree bɛhyira no na mama nʼahiafoɔ adidi amee.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Mede nkwagyeɛ bɛfira nʼasɔfoɔ na nʼahotefoɔ ato ahurisie dwom daa.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: “Mɛma ɔberempɔn bi apue wɔ Dawid ahennie mu na mede kanea asi hɔ ama deɛ masra no ngo no.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Mede aniwuo bɛfira nʼatamfoɔ, nanso nʼahenkyɛ bɛhyerɛn wɔ ne tiri so.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Hwɛ ɛyɛ a ɛyɛ ne fɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ sɛ anuanom bom tena faako!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Ɛte sɛ ngo a ɛsom bo a wɔahwie agu apampam, na ɛsiane kɔgu bɔgyesɛ mu, ɛsiane kɔgu Aaron bɔgyesɛ mu, ma ebi kɔgu nʼatadeɛ abakɔn so.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Ɛte sɛ Hermon bosuo a ɛtɔ gu Bepɔ Sion so. Ɛhɔ na Awurade ahyɛ ne nhyira, nkwa a ɛtoɔ ntwa da no.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Awurade asomfoɔ nyinaa, monkamfo Awurade, mo a mosom wɔ Awurade fie anadwo nyinaa.

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Momma mo nsa so wɔ kronkronbea hɔ na monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Awurade a ɔbɔɔ soro ne asase no, mfiri Sion nhyira mo.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Monkamfo Awurade din; monkamfo no, mo Awurade asomfoɔ,

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: mo a mosom wɔ Awurade fie, wɔ adihɔ a ɛwɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn fie.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ; monto ayɛyie dwom mma ne din, na ɛno na ɛyɛ anisɔ.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Awurade ayi Yakob sɛ ɔnyɛ ne deɛ, wayi Israel sɛ nʼadeɛ a ɛsom bo.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Menim sɛ Awurade so; Ɔso sene anyame nyinaa.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ deɛ ɔpɛ biara, wɔ ɔsoro ne asase so, ɛpo ne emu abunu nyinaa.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Ɔma omununkum ma ne ho so firi asase ano ba; ɔsoma anyinam ka osutɔ ho na ɔma ahum tu firi nʼakoradan mu.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔkumm Misraim mmakan, nnipa ne mmoa mmakan.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Ɔsomaa ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne nʼanwanwadeɛ baa mo mfimfini, Ao Misraim, de tiaa Farao ne nʼasomfoɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Ɔsɛee amanaman pii na ɔkunkumm ahemfo akɛseɛ,

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Amorifoɔ ɔhene, Sihon Basan ɔhene, Og ne Kanaan ahemfo nyinaa,

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: na ɔde wɔn nsase maa sɛ agyapadeɛ; ɔde maa ne nkurɔfoɔ Israelfoɔ.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wo din wɔ hɔ daa. Ao Awurade wo din ahyeta awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛdi ama ne nkurɔfoɔ na ɔbɛhunu nʼasomfoɔ mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Amanaman no ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a wɔde onipa nsa na ayɛ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wɔntumi nkasa, wɔwɔ ani, nanso wɔnhunu adeɛ;

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm, na ahomeɛ nso nni wɔn anom.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ ahoni no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara, saa ara na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so no bɛyɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade, Ao Israel fiefoɔ; monkamfo Awurade, Ao Aaron fiefoɔ;

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: monkamfo Awurade, Ao Lewi fiefoɔ; monkamfo Awurade, mo a mosuro no.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Momfiri Sion nkamfo Awurade, monkamfo deɛ ɔte Yerusalem no. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna Awurade ase na ɔyɛ. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna anyame mu Onyankopɔn ase. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna awuranom mu Awurade no ase. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno nko ara na ɔyɛ anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔfiri ne nteaseɛ mu bɔɔ ɔsoro. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔtrɛɛ asase mu de kataa nsuo so. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔbɔɔ nkanea akɛseɛ no. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔɔ owia sɛ ɛnni adekyeeɛ so. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔɔ ɔsrane ne nsoromma sɛ wɔnni adesaeɛ so no. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔkunkumm Misraimfoɔ mmakan, Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na ɔyii Israelfoɔ firii wɔn mu no. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔde nsa kɛseɛ ne basa a watene mu. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔpaee Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no mu no, Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na ɔde Israelfoɔ faa mfimfini no. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nanso, ɔpraa Farao ne nʼasraafoɔ guu Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ mu no. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔdii ne nkurɔfoɔ anim wɔ ɛserɛ no so. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔkumm ahemfo akɛseɛ no, Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na ɔkumm ahemfo akunini no. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔkumm Amorifoɔ ɔhene, Sihon, Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ne Basanhene, Og. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Na ɔde wɔn nsase maa sɛ agyapadeɛ. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔde maa ne ɔsomfoɔ Israel sɛ agyapadeɛ. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔkaee yɛn, yɛn mmerɛyɛ mu. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Na ɔgyee yɛn firii yɛn atamfoɔ nsam. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔno na ɔma abɔdeɛ biara aduane. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Monna ɔsorosoro Onyankopɔn no ase. Nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Babilonia nsubɔntene ho, ɛhɔ na yɛtena suiɛ ɛberɛ a yɛkaee Sion no.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔ nsukakye nnua so na yɛde yɛn asankuo sensɛneeɛ,

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: ɛhɔ na yɛn nnommumfafoɔ bisaa yɛn nnwom, yɛn ahohiahiafoɔ pɛɛ yɛn hɔ ahurisie nnwom; wɔkaa sɛ, “Monto Sion nnwom baako mma yɛn!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛatumi ato Awurade nnwom ɛberɛ a yɛwɔ ananafoɔ asase so?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalem, sɛ mewerɛ firi wo a ma me nsa nifa werɛ mfiri sankubɔ.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Sɛ mankae wo sɛ mʼanigyedeɛ kɛseɛ pa ara a, ma me tɛkrɛma nka mfam mʼanomu.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, kae deɛ Edomfoɔ yɛeɛ wɔ ɛda a Yerusalem hwee ase no. Wɔteam sɛ, “Monnwiri, monnwiri ngu fam nkɔka nʼafapem!”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Ao Babilonia babaa a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛsɛe wo, nhyira nka deɛ ɔtua wo ka wɔ deɛ wode ayɛ yɛn so.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Nhyira nka deɛ ɔkyekyee wo nkokoaa de wɔn bobɔɔ abotan so.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mɛfiri mʼakoma nyinaa mu ayi wo ayɛ; mɛto wʼayɛyie dwom wɔ anyame no anim.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Mede mʼani bɛkyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no, akoto wo na makamfo wo din wɔ wʼadɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛdie enti ɛfiri sɛ wɔapagya wo din ne wʼasɛm no asene nneɛma nyinaa.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Ɛberɛ a mesu mefrɛɛ wo no, wogyee me so; womaa me nyaa akokoɔduru ne nnamyɛ.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, sɛ ahemfo a ɛwɔ ewiase nyinaa te wʼanomu asɛm a ma wɔn nkamfo wo.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnto Awurade akwan ho nnwom, na Awurade animuonyam yɛ kɛseɛ.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ Awurade wɔ ɔsorosoro deɛ, nanso ɔhwɛ mmɔborɔfoɔ, na ahantanfoɔ deɛ, ɔhunu wɔn akyirikyiri.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ menam ɔhaw mu deɛ, nanso wobɔ me nkwa ho ban; wotene wo nsa wɔ mʼatamfoɔ abufuo so, na wode wo nsa nifa gye me nkwa.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Awurade bɛma deɛ wahyehyɛ ama me no aba mu; Ao Awurade, wʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa, nnyaa wo nsa ano adwuma hɔ. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, woahwehwɛ me mu na woahunu me.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Wonim mʼasetena ne me sɔreɛ; wofiri akyirikyiri hunu mʼadwene mu.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Wonim mʼadifirie ne me nnaeɛ; wonim mʼakwan nyinaa.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Ansa na mɛbue mʼano akasa no Ao Awurade, na wonim ne nyinaa dada.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Woatwa me ho nyinaa ahyia na wobɔ me ho ban.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Saa nimdeɛ yi boro me nteaseɛ so, ɛyɛ me nwanwa dodo.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Ɛhe na mɛtumi afiri wo honhom anim akorɔ? Ɛhe na mɛtumi adwane afiri wʼanim akorɔ?

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Sɛ mede adekyeeɛ ntaban tu na mekɔtena ɛpo akyi nohoa a,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: mpo ɛhɔ na wo nsa bɛgya me akɔ, na wo nsa nifa bɛsɔ me mu.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Na meka sɛ, “Ampa ara esum mmɛkata me so na hann nnane adesaeɛ ntwa me ho nhyia a,”

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: esum mpo nnyɛ sum mma wo; na anadwo bɛhyerɛn sɛ awia; esum ne hann yɛ wo pɛ.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Na wo na wobɔɔ me honhom wonwonoo me wɔ me maame awotwaa mu.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Mekamfo wo, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛɛ me anwanwakwan so a ɛyɛ hu. Wo nnwuma yɛ nwanwa. Menim ɛno yie pa ara.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Wɔamfa me bɔberɛ anhinta wo ɛberɛ a wɔyɛɛ me kɔkoam no; ɛberɛ a wɔnwonoo me asase yam no,

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: wʼani hunuu me ɛberɛ a meyɛ mogya toa no. Nna dodoɔ a woatwa ama me no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ wo nwoma mu ansa na emu baako reba mu.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, wo nsusuiɛ som bo ma me! Woka ne nyinaa bɔ mu a, ɛso dodo!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Sɛ mese mɛkan a, ne dodoɔ bɛboro mpoano anwea, sɛ menyane a, me ne wo wɔ hɔ ara.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, sɛ anka wobɛkumkum amumuyɛfoɔ a! Momfiri me so, mo mogyapɛfoɔ!

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Wɔde adwemmɔne ka wo ho asɛm; wʼatamfoɔ mmɔ wo din pa.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, metane wɔn a wɔtane wo, na mekyiri wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ.

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Menni hwee sɛ ɔtan a mewɔ ma wɔn; mefa wɔn sɛ mʼatamfoɔ.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Hwehwɛ me mu, Ao Onyankopɔn, na hunu mʼakoma; sɔ me hwɛ na hunu mʼadwene.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Hwɛ sɛ bɔne bi wɔ me mu a, na fa me fa ɛkwan a ɛkɔ daa nkwa so. Wɔde ma dwomkyerɛfoɔ.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Ao Awurade gye me firi nnipa bɔne nsam; bɔ me ho ban firi basabasayɛfoɔ nsam,

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔdwene bɔne wɔ wɔn akoma mu na wɔhwanyane ɔko mu da biara.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Wɔse wɔn tɛkrɛma ano te sɛ ɔtweaseɛ deɛ; ananka borɔ wɔ wɔn ano.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, yi me firi amumuyɛfoɔ nsam; bɔ me ho ban firi basabasayɛfoɔ a wɔdwene sɛ wɔbɛtwintwan mʼanan mu.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Ahantanfoɔ asum me afidie; wɔatrɛtrɛ wɔn asau nhoma mu, wɔasunsum me mfidie wɔ me kwan so.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, meka kyerɛ wo sɛ, “Wone me Onyankopɔn.” Ao Awurade, tie me mmɔborɔ su.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade, me gyefoɔ ɔhoɔdenfoɔ a wobɔ me tiri ban ɔko da,

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: nyɛ amumuyɛfoɔ abisadeɛ mma wɔn, Ao Awurade; mma wɔn nhyehyɛeɛ nyɛ yie.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Wɔatwa me ho ahyia, nanso, ma amumuyɛsɛm a ɛfiri wɔn anomu nsɛe wɔn.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Ma nnyasrama ngu wɔn so; ma wɔnto wɔn ngu ogya mu, ngu atɛkyɛ amena mu a wɔrensɔre bio.

english_verse: Chase those cruel liars away! Let trouble hunt them down.
translation_verse: Mma dinsɛefoɔ ntim asase no so; ma amanehunu ntaataa basabasayɛfoɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Menim sɛ Awurade bu ahiafoɔ atɛntenenee na ɔka onnibie asɛm ma no.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Ampa ara, teneneefoɔ bɛkamfo wo din na wɔn a wɔnam tee no bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mesu mefrɛ wo, bra me nkyɛn ntɛm so. Sɛ mesu mefrɛ wo a, gye me so.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ma me mpaeɛbɔ mmra wʼanim sɛ aduhwam; ma me nsa a mapagya nyɛ sɛ anwummerɛ afɔrebɔ.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, ma ɔwɛmfoɔ nwɛn mʼano; na wɛn mʼano ɛpono.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Mma wɔnntwe mʼakoma nkɔ deɛ ɛyɛ bɔne ho, na ankɔyɛ deɛ amumuyɛfoɔ yɛ no bi; mma me ne abɔnefoɔ nni wɔn nnɔkɔnnɔkɔwadeɛ.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Ma ɔteneneeni mmɔ me, ɛyɛ ayamyɛ; ma ɔnka mʼanim, ɛyɛ me tiri so ngo. Me tiri rempo. Me mpaeɛbɔ da so tia abɔnefoɔ nneyɛɛ daa.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Wɔbɛto wɔn sodifoɔ afiri abotan so abɛhwe fam; na amumuyɛfoɔ bɛhunu sɛ me nsɛm no yɛ nokorɛ.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka sɛ, “Sɛdeɛ obi funtum na ɔtutu asase no, saa ara na wɔabɔ yɛn nnompe ahwete ɛda ano.”

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Nanso, Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade, wo so na mʼani da; wo mu na mehinta. Nnya me mma owuo.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Bɔ me ho ban firi mfidie a wɔasunsum me no mu, mfidie a abɔnefoɔ asunsum no.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Ma amumuyɛfoɔ no ankasa atena nyi wɔn, na menkɔ me baabi asomdwoeɛ mu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Meteam mesu frɛ Awurade; me ma me nne so su frɛ Awurade sɛ ɔnhunu me mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Mehwie mʼahiasɛm megu nʼanim; meka me haw kyerɛ no.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Sɛ me ɔkra tɔ baha wɔ me mu a, ɛyɛ wo na wonim mʼakwan. Ɛkwan a menam so no nnipa asum me afidie wɔ so.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Hwɛ me nifa so na hunu sɛ; mʼasɛm mfa obiara ho; menni dwanekɔbea bi; me nkwa mfa obiara ho.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, mesu mefrɛ wo; mese, “Wone me dwanekɔbea, me kyɛfa wɔ ateasefoɔ asase so.”

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Yi me firi me nneduadan mu, na makamfo wo din. Afei teneneefoɔ bɛtwa me ho ahyia ɛsiane wo papa a woayɛ me enti.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, tie me mpaeɛbɔ, tie me nkotosrɛ; wɔ wo nokorɛdie ne tenenee mu bra bɛboa me.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Mfa wʼakoa nkɔ atemmuo mu, na ɔteasefoɔ biara ntene wɔ wʼanim.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Ɔtamfoɔ no taa me, ɔbɔ me hwe fam; ɔma me tena esum mu te sɛ wɔn a wɔawuwu dadaada.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Ɛno enti me honhom atɔ piti wɔ me mu; na mʼakoma aba mu abu wɔ me mu.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Mekae tete nna no; medwendwene wo nnwuma ne deɛ wo nsa ayɛ nyinaa ho.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Mepagya me nsa kyerɛ wo; wo ho sukɔm de me kra sɛ asase wesee.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, gye me so ntɛm; me honhom tɔ piti. Mfa wʼanim nhinta me anyɛ saa a, mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔkɔ amena mu no.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Ma mente wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no ho asɛm daa anɔpa, na mede me ho ato wo so. Kyerɛ me ɛkwan a memfa so, na wo na mema me kra so kyerɛ.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade gye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam, na wo mu na mede me ho hinta.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ me na menyɛ wʼapɛdeɛ, na wo ne me Onyankopɔn; ma wo honhom pa no nni me ɛkan wɔ asase tamaa so.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wo din enti, kyɛe me nkwa so; wo tenenee mu, yi me firi ɔhaw mu.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔ wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no mu, yi mʼatamfoɔ hɔ; na sɛe wɔn a wɔkyiri me nyinaa, na meyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Nkamfoɔ nka Awurade, me Botan, deɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ me nsa akodie, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ me nsateaa akodie.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ mʼadɔeɛ Onyankopɔn ne mʼaban, mʼabandenden ne me ɔgyefoɔ, me kyɛm a mewɔ dwanekɔbea wɔ ne mu; ɔno na ɔka nnipa hyɛ mʼase.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, hwan ne onipa, a wʼani ku ne ho? Hwan ne onipa ba, a wodwene ne ho yi?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Onipa te sɛ ahomeɛ; ne nna te sɛ sunsum a ɛretwam.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, firi ɔsoro hɔ na siane bra fam; fa wo nsa ka mmepɔ, na ɛmfiri wisie.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Soma anyinam na bɔ atamfoɔ no hwete; to wo mmemma no ma wɔn nnwane.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Tene wo nsa firi soro bra fam; gye me na yi me firi nsuo akɛseɛ ho, firi ananafoɔ nsam,

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: wɔn a atorɔ ayɛ wɔn anomu ma, na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nnaadaa.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Ao Onyankopɔn, mɛto dwom foforɔ ama wo; mɛto dwom wɔ sankuo a nhoma edu gu soɔ so ama wo,

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: ama Ɔbaako a ɔde nkonimdie ma ahemfo, na ɔgye ne ɔsomfoɔ Dawid firi akofena kɔdiawuo ano.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Gye me na yi me firi ananafoɔ nsam, wɔn a atorɔ ayɛ wɔn anomu ma na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nnaadaa.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Afei yɛn mmammarima mmeranteberɛ bɛyɛ sɛ afifideɛ a wɔahwɛ so yie, na yɛn mmammaa bɛyɛ sɛ adum a wɔasene de asiesie ahemfie.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Yɛn asan bɛyɛ ma. Aduane ahodoɔ biara bɛba mu bi. Yɛn nnwan bɛdɔɔso ayɛ mpem mpem, ayɛ mpemdu du wɔ yɛn mfuo so;

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: yɛn anantwie bɛtwe nnuane a ɛdɔɔso na emu yɛ duru. Obiara rentumi nnwiri yɛn afasuo ngu; yɛrenkɔ nkoasom mu, na agyaadwotwa remma yɛn mmɔntene so.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka nnipa a ɛbɛba mu saa ama wɔn. Nhyira nka nnipa a wɔn Onyankopɔn ne Awurade.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Mɛma wo so, me Onyankopɔn, me Ɔhene; mɛkamfo wo din daa daa.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Ɛda biara, mɛkamfo wo; na mama wo din so daa daa.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Awurade so, na ɔsɛ nkamfo kɛseɛ; obiara rentumi nsusu ne kɛseyɛ.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ baako bɛkamfo wo nnwuma akyerɛ ɔfoforɔ; wɔbɛka wo nnwuma akɛseɛ ho asɛm.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka wʼanimuonyam ne wo tumi a ɛhran no ho asɛm, na mɛdwene wʼanwanwadwuma ho.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka wo nnwuma a ɛyɛ hu no mu tumi ho asɛm; na mapae mu aka wo nneyɛɛ akɛseɛ no akyerɛ.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛhyɛ wo papayɛ mmorosoɔ no ho fa, na wɔde anigyeɛ ato wo tenenee ho dwom.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ; ne bo kyɛre fu na nʼadɔeɛ dɔɔso.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ ma obiara; na ɔwɔ ahummɔborɔ ma nʼabɔdeɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Ao Awurade, wʼabɔdeɛ nyinaa bɛkamfo wo; na wʼahotefoɔ bɛma wo so.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛka wʼahennie no animuonyam ho asɛm na wɔaka wo mmaninyɛ ho asɛm,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nnipa bɛhunu wo nnwuma akɛseɛ ne wʼahennie animuonyam a ɛhran no.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Wʼahennie yɛ daa ahennie, na wo tumidie wɔ hɔ ma awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ nyinaa. Awurade di ne bɔhyɛ nyinaa so, na ɔwɔ ɔdɔ ma biribiara a wayɛ.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Awurade wowa wɔn a wɔhwe ase na ɔpagya wɔn a wɔn nnesoa ama wɔakom.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Ani nyinaa hwɛ wo ɛkwan, na woma wɔn wɔn aduane wɔ ne berɛ mu.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Wobue wo nsam na woma biribiara a ɛwɔ nkwa no nʼapɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Awurade tene wɔ nʼakwan nyinaa mu; na ɔyɛ adɔeɛ ma deɛ wayɛ nyinaa.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa, wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nokorɛ mu nyinaa.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no no apɛdeɛ ma wɔn; ɔtie wɔn sufrɛ na ɔgye wɔn.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Awurade hwɛ wɔn a wɔdɔ no nyinaa so, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ deɛ, ɔbɛsɛe wɔn nyinaa.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Mʼano bɛkamfo Awurade. Ma abɔdeɛ nyinaa nkamfo ne din kronkron no daa daa.

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Mɛkamfo Awurade me nkwa nna nyinaa; mɛto ayɛyi dwom ama me Onyankopɔn, sɛ mete ase yi.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Mommfa mo ho nto mmapɔmma so, adasamma a wɔrentumi nnye nkwa.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔn honhom tu kɔ a, wɔsane kɔ dɔteɛ mu, saa da no ara wɔn nsusuiɛ nyinaa yɛ kwa.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne deɛ ne ɔboafoɔ ne Yakob Onyankopɔn, deɛ nʼanidasoɔ wɔ Awurade, ne Onyankopɔn mu.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Ɔno ne ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfoɔ, ɛpo ne biribiara a ɛwɔ mu nyinaa Awurade a ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ daa no.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: Ɔdi ma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so, na ɔma wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn aduane. Awurade gyaa nneduafoɔ,

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Awurade ma anifirafoɔ hunu adeɛ. Awurade pagya wɔn a wɔakom. Awurade dɔ teneneefoɔ.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Awurade hwɛ ahɔhoɔ so na ɔwowa nwisiaa ne akunafoɔ, na amumuyɛfoɔ akwan deɛ, ɔdane ani.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Sion, Awurade wo Onyankopɔn di ɔhene daa daa, wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔto ayɛyie dwom ma yɛn Onyankopɔn, ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛfata sɛ wɔkamfo no!

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Awurade kyekyere Yerusalem; Ɔboaboa Israel nnommumfoɔ ano.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Ɔsa wɔn a wɔn akoma abotoɔ yadeɛ na ɔkyekyere wɔn akuro.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Ɔnim nsoromma no dodoɔ na ɔde obiara din frɛ no.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Yɛn Awurade so, na ne tumi yɛ kɛseɛ; yɛrente nʼase nwie.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Awurade wowa ahobrɛasefoɔ na ɔtoto amumuyɛfoɔ hwe fam.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Monto aseda nnwom mma Awurade. Momfa sankuo nto dwom mma yɛn Onyankopɔn.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Ɔde omununkum kata ɔsoro ani; ɔde osutɔ ma asase ma ɛserɛ nyini wɔ nkokoɔ so.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Ɔma anantwie aduane na sɛ anene mma su a, ɔma wɔn aduane.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ ɔpɔnkɔ ahoɔden na nʼani sɔ na ɛnyɛ onipa ahoɔden nso.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Na mmom, Awurade ani sɔ nnipa a wɔsuro no, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no so no.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Momma Awurade so, Ao Yerusalem; kamfo wo Onyankopɔn, Ao Sion,

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: ɔma wʼapono akyi adaban yɛ den na ɔhyira wo nkurɔfoɔ a wɔte wo mu.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ɔma wʼahyeɛ so dwo na ɔde ayuo amapa ma wo.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Ɔsoma nʼahyɛdeɛ kɔ asase so; nʼasɛm tu mmirika ntɛm so.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛ sukyerɛmma mu sɛ odwan ho nwi, na ɔpete obosuo nsukyeneeɛ sɛ nsõ.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Ɔtoto asukɔtweaa gu fam sɛ mmosea. Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina nʼawɔ denden no ano?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Ɔsoma nʼasɛm no ma ɛnane no; ɔhwanyane ne mframa, na nsuo tene.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Wada nʼasɛm adi akyerɛ Yakob, ne mmara ne ɔhyɛ nsɛm akyerɛ Israel.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔnyɛɛ yei mmaa aman foforɔ biara; wɔnnim ne mmara. Monkamfo Awurade!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade! Monkamfo Awurade mfiri ɔsorosoro, monkamfo no wɔ ɔsoro sorɔnsorɔmmea.

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nʼabɔfoɔ nyinaa, monkamfo no, ne ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, monkamfo no.

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Owia ne ɔsrane, monkamfo no, nsoromma a ɛhran nyinaa, monkamfo no.

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Monkamfo no, ɔsoro mu ɔsoro ne mo nsuo a mowɔ ɔsoro atifi.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Momma wɔn nyinaa nkamfo Awurade din, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔhyɛeɛ na wɔbɔɔ wɔn.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɔde wɔn sisii hɔ afebɔɔ; na wahyɛ nʼasɛm a ɛrentwam da.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade mfiri asase so, mo, ɛpo kɛseɛ mu abɔdeɛ ne ɛpo bunu nyinaa,

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: anyinam ne asukɔtweaa, sukyerɛmma ne omununkum, ahum a moyɛ nʼapɛdeɛ,

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: mo, mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ nyinaa, nnua a ɛso aba ne ntweneduro nyinaa,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: wira mu mmoa ne anantwie, abɔdeɛ nketewa ne nnomaa a wɔtuo,

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: asase ne amanaman nyinaa so ahemfo, mo, mmapɔmma ne asase sodifoɔ nyinaa,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa mmasiriwa ne mmɔfra nso.

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Ma wɔnkamfo Awurade din, na ne din so sene edin biara; nʼanimuonyam korɔn wɔ asase ne ɔsoro so.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Wapagya abɛn bi ama ne nkurɔfoɔ, ama nʼahotefoɔ nyinaa animuonyam, Israelfoɔ, nnipa a wɔda nʼakoma so no. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade, monkamfo no wɔ ahotefoɔ asafo mu.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Ma Israel ani nnye ne Yɛfoɔ mu. Ma Sion mma ani nnye wɔn Ɔhene mu.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Ma wɔmfa asa nkamfo ne din na wɔmfa sankuo ne akasaeɛ nto dwom mma no.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Na Awurade ani sɔ ne nkurɔfoɔ; ɔde nkwagyeɛ kyɛ hyɛ ahobrɛasefoɔ.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Momma ahotefoɔ nni ahurisie wɔ animuonyam yi mu; na wɔnto ahosɛpɛ dwom wɔ wɔn mpa so.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn nkamfo nhyɛ wɔn anomu na ɛnyɛ akofena anofanu wɔ wɔn nsam,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nkyekyere wɔn ahemfo, ne dadeɛ mpɔkyerɛ ngu wɔn atitire,

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: sɛ wɔmfa mmu atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ atia wɔn no. Yei ne nʼahotefoɔ nyinaa animuonyam. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Monkamfo Awurade. Monkamfo Awurade wɔ ne kronkronbea; monkamfo no wɔ ɔsoro tumi mu.

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Monkamfo no wɔ ne tumi mu nneyɛɛ ho; monkamfo no wɔ ne kɛseyɛ a ɛboro biribiara soɔ ho.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Momfa totorobɛnto nnyegyeeɛ nkamfo no, momfa asankuo ne bɛnta nkamfo no,

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: momfa akasaeɛ ne asa nkamfo no, momfa sankuten ne atɛntɛbɛn nkamfo no,

english_verse: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
translation_verse: momfa kyankyan mmobɔmu so nkamfo no, momfa kyankyan nnyegyeeɛ nkamfo no.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Momma deɛ ɛhome nyinaa nkamfo Awurade. Monkamfo Awurade.

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛkyerɛ nnipa nyansa ne ahohyɛsoɔ; ne sɛ ɛbɛboa ma wɔate nsɛm a emu dɔ ase;

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: sɛ wɔbɛnya ahohyɛsoɔ na wɔabɔ ɔbra pa, a ɛbɛma wɔayɛ ade pa, deɛ ɛtene na ɛho nni asɛm;

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛbɛma deɛ nʼadwene mu nnɔ anya nyansa na mmabunu anya nimdeɛ ne adwene.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Anyansafoɔ ntie na wɔmfa nka deɛ wɔnim ho, na deɛ ɔwɔ nhunumu nya akwankyerɛ a

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: ɛbɛma woate mmɛ ne akasabɛbuo, anyansafoɔ nsɛnka ne aborɔme ase.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ nimdeɛ ahyɛaseɛ, na nkwaseafoɔ bu nyansa ne ahohyɛsoɔ animtiaa. Nyansa Pɛ Ho Afutusɛm Nnaadaa Ho Kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Me ba, tie wʼagya akwankyerɛ na mpo wo maame nkyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Ɛbɛyɛ wo tiri animuonyam abotire ne wo kɔn mu ntweaban.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ daadaa wo a, mma wɔn ho ɛkwan.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔka sɛ, “Bra ma yɛnkɔ; ma yɛnkɔtetɛ na yɛnkum obi, ma yɛnkɔtɛ ntwɛn mmɔborɔni bi;

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: ma yɛmmemmene wɔn anikann sɛ ɛda, yɛmmene wɔn sɛ wɔn a wɔkɔ damena mu;

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: yɛbɛnya nneɛma a ɛsom bo ahodoɔ na yɛde afodeɛ ahyɛ yɛn afie ma;

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: enti, fa wo ho bɛhyɛ mu, na wobɛnya wo kyɛfa wɔ ahonyadeɛ no mu” a,

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: Me ba, wo ne wɔn nnante, mfa wo nan nsi wɔn akwan so;

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Wɔn nan de ntɛmpɛ kɔ bɔne mu, na wɔde ahoɔherɛ ka mogya gu.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Ɛho nni mfasoɔ sɛ obi bɛsum nnomaafidie wɔ ɛberɛ a nnomaa nyinaa hwɛ!

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Saa nnipa yi tetɛ pɛ wɔn ankasa mogya; wɔtetɛ wɔn ankasa wɔn ho!

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Saa na wɔn a wɔdi korɔnodeɛ akyi no awieeɛ teɛ; ɛma wɔhwere wɔn nkwa! Nyansa A Wɔpo Ho Kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Nyansa team wɔ mmɔntene so, ɔma ne nne so wɔ adwaberem,

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: ɔteaam wɔ afasuo no atifi, ɔkasa wɔ kuropɔn no apono ano sɛ,

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Mo adwenemherɛfoɔ, mobɛyɛ adwenemherɛ akɔsi da bɛn? Fɛdifoɔ bɛdi fɛ akɔsi da bɛn? Nkwaseafoɔ bɛkyiri nimdeɛ akɔsi da bɛn?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Sɛ motiee mʼaninka a, anka mekaa mʼakoma mu nsɛm nyinaa kyerɛɛ mo maa mo hunuu me nsusuiɛ.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: sɛ mopoo mʼafotuo, na moampɛ mʼanimka enti,

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: sɛ abɛbrɛsɛ bi bu fa mo so te sɛ ahum, na amanehunu bi bɔ fa mo so sɛ twahoframa, na awerɛhoɔ ne ɔhaw mene mo a,

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: “Afei mobɛfrɛ me, nanso meremmua mo; mobɛhwehwɛ me, nanso morenhunu me.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ wɔkyirii nimdeɛ na wɔampɛ sɛ wobɛsuro Awurade.

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Esiane sɛ w ɔpoo mʼafotuo, na wɔbuu me ntenesoɔ animtiaa enti,

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: wɔbɛdi wɔn akwan so aba na wɔn nhyehyɛeɛ mu aduane bɛmee wɔn.

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: Na ntetekwaafoɔ asoɔden bɛkum wɔn, na nkwaseafoɔ tirimudɛ bɛsɛe wɔn;

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Nanso, obiara a ɔbɛtie me no, ɔbɛtena ase asomdwoeɛ mu na ne ho bɛtɔ no a ɔrensuro ɔhaw biara.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ wotie me nsɛm, na woma me nkyerɛkyerɛ tena wo mu a,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: sɛ wowɛn wʼaso ma nyansa na wode wʼakoma ma nteaseɛ,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: na woma wo nne so frɛ nhunumu na wosu frɛ nteaseɛ,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: na sɛ wohwehwɛ no te sɛ deɛ wohwehwɛ dwetɛ na wo hwehwɛ no sɛdeɛ worepɛ ademudeɛ a ahinta a,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ɛno na wobɛte Awurade suro ase na woahunu Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Awurade ma nimdeɛ, na nʼanom na nyansa ne nteaseɛ firi ba.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Ɔkora nkonimdie ma wɔn a wɔteneɛ, ɔyɛ kyɛm ma wɔn a wɔn akwan yɛ pɛ,

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: ɔwɛn deɛ ɔtene akwan, na ɔbɔ wɔn a wɔdi no nokorɛ no akwan ho ban.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ɛno na wobɛte deɛ ɛyɛ ne deɛ ɛyɛ pɛ ne deɛ ɛfata, ɛkwan biara a ɛyɛ ase.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Afei nyansa bɛwura wʼakoma mu, na nimdeɛ ayɛ ahomeka ama wo kra.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Adwene bɛbɔ wo ho ban na nteaseɛ ahwɛ wo so.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Nyansa bɛyi wo afiri amumuyɛfoɔ akwan mu, ɛbɛyi wo afiri nnipa a wɔn nsɛm yɛ basabasa nsam,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: na wɔmane firi akwan pa so kɔnante esum akwan so,

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔn ani gye bɔneyɛ ho, na wɔdi ahurisie wɔ bɔne mu basabasayɛ ho,

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔn akwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye na wɔyɛ abonsamfoɔ wɔ wɔn akwan mu.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Nimdeɛ bɛgye wo afiri ɔbaa waresɛefoɔ no nsam, afiri ɔbaa warefoɔ sansani a ɔka nnaadaasɛm ho,

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: deɛ wagyaa ne mmabaawaberɛ mu kunu na wapo apam a ɔyɛɛ wɔ Onyankopɔn anim no.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ne fie yɛ ɛkwan a ɛkɔ owuo mu na nʼakwan kɔ awufoɔ honhom nkyɛn.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔkɔ ne nkyɛn no nsane mma anaasɛ ɔrensi nkwa akwan so.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Enti wobɛdi nnipa pa anammɔn akyi na woanante ateneneefoɔ akwan so.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔtene bɛtena asase no so, na wɔn a asɛm nni wɔn ho no na wɔbɛka hɔ;

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: na wɔbɛtwa amumuyɛfoɔ afiri asase no so, na wɔatɔre atorofoɔ ase.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Me ba, mma wo werɛ mfiri me nkyerɛkyerɛ, kora me mmara yi wɔ wʼakoma mu,

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: na ɛbɛma wo nkwa aware, mfeɛ bebree na ɛde yiedie abrɛ wo.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Mma adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ mfiri wo nkyɛn fa yane wo kɔn mu twerɛ gu wʼakoma ɛpono so.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Na wobɛnya adom ne din pa wɔ Onyankopɔn ne nnipa anim.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Fa wʼakoma nyinaa to Awurade so na mmfa wo ho nto wʼankasa nteaseɛ so;

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: hunu no wʼakwan nyinaa mu, na ɔbɛtene wʼakwan.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Nnye wo ho nni sɛ woyɛ onyansafoɔ suro Awurade na kyiri bɔne.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Ɛde ahoɔden bɛbrɛ wo onipadua na ayɛ aduane ama wo nnompe.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Fa wʼahonya hyɛ Awurade animuonyam, ne wo nnɔbaeɛ a ɛdi ɛkan nyinaa;

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: na ɛno na ɛbɛma wo pata ayɛ ma abu so, na nsã foforɔ abu afa wʼankorɛ so

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ Awurade tene wo so a, tie no yie, na sɛ ɔka wʼanim a, mpa aba,

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ, obiara a Awurade pɛ nʼasɛm no, ɔtwe nʼaso, sɛdeɛ agya tene ɔba a ɔdɔ no so no.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka onipa a ɔhunu nyansa, onipa a ɔnya nteaseɛ,

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, nimdeɛ ho mfasoɔ sene dwetɛ, na deɛ ɛfiri mu ba sene sikakɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Ne boɔ yɛ dene sene bota; na worentumi mfa wʼapɛdeɛ biara ntoto ho.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Nkwa tenten wɔ ne nsa nifa mu; ahonyadeɛ ne animuonyam wɔ ne nsa benkum mu.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Nʼakwan yɛ ahomeka, na nʼasa nyinaa yɛ asomdwoeɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ nkwa dua ma wɔn a wɔsɔ ne mu; wɔn a wɔkura ne mu no bɛnya nhyira.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nyansa mu na Awurade yɛɛ asase fapem, na nteaseɛ mu na ɔde ɔsoro timii hɔ.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri ne nimdeɛ mu na ɔkyekyɛɛ ebunu mu, na omununkum nso tɔɔ bosuo.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Me ba, fa atemmuo pa ne nhunumu sie, na mma ɛmfiri wʼani so;

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: ɛbɛyɛ nkwa ama wo, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛma wɔ kɔn nya animuonyam.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Afei wo kwan so bɛyɛ wo dwoodwoo, na wo nan rensunti;

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: sɛ woda a worensuro; sɛ woda a wʼani bɛkum.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Nsuro mpofirim amanehunu anaa ɔsɛeɛ a ɛba amumuyɛfoɔ so,

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade bɛyɛ wʼawerɛhyɛm na ɔbɛkora wo nan afiri afidie mu.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Mfa ade pa nkame wɔn a wɔfata, ɛberɛ a tumi wɔ wo nsam.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Nka nkyerɛ wo yɔnko sɛ: “Kɔ na bra; mede bɛma wo ɔkyena” wɔ ɛberɛ a wowɔ no saa ɛberɛ no.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Mpam ɔhaw mma wo yɔnko ɛberɛ a ɔne wo te yie.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Mfa ɛso nto obi so kwa ɛberɛ a ɔnyɛɛ wo bɔne biara.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Mma wʼani mmere basabasayɛfoɔ, na mfa nʼakwan no mu biara,

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ Awurade kyiri basabasayɛfoɔ na ɔde ne werɛ hyɛ ɔteneneeni mu.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Ɔdi fɛdifoɔ a wɔyɛ ahantan ho fɛ na ɔdom ahobrɛasefoɔ.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Anyansafoɔ bɛnya animuonyam adi, nanso nkwaseafoɔ deɛ, ɔma wɔn anim gu ase.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Me mma, montie me, montie agya nkyerɛkyerɛ; monyɛ aso na moanya nteaseɛ.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Mema mo adenim a ɛkɔ anim, enti monnyaa me nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Meyɛ ɔbabanin wɔ mʼagya fie, meda so yɛ abadomaa na me maame di me bakorɔ no,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Ma me nsɛm nni wʼakoma mu dɛm di me nkyerɛkyerɛ so na wobɛnya nkwa.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Nya nyansa, nya nteaseɛ; mma wo werɛ mfiri me nsɛm anaa ntwe wo ho mfiri ho.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Nnya nyansa hɔ, na ɛbɛbɔ wo ho ban; dɔ no, na ɛbɛhwɛ wo so.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nyansa boro biribiara so; enti hwehwɛ nyansa. Ɛwom sɛ ne boɔ te sɛ wʼahodeɛ nyinaa deɛ nanso nya nteaseɛ.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Di no nni na ɛbɛpagya wo; yɛ no atuu, na ɛbɛhyɛ wo animuonyam.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Ɔde nkonimdie nhwiren hankra bɛgu wo tiri so na wama wo ahenkyɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Me ba, tie na fa deɛ meka no, na wo nkwanna bɛyɛ bebree.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Mɛkyerɛ wo nyansakwan na mede wo afa akwan a ɛtene so.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Sɛ wonante a, wʼanammɔntuo bɛkɔ yɛɛ na sɛ wotu mmirika a, worensunti.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Di nkyerɛkyerɛ so; na nnyaa mu bɔ ho ban yie, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ wo nkwa.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Ntu wo nan nsi amumuyɛfoɔ kwan so na nnante abɔnefoɔ kwan so.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Kwati no, ntu kwan mfa so; dane firi so na kɔ wo baabi.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔntumi nna kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛyɛ bɔne; na wɔntɔ nko kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛma obi ahwe ase.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛsɛm yɛ wɔn aduane, na basabasayɛ yɛ wɔn nsa.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ kwan te sɛ adekyeɛ hann a ɛdi ɛkan, ɛkɔ so hyerɛn yie kɔduru awia ketee.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Nanso, amumuyɛfoɔ kwan te sɛ esum kabii; wɔnnim deɛ ɛma wɔsunti.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Me ba, yɛ aso ma deɛ meka; tie me nsɛm no yie.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Mma ɛmfiri wʼani so, fa sie wʼakoma mu;

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ nkwa ma wɔn a wɔhunu ne akwahosan ma onipadua no nyinaa.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa akyi, bɔ wʼakoma ho ban, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛno ne wo nkwa asutire.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Mma akontonkyesɛm mfiri wʼano; mma nkontomposɛm mmɛn wʼano koraa.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Hwɛ wʼanim tee, na ma wʼani nkɔ deɛ ɛwɔ wʼanim no so.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɛkwan tamaa ma wo nan na fa akwan a atim so.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Mmane mfa nifa anaa benkum; twe wo nan firi bɔne ho.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Me ba, yɛ aso ma me nyansa; tie me nhunumu nsɛm no yie,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma woahwɛ yie, na wʼano akora nimdeɛ.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ ɔbaa dwamanfoɔ ano sosɔ ɛwoɔ, na ne kasa kɔ yɛɛ sene ngo;

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: nanso, awieeɛ no ɛyɛ nwono sene bɔnwoma, ɛyɛ nam sɛ akofena anofanu.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ne nan kɔ owuo mu; nʼanammɔntutuo kɔ ɛda mu tee.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Ɔnnwene ɛkwan a ɛkɔ nkwa mu ho; nʼakwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye, nanso ɔnnim.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Enti, afei, me mma, montie me; Monntwe mo ho mfiri deɛ meka ho.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Ɛkwan a ɛmmɛn noɔ no na momfa so mommmɛn ne fie ɛpono ano,

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a, mode mo ahoɔden bɛma afoforɔ na mode mo mfeɛ ama otirimuɔdenfoɔ,

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a, ahɔhoɔ bɛfom mo ahonyadeɛ na mobrɛ de ahonya akɔ afoforɔ fie.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Mo nkwanna akyi, mobɛsi apinie ɛberɛ a mo honam ne mo onipadua asa no.

english_verse: and shout, “I hated advice and correction!
translation_verse: Na moaka sɛ, “Na mekyiri ahohyɛsoɔ! Mʼakoma ampɛ ntenesoɔ!

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Manyɛ ɔsetie amma mʼakyerɛkyerɛfoɔ na mantie mʼakwankyerɛfoɔ asɛm.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Maduru ɔsɛeɛ ntɛntɛnoa wɔ asafo no nyinaa mu.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Nom nsuo firi wʼankasa ankorɛ mu, nsuo a ɛtene firi wʼankasa abura mu.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ wo nsutire yiri fa mmɔntene so na wo nsuwa kokɔ ɔman adwaberem anaa?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Ma ɛnyɛ wo nko ara dea, a wone ahɔhoɔ nnkyɛ da.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka wʼasubura na wʼani nka wʼababunuberɛ mu yere ho.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ ɔtwe bereɛ dɔfoɔ, ɔwansane animuonyamfoɔ. Ma ne nufoɔ nsɔ wʼani daa na ne dɔ nkyekyere wo.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Me ba, adɛn enti na woma ɔbaa dwamanfoɔ kyekyere wo? Adɛn enti na woda ɔbarima foforɔ bi yere kokom?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Awurade hunu onipa akwan nyinaa, na ɔhwehwɛ ne nyinaa mu.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ nnebɔne sum no afidie; na ne bɔne nhoma kyekyere no papee.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛwu ɛsiane ahohyɛsoɔ a ɔnni enti, na wayera ɛsiane nʼagyegyentwisɛm enti.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ woadi akagyinamu ama ɔyɔnko bi, sɛ wode wo biribi asi awowa ama obi,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: sɛ deɛ wokaeɛ ayi ka ama wo na sɛ wʼano asɛm afidie ayi wo a,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ yɛ yei, me ba, na fa tete wo ho, sɛ ɔyɔnko nsa aka woɔ no nti: fa ahobrɛaseɛ kɔ nʼanim; na kɔ so pa wo yɔnko no kyɛw!

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Mma wʼani nkum na nntɔ nko.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Gye wo ho, sɛdeɛ ɔforoteɛ dwane firi ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ nsam anaa sɛdeɛ anomaa dwane firi fidisumfoɔ afidie mu.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofoɔ, kɔ atɛtea nkyɛn; hwɛ nʼakwan, na hunu nyansa!

english_verse: Ants don't have leaders,
translation_verse: Ɔnni ɔsahene, ɔnni ɔhwɛfoɔ anaa sodifoɔ bi,

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: nanso, ɔde aduane sie wɔ ahuhuro ɛberɛ mu ɔboaboa nnuane ano wɔ twaberɛ.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Nna kakra, nkotɔ kakra, nsa a woabobɔ de rehome kakra,

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: ɛbɛma ohia aba wo so sɛ ɔkwanmukafoɔ na ahokyere ato ahyɛ wo so sɛ deɛ ɔkura tuo.

english_verse: Worthless liars go around
translation_verse: Onipa teta ne ohuhuni a ɔde atorɔ kyini,

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: deɛ ɔde nʼakoma mu nnaadaa bɔ ɛpɔ bɔne, na ɔde mpaapaemu ba ɛberɛ biara.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Ɛno enti amanehunu bɛba ne so prɛko pɛ; wɔbɛsɛe no mpofirim, a wɔrenya ano aduro.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Nneɛma nsia na Awurade mpɛ, nneɛma nson na ɛyɛ nʼakyiwadeɛ:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: ani a ɛtra ntɔn, atorɔ tɛkrɛma, nsa a ɛka mogya a ɛdi bem guo,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: akoma a ɛdwene amumuyɛ ho, nan a ɛtutu mmirika kɔyɛ bɔne,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: Ɔdansekurumni a ɔdi atorɔ ne onipa a ɔde mpaapaemu ba anuanom mu. Awaresɛeɛ Ho Kɔkɔbɔ

english_verse: Obey the teaching of your parents—
translation_verse: Me ba, tie wʼagya ahyɛdeɛ na nnyaa wo maame nkyerɛkyerɛ mu.

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Fa kyekyere wʼakoma ho daa; na fa kyekyere wɔ kɔn mu.
