english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Wonante a, ɛbɛkyerɛ wo ɛkwan; sɛ woda a, ɛbɛwɛn wo; sɛ wonyane a, ɛbɛkasa akyerɛ wo.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Na saa ahyɛdeɛ yi yɛ kanea; saa nkyerɛkyerɛ yi yɛ hann, na ahohyɛsoɔ ntenesoɔ yi yɛ nkwa kwan,

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: ɛtwe wo firi ɔbaa a ɔnni suban pa no ho, firi ɔbaawarefoɔ sansani tɛkrɛmadɛ ho.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Mma wo kɔn nnɔ nʼahoɔfɛ mma nʼani akyideda no ntwetwe wo,

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, odwamanfoɔ de animguaseɛ bɛbrɛ wo, na obi yere gyegye wo kɔ owuo mu.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Obi bɛtumi asɔ ogya agu ne srɛ so a ɛnhye nʼatadeɛ anaa?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Obi bɛtumi anante gyasramma so a mpumpunnya mmobɔ ne nan ho anaa?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Saa na ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbarima foforɔ yere da no teɛ obiara a ɔde ne nsa bɛka noɔ no remfa ne ho nni da.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Nnipa mmu ɔkorɔmfoɔ a wakɔwia adeɛ animtiaa sɛ ɛkɔm de no na ɔde rekɔdwodwo ano enti.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Mmom sɛ wɔkyere no a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtua ka mmɔho nson; sɛ ɛhia sɛ wɔtɔn ne fie agyapadeɛ nyinaa mpo a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtɔn.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima a ɔsɛe awadeɛ no nni adwene; obiara a ɔyɛ saa no sɛe ne ho.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Ɔboro ne animguaseɛ na ɔbɛnya, na nʼahohora rempepa da.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Ninkunutweɛ hwanyane okunu abufuo na sɛ ɔtɔ were a, ahummɔborɔ biara nni mu.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Ɔrennye mpata biara; na ɔbɛpo adanmudeɛ, sɛ ɛso sɛ ɛdeɛn mpo a.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Me ba, fa me nsɛm sie na kora mʼahyɛdeɛ wɔ wo mu.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Di mʼahyɛdeɛ so na wobɛnya nkwa; bɔ me nkyerɛkyerɛ ho ban sɛ deɛ wodɔ noɔ.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Kyekyere bɔ wo nsateaa ho; twerɛ no yie gu wʼakoma ɛpono so.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Ka kyerɛ nyansa sɛ, “Wo yɛ me nuabaa,” na frɛ nteaseɛ wo busuani;

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛtwe wo afiri ɔbaawaresɛefoɔ ho, afiri ɔbaawarefoɔ sansani nsɛmmɔdɛ ho.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Me fie mpomma ano mede mʼani faa ntokua mu.

english_verse: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
translation_verse: Na ɔnam borɔno a ɛbɛn ɔbaa no fie so a nʼani kyerɛ ɔbaa no fie

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Afei ɔbaa bi firi bɛhyiaa no a wasiesie ne ho sɛ odwamanfoɔ a nnaadaa wɔ nʼakomam.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: (Ɔyɛ hyirenn na hwee mfa ne ho, ɔntena efie koraa;

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: ɛnnɛ wɔhunu no mmɔntene so, ɔkyena na ɔte adwaberem, ɔtetɛ wɔ mmantwea mmantwea.)

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Ɔsɔɔ ne mu fee nʼano wamfɛre, na ɔkaa sɛ,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Mewɔ ayɔnkofa ayɛyɛdeɛ wɔ efie; ɛnnɛ madi me bɔhyɛ so.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Enti mebaeɛ sɛ merebɛhyia wo; mehwehwɛɛ wo na mahunu wo!

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Mato me mpa mede nwera a wɔahyɛ no aduro a ɛfiri Misraim.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mede nnuhwam apete me mpa so: kurobo, pɛperɛ ne sinamon.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Bra, ma yɛmfa ɔdɔ mmɔ ɔdɔ mu nkɔsi anɔpa;

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Me kunu nni efie; watu kwan na ɔbɛkyɛre.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Ɔde sika a ɛdɔɔso hyɛɛ ne sikabɔtɔ ma na ɔremma kɔsi ɔsrane no korokumatwa berɛ mu.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Ɔde akorɔkorɔ bɔɔ no asɔn; ɔde nnaadaa nyaa no ne no daeɛ.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Ɔdii nʼakyi prɛko pɛ te sɛ nantwie a ɔrekɔ akumiiɛ, anaa ɔwansane a ɔde ne tiri rekɔhyɛ hankrafidie mu

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: kɔsi sɛ bɛmma bɛhwire ne brɛboɔ mu, te sɛ anomaa a ɔrekɔtɔ anomaa afidie mu na ɔnnim sɛ ɔbɛhwere ne nkwa.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Na afei, me mma, montie me; monyɛ aso mma deɛ meka.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Mommma mo akoma mpatere nkɔ ne so na mommane mfa nʼakwan so.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Bebree na wɔnam ne so ahwehwe ase; wɔn a wakum wɔn dɔɔso pa ara.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ne fie yɛ ɛda kwantempɔn a ɛkɔ owuo mpia mu.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Tie: Nyansa refrɛ. Nteaseɛ ma ne nne so.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Ɛkwan no so, sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ, nkwantanan no so, ɛhɔ na ɛgyina,

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: apono a ɛkɔ kuropɔn no mu ho, ɛteam wɔ aboboano hɔ sɛ,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Ao, mo mmarimma na meteam mefrɛ; meteam frɛ adasamma nyinaa.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Mo a moyɛ ntetekwaa, mo mma mo ani nte; mo a moyɛ nkwaseafoɔ, monnya nteaseɛ.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Montie, na mewɔ nsɛm pa bi ka kyerɛ mo; mebue mʼano ka deɛ ɛyɛ.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Mʼano ka deɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ, ɛfiri sɛ mʼanofafa kyiri amumuyɛsɛm.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Mʼano mu nsɛm nyinaa yɛ pɛ; ebiara nni mu a ɛyɛ nkontompo anaa nnaadaasɛm.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Ne nyinaa mu da hɔ ma deɛ ɔwɔ nhunumu; ɛho nni asɛm ma wɔn a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Mompo dwetɛ na momfa mʼakwankyerɛ, momfa nimdeɛ na mompo sikakɔkɔɔ amapa.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ nimdeɛ som bo sene mmota, na wɔrentumi mfa deɛ wopɛ biara ntoto ho.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: “Me, nyansa, mene aniteɛ na ɛteɛ; nimdeɛ ne nhunumu wɔ me.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔsuro Awurade ɛne sɛ wɔkyiri bɔne; mekyiri ahantan ne ahomasoɔ, ɔbra bɔne ne nnaadaasɛm.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Afotuo ne atemmuo pa wɔ me; mewɔ nteaseɛ ne tumi.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Me so na ahemfo nam di adeɛ na sodifoɔ nam me so hyehyɛ mmara a ɛyɛ pɛ;

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Mmapɔmma de me bu ɔman ne atitire nyinaa a wɔdi asase so ɔhene.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Medɔ wɔn a wɔdɔ me, na wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me no hunu me.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Ahonyadeɛ ne animuonyam wɔ me nkyɛn, ahodeɛ a ɛkyɛre ne yiedie nso saa ara.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Mʼaba yɛ sene sikakɔkɔɔ amapa; deɛ ɛfiri me mu boro dwetɛ a wɔasɔne so so.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Tenenee akwan so na menam atɛntenenee akwan so,

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: mede ahodeɛ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ me na mehyɛ wɔn adekoradan ma ma.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: “Awurade bɔɔ me sɛ nʼabɔdeɛ mu abakan dii ne tete nneyɛɛ anim;

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: ɔyii me sii hɔ firi tete, ansa na ewiase rehyɛ aseɛ.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Wɔwoo me ansa na wɔrebɔ ɛpo kakraka no ansa na wɔreyɛ nsutire a nsuo ahyɛ no ma no;

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: ansa na wɔde mmepɔ resisi hɔ, wɔwoo me ansa na nkokoɔ reba,

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: ansa na ɔbɔɔ asase ne ne mfuo anaa dɔteɛ biara a ɛwɔ asase soɔ.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Mewɔ hɔ ansa na wɔbɔɔ soro, ɛberɛ a ɔtwaa hyeɛ too ebunu no ani no,

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a ɔbɔɔ omununkum wɔ soro na ɔde ebunu mu nsutire tintim hɔ denden no,

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: ɛberɛ a ɔtwaa hyeɛ maa ɛpo sɛdeɛ nsuo no rentra ne hyeɛ, ne ɛberɛ a ɔtwaa asase fapem no,

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: na meyɛ odwumfoɔ a mete ne nkyɛn. Anigyeɛ hyɛɛ me ma daa na medii ahurisie wɔ nʼanim ɛberɛ biara,

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: na mʼani gye wɔ ne ewiase nyinaa mu na mʼani ka wɔ adasamma mu.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: “Enti me mma, montie me; nhyira ne wɔn a wɔnante mʼakwan so.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Montie mʼakwankyerɛ na monhunu nyansa; mommu mo ani nngu so.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Nhyira ne onipa a ɔtie me, ɔwɛn mʼaboboano daa, na ɔtwɛn wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Na obiara a ɔhunu me no nya nkwa na ɔnya anisɔ firi Awurade nkyɛn.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Na deɛ woanhwehwɛ me no ha ne ho na wɔn a wɔtane me no dɔ owuo.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nyansa asi ne fie; watwa nʼafadum nson ho.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Wasiesie nʼaduane afra ne nsã wato ne ɛpono.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Wasoma ne mmaawa, na ɔfrɛ firi kuropɔn no sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ sɛ,

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: “Momma ntetekwaafoɔ nyinaa mmra ha!” Ɔka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔnni atemmuo sɛ,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Mommra mmɛdi mʼaduane na monnom nsã a mafra no.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Monnya mo ntetekwaasɛm no na mobɛnya nkwa; monnante nteaseɛ akwan so.”

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔtenetene ɔfɛdifoɔ no frɛ ahohorabɔ; na deɛ ɔka amumuyɛfoɔ anim no nya ɔyea.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Ɛno enti, nnka ɔfɛdifoɔ anim na ɔmmɛtane wo; ka onyansafoɔ anim na ɔbɛdɔ wo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Ma onyansafoɔ akwankyerɛ na ɔbɛkɔ so ahunu nyansa; kyerɛkyerɛ ɔteneneeni na ɔde bɛka nʼadesua ho.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ nyansa ahyɛaseɛ Ɔkronkronni no ho nimdeɛ yɛ nteaseɛ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Me mu na wo nna bɛdɔɔso, na wɔde mfeɛ bɛka wo nkwa ho.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ onyansafoɔ a, wobɛnya wo nyansa ho mfasoɔ; sɛ woyɛ ɔfɛdifoɔ a, wo nko ara na ɛbɛhunu amane.

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Ɔbaa ɔkwasea yɛ ɔkasafoɔ; ɔnni ahohyɛsoɔ na ɔnni nimdeɛ.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Ɔte ne fie ɛpono ano, na ɔte akonnwa a ɛsi kuropɔn no sorɔnsorɔmmea,

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: na ɔfrɛfrɛ wɔn a wɔtwam hɔ, wɔn a wɔnam wɔn kwan so tee sɛ,

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Momma ntetekwaafoɔ nyinaa mmra ha” ɔka kyerɛ wɔn a wɔnni atemmuo sɛ,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Nsuo a wɔwia no yɛ fremfrem na aduane a wɔdi no ahintaeɛ no yɛ dɛ!”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Nanso wɔnnim koraa sɛ awufoɔ wɔ hɔ sɛ nʼahɔhoɔ wɔ ɛda no ase tɔnn.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Salomo mmɛbusɛm: Ɔba nyansafoɔ ma nʼagya ani gye, na ɔba kwasea brɛ ne maame awerɛhoɔ.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ɛkwan bɔne so ahonya nni boɔ, nanso tenenee gye onipa firi owuo mu.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Awurade remma ɛkɔm nne ɔteneneeni na omumuyɛfoɔ deɛ ɔka nʼadepa gu.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Nsa a ɛnyɛ adwuma ma onipa di hia, nanso nsiyɛfoɔ nsa de ahonya ba.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔboaboa nnɔbaeɛ ano wɔ ahuhuro berɛ no yɛ ɔba nyansafoɔ na deɛ ɔda wɔ twaberɛ mu no yɛ ɔba nimguaseni.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ hyɛ nhyira kyɛ na akakabensɛm ayɛ omumuyɛfoɔ anom ma.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni nkaeɛ yɛ nhyira, na omumuyɛfoɔ din bɛporɔ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Akoma mu nyansafoɔ tie ɔhyɛ nsɛm, na ɔkwasea kasafoɔ hwe ase.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Ɔnokwafoɔ nante dwoodwoo, na deɛ ɔfa akwan kɔntɔnkye so no ho bɛda adi.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔde nitan bu nʼani no de ɔhaw ba, na ɔkwasea kasafoɔ hwe ase.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni anom yɛ nkwa asutire, na akakabensɛm ayɛ omumuyɛfoɔ anom ma.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Ɔtan hwanyan mpaapaemu, nanso ɔdɔ kata mfomsoɔ nyinaa so.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Wohunu nyansa wɔ nhunumufoɔ anom, na abaa fata deɛ ɔnni atemmuo akyi.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Adefoɔ ahonya yɛ wɔn kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban, nanso ahiafoɔ hia yɛ wɔn asehweɛ.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Ateneneefoɔ akatua de nkwa brɛ wɔn, na deɛ amumuyɛfoɔ nya no de asotwe brɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔtie nteteeɛ pa no kyerɛ nkwa kwan, na deɛ ɔpo ntenesoɔ no di afoforɔ anim yera ɛkwan.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔkata nitan soɔ no yɛ ɔtorofoɔ, na deɛ ɔdi nsekuro no yɛ ɔkwasea.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Mfomsoɔ mpa ɔkasa bebree mu, na deɛ ɔkora ne tɛkrɛma no yɛ onyansafoɔ.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni tɛkrɛma yɛ dwetɛ amapa nanso omumuyɛfoɔ akoma nni boɔ.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ ano ho mfasoɔ ma bebree aduane, na atemmuo a nkwaseafoɔ nni enti wɔwuwu.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Awurade nhyira de ahonya ba, na ɔmmfa ɔhaw biara nka ho.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Bɔneyɛ yɛ anigyedeɛ ma ɔkwasea, nanso deɛ ɔwɔ nimdeɛ anigyeɛ wɔ nyansa mu.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Deɛ amumuyɛfoɔ suro no bɛba wɔn so; na deɛ teneneefoɔ pɛ no, wɔde bɛma wɔn.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Sɛ ahum no bɛtwam a, amumuyɛfoɔ yera, nanso teneneefoɔ gyina hɔ pintinn afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ nsã kekakeka ka ɛse, na wisie kɔ ani no, saa ara na ɔkwadwofoɔ yɛ ma wɔn a wɔsoma noɔ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Awurade suro ma nkwa tenten, nanso wɔtwa amumuyɛfoɔ nkwa so.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ anidasoɔ de ahotɔ ba, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ anidasoɔ nkɔsi hwee.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Awurade ɛkwan yɛ dwanekɔbea ma ɔteneneeni, nanso ɛyɛ ɔsɛeɛ ma wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Wɔrentɔre teneneefoɔ ase da, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ renka asase no so.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nyansa firi teneneeni anom ba nanso tɛkrɛma a ɛdaadaa no wɔbɛtwa atwene.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ ano nim adeɛ a ɛfata na omumuyɛfoɔ ano nim deɛ ɛyɛ nnaadaasɛm nko ara.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Awurade kyiri asisie nsania, na nʼani gye nokorɛ nkariboɔ ho.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Ahantan ba a, animguaseɛ na ɛdi soɔ nanso ahobrɛaseɛ de nyansa ba.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ahonya nnka hwee abufuhyeɛ da no, nanso tenenee gye nkwa firi owuo mu.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔnnyɛ bɔne teneneeyɛ bɔ ɛkwan tee ma wɔn, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ amumuyɛsɛm brɛ wɔn ase.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Pɛyɛfoɔ teneneeyɛ gye wɔn, nanso akɔnnɔ bɔne afidie yi nkontompofoɔ.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Sɛ omumuyɛfoɔ wu a, nʼanidasoɔ yera; deɛ ɔsusuu sɛ ɔbɛnya afiri ne tumi mu nyinaa no yɛ kwa.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Wɔgye ɔteneneeni firi amaneɛ mu, na ɛba omumuyɛfoɔ so mmom.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔnsuro Onyame de nʼano sɛe ne yɔnko, nanso ɔteneneeni nam nimdeɛ so firi mu.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Sɛ teneneefoɔ di yie a, kuropɔn no di ahurisie; nanso amumuyɛfoɔ wu a, wɔbɔ ose.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Pɛyɛfoɔ nhyira ma kuropɔn no kɔ so, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ ano bɔ no.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔnni adwene no bu ne yɔnko animtiaa, nanso deɛ ɔwɔ nhunumu no to ne tɛkrɛma nnareka.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Osekuni da kɔkoamsɛm adi, nanso deɛ yɛnya ne mu ahotosoɔ no kora kasasie so.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Ɔman a ɛnni akwankyerɛ no bɔ, nanso afotufoɔ dodoɔ ma nkonimdie ba.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔdi agyinamu ma ɔfoforɔ no bɛhunu amane, na deɛ ɔmmfa ne nsa nhyɛ awowasie ase no aso mu dwo no.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Ɔbaa a ne yam yɛ no wɔde obuo ma no, nanso mmarima basabasayɛfoɔ nya ahodeɛ nko ara.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Ɔyamyɛfoɔ yɛ ma ne ho, na otirimuɔdenfoɔ de ɔhaw ba nʼankasa so.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ nya akatua a ɛnnyina, nanso deɛ ɔgu tenenee aba no twa akatua a ɛdi mu.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔyɛ nokorɛ teneneeni no nya nkwa, nanso deɛ ɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne no kɔ owuo mu.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Awurade kyiri nnipa a wɔn akoma akyinsa, na nʼani gye wɔn a wɔn akwan ho nni asɛm ho.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Gye to mu sɛ, amumuyɛfoɔ bɛnya wɔn akatua, na teneneefoɔ bɛnya wɔn tiri adi mu.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Ɔbaa hoɔfɛfoɔ a ɔntumi nsi gyinaeɛ no te sɛ sika kawa a ɛhyɛ prako hwene mu.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ apɛdeɛ wie yie, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ anidasoɔ wie abufuhyeɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Obi yɛ adɔeɛ, na ɔnya ne ho bebree; obi nso yɛ adɔna, nanso ɛhia no.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Ɔyamyɛfoɔ bɛkɔ so anya ne ho; na deɛ ɔma ebinom mee no nso bɛmee.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nnipa dome deɛ ɔde atokoɔ sie, na nhyira ba deɛ ɔtɔn ne deɛ so.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔhwehwɛ papa akyiri ɛkwan no nya anisɔ, na deɛ ɔhwehwɛ bɔne no, bɔne ba ne so.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔde ne ho to nʼahonyadeɛ soɔ no bɛhwe ase, na ɔteneneeni bɛyɛ frɔmm sɛ ahahan mono.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔde ɔhaw bɛto nʼabusua so no bɛdi mframa adeɛ, na ɔkwasea bɛyɛ onyansafoɔ ɔsomfoɔ.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni aba yɛ nkwa dua, na deɛ ɔgye akra no yɛ onyansafoɔ.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Sɛ teneneefoɔ nya wɔn akatua wɔ asase so a ɛnneɛ na wɔn a wɔnnim Onyame ne abɔnefoɔ nso ɛ!

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔpɛ ahohyɛsoɔ no pɛ nimdeɛ, na deɛ ɔkyiri ntenesoɔ no yɛ ogyimifoɔ.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Onipa pa nya Awurade nkyɛn adom, na Awurade bu onifirani fɔ.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛsɛm rentumi mma onipa ase ntim, na wɔrentumi nntu ɔteneneeni ase.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Ɔyere a ɔwɔ suban pa yɛ ne kunu ahenkyɛ, nanso ɔyere animguasefoɔ te sɛ porɔeɛ wɔ ne kunu nnompe mu.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ pɛ, na amumuyɛfoɔ afotuo yɛ nnaadaa.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ nsɛm da hɔ twɛn mogya, na ɔteneneeni kasa yi wɔn firi mu.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Wɔtu amumuyɛfoɔ gu na wɔyera, nanso teneneefoɔ fie gyina pintinn.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Wɔkamfo onipa sɛdeɛ ne nyansa teɛ na nnipa a wɔn adwene yɛ kɔntɔnkye deɛ, wɔbu wɔn animtiaa.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ wo ho sɛ ɔteta a nso wowɔ ɔsomfoɔ, sene sɛ wobɛyɛ wo ho sɛ obi, nanso wonni aduane.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni ma nʼayɛmmoa deɛ wɔpɛ, na amumuyɛfoɔ nneyɛɛ a ɛyɛ pa ara yɛ atirimuɔden.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔyɛ nʼasase so adwuma no bɛnya aduane bebree, na deɛ ɔdi nsɛm huhuo akyi no nni adwene.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ pɛ abɔnefoɔ afodeɛ, nanso ɔteneneeni ase dɔre.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔnefoɔ anosɛm yi no sɛ afidie, nanso ɔteneneeni nya ne ho tete wɔ ahohiahia mu.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Nneɛma pa firi onipa anomu aba mu hyɛ no ma sɛdeɛ ne nsa ano adwuma ma no akatua no.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea akwan tene wɔ nʼani so, na ɔnyansafoɔ tie afotuo.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea bo nkyɛre fu, nanso ɔbadwemma bu nʼani gu atɛnnidie so.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ɔdanseni nokwafoɔ di adanseɛ turodoo, na deɛ ɔdi adansekurumu no twa nkontompo.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Nsɛm hunu keka wowɔ te sɛ akofena nanso onyansafoɔ tɛkrɛma ma abodwoeɛ.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Ano a ɛka nokorɛ no tim hɔ daa, na atorɔ tɛkrɛma ɛnkyɛre koraa.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Nnaadaa hyɛ wɔn a wɔdwene bɔne ho akoma mu, na wɔn a wɔpɛ asomdwoeɛ nya ahosɛpɛ.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw biara rento ɔteneneeni, nanso amanehunu mee amumuyɛfoɔ.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Awurade kyiri ano a ɛtwa atorɔ, na nʼani gye nnipa a wɔdi nokorɛ ho.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Ɔnifirafoɔ mmɔ ne nimdeɛ ho dawuro na nkwaseafoɔ akoma da agyimisɛm adi.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Nsa a ɛyɛ adwuma no bɛdi tumi, nanso akwadworɔ wie nkoasom mu.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Akoma a ɛpere adeɛ ho ma onipa boto, nanso nkuranhyɛsɛm bi hyɛ no den.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni wɔ ntoboaseɛ wɔ ayɔnkofa mu, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ kwan ma wɔfom.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Onihafoɔ ntoto ne hanam, nanso nsiyɛfoɔ ahonyadeɛ som bo ma wɔn.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Tenenee kwan mu wɔ nkwa; na owuo nni saa ɛkwan no so.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Ɔba nyansafoɔ tie nʼagya nkyerɛkyerɛ; na ɔfɛdifoɔ ntie animka.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Nneɛma pa a ɛfiri onipa anom no ma no anigyeɛ, na wɔn a wɔnni nokorɛ no kɔn dɔ basabasayɛ.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔkora nʼano no kora ne nkwa so, nanso deɛ ɔkasa a ɔnsusu ho no bɛba ɔsɛeɛ mu.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Onihafoɔ pere hwehwɛ nanso ɔnnya hwee, na deɛ ɔyɛ adwuma no nya deɛ ɔpɛ biara.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ kyiri deɛ ɛnyɛ nokorɛ, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ de aniwuo ne ahohora ba.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Tenenee bɔ ɔnokwafoɔ ho ban, na amumuyɛsɛm tu ɔbɔnefoɔ gu.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Obi yɛ ne ho sɛ ɔdefoɔ, a nso ɔnni hwee, ɔfoforɔ yɛ ne ho sɛ ohiani, a nso ɔwɔ ahonya bebree.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Obi ahonya bɛtumi agye no nkwa, nanso ohiani nte ahunahuna biara.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ kanea hyerɛn pa ara, nanso wɔdum amumuyɛfoɔ kanea.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Ahantan de ntɔkwa nko ara na ɛba, na wɔhunu nyansa wɔ wɔn a wɔtie afutuo mu.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Ahonya a ɛnam kwammɔne soɔ no hwere ntɛm so, na deɛ ɔboa sika ano nkakrankakra no ma ɛdɔɔso.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Anidasoɔ a wɔtu hyɛ da no bɔ akoma yadeɛ, nanso anigyinadeɛ a nsa aka no yɛ nkwa dua.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔtwiri ahyɛdeɛ no bɛtua so ka, nanso deɛ ɔde obuo ma mmara no, wɔma no akatua.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Onyansafoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ te sɛ nkwa asutire, ɛyi onipa firi owuo afidie mu.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Nhunumu pa de adom ba, nanso atorofoɔ ɛkwan so yɛ den.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Ɔbadwemma biara yɛ nʼadeɛ wɔ nimdeɛ mu, nanso ɔkwasea da nʼagyimisɛm adi.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Ɔsomafoɔ mumuyɛfoɔ tɔ amaneɛ mu, nanso ɔnanmusini nokwafoɔ de abodwoɔ ba.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔpo ntenesoɔ no kɔ ohia ne animguaseɛ mu, na deɛ ɔtie ntenesoɔ no, wɔhyɛ no animuonyam.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Akɔnnɔdeɛ a nsa aka ma ɔkra ani gye, nanso nkwaseafoɔ kyiri sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho firi bɔne ho.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔne onyansafoɔ nante no hunu nyansa, na deɛ ɔne nkwaseafoɔ bɔ no hunu amane.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw di ɔbɔnefoɔ akyi, na nkɔsoɔ yɛ teneneeni akatua.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Onipa pa de agyapadeɛ gya ne nananom, na wɔkora ɔbɔnefoɔ ahonyadeɛ so ma ɔteneneeni.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ohiani afuom nnɔbaeɛ tumi ba pii, nanso ntɛnkyea pra kɔ.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔkyɛe nʼabaa so no tane ne ba, na deɛ ɔdɔ no no hwɛ sɛ ɔbɛtene no.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ didi ma wɔn akoma mee nanso, ɛkɔm de amumuyɛfoɔ.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Ɔbaa nyansafoɔ si ne dan, nanso ɔbaa kwasea de nʼankasa ne nsa dwiri ne deɛ gu fam.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Deɛ ne nanteɛ tene no suro Awurade, na deɛ nʼakwan kyea no bu no animtiaa.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea kasa ma wɔbɔ nʼakyi abaa, nanso anyansafoɔ ano bɔ wɔn ho ban.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Baabi a anantwie nni no, adididaka no mu da mpan, na ɔnantwie ahoɔden mu na nnɔbaeɛ pii firi ba.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ɔdanseni nokwafoɔ rennaadaa, ɔdansekurumni hwie atorɔ gu hɔ.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Ɔfɛdifoɔ hwehwɛ nyansa nanso ɔnnya, nanso wɔn a wɔwɔ nhunumu nya nimdeɛ ntɛm.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Twe wo ho firi ɔkwasea ho, ɛfiri sɛ, worennya nimdeɛ mfiri nʼano.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Anitefoɔ nyansa ne sɛ wɔbɛdwene wɔn akwan ho, na nkwaseafoɔ agyimisɛm yɛ nnaadaa.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Nkwaseafoɔ de bɔne ho adwensakyera di fɛ, na wɔn a wɔtene mu na anisɔ wɔ.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Akoma biara nim ɔyea ɛwɔ ne mu, na obi foforɔ rentumi ne no nkyɛ nʼanigyeɛ.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛsɛe mumuyɛfoɔ efie, nanso teefoɔ ntomadan bɛyɛ frɔmm.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Ɛkwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ wɔ onipa ani so, nanso ɛkɔwie owuo mu.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ɔsereɛ mu mpo, akoma tumi di yea, na anigyeɛ tumi wie awerɛhoɔ.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Akyirisanfoɔ bɛnya akatua sɛdeɛ wɔn akwan teɛ, na onipa pa nso bɛnya ne deɛ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Atetekwaa gye biribiara di, nanso ɔnitefoɔ dwene nʼanammɔntuo ho.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Onyansafoɔ suro Awurade na ɔdwane bɔne, nanso ɔkwasea yɛ asowuiɛ ne basabasa.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Onipa a ne bo nkyɛre fuo no yɛ nkwaseadeɛ, na deɛ ɔpam apammɔne no, wɔtane no.

english_verse: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
translation_verse: Ntetekwaafoɔ agyapadeɛ ne gyimie, na wɔde nimdeɛ bɔ anitefoɔ abotire.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Nnipa bɔnefoɔ bɛkoto nnipa pa anim, na amumuyɛfoɔ akoto ateneneefoɔ apono ano.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ahiafoɔ deɛ, wɔn ayɔnkofoɔ mpo mpɛ wɔn anim ahwɛ, nanso adefoɔ wɔ nnamfonom bebree.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbu ne yɔnko animtiaa yɛ bɔne, na nhyira nka deɛ ne yam yɛ ma onnibie.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔbɔ pɔ bɔne nyera ɛkwan anaa? Nanso wɔn a wɔhyehyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ no nya adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Adwumadenyɛ nyinaa de mfasoɔ ba, na kasa hunu deɛ, ɛkɔ ohia mu.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Anyansafoɔ ahonya ne wɔn abotire, na nkwaseafoɔ agyimisɛm so gyimie aba.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔdanseni nokwafoɔ gye nkwa, nanso ɔdansekurumni yɛ ɔdaadaafoɔ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔsuro Awurade no wɔ banbɔ a emu yɛ den, na ɛbɛyɛ dwanekɔbea ama ne mma.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Awurade suro yɛ nkwa asutire, ɛyi onipa firi owuo afidie mu.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Ɔman mu nnipa dodoɔ yɛ ɔhene animuonyam, nanso sɛ asomfoɔ nni hɔ a mmapɔmma no sɛe.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔwɔ abodwokyerɛ wɔ nteaseɛ a emu dɔ, na deɛ ne bo fu ntɛm no da agyimisɛm adi.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Akoma mu asomdwoeɛ ma onipadua nkwa, na anibereɛ ma nnompe porɔ.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔhyɛ ahiafoɔ soɔ no bu wɔn Yɛfoɔ animtiaa, nanso deɛ ɔhunu ohiani mmɔbɔ no hyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Sɛ amanehunu ba a amumuyɛfoɔ hwe ase, nanso owuo mu mpo teneneefoɔ wɔ dwanekɔbea.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Nyansa te nteaseɛ akoma mu, na nkwaseafoɔ mu mpo, ɔyi ne ho adi.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Tenenee pagya ɔman na bɔne yɛ animguaseɛ ma nnipa biara.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Ɔhene ani sɔ ɔsomfoɔ nyansani, na ɔsomfoɔ nimguaseni hyɛ no abufuo.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Mmuaeɛ pa dwodwo abufuo, nanso asɛm a ano yɛ den hwanyane abufuo mu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Onyansafoɔ tɛkrɛma yi nimdeɛ ayɛ, nanso ɔkwasea ano woro agyimisɛm.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Awurade ani hunu baabiara, na ɛhwɛ amumuyɛfoɔ ne apapafoɔ.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Tɛkrɛma a ɛde abodwoɔ ba yɛ nkwa dua, nanso nnaadaa tɛkrɛma dwerɛ honhom.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea mmfa nʼagya ntenesoɔ nyɛ hwee, na deɛ ɔtie ntenesoɔ no kyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔnitefoɔ.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Ahonya bebree wɔ ɔteneneeni fie, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ adenya de ɔhaw brɛ wɔn.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Anyansafoɔ ano trɛtrɛ nimdeɛ mu; nanso ɛnyɛ saa na nkwaseafoɔ akoma teɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Awurade kyiri amumuyɛfoɔ afɔrebɔ, nanso teefoɔ mpaeɛbɔ sɔ nʼani.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Awurade kyiri amumuyɛfoɔ akwan, nanso ɔdɔ wɔn a wɔti tenenee.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Asotwe denden wɔ hɔ ma dea ɔmane firi ɛkwan no so, deɛ ɔtane ntenesoɔ no bɛwu.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Owuo ne Ɔsɛeɛ da Awurade anim, na nnipa akoma mu deɛ, ɔnim ma ɛboro so.

english_verse: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
translation_verse: Anigyeɛ akoma ma anim yɛ seresere, na akoma a abotoɔ dwerɛ honhom.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Nhunumufoɔ akoma hwehwɛ nimdeɛ, nanso ɔkwasea ano ka agyimisɛm.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so nna nyinaa yɛ mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ, nanso anigyeɛ akoma wɔ daa ahosɛpɛ mu.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Ketewa bi a yɛnya a Awurade suro ka ho no yɛ sene ahonyadeɛ bebree a ɔhaw bata ho.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Nhahamma aduane a ɔdɔ wɔ mu no yɛ sene nantwie sradenam a ɔtan bata ho.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Deɛ ne bo fu ntɛm de mpaapaemu ba, nanso deɛ ɔwɔ ntoboaseɛ pata ntɔkwa.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Nkasɛɛ ama onihafoɔ kwan asi, nanso teneneefoɔ kwan yɛ tempɔn.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Ɔba nyansafoɔ ma nʼagya ani gye nanso ɔba kwasea bu ne maame animtiaa.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Agyimisɛm ma deɛ ɔnni adwene ani gye, nanso deɛ ɔwɔ nteaseɛ no fa ɛkwan a ɛtene so.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛnni afotuo no sɛe, nanso afotufoɔ bebree ma ɛyɛ yie.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔma mmuaeɛ a ɛfata no ani gye, asɛm a ɛba berɛ pa mu no nso yɛ.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Onyansafoɔ asetena mu kwan ma no nkɔsoɔ ɛsi ne da mu korɔ ho ɛkwan.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Awurade sɛe ɔhantanni fie na ɔma akunafoɔ ahyeɛ yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Awurade kyiri amumuyɛfoɔ nsusuiɛ, nanso nʼani sɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ kronn no deɛ.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Ɔdufudepɛfoɔ de ɔhaw brɛ nʼabusua, nanso deɛ ɔkyiri kɛtɛasehyɛ no bɛnya nkwa.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni akoma kari ne mmuaeɛ, nanso omumuyɛfoɔ ano woro bɔne.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Animu a ɛteɛ ma akoma nya ahomeka, na asɛm pa ma nnompe ahoɔden.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔtie animka a ɛma nkwa no ne anyansafoɔ bɛbɔ mu atena ase.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔmfa ahohyɛsoɔ no bu ne ho animtiaa, na deɛ ɔtie ntenesoɔ no nya nhunumu.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Awurade suro kyerɛ onipa nyansa, ahobrɛaseɛ di animuonyam anim.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Akoma mu nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ onipa dea, na tɛkrɛma mmuaeɛ firi Awurade.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ onipa sɛ nʼakwan nyinaa yɛ kronn nanso Awurade na ɔpɛɛpɛɛ adwene mu.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Fa deɛ woyɛ nyinaa hyɛ Awurade nsam, na wo nhyehyɛeɛ bɛsi yie.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Awurade yɛ biribiara ma nʼankasa botaeɛ, mpo, ɔhwɛ omumuyɛfoɔ kɔsi amanehunu da.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Awurade kyiri akoma mu ahantanfoɔ nyinaa. Nya saa nteaseɛ yi sɛ, wɔremfa wɔn ho nni.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Wɔnam ɔdɔ ne nokorɛ so pata bɔne; onipa nam Awurade suro so yi bɔne akwa.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa akwan sɔ Awurade ani a, ɔma nʼatamfoɔ mpo ne no tena asomdwoeɛ mu.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Kakraa bi a wɔnam tenenee kwan so nya no yɛ sene mfasoɔ pii a wɔnam ntɛnkyea so nya.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Onipa yɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ nʼakoma mu, nanso Awurade na ɔhwɛ nʼanammɔntuo.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔhene anomu kasa te sɛ nkɔmhyɛ, enti ɛnsɛ sɛ nʼano ka deɛ ɛnyɛ atɛntenenee.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Nsania ne abrammoɔ a nsisie nni mu firi Awurade; nkariboɔ a ɛwɔ kotokuo mu no, ɔno na ɔyɛeɛ.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Ahemfo kyiri bɔneyɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ahennwa si tenenee so.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Ɔhene abufuhyeɛ yɛ owuo somafoɔ, nanso onyansafoɔ bɛdwodwo ano.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhene anim te a, ɛyɛ nkwa, nʼadom te sɛ osutɔberɛ mu osumuna.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛnya nyansa sene sɛ wobɛnya sikakɔkɔɔ, sɛ wobɛnya nhunumu sene sɛ wobɛnya dwetɛ!

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni kwantempɔn kwati bɔne; deɛ ɔhwɛ nʼakwan yie no bɔ ne nkwa ho ban.

english_verse: Too much pride will destroy you.
translation_verse: Ahantan di ɔsɛeɛ anim, na ahomasoɔ honhom nso di ahweaseɛ anim.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ honhom mu hiani wɔ wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so mu sene sɛ wo ne ahantanfoɔ bɛkyɛ afodeɛ.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔyɛ ɔsetie ma nkyerɛkyerɛ no nya nkɔsoɔ; nhyira nka deɛ ɔde ne ho to Awurade so.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Wɔfrɛ akoma mu anyansafoɔ sɛ nhunumufoɔ, na kasa pa ma nkyerɛkyerɛ kɔ so.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Nteaseɛ yɛ nkwa nsutire ma wɔn a wɔwɔ bi, nanso agyimisɛm de asotweɛ brɛ nkwaseafoɔ.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Onyansafoɔ akoma kyerɛ nʼano kwan, na nʼanofafa ma nkyerɛkyerɛ kɔ so.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Abodwosɛm te sɛ ɛwokyɛm ɛyɛ ɔkra dɛ, na ɛsa nnompe yadeɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Ɛkwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ wɔ onipa ani so, nanso ɛkɔwie owuo mu.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Odwumayɛfoɔ akɔnnɔ ma no yɛ adwuma den; ɛfiri sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔkum ne kɔm.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Ohuhuni bɔ pɔ bɔne, ne kasa te sɛ egyadɛreɛ a ɛhye adeɛ.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Onipa kɔntɔnkye de mpaapaemu ba, na osekuni tete nnamfonom ntam.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Basabasayɛni daadaa ne yɔnko na ɔde no fa ɛkwammɔne so.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbu nʼani no redwene bɔneyɛ ho; na deɛ ɔmua nʼano no ani wɔ bɔne so.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Ɛdwono yɛ animuonyam abotire; tenenee mu asetena na ɛde ba.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔwɔ abodwokyerɛ no yɛ sene ɔkofoɔ, na deɛ ɔmfa abufuo yɛ sene deɛ ɔko fa kuropɔn.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Wɔtwe ntonto de hwehwɛ deɛ Awurade pɛ, nanso ne gyinasie biara firi Awurade.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Aduane mmɔwe a asomdwoeɛ wɔ ho yɛ sene efie a apontoɔ ahyɛ no ma a nso basabasayɛ wɔ mu.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Ɔsomfoɔ nyansafoɔ bɛdi ɔba nimguasefoɔ so, na ɔbɛnya ne kyɛfa wɔ agyapadeɛ no mu sɛ anuanom no mu baako.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Kyɛmferɛ wɔ hɔ ma dwetɛ na fononoo wɔ hɔ ma sikakɔkɔɔ nanso Awurade na ɔsɔ akoma hwɛ.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ tie nsusuiɛ bɔne; ɔtorofoɔ yɛ aso ma adwen bɔne tɛkrɛma.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔdi ahiafoɔ ho fɛ no bu wɔn Yɛfoɔ animtiaa; na deɛ ɔfoa amanehunu soɔ no bɛnya asotwe.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Mmanananom yɛ mmasiriwa animuonyam, na awofoɔ yɛ wɔn mma ahohoahoa.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Anokrokro nyɛ mma ɔkwasea, saa ara na ano a ɛdi torɔ mfata ɔhene.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Kɛtɛasehyɛ daadaa deɛ ɔma; ɔgye sɛ ɛbɛma no nkonim.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbu nʼani gu mfomsoɔ so no ma ɔdɔ ɛkwan, na deɛ ɔbɔ soɔ no tete nnamfonom ntam.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Nkaanim sɔ onipa a ɔwɔ nhunumu ani sene mmaa ɔha a wɔbɔ ɔkwasea.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Onipa bɔnefoɔ ani wɔ atuateɛ nko ara so na wɔbɛsoma odwumayɛfoɔ tirimuɔdenfoɔ akɔ ne so.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛhyia sisire a wɔawia ne mma sene ɔkwasea a ɔregyimie.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi de bɔne tua papa so ka a, bɔne rempa ne fie da.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Ntɔkwa ahyɛaseɛ te sɛ deɛ wɔretue suka; enti gyae ma ɛnka na ankɔfa ɔham amma.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔbɛgyaa deɛ ɔdi fɔ ne sɛ wɔbɛbu deɛ ɔdi bem kumfɔ no, Awurade kyiri ne mmienu.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Sika a ɛwɔ ɔkwasea nsam ho nni mfasoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni botaeɛ biara sɛ ɔbɛhunu nyansa.

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Adamfo kyerɛ ɔdɔ ɛberɛ nyinaa mu, wɔwo onua barima ma ahokyere berɛ.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔpɛ ntɔkwa no dɔ bɔne; deɛ ɔsi ɛpono tentene no frɛfrɛ ɔsɛeɛ.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔwɔ akoma kontonkyi no nnya nkɔsoɔ; deɛ ne tɛkrɛma daadaa no tɔ amaneɛ mu.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔwo ɔba kwasea no di awerɛhoɔ; ɔba kwasea agya nni anigyeɛ.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Akoma mu anigyeɛ yɛ aduro ɛsa yadeɛ, nanso honhom a apɛkyɛ no wewe nnompe.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ gye adanmudeɛ wɔ esum ase de kyea atɛntenenee.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔwɔ nhunumu no ani kɔ nyansa so, na ɔkwasea toto nʼani kɔsi asase ano.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Ɔba kwasea hyɛ nʼagya awerɛhoɔ, na ɔma deɛ ɔnyinsɛnee no no di yea.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔtwe deɛ ɔdi bem aso, anaasɛ wɔtwa adwumayɛfoɔ mmaa wɔ wɔn nokorɛdie enti.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Ɔnimdefoɔ dwene nʼanom kasa ho, na deɛ ɔwɔ nhunumu no wɔ abodwoɔ.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea nni nhunumu ho anigyeɛ na mmom deɛ ɔpɛ ara ne sɛ ɔde nʼadwene bɛto dwa.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Onipa anom nsɛm yɛ nsuo a emu dɔ, na nyansa asutire yɛ asuwa a ɛrepu ahuro.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔdi ma omumuyɛfoɔ anaasɛ wɔbu deɛ ɔdi bem atɛnkyea.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea ano de akasakasa ba na nʼano frɛfrɛ ɔhweɛ.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea ano yɛ ɔno ara sɛeɛ na nʼanofafa yɛ ne kra afidie.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Osekuni anom asɛm te sɛ mfremfremadeɛ; ɛwurawura kɔ onipa akwaa mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔtoto nʼadwuma ase no nuabarima ne deɛ ɔyɛ ɔsɛefoɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Awurade din yɛ abantenten a ɛyɛ den; ahotefoɔ dwane kɔtoa na wɔnya banbɔ.

english_verse: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.
translation_verse: Adefoɔ ahonyadeɛ ne wɔn kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔfa no sɛ ɔfasuo tenten a wɔntumi mforo.

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Ansa na onipa bɛhwe ase no ɔnya ahomasoɔ akoma, na ahobrɛaseɛ di animuonyam anim.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔntie asɛm ansa na wama mmuaeɛ no, ɛno ne ne gyimie ne nʼanimguaseɛ.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Onipa sunsum na ɛhyɛ no den wɔ yadeɛ mu na honhom a apɛkyɛ deɛ, hwan na ɔpɛ?

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Nhunumu akoma nya nimdeɛ; na anyansafoɔ aso nso hwehwɛ.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Akyɛdeɛ bue ɛkwan ma deɛ ɔde ma na ɛde no ba atitire anim.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ deɛ ɔbɔ ne nkuro kane no sɛ nʼasɛm yɛ dɛ, kɔsi sɛ ɔfoforɔ bɛba abɛbisa no nsɛm no mu.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Ntontobɔ twa akyinnyegyeɛ so, na ɛpata atamfoɔ.

english_verse: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
translation_verse: Onua a wɔafom noɔ no asɛm yɛ dene sene kuropɔn a ɛwɔ banbɔ, akyinnyegyeɛ te sɛ abankɛsewa apono a wɔabram akyire.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Onipa anom asɛm so aba ma ɔyafunu mee, nnɔbaeɛ a nʼanofafa twa no mee no.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Tɛkrɛma kura nkwa ne owuo tumi, na wɔn a wɔdɔ no no bɛdi nʼaba.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Deɛ wanya yere no anya adepa na ɔnya adom firi Awurade hɔ.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ohiani srɛ ahummɔborɔ, nanso ɔdefoɔ de kasaden bua no.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Ɔbarima a ne nnamfonom dɔɔso bɛtumi ahwe ase, nanso adamfo bi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛfam ne ho asene onua.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ohiani a ne nanteɛ ho nni asɛm no yɛ sene ɔkwasea a nʼasɛm mfa ɛkwan mu.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Mmɔdemmɔ a nimdeɛ nka ho no nyɛ, saa ara na ntɛmpɛ a ɛma obi yera ɛkwan nso nyɛ.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Onipa agyimisɛm sɛe nʼabrabɔ, nanso nʼakoma huru tia Awurade.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Ahonya frɛfrɛ nnamfonom bebree; nanso ohiani adamfo gya no hɔ.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.
translation_verse: Adansekurumni bɛnya nʼakatua, na deɛ ɔtwa nkontompo remfa ne ho nni.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Nnipa pii pɛ adom firi sodifoɔ nkyɛn, na deɛ ɔkyɛ adeɛ yɛ obiara adamfo.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ohiani abusuafoɔ nyinaa po no, na saa ara na ne nnamfonom po no! Mpo ɔhwehwɛ wɔn pɛ sɛ ɔpa wɔn kyɛw, nanso ɔnhunu wɔn baabiara.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔnya nyansa no dɔ ne kra; deɛ ɔpɛ nhunumu no nya nkɔsoɔ.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Adansekurumni bɛnya asotwe, na deɛ ɔtwa nkontompo no bɛyera.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Onipa nyansa ma no ntoboaseɛ; sɛ ɔbu nʼani gu mfomsoɔ bi so a ɛhyɛ no animuonyam.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Ɔhene abufuo te sɛ gyata mmobom, na nʼadom te sɛ ɛserɛ so bosuo.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Ɔba kwasea yɛ nʼagya ɔsɛeɛ, ɔyere ntɔkwapɛfoɔ te sɛ nsusosɔ a ɛntwa da.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Afie ne ahonyadeɛ yɛ agyapadeɛ a ɛfiri awofoɔ, na ɔyere nimdefoɔ firi Awurade.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Akwadworɔ de nnahɔɔ ba, na ɛkɔm de ɔkwadwofoɔ.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔdi nkyerɛkyerɛ so no bɔ ne nkwa ho ban, na deɛ ɔgyaagyaa ne ho no bɛwu.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔyɛ adɔeɛ ma ohiani no yɛ de fɛm Awurade, na ɔbɛtua no deɛ ɔyɛ no so ka.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Tene wo ba, na ɛno mu na anidasoɔ wɔ, na ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔde no kɔ owuo mu no mu baako.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛ sɛ onipa a nʼakoma ha no no tua so ka; sɛ woka ma no a wobɛyɛ bio.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Tie afotuo na gye nkyerɛkyerɛ to mu, na awieeɛ no, wobɛhunu nyansa.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Nhyehyɛeɛ bebree wɔ onipa akoma mu, nanso deɛ Awurade pɛ no na ɛba mu.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Deɛ onipa pɛ ne nokorɛ dɔ; ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ ohiani sene sɛ wobɛyɛ ɔtorofoɔ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Awurade suro kɔ nkwa mu; na onipa de abotɔyam home a ɔhaw bi nni mu.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofoɔ nsa ka ayowaa mu na ɔremma so mpo nkɔ nʼano!

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Twa ɔfɛdifoɔ mmaa, na atetekwaa bɛfa adwene; ka deɛ ɔwɔ nhunumu anim, na ɔbɛnya nimdeɛ.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbɔ nʼagya korɔno na ɔpamo ne maame no yɛ ɔba a ɔde aniwuo ne animguaseɛ ba.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Me ba, sɛ wogyae nkyerɛkyerɛ tie a, wobɛmane afiri nimdeɛ nsɛm ho.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Adansekurumni di atɛntenenee ho fɛw; na omumuyɛfoɔ ano mene bɔne.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Wɔasiesie asotwe ama fɛdifoɔ, ne mmaabɔ ama nkwaseafoɔ akyi.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Nsa yɛ ɔfɛdifoɔ na nsaden yɛ ntɔkwapɛfoɔ; na obiara a nsã bɛma wafom ɛkwan no nnyɛ onyansafoɔ.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Ɔhene abufuhyeɛ te sɛ gyata mmobom; na deɛ ɔhyɛ no abufuo no de nkwa twa so.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ onipa animuonyam sɛ ɔbɛkwati akasakasa, nanso ogyimifoɔ biara pɛ ntɔkwa.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Onihafoɔ mfuntum nʼasase wɔ ne berɛ mu; enti ɛduru twaberɛ a ɔnnya hwee.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Onipa akoma apɛdeɛ yɛ subunu mu, nanso onipa a ɔwɔ nhunumu no twetwe.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Nnipa dodoɔ no ara ka sɛ wɔwɔ ɔdɔ a ɛnsa da, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi ahunu ɔnokwafoɔ?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni bu ɔbra kronkron; nhyira ne ne mma a wɔba nʼakyi.

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhene tena nʼahennwa so bu atɛn a, ɔde nʼani huhu bɔne nyinaa so gu.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka sɛ, “Mapra mʼakoma mu; meyɛ kronn na menni bɔne”?

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Nkariboɔ ne susudua a ɛnyɛ papa no Awurade kyiri ne mmienu.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Mpo wɔnam abɔfra nneyɛɛ so hunu no, sɛ ne suban yɛ kronn ne papa.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: Aso a wɔde te asɛm ne ani a wɔde hunu adeɛ, Awurade na wayɛ ne mmienu.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Mma nna nyɛ wo dɛ, na woanni hia; ɛnna, na wobɛnya aduane ama abu so.

english_verse: Everyone likes to brag about getting a bargain.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔfoɔ ka sɛ, “Ɛnyɛ, ɛnyɛ!” nanso sɛ ɔkɔ a, ɔde deɛ watɔ no hoahoa ne ho.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Fa obi a ɔdi ɔhɔhoɔ akagyinamu atadeɛ; sɛ ɔregyina ɔbaa huhufoɔ akyi a, fa si awowa.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Aduane a wɔnya no ɛkwan bɔne so no yɛ onipa anomu dɛ, nanso akyire no ɛdane mmosea wɔ nʼanom.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Pɛ afotuo yɛ wo nhyehyɛeɛ; sɛ wotu ɔsa a, nya ho akwankyerɛ.

english_verse: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
translation_verse: Osekuni da kokoamsɛm adi; enti twe wo ho firi onipa a ɔkasa bebree ho.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi dome nʼagya anaasɛ ne maame a, wɔbɛdum ne kanea wɔ esum kabii mu.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Agyapadeɛ a wɔpere ho nya no ahyɛaseɛ no renyɛ nhyira akyire no.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Nka sɛ, “Mɛtua wo saa bɔne yi so ka!” Twɛn Awurade, na ɔbɛgye wo.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Awurade kyiri nkariboɔ a ɛnyɛ papa, na nsisie nsania nso nsɔ nʼani.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Awurade na ɔkyerɛ onipa anammɔntuo. Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na obi bɛte nʼankasa akwan ase?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Obi pɛ ntɛm hyɛ bɔ, ansa na wadwene ho a, ɔsum ne ho afidie.

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Ɔhene nyansafoɔ hunu amumuyɛfoɔ; na ɔde ayuyamfidie hankra fa wɔn so.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Awurade kanea hwehwɛ onipa honhom mu, ɛhwehwɛ ne mu baabiara.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔ ne nokorɛdie bɔ ɔhene ho ban; nʼadɔeɛ ma nʼahennwa tim.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Mmeranteɛ animuonyam ne wɔn ahoɔden, tidwono nso ne mmasiriwa animuonyam.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Ɔhweɛ ne apirakuro hohoro amumuyɛ mmaaka te akoma mu.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Ɔhene akoma da Awurade nsam; ɔkyerɛ no ɛkwan te sɛ asutene ma ɔkɔ baabiara a ɔpɛ.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Onipa akwan nyinaa tene wɔ nʼani so, nanso Awurade na ɔkari akoma.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ adepa ne adeɛ a ɛtene a ɛsɔ Awurade ani sene afɔrebɔ.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Ani a ɛtra ntɔn ne ahomasoɔ akoma, ne amumuyɛfoɔ asetena nyinaa yɛ bɔne!

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Ahonya a nkontompo tɛkrɛma de ba no yɛ huhuro ne owuo afidie.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ basabasayɛ bɛtwe wɔn akɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ deɛ ɛtene.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔdi fɔ no akwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye, na deɛ ne ho nni asɛm no adeyɛ tene.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Suhyɛ twɛtwɛwa ase baabi tena yɛ sene sɛ wo ne ɔyere ntɔkwapɛfoɔ bɛtena efie.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ kɔn dɔ bɔne; ɔnni ahummɔborɔ mma ne yɔnko.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔtwe fɛdifoɔ aso a, ntetekwaafoɔ hunu nyansa, sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ onyansafoɔ a, ɔnya nimdeɛ.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni no nim deɛ ɛrekɔso wɔ omumuyɛfoɔ fie na ɔde omumuyɛfoɔ no kɔ ɔsɛeɛ mu.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa sisi nʼaso wɔ mmɔborɔni su ho a ɔno nso bɛsu afrɛ, na wɔrennye no so.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Kokoam adekyɛ dwodwo akoma, kɛtɛasehyɛ nso pata abufuhyeɛ.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Sɛ wobu atɛntenenee a, teneneefoɔ anigye nanso ɛyɛ ahunahuna ma abɔnefoɔ.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔmane firi nhunumu kwan soɔ no bɛhome wɔ awufoɔ fekuo mu.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔdi ahosɛpɛ akyi no bɛyɛ ohiani; deɛ ɔpɛ nsã ne ngo no rennya ne ho da.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ de wɔn nkwa to hɔ ma teneneefoɔ, na atorofoɔ yɛ saa ma wɔn a wɔyɛ pɛ.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛtena ɛserɛ so, sene sɛ wo ne ɔyere ntɔkwapɛfoɔ a nʼakoma ha no bɛtena.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Nnuane pa ne ngo ayɛ onyansafoɔ fie ma, nanso ɔkwasea di deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔti tenenee ne ɔdɔ no ɔnya nkwa, yiedie ne animuonyam.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Onyansafoɔ to hyɛ ahoɔdenfoɔ kuropɔn so na ɔdwiri abandenden a wɔn werɛ hyɛ mu gu fam.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔkora nʼano ne ne tɛkrɛma no ɔtwe ne ho firi amanenya ho.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Ɔhantanni a ɔma ne ho so no, ne din ne “Ɔfɛdifoɔ” ɔde ahantan ntrasoɔ yɛ adeɛ.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔkwadwofoɔ kɔn dɔ no bɛyɛ owuo ama no, ɛfiri sɛ ne nsa mpɛ adwumayɛ.

english_verse: But people who obey God are always generous.
translation_verse: Ɛda mu nyinaa ɔpere sɛ ɔbɛnya bebree, nanso ɔteneneeni deɛ, ɔma a ɔnnodo ho.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ afɔrebɔ yɛ akyiwadeɛ, ne titire ne sɛ ɔde adwemmɔne bata ho.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Adansekurumdini bɛyera, na obiara a ɔtie noɔ no nso wɔbɛsɛe no.
