english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛfoɔ di akakabensɛm na ɔteneneeni deɛ, ɔdwene nʼakwan ho.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyansa, nhunumu ne nhyehyɛeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ yie atia Awurade.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Wɔsiesie apɔnkɔ ma ɔko da, nanso nkonimdie yɛ Awurade dea.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ abɔfra ɛkwan a ɔmfa so, na sɛ ɔnyini a ɔremfiri so.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Adefoɔ di ahiafoɔ so, na boseagyeni yɛ deɛ ɔde fɛm ɔsomfoɔ.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔdua amumuyɛsɛm no twa ɔhaw na wɔbɛsɛe nʼabufuhyeɛ abaa.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔyamyɛfoɔ bɛnya nhyira ɛfiri sɛ ɔne ahiafoɔ kyɛ nʼaduane.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Pam ɔfɛdifoɔ na basabasayɛ nso bɛkɔ; ntɔkwa ne atɛnnidie to atwa.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Obi a ɔdɔ akoma a emu teɛ na ne kasa ho yɛ nyam bɛnya ɔhene afa no adamfo.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofoɔ ka sɛ, “Gyata bi wɔ mfikyire hɔ!” anaasɛ, “Wɔbɛkum me wɔ mmɔntene so.”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Ɔbaa waresɛefoɔ anomu yɛ amena donkudonku; deɛ ɔhyɛ Awurade abufuo ase no bɛtɔ mu.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Agyimisɛm kyekyere abɔfra akoma ho, nanso ntenesoɔ abaa bɛpamo akɔ akyiri.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Obi bɛsisi ohiani de apɛ ahonya anaa ɔbɛkyɛ ɔdefoɔ adeɛ, ne nyinaa de no kɔ ohia mu. Anyansasɛm

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Yɛ aso na tie anyansasɛm yi; fa wʼakoma di me nkyerɛkyerɛ akyi,

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ sɛ wokora saa nsɛm yi wɔ wʼakoma mu, na ne nyinaa ada wʼano.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ wode wo ho bɛto Awurade so, merekyerɛkyerɛ wo ɛnnɛ, aane wo.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Mentwerɛɛ mmɛ aduasa mmaa wo, deɛ ɛyɛ afotusɛm ne nimdeɛ,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo nokorɛ ne deɛ akyinnyeɛ nni ho, sɛdeɛ wobɛnya mmuaeɛ pa ama deɛ ɔsomaa woɔ no anaa?

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ahiafoɔ korɔno, sɛ wɔyɛ ahiafoɔ enti, na nnsisi wɔn a wɔnni bie wɔ asɛnniiɛ,

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ Awurade bɛdi wɔn asɛm ama wɔn na wafom afa wɔn a wɔfom ahiafoɔ fa.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Mfa obi a ne bo ha no adamfo, na mmfa wo ho mmɔ deɛ ne bo nkyɛre fu,

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a, wobɛsua nʼakwan na woakɔtɔ afidie mu.

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ deɛ ɔde ne nsa hyɛ krataa ase di agyinamu, anaasɛ deɛ ɔdi akagyinamu;

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: na sɛ wonni deɛ wɔde tua a wɔbɛhwan wo mpa mpo afiri wʼase.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Ntutu tete aboɔ a wɔde ato hyeɛ; deɛ wo nananom de sisii hɔ no.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Wohunu odwumayɛfoɔ a ne nsa akokwa nʼadwuma ho anaa? Ahemfo anim na ɔbɛsom, na ɔrensom wɔ mpapahwekwaa anim.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Nni obi a ɔyɛ pɛpɛɛ aduane nni nʼakɔnnɔ aduane akyi;

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Sɛ wo ne ɔhene bi to nsa didi a, hwɛ deɛ ɛsi wʼanim no yie,

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ adidibrada a, hyɛ wo ho so.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Nni nʼaduane akɔnnɔ akɔnnɔ no akyi, ɛfiri sɛ saa aduane no daadaa nnipa.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ obi a ɛberɛ biara ɔdwene sika ho. Ɔka sɛ, “Didi na nom,” nanso ɛnyɛ nʼakoma mu.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Mmiri wo mogya ani mpɛ sika; hunu nyansa na to wo bo ase.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Wʼani bɔɔ sika so ara pɛ, na atu ayera, ampa ara ɛbɛfu ntaban na atu akɔ ewiem sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Kakra a woadi no wobɛfe na ɛno enti wo nkamfo ho remma mfasoɔ.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Nkasa nkyerɛ ɔkwasea, ɛfiri sɛ ɔremfa nyansa a ɛwɔ wo kasa mu no.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Ntutu tete aboɔ a wɔde ato hyeɛ ngu, na ntra hyeɛ nkɔ nwisiaa mfuo mu,

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Me ba, tie, na hunu nyansa, ma wʼakoma mfa ɛkwan tenenee so.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Mfa wo ho mmɔ akɔwensafoɔ anaasɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ ɛnam mmorosoɔ,

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, akɔwensafoɔ ne adidibradafoɔ bɛyɛ ahiafoɔ, na anikum fira wɔn ntomago.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Tie wʼagya a ɔwoo woɔ no, na sɛ wo maame bɔ aberewa a, mmu no animtia.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Tɔ nokorɛ na ntɔn da; nya nyansa, ahohyɛsoɔ ne nhunumu.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Ɔteneneeni agya wɔ anigyeɛ bebree; deɛ ɔwɔ ɔba nyansafoɔ no anigye ne ho.

english_verse: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
translation_verse: Ma wʼagya ne wo maame ani nnye; ma ɔbaa a ɔwoo woɔ no nnya ahosɛpɛ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Me ba, fa wʼakoma ma me na ma wʼani nkɔ mʼakwan ho,

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: na odwamanfoɔ yɛ amena donkudonku ɔyere sansani yɛ ɔdaadaafoɔ.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Ɔtɛ, twɛn, te sɛ ɔkwanmukafoɔ na ɔma mmarima mu atorofoɔ dɔɔso.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Hwan na wɔadome no? Hwan na ɔdi awerɛhoɔ? Hwan na ɔdi apereapereɛ? Hwan na ɔnwiinwii? Hwan na wapirapira hunaa? Hwan na mogya ada nʼani so?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔkyɛre nsã ho, na wɔka nsã a wɔafrafra hwɛ.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Nhwɛ nsã ani kɔkɔɔ no haa, ɛberɛ a ɛretwa yerɛ yerɛ wɔ kuruwa mu, na ɛkɔ yɔɔ no.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Awieeɛ no ɛka te sɛ ɔwɔ na ɛwɔ borɔ te sɛ ahurutoa.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Wʼani bɛhunu nneɛma a wonhunuu da, na woadwene nneɛma basabasa ho.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Wobɛtɔ ntintan te sɛ hyɛn mu dwumayɛni a, ɔkura ɛhyɛn dua a, ɛrehinhim mu den, na ɛdenkye denkye wɔ ɛpo so.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Na wobɛka sɛ, “Wɔbɔ me, nanso mempira. Wɔboro me, nanso mente ɔyea biara. Ɛberɛ bɛn na menyane akɔpɛ nsã anom bio?”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Ɛnha wo ho wɔ abɔnefoɔ enti na ɛmma wʼani mmere amumuyɛfoɔ nso,

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Mma wʼani mmerɛ amumuyɛfoɔ, mfa wo ho mmɔ wɔn;

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Ɛfiri sɛ, wɔn akoma dwene atirimuɔdensɛm ho, na wɔn ano ka deɛ ɛde basabasayɛ ba ho asɛm.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, ɔbɔnefoɔ nni anidasoɔ biara daakye, na wɔbɛdum amumuyɛfoɔ kanea.

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Wɔde nyansa na ɛsi efie, na nhunumu mu na wɔma ɛtim;

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: ɛnam nimdeɛ so na wɔnya ademudeɛ a ɛho yɛ na na ɛyɛ fɛ hyehyɛ nʼadan mu.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Me ba, suro Awurade ne ɔhene, na mfa wo ho mmɔ adɔnyɛfoɔ ho,

english_verse: Wisdom brings strength, and knowledge gives power.
translation_verse: Onyansafoɔ wɔ tumi a ɛso, na onimdefoɔ nyini ahoɔden mu;

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: deɛ ɔretu sa hia akwankyerɛ, deɛ ɔrepɛ nkonimdie no hia afotufoɔ pii.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ saa baanu yi de ɔsɛeɛ bɛba wɔn so mpofirim, na hwan na ɔnim amanehunu ko a wɔbɛtumi de aba? Anyansafoɔ Nsɛnka A Ɛkeka Ho

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Nyansa wɔ akyiri dodo ma ɔkwasea; wɔ apono ano dwabɔ mu no ɔnni hwee ka.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Yeinom nso yɛ anyansafoɔ Nsɛnka: Atemmuo a animhwɛ wɔ mu no nyɛ:

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Onipa ɔbɔ pɔ bɔne no wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔkɔtwebrɛfoɔ.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Ogyimifoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ bɔne, nnipa kyiri ɔfɛdifoɔ.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔbɛka akyerɛ deɛ ɔdi fɔ sɛ, “Wo ho nni asɛm” no nnipa bɛdome no na amanaman remmɔ no din pa.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Sɛ wʼabamu go wɔ ɔhaw mu a, na wʼahoɔden sua!

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Na wɔn a wɔbu afɔdifoɔ fɔ no ɛbɛsi wɔn yie, na nhyira bɛba wɔn so.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Gye wɔn a wɔde wɔn rekɔ akɔkum wɔn no nkwa; na sianka wɔn a wɔtɔ ntintan kɔ akumiiɛ.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Sɛ woka sɛ, “Na yɛnnim yei ho hwee a,” deɛ ɔkari akoma hwɛ no nhunu anaa? Deɛ ɔbɔ wo nkwa ho ban no nnim anaa? Ɔrentua deɛ obiara ayɛ so ka anaa?

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Mmuaeɛ pa te sɛ mfeano.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: Me ba, di ɛwoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ; ɛwokyɛm mu woɔ yɛ wʼanomu dɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Hunu nso sɛ nyansa yɛ wo kra dɛ; sɛ wonya a, wowɔ anidasoɔ ma daakye, na wʼanidasoɔ renyɛ kwa.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Wie wo mfikyidwuma na siesie wo mfuo; ɛno akyi, si wo fie.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Nkɔtɛ ɔteneneeni fie sɛ ɔkwanmukafoɔ, na ɛnkɔto nhyɛ nʼatenaeɛ so,

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ ɔteneneeni hwe ase mpɛn nson deɛ, nanso ɔsɔre bio, na amumuyɛfoɔ deɛ, amanehunu baako ma wɔhwe ase.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Nni adanseɛ ntia ɔyɔnko a ɔnyɛɛ wo hwee, na mfa wʼano nnaadaa.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Sɛ wo ɔtamfoɔ hwe ase a mma ɛnyɛ wo dɛ; na sɛ ɔsunti a mma wʼakoma nni ahurisie,

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ Awurade bɛhunu wʼadwene na ɔrempɛ na ɔbɛyi nʼabufuhyeɛ afiri ne so.

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Nka sɛ, “Deɛ wayɛ me no me nso mɛyɛ no bi; deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no metua ne so ka.”

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Menante faa onihafoɔ afuo ho twaa mu wɔ deɛ ɔnni adwene bobefuo nso ho;

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: nkasɛɛ afu wɔ baabiara, wira afu akata asase no so, na aboɔ afasuo no nso abubu.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Mede mʼadwene kɔɔ deɛ mehunuiɛ no so na mesuaa biribi firii mu:

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: nna kakra, nkotɔ kakra, nsa a woabobɔ de rehome kakra,

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Yeinom yɛ Salomo mmɛbusɛm nkekaho a Yudahene Hesekia afotufoɔ twerɛeɛ:

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyamhyɛ sɛ wɔde asɛm sie; sɛ wɔpɛɛpɛɛ asɛm mu nso hyɛ ahemfo animuonyam.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ ɔsoro korɔn na asase mu dɔ no, saa ara na wɔrentumi nhwehwɛ ahemfo akoma mu.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔyi dwetɛ ho a, dwetɛdwumfoɔ tumi de yɛ adeɛ a ɛho wɔ mfasoɔ;

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Yi amumuyɛfoɔ firi ɔhene anim, na tenenee bɛma nʼahennwa atim.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Mma wo ho so wɔ ɔhene anim, na mpere diberɛ wɔ atitire mu;

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ ma no sɛ ɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ, “Bra soro ha,” sene sɛ ɔbɛbrɛ wo ase wɔ otitire bi anim. Deɛ wode wʼani ahunu no

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: mpɛ ntɛm mfa nkɔ asɛnniiɛ, na sɛ awieeɛ no wo yɔnko gu wʼanim ase a ɛdeɛn na wobɛyɛ?

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Sɛ wo ne wo yɔnko di asɛm a nna obi foforɔ ahintasɛm adi,

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: anyɛ saa a, deɛ ɔbɛte no bɛgu wʼanim ase na edin bɔne a wobɛnya no rempepa da.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Asɛm a wɔka no sɛdeɛ ɛfata no te sɛ sika kɔkɔɔ a wɔabɔ sɛ aprɛ de atuatua dwetɛ nsiesieɛ mu.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Sikakɔkɔɔ asomuadeɛ anaa sikakɔkɔɔ amapa ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ onyansafoɔ animka a ɔde ma deɛ ɔyɛ aso ma no.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ sukyerɛmma ma ewiem dwoɔ wɔ otwa berɛ mu no saa ara na ɔsomafoɔ nokwafoɔ teɛ ma wɔn a wɔsoma no; na ɔma ne wuranom akomatɔyam.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Omununkum ne mframa a ɛmfa osutɔ mma no te sɛ onipa a ɔde akyɛdeɛ a ɔmmfa mma hoahoa ne ho.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Ntoboaseɛ ma sodifoɔ ti da, na tɛkrɛmabereɛ tumi bu dompe mu.

english_verse: Eating too much honey can make you sick.
translation_verse: Sɛ wonya ɛwoɔ a, enni ntra so, ne bebrebe bɛma woafe.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Ntaa nkɔ wo yɔnko fie, wo ho fono no a, ɔbɛtan wo.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔdi adansekurumu tia ne yɔnko no te sɛ aporibaa, afena anaa bɛmma a ano yɛ nnam.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Ɛse a ɛyare kaka anaa ɛnan a ɛyɛ apakye te sɛ deɛ wode wo ho to ɔtorofoɔ so hiada mu.

english_verse: Singing to someone in deep sorrow is like pouring vinegar in an open cut.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔto dwom kyere ɔwerɛhoni no te sɛ deɛ ɔpa ntoma gu awɔberɛ mu anaa te sɛ nsã nyinyanyinya a wɔhwie gu afransa soɔ.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛkɔm de wo ɔtamfoɔ a, ma no aduane nni; sɛ osukɔm de no a, ma no nsuo nnom.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Sɛ woyɛ saa a, wobɛsoso gyasramma agu nʼatifi, na Awurade bɛma wo akatua.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ atifi fam mframa de osutɔ ba no, saa ara na tɛkrɛma a ɛdi nsekuro de omuna ba.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛtena suhyɛ ase mantweaa bi, sene sɛ wo ne ɔyere ntɔkwapɛfoɔ bɛtena efie.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Nsuonwunu a ɔkra a ato baha nya no te sɛ asɛmmɔdɛ a ɛfiri akyirikyiri.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Asutire a ahono anaa abura a ayɛ pɔtɔɔ, te sɛ ɔteneneeni a ɔgyaa ne ho ma amumuyɛfoɔ.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔdi ɛwoɔ ntrasoɔ, na ɛnyɛ fɛ nso sɛ obi pɛ animuonyam ma ne ho.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔnni ahohyɛsoɔ no te sɛ kuropɔn a nʼafasuo abubu agu fam.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ sukyerɛmma te ahuhuro berɛ anaasɛ osutɔ te wɔ otwa berɛ no saa ara na animuonyam mfata ɔkwasea.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ apatuprɛ tuo anaasɛ asomfena tu danedane ne ho no, saa ara na nnuabɔ hunu nsi hwee.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Ɔkafoɔ abaa wɔ hɔ ma ɔpɔnkɔ, nnareka wɔ hɔ ma afunumu, na abaa wɔ hɔ ma nkwaseafoɔ akyi.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Nhwɛ ɔkwasea agyimisɛm so mma no mmuaeɛ, anyɛ saa a wo nso bɛyɛ sɛ ɔno.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Gyina ɔkwasea agyimisɛm so ma no mmuaeɛ anyɛ saa a ɛbɛyɛ no sɛ ɔnim nyansa.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Sɛ wode nkra bi soma ɔkwasea a, ɛte sɛ woatwa wʼankasa nan anaasɛ woafrɛ basabasayɛ.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Apakye nan a awu na ɛsensɛn hɔ no, yɛ abɛbusɛm a ɛda ɔkwasea ano.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Ɛboɔ a wɔakyekyere afam ahwimmoɔ so, te sɛ animuonyam a wɔde ama ɔkwasea.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Nkasɛɛ dua a ɛkura ɔkɔwensani no te sɛ abɛbusɛm a ɛda ɔkwasea ano.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbɔ ɔkwasea anaa obi hunu paa no te sɛ agyantoni a ɔpira nnipa kwa.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ ɔkraman sane kɔ ne feɛ ho no, saa ara na ɔkwasea ti nʼagyimisɛm mu.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Woahunu obi a ɔyɛ onyansafoɔ wɔ nʼankasa ani so? Anidasoɔ pii wɔ ɔkwasea mu sene no.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofoɔ ka sɛ, “Gyata wɔ ɛkwan no mu, gyata nenam mmɔntene no so!”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ ɛpono di akɔneaba wɔ ne mponterɛ so no, saa ara na ɔkwadwofoɔ twa ne ho wɔ ne mpa so.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofoɔ de ne nsa si aduane mu, na ɛyɛ no aniha sɛ ɔbɛyi akɔ nʼano.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Ɔkwadwofoɔ yɛ onyansafoɔ wɔ ɔno ankasa ani so sene nnipa baason a wɔdwene asɛm ho na wɔabua.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Obi a ɔsɔ ɔkraman aso twe noɔ no te sɛ obi a ɔretwam na ɔde ne ho kɔfra ntɔkwa a ɛmfa ne ho mu.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: Ɔbɔdamfoɔ a ɔtoto atuo anaa agyan kɔdiawuo no

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: te sɛ obi a, ɔdaadaa ne yɔnko na ɔka sɛ, “Na mede redi agorɔ!”

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Yensin hi a, ogya dum; nsekuro nni hɔ a ntɔkwa toɔ twa.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ gyabidie dane gyasramma na anyina dane ogya no, saa ara na ntɔkwapɛfoɔ hyɛ ntɔkwa mu kutupa.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Osekuni anom asɛm te sɛ mfremfremadeɛ; ɛwurawura kɔ onipa akwaa mu nyinaa.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ wɔde dwetɛ fi adura asankago ho no saa ara na anoɔdɛ kata amumuyɛ akoma so.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Onipa bɔne kasa te sɛ deɛ ɔyɛ, nanso nnaadaa ahyɛ nʼakoma ma.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ ne kasa yɛ dɛ deɛ, nanso ɛnnye no nni, ɛfiri sɛ akyiwadeɛ nson ahyɛ nʼakoma ma.

english_verse: Everyone will see through those evil plans.
translation_verse: Ebia nnaadaa bɛkata nʼadwemmɔne so, nanso nʼamumuyɛsɛm bɛda adi wɔ badwa mu.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Sɛ onipa tu amena a, ɔbɛto mu; sɛ onipa pire ɔboɔ a, ɛbɛsane aba ne so.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Atorɔ tɛkrɛma kyiri wɔn a ɔgu wɔn ho fi, na nnaadaa ano de ɔsɛeɛ ba.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Mfa ɔkyena nhoahoa wo ho, na wonnim deɛ ɛda bi de bɛba.

english_verse: Don't brag about yourself— let others praise you.
translation_verse: Ma ɔfoforɔ nkamfo wo; na ɛnyɛ wʼankasa; ma ɛmfiri ɔfoforɔ anomu na ɛnyɛ wo.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Ɛboɔ mu yɛ duru, na anwea yɛ adesoa, nanso ɔkwasea abufuhyeɛ yɛ duru sene emu biara.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Abufuo tirim yɛ den, na abufuhyeɛ sɛe adeɛ, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina ninkuntwe ano?

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Animka a ɛda edwa yɛ sene ɔdɔ a asuma.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Apirakuro a ɛfiri adamfo nkyɛn no yɛ sene ɔtamfoɔ mfeano bebrebe.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Ɛwoɔ nyɛ deɛ wameeɛ akɔnnɔ, nanso deɛ ɛkɔm de noɔ no, deɛ ɛyɛ nwono yɛ nʼanom dɛ.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Onipa a wayera ne fie ɛkwan, te sɛ anomaa a wafiri ne pirebuo mu rekyinkyini.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Ngo ne aduhwam ma akoma ani gye, adamfo ho anigyeɛ firi nʼafotu pa a ɔma.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Nnyaa wʼadamfo ne wʼagya adamfo mu, nkɔ wo nuabarima fie ɛberɛ a ɔhaw ato woɔ, na ɔyɔnko a ɔbɛn woɔ no yɛ sene onuabarima a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Me ba, hunu nyansa na ma mʼakoma ani nnye; ɛno na ɛbɛma manya mmuaeɛ ama obiara a ɔbu me animtiaa.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Mmadwemma hunu asiane na wɔhinta, nanso ntetekwaafoɔ kɔ wɔn anim kɔtɔ mu.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Fa atadeɛ a ɛhyɛ obi a ɔdi ɔhɔhoɔ akagyinamu; sɛ ɔregyina ɔbaa huhufoɔ akyi a, fa si awowa.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi team hyira ne yɔnko anɔpahema a, wɔbɛfa no sɛ ɛyɛ nnome.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Ɔyere ntɔkwapɛfoɔ te sɛ osutɔ da nsusosɔ a ɛnnyae da;

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: sɛ wopata no a, ɛte sɛ deɛ wopata mframa anaa wode wo nsa bɛsɔ ngo mu.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Dadeɛ se dadeɛ, saa ara na onipa se ɔfoforɔ.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔhwɛ borɔdɔma dua so no bɛdi ɛso aba, na deɛ ɔsom ne wura no, wɔbɛhyɛ no animuonyam.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ nsuo yi animdua kyerɛ no, saa ara na onipa akoma da onipa no adi.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ Owuo ne Ɔsɛeɛ bo ntɔ da no, saa ara, na onipa ani nso bo ntɔ da.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Kyɛmferɛ wɔ hɔ ma dwetɛ na fononoo wɔ hɔ ma sikakɔkɔɔ, nanso wɔnam nkamfo a onipa nya so na ɛso no hwɛ.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Sɛ wowɔ ɔkwasea wɔ ɔwaduro mu, sɛ wode ɔwɔma wɔ no te sɛ deɛ wosi aburoo a, worentumi nnyi agyimisɛm mfiri ne ho.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Ma ɛnyɛ wo asɛnhia sɛ wobɛhunu wo nnwankuo tebea, na ma wʼani nkɔ wʼanantwikuo so;

english_verse: because wealth and honor don't last forever.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ, ahonya ntena hɔ daa, na ahenkyɛ ntena hɔ mma awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ nyinaa.

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Sɛ wotwa ɛserɛ no na foforɔ fifiri na wɔboaboa nkokoɔ so ɛserɛ no ano a,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: ɛnneɛ nnwammaa no bɛma wo ntoma, na mpɔnkye ama sika a ɛtɔ mfuo.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Wobɛnya mmirekyie nufosuo bebree ama wo ne wʼabusuafoɔ adi ne aduane ama wo mmaawa.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ dwane ɛberɛ a obiara ntaa no, nanso teneneefoɔ koko yɛ duru sɛ agyata.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Atuateɛ ɔman nya sodifoɔ pii, nanso onipa a ɔwɔ nhunumu ne nimdeɛ ma mmara yɛ adwuma.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Sodifoɔ a ɔhyɛ ahiafoɔ so no te sɛ brampɔnsuo a ɛsɛe mfudeɛ.

english_verse: Lawbreakers praise criminals, but law-abiding citizens always oppose them.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔpo mmara no kamfo amumuyɛfoɔ, na wɔn a wɔdi mmara so no si wɔn kwan.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Abɔnefoɔ nte atɛntenenee ase, nanso wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no, te aseɛ yie.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ohiani a ne nanteɛ ho nni asɛm yɛ sene ɔdefoɔ a nʼakwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔdi mmara so yɛ ɔba a ɔwɔ nhunumu, nanso deɛ ɔne adidibradafoɔ bɔ no gu nʼagya anim ase.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔgye mfɛntom mmorosoɔ de nya ne ho no ɔboaboa ano ma deɛ ɔbɛyɛ ahiafoɔ adɔeɛ.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi nni mmara so a, ne mpaeɛbɔ mpo yɛ akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔdi teneneefoɔ anim de wɔn fa ɛkwan bɔne so no bɛhwe ɔno ankasa afidie mu, nanso wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm no bɛnya agyapadeɛ a ɛyɛ.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Ɔdefoɔ tumi yɛ onyansafoɔ wɔ nʼankasa ani so, nanso ohiani a ɔwɔ nhunumu no hunu sɛdeɛ ɔteɛ.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Sɛ teneneefoɔ di nkonim a, nnipa di ahurisie pii; nanso sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ nya tumi a nnipa kɔhinta.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔkata ne bɔne soɔ no nnya nkɔsoɔ, na deɛ ɔka ne bɔne na ɔgyae yɛ no nya ahummɔborɔ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Nhyira nka deɛ ɔsuro Awurade ɛberɛ nyinaa, nanso deɛ ɔpirim nʼakoma no tɔ amaneɛ mu.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Omumuyɛfoɔ a ɔdi nnipa a wɔnni mmoa so no te sɛ gyata a ɔbobɔm anaa sisire a nʼani abereɛ.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Sodifoɔ tirimuɔdenfoɔ nni adwene, na deɛ ɔkyiri mfasoɔ a wɔnam ɛkwan bɔne so nya no bɛnya nkwa tenten.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Deɛ awudie ma ne tiboa bu no fɔ no, ɔbɛyɛ ɔkobɔfoɔ akɔsi ne wu da; mma obiara mmɔ ne ho ban.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Deɛ ne nanteɛ ho nni asɛm no, wɔgye no firi ɔhaw mu, nanso deɛ nʼakwan yɛ kɔntɔnkye no bɛhwe ase mpofirim.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔyɛ nʼasase so adwuma no bɛnya aduane pii, nanso deɛ ɔdwene nneɛma hunu ho no bɛnya ne so ne ne hia.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Wɔbɛhyira onipa nokwafoɔ pii, na deɛ ɔpere pɛ ahonyadeɛ no remfa ne ho nni.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Animhwɛ nyɛ, nanso aduane kakra enti nnipa yɛ bɔne.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔyɛ pɛpɛɛ pere sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔdefoɔ na ɔnnim sɛ ohia retwɛn no.

english_verse: Honest correction is appreciated more than flattery.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔka obi anim no bɛsɔ nnipa ani akyire asene deɛ ɔwɔ tɛkrɛmadɛ.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔbɔ nʼagya anaa ne maame korɔno na ɔka sɛ, “Ɛnyɛ bɔne” no, ɔne ɔsɛefoɔ na ɛbɔ.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔdifodepɛfoɔ de mpaapaemu ba na deɛ ɔde ne ho to Awurade so no bɛnya nkɔsoɔ.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔgye ne ho die no yɛ ɔkwasea, na deɛ ɔnante nyansa mu no wɔbɛgye no.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔma ahiafoɔ no, hwee renhia no, nanso deɛ ɔbu nʼani gu wɔn so no nya nnome pii.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ nya tumi a, nnipa kɔhinta; na sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ ase tɔre a, teneneefoɔ ase dɔre.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Obi a ɔkɔ so yɛ tufoanteɛ wɔ animka pii akyi no wɔbɛsɛe no mpofirim a wɔrentumi nsi ano.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Sɛ teneneefoɔ di yie a, nnipa no di ahurisie; sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ di nnipa so a, wosi apinie.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔdɔ nyansa no ma nʼagya anigye, nanso nnwamanfoɔ yɔnko sɛe nʼahonya.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Ɔhene nam atɛntenenee so ma ɔman no asomdwoeɛ, nanso deɛ ɔde adifudepɛ gye adanmudeɛ no bɔ ɔman no.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Obiara a ɔdaadaa ne yɔnko no sum ne nan afidie.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ bɔne sum no afidie, nanso ɔteneneeni bɛtumi ato dwom ama nʼani agye.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Ahiafoɔ atɛnteneebuo ho hia teneneefoɔ, nanso amumuyɛfoɔ nni saa tema no.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Fɛdifoɔ de basabasayɛ ba kuropɔn mu, nanso anyansafoɔ dwodwo abufuo ano.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Sɛ onyansafoɔ de ɔkwasea kɔ asɛnniiɛ a, ɔkwasea no bobom kasa di fɛ, na asomdwoeɛ mma.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Mogyapɛfoɔ kyiri ɔnokwafoɔ, na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkum deɛ ɔtene.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea da abufuo nyinaa adi, nanso onyansafoɔ hyɛ ne ho so.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Sɛ sodifoɔ tie nkontomposɛm a, nʼadwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa bɛyɛ amumuyɛfoɔ.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Ohiani ne ɔhyɛsofoɔ nyinaa wɔ saa adeɛ baako yi: Awurade ma wɔn baanu nyinaa ani a wɔde hunu adeɛ.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔhene di ahiafoɔ asɛm yie a, nʼahennwa bɛtim hɔ daa.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Ntenesoɔ abaa ma nyansa, na abɔfra a wɔde ne pɛ ma noɔ no, gu ne na anim ase.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ di yie a, bɔne nso kɔ so, na teneneefoɔ bɛhunu wɔn asehweɛ.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Tene wo ba so, na ɔbɛma wo asomdwoeɛ; ɔbɛma wo ɔkra ani agye.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Sɛ anisoadehunu nni hɔ a, nnipa no yɛ basaa; na nhyira nka deɛ ɔdi mmara so.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Wɔmmfa anomu nsɛm nko ara ntene ɔsomfoɔ so, ɔte aseɛ deɛ, nanso ɔremfa.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Wohunu obi a ɔpere ne nsɛm ho anaa? Ɔkwasea mu wɔ anidasoɔ sene no.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Sɛ obi korɔkorɔ ne ɔsomfoɔ firi ne mmɔfraase a, awieeɛ no ɔde awerɛhoɔ na ɛbɛba.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Onipa a ne bo afuo de mpaapaemu ba, na deɛ ne bo nkyɛre fu no yɛ bɔne pii.

english_verse: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Onipa ahomasoɔ brɛ no ase, nanso deɛ ɔwɔ ahobrɛaseɛ no nya animuonyam.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɔboa ɔkorɔmfoɔ no ha ɔno ankasa ho. Wɔama waka ntam enti ɔsuro sɛ ɔbɛdi adanseɛ.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Onipa ho suro bɛtumi ayɛ afidie ama wo, na deɛ ɔde ne ho to Awurade so no, wɔbɛgye no.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bebree hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya ɔhene ne no akasa, nanso onipa nya atɛntenenee firi Awurade nkyɛn.

english_verse: Good people and criminals can't stand each other.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɔ kyiri atorofoɔ; na amumuyɛfoɔ kyiri wɔn a wɔn akwan tene.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Yake babarima Agur nsɛm a ɔkaeɛ a ɛyɛ nkɔmhyɛ: Saa ɔbarima yi ka kyerɛɛ Itiel ne Ukal sɛ:

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: “Me na mennim hwee koraa wɔ nnipa mu, menni onipa nteaseɛ.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Mensuaa nyansa, na menni Ɔkronkronni no ho nimdeɛ nso.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Hwan na waforo akɔ soro na wasiane aba fam? Hwan na wabɔ mframa boa wɔ ne nsa mu? Hwan na ɔde nʼatadeɛ abɔ nsuo boa? Hwan na ɔbɔɔ asase hahanaa yi? Ne din de sɛn, na ne ba barima nso din de sɛn? Sɛ wonim a ka kyerɛ me!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: “Onyankopɔn asɛm biara yɛ nokorɛ; ɔyɛ kyɛm ma wɔn a wɔdwane toa no.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Mfa biribi nka nʼasɛm ho, anyɛ saa a ɔbɛka wʼanim ama woayɛ ɔtorofoɔ.

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: “Ao Awurade, nneɛma mmienu na mehwehwɛ firi wo nkyɛn; mfa nkame me ansa na mawu:

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Yi atorɔ ne ahohwisɛm firi me mu; mma mennyɛ ohiani anaa ɔdefoɔ; nanso ma me deɛ medi daa.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Anyɛ saa a, ebia menya me ho pii ama mapa wo na maka sɛ, ‘Hwan ne Awurade?’ Anaa mɛyɛ ohiani na mabɔ korɔno, na ama magu me Onyankopɔn din ho fi.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: “Nsɛe ɔsomfoɔ din nkyerɛ ne wura; sɛ woyɛ saa a, ɔbɛdome wo na wobɛtua so ka.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: “Nnipa bi dome wɔn agyanom, na wɔnnhyira wɔn maamenom nso;

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Wɔn a wɔtene wɔ wɔn ankasa ani so a ɛnso wɔnhohoroo wɔn ho fi;

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: wɔn a wɔn ani tra ntɔn, na wɔbu animtiaa;

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: “Amemem wɔ mmammaa mmienu a wɔteam sɛ, ‘Fa ma me! Fa ma me.’ “Nneɛma mmiɛnsa na ɛmmee da. Dabi, nneɛma ɛnan wɔ hɔ a ɛnka da sɛ, ‘Ɛyɛ!’

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Damena, obonini awotwaa, asase a ɛyɛ wesee daa, ne ogya a ɛnka da sɛ, ‘Ɛyɛ!’

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: “Ani a ɛyi agya ahi, na ɛbu ɛna animtia no, bɔnhwa ho anene bɛtutu, na apete abɛdi.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: “Nneɛma mmiɛnsa na ɛyɛ me nwanwa, ɛnan na mente aseɛ:

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Ɛkwan a ɔkɔdeɛ nam so wɔ ewiem, sɛdeɛ ɔwɔ nante ɔbotan so, ɛkwan a ɛhyɛn nam so wɔ ɛpo hahanaa so, ne sɛdeɛ ɔbarima dɔ ababaawa.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: “Ɔbaa waresɛefoɔ ɛkwan nie: Ɔdidi, ɔpepa nʼano na ɔka sɛ, ‘Menyɛɛ mfomsoɔ biara.’

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: “Nneɛma mmiɛnsa na ɛma asase woso, ɛnan na asase ɛntumi nnyina ano:

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: akoa a wabɛyɛ ɔhene, ɔkwasea a wadidi amee,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: ɔbaa a wɔmmpɛ no na wawareɛ, afenaa a ɔtu nʼawurakwaa tena nʼanan mu.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: “Nneɛma nketenkete ɛnan na ɛwɔ asase so, nanso wɔyɛ anyansafoɔ ankasa:

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Ntɛtea yɛ abɔdeɛ nketewa a wɔnni ahoɔden, nanso wɔboaboa wɔn aduane ano ahuhuro berɛ mu;

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Nkukuban—yɛ abɔdeɛ a wɔnni ahoɔden, nanso wɔyɛ wɔn afie wɔ abotan mu,

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: ntutummɛ nni ɔhene, nanso wɔsa so akuakuo, kɔ wɔn anim;

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: wɔtumi de nsa kyere ɔkoterɛ, nanso wɔhunu no aberempɔn ahemfie.

english_verse: Three or four creatures really strut around:
translation_verse: “Nneɛma mmiɛnsa na wɔwɔ aberempɔn nanteɛ, ɛnan na wɔkeka wɔn ho te sɛ aberempɔn:

english_verse: Those fearless lions who rule the jungle,
translation_verse: gyata, mmoadoma ɔhene a, biribiara mmɔ no hu;

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: akokɔnini a ɔretutu taataa, ɔpapo, ne ɔhene a nʼasraafoɔ atwa ne ho ahyia.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: “Sɛ woayɛ ɔkwasea ama wo ho so, anaa woadwene bɔne a, ma wʼani nwu na mua wʼano!

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ wɔka nufosuo nu mu a sradeɛ firi mu ba na wɔkyinkyim hwene a ɛtu mogya no, saa ara na abufuo de akasakasa ba.”

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Ɔhene Lemuel nsɛm a ɛyɛ nkɔmhyɛ a ne maame kyerɛɛ no:

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Ao me babarima, me yafunu ba, Ao mebɔhyɛ ba,

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: nsɛe wʼahoɔden wɔ mmaa ho, wɔn a wɔgu ahemfo asu no.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Lemuel, nsã nyɛ mma ahemfo; asanom nyɛ mma ahemfo, ɛnsɛ sɛ sodifoɔ pere nsaden ho;

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Fa nsaden ma wɔn a wɔresɛe, na fa nsã ma wɔn a wɔwɔ amanehunu mu;

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Momma wɔnnom, na wɔn werɛ mfiri wɔn hia na wɔnnkae wɔn awerɛhoɔ bio.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: Kasa ma wɔn a wɔntumi nkasa mma wɔn ho, kasa ma mmɔborɔfoɔ yiedie.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Kasa na bu atɛntenenee; kasa ma ahiafoɔ ne onnibie yiedie. Awieeɛ: Ɔyere A Ɔsom Bo

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Ɔyere pa, hwan na ɔbɛnya? Ɔsom bo pa ara sene nhwene pa.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Ne kunu wɔ ne mu ahotosoɔ pa ara na biribiara a ɛwɔ boɔ nhia no.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Ɔde deɛ ɛyɛ brɛ no, na ɛnyɛ ɔhaw, ne nkwa nna nyinaa mu.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Ɔhwehwɛ odwannwi ne asaawa na ɔde ne nsa nwono wɔ fɛ so.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛ adwadifoɔ ahyɛn, ɔde ne nnuane firi akyirikyiri ba.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Adeɛ nnya nkyeeɛ no na wasɔre; ɔsiesie aduane ma nʼabusuafoɔ na ɔkyekyɛ nnwuma ma ne mmaawa.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Ɔdwene afuo ho, na ɔtɔ; ɔfiri deɛ ɔnya mu yɛ bobefuo.

english_verse: and she always works hard.
translation_verse: Ɔde nsi yɛ nʼadwuma; nʼabasa mu wɔ ahoɔden ma nʼadwuma.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Ɔhwɛ sɛ nʼadwadie ho wɔ mfasoɔ, na ne kanea ɛnnum anadwo.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Ɔgo ne nsam ma ahiafoɔ na ne nsa so onibie so.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Sɛ sukyerɛmma tɔ a ne yam nhyehye no wɔ ne fiefoɔ ho; ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nyinaa wɔ aduradeɛ a wɔde ko awɔ.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ ne mpasotam; na ɔfira nwera ne serekye ntoma.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Ne kunu wɔ animuonyam wɔ kuropɔn ɛpono ano, baabi a ɔne asase no so mpanimfoɔ tena.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Ɔpempam nwera ntadeɛ tontɔn, na ɔtu abɔwomu ma adwadifoɔ.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ ahoɔden ne animuonyam; na ɔnsuro nna a ɛwɔ nʼanim.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Ɔkasa nyansa mu, na nokorɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ ne tɛkrɛma so.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Ɔhwɛ ne fidua mu nnwuma so na ɔnnyegye aniha so.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Ne mma sɔre a wɔfrɛ no nhyira; ne kunu nso saa ara, na ɔkamfo no sɛ,

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Mmaa pii yɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ edin, na wo deɛ, wosene wɔn nyinaa.”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Ɔbaa kɔnɔfoɔ yɛ nnaadaa, na ahoɔfɛ twam ntɛm so; nanso ɔbaa a ɔsuro Awurade no fata nkamfoɔ.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Fa abasobɔdeɛ a wanya no ma no, na wɔnkamfo ne nnwuma wɔ kuropɔn ɛpono ano.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Yeinom ne nsɛm a Ɔsɛnkafoɔ, ɔhene Dawid babarima a ɔyɛ ɔhene wɔ Yerusalem seɛ:

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: “Ahuhudeɛ! Ahuhudeɛ!” Ɔsɛnkafoɔ no na ɔseɛ. “Ahuhudeɛ mu ahuhudeɛ Biribiara yɛ ahuhudeɛ.”

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Ɛdeɛn na onipa nya firi nʼadwumayɛ nyinaa mu? Deɛn na ɔnya firi deɛ enti ɔkum ne ho yɛ no awia so no?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ba na ɛkɔ, nanso asase tim hɔ daa.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Owia pue na owia kɔtɔ, na ɛyɛ ntɛm kɔ deɛ ɛpue firiiɛ hɔ.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Mframa bɔ kɔ anafoɔ fam na ɛdane hwɛ atifi fam; ɛkyinkyini kɔ baabiara na ɛsane bɔ fa ne kwan so.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Nsubɔntene nyinaa tene kɔgu ɛpo mu, nanso ɛpo nyɛ ma da. Baabi a nsubɔntene no firie no ɛhɔ na wɔsane kɔ bio.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Biribiara yɛ ɔbrɛ a ɛboro deɛ obi bɛka soɔ. Ani nhwɛ adeɛ nwie da na aso nso ntie nsɛm mma ɛmmu so da.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before; nothing is new, nothing under the sun.
translation_verse: Deɛ aba no bɛba bio, deɛ wɔayɛ no, wɔbɛyɛ bio; adeɛ foforɔ biara nni owia yi ase.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Biribi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛtumi aka wɔ ho sɛ: “Hwɛ! Yei yɛ ade foforɔ” anaa? Ɛwɔ hɔ dada firi tete nteredee; ɛwɔ hɔ ansa na wɔwoo yɛn.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Wɔnnkae tetefoɔ no, na wɔn a wɔnnya nnwoo wɔn no nso wɔn a wɔbɛdi wɔn akyi no renkae wɔn. Nimdeɛ Yɛ Ahuhudeɛ

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Me, Ɔsɛnkafoɔ, na meyɛ Israelhene wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: Metuu me ho sii hɔ sɛ mede nimdeɛ bɛsua ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ biribiara a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase ho. Adesoa duruduru bɛn na Onyankopɔn de ato adasamma soɔ yi!

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Mahunu biribiara a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase; ne nyinaa nka hwee, ɛte sɛ deɛ obi de mmirika taa mframa.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Deɛ akyea no, wɔntumi ntene; na deɛ ɛnni hɔ no, wɔntumi nkan.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Mekaa wɔ me ho sɛ, “Hwɛ, manyini na manya nimdeɛ bebree asene obiara a watena Yerusalem ahennwa so ansa na merebɛdi adeɛ. Manya nhunumu ne nimdeɛ mu osuahunu.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Afei, meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ mɛhwehwɛ na mate nimdeɛ ase, ɛne abɔdamsɛm ne nkwaseasɛm. Nanso mehunuu sɛ yei nso te sɛ deɛ obi di mmirika taa mframa.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Nimdeɛ bebree de awerɛhoɔ na ɛba; nyansa bebree de ahohiahia bebree ba.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: Mekaa mʼakomam sɛ, “Afei bra, mede anigyeɛ bɛsɔ wo ahwɛ na yɛahunu deɛ ɛyɛ.” Nanso, ankɔsi hwee.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Mekaa sɛ, “Ɔsereɛ yɛ nkwaseadeɛ. Na ɛdeɛn na anigyeɛ tumi yɛ?”

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Mepɛɛ sɛ mehunu deɛ ɛyɛ pa ara ma yɛn wɔ ɛberɛ tiawa a yɛwɔ wɔ asase yi so. Enti meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ mede nsã bɛsɛpɛ me ho na mahwehwɛ, ahunu nkwaseasɛm asekyerɛ, a mʼankasa deɛ, mennyɛ ɔkwasea.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Mede me nsa hyɛɛ nnwuma akɛseɛ ase; mesisii adan yɛɛ bobe nturo.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: Meyɛɛ nturo ne ahomegyebea na meduaduaa nnuaba ahodoɔ bebree wɔ mu.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: Mesisii nsukoraeɛ a mɛtwe nsuo afiri mu, de agugu nnua a ɛrenyini no so.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Metɔɔ nkoa ne mfenaa, na menyaa ebinom nso a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ me fie. Afei nso menyaa anantwie ne nnwan bebree sene obiara a wadi mʼanim wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: Mepɛɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ, gyegyee ahemfo ne amantam no ademudeɛ kaa ho. Mefaa mmarima ne mmaa nnwomtofoɔ, pɛɛ mmaa atenaeɛ nso; deɛ ɛyɛ ɔbarima akoma anigyedeɛ biara.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Megyee edin sene obiara a wadi mʼanim wɔ Yerusalem. Yeinom nyinaa mu no, me nimdeɛ kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma.

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: Deɛ mʼani hwehwɛeɛ biara, mamfa ankame no; mansi mʼakoma anigyeɛ ho ɛkwan. Mʼakoma ani gyee me nnwuma nyinaa ho, na yei yɛ mʼadwumayɛ so akatua.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Nanso sɛ mehwɛ deɛ me nsa ayɛ nyinaa ne deɛ mabrɛ anya a, ne nyinaa nka hwee, ɛte sɛ deɛ wɔtu mmirika taa mframa. Mannya mfasoɔ biara wɔ owia yi ase. Nimdeɛ Ne Nkwaseadeɛ Yɛ Ade Huhuo

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Mede mʼadwene kɔɔ nimdeɛ, abɔdamsɛm ne nkwaseasɛm so. Ɛdeɛn bio na deɛ wɔadi ɔhene adeɛ bɛtumi ayɛ asene deɛ wɔayɛ dada no?

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Mehunuu sɛ, nimdeɛ yɛ sene nkwaseasɛm, sɛdeɛ hann yɛ sene esum no.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Onyansafoɔ ani wɔ ne tirim, na ɔkwasea deɛ, ɔnante esum mu; nanso mehunuu sɛ wɔn nyinaa hyɛberɛ yɛ pɛ.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Afei mesusuu mʼakomam sɛ, “Ɔkwasea hyɛberɛ bɛto me nso. Enti sɛ mehunu nyansa a, mfasoɔ bɛn na menya?” Mekaa wɔ mʼakomam sɛ, “Yei nso nka hwee.”

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ɛno enti asetena fonoo me, na adwuma a yɛyɛ wɔ owia yi ase no haa me. Ne nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ, te sɛ deɛ wɔtu mmirika taa mframa.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Mekyirii deɛ mayɛ adwuma apɛ nyinaa wɔ owia yi ase, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ megya hɔ ma deɛ ɔbɛdi mʼadeɛ.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Na hwan na ɔnim sɛ onipa ko no bɛyɛ onyansafoɔ anaa ɔkwasea? Nanso deɛ mabiri me mogya ani apɛ wɔ owia yi ase nyinaa bɛkɔ ne nsam. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Enti mepaa aba wɔ owia yi ase adwumaden ho.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Na onipa bɛfiri ne nimdeɛ, nyansa ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ mu ayɛ nʼasɛdeɛ, na afei ɛsɛ sɛ ogya nʼadwumayɛ so aba ma obi a ɔnyɛɛ adwuma biara. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ, na ɛha adwene.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Ɛdeɛn na onipa nya firi ne brɛ ne dadwene a ɔde yɛ adwuma wɔ owia yi ase mu?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ne nkwa nna nyinaa, nʼadwumayɛ yɛ ɔyea ne ɔhaw; anadwo mpo nʼadwene yɛ adwuma. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Biribiara nsene sɛ onipa bɛdidi na wanom na wanya ahomeka wɔ adwumayɛ mu. Yei nso mehunuu sɛ ɛfiri Onyankopɔn,

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno a, anka hwan na ɔbɛtumi adidi anaasɛ ɔbɛnya ahomeka?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Onipa a ɔsɔ Onyankopɔn ani no, ɔma no nimdeɛ, nyansa ne anigyeɛ, nanso omumuyɛfoɔ deɛ, ɔma ɔboaboa ahonyadeɛ ano ma deɛ ɔsɔ Onyankopɔn ani. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔde mmirikatuo taa mframa.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Biribiara wɔ ne berɛ, na dwumadie biara a ɛwɔ ɔsoro ase wɔ ne berɛ.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Awoɔ wɔ ne berɛ, na owuo wɔ ne berɛ, ogu wɔ ne berɛ, na otwa nso wɔ ne berɛ,

english_verse: There is a time for finding and losing, keeping and giving,
translation_verse: adehwehwɛ wɔ ne berɛ, na adehwereɛ wɔ ne berɛ, adekora wɔ ne berɛ, na adetoguo wɔ ne berɛ,

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: ɔdɔ wɔ ne berɛ, na ɔtan wɔ ne berɛ, ɔko wɔ ne berɛ, na asomdwoeɛ wɔ ne berɛ.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Mfasoɔ bɛn na odwumayɛfoɔ nya firi nʼadwumaden mu?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Mahunu adesoa a Onyankopɔn de ato nnipa so.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Wayɛ biribiara fɛfɛ wɔ ne berɛ mu. Ɔde nkwa a ɛnsa da ahyɛ nnipa akoma mu, nanso wɔntumi nte deɛ Onyankopɔn ayɛ firi ahyɛaseɛ kɔsi awieeɛ no ase.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Menim sɛ biribiara nni hɔ a ɛyɛ ma nnipa kyɛn sɛ wɔbɛgye wɔn ani na wayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ ɛberɛ a wɔte ase.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Sɛ obiara bɛdidi na wanom na wanya anigyeɛ wɔ ne dwumadie nyinaa mu, yei ne Onyankopɔn akyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: Menim sɛ biribiara a Onyankopɔn yɛ no bɛtena hɔ daa, wɔrentumi mfa biribi nka ho na wɔrentumi nyi biribi mfiri mu. Onyankopɔn yɛ yei sɛdeɛ nnipa de anidie bɛma no.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Biribiara a ɛwɔ hɔ ɛnnɛ no, aba pɛn, na deɛ ɛbɛba no nso aba dada; na Onyankopɔn bɛfrɛ deɛ asi dada no ama akontabuo.

english_verse: Everywhere on earth I saw violence and injustice instead of fairness and justice.
translation_verse: Na mehunuu biribi foforɔ wɔ owia yi ase sɛ: Amumuyɛsɛm wɔ deɛ atemmuo wɔ, atɛnteneneebea no, amumuyɛsɛm wɔ hɔ.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Medwenee wɔ mʼakomam sɛ, “Onyankopɔn bɛbu teneneefoɔ ne amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa atɛn, ɛfiri sɛ adwuma biara bɛnya ne berɛ, adeyɛ biara ne ne berɛ.”

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Afei medwenee sɛ, “Nnipa deɛ, Onyankopɔn sɔ wɔn hwɛ ma wɔhunu sɛ wɔte sɛ mmoa.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Onipa hyɛberɛ te sɛ mmoa deɛ, na ɛda hɔ ma wɔn nyinaa. Sɛdeɛ ɔbaako wuo no, saa ara na ɔfoforɔ nso wuo. Wɔn nyinaa wɔ ahomeɛ baako; onipa nni biribi a ɔde kyɛn aboa. Biribiara yɛ ahuhudeɛ.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Wɔn nyinaa kɔ faako; wɔn nyinaa firi dɔteɛ mu na wɔsane kɔ dɔteɛ mu.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Hwan na ɔnim sɛ onipa honhom foro soro, na aboa deɛ siane kɔ asase mu anaa?”

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: Enti mehunuu sɛ biribiara nni hɔ a ɛyɛ ma onipa kyɛn sɛ nʼani bɛka nʼadwuma ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno ne ne kyɛfa. Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi de no asane aba sɛ ɔmmɛhwɛ deɛ ɛbɛsi ne wuo nʼakyi?

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Bio, mehwɛ mehunuu nhyɛsoɔ a ɛrekɔ so wɔ owia yi ase: Mehunuu wɔn a wɔredi wɔn nya no nisuo na wɔnni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ biara; tumi no wɔ wɔn nhyɛsofoɔ no nsam na wɔnni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ biara.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Na mekaa sɛ: Awufoɔ a wɔawuwu dada no ani gye sene ateasefoɔ; wɔn a wɔda so wɔ nkwa mu no.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Na deɛ ɔyɛ sene baanu yi ne deɛ ɔnnya mmaeɛ, deɛ ɔnnya nhunuu bɔne a wɔyɛ wɔ owia yi ase.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Na mehunuu sɛ adwumayɛ mu ɔbrɛ ne deɛ onipa tumi yɛ nyinaa nnyinasoɔ ne sɛ, nʼani bere ne yɔnko. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ, mmirika a wɔtu taa mframa.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ɔkwasea bobɔ ne nsa gu ne ho na ɔsɛe ne ho.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nsa ma baako a asomdwoeɛ wɔ mu yɛ sene nsa ma mmienu a ɔbrɛ bata ho. Ɛte sɛ deɛ wotaa mframa.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Afei nso mehunuu biribi a ɛnka hwee wɔ owia yi ase:

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Na ɔbarima bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ ankonam; ɔnni ɔbabarima anaa onuabarima. Nʼadwumaden amma nʼawieeɛ da, nanso nʼani ansɔ nʼahonya. Ɔbisaa ne ho sɛ, “Na hwan na merebrɛ ama no, na adɛn enti na mede anigyeɛ kame me kra?” Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ, ɛyɛ ɔhaw kwa.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Baanu yɛ sene ɔbaakofoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnya wɔn adwumayɛ so mfasoɔ a ɛsɔ ani:

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbaako hwe ase a ne yɔnko bɛtumi aboa no. Nanso onipa a ɔhwe ase a ɔnni ɔboafoɔ no yɛ mmɔbɔ.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Bio, sɛ baanu da bɔ mu a, wɔka wɔn ho hye. Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔkɔntenkorɔ aka ne ho hye?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Ɔbaakofoɔ deɛ, wɔbɛtumi aka no ahyɛ nanso baanu tumi pere wɔn ti. Homa a wɔawɔ no mmɛsa no, wɔntumi ntete mu ntɛm. Ɛkankɔ Yɛ Adehunu

english_verse: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.
translation_verse: Ɔbabunu nyansafoɔ a ɔdi hia yɛ sene ɔhene akɔkoraa a ɔyɛ kwasea na ɔntie kɔkɔbɔ bio.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Ebia na ɔbabunu no firi nneduafie na ɔbɛdii adeɛ anaasɛ wɔwoo no too ohia mu wɔ adehyeɛ abusua mu.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Mehunuu sɛ wɔn a wɔtenaa ase na wɔnantee owia yi ase nyinaa dii ɔbabunu no akyi, deɛ ɔdii ɔhene no adeɛ no.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nnipa dɔm a wɔntumi nkane wɔn dii nʼakyi. Nanso nkyirimma no ani annye ne ho. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ, ɛte sɛ wotaa mframa.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Sɛ wokɔ Onyankopɔn fie a, hwɛ wʼanammɔntuo yie. Bɛn no na tie no sene sɛ wobɛbɔ nkwaseafoɔ afɔdeɛ, wɔn a wɔnnim mfomsoɔ a wɔyɛ no.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Mpɛ ntɛm nkasa, mma wʼakoma ho mpere no sɛ ɔbɛka asɛm bi wɔ Onyankopɔn anim. Onyankopɔn te ɔsoro na wo deɛ, wo wɔ asase so, enti ma wo nsɛm nyɛ kakraa bi.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Sɛdeɛ adaeɛsoɔ firi adwendwene bebree mu ba no, saa ara na ɔkwasea kasa tentene teɛ.

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: Sɛ wohyɛ Onyankopɔn bɔ a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase wɔ ho. Ɔnni anigyeɛ wɔ nkwaseafoɔ mu; enti di wo bɔhyɛ so.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Sɛ woanhyɛ bɔ koraa a, ɛyɛ sene sɛ wobɛhyɛ bɔ na wonni so.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Mma wʼano mfa wo nkɔ bɔne mu. Nyi wʼano nkyerɛ asɔredan mu ɔsomfoɔ sɛ, “Me bɔhyɛ no yɛ mfomsoɔ.” Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn bo fu deɛ woka na ɔsɛe wo nsa ano adwuma?

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Adaeɛso ne nsɛm keka bebree nka hwee. Enti suro Onyankopɔn. Ahonya Yɛ Ahuhudeɛ

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Sɛ wohunu ohiani a wɔhyɛ ne so wɔ ɔmansin bi mu, na atɛntenenee ne ahofadie abɔ no a, mma yeinom nyɛ wo nwanwa ɛfiri sɛ, deɛ ɔso sene no hwɛ ne so, na deɛ ɔso sene wɔn baanu no nso hwɛ wɔn so.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Asase no so siadeɛ wɔ ɛso nnipa nyinaa, na ɔhene no ankasa na ɔnya mfuo no so mfasodeɛ.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Deɛ nʼani bere sika no nnya deɛ ɛdɔɔso da; na deɛ ɔpɛ ahonyadeɛ dodoɔ no ani nsɔ deɛ ɔnya. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Adetɔndeɛ bu so a, saa ara na atɔfoɔ no nso dɔɔso. Na mfasoɔ bɛn na deɛ ɛwɔ noɔ no nya sene sɛ ɔde nʼani bɛhwɛ?

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Ɔpaani da ma nʼani kum, sɛ wadidi amee anaasɛ wammee, nanso ɔdefoɔ ahonya dodoɔ enti ɔntumi nna.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Ɔhaw kɛseɛ bi a mahunu no wɔ owia yi ase nie: sɛ wɔboaboa ahonyadeɛ ano de ha ne wura,

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: anaasɛ ɔbɛhwere ahonyadeɛ wɔ amanehunu mu a enti sɛ ɔnya ɔbabarima bi a hwee nni hɔ a wɔde bɛgya no.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Adagya na onipa de firi ne maame yafunu mu baeɛ, na sɛdeɛ ɔbaeɛ no, saa ara na ɔbɛkorɔ. Ɔmmfa nʼadwumayɛ so mfasodeɛ biara a ɔbɛtumi akuta wɔ ne nsa mu nkɔ.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Yei nso yɛ ɔhaw kɛseɛ: Sɛdeɛ onipa ba no, saa ara na ɔkorɔ, na mfasoɔ bɛn na ɔnya wɔ ɛberɛ a ɔyɛ adwuma ma mframa?

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: Ne nna nyinaa mu no, ɔdidi a, nʼanom nyɛ no dɛ ɛfiri sɛ abamubuo, ateeteeɛ ne abufuo wɔ no so.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Afei mehunuu sɛ ɛyɛ ma onipa sɛ ɔbɛdidi na wanom na wama nʼani agye nʼadwumaden ho wɔ owia yi ase, wɔ mmerɛ kakra a Onyankopɔn de ama no yi mu, ɛfiri sɛ yei ne ne kyɛfa.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Deɛ ɛka ho ne sɛ, sɛ Onyankopɔn ma onipa bi ahonyadeɛ ne adenya, na ɔnya ahotɔ, de anigyeɛ yɛ nʼadwuma, na ɔhunu sɛ ne kyɛfa ne no a, ɔnnkae sɛ ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn akyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Ɔnntaa ntena ase nnwene ne nkwa nna ho, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn de akoma mu anigyeɛ ama no.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Mahunu bɔne foforɔ bi wɔ owia yi ase a ɛhyɛ nnipa so yie:

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Onyankopɔn ma onipa ahonyadeɛ, adenya ne animuonyam sɛdeɛ biribiara a nʼakoma pɛ no ɛmmɔ no, nanso Onyankopɔn amma no kwan sɛ ɔmfa nnye nʼani, na ɔhɔhoɔ mmom na ɔde gye nʼani. Yei yɛ ahuhudeɛ, ɔhaw a ɛyɛ yea.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Onipa bɛtumi anya mma ɔha na wanyini akyɛre; nanso ne mfeɛ dodoɔ yi akyi no, nʼahonya no amma nʼani annye, na ne sie nso anyɛ fɛ a, ɔpɔn ba ho wɔ mfasoɔ sene no.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: Ɛwom sɛ wanhunu owia na ɔnnim hwee deɛ, nanso ɔbɛnya ahomegyeɛ bebree sene deɛ saa ɔbarima no bɛnya.

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: Mpo sɛ ɔtena ase mfeɛ apem mmɔho na wammfa nʼahonyadeɛ annye nʼani a, wɔn nyinaa nkɔ faako anaa?

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Onipa brɛ nyinaa yɛ nʼano ntia, nanso nʼakɔnnɔdeɛ mmee no da.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Na ɛdeɛn na onyansafoɔ wɔ de sene ɔkwasea? Sɛ ohiani yɛ nʼakwan yie wɔ afoforɔ anim a mfasoɔ bɛn na ɔbɛnya?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Deɛ aniwa hunu no yɛ sene deɛ akɔnnɔ kyini hwehwɛ. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ. Ɛte sɛ wotaa mframa.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
